<3.1>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahmākṣarātītāya cakriṇe |
pareśāya dhvajaśūladhanuścihnāya śārṅgiṇe || 1 ||
sarvakāntāya kāntāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ |
muktabandhāya hṛdyāya namaḥ sarvāvatāriṇe || 2 ||
yasmāt sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ yena puṣṭiṃ prayāti ca |
yatra sthitaṃ bhavedante tasmai kāntāya te namaḥ || 3 ||
yasmāt sarve hyavatārāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyā bhavantyapi |
kālo māyā yadaṃśāśca tasmai kāntāya te namaḥ || 4 ||
yāha vai sukhadālakṣmīḥ viśveśvarasutā tava |
priyā bhūtvābhavaṃ nārāyaṇīśrīste namo namaḥ || 5 ||
anantāḥ kanyakā jātā nārāyaṇyo hareḥ priyāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namo namaḥ || 6 ||
lakṣmīkāntāya kāntāya rādhākāntāya te namaḥ |
māṇikyāvāhine ramāpataye te namo namaḥ || 7 ||
śrīśāyate padmāvatīpataye ca namo namaḥ |
brahmapriyāśanādyānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ || 8 ||
ṣaṣṭhī yā manasā devī taddhavāya ca te namaḥ |
dīpāvalīnāṃ pataye talājāpataye namaḥ || 9 ||
kāmadhenupragopāyārjantīnāṃ pataye namaḥ |
krodhaneśāya ca dharāputrīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 3.1.1 0||
sūcīkāntāya ca vanadevījeśāya te namaḥ |
dāmanīpataye kaṃkatālikeśāya te namaḥ || 11 ||
pitṛkanyāprakāntāya janapitṛsuteśine |
pitṛdāsīśvarāyāpi bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 12||
rāsātalīnāṃ kāntāya vāsantikeśa te namaḥ |
sālamālīyanārīṇāmīśvarāya ca te namaḥ || 13||
svastikīnāgakanyānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ |
nāginīnāṃ ca pataye parameśāya te namaḥ || 14||
śāvadīnoprakāntāya pareśāya ca te namaḥ |
aindrajālikakāntānāṃ pataye te namo namaḥ || 15||
vidyānāthāya ca sarasvatīśāya ca te namaḥ |
lākṣmaṇīśāya devāya nāḍikeśāya te namaḥ || 16||
gāndharvīṇāṃ ca pataye jummasemlīśa te namaḥ |
sāntapanīvarāyāpi sauratīpataye namaḥ || 17||
mahābāleśvarīśāya cailabīleśa te namaḥ |
dākṣajāvaṃgarīśāya cauṣṇīśāya ca te namaḥ || 1 8||
prācīnīnāṃ pataye te piśaṃgīpataye namaḥ |
sāntāṇarīśvara kṛṣṇa śaibīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || 19||
thārkūṭasthīpramadeśa vīrajārīśa te namaḥ |
śāktyakṣīpramadānātha piśācīśvara te namaḥ ||3.1.20||
kālimāśīśvara kṛṣṇa dīnabandho ca te namaḥ |
auralakaitavīśāya krāthakīpataye namaḥ ||21||
pṛthuputrīsvāmine te coṣṭrālīpataye namaḥ |
hāṃkārīsvāmine jayakāṣṭhajeśāya te namaḥ ||22||
tīrāṇīpataye nātha cālvīnārīśa te namaḥ |
jīnavarddhisuteśāyānāthānāthāya te namaḥ ||23||
prakīrṇapramadeśāya parameśāya te namaḥ |
ālpakaitavīkāntāya pārīśānīśa te namaḥ ||24|||
indurāyasuteśāya mudrāṇḍīpataye namaḥ |
gaṇḍabhūpasuteśāya līnorṇāpataye namaḥ ||25||
bārhacchārīsvāmine te bālalīnīśa te namaḥ |
vārasiṃhīsvāmine te rāyagāmīśa te namaḥ ||26||
phainatāntavīkāntāya stokahomīśa te namaḥ |
kāṣṭhayānīsvāmine te kolakīpataye namaḥ || 27||
dainamānīsvāmine te mama kāntāya te namaḥ |
pareśāya namo rāyakinnaṭīpataye namaḥ ||28||
rāyakoṭīsvarīśāya namaste paramātmane |
rāyaraṇajitputrīśa namaste haraye namaḥ || 29||
rāyavākakṣikeśāya rāyamārīśakeśine |
rāyabāleśvarīśāya rāyalambārikeśine ||3.1.3 0 ||
namaste rāyanavārikeśa śrīparamātmane |
rāyahūṇḍeśikeśāya rāyakūpeśikeśine ||3 1 ||
kālīmaṇḍīsvāmine te vanajeleśikeśine |
pārāvārapibīśāya koṭiśeśāya te namaḥ ||3 2||
satīśīśāya devāya tretākarkaśikeśine |
āṇḍajarāsvāmine te bālyarājasīsvāmine ||33||
rāyasomanīsvāmine te sarveśāya namo namaḥ |
urugavākṣikeśāya parāṅvratanikeśine ||34||
rāyasvastrīśa te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho namaḥ |
aiśānapānīśa kānta rājārāyīśa te namaḥ ||35||
maṃgalādiprakāntāya cājanābhīśvarāya ca |
namaḥ kauberikeśāya māhendrīpataye namaḥ ||36 ||
yamīnāṃ svāmine kṛṣṇa vāyavīśāya te namaḥ |
vaiśvakarmīsvāmine te vārkṣīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 37||
raudrīṇāṃ pataye vahniputrīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ |
śrāvaṇīnāṃ ca pataye khānijīśāya te namaḥ ||38||
sāṃvatsarīsvāmine te gopīnāṃ pataye namaḥ |
prācīnīnāṃ svāmine te piśaṃgīsvāmine namaḥ || 39||
rāśiyānīśvara romāyanīśvara ca te namaḥ |
pāraśīpataye kṛṣṇa dhīvarīpataye namaḥ ||3.1.40||
kinnarīpataye kṛṣṇāmarīṇāṃ pataye namaḥ |
gaurīṇāṃ pataye parīpataye te namo namaḥ ||41 ||
ābriktīsvāmine hāritīśāya te namo namaḥ |
pātālīpataye svargīpataye te namo namaḥ ||42||
apsarasāṃ dineśāya brahmasaro’dhiśāsine |
gāndharvīṇāṃ pataye te kuśaleśāya te namaḥ ||43 ||
vidyanmaṇisvāmine te bhaumīnāṃ pataye namaḥ |
dānavīnāṃ pataye te śaktīnāṃ pataye namaḥ ||44||
kāśikākanyākānātha dhenupālīśa te namaḥ |
kāntākānteśa sarveśa mama prāṇeśa te namaḥ ||45||
namaḥ śrīkaṃbharāputra santuṣṭānuja te namaḥ |
tvayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||46||
śrīkṛṣṇāyaviṣṇavesvāmine matpataye namaḥ |
lakṣmīśeśastvamevarṣisattamastvaṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||47||
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ jāṭharaśca tṛptidastvaṃ pareśvara |
prāpya tvāṃ tvarbudādyāśca nāryo muktiṃ gatāstviha ||48||
muktāśca muktimāpannā narā jātāḥ parārdhagāḥ |
tvāṃ bhajitvā svaḥ prayānti janaṃ satyaṃ prayānti ca ||49||
tvāṃ bhajitvā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājakṣmāṃ prayānti ca |
tvāṃ bhajitvāmṛtalokaṃ golokaṃ ca prayānti vai |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma tvāṃ bhajitvā prayānti hi ||3.1.50||
bhavatā bhagavan sarvaṃ samādhau darśitaṃ hi naḥ |
me tadārabhya jijñāsā vartate kālagocarā ||51||
ātyantike laye muktamaṇḍaleṣu virājase |
prākṛte punarārabdhe sarge kālena nodite ||52||
pradhānapuruṣe jāte mahāviṣṇau tathodgate |
vairāje ca tato jāte tathā jāte ca vedhasi ||53 ||
idānīṃpariparyantaṃ kālaḥ kiyān gato vada |
jñātavyaṃ cāpyadhikaṃ ced vidyeta vada me hare ||54||
yadyahaṃ jñānapātraṃ ced vada me prāṇarakṣaka |
pṛthvyāmidānīṃ kālo’pi kiyānastīti me vada ||55||
puruṣottama evāsi sarvajñaḥ sākṣagocaraḥ |
tvāṃ vinānyo na vai śakto vaktaṃ bhavennarāyaṇa ||56||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kālasaṃkhyānamādarāt |
vaktumaśakyamanyena jñātuṃ cāśakyamityapi ||57||
yadā nāsīnmahāmāyā sṛṣṭirūpā guṇatrayā |
līnā madicchārūpā sā yadāsīdakṣare pade ||58||
yadā nāsīnmahākālaḥ puruṣastatprayojanaḥ |
līnaścāsīnmadaiśvaryarūpo muktaḥ sa cākṣare ||59||
tadākṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma mamaivāsīnna cetarat |
brahmasṛṣṭiḥ kevalā sā naiśvarī jīvanī kutaḥ ||3.1.60||
mahāpralaya evāsau bodhyastvayā narāyaṇi |
mayā cekṣā kṛtā hyeko bahu syāṃ māyayānvitaḥ ||6 1 ||
tadā tvicchāsvarūpā sā māyā prakāśamāgatā |
divyā muktānikā śaktirmama sā tu guṇātmikā ||62||
kālākhyaḥ puruṣaścāpi mayā prakāśitastataḥ |
mamaiśvaryasvarūpaḥ sa mukto tayānvayaṃ gataḥ ||63||
yugalaṃ tattu prakṛtipuruṣau madapatyakau |
jātau tābhyāṃ mayā tvājñā dattā sṛṣṭyarthameva ha ||64||
tābhyāṃ ca jātamātrābhyāṃ sṛṣṭyāraṃbhaḥ kṛtaḥ prage |
ekaṃ suyugalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam ||65||
tena sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā mahāviṣṇukoṭyarbudātmikā |
pradhānapuruṣaḥ so’yaṃ sāyaṃ ca vyaśanattataḥ ||66||
rātryante ca prage kālaprakṛtibhyāṃ punarnavam |
yugalaṃ sṛṣṭamevānyat pradhānapuruṣātmakam ||67||
sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca sāyaṃ tadvinaṣṭaṃ punareva ha |
divaso’yaṃ mahākālakalpaḥ saṃprocyate’kṣare ||68||
sahasraṃ tu mahākālakalpānāṃ varṣamekakam |
prakṛteścāpi kālasya vidyate tatra sarvathā ||69||
etādṛśāni varṣāṇi pañcāśad vigatāni vai |
prakṛtipuruṣasyaivaikapañcāśattu vatsaram ||3.1.70||
vartate’dyādyadivasaṃ tāvatyaḥ sṛṣṭayo gatāḥ |
te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi pradhānapuruṣā mṛtāḥ ||71 ||
ekapañcāśatsahasrādyaḥ pradhānapuruṣo’sti vai |
śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam ||72||
ayaṃ pradhānapuruṣaḥ prātareva navaṃ navam |
mahāviṣṇuṃ janayati vairājīsṛṣṭikārakam ||73||
mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vai sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake |
evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ pradhānakṛt| ||74||
pradhānapuruṣasyāsya vai pañcāśatsamā gatāḥ |
tat pañcāśatsahasrāṇi te mahāviṣṇavo mṛtāḥ ||75||
ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai |
ekapañcāśatsahasrādyo mahāviṣṇū rājate ||76||
śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam |
mahāviṣṇuścāyamatra prātareva navaṃ navam ||77||
vairājaṃ janayatyeva vaidhasīsṛṣṭikāraṇam |
vairājaśca sa vai sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake ||78||
evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ pravidyate |
mahāviṣṇormama piturgopālakṛṣṇakasya vai ||79||
mahāviṣṇoścāsya tatra vai pañcāśatsamā gatāḥ |
vai pañcāśatsahasrāṇi vairājāstatsutā mṛtāḥ ||3.1.80||
ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai |
ekapañcāśatsahasrādyo vairājo virājate ||8 1||
śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam |
vairājaścāpyayamatra prātareva navaṃ navam ||82||
brahmāṇaṃ janayatyeva viṣṇurudrasamanvitam |
sa brahmāpi sadā sāyaṃ naśyatyeva dināntake ||83||
evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ virāṭkṛtam |
asya vairājapuṃsaśca paṃcāśadvai samā gatāḥ ||84||
te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi brahmāṇastatsutā mṛtāḥ |
ekapañcāśattame’bde cādyasya divasasya vai ||85||
ekapaṃcāśatsahasrādyo vedhāśca virājate |
śṛṇu cāgre’pi kālaṃ vai nārāyaṇīśri sarjanam ||86||
vedhāścāpyayamevātra prātareva navaṃ navam |
āsvargāntaṃ sṛjatyeva surarṣimānavādikam ||87||
āsvargāntaṃ ca sāyaṃ vai nityaṃ naśyati tattathā |
evaṃ sahasradivasātmakaṃ varṣaṃ hi vaidhasam ||88||
ekaṃ kalpasahasraṃ tad brahmaṇo’bdaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
vedhaso’sya gatāścāpi tatpañcāśatpravatsarāḥ ||89||
tatpañcāśatsahasrāṇi trailokyāni mṛtāni vai |
ekapañcāśattame’bde tvādyasya divasasya vai ||3.1.90||
ekapañcāśatsahasrādyaḥ kalpo vārāhasaṃjñakaḥ |
vartate divasaḥ so’yaṃ cādyaṃ yugacatuṣṭayam ||9 1 ||
ayaṃ caturmukhaścāste brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
brahmaṇo divasaḥ kalpa iti nāmnā kṛto mayā ||92||
vairājasya tu divaso mahākalpaḥ kṛto mayā |
mahāviṣṇostu divaso mahāmahākhyakalpakaḥ ||93||
pradhānapuṃso divasaḥ kṛtaḥ prākṛtakalpakaḥ |
māyākālasya divaso mahākālākhyakalpakaḥ ||94||
tannāśe ca mahān prokto mahāpralaya eva ha |
brahmā varṣaśataṃ cāste virājo’pi tathā nijam ||95||
mahāviṣṇurnijaṃ varṣaśataṃ jīvati ceśvaraḥ |
pradhānapuruṣaścāpi nijaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā ||96 ||
prakṛtipuruṣaścāpi nijaṃ varṣaśataṃ tataḥ |
tādṛgvarṣaśataṃ mahāpralayo vai niśātmakaḥ ||97||
punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ punarmahāpralayaścaivameva ha |
kṛtaṃ tantraṃ mayā śrīnārāyaṇīśri praśāśvatam || 98||
punarmahāsṛṣṭireva mahāpralayakaḥ punaḥ |
brahmaṇo divase caike manavaśca caturdaśa ||99||
utpadyante vilīyante kā teṣāṃ gaṇanā priye |
ekaṃ kalpasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo’bdaśca yo mataḥ || 3.1.100 ||
tadabdāṣṭasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇastadyugaṃ smṛtam |
ekaṃ yugasahasraṃ tu savanaṃ brahmaṇo matam || 101 ||
lakṣaikavāraṃ trailokyanāśe brahmā vinaśyati |
lakṣaikavāraṃ cājasya nāśe virāḍ vinaśyati || 1 02||
lakṣavairājanāśe ca mahāviṣṇurvinaśyati |
mahāviṣṇulakṣanāśe pradhānapuṃvināśanam || 1 03||
pradhānapuṃlakṣanāśe prakṛtipuṃvināśanam |
ityevaṃ kālagaṇanā bodhyā tvayā narāyaṇi || 1 04||
tāsu tāsu ca sarvāsu sṛṣṭiṣvahaṃ tvayā saha |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 05||
prādurbhavāmyavatārī śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ |
avatārā hyasaṃkhyātā me tatra saṃbhavantyapi || 1 06||
ahaṃ vedmi na cānyastān sarvajño’haṃ na cetaraḥ |
vidanti nāpyavatārāḥ pūrvasṛṣṭivido hi te || 1 07||
mā sandehaṃ vidhehyatra mama dairghyaṃ durantakam |
adhikaṃ pṛccha jijñāsyaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 1 08||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nārāyaṇīśrīkṛtā puruṣottamastutiḥ sṛṣṭikālagaṇanā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

<3.2>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
vedhaso’sya harekṛṣṇa puruṣottama matpate |
dvāpañcāśadvatsarāṇāṃ nāmāni vettumeva me || 1 ||
icchā prajāyate tasmād vada śrīpuruṣottama |
manūnāṃ cāpi ca caturdaśānāṃ nāmamātrakam || 2 ||
vettumicchāmi bhagavan kalpe vārāhake tvaham |
ekapañcāśattame’bde ye kalpāścāntato gatāḥ || 3 ||
tānapi vettumicchāmi tava prākaṭyayoginaḥ |
saṃkṣepād vada me kānta yadi bhāro na vidyate || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
brahmaṇo’sya vatsarastu prathamaḥ padmavatsaraḥ |
nālakramo dvitīyaśca nālordhvagastṛtīyakaḥ || 5 ||
turyaṃ stāvanavarṣaṃ ca vyomavāṇaṃ tu pañcamam |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tapovapsaraṃ ca saptamaṃ yamavatsaram || 6 ||
niyamaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ cāpi varṣaṃ navamamāsanam |
daśamaṃ prāṇarodhākhyaṃ caikādaśaṃ pratihṛtiḥ || 7 ||
dvādaśaṃ dhāraṇaṃ varṣaṃ dhyānavarṣaṃ trayodaśam |
caturdaśaṃ tu mananaṃ pañcadaśaṃ samādhikam || 8 ||
ṣoḍaśaṃ prajñātavarṣaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitam |
aprajñātaṃ saptadaśaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ tu līnatā || 9 ||
navadaśaṃ vatsaraṃ tu sākṣātkārābhidhaṃ tataḥ |
viṃśatitamavarṣaṃ ca sṛṣṭibhānābhidhaṃ tataḥ || 3.2.10 ||
ekaviṃśatitamaṃ vai vedavatsarasaṃjñakam |
rudravatsaranāmnā ca dvāviṃśo vatsarastataḥ || 11 ||
sanātanastrayoviṃśaścaturviṃśastathārṣakaḥ |
dharmavarṣaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ṣaḍviṃśo’naṅgavatsaraḥ || 1 2||
saptaviṃśo’dharmasaṃjño’ṣṭāviṃśo’nalavatsaraḥ |
navaviṃśaṃ pitṛvarṣaṃ triṃśastu devavatsaraḥ || 13 ||
ekatriṃśaṃ mānavākhyaṃ dvātriṃśaṃ kalpapādapam |
trayastriṃśaṃ sasyasaṃjñaṃ catustriṃśaṃ tu pāśavam || 14||
pañcatriṃśaṃ yākṣavarṣaṃ ṣaḍviṃśaṃ rākṣasābhigham |
saptatriṃśaṃ cāṇḍajākhyamaṣṭātriṃśaṃ tu gharmajam || 1 5||
navatriṃśaṃ nāgavarṣaṃ catvāriṃśaṃ tu yādasam |
adhvarākhyaścaikacatvāriṃśo vai vatsarastataḥ || 16 ||
hiraṇyavatsaraṃ dvācatvāriśaṃ ca tataḥ param |
rājataṃ tricatvāriṃśaṃ kāpālakaṃ tataḥ param || 1 7||
apsarovatsaraṃ pañcacatvāriṃśaṃ tato’bhavat |
brahmasarovatsaraṃ ca svardhūnīvatsaraṃ tataḥ || 18 ||
arcimārgābhidhamaṣṭacatvāriṃśaṃ ca vatsaram |
abdhimanthaṃ tato varṣaṃ nāradākhyaṃ ca vatsaram || 19 ||
ekapañcāśattama somanāthavatsaraṃ tataḥ |
dvipañcāśattamaṃ varṣaṃ vaiṣṇavākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3.2.20 ||
gāyatrīvatsaraṃ tripañcāśattamaṃ pravartsyate |
ekapañcāśattame’yaṃ vārāho nāma kalpakaḥ || 21 ||
mayā vārāharūpeṇa kṣitirjalāt samuddhṛtā |
atra vai manavo bhūpā bhaviṣyanti caturdaśa || 22||
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvastataḥ svārociṣo manuḥ |
uttamaśca tāmasaśca raivataścākṣuṣastataḥ ||23||
vaivasvataśca sāvarṇī cāṣṭamo manureva ha |
navamo dakṣasāvarṇī brahmasāvarṇikastataḥ ||24||
tataśca dharmasāvarṇiḥ rudrasāvarṇikastataḥ |
tataśca devasāvarṇiścendrasāvarṇikastataḥ ||25||
caturdaśaite manavaścendrāścāpi caturdaśa |
divase samprajāyante rātrau tāvān layo mataḥ ||26||
kalpe kalpe bhavāmyeva pṛthivyāṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
te pañcāśatsahasrāṇi kalpāstu brahmaṇo gatāḥ || 27||
nārāyaṇi hyavatārī tāvatsaṃkhyo’bhavaṃ kṣitau |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||28||
yuge yuge tvavatārā me bhavanti yathākriyam |
teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na cāstyeva jānāmyahaṃ na cetare ||29||
tatra nāmānyanantāni bhavanti guṇakarmabhiḥ |
kintu kalpe tvekavāraṃ bhavāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 3.2.3 0||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ |
avatārī koṭibhaktabhaktānīpatirīśapaḥ ||3 1 ||
yatra kalpe samāraṃbhe yo’vatāro bhavenmama |
tena nāmnāpi ca mayā sa vai kalpaḥ prakāśyate || 32|||
tasmāt kalpābhidhānāni madvijñānakṛtāni vai |
na śakyamānupūrvyeṇa teṣāṃ vaktuṃ pravistaram ||33|||
anāditvāddhi kālasya hyasaṃkhyānācca vedhasām |
ābhūtasamplavo hyetadahorātraṃ smṛtaṃ tataḥ ||34||
trailokye yāni sattvāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca |
ābhūtebhyaḥ pralīyante tasmādābhūtasamplavaḥ ||35||
caturyugasahasrānte divase brahmaṇo gate |
suṣupsurviśvasṛṭ naijāṃ rātriṃ vai kurute tataḥ || 36||
tataḥ sa vasati rātriṃ tamasyekārṇave jale |
prātaḥ sisṛkṣayā yukto yathāpūrvaṃ karoti ca ||37||
vatsarāraṃbhadivase brahmā yadyat karoti hi |
pradhānaṃ karma tannāmnā vatsaro vāpi jāyate ||38||
tatpañcāśattame varṣe vedhasaḥ kalpakeṣvaham |
bahuvāraṃ samutpanno nārāyaṇyā tvayā samam ||3 9||
brāhmakalpe pādmakalpe vairājakalpake tathā |
śvetakalpe lohite ca kṛṣṇakalpe’bhavaṃ tathā ||3.2.40||
sanatkalpe bhavakalpe bhuvaḥ kalpe’bhavaṃ tathā |
tapaḥkalpe bhāvakalpe raṃbhakalpe ṛtau tathā ||41 ||
ṛtukalpe vahnikalpe havyavāhanake’pi ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tadābhavam ||42||
sāvitrakalpe bhuvaḥkalpe cośikakalpake |
kuśike cāpi gāndhāre ṛṣabhe ṣaṭjakalpake ||43||
mārjālīye madhyame ca vairāje kalpake’pi ca |
niṣāde prāṇake cāpi meghavāhye’bhavaṃstathā ||44||
cintake cākūtike vijñātau mānase’pi ca |
bhāve rathantare śvetalohite raktavāsasi ||45||
pīte ca sitakalpe ca viśvarūpe’bhavaṃstathā |
tadanyeṣu ca kalpeṣu yathākāryaṃ narāyaṇi ||46||
abhavaṃścābhavaṃścāpi me’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ |
kalpe kalpe’pi bahudhā śrīstvaṃ bahvī prajāyase ||47||
mama patnī yathā tvadya vivāhyā mama jāyase |
tava nāmānyanantāni te’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ ||48||
jānāmyahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nārāyaṇīśri sarvathā |
nārāyaṇi tvidaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ mamaiva tejasā ||49||
mama lakṣmyā mamaiśvayairmadguṇairmadvibhūtibhiḥ |
madaṃśairmama sāmarthyairmama sampatsamṛddhibhiḥ ||3.2.50||
pataṃge cāpi mattejaḥ pradīpe’pi ca māmakam |
vidyuti grahanakṣatratārāsu śaśisūryayoḥ ||51||
mama tejo hi sarvatra tejasvino mayā hi te |
maṇyoṣadhiṣu dyumārge svarge jane tapasyapi ||52||
maharloke satyaloke merau tejo hi māmakam |
lokāloke śaṃkare ca viṣṇau cāje virājake ||53 ||
mahāviṣṇau pradhāneśe prakṛtīśe’kṣare’pi ca |
mukteṣu cāpi sarveṣu cāvatāreṣu sarvathā ||54||
aiśvaryaguṇatejāṃsi mamaiva santi tāni vai |
mama mūrteḥ kiraṇaiste puṣṭiṃ tṛptiṃ vidanti ca ||55||
puruṣottamamūrteśca kiraṇānāṃ vicitratā |
puṣṇāti muktajātāni vibhinnatṛptidānataḥ ||56||
sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣo’haṃ caikamāno’kṣare pare |
poṣayāmi muktajanān mahānandādidānakaiḥ ||57||
mama tejāṃsi sarvāṇi mahānandamatāni vai |
śāntiśītalatātṛptisudhābhṛtāni santi ca ||58||
tadbhoktāro muktajanā muktānyaśca tvayā saha |
śāśvatānandapūrṇāste nityatṛptā bhavanti hi |||59||
romṇāṃ mūrteḥ kiraṇāni niryānti rasabhṛnti vai |
sṛṣṭitrayasyauṣadhayaḥ puṣṇanti tadrasaiḥ sadā ||3.2.60||
muktāśca tadrasaiḥ puṣṭāḥ sarvadaikapramāṇinaḥ |
eṣāṃ tejāṃsi netrābhyāṃ niryānti bhāskarāṇi vai ||61 ||
tatprabhābhiḥ prapaśyanti sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ |
dakṣanetrakiraṇebhyaḥ sūryā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ ||62||
vāmanetrakiraṇebhyaścandrā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ |
mastakasya ca paridherbhavanti stanayitnavaḥ ||63||
sṛṣṭitrayasya vai vidyutpravāhāśca bhavantyapi |
mukhamādhuryatejāṃsi nissarantyabhito hareḥ ||64||
tanmādhuryamadhubhiśca tṛpyanti muktakoṭayaḥ |
tṛptibhṛdbhirhi kiraṇaiḥ sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ ||65||
kapolābhyāṃ mama mūrterniryānti mohinīprabhāḥ |
tābhirmuktāstatheśādyā mugdhā mūrtau bhavanti vai ||66||
oṣṭhābhyāṃ cāmṛtabhṛnti niryānti kiraṇāni vai |
tadrasāmṛtapānena tṛpyanti trisṛjisthitāḥ ||67||
netraprāntāt prabhavanti tejāṃsi premabhṛnti ca |
taiścākṛṣṭāḥ premabhāgā jāyante trisṛjisthitāḥ ||68||
sudhābhṛtāni dantebhyo jāyante kiraṇāni vai |
sudhāpānaiḥ sṛṣṭayo vai sarvāstṛpyanti sarvadā ||69||
pīyūṣāṇāṃ kiraṇāni bhālamadhyād bhavanti vai |
pīyūṣapānatṛptāśca jāyante trisṛjisthitāḥ ||3.2.70||
karṇābhyāṃ saṃprajāyante tāratejaḥsvarātmakāḥ |
tejaḥpravāhāstaiḥ sarve śṛṇvanti divyakarṇakāḥ ||7 1 ||
mūrterabhito jāyante miṣṭasparśāḥ sukhāvahāḥ |
spārśanaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ spṛṣṭā bhuñjate sukhamācyutam ||72||
jihvātaḥ kiraṇānīṣṭamiṣṭarasāni yānti hi |
sarvasṛṣṭijanāstaistu rasyante’danti tadrasam| ||73||
nāsikātaḥ kiraṇāni gandhavanti prayānti ca |
tadgandhaiḥ sarvasṛṣṭisthā jighranti vai sugandhikam ||74||
śrīharerme hṛdayāttu nissarantyabhitaḥ khalu |
śāśvatānandapūrṇāni kiraṇāni sukhāni vai ||75||
tairmahānandamagnāśca vartante trisṛjisthitāḥ |
mama mūrghnaścidākāśātmakabrahmākhyarandhrataḥ ||76||
prabhavanti mahānandā miṣṭā vāṇī parā tathā |
tābhyaḥ sṛṣṭitrayasthāśca vyāharanti vacāṃsi hi ||77||
madvācā vāgminaḥ sarve matkṛtārthānuyoginaḥ |
maddhastābhyāṃ kiraṇāni kriyāvanti prayānti ca ||78||
taiśca sṛṣṭitrayasthā vai bhavanti yatnaśīlinaḥ |
mamodarāt kiraṇāni niryānti paritastathā ||79||
prāṇadāni ca taiḥ sarve jīvanti trisṛjisthitāḥ |
mama prajananād yāntyānandāḍhyakiraṇāni vai ||3.2.80||
tanmātrayānandavantaḥ sṛṣṭitrayasthadehinaḥ |
manmūrteḥ pādayoryānti vihārakiraṇāni vai ||8 1 ||
tairbhavanti sagatikāḥ sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ |
manmūrteḥ kaṭibhāgācca prayānti kiraṇāni ha ||82||
sabalāni ca taiḥ sarve balavanto bhavanti hi |
pṛṣṭhadaṇḍāt kiraṇānyādhāravanti prayānti ca ||83 ||
tena lokāṇḍakoṭyaścādhārastaṃbhāśritāḥ sadā |
mama pāyūtsarjabhāso yānti vai sṛṣṭikoṭiṣu ||84||
tābhirbhābhiḥ samutsargo jananāni bhavanti ca |
mama nitambabhāgābhyāṃ kiraṇāni prayānti ca ||85||
āsyaśaktyāsanabaddhāḥ sarve lokā bhavanti taiḥ |
mamāntaragatā bhāsaḥ prayānti sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||86||
tābhirbhābhirmananaṃ ca bodhanaṃ mānanaṃ tathā |
cintanaṃ nirṇayaṃ sākṣādvijñānaṃ yānti dehinaḥ ||87||
mama kaustubhakiraṇaiḥ pradīpāḥ saṃbhavanti ca |
mama saundaryakiraṇaiḥ sundaryaḥ sṛṣṭayastvimāḥ ||88||
mama lakṣmyāśca kiraṇairgṛhiṇyaḥ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu |
gṛhalakṣmyo bhavantyeva sarvasaubhāgyaśobhitāḥ ||89||
mama vātsalyakiraṇaiḥ snehabaddhā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ |
mamodāryaprabhābhiścaudāryayuktā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ ||3.2.90 ||
mamābhirūpakiraṇaiḥ sarvaṃ rūpānvitaṃ sadā |
mama kalpākhyakiraṇaiḥ kāmāvasāyitādikāḥ ||9 1 ||
siddhayaḥ sampravartante kalpapādapavallayaḥ |
mama dharmapradaraśmibhiśca tṛpyaṃ sṛjitrayam || 92||
pākaṃ ca pariṇāmaṃ ca prayānti taiśca sṛṣṭayaḥ |
mama raudraiśca kiraṇaistirobhāvaṃ prayāntyapi ||93||
sthairyaśaktimayaiścāpi kiraṇaiḥ sarvamaṇḍalam |
sṛṣṭitrayātmakaṃ svasvakramasthairye pravartate ||94||
mamāpūrakakiraṇairāpūryante hi sṛṣṭayaḥ |
mama puṇyakakiraṇaiḥ pūyante ceśvarādayaḥ ||95||
mama vijñānakiraṇaiḥ sārvajñyaṃ yanti dehinaḥ |
mama kṛpāprabhābhiśca samudyanti hi dehinaḥ ||96||
mama śobhāprabhābhiśca śobhante sṛṣṭināyakāḥ |
mama guptapratejobhirnigūḍhaiśvaryayoginaḥ || 97||
mama mūrternididhyāsairmanmayāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā |
saditi mama cākhyāsti tadvanto ye bhavanti vai || 98 ||
mamātyantasayujāste santo manmūrtayaḥ priyāḥ |
bhavatyaḥ kāśikākṣetre vidhāyāgniṃ pradakṣiṇam ||99||
mama sāyujyamāpannāḥ satyo manmūrtayaḥ priyāḥ |
māmārādhya mama yoga gatāste mūrtayo mama || 3.2.10 0||
muktāśceśāḥ surā viprāḥ santo gāvaśca kanyakāḥ |
kumārā brahmaśīlāśca satyaśca mūrtayo mama || 10 1||
mama mūrteḥ kiraṇaiśca sattāvadbhiḥ sṛjitraye |
prajāyante tu rājāno madyogānmūrtayo mama || 1 02||
indraḥ svāyaṃbhuvo brahmā vairājastatpitāpi ca |
tatpituśca pitā cāpi sarvāstā mama mūrtayaḥ || 103 ||
śacī śatasvarūpā sāvitrī vairājikā tathā |
mahālakṣmīḥ pradhānā ca prakṛtirmama mūrtayaḥ || 1 04||
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyāśca mūrtayaḥ |
nārāyaṇāstathā santaḥ sādhvyaśca mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 05||
agnirviṣṇuḥ suvarṇaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ cetanaṃ guruḥ |
yugalaṃ tulasī satyaṃ sarvadā mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 06||
vedaḥ sūryo vyavasāyo daṇḍaḥ sneho’tithiḥ sukham |
arbhakaścāśrito’nātho vidyārthī mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 07||
rājācāryaḥ pradhānaścopadeṣṭā vyāsa ārtihāḥ |
rakṣakaḥ pālakaḥ svāmī śaraṇyo mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 08||
yajñaḥ śrāddha pūjanaṃ ca svāgataṃ madhuparkakam |
dakṣiṇā havyakavyādi manmayaṃ mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 09||
kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī jalakumbhī ca mārjanī |
madarthaṃ tūpayuktāstāḥ pāvanyo mama mūrtayaḥ || 3.2.11 0||
śayyā yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca godhanādyaṃ gṛhādikam |
madarthaṃ copayuktaṃ cet sarvaṃ manmūrtirūpi tat || 111 ||
sarvaṃ madanvitaṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā mama |
madarthaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mama sāyujyadaṃ bhavet || 1 12||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra bhojanaṃ mūrtirūpyaham |
sarveṣāṃ pṛccha me cānyajjijñāsitaṃ tu te yadi || 113 ||
paṭhitvemaṃ tathā śrutvā madbhāvaṃ cāpnuyāt priye |
muktiṃ muktiṃ labhet tīrthaphalaṃ yogaphalaṃ labhet || 1 14||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvāpañcāśadvatsaranāmāni, vartamānakalpīyacaturdaśamanunāmāni, pañcāśadvarṣīyāntimacatvāriṃśatkalpanāmāni, puruṣottamakiraṇapoṣyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayādītivibhūtivarṇanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<3.3>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavanme kṛpāsindho vada jijñāsitaṃ tvidam |
dvāpañcāśadvatsareṣu brahmaṇo yatra vatsare || 1 ||
mukhyāvatārī tvaṃ jāto nāmakarmaguṇānvitaḥ |
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvallīlā muktidā yataḥ || 2 ||
nānto’sti te’vatārāṇāṃ tadbhāraṃ na dadāmi te |
avatārisvarūpasya prākaṭyaṃ tatpurābhavam || 3 ||
śrotumicchāmi bhagavan yanme’pi smaraṇaṃ bhavet |
puruṣottamaprākaṭyamātraṃ me vada vatsala || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathayāmi nibodha me |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ tattaccaritraṃ mama bhāmini || 5 ||
vedhaso vatsare pādme kalpāṣṭame’ṣṭame manau |
vedhaso nālakhaṇḍādvai rohiṇāṇḍodaro’suraḥ || 6 ||
jajñe brahmāṇḍatulyo vai śarīreṇa balena ca |
tejasā tāmasenāpi trilokibhakṣako’bhavat || 7 ||
rudreṇa gadayā cāpi triśūlena pratāḍitaḥ |
dudrāva jalamadhye sa rudrastamanvagāttadā || 8 ||
pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ bhittvā praviveśāṇḍamaṇḍalam |
satyaṃ tapo janaṃ tyaktvā maharlokamupāyayau || 9 ||
meroḥ sa gahvare sūkṣmo bhūtvā gupto’vasattataḥ |
rudraḥ svargaṃ vīkṣituṃ vai mahendrālayamāyayau || 3.3.1 0||
devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ |
indrasabhā prapūrṇābhūt sūryacandrādibhistadā || 11 ||
rohiṇāṇḍodaro jñātvāvasaraṃ vavṛdhe tadā |
merutulyodaro bhūtvā mukhyaṃ vyādāya tāṃ sabhām || 1 2||
sasvargāṃ sūryacandrendrarudranakṣatrasaṃyutām |
nyagilat sahasā sarvaṃ svargaṃ tasyodare’bhavat || 13||
hāhākāro mahāñjātaścukṣubhurbhūtalāni ca |
maharjanādilokāścākasmādvai pracakampire || 14||
satyaloke mahān kampastadā jāto’tidāruṇaḥ |
lokālokācalaścāpi muhuḥ kampamagāttadā || 15||
akasmāt pralayaṃ jñātvā svargalokasya devatāḥ |
sarudrendrārkaśaśino rohiṇāṇḍodare sthitāḥ || 16||
tuṣṭuvurbhayamāpannā māṃ tadā puruṣottamam |
parabrahma kṛpāsindho sarvarakṣaka mādhava || 17||
namaste bhagavan sarvāntaryāmin parameśvara |
tvāṃ vinā rakṣako nānyaścākasmikalayādiha || 18||
vidyate prāṇanātha tvaṃ rakṣa rakṣa mahālayāt |
kevayaṃ svargavāsāśca kutrātra gahvare gatāḥ || 19||
na jānīmo vayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa jagadguro |
svargaṃ divyaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ mahati gahvare ||3.3.20||
patitaṃ kiṃ ca vā bhūt sattvaṃ vā nyagiladdhi naḥ |
akāle pralayaḥ prāptastasmād rakṣaya rakṣaya ||2 1 ||
śaraṇaṃ tava yātāḥ smaḥ samarpitāḥ svayaṃ surāḥ |
ātmanivedinaste’tra yatheṣṭaṃ kuru naḥ kṛte ||22||
ityevaṃ saṃstutaścāhaṃ brahmaṇāpi ca saṃstutaḥ |
tvayā sākaṃ tadā nārāyaṇīśri rohitodare ||23 ||
indrasya mānasaḥ putraḥ sacakraścābhavaṃ drutam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||24||
tvaṃ tadā mānasī putrī rudrasyāpyabhavaḥ priye |
devāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāptaṃ māṃ tadā puruṣottamam ||25||
vilokya magnahṛdayāḥ pupūjurhṛdayārpaṇaiḥ |
mayā tūrṇaṃ tadā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ mahat kṛtam ||26||
koṭyaraṃ kartanaṃ rohitāṇḍodarasya varṣmaṇaḥ |
mayā muktaṃ karāttūrṇaṃ nyakartayat tadāsuram ||27||
parito bahudhā gatvā bhramitvā ca muhurmuhuḥ |
cakrotpanno mahānagniścāsuravarṣmakhaṇḍakān ||28||
koṭidhā tatkartitām̐śca bhasmasāt pracakāra ha |
tacca bhasma tadā svarṇaṃ rohitākhyaṃ hyabhūttdā ||29||
rohitāṇḍodaranāśe jāte svasthāḥ surādayaḥ |
māṃ viditvākṣareśaṃ śrīmahendrabālakaṃ prabhum ||3.3.3 0||
rakṣakaṃ parameśānaṃ cendrālaye surālaye |
mahotsavaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā rudro vai devasākṣike ||31 ||
maṇḍape tvāṃ nijāṃ putrīṃ mānasīṃ me dadau tadā |
ramaṇīṃ daivavidhinā prāptavām̐stvāṃ tadāpyaham ||32||
mama saṃjñā tadā cāsīdanādidyunarāyaṇaḥ |
tadā svarga tathā devā yathāvat sthāpitā mayā ||33||
mama yogabalenaiva vikṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam |
avatārī svayaṃ so’haṃ yo’haṃ cātrāsmi so’bhavam ||34||
smara raudri priye tatra līlā me tava yoginīḥ |
me’vatārāstatra varṣe pratyahaṃ bahavo’bhavan ||35||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ cādyaṃ janma me mānasaṃ tadā |
atha dvitīyaṃ janmāpi dvitīye vatsare śṛṇu || 36||
nālakramābhidhe varṣe brahmaṇaḥ prathame’hani |
tṛtīyasya manorante merurnāmnā hi parvataḥ ||37||
caturdaśastarāṇāṃ vai bhāreṇa mahatā tadā |
ākrānto’bhūttadā pātālādho viveśa vai manāk ||38||
caturdaśastarairyuktaḥ surāsurālayānvitaḥ |
nimnabhāvaṃ gate merau bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||39||
bhagnāni meruṇā sākaṃ cādhobhāvaṃ gatāni vai |
bhugnāni merupārśveṣu cākṛṣṭāni samantataḥ ||3.3.40 ||
prajātāni tadā satyaṃ svargaṃ bhūśca rasātalam |
sarvaṃ vai budhnabhāvaṃ ca gataṃ cābhūt samantataḥ ||41 ||
lokālokācalaścāpi prākāro’ṇḍasya sarvataḥ |
āntarābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṭo hrasvavalayatāṃ yayau ||42||
tathāpi tasya balato bhugnānyapi sthirāṇi vai |
bhuvanānyabhavam̐statra kṣaṇaṃ saṃkucitānyapi |||43 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ staṃbhanāśaṃ vilokya ca |
brahmāṇḍanāśaṃ matvā tadrakṣārthaṃ parameśvaram ||44||
parabrahma hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ tu mām |
astuvan parayā bhītyā rakṣārthaṃ merubhūbhṛtaḥ ||45||
brahmāṇḍasyāsya rakṣārthaṃ lokānāmavanāya ca |
tvamādhāro’si sarveṣāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ pareśvara ||46 ||
sarvasṛṣṭisthairyaśaktistvayyeva vartate prabho |
tavāntarvartamānatvāt sthiraṃ sarvaṃ pravidyate ||47||
bhagavan bhavadutpannaṃ tvadādhāraṃ samastakam |
tvayā hīnaṃ layaṃ ceyāt trāhi nāśābhisannidheḥ ||48||
vinā staṃbhaṃ gṛhaṃ naiva tiṣṭhedaṇḍaṃ tathā tvidam |
meruṃ vinā bhuvanāni tiṣṭheyurnaiva cāmbare ||49||
merurmūle viśatyeva bhārākrāntaḥ starānvitaḥ |
vayaṃ nāśagatāḥ syāma rakṣaṃ meruṃ tadāśrayam ||3.3.50 ||
itistutvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ cakrurmama sureśvarāḥ |
ahaṃ lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ tūrṇaṃ cākṣaradhāmataḥ ||51||
samāyayau satyaloke vedhasaḥ sannidhau drutam |
surāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra vedhasoṃ’kerbhako’bhavam ||52||
ujjvalaḥ koṭisūryābhaḥ sajaṭaḥ sarvabhūṣaṇaḥ |
hasannaṃke samuvāca vedhasaṃ pitarityaham ||53 ||
sa māṃ putreti sambodhya māyayā cāgrahīt sutam |
devā natvā hariṃ matvā puṣpādyaiḥ parameśvaram ||54||
māmānarcuḥ stavaṃ cakruḥ rakṣetyūcuḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
anādiśrīmerunārāyaṇanāmā suto’pyaham ||55||
tūrṇaṃ tvāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ kṛtvā meroḥ pradhāriṇīm |
mama rūpe’tisampannāṃ līnāṃ kṛtvātisatvaram ||56||
devān brahmādikān nītvā saha pātālamāyayau |
merumūlaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yannihitaṃ tadapūjayam ||57||
tvāṃ prapūjya mahānārāyaṇīśri cādideśa ha |
atra śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ viśeti sahasā tadā ||58||
tvaṃ praviṣṭā mahāśaktirmayā sṛṣṭā mayānvitā |
mayā merustadā devaiḥ sākaṃ mūle samuddhṛtaḥ ||59||
uttolito’tibalibhiḥ sākaṃ brahmādibhiḥ saha |
yathāpekṣa tato meruśconnatiṃ pragato’bhavat ||3.3.60||
bhuvanāni samastāni samasūtratalāni ca |
babhūvurvāsayogyāni devādyāḥ sukhino’bhavan ||61 ||
tvayā lakṣmi nijacchāyātmikayā dhṛtisaṃjñayā |
tadārabhya dhṛtaścāyaṃ merurmūle ciraṃ sadā ||62||
ahaṃ viveśa ca tatra merau dhāraṇarūpavān |
ambarākarṣaṇarūpo’ntarātmā merugarbhagaḥ ||63||
evaṃ merau paraṃ kṛtvā sthairyaṃ tataḥ surādibhiḥ |
saha mūlāni lokānāṃ merulagnāni vīkṣya ca ||64||
sulagnāni tadā kṛtvā sthirāṇyāsthāya vai kramāt |
rasātalāttathā mahātalāt talātalāttathā ||65||
sutalād vitalāccāpi tathātalād bhuvaṃ prati |
ājagāma tvayā sākaṃ bhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanam ||66||
tapaḥ satyaṃ paraṃ gatvā cājaputraḥ sthiro’bhavam |
anādiśrīmerunārāyaṇo’haṃ vedhasaḥ sutaḥ ||67||
meruputryā tvayā sākaṃ surādibhirvivāhitaḥ |
ākalpāntaṃ tadā cāsaṃ sarvarakṣaṇahetave ||68||
avatārī svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
avatārāstadā varṣe kalpe kalpe mamābhavan ||69||
aneke kāryavaśagā yatpāro naiva vidyate |
mahānārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ smara svatsaṃbhava tadā ||3.3.70||
mamāpi saṃbhavaṃ merunārāyaṇātmakaṃ śubham |
athānye vatsare lakṣmi tṛtīye vedhaso’pi ca ||71 ||
kathayāmi janurme’tra śṛṇu kṛṣṇanarāyaṇi |
nālordhvavatsare cādye kalpe manau tṛtīyake ||72||
nārāyaṇi tadā svarge bhūtale sūryamaṇḍalam |
aśātitaṃ tu lokānāṃ bhasmasāt kārakaṃ hyabhūt ||73||
lakṣaraśmiyutaṃ cāsīd dāhakaṃ sarvatomukham |
diśāṃ vidiśāṃ lokānāṃ grahāṇāṃ sṛṣṭidehinām ||74||
bhūtalānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ samudrāṇāṃ ca dāhakam |
bhuvaḥsthānāṃ vāyavīyasṛṣṭīnāṃ dāhakaṃ hyabhūt ||75||
lokālokasyāpi merordāhakaṃ vanavāsinām |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca tārāṇāṃ dāhakaṃ janavāsinām ||76||
maharlokanivāsānāṃ tathordhvavāsināmapi |
samantato’bhavaccāpi dāhakaṃ bhasmasātkaram ||77||
taddāhaduḥkhamāsādya manavo devatāstathā |
sarvalokanivāsāśca tuṣṭuvurvedhasaṃ tadā ||78||
brahmā stutiṃ samākarṇya yayau sūryasya śāntaye |
so’pi dagdhaḥ parāvṛtya satyalokaṃ yayau tadā ||79||
śaṃkaro vai mahāśāntiṃ kartuṃ yayau raviṃ prati |
so’pi dagdho namaskṛtya parāvṛtyākriyo’bhavat ||3.3.80||
tato viṣṇustathā devā militvā parameśvaram |
tuṣṭuvurmāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||81 ||
sūryatejaḥpraśāntyarthaṃ namaścakruḥ punaḥpunaḥ |
koṭisūryapraṇetastvaṃ bhagavan parameśvara ||82||
jagaccakṣurjagatprabhāprada sūryāt prarakṣaya |
vayaṃ trilokavāsāśca tathānye cordhvavāsinaḥ ||83||
dagdhā bhavāmaḥ sūryasyānalairlakṣaprasarpibhiḥ |
tvayā kṛtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ saprakāśaṃ sukhārthakam ||84||
tadyadi syād dagdhabhasma kiṃ sūryasya prayojanam |
tasmād rakṣaya deveśa taptān śāntān vidhehi naḥ ||85||
ityuktvā pradaduḥ pūjāṃ bahvīṃ me’rpaṇarūpiṇīm |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||86||
tadāhaṃ kamale sākaṃ tvayā tūrṇaṃ narāyaṇaḥ |
akṣarādāyayau satyaṃ brahmasthānaṃ tataḥ param ||87||
devaiḥ sampūjitaścāhaṃ viṣṇoraṃke’bhavaṃ sutaḥ |
sahasrahastakaḥ saumyaḥ kirīṭakuṇḍalādimān ||88||
śāṇaśastrādiyuktaśca sudhāmṛtaghaṭādimān |
sudarśanaṃ mayā tatra śāṇātmakaṃ kṣaṇāt kṛtam ||89||
sarvāgniśāmakaṃ sudhāmṛtaṃ śātanaśaktikam |
mayā lakṣmi tadājñaptā tvaṃ devī śātanī bhava ||3.3.90||
sūrye praviśya ca tatrāmṛtaṃ dhāraya śātani |
auṣṇyaṃ yadvad bhavennyūnaṃ tathā vidhehi satvaram ||9 1||
tvaṃ cājñāṃ me samādāya tūrṇaṃ vahnisvarūpiṇī |
mahātejomayī bhūtvārbudatāpakarī satī ||92||
amṛtaṃ ca samādāya praviṣṭā sūryamaṇḍalam |
śanaiḥ sudhāṃ ca tadgarbhe sannihitavatī tataḥ ||93||
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kiraṇāni śāntimāptāni vai raveḥ |
tvama ca śanaiḥ śanaistatra svaṃ tejaḥ samupāharaḥ ||94||
tataścāhaṃ tava rūpe śāṇe yantre raviṃ tadā |
dhṛtvā tejo’titīkṣṇām̐śca pradeśānapyaśātayam ||95||
sarvān vibhidya taddeśān devādibhyastadādadam |
te cakruścāyudhānyeva cāvyāhatāni vai tadā ||96||
sūryo mayā kṛtastatra sahasrāṃśuḥ sukhapradaḥ |
anyeṃ’śavastvayā lakṣmi līnīkṛtāḥ svavarṣmaṇi ||97||
tata ārabhya sūryaḥ sa lokasampatkaro’bhavat |
sā tvaṃ tataśca tatputrī saurī śātanikābhidhā ||98||
abhavaḥ sā mayā viṣṇuputreṇa sūryaśātinā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenāpi vivāhitā ||99||
kalpāntaṃ cāvasastatra smara tvaṃ tanmayā saha |
āsīnnārāyaṇīśri yat sūryakarmābhavaṃ prabhuḥ ||3.3.1 0 0||
parabrahma svayaṃ sūryakarmāhaṃ cābhavaṃ priye |
evaṃ tatrāpi varṣe cāvatārā mama koṭiśaḥ || 101 ||
sañjātā dharmaguptyarthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ dehināṃ tathā |
avatārī svayaṃ prokto’nādiviṣṇunarāyaṇaḥ || 1 02||
tṛtīyaṃ mama vai lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ tatra vatsare |
jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hastāmalakavat priye || 10 3||
māṃ bhajitvā tadā muktiṃ gatā hyasaṃkhyadehinaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 04||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ prathame varṣe’nādiśrīdyunārāyaṇasya rohiṇāṇḍodarāsuranigalitasvargarakṣārtham, dvitīye varṣe svabhāreṇa nimajjato merordhāraṇārtham anādimerunārāyaṇasya, tṛtīye varṣe dāhayato raveḥ śātanārtham anādiviṣṇunārāyaṇasya, ca prākaṭyamitinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<3.4>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ caturthaṃ mama vartanam |
candrarakṣākaraṃ svarge gāyatāṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 1 ||
stāvane vatsare’jasya kalpe caturthake tadā |
dvādaśe ca manau vartamāne’suro’tidāruṇaḥ || 2 ||
dhūmro nāmnābhavad raudraḥ śaṃbhormastakapṛṣṭhataḥ |
samutpanno vyomadeho’ntarīkṣago bhayaṃkaraḥ || 3 ||
śaṃbhorlalāṭe bhāvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāntamayaṃ maṇim |
spardhāṃ kṛtvā yayau vyomni cāvāptuṃ vai niśāmaṇim || 4 ||
candramasaṃ samāhartuṃ yatnaṃ tadākarod bahum |
candreṇa vāryamāṇaḥ sa niśitaiḥ śastrahetibhiḥ || 5 ||
nipapātāmbarādadrau śvetaśṛṃgābhidhe tadā |
śaṃbhumuddiśya ca tapaḥ śaṃbhuputro’karottataḥ || 6 ||
nirāhāro’bhavattvekayugaṃ tato hi śaṃkaraḥ |
prasannaḥ prāha dhūmraṃ taṃ putraṃ mastakapṛṣṭhajam || 7 ||
vada kiṃ rocate te’dya kathaṃ tapasi vartase |
vadeṣṭaṃ pradadāmyeva mā kṛthāstapa ugrakam || 8 ||
ityuktaścāsuraḥ prāha varaṃ dehi jayāvaham |
candraṃ jeṣyāmyayatnena tathecchāmi na cetarat || 9 ||
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha dadau dhūmrāya śūlakam |
apradhṛṣyamavināśyaṃ cakrāccāpi bale’dhikam || 3.4.1 0||
tadādāya tu dhūmraḥ sa mervadriṃ prathamaṃ yayau |
sārvabhaumajayaṃ kartuṃ tṛṣṇātantuprapreritaḥ || 11 ||
meruvāsān surān jitvā pṛthvyāṃ jetuṃ nṛpān yayau |
jitvā bhūmau bhūbhṛtaśca pātālān prayayau tataḥ || 12||
daityānnāgānkacchapām̐śca makarānmatsyakām̐stathā |
nakrān jitvā phaṇadhrām̐śca jitvā yayāvaraṇyakam || 1 3||
vidyādharām̐śca gandharvān jitvā ca kinnarām̐stataḥ |
guhyakān cāraṇān jitvā yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm || 14||
yamadūtām̐stadā jitvā yuyudhe sa yamena vai |
yamo daṇḍena kālenāsuraḥ śūlena vai mithaḥ || 15||
yuyudhāte tu naikasya parājayo’tra vidyate |
yamena saṃsmṛto rudro’sureṇa saṃsmṛto haraḥ || 16||
hararudrau samāyātau madhyasthau sambabhūvatuḥ |
vārayāmāsatustau ca yayatuḥ śaṃsitau gṛham || 17||
athāsuro garvayukto yayau cendraṃ divaspatim |
indro jñātvā mahādevadattaṃ śūlamajayyakam || 18||
utthāya saumyabhāvena satkāraṃ kṛtavān śubham |
asurāya dadau ramyaṃ hāraṃ maṇyabhinirmitam || 19||
pūjayāmāsa ca śaṃbhoḥ śūlaṃ bahuvidhānataḥ |
asuro’pi vinā roṣaṃ mṛdurbhūtvā vilokya tat ||3.4.20||
yayau sūryaṃ vijetuṃ ca sūryaścāstaṃ drutaṃ yayau |
yayau tadāsuro’jaṃ ca vijetuṃ parameṣṭhinam ||21 ||
brahmā jñātvā śāṃbhavaṃ tat triśūlaṃ sampupūja ha |
madhuparkaṃ dadau cāpyasurāya mānanaṃ dadau ||22||
dhūmrastvāsanamāsādya sauvarṇaṃ bahuśobhanam |
mumude ca mṛdurbhūtvā natvājaṃ prayayau divam ||23||
candraṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrṇabhāsaṃ yayau taṃ prati satvaram |
sadā candrastatra cāsīnnīrogaḥ sakalaḥ sadā ||24||
ekarūpaḥ kṣayavṛddhivarjitaḥ śāśvataḥ sukhaḥ |
grahagrāsādihīnaśca pūrṇakalaḥ samantataḥ || 25||
tādṛśaṃ pūrṇapīyūṣaṃ gatvā dhūmro bhayānakam |
śatacandrāyataṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā jagrāha pāṇinā ||26|||
sparśaiḥ sudhāmṛtānāṃ tu kiraṇānāṃ mahāsuraḥ |
sukhaṃ mahānandabhṛtaṃ hyavāpāpūrvamuttamam || 27||
ataścandre jātalobho jagrāsa śaśinaṃ mukhe |
hāhākāro mahānāsīt svarge pṛthvyāṃ samantataḥ || 28||
amṛtasya nidhānaṃ vai śītatejobhṛtaṃ maṇim |
tajjyotsnāmanavāpyaivauṣadhayo’tivijīvanāḥ || 29||
mṛtaprāyā abhavam̐śca devāścāmṛtavarjitāḥ |
kiraṇādhārajīvāśca sarve maraṇaśālinaḥ || 3.4.3 0||
tadā jātāścātha devāḥ svaguroḥ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ |
sadaspatirdevaguruścāstaut māṃ parameśvaram || 31 ||
candrasya rakṣaṇārthāya lokarakṣaṇahetave |
namo devādhidevāya sūryacandrapracakṣuṣe || 32||
sarvāntaryāmiṇe rakṣākarāya paramātmane |
puruṣottamasaṃjñāya sudhāpradāya śārṅgiṇe ||33||
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ bhāskarāya mahātmane |
namaścāntaravedyāya cābhaktakṣayakāriṇe ||34||
samāyāhi hare śīghraṃ rakṣāṃ tvaṃ śaśinaḥ kuru |
mahādevo dhyānamagnaścirakārī virājate ||35||
śīghraṃ dhūmrād rakṣa muktapate śrīparameśvara |
stutaścaivaṃ tadā cāhaṃ nārāyaṇīśri satvaram || 36||
tvayā sākaṃ tvājagāma devagurorgṛhaṃ divi |
drāgevādṛśyarūpo’pi tadaṅge mānasaḥ sutaḥ || 37||
samabhavaṃ subālo’haṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśūlaśaktiśarāyudhaḥ || 38||
vajradhanurdaṇḍapāśakhaṅgacarmavirājitaḥ |
tvaṃ tadā tu mayājñaptā praviṣṭā cāsurodare || 39||
candramasi sthirā jātā cāndrī kalāprarakṣiṇī |
tvadbalādvai tadā lakṣmi candro mūrcchāṃ na cāptavān ||3.4.40||
nāpi tejovihīnaśca nāpi cāmṛtavarjitaḥ |
nāpi saṃpācito garbhe dhūmrāsureṇa vahninā ||41 ||
evamevābhavadgarbhe yathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat |
athāha pūjito devairdevagurvaṃkaśobhitaḥ ||42||
prārthito’suranāśārthaṃ jagāmāhaṃ mahāsuram |
devasainyena sahito yuyudhe candraghātinā || 43||
tadā lakṣmi mayājñaptā kanyārūpābhavaḥ kṣaṇam |
asuro dhūmrasaṃjño’pi tvāṃ vilokya mumoha ca ||44||
śūlaṃ visṛjya ca kṣaṇaṃ tvāṃ dhartuṃ yatnamācarat |
tvayā śūlaṃ tadā grastaṃ mamājñayā hi śāṃkaram ||45||
mayā cakreṇa vai śīghraṃ hato’suraḥ sahasradhā |
dhūmro vināśamāpanno bhasmasādabhavattadā ||46||
candraḥ pūrṇakalastatra nirjagāmodarād bahiḥ |
tvaṃ ca śūladharī cāndrī kanyā nāmnā tu kaumudī ||47||
vardhitā sarvadevādyaiḥ pūjitā parameśvarī |
ahaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitaśca vardhito vanditastathā ||48||
devaguroḥ sutaścāhaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
candramasā harirjñātvā vanditaḥ pūjitastathā ||49||
kanyā tvaṃ kaumudīnāmnī dattā mahyaṃ tadā priye |
mayā vivāhitā tvaṃ ca devagurorgṛhoṣiṇā ||3.4.50||
anādiśrīdevanārāyaṇanāmnā narāyaṇi |
tataḥ sasmāra śaṃbhuṃ ca devagurorgṛhe’pyaham ||51 ||
śaṃbhustūrṇaṃ samāyāto jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram |
dhūmrāsuraṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca jñātvā mumoda vai haraḥ ||52||
triśūlaṃ pradadau śaṃbhuścandramase hi śāśvatam |
pitā tubhyaṃ dadau śūlaṃ yautakaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam ||53||
tvayā mahyaṃ pradattaṃ ca mayā haste surekhakam |
kṛtaṃ dhṛtaṃ sarvadaiva paśya dakṣe kare mama ||54||
triśūlaṃ rekhitaṃ cāste prākaṭyaṃ yāti cecchayā |
smara lakṣmi tava prākaṭyaṃ ca me’pi tadābhavam ||55||
avatārī svayaṃ cāsaṃ tadā devanarāyaṇaḥ |
avatārāstadā me’pyāsam̐śca koṭisahasraśaḥ |||56||
ākalpāntaṃ cābhavaṃ vai tvayā sākaṃ gurorgṛhe |
athājasya pañcame vatsare yo’haṃ tadābhavam ||57||
ādye kalpe cādyamanau tvaṃ cābhavaḥ kathāṃ śṛṇu |
vyomabāṇābhidhe varṣe prākkalpe prathame manau ||58||
vidyamāne brahmaputrā maharṣayo’jasaṃsadi |
saṃhatāśca pracakrurvai vicāraṃ vedavādinaḥ |||59||
brahmāṇḍe bhūtalaṃ karmabhūmiḥ phalapradāsti yat |
tatra kṛtaṃ dehibhirvai dattaṃ dānaṃ vṛṣādikam ||3.4.60||
anyalokagataiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpyate bhojanādikam |
bhūtale yatpradattaṃ ca jalānnāmbarabhūṣaṇam ||61||
kṣetravāṭīrūpyakanyāsuvarṇagṛhasādhanam |
havyaṃ kavyaṃ baliḥ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ śrāddhaṃ sahāyakam ||62||
sarvaṃ lokāntare dātrā kartrāpyate’yutottaram |
yathā jīvanti sannyāsā vānaprasthāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ ||63||
gārhasthyamupasaṃlambya tathālambya kṣitau kṛtam |
jīvanti svargadevāśca pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ ||64||
sukṛtaṃ tad yajñakāryaṃ jīvanaṃ sarvadehinām |
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ yatra devānāṃ havyamityapi ||65||
śrāddhaṃ ca pitṛdevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyamityapi |
soma sudhāmṛtaṃ bhojyaṃ yajñe sarvaṃ hi labhyate ||66||
tasmād yajñaḥ prakartavyaḥ śikṣaṇīyaḥ kriyātmakaḥ |
mānavebhyo bhūdevebhyaḥ kriyāsantānahetave ||67||
kratutantau samārabdhe sandhite yojite kṛte |
yajñānāṃ sampracāreṇa jīvanaṃ syānnirāmayam ||68||
tasmād gacchāma evādya maharṣayo hi bhūtalam |
devān pitṝn saha nītvācariṣyāmaḥ kratūttamam ||69||
itisammantrya munayaḥ pitaraśca sureśvarāḥ |
āyayurbhūtalaṃ lakṣmi yajñārthaṃ merusannidhau ||3.4.70||
pālāśāraṇyake sarve svargaṃgāyāstaṭe sthitāḥ |
prayatante sma yajñārthaṃ bhinnakarmaniyojitāḥ ||71 ||
prathamo’yaṃ yato yajñaḥ kramaṃ jānanti naiva te |
na kaścit sarvayajñānāmabhyāsī karmagocaraḥ ||72||
yathākramaviniryoktā deve pitari bhūsure |
maharṣau vā tadā tatrābhavat karmakramābhivit ||73||
tataste mohamāpannāḥ karmakāṇḍāpravedinaḥ |
idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ pūrvamevamāgrahiṇo’bhavan ||74||
aniścitte kratukrame tadaṃgānāṃ krame’pi ca |
vedhaḥputro brahmakumārākhyau naiṣṭhikaśīlavān ||75||
yajamānaṃ cāha tatra jyotiṣmannāmakaṃ manum |
vayaṃ sarve karmakāṇḍe hyapūrvagocarāḥ khalu ||76||
viguṇe tu phalaṃ yajñe viparītaṃ bhavediti |
yajñadraṣṭā yajñavaktā nānyo nārāyaṇaṃ vinā ||77||
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam |
tamevārādhayāmo’tra saṃhatya kramahetave ||78||
sa cāgatya kratuṃ sarvaṃ śikṣayiṣyati yajñakṛt |
yajñadevaḥ sa yajñātmā yajñajño yajñakārakaḥ ||79||
ityukto vai manuścānye svīcakrustadvacastataḥ |
parameśaṃ militvaivārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||3.4.80||
maharṣayaśca pitaro devatā bhūsurādayaḥ |
oṃ namo yajñarūpāya parameśāya karmiṇe ||8 1||
yajñadevāya yajñāya yajñajñāya kratukṛte |
yajñaśāstre’dhvarakāryakāriṇe paramātmane ||82||
namo’ntaryāmiṇe naśca sāhāyyadāya śārṅgiṇe |
ityastuvan surādyā māṃ yajñārthaṃ puruṣottamam ||83||
tadāhaṃ tu tvayā sākaṃ śrutvākṣare’pi cārthanām |
agacchaṃ gāṃgatīraṃ vai meroḥ pālāśakṛdvanam ||84||
brahmakumāranikaṭe bālo’hamṛṣiveṣadhṛk |
sarvavidyāmayaḥ sarvamantradraṣṭā niyogavān ||85||
yāvadvidhipravīṇo’haṃ yāvatpātradharo dvijaḥ |
sarvakramābhivettā ca sarvadravyādibodhavān ||86||
dvitīyo vai yathā brahmā tathā prakaṭito’bhavam |
sarve dṛṣṭvā tu māṃ vipraṃ koṭibhāskarabhāsuram ||87||
sahasotthāya nemurmāṃ kastvaṃ papracchurutsukāḥ |
adhvaro’haṃ hi bhagavān bhavadārādhanāphalam ||88||
ityuktvāhaṃ bālarūpo brahmakumārakāṅkagaḥ |
abhavaṃ putrabhāvenābhāvayat so’pi māṃ tathā ||89||
tvaṃ tadā cāviśo jyotiṣmanmanau bhūyasī satī |
athāhaṃ ca samāśvāsya sarvān yajñārthakarmasu ||3.4.90||
niyujya kramavāraṃ tān prāvartayaṃ kratuṃ tadā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||91||
anādiśrīyajñanārāyaṇo bhūtvā vyadhāpayam |
avabhṛthāntaṃ yajñaṃ taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sārvabhaumikam ||92||
adhvaro’haṃ manostasmād yayāce dakṣiṇāṃ tadā |
bhūyasīṃ yajñabhūmau vai maṇḍape vedikāntike ||93||
tadā tvaṃ kanyakā nāmnā bhūyasī dakṣiṇābhidhā |
prādurabhavaḥ kalyāṇi kanyakā vai madarthinī ||94||
manorjyotiṣmataḥ putrī nārāyaṇī hi bhūyasī |
adhvare’mbarabhūṣāḍhyā koṭisvarṇadhanānvitā ||95||
madyogyā yācamānāya mahyaṃ vai manunārpitā |
tata ārabhya tadvarṣe sahasrakalpakātmake ||96||
mayādiṣṭaprakāreṇādhvarāḥ sarve pravartitāḥ |
kalpāyuścābhavam̐statra tvayā sākaṃ mahādhvaraḥ ||97||
yajñanārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ cānādiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
avatārī svayaṃ svāmī parabrahma pareśvaraḥ ||98||
bhūyasī dakṣiṇānāmnī tvaṃ me patnī tadābhavaḥ |
smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tatkalpaṃ taṃ ca vatsaram ||99||
tato’nye me’vatārāśca tatrābhavan hi koṭiśaḥ |
vedmi sarvānahaṃ lakṣmi nānye smaranti tānapi || 3.4.1 00||
sarvayajñasvarūpo’smi sarve yajñā mayi sthitāḥ |
sarvayajñā mūrtayo me sarvayajñapravartakaḥ || 101 ||
bhoktā sarveṣu yajñeṣu sarvādhvaraphalapradaḥ |
sarvakriyākalāpajñaścāhaṃ bhavāmi cādhvare || 10 2||
tvāṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhāmi daive paitrye tathārṣake |
mānave vā vidhau lakṣmi dāne’rhaṇe ca pūjane || 10 3||
jape vrate krame jñāne sākaṃ tvayā vṛṣe’pi ca |
upatiṣṭhāmi deveśi śiveśvari na cānyathā || 104||
ityevaṃ cādhvaraṃ janma kathitaṃ vai tvayā saha |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi mahādhvaraphalaṃ bhavet || 1 05||
tavāpi smaraṇāllakṣmi bhūyasīdakṣiṇāphalam |
sampatsiddhirbhavedatra paratra mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 10 6||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaturthavatsare dhūmrāsuranāśārthaṃ candrarakṣārtham anādidevanārāyaṇasya, pañcamavatsare’dhvaratantusampādanārtham anādiyajñanārāyaṇasya ca prākaṭyamitinirūpaṇanāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<3.5>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe tāpasavatsare |
vedhaso’sya dvitīye kalpake ca prathame manau || 1 ||
prākaṭyaṃ tava rudrācca mamāpi brahmato’bhavat |
pratikalpaṃ trilokīnāmutpattistatra jāyate || 2 ||
utpādako’tra vai brahmā sāyaṃ saṃhārako haraḥ |
poṣaṇasya prakartā tu viṣṇustatra sadā mataḥ || 3 ||
kintu taṃ niyamaṃ tyaktvā rudro devo maheśvaraḥ |
brahmāṇamāha mā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru tvaṃ yat karomyaham || 4 ||
sāyaṃkālasya kāryaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa lokasaṃhṛtim |
na me tad rocate brahman saṃhārākhyaṃ hi karma yat || 5 ||
yogināṃ mādṛśānāṃ tanmahad duḥkhaṃ vivekinām |
saṃhṛtirnahi yogyā me hiṃsātmikātinirghṛṇā || 6 ||
satāṃ dharmo na vai hiṃsā paraduḥkhapradātṛtā |
paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutve mama hiṃsā na rocate || 7 ||
api kāyena manasā necchāmi parahiṃsanam |
kutaśca karmaṇā kurve pāpakṛt karma bhīṣaṇam || 8 ||
apadebhyaḥ sapadānāṃ hiṃsā pāpādhikānvitā |
sapadeṣvapi likṣāṇāṃ makṣikāṇāṃ tato’dhikā || 9 ||
caṭakānāṃ ca gṛdhrāṇāṃ garuḍānāṃ tato’dhikā |
śvādīnāṃ gomahiṣāṇāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tataḥ || 3.5.1 0||
nāgānāṃ ca piśācānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca tato’dhikā |
daityānāṃ rakṣasāṃ hiṃsā dānavānāṃ tato’dhikā || 11 ||
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ ca śvapākinām |
mānavānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca tato’dhikā || 12||
kanyakānāṃ kumārāṇāṃ bālānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā |
yogināṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ sādhūnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || 13||
sagarbhāṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ satīnāṃ ca tato’dhikā |
tīrthānāṃ cāpi caityānāṃ pratimānāṃ tato’dhikā || 14||
mandirāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca tato’dhikā |
mumukṣūṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ hiṃsā pāpādhikā tathā || 15||
yajñīyānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca tato’dhikā |
vedānāṃ cāpi śāstrāṇāṃ hiṃsanaṃ sarvato’dhikam || 16||
haryeśānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ hiṃsanaṃ ca tato’dhikam |
ityeṣāṃ pāpavistāro hiṃsātmā me na rocate || 17||
kariṣye’haṃ sarjanaṃ vai kuru tvaṃ vai visarjanam |
ciraṃ mayā kṛtaṃ visarjanaṃ tvayā prasarjanam || 18||
āyatau tvaṃ vidhehyeva visarjanaṃ na sarjanam |
ahaṃ sadā kariṣye sarjanaṃ na tu visarjanam || 19||
ityuktaśca tadā lakṣmi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
śaṃkaraṃ prāha mā maivaṃ tvādṛśo hiṃsako’smi na ||3.5.20||
śreṣṭhaṃ kāryaṃ vihāyaiva kaḥ kaniṣṭhe viśejjanaḥ |
brāhmaṇo’haṃ na tatkartuṃ śaknomyatra kadācana ||21 ||
rudrasya tava kāryaṃ tat krūrasya nirghṛṇasya ca |
brāhmaṇā dayayā yuktā na niṣādāḥ kadāpi vai || 22||
mayā naiṣādikaṃ kāryaṃ manasāpi na manyate |
jālaṃ pāśo ghātanaṃ ca kartanaṃ kūrcanaṃ tathā ||23||
vidalanaṃ rodhanaṃ ca naiṣādikaṃ hi tadbhavet |
dāhanaṃ bhedanaṃ cāpi peṣaṇaṃ prāṇakarṣaṇam ||24||
māraṇaṃ pāpakarmaitanme na śaṃbho prarocate |
nāhaṃ tatra kṛtaprajño bhavām̐stat kartumarhati ||25||
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro lakṣmi raudrabhāvamupāgataḥ |
asahamāno vākyāni jagrāha vedhasaṃ gale ||26 ||
nyapātayat kṣitau tatrottānaṃ vai vedhase haraḥ |
pādaṃ datvā balād vakṣasyeva śūlaṃ gale nyadhāt ||27||
hāhākāro mahānāsīttadā trailokyavāsiṣu |
brahmaṇo’dya vināśo vai bhaviṣyatīti menire ||28||
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā jaḍāśca cetanā api |
cakampire rudraroṣānmadhyasthaḥ ko’pi nāgamat ||29||
bhayaṃ gato’pi viṣṇuścānyasya tatra tu kā kathā |
brahmā sasmāra māṃ tatra trātāraṃ parameśvaram ||3.5.30||
akṣarānmama vai sthānāttūrṇaṃ tatra samāyayau |
tvayā sārdhaṃ tadā lakṣmi śūlaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā ||31||
tvamādiṣṭā praveṣṭuṃ ca hare śāntikarī satī |
hararoṣo’bhavacchāntastavāveśāttadā priye || 32||
vivedākāryamevaitannamro māṃ vīkṣya lajjitaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||33||
koṭisūryasamābhāsaṃ sarvābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam |
sarveśvaraṃ dhṛtaśūlaṃ brahmarakṣākaraṃ prabhum ||34||
akasmādāgataṃ śāntaṃ sarvāntaranivāsinam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ||35||
brahmaṇo vakṣasi nyastaḥ śaṃbhupādo mayā tadā |
śūlaṃ ca mama hastābhyāmuddhṛtau līlayā priye ||36||
śaṃbhuḥ papāta vegenottāno mama balāttadā |
pārśve patantaṃ śaṃbhuṃ taṃ devāścālambanaṃ daduḥ ||37||
rakṣa rakṣa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa pareśvara |
ajaṃ rakṣa haraṃ rakṣa rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāgatān ||38||
sarve vayaṃ tava bālāḥ poṣyā rakṣyāḥ sadā tvayā |
ityuktvā te nipeturme pādayordaṇḍavat tadā ||39||
puṣpādyairmānasairbhāvaiḥ pupūjurmāṃ dayābhṛtam |
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ brahmavakṣogataṃ harim ||3.5.40||
śaṃkaro’pi ca me bhakto prayayāce kṣamāpanam |
mayā śaṃbhubodhitaśca saṃhāre dūṣaṇaṃ na te ||41 ||
mama śaktisvarūpo’si kartāhaṃ tava rūpavān |
mayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ vijñavedhaḥsvarūpiṇā || 42||
mayā sampuṣyate sarvaṃ dātṛviṣṇusvarūpiṇā |
mayā saṃhriyate sarvaṃ hartṛharasvarūpiṇā ||43||
yo’haṃ so’haṃ haro viṣṇurbrahmā bhinnābhidhānvitaḥ |
pṛthagbhāvo na bhavatāṃ mama māyā durāsadā ||44||
tayā bhedaṃ gataścāhaṃ mamecchayaiva māyayā |
karomi bhedavat sarvaṃ vibhinnaṃ cetaro yathā ||45||
ajñānivacceṣṭayāmi līlā me sārvakālikī |.
tatra te dūṣaṇaṃ śaṃbho hiṃsādoṣātmakaṃ na vai ||46||
utpannaṃ syād vinaṣṭaṃ vai svabhāva eṣo vastunaḥ |
tatra draṣṭā bhavān rudro vināśe nyāyato mama ||47||
nimittāni pralayādyāḥ kālo yugā niśāstathā |
kālasīmā nimittaṃ vai mayā maryādayā kṛtā ||48||
tasmātte dūṣaṇaṃ śaṃbho saṃhāre nāsti sarvathā |
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro lakṣmi mayā svāsthyamupāgataḥ ||49||
kalahaṃ taṃ parityajya sadā saṃhāramānasaḥ |
sevate manniyogaṃ vai harate’nte yathoditam ||3.5.50||
athāhaṃ saṃvinīyaiva śaṃbhuṃ brahmasuto’bhavam |
anādiśrībrahmanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||51 ||
tvaṃ ca lakṣmi haradehānniṣkrāntā kanyakā tataḥ |
vaiṣṇavī rudraputrī vai mahyaṃ hareṇa cārpitā ||52||
ityevaṃ mama vai tatra prākaṭyaṃ ca tavāpyabhūt |
ākalpāntaṃ tataścāhaṃ brahmanārāyaṇo’vasam ||53||
tvayā sākaṃ hi vaiṣṇavyā nārāyaṇīśri tatsmara |
evamanye’pyavatārāḥ koṭiśastatra me’bhavan ||54||
na tān śaktāḥ prasaṃkhyātuṃ cānye māmantarā priye |
athānye vatsare cāpi prākaṭyaṃ mama saṃśṛṇu ||55||
yamākhye vatsare cādye kalpe cādye manau tathā |
devatānāṃ vivādo’bhūd dhiṣṇyārthaṃ svargavāsinām ||56||
ekaḥ prāha mahendrasya padaṃ bhokṣye’hameva ha |
cāparaśca tadā prāha sūryo’haṃ nāparo bhavet ||57||
tṛtīyaḥ prāha candro’haṃ turyaḥ prāha dhanī tvaham |
kaścit prāha jaleśo’haṃ kaścitprāha maruttvaham ||58||
vasuścāhaṃ devaguruścāhaṃ ceśānadevatā |
ahamagnirgaṇeśo’haṃ senānyahaṃ dhruvo’pyaham ||59||
merurmama divaṃ me’pi maruccāhaṃ bhavāmyapi |
yamaścāhamahaṃ viṣṇurbhavāmi śaṃkaro’pyaham ||3.5.60||
dikpālo’haṃ lokapālaḥ sādhyo’haṃ saṃbhavāmi vai |
viśvadevapadaṃ cāhaṃ bhokṣye pitṛpadaṃ tvaham ||61 ||
ityevaṃ vadamānānāṃ surāṇāṃ kalaho mithaḥ |
varivarti mahānevāśāmyaḥ kenāpi śāsinā | |62||
parasparaṃ tadā lakṣmi balino devasattamāḥ |
prasahyeṣṭapadānyeva svāyattokṛtya sarvathā ||63||
sthitavanto nirbalāśca nirādhārāstadābhavan |
andharājyaṃ yathā svargaṃ tatrābhavad balārjitam ||64||
sāttvikā devatāścendravasucandrādayastadā |
āndhyasya vāraṇārthaṃ vai mimilurvai gurorgṛhe ||65||
kathamāndhyaṃ nivartetetyevaṃ vicāraṇā vyadhuḥ |
brahmaṇo vāpi śaṃbhorvā viṣṇorvā vacanāni vai ||66||
amaryādā na manyante devā garvapravegitāḥ |
tasmādatra prakartavyaḥ sarveṣāṃ hitakṛd vidhiḥ ||67||
yathā suragururmārgaṃ darśayet kurma eva tam |
śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā devānāha suraguruḥ svayam ||68||
dyauḥ sadā devamātā vai devān garbhe prarakṣati |
seyaṃ mūrtimatī cāste kurmastat sā vadecca yat ||69||
viṣṇurnāma tathādityo rājate’tra sadasyapi |
yathā vadet tathā sarve kurmastadvacanaṃ hitam ||3.5.70 ||
ityuktau tau namaskṛtya devān sarvānupasthitān |
prāhaturnirṇaye cāndhye yogyau nāvāṃ tathāpi vaḥ ||71 ||
sūcayāvo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam |
ārādhayāmaścātraivādhikārapadada prabhum ||72||
sa eva nirṇayaṃ naśca dāsyatyevākṣarādhipaḥ |
yena sampālitaṃ sarvaṃ yena sannoditaṃ tvidam ||73||
yena sañcālitaṃ yāti sa no dāsyati nirṇayam |
yena ṛddhiḥ pradattā ca yathākarma yathāguṇam ||74||
yathāsthānaṃ yathaiśvaryaṃ yathādhiṣṇyaṃ padāni ca |
ārādhitaḥ samāgatya sa no dāsyati nirṇayam ||75||
ityuktāḥ sarvadevāste prasahya balavādinām |
śāsanārthaṃ sasmaruśca parabrahma sanātanam ||76||
akṣareśaṃ bhagavatāṃ bhagavantaṃ pareśvaram |
tūrṇaṃ cākṣaradhāmno’haṃ samāyāto mahāprabhuḥ ||77||
tvayā sākaṃ tadā nārāyaṇīśri pareśvaraḥ |
devaguroḥ sabhāyāṃ vai viṣṇvākhyādityasannidhau ||78||
divyo divyāmbarabhūṣo divyaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
koṭicandrārkarūpaśca sabhāmadhye vyavasthitaḥ ||79||
tvamādiṣṭā tadā lakṣmi dyutanau samavasthitā |
adṛśyā śāsayitrī tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇī ||3.5.80||
surā dṛṣṭvā tu māṃ sarveśvareśvareśvareśvaram |
praṇatāścāsanaṃ cāpi madhuparkaṃ dadustataḥ ||81||
kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐ścāhaṃ tebhyaste’pyanivedayan |
āndhyaṃ svarge pradhiṣṇyārthaṃ tacchāntiṃ cārthayannapi ||82||
mayā nārāyaṇīśri vai tadā sudarśanāni me |
samarthamuktarūpāṇi śāsakāni samantataḥ ||83||
krūrāṇi sāyudhānyeva prahitāni divi priye |
yatra yatra surāḥ santi paradhiṣṇyasthitāstadā ||84||
tām̐stānāhūya sarvān vai mama yuktāḥ sudarśanāḥ |
dhṛtvā dhṛtvā gurordvāraṃ samāninyurmadantike ||85||
mayā pṛṣṭāścāndhyapravartayitāraśca vai tadā |
nocuste lajjitāḥ kiñcit kṣamāṃ matto yayācire ||86||
daṇḍitā vai mayā sarve yamitāśca nije pade |
sthāpitāśca yathāyogye pade devā divi sthitāḥ ||87||
sarveṣāmadhikāre vai vyavasthā ca mayā kṛtā |
tadā tvaṃ ca mayādiṣṭā sarvaniyāmikā satī ||88||
paradhiṣṇyāyogyapātranirodhinī tadābhavaḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ ca mayā lakṣmi tadā tubhyaṃ samarpitam ||89||
dhiṣṇye dhiṣṇye tvayā tatra sthātavyaṃ sarvadā priye |
ayogyaścet samāgacchet prasahya padamuttamam ||3.5.90||
anyasyānyastadā lakṣmi tvayā kṣepyo vidūrataḥ |
tadārabhya hi deveṣu cānyapade’paraḥ kvacit ||9 1||
upaviṣṭaṃ samartho vai jāyate kṣipyate drutam |
evaṃ sarvapadeṣveva tvaṃ tadā saṃsthitā priye ||92||
ahaṃ putro’bhavaṃ viṣṇorādityasya tadā priyaḥ |
tvaṃ tataḥ kanyakā jātā dyugarbhā śrīrnarāyaṇī ||93||
dyāvā tadārpitā mahyaṃ tadā tvaṃ dyunarāyaṇī |
ahamāsaṃ tadā kalpe’nādyādityanarāyaṇaḥ ||94||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpatiracyutaḥ |
ākalpāntaṃ tadādityagṛhe’vasaṃ sutaḥ sadā ||95||
dyuputrī tvaṃ mama patnī devavīthī tadābhavaḥ |
ahaṃ smarāmi tatsarvaṃ smara tvaṃ devavīthikām ||96||
parabrahma svayaṃ cāhamabhavaṃ tatra vai sadā |
asaṃkhyā me’vatārāśca tatra varṣe’bhavannapi ||97||
evaṃ dhiṣṇyavivādaṃ vai tyaktvā devā yathoditam |
svasvadhiṣṇyaṃ gatāḥ sarve vivādapadavarjitāḥ ||98||
tadārabhya punarnaiva padārthaṃ yodhanaṃ kvacit |
babhūva tatra varṣe vai tathā kalpāntare’pi ca ||99||
mayā niyamitaṃ sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ sthāpitaṃ yathā |
tathaiva yāti sukhato viparītaṃ na vai kvacit ||3.5.1 0 0||
ityevaṃ te śivaputri prākaṭyaṃ kīrtitaṃ mama |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 1 01||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ṣaṣṭhavatsare rudraśāsanārtham anādibrahmanārāyaṇasya, saptamavatsare devānāṃ dhiṣṇyaniyamārtham anādyādityanārāyaṇasya, prākaṭyamiti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<3.6>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tato’pi cāṣṭame punaḥ |
ajasya niyamākhye vatsare kalpe tu pañcame || 1 ||
saptame tu manau vartamāne tatra tadāpyaham |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 2 ||
mānāvānāṃ sukhārthaṃ vai tadā prakaṭito’bhavam |
pātāle tvekadā nāgāḥ kāmarūpadharāḥ priye || 3 ||
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prīṇayituṃ mahārudraṃ pracakrire |
yajñe tatra mahārudre phaṇādhrāṇā kulāni vai || 4 ||
dvāpañcāśatsahasrāṇi saṃhatāni tadābhavan |
kṛṣṇā raktāstathā citrāḥ śvetāḥ śvitrāśca karburāḥ || 5 ||
nīlāḥ pītāśca haritāḥ svastikāścandrakāstathā |
paṭṭiśā dviphaṇāścāpi triphaṇāśca catuḥphaṇāḥ || 6 ||
śatānanāstathā nāgāḥ sahasraphaṇino’pare |
nāgarājāḥ karkaṭakāḥ śītalā ḍiṇḍimāstathā || 7 ||
bhūphiṇḍādyāḥ koḍiphāśca pāṇḍurāḥ paṇḍakāstathā |
śūlakā daṇḍakāścāpi dvimukhā divyacākṣuṣāḥ || 8 ||
oṃkārāstilavarṇāśca pāraḍaṅkāḥ kaṇāśanāḥ |
tiryagdhārāḥ sūtradhārā mudrapṛṣṭhā dvipṛṣṭhakāḥ || 9 ||
dvijihvā bahujihvāśca bahudaṃṣṭrā viṣālayāḥ |
kālakūṭāḥ samaṇayaḥ kārdamikāśca vārśayāḥ || 3.6.1 0||
ānalikāścānilakā mārucchrayāḥ sapakṣakāḥ |
ugrakāḥ śāntadāsāśca māhālasyā viḍambinaḥ || 11 ||
ityevaṃ bahujātīyāḥ kaṇādhrāḥ saṃhatāstadā |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ yajñadevaṃ nijeṣṭaṃ cānalānanam || 12||
ījire toṣayāmāsurmiṣṭāhutibhirutsukāḥ |
sahasradivasaṃ naijaṃ yajñaṃ niyamato vyadhuḥ || 13 ||
gurusteṣāṃ svastiko’bhūt śeṣo’bhūnnṛpatistadā |
agragaṇyo yajamānaścānye puṇyāśca ṛtvijaḥ || 14||
pātālīyāni miṣṭāni sāmudrāṇi rasāni ca |
phalānyāraṇyajanmāni pārthivānyadanāni ca || 15||
kaṇām̐śca sasyajām̐ścāpi kandām̐ścauṣadhiśākhinaḥ |
samidhaśca vividhā vai gundrāṇi vividhāni ca || 1 6||
bhūvikārāṇi sarvāṇi bhojyāni havyakāni ca |
vratādanāni yogyāni juhuvustatra cādhvare || 17||
saṃkarṣaṇo mahādevo nijamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ |
pātālīyasurāḍhyaśca gāruḍaiḥ surakoṭibhiḥ || 18||
surāṇībhiśca sahitastṛptiṃ parāṃ makhe yayau |
pratyakṣo’bhūd rudrarūpadharastatrāntime dine || 19||
pūrṇāhutau pāyasādyairvṛtaistilaiśca piṣṭakaiḥ |
miṣṭarasaiḥ kriyamāṇāyāṃ kaṭvoṣadhibhistadā ||3.6.20||
prasanno’smītyāha sarpān tṛpto’smīti punaḥ punaḥ |
varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ sukhino bhavantvityāha tānpunaḥ ||21 ||
tadā rājā prajādyāste sarpā yayācire tataḥ |
vayaṃ vai mānave loke bhavāmo rājyabhāginaḥ ||22||
karma kṛtvā prayāsyāmo muktiṃ svargaṃ paraṃ layam |
dehyevaṃ varadānaṃ cet prasanno’si sukarṣaṇaḥ ||23||
varayogyāḥ sma ca viṣṇo sakarṣaṇa nijeṣṭada |
saṃkarṣaṇo vicāryaiva kṣaṇāntare jagāda tān ||24||
āraṇyavāsāḥ satataṃ mahāraṇyanivāsinaḥ |
bhavantu rājyabhoktāraḥ pṛthvyāṃ surasabhoginaḥ |||25||
mā mānavān bhūnivāsānudvejayantu vai kvacit |
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā varaṃ dadāmi vo dvijāḥ ||26||
evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu bhavatsu sukhamuttamam |
bhaviṣyati sukhaṃ yāntvabhyudayaṃ satataṃ dvijāḥ ||27||
ityuktvā ca haviṣyānnaṃ pūrṇāhutisvarūpakam |
labdhvā saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ sasuro’dṛśyatāṃ yayau ||28||
atha nārāyaṇīśri vai tataste phaṇino’pi vai |
balino varadāne na satṛṣṇā mānave guṇe ||29|||
mānaveṣu ca bhogeṣu gṛdhgino mohamāritāḥ |
āyayurvāyuvivarairbhūlokaṃ vai samantataḥ ||3.6.3 0||
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve narā nāryo hi mānavāḥ |
sarpākṛtayo naivaiṣāṃ santi yadāgatā bhuvi ||31||
pracchannāste mānaveṣu vartante ca vasanti ca |
hartuṃ rājyāni bhogāṃśca kāpaṭyabhṛtyakarmiṇaḥ ||32||
sarvatra bhūtale te vai rūpasaundaryaśālinaḥ |
nāgāścāpi ca nāginyo’bhavan bhṛtyakriyāparāḥ ||33||
rājasu śreṣṭhiṣu vipravargeṣvamātyaseviṣu |
sattāvatsu pradhāneṣu gṛhiṣvapyavasam̐śca te ||34||
bhṛtyā dāsāstathā dāsyo bhūtvā varṇānukāriṇaḥ |
vivāhitāśca kanyā vai mitho mānavayonibhiḥ ||35||
samūhurmānavakanyā nāgāśca nararūpiṇaḥ |
evaṃ sambandhamāpannā labdhvāvasarameva te ||36||
daśanti sma narān rātrau nidrāvaśān kvacit kvacit |
mriyante saṃdaṃśitāśca nṛpā rājñyaśca sarvathā ||37||
śreṣṭhinaśca dhanāḍhyāśca sarve varṇeṣu sattamāḥ |
riktaṃ sthalaṃ ca sampattiṃ nijāṃ kṛtvā ca te tataḥ ||38||
bhuṃjate smoragāḥ kāmarūpadhrāḥ pṛthivīśvarāḥ |
saṃkarṣaṇasya vacanaṃ nānuṣṭhitaṃ hi tāmasaiḥ ||39||
svārthaparaiśchadmadharaiḥ pracchannabhogatatparaiḥ |
evaṃ tairmānavī sṛṣṭiḥ prāyaśo vai vināśitā ||3.6.40||
pracchannadaṃśadoṣaiśca nijasvārthaparāyaṇaiḥ |
nāgajātīyugaptāpi nijasṛṣṭirvivardhitā ||41 ||
mānavānāṃ kriyāḥ sarvā devārādhanamityapi |
luptaṃ luptaṃ yajñakāryaṃ sandhyā luptā tathāhutiḥ ||42||
śrāddhaṃ luptaṃ tathā dānaṃ damo luptaśca mānuṣaḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ gotrasaṃkalpāstathā luptāḥ samantataḥ ||43 ||
saṃskārā mānavā luptā udbhūtāścoragakriyāḥ |
vratāni cāpi luptāni luptamāvāhanādikam ||44||
arghaṃ luptaṃ raveścāpi vaiśvadevo layaṃ gataḥ |
pretakāryaṃ tathā luptaṃ devālayā nirarhaṇāḥ ||45||
kathāṃśāśca layaṃ prāptā viprā nṛpā mṛtāḥ khalu |
brahmacārinivāsāśca guruvāsā layaṃ gatāḥ ||46||
satyaḥ sādhvyo mṛtāścāpi māritā nāgakoṭibhiḥ |
sādhavo’pi mṛtāścāpyāvāsā grāmāḥ purāṇi ca ||47||
amānavāstu te jātā nāgakopaiḥ samantataḥ |
pravarāṇāṃ ca nāmāni layaṃ gatāni vāsiṣu ||48||
na jñāyante janaiścaitat kuta evaṃ vyajāyata |
atha devā yajñahīnāḥ pitarastṛptivarjitāḥ ||49||
śatavarṣe gate kāle’vicāryan samāhitāḥ |
kuta evaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhūtale’śubham ||3.6.50||
mānavānāṃ śataṃ varṣāṇāṃ gataṃ bhūtale’pi naḥ |
āmantraṇāvāhanādi naiva bhavati vai katham ||51 ||
dṛṣṭyā tu divyayā vīkṣya jñātavanto narā mṛtāḥ |
sarpā rājyāni kurvanti prajāḥ sarpātmikā api ||52||
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarpā nāginyo yoṣitaistathā |
iṣṭarūpapradhāriṇyo bhuñjate bhūmisampadaḥ ||53||
etajjātamaniṣṭaṃ vai dharmakarmavivarjitam |
tiryañcastāmasāḥ sarpāḥ pracchannachadmakāriṇaḥ ||54||
bhuñjate mānavān bhogān devarṣyunnatighātinaḥ |
mānavānāṃ bahudhā vai ghāto jātaḥ purādiṣu ||55||
vasatyādau na vidyante mānavāḥ phaṇino’ntarā |
araṇyādau pravidyante mānavā viralāḥ kvacit ||56||
te tvasmābhiścetanīyā nāgebhyo maraṇaṃ prati |
nāgānāṃ māraṇopāyān bodhanīyāśca pratyapi ||57||
ityabhimantrya kamale āyayuste bhuvastalam |
ilāvṛttaṃ madhyakhaṇḍaṃ cāraṇyānīsamanvitam ||58||
yatrāsate dvijāḥ śuddhāstvaraṇye sarpavarjitāḥ |
gāruḍāścāpyatharvajñā homakarmaparāyaṇāḥ ||59||
ṛṣīn devān pravilokya dvijāḥ svāgatamācaran |
madhuparkaṃ pradāyaivāgamane hetumityapi ||3.6.60||
jijñāsavaḥ samapṛcchan devāstadāvadannabhi |
vijānantu dvijāḥ sarve mānavā nāgakoṭibhiḥ ||61||
mṛtāḥ sarve viṣayogairmriyante’pi dine dine |
nāgā mānavarūpāste saṃkarṣaṇavarād bhuvi ||62||
samāgatya hi vartante mārayitvā tu mānavān |
bhuñjānā mānavān bhogān modante chadmavartinaḥ ||63||
dharmakarmārādhanāvāhanārhaṇārpaṇādikam |
daivaṃ paitryaṃ tathā sauryaṃ viniṣṭaṃ karma jātakam ||64||
bhavanto’raṇyavāsāśca jīvantīti hareḥ kṛpā |
yatra nāgā na cāyatā diṣṭyā yūyaṃ hi jīvatha ||65||
nāgānāṃ māraṇopāyānātharvaṇagatān manūn |
japitvā nāgasṛṣṭīnāṃ bhūmau kurvantu saṃkṣayam ||66||
nāgayajñaṃ prakurvantu sārvabhaumā dvijāstviha |
ārādhayantu lokeśaṃ parameśaṃ kratau tathā ||67||
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
nijarakṣāṃ prakurvantu drāvayantūragānitaḥ ||68||
ityuktvā pitaro devāḥ prayayurnijamandiram |
vipra|ścerāvṛtakhaṇḍasthitā yajñaṃ pracakrire ||69||
tatra gāruḍasaṃjño vai niṣṇāto’tharvakarmasu |
hotābhavat tadā yajñe’nye viprā havanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||3.6.70||
atha sarpāḥ patantyeva na ca yajñe vikarṣitāḥ |
asamarthāstu te mantrā ūcurviprān samāhitāḥ ||71||
ārādhayantu deveśeśvareśvareśvareśvaram |
sa vai yuṣmaddhitaṃ viprāḥ kariṣyati pareśvara ||72||
ityuktāste drutaṃ lakṣmi brahmasatraṃ pracakrire |
gāruḍākhyadvijasyaiva guhe sahasrabhūsurāḥ ||73||
tatra tūrṇaṃ hariścāyādakṣarādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
yo’haṃ so’haṃ tvayā sākaṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||74||
gāruḍasya gṛhamadhye paśyatāṃ dvijayoginām |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo mantraiḥ prasevitaḥ ||7 ||
mūrtimadbhistathā vedairyuktastatrābhavaṃ puraḥ |
vīkṣyotthāya dvijā mahyaṃ nemuḥ svāgatamācaran ||76||
āsanaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca daduḥ pādyaṃ samarhaṇam |
sarve nivedayāmāsuḥ kaṣṭaṃ mānavanāśanam ||77 ||
ahaṃ svastītyuvācaitān gataṃ bhayaṃ ca vo’dhunā |
kurvantu sarpasatraṃ vai niyuñjantu manūnimān ||78||
ityuktā gāruḍā viprā mama vākyena noditāḥ |
nāgasatraṃ vyadhustūrṇaṃ jagurmantrān phaṇāhanaḥ ||79 ||
ommāmarttyasadorvvimartyasadovvisa
rpiṇo’thāpyasarpiṇoggarasañjuṣaḥ |
ommiṣammṛtaṅkalmaṣiṇo’mbhūjuṣiṇo’nvabhujino’vapatantviha havīṃṣi juhma om ||3.6.80||
omvviṣasiṇo danntaggāriṇo nnṛhaṇino’nṛjusariṇoddharmahaṇo vvappatantviha |
oṃ śatarasraviṇo’bdhirasraviṇo’pyanugkṣaranntviha
rauddrakārcciṣṣu vvāpatanntviha ||81 ||
oṃ śammṛtijuṣo’timmṛtijuṣotiphphaṇijuṣo’tippuṣijuṣovvābhippatanntviha |
ombhūtiñjuṣo’tinnatiñjuṣo’śchadmañjuṣo’dhippatiñjuṣombhitaṣpatanntviha ||82||
itimantrāñjagustatra gāruḍā bhūsurāstadā |
juhuvuḥ krūrabījādyairnāgānāmantrya mantrakaiḥ ||83 ||
āsamudrāntabhūbhāgādāgatyāgatya cāmbarāt |
nāgāḥ patanti kuṇḍe vai tadā kṣveḍānalolbaṇe ||84||
sahasraśo mṛtā dagdhāḥ śeṣā baddhāśca rajjubhiḥ |
mantrabaddhā na vai śaktāścātmānaṃ moktumeva te ||85||
atha baddho’nantaśeṣastuṣṭāva māṃ pareśvaram |
rakṣa nātha kṛpāsindho mocayāsmān mahānalāt ||86||
sthāsyāmo na kṣitau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara |
śaraṇe patitām rakṣa jīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ ||87||
anantaśeṣo bhakto’smi sadā te’haṃ janārdana |
ityukto’haṃ tadā prāhānantaṃ bhūsthān phaṇādharān ||88||
sarvajātīyanāgām̐stvaṃ nītvā yāhi hyadhastalam |
mā punaścātra vai loke mānave svapadaṃ kuru ||89||
ityuktaḥ svīcakāraiva sarvaṃ mayā pramocitaḥ |
sarpāḥ sarve mocitāśca mṛtyumukhāddhi gāruḍāt ||3.6.90 ||
ananto mama bhaktaśca pupūja māṃ pareśvaram |
tadā tvaṃ jānakījanye śeṣaputrī tadābhavaḥ ||91 ||
ānantī tvaṃ ca śeṣeṇārpitā mahyaṃ hi dakṣiṇā |
tadātharvaṇagāruḍadvijaputrāya śārṅgiṇe ||92||
rakṣiṇe nāgasarpāṇāṃ śrīśāya paramātmane |
atha yajño niyamito mayā parihṛtastadā ||93||
śeṣaḥ sarpakulānyeva sarvabhūtalagāni vai |
nītvā yayau bilānyeva pātālākhyāni vai tadā ||94||
mānavo’yaṃ tato loko garahīno mayā kṛtaḥ |
athelāvṛttakhaṇḍasthān mānavān sarvabhūmiṣu ||95 ||
avāsayaṃ cākaravaṃ bahuvaṃśayutām̐stathā |
punarvai mānavaṃ varṣaṃ mānavaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ tataḥ ||96 ||
daivapaitryaparāḥ sarve mama yogena bhūsurāḥ |
babhūvurbahuvijñāśca svastimantaśca devatāḥ ||97||
anādiśrīgarutmannārāyaṇo’haṃ tadābhavam |
ānantī tvaṃ mama patnī śeṣakanyā tadābhavaḥ ||98||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
avatārī svayaṃ tatra prākaṭyaṃ kṛtavān mama ||99||
tato’vatārā bahavastadvarṣe brahmaṇo’bhavan |
vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitat smarānanti purābhavam || 3.6.10 0||
bhūloke mānavānāṃ vai tadā rakṣā mayā kṛtā |
tvayā sākaṃ tataścākalpāntaṃ sthiro’bhavam̐stataḥ ||1 01 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya kīrtanātsmaraṇādapi |
nāgabhīrjāyate naiva bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 10 2||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭamavatsare sarpāṇāṃ śāsanārtham bhūmāvanādigarutmannārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamitinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

<3.7>
atha nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ samākarṇaya matkathām |
daityānāṃ pāvanīṃ ramyāṃ sutalābhinivāsinām || 1 ||
brahmaṇaścāsanākhye vatsare vai navame purā|
kalpe caturdaśe cādye manau sutalake tale || 2 ||
āsīd rājā calavarmā sārvabhaumo mahābalaḥ |
atalasya vitalasya sutalasya janeśvaraḥ || 3 ||
trilokyāṃ yasya vai yānaṃ vyomagaṃ tvabhavattadā |
atalasya vitalasya sutalasya prajā janāḥ || 4 ||
caladevaṃ pupūjurvai pratyakṣaṃ rakṣakaṃ nṛpam |
rājāpi dharmavānāsīt prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 5 ||
mama bhakto śivakanye devapūjāparāyaṇaḥ |
anāthātithinārīṇāṃ śaraṇyaḥ śīlaśobhanaḥ || 6 ||
dinārdhe yasya nityaṃ vai yāti devasya pūjane |
tadardhaṃ ca tato yāti rājyāvalokane tataḥ || 7 ||
śeṣārdhaṃ nijalokeṣu pravāse yāti sarvadā |
evaṃ kṛtavatastasya jijñāsābhūttapomayī || 8 ||
karmabhūmau tapaḥ śīghraṃ phalatyayutadhā yataḥ |
pṛthvyāṃ gatvā tapaḥ kāryaṃ vicāryeti vimānagaḥ || 9 ||
ṛṣyārṣe sadguruṃ pṛṣṭvā rājyaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ sa ca |
kṛtvā tu gurusād rājā prāyayau mānavīkṣitau || 3.7.10 ||
kumudācalamāsādya śītavyāpte vane sadā |
tapastepe nirāhāraḥ sahasravatsarāṇi saḥ || 11 ||
tatra tapasi rājāsau divyadṛṣṭyā vyalokayat |
nārāyaṇaṃ pareśānaṃ devaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 2||
māmeva paramātmānaṃ natvovāca manogatam |
namaste parameśāya tapaḥphalapradāyine || 1 3||
bhaktamānasapūrāya haraye paramātmane |
ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre papau maccaraṇāmṛtam || 14||
yayāce preryamāṇaśca mayā calanṛpastadā |
acalatvaṃ dehi me’tra calaṃ tu nāśameti vai || 15||
calaṃ rājyaṃ calaṃ vittaṃ calaṃ kuṭumbakaṃ tathā |
calaṃ ca jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇa sutalādi calaṃ tataḥ |
acalatvaṃ vṛṇe tvatto bhakto’haṃ dehi me matam || 1 6||
śrīparameśvara uvāca 
śṛṇu rājan calaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ calamityapi |
kālaścalaścalā māyā calaṃ manaśca jīvanam || 17||
cale bhavet calaṃ sarvaṃ hyacalaṃ te mataṃ vada |
śrīcaladeva uvāca 
calaṃ cittaṃ calā lakṣmīścalaṃ śāsanamityapi || 18||
acalā tava bhaktirhi tāṃ vṛṇe dehi me prabho |
acalāyāstataḥ pātramacalaṃ syāṃ ca keśava || 1 9||
śrīparameśvara uvāca 
acalā me premabhaktiḥ sevā sā premapūrvikā |
tatpātramacalaṃ tvaṃ ced bhavituṃ vai samicchasi ||3.7.20 ||
tadā muktirmama loke te dadāmyacalāṃ dhruvām |
gṛhāṇa śīghraṃ me mantraṃ yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||2 1 ||
śrīcaladeva uvāca 
calo’haṃ cācalo jātaścedānīṃ kṛpayā tava |
acalasyācalo vaṃśo bhavedevaṃ vidhehi me ||22||
śrīparameśvara uvāca 
yathā tvamacalo jāto matkṛpāṃśāttathā tava |
vaṃśo’pyacalatāṃ rājan madyogāt samprayāsyati || 23 ||
anapatyo bhavānāste sāpatyo bhava bhūpate |
māṃ vinā tu calaṃ sarvaṃ tavāpatyaṃ bhavāmyaham || 24||
acalo’haṃ tavāpatyaṃ bhavāmyatra vilokaya |
ityuktvāhaṃ tadā lakṣmi tasya vai mānasaḥ sutaḥ || 25|||
abhavaṃ tvārṣadevākhyo rājātitoṣaṇaṃ yayau |
tapaḥ samāpayitvaiva nītvā nṛpaṃ mayā saha || 26||
sutalaṃ tatra ṛṣyāryo gururmā jñātavān prabhum |
madājñayāpi lakṣmi tvam ṛṣyārṣasya sutābhavaḥ || 27||
rājā svaṃ mānasaṃ putraṃ tvārṣadevaṃ vidhānataḥ |
rājye’bhyaṣecayat ṛṣyārṣo’pi sutāṃ dadau sa me || 28||
ārṣapadmābhidhā tvaṃ cāsevayaḥ śrīpatiṃ ca mām |
ārṣadevaṃ cāvatāriprabhuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 29||
pālanārthaṃ vacanasya mayāpi mānasaḥ sutaḥ |
viṣṇureva svayaṃ putrarūpeṇa prakaṭīkṛtaḥ || 3.7.3 0||
dṛḍhadhruvābhidhaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāsumāyudhaḥ |
jātamātro yuvā viṣṇurekhaiśvaryādiśobhanaḥ || 31 ||
acale vai pade cordhve svargānte viniyojitaḥ |
padādhāraṃ jagatāṃ vai grahāṇāṃ jyotiṣāṃ tathā ||32||
nakṣatrāṇāṃ tārakāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalāni ca |
bhramanti sma diśāṃ dhrauvyād dhruvanāmnā dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ||33||
caladevo mayā nārāyaṇīśri preṣito’kṣaram |
acalaṃ cāvyayaṃ dhāma pālitaṃ madvaco mayā || 34||
acalo’haṃ tathānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sutaḥ |
parabrahma svayaṃ cānādyārṣanārāyaṇābhidhaḥ || 35 ||
mama putraḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurdṛḍhadhruvābhidhastathā |
ākalpāntaṃ tvacalo’pi mayā kṛto vacobalāt || 36 ||
evaṃ vai bhūtale lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ me purābhavat |
rājyaṃ ca sutale loke putrasya tu divopari ||37||
tadā tvam ṛṣyārṣaputrīṃ cārṣapadmāṃ nijāṃ smara |
prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ cārṣanārāyaṇi prabhormama ||38||
tataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prākaṭyaṃ me śṛṇu priye |
atha lakṣmi mama vaṃśe dṛdadhruvasya va sutaḥ ||35 ||
thurānandātmakaścāsīd bhaktarāṭ tāpaso muniḥ |
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ vaiṣṇavo manukālikam ||3.7.40 ||
prasanno bhagavān brahmā varadānaṃ dadau tadā |
mā tapaḥ kuru rājendra varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ||41 ||
ityukto brahmaṇā prāha tava varṣadvayāyuṣam |
sahasradvayakalpātmajīvanaṃ māṃ ciraṃ kuru ||42||
tathāstviti dadau vedhā varadānaṃ thurāya ha |
thurānando’pi bubhuje satyaloke yathāyatham ||42 ||
divārātrivimiśraṃ vai varṣadvayāyureva ha |
navame vatsare dvedhā varṣadvayāyuridgatam ||44||
sahasrakalpā divasā niśāḥ sahasrakalpikāḥ |
athaivaṃ daśame prāpte vatsare prāṇarodhane ||45 ||
vedhasaścāpi divase kalpe caturdaśe tadā |
manau ca prathame tatra thurānandasya vai priye ||46 ||
brahmavarṣadvayakālo gato rātridivādibhiḥ |
so’pi jātismarastatra punaścārabdhavām̐stapaḥ ||47||
trilokīnāṃ hi rājyārthaṃ sa ca devairnivāritaḥ |
satyalokādṛṣibhiśca janādibhyaśca pitṛbhiḥ ||48||
divaḥ surairmānavaiśca bhūtalād vinivāritaḥ |
yayau tapo’rthamatalaṃ satkṛto dānavaistadā ||49||
daityaiśca satkṛtaścāpi satkṛtaścāsurairapi |
tapaścacāra raudraṃ vai rudramārādhayanmakhe ||3.7.5 0 ||
mastakaṃ netrasahitaṃ juhāva kuṇḍage’nale |
rudrastāvattatra sākṣādabhavad divyabhāsuraḥ ||51 ||
vada kiṃ rocate te’tra vṛṇu sarvaṃ dadāmi te |
thurānandastadā prāhāvadhyatvaṃ dehi me prabho ||5 2||
haraḥ prāha vinā kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma sanātanam |
avadhyatvaṃ tava jātaṃ lagnaṃ bhavatu te śiraḥ ||5 3 ||
ityuktaḥ sa thurānando dhruvaputro’tiharṣitaḥ |
parihāraṃ tapasaśca pracakre svādhvarasya ca ||54||
atha rājāpi cādātuṃ prasthānaṃ dānavānvitaḥ |
cakre bhuvaṃ divaṃ satyaṃ daityāsurasamanvitaḥ ||55||
yatra yatrābhavadrājyābhiṣiktaṃ padamuttamam |
sattāśritaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ cānyalokinām ||56||
tām̐stān sattāvataḥ sarvān vijitya yuddhadurmadaḥ |
nijāśritān vaśān kṛtvā tattatpadeṣu dānavān ||57||
daityānasurān svavaśān nṛpatīnabhyaṣecayat |
bhūtale sarvakhaṇḍeṣu nṛpā daityāśca dānavāḥ ||58 ||
sattādhīśā asurāścābhavan prajāprapīḍakāḥ |
dharmakarmavihīnāśca bhraṣṭācārasamanvitāḥ ||5 9 ||
aśīlāḥ kāmakārāśca hiṃsādaurātmyasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
ayajñaśīlāḥ bhoktāro’bhavan prajādhanasya te || 3.7.6 0||
tīrthadānārhaṇariktā vipathā brahmavarjitāḥ |
surā api ca pitaro maharṣayaśca tadbhayāt || 61 ||
duḥkhitā abhavan sarve mānavā rākṣasārditāḥ |
thurānando’pi sarveṣu lokeṣu tvasurānvitaḥ ||6 2||
vimānena prayātyevoddhoṣayatyeva sarvathā |
māṃ yajantu mānayantvārādhayantu janādhipam || 63||
parameśaṃ ca māṃ sākṣānmatvārpayantu copadāḥ |
yajñe māṃ pūjayantveva devatāyataneṣvapi || 64||
gaṇeśasya sthale māṃ ca pūjayantu sadā janāḥ |
āharantu karaṃ mahyaṃ kīrtayantu guṇānmama ||65 ||
paśyantu matpratimāṃ copacārānarpayantu me |
prātargṛhṇantu mannāma viṣṇuścāhaṃ na cetaraḥ || 66||
thurānando thurānando thurānando raṭantviti |
thurānande mahānando brahmānando miliṣyati || 67||
thuro’haṃ brahmasaṃjño’smi thure māyā na vidyate |
thuraṃ prāpya ca saṃsevya kaṣṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavet sadā || 68 ||
māṃ thuraṃ māthuraṃ labdhvā bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā |
astyahaṃ yogināṃ rājā pitṝṇāṃ dyusadāṃ tathā || 69 ||
mānavānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca daityānāṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā |
vasūnāṃ ca nidhīnāṃ ca dikpālānāṃ nṛpo’smyaham ||3.7.70 ||
samudrāṇāmaraṇyānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ nṛpo’smyaham |
ityajasya prāṇarodhākhye varṣe daśame tathā ||71 ||
kalpe caturdaśe tatra manau ca prathame nṛpaḥ |
balavānabhavad rājā daityadānavapūjitaḥ ||72 ||
atha bhaktaḥ prajā devāḥ pitaro munayaḥ striyaḥ |
satyaśca sādhavo māmārādhayāmāsurīśvari ||73 ||
pracchannāḥ svagṛhe svasvahṛdayeṣu samāhitāḥ |
tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīhariṃ māṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ mānavādayaḥ ||74||
hare nātha kṛpāsindho dīnabandho janārdana |
adharmārdana daityānāmantakṛt parameśvara ||79 ||
rakṣa rakṣa hare kṛṣṇānādinārāyaṇa prabho |
parabrahmāntarātmam̐stvaṃ rakṣa no dānavārditān ||76||
ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ cakrurbahudhā sarvadehinaḥ |
tadāhaṃ saṃvicāryaiva thurānandasya karma tat ||97||
varadānāntamevāpi tvayā sākaṃ samāgamam |
bhūtale mānave loke meroḥ paścimakhaṇḍake ||78||
nāmnā bhāmantake khaṇḍe samprajñānadvijālaye |
viśokānāmapatnyāstu sannidhau darśanāttadā ||79||
prāvirāsaṃ bālarūpaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ |
cakravajraśaktiśūladaṇḍapāśadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||3.7.8 0 ||
aṣṭabāhurhariḥ so’haṃ parabrahmanarāyaṇaḥ |
ujjvalaḥ koṭikāmordhvaprabhāvān kuśalo mṛdhe ||8 1 ||
sarvāstramantravidvijño brahmabhāvaparāyaṇaḥ |
tadā tvaṃ ca samādiṣṭā mayā lakṣmi drutaṃ gatā ||8 2||
thurānandālaye naijaṃ prākaṭyamāptumīśvarī |
thurānandasya putrī tvaṃ jātamātrā tu mānasī |||8 3||
jyotsnākumārikānāmnī sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā |
abhavaśca svayaṃvarayogyā nṛpālaye tadā ||84||
rājā svayaṃvarākhyaṃ ca samājaṃ kṛtavān kṣitau |
bhāmantake mahākhaṇḍe trilokyāhvānamācarat ||85||
svayaṃvarasya tatraiva maṇḍapo devamaṇḍapaḥ |
indrapurīsamastena nṛpeṇa kāritastadā ||8 6||
nirṇīte divase tatrāyayurdaityāśca dānavāḥ |
rājānaḥ pārthivāḥ pātālādhipāśca divo’dhipāḥ ||87||
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ dikpālā lokapālinaḥ |
āyayurmaṇḍape tatra jyotsnākumārikāṃkṣayā ||88 ||
samājo’bhūccārbudānāṃ rājñāṃ tatra nṛpālaye |
jyotsnā śṛṃgāritā śreṣṭhe muhūrte varamālikām ||89||
nītvā bandhubhirutkṛṣṭāyudhavedibhirānvitā |
yathārthajyotsnikā kanyā sarvākarṣaṇakāriṇī ||3.7.90 ||
suparicārayitryā ca kulaśuddhijñayoṣitā |
guruṇā cāpi vipreṇa yuktā maṇḍapamāyayau || 91 ||
lokottarasvarūpā tvaṃ samājajāḍyakāriṇī |
mugdhaḥ sarvaḥ samātstvāṃ vilokyākṣaravāsinīm || 92||
na dṛṣṭā na śrutā kvāpi kanyedṛśī mamāstviyam |
ityevaṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tatra hṛdayānyabhavan kṣaṇam ||93||
apūrṇarūpayogānāṃ bhagnānyāsan manāṃsi vai |
pūrṇānāmapi sandehāspadānyāsan manāṃsi vai ||94||
tava kāntyā tadā lakṣmi samājo’rbudabhūbhatām |
nistejā iva nikaṭe’bhavattatra kṣaṇāntare || 95 ||
svargasyāpi tu rājāno prabhagnāśāstadābhavan |
nāsmān variṣyatīyaṃ vai svāyogyān rūpavarjitān || 96||
ityevaṃ caiṣaṇāhīnāstadānyeṣāṃ tu kā kathā |
atha tvaṃ gopuraṃ gatvā natvā gopuradevatām || 97||
praviṣṭā maṇḍapaṃ divyamārgeṇa svarṇaśobhinā |
dṛṣṭavatī ca rājanyaṃ śrutavatī ca vṛddhayā || 98||
alabdhahṛcchayā tatrālagnacittā punaḥ punaḥ |
vāratrayaṃ bhramitvaiva maṇḍapaṃ vīkṣya sarvataḥ ||99||
adṛṣṭvā māṃ varamālāyutā gopuramāgatā |
tatrāhamabhavaṃ vipro’labdhapraveśa eva ha || 3.7.100 ||
daridraḥ pītadhautraśca pītakañcuka eva ca |
saveṣṭanaśirā vipraḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣiko yuvā || 101 ||
rūpasaundaryayuktaśca sūkṣmasarvāyudhānvitaḥ |
daityasaṃhārakṛtsūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ pracchādya cāgataḥ || 1 02||
kṛtacandrastathā bhāle kare tu japamālikaḥ |
pādayoḥ pāduke bibhran lokavilakṣaṇo’bhavam || 103 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso navamavatsare caladevavaṃśe dhruvasyācalatārtham anādyārṣanārāyaṇasya, daśamavatsare dhruvadevaputrasya thurānandasya dānavardhitasya parābhavārtham anādiprājñanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyaṃ jyotsnākumārikālakṣmyāḥ svayaṃvaraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptamo’dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

<3.8>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
tvayā lakṣmi tato vīkṣya kāntaṃ purātanaṃ nijam |
varamālā mama kaṇṭhe’rpitā rājñāṃ prapaśyatām || 1 ||
sarvaḥ samājaścakito mahāścaryaparo’bhavat |
aho vipro rājakanyāṃ prāptavānityabhūt svanaḥ || 2 ||
daridrāya gatā kanyā bhāgyahīnāya bhikṣiṇe |
asamānasamastāya gatā kanyā tu mṛtyave || 3 ||
aho rājagṛhe janma bhāgyaṃ dāridryaduḥkhadam |
kalpavallī kāṃcanābhā bhallukakaragābhavat || 4 ||
sauvarṇapadminī ramyā patitā śuṣkakardame |
sthalapadmātmikā mālā vānarasya gale gatā || 5 ||
svātisalilayugvidyut patitā śuṣkaparvate |
lakṣmīrdivyā rājayogyā daridre patitādhunā || 6 ||
kaumudī candramutsṛjya kṣudratārakamāśritā |
prabhā sūryaṃ parityajya śūnyamambaramāśritā || 7 ||
vidyā santaṃ vihāyaiva vaitaṇḍikamadhiśritā |
dyaurmahendraṃ parityajya nairṛtaṃ samupāśritā || 8 ||
kāntiḥ kāntaṃ parityajya bhrāntivad bhrāntamāśritā |
satī satyaṃ vihāyaiva māyayā māyinaṃ gatā || 9 ||
jaṭā śaṃbhuṃ parityajya vaṭastambaṃ pravalgitā |
gaṃgā viṣṇupadaṃ tyaktvā kṣārasāgaramāgatā || 3.8.10 ||
bhakti dharmaṃ parityajya duḥśīlaṃ samupāgatā |
śayyā yugalaṃ santyajya vidhuraṃ samanusṛtā || 11 ||
siṃhikā siṃhamutsṛjya śūkaraṃ samupāgatā |
kariṇī hastinaṃ tyaktvā geṇḍukaṃ paśumāśritā || 1 2||
sarīsṛpaṃ gatā tyaktvā śeṣaṃ nāgaṃ hi nāginī |
kalgirvai mukuṭaṃ tyaktvā yātā cirpaṭaveṭanam || 1 3||
aho bhāgyasya balitā rājñī vāggharimāśritā |
naivaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ purā kvāpi dṛśyante na janaiḥ kvacit || 14||
divyā cintāmaṇimālā kukkurakaṇṭhamāhitā |
manyāmahe janāścaitad daivenāsyāḥ kṛtaṃ kila || 15||
yadvā samājamālakṣyābhibhūtā kanyakā yataḥ |
tejobhirvai samājasya bhānahīnākarodidam || 1 6||
anabhīṣṭaṃ hi tajjātaṃ kanyayā neṣyate khalu |
yadvā kanyā na jānāti māleyaṃ varamālikā || 17||
sādhāraṇīṃ samālakṣya daridrāya samarpitā |
varamālā harikāṇāṃ dvitīyā vā bhaviṣyati || 18||
iyaṃ tu viprapūjārthaṃ matā vā kanyakā nviti |
tasmāt kanyā daridrāya na deyā satsu rājasu || 19||
yadvā rājā dadatyasmai hariṣyāmo vayaṃ tu tām |
svayaṃvare’pi sampanne yuddhādhīnā hi kanyakā ||3.8.20||
yodhayitvā satī ratnaṃ prāpsyāmo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ityevaṃ bahudhā tatra vadanti sma nṛpādayaḥ ||21 ||
kanyāyā janakaścāpi kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ jagāma ha |
vīkṣya kanyā daridrāya gateti jvaramāpa ha ||22||
novācāpi tadā kiñcid bhāgyaṃ matvā sutākṛte |
rājā tu vidhivad dātuṃ samicchati varāya vai ||23||
tāvad rājñī guruścāpi vṛddhā nyaṣedhayannṛpam |
rājan mā kṣiprakāryatra bhavān bhavatu maṇḍape ||24||
ayogyaṃ cedamāpannaṃ kanyā bhrāntā yato’sti vai |
yadvā vicittabhāvāsti mānasasthairyavarjitā ||25||
tasmānmālā punardeyā svayaṃvarārthameva ha |
rājā vākyaṃ samādṛtya tathāstviti jagāda tān ||26||
atha rājanyavargo’pi mene yogyaṃ tu tattathā |
kanyā pṛṣṭā muhuścaitadviṣaye janakādibhiḥ ||27||
novāca sā tadā kiñcid rameśeṅgitavedinī |
vipraṃ rājā tadā gatvā kṛtvā dūraṃ ca kanyakām ||28||
nītvāyayau maṇḍapaṃ ca datvā mālāṃ parāṃ punaḥ |
kanyā vihṛtya sarvatra maṇḍape karamālikā ||29||
evameva samāste sā kasmaicinnārpayatyapi |
na sā vakti na vānyaṃ sā paśyati nāpi cecchati ||3.8.30||
āsurāṇāṃ vināśasya miṣaṃ cintayatīva sā |
athāha tu tadā lakṣmi gopuraṃ tvāṃ samāgatām ||31||
samālāṃ māmakīṃ matvā kare gṛhītavān balāt |
