yatra bhaktyāgamastatra dharmāgamo’pi vai dhruvaḥ |
jñānavairāgyayoścāpyāgamaśca sampadāṃ dhruvaḥ || 43 ||
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadbhiḥ sahopapadyate |
tatra lakṣmīśca kamalā śrīḥ siddhiḥ śāśvatī dhruvā ||44||
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastatra yajñā vratāni ca |
tapāṃsi cāpi sarvāṇi surāḥ sarve’pi tatra ca ||45 ||
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sadbhirbhuṃkte phalajalādikam |
tatra vai bhuṃjate devāḥ pitaraśca jagattrayam ||46 ||
adya vai vanavāso nau sādhvorāgamakāraṇāt |
saphalaḥ khalu sañjāto rājyādhiko’pi modadaḥ ||47||
adya nau tvanapatyatvaṃ vilīnaṃ satprasevanāt |
adya nau nirdhanatvaṃ ca mahatyarthe phalapradam ||48||
adya nau jīvanaṃ jātaṃ sārthakaṃ suprajīvanam |
adya nau mānasau bhāvau pūritau niścitau tviha ||49 ||
manyāvahe’dya kālo’pi pavitratāṃ prayāsyati |
śakunāni śubhānyeva jāyante bhavadāgamāt ||3.15.50 ||
sphuranti śubhabodhāni cāṅgāni nau tvadāgamāt |
vasatāmatra pūjyau vai sevayiṣyāva ādarāt ||51 ||
satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena taranti dehino’bhavam |
vane ca nirjane cātra bhavadvāsena śobhanaḥ ||52||
satsaṃgo modajanako naḥ pratyahaṃ bhaviṣyati |
eṣā bakulavṛkṣādhobhāge vai parṇaśālikā ||53||
bhavadbhyāmarpitā ramyā śītātapanivāraṇī |
āvāṃ tvanyāṃ kariṣyāvaḥ kuṭiṃ svāśrayadāyinīm ||54||
ityuktvā viprayugalaṃ patitaṃ pādayorhi nau |
mayoktaṃ ca tadā tābhyāṃ kuśalaṃ bhavatoḥ sadā ||55||
nirāmayaṃ cābhyudayaḥ sukhamastu ca śāśvatam |
āvāṃ vanecarau svo’tra naikasthānanivāsinau ||56||
nirbandhanau sarvavāsau guptakuṭinivāsinau |
bhavadvidhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ tu samāgame ||57||
daivecchayā jāyamāne tiṣṭhāvo gopradohanam |
tathāpīśvarabhaktānāṃ nirmalānāṃ tapasvinām ||58||
gṛhe sañjāyate kvāpi pakṣapāto hi nau mudhā |
premṇātithyaṃ gṛhītaṃ ca gṛhītaṃ svāgataṃ tathā |||5 9 ||
ājñāṃ prāpya gamiṣyāvo vanāntaraṃ ca vo’stu śam |
tadā tau cāśrūṇi muktvā prāhaturnau mudānvitau ||3.15.60 ||
kuṭiryatra satāṃ saṃgaḥ sā kuṭirna tu pārṇikī |
vāso yatra satāṃ yogaḥ sa vāso na tu bhūmigaḥ ||6 1 ||
jīvanaṃ ca saha sadbhirjīvanaṃ na tu bhojanam |
sukhaṃ sevā satāṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ nāparaṃ śubham ||62||
āvāṃ sādhusvarūpau svo yāsyāvo’nubhavatpadam |
yadvātra kurutāṃ vāsaṃ sevālābho hi nau bhavet ||63 ||
bhavadāgamane vṛkṣā modante vanapakṣibhiḥ |
bhavadāgamane vallyo vikāsante supuṣpakaiḥ ||64||
bhavadāgamane’ṅgāni hṛdayāḍhyāni sarvathā |
anubhavantyapūrvāṇi sukhānyānandakāni ca ||65||
tiṣṭhate ca tato’traiva dāsau svo bhavatoriha |
mayoktau ca tadā tau vai kathamīdṛk parāgrahaḥ ||66 ||
kriyate’tra bhavadbhyāṃ vai vadataṃ hārdameva nau |
tāvubhāvāhatustatra vane tvekākinau sadā ||67||
āvāṃ vāsaṃ prakurvaśca bhavatāṃ tu sthitāviha |
sārthavāso bhavedeva satāṃ saṃgo hi durlabhaḥ ||68||
sapatnīkagṛhasthasya vāsastvekākino vane |
bhayado vai tataḥ stheyaṃ gṛhasthena sahāyinā ||69||
dvayorgṛhasthayorvāsaḥ śobhano vai vanāntare |
trayāṇāṃ cādhikānāṃ ca vāso vai cātiśobhanaḥ ||3.15.70 ||
nārīṇāṃ tu satīdharmānvitānāṃ dharmapālane |
sāhāyyaṃ syāt pramadā hi sādhvyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sukhāśrayāḥ ||71 ||
tasmād vāṃ rocayāvo’tra vāsaṃ sādhupradharmiṇoḥ |
vinā vai bhavatorvāsaṃ śāntinau na bhaviṣyati ||72||
tadā mayoktaṃ ca tathāstvityomityabhinoditau |
sukhaṃ cāvāpatustūrṇaṃ harṣānvitau babhūvatuḥ ||73 ||
āvāṃ sukhasthitau tayoścāvāse kṛtapūjanau |
mudā sāyaṃ gataṃ vārtālāpaiḥ saddharmabodhanaiḥ ||74||
sandhyāṃ kṛtvā niśāyāṃ ca harervārtā vidhāya ca |
suṣvupuścāpi catvāro niśānte ca dvayorapi ||75||
brāhmamuhūrte pūrve vai samaye śobhane tadā |
viprasya cāpi viprāṇyāḥ svapne cāvāmupāgatau ||76||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau sākṣāttāpasau samupāgatau |
putrarūpo’pyahaṃ jātastvaṃ svapne putrikābhavaḥ ||77|||
yamalaṃ ca dvijābhyāṃ vai prāptaṃ bālasvarūpi tat |
prāpya viprau sumuditau tataḥ svapnaṃ nyavartata ||78 ||
āvāmadṛśyatāṃ prāptau tau tu jāgaritau tadā |
abhavatāṃ tato draṣṭuṃ tau svakuṭyāṃ tu nāvubhau ||79||
adṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ prāptau ca muditau tataḥ |
āvāṃ tatra tadā lakṣmi vāyudevaṃ hi garbhagam ||3.15.8 0||
samāhūya dadatuśca garbhājñāṃ garbhadarśanam |
prakārasya yathā garbhavatī vai pramadā bhavet ||8 1 ||
vāyuścaivaṃ cakārāpi garbhakukṣau vasan sadā |
yathā garbhavatī nārī tathaudaramadarśayat ||82||
āvāmadṛśyarūpeṇa vartamānau tadāśraye |
pratimāyāṃ samaye tvāgate yamalameva ha ||83||
prādurbhūtau yadā vāyurgarbhadvārād viniryayau |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇau yamalātmakau ||84||
kanyākumārakau cobhāvajāyevahi tatpuraḥ |
ayonijāvapi yadvad yonijāviva vai tadā ||85||
ākāśātpuṣpavṛṣṭiśca devamuktakṛtābhavat |
dundubhayo nineduśca vane jāto mahotsavaḥ ||86||
ṛṣayaśca samājagmustatra darśanahetave |
maṃgalaṃ bahudhā tatra jātaṃ janestadāvayoḥ |||87||
kṛtasaṃskārakau sarvavidhau ca yamalātmakau |
āvāṃ vṛddhiṃ gatau tatrāraṇye ca brahmacāriṇau ||88||
sādhudharmaparau sādhudīkṣāyuktau svayaṃkṛtau |
ajāyevahi tatraiva brahmasūtrānvitāvapi ||89||
athāraṇyanivāsebhyo grāmavāsebhya ityapi |
upādiśāvaḥ sādhūnāṃ dharmān tyāgāśramārthinām || 3.15.90 ||
kāmadevasya vai tyāgo jihvārāsanavarjanam |
mohadarśanasantyāgaḥ snehaspārśanavarjanam ||9 1 ||
calaśabdādisantyāgo vikṛtigandhavarjanam |
parigrahasyāsaṃgaśca rāgadveṣavivarjanam || 92||
yātrāmātrānnasalilagrahaṇaṃ cāniketanam |
maunaṃ karmaparityāgo harau sarvārpaṇātmanā || 93 ||
tapodharmo nigrahaśca vāsanātyajanaṃ sadā |
mamāhaṃtyājanaṃ cāpi daihyabhinnaprabodhanam || 94||
sarvadrohākaraṇaṃ ca kṣamā sahiṣṇutā dayā |
adhyātmacintanaṃ nityaṃ parameśasya pūjanam || 95 ||
brahmasthityā vartanaṃ ca śokamohavivarjanam |
ayācite ca samprāpte santoṣaścārjavaṃ tathā || 96 ||
kāṣāyāmbaradhāritvaṃ karapātrakatā tathā |
yathāpekṣāmbaragrāho yathāsukhaṃ vane sthitiḥ || 9 7||
oṃ namaḥ śrīśīlanārāyaṇāya paramātmane |
itimātrajapaścāpi bhaktiśca paramātmani || 98 ||
ityevaṃ vai narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ sādhuvṛttitā |
śikṣitā vai tadāvābhyāṃ mānavebhyaḥ sukhāvahā || 99 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā |
mayā tvayā tadānādisādhudharmāḥ pravartitāḥ || 3.15.100 ||
anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇena paramātmanā |
anādisvāminīnārāyaṇyā tvayānvitena ha | | 101 ||
sahodareṇa vai bhrātrā mayā sādhusvarūpiṇā |
sahodaryā ca vai svasrā tvayā sādhvyā suyoṣitā || 102 ||
koṭiśo mānavā jātāḥ sādhavaḥ śīlavartanāḥ |
sādhvyaśca koṭiśo jātāḥ śīlavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 103 ||
tato yajñāśca saṃjātā vratāni vividhāni ca |
bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi mandirāṇi mamāpi ca | | 1 04||
śīlasya niyamaścāpi daivapaitryakriyāstathā |
tīrthasevā sādhusevā sarve dharmāḥ pravartitāḥ || 1 05||
anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇena vai mayā tadā |
sarvaṃ jānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi smara prākaṭyameva yat || 106 ||
anye’pi ca tadā tatrāvatārā mama naikaśaḥ |
abhavan kāryavaśagā jānāmyahaṃ na cetaraḥ || 1 07||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ me te prākaṭyaṃ śīlahetave |
smaraṇācchravaṇāccāpi pāṭhanānbhuktimuktidam || 1 08||
ākalpāntaṃ tvāvayośca tadābhavaṃ nivāsanam |
dharmārthaṃ sādhurūpeṇa koṭibhiḥ sādhubhiḥ saha || 10 9||
śiṣyapraśiṣyaśākhāśca vyavardhanta tadā kṣitau |
mātre pitre tato muktiṃ datvā gatau nijākṣaram || 3.15.110 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭādaśe vatsare sādhudharmasthāpanārtham anādiśrīśīlanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||

<3.16>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brahmaṇo vatsare tataḥ |
sākṣātkṛnnāmake ṣaṣṭikalpe trayodaśe manau || 1 ||
kailāsavāso rudro vai tīrthārthamagamat kṣitau |
paryaṭan cāṭulādrau sa viṣṇutīrthamupāyayau || 2 ||
tatra vai parvate ramyā śāradākhyā saridvarā |
brahmaputryavahat tasyāstaṭe śrāntaḥ śubhaṃ jalam || 3 ||
pītvā prokṣya niṣasāda dhyānamagno’bhavat kṣaṇam |
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarveśvaraṃ dadhyau pareśvaram || 4 ||
tāvadvanāt samāyāto vārāho mattavegavān |
mastakena haraṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhāvan vallmīkavaddhi saḥ || 5 ||
uccakhānāvilokyaivāspaṣṭaṃ bhasmāvṛtaṃ haram |
dhyānāttūrṇaṃ samuttasthau vārāhaṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaraḥ || 6 ||
roṣaṃ cakāra sahasā bhrakuṭiḥ raktatāṃ gatā |
tasyā vyāghrānalo vahnijvālāmālāsamākulaḥ || 7 ||
samutpannastāmaso vai mahāsuro’drisadṛśaḥ |
vārāhaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇānāśayacchaṃbhunoditaḥ || 8 ||
vārāhacarma saṃgṛhya vyāghrānalo harājñayā |
jāṭharānalaśāntyarthaṃ yayāce bhojanaṃ harāt || 9 ||
śaṃbhustvāha samudrāntarvartināṃ yādasāṃ kulam |
bhojanaṃ vai mayā dattaṃ tava yāhi jalāntikam || 3.16.1 0||
vyāghrānalo’tibalavān kāmarūpadharo gaṇaḥ |
nirbhayaḥ kṣutpraśāntyarthamabdhitīramupāyayau || 1 1||
bhakṣayāmāsa yādāṃsi makarān kacchapān timīn |
yathāyathā bhojanaṃ sa cakre tathā tathāsya ha || 12||
jāṭharāgniḥ pradīptaśca pācakaḥ san vyavardhata |
śarīraṃ ca tathā tasya vṛddhiṃ jagāma śailavat || 1 3||
daśayojanavistāro bhūtvābdhiṃ sa viveśa ha |
bhakṣayāmāsa bahuśo yādāṃsi pratyahaṃ sa ca || 14||
māsānte ca babhūvāpi śatayojanavistṛtaḥ |
varṣānte sa babhūvāpi sahasrayojanāyataḥ || 15||
mahāsamudramāviśya jalaṃ pibati śvāsataḥ |
jhaṣādyāḥ koṭiśo yānti tasyodare pacanti ca || 16||
jalaṃ sarvaṃ cānalena dagdhaṃ prajāyate’pi ca |
atha kāle vyatīte so’yutayojanavistṛtaḥ || 17||
vyāghrānalo’bhavad vārdhau pibatyapi divāniśam |
sahasrayojanaṃ vārdhi śuṣkaṃ karoti nirjalam || 18|.
evaṃ sarve samudrāśca pītāstena kramāt khalu |
mahājalaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ pītaṃ bhūparito’bdhijam || 1 9||
vinā jalaṃ na vai meghā prajāyante’bdhimaṇḍalāt |
abdhiṣvagnistasya vyāghrānalasya prasṛto’bhavat || 3.16.20||
samudravivarāścāgnimayāḥ pṛthvī tathābhavat |
śuṣkā jalena hīnā ca garbhajalamadahyata || 21 ||
śuṣkaṃ ca bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ vṛṣṭirodho vyajāyata |
mamruśca dehinaḥ prāyo yoginastu trilokya tat || 22||
samādhau pravilīnā vai ṛṣayastu divaṃ yayuḥ |
akālaḥ pralayo bhūmau jāto vyāghrānalena vai || 23||
jalālābhe kardamādīn vyāghrānalo’tti vai talāt |
sarvato jalahānyā ca pṛthvī rūkṣagatiṃ gatā ||24||
vārdhayastu mṛtaprāyāḥ śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ |
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpānātha vyāghrānalānmaholbaṇāt ||25||
bhakṣayatyeva yādāṃsi kardamāni jalāni ca |
akālapralayo jāto mṛtā iva vayaṃ tataḥ || 26||
raudro’yaṃ vartate cādyāyutayojanavistṛtaḥ |
āyatau vardhamāno’yaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ nigaliṣyati || 27||
tadanto bhavatā kāryo bhavataḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ |
kṣāraḥ pīto hi sarvasvaścānye pītāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ || 28||
bhavantamantarā nāsyāsurasyāntakaro’paraḥ |
bhavatā rakṣyate sarvaṃ cāpatyamiva sarvadā ||29||
vayaṃ samudrāḥ sarve vai rādhāputrā jalātmakāḥ |
pitā naḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva bhagavāna rādhikāpatiḥ ||3.16.3 0 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvatāra eva yaḥ |
golokādhipatirgopīpatiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ || 3 1||
tataḥ putrā vayaṃ te smo rakṣa kaḥ puruṣottama |
ityevamarthitaścāhaṃ samudraiḥ saptabhistadā || 32||
tvayā sākaṃ mahālakṣmi vārdhīnāṃ gocaro’bhavam |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasvastikadhvajaśūlavān || 3 3||
pūjito vanditastaiśca miṣṭodenābhivanditaḥ |
miṣṭodasyaiva patnyāṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ tu tadābhavam || 34||
bālo’haṃ jātamātro’pi yuvābdhiputra eva ha |
tvaṃ tadā śivasatyeśri puṇḍarīkasya putrikā ||35||
bhūbhṛtaścābhavaḥ sarvaiśvaryasaundaryalakṣitā |
nāmnā śrīpuṇḍarīkaśrīḥ sarvakalyāṇakāriṇī ||36||
athāhaṃ ca prasasmāra vāhanaṃ jalagāmyapi |
tadā miṣṭodakātprāpto jalaturaṃgamo’dbhutaḥ ||37||
sapakṣaḥ śuṇḍhavām̐ścāpi sajālapādavānapi |
kāmarūpadharaścāpi śvāsarodhasamādhimān ||38||
bale’bdhisadṛśaścāpi gatyā vidyutsamo’pi ca |
adhṛṣyaḥ parvataprāyaḥ śvetavarṇasturaṃgamaḥ |||3 9||
bhūvāryambaragamanaḥ sthūlasūkṣmādisiddhimān |
sarvabhāṣāpravaktā ca divyadeho’vibhedyakaḥ ||3.16.40||
svambālikāyutaścāpi yuddhakauśalyaśevadhiḥ |
cintāmaṇyabhiyuktaśca maṇimauktikabhūṣaṇaḥ ||41 ||
jalāntardīpakāntiścāndhakāre suprakāśavān |
naisargadṛḍhavarmāḍhyaḥ śastraprasavatūṇavān ||42||
sudhāsrāvikesarāḍhyo mṛtyuhṛtkalgiśobhitaḥ |
puṣṭaḥ sarvāṃgatāmrāḍhyaścāgapya māṃ nanāma saḥ || 43||
patkhurairharṣaṇaśabdaiḥ stavanaiḥ pakṣavistaraiḥ |
uccāgrairjavakampaiśca svāgataṃ sa mamācarat ||44||
mayā vāhanarūpo’sau nirvidhnāya prapūjitaḥ |
vijayāya ca tatpṛṣṭhe datto dakṣaḥ karo mayā |||45|||
amṛtaṃ pāyitaścāpi bhāle tilakitastathā |
yātrārthaṃ bodhitaścāpi saṃgarārthaṃ prahreṣitaḥ ||46||
hreṣāśabdo’sya vai lakṣmi dikpālānāṃ gṛhān yayau |
cakampe dyauḥ samastā vai pṛthivyāstatra kā daśā ||47||
parvatāśca samudrāśca jaladevāśca mātaraḥ |
varuṇaśca nadā nadyo yuddhārthaṃ militā mayā ||48||
svasvavāhanasaṃyuktāścākāritā mayāyayuḥ |
viṣṇuhastatalotpannaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ mahāgajam ||49||
cādhiruhya devarājastatra lakṣmi samāyayau |
rudraujaḥsaṃbhavaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca pauṇḍrakābhidham ||3.16.50||
mahiṣaṃ dharmarājaśca samāruhyāyayau tadā |
brahmakarṇamalodbhūtaṃ śyāmaṃ jaladhināmakam ||51||
śiśumāramadhiruhya varuṇastatra cāyayau |
tathā śakaṭacakrākṣaṃ śelākāraṃ naraṃ śubham ||52||
sapakṣaṃ cāmbikāpajjamāruhya dhanadaḥ sthitaḥ |
gandharvān bhujagendrām̐ścāruhya śvetavṛṣām̐stathā ||53||
rudrā raudrāsuranāśārthaṃ tatra samupāyayuḥ|
ardhasahasrahaṃsāḍhyarathamāruhya candramāḥ ||54||

kuṃjarasthā vasavaśca yakṣāśca naravāhanāḥ ||55||
kinnarā bhujagārūḍhā hayārūḍhau tathāśvinau |
sāraṃgādhiṣṭhitāścāpi marutaścāyayurbalāḥ ||56||
gandharvāśca svarārūḍhā agnirmeṣasya pṛṣṭhagaḥ |
samudrā makarārūḍhā surā yānavimānagāḥ ||57||
brahmā haṃsasamārūḍho viṣṇurgaruḍavāhanaḥ |
ṛṣayaścāsanasthāśca pitaraḥ puṇyavāhanāḥ ||58||
pṛthivī śeṣavāhā ca śeṣaḥ kacchapavāhanaḥ |
kacchapā meghavāhāśca meghāśca vāyuvāhanāḥ ||59||
parvatāḥ pakṣavāhāśca vidyuto meghavāhitāḥ |
nadā nadyastaraṃgasthāḥ saśastrāḥ samupāyayuḥ ||3.16.60 ||
tadā vādyānyavādyanta devānāṃ tānarohiṇaḥ |
baladā ninadāścāpyaśrūyanta dyusadāṃ tadā ||6 1 ||
vyāghrānalaḥ praśuśrāva ninādān vai digantagān |
ruṣṭaścāpyasahamānastūrṇamāsphoṭayan muhuḥ ||62|
ūrūn karatalaiścāpyamocayaccāṭṭahāsakān |
ūrdhve coḍḍīya saṃvīkṣya yuddhasannāhasaṃsthitān ||63||
surān śīghraṃ gadāṃ gurvīmudgṛhya garvamohitaḥ |
ākāśaṃ pūrayan tanvā māṃ surān prati cāyayau ||64||
ucchraye gamanasparśī dīrghaścāyutayojanaḥ |
viśālo vārdhivad vyāghrānalo yuddhārthamāyayau ||65||
indreṇa dharmarājena samaṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ |
varuṇena dhanadena samaṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ ||66||
candramasā tathā rudrairādityairyuyudhe’pi saḥ |
mūrchāṃ prāpya punaryuddhaṃ cakre balī punaḥ punaḥ ||67||
yakṣaiśca kinnaraiścāpi marudbhiryuyudhe balī |
agninā brahmaṇā sākaṃ viṣṇunā yuyudhe muhuḥ ||68||
parvataiścāpi vidyudbhiryuyudhe cātidāruṇaḥ |
sahasrarūpadhṛgbhūtvā yuyudhe ca suraiḥ saha ||69||
pradhāvan vyomamārgeṇākarṣayan grahamaṇḍalam |
nakṣatrāṇi pātayaṃśca dudrāva yuyudhe’pi ca ||3.16.70||
sthiraṃ tadāmbaraṃ cāpi sakampaṃ vai vyalakṣyata |
vāyustarā vyamuñcanta dhṛtiśaktīḥ prakampitāḥ ||71 ||
pṛthvī kampena ca tadā saṃsthānāni vyasarjayan |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca gatayo’pi savyāhatayo’bhavan ||72||
vijayasyāpi viśvāsaścāgād dvayorhi saṃśayam |
pralayo mumude cāti puṣṭiṃ vīkṣyāyatau nijām ||73||
āyudhāni samastāni praviśya varṣma cāsuram |
viniryānti paraṃ pāraṃ mārgagānīva romataḥ ||74||
nāsya dehe garbhabhāge sparśo’pi śastrakṛttadā |
jāyate tādṛśaścāste yuddhyatyatyantamojasā ||75||
prāṇān glahām̐stadā kṛtvā paṇaṃ kṛtvā vināśane |
nāśe vā niścayaṃ kṛtvā vṛkānalaḥ prayuddhyati ||76 ||
gadayā tomareṇāpi śaktyā pāśena cāsinā |
khaḍgena kṣepaṇaiścāpi parvataiścopalādibhiḥ ||77||
śūlena cāpi cakreṇa daṇḍena ca śaraistathā |
vakṣasā bāhunā cāpi hastyādibhiśca tāḍanaiḥ ||78||
evaṃ yuddhaṃ cakārāsau vṛkānalo’surastadā |
devāśca balavanto’pi prāpurmahāpariśramam ||79||
athāhaṃ ca tadā lakṣmi viniścitya durāsadam |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ cāsmai mumoca lakṣadhāravat ||3.16.80||
pralayāgnisamaṃ ghoraṃ svargapātāladāhakam |
vardhamānaṃ mahadrūpaṃ dadāhainaṃ samantataḥ ||8 1||
vyāghrānalaśarīrādvai khaṇḍāstadā tu koṭiśaḥ |
pṛthagbhūtāḥ kartitā ye te’pi vyāghrānalāḥ punaḥ ||82||
bhavanti tvasurāstena tulyāstatra hi saṅgare |
cakraṃ tūrṇaṃ mayājñaptaṃ dahyatyeva ca tānapi ||83 ||
antarīkṣaṃ samastaṃ ca tadā vahnyambaraṃ hyabhūt |
pralayāgnisamāvyāptaṃ brahmāstramiva vā hyabhūt ||84||
tadā mayā tvamājñaptā mahāmāyāsvarūpiṇī |
mohinīrūpamāsthāyāsurasya jaḍatāptaye ||85||
sannidhāvambare prāptāsuro mohamupāgataḥ |
yuddhaṃ cāsaṃkhyarūpāṇi tyaktvā tvāṃ dhartumāgataḥ ||86||
samāślikṣacca yāvat tvāṃ tāvat tvayā svavahninā |
vyāghrānalasya vahnirvai samasto’pi hṛto’ntarāt ||87||
vyāghrānalo vinā bhānaṃ vinānalaṃ ca taijasam |
jaḍībhūto’bhavattāvat sudarśanena bheditaḥ ||88||
papāta śatadhā cāpi sahasradhā mahārṇave |
khaṅkaśṛṃgāṇi jātāni vārdhau taddehakhaṇḍakāḥ ||89||
nirjīvāśca jalamadhye parvatā iva te’bhavan |
evaṃ vyāghrānale lakṣmi nāśite meghagarjanāḥ ||3.16.90||
ākāśe cābhavam̐statra samudrāścārdratāṃ yayuḥ |
mama dehāttadā dhārā jalānāṃ ca pariśramāt ||91 ||
abhavan vardhamānāstāḥ samudrānabhyapūrayan |
ākāśādabhavad vṛṣṭirjayapuṣpākṣatātmikā ||92||
surā mudaṃ yayuścāpi pupūjurmāṃ śriyāḥ patim |
mayāpi satkṛtā devāḥ kṛtakāryā nijālayam ||93|||
yayurlakṣmi tadā tvaṃ cādṛśyabhāvamupāgatā |
mamāpi vāhanaṃ cāśvastvayā sākaṃ pitustava ||94||
gṛhaṃ prāpayya ca tvāṃ tu miṣṭodaṃ samupāgataḥ |
ahaṃ surānnamaskṛtya miṣṭodaṃ samupāgataḥ ||95||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīvārdhinārāyaṇanāmnā kṣitau tataḥ ||96||
prasiddhaścābhavaṃ mahyaṃ puṇḍarīkaḥ pitā tava |
dadau putrīṃ tu vidhinā yogyāya me’ntarātmane ||97||
surādivanditāyeśeśvarāya paramātmane |
tvāṃ samudvāhya vidhinā puṇḍarīkaśriyaṃ tataḥ ||98||
aśvaṃ ca vāhnaṃ labdhvāvicaraṃ bhuvanatraye |
ākalpāntamatiṣṭham̐śca dharmarakṣaṇahetave ||99||
anādiśrīhariḥ so’haṃ parabrahma sanātanaḥ |
vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitat mama prākaṭyamuttamam || 3.16.10 0||
evaṃ jātā hyavatārā mama tatrāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi kīrtanātsmaraṇādapi || 101 ||
bhuktimuktipradāḥ sarve camatkāraparāyaṇāḥ |
smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śivaputri camatkṛtim || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ekonaviṃśe vatsare raudrasya vyāghrānalāsurasya nāśanārtham anādiśrīvārdhinārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamiti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||

<3.17>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ ca tato mama |
vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭimānākhye vatsare cādyakalpake || 1 ||
ādye manau saṃpravṛtte brahmā nidrāṃ vihāya ca |
prabhāte devanadyāṃ vai snātuṃ yayau vicintayan || 2 ||
adya sṛṣṭiṃ kīdṛśīṃ ca kurve trilokiśobhanām |
mādṛśīṃ sarvathā kurve bhedabhāvavivarjitām || 3 ||
iti saṃkalpya vai sasnau sandhyāṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau |
naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sṛṣṭiśālāṃ samāviśat || 4 ||
sṛṣṭiyantraṃ sa pasparśa garbhayantraṃ vyalokayat |
caturmukhā samastā ca sṛṣṭiradya prajāyatām || 5 ||
iti saṃkalpayāmāsa tāvanmaharṣayastataḥ |
svatulyā abhavan sarve caturmukhā dvijātayaḥ || 6 ||
devāḥ sarve’pi ca tathābhavam̐ścaturmukhāḥ śubhāḥ |
mānavāścāpi gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sādhyadevatāḥ || 7 ||
kiṃpumāṃsaḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇaśca sarīsṛpāḥ |
svedajā aṇḍajādyāśca jarāyūjāśca dehinaḥ || 8 ||
kalalotthāśca yādāṃsi mṛjjanyāḥ patrasaṃbhavāḥ |
tṛṇotthā vivarotthāśca pātālādisamudbhavāḥ || 9 ||
sarve vedhaḥprasaṃkalpājjātāścaturmukhā nanu |
daityāśca dānavāścāpi rākṣasā āsurāstathā || 3.17.1 0||
yakṣāḥ piśācakā bhūtāḥ sarvabhavam̐ścaturmukhāḥ |
vedhasā pitṛbhirdevairmānavairbhaktapuṃgavaiḥ || 1 1||
kathāprasaṃge sarvatra varṇito’haṃ caturmukhaḥ |
sarve caturmukhāḥ santītyevaṃ vedā vadantyapi || 1 2||
muktāścaturmukhāḥ sarve īśvarāśca caturmukhāḥ |
ityevaṃ kalpanāṃ cakrurnijavat kathakā janāḥ || 13 ||

anye vadanti bhagavānāste’pyasaṃkhyamastakaḥ || 15||

apare ca tadā śrīśo vartate hyekamastakaḥ || 16 ||

yathā vayaṃ tathā so’pi yathā haristathā hyajaḥ || 17||
yathā brahmā tathā sarve maharṣayastathā surāḥ |
tathā ca mānavāḥ sarve vayaṃ yathā tathā hariḥ || 18||
evaṃ tatrāvadan kecidevamāsīd vivādanam |
etannirṇayalābhārthaṃ vivādā bahavo’bhavan || 19||
atharṣibhirmānivaiśca devaiḥ saṃhatya bhūtale |
taṭe suvarṇagaṃgāyāścottare pariṣat kṛtā ||3.17.20||
tatra dvijāgraṇīḥ śrautavṛṣarṣiḥ prāha kīdṛśaḥ |
bhagavān vai parabrahma yaḥ samupāsyate prabhuḥ ||21 ||
vaidikāstu tadā prāhurvedaprāmāṇyagāmina |
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt ||22||
anye prāhuśca taṃ deveśvareśvaraṃ hariṃ tadā |
sarvataḥ pāṇipādo’yaṃ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ ||23||

pare prāhurhariṃ tatra parameśaṃ sanātanam ||24||

anye tadā tu taṃ prāhuścaturmukhaṃ nijādṛśam ||25||
brahmā prāha hariścāste’kṣare dhāmnyekamastakaḥ |
dvibhujaśca dvipāccāpi dvicakṣuśca dvikarṇakaḥ ||26||
athāpare tadā prāhurnaiva naivaṃ kadāpi vai |

athāste bhagavān divyastathā dṛśyo bhaviṣyati |
atha sarve militvaiva svarṇanadītaṭe ca te ||3.17.3 0||
japayajñātmikāṃ mukhyāṃ bahubhaktyupabṛṃhitām |

sarveṣāṃ ca satyadayāyajñatapomayāni ca |
sukhānyāsan prasiddhāni tattatphalapradāni ha || 10 1||
dāsānāṃ tu vyavasāyadāsyatuṣṭistavāñci ca |
evamāsan mukhānyeva phaladāni tadā sṛjau || 1 02||
ityevaṃ śrīśivasvāmisute prākaṭyameva me |
tvayā sākaṃ tadā jātamudīritaṃ sukhāspadam || 1 03||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇātpāpanāśanam |
yatheṣṭarddhiprāpaṇaṃ ca mokṣalābhaḥ prajāyate || 1 04||
sarvatīrthaphalānyeva sarvayajñaphalānyapi |
sarvavrataphalānyeva jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso viṃśatitame vatsare sṛṣṭisadṛśasyānādicaturmukhanārāyaṇasya pramākṣikīramāsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||

<3.18>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ satkathāṃ paramāṃ mama |
ekaviṃśe vedhaso vai vatsare vedavatsare || 1 ||
kalpe’śītitame cāpi manau dvādaśake purā |
abhūd bhaktaḥ puṇyarāto dvijo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
patnī tasya rādhanikānāmnī cābhūt pativratā |
dampatī cakraturnityaṃ snānaṃ dhyānaṃ mamārhaṇam || 3 ||
bhajanaṃ cakratuścāpi japayajñaṃ ca saṃghaśaḥ |
akhaṇḍanāmadhunyaṃ ca pracakratuḥ kvacitkvacit || 4 ||
lakṣatulasikāpatraiḥ pūjanaṃ cakratuśca me |
kārtike ca madarthaṃ vai vratānyudyāpanāni ca || 5 ||
navānnānāṃ sumiṣṭānāṃ naivedyāni pracakratuḥ |
māghe vāsantikaṃ cāpyutsavaṃ pracakratustathā || 6 ||
puṣpadolotsavaṃ cāpi vaiśākhasya vratāni ca |
cāturmāsye niyamām̐śca bhaktiyuktān pracakratuḥ || 7 ||
nityaṃ pracakratuḥ sādhusādhvīsevāṃ samutsukau |
tābhyāṃ sādhumukhādākarṇitaṃ kathāprasaṃgataḥ || 8 ||
annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ vastradānaṃ prakīrtyate |
vastradānāt paraṃ dānaṃ dhanadānaṃ prakīrtyate || 9 ||
dhanadānātparaṃ dānaṃ godānaṃ samprakīrtyate |
godānācca paraṃ dānaṃ kanyādānaṃ prakīrtyate || 3.18.1 0||
kanyādānāt paraṃ dānaṃ putradānaṃ suvaṃśakṛt |
putradānāt paraṃ dānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ prakīrtyate ||1 1||
kṣetradānātparaṃ dānamārogyasya pradānakam |
ārogyadānataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ savṛttigṛhadānakam || 1 2||
savṛttigṛhadānācca puṇyadānaṃ paraṃ matam |
puṇyadānāddharmakarmapradānaṃ paramaṃ matam || 13||
dharmakarmapradānācca jñānadānaṃ sadādhikam |
jñānadānād bhaktidānaṃ sarvebhyaścātiricyate || 14||
bhaktidānāt svargadānaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam |
śreṣṭhaṃ bhaktiyutaṃ cettat tato’bhayapradānakam || 15||
sarvadānāni ramyāṇi paralokapradāni ca |
brahmāṇḍadānatulyāni yāni yāni ca santi vai || 16||
jīvābhayapradānasya nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām |
abhayaṃ kālato māyātaścāpi karmatastathā || 17||
pāpato yamadūtāśca kuhṛdbhyaḥ śatrutastathā |
vāsanātaśca bandhebhyo muktiścābhayadānakam || 18||
apunarāvṛttirūpā muktiryā sādhikā tataḥ |
sālokyā tatra vai śreṣṭhā sārṣṭyākhyāto garīyasī || 1 9||
sārūpyākhyā tataḥ śreṣṭhatarā proktā sukhānvitā |
sāmīpyākhyā sarvaśreṣṭhatamā tato’pi vai tadā ||3.18.20||
sāyujyākhyā cātiśreṣṭhatamā yatparamā na vai |
vidyate’nyābhayadānātmikā mūrddhanyaśālinī ||2 1||
tasmāt sarvapradānebhyo’bhayadānaṃ viśiṣyate |
anyairvai pūrvakāle yad yādṛśaṃ nārpitaṃ kṛtam || 22||
tādṛśaṃ dānamevātra dātavyaṃ cābhayātmakam |
ityevaṃ ca satāṃ vaktrāchrutvā kathāmṛtaṃ tataḥ ||23||
puṇyarātastathā patnī vicāraṃ cakraturmuhuḥ |
dānaṃ dadatyatra loke dhanāḍhyāśca dhanādikam ||24||
āvābhyāṃ tu pradātavyaṃ pūrvaṃ kaiścinna yat kṛtam |
yādṛśaṃ na pradattaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ deyameva nau ||25||
athaivaṃ tau saṃvicārya kuruto bhaktidānakam |
jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ dadataśca kurutaśca svayaṃ sadā ||26||
evaṃ yāteṣu māseṣu varṣeṣvapi ca vai tataḥ |
prāṇāyāmaparau jātau yogakriyāparāyaṇau || 27||
prāṇarodhasamarthau ca samādhisthitivartinau |
tāpasau brahmaparamau tyaktadehasukhau tataḥ ||28||
videhau jīvanamuktau māyāsaṃgavivarjitau |
kṣapitabandhakarmāṇau dagdhaiṣaṇau ca yoginau ||29||
anyeṣāmabhayadānadharmamātraparāyaṇau |
vicārayantau satataṃ kathaṃ mokṣāśca dehinām ||3.18.3 0||
ātyantiko bhaveccātra kartavyaṃ dānameva tat |
abhīdānasamaṃ dānaṃ nānyad bhavati vai tataḥ ||3 1
dātavyaṃ cābhayadānaṃ sarvajīvebhya eva ha |
ekaikasmai mokṣadānaṃ copadeśād bhavediha |
mantradānaiḥ śatānāṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ bhavediha || 32
yatnaśca bahulastatra sādhanasyāvalambinoḥ |
āvayorvai bhavedeva tasmāt sādhye svayaṃ harau ||33|
yatnaḥ samyaga vidhātavyaḥ prāpaṇīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
bhūlokasthamanuṣyāṇāṃ tatsambandhavatāṃ tathā ||34|
tiraścāmapi mokṣaḥ syādevamarthyaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
yuge vā yugadaśake manau vānyamanau sthite ||35||
pratyakṣaḥ śrīhariścāyād dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāśvatīm |
sarvebhyo mānavebhyaśca yathā yatnastathātra vai ||36||
dehenānena kartavyo mahān svalpastu naiva ha |
ityāniścitya kamale tāvubhau bhaktisaṃyutau ||37||
mama mūrteḥ samīpasthau jagrahaturvrata dṛḍham |
adyārabhya japayajñaḥ kartavyaḥ śrīhareḥ śubhaḥ ||38||
rātriṃdivaṃ vyomavāsaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvaikakālikam |
phalaṃ caikavidhaṃ vāri pātavyaṃ caikavārakam ||39||
yāvaddharirmilennaiva kartavyaṃ tāvadeva hi |
śīlaṃ vrataṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ vane vastavyameva ca ||3.18.40 ||
ityevaṃ vrataniyamaṃ gṛhītvā dampatī hi tau |
yugādidinamārabhya cakratustapa uttamam ||41 ||
dehasya dhāraṇe śaktau yatheṣṭaṃ tyajane’pi ca |
kālasya rodhane śaktau mṛtyuñjayau babhūvatuḥ ||42||
aniśaṃ māṃ bhajamānau nārāyaṇaparāyaṇau |
babhūvatuḥ priyau me’pi mama bhaktiparāyaṇau ||43||
mayā tvadṛśyarūpaṃ ca tadrakṣārthaṃ sudarśanam |
sthāpitaṃ tadvane pārśve kālādibhayanuttaye ||44||
dāvānalo’tivṛṣṭiśca jhaṃjhāvāto’tiśītatā |
himavṛṣṭiśca vā krūraprāṇivighnādikaṃ sadā ||45||
nivāryate hi cakreṇa bhaktarakṣākareṇa me |
adhairyasaṃbhṛtordvayoryugacatuṣṭayam ||46 ||
vyatītaṃ ca tataścāhaṃ viprarūpo yayau puraḥ |
bhikṣāṃ dehīti madhyāhne’vocaṃ tayoḥ samīpataḥ ||47||
śīghramutthāya viprāya jalaṃ phalaṃ tathāsanam |
pādyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca namaskāraḥ kṣamāpanam ||48||
nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno’stu cetyuktvārpitameva me |
labdhvā mayoktau tau bhaktau śreyo vāmastu sarvadā ||49||
omityuktvāhaturmāṃ tau hi sarveṣāṃ dehināmiha |
śreyo yathā bhavet śreṣṭhamāśīrvādān pradehi nau ||3.18.50 ||
mayoktaṃ pāpino jīvā bhavanti vāsanāmayāḥ |
teṣāṃ śreyo bhaveccāpi tapoyogasamādhibhiḥ ||51||
bahukālānuṣṭhitaiśca nālpakālena vai khalu |
tāvāhaturhariścātra nau kadā vai miliṣyati ||52||
sarvamānavamokṣārthaṃ kadā sākṣānmiliṣyati |
sarvadehipramokṣārthaṃ kadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ||53||
mayā śrutvā tadoktaṃ vai vāṃ harirmilito’sti vai |
sarvamānavamokṣārthamardhamanvantare gate ||54||
miliṣyati hariḥ sākṣāttapobhaktivalādiha |
pūrṇe manvantare yāte tiraścāmapi muktaye ||55||
miliṣyati prabhuścātra yathābuddhi vadāmyaham |
ityāśrutya sīmavākyaṃ prahṛṣṭau tāvubhāvapi ||56||
pādayoḥ patitau me ca pupūjatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
nematuśca muhuḥ pādarajaḥ sma lihatastadā ||57||
ayaṃ nārāyaṇaśceti vijñāya tau samutsuko |
darśanaṃ nijarūpasya dehīti vadataḥ sma mām ||58||
ahaṃ tadā prasannaśca dadau divyaṃ svadarśanam |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prasannatānvitam ||59||
anekakoṭicandrabhānanaṃ cābharaṇānvitam |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakratuśca vividhapūjanam ||3.18.60||
varārthaṃ kathitau tau ca prārthayāmāsatustadā |
mānavānāṃ kṣitisthānāṃ tatsambandhavatāṃ tathā ||61 ||
prāṇināṃ paramāṃ muktimicchāvo yugapat prabho |
varaṃ varāṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taṃ sarvābhayapradānakam ||62||
dehi nātha kṛpāsindho prasanno bhava keśava |
itinārāyaṇīśri prārthayatāṃ tau varaṃ param ||63||
mayoktau bhavatormokṣakaraṇārthamahaṃ tviha |
samāyāto’smi tūrṇaṃ cāgacchatāṃ vai mayā saha ||64||
āvāhatuḥ prabho mokṣo nau te yogānna saṃśayaḥ |
jñāta eva ca jīvānāṃ mānavānāṃ tu mokṣaṇam ||65||
vināvāṃ na prayāsyāvo yatheṣṭaṃ kuru vatsale |
hariḥ prāha tathecchāpi pūrṇā kālena vai kvacit ||66||
bhaviṣyati tapobhaktyā yāmi vāṃ kuśalaṃ bhavet |
ityuktvāhaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tūrṇaṃ jagāma padmaje || 67||
tau prasannau pūrṇakāmau vardhamānapraharṣaṇau |
cakraturmama bhaktiṃ ca smarantau viprarūpiṇam ||68||
nityaṃ navotsāhavantau catvāriṃśadyugāvadhim |
cakratuśca tapobhaktiṃ tadāhaṃ punarāyayau ||69||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrībhagavān svayam |
tāpasau mama bhaktau tu śuṣkadehau jagāda ha ||3.18.70||
manuṣyān bhūsthitān sarvān nītvā yātaṃ mamākṣaram |
evaṃ phalaṃ tapaso vāṃ pradātuṃ samupāgataḥ ||71 ||
svīkurutaṃ tapaḥsiddhiṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pramuktidām |
tatastau māṃ prapūjyaiva saṃsevya paramādarāt ||72||
āhaturbhagavannatra manuṣyāṇāṃ gṛhe gṛhe |
gāvo’śvāḥkariṇaścoṣṭrā ajāścāśvatarā mṛgāḥ ||73 ||
ūraṇāḥ śvāpadāścāpi siṃhāśca gavayādikāḥ |
ye ye vai paśavaḥ santi śukādyāḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye ||74||
sarīsṛpādyā ye cāpi ye manuṣyopayoginaḥ |
sarve te mānavaiḥ sākaṃ muktimīyustathā kuru ||75||
tān vihāya manuṣyāṇāṃ muktiṃ necchāva eva ha |
śrutvāhaṃ cāvadaṃ tābhyāṃ cireṇaiva bhaviṣyati ||76 ||
tatastau harṣasampannau jātau kālāvadhiṃ gatau |
pūjāṃ prāpya tatastūrṇamahamadṛśyatāṃ yayau ||77||
atha bhaktau ca tau tadvat tapobhaktiparāyaṇau |
ajāyatāṃ mayi snigdhau jalānnarahitau tataḥ ||78||
tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ tayorjātaṃ bhaktiḥ pūrṇābhavat tadā |
tṛṇaśchannau mṛttikākhyau tapasā jātavigrahau ||79||
manvantare gate kāle madarthaṃ tau babhūvatuḥ |
dehināmupakārārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ paśudehinām ||3.18.80||
abhīdānapradānārthaṃ tyaktasaukhyau babhūvatuḥ |
mama yogapradānārthaṃ jīvānāṃ sarvathā hi tau ||8 1 ||
pāṣāṇamṛttikākalpau tapobhaktau babhūvatuḥ |
tato’haṃ sahasā tatra lakṣmyā ca pārṣadaiḥ saha ||82||
sarvapūjādisāmagrīyukto vai samupāyayau |
īśvarāścātha munayo devāśca ṛṣayo’pi ca ||83| |
āyayuḥ sarvatīrthāni tatra sthale nu māṃ tadā |
dundubhayaśca devānāmavādyanta tadāmbare ||84||
candanānāṃ suvṛṣṭiścāmṛtavṛṣṭistadābhavat |
jayanādāśca bhūtānāmabhavanparito’bhitaḥ ||85||
vimānānyapyasaṃkhyānyāyātāni svargiṇāṃ tadā |
madicchayā ca muktānāṃ koṭayaḥ samupāgatāḥ ||86||
koṭikoṭivimānāni koṭikoṭīśvarāstathā |
koṭikoṭisurāścāpi koṭikoṭimaharṣayaḥ ||87||
ambaraṃ sarvathā vyāptamabhavan tadvimānakaiḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||88||
avatīrya vimānācca brahmahradajalaṃ sthale |
tayostapaso bhūmau vai mṛttikāyāṃ nikuñjake ||89 ||
añjalinākṣipaṃ tatra tāvad bhūmermahānalaḥ |
divyatejomayaḥ prāvirāsīt svargādhitaijasaḥ ||3.18.90 ||
tejomadhyaḥ tato jātā divyā tanurdvijasya ha |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharā mūrtiḥ suśobhanā ||91 ||
ākṣaramuktasadṛśī tatpatnī ca tathāvidhā |
muktānikāsvarūpā cābhavat tatra ramādṛśī ||92||
ubhau mayābhāṣitau ca kṣemaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhaṃ prati |
āhatustau kṛpayaiva pāraṃ yātau tavāśritau ||93||
muktiyogyau samanujaiḥ satatsambandhidehibhiḥ |
paśupakṣyādibhiḥ sākaṃ jātau cedabhidhāritau ||94||
tadā nārāyaṇakṛṣṇa parameśa parātpara |
muktiṃ dehi manuḥ kālo vyatīto vacanāttava | |95||
abhīpradānakaṃ dehi parameśvara mādhava |
vimānāni hyasaṃkhyāni samāyātāni yāni ca ||96||
namastebhyo bhavatātra sahitebhyo’pi koṭidhā |
namaḥ samastabhūtātman parameśa namo’stu te ||97||
akṣarādhipate cāntaryāmin bhaktārthapūraka |
kuru muktiṃ dehināṃ vai madarthitāṃ tu satvaram ||98||
kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavan manukālena vai mayā |
tapobhaktyā niruddhastvaṃ sarveṣāṃ mokṣahetave ||99||
aparādhaparārdhāni mayā kṛtāni keśava |
kṣāntvā dhāmāni sarvān vai dehino naya mādhava || 3.18.1 00||
yathāyogyāni dhāmāni naya svatantrako’si yat |
nāgraho bhagavanme’tra svarge satye tathākṣare || 101 ||
ityarthitaṃ mama sarvaṃ vidhehi parameśvara |
asaṃkhyābhayadānecchā pūritā svāminā tvayā || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaikaviṃśe varṣe sarvabhūmidehimokṣārthaṃ tapasyato rādhanikāpuṇyarātaviprayormanvantarakāle gate vāñcchāpūraṇārthaṃ śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasya sarveśvaradevādisahitasyasamāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||

<3.19>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tato’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
puṇyaṃ bhaktiṃ tapo dṛṣṭvā bhaktayormanukālajam || 1 ||
yoginoḥ pātrayormamānugrahasya ca divyayoḥ |
īśvarībhūtayorhārdaṃ pūrayituṃ purārthitam || 2 ||
bhūloke mānavā ye ye narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ |
bālā vṛddhā yuvānaśca vidhurā gṛhiṇastathā || 3 ||
tyāgino vanavāsāśca tān sarvān vai samantataḥ |
yugapad divyadehāśca kṛtvā vimānasaṃsthitān || 4 ||
kām̐ścidapreṣayaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ kāṃścit kṣīrodaghim |
kāṃścit svargaṃ ca vividhaṃ kām̐ścijjanaṃ mahastapaḥ || 5 ||
kām̐ścidvai satyalokaṃ ca kāṃścid vaikuṇṭhamāvṛtau |
kām̐ścid vairājalokām̐śca kām̐ścid vaiṣṇavasatpadam || 6 ||
kām̐ścittu nityakailāsaṃ kāṃścidavyākṛtaṃ padam |
amṛtaṃ dhāma kāṃścicca kām̐ścid vaikuṇṭhamuttamam || 7 ||
kām̐ścid golokamevāpi kām̐ścidakṣaramuttamam |
kām̐ściddhāmānyanekāni yeṣāṃ yogyāni yāni ca || 8 ||
tāni tān prāpayāmāsa cāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
atha ye paśavaścāpi pakṣiṇaśca mṛgādayaḥ || 9 ||
sarīsṛpādayaścāpi mānavādhārajīvanāḥ |
mānavāpekṣakāḥ sarve grāmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 3.19.10 ||
divyadehāḥ kṛtāstūrṇaṃ dvibhujā devakoṭayaḥ |
tān sarvānapi divyeṣu vimāneṣu nidhāya ca || 1 1||
svargaṃ janaṃ mahaḥ satyaṃ sauryaṃ cāndraṃ ca vāruṇam |
āgneyaṃ tāpasaṃ cārṣaṃ vairājaṃ dhāma ityapi || 12||
apreṣayaṃ yathāyogyān jīvān bhaktecchayā tvaham |
dagdhvā janyāni karmāṇi bhūsthān jīvānamocayam || 1 3||
aprāpayaṃ divyalokān yathāpekṣamanugrahāt |
lakṣmi kṛpā mayā ceyaṃ kṛtā bhaktānusāriṇī || 14||
bhūlokaḥ prāyaśaḥ śreyolokeṣu preṣito’bhavat |
pṛthvī riktā ca sañjātā vinā mānavarūpakaiḥ || 15||
tathā tadyogayuktānāṃ paśvādīnāṃ ca rūpakaiḥ |
riktā jātā mahī sarvā bhaktayostapaso balāt || 16||
puraiva mocitā jīvā abhīdānapradānakaiḥ |
mama bhaktena vipreṇa puṇyarātena yoginā || 17||
madbhaktānyā tathā rādhanikayā dvijayoṣitā |
sarvasṛṣṭau kṛpāluścāhaṃ tadā khyātimāpa ha || 18||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bhaktādhīnaḥ prabhūtvaivākaravaṃ śreya uttamam || 19 ||
tato’bhavaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛpā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato bhaktaṃ puṇyarātaṃ tathā satīm || 3.19.20 ||
rādhanikāṃ divyadehau kṛtvā viṣṇusvarūpiṇau |
vimāne sve sthāpayitvāpreṣayaṃ tau nijākṣaram || 21 ||
atha brahmādayo devā bhūtalaṃ vīkṣya nirjanam |
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ punarmānavasṛṣṭaye || 22||
paśvādīnāṃ ca sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sthātuṃ cākalpameva mām |
tato’haṃ bhūtale loke nyavasaṃ divyarūpavān || 23 ||
tvayā divyasvarūpiṇyā lakṣmyā sākaṃ pumuttamaḥ |
punaḥ sṛṣṭimakaravaṃ yathāpūrvāṃ tu mānasīm || 24||
mānavānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ sarvadehinām |
icchayā vedhasaścāpi nyavasaṃ kalpakāntakam || 25 ||
evaṃ muktiḥ kṛtā cāpi punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtāpi ca |
smara sarvaṃ śivarājñi pare jānanti naiva tat || 26||
avatārā hyasaṃkhyātā jātā me kāryato’pi ca |
vatsare tatra kalpeṣu vedmi sarvānahaṃ priye || 27||
kṛpāvatīramā tvaṃ ca tadābhavo mayā saha |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ mama vai tadā || 28 ||
athānyavatsare cāpi kathayāmi nibodha me |
brahmaṇo vai rudravatsarākhye dviśatakalpake || 29 ||
babhūva cāraṇo bhakto rakṣālayābhidhānakaḥ |
cāraṇī tasya bhāryā ca nāmnā tu santayoginī || 3.19.30 ||
yogabhraṣṭau pūrvabhaktau jātismarau babhūvatuḥ |
bhajamānau ca māṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram || 31 ||
snānabhaktiparau sādhusādhvīsevāparāyaṇau |
nivasataḥ sma mahiṣīgovraje drumasaṃkule || 3 2||
pallyāṃ kharvaṭanikaṭe tṛṇaghāsādiśobhane |
antarīkṣaprakāśe vai kāmakalpānadītaṭe || 33 ||
cārayataḥ paśūnnityaṃ dadhighṛtādijīvanau |
ūrṇavastrau hare kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃsmarau || 34||
anivedya ca me sthālīṃ polikādadhipūritām |
prātarnaiva na madhyāhne bhuñjāte na tathā niśi || 3 5||
jalaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ vanyadrumebhya eva ca |
āhṛtya sundaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hṛdyaṃ cārpayato mama || 36||
sādhavo’tithayaścāpyāyānti ye tu nijoṭajām |
tebhyo’rpayato dugdhānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ca polikāḥ || 37||
santastṛptāḥ prakurvanti nāma saṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ |
divāniśaṃ ca vā yānti yatheṣṭaṃ vā vasantyapi || 38||
sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti yoginyaḥ satyadevatāḥ |
brahmacāriṇya evāpi prasiddhaṃ cāraṇālayam ||39||
devālayo yathā tadvad pallī sā govrajātmikā |
satīsādhvīsatāṃ vāsād devālayasamābhavat ||3.19.40 ||
yatra madbhajanaṃ nityaṃ yatra matpūjanaṃ sadā |
yatra matkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ tatra devālayo mama ||41 ||
ityahaṃ cāgocaro’pi nyavasaṃ tatra padmaje |
bhaktānāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ gṛhe cāpi ca maṇḍale || 42||
tīrthe cāpi vasāmyeva bhaktakalyāṇahetave |
bhuñje svapimi nṛtyāmi pibāmi ca rame’nvaham ||43||
viharāmi vihasāmi sahayāmi viśāmi ca |
yatte vadāmi gāyāmi prasīdāmi bhajāmi ca ||44||
snāmi śaucāmi saṃkurve cintayāmi ca raumyapi |
bhaktaiḥ saha militvaivācarāmi vividhāṃ kriyām ||45||
līlāṃ mokṣakarīṃ sarvā divyāmānandayāmyapi |
rāsabhāvena gopaiśca gopībhiśca bhrame’pi ca ||46||
madbhaktānāṃ nivāseṣu tathā vasāmi sarvadā |
evaṃ cāraṇavāse’haṃ nyavasaṃ bhaktamaṇḍale ||47||
sarvathā sarvadādṛśyo na jānanti yathā hi te |
tathāvasaṃ tayoḥ kuṭyāṃ govraje mūrtirūpavān ||48||
athaikadābhavat kāmakalpānadyāstaṭe śubhaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ vai samājaśca mahotsavo’nnasatrakaḥ ||49||
tatra yātāścāraṇāśca sādhavo’pi samutsave |
annasatramaye yajñe bhojayituṃ janānapi ||3.19.50 ||
annadānaṃ dugdhadānaṃ vastradānaṃ ghṛtārpaṇam |
kriyate ca yathāśakti bhikṣukebhyo nadītaṭe ||51 ||
dānotsava itikhyātiḥ satrasyāsya tato’bhavam |
tatra sarve cāraṇā vai gatāścātha tu cāraṇī ||52||
ekākinī gṛharakṣākṛte gehe sthitābhavat |
vatsānāṃ pālanādyarthaṃ gṛhakāryārthamityapi ||53 ||
atha devāḥ samāyānti vyomamārgāt tadā bhuvi |
dānasthale mahātīrthe mahāścaryaparāstadā ||54||
viprāśca bhikṣukā bhūtvā bhūtvā sādhusvarūpiṇaḥ |
kiṃciddānaṃ svīkurvanti kāmakalpaphalapradam ||55||
dāturgrahitustulyaṃ vai jāyate tatra tatphalam |
ataḥ puṇyapralobhena devā gṛhṇanti dānakam ||56||
vaicitryaṃ dānasatre’trobhayataḥ phaladaṃ yataḥ |
athāmbarāttadā devo vaimāniko’lpapuṇyavān ||57|||
niryayau vyomamārgeṇa pallīṃ paśyan nadīṃ prati |
tena mohadṛśā dṛṣṭā surūpā cāraṇī satī ||58||
ujjvalā puṣṭadehā ca yuvatī svalpavastrikā |
nirjane prabhayā vyāptā sughaṭṭāṃgasuśobhanā ||59||
miṣṭasvaraṃ samuddhāṭya kīrtane magnamānasā |
snānārdrasarvadehā ca siñcamānā jalaṃ tanau ||3.19.6 0||
svarṇacampakavarṇābhā ratimūrtirivāparā |
evaṃ vilokya mugdho’sau vaimāniko hi nirjane ||6 1 ||
cakame tāṃ satīṃ devīmavātarat tadantikam |
bhūtvā devo’pi ca yuvā surūpaścāraṇottamaḥ ||62||
sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhaḥ puṣṭaśca navayauvanaḥ |
kāmamūrtiriva tatra śobhate tejasā hyati || 63||
āyayau sannidhau tasyā hasan spraṣṭuṃ yatheṣṭakam |
sāpi bhaktā navaṃ dṛṣṭvā janaṃ tūrṇaṃ sakāmukam ||6 4||
śīghramutthāya kuṭyāṃ sā yayau śīlāvanāya vai |
māṃ deva mā prapaśya tvaṃ kudṛṣṭyā śīlaśālinīm ||65||
pūjayāmi namaskurve prayāhi yāhi śaktimān |
pradharṣaṇamakāmāyā nikṛṣṭaphaladaṃ yataḥ ||66||
mānyāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā devāḥ svalpe tāḍyā na vai mayā |
yāhi satraṃ sukhaṃ tyaktvāśāṃ durantāṃ vimānavan ||67||
eṣa dugdhāñjaliṃ tubhyamarpayāmyarhaṇārthakam |
mama vākyaṃ susammānya prayāhi tvaṃ yathāgatam ||68||
sādho pativratāyāśca tapasvināṃ gavāṃ tathā |
anivāryo bhaved daṇḍo yamasya brahmacāriṇām ||6 9||
devo vā sārvabhaumo vā vipro vā ceśvaro’pi vā |
bhavet kupathago daṇḍyaḥ pathi tiṣṭhan prapūjyakaḥ ||3.19.70||
ityukto’pi satīṃ tāṃ cāraṇīṃ spraṣṭuṃ ca dharṣitum |
upāyayau sa śālāyāṃ khinnā satī jagāda tam |||71|||
devo bhūtvā divyabhogān bhuktvāpi mānave tanau |
mohaṃ yāto bhavānatra bhasmasād bhava kāmuka ||72||
mā devāścādyataḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāyāntu vimānagāḥ |
ye’bhiyāsyanti bhūbhāge bhaviṣyanti hi bhasmasāt ||73||
ityuktamātra evāsau bhasmasādabhavattadā |
dānasatre ca ye devāḥ pṛthivīsthāstadābhavan ||74||
te’pi tūrṇaṃ śāpamātrādabhavan bhasmasāt priye |
hāhākārastadā jātaścāraṇīśāpataḥ kṣitau ||75||
jñātvā devā divyabuddhyā kāraṇaṃ svavināśakam |
drutaṃ ca dudruvurvyomnā dānaṃ tyaktvā nijālayān ||76||
devāgamo’bhavad ruddho brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
indracandrādayaścāpi bhuvaṃ nāyānti bhīvaśāḥ ||77||
devatā na samāyānti tīrthadevā yayurdivam |
pativratāyāḥ śāpena bhayamāptā divaṃ gatāḥ ||78||
atha ye mānavā loke pāpāste tīrthagāminaḥ |
pāpaṃ prakṣālayantyeva tīrtheṣu bhūmigeṣu vai ||79||
tāni pāpāni tīrthānāṃ dagdhuṃ nāyānti devatāḥ |
kuṃbhe parvaṇi saṃkrāntau cāvabhṛthe’pi bhīvaśāḥ ||3.19.80||
atha tīrthāni sarvāṇi pāpākrāntāni pāpinām |
duḥkhitānyabhavam̐ścāpyārādhayāmāsuracyutam ||8 1 ||
satīśāpāt surā naivāyānti bhūmaṇḍalaṃ bhayāt |
asmannāśo bhavedevācireṇa pāpasaṃgrahāt ||82||
tasmādāgatya bhagavannuddhāraṃ kuru no bhuvi |
parabrahma svayaṃ cāhaṃ devānāṃ stavanaistataḥ ||83 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhuvamāgataḥ |
cāraṇīgṛhamāgatya tadaṅke putratāṃ gataḥ ||84||
tīrthairdevaiḥ pūjitaśca śaṃkhacakrādicihnavān |
tvaṃ tadā cābhavo ratnadhanākhyacāraṇātmajā ||85||
tena vijñāya cihnaistvaṃ ramā ratnanarāyaṇī |
ratnanārāyaṇīśrīstvamarpitā vidhinā ca me ||86||
anādiśrītīrthanārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ |
sarvatīrthaiścāraṇaiśca prakhyāpitaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||87||
tataḥ sākaṃ tvayā cāhaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ sahitastathā |
tīrthānyakaravaṃ sarvāṇyabhigatvā punaḥ punaḥ ||88||
aghānyadahaṃ teṣāṃ cākaravaṃ śāpamokṣaṇam |
devānāmāgamārthaṃ vai pṛthvyāṃ mātṛnideśataḥ ||89||
tato devā āyayuśca śāpasaṃharaṇottaram |
athāhaṃ kalpaparyantaṃ tīrthanārāyaṇo’bhavam ||3.19.90||
nyavasaṃ dharmamāsthāya nītvā ca pitarau saha |
bhaktānnītvā nijaṃ dhāma tato yayau purātanam ||91 ||
ityetanmama bhūbhāge cāraṇīśāpanuttaye |
prākaṭyaṃ yatpurā jātaṃ kathitaṃ kamale ca te ||92||
jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ nānye jānanti vismarāḥ |
smara tvaṃ cāraṇīṃ jātāṃ ratnanārāyaṇīṃ priye ||93 ||
anye tadāvatārā me pṛthvyāṃ jātā anekaśaḥ |
sākaṃ tvayā śivarājñi tān jānāmi samastakān ||94||
tato mayā kṛtā loka cāraṇā devajātayaḥ |
yathā santastathā sarve yathā viprāśca bhūsurāḥ ||95||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇāt smaraṇāttathā |
mananānmama prākaṭyasyāpi syānmokṣabhāg janaḥ ||96||
dhanavān dharmavān syācca putravān sarvaśaktimān |
nārī saubhāgyasaukhyādyaiśvaryavatī bhavedapi || 97||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvāviṃśe vatsare tīrthapāvanārthaṃ cāraṇyā aṃke’nāditīrthanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadaśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||

<3.20>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param |
sarveśvareśvareśānāṃ viniyantuḥ parātmanaḥ || 1 ||
trayoviṃśe vedhasaśca sanātanākhye vatsare |
dvipañcāśattame kalpe prathame ca manau purā || 2 ||
pṛthivyāṃ suranadyāśca taṭe kālādane vane |
madhumacchṛṃgavatpārśve kṣmāsurāḥ sma vasanti vai || 3 ||
tāpasā dhyānaparamā yajñayāgaparāyaṇāḥ |
brahmakāryaparāścāpi paramārthaparāyaṇāḥ || 4 ||
gṛhadharme sthitāḥ karmajñānamukhyāḥ vibhaktikāḥ |
manvate na bahubhaktiṃ sma te mokṣasya sādhanam || 5 ||
dharmayuktaṃ hi vijñānaṃ vivekaṃ bahu manvate |
jaḍājaḍavivekā ye nijadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 6 ||
taranti sarvabhogāḍhyā api jñānena bandhanam |
akartātmā cāpyabhoktā nityaśuddho’sti varṣmasu || 7 ||
ahaṃmamatvarahito rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ |
sukhaduḥkhavimuktaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
vāsanāśayahīnaśca kriyāyatnavivarjitaḥ |
bahirbuddhivihīnaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
rajobhāvavihīnaśca kāmakrodhādivarjitaḥ |
vṛthāceṣṭāvihīnaśca mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 3.20.1 0||
strīputragṛhayukto’pi vanavāṭīsamanvitaḥ |
mahiṣīgovṛṣayuk ca nirbandho mukta eva saḥ || 11 ||
lokācārayuto nityaṃ śāstrācāraparāyaṇaḥ |
maryādāyāṃ vartamāno mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 2||
ityevaṃ vṛṣamukhyāste kṣmāsurā makhakarmiṇaḥ |
sustrīputrīputrayuktā vartante sma sarittaṭe || 13 ||
phalamūladalāhārāḥ sūryapakvāśanāstathā |
ṛtupakvāśanāścāpi vartante sma nirāśayāḥ || 14||
brahmaśīlaparāścāpi cīravalkaladhāriṇaḥ |
jaṭābhasmādiyuktāśca parṇakuṭyādivāsinaḥ || 15||
brahmacaryaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pālayanti vratāni ca |
yajñotsavān prakurvanti smotsavān jñānināmapi || 16||
evaṃ vai vartamānāste janeṣu bhūtalādiṣu |
sthāpayanti sma vai jñānaṃ sakarma mokṣasādhanam || 17||
bhaktiṃ smaranti naivaite dharme samāśrayanti ca |
tato vai caikadā bhaktyā patnyātikṛśayā patiḥ || 18||
dharmadevo’rthitaḥ puṣṭyai nijāyāḥ prāṇarakṣakaḥ |
kānta rakṣaka lokānāṃ patnīvrato’sti vai bhavān || 1 9||
tava puṣṭiṃ prakurvanti kṣmāsurāḥ kalpake’tra ca |
mama sthānaṃ na tatrāsti mṛtiṃ yāsyāmi vai tataḥ ||3.20.20 ||
māṃ vihāya tvayā nātha na gantavyaṃ kadācana |
tava puṣṭirmama hānirnaitad yuktaṃ kadācana ||21 ||
yathā puṣṭirmama syācca tathā pālyā tava priyā |
apriyā cet tavāhaṃ vāstrīti tyājyā sadā khalu ||22||
yena me maraṇaṃ śreyaḥkaraṃ syānna tu jīvanam |
ityukto dharmadevo vai śuśoca kṣaṇamāntare ||23 ||
bhaktipuṣṭiṃ hṛdi kṛtvā nirṇayāmāsa tatkṛtim |
yayau nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ parabrahma sanātanam ||24||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam |
akṣarākhye pare dhāmni cāgatya ca pupūja mām ||25||
prārthayad bhaktidevyāstu sthāpanārthaṃ kṣitau vṛṣaḥ |
parabrahma harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa pareśvara ||26||
adya kalpe kṣitau lokā dharmamātraparāyaṇāḥ |
karmakāṇḍaparāścāpi bhaktihīnā vivekinaḥ ||27||
jaḍacetanabhedajñāḥ kaivalyārthā bhavanti vai |
upāsanā na caivāsti nārāyaṇasya te prabho ||28||
arcāgandho’pi naivāsti kṣmāyāṃ kvāpi harestava |
tataścārcāsvarūpasyārhaṇamupāsanādikam ||29||
pravartayituṃ bhagavan bhaktiṃ poṣayituṃ tathā |
jīvayituṃ bhaktibhedān prayāsaṃ vaha mādhava ||3.20.3 0||
śrutvaivaṃ prārthanāṃ dharmadevasya bhaktipoṣiṇīm |
drutaṃ lakṣmi sadāyuktayoginaṃ hi sadāśivam || 31 ||
prerayāmāsa pṛthvyāṃ vai gantuṃ khaṇḍayituṃ tathā |
kevalaṃ karmavādaṃ ca jñānavādaṃ ca kevalam ||32||
bhaktiṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ vai karma jñānaṃ na mokṣadam |
ityevamupadeśārthaṃ preṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram ||33||
sa ca bhūmau drutaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā lokāṃśca karmaṭhān |
bhaktihīnān kṣmāsurādīn racayāmāsa kautukam ||34||
digambaro yuvā bhūtvojjvalo mohakavigrahaḥ |
devyā yukto haraḥ puṣṭo yayau kṣmāsurakharvaṭam ||35||
yatra vasanti sarve te karmaṭhāḥ kṣmāsurādayaḥ |
tatpatnyaścāpi tatkanyāḥ kumārāśca dvijodbhavāḥ ||36||
karmaṭhāḥ sarva evaite bhedajñānaparā api |
bhaktihīnā divyadṛṣṭivihīnā dehamāninaḥ ||37||
kāmakrodhaparāścāpi devamāhātmyavarjitāḥ |
yogisādhupratimādimāhātmyavarjitāstathā ||38||
ātitheyavihīnāśca brāhmadaśāvivarjitāḥ |
saṃsāradṛṣṭiyuktāśca doṣabhaddhṛdayānvitāḥ ||39||
evaṃvidhāḥ kṣmāsurāste yatra vasanti saṃhatāḥ |
narā nāryo grāmavāsāḥ parṇakuṭyādivāsinaḥ ||3.20.40||
tatrāyaṃ śaṃkaro nagno yayau ceṣṭāṃ tu kāminaḥ |
kurvan gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti kanyāstathā kumārakāḥ ||41 ||
yuvatyaśca tathā nāryo mattaṃ vilokya dehinam |
pramattaṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭaṃ mohakaṃ tamanudrutāḥ ||42||
narmavākyāni jagadurvīkṣayāmāsurīśvaram |
kāmukaṃ hasamānāśca cikṣipurdhūlikādikam ||43 ||
kāścittu tāḍayāmāsurnitambe daṇḍayaṣṭibhiḥ |
mohitāḥ śmāsurapatnyo’nujagmurbhānavarjitāḥ ||44||
pasparśuḥ sukhālobhena ninyurnirjanakuṃjake |
viprā vīkṣya tathā śrutvā karmakāṇḍaparāyaṇāḥ ||45||
mṛṣāvivekadhvajino’nupeturhananāya tam |
prāpya daṇḍairyaṣṭibhiśca tāḍayāmāsuratyati ||46||
śaṃkaro yuktayogyeva duḥkhaṃ jānāti naiva ha |
tāḍanaṃ balavat prāpya mamāra patito bhuvi ||47||
śavībhūto’bhavat tatra śvāsaṃ gṛhṇāti naiva ha |
samādhau vartate yadvanmṛto yathābhavattadā ||48||
te ca santyajya patitaṃ viprāḥ svasvālayān yayuḥ |
satī devī tataḥ kruddhā śaśāpa tān pratāḍakān ||49||
yato mithyājñānakarā vivekadhvajino dvijāḥ |
ātmasattāvihīnāśca nijākartṛtvamāninaḥ ||3.20.50||
akartṛtvamabhoktṛtvaṃ nityaśuddhatvamātmani |
aṃśamātraṃ na manvānā vāgāḍambaravedinaḥ ||5 1 ||
karmaṭhā deharūpāśca kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ |
yogināṃ ca satāṃ divyamāhātmyasyāvidastathā || 52||
kāmakriyāparā yūyaṃ svavatpare’bhiśaṃkinaḥ |
nirdayā brahmahatyākā mṛtiṃ yāntu yathā haraḥ |||53 ||
iti satyā cābhihite kheṭe kharvaṭake vane |
kṣmāsurā naravargāste drutaṃ kramānmṛtiṃ yayuḥ ||54||
śavā gṛhe gṛhe jātā narāṇāṃ vasatiṣvapi |
hāhākāro mahān jāto viprāvāseṣu cābhitaḥ ||55||
viprā mṛtiṃ prayāntyeva nagnanāryāḥ praśāpanāt |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ rakṣaṇārthamihādya vai |||56||
nāryo rudanti parito bālāḥ kanyā rudantyapi |
mānavāścāpi saṃśrutvā rudanti ca sthale sthale ||57||
ātmabhāvavihīnāśca vivekajñānavarjitāḥ |
vāṅmātrajñānakartāro bhedajñānavivarjitāḥ ||58||
karmaṭhāḥ krodhakāmādidoṣayuktāḥ śucānvitāḥ |
sarvatra mānave loke kṣitau deśeṣu vai tadā ||59||
kṣmāsurā gatabhānāśca gatāsavo’bhavam̐stadā |
dinamadhye tu sarvasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kamale tadā || 3.20.60||
koṭyarbudaśavānāṃ vai śmaśānānyabhavam̐stadā |
gṛhe gṛhe śavastatra kṣaṇe kṣaṇe prajāyate ||6 1 ||
kopo’yaṃ kaścidevāpi mahattama iti striyaḥ |
anye janā aviprādyā menire sarvanāśakaḥ ||62||
yatra yatrābhavan viprāḥ karmaṭhā bhinnavādinaḥ |
bhaktihīnāśca te sarve śavatāṃ bhejire tadā ||63||
hāhākāre tathā jāte narā nāryo’vaśeṣitāḥ |
ārādhanāṃ pareśasya cakrurme paramātmanaḥ ||64||
tvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ jīvanaṃ ca tvaṃ rakṣākara mādhava |
tvaṃ strīṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ nātha jīvayāsmatpatīn janān ||6 5 ||
ityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā nimittaṃ cāgame mama |
ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi cāyayau puruṣottamaḥ ||66 ||
bhuvaṃ śīghraṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādiśobhitaḥ |
svarṇabhūṣāmbaraśālī divyatejo’bhirājitaḥ ||67||
yatra haraśavaścāste yatra dvijaśavāstathā |
tatra pradarśya madrūpaṃ samāśvāsya ca yoṣitaḥ ||68||
tathā narān dvijabhinnānahaṃ dhairyaṃ paraṃ dadau |
karmaṭhā jñānakartāro vivekācāravarjitāḥ ||69||
śuṣkajñānā bhaktihīnāḥ sādhvaparādhakāriṇaḥ |
sadyaḥ phalamime prāptāścāviditvāparādhinaḥ ||3.20.70||
śuṣkajñāne mahatpāpaṃ jñātuścācāravarjinaḥ |
jñāyate yat procyate’pi nācaryate na dhāryate ||71 ||
tatpāpasadṛśaṃ pāpaṃ nānyad bhavati dehinām |
karmakāṇḍaratāśceme vivekadhvajinastathā ||72||
rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ pālayanti na sarvathā |
māritastvavadhūto’yaṃ yogī vivekavām̐śca taiḥ ||73 ||
sādhorbhaktivihīnaiśca mṛtiścāmantritā nijā |
atha lokā janā nāryaḥ papracchuḥ parameśvaram ||74||
kathameṣā mahāpattirvilīyeta praśādhi naḥ |
ahaṃ tadāvadṃ tebhyo lakṣmi tatpūjanāya vai ||75||
śavaṃ taṃ māritaṃ gatvā pūjayantu pratiṣṭhitam |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvantu tanmūrtiṃ pūjayantu ca ||76||
ṣoḍaśādyupacārairvai naivedyārpaṇasevanaiḥ |
nīrājanādibhiścāpi stavanaiḥ pūjayantu tam ||77||
tadā prayāsyati dhvaṃsaṃ mṛtyorupadravastvayam |
śrutvā nāryo narāścāpi mṛṣāvivekavarjitāḥ ||78||
sarve nītvā susāmagrīścandanākṣatamālikāḥ |
dhūpadīpasunaivedyavastrālaṃkārapādukāḥ ||779 ||
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā prapūjya sarvavastubhiḥ |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ cakruste matpūrvāḥ strīnarādayaḥ ||3.20.80||
nīrājanaṃ pracakruśca tāvacchaṃbhuḥ sacetanaḥ |
bhūtvā netre samunmilyotthito’bhavat kṣaṇāntare ||8 1 ||
naivedyaṃ ca dadustasmai jalapānaṃ dadustataḥ |
harastadā prasannaścābhavad varārthamāha tān ||82||
sarve tadārthayāmāsurmṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ punaḥ |
haraḥ prāha prapūjyaināṃ devīṃ labdhvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||83 ||
jīvitāste bhaviṣyanti nānyathā tu kadācana |
atha devīṃ pupūjuste lakṣmi nāryo narāstathā ||84||
arthayāmāsurevāpi mṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ punaḥ |
śivā prāha yathā cātra pūjitā śaṃkarānvitā ||85||
tathā lakṣmīmimāṃ śrīmannārāyaṇasamanvitām |
pūjayantu tataḥ sarve mṛtā yāsyanti jīvanam ||86||
ityuktāśca narā nāryaḥ pupūjurmāṃ tvayānvitam |
tataḥ sarve cotthitāścāparādhamṛtivarjitāḥ ||87||
te jīvaṃ prāpya māṃ jīvannārāyaṇeti vai jaguḥ |
khyātiṃ prāptastadānādijīvannārāyaṇo’pyaham ||88||
tvayā sākaṃ mama mūrti bhaktinārāyaṇātmikām |
sarvadā tu tato bhaktyā matpradarśitayā janāḥ ||89||
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tyaktvā śuṣkaṃ vivecanam |
karmakāṇḍaṃ ca vai sarvasamarpaṇātmakaṃ vyadhuḥ ||3.20.9 0||
śaṃkarastān samastām̐ścopādideśa madarpaṇam |
sarvavidhaṃ karmakāṇḍaṃ mama bhaktyātmakaṃ tataḥ ||9 1 ||
dharmayuktaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ jñānaṃ tu vedanaṃ mama |
tataḥ pravartitaṃ tatra kalpe mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||92||
bhakterujjīvanaṃ jātaṃ bhaktimārgaḥ pravartitaḥ |
mūrtayo mama śaṃbhośca saśaktikāśca bhūtale ||93 ||
tatastairjīvamāpannaiḥ sthāpitā darśitā yathā |
pūjitāścāpi sarvatra bhaktiḥ puṣṭiṃ jagāma ha ||94||
evaṃ śaṃbhuḥ satīyuktaḥ kṛtvā kautukamuttamam |
sthāpayitvā kṣitau mūrtipūjāṃ bhaktiṃ tathottamām ||95||
yayāvadṛśyatāṃ cāhaṃ jīvanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
tvayā sākaṃ kṣitau kalpāntakaṃ kālamuvāsa ha ||96||
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri prākaṭyaṃ kīrtitaṃ mama |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||97||
dharmasya bhaktiyuktasyopāsanāyāśca puṣṭaye |
pūjāyā mama mūrteśca mūrteśca śaṃkarasya ca ||98||
nāsīlliṃgaṃ ca tatkalpe mūrtirāsīddharasya vai |
mama mūrtistadaivāsīnnāsīdviṣṇuśilā tadā ||99||
evaṃ pūrvaṃ tu yajjātaṃ vedmyahaṃ sarvameva tat |
smara tvaṃ mama pūjādi tadā prākaṭyamityapi || 3.20.10 0||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
mama pūjāphalaṃ lakṣmi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastrayoviṃśe vatsare bhakteḥ prārthanayānādiśrījīvanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyaṃ śaṃkaradvārā bhaktimārgapravartanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||

<3.21>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri prākaṭyaṃ cāparaṃ mama |
caturviṃśe vatsare ca vedhasastvārṣasaṃjñake || 1 ||
kalpe śatatame ṣaṣṭhe manau yathābhavat purā |
tadānīṃ vedavidvāṃso brāhmaṇā yatayastathā || 2 ||
devatāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi pitaraścājanirmite |
sarvamedhātmake yajñe mimilurmokṣadātaṭe || 3 ||
vicārāstatra sarveṣāmabhavan matparāyaṇāḥ |
kīdṛśo’yaṃ hariḥ sevyaścaikalo vāpi yugmakaḥ || 4 ||
nirguṇo vā saguṇo vā mūrto hyamūrtaṃ eva vā |
agnirūpo’thavādityasvarūpo vāpyarūpakaḥ || 5 ||
atha tatra svayaṃ brahmā jagāda yugalātmakaḥ |
anye maharṣayaḥ prāhuścaika eva parātparaḥ || 6 ||
devāḥ prāhuḥ saguṇo’yaṃ yatayo nirguṇaḥ svayam |
sevanīyo yathāyogyo mūrtimānapare jaguḥ || 7 ||
karmaṭhāḥ prāhurevāyaṃ sevanīyo hyamūrtakaḥ |
agnirūpo hariḥ sākṣāt pare prāhurhi bhāskaraḥ || 8 ||
sevanīyo brahmamūrtiścetyevaṃ vādamācaran |
nirṇayo naikarūpo’bhūt tadā viṣṇurjagāda ha || 9 ||
śaṃbhuścāyaṃ yathā tvasmān vadennirṇaya eva saḥ |
śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā harervākyaṃ prajagāda sabhājanān || 3.21.10 ||
dhyānaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prakurvantu svayaṃ dāsyati nirṇayam |
ityuktaṃ śaṃkaravākyaṃ sarvamedhādhvare tadā || 11 ||
dhyānamagnā abhavam̐śca devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ |
tāvad vyomno divyatejomayo’driḥ samupāyayau || 12||
avyāpnodambaraṃ sarvaṃ divaṃ bhuvaṃ digantaram |
tanmadhye suvimānaṃ cākṣarābhidhaṃ mama priyam || 1 3||
adṛśyata tadā lakṣmi tatrāhaṃ ca tvayā saha |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’rdhakamalātanuḥ || 14||
pratyakṣaḥ puratasteṣāṃ dhyāne tataśca gocaraḥ |
ardhe śikhā śirasyāste’rdhe śrīkeśātmadhammilaḥ || 15||
ardhabhāle sutilakaṃ cārdhabhāle sucandrakaḥ |
dakṣe karṇe kuṇḍalaṃ ca vāme kuṇḍalikairiṇī || 16||
dakṣe tu nirmalaṃ cūrṇaṃ vāme netre tu kajjalam |
dakṣe śmaśrustathā riktā nāsā vāme sanitthakā || 17||
dakṣaṃ vakṣaśconnataṃ ca vāmaṃ stanasamanvitam |
dakṣahastau śaṃkhacakrayutau sukaṭakānvitau || 18||
vāmahastau padmamālāśṛṃkhalāvyajanānvitau |
dakṣe śrīvatsacihnārdhaṃ vāme mūrtyardhakaṃ ca me || 19||
dakṣodare’rdhatrivalī vāme samodarātmatā |
dakṣe’rdhaṃ naraliṃgaṃ ca vāme’rdhāyonirityapi ||3.21.20||
dakṣe tveko hi vṛṣaṇo vāme tu guptagranthikā |
dakṣapādaḥ saromā cāromā vāmaḥ samujjvalaḥ |
naravaddīrghaphaṇakaḥ nārīvaddhrasvasatphaṇaḥ ||21 ||
dakṣārdhaṃ śyāmasaundaryaṃ vāmārdhaṃ kanakojjvalam |
dakṣārdhaṃ pītadhautrādisvarṇārdhamukuṭānvitam ||22||
vāmārdhaṃ kañcukīśāṭīsvarṇamukuṭikānvitam |
dakṣārdhaṃ narabhūṣāḍhyaṃ vāmaṃ nārīvibhūṣaṇam ||23||
dakṣaṃ puṃbalasaṃyuktaṃ vāmaṃ nārīsumārdavam |
evaṃ bhūtvā caika eva tathāpi dvisvarūpavān ||24||
pratyakṣaḥ puratasteṣāmardhaśrīśanarāyaṇaḥ |
dadhyuste cāntare māṃ ca tādṛśaṃ dvyekarūpiṇam ||25||
pupūjurmānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro’pi mām |
brahmādyāḥ prārthayāmāsuratra kṣitau sadā vasa ||26||
evamevasvarūpastvaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave |
tato’haṃ mokṣadānadyāstaṭe merostu paścime ||27||
ādhvare bhūtale nityamavasaṃ sarvagocaraḥ |
ākalpāntaṃ parameśaḥ śikṣayan pratimārhaṇam ||28||
anādiśrīmadardhaśrīśvaranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
tathaiva mandirādau ca gṛhe gṛhe ca sarvathā || 29||
mūrtiścaikavidhā me’bhūdardhaśrīśanarāyaṇī |
tathaivopāsanā dhyānaṃ pūjanaṃ veṣadhāraṇam ||3.21.3 0||
sarvaṃ me tādṛśaṃ hyāsīd bhaktaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ vapuḥ |
madicchayā mayā lakṣmi tatra kalpe tathā kṛtam ||3 1||
dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai yathākṣare viśiṣṭakam |
atha devādayo māṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ tathāvidham ||32||
pūjayantyupāsayanti sma ca muktiṃ vrajanti ca |
ityevaṃ me tatra kalpe prākaṭyamuditaṃ tava ||33||
ityevaṃ smara yugmaikyaṃ nijaprākaṭyamīśvari |
sarvaṃ jānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi tathā naikāvatārakān ||34||
athāgre cetaranme ca prākaṭyaṃ pravadāmi te |
pañcaviṃśe vedhasaśca dharmākhye vatsare tadā || 35||
kalpe pañcaśate cādye manau pitṛgaṇāḥ purā |
pṛthvyāmāgatya vaṃśebhyo jagaduḥ śrāddhabhojanam ||36 ||
tattadvaṃśodbhavā lokā vidyāvanto vyadhuśca tat |
śraddhayā pitṛsaṃghānuddiśya piṇḍādikaṃ daduḥ ||37||
te sarve pitaraścāpi vinirgatyārdhadehinaḥ |
prasāritakarābhyāṃ vai piṇḍān prajagṛhurmudā || 38||
prasannavadanāścāpi samujjvalakarāstathā |
nābhyūrdhvadṛśyadehāśca piṇḍān prāpyaiva tasthire ||39||
karasthabhojanāḥ sarve evameva sthirāstadā |
abhuñjānā abhavam̐śca maunāḥ śāntā nirutsukāḥ ||3.21.40 ||
tadā vaṃśajaviprādyairabhuñjānā vilokitāḥ |
pṛṣṭāśca pitaraḥ sarve kathaṃ bhuṅdhve na cārpitam ||41 ||
te prāhuśca hareḥ prāsādikaṃ nāstyetadeva yat |
tadabhakṣyaṃ sadāsmākaṃ yataśca vaiṣṇavā vayam ||42||
atha vaṃśyāḥ pṛṣṭavantaḥ kathaṃ prāsādikaṃ bhavet |
yadatra dṛśyate naiva na cāste ca narāyaṇaḥ ||43||
tadā te pitaraḥ prāhurharisūktaṃ japantviha |
haristvāgatya piṇḍādi pāyasānnaṃ grahīṣyati ||44||
atha te harisūktenārādhayanmāṃ tadā kṣaṇe |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||45||
ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi pitṝṇāṃ bhaktirodhataḥ |
pratyakṣastatra vaṃśyānāmagre nābhyūrdhvadehakan ||46||
pitṛbhiḥ saha tatraiva niṣadya bhuktavān payaḥ |
pāyasaṃ cāpi miṣṭānnaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ ca mūlakam ||47||
tvaṃ ca nārāyaṇīśri svanābhyūrdhvadṛśyavigrahā |
śṛṃgāritā mayā sākaṃ bhuktavatī ca pāyasam ||48||
atha te pitaraḥ sarve jalānnādikameva tu |
prāsādikaṃ mayā dattaṃ bhuktavantaḥ sukhotsukāḥ ||49||
tṛptāḥ sarve yayurbhuktvā pitṛlokān nijālayān |
ahaṃ sañjo’bhavaṃ yāvattāvad viprādibhiḥ kṣitau ||3.21.50||
prārthitau nityavāsārthaṃ nānyūrdhvadehadhāriṇau |
ardhadṛśyau divyarūpau sundarau saumyavigrahau ||51||
tathāstvityucitaṃ matvā sthitavantau sadā kṣitau |
ākalpāntaṃ ca nābhyūrdhvārdhamūrtidhāriṇau sadā ||52||
mūrtayaścāpi tādṛśyo gṛhe vane ca mandire |
dhyāne’rhaṇe cotsave cābhavam̐stathārdhavigrahāḥ ||53||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
anādyardhapitṛnārāyaṇākhyaḥ prathito’bhavam ||54||
smara lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ mama mūrtiṃ tadārdhinīm |
athānye’pyavatārā me’bhavam̐stadāpi koṭiśaḥ ||55||
jānāmyahaṃ samastāṃstānnānye jānanti vai gatān |
smaraṇādvandanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradān śubhān ||56||
nāmyadho māyiko bhāgo nārako janmasampradaḥ |
nābhyūrdhvaṃ pāvano bhāgo mokṣado darśito mayā ||57||
ardhordhvamūrtirūpeṇa tadā jñānaṃ tathābhavat |
evaṃ vijñāya sampūjya yātā dhāmākṣaraṃ janāḥ ||58||
atha vakṣye vedhasaśca ṣaḍviṃśe’naṅgavatsare |
kalpe saptaśate manau saptame’haṃ pareśvaraḥ ||59||
prāvirāsaṃ plakṣamadhye’nādiplakṣanarāyaṇaḥ |
tatra kalpe mahātmāno hyātmajñānaparāyaṇāḥ ||3.21.60 ||
āsan vai sādhavo dhīrā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
jaṭāvalkalavastrāścāyācitānnādikāśanāḥ ||61 ||
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭā lokakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ |
yajñopavītayuktāśca tilakānvitavigrahāḥ ||62||
kaṇṭhīmālādiśobhāśca dhyānabhajanakāriṇaḥ |
ekadā militāḥ sarve viṣṇunadyāstaṭe śubhe ||63||
bhaktyaraṇye tapo’rthaṃ vai bhaktyarthaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
saṃvādaṃ te pracakruśca parasparaṃ susaṃhatāḥ ||64|||
tapaḥ śreyaḥpradaṃ kiṃ vā bhaktiḥ śreyaḥpradā dvijāḥ |
yadvobhayaṃ mataṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ ceduttamaṃ nu kim ||65||
ityevaṃ praśnasāre ca jāte kalyāṇayogiṣu |
eke prāhustapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pare prāhurna tattathā ||66||
tapasā kṣīyate pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ prajāyate śubham |
tena bhogopalabdhiśca svargaṃ ca maraṇaṃ kṣaye ||67||
tato vai laukikaṃ śreyastapaścānte na tattathā |
tasmād bhaktiḥ parā śreṣṭhā śreyaḥpradā hi śāśvatī ||68||
anye prāhuḥ sakāmā sā nātyantaśreyasaḥ pradā |
niṣkāmā śreyasī śreṣṭhā paraśreyaḥpradā hi sā ||69||
pare tvāhuryadi bhaktirniṣkāmā kāmanāṃ vinā |
phalahīnā vṛthā sā hi prayāsamātrarūpiṇī ||3.21.70||
tasmāt sakāmā sā kāryā sveṣṭasatphaladāyinī |
ityevaṃ vadamāneṣu maharṣiṣu tadā vṛṣaḥ ||71 ||
dharmadevo viprarūpaḥ samājastho’bravīdidam |
sarveṣāmantarātmā yaḥ sarvasākṣī virājate ||72||
sa devo’tra drume plakṣamaye dharmye virājate |
tasya pūjāṃ prakṛtvaiva praśnabhāro’tra pippale ||73||
nyasanīyaścottaraṃ ca tatsthaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pradāsyati |
ityevaṃ tvekamatyaṃ vai kṛtvā maharṣayastadā ||74||
pippalaṃ tatra sampūjyāśrāvayan parameśvaram |
kimatyantaṃ paraṃ śreyastapo bhaktiśca vā prabho ||75||
iti saṃśrāvya tasthuśca varṣaśataṃ tapo’nvitāḥ |
tathāpi labdhavanto nottaraṃ plakṣāttapodhanāḥ ||76 ||
tāvad vyomagirā devaḥ pareśvaro jagāda tān |
tapasā na bhavecchreya ātyantikaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||77||
ārādhayantu māṃ brahmaparamaṃ sarvasākṣiṇam |
niṣkāmabhaktyā tuṣṭo’haṃ bhavāmi satataṃ dvijāḥ ||78||
bhaktyā cātyantikaṃ śreyaścātyantikamavāpsyatha |
ityuktāste jagaduśca kathaṃ bhaktirvinā harim ||79||
sākṣāddhariṃ vinā bhaktiḥ premasevā kathaṃ bhavet |
vayaṃ cet tapasā pūtāḥ pātrabhūtāḥ sma mādhava ||3.21.80||
asmanmadhye samāgatya śaśvattiṣṭha kṛpālaya |
bhaktāḥ priyāśca te nityaṃ yadarthaṃ cāmbare sthitaḥ ||8 1 ||
adṛśyo’pi bhaktapakṣī vyomavāṇyāpi vatsalaḥ |
karoṣi śāsanaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ matvā nijāñjanān ||82||
yathā śabdena ca tathā svarūpeṇāpi śādhi naḥ |
pratyakṣeṇa nijānasmān samānandaya mādhava ||83 ||
ityukto’hamavadam̐stān bhāvayantu samāhitāḥ |
prāpte cārādhanāpāke bhaviṣyāmi hi gocaraḥ ||84||
atha nārāyaṇīśri svabhāgyāni cottamāni vai |
manyamānā dvijāstatra śatavarṣāṇi saṃsthitāḥ ||85||
ārādhayanto deveśeśvareśvareśvareśvaram |
sādhavaste nirāśāśca brahmāśāmātratatparāḥ ||86 ||
brahmarūpā brahmabhūtāḥ plakṣachāyāmupāśritāḥ |
jepurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca bhejurmāṃ nāmakīrtanaiḥ ||87||
ānarcurmāṃ tulasyādyairdadhyurmāṃ mānase gṛhe |
gateṣu śatavarṣeṣu satāmabhyāsināṃ mama ||88||
sannidhāvabhavaṃ sākṣāt plakṣamūlasamāśritaḥ |
tvayā lakṣmyā sahitaḥ śrīplakṣanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||89||
plakṣastambe garbhabhāge divye tejo’bhimiśrite |
sāvakāśe cidākāśe plakṣabrahmaṇi saṃsthitaḥ ||3.21.9 0||
vāme sākaṃ tvayā padme caturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||9 1 ||
svecchayaiva samudbhūtaḥ sādhuvāñcchāprapūrtaye |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasvastikadhvajaśūlavān ||92||
sarvadivyābharaṇaśca svarṇamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ |
divyacampakavarṇābho divyāmbaradharastathā ||93||
divyatejobhisaṃvyāpto yugalātmā pareśvaraḥ |
sādhvicchāpūrakastatra pratyakṣaḥ śreyasāṃ pradaḥ ||94||
atha divyanayanāste vyapaśyanmāṃ drumāntare |
divyagṛhāmbare tatra drumābhinnaṃ pumuttamam || 95||
nemuścakrurdaṇḍavacca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram |
pupūjustatra militaiścopacārādibhistadā ||96||
snehabhaktyā sadā bhejurmāṃ prarakṣya ca maṇḍale |
ityevaṃ sarvalokānāṃ śreyaḥprado’bhavaṃ priye ||97||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ sanātanaḥ |
puruṣottama evāhaṃ svecchayā sādhumaṇḍale ||98||
anādiśrīplakṣanārāyaṇātmā cābhavaṃ sthitaḥ |
vedmyahaṃ sarvameveti smara tvaṃ plakṣavāsinīm ||99 ||
tava mūrtiṃ śubhāṃ lakṣmīsvarūpiṇīṃ sanātanīm |
anye’pi cāvatārā me’bhavan śatasahasraśaḥ || 3.21.1 00||
īśvarā nāpi jānanti kutaḥ surāśca mānavāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya śrāvaṇātsmaraṇādapi || 101 ||
sevanātplakṣavāsinyāste ca me sevanādapi |
bhuktiścāpi bhavenmuktirmuktiḥ śreṣṭhā ca vai bhavet || 1 02||
pippalaśrīṃ tvarcayed yaḥ pippale śrīnarāyaṇam |
tasya lakṣmyā anapāyo mokṣāvāptirdhruvā bhavet || 10 3||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścaturviṃśe vatsare’nādiśrīmadardhaśrīśanārāyaṇasya, pañcaviṃśe vatsare’nādiśrīmadardhapitṛnārāyaṇasya, ṣaḍviṃśe vatsare cānādiśrīplakṣanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||

<3.22>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama cāparam |
avṛṣākhye vedhasaśca saptaviṃśe tu vatsare || 1 ||
kalpe catuḥśate manau tṛtīye bhūtale’bhavan |
bhūsurā yajñakartāraścakruste cādhvarān bahūn || 2 ||
agnihotraṃ darśahomaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ prayājakam |
sviṣṭakṛdyajanaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ ca vaiśvadaivatam || 3 ||
cāturmāsyaṃ sākamedhaṃ somaṃ cāgrāyaṇeṣṭikam |
avabhṛtheṣṭiṃ tathā cātirātraṃ vājapeyakam || 4 ||
agniṣṭomaṃ tathā sautrāmaṇiṃ ca rājasūyakam |
aśvamedhaṃ sarvamedhaṃ puṃmedhaṃ ca savān bahūn || 5 ||
bṛhaspatisavaṃ vaiśyasavaṃ somasavaṃ tathā |
gosavaṃ brāhmaṇasavaṃ tathaudanasavaṃ śubham || 6 ||
pṛthisavaṃ marutstomaṃ putreṣṭiṃ ca tathāparān |
yajñān vyadhuścaikadā te prārebhire nṛmedhakam || 7 ||
pañcāhaṃ tatra vai yajñe dvyūnadviśatapūruṣān |
devatābhyo hi vidhinopākṛtya ca tataḥ param || 8 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ viśasanaṃ kartumārebhire dvijāḥ |
vapārthaṃ havanārthaṃ ca bhrāntāstattvavido dvijāḥ || 9 ||
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ye nṛpaśavaścābhavan |
nyūnadvādaśavarṣāste yajñopavītadhāriṇaḥ || 3.22.10||
bhaktā abhaktā viprādyā āsan yajñārthakalpitāḥ |
tatraikastvabhavad yogī mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 11 ||
kālamāyādyasaṃgī ca dehādau nispṛho naraḥ |
śubhravarṇaḥ sundarākhyaḥ komalo mudabhṛnmukhaḥ || 12|||
pāvitaḥ prathamo viprairupākṛtaḥ samāhṛtaḥ |
viśasanasya śālāyāṃ yathāvidhi samarcitaḥ || 1 3||
nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇāntarātmannitimānasaḥ |
ātmanivedano nityaṃ madarthasarvaceṣṭakaḥ || 14||
etādṛśaṃ mama bhaktaṃ jñātvā viśasanārthakam |
tūrṇaṃ cāhaṃ samāyātaḥ padme viśasanagṛhe || 15||
adṛśyaḥ karmaṭhānāṃ vai dṛśyo bhaktasya me tadā |
adṛśyīkṛtya madbhaktaṃ sthito’haṃ tatsthale sphuṭaḥ || 16||
tadākāraśca maunaśca bhaktarakṣārthamityapi |
bhrāntināśārthamevāpi hiṃsāyāśca vichittaye || 17||
dharmarakṣārthamevāpi mṛṣākarmavichittaye |
viprebhyo bodhadānārthaṃ yathārthatāpravṛttaye || 18||
tāmasānāṃ pāpakarmanāśārthaṃ śasanālaye |
prāvirāsaṃ tadā lakṣmi pratyakṣaḥ svīyarakṣakaḥ || 19||
atha te yāgadīkṣāptā dvijā mantrān jagustadā |
prokṣya sarvaṃ suvidhinā pūruṣaṃ māṃ prajagṛhuḥ ||3.22.20||
mukhabandhaṃ nirdayāśca pracakruryavapūraṇaiḥ |
vṛṣaṇau mardayāmāsuśchedayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 21||
jīvato me bhramayuktā bhrāntyātmavidhinā khalāḥ |
viśasanaṃ pracakruśca tadāhaṃ pāpināśakṛt ||22||
kartitābhyāṃ vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ vajrābhābhyāṃ tu satvaram |
karmaṭhānāṃ kapālāni brahmarandhrāṇyatāḍayam ||23||
vajramaṇinibhābhyāṃ sāgnibhyāṃ pratāḍitā dvijāḥ |
jajvaluścāpi mamruśca bhinnamūrdhakapālakāḥ ||24||
sahasraśaḥ samutpannā mahānto vartulāśca te |
mahāśilāsvarūpāśca pralayānalasannibhāḥ || 25||
dāhayāmāsureveme pṛthvīṃ nabhaśca tārakān |
bhedayāmāsureveme śailaprāyāstadākhilam ||26|||
nāśayāmāsuḥ parito yajñaṃ yajñīyakānyapi |
hāhākāro mahāñjātaḥ svargapralayavāhakaḥ ||27||
pṛthivyāṃ pattanānāṃ ca dahyanti bahularddhayaḥ |
araṇyāni cārṣavāsā dahyanti vṛṣaṇānalāt ||28||
śālā grāmā āvasathā dagdhāstairvṛṣaṇānalaiḥ |
atha viprā jīvavantaḥ prārthayāñcakrire surān || 29||
rakṣayantu surāścāsmān mṛtyumukhasamāvṛtān |
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmo vyutkramāderavantu naḥ ||3.22.30||
naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣyāmo bhrāntiṃ tyakṣyāma eva naḥ |
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāpārāvārapārīṇamādhava ||3 1 ||
ityevaṃ mriyamāṇāste nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ |
manniyuktāstadā yajñādhidevā jagadurdvijān ||32||
śālāyāṃ vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ vai tayorgrāmā hi nirgatāḥ |
divyā divyacamatkārāḥ śālagrāmā hi te hareḥ ||33 ||
bhaktarakṣākṛte’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
upasthitaḥ śāsituṃ vaḥ puṃpaśurūpavān hariḥ ||34||
tasya tvime vṛṣaṇā vai śālagrāmā bhavanti hi |
agnirūpā vajrarūpāḥ śāstāro bhavatāṃ dvijāḥ || 35||
yūyamakāryakaraṇā hiṃsābhrāntā vimārgagāḥ |
devānāṃ no havyamiṣṭaṃ na māṃsaṃ vai kadācana || 36 ||
pāyasānnaṃ ceṣṭatamaṃ tena kurvantu cādhvarān |
phalāni śarkarāścāpi bījāni kamalāni ca || 37||
kaṇā vrīhiyavāścāpi śālayaśca dalāni ca |
tilā miṣṭānnamapi ca madhu rasāśca śobhanāḥ ||38||
samidhaśca priyā nityaṃ devānāṃ na tu māṃsakam |
dvijā bhrāntā bhavanto vai hiṃsāṃ kurvantu mā tviha || 39||
vayaṃ pavitrā devā mā hyaśuddhe yojayantu naḥ |
pāpaphalaṃ tu vai duḥkhaṃ bhavatāṃ tad bhaviṣyati ||3.22.40||
puṃstvapraṇāśanaṃ caccādhvare’nuṣṭhīyate dvijāḥ |
bhavadbhiḥ svasya puṃstvasya vināśaḥ kriyate divi ||41 ||
svargasyāpi vināśo vo hiṃsādoṣeṇa jāyate |
vayaṃ śuddhivihīnāśca māṃsadoṣeṇa cādhvare ||42||
prāyaścittīyakarmāṇo bhaviṣyāmo dvijāstviha |
svarge prāyaścittakarma tvakṛtvā svasvamandiram ||43 ||
saṃpraveṣṭamaśaktā hi hiṃsāṃ kurvantu no tataḥ |
śālagrāmamahāgneśca śāntiryathā bhavediha ||44||
tathā viṣṇuṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |
ārādhayāmastvatraiva surarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ||45 ||
svayameva hariścāgneḥ śāntiṃ tatra kariṣyati |
ayaṃ cāvṛṣaṇo devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ naraḥ ||46 ||
bhavadbhirhomakāryārthaṃ yojitaḥ saṃskṛtastviha |
tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ śaraṇaṃ sampatantu ca ||47||
sa hi rakṣāṃ rakṣako vai kṣamāṃ kṛtvā kariṣyati |
ityuktāste surā lakṣmi tadā tuṣṭuvurīśvarāḥ ||48||
pitaro mānavā viprā māmevāvṛṣaṇaṃ harim |
tvaṃ parabrahma bhagavān mūlaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||49||
ekamevādvitīyastvaṃ sarveśvarapareśvaraḥ |
tvamevākṣaramuktānāmakṣarasyāpi kāraṇam ||3.22.50||
avatārāvatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ śaktisañjuṣām |
śaktīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarveśvarāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān ||51 ||
yajñānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān |
vidhīnāṃ ca nidhīnāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān ||52||
sarveṣāṃ karmakāṇḍānāṃ devānāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavān |
kartā prerayitā tvaṃ ca vettā tṛptistvameva ca ||53||
dvijāśca karmaṭhāścāpi yajamānastvameva ca |
dravyāṇi sarvahavyāni tvameva bhagavannasi ||54||
arthajñānaṃ vidherjñānaṃ mantrajñānaṃ ca vaidikam |
tvāṃ vinā ca kriyājñānaṃ ko’nyo darśayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||55||
kṣamāṃ kṛtvā hare nātha dahyamānaṃ jagat tviha |
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho’parādhām̐śca kṣamasva naḥ ||56||
ajñātamantratattvāśca vayaṃ viśasanaṃ tu yat| |
kṛtavanto narasyaitat kṣamasva kṛpayā prabho ||57||
ajñānināmaparādhān kṣamante jñānino janāḥ |
tvaṃ pitā jananī rakṣākaro vijño maheśvaraḥ ||58||
tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvakartā ca sarvaśāstā sukhapradaḥ |
yathārthabodhakaścāsi śādhi naḥ puruṣottama ||59||
ete tvaccharaṇaṃ prāptāstrāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān |
ityevaṃ prārthitaścāhaṃ tadā lakṣmi pumuttamaḥ ||3.22.6 0||
upādideśa tān sarvān vedārthaṃ mama bhāṣitam |
dvijatvaṃ dayayā śreyovidhānenāpyahiṃsayā ||6 1||
śuddhyā bhaktyā rāgadveṣarāhityena prajāyate |
alobhenāpyakāmenātṛṣṇayā tapasā tathā ||62||
sadācāreṇa dharmeṇa santoṣeṇa prajāyate |
satyena daivavṛttyā ceśvarārpaṇena vipratā ||63 ||
adroheṇābhayadānamokṣadānena jāyate |
tad brāhmaṇyaṃ vidyayā ca vedenādhiprakāśate ||64||
prāpya tad drohakaraṇaṃ dvijānāṃ vṛṣa eva na |
hiṃsā droho mahānatra svargamokṣanirodhakṛt ||65||
paraduḥkhakaraścātmā duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkte’pi tādṛśam |
jīvataḥ śasane duḥkhamapāraṃ tatra jāyate ||66||
evaṃ duḥkhaṃ pradāyaiva dharmo’dharmatvamṛcchati |
anyaccāpi ca viprendrāḥ śṛṇvantu suvivekavat ||67||
śuddhaṃ svādu sugandhaṃ ca paramānnaṃ mukhe gatam |
ucchiṣṭaṃ jāyate tattūdare malatvamṛcchati ||68||
tadvikārāḥ peśikāmāṃsādyā malasvarūpiṇaḥ |
devādibhiḥ kathaṃ sattvamayaiḥ śuddhaiḥ sudhādanaiḥ ||69||
bhujyante tādṛśaṃ viprā vicārayantu tāttvikam |
tāmasyo makṣikā yatra vyākulitā bhavanti hi ||3.22.70||
aśuddhaṃ cāpi durgandhaṃ tāmasaṃ malinaṃ hi tat |
kathaṃ devā dvijāstadvai samiccheyurhi bhojanam ||71 ||
dugdhaṃ sugandhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vai rasātmakaṃ ghṛtānvitam |
sāttvikā yat samicchanti pavitraṃ bhojanaṃ payaḥ ||72||
makṣikā yat samicchanti sugandhaṃ miṣṭakaṃ madhu |
rasām̐śca vividhān miṣṭām̐stān samicchanti devatāḥ ||73||
tasmāddhiṃsātmakaṃ yajñaṃ mā kurvantu dvijottamāḥ |
paśūnāṃ bandhanaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ viśasanaṃ tathā ||74||
vapoddharaṇaṃ homādi sarvaṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ hi tat |
hiṃsā kvāpi na vai kāryā cetyevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||75||
sarvārpaṇaṃ harau kāryaṃ ceti me vaidikī śrutiḥ |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ sutaḥ ||76||
sutā patnī patirgauśca kṣetraṃ sampat svayaṃ tathā |
nārāyaṇāya dātavyaṃ cetyevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||77||
nārāyaṇātmanā dhyātvā kṛtvā nārāyaṇe’rpaṇam |
yathārhamupayoktavyaṃ na tu ghāto vidhīyate ||78||
upākṛtyaiva tu tattaddevatābhyo yathārpitam |
sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ kṛtvā yoktavyaṃ vaiṣṇavo vṛṣaḥ ||79||
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇasyeti dhyātvaivaṃ ca tataḥ param |
grahītavyaṃ nānyatheti sarvaṃ svaṃ prārpayeddharau ||3.22.80||
vaiśyasave caturvarṣastrīpaśuśca tathārpitaḥ |
utsraṣṭavyo hareḥ sā ca bhoktavyā naiva sarvathā ||8 1 ||
pūjanīyā devikā sā ceti vai vaidikī śrutiḥ |
gosave’pi tathā gāvo’rpaṇīyāḥ parameśvare ||82||
dakṣiṇāścāyutasaṃkhyāgāvo matāḥ prapūjitāḥ |
utsraṣṭavyāḥ pūjanīyā dātavyā dugdhalabdhaye ||83||
marutstome’pi ca saptadaśāpi pañcavatsarāḥ |
puṃpaśavastathāspṛṣṭagarbhā varṣatrayātmakāḥ ||84||
strīpaśavaścārpaṇīyāḥ parameśe parātmani |
sādhavaste tathā sādhvyo bhaveyurbrahmabodhadāḥ ||85||
prathame ca dvitīye ca tṛtīye vatsare’pi ca |
caturthe pañcame varṣe tathāsaṃkhyā narāḥ striyaḥ ||86||
tyāgāśrame pradātavyā acyutagotrakā iti |
vaiṣṇavāste prakartavyā ityevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||87||
aśvamedhe’pi daivaḥ sa nopayoktavya eva ha |
aśvo yo’rpita evāpi devāya devatāyanaḥ ||88||
kuṣmāṇḍākhyaṃ phalaṃ deyaṃ vahnaye devatājuṣe |
puroḍāśāḥ pradātavyāścaravo’pi yathocitam ||89||
evametanna sandeho vidheyo brāhmaṇairiha |
vedavaktāpyahaṃ cāsmi yajñātmāpyahameva ca ||3.22.90||
mantre’hameva tiṣṭhāmi hārde vidantu me dvijāḥ |
pratijñāṃ samprakurvantu hantavyo jantureva na || 91 ||
pūjanaṃ me vṛṣaṇayoḥ śālagrāmasvarūpayoḥ |
kurvantu tena śāntirvai bhaviṣyatyanalasya ha ||92||
nānyathā syādagniśāntirjagad bhasmībhaviṣyati |
śālāsu kartitau me vai vṛṣaṇau puṃstvasaṃbhṛtau ||93||
tābhyāṃ grāmāḥ samūhāścotpannāḥ koṭyarbudādhikāḥ |
śālagrāmā hi te sarve matsvarūpā madātmakāḥ ||94||
jagadbhasmakarāḥ sarve tānarcayantu vai dvijāḥ |
ityuktāḥ kṣmāsurāḥ sarve bahubhiścopacārakaiḥ ||95||
vaiṣṇavaiḥ sāmamantraiśca puṃsūktaiśca punaḥ punaḥ |
pupūjuścāpi nāpyetāḥ śāntāḥ śālaśilāstadā ||96||
ahaṃ viprānakathayaṃ saṃśṛṇudhvaṃ vai samāhitāḥ |
vinā yogyāsanaṃ naiva śāntiṃ yāsyanti tāḥ śilāḥ ||97||
prārthayantu śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ yogyaṃ sā saṃvidhāsyati |
atha viprairarcitā tvaṃ lakṣmīsūktādibhistadā ||98||
pūjitā vanditā cāpi śāntyarthaṃ viniveditā |
tatastvaṃ pippalapatrākārapīṭhātmikābhavaḥ ||99||
divyāsanātmikā jātā divyasauvarṇarūpiṇī |
siṃhāsanābhidhānā vai dhṛtavatyapi tāḥ śilāḥ || 3.22.100 ||
atha śāntiṃ tathā sthairyaṃ śilāḥ prāptāśca niṣkriyāḥ |
upadravavihīnāśca śānto’gniḥ sarvato diśi || 10 1||
suraiśca pitṛbhiḥ sarvairmānavairmunibhistadā |
pūjitā bahubhāvādyaiḥ śālagrāmāśca candanaiḥ || 1 02||
sugandhibhiścopacārairdivyāste harayo’bhavan |
haryātmakā hareraṃśā haryarcārūpiṇaḥ sadā || 103 ||
harerme’ṅgamayā madātmakā mokṣapradāyinaḥ |
śrīyuktāste bhagavanto’bhavanpāṣāṇamūrtayaḥ || 1 04||
atha mūlau vṛṣaṇau me mayā dhṛtau yathāsthale |
lagnitau ca yadā tau me tadāhaṃ puṃstvasaṃyutaḥ || 1 05||
pūrṇamūrtirabhavaṃ vai bhaktā mayā hi rakṣitāḥ |
naramedhe purā yajñe bhūtvā pratyakṣarūpiṇā || 1 06||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīśālapuṃstvanārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tadā || 1 07||
saumyaḥ śālagrāmamūrtiḥ pīṭhikāśrīśubhāsane |
ākalpaṃ cābhavaṃ lakṣmi smara māṃ tvāṃ tathāvidhām || 1 08||
avasaṃśca tvayā sākaṃ mūrtimān śrīpatiḥ pumān |
anye me te’vatārāśca tatra kalpe’bhavan priye || 1 09||
sarvān vedmi yathākāryamavatārān hi me priye |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate || 3.22.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’vṛṣākhye saptaviṃśe vatsare naramedhe bhaktarakṣārtham anādiśrīpuṃstvanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyaṃ naramedhādiyajñārthajñānādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||

<3.23>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ me cātipāvanīm |
prākaṭyarūpāṃ divyāṃ ca vedhaso’nalavatsare || 1 ||
aṣṭāviṃśe tvaṣṭaśate kalpe ca prathame manau |
rājāsīt sūryavarcākhyo brahmaṇā tvanubodhitaḥ || 2 ||
vedamārgarataḥ sarvastarāṇāṃ maṇḍaleśvaraḥ |
vyomacārivimānena devānāṃ sadasi sthitaḥ || 3 ||
pātāleṣu tathā merau graheṣu gatimān vratī |
mama pūjāparo nityaṃ siddhānāṃ sevako yuvā || 4 ||
prajānāṃ mama bhaktyarthaṃ yatnavān sādhusadguṇaḥ |
sa tvekadācintayaddhi rājñyā samaṃ nijālaye || 5 ||
mānavo’yaṃ mama dehaḥ priye nṛpābhibodhitaḥ |
nṝnpātītiyathārthaṃ vai kadā pravartate priye || 6 ||
rājñī prāha manuṣyāṇāṃ deho’yaṃ mokṣasiddhaye |
nṝṇāṃ mokṣapradātṛtve nṛpaḥ svārthe pravartate || 7 ||
nṛpaśabdo’nyathā naiva sārthakaḥ śāsane mataḥ |
bhūtvā bhūtvā vilīyante mānavāḥ karmasaṃhṛtāḥ || 8 ||
teṣāṃ pālanakārye ca kṛte’pi yānti saṃkṣayam |
deharakṣā na vai rakṣā dehapatvaṃ na pālanam || 9 ||
annāni ca jalaṃ vahnirvāyuḥ pānti svabhāvataḥ |
rājñāṃ tatrāvaśyakatā nāsti svabhāvapālite || 3.23.1 0||
śreṣṭhayuge na vai cauryaṃ na chadma nāpahartṛtā |
tena yugaḥ prayātyeva rājñāṃ tatra na pālitā || 1 1||
kṛte yuge satyadharme rājā nirarthako yataḥ |
sārthakatvaṃ nṛpatvaṃ tu mārgaṇīyaṃ bhaved yadi || 12||
mama buddhau mokṣadānapradānena nṛpālitā |
sārthaketi prajānātha pratibhātyeva tatkuru || 1 3||
rājā bhaktyā svayaṃ mokṣaṃ prayātyeva yathā tathā |
prajāścāpi parābhaktyā mokṣamāpnuyureva cet || 1 4||
nṛpatitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena sārthakaṃ janmavedinā |
etādṛśaṃ nṛpatvaṃ tvaṃ rājan kuru pramuktidam || 15||
śrutvaivaṃ mahiṣīvākyaṃ nṛpo mumoda cāntare |
śrutitulyāṃ satīṃ matvā patnīṃ mokṣasahāyinīm || 16||
punaḥ papraccha tāṃ mudgāyanīnāmnīṃ nijāṃ priyām |
kayā rītyā nṛṇāṃ mokṣakaraṇaṃ syāt praśādhi me || 17||
mudgāyanī tadā prāha ṛṣīn siddhān tapasvinaḥ |
sādhūn sādhvīḥ samāhūya lokāntarebhya ityapi || 18||
mandiraṃ kārayitvā ca mokṣadāṃ pārameśvarīm |
pratimāṃ sthāpayitvā tvaṃ sadā kuru mahotsavān || 19||
prajāḥ sevāṃ pūjanaṃ ca darśanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā |
kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ bhṛtyaṃ dāsyaṃ ca vandanaṃ stavam ||3.23.20||
kariṣyanti bhajanaṃ ca nartanaṃ bhāvanārpaṇam |
annavastrārpaṇaṃ pātrārpaṇaṃ ca candanārpaṇam ||2 1||
śṛṃgārāṇāmarpaṇaṃ ca sugandhānāṃ tathārpaṇam |
pañcāmṛtārpaṇaṃ cāpi gītārpaṇaṃ japārpaṇam ||22|||
ātmārpaṇaṃ kariṣyanti gamiṣyanti paraṃ padam |
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ cāpi dīpārpaṇaṃ dhvajārpaṇam ||23||
vādyārpaṇaṃ vādanaṃ ca phalapuṣpārpaṇaṃ tathā |
kuṃkumākṣatahārāṇāmarpaṇaṃ dhūpakārpaṇam ||24||
naivedyārpaṇamevāpi tathā nīrājanārpaṇam |
pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ namo daṇḍavacca tathāñjalim |||25|||
hāvaṃ bhāvaṃ ca vai harerālocanaṃ ca cintanam |
mananaṃ nirṇayaṃ cāpi kariṣyanti janāḥ kathām ||26||
dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vā yaṣṭikāṃ ca vā |
ābharaṇāni divyāni maṇīn ratnāni hīrakān ||27||
mañjarīḥ puṣpamālāśca gucchān veṣān suśobhanān |
mukuṭaṃ kaṭakaṃ mālāṃ śṛṃkhalāṃ mekhalāṃ tathā ||28||
ūrmikāṃ cāpi hetīṃśca śaṃkhacakrādikāni ca |
naktakaṃ sukhaśayyāṃ ca pāduke yānamuttamam || 29||
vāhanaṃ ca vimānaṃ ca godhanaṃ ca rasādikam |
sumiṣṭaṃ śarkarādyaṃ ca madhu ghṛtaṃ kaṇādikam ||3.23.3 0||
ghaṭaṃ sukalaśaṃ sthālīṃ pūjāpātrāṇi varttikāḥ |
utsavopakaraṇāni dāsyanti mānavāḥ khalu ||3 1 ||
haraye tvarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
karmaṭhā api satrāṇi kṛtvā vai mandire hareḥ |||32||
bhikṣukāśca prasādānnaṃ bhuktvā yāsyanti tatpadam |
aparādhakṛtaḥ kṣamāṃ yācitvāpi hareḥ puraḥ ||33 ||
pāpāḥ pāpaṃ nivedyāpi yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim |
vratī vratāni prārpyaiva gamiṣyati paraṃ padam |||24||
nāryo nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ bhajitvā parameśvaram |
kāntaṃ sarveśvaraṃ taṃ ca yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ||25||
bālā vṛddhāḥ sadhanā vā nirdhanā api sarvathā |
bhajitvā bhagavantaṃ taṃ yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ||365||
tasmād rājannṛṇāṃ mokṣamārgasyodghāṭanāya vai |
nṛpatitvaṃ sārthakaṃ vai kartuṃ śrīharimandiram ||37||
prakāraya śubhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sahasraikaghaṭānvitam |
sahasraśikharaṃ ramyaṃ sauvarṇakalaśānvitam ||38||
gaganasparśi śobhāḍhyaṃ tatraiva vidhinā harim |
bhagavantaṃ prabhuṃ devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya kānakam ||3 9||
pratimārūpiṇaṃ devaṃ devarṣigaṇabodhitam |
surūpaṃ sundaraṃ jagatkartāraṃ parameśvaram ||3.23.40 ||
nijaśaktiyutaṃ nijaiśvaryapārṣadasevitam |
nijāyatanasaṃyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya tatra ca ||41 ||
sarvadṛśyaṃ sarvasevyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśakam |
sarvaśāntipradaṃ devaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||42||
ityuktvā svāmine rājñī tūṣṇīmāsa kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
rājā pathyaṃ ca tathyaṃ ca mene mokṣapradaṃ vacaḥ ||43 ||
japasatraṃ cakārāsau māsikaṃ kīrtanānvitam |
āhvayāmāsa siddhām̐śca ṛṣīndevāṃśca mānavān ||44||
akhaṇḍanāmabhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa māsikam |
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama ||45 ||
antarātman prabho viṣṇo parameśa namo’stu te |
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ rājā kārayāmāsa cāniśam ||46||
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi sudhāsvādūni vai dadau |
sevāṃ sarvavidhāṃ sarvasatriṇāṃ vidadhe mudā ||47||
nityamāyānti lokebhyaḥ prayānti ca surādayaḥ |
bhajanaṃ satataṃ tatra jāyate’virataṃ priye ||48||
evaṃ māse śrāvaṇe vai vyatīte cāntime dine |
pūrṇātithau sabhāmadhye praśnaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ||49||
mānuṣāṇāṃ mokṣagatirakhaṇḍitā bhavediha |
yathā tathā surādyā me darśayantu prathāṃ śubhām |||3.23.50||
atha siddhāstadā prāhurmandiraṃ tvatra kāraya |
ṛṣayaśca surāścāpi mānavā jagadustathā ||51 ||
mandireṇa parā puṣṭirmokṣasyātra bhaviṣyati |
tatprakāraya rājendra pratiṣṭhāpaya tatra ca ||52||
śrīpatiṃ paramātmānaṃ parabrahma pareśvaram |
pratimārūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sarvamokṣapradaṃ prabhum ||53||
omityuktvā japayajñaṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tato nṛpaḥ |
kārayāmāsa sauvarṇaṃ sahasraśikharānvitam ||54||
