nakṣatrasparśi sudṛśyaṃ mandiraṃ prathamaṃ bhuvi |
sāṃgopāṃgasamastaṃ vai jātaṃ pūrṇaṃ tataḥ param |||55|||
cintayāmāsa mūrtyarthaṃ kutaḥ kasmād bhavediti |
rātrau rājācintayacca nirviṇṇo mānase’bhavat ||56||
sasmāra māṃ parabrahma śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
ahaṃ bhaktasmṛtiṃ jñātvā sākaṃ tvayā tu padmaje ||57||
gatavān yatra rājāsau pratyakṣatāṃ gato’bhavam |
sūryavarcāstadā dṛṣṭvā natvā māṃ gocaraṃ puraḥ ||58||
praṇanāma madhuparkaṃ dadau cakāra daṇḍavat |
āsanaṃ pradadau mahyaṃ sarvābharaṇaśāline ||59||
sarvatejo’bhidīptāya sarvaiśvaryānvitāya ca |
sarvaprasannatāvṛṣṭikārakāyāntarātmane ||3.23.6 0||
pradadau bhojanaṃ pānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca nijārpaṇam |
sarvasvārpaṇamevāpi cakre bhaktyānvito nṛpaḥ ||6 1 ||
prārthayāmāsa māṃ tatra nirmite mandire śubhe |
nityavāsasya yogye vai mahodyānābhisaṃvṛte ||62||
pratyakṣaṃ bhagavannatra vasa sthiraḥ sadā bhava |
salakṣmīkaḥ pārṣadādyaiścopakaraṇairanvitaḥ ||63 ||
mayā lokasya mokṣārthaṃ tathāstvevaṃ samīritam |
athoktaṃ yāhi rājendra vanānte śiṃśapādrumam ||64||
ṛṣīṇāmāśramamadhye sthitaṃ mahāntamuttamam |
tatpārśvasthaṃ vāmagaṃ ca vaṭavṛkṣaṃ śubhottamam ||65||
mandire’tra yathāvāso mama tatra tathaiva ca |
tau vṛkṣau tava rājye’tra nau mūrtirūpiṇau nṛpa ||66 ||
svecchayaiva mayā lakṣmyā cobhābhyāṃ kalpitau kṛtau |
nityau divyau mama rūpau prācīnau bahuvatsarau ||67||
nityapuṣṭau devapūjyau vartete śrīnarāyaṇau |
tānibhau nṛpa cāvāṃ svo yāhi pūjaya mānaya ||68||
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitau nityau vartāmahe drurūpiṇau |
atha mūrtisvarūpau vai tābhyāṃ prakāśitāviha ||69||
sthāsyāvaścātra vidhinā pratiṣṭhitau svayaṃ nṛpa |
ityuktaḥ sa yayau rājā mahodyāne vaṭāntikam ||3.23.70||
śiṃśapādrumasaṃyuktaṃ divy divyarasānvitam |
vaṭaṃ śubhraṃ samālokya nṛpastvāścaryamāptavān ||71 ||
ṛṣīn praṇamya vidhivanmaharṣigaṇakāritām |
pūjāṃ cakre drumayoḥ saṃyuktayośca nṛpaḥ svayam ||72||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ jaladānaṃ naivedyaṃ kusumāñcalim |
datvā cārāretrikaṃ cakre tadāhaṃ śiṃśapādrume ||73 ||
stambe nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātparamātmā sanātanaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||74||
śyāmalaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca divyarūpo’bhavaṃ puraḥ |
śiṃśapāstamba evāhaṃ cāhaṃ stambo na vai pṛthaka ||75||
śākhā me pārṣadāḥ sarve pārṣadāṇyaśca vai tadā |
maddehayogavantaste hyadṛśyanta madātmakāḥ ||76||
atha vṛkṣe vaṭe stambe bhavatīgocarā priye |
stambābhinnā stambagarbhā vaṭakāraṇarūpiṇī ||77||
śākhāśca tava sakhyaśca muktānyaḥ śobhanāḥ priyāḥ |
adṛśyanta tvadabhinnāstvadyoginyastvadātmikāḥ ||78||
evaṃ māṃ tvāṃ vīkṣya rājā sūryavarcā mudānvitaḥ |
prakṛtvā daṇḍavattūrṇaṃ saṃprokṣya vedamantrakaiḥ ||79||
māṃ tvāṃ sammānapūrvaṃ cārohayāmāsa vai rathe |
sauvarṇe śatakalaśe vimānavatsuśobhite ||3.23.80||
śataikahastivāhye ca mahotsavasamanvitaḥ |
ānīya mandirabhūmau maṇḍape vidhivattadā ||8 1 ||
saṃsthāpya vidhinā kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ sarvakarmabhiḥ |
mandire māṃ tvāṃ tathā ca pārṣadān tvatsasvīstathā ||82||
saṃpratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa divyaṃ pratyakṣamāgatam |
ākalpaṃ nyavasaṃ naije mandire vai tvayā saha ||83 ||
divyarūpo divyanetravatāṃ bhaktijuṣāṃ kṛte |
mūrtirūpaścarmacakṣuṣmatāṃ māyājuṣāṃ kṛte ||84||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīśiṃśapānārāyaṇaḥ śyāmalo’bhavam ||85||
anādiśrīśyāmanārāyaṇetikhyātimāptavān |
tvaṃ vaṭaśrīkhyātimāptā mama pārśve’tisundarī ||86||
gauraśvetasuvarṇā vai divyadehā manoramā |
mānavāstu tato nityaṃ surā maharṣayo’pi ca ||87||
pitaraścāsurāścāpi māṃ tvāṃ prasevya muktigāḥ |
babhūvustatra kalpe vai lakṣmi nṛpatā sārthikā ||88||
rājñā tena kṛtā rājñyupadeśena pramokṣadā |
sarvābhayapradānaṃ vai kṛtaṃ rājñā madarpaṇāt ||89||
etajjānāmyahaṃ lakṣmi śyāmalaṃ mama rūpakam |
gauraṃ rūpaṃ tava lakṣmi smara tanmandiraṃ hyapi ||3.23.90||
smara taṃ pārṣadaṃ cāpi rājānaṃ ca sakhīṃ nṛpīm |
smarāsaṃkhyām̐stadā jātānmuktān koṭyarbudābjakān ||9 1||
anye tadāpyavatārā mama jātā hyanekaśaḥ |
yathākāryānurūpā vai jānāmyetānahaṃ priye ||92||
evaṃ śyāmalarūpeṇa bhaktānāṃ bhaktimuttamām |
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ pādasevanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā ||93||
arcanaṃ sakhyamevāpi tathā cātmanivedanam |
lepanaṃ mārjanaṃ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ ca bhojanam ||94||
jalapānaṃ vastrabhūṣādānaṃ śṛṃgārakaṃ tathā |
ārādhanaṃ namaskāraṃ sahayānaṃ ca nartanam ||95||
gāyanaṃ ramaṇaṃ vāṭyāṃ vihāraṃ hasanaṃ tathā |
sarvaṃ tvaṃgīcakārāhaṃ bhūtvā prasanna eva tān ||96||
nināya mama dhāmāpi tvakṣarākhyaṃ paraṃ padam |
vaiṣṇavī pṛthivī sarvā narā nāryaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||97||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi madyogānmuktimāyayuḥ |
śyāmalaḥ śyāmalaśceti nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||98||
gāyanto jīvavṛndā māmīyuḥ kalpe tadā priye |
pāpino’pi hare śyāma vandato dharmiṇo’bhavan ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇānmuktimāpnuyāt |
ante rājā sadeśaśca sagotraḥ saprajājanaḥ || 3.23.10 0||
sāśritaḥ sabhṛtyakaśca sastrīko muktimāpa ha |
api go’śvaprabhṛtayaścāpi muktiṃ yayuḥ parām || 10 1||
tasmānmandiranirmāṇaṃ pratimāsthāpanaṃ mama |
śreṣṭhamabhayadānaṃ tajjīvānāṃ jāyate kṣitau || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭāviṃśe vatsare sūryavarcānṛpadvārā mandire’nādiśrīśiṃśapā(śyāma)nārāyaṇasya vaṭaśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādiniparūṇanāmā trayoviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||

<3.24>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri brahmaṇaḥ pitṛvatsare |
navaviṃśe navatyātmakalpe ca saptame manau || 1 ||
āsīdvai mama loke’tra prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu padmaje |
brahmaṇo guptaromabhyaścāsuraścitrarūpavān || 2 ||
mayūranāmako jajñe sapakṣapicchacañcukaḥ |
pādayuktaḥ kāmarūpadharaḥ parvatasannibhaḥ || 3 ||
ḍayamāno’mbare tvākarṣayati grahamaṇḍalam |
pṛthvyāṃ gacchan grāmakūṭān parvatān samakarṣati || 4 ||
jale’ntaḥ sampraviṣṭaḥ san saṃkṣobhayati vāridhīn |
kampayatyeva pṛthivīṃ devām̐strastān karoti ca || 5 ||
mānuṣānnāgasarpāṃśca sahasraśo haratyapi |
kvacid bhavati devaḥ sa mahendrābhaḥ svarūpavān || 6 ||
kvacicca mānavaṃ rūpaṃ samrāṇṇibhaṃ bibhartti ca |
kvacinmaharṣitulyaśca tejaḥparidhiśobhanaḥ || 7 ||
jāyate kāmarūpo vai mohako balavānapi |
tapaścacāra rājasya lobhād varṣasahasrakam || 8 ||
brahmā tuṣṭo varaṃ prādānmṛtyurhariṃ vinā na te |
sa tvevaṃ prāpya vacanaṃ tuṣṭo niḥśaṃka eva ha || 05 ||
satye loke jane svarge mānave cātalādiṣu |
tattadrūpadharo bhūtvā yāti bhuṃkte prahṛṣyati || 3.24.1 0||
kvacid devagṛhān gatvāmṛtaṃ bhuktvā prayāti ca |
devīṃ vā mānavīṃ nārīṃ hṛtvā yāti sthalāntaram || 11 ||
yakṣiṇīṃ rākṣasīṃ nītvā smṛddhiṃ nītvā prayāti vā |
dānavīṃ vā satīṃ nāgīṃ nītvā yāti vanāntaram || 12 ||
gā vatsatarīraśvān gajānnītvā prayāti ca |
merordroṇyāṃ vanāḍhyāyāṃ śatayojanavistare || 13 ||
araṇye svālayaṃ cakre smṛddhaṃ subhogaśobhanam |
hṛtvā hṛtvā narānnārīrdevīrvā rākṣasīśca vā || 14||
sarvaṃ naijaṃ sa kṛtvaiva bhuṃkte bhogamayaṃ ca tat |
yuddhe na maraṇaṃ yāti brahmaṇo varadānataḥ || 15||
sarvatra gatimatvācca vijayaṃ labhate sadā |
evaṃ samrāṭsamo jātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ svabalāddhi saḥ || 16||
nṛpānanyān śanairjitvā nṛpeśvaro’bhavattataḥ |
sāmrājyaṃ mama sarvatra pārthivaṃ ceti vakti ca || 17||
uddhoṣaṇāṃ kṛtavām̐śca cakravartyahameva yat |
balī sarvatra gatvaiva jayatyākṣitimaṇḍalam || 18||
nṛpān rājye’surān pratiṣṭhāpya rājyaṃ karoti ca |
evaṃ śanaiḥ samabhavaccakravartī mayūrakaḥ || 19||
pradharṣitumathendrāṇīṃ svargalokaṃ jagāma saḥ |
uddhṛtya tāṃ cāmbareṇoḍḍīya yāvad bhuvaṃ prati ||3.24.20||
prayāti tāvadevendro vajreṇainaṃ jaghāna ha |
vajraṃ cānalaprakhyaṃ tajjagrāsa cañcusaṃdhṛtam ||21||
atha trāsaṃ jagāmendraḥ vīkṣya māyūrakaṃ balam |
nivavṛte nijaṃ sthānaṃ dikpālebhyo nyavedayat ||22||
sajjāḥ sarve’pi dikpālā yuddhārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ |
yamaḥ kuberaśceśāno varuṇo nirṛto’nilaḥ ||23||
analo’rkaśca rudraśca pṛthvyāṃ sarve samāyayuḥ |
sabalāḥ sajjaśastrāśca vineduścāmbare ca te ||24||
bhutvā nādān samarārthān garjanā dyusadāṃ tathā |
mayūro niryayau śīghraṃ yuddhārthaṃ balasaṃyutaḥ ||25||
daśasāhasrasenānīsahito’bjabhaṭānvitaḥ |
yuyudhe ghorasaṃgrāmaṃ samvatsaraṃ hi mānavam ||26||
hataṃ sainyaṃ hi bahudhā svasya tadapyajīvayat |
āsuryā vidyayā mitho yuyudhe dyusadīśvaraiḥ ||27||
māyūrakā mahākrūrā āsurā vai samantataḥ |
sākaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sarve yuyudhire’tinirbhayāḥ ||28||
nānto yuddhasya bhavati māyūro nāpi naśyati |
virāmo na surāṇāṃ ca manuṣyā duḥkhino’bhavan ||29||
mānavyaśca surāṇyaśca satyo nāginya ityapi |
daityānyaścāpi vai trastā niryānti sma na vai bahiḥ ||3.24.30 ||
trailokyāṃ sarvalokeṣu prajāsu cāpi rājasu |
udvejanaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca vartate’sya sadā tadā ||3 1||
nirviṇṇāścātha vai devāḥ pariśramaṃ gatā bahum |
nistejasko ravirjāto mahendro bhagnamānasaḥ ||32||
varuṇaḥ kṣīṇaśaktiśca yamo vibhramatāṃ gataḥ |
nirṛto’pi kṣīṇasainyo’bhavattatra raṇe tathā ||33||
īśāno’pi hatotsāhaḥ kuberaḥ kṣīṇasattvakaḥ |
agnistaikṣṇyavihīnaśca marudrodanamācaram ||34||
anye devā gatāśāścābhavannṛpāstu tadvaśāḥ |
evaṃ kāle samāpanne duḥkhe ca sarvato’dhike ||35||
devā raṇaṃ vihāyaiva yayuste brahmaṇo gṛham |
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ jagaduḥ svāpakṛṣṭatām ||36||
āsurasya balaṃ cāpi rakṣārthaṃ cānvarodhayan |
brahmā śrutvā tu tānāha yatiṣye bhavatāṃ kṛte ||37||
sarve caivātra tiṣṭhantvārādhayantu hariṃ param |
hariṃ vinā na vai tasya nāśako’nyo’sti madvarāt ||38||
ityuktā devatādyāścārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
māmanādiśrīśanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||39||
ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi gajārūḍho’kṣarād drutam |
upāyayau satyalokaṃ tadā brahmasabhāsthalam ||3.24.40||
brahmādyāḥ svāgataṃ pūjāṃ mama cakrustataḥ param |
jagadurnijaduḥkhaṃ cāsuranāśaṃ pravavrire ||41 ||
tadāhaṃ cāsuranāśaṃ padmaje samacintayam |
yāntu naijān pradeśānityavadaṃ ca surānaham ||42||
śīghraṃ surā yayurnaijān deśānahaṃ ca mānavam |
rūpaṃ dhṛtvājagāma kṣmāṃ yatrālayo’surasya vai ||43||
kṣātraṃ rūpamahaṃ dhṛtvā saśaraṃ dhanuṣā yutam |
gatvā ca gopure tasya bhikṣāyātrāṃ vyadhāpayam ||44||
mayūraśca tadā dūtairvijñaptaḥ svayameva tu |
ātithyārthaṃ gopuraṃ svaṃ cājagāma samutsukaḥ ||45||
natvā māṃ kinnu bhikṣāyāṃ yācase tviti cāha saḥ |
yuddhabhikṣāṃ dehi me’tra yāce’haṃ nāparāmiti ||46||
yācitaḥ sa dadau bhikṣāṃ jalaṃ dhṛtvā kare tadā |
śastreṇa śastraṃ saṃyujya dhanuṣāptā mayāpi sā ||47||
tatraiva yuddhaṃ hyabhavad gopurāgre vanottame |
ghoraṃ tenaiva sākaṃ vai māsāntaṃ subhayaṃkaram ||48||
surāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ śīlasañjuṣām |
rājñāṃ cāpi pravīrāṇāṃ romaharṣaṇakārakam ||49||
devā ākāśamārgeṇa jñātvā yuddhapravartanam |
paśyantyāgatya tatraiva jayaṃ vadanti me tadā ||3.24.50||
eko’haṃ vai mayūreṇa yuddhaṃ karomi nāparaḥ |
māsānte mama bāṇaiśca śastrairastrairgadādibhiḥ ||5 1 ||
bhinnapiccho’bhavattūrṇaṃ nirāśo’pyabhavattadā |
māyūrakānnijayoddhṛn yojayāmāsa saṃyuge ||52||
te sāhāyyakarāstasya māmāvṛttya samantataḥ |
yuyudhire’tivegena cārbudāste mayūrakāḥ ||53||
māyārūpadharāścāpi māyāśastradharāstathā |
māyāveṣadharāścāpi māyāyuddhakarāstathā ||54||
mṛṣādehadharāścāpi mṛṣāsainyanirūpiṇaḥ |
sarve mayā hatāstatra sudarśanena vai kramāt ||55||
dagdhā mṛtā mayūrāste sudarśanasya tejasā |
māyūrakī purī dagdhā bhaktā mayā surakṣitāḥ ||56||
śacyādikāḥ priyā yāśca mānavyaścāpi mānavāḥ |
narā nāryo devatāśca mayā tatraiva rakṣitāḥ ||57||
āsurāste hatāḥ sarve māyūravaṃśayoginaḥ |
sarve niravaśeṣāste kṛtāḥ sudarśanena vai |||58||
māyūrakastathā dṛṣṭvā vināśaṃ svasya sarvathā |
andho bhūtvā mahākhaḍgaṃ dhṛtvā kare vihāyasā ||59||
adriprāyaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā papāta mama mastake |
hantuṃ māṃ khaḍgadhāreṇa tāvanmayā sudarśanam ||3.24.60||
adhastātpreritaṃ tasmai dadāha taṃ tadāmbare |
bhasmībhūtaḥ samasto vai vyomnyeva samapadyata ||61 ||
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirmamopari |
candanākṣatavṛṣṭiśca jayaghoṣāstathābhavan ||62||
māyūravaṃśajā nāryo rurudurvai tadā mudhā |
devānāhūya ca tadāvātaraṃ tatra pattane ||63 ||
māyūrake mahāraṇye sarvasmṛddhisuśobhane |
kārāgāraṃ vilokyāpi tatsthānamocayaṃ janāna ||64||
devānamocayaṃ tūrṇaṃ tathā devīramocayam |
śacīmukhyādevatāścāmocayaṃ mānavīstathā ||65||
tadrājye devatāḥ sarvā devāśca mānavā api |
māṃ kṣatraṃ paramātmānaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ||66||
tīrthajalairabhiṣicya pupūjurhi vidhānataḥ |
pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsuśca śriyā sākaṃ samutsukāḥ ||67||
anekāḥ kanyakā nāryo mayūravaṃśajāstadā |
anāthā māṃ paraṃ nāthaṃ prāpya tā vavrire mudā ||68||
mayā yajñe pāvitāśca gṛhītā vidhinā kare |
brahmādyairarpitāḥ sarvā mama patnyastadābhavan ||69||
evaṃ mayā mayūrākhyo mahāsuro hataḥ purā |
māṃ vinā tasya vai nāśo nānyena nirmito yataḥ ||3.24.70||
tasya tejo nirgataṃ tu mayyeva śāntimāpa ha |
muktiṃgato’suraḥ so’pi tathānye’pi ca ye hatāḥ ||71||
sarve mokṣaṃ gatā me yat sudarśanena vai hatāḥ |
mocitāścāpi rājāno māṃ prapūjya pareśvaram || 72||
yayuste vai nijadeśān surāśca tridivaṃ gatāḥ |
nāgapatnyaśca mānavyastathā devyo’pyanāthikāḥ ||73||
māṃ vivāhya sthitā sarvā mama patnyastadā priye |
tvaṃ sarvāsāṃ rājarājñīnāmnī śrīrabhavastadā ||74||
ayonijā kṣātrarūpadhartrī matpārśvaśālinī |
atha picchānmayūrasya saṃgṛhya mārjanī tvayā ||75||
kṛtā bhūmārjanārthaṃ vai tathā matpārṣadairapi |
mārjanikāḥ kṛtāḥ sarvāḥ surūpāḥ śobhanā api ||76||
athāhaṃ svavimānena bhūtale sarvato diśi |
yatra yatrāsurāścāsan mayūreṇa nṛpīkṛtāḥ |
tatra tatraiva gatvā ca hatvā tān mūlataḥ priye || 77||
dadau rājyāni sarvāṇi kṣatriyebhyo yathāyatham |
evaṃ mayā mama sarvaṃ sāmrājyaṃ bhūtale’bhitaḥ ||78||
sthāpitaṃ ca tadā śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramātmanā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena cakradhāriṇā ||79||
anādiśrīkṣatranārāyaṇarūpeṇa rakṣatā |
anādiśrīrājarājñīsahitena smara priye ||3.24.80||
mayā kṣātravṛṣāḥ sarve pālitāḥ kṣitimaṇḍale |
sarve yajñāḥ kṛtāścāpi rakṣitāśca prajā api ||8 1||
devatā rakṣitāścāpi dharmamārgāḥ pravartitāḥ |
satraprathāḥ kṛtāścāpi vedamārgāḥ prapoṣitāḥ ||82||
nītayaḥ sthāpitāścāpi sādhavo rakṣitāstadā |
sanmaṭhāḥ kāritāḥ śreṣṭhā devādayāśca kāritāḥ ||83|||
tīrthāni rakṣitānyeva bhikṣukāścāpi rakṣitāḥ |
kathā nārāyaṇasyāpi sarvā nityaṃ pravācitāḥ ||84||
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pālitāśca dharme sadā prarakṣitāḥ |
bhaktiśca mama te cāpi sarvakṣmāyāṃ pravartitā ||85||
vaidikaścāpyātmabodhaḥ kalpe tadā mayoditaḥ |
sabhāyāṃ me tadā lakṣmi daśasāhasrasādhavaḥ ||86||
daśasāhasraviprāśca daśasāhasrasādhvikāḥ |
daśasāhasrabaṭavo daśasāhasravaidikāḥ ||87||
daśasāhasrātithayo daśasāhasrabhikṣukāḥ |
daśasāhasrānāthāśca daśasāhasrajāpakāḥ ||88||
daśasāhasramakhino daśasāhasrasatriṇaḥ |
daśasāhasrayamino daśasāhasratāpasāḥ ||89||
vratino daśasāhasrā daśasāhasrapaṇḍitāḥ |
daśasāhasradāsāśca daśasāhasradāsikāḥ ||3.24.90||
daśasāhasrayogajñā daśasāhasracāraṇāḥ |
nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti sattvasthā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ ||91 ||
mama bhaktiyutāḥ sarve mama satre prabhojinaḥ |
mama mūrteśca dhartāro dhyānamārge kṛtādarāḥ ||92||
babhūvuḥ kṛtavāsāśca sadā svātmanivedinaḥ |
mayā pṛthvyāḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sāptasāmudrasaṃvṛtam ||93||
mānavānāṃ hi mokṣārthaṃ devānāṃ sukhalabdhaye |
pātālādinivāsāśca svargādikanivāsinaḥ ||94||
anvasaram̐śca māṃ sarve bhejurmāṃ sakaleśvaram |
ākalpaṃ tu tadā cāhaṃ nyavasaṃ bhūtale’niśam ||95||
vaikuṇṭhatulyā pṛthivī nirātaṃkā tadā hyabhūt |
kalpadrumāstathā kāmadhenavaḥ kāmavallikāḥ ||96||
cintāmaṇayaḥ sarvatra tadāsan mama yogataḥ |
sadā kṛtayugaścāpi kālaścaikavidho’bhavat ||97||
mānasyaścāpi ca spārśanyaśca dārśanikāstathā |
tathā ca sahavāsinyaścāsan vai sṛṣṭayastadā ||98||
smara sarvaṃ rājarājñīśri tvaṃ rājādhirājatām |
jānāmyahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nānye jānantyabuddhayaḥ ||99||
avatārāḥ pare cāpi tadāsanme yathocitāḥ |
devamānavarūpāśca tattatkāryanivartakāḥ || 3.24.10 0||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra prākaṭyaṃ mama padmaje |
paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 101 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso navaviṃśe vatsare māyūrakāsuranāśārtham anādiśrīrājanārāyaṇasya rājarājñīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||

<3.25>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama vai tataḥ |
triṃśattame vedhasastu devavatsarasaṃjñake || 1 ||
varṣe kalpe daśaśate manau caturdaśe purā |
camatkāraṃ tava lakṣmi vadāmi hi mayā saha || 2 ||
prākaṭyaṃ vai tadā loke yadāsīd bhūtale śṛṇu |
prānte kṛte’bhavan bhaktāḥ surāṣṭre pañca cāvayoḥ || 3 | |
devasakhaśca kīrtiśca ciklīta kardamastathā |
jātavedaśca te viprāḥ sahodarāśca sāttvikāḥ || 4 | |
tāpasā dharmaniyatāḥ santuṣṭā brahmavādinaḥ |
śauce tapasi santoṣe svādhyāye bhajane ratāḥ || 5 ||
adrohe satyabhāve cāsteye śīle’parigrahe |
kṛtābhyāsāḥ śame cāpīndriyāṇāṃ nigrahe ratāḥ || 6 ||
titikṣāyāṃ kṣamāyāṃ ca mārdave śreyasi sthitāḥ |
yoge vivekaje jñāne satvotkarṣe sadā sthitāḥ || 7 ||
dhyāne home jape pūjāyāṃ ca satkārasevane |
ātmabrahmātmavijñāne cātmanivedane sthitāḥ || 8 ||
siddhyaṣṭakaṃ tathā tveṣāṃ nidhīnāṃ navakaṃ sadā |
kalpavāṇī ca sevāyāṃ vartante kāmadhenavaḥ || 9 ||
ākāśaśāyinaścaite digvastrāḥ phalabhojanāḥ |
jalāmṛtādipānāśca prabhādīpāḥ samādhigāḥ || 3.25.10 ||
ātmānalā brahmagṛhāścāntarātmasahāyinaḥ |
bhaktiyuktāḥ sādhusaṃgāḥ satīsatkāratatparāḥ || 11 ||
atithipūjakāḥ sarve nirīhāśca videhinaḥ |
anāvaraṇabhāvāśca tathāvyāhatasañcarāḥ || 12||
bhūtasparśādihīnāśca dehadoṣādivarjitāḥ |
vajratulyā divyadehā divyānandaparāyaṇāḥ || 13 || 
saṃkalpaprāptasarvasvabhogayogādiyātrikāḥ |
vāksiddhā duḥkhahantāraḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalāḥ || 14||
brahmā vipṇurmaheśo’rkaścandra ivāparāḥ surāḥ |
khyātāḥ kṣitau bhuvaḥsvargamaharjanatapassu ca || 15||
satye loke tathā merau pātāleṣvapi sarvathā |
aiśvaryaśālinaḥ sarve īśvarā aparā iva || 16||
devavad duḥkhahartāro yogivadātmadarśakāḥ |
śreṣṭhivaddhanadātāraḥ pativatputradāyinaḥ || 17||
rakṣakāḥ svāmivaccāpi dātāro viṣṇuvattathā |
jñāne brahmasabhāḥ sarve pūraṇe kalpapādapāḥ || 18||
brahmacaryojjvalā deheṣvapi kṣmābhā dhṛtau tathā |
sahasre sādhavaśceme pūrṇakāmāśca muktavat || 1 9||
etādṛśān prasiddhān vai jñātvā lokāstu duḥkhinaḥ |
samāyānti nijārtīnāṃ vināśārthaṃ divāniśam || 3.25.20 ||
rogiṇo bhoginaścāpi dīnā dāridryabhāginaḥ |
kadaryāḥ śatruduḥkhāśca vidhurāśca viputriṇaḥ || 21 ||
anannāmbarasaudhāśceṣaṇāvanto bubhukṣavaḥ |
mumukṣavo mumūrṣavaścāyānti śaraṇaṃ sadā ||22||
teṣāṃ kleśānnāśayanti hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ |
dātāraḥ sarvavastūnāṃ sukhānāṃ dhanasampadām || 23||
mānavāśca narā nāryo yānti pūrṇamanorathāḥ |
ānanditāḥ pūrṇakāmāḥ pūrṇāśāḥ pūrṇamānasāḥ |||24||
dhanārthibhyo dadatyete dhanāni siddhijāni vai |
putrārthibhyo dadatyete’patyānyabhīṣṭakāni ca |||25||
patiṃ patnīṃ gṛhaṃ rājyaṃ kṣetraṃ gajaṃ ca gāstathā |
ārogyaṃ vaṃśavistāraṃ sampadaśca dadatyapi |||26||
tāpatrayādirāhityaṃ kurvanti śaraṇārthinaḥ |
evaṃ sarve camatkārabhṛtā īśvarasadṛśāḥ || 27||
bhavanti sma kṣitau lakṣmi bhaktāste me’pi sarvathā |
athaikadālaye teṣāṃ lakṣmīvāñcchāparāyaṇaḥ || 28||
asurastvāyayau nāmnā prasaviṣṇurmahābalaḥ |
viprarūpadharaḥ so’yaṃ tāpasaḥ kāmavāsanaḥ || 29||
nārāyaṇasya yā patnī sā me patnī bhavediti |
lakṣmyāste kāmanāyukto bhaktānāṃ pura āyayau ||3.25.3 0 ||
yayāce svepsitāṃ bhikṣāṃ pañcabhyo’pi tadāsuraḥ |
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇapatnīṃ mahyaṃ dadatu dāninaḥ || 31 ||
bhaktāstvayogyabhikṣāṃ tāṃ śrutvaiva menire tadā |
kintvadātṛtvagaṇanāsparśārthaṃ prāhuromiti || 3 2||
harirvai balavānenaṃ lakṣmīrvā saṃhariṣyati |
iti vicārya dānendrāḥ sasmaruḥ śrīṃ mama priyām || 33 ||
bhaktecchānusāriṇā ca mayājñaptā ca vai drutam |
ākṣarāttvaṃ hi pañcānāṃ purataḥ samupasthitā || 34||
kumārikā surūpā ca dvādaśādhikavatsarā |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā svarṇacampakavigrahā ||35 ||
śobhanāṃ mohinīrūpāṃ tvāṃ vilokya tadāsuraḥ |
mene svārthasya vai siddhiṃ mumude hṛdi tāsamaḥ ||36 ||
atha devasakhādyāste dṛṣṭvā pupūjurīśvarīm |
nārāyaṇīṃ samarthāṃ ca vijñapyāpi kṣamārthanam ||37||
āsure dānarūpārthaṃ kāryaṃ nivedya vai jalam |
kareṣvādāya ca dadruścāsurāya priye tadā ||38 ||
tvāmāsādya prasaviṣṇuścāsuro viprarūpadhṛk |
yayau gṛhaṃ nijaṃ tatra tvayā vrataṃ dhṛtaṃ param ||3 9||
brahmacaryābhidhānaṃ vai naiṣṭhikaṃ pālyameva tat |
aviplutaṃ tāpasaṃ ca spraṣṭavyo nāsuraḥ kvacit ||3.25.40 ||
atha tvaṃ tadgrahaṃ prāptā tvāṃ sa spraṣṭaṃ samīcchati |
kintu pralayānalabhāṃ jvālāmālāsamāvṛtām ||41 ||
tvāṃ vilokya trastamanā yathāgato nivartate |
atha vicārya bahubhirdivasaiḥ kāraṇāntaram ||42||
tava sparśasya siddhyarthaṃ punarbhaktān hi pañca tān |
pratyāyayau subhikṣārthaṃ ratiṃ mūrtimatīṃ tathā ||43||
kāmaṃ sumūrtaṃ bāṇām̐śca vasantaṃ me dadatviti |
pañca bhaktāstu te tatra sasmarustān tathākṛte ||44||
kāmādyā āyayustūrṇaṃ saṃkalpitāstadā puraḥ |
atha daduste dāne’pi mahāsurāya tām̐stadā ||45||
asurastānupādāya yayau naijālayaṃ prati |
tān kāmādīnādideśa praveṣṭuṃ kamalātanau ||46 ||
yaiḥ sā sampīḍitā lakṣmīrmāṃ svayaṃ samupeṣyati |
ityevaṃ so’suraścāpi pratīkṣāṃ prākarodapi ||47||
atha kāmo nicikṣepa bāṇānunmādakādikān |
vasantaḥ sumanobhirvai paritaḥ sumanoharaḥ ||48 ||
praphullitaḥ śriyāstatra praphullatāṃ nayatyapi |
ratistataḥ svayaṃ mūrtimatī lakṣmyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||49 ||
praveśaṃ cehamānā tu sahāsyā samupāyayau |
lakṣmīrvijñāya tāṃ duṣṭāṃ kāmapatnīṃ durāśayām ||3.25.50 ||
sadyo roṣaṃ samāpannā tvaṃ tadā parameśvarī |
netrābhyāṃ pralayāgniṃ vai cotpāditavatī svayam |||5 1 ||
dṛṣṭavatī ratiṃ kāmaṃ vasantaṃ ca śarānapi |
asuraṃ ceti tān sarvān kṣaṇamātreṇa bhasmasāt| |||52|||
kṛtavatyeva deveśi naiṣṭhikavrataśālinī |
hāhākārastadā jāto deveṣu mānaveṣvapi ||53 ||
raternāśāt kāmanāśād vasantādervināśanāt |
ṛtvabhāve vanāraṇyodyānādyāḥ puṣpavarjitāḥ ||54||
navāṃkuravihīnāśca lakṣmīśūnyāstadābhavan |
satyāmapi tu lakṣmyāṃ vai nirlakṣmīkaṃ jagaddhyabhūt ||55||
nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca pramodā vilayaṃ gatāḥ |
ānandā nāśamāpannāḥ prasaviṣṇuvināśanāt ||56||
evaṃ lakṣmi tvayā dagdhā ratyādyā netravahninā |
jagat sarvaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ ca sañjātaṃ tvadvratena vai ||57||
devāśca mānavāścāpi maharṣayaśca dehinaḥ |
sarve vicārya kimidaṃ kathaṃ ceti samanvitāḥ |||58||
yayuḥ satye vedhase ca prāhuḥ kaṣṭaṃ tu ṣāṇḍhikam |
ratirnāsti na kāmo’sti vasanto nāsti vai kvacit ||59||
kimidaṃ ca kathaṃ jātaṃ nivārayārttimulbaṇam |
ityuktastu tadā brahmovāca kṣaṇaṃ vicārya vai ||3.25.6 0 ||
pūrve ye pañcadevāśca pañcendrāste tataḥ param |
pañca bhaktā hi kalpe’smin bhajante parameśvaram ||6 1 ||
devasakhādayaḥ sarve dātāraścārthisampadaḥ |
īśvarāḥ pañca te dātuṃ samarthāḥ sarvasampadaḥ ||6 2||
tebhyaścārpitavān lakṣmīṃ prasaviṣṇurmahāsuraḥ |
mama liṃgamalotpanno balī khalo’tidoṣabhṛt ||63||
te viprā vai samāhūya lakṣmīṃ tasmai dadustataḥ |
asurastāṃ samādāya yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ prati ||64||
lakṣmīrvrataṃ dadhārāpi naiṣṭhikīṃ brahmacāritām |
asuraḥ kāmavegena spraṣṭuṃ lakṣmīmupāgataḥ ||65||
vīkṣya tāṃ pralayotpannāgnibhā trasto mahāsuraḥ |
punargatvā ca viprebhyo yayāce tu ratiṃ tathā ||66 ||
kāmaṃ vasantaṃ bāṇāṃśca mūrtimataśca te dvijāḥ |
dadustasmai sarvamūrtān nītvāsuro yayau gṛham ||67||
prerayāmāsa tān sarvān lakṣmīṃ kartuṃ hi cañcalām |
lakṣmīḥ kruddhā svacakṣubhyāmutpādya pralayānalam ||68||
bhasmīcakāra tān sarvān jagat tena tathaiva ca |
kāmabāṇavasantaiśca ratyā hīnaṃ nirarthakam ||6 9||
nirānandaṃ prasaṃjātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvetadeva yat| |
kathitaṃ tatra vai nānyastūpāyo’styatra vārakaḥ ||3.25.70 ||
lakṣmīkrodhena kāmo’pi ratiścāsurako’pi ca |
prasavaste tathā bāṇā vasantaśca mṛtāḥ sadā ||7 1 ||
lakṣmīścet tān punaḥ sarvānutpādayet prasāditā |
naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamevāpi prasamāpya hareḥ puraḥ ||72 ||
parameśasyājñayā ca sarvānujīvayed yadi |
tadā ṣaṇḍhatvadoṣo’yaṃ trailokyād vigamiṣyati ||73 ||
nānyatheti tadarthaṃ śrīhariṃ prati yatāmahe |
ārādhanāṃ prakurmo’tra hariḥ svayaṃ sutoṣitaḥ ||74||
samāyāsyatyatra śīghraṃ duḥkhaṃ nivārayiṣyati |
ityuktāste satyaloke cakruḥ prārādhanāṃ mama ||75||
lakṣmyā tvayā viyogena duḥkhitayā smṛto’pi ca |
samāyātaḥ satyalokaṃ brahmādīnāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ ||76||
dṛṣṭavantaśca te māṃ vai divyarūpaṃ sanātanam |
śaṃkhacakradharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |||77||
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam |
ānarcuste pracakruśca svāgataṃ tuṣṭavustataḥ ||78||
sarvaduḥkhapraśāntyarthaṃ māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam |
śrutvā teṣāṃ prārthanāṃ cāvocaṃ tebhyastadā priye ||79||
lakṣmyā kṛtaṃ na cāhaṃ tad vikartuṃ prabhuratra ha |
tasmād yāmo yatra devī lakṣmīrvane virājate ||3.25.80 ||
sthitā sā brahmacarye vai prasaviṣṇuvane satī |
tāpasī naiṣṭhikadharme vartate sā maheśvarī ||81 ||
atha sarve vayaṃ tatrāyātā yatra tava sthalī |
vilokya māṃ prasannā tvaṃ papāta mama pādayoḥ | |8 2||
svāgataṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtavatyatibhāvataḥ |
ratyādinārājanyaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ prati niveditā ||8 3 ||
stutā sarvaiśca devādyaiḥ prasāditā punaḥ punaḥ |
tvamāttha sarvadevādīn dinānto’yaṃ pravidyate | |8 4||
śvaḥ prātaste tu kāmādyā brahmaṇo dehajāḥ sutāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti hi ratyādyāḥ samarthā dehadhāriṇaḥ ||85||
prasravākhyo’suraścāpi srāvātmā saṃbhaviṣyati |
adya sandhyāsamaye vai teṣāṃ nāsti prayojanam ||86 ||
naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamāsthāya bhajantāṃ parameśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||87||
ahaṃ bhajāmi cātraivāmanvantaṃ svāminā saha |
bhagavān mama kāntaśca naiṣṭhiko’pyatra tiṣṭhatu ||88 ||
mayā vrataṃ dhṛtaṃ tvetannaiṣṭhikaṃ pralayāntikam |
sarve’pi vai vrate tatra tiṣṭhantu śreyasāṃ prade ||89||
tvayoktāste tadā devā mānavāḥ ṛṣayastathā |
sarve sthitā vrate tatra naiṣṭhike’nyadināvadhim || 3.25.90 ||
ahaṃ tavecchayāraṇye bhūmau lakṣmi tadāvasam |
anādiśrībrahmacārinārāyaṇābhidhastvayā || 91 ||
saha tvaṃ vratamāpannā sadaiva tapasi sthitā |
sādhvī dharmavatī lakṣmi naiṣṭhikīśrīriti priye ||92 ||
atha sṛṣṭistadā cānte manau ruddhā samantataḥ |
mṛtā vṛddhāśca saṃbhūya prajāḥ śanaiḥ śanaistadā || 93 ||
tāvatpralayakālaścāyayau sarvaṃ niśāmukhe |
yathākramaṃ nityavacca saṃhṛtaṃ parameṣṭhinā || 94||
tvaṃ vrataṃ svaṃ samāpyaiva devasakhāśramaṃ prati |
mayā sākaṃ gatā lakṣmi tānādāya tato divam || 95||
prāpayya tān pañcabhaktān bhāvimahendravigrahān |
maharlokaṃ janalokaṃ satyalokaṃ tataḥ param || 96 ||
prāpayya brahmaṇe’rpayya vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca mayā saha |
gatvā tataḥ paraṃ me’pi dhāmākṣaraṃ gatābhavat | | 97| |
ityevaṃ mama te cāpi prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ priye |
smara tattāpasaṃ rūpaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ cākṣareśvari ||98 ||
anye’vatārāstadvarṣe mama te cāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
jātāstān vai samastāṃśca vedmyahaṃ netare surāḥ || 99||
atha kalpāntare ratyādayo jātā ajātmajāḥ |
sadehā ajasāhāyyapradāste vacanāt khalu || 3.25.100 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya naiṣṭhikasya phalaṃ bhavet |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭamāpnuyāttathā || 101 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastriṃśe vatsare devasakhādibhaktyā prāptalakṣmyā kṛtaprasravaṇāsuraratikāmavasantabāṇādibhasmībhāvottaraṃ naiṣṭhikatāpālanārtham anādiśrībrahmacārinārāyaṇasya naiṣṭhikīśriyā saha prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||

<3.26>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param |
vedhaso mānavākhye vai caikatriṃśe tu vatsare || 1 ||
kalpe tu ṣaṭśate trayodaśe manau tadā purā |
brahmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭhanimnādhobhāgānmalimaso’suraḥ || 2 ||
hallakākhyo babhūvāpi śavabhakṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ |
tapastepe mahāghoraṃ cārdhakalpaṃ hi dāruṇam || 3 ||
brahmā tutoṣa ca tato gocaro’syābhavad bhuvi |
asuro mṛttikābhūto vallīvṛkṣādhirohitaḥ || 4 ||
asthimṛdastitāmātro yatrāsīt tatra viśvasṛṭ |
gatvā jalenābhiṣicya drumānutsārya pārśvataḥ || 5 ||
mṛttikādrumūlabhāgāt hallakaṃ cābhyajīvayat |
vallīpādaśarīraśca haridvarṇo’tidurbalaḥ || 6 ||
śmaśrulo vedhasaḥ putrastūttasthau mūlajālakāt |
vedhasaṃ jīvayantaṃ svaṃ vīkṣya neme’tibhāvataḥ || 7 ||
yayāce’pi varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kālasaṃhārakārakam |
kālaṃ vā kālarūpaṃ vā saṃhārakaṃ hi dehinām || 8 ||
saṃhārayāmyahaṃ caivaṃ varaṃ dehi pitāmaha |
brahmā prāha varaścāyaṃ me balādatiricyate || 9 ||
nāhaṃ dātuṃ samartho’smi kālādhīno’smyahaṃ yataḥ |
hallakastu tadā prāha dehi cet taṃ na cāparam || 3.26.1 0||
tapaḥ kariṣye satataṃ tadarthaṃ vai pitāmaha |
kālaṃ hantuṃ samartho vai kaścideva hariṃ vinā || 1 1||
naivāsti sṛṣṭijo vyaktiviśeṣo’pi kathaṃcana |
ato hallaka yadvacmi śṛṇu te yadi rocate || 1 2||
kālasya khalu rūpāṇi bahūni santi sṛṣṭiṣu |
teṣvekasyaiva rūpasya sakṛt hantā bhaviṣyasi || 1 3||
yadi te rocate tvetattadā gṛhāṇa me varam |
ityukto mohavaśago hallako vai tadā varam ||14||
jagrāha tattapastyaktvā yayau meruguhāṃ prati |
brahmaṇo varadānena garviṣṭho vartate sadā || 15||
surān daityān rākṣasāṃśca dānavān kinnarādikān |
tāmasān rājasān devān yakṣān kiṃpuruṣādikān || 1 6||
gandharvāṃścāraṇām̐ścāpi gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ |
avamānaṃ karotyeva yuddhyatyeva sthale sthale || 1 7||
brahmaṇo varadānasyānarthaṃ prakāśayatyapi |
kālanāśaka eveti nijaṃ prakhyāpayatyapi || 18||
svarge jayaṃ samāsādya pātāleṣu yayau tataḥ |
tatrāpi vijayaṃ prāpya lokālokaṃ yayau hi saḥ ||19||
sarvatra vijayaṃ prāpya yamalokaṃ tato yayau |
yamastaṃ pūjayāmāsa jñātvā kālavināśakam || 3.26.20||
hallako’yaṃ tato jñātvā nijaṃ vijayinaṃ param |
yayau kailāsalokaṃ sa jetuṃ rudraṃ śivaṃ haram ||2 1 ||
gaṇāḥ kailāsavāsā vai jaṅgabhadrādayastu tam |
nyavārayan gopurād vai tato’sau hallako ruṣā ||22||
yuyudhe dvārapālaiśca vijitya tān gaṇān parān |
gaṇeśān bhūtamūrdhanyān bhairavādīṃstataḥ param ||23||
śaṃbhugṛhaṃ yayau krūro duṣṭo malinavāsanaḥ |
kailāsaṃ vai nijaṃ kartuṃ vaśe kartuṃ satīṃ tathā || 24||
gaṇān bhṛtyāṃstathā kartumiyeṣa vīkṣya sampadaḥ |
prāha śaṃbhuṃ bhava bhṛtyo mama śaṃbho’nyathā tava ||25||
vidhāsye’haṃ vināśaṃ vai dehi satīṃ tu me tava |
kailāsarājyaṃ me datvā yāhi tvaṃ meruparvatam ||26||
punaḥ kālāntare dāsye tṛpto’haṃ te yathāyatham |
śaṃbhurvicārayāmāsa balaṃ tvasya bhavet kiyat ||27||
yotsye’nena tu balinā brahmaṇo varayoginā |
nāśayiṣye kṣaṇādenaṃ varadānayutāsuram ||28||
vicāryaivaṃ kālarūpaṃ raudraṃ dadhāra śaṃkaraḥ |
triśūlaṃ tvantimalayakartṛ dadhāra taijasam ||29||
sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ samāyayau |
yuddhārthaṃ tasya sānnidhyaṃ tāvat hallaka ityapi ||3.26.3 0 ||
jagrāha pārvataṃ rūpaṃ bhayakṛcca vināśakṛt |
saśūlacandrakaśastraṃ kare dadhāra cāyasam ||3 1 ||
kālakālo yathā bhāti tathā bhātyatra hallakaḥ |
yuddhadundubhayo neduḥ kailāse gaṇatāḍitāḥ ||32||
devā deveśvarāstatrāyayuḥ kautukakarṣitāḥ |
śaṃbhoḥ sāhāyyakāḥ sarve dikpālāśca samāyayuḥ ||33||
yuddhaṃ hallakaharayorjātaṃ pralayakārakam |
meghā naṣṭāḥ phaṭākaiścādrayo naṣṭāśca hetibhiḥ ||34||
kṣitiḥ śīrṇā patpraghātaiḥ kampaiścukṣubhire’bdhayaḥ |
vegairnipetustārāśca jagarjurnādanairdiśaḥ ||35||
gaṇā gaṇeśvarāstatra trāsamāpurmṛtiṃ prati |
bhagnāḥ kecit kaṭibhāgāt kecit skandhapradeśataḥ ||36||
anye galātpare jānvorbhāgād bhagnā mṛtiṃ yayuḥ |
bhūtapretapiśācādīn kālabhairavabhairavān ||37||
hastenaikena saṃgṛhya mukhe nyasyātti hallakaḥ |
śūrabhadraṃ vīrabhadraṃ jaṅgabhadraṃ subhadrakam ||38||
vāmahastena yugapanmukhe nyasya cakhāda tān |
etādṛśo mahānāste kālakālo mahāsuraḥ ||39||
śaṃkaraḥ saṃśayamāpto jaye triśūlasaṃsravāt |
śaṃbhorhastagataṃ śūlaṃ sraṃsate sma punaḥ punaḥ ||3.26.40||
vṛṣabhaśca tathā siṃho dvāvetāvapi vai tadā |
hallakasya pracakreṇa nikṛtau mṛtyumāpatuḥ ||41 ||
satī saṃśayamāpannā jīvane śaṃkarasya tu |
śīghraṃ śaṃbhoḥ śarīre sā tirobhāvamupāgatā ||42||
śaṃbhurvijñāya kailāsaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ mṛtānugam |
tyaktvā ca jīvanāśāṃ sa dudrāva hallakāntikam ||43||
puraścāgatya śīghraṃ svaṃ triśūlaṃ pralayānalam |
mārayāmāsa mūrdhnyasya hallakasya galopari ||44||
hastād viyujya vegena hallakasya gale gatam |
praviṣṭaṃ cānalaprakhyaṃ triśūlaṃ taddharasya yat| ||45||
nigalitaṃ gataṃ tatra rasabhāvamupāgatam |
pathyaṃ jātaṃ hallakasyodare’mṛtamivābhavat ||46||
atyadbhutamidaṃ jātaṃ kālaśūlaṃ hi jīrṇitam |
evamanyāni śūlāni triśūlāni ca hetayaḥ ||47||
sarve hallakavarṣmāpya rasabhāvamupāgatāḥ |
ahetiḥ śaṃkaro jātastadā viṣṇuṃ tathā hyajam ||48||
prasasmāra śivastūrṇaṃ viṣṇustatra hyupāyayau |
cakraṃ dadau nijaṃ tasmai harāya ca haro’pi tat ||49||
cakraṃ mumoca kaṇṭhe’sya hallakasya rasaṃ hyabhūt |
athānyaccakramādhattaṃ muktaṃ tad rasatā gatam ||3.26.50||
evaṃ cakrāṇi sarvāṇi gatāni rasato tadā |
brahmā tvāgatya ca tatra yāvatpaśyati śaṃkaram ||51 ||
tāvat saśūlacandreṇa muktena vegagāminā |
śaṃkarasya śiraḥ kaṇṭhānnikṛtaṃ hallakena vai ||52||
hāhākāro mahān jāto raudro rudro’pi vai hataḥ |
śokamāpuḥ sarvadevā mānavāśca maharṣayaḥ ||53 ||
athāpi sarvabhūtāni babhūvuḥ śokabhāñji ca |
hallakasyāpi sāmarthyaṃ śūlacandrāyudhena vai ||54||
sahaiva tu gataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇo varadānataḥ |
asāmarthyo babhūvāpi vijñātaḥ sarvayoddhṛbhiḥ ||55 ||
brahmaṇoditamevātha vijñāya tu surāstataḥ |
gaṇāścābhipradudruvurmāraṇāyāsurasya vai ||56||
tāvattriśūlacakrāṇi sarvāṇyapi ca yāni vai |
galitānyabhavam̐stāni nirgatya cāyayurdrutam ||57||
viṣṇuṃ prati samastāni śaṃkarasya śavaṃ prati |
viṣṇuścakraṃ mumocāsmai yāvat tāvatsa hallakaḥ ||58||
hare viṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam |
uktvā papāta sahasā pādayoḥ śārṅgiṇo’suraḥ ||59||
na hantavyo vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam |
ataścakraṃ nāhanattaṃ viṣṇo viṣṇo pravādinam ||3.26.60||
brahmaṇo varadānācca tathānimittaśālinam |
brahmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭhaputraṃ ca bhaktaṃ tāpasayoginam ||61 ||
babandha taṃ hariḥ pāśaiḥ śaṃkarasyāparādhinam |
vadantaṃ ca hare viṣṇo nārāyaṇa prapāhi mām ||62||
raṭantaṃ manasā māṃ ca smarantaṃ ca hṛdā hi mām |
etādṛśaṃ haraghnaṃ taṃ devahatyā surāsadā ||63 ||
vavalge krūrarūpā sā śatacakrakarā harā |
prāṇānāṃ grāsasāmarthyā vikṛtā vikṛtānanā ||64||
ghorāṃ ca valgitāṃ tvenāṃ hallako vīkṣya duḥkhadām |
cukrośa bahudhā tatra raṇāṃgaṇe surāntike ||65||
hatyayā tāḍito devaistāḍito gaṇakoṭibhiḥ |
mṛtaprāyo maran vavre hareḥ śaraṇarakṣiṇaḥ ||66||
dehi me bhaktarūpāya śaraṇasthāya mādhava |
agryaṃ padaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ dveṣiṇe śaṃkarasya vai ||67||
brahmaṇo varadānācca mahākālasya caikakam |
rūpaṃ mayā hataṃ lābhaṃ vinā vai śāṃkaraṃ tvidam ||68||
hatvā hato’smi sañjāto māyayā garvanoditaḥ |
tapaḥ sarvaṃ kṣiptarvośca tāmase karmaṇi prabho ||69||
ataḥ kṛpayā viṣṇo tvaṃ sukhaṃ dehi kṛpāṃ kuru |
devahatyā dahatyeṣā tāṃ nivāraya keśava ||3.26.70 ||
ityuktvātirurodāpi maraṇāntikatāṃ yayau |
viṣṇuḥ prāha manoḥ kālaṃ tathā rātriḥ prapūrṇikā ||71 ||
devahatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhuṃkṣva hallaka raurave |
pañcadaśamanūnāṃ vai kālānte divasāntare ||72||
yāvad duḥkhāni saṃbhuktvā malino mlecchakarmavān |
mleccheśvaro bhavān bhakto brahmaṇo me bhaviṣyati ||73||
anekasaṃkhyalokānāmāsurāṇāṃ gururmahān |
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuryamadūtaiśca hallakam ||74||
preṣayāmāsa pāpaṃ taṃ sahatyākaṃ yamālayam |
atha devāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaro mānavā dvijāḥ ||75||
pārṣadāśca gaṇāścāpi bhaktā devyaḥ satīstriyaḥ |
yoginyo mātaraścāpi grahādyā dyusado’pi ca ||76 ||
bhaktāḥ sarve ca kailāse saṃgatā hariṇā smṛtāḥ |
viṣṇustebhyastathā tābhyaḥ śaṃbhorujīvanāya vai ||77||
provācārādhanāṃ kartuṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya svāminaḥ sataḥ ||78||
sarvāntaryāmiṇaste’thārādhayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
māṃ sadākṣaradhāmasthaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||79||
drāgevāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ śrutvārādhanamāgataḥ |
kailāse gocaraścakṣuṣmatāṃ divyasumūrtimān ||3.26.80||
vīkṣya māmabhavan sarve viśokāścārthayam̐stataḥ |
śaṃbhujīvanadānārtha tato’haṃ prāviśaṃ tanau ||81 ||
śaṃkarasya kabandhe’pi mastake’pi ca yogataḥ |
prāṇaśaktiṃ pradāyaivājīvayaṃ cāpyasandhayam ||82||
kabandhe mastakaṃ śaṃbhoścārcayaṃ devakoṭibhiḥ |
pitṛbhirmānavaiścāpi maharṣibhistataḥ param ||83 ||
śūrabhadrādayo ye ca carvitāśca mṛtāstadā |
ye ca lakṣmi mṛtāḥ sarve hatā ye ca gaṇāśca te ||84||
mayā smṛtā manojanyā abhavan jīvanānvitāḥ |
āgatya purataḥ śaṃbhostasthuste navasṛṣṭayaḥ ||81||
vṛṣabhādyā mṛtāścāpyujīvitāstatra vai mayā |
gaṇānāṃ koṭayaḥ sarvā devānāṃ koṭayastathā ||86 ||
sarvā mayā prasaṃkalpya svasthāścojjīvitāstadā |
śaṃkarasya punarjīvotsavaḥ kailāsake kṛtaḥ ||87||
satī śaṃbhoḥ svarūpācca tadojjagāma gocarā |
pratyakṣā vai mahādevī prasannā cābhavattataḥ ||88||
ārthayanmāṃ nityameva kailāse bhūtalopari |
sthātuṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmyā śaṃbhuścārthayadeva tu ||89||
devāśca mānavāścāpyārthayanmāṃ puruṣottamam |
sthātuṃ kailāsake kṣetre dehināṃ śreyase’pi ca ||3.26.90||
tato’haṃ śivarājīśri tvayā sākaṃ sadāvasam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||91 ||
anādiśrīśivanārāyaṇanāmnā śiveśvaraḥ |
tvaṃ tadā cābhavastatra śivanārāyaṇī priye ||92||
atha devā yayuḥ sarve mānavāḥ pitarastathā |
svasvalokān munayaśca kailāse’haṃ tato’vasam ||93||
ākalpāntaṃ śivarājñi jānāmyahaṃ na cetare |
smara te me’pi divyaṃ tatprākaṭyaṃ kamale priye ||94||
bhadrādrau śītale ramye viśāle’yutayojane |
tatra sthite tu kailāse bhūbhāge tvavasaṃ sadā ||95||
vaiṣṇavī pṛthivī sarvā tadā prābhūnmayā kṛtā |
devāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve tvāsan bhaktiparā mama ||96||
mama bhakte phalaṃ lakṣmi rājase tāmase’pi ca |
asure vā sure vāpi prāpte kāle’ṅkurāyate ||97||
tasmād bhaktiḥ sarvaśreṣṭhā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
sthāpyate vai mayā dharmayutā kāle yuge dine ||98||
kalpānte vā samārambhe sthāpayāmi sadā hitām |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||99||
smṛddhisampatputravām̐śca bhavedānandaśevadhiḥ |
mahaiśvaryayutaścāpi parameśasarūpavān ||3.26.1 0 0||
sarvavighnavināśaśca sarvāmṛtaniṣevaṇaḥ |
bhavecchāśvatavāsaśca brahmasāyujyavān bhavet || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasa ekatriṃśe vatsare hallakāsurasya brahmaṇo varadānād vijayayātrāyāṃ śaṃbhośśiracchede samujjīvanārtham anādiśrīśivanārāyaṇasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||

<3.27>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇāśri tvaṃ paraṃ tasmāt kathāmṛtam |
prākaṭyaṃ me yathā te ca dvātriṃśe parameṣṭhinaḥ || 1 ||
kalpadruvatsare ṣaṭpaṃcāśatkalpe’ṣṭame manau |
ekadā vai kuberasya yakṣaḥ suvarṇamālikaḥ || 2 ||
yayau svarge vihartuṃ ca tato viṣṇupuraṃ yayau |
satyalokaṃ tato vīkṣya dikpālānāṃ tathālayān || 3 ||
vīkṣya yamālayaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm |
tāvattasyāyuṣaścānto jāto mṛtyuṃ gato hi saḥ || 4 ||
yakṣasya yamarājaḥ prākārayaccāntimāṃ kriyām |
jñātvā kubero yakṣasya maraṇaṃ vai yamālaye || 5 ||
yamadūtairmāritaścetyamanyata tato ruṣā |
jvalan sainyena sahito yamasthalyāṃ svayaṃ yayau || 6 ||
yodhayāmāsa bahudhā yamena saha vai tadā |
yamaṃ jitvā svarṇamālaṃ nināya svagṛhaṃ prati || 7 ||
atha rājā yamastūrṇamāhvayāmāsa nirṛtim |
rākṣasaṃ sainyasahitaṃ nirṛto’pi talasthitān || 8 ||
pātālādinivāsām̐śca rākṣasān yuddhaśālinaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyānāhvayāmāsa svapakṣagān || 9 ||
kuberaṃ tasya rājyaṃ ca jetuṃ yayuśca te tataḥ |
yuddhavādyānyavādyantālakāyāḥ sannidhau hi khe || 3.27.1 0||
jñātvā kuberakastvetanniryayau yakṣakoṭibhiḥ |
yuddhaṃ tvākasmikaṃ tatrābhavat sarvavināśakam || 1 1||
yāmyadūtairhatā yakṣāḥ koṭiśo rākṣasaistathā |
kubero’pi hataḥ kaṇṭhād dvedhā yamena vai tadā ||12||
kuberarājyaṃ sarvaṃ svāyattīkṛtaṃ yamena tu |
nirṛtena tathā rājye rākṣasā niyatīkṛtāḥ || 13||
atha yakṣāḥ pare kecit trastāḥ śrīśānadikpatim |
indraṃ varuṇaṃ vāyuṃ ca gatvā nyavedayaddhi tat || 14||
te sarve tvāyayustūrṇaṃ kuberanagarīṃ prati |
dṛṣṭvā te dharmarājaṃ vai tathā nirṛtamityapi || 15||
īśāno nijaśiṣyasya kuberasya ca pakṣagaḥ |
vairaniryātanārthaṃ vai yuddhaṃ cakre hi dāruṇam || 16||
mahendro’pi tathā vahnirvāyurvaruṇa ityapi |
kuberapakṣamādāya yuddhaṃ cakruryamena te || 17||
atha sūryaḥ svaputrasya yamasya pakṣamāvahan |
svarbhānuśca tathā śaniścaraścānye’pi rākṣasāḥ || 18||
yamapakṣaṃ parigṛhya yuddhaṃ dadurmaholbaṇam |
koṭiśaśca gaṇāstatra surā yakṣā hatāḥ punaḥ ||19||
abhyastayuddhakarmāṇo yāmyā jayaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ |
rākṣasā lebhire yuddhe vijayaṃ yāmyapakṣagāḥ ||3.27.20||
krūrāśca krūrakarmāṇo lohaghṛṣṭakarādayaḥ |
loṣṭhāgniśastrayantrāstrakovidā nirghṛṇā yamāḥ ||21||
mārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ vāyuṃ cendraṃ jalādhipam |
īśānaṃ cānalaṃ cāpi bhagnāste naṣṭasainyakāḥ ||22||
hāhākāro mahānāsījjagatyāṃ sarvaśastadā |
devāstrastā yayuḥ satyaṃ gahvarāṇyapare tathā ||23||
pṛthvyāṃ svarge ca sarvatra balaṃ pātālavāsinām |
dikpālānāṃ pradeśeṣu tvabhavad vardhitaṃ tadā ||24||
lakṣmi tadāntarīkṣaṃ vai cakampe sarvato diśaḥ |
dikpālānāṃ vivādeṣu bhṛtyakoṭyo hatā mṛtāḥ ||25||
yamarājo’bhavad rājā cālakāyāḥ samantataḥ |
astitvaṃ vai kuberasya niṣkāsitaṃ samantataḥ ||26||
nirṛtāḥ rākṣasāḥ sarve yamāścārkaḥ śanistathā |
rāhuścānye pare cāpi babhūvuḥ svabalaidhitāḥ ||27|||
svatantrā iva trailokyāṃ ghnanti virodhaśālinaḥ |
niṣkāsayanti cānamrān devādīn nijavāsataḥ ||28||
evaṃ jātaṃ svargaloke cāvyavasthaṃ mitho’pi ca |
dikpālānāṃ balaṃ naṣṭaṃ yamadaṇḍasya sannidhau || 29||
indrājñāyāṃ na vartante sūryacandrādayo’pare |
surāstadāśritāścāpi svargaṃ vai paragaṃ hyabhūt ||3.27.3 0 ||
athaivaṃ vīkṣya kamale īśānendrānalānilāḥ |
varuṇaśca pare devā mahendragṛhamāyayuḥ ||3 1||
cakruśca mantraṇāṃ tatra kiṃkartavyavihīnakāḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ sasmaruścāpi viṣṇuṃ sasmarurīśvarāḥ ||32||
śeṣaṃ prasasmaruścāpyāyayuste parameśvarāḥ |
śuśruvuste kuberasya nāśaṃ cānyaparājayam ||33||
vijayaṃ dharmarājasya śokaṃ cakruḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā |
dharmarājagṛhe tatrānyāyo naiva bhavediti ||34||
kāraṇaṃ sarvamevāpi jñātvā yakṣasya vai mṛtim |
nyāyyāmanyāyamālambya kuberasya tu yodhanam || 35||
kampayitvā śirāṃsyete menire na jayaṃ punaḥ |
yatrānyāyo na vijayastatra saṃbhavati kvacit ||36||
kuberasyānyāyabhāktve mṛtyuścāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ dehināṃ nāyako yamaḥ ||37||
āyuṣyānte nayatyeva tatra kā paridevanā |
indraṃ vāyuṃ jaleśaṃ ceśānaṃ vahniṃ tayeśvarān ||38||
nayatyeva yameśo vai kā kathānyasya vai mṛteḥ |
tasmād yamāya devāya devo vai vijayo’tra ha ||39||
asmābhistu pramantavyaḥ parājayo’tra karmaṇi |
kubero dikpatirbhūtvā tvanyāyaṃ kurute yadi ||3.27.40||
tatpakṣāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ syād vardhitaṃ punaḥ |
tasmādatra na viṣṇośca śeṣasya vedhaso’pi ca ||41||
anyeṣāmapi cāturyaṃ jayameṣyati vai surāḥ |
atastatra na gantavyaṃ yatrāste yamarāṭ svayam ||42||
alakāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvanāśāya bho surāḥ |
kintu devādhidevānāmīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ ||43||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīśaḥ śrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ ||44||
smartavyastvatra vāde vai nirṇayaṃ sa vidhāsyati |
indragṛhe mahāsatraṃ kurvantu prajayātmakam ||45||
parameśasya bho devāḥ svayamāyāsyati prabhuḥ |
ityuktāste harādyāśca devā indrālaye tadā ||46||
japasatraṃ pracakruśca deveśvarāśca sarvaśaḥ |
hare kṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo parameśa parātpara ||47||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣa pareśvara |
satataṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurdevānāṃ pūrṇavatsaram ||48||
indrasya vatsarānte śrīhariścāhaṃ samāyayau |
gocaraḥ sarvadevānāṃ śaṃkhacakrādimān prabhuḥ ||49||
tvayā sākaṃ tadā lakṣmyā sarvabhūṣāḍhyayā priye |
devā māmanusaṃvīkṣyāścarthaparāḥ susatvaram ||3.27.50||
utthāya nemurbahudhā cakruśca pūjanaṃ mama |
madhuparkaṃ daduścāpi satkāraṃ ca dadhustataḥ ||51||
mahāsanaṃ dadustatropāviśaṃ ca tvayā saha |
nyavedayam̐śca te sarvamudantaṃ dhanarakṣiṇaḥ ||52||
yakṣāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ cāpi nijānāṃ ca parājayam |
yamasya vijayaṃ cāpi svarge svatantratāṃ tathā ||53||
avyavasthā ca deveṣu śuśrāvāhaṃ ca padmaje |
kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ tadā kṛtvāvocaṃ dikpālakānidam ||54||
bhavadbhirvai mayā sākaṃ gantavyaṃ yatra vai yamaḥ |
kuberasya nagaryāṃ hi sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||55||
sāmnā vādasya sarvasya neṣye’ntaṃ prasukhāvaham |
ityuktvāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha |||56||
agacchaṃ tvalakābhūmau yamanaiṛtasannidhau |
śrutvā māṃ sa tu tūrṇaṃ vai trastamanā upāyayau ||57||
padbhyāṃ matsannidhau lakṣmi bhayaṃ prāpāpyacintayam |
pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre papau vāryamṛtaṃ mama ||58||
svāgataṃ pradadau cāpyāsanaṃ vādyānyavādayat |
dāsavat sarvadevānāṃ paśyatāṃ prajagāda mām ||59||
aparāddhaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa kubero mārito mayā |
nagarīyaṃ kṛtā vaśyā kṣamasva puruṣottama ||3.27.60||
anyāyamārgiṇāṃ daṇḍo’vaśyaṃ bhavati keśava |
yadyahaṃ syāṃ tathā tarhi daṇḍo mayyapi dhīyatām ||61||
ityuktvā śaraṇaṃ prāpya papāta pādayormama |
anyāyena vihīnasya daṇḍo naiva hi yujyate ||62||
kubero’yaṃ mārito yat tanna yogyaṃ bhavediha |
yakṣeśvaro jīvanīyo jīvanīyā gaṇā api ||63||
surādyā jīvayitavyā ye hatā āhave yama |
kuberasya purī tasmai dātavyā punareva ha ||64||
tvayā dharma pragantavyaṃ yamarājapurīṃ prati |
saṃyamanīṃ sadā rakṣa mānyagṛdhnāṃ samācara ||65||
ityuktaśca mayā dharmarājo’yācata vai kṣamām |
padaṃ kauberakaṃ tyaktvā prasthānamakarot tataḥ ||66||
mayā lakṣmi kuberasyāvāhanaṃ tatra vai punaḥ |
kṛtaṃ mānasaputro me jajñe dhanādhipastataḥ || 67||
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto yakṣāśca jajñire punaḥ |
anye mṛtāḥ surāḥ sarve jajñire mānasā mama ||68||
sutā devādayaste vai māmānarcurmudānvitāḥ |
mayārpitaṃ kuberāya mānasāya padaṃ punaḥ ||69||
tenārthitastadā cāhaṃ nityavāsārthameva ha |
svarṇavatyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai nyavasaṃ svarṇavarṇavān ||3.27.70 ||
śaṃkarādyāḥ pūjayitvā yayuste svapadāni hi |
yamo yayau yāmyapadaṃ cānye yayurnijālayān ||71 ||
kuberasya navīne tūdbhave tasya mahotsavaḥ |
mayā kṛtaḥ svarṇapuryāṃ pūjito vardhitastathā ||72||
tvaṃ sadā kānakīlakṣmīrmayā sākaṃ virājitā |
anādiśrīsvarṇanārāyaṇena sārdhamīśvarī ||73 ||
ākalpāntaṃ nyavasaṃ vai svarṇavatyāṃ pareśvaraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||74||
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ dikpālānāṃ niyāmakaḥ |
sarvarakṣākaraḥ sākṣācchrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||75||
smara lakṣmi suvarṇe tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me ca te tadā |
rājarājeśvarīrūpaṃ sarvānandapariplutam ||76||
atha sūryādayaścānye devā yamānugā api |
kṣamāpya māṃ bhajante sma svarṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ||77||
hiraṇyavarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ svarṇaśmaśruṃ yamārdanam |
dikpālānāṃ niyantāraṃ vinetāraṃ virodhinām ||78||
kleśānāṃ śāntikartāraṃ dātāraṃ sampadāṃ tathā |
dagdhāraṃ pāpapuñjānāṃ hartāraṃ vipadāṃ ca mām ||79||
pūjayanti hi devādyāḥ parameśaṃ sanātanam |
paravrahmākṣarātītaṃ satpatiṃ muktasevitam ||3.27.80 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇādapi muktibhāg|
bhuktibhāgapi jāyeta svarṇaśri nātra saṃśayaḥ ||8 1 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso dvātriṃśe vatsare yamena māritasya kuberasyojjīvanārtham anādiśrīsvarṇanārāyaṇasya kānakīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||

<3.28>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīlakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param |
vedhaso vatsare trayastriṃśe sasyābhidhe purā || 1 ||
kalpe triṃśattame tvekādaśe manvantare tathā |
meroḥ pūrve śvetakhaṇḍe’ruṇācalo’bhavadgiriḥ || 2 ||
yojanotsedha evāyaṃ daśayojanavistṛtaḥ |
jvālāgarbhaḥ sadā cāste vahnirasāḍhyakandaraḥ || 3 ||
na pārśve mānavāḥ santi nāraṇyāni vanānyapi ||
nadyastūṣṇapravāhā vai bhūmistvaṃgārasannibhā || 4 ||
varṣe varṣadvaye varṣāṣṭakottare śatābdake |
jvālāruṇācalo jvālāmayo bhavati sarvataḥ || 5 ||
vahnirasāḥ pravartante deśeṣu ca saritsvapi |
tatpratāpātpradahyanti dūradeśā api priye || 6 ||
mānavāḥ paśavaścāpi pakṣiṇo vyomacāriṇaḥ |
tāpoṣmaṇā pramūrchāptā vyasavaḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 7 ||
sasyānāṃ ca vanānāṃ ca vahnisekena bharjanam |
dūrasthānāṃ bhavatyeva phalapuṣpādināśakam || 8 ||
yāṃ diśāṃ prati vāyūnāṃ pravāhā yānti sānalāḥ |
śatayojanaparyantā deśā bhavanti bharjitāḥ || 9 ||
vahnisekamṛtā jīvāḥ pralayasthā bhavanti vai |
ekadā tu mahājhaṃjhāvāto babhūva cāmbare || 3.28.10 ||
jvālāruṇācalaścāpi vahnirūpo babhūva ha |
vahnijvāloṣmapūrāṇyāvahan pravāyuṇoditāḥ || 11 ||
ativegena pūrvasyāṃ śatayojanaveginaḥ |
meroḥ pārśve vasatayo lakṣaśo dehino’bhavan || 1 2||
uṣmaṇā dagdhadehāste mṛtāścirapravāhiṇā |
koṭiśo gajago’śvādyā nagarāṇi sahasraśaḥ || 13||
tatrāsīnnagaraṃ svāminagaraṃ yojanāyatam |
prāyaśo mama bhaktaiścādhiṣṭhitaṃ pāvanairjanaiḥ || 14||
maṭhāśca sādhusādhvīnāṃ yatīnāmabhavan śubhāḥ |
brahmacaryavratānāṃ ca satīnāṃ dharmayoṣitām || 15||
āśramā bahavaścāsan japayajñakṛtāṃ tathā |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ yogināṃ ca karmaṭhānāṃ mahālayāḥ || 16||
babhūvuryatra devārthā devālayāḥ prasevinām |
madarthaṃ tapasā bhaktā yatrāsan vai videhinaḥ || 17||
mama lakṣyaparāstyaktamadarthasarvabhogakāḥ |

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vedhaso yākṣanāmake |
pañcatriṃśe vatsare ca kalpe’ṣṭāśītiyucchate || 1 ||
tṛtīye ca manau jātaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me śṛṇu priye |
aṃśukramatho rājarṣistadāsīd dakṣiṇe vratī || 2 ||
meroḥ sannihite deśe nālaveyaprajādhipaḥ |
samastasya nalavasya bhūkhaṇḍasya niyāmakaḥ || 3 ||
anye sahasrabhūpāśca karadāstasya cābhavan |
dānī dhyānī vratī bhaktaḥ sādhusevī śravī makhī || 4 ||
harinyāsī nivedī ca viśvāsī pūjako mama |
nṛpoṃ’śukramatho lakṣmi mahāvaiṣṇavasatkriyaḥ || 5 ||
yathābhavattathā tasya patnyo’pi haridīkṣitāḥ |
vaiṣṇavyaḥ śatasaṃkhyāścābhavan hariparāyaṇāḥ || 6 ||
dātryo dhyātryo vratinyaśca bhaktāḥ sādhuprasevikāḥ |
śraviṇyaśca makhinyaśca harinyāsinya ityapi || 7 ||
ātmanivedikāḥ sarvā viśvāsinyaśca pūjikāḥ |
pātivratyaparāścāpi mayi sarvakṛtādarāḥ || 8 ||
madarcāyāṃ lagnacittā matsādhudivyadṛṣṭikāḥ |
patyau harau satsu nityaṃ samasevāsamādarāḥ || 9 ||
rājñaḥ putrāstriśatāni putryaḥ śatadvayaṃ tathā |
pitṛvat mātṛvat satsu harau sevāparāyaṇāḥ || 3.29.1 0||
manasā vastubhirdehaiḥ sevante bhagavatkulam |
sarve cāsan divyabhāvā videhāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ || 1 1||
naiṣāṃ rājye kadāpyāsan nītayo duḥkhaviplavāḥ |

aparigrahadharmāṇaḥ santo me brahmamūrtayaḥ |

bhajante māmāśramasthā niṣkāmā matparāyaṇāḥ ||44||
atha teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokyātmaniveditām |
kṛpayāhaṃ tadeyeṣoṣitaṃ sādhvīsatāṃ gaṇe ||45||
mādhavākhye mama māse rājā cakāra kīrtanam |
māsikaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ ca triṃśaddinaṃ makhātmakam ||46||
hare nārāyaṇa viṣṇo kṛṣṇa keśava mādhava |
parabrahma prabho śrīśa puruṣottama satpate ||47||
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane |
namo’ntarātmane sādhusvarūpāyākhilātmane ||48||
namaḥ sādhvīsvarūpāya śrīkāntāya sadātmane |
namo bhaktipralabhyāya sevāsādhyāya cakriṇe ||49||
svatantrastvaṃ cākṣareśo vartase muktakoṭiṣu |
tathātrāyāhi sākṣādvai divyamūrtiryathāsi naḥ ||3.29.50||
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ rājā prajāśca sādhavaḥ |
taiḥ sahāyaṃ kīrtayāmi nṛtyāmi ca hasāmi ca ||51||
bhuñje tiṣṭhāmi saṃyāmi niṣīdāmi vadāmi ca |
pibāmi cāpi jighrāmi rasayāmi svapimyapi ||52||
pramode cānandayāmi viharāmi namāmi ca |
praseve sādhuveṣo’haṃ sādhuṣu tanmakhotsave ||93||
gūḍharūpaṃ ca māṃ te tu naiva jānanti mādhavam |
sādhuṃ kaṃcit prajānanti kecanaiva samājake ||14||
tva tadābhūḥ satī sādhvī bālā śīlaparāyaṇā |
kāṣāyāmbaraveṣā ca pratyakṣā gūḍhasadguṇā ||55||
gūḍharūpā gūḍhacihnā sādhvīsevāparāyaṇā |
sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍale tatra vyacaraḥ samavartanā ||56||
na tāḥ sādhvyaḥ prajānanti lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ gocarāmapi |
mama māyā tathā cāste svatantrāvaraṇātmikā ||57||
annasatraṃ makhasatraṃ tathā kīrtanasatrakam |
mādhavānte prapūrṇaṃ ca jātaṃ vai pūrṇacandrake ||28||
dine sāyaṃ kathāṃ cakrurmama māhātmyabodhinīm |
sādhavaścāpi satyaśca rājā prajā mahotsave ||59||
mama pūjāṃ tataścakrurniśi mūrtau suvastubhiḥ |
nīrājanaṃ tataścakruḥ puṣpāñjalīrdadustataḥ ||3.29.60||
bhojanāni pradaduśca tataḥ savādyanartanam |
kīrtanaṃ tālamānādyaiḥ susvaraistālikādibhiḥ ||61 ||
kiṃkiṇīghurghuraśabdaiścakrurjāgaraṇānvitāḥ |
tadāhaṃ kīrtanākṛṣṭaḥ prāvirāsaṃ hi nartakaḥ ||62||
nartakī tvaṃ bālikā vai bālo’haṃ ṣoḍaśābdikaḥ |
caturdaśābdikī tvaṃ ca suveśābhūṣaṇānvitā ||63||
māyūrapicchamukuṭā divyakuṇḍalaśobhanā |
nṛtyārhasarvaveṣāḍhyā prasannā nāṭyakovidā ||64||
ahaṃ cāpi tathārūpaḥ sarvayogyaparigrahaḥ |
sabhāyāṃ raṅgamadhye cāgato’lakṣyapradeśataḥ ||65||
na vai kaiścidahaṃ jñāto jñātā vā ca kuto nvimau |
cakitā nau vilokyāsan rājādyāste sabhājanāḥ ||66 ||
āvayorvai mahattejaḥ sabhāyāṃ prāsarattadā |
ānandamodasaukhyāni prāsaran vai samājake ||67||
miṣṭaṃ sveṣṭaṃ kāmitaṃ ca mahāsaukhyaṃ tadābhavat |
janānāṃ tvāvayoryogānnṛtyagītipratālanaiḥ ||68||
asmallīnāstadā sarve pratyayaikapratānitāḥ |
cākṣuṣamātravegāśca śravaṇākṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||69||
vyapaśyan nirnimeṣā māṃ tvāṃ divyāṃ śrīṃ śriyaḥpatim |
anantakoṭisūryābhamasaṃkhyacandraśobhanām ||3.29.70||
māṃ tvāṃ vyalokayan lokāḥ kṛpāluṃ ca kṛpānvitām |
kīrtanaṃ snehabhajanaṃ kāraṇaṃ satprasevanam ||71 ||
divyabhāvaḥ sadā satsu hetavo darśane hi nau |
athānṛtyanta bhaktānyo bhaktāścākṛṣṇamānasāḥ ||72||
paramānandamagnāśca dehātibhānavarjitāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tatra darśanaṃ cāvayoḥ śubham ||73||
divyaṃ yathākṣare dhāmni tathābhavat kṣaṇaṃ tadā |
athānantaramevāhaṃ tejastiro vyadhāpayam ||74||
ākṛṣṭā vṛttayasteṣāṃ svāsthyamāptā yathendriyam |
tato nau nijatulyau te vyalokayantupasthitau ||75||
vinivṛttā drutaṃ nṛtyād gāyanāt kīrtanādapi |
mahāścaryabharā nemurdaṇḍavattvāṃ ca māṃ janāḥ ||76||
dadurmukhyāsanaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ nṛpādayaḥ |
āvāṃ siṃhāsanasthau ca pupūjuste kṛtādarāḥ ||77||
candanairakṣataiścāpi puṣpairhāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
rājādyā ratnahāraiśca sauvarṇaraśanādibhiḥ ||78||
mukuṭādyaiśca bhūṣābhirdhūpainaiṃvedyābhojanaiḥ |
miṣṭapānaiśca tāmbūlairnīrājanena saṃstavaiḥ ||79||
namaskāraiśca te sarve daṇḍavadbhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
jayaśabdairharṣanādairvetradhṛgghoṣaṇaistathā ||3.29.80||
sarve prasādayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ tadā |
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā jñātvā vai parameśvaram ||8 1 ||
sādhava ūcuḥ
yatra kvāpi bhavejjanma paścātpuṇyapratāpataḥ |
bhavaccharaṇamāpannāḥ putrāḥ smo bhagavam̐stava ||82||
acyuto vai pitā yasya te tvacyutā bhavanti vai |
vayaṃ cācyutatāṃ prāptāḥ kṛpaiṣā śrīhare tava ||83||
suputreṣu ca divyeṣu kṛpayā tvaṃ samāgataḥ |
snehapātrāṇi saṃvīkṣya pratyakṣaḥ sā kṛpāparā |||84|||
athāto’pi sadā satsu vāso yathā tanau tathā |
satāṃ madhye vasa kṛṣṇa kṛpeyaṃ pāramārthikī ||85||
yathā dhāmni tathā satsu maṇḍaleṣu nivāsanam |
sadā sādhusvarūpeṇa karotu paramāṃ kṛpām ||86||
sādhvya ūcuḥ
mātarlakṣmi mahāmātastvā vayaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ |
mokṣārthinyo brahmasādhvyo bhavatyāḥ putrikā vayam ||87||
mātṛvātsalyamatyantaṃ sutāsu tu nisargajam |
tatpuraskṛtya janani dadāsi darśanaṃ hi naḥ ||88||
abalānāṃ balopetaṃ bhāgyamadya pravartate |
divyatāṃ prāpya te yogānmuktatāṃ yāma eva ha ||89||
karuṇā te’pyatulyāsti yatsādhvīṣu vibhāvanam |
tatrāpi cātikāruṇyaṃ yadi vāsaṃ prarocayeḥ ||3.29.90||
prārthanāmurarīkṛtya yatheṣṭaṃ prakarotviha |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayākṣareśvari || 91 ||
rājñī provāca
dhanyāhaṃ mama putryaśca putrā rājyaṃ nṛpastathā |
prajā dhanyā mama lakṣmi yadatra darśanaṃ tava ||92||
kuru vāsaṃ sadā cātra tava sarva bhavatyapi |
dāsyahaṃ sarvadā te’smi vasa lakṣmi kṛpāṃ kuru ||93||
saṃsāre lābha evātra prāptaḥ sādhvīsamāgamaḥ |
bhavatyā darśanaṃ sākṣāt sa evānanyalābhakaḥ ||94||
rājovāca
kulaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ vaṃśaḥ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇa bhavatkṛte |
mayārpitaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvadātmakaṃ tvadarthakam ||95||
kṛpeyaṃ darśanaṃ sākṣāttavātra satsamāgamāt |
prāptavyaṃ sarvamevādya prāptaṃ cātyantikaṃ phalam ||96||
sarvadā vasa me gehe kṛpāṃ kṛtvā pareśvara |
ityuktvā praṇanāmaiva pavāta pādayornṛpaḥ ||97||
tathāstvomiti taṃ coktvā nyavasaṃ sādhumaṇḍale |
anādiśrīsādhunārāyaṇaḥ sākaṃ tvayā priye ||98||
ākalpāntaṃ tataḥ sādhvīnārāyaṇyāvasaṃ kṣitau |
smara tvāṃ māṃ tathā sarvaṃ cāvatārān parānapi ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇānmuktimāvrajet| |
prākaṭyaṃ me tavoktaṃ vai mokṣadaṃ kṛpayānvitam || 3.29.1 00||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ pañcatriṃśadvatsareṃ’śukramathanṛpaterbhaktyānādiśrīsādhunārāyaṇasya sādhvīnārāyaṇyā lakṣmyā saha prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||

<3.30>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato rājñā sevito’haṃ sadā hariḥ |
sādhusevāphalaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ dadau nṛpāya vai || 1 ||
kuṭumbasahitaḥ saukhyaṃ bhuktvā svargaṃ yayau tataḥ |
tatra saukhyāni bhuktvaiva vairājadevatātmakaḥ || 2 ||
bhūtvā sukhāni bhuktvaiva satyalokaṃ yayau punaḥ |
tato vaikuṇṭhamāsādya sukhaṃ bhuktvā divaṃ punaḥ || 3 ||
madicchayaiva samprāpto bhakteḥ pravartanāya ha |
tataḥ koṭyadhilokānāmīśvaraḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 4 ||
nārāyaṇasvarūpaḥ so’saṃkhyalokān svakāśritān |
nītvā bhaktiyutān dhāmākṣaraṃ me samprayāsyati || 5 ||
aṃśukramatha evāyaṃ bhakto me yādṛśo’bhavat |
tādṛśā nāpare loke bhaviṣyanti nivedinaḥ || 6 ||
putrāḥ putryaśca rājñyaśca rājā prajāstathānugāḥ |
sarve sarvāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi madarthasarvasampadām || 7 ||
kṛtopayogā āsam̐ste vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ |
athānyatte kathayāmi prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu mādhavi || 8 ||
vedhaso rākṣasākhye ṣaṭtriṃśe varṣe tataḥ punaḥ |
kalpe ṣaṇṇavatisaṃkhye saptame ca manau priye || 9 ||
prākaṭyaṃ me yathā jātaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivāvatāriṇaḥ ||3.30.1 0||
kṛte yuge pañcadaśe yogī nāmnā hariprathaḥ |
kuṃbhakāro’bhavat pṛthvyāṃ viṣṇupadyāstaṭe śubhe || 11 ||
ābālyātsādhuyogena babhūva bhaktarāṭ mama |
mātā śreṇīmatī tasmai dadātyapi suśikṣaṇam || 12||
aṃke stanyaprapāne ca preṃkhāyāṃ kaṭivāsane |
khaṣṭvikāyāṃ tathā yoge bālānāṃ khalane’pi ca ||13||
vada putra harernāma kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa narāyaṇa |
vada putra śriyā nāma lakṣmi lakṣmi narāyaṇi || 14||
evaṃ mātā nijaṃ putraṃ śikṣayatyeva muktaye |
śreyase pāpanāśāya janmasārthakyahetave || 15||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama |
parabrahmākṣarātīta śrīpate parameśvara || 16||
evaṃ svayaṃ ca tanmātā karoti kīrtanaṃ mama |
sadaiva sarvakāryeṣu bhaktimatī hi sadguṇā ||17||
kuṃbhakāro’pi viraṇo nāmnā me bhaktimān sadā |
sarvakārye smaratyeva māṃ satāṃ sevako’pi san ||18 ||
bhajatyeva hariṃ nityaṃ smaratyeva janārdanam |
karotyevārpaṇaṃ mahyaṃ tato bhuṃkte yathocitam || 19||
sāyaṃ nityaṃ mama mālāmāvartayati manmanāḥ |
karotyapi sadā sevāṃ satāṃ bhaktimatāṃ śubhām ||3.30.20||
gṛhakāryaṃ pātrakāryaṃ grāmasevādikaṃ tathā |
yadā karoti tatrāpi gṛṇāti śrīnarāyaṇa ||21||
kare mālāṃ gale mālāṃ sadā rakṣati kuṃbhakṛt |
harernāma japan kālaṃ sārthakayati sarvadā ||22||
śṛṇu lakṣmi prabhaktasya bhaktirnāstyeva durlabhā |
sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu sulabhātmanivedinaḥ ||23||
viraṇaḥ prātarutthāya nārāyaṇeti saṃvadan |
ghaṭaṃ nītvā nadīṃ yāti snāti raṭati māṃ harim ||24||
jalaṃ bhṛtvā gṛhaṃ yāti pippalasya tu mūlake |
smṛtvā māṃ salilaṃ tatra siñcatyapi tataḥ sa ca ||25||
sūryaṃ natvā mṛttikāyāḥ kṛtaṃ māṃ ca praṇamya ca |
raṭan khādati mahyaṃ cārpitaṃ prātarhi roṭakam ||26||
tathaiva kuṃbhikṛt patnī bhuṃkte bhuṃkte suto’pi ca |
athādātuṃ mṛdo yānti kīrtayanto hariṃ trayaḥ ||27||
kharapṛṣṭhe mṛdo yogyā āharanti yadā tadā |
hareḥ kītanakartārastrayo yānti gṛhaṃ prati ||28||
gardhapyai gardhapāyāpi tṛṇādi ca jalādi ca |
hariprasādasalilaiḥ saṃprokṣya tad dadatyapi ||29||
jalairmṛdaścārdrayanti kīrtayanti hariṃ tadā |
mardayanti mṛdaścāpi kīrtayanti tadāpi mām ||3.30.30 ||
cakraṃ ca kīlake dhṛtvā bhrāmayanti smaranti mām |
piṃḍaṃ cakre sthāpayanti māṃ smaranti janārdanam ||3 1 ||
ghaṭaśarāvapātrāṇi racayanti smaranti mām |
tantunā ca pṛthak kṛtvāvatārayanti cāpyadhaḥ ||32||
smaranto māṃ ṭīppayanti pātrāṇi ṭīppasādhanaiḥ |
vahnibhrāṣṭryāṃ klṛptayanti pakvayanti smaranti mām ||33||
vikrīṇanti ca pātrāṇi pakvāni ca smaranti mām |
labdhadravyairannaśākādikaṃ krīṇanti cāpaṇāt ||34||
randhayanti bhojanāni smaranti ca raṭanti mām |
sthālyāṃ bhṛtvārpayitvā me bhuñjate manniveditam ||35||
evaṃ yātrāṃ kuṭumbasya nirvartayanti matparāḥ |
sāyaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti satāṃ mukhānmamālaye ||36||
rātrau śrutaṃ smarantyeva vicārayanti muktaye |
na vinā bhojanaṃ mokṣo bhaktirna puṇyamantarā || 37||
puṇyaṃ sevāṃ vinā naiva sevā kṛpāṃ vinā ca na |
kṛpā dāsyaṃ vinā naiva dāsyaṃ śraddhāṃ vinā na vai ||38||
śraddhā jñānaṃ vinā nāpi jñānaṃ na śravaṇaṃ vinā |
śrutirvinā na satsaṃgaṃ satsaṃgo na sato vinā ||39||
santo bhāvaṃ vinā naiva bhāvo vinā na bhāvanām |
bhāvanākhyastu saṃskāro na vinā prāgupārjitam ||3.30.40||
prāgupārjitamatraiva bhujyate phalarūpi tat |
adyopārjitamanyatra bhokṣyate śreyasāṃ pade ||41 ||
śreyaḥ sarvavidhaṃ sādhyaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ narāyaṇaḥ |
tasya caraṇe mokṣo’sti prāptavyaḥ prematantunā ||42||
premapātraṃ harermūrtiścetanā sādhusaṃjñikā |
santaḥ prasādayitavyāḥ sevābhiḥ śreyaicchubhiḥ ||43||
annaṃ jalaṃ ca vastraṃ ca tredhā nirvāhasādhanam |
gṛhaṃ kāntā ca dhenuśca tredhā tvālambanaṃ matam ||44||
udyamaḥ putra ārogyaṃ tretā dhairyasya sādhanam |
āyaḥ kośo bāndhavāśca tredhā balasya sādhanam ||45||
maitryaṃ mānaṃ yaśaśceti tredhā sthiterhi sādhanam |
vidyā vṛttirvaśitvaṃ ca tredhā vaitṛṣṇyasādhanam ||46||
tṛptirvirāga aiśvaryaṃ tredhā śānteḥ prasādhanam |
dharmaḥ kṣamā titikṣā ca tredhā sukhasya sādhanam ||47||
santo hariśca śīlaṃ ca tredhā mukteḥ prasādhanam |
duḥkhaṃ viveko’vamānaṃ tredhā vairāgyasādhanam ||48||
karma tṛṣṇā vāsanā ca tredhā saṃsārakāraṇam |
droho nindā ca nāstikyaṃ tredhā nirayasādhanam ||49||
pramādo moha īhā ca tredhā mṛtyunimantraṇam |
naiṣkarmyamarpaṇaṃ bhaktistredhā mokṣasya sādhanam ||3.30.50||
tasmānmokṣārthameveha yatitavyaṃ nirantaram |
anyāni samparityajya nirvāṇakāraṇeṣviha ||51||
ghaṭā yathā vibhinnā vai prajāyante tathātviha |
prajā lokāśca karmāṇi sukhāni pratyahaṃ hatāḥ ||52||
kālavegena naśyanti dehadaihikasampadaḥ |
kā nārī ko naraḥ putraḥ putrī vā kṛtrimaṃ tviha ||53||
sambandhā nāmasaṃjñāśca yathā mṛdā bhavantyapi |
tathā ṣāṭkauśikādīnāṃ nāmasaṃjñāśca kṛtrimāḥ ||54||
kṛtrimaṃ dehamāsādya jñātvā mokṣasya sādhanam |
yadi sādhyet mokṣo na vṛthā janma hi mānavam ||55||
sarvatra viṣayāḥ santi kṣudhā tṛṣā pramodanam |
aihikaṃ sarvameveti kṣaṇikaṃ jīvabandham ||56||
navaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ ca nityaṃ nityaṃ prajāyate |
na cānto’sti bandhanānāṃ nave varṣe navā ghaṭāḥ ||57||
ghaṭakartā mṛtiṃ yānti cānyastatra pravartate |
ghaṭānāṃ ghaṭakartṝṇāṃ pravāho na nivartate ||58||
pravāhapatitā jīvā mamāhaṃpāśapāśitāḥ |
ghaṭe naṣṭe’pi khaṇḍeṣu badhyante mohapāśitāḥ ||59||
kālena nāśaḥ sarveṣāmavaśyaṃ jāyate tviha |
paśyantaśceti mokṣārthaṃ yatante na mṛtā hi te ||3.30.60||
punaḥ punarmariṣyanti vinā śāśvatasevanam |
tasmānnārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||6 1 ||
parabrahmāntarātmā śrīhariḥ sevyaḥ sadā bhuvi |
bhajantu paramātmānaṃ raṭantu harināma ca ||62||
dhyāyantu ca harikṛṣṇaṃ prāpnuvantu pareśvaram |
evaṃ nityaṃ niśāyāṃ vai viraṇādyā nijaṃ hitam ||63||
vicārayanti satyārthaṃ bhajante sma ca māṃ sadā |
evaṃ yāte svalpakāle trayaste kuṃbhakarmiṇaḥ ||64||
sādhusevāparāḥ sādhvāśrayāśca sarvathābhavan |
tadgṛhaṃ mandiraṃ jātaṃ mama sādhuniṣevaṇāt || 65 ||
sādhavo nityamevātra kurvanti matkathādikam |
viraṇasya kuṃbhakṛtaḥ putro hariprathaḥ svayam ||66||
ānandabrahmaguruto dīkṣāṃ jagrāha sādhavīm |
sādhurbhūtvā prabhuṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ divāniśam ||67||
vāksiddhistasya sampannā yathā vakti prajāyate |
athaikadā satāṃ tatra sabhāyāṃ bhajane mama ||68||
jāyamāne tānamiśre’mbarāttatra manuḥ svayam |
saptamo varṇiśālākhyo vimānena hi niryayau ||69||
sādhavaḥ kuṃbhakārādyāḥ sādhvyaśca bhajanottaram |
viṣṇupadyāstaṭe snānādyarthaṃ yayuḥ sakīrtanāḥ ||3.30.70||
snānti kecittathānye ca kīrtayanti pareśvaram |
yāvad ghaṭṭe’mbaraṃ dūraṃ bhramitvā manureva saḥ ||71 ||
yadṛcchayā viṣṇupadyāstaṭaṃ cāvātaraddhi saḥ |
rājarūpo bhṛtyayukto jalāvatāramāyayau ||72||
yatra te bhajane magnāḥ sādhvādyāḥ snānahetave |
tiṣṭhanti māṃ bhajantaśca raṭanto harikīrtanam ||73||
varṇiśālo manustatra bhṛtyānāha sagarvakaḥ |
imān vai mānavānatra sarvānnārīnarādikān ||74||
niṣkāsayantu rundhantu dūrameva nadītaṭāt |
yāvadahaṃ jale nadyāḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā na yāmi ca ||75||
tāvad bhṛtyāḥ karairdhṛtvā niṣkāsayantu dūrataḥ |
ityuktvā bhṛtyavargāste pratyudgamya samantataḥ ||76||
dūrayāmāsurevaitān vārayāmāsureva ca |
sādhavo’pi vinivṛttā ānandabrahmanoditāḥ ||77||
hariprathaḥ sādhubhaktaḥ prāha dūtān kathaṃ tvidam |
rodhanaṃ vāraṇaṃ snāne bhavadbhiḥ saṃvidhīyate ||78||
dūtāḥ prāhuśca te kiṃ vā prayojanaṃ vibhāvane |
gaccha dūraṃ yāntu sarve nātrāveśo bhaviṣyati ||79||
evaṃ vadanto dūtāśca jagṛhurbhujameva ca |
dūraṃ niṣkāsayāmāsurhariprathaṃ tathāparān ||3.30.80 ||
hariprathastadovāca mṛtiṃ yātu nṛpo hi vaḥ |
evamukte manustatra kṣaṇe mamāra jīvataḥ ||81||
vyasuḥ śavo’bhavacchīghraṃ papāta bhuvi padmaje |
prasāritakarapādaḥ prākrośan cogravegataḥ |||82||
hāhākārastadā jātaścākṛtyaṃ samajāyata |
dūtāstūrṇaṃ gatāḥ pārśve’sevayan pavanārpaṇaiḥ ||83||
pādasaṃvāhanairvāripānadānaistathāpi saḥ |
manuryayau vihāyaiva prāṇān dharmālayaṃ tadā ||84||
hāhākāro’bhavat sarvaprajāpāleṣu vai tadā |
dikpāleṣu samasteṣu deveṣu satyavāsiṣu ||85||
maharṣiṣu mahendrādau manurmṛto’bhavaddhi śuk |
atha sarve’jaśaṃbhvādyāścāyayuryatra sa mṛtaḥ ||86||
jīvanārthaṃ tadā sarve cakruścārādhanaṃ hareḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama padmaje ||87||
ahaṃ tatra samāyātastvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||88||
prārthitastairjīvanārthaṃ mayā te bodhitāstadā |
madbhaktasya kṛtaṃ nāhaṃ parāvartayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||89||
prasādanīyo bhakto me sa vai śreyo vidhāsyati |
tato bhaktaṃ surā nemuścārthayāmāsureva ca ||3.30.90||
jīvanaṃ ca kṣamāṃ cāpyarthayāmāsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
pūjayāmāsurevāpi sādhūn hariprathastadā ||91 ||
jñātvā māṃ paramātmānaṃ natvābhyarcya śavopari |
jalaṃ cikṣepa tāvadvai manuḥ prāṇayuto’bhavat ||92||
uttasthau ca hariṃ māṃ sa tuṣṭāva sampupūja ca |
sādhūnnatvā kṣamāṃ labdhvā yayau naijaṃ padaṃ punaḥ ||93||
sādhubhiścārthitaścāhaṃ hariprathasya mandire |
nyavasaṃ sarvadā lakṣmi sākaṃ tvayā satāṃ gṛhe ||94||
anādiśrībhaktanārāyaṇanāmnā svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
tvaṃ tadā śrīkuṃbhikāśrīritikhyātiṃ gatābhavaḥ ||95||
vedmyahaṃ sarvamevaitanmanonāśaṃ ca jīvanam |
smara sarvaṃ viṣṇupadītaṭādikaṃ satījanān ||96||
caturyugaṃ pūrṇameva nyavasaṃ sādhubhiḥ saha |
anye’pi ca tato jātāḥ sampradāyāstadā mama ||97||
anye’vatārāḥ saṃbhūtā lokarakṣaṇahetave |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||98||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvatsare hariprathabhaktasya śāpena mṛtasya varṇiśālamanorujjīvanārtham anādiśrībhaktanārāyaṇasya kuṃbhikāśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||

<3.31>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi mama prākaṭyaśobhanām |
saptatriṃśe’ṇḍajākhye vatsare vai vedhasaḥ purā || 1 ||
ekonanavatikalpe ṣaṣṭhe manau samudbhavām |
ṛṣirnāmnājahārito babhūva tāpaso mahān || 2 ||
vedavijñaḥ sādhudharmaścaikalo’pi vane vasan |
adhyāpayati viprādīn satkaroti samāgatān || 3 ||
atithīnarcayatyanyān dadātyebhyaḥ samāśrayam |
āśrame parṇaśālāyāṃ vasati vṛkṣamaṇḍale || 4 ||
phalakandadalapatramūlāḍhyān pādapān sa ca |
vṛttyarthaṃ jalamādattvā poṣayatyapi sarvadā || 5 ||
devānāṃ ca satāṃ cābhyāgatānāṃ svāgatādikam |
karoti phalamūlādyaiḥ pakvairmiṣṭairniveditaiḥ || 6 ||
atha rājā sainyayukto vidravādhipatistadā |
yātrārthamabhigacchan vai mārgeṇāśramamāyayau || 7 ||
viśrāntiṃ prāpa madhyāhne na ca jānāti tamṛṣim |
samarthaṃ cāśramavāsaṃ matvā kiṃcid vanecaram || 8 ||
rājā neme na vipraṃ taṃ sādhuṃ sādhusvabhāvakam |
pratyutāsya drumastambādiṣūṣṭrān kariṇo vṛṣān || 9 ||
turaṃgamān mumocaite bhakṣayāmāsureva ca |
bhañjayāmāsurāmūlānnāśayāmāsurityapi || 3.31.10 ||
puṣpitān phalitān vṛkṣān ṛṣirdṛṣṭvāvadan nṛpam |
mā rājan mama vṛkṣāṇāṃ nāśaṃ vidhehi mūlataḥ || 1 1||
niṣkāsaya paśūn dūre pārśve’raṇye drumānvite |
rājovāca vanaṃ me’sti sarvaṃ rājño bhavatyapi || 12||
paśavo me kṣudhāvyāptā bhakṣayiṣyanti vai drumān |
yāhi tvaṃ dūrataścāsmāt sthānādvanecaro’si yat || 13||
ṛṣirgarviṣṭhanṛpaterdaṇḍaṃ vyacintayad drutam |
jalamādāya haste ca śaśāpa bhava ghoṭakaḥ || 14||
tūrṇaṃ rājābhavattatra turaṃgamo’tiśobhanaḥ |
sainyaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpa sarvaṃ prārthayāmāsa tamṛṣim || 15||
tasya rājño vimokṣārthaṃ rājñī cāpyārthayanmuhuḥ |
ṛṣistasyai tadā prāha patiste’śvo’yamuttare || 16||
kāle’śvamedhayajñe tvatputraniṣpādite punaḥ |
snātvā nārāyaṇayogādavabhṛthe nṛpo naraḥ || 17||
bhaviṣyati na sandehaścedānīṃ yātu vai gṛham |
ityuktā svapatiṃ cāśvaṃ nītvā sā svagṛhaṃ yayau || 18||
sasainyā sā gṛhaṃ gatvārādhayatparameśvaram |
rājñyā yaśovarākhyāyāḥ putro dharmadharābhidhaḥ || 39||
piturvarmadharākhyasya mokṣārthaṃ yajñamārabhat |
dīkṣitaḥ sañcayāmāsa yajñīyaṃ vastujātakam ||3.31.20||
śuddhapṛthvyāṃ catuṣprānte vājimedhīyamaṇḍape|
yajñakārye vartamāne guruṇā devasatriṇā ||21||
sarvasyāptyai sarvajityai sarvaśāpavichittaye |
sarvapāpopaśāntyai ca hūyamāne’nale ghṛte ||22||
devāḥ sākṣāt samāyam̐śca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
anye devāścāyayurvai bhāgadheyādhikāriṇaḥ ||23||
devasatrī gururvipro’pūjayattaṃ turaṃgamam |
pūrvabhāge kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ paścārdhe śvetarūpiṇam ||24||
lalāṭe śakaṭākārapuṇḍrayutaṃ śubhākṛtim |
prāgasakṛtprapāyitasomarasāśvayugmajam ||25||
jātamātraṃ prapāyitasomarasaṃ ca vardhitam |
caitryāṃ sāṃgrahaṇīṣṭikṛd vaiśākhyāṃ ca nṛpastataḥ ||26||
prajāpatidevatākayāgakṛcca tataḥ param |
amāvasyeṣṭikṛccāpi kāritavapanastathā ||27||
dhṛtanūtnāmbaro maunī kṛtāgnihotrasatkriyaḥ |
pare’hni maṇḍape gatvā kṛtaikādaśakāhutiḥ ||28||
brahmaudanaṃ ca ṛtvigbhyaścāśayitvā sukalpya tān |
yajñīyāśvaṃ yajamānaḥ śvānaṃ ca caturakṣakam ||29||
taḍāgādijale nītvā sartvik tau samaprokṣayat |
adhvaryuścāprokṣayacca śvānamutsṛjya vai tataḥ ||3.31.30 ||
aśvaṃ cāvāsṛjat pṛthvyāṃ bhramaṇārtha nṛpaḥ svayam |
rakṣakairdhanvibhiḥ śūraiścatuḥśatairyutaṃ tataḥ || 3 1||
nṛpaḥ pratyahamevāpi viṣṇukramaṇasaṃjñakān |
homān sāyaṃ ca prātaśca kurvan vīṇāpragāthinau ||32||
brahmakṣatrau samāhūya gāyayatyeva vai yaśaḥ |
pāriplavaṃ śṛṇotyeva pratīkṣate’śvakāgamam ||33||
āśvapadikamārgeṣu yogyahomānakārayat |
mukhyaṃ dantān hanūṃ coru pādau liṃgaṃ ca vājinaḥ ||34||
saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cāpyakārayan nṛpatiḥ svayam |
gamanaṃ dhāvanaṃ cākrandanaṃ heṣaṇamityapi ||35||
śayanaṃ cāpyavaghrāṇaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ vājino guṇān |
saṃsmṛtya devatīkṛtya tebhyo homān dadau nṛpaḥ ||36||
atha kṛtvā vijayaṃ cāgatamaśvaṃ tu pāvanam |
prapūjyāsthāpayat sthāne sutyākamakārayannṛpaḥ ||37||
sutyātraye dvitīye’hni codgātuḥ sthānake’śvakam |
udgātāraṃ vyadhād rājā vaḍavābhiḥ samanvitam ||38||
hreṣāṃ cakāra turagaścodgīthaḥ sa vyajāyata |
akhātayattato yūpānekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakām ||39||
madhye cottaradakṣiṇakoṇayoḥ suvyavasthitān |
pūrve’gniṣṭhe turagaṃ taṃ babandha rājjudālaje ||3.31.40||
yūpe’sya pārśvayordevadārujau dvau ca yūpakau |
tatpārśvayostrayastrayo bilvavṛkṣavinirmitāḥ ||4 1 ||
tatpārśvayostrayastrayaḥ khādirāstatprapārśvayoḥ |
pālāśāśca trayastrayo yūpāstān samapūjayat ||42||
aśvaṃ raśanayāveṣṭya trayodaśa paśūn parān |
raśanāyāṃ rajjubandhairabandhayacca pārthivaḥ || 43 ||
aśvalalāṭe cāgneyaṃ paścabhāge tu pauṣṇakam |
uparyaindrāpauṣṇapaśumabandhayacca pārthivaḥ ||44||
bāhvorājñeyakau kṛṣṇagrīvau cābandhayannṛpaḥ |
tvāṣṭrau sakthnoḥ śvetapṛṣṭhau bārhaspatyau tu pārśvayoḥ || 45||
śvetavarṇodaraṃ dhātṛdaivaṃ cādho hyabandhayat |
pucche śvetamajaṃ cāpyabandhayat pārthivastataḥ ||46 ||
kṛṣṇavarṇamajaṃ sauryaṃ dakṣapārśve’pyabandhayat |
yāmyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāmapārśve’bandhayaccaivameva saḥ ||47||
grāmyān śatatrayaṃ navacatvāriṃśad babandha saḥ |
āraṇyakān śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ cāpi babandha saḥ ||48 ||
ajādayo grāmyavācyā āraṇyāḥ śvāpadādayaḥ |
tadupākaraṇaṃ cakre paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā ||49||
namaskṛtya paśūn sarvān saṃkalpya devatārthakān |
divyānpūjyānapasāryāvāsṛjattānpaśūnnṛpaḥ | |3.31.5 0 ||
aśvanāmnā sukuṣmāṇḍaṃ dhṛtvā ghṛtāktakambale |
kṛtvā prākśirasaṃ codakpādaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ vyadhāt ||5 1 ||
rājñyaḥ patnyo grāmyaśabdairgarhāṃ vyadhustataḥ param |
phalagarbhavapāhomān ṣaṭ prajāpataye dadau ||52||
viṣṇukramānakrāmacca kuṣmāṇḍānyaparāṇi ca |
paśusthānāni saṃjñapya homān sarvānakārayat ||53 ||
ājyādinā tisra āhutīśca hutvā tataḥ param |
patnīsaṃyājāntakarmānuṣṭhāya vyaramannṛpaḥ || 54||
sutyādine tṛtīye ca kṛtvā saumikakarma ca |
prājāpatyān paśūnekādaśa kuṣmāṇḍarūpiṇaḥ ||55||
hutvā karmāṇyanuṣṭhāyāvabhṛthaṃ pracakāra ha |
piṃgākṣaśvetakuṣṭhasya puruṣasya tu mūrdhani ||56 ||
homatrayaṃ pradatvā cādadat śatasuvarṇakam |
kṛtvā traidhātavīyeṣṭim āsamvatsarameva ha ||57||
tattadṛtuphalaiḥ rājāyajaccāśvaṃ prapūjayan |
daivāśvaṃ devavanmene rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ||58 ||
vatsarānte lakṣayatīn sādhūn sanyāsinastathā |
satīḥ sādhvīstathā viprān bālān vidyārthinastathā ||59 ||
vidyārthinīrbhikṣukīśca bhojayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ |
āvarṣaṃ nityahomānte dadau dānāni bhāvataḥ ||3.31.60||
pratīkṣate kadā cāśvarūpaḥ pitā manuṣyatām |
gacchediti vicārastho nidrāṃ yayau nṛpo niśi ||61||
vatsarānte yajñaparihāre rātrau narāyaṇam |
dadarśa divyarūpaṃ cācyutaṃ mukuṭamaṇḍitam ||62||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam |
sarvaiśvaryādisampūrṇaṃ nyūnaṣoḍaśavatsaram ||63||
ācaturdaśahāyanyā tvayā lakṣmyā virājitam |
prasannānanayā satyā tadā saubhāgyaśobhayā ||64||
nidrāyāmeva tuṣṭāva śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam |
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ cāśvarūpaścāśvamedhastvameva ca ||65||
tvaṃ rājā tvaṃ rājyapālastvaṃ rājeśvara eva ca |

tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprabhuḥ śrīmatpuruṣottama sarvarāṭ ||68||

śāpajanyaṃ drutaṃ nārāyaṇa nāśaya keśava ||3.31.70||
evaṃ tuṣṭāva māṃ rājā tadā so’bhihito mayā |

anarpito’śvamedhaśca mayi cārpaṇavarjitaḥ ||72|||
tvadicchāpūrako naiva vartate’dya narādhipa |
tasmātpunastvaśvayajñaṃ kuru pūjaya māṃ punaḥ ||73||
sarvatra sarvakāryeṣu tataste janako naraḥ |
mānuṣatāṃ punaścāpi sameṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||74||
darśanaṃ me punarbhāvi sarvaṃ yogyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ prāptastvayāhaṃ śrīnarāyaṇi ||75||

punaścakre’śvamedhaṃ sa vidhinā māṃ prapūjayan ||77||
avabhṛthe punaścāhaṃ prāpto divyasvarūpavān |
tvayā sākaṃ tadā lakṣmi snātvā vāri ca pāvanam ||78||

pūrvarūpaṃ rājarūpaṃ prāptavān drutameva ha |
sāśrurjātismaro māṃ sa tuṣṭāva bahugadgadaḥ ||3.31.80||
yaśovarābhidhā rājñī śri te satkāramācarat |
devasatrī gurustasyāḥ pupūja māṃ pareśvaram |8 1||
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ prārthayāmāsa vai punaḥ |
ajahāritavacanādbhagavan samupāgataḥ ||82||
śāpamuktyai nṛpasyāsya vasātra bhagavan sadā |
tathāstvevaṃ mayoktaśca devasatrī tapodhanaḥ ||83 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīmedhanārāyaṇanāmnā sthiro’bhavam ||84||
tvayā medhāvatīlakṣmyā sākaṃ vidravakhaṇḍake |
tataḥ pṛthvyāṃ cāśvamedhā yajñā vai bahavo’bhavan ||85||
uccāvacā makhā yathāśaktyākurvan narādhipāḥ |
vinā yuddhaṃ divyamaśvaṃ prapūjya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||86||
vartamānasya me bhūmau pūjitasyāśvamedhake |
utsṛṣṭaṃ turagaṃ kecinnābadhnan mama bhītitaḥ ||87||
