pakṣe gṛhe makhe cāste pratyakṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||88||
tasya yajñe yuddhavighnaṃ kartavyaṃ nahi sarvathā |
yuddhena vijayaṃ kaścinnaiva yāsyati nirṇayaḥ ||89||
ityevaṃ tatra kalpe vai yajñā hiṃsāvivarjitāḥ |
daivapāśavabhoktāro’bhavan mattoṣakāriṇaḥ || 3.31.90||
ajahāritavipraśca sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
śrutvā māṃ tvāyayau śīghraṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||9 1 ||
rājagṛhaṃ ca rājānaṃ militvā māṃ tataḥ param |
sādhurūpo mama bhakto matsevāyāṃ vyarājata ||92||
pradadau sa mayājñapto vaiṣṇavān śreyase manūn |
prajābhyo bodhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa macchritān || 93 ||
varmadharo’pi vairāgyāt prāpya dīkṣāṃ tu sādhavīm |
upādideśa lokebhyaḥ pratyakṣopāsanāṃ hi me ||94||
bheje māṃ satataṃ sādhuḥ sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
rājñī yaśovarā cāpi sādhvīdīkṣāmavāpya mām ||95||
bheje śriyā yutaṃ nityaṃ sādhvīdharmaparāyaṇā |
nārībhyaḥ pradadau sā tu dīkṣāṃ me vaiṣṇavīṃ satīm ||96||
bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa kārayāmāsa vaiṣṇavīḥ |
sādhvīrbrahmasvarūpasthā brahmaśīlaprapālikāḥ || 97||
ākalpāntaṃ sthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi |
smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvaṃ medhāvatīṃ nijām ||98||
evamanye’vatārā me jātāstato’pyanekaśaḥ |
jānāmyahaṃ tu tānsarvān dharmakāryaparāyaṇān || 99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpyāghāni nirdhūya sarvathā || 3.31.10 0||
sakāmaśced bahūn svargān bhuktvā ciraṃ tataḥ param |
yāyād brahmaparaṃ dhāma bhaktyā me satataṃ priyam || 10 1||
niṣkāmasya tu bhaktasya bhaktirme jāyate drutam |
sarvasaukhyaiḥ susantuṣṭo yāti matparamaṃ padam || 1 02||
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ sarvavratotthaṃ ca phalaṃ tathā |
sarvasevāphalaṃ cāpi prāpnuyāt śravaṇājjanum || 103 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ saptatriṃśe vatsare’jahāritaśāpenāśvībhūtasya varmadharanṛpasya mokṣārthaṃ tatputrakṛtāśvamedhe’nādiśrīmedhanārāyaṇasya medhāvatīśriyā sahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||

<3.32>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param |
vedhaso’ṣṭātriṃśavarṣe kalpe ṣaṣṭe’ṣṭame manau || 1 ||
brahmadharmasamutpanno’suro’riṣṭo’nalādanaḥ |
vavṛdhe jātamātraḥ sa bubhukṣito’titaijasaḥ || 2 ||
anyatejāṃsi yaddehe layaṃ yānti samantataḥ |
agnīn sarvān bhakṣayati nānyaṃ bhuṃkte hi janmataḥ || 3 ||
jalaṃ pṛthvīṃ na grasate grasate’nalamātrakam |
yatra yatrānalāḥ santi vahnayastatra tatra saḥ || 4 ||
gatvā gatvā prasahyāgniṃ dhṛtvā dhṛtvātti sarvaśaḥ |
brahmaṇo mānasaṃ putraṃ mahāgniṃ sa tvabhakṣayat || 5 ||
tattrisutān pāvakaṃ ca pavamānaṃ śuciṃ tathā |
abhakṣayattathā pāvakātmajaṃ saharakṣakam || 6 ||
pavamānātmajaṃ kavyavāhanaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat |
śucyātmajaṃ havyavāhaṃ dhṛtvāsuro’pyabhakṣayat || 7 ||
agneścaturthaṃ putraṃ brahmaudanāgnimabhakṣayat |
brahmaudanāgniputraṃ ca bharataṃ cāpyabhakṣayat || 8 ||
tathā bharataputraṃ ca vaiśvānaramabhakṣayat |
athāgneḥ pañcamaṃ putramatharvāṇamabhakṣayat || 9 ||
atharvaputrānamṛtaṃ dadhyaṅgamaṅgiraṃ tathā |
nirmathya ceti caturo’pyabhakṣayat mahāsuraḥ | | 3.32.10 ||
nirmathyasya sutaṃ gārhapatyaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat |
gārhapatyasutau śaṃsyaṃ śukaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat | | 11 | |
śaṃsyasutānāvasathyaṃ sabhyaṃ cāhavanīyakam |
abhakṣayanmahāriṣṭānalādo nāma cāsuraḥ || 12 ||
tathā śaṃsyasutānanyān nadīṣu jātasaṃbhavān |
dhiṣṇisaṃjñānapi putrānabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 13 ||
ṛtuṃ pravāhaṇaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ samrājaṃ kṛśānukam |
pāriṣadaṃ pratalkaṃ ca nabhasaṃ ca vasuṃ tathā || 1 4||
ajaikapādṃ cāhirbudhnaṃ ca gṛhapatiṃ tathā |
abhakṣayacca hotrīyaṃ śāntapracetasaṃ tathā || 15||
viśvadevaṃ tathāvakṣumacchāvākamabhakṣayat |
uśīraṃ ca kaviṃ potamāvārimapyabhakṣayat || 1 6||
bhāriṃ naiṣṭhīyasaṃ cāpi vyaratnimapyabhakṣayat |
mārjālīyamavatphūrjamabjaṃ ca jāṭharaṃ tathā || 17 ||
jaṭharasya sutaṃ manyumantaṃ tathā hyabhakṣayat |
savarttakaṃ manyumajjaṃ vāḍavaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat || 18 ||
vāḍavotthaṃ saharakṣaṃ kṣāmaṃ ca saharakṣajam |
kṣāmātmajaṃ ca kravyādaṃ hyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 1 9||
śuceḥ putramāraṇeyaṃ cāparaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat |
āraṇeyasutaṃ cāyuṃ cāyujaṃ mahimānakam || 3.32.20 ||
mahimānasutaṃ cāpi savanaṃ cāpyabhakṣayat |
savanotthaṃ cādbhutaṃ ca vividhiṃ cādbhutātmajam || 21 ||
vividhijaṃ tathārkaṃ cāpyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ |
arkasutān vājasṛgamanīkavantamityapi || 22 ||
yaṣṭikṛtaṃ rakṣohaṃ ca surabhiṃ ca vasuṃ tathā |
annādaṃ rukmarājaṃ cāpyabhakṣayanmahāsuraḥ || 23 ||
evamanyān śmaśānasthān mahāsuro’pyabhakṣayat |
evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri vai jagaccāgnivivarjitam || 54||
dāhaśūnyaṃ pākaśūnyaṃ himavat saṃvyajāyata |
mṛtyūnmukhaṃ samastaṃ vai vīkṣya pṛthvī śucānvitā || 25||
yayau satyālayaṃ tatra brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā |
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyānalarakṣārthameva sā || 26 ||
analādavināśārthaṃ cakre vai prārthanāṃ muhuḥ |
brahmā sasmāra manasā māṃ tadā puruṣottamam || 27 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim || 28||
śrupvāhaṃ prārthanāṃ lakṣmi pratyakṣo brahmaṇo’bhavam |
tvayā sākaṃ tadā padme brahmā pupūja māṃ tathā ||29||
tvāṃ pupūja pṛthivī sārthayad rakṣārthamityatha |
asurasya vināśārthaṃ tadā tvaṃ tu madājñayā ||3.32.30||
pṛthvīputrī cābhavaśca pārthivīśrīḥ sukanyakā |
tvāṃ nītvā sā yayau tūrṇaṃ bhūlokaṃ vimalāśayā ||3 1||
ahaṃ vahneḥ svarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā jvālātmako’bhavam |
analādo’suro māṃ saṃvīkṣya merau samādravat ||32||
bhakṣaṇārthaṃ cāyayau prādravaṃ cāhaṃ bhuvaṃ prati |
yatra tvaṃ bhūsahitā ca pratīkṣase mamāgamam ||33||
bhānumatparvatasyaiva gahvare tatra cāgamam |
paśyantyāśca tava cāpi pṛthvyāstatra mahāsuraḥ ||34||
agilanmāṃ mahājvālāmayāgniṃ parameśvaram |
ahamantargato bhūtvādahaṃ taṃ vai mahāsuram ||35||
bhasmībhūtaṃ ca taṃ kṛtvā vahnīnajīvayaṃ punaḥ |
sarve’gnayastadā jīvasahitāścetanāḥ śubhāḥ ||36||
yathāpūrvamabhavam̐ste’stuvanmāṃ cāpyapūjayan |
anādiśrīvahninārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||37||
mayājñaptā vahnayaste svasvasthāneṣu vai drutam |
pravṛttāḥ svasvakāryeṣu saśaktāśca samanvitāḥ ||38||
atha jaganti vai lokāḥ prajāśca sāgnayo’bhavan |
himabhāvo gatasteṣāṃ sajīvā hyabhavan punaḥ || 39||
sarve jñātvā mama tatra prākaṭyaṃ tu surādayaḥ |
āyayuḥ pūjanārthaṃ te vyomavṛṣṭistato’bhavat ||3.32.40||
candanānāṃ kusumānāṃ jayaśabdastathābhavan |
mahotsavaḥ kṛtastatra sarvadevādibhirmama ||41 ||
pṛthvyā tvaṃ cārpitā mahyaṃ pārthivīśrīrvivāhitā |
ākalpāntaṃ sthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ narāyaṇi ||42||
prākaṭyaṃ me kathitaṃ te lakṣmi smara sukhapradam |
anye’vatārā bahavastadā varṣe’bhavanmama ||43||
jānāmyetān samastān vai nānyo jānāti kaścana |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate ||44||
vahnerupadravo na syād rogāḥ syurna kadācana |
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo nityaṃ labhedevātra pāṭhakaḥ ||45||
athānyaccāpi me lakṣmi prākaṭyaṃ ca tataḥ param |
kathayāmi samāsena mahāpuṇyapradaṃ śubham ||46||
navatriṃśe vedhasaśca nāgavarṣe purābhavat |
ṣaṣṭhakalpe ṣaṣṭhamanau ilodaro mahāsuraḥ ||47||
rasādaḥ sarvatattvānāṃ rasabhakṣaka ulbaṇaḥ |
rāhoḥ putro’surakarmā svargabhūrasabhakṣakaḥ ||48||
sa hi pṛthvyāṃ samāgatya tapastepe’tidāruṇam |
sahasravatsarān mero tutoṣa śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||49||
āyayau sannidhau tasyovāca vṛṇu varaṃ tataḥ |
asuraḥ saṃyayāce’pi sarvarasaprabhakṣitām ||3.32.50 ||
tathāstviti haraḥ proktvā tirobabhūva satvaram |
asuraḥ sa sadā pārthivān rasān salilasthitān ||51 ||
bhuṃkte yatheṣṭaṃ satataṃ puṣṭimeti samantataḥ |
tatastṛptaḥ punarvarṣasahasrordhvaṃ tapaḥ param ||52||
cakre brahmāṇamuddiśyāvadhyabhāvārthameva saḥ |
vāyvāhāraṃ śuṣkagātraṃ vīkṣya brahmā hyupāyayau ||53||
uvāca prokṣya salilaiḥ sajīvīkṛtya taṃ tadā |
varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ me prasanno’smi mahāsura ||54||
so’pi netre samunmilyovācājeyatvamuttamam |
caturdaśabhuvāṃ vāsairnāhaṃ jayyo bhavāmi ha ||55||
tathāstviti brahmavākyaṃ prāptavān sa mahāsuraḥ |
brahmāpyadṛśyatāṃ prāpya yayau tato mahāsuraḥ ||56||
bubhuje bahuśo bhogānnirbhayo daivamānuṣān |
athāpi cintayāmāsa maraṇaṃ me tu no bhavet ||57||
tatastapaḥ punaḥ kāryaṃ merau varṣasahasrakam |
vicāryetthaṃ cakārāpi viṣṇumuddiśya vai tapaḥ ||58||
viṣṇurvarṣasahasrānte tvāyayau devanoditaḥ |
prāha taṃ te kimiṣṭaṃ vai vṛṇu viṣṇurahaṃ tviha ||59||
varapradānakāryāya samāyāto’smi mā ciram |
asuraḥ prāha yadyevaṃ maraṇaṃ me na vai bhavet ||3.32.60 ||
tathā vṛṇomi viṣṇoste varadānaṃ mayepsitam |
viṣṇuḥ prāha janiryasya mṛtistasya dhruvāsura ||6 1 ||
pituste rāhusaṃjñasya maraṇaṃ dhruvameva ha |
tatpituḥ kaśyapasyāpi tatpituścāpi vai dhruvam ||62||
amṛtyuḥ kasyacinnāsti vinā śrīpuruṣottamam |
ātmā nityaḥ karmabhoktā vasati dehapañjare ||63||
sa ca dehādviniryāto mṛta ityupacaryate |
dehaḥ ṣāṭkauśikaścāsti kośā bhūtādisaṃbhavāḥ ||64||
bhūtānāṃ pariṇāmāśca jāyante nityameva ha |
pariṇāmā sadānityāstato’nityaṃ hi varṣma ca ||65||
anityasya na nityatvaṃ varamanyaṃ vṛṇu dhruvam |
rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca pātālaṃ ciraṃjīvitvamityapi ||66||
dadāmi te’sura dravyaṃ svarṇarūpyādi bhūtalam |
sauryaṃ cāndraṃ ca māhendraṃ padaṃ kauberamityapi ||67||
vṛṇu cānyatpadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mā ciraṃ pradadāmi yat |
śrutvaivamāha sarvādo mā mṛtyurme bhavediha ||68||
tridevatatsṛṣṭijebhyaśceti vṛṇomi dehi me |
tathāstviti hariḥ prāhādṛśyatāṃ sa drutaṃ yayau ||69||
athāsurastapastyaktvā mṛtyubhīvarjitastathā |
devadaityamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhogān bhuṃkte prasahya saḥ ||3.32.70||
brahmaṇaścāpi viṣṇoḥ saḥ śivasyāpi vibhūtikāḥ |
sarvā āhṛtya ca balād bhuṃkte varabalaidhitaḥ ||71 ||
hyekadā sa yayau jitvā devān kailāsamityapi |
śaṃkaraṃ prāha yuddhaṃ me kailāsaṃ vā pradehi me ||72||
śaṃbhuḥ prāhārdhamevaitat kailāsaṃ tava sarvathā |
gṛhāṇeti tadā so’pi cārdhaṃ prāpya mumoda ha ||73||
athāyayau satyalokaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prāha me tava |
padaṃ brahman hi sarvasvaṃ dehi vā yuddhameva vā ||74||
brahmā prāha gṛhāṇedaṃ pārameṣṭhyapadārdhakam |
labdhvā so’pi prasanno’bhūd yayau viṣṇuṃ payodadhim ||75||
prāha me śvetabhūdvīpaṃ dehi viṣṇo saroṣakam |
yadvā yuddhaṃ ca me dehi kuru yatte hi rocate ||76||
viṣṇuḥ prāha tu te dattaṃ kṣīrābdhyardhapadaṃ sadā |
labdhvāsuraḥ prasannaśca yayau meruṃ nijālayam ||77||
atheyeṣa śivāṃ śrīṃ ca brāhmīṃ devīrmahāsuraḥ |
arthayāmāsa tā yāvat tāvaddevā vināśane ||78||
matiṃ cakruścāsurasya kautukaṃ ca vyadhurdrutam |
piśācinītrayaṃ tattadrūpadharaṃ haraḥ svayam ||79||
prāhiṇot taṃ tata ilodaro jaharṣa mūḍhadhīḥ |
piśācinyo vrataṃ cakruḥ sarvarasaprabhakṣaṇam ||3.32.80||
māsamātraṃ vrataṃ sarvarasabhakṣaṇanāmakam |
kṛtvā tato vrate pūrṇe bhaviṣyāmaḥ prasevane ||81 ||
upasthitā iti śrutvā jñātvā ca mumude’suraḥ |
samartho’yaṃ sarvarasasañcaye vartate yataḥ ||82||
pārthivān vai sarvarasān jalīyānapi sarvaśaḥ |
pākāpākakṛtān sarvānānayāmāsa satvaram ||83||
dadau tābhyastrivargābhyaḥ piśācinībhya eva ca |
bhojayāmāsa bahudhā pāyayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||84||
pṛthvī rasavihīnā vai jalaṃ rasavihīnakam |
tattvāni yāni rasyāni tānyarasāni cābhavan ||85||
rasaśūnyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ cāmṛtamityapi |
havyaṃ kavyaṃ cāmiṣādi sarvaṃ rasavihīnakam ||86||
jātaṃ tena samastaṃ cābhojyaṃ cāpeyamityapi |
kleśamāptāḥ prajāḥ sarvā devāsurarṣimānavāḥ ||87||
parameśārpaṇe cāpi naivedye rasavarjitā |
sarvā jātā tataśceśā nādanti bhojanaṃ kharam ||88||
te’tha sarve militvā māmārādhayan suduḥkhitāḥ |
ilodarasya nāśārthaṃ tuṣṭuvurbahudhā tathā ||89||
śrutvāhaṃ ca parabrahma śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||3.32.90 ||
tvayā sākaṃ tvakṣarādvai dhāmno lakṣmi svayaṃ hariḥ |
āyayau devakoṭīnāmagre sākṣād babhūva ha ||9 1 ||
pūjitaścārthitaścāpi nivedito’surārdane |
gato’haṃ merubhūbhāge yatrāsuraḥ pramodate ||92||
rasarūpo’bhavaṃ tatra hrado bhūtvā vyavasthitaḥ |
miṣṭaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaścānandadaḥ sukhadaḥ śubhaḥ ||93||
ujjvalaḥ śvetapīyūṣarūpaśca mādako mṛduḥ |
pravāharūpaścāpūrṇo hrado’bhavaṃ tadantike ||94||
piśācinyastisra eva vīkṣya rasottamaṃ hradam |
kathayāmāsurevainaṃ so’pi tūrṇaṃ samāyayau ||95||
papau rasaṃ tathā tāśca pāyayāmāsa sotsavaḥ |
pāne tṛptirna codgāro jāyate pāti vai muhuḥ ||96||
bhānaṃ tyaktvā papau cāti papāvākaṇṭhameva tu |
raso’haṃ na bhamau tvasyodare so’pi vyavardhata ||97||
pītvā pītvākṣayaṃ sarvaṃ rasaṃ so’bhūnmahodaraḥ |
yāvatī mahimāsiddhistatastāvadabhūnmahān ||98||
mānottaraṃ gataścāpi papau rasaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
udaraṃ tasya vai tyaktvā śaktiṃ vai dhāraṇātmikām ||99||
madhyanābhipradeśācca pāṭitaṃ hṛdayāvadhim |
jaghanaṃ pāṭitaṃ cāpi nirgato’haṃ rasātmakaḥ ||3.32.1 00 ||
bahirevodarāttasya papāta sa mamāra ca |
anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tvayā saha || 101 ||
anādiśrīrasalakṣmyā sākaṃ tatrābhavaṃ sthitaḥ |
piśācinyaḥ prasannāśca pūjayitvā hariṃ tu mām || 10 2||
yayuḥ kailāsamevaitāḥ devādyāstatra cāyayuḥ |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca tuṣṭuvurmāṃ rasātmakam || 1 03||
anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
sarvadā ca nivāsārthamarthayāmāsurīśvarāḥ || 1 04||
ahaṃ sadāvasaṃ pṛthvyāṃ rasapuṣṭipravṛddhaye |
manvantaraikamātraṃ mūrtimānabhavaṃ tadā || 1 05||
tato rasātmako bhūtvākalpaṃ sthito’bhavaṃ priye |
smara lakṣmi mama tadvai prākaṭyaṃ tadrasātmakam || 1 06||
atha devā yayuḥ sarve naijān vāsān divādiṣu |
anye tadāvatārā me’bhavam̐ścāpi sahasraśaḥ || 1 07||
avatārī parabrahma rasanārāyaṇo’bhavam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭātriṃśe varṣe analādamahāsuravināśārtham anādiśrīvahninārāyaṇasya pārthivīśriyāsahitasya, tathā navatriṃśe vatsare ilodarasya rasādasya mahāsurasya vināśārtham anādiśrīrasanārāyaṇasya śrīrasalakṣmyā sahitasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||

<3.33>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścāpi prākaṭyaṃ mama vacmi te |
vedhaso vatsare catvāriṃśe kalpe’ṣṭame tathā || 1 ||
manau ca daśame prāntadvāpare bhūtale’bhitaḥ |
kālabalena dharmasya nairbalye pāpidehiṣu || 2 ||
adharmasya bale vyāpte’surāṇāṃ balavardhane |
prajāstvāsan pīḍitā vai makhā ruddhāḥ samantataḥ || 3 ||
dānaṃ dayā damādyāśca sarvathā vilayaṃ gatāḥ |
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ dṛśyante naiva bhūtale || 58 ||
śaucaṃ tapo vrataṃ ceti naṣṭānyati prajāsu vai |
dṛśyate nopakāritvaṃ śīlaṃ naiva ca naiva ca || 5 ||
bādhante durbalān sarve baliścopabhuṃjate |
tatsmṛddhīste prasahyaivāpyapaharanti sarvaśaḥ || 6 ||
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ koṭayo bhuvi |
sarvatraivāvalokyante tīrthayātrā layaṃ gatā || 7 ||
maryādā naranārīṇāṃ rākṣasairhi vināśitā |
sarvavarṇāḥ svatantrāśca dharmanyāyavivarjitāḥ || 8 ||
devānāmarhaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sarvathaiva layaṃ gatam |
bālānāthātithīnāṃ ca pālanaṃ vilayaṃ gatam || 9 ||
nāstikyaṃ sarvakāryeṣu sarvadharmeṣu cābhavat |
vṛddhānāṃ cāvamānādi dhārmikāṇāṃ prapīḍanam || 3.33.1 0||
āsuraiḥ sarvathā loke kṛtaṃ tvabhakṣyabhakṣakaiḥ |
apeyapānakaiścāpyakāryairjugupsitairapi || 11 ||
nṛpāḥ sarve daityavaṃśā ācāryā daityavaṃśinaḥ |
guravo’pi daityavaṃśā sambabhūvuryadā kṣitau || 12||
daivaṃ paitryaṃ tathā svargyaṃ sarvaṃ layaṃ gataṃ drutam |
tadā devaiśca ṛṣibhirmānavairdharmamānasaiḥ || 13||
ārādhitaḥ svayaṃ śrīmatparameśvara eva ha |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 14||
jñānaviṣṇugṛhe putrasvarūpo’haṃ tadābhavam |
sudarśanena sahitaścakranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | | 15||
mātā me vedinī cāsīt tatkukṣeḥ prakaṭo’bhavam |
tadā tvaṃ mannideśena rājakanyābhavaḥ śubhā || 16||
sārvabhaumasya nṛpaterbrahmacitradharasya vai |
rājñyāḥ śobhālikānāmnyāḥ kukṣau sudhākṣiṇī tadā || 17||
sudhākṣyāste pitā cakre samrāṭ svayaṃvaraṃ tava |
mahotsavaṃ tatastatra rājāno’surapuṅgavāḥ || 18||
tvadāśayāyayuḥ sarve samrājaḥ khaṇḍagāstathā |
parakhaṇḍagatāścāpi vaimānikā balotkaṭāḥ || 1 9||
ahaṃ vaiśyo jñānaviṣṇoḥ sutaścakrasamanvitaḥ |
yayau svayaṃvare tatra rūpaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ || 3.33.20||
tvaṃ māṃ vilokya sarvāstān vihāya parameśvarī |
sabhāmadhye dadau mālāṃ mama kaṇṭhe’tiśobhanām || 21 ||
atha rājanyavargāste kruddhā yuddhārthamutthitāḥ |
mayā sudarśanenaivāyutabhūpā nipātitāḥ || 22||
sādhāraṇānāṃ saṃkhyā na daityāḥ sarve hatā mayā |
dānavā nihatāścāpyasurāḥ sarve nipānitāḥ || 23 ||
pitā te rakṣitastveko bhakto me so’bhavattataḥ |
rājyaṃ nijaṃ sudhākṣiṇyai dattavān putravarjitaḥ || 24||
mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sahasravatsaraṃ tataḥ |
dharmāḥ saṃsthāpitā loke prajāsu devapitṛjāḥ ||25||
maryādā dānayajñānāṃ sthāpitā ca punarmayā |
anādiśrīcakranārāyaṇena sarvajiṣṇunā || 26||
smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sāmrājyaṃ tava vai tadā |
jānāmyahaṃ hi tat sarvaṃ nānye jānanti kecana |||27|||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam |
anye’vatārāḥ śataśo dharmarakṣākarā mama ||28||
jātāstadānīṃ bahudhā devamānavasiddhajāḥ |
dharmarakṣākarā muktipradāstān padmaje smara ||29||
athāpi vedhasastvekacatvāriṃśe tu vatsare |
adhvarākhye tripañcāśatkalpe manau tu saptame || 3.33.30 ||
saptaṣaṣṭhitame cāpi kalau prākaṭyameva me |
abhavattacchṛṇu śri tvaṃ parabrahmaṇa eva ha | | 31 | |
kalerbale’tisaṃvyāpte jane mlecchamaye tathā |
ekākāre sarvaloke varṇāśramavivarjite | | 32 | |
vitastimātradehe ca pṛthvīvivaramandire |
tṛṇamūlādane loke daivapaitryavivarjite | | 33 | |
kuṭumbalope sarvatra svārthasambandhamātrake |
yatheṣṭayugale loke mama bhānavivarjite | | 34 | |
upadravādhike cālpasukhe cāśrayavarjite |
jāte ca satyadharmāṇāṃ sthāpanārthaṃ svayaṃ hariḥ | | 35 | |
prādurabhavaṃ bhūmau vai bhaktasya putratāṃ gataḥ |
nāmnā drāvaṇaviprasya caturbhujaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | | 36 ||
tvaṃ tadā brahmavarcasthā mama dehe sthitā sadā |
abhavo’dṛśyarūpā śrīrvijayākhyā mayā saha | | 37 | |
āsurāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ garuḍaḥ saṃsmṛto mayā |
ratho divyo gajāścāpi caturdantāḥ sitaprabhāḥ | | 38 | |
āyudhāni samastāni gadākhaṅgaśarāsayaḥ |
dhanuśśaktivajracakraprāśatomarakuntalāḥ | | 39 | |
astraśastradharaścāhaṃ tvayā vijayayā saha |
jaitraṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya gāruḍadhvajamūrdhvagam ||3.33.40 | |
hastivāhyaṃ vyomagaṃ ca yuyudhe’surakoṭibhiḥ |
nāśitāśca nṛpāḥ pūrvaṃ mlecchā daityeśvarā balāḥ | | 41 ||
dānaveśāścāsureśāstato mlecchaprajādikāḥ |
mayā ca rakṣitāstatra saṃgrāme śaraṇāgatāḥ | |42 | |
kṛtāste pāyayitvāmbho pādayorbrāhmaṇāḥ punaḥ |
niṣkāsitāśca te sarve matprākaṭyānalāntarāt | | 43 | |
pāvitāśca kṛtāḥ kāyākalpitā dvijakoṭayaḥ |
sthāpitāsteṣu sarveṣu dharmā me satyasaṃbhavāḥ | | 44 | |
mamāstitvabalenāpi bhūtāni sāttvikāni vai |
saṃbhūtāni samastāni narā nāryo’tisāttvikāḥ | | 45 | |
satyadharmaparāḥ sarve saṃbhūtā matprabhāvataḥ |
pavanānalavārbhūmivyomādyāḥ sattvatāṃ gatāḥ | |46 ||
vṛkṣavallītṛṇādyāśca rasapūrṇāstadābhavan |
viprāḥ kṛtā hi rājāno yaśāścāpi pravartitāḥ | | 47 ||
āstikyaṃ dānadharmāśca vivāhāśca pravartitāḥ |
sādhusādhvījanāścāpi santaḥ siddhāḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ | |48 ||
tiṣyo vināśitaścāpi satyaḥ saṃsthāpito mayā |
devāśca rakṣitā sarve ṛṣayaḥ sthāpitāḥ punaḥ | | 49 ||
mandirāṇi kāritāni homaśālā vidhāpitāḥ |
satyatretāyugakālamavasaṃ bhūtale tadā ||3.33.50||
smara lakṣmi tadā camatkāraṃ mama purātanam |
anādiśrīsatyanārāyaṇaṃ śrīvijayānvitam ||51||
parabrahma svayaṃ satyasthāpakaṃ cāvatāriṇam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |||22||
evamanye’pyavatārāstatra tatra sahasraśaḥ |
mama jātāstu tān sarvān jānāmyahaṃ na cetaraḥ ||53||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya satyadharmāśrito bhavet |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭaphalavān bhavet ||54||
athānyanmama divyaṃ ca prākaṭyaṃ kathayāmi te |
brahmaṇo dvācatvāriṃśābde hiraṇyābhidhānake ||55||
kalpe navatisaṃkhye cārambhe cādyamanostathā |
pṛthvyāṃ dvādaśakhaṇḍānāṃ vibhājakāstu parvatāḥ ||56||
sapakṣāśca svatantrāśca tathānye dvīpaparvatāḥ |
cetanāḥ sabalā mūrtāḥ sthānārthaṃ vādamādadhan ||57||
ahaṃ meroḥ sannidhāne nivatsyāmi na dūrataḥ |
ahaṃ cāha tathetyevamanyonyeṣāṃ vivādanam ||58||
abhavad balinastatra ye cāseste tu vai balāt |
iṣṭasthaleṣvavasam̐śca pare yātā manuṃ prati ||59||
svasvakaṣṭanivedārthaṃ manunāhūya bodhitāḥ |
tathāpi menire naiva baliṣṭhāste manorvacaḥ ||3.33.60||
athendrāya dadāvājñāṃ vajradharāya śikṣaṇam |
parvatevyaḥ pradātuṃ cānyathā daṇḍayituṃ nagān ||61||
indrastvāgatya bhūbhāge merau meroḥ samīpataḥ |
parvatān mūrtarūpām̐ścāhūya jagāda taddhitam | |62||
brahmaṇā nirmitā yūyaṃ pṛthvīsthairyasya hetave |
khaṇḍavibhāgakāryāya ratnanidhānahetave ||63||
prajārakṣaṇakāryāya khaṇḍaprākārahetave |
ye ye yatra niyuktāste tatra tatraiva sarvathā ||64||
nivasantu nānyathā vai hitaṃ me vacanaṃ yataḥ |
anyathā bhavatāṃ pakṣān śātayitvā balādaham |
vajreṇa sarvathā yuṣmān pātayiṣye yathāsthalam ||65||
ityevaṃ garvayuktaṃ vai śrutvendravākyamulbaṇāḥ |
parvatāstūrṇamevaite samutpeturvihāyasā |
sarve balino garviṣṭhāḥ svecchārūpadharāstadā ||66||
grahatulyā mahendrasyopari nipetureva ha |
indrastu marditastatra mṛtaprāyo babhūva ha ||67||
vajraṃ vajradharasyāpi naṣṭaṃ cūrṇaṃ babhūva ca |
indrabalaṃ hataṃ dīrghabhūbhṛdbhiścūrṇitaṃ tadā ||68||
kaccaritāḥ surādyāśca palāyanaṃ pracakrire |
bhūbhṛto vyomagāścāpi yuddhaṃ cakruḥ suraiḥ saha ||69||
pṛthvī bhāreṇa hīnā ca samataulyaṃ vihāya sā |
mahājalatalaṃ gantuṃ pārśvanimnā babhūva ha ||3.33.70 ||
athotpātā babhūvuśca grahāṇāmapi sarvataḥ |
vāyūnāmapi cāsthairyaṃ parvataiśca kṛtaṃ hyabhūt ||7 1 ||
gaganaṃ kampate sarvaṃ samaṇḍalaṃ laye yathā |
pṛthivyāḥ rakṣaṇaṃ sthairyaṃ parvatasthairyalambitam ||72||
pṛthvīsthairye tato meroḥ sthairyaṃ dhruvasya cāpi vai |
satyevaṃ svargalokānāṃ sthairyaṃ sukhaṃ bhavediti ||73 ||
vicārya sahasā brahmā rudro viṣṇuśca devatāḥ |
mahānto namrabhāvāśca sāntvanāyuktabodhinaḥ ||74||
bodhayāmāsurevaitān parvatān bahudhā tadā |
niyuktasthānavāsārthaṃ tathāpyete na menire ||75||
hiraṇyakaḥ kānakaśca rājato rātnakastathā |
māṇeyaśca vaiṣṇavaśca haimeyaśca digīśakaḥ ||76 ||
bhairavaśca mahendraśca tathodayanaparvataḥ |
āruṇaśca mahābhaśca lokālokaśca merukaḥ ||77||
evamanye mahāraudrā menire na tadā surāḥ |
parvatānāṃ mahākleśapraśamāya narāyaṇam ||78 ||
parameśaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim |
sasmarustūrṇamevāhaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||79 ||
parabrahma svayaṃ tatrājagāma tūrṇameva ha |
sudarśanaṃ dhṛtaṃ cakraṃ gadā pṛthvyāṃ dhṛtā mayā ||3.33.80 ||
yatra cordhvābhavat pṛthvī tatrāpekṣitavattataḥ |
samatolābhavat sā ca rakṣitāyudhabhārataḥ ||81 ||
parvatāṃśca samāhūya varadānena te tataḥ |
yojitāśca mayā lakṣmi mama vāsakṛtā hi te ||82||
ye mayokteṣu deśeṣu sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kṣitau |
tatra tatrāhamevāpi sthāsye śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||83 ||
tataste parvatāstūrṇaṃ mama vākyaṃ samāśritāḥ |
merumadhye ca parito lokāloko vidhāpitaḥ ||84||
catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāro lambā samudragāḥ kṛtāḥ|
hiraṇyako’gnikoṇe ca kānako nirṛte’kvake ||85||
rājataśca marutkoṇe ratnakaśceśakoṇake |
pūrve cottaradakṣāvāyatau māṇeyavaiṣṇavau ||86 ||
dakṣiṇe prākpaścalambau haimeyaśca digīśakaḥ |
paścime cottaradakṣau mairavaśca mahendrakaḥ ||87||
uttare cāruṇo mahābhaścāyatau niveśitau |
pūrvābdhau nihitaścāpyudayanaḥ sarvabhānvitaḥ ||88||
evamanye parvatāśca madhye madhye niveśitāḥ |
atha te prārthanāṃ cakruḥ pakṣanāśo hi no na vai ||89||
bhavediti mayoktaṃ ca sapakṣāḥ santu vai sthirāḥ |
yadyākāśe gatimanto bhaviṣyatha tadā hyayam || 3.33.9 0||
mahendro vajradhāreṇa śātayiṣyati pakṣakān |
tataste sthairyamāpuśca svasvasthāne yathāsukham ||9 1 ||
atha devādayaḥ sarve pūjayitvā ca māṃ yayuḥ |
nijalokān parvateṣu nivāsaṃ ca tvayā saha ||92||
vyadhāpayaṃ bahurūpadharo rakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ |
ākalpāntaṃ nyavasaṃ vai tvayā hiraṇyayā saha || 93 ||
anādiśrīhiraṇyaśrīnārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
vāgbaddho’haṃ parvateṣu nyavasaṃ bodhayan surān ||94||
mānavānapi pitṝm̐śca maharṣīn vyomacāriṇaḥ |
atha sthirābhavat pṛthvī parvatāḥ sukhino’bhavat ||95||
nirbhayā mama vāsena prajāśca sukhitāstathā |
anādiśrīhiraṇmayanārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ||96||
smara nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tvāṃ hiraṇyāṃ tathā smara |
evamanye’pyavatārā devamānavajantuṣu ||97||
kāryāpekṣā abhavam̐śca tān jānāmi samastakān |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavecchubhā ||98||
mama smarturgṛhe vāso nityadā mama jāyate |
yatra me bhāvayuktāśca bhaktā vasanti tatra ca ||99||
vasāmyeva na sandeho parvate ca vane’pi ca |
gṛhe prāsādake cāpi mahālaye jale’pi ca || 3.33.100 ||
mama bhaktasya rakṣārthe puṣṭyā rakṣārthamityapi |
devānāṃ cāpi lokānāṃ sṛṣṭeḥ rakṣārthamityapi || 101 ||
nivasāmi sthalaṃ kṛtvā tadrūpo’mānavo’pi san |
yatra vasāmi tatraiva dhāmākṣaraṃ mamāsti ca || 1 02||
muktāścāyānti tatraiva sarve tatra prapadyate |
māyikā naiva paśyanti paśyanti divyacakṣuṣaḥ || 103||
siddhā muktāḥ sādhavaśca santaḥ sanyāsino’malāḥ |
sādhvyaḥ satyaśca bhaktāṃśca paśyanti majjaniṃ priye || 1 04|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaścatvāriṃśe vatsare daityānāṃ nāśārtham anādiśrīcakranārāyaṇasya sudhākṣiṇīśrīsahitasya, ekacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca satyayugadharmasthāpanārtham anādiśrīsatyanārāyaṇasya vijayāśrīsahitasya, dvācatvāriṃśe vatsare ca parvatānāṃ sthityartham anādiśrīhiraṇyanārāyaṇasya hiraṇyāśrīsahitasya prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||

<3.34>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mama cetarat |
brahmaṇo rājate varṣe tricatvāriṃśake purā || 1 ||
kalpe dvāṣaṣṭiyuksaptaśate manau trayodaśe |
bhakto viṣṇornaiṣṭhikaścābhavannāmnā nirañjanaḥ || 2 ||
vipro drumanivāsaśca mūlapatraphalāśanaḥ |
satyadharmaparo nityaṃ harerme japatatparaḥ || 3 ||
prāṇāyāmaparaścāpi siddhāsanaparāyaṇaḥ |
pratyāhāraparaścāpi dhāraṇādhyānatatparaḥ || 4 ||
kāyena manasā vācātmanā viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ |
saṃyamī brahmavidvām̐śca rāgadveṣādivarjitaḥ || 5 ||
śuddhasphāṭikavadbhāsvān vyomavannirmalāntaraḥ |
satsaṃgasnehapūrṇaśca satāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ || 6 ||
brahmadṛṣṭirbrahmayatno brahmavat siddhiśevadhiḥ |
yathā brahmā yathā viṣṇuryathā śaṃbhustathā hyaham || 7 ||
upāsanābalāt sarvaiśvaryābdhiḥ samajāyata |
naikarūpadharaścāpi parakāyapraveśavān || 8 ||
deveśvarādilokeṣu cāvyāhatagatistathā |
samādhisiddhimān bhakto mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 9 ||
sa tvekadā sthito vṛkṣamūle’vicārayad yathā |
viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ tvadya pṛcchāmi hṛdayasthitam || 3.34.10 ||
nārāyaṇasya vai divyaṃ darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tviti |
vicāryetthaṃ prage snātvā pūjāyāṃ niṣasāda saḥ || 11 ||
viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ nyasyārcayat sarvopacārakaiḥ |
tataḥ samādhimāsādyāhvayad viṣṇuṃ puraḥsthitam || 1 2||
divyarūpaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ sa papraccha vinayānvitaḥ |
nārāyaṇasya vai divyaṃ darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tviti || 13 ||
viṣṇuḥ prāhāhamasmyeva nārāyaṇaḥ prapaśya mām |
caturbhujaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ śaṃkhacakragadābjavān || 14||
nirañjanaśca taṃ prāha bhavānnārāyaṇo’paraḥ |
paranārāyaṇo nāsti paraṃ darśaya me tviha || 1 5||
viṣṇuḥ śrutvābhavattatra sahasrabhujavām̐stadā |
sahasraviṣṇusadṛśastejasā vayasā guṇaiḥ || 16 ||
prāha nirañjanaṃ paśya nārāyaṇaṃ hi matparam |
mādṛśā viṣṇavaścāsmādutpadyante dine dine || 17||
varṣe varṣe sahasrāṇi vilīyante punaḥ punaḥ |
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca sampūjya natvā prāha nirañjanaḥ || 18||
yadyapyayaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrabhujavān prabhuḥ |
paranārāyaṇaścāsti tathāpyasmātparo’paraḥ || 1 9||
nārāyaṇo bhavatyeva yasya me darśanaṃ priyam |
bhaktābhilāṣāṃ saṃvīkṣya jñātvā viṣṇustataḥ param ||3.34.20||
rūpaṃ vivartayāmāsa mahāviṣṇavātmakaṃ drutam |
mahālakṣmīsevitaṃ ca koṭivairājasadṛśam || 21||
tejasā vayasaiśvaryairguṇairvibhūtivaibhavaiḥ |
darśayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ cāha bhaktaṃ prapaśya mām ||22||
ayutāyutabāhuṃ cāyutākṣipatkajam |
idaṃ me paramaṃ rūpaṃ koṭivairājakāraṇam || 23 ||
śrutvā jñātvā vīkṣya natvā prapūjya ca nirañjanaḥ |
prāha viṣṇuṃ na cāpyetatparamaṃ rūpamaiśvaram ||24||
ito’pyanyad vartate tad rūpasyāsyāpi kāraṇam |
me tad darśaya rūpaṃ vai paramordhvamito’pi yat || 25||
śrutvā bhaktasya bhāvaṃ ca jñātvā viṣṇustataḥ param |
vivartayāmāsa rūpaṃ tat tato’pi mahattaram || 26||
mahāviṣṇukoṭitulyaṃ koṭyaiśvaryādhikaṃ param |
rūpalāvaṇyamādhuryatejaādibhirudgatam ||27|||
koṭyayutākṣibāhuṃ koṭyayutapadāmbujam |
koṭikoṭiguṇordhvaṃ ca prāha paśya tato’dhikam ||28||
nirañjanastu taṃ vīkṣya natvā prapūjya bhāvavān |
kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā jagāda ha ||29||
etadrūpaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kṛpayā tava sadguro |
sarvaiśvaryabhṛtaṃ sarveśvarāṇāṃ ca niyāmakam ||3.34.30||
īśvarāṇāṃ ca yā sṛṣṭistasyāsteṣāṃ ca śāsakam |
tṛpto’smi vīkṣya paramaṃ rūpaṃ te paramaprabho ||3 1 ||
kintu nātyantatṛpto’smi cāgre dhāvati me manaḥ |
draṣṭaṃ te paramaṃ rūpaṃ tato’pi pārameśvaram ||32||
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā bhaktabhāvaṃ viṣṇurbhūmasvarūpakam |
drutaṃ vivartayāmāsa tato’bjārbudanetrakam ||33||
abjārbudādicaraṇaṃ tato koṭyabjasadguṇam |
koṭibhūmotpādakaṃ ca koṭisaṃkarṣaṇādikṛt || 34||
vāsudevātmakaṃ divyaṃ koṭipradyumnasevitam |
koṭitejomahaiśvaryāniruddhādisamanvitam ||35||
vāsudevaṃ prabhuṃ vīkṣya saṃhṛṣṭamānaso hyati |
babhūva bhaktarāṭ tūrṇaṃ neme taṃ daṇḍavanmudā ||36||
tuṣṭāva ca hṛdā paścād viṣṇuṃ prāha punaḥ sa ca |
nātra tṛptiṃ manaśceti pradarśaya tato’dhikam ||37||
yāvat catuṣṭayaṃ tāvatparaṃ rūpaṃ na tad bhavet |
eka evādvitīyaḥ saḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ ||38||
śrutvā jñātvā bhaktabhāvaṃ viṣṇustataḥ punarnijam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa śobhanam ||39||
bhaktastaṃ cāpi natvaiva prapūjya daṇḍavad vyadhāt |
naitadrūpaṃ ca tatprāha tato viṣṇuḥ punaśca tam ||3.34.40 ||
rādhākṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ svaṃ darśayāmāsa vai tadā |
natvābhyarcya stutiṃ kṛtvā bhaktaḥ prāha punastathā ||41||
ito’pyūrdhvaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇeśvareśvaraḥ |
sarvāntaryāmikaḥ śrīmān pareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||42||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ |
akṣarādhipatirnātho muktakoṭyādisevitaḥ ||43||
yastaṃ nirañjanaṃ yāvadavatārāvatāriṇam |
draṣṭumicchāmi vai viṣṇo kṛpā cenmayi darśaya ||44||
viṣṇurnirañjanaṃ prāha me’dhikāro na tatra vai |
tadrūpaṃ ke’pi śaktā no dhartuṃ tasyāvatāriṇaḥ |||45|||
avatārā īśvarā vā saguṇā nirguṇā api |
aṃśā vibhūtayaścāpi kalāveśā maheśvarāḥ ||46 ||
vibhavāścāpi vā vyūhā dhartuṃ śaktāḥ kadāpi na |
avatārī svayaṃ dhartuṃ śakto rūpāṇi tāni vai ||47||
tasmānnāhaṃ samartho’smi pradarśayitumeva tam |
yadi tvaṃ vīkṣituṃ taṃ ced samicchasi nirañjana ||48||
madantaryāmiṇaṃ taṃ tvaṃ pūjayasva pareśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||49||
yastvadātmā sa evāpi mamātmā hṛdaye sthitaḥ |
akṣare parame dhāmni sa evātmā sadā sthitaḥ ||3.34.50||
parabrahma svayaṃ tuṣṭastava dhyānena sevayā |
tīvrayopāsanayāpi snehabhaktyātimātrayā ||5 1 ||
svayaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ cātrāgamiṣyati kṛpāvaśaḥ |
bhaja taṃ śrīpatiṃ sarvapatiṃ hyekaṃ pareśvaram |||5 2||
sarvamuktapatiṃ sarvaśaktipatiṃ ramāpatim |
māṇikīvāhinaṃ taṃ saṃ bhaja drakṣyasi keśavam ||53 ||
dvibhujaṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ ca tam |
ityuktvā sahasā viṣṇustiro’bhavat tataḥ param ||54||
nirañjano vyadhād dhyānaṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ |
dhāraṇāṃ ca vyadhāccāpi dhyānaṃ punarvyadhāttathā ||55||
samādhiṃ ca tato lebhe mayi śrīpuruṣottame |
akṣare parame dhāmni samāyayau samādhinā ||56||
dadarśa mama rūpaṃ ca tvayā sākaṃ parātparam |
divyaṃ muktajuṣaṃ sarvāvatārādivilakṣaṇam ||57||
ekamevādvitīyaṃ tat sarvodagraṃ parātmakam |
yatra sarvāvatārāśca sarvadhāmāni yāni ca ||58||
sarveśvarāśca tallokāḥ sṛṣṭayaśca samastikāḥ |
nirañjano dadarśaiva mūlaṃ rūpaṃ dadarśa ca ||59||
prārthayāmāsa bhakto māṃ gantuṃ loke nije saha |
ātyantikavimuktyarthaṃ jīvānāṃ gocaro bhava ||3.34.6 0||
bhaktavaśyo’pyahaṃ tasmai tathāstvevaṃ tadāvadam |
tvayā sākaṃ śriyā cāhaṃ bhaktena saha bhūtale ||6 1||
samāyayau tadā lakṣmi sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bhaktecchāpūrakaścāhaṃ bhūloke mānavo’bhavam ||62||
nirañjanasya vai gehe prākaṭyaṃ me hyajāyata |
tvaṃ tadā pārśvavāsasya tāpasasya dvijasya ca ||63||
nāmnā niṣkiñcanasyāpi putrī vyajāyathāḥ priye |
sa ca kālenārpayanme jñātvā māmavatāriṇam ||64||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ parameśaṃ sanātanam ||65||
tataścāhamanādiśrīnairañjaninarāyaṇaḥ |
khyātimāptastvayā sākaṃ naiṣkiñcanīśriyā priye ||66||
manvantaraṃ nyavasaṃ ca mocayan mānavān śritān |
smara lakṣmi tadā māṃ tvāṃ prākaṭyaṃ smara śobhanam ||67||
anye’vatārāstatrāpi kalpe’bhavan mama priye |
sarvān jānāmyahaṃ nānye jānanti tānnarāyaṇi ||68||
asaṃkhyajīvā mokṣe vai tadā sampreṣitā mayā |
tvayā cāsaṃkhyajīvāśca sādhvyaścāpi vimocitāḥ ||69||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭānandavān bhavet ||3.34.70||
agrahā nāma te mātā mama mātāśutoṣiṇī |
prāpya putrīṃ śriyaṃ putraṃ parameśaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||71||
menāte janmasāphalyaṃ muktānyau te hyubhe sadā |
ācāryāṇyau tu te jāte lokānāṃ mātarāvubhe ||72||
yaśasvinyau mokṣadātryau sarvapūjye parāspade |
vaṃśau tau sarvadā pūjyau babhūvatustadā priye ||73||
athetaracca lakṣmi tvaṃ śṛṇu prākaṭyameva me |
vedhaso vatsare catuścatvāriṃśe kapālake ||74||
navanavatyūrdhvanavaśate kalpe’dvaye manau |
pativratā mama bhaktā nāmnā puṇyavatī satī ||75||
viprāṇī devapuṣpasya viprasyābhūd vivāhitā |
śīlaparā dharmaparā devapūjāparāyaṇā ||76||
patisevāparā cāpi satyadharmaparāyaṇā |
tīrthakartrī vratakartrī dhyānayogaparāyaṇā ||77||
vipro’pi dhārmikaścāsīt sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ |
yugalaṃ nirapatyaṃ vai vārdhakyābhibhavānvitam ||78||
ajāyata suto naiva sutā nāpi vyajāyata |
satī putreṣaṇākhinnā bhāgyaṃ śuśoca vai muhuḥ ||79||
ekadā bhāgyakartāraṃ vedhasaṃ sā śaśāpa ha |
jaḍo bhava prajāhīno yathā cāvāṃ tathā bhava ||3.34.80||
drutaṃ tadā satyaloke vedhaso hastatastadā |
nirmāṇadaṇḍo’pyapatat kulālasya karād yathā ||8 1 ||
saṃsāracakraṃ nyapatat kīlakāt pārśvabhūtale |
brahmāṇḍaghaṭapiṇḍaśca viśīrṇo vegaśātitaḥ ||82|||
tanturdūraṃ tathākṣiptaṃ kṣiptānyupakarāṇyapi |
brahmā tu jaḍatāṃ prāptaḥ śavavanmūrchito’bhavat ||83||
ghaṭaśālā sakampā ca vyajāyata vimardanāt |
kṛtānyanyāni cāṇḍāni bhagnāni cakrato’bhavan ||84||
hāhākāro mahān jāto ghaṭaśālābhitastadā |
brahmā sraṣṭā mṛtaśceti mṛtaprāyo hi mūrchitaḥ ||85||
kāraṇaṃ kiṃ na vai vidmo jaguḥ kāryakarāstathā |
sāvitryādyāścāyayurvai rurudurvīkṣya mūrchitam ||86||
siddhā maharṣayaścāpyāyayustatra prajeśvarāḥ |
brahmaputrāḥ kāryakarāḥ śālāyāṃ samupāyayuḥ ||87||
dikpālāścāyayuḥ sarve brahmāṇaścāpare’pi ca |
śāpajaḍaṃ tathā vīkṣya vīkṣya sṛṣṭivihīnakam ||88||
vilāpaṃ bahudhā cakruste sarve tatra saṃhatāḥ |
atha ye ye brahmaputro brahmaputryastathā ca yāḥ ||89||
brahmaṇaścānapatyatvaśāpenāpi samāvṛtāḥ |
mṛtyave samajāyanta rugṇāśca mūrchitā drutam || 3.34.90 ||
yathā dvau putrahīnau tau putrīhīnau tathā yathā |
tathā brahmāpi putryādihīno sāvitrikā tathā ||9 1 ||
putraputryādihīnā ca bhavituṃ daivayojitā |
nijaputrānnijaputrīrdadarśa jaḍarogiṇaḥ ||92||
mumūrṣūn sahasā tatra yataḥ śāpo bhayaṃkaraḥ |
dvayorevāvaśeṣārthaṃ śāpaḥ satyāḥ pravartitaḥ ||93||
tadā sarvaiḥ smṛto viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurvirāṭ narāyaṇaḥ |
sarve kṣaṇādāyayuśca śāparodhanahetave ||94||
militvā kāraṇaṃ mārgayitvā yayurdrutaṃ satīm |
puṇyavatīṃ prati kṣmāyāṃ sāntvayāmāsureva tām ||95||
sā prapūjya bhagavataḥ sarvān prāha hṛdi sthitam |
bhāgyaṃ mama kathaṃ putraputrīhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ ||96||
nāhaṃ śāpaṃ pradattaṃ nivartayiṣye sureśvarāḥ |
yathāgatā gṛhaṃ yāntvanyathā śaptā bhaviṣyatha ||97||
jñātvā śrutvā ca bhaktāyā vacanaṃ balavattadā |
bhītāḥ sarve sasmaruśca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||98||
taiḥ smṛto’haṃ bhagavānāgatastatra tu padmaje |
tvayā sākaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||99||
puṇyavatī prabhuṃ vīkṣya lajjānamrā babhūva ha |
iṣṭadevaṃ parameśaṃ vīkṣya maccharaṇaṃ gatā || 3.34.10 0||
papāta pādayostūrṇaṃ patyā saha ca me ca te |
mayoktā sāntvitā sā tu yayāce yugalaṃ tadā || 101 ||
putraṃ māṃ ca tathā putravadhūṃ tvāṃ ca tataḥ param |
vedhasaśca bhavecchāpanivṛttirbhāgyarohaṇāt || 102||
tathāstviti mayā proktā sā jagāda ca vedhasaḥ |
jaḍatvaṃ yātu cāvābhyāṃ tulyatā cāpi māstu ca || 103 ||
saprajatvaṃ bahuputraputrīmatvaṃ bhavatvapi |
ityuktamātre tūrṇaṃ sā ghaṭaśālā sucetanā || 1 04||
brahmā ca brahmaṇaścāpyapatyāni cetanāni vai |
jijīviṣavo’jāyanta satīvākyapraṇoditāḥ || 1 05||
ahaṃ tasyāḥ suto jātastatraiva parameśvaraḥ |
anādiśrīpuṇyanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 06||
tvaṃ ca kalyāṇikānāmnyā bhaktāyā mama putrikā |
abhavaścāgnihotrasya dvijasyāpatyarūpiṇī || 1 07||
tena mahyaṃ pradattā tvaṃ vidhinā madvivāhitā |
abhavastvaṃ tadā lakṣmi kalyāṇīśrīritiśrutā || 1 08||
smara sarvaṃ januste me sarvasaubhāgyakārakam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇād bhuktimuktidam || 1 09||
anye tathāvatārā me tadābhavan sahasraśaḥ |
bhuktimuktipradāścāpi lokarakṣākarāḥ priye || 3.34.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasastricatvāriṃśe vatsare bhaktārtham anādiśrīnairañjanīnārāyaṇasya naiṣkiñcanīśrīsahitasya, catuścatvāriṃśe vatsare ca brahmaṇaḥ puṇyavatīśāpanivṛttyartham anādiśrīpuṇyanārāyaṇasya kalyāṇikāśrīsahitasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||

<3.35>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścordhvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me’psaro’bdake |
vedhasaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśābde kalpe sahasrake || 1 ||
dvitīye ca manau sarvāpsarasāṃ bhaktibhāvanaiḥ |
ākṛṣṭo’haṃ mokṣadātānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
āvirāsaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai śṛṇu tatpadmaje yathā |
svarge satye mahendrasya sabhāyāṃ devakoṭiṣu || 3 ||
tathānyatra praśaṃsā vai sarvatra mama jāyate |
rūpe guṇe svabhāve caiśvarye sukhe vilāsane || 4 ||
sparśe śabde vihāre ca śīle tṛptau rase bale |
ānande sahavāse ca yoge hāsye ca narmaṇi || 5 ||
śayane sevane mohe hāve bhāve vikarṣaṇe |
mode pramode ramaṇe utsave bhojane sthitau || 6 ||
āsane vāhane yāne gṛhe pāne ca nartane |
śṛṃgāre ca sugandhe ca vīrye parākrame kṛtau || 7 ||
rañjane ca kriyāyāṃ ca prasannatve prabhogane |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyo na cāparaḥ || 8 ||
evaṃ praśaṃsāṃ śrutvaivāpsarasaḥ koṭiśo divi |
spṛhāṃ cakrurmama yoge bhāge vilāsane ratau || 9 ||
tāstu bhogān vihāyaiva mama prāptyarthamutsukāḥ |
vratāni cakrurbahūni mānava iva yoṣitaḥ || 3.35.10 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
asmatpatirbhavedyena tṛptāḥ syāma hi sarvathā || 1 1||
iti saṃkalpya sarvāstāḥ pūjanaṃ mama savyadhuḥ |
mayāpyākāśavāṇyā vai tābhyastato niveditam || 1 2||
sarvā bhavantu mānuṣyo nijāṃśaiḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ |
rājaputryo vipraputryo bhaktaputryaśca sarvathā || 13 ||
adyārabhya yatheṣṭaṃ vai gṛhṇantu janma bhūtale |
meroḥ paścimato bhāge khaṇḍe hemarathāhvaye || 14||
tatrāhaṃ mānavo miliṣyāmi vai kṣatrapuṃgavaḥ |
varciṣṇuvaṃśamūrdhanyaḥ parabrahma svayaṃ hariḥ || 1 5||
ityuktāstā apsaraso dadhrurjanmāni sarvaśaḥ |
ahaṃ sākaṃ tvayā lakṣmi khaṇḍe hemarathābhidhe || 1 6||
varciṣṇukṣatriyavaṃśe bṛhadindranṛpālaye |
prabhāsvatīmahiṣyāṃ vai prādurāsaṃ drutaṃ tadā || 1 7||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhādivirājitaḥ |
bhaktau me pitarau dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ menāta eva ca || 1 8||
devadundubhayo nedurmaharṣayo’pi maṃgalam |
smaraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurvardhayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||1 9||
puṣpavṛṣṭirvyomamārgādabhavacchubhaśaṃsikā |
utsavaṃ cakrire rājā prajāḥ surā maharṣayaḥ |||3.35.20 ||
atha tvaṃ rukmacampāyā rājñyā gavendrabhūpateḥ |
kukṣau tadābhavaḥ prāduḥ sarvasaubhāgyasundarī ||21 ||
śātakuṃbhābhadehā ca sarvalakṣmasamanvitā |
prāpte vivāhayogye ca kāle mahyaṃ samarpitā ||22||
tava pitrā tathā mātrā pradattā mama bhāminī |
mayā ca vidhinā tatra vivāhitātisundarī ||23||
samrājastasya rājñaścotsave vaivāhike mama |
ādeśānnṛpavaṃśāśca śreṣṭhivaṃśāstathā pare ||24||
dvijavaṃśāḥ kṣatravaṃśā vaiśyavaṃśāḥ samāyayuḥ |
apsarasaśca yāḥ kanyā māṃ svapne dadṛśurniśi ||25||
vivāho jāyate naśca hariṇā paramātmanā |
tava vivāharātrau tā dadṛśurmāṃ patiṃ prabhum ||26||
atha tā nirṇayaṃ cakrurmadarthaṃ vai svayaṃvare |
patiṃ svayaṃ grahīṣyāmo varamālāpradānataḥ || 27||
athāha paramātmā ca mahaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
tāsāṃ madarthakanyānāṃ pitṛbhyāṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||28||
svapne tābhyāṃ nijā putrī mahyaṃ datteti cotsave |
tata utthāya pitarau sarvāsāṃ vai svabhāvataḥ ||29||
tāṃ tāṃ sutāṃ dattavantau mahyaṃ śrīparamātmane |
koṭiśo’psaraso māṃ vai prāpya kāntaṃ yathepsitam || 3.35.30 ||
ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ sukhaṃ prāpuranuttamam|
ekamanvantaraṃ rājā cakravartī tadābhavam || 31 ||
nāmnā samrāḍbṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇanṛpeśvaraḥ |
mama putrāstadā koṭyarbudābjāḥ putrikāstathā || 32 ||
tathāsaṃkhyā abhavam̐śca rājavaṃśeṣu cārpitāḥ |
mama pautrāśca dauhitrā brahmakṣatraviśātmakāḥ || 33||
prajātmakāstathā jātā rājāno’pi ca bhūtale |
manvantarānte patnīstā mokṣayitvā tataḥ param ||34||
ahaṃ vanaṃ jagāmāpi sākaṃ tvayā narāyaṇi |
araṇye cādṛśyabhāvaṃ tvayā sākaṃ gato’bhavam ||35||
evaṃ mamāpi lokeṣu pūjā tataḥ pravartitā |
anādiśrībṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇasya sarvadā ||36 ||
rukmavatyā tvayā sārdhaṃ cākalpāntaṃ hi padmaje |
smara sarvaṃ śivarājñi prākaṭyaṃ te ca me’pi ca ||37||
evamanye’pyavatārāstatkalpe bahavo’bhavan |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ parā bhavet ||38||
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ syācca yāvadvrataphalaṃ tathā |
yāvaddānaphalaṃ cāpi yāvacchrautaphalaṃ bhavet ||39||
sarvapāpavināśaḥ syāt sarvānandāptirityapi |
sarvapramodabhāk syācca mama prāptistathā bhavet ||3.35.40 ||
athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi prākaṭyaṃ mama tacchṛṇu |
vedhaso vatsare ṣaṭacatvāriṃśe brahmasārase ||41 ||
kalpe navaśate ṣaṣṭhe manau cādye kṛte purā |
brahmaṇā nirmitā viprā medhāvanto maharṣayaḥ ||42||
ūṣuste bhūtale karmabhūmau tvaravyavāsinaḥ |
pratyakṣadarśinaḥ sarve sarvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||43||
brahmavidyābhavat teṣāṃ svābhāvikī pravartikā |
atha tretāyuge prāpte sāṃśe hrāsaṃ gatā tadā ||44||
tarkavādā abhavam̐śca maharṣayaḥ parasparam |
vismṛtayo’bhavam̐ścāpi kālenāvidyayā hatāḥ ||45||
tataścārādhayāmāsurmāṃ śrīśaṃ puruṣottamam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram |
ahamāvirbhavaṃ teṣāṃ madhye jñānapradāpakaḥ ||46||
vidyāmadhyāpayāmāsa brāhmīṃ parāṃ tathāparām |
vedavidyā tathā cātmavidyāṃ dharmakriyātmikāḥ ||47||
vidyāścānyā maharṣibhyo’dhyāpayāmāsa trai tadā |
kutarkanāśinīṃ pūjābhaktibodhabhṛtāṃ śubhām ||48||
mokṣadāṃ svargadāṃ vidyāmadhyāpayaṃ hitapradām |
maharṣīṇāṃ guruścāhaṃ vedavidyāprado’bhavam ||49||
brahmasvararṣiputraḥ san gaurave ca pade sthitaḥ |
vipro bhūtvāvartayaṃ vai maharṣigaṇasevataḥ ||3.35.50||
ādvāparāntāyuṣko’haṃ tvayā sākaṃ suvidyayā |
hṛdantararṣisutayā nāmnā suvidyayā śriyā ||51 ||
anādiśrīgurunārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
smara tvaṃ tvāṃ sarvavidyādhiṣṭhātrīṃ tu tadā priye ||52||
evamanye’pyavatārā bahavo’pi tadābhavan |
jānāmyetānahaṃ sarvān smara tān parameśvari ||53 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tamo līyeta mūlataḥ |
brahmaprakāśo jāyeta tathātmadarśitāṃ vrajet ||54||
ityevaṃ mama kamale prākaṭyaṃ kathitaṃ tava |
athānyadapi kathaye parabrahmaṇa eva me ||55 ||
svardhūnīvatsare saptacatvāriṃśe tu vedhasaḥ |
kalpe’ṣṭādaśake triṃśacchatottare’ṣṭame manau ||56||
rājābhavanmama bhakto bṛhaddharmā janeśvaraḥ |
sa tu yajñaṃ rājasūyaṃ samārabhata śobhanam ||57||
rājadhānyāṃ prasiddhāyām ojasvatyāṃ nṛpaḥ svayam |
iṣṭīṃśca paśuyāgau ca somayāgān vyadhāpayat ||58|| 
navatriṃśadviśiṣṭaikaśatamiṣṭīnakārayat |
ṣaṭsomayajñakān sapta darvīhomānakārayat ||59||
phālgune śuklapakṣasya prathame pratipaddine |
samārabhaddhi tajyajñaṃ varṣamekaṃ tu tatra ca ||3.35.60 ||
cāturmāsyānuṣṭhānaṃ tvakārayadvidhinā nṛpaḥ |
vaiśvānarasya ca parjanyasyeṣṭiṃ cāpyakārayat ||6 1 ||
āgneyaṃ saumyaṃ sāvitraṃ sārasvataṃ tataḥ param |
pauṣṇaṃ ca mārutaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyakam ||62||
yāgānetānaṣṭasaṃkhyān vaiśvadevākhyaparvaṇi |
akārayat svayaṃ rājā tatra kramācca devatāḥ ||63 ||
agnaye’ṣṭākapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ samārpayat |
somāya ca caruṃ savitre dvādaśakapālakam ||64||
caruṃ samārpayat sarasvatyai caruṃ dadau tathā |
pūṣṇe piṣṭacaruṃ marute tu saptakapālakam ||65||
puroḍāśaṃ dadau viśvedevebhya āmikṣakāṃ dadau |
dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ dadāvekakapālakaṃ śubham ||66||
puroḍāśaṃ tatastatra madhuṃ ca mādhavaṃ tathā |
śukraṃ śuciṃ ghṛtahomairatarpayannṛpaḥ svayam ||67||
evaṃ kṛtvā vaiśvadevaparva tato dvitīyakam |
varuṇapraghāsaparva cakre tu vidhinā nṛpaḥ ||68||
āgneyaṃ saumyaṃ sāvitraṃ sārasvataṃ ca pauṣṇakam |
aindrāgnaṃ mārutaṃ cāpi vāruṇaṃ kāyameva ca ||69 ||
akārayannavayāgān tatrāgniṃ stomamityapi |
savitāraṃ tathā sarasvatīṃ pūṣāṇamityapi ||3.35.70 ||
indrāgnī marutaścāpi varuṇaṃ kaṃ krameṇa vai |
tattaddravyairnṛpaḥ samyagavartayat havādibhiḥ ||71 ||
nabhaṃ nabhasyam iṣaṃ corjaṃ ceti hutvāpyatarpayat |
avabhṛthaṃ cakārāpi niyamān jagṛhe’pi ca ||72||
tataśca tṛtīyaṃ sākamedhaparvāpyakārayat |
anīkavatyādīṣṭīśca mahāhavīṃṣi cetyapi ||73||
pitṛyajñaṃ tryambakahavīṃṣi cāpi vyadhāpayat |
ṛṣabhaṃ cāhvayaccāpi krīḍaneṣṭiṃ hyakārayat ||7||
sahaṃ sahasyaṃ tapasaṃ tapasyaṃ cetyatarpayat |
tataśca vidhinā mahāpitṛyajñe hyakārayat ||75||
pitṛmantaṃ barhiṣado’gniṣvāttānapyatarpayat |
piṇḍān dadau ca vidhinā tryambakahavīṃṣi dadau ||76||
rudrāya homaṃ pradadau cakārāditidaivatam |
yāgaṃ ca caruṇā paścāt śunāsīrīyaparvakam ||77||
kārayāmāsa nṛpatirāgneyādīn yathāyatham |
kārayāmāsa ca tathā aindrāgnaṃ vaiśvadaivakam ||78||
śunāsīrīyakaṃ vāyavyaṃ sauryaṃ yāgamityapi |
akārayattathā tattaddevatāścāpyatarpayat ||79||
adhikamāsanāmnā caikakapālaṃ dadau tathā |
aiṣṭikāni samastāni samvatsareṇa cākarot ||3.35.8 0||
tato rājā pavitrādīn ṣaṭ somayāgakānapi |
krameṇākārayaccāpi sahasradhenudakṣiṇāḥ ||8 1||
dadau cāpyanumatyādīnaṣṭau yāgān vyadhāpayat |
anumatyai puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālakaṃ dadau ||8 1||
ādityaṃ ca caruṃ cāpi pradadau nṛpatistathā |
āgnāvaiṣṇavakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ dadau ||83||
agnīṣomīyakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ dadau |
aindraṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ cāgneyakaṃ tataḥ ||84||
aṣṭākapālakaṃ caindraṃ dadhi nṛpo dadau tayā |
aindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ caruṃ vaiśvadaivatam ||85||
saumyaṃ śyāmākaṃ ca caruṃ sārasvataṃ caruṃ dadau |
aṣṭākapālamāgneyaṃ raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum ||86||
aindraṃ dadhi yavamayaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca caruṃ dadau |
apāmārgakṛtān homān nṛpaścākārayattataḥ ||87||
dhātre dadau puroḍāśaṃ tad dvādaśakapālakam |
anumatyai caruṃ rākāyai caruṃ ca dadau nṛpaḥ ||88||
sinīvālyai caruṃ kuhvai caruṃ dadau ca dakṣiṇāḥ |
govṛṣabhau dadau cātha tato’nyahavanānyapi ||89||
āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ |
puroḍāśaṃ tathendrāvaiṣṇavaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ dadau ||3.35.90 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ ca pradadau nṛpatistathā |
agnīṣomīyakaṃ caikādaśakapālakaṃ tadā ||9 1 ||
puroḍāśaṃ dadāvindrāsomīyakaṃ ca tādṛśam |
saumyaṃ caruṃ dadau cāpi saumapauṣṇaṃ caruṃ dadau ||92||
aindrāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ pauṣṇaṃ ca dadau nṛpastathā |
tato vaiśvānarīyāṃ dvādaśakapālikāṃ śubhām |||93 ||
iṣṭiṃ cakāra ca vāruṇaṃ caruṃ pradadau tataḥ |
bārhaspatyaṃ carumaindramaikādaśakapālakam ||94||
puroḍāśaṃ dadau cāthādityaṃ caru dadau tataḥ |
nairṛtaṃ ca carumaṣṭākapālamagnidaivatam || 95||
puroḍāśaṃ dadau daśakapālaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā |
puroḍāśaṃ dadau saptakapālaṃ mārutaṃ tathā ||96||
sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau |
āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ dadau tathā ||97||
pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ raudramapi caruṃ dadau nṛpastataḥ |
dvādaśeṣṭīstato rājā kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ||98||
cakāra dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭiṃ mitraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ tathā |
ayajacca tataścāgnīṣomīye’ṣṭau havīṃṣi ca ||99||
dadau yathāgnaye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālakam |
somāya śyāmākacaruṃ dadau svayaṃ nṛpastataḥ || 3.35.100 ||
savitre dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau |
gāvīdhukaṃ ca rudrāya caruṃ dadau nṛpastataḥ || 10 1||
caruṃ naivārakaṃ bṛhaspataye ca dadāvapi |
indrāyaikādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau || 10 2||
mitrāya ca caruṃ varuṇāya yavamayaṃ carum |
evaṃ datvā sarvayāgān kṛtvā rājā sthito’bhavat || 1 03||
brahmā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā prajābhyaḥ sannyavedayat |
ayaṃ rājā bhavatīnām aṅgīcakruḥ prajāḥ nṛpe || 1 07||
abhiṣekaṃ jalaiścakruḥ rājāṣaṭhomamācarat |
sarvadravyādisampannaṃ devatāhlādakārakam || 1 05||
pārthahomottaraṃ bhūpau rathaṃ samāruroha ca |
rathamocanahomām̐śca kṛtvāsanasthito nṛpaḥ || 1 06||
kathāṃ śṛṇvan bhūsurebhyo datvā svarṇaṃ tataḥ param |
vaiśvadevaṃ tathā māhendrayāgaṃ ca vyadhāttataḥ || 1 07||
avabhṛtheṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca havīṃṣi daśa cātanot |
aṣṭākapālamāgneyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ dadau tataḥ || 1 08||
sārasvataṃ caruṃ cāpi dadau rājā tataḥ param |
sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśakaṃ dadau || 1 09||
pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ tathā bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ dadāvapi |
aindramekādaśakapālaṃ dadau ca nṛpastataḥ || 3.35.11 0||
vāruṇaṃ ca daśakapālaṃ saumyaṃ ca caruṃ dadau |
tvāṣṭramaṣṭākapālaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālakam || 111 ||
puroḍāśaṃ dadau caivaṃ saṃsṛpāmapyavartayat |
dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau śreṣṭhāṃ rājā svayaṃ ca maṇḍape || 1 12||
adhvaryave svarṇamayau darpaṇau ratnaśobhitau|
udgātre mālikāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ hotre tu vartulām || 1 13||
prastotre pratihartre ca dadāvaśvaṃ sabhūṣaṇam |
brahmaṇe bālagarbhiṇīrdaśa gāḥ sandadau nṛpaḥ || 1 14||
maitrāvaruṇāya ca vandhyāṃ gāṃ dadau nṛpatistadā |
brāhmaṇācchaṃsine balīvardaṃ dadau nṛpastadā || 11 5||
neṣṭe potre pradadau ca dhautāmbare śubhe tadā |
acchāvākāya śakaṭaṃ yavapūrṇaṃ dadau tadā || 1 16||
agnīdhe ṛṣabhaṃ cāpi dadau nṛpastathāvidhim |
daśapeyaṃ kratuṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ jagrāha vai tataḥ || 1 17|||
keśānāmavapanākhyaṃ samvatsarāvadhi nṛpaḥ |
tataścātirātrasaṃsthātmakaṃ somakratuṃ vyadhāt || 1 18||
vyuṣṭidvirātramevāpi kṣatradhṛtiṃ vyadhāpayat |
sautrāmaṇiṃ cakārāpi vidhinā nṛpatistataḥ || 1 19||
aindraṃ tathāśvinaṃ sārasvataṃ caindravāyodhasam |
payograhātmakaṃ homaṃ dadau rājā hyavabhṛtham || 3.35.1 20||
cakāraivaṃ ca dānāni dadau rājā bahūnyapi |
iyeṣa rājyaṃ datvaiva dīkṣāṃ ca sādhavīṃ śubhām || 121 ||
grahītuṃ sveṣṭadevādvai viprebhyaḥ sa nyavedayat |
sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ viprebhyo dadau dāne hi dakṣiṇām || 1 22||
vrataṃ tvanaśanaṃ cakre sapatnīko madarthakaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 1 23||
svayamāgatya māṃ dīkṣayitvā sādhuṃ vyadhāpayet |
rājasūyādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ harau tadārpayat ||1 24|||
ahaṃ tanniścaya jñācvā viprāṇāṃ prārthanāmapi|
bhaktecchāpūraṇārthaṃ vai tvayā sākaṃ hi padmaje || 1 25||
āvirbabhūva sahasā koṭibhāskarasannibhaḥ |
svāgataṃ me ca te cakruḥ pūjanaṃ ca tato’pyaham || 126 ||
dadau rājñe mahādīkṣāṃ sādhavīṃ mokṣadāṃ śubhām |
rājñyai dīkṣāṃ dadau cāpi vīkṣya viprā maharṣayaḥ || 127||
lakṣamitā mahādīkṣāṃ jagṛhurmatta eva te |
ahamācāryarūpaśca sādhudharmānabodhayam || 1 28||
vaiṣṇavyastāḥ prajā jātāḥ samastā mokṣagāḥ priye |
tvaṃ satīnāṃ mahācāryāṇī tadā saṃvyajāyathāḥ || 129||
anādiśrīmahācāryanārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tataḥ |
anādiśrīmahācāryāṇīśrīyuto hariḥ svayam || 3.35.13 0||
sadbhiḥ samprārthitaścāhaṃ manvantaraṃ bhuvastale |
vyacaraṃ divyarūpo vai mokṣadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 131 ||
smara tvaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ lakṣmi mahācāryasvarūpiṇau |
evamanye’pyavatārā mamābhavan sahasraśaḥ || 132||
rājā nāmnābhavat rājasūyāyano hi dīkṣitaḥ |
rājñī ca rājasūyaśrīrabhavat sādhvikā tadā || 133 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavet priye |
svargo mokṣo bhaveccāpi rāgo virāgatāṃ vrajet || 134||
avidyā vilayaṃ gacchedīyurbandhā vilopatām |
divyarūpo bhavet puṇyaśālisevyo bhavediha || 135||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśe vatsare’psarasāṃ mānuṣībhūtānāṃ manorathapūraṇārtham anādiśrībṛhadbrahmanārāyaṇasya rukmavatīśrīsahitasya, ṣaṭcatvāriṃśe vatsare ca maharṣibhyo brahmavidyādidānārtham anādiśrīgurunārāyaṇasya suvidyāśrīsahitasya, saptacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca haribhaktasya bṛhaddharmanṛpateḥ rājasūyayajñe sarvasvadānottaraṃ sādhvīmahādīkṣārthaṃ prārthitasyānādiśrīmahācāryanārāyaṇasya ācāryāṇīśrīyutasya ca prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||

<3.36>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me tataḥ param |
vedhaso’rcimārganāmni vatsare cātha kalpake || 1 ||
saptaṣaṣṭyadhike cāṣṭaśate’tha pañcame manau |
rudrakukṣeḥ samudbhūto vidyutsrāvo hi rākṣasaḥ || 2 ||
saḥ pracakre tapaścograṃ śaṃbhutoṣaṇahetave |
sūryacandrāgnitejobhyaścātitejo’bhilabdhaye || 3 ||
pañcaśateṣu varṣeṣu gateṣu śaṃkaraḥ svayam |
tutoṣa parayā prītyā varārthaṃ cānvarodhayat || 4 ||
so’pi vavre varaṃ sūryacandrāgnitejasāṃ param |
tejo me syād yatheṣṭaṃ vai devādyanāśyameva ca || 5 ||
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha varaṃ labdhvātimodavān |
tapastyaktvojjvalo bhūtvā svargaṃ cāyāti yāti ca || 6 ||
apsaraso mumuhuśca devyo’pi mohamāgatāḥ |
cañcalāstaṃ vīkṣya cānududruvurvāritāḥ suraiḥ || 7 ||
devānāṃ svargaloke vai kleśo’yaṃ nūtano’bhavat |
daityo’pi rākṣasarūpaṃ pragṛhya devatojjvalaḥ || 8 ||
devābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ svargāt svargaṃ prayāti ca |
mohayatyeva devīśca kalahaṃ janayatyapi || 9 ||
sūryādhikaḥ surūpaśca sutejāḥ suprabhādharaḥ |
bhūtvā sūryaṃ samabhyeti tiraskaroti bhāskaram || 3.36.10 ||
candraṃ vahniṃ samabhyeti tiraskaroti tejasā |
vaḍavāgniṃ samabhyeti grahānabhyeti vai tathā || 11 ||
pātālādau maṇidhrām̐ścābhyeti tiraskaroti ca |
mahājale tale cāpi sāmudre maṇiyādasām || 1 2||
prakāśān vai tiraskṛtya garvaṃ svīyaṃ karoti saḥ |
sarvarūpadharo daityo jñātvā balaṃ nijaṃ mahat || 13 ||
iyeṣa rājā bhavituṃ yayau kuberapattanam |
yuyudhe’ti kubereṇa cātmasāt kṛtavān purīm || 14||
tato vahniṃ yayau yuddhe jigāya svavaśaṃ nyadhāt |
candraṃ jetuṃ yayau cāpi so’pi tadvaśago’bhavat || 15||
sūryaṃ jetumiyeṣāpi yuddhārthaṃ prayayau ravim |
yuyudhe caturo māsān vidyutsrāvo mahāsuraḥ || 16||
parājayaṃ na cāpnoti śramaṃ yāti na vai manāka |
vidyutaḥ prakaṭīkṛtya lokān dagdhān karoti ca || 17||
sūryādadhikatejobhirdahatyetajjagattrayam |
hāhākārastadā jātaḥ sūryaḥ khinnaḥ śuśoca ha || 18||
sasmāra paramaṃ brahma parameśaṃ sanātanam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam || 1 9||
saśrīko’haṃ samāyātaḥ sūryarakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ |
hiraṇmayaḥ pareśo vai sarvatejo’straśastravān ||3.36.20||
īśanīsaṃjñayā sarvaśaktimatyā tvayā saha |
lakṣmi | sūryakṛtasvārhapūjāgatādisatkriyaḥ ||21 ||
sudarśanena cakreṇāśātayaṃ cāsuraṃ hi tam |
vidyutsrāvo vināśaṃ ca prāpaccābdhau papāta saḥ || 22||
jagatsu tasya visṛṣṭān vahnīnaśāmayaṃ tvaham |
tadā devarṣigandharvagrahamānavakoṭibhiḥ ||23||
saṃstuto’haṃ sarvabhūṣu paryaṭanaṃ cakāra vai |
sūrye hiraṇmayaścāhaṃ hiraṇyakeśavān hariḥ ||24||
candre rājatadeho’haṃ kūpyakeśaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ |
vahnau prabhojjvaladehaḥ prabhāśmaśrurbhavāmyaham ||25||
bhūtale tu tvayā sākaṃ mānavairabhiyācitaḥ |
anādiśrīmahāvidyunnārāyaṇo’bhavaṃ tadā ||26||
vaidyutīśrīyutaścāhaṃ loke’tra mānave’vasam |
manvantaraṃ tu kālaṃ vai mānavānāṃ hi muktaye ||27||
smara lakṣmi ca me te ca prākaṭyaṃ vai tathoditam |
anyāstathāvatārā me jātā vai bahavo bhuvi ||28||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya duḥkhahānirbhavediha |
bhuktiścātra bhavettvante muktirme śāśvate pade ||29||
atha te’nyacca me vacmi prākaṭyaṃ śṛṇu sundari |
vedhaso’bdhimathanākhye vatsare ca navādhike ||3.36.3 0||
catvāriṃśe’tha dvipañcāśadūrdhve kalpake śate |
tṛtīye ca manau lakṣmi loke’bhavaṃ tvayā saha ||3 1 ||
rasātalasya daityasya rasabhakṣasya vai sutaḥ |
madhubhakṣo’bhavad daityo balavān tapasā purā ||32||
sa tu tepe tapastīvraṃ sundarākhye girau tadā |
śaṃkaraṃ tapasārādhya varaṃ vavre hi śaṃkarāt ||33||
rasān bhoktuṃ madhūn bhoktuṃ śaktirme vipulā bhavet |
yathā yathā bhakṣayāmi tathā tathā ca pācanam ||34||
bhavedeva na cājīrṇaṃ bhavenme vai kadācana |
aruciścāpi me na syātpuṣṭirbalaṃ mahad bhavet ||35||
śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha cāhatvauṣadhipādapān |
rasān madhūn bhuṃkṣva kā cānyathā maraṇaṃ tava ||36 ||
ityevaṃ varadānaṃ vai datvādṛśyo haro’bhavat |
madhubhakṣo’suraścāpi sundarādrau drumādiṣu ||37||
praviśya māyayā sarvān madhūn cūṣati cāntarān |
patrapuṣpādikasthān sa madhūn cūṣati sarvaśaḥ ||38||
phalāni naiva jāyante śuṣyanti ca dalānyapi |
navāṃkurāṇi sarvāṇi nārohanti tataḥ param ||39||
mūlarasaṃ stambarasaṃ sthāṇurasaṃ tataḥ param |
skandharasaṃ ca śākhānāṃ rasān bhuṃkte samastakān ||3.36.40 ||
upaśākhārasām̐ścāpi patrarasān sa cūṣati |
puṣparasān phalarasān cūṣatyeva samastakān ||41||
vṛkṣebhyaścāpi valībhyaḥ stambebhyastṛṇamūlataḥ |
kandebhyaśca śalākābhyo rasān bhuṃkte samastakān ||42||
māyayā śatarūpaśca sahasrāyutarūpavān |
koṭyarbudābjarūpaśca bhūtvā bhūtvātikhādati ||43||
yathā yathā rasān bhuṃkte pacanti sarvaśaśca te |
puṣṭo bhavati balavām̐śca samartho bhojane’dhikaḥ ||44||
māyayā cāyatavapuḥ parvateṣu vaneṣu ca |
araṇyeṣu mahodyāneṣvapi saudhadrumeṣu ca ||45||
vāṭikāsu kṛṣisasyeṣvapi sarveṣu śākhiṣu |
aṃkureṣu tathāmeṣu pakvāpakveṣu sarvathā ||46||
madhūn rasān sadā bhuṃkte karoti śuṣkaśākhinaḥ |
śuṣkāyante hyaraṇyāni kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ||47||
prajābhiśca paśubhiśca pakṣibhirjantubhistathā |
prāṇibhirnaiva cāpyante rasāśca madhavo’pi ca ||48||
kṣudhābhiḥ pīḍitā sarve mriyante’kālamṛtyavaḥ |
avagrāhaṃ vinā jātaṃ durbhikṣaṃ prāṇanāśakam ||49||
mānavānāṃ ca lokeṣu pātālebhyaḥ samāyayau |
mahāsuraḥ pṛthivīsthānacūṣad drulatātarūn ||3.36.50||
pārthivān sārvabhaumām̐śca vallītṛṇādipādapān |
cakre sarvāṃśca sahasā nīrasān śuṣkavigrahān ||51||
mānavānāṃ bhojanāni devānāṃ bhojanāni ca |
praṇaṣṭāni samastāni rasamūlāni sarvathā ||52||
madhūni sarvajātīni pītāni tena rakṣasā |
vardhitaḥ sa tu balavān vāyuvad vyāpako’bhavat ||53||
udbhijjeṣu mahāśaktyā vyāpakaḥ so’bhavad varāt |
māyayā cāpi daityaḥ saḥ sarvānnakhādako’bhavat ||54||
nirarthakā yato meghā kṛṣirnirarthikā tathā |
pṛthvyāḥ rasapradānatvaṃ nirarthakaṃ kṛtaṃ tadā ||55||
bījānāṃ rasaśaktiśca sarvā nirarthikā kṛtā |
prajārthaṃ cāsureṇaiva jagat kṣudhāprapīḍitam ||56||
kṛtaṃ tena tato lokāścārādhayan hariṃ ca mām |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||57||
śrutvā tu prārthanāṃ teṣāṃ jñātvāsuropapīḍanam |
virasatvaṃ cauṣadhīnāmājagāma bhuvaṃ prati ||58||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgādihetimān svayam |
divyarūpo hariḥ so’haṃ yuyudhe tena vai tadā ||59||
sudarśanena cakreṇa madhubhakṣo hato mayā |
tvaṃ mayā mādhavī lakṣmīḥ kṛtvā drumeṣu veśitā ||3.36.60||
sarvapādapajātīnāṃ madhurūpā rasātmikā |
tvamabhavastadā lakṣmi mādhavīśrīḥ samūrjitā ||6 1 ||
anādiśrīmadhunārāyaṇaścāhaṃ prajāsvapi |
gocaro nyavasaṃ manvantarakālaṃ tvayā saha ||62||
praveśāttavavṛkṣāśca rasānvitāstadābhavan |
sarvalokeṣu sarvatra madhuvāhā hi pādapāḥ ||63||
abhavan sindhavaścāpi madhukṣarāśca dhenavaḥ |
oṣadhayo madhugarbhā mādhavīvāsitāstadā ||64||
babhūvuḥ pallavitāśca phalitāśca madhupradāḥ |
mādhavo’haṃ tadā lakṣmi rasātmakastvayā saha ||65||
avasaṃ cāpi vṛkṣādau mādhavyā parameśvaraḥ |
lokā apūjayam̐statra mādhavīmādhavau ca nau ||66||
smara tvaṃ mādhavīrūpaṃ māṃ ca madhurasātmakam |
anye’pi ca tadā devā maharṣayaśca māṃ priye ||67||
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā prāṇadaṃ parameśvaram |
etatte kathitaṃ nārāyaṇi prākaṭyameva me ||68||
te’pi rakṣākaraṃ lokaprajānāṃ sarvadehinām |
athāpyanyat pravakṣyāmi prākaṭyaṃ te ca me’pi ca ||69||
vedhaso vatsare pañcāśattame nāradābhidhe |
aṣṭāśītyūrdhvake catuśśate kalpe’ṣṭame manau ||3.36.70||
tiṣye ca saptatau bhūmau daityāśca dānavāstathā |
asurā nāstikā dharmahaṇo’bhavan samastataḥ ||71 ||
dharmāśca mānavā naṣṭāḥ krauryaṃ pravartitaṃ bahu |
māṃsādāścābhavan sarve mlecchavarṇā narāḥ striyaḥ ||72||
pāpātmānaḥ pāpakarāḥ pāpamātraparāyaṇāḥ |
sarvādāḥ sarvabhakṣāśca sarvabhoktāra utpathāḥ ||73 ||
paśūn pakṣigaṇān jantūn bhakṣayanti hi mānavāḥ |
mānavān mānavāścāpi bhakṣayantīti kā kathā ||74||
anyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ lakṣmi hāhākāro’bhavad bhuvi |
āraṇyakā hi paśavo bhakṣitā mānavaiḥ khalu ||75||
pakṣiṇo bhakṣitāścāpi milanti na yathā tathā |
vanāraṇyānyabhavam̐śca paśupakṣikṣayāṇi vai ||76||
paśupakṣivihīnāni tataste mānavāḥ khalu |
grāmyān paśūn pakṣiṇaśca bhakṣayituṃ samārabhan ||77||
mahiṣyaścāvikā ūraṇyaśca sarvāḥ prabhakṣitāḥ |
aśvā uṣṭrā gardabhāśca vṛṣabhāścāpi bhakṣitāḥ ||78||
hastinaścāpi gavayā hariṇā vānarā api |
ṛkṣāḥ siṃhāḥ śvāpadāśca śvānaśca śūkarādayaḥ ||79||
sarve’pi bhakṣitāḥ krūraiḥ rākṣasairdaityadānavaiḥ |
mānavaistādṛśaiḥ sarvairgāvo vatsāśca bhakṣitāḥ ||3.36.80||
dhenavaśca prabhakṣyante māṃsādaiśca yadā kṣitau |
tadā rakṣārthamevāhaṃ cāyāmyaprerito’pi san ||8 1 ||
devā goṣu sthitāḥ sarve tāsāmārādhanāvaśaḥ |
devānāṃ duḥkhahantāhaṃ gavāṃ rakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ ||82||
dharmarakṣākaraścāpi pṛthvyāṃ sākaṃ tvayā priye |
tūrṇaṃ cāgatavān sākṣāt sarvaśastradharo hariḥ ||83||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
dhenurakṣānimittaṃ vai samālambya pareśvaraḥ ||84||
sarvarakṣākaro dharmarakṣakaḥ śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
kalerdoṣavihantāhaṃ śīghraṃ vai gocaro’bhavam ||85||
ākṣarākhye rathe sthitvā hanyate yatra gauḥ kṣitau |
tatsthale vyomamārgeṇa tūrṇaṃ gatvāhanaṃ hi tam ||86||
gohantāraṃ ghātakaṃ ca ghātakānaparānapi |
ahanaṃ tatra tatraiva tena ruṣṭāstadagragāḥ ||87||
saṃbhūya māṃ prahantuṃ te cāyayurvai sthale sthale |
mlecchaprāyā dānavāśca daityāścāsurakoṭayaḥ ||88||
ahanaṃ tān saṃgare’haṃ bhramitvā sakalāṃ kṣitim |
koṭyarbudā hatā hiṃsrāḥ sāttvikyo mocitāḥ prajāḥ ||89||
mama vāyuprasaṃgena śiṣṭāśca sattvino’bhavan |
gavāṃ rakṣā kṛtā viprarakṣā rakṣā satāṃ tathā ||3.36.90||
dharmarakṣā kṛtā cāpi devāḥ santoṣitā mayā |
satyadharmāḥ sthāpitāśca mlecchā nṛpā vihiṃsitāḥ ||91 ||
ahiṃsā sthāpitā cāpyupāsanā mama cāhitā |
devānāṃ pūjanārthaṃ ca sarvaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ punaḥ ||92||
sevādharmo dayādharmaḥ sthāpitaśca mayā punaḥ |
anādiśrīnāthanārāyaṇaḥ pṛthvyāṃ sthiro’bhavam ||93||
anāthānāṃ tu dhenūnāṃ rakṣako nāthanāmadhṛk |
tvaṃ ca lakṣmi ghenumatīśrīrnāmnā cābhavastadā ||94||
yugārdhaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ vai sthitvāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
tvayā sākaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ smara tadā janum||95||
mamaivaṃ tiṣyalokānāṃ śikṣārthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ |
aṃśāveśakalābhūtyādyavatārā bhavantyapi ||96||
teṣāṃ vai gaṇanā nāsti kāryavaśād bhavanti yat |
kāryaṃ niṣpādya līyante mayyeva śivaśaṃbhuje ||97||
kalpe kalpe svayaṃ svecchāvaśo bhaktavaśo’thavā |
samāgacchāmi bhūmau vai kṛpayā hitakṛt prabhuḥ ||98||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
avatārī parabrahma svayaṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi |
yatheṣṭaphalasatprāptirbhavedapīha sarvathā || 3.36.1 00||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhaso’ṣṭacatvāriṃśe vatsare vidyutsrāvarākṣasasya sūryacandrādivijeturvināśārtham anādiśrīmahāvidyunnārāyaṇasya īśanīśrīsahitasya, navacatvāriṃśe vatsare ca madhubhakṣādidaityanāśārtham anādiśrīmadhunārāyaṇasya mādhavīśrīsahitasya, pañcāśattame vatsare ca gohantṝṇāṃ dharmahantṝṇāṃ tiṣye daityānāṃ nāśārtham anādiśrīnāthanārāyaṇasya dhenumatīśrīsahitasya ca, prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||

<3.37>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prākaṭyaṃ me’vatāriṇaḥ |
vedhaso vaiṣṇave caikapañcāśattamavatsare || 1 ||
ādye kalpe cādyamanau kṛte yuge hi vedhasaḥ |
āyuṣyārdhotsavaṃ svarṇotsavaṃ devādayo’rjayan || 2 ||
satyaloke’bhavattatra samājo dyunivāsinām |
talavāsāḥ svargavāsā janataponivāsinaḥ || 3 ||
meruvāsā mānasasthā lokālokanivāsinaḥ |
vairājavāsāścaivānye satyalokaṃ samāyayuḥ || 4 ||
siddhāḥ sādhyā brahmaśīlā brahmacāriṇa āyayuḥ |
maharṣayaśca ṛṣayaḥ pitaraśca samāyayuḥ || 5 ||
lokapālā devapālā lokeśvarāḥ samāyayuḥ |
ādityā vasavo rudrā manavo’śvinīputrakau || 6 ||
indrā grahāśca tārāśca nakṣatrāṇi samāyayuḥ |
yakṣāśca cāraṇā yāmyā gandharvāśca samāyayuḥ || 7 ||
kiṃpuṃsaḥ kinnarāḥ sarpā nāgā rakṣāṃsi cāyayuḥ |
kailāsasthāḥ kṣīravāridhisthāścāpi samāyayuḥ || 8 ||
mānavāśca nadā nadyo vṛkṣā vallyaḥ samāyayuḥ |
tīrthāni ṛtavaḥ kālāḥ pakṣādyāśca samāyayuḥ || 9 ||
yugāśca vatsarāścāpi bhūtatattvāni cāyayuḥ |
dharmavaṃśāḥ satīsādhvyo yoginyaśca tathāyayuḥ || 10||
aṇḍajāḥ paśavaścāpi jātismarāḥ samāyayuḥ|
sutāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaḥ paṇḍitā yayuḥ || 11 ||
vedā rudrāśca rājāno yādāṃsi ca samāyayuḥ |
khātākhātasamudrāśca parvatādyāḥ samāyayuḥ || 12
brahmasaraso’psaraso dāsā dāsyaḥ samāyayuḥ |
vāhanāni vicitrāṇi śastrāstrāṇi samāyayuḥ || 13||
svarāḥ śāstrāṇi vidyāśca vidyāputryaśca samāyayuḥ |
deśāḥ khaṇḍā mūrtimantaḥ svedajāścāpi cāyayuḥ || 14||
manojā dehajā sparśajanyāśca dṛṣṭijā yayuḥ |
jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi kāmarūpāḥ samāyayuḥ || 15||
kāmādyāśca vasantādyā gaṇāśca pārṣadā yayuḥ |
bhaktā muktā īśvarāśceśānyaścāpi samāyayuḥ || 16||
sarveṣāṃ vai samājo’bhūdasaṃkhyānandasaṃplutaḥ |
prātarvai brahmaṇastatrābhiṣekaṃ te pracakrire || 17||
tataḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ cājaṃ pupūjuste vidhānataḥ |
bhūdevāḥ svargadevāḥ satyadevā vanadevatāḥ || 18||
sarvajñātipradevāśca pupūjuḥ parameṣṭhinam |
āśīrvādān daduścāpi daduścāpyupadāḥ śubhāḥ || 19||
bṛhaspatyādidevānāṃ vācakānāṃ śubhānyapi |
brahmaśaṃsīnyabhavam̐śca vyākhyānāni sabhāsthale ||20||
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cāpi bahudhā ca tato’bhavat |
saṃgītāni vicitrāṇi bhojanāni tathābhavan ||21 ||
pāritoṣikadānāni śreṣṭhānyapi tadābhavan |
atha tatra sudhāpānaṃ cāmṛtānnādibhojanam ||22||
kṛtvā sarve pracakruśca mama bhaktimahotsavam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya bhajanaṃ mama ||23||
parabrahmākṣarātīta pareśa puruṣottama |
jaya brahmeśa sarveśa śrīhare parameśvara || 24||
jayāvatāradhartastvaṃ jaya vyūhavibhāvana |
jayeśvareśa deveśa jayāntaryāminīśvara |||25||
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ savādyāḥ sarvadehinaḥ |
tato vai tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve brahmādyā māṃ samāhitāḥ || 26||
āgaccha bhagavan bhartaḥ sarvasṛṣṭivibhāvana |
parameśa kṛpāṃ kṛtvā no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya || 27||
avatāreśa dhāmeśa mukteśa yāvadīśvara |
nirguṇeśa saguṇeśa no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya ||28||
tvamāyustvaṃ parā sattā tvaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tvaṃ prarājatā |
tva prakāśaśca vijñānaṃ tvamicchā tvaṃ prayatnakaḥ || 29||
tvaṃ kriyā tvaṃ viniyogastvaṃ phalaṃ tvaṃ phalapradaḥ |
tvaṃ bhoktā tvaṃ bhogyavāsastvaṃ bhogādhisthadevatā ||3.37.30 ||
tvaṃ cātmā tvaṃ parātmā ca tvaṃ sarvaṃ tvayi sarvakam |
sarveṣu tvaṃ mahārāja no gṛhāṇyadya pāvaya ||3 1 ||
ityarthitastadā lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ hariḥ svayam |
ahaṃ vicārya sahasā satyaloke samāgamam ||32||
gocaro vai sabhāmadhye bhaktānāṃ bhajanakṣaṇe |
sarvatejo’bhisampanno divyarūpo mahāprabhuḥ ||33||
vyarājaṃ sarvadevādyarpitasvarṇaśubhāsane |
brahmā nanāma ca viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurnanāma māṃ tataḥ ||34||
surādyāśca samānarcurmāṃ pracakruśca daṇḍavat |
tvāṃ tathā mānayāmāsuḥ sāvitryādyāḥ satīstriyaḥ ||35||
āvābhyāṃ cāśiṣā brahmā vardhito’dbhiḥ praṣecitaḥ |
brahmādyāśca tato nau vai naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ śubham ||36||
ārpayan tāmbūlakādi jalaṃ cāmṛtamityapi |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruḥ prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||37||
kṛpayā pāvitāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara |
diṣṭā te darśanaṃ labdhaṃ sarveśvarasya vai prabho ||38||
anugraheṇa te caitad brahmāṇḍaṃ puṇyatāṃ gatam |
,pāvano’dya samājaśca divasaśca vayaṃ hyapi ||39||
yathā kṛtvā kṛpāṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ satyalokake |
tathā kṛtvā kṛpāṃ dehi darśanaṃ sarvalokake ||3.37.40||
vasa satye tapasyapi jane mahari bhūtale |
atatvādau vasa śīśa parabrahma kṛpāṃ kuru ||41 ||
ityevamarthitaścāhaṃ tvayā sākaṃ hi padmaje |
sarvaistadā tathāstvevaṃ mayā tatra pratiśrutam ||42||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ | puruṣottamaḥ |
parabrahma svayaṃ satye jane tapasi bhūtale ||43||
maharloke tathā svarge gamanāya mano dadhe |
brahmaṇaścotsavānte vai vidāyaṃ prāpya mānavāḥ ||44||
surā deveśvarāścāpi pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ |
ninyurmāṃ svasvalokeṣu nānārūpadharaṃ vibhum ||45||
anādiśrīvibhunārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
vibhvīśrīsahitaṃ cāhaṃ bhūtalādau tadāvasam ||46||
ekamanvantaraṃ tatra kṛpayā tatra tatra ca |
smara lakṣmi tava me’pi prākaṭyaṃ pārameśvaram ||47||
viṣṇoścāpi ca pañcāśadvarṣānte svarṇakotsave |
śvetadvīpe yayau cāpi tvayā sākaṃ tataḥ param ||48||
śaṃbhoścāpi ca pañcāśadvarṣānte svarṇakotsave |
kailāse ca yayau cāpi tvayā sākaṃ pareśvari ||49||
brahmā jyeṣṭho madhyamaśca viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ |
bhrātaraste trayo vairājād dinaikye prajajñire ||3.37.5 0||
ekapañcāśattamasya varṣasyādyadine tataḥ |
mahotsaveṣu teṣāṃ vai tatropasthitavānaham ||51||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu madyogānmānasīprajāḥ |
pārśanī dārśanī cāpi saṃginī ca prajā tathā ||52||
sarvāstā abhavam̐llakṣmi nārāyaṇyo mamāśritāḥ |
vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā jātā manvantareṣu tāstathā ||53 ||
bhaktānyaḥ satprajāḥ sarvā mama yogena vai tadā |
ākalpāntaṃ ca tāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇyo’bhavan prajāḥ ||54||
asaṃkhyā me’vatārāśca te’vatārā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
smara tān śri tvayā sākaṃ jānāmyahaṃ yathāyatham ||55||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te ye prākaṭyaṃ paramottamam |
athānyatte kathayāmi vedhasaḥ somavatsare ||56||
dvāpañcāśattame ṣaṣṭikalpe caturthake manau |
brahmaikadā sabhāyāṃ svaputrānṛṣīṃśca devatāḥ ||57||
pitṝnupādideśāpi karmakāṇḍān sukhapradān |
dhyānaṃ kuruta prātarvai snānaṃ kuruta vai tataḥ |
pūjāṃ kuruta devānāṃ brahmāṃśānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||58||
vaiśvadevaṃ ca kuruta naivedyaṃ kurutāpi ca |
atitheyādiyajñām̐śca kuruta vyāvahārikam ||59||
sandhyāṃ ca vandanaṃ bhaktiṃ śravaṇaṃ kīrtanādikam |
kurutāpi ca viśrāntiṃ nidrāṃ śuddhiṃ ca bhojanam ||3.37.6 0 ||
daivaṃ paitryaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ dānaṃ kuruta sevanam |
satāṃ sevāṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ dharmaṃ kuruta satkriyām ||6 1||
dārān putrān duhitṝśca patiṃ sambandhibāndhavān |
poṣayata paśūn gāśca pakṣiṇo jantudehinaḥ ||62||
paropakāraṃ kuruta gṛhāṇi vāṭikāstathā |
kṣetrāṇi sasyajātāni poṣayata samāśritān ||63||
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ copārjayata yathocitān |
sukhaṃ svargaṃ labhadhvaṃ ca punaḥ punardine dine ||64||
sṛṣṭipravāhaṃ kuruta cākhaṇḍitaṃ hi putrakāḥ |
kalpānte satyalokaṃ vai samāyāta tataḥ punaḥ ||65||
kalpāraṃbhe saṃbhavata mahārṣayaḥ surāḥ punaḥ |
pitaraśca lokapālāḥ sṛṣṭisañcālanārthakāḥ ||66||
śrutvaiva brahmaṇaḥ putrā ye cāsan siddhayoginaḥ |
brahmaśīlā brahmavratāste papracchuḥ pitāmaham ||67||
ruciryeṣāṃ na vai tatra teṣāṃ karma pitāmaha |
yadyuktaṃ vāparaṃ cāste pṛthak kṛtvā prabodhaya ||68||
śrutvaivamāha vedhāstān karma dvedhā bhavediha |
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca phalaṃ dvedhāpi vai tayoḥ ||69||
uktaṃ sarvaṃ pravṛttaṃ tad dāraputradhanādijam |
rāgadveṣādiyuktaṃ ca kāmakrodhādisaṃbhṛtam ||3.37.70 ||
vāsanāmohayuktaṃ ca sambandhaṃ gṛhalobhajam |
atyāgo yatra dārāṇāṃ tayā lokaiṣaṇākṛtām ||71 ||
dvandvānāṃ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ janmamaraṇayostathā |
āvarttānāṃ na vai tyāgo saṃsārānto na yatra ca ||72||
punarāvartanaṃ yatra jarāmṛtyusamanvitam |
viṣayecchāsamāvāptirbhogatṛṣṇāmayaṃ tathā ||73||
śītoṣṇādisusaṃyuktaṃ śokodvegādiyojitam |
utsavānutsavākrāntaṃ vaṃśavistāralambitam ||74||
pravṛttaṃ sarvamevaitanmayoktaṃ sṛṣṭihetukam |
pūrve saptarṣayaścāpi tathā daśa maharṣayaḥ ||75||
prajāpatayo manavaḥ kṛtvā pravṛttikarma tat |
punarāvṛttirūpāṇi śmaśānāni hi bhejire ||76||
rāgadveṣayutaṃ śokodvegaduḥkhādisaṃbhṛtam |
aśuddhikarmamithunaṃ yadgṛhe tacchmaśānakam ||77||
tāpatrayodbhavo yatra puṇyāpuṇyodayastathā |
iṣaṇātrayasambandhastadgṛhaṃ vai śmaśānakam ||78||
mriyante cāpi ca pretā jāyante yatra duḥkhinaḥ |
garbhavāsāśca sūyante tadgṛhaṃ vai śmaśānakam ||79||
aśuddhadehayoryogo yatra vai kāmito’sti tat |
mṛtānāṃ maraṇāyaiva janmagṛhaṃ śmaśānakam ||3.37.80||
saṃsāraḥ sarva evāsti śmaśānaṃ vai pravartakam |
tato bhinnaṃ tu yatkarma nivṛttiḥ sā tu mokṣadā ||81||
yatra dāragraho nāsti nāsti kāmasya vāsanā |
rāgadveṣau kāmaroṣau gṛhalobho na yatra ca ||82||
moho nāsti neṣaṇā ca dvandvāni santi yatra na |
sā sthitiḥ brahmaśālāsti brahmavidyāpradāyinī |||83||
brahmacaryaṃ yatra cāsti brahmārpaṇaṃ ca yatra vai |
viṣayecchālayaścāpi bhogatṛṣṇālayastathā ||84||
ātmatṛptiścātmaratiḥ parabrahmaprasaṃgitā |
śokodvegoṣṇaśītādisparśāpi yatra nāsti vai ||85||
brahmotsavaḥ sadā yatrācyutagotratvamityapi |
satāṃ satsaṃga evāpi brahmārpaṇaparasthitiḥ ||86||
nivṛttaṃ taddharau premabhaktyātmakaṃ hi karma yat |
sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tadvai samanuṣṭhāya sādhavaḥ ||87||
sannyāsinastathā siddhā yatayaścordhvaretasaḥ |
brahmaśīlā brahmaparā satyaḥ sādhvyastathāvidhāḥ ||88||
tyāgamārgāśritāḥ pūrve dhruvasvargāṇi bhejire |
yanna duḥkhādisaṃbhinnaṃ na ca grastaṃ tathottare ||89||
apunarāvṛtti sukhaṃ cāhataṃ svargamuttamam |
tatsvargaṃ śrībhāgavatāḥ pūrve vai pratipedire || 3.37.90||
bhagavantaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
parabrahmākṣarātītaṃ bhajitvā puruṣottamam ||91 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam |
bhajitvā śrīpatiṃ muktapatiṃ dhāma prapedire ||92||
tatsevāṃ tadbhajanaṃ ca taddarśanaṃ taddāsyakam |
tadarcanaṃ ca tatsakhyaṃ tasmai cātmanivedanam ||93||
tadyogaṃ tatra sarvasvaṃ samarpya dhāma pedire |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma parāmuktisthalaṃ dhruvam ||94||
śāśvatānandasandohaṃ nivṛttāstat prapedire |
puruṣottamayogena dhāmottamaṃ prapedire ||95||
bhavantaḥ sādhavaḥ siddhā brahmadharmaparāyaṇāḥ |
nivṛttikarma sampādya prayāntu paramākṣaram ||96||
ityuktāste yatayo vai santuṣṭāścanivartanam |
sarvārpaṇaṃ ca bhajanaṃ kṛtvāptāḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ||97||
brahmā cātha tato’pyāhobhayān ṛṣīn yatīn punaḥ |
pravṛttaṃ vā nivṛttaṃ vā brahmārpaṇaṃ nivartanam ||98||
daihyaṃ vā daihikotthaṃ vā karmobhayaṃ kṛtaṃ hyapi |
parameśe ca sarveśe pratyakṣe’rpitameva cet ||99||
nivṛttaṃ tat prajāyeta mokṣadaṃ hariyogataḥ |
analasyātivegena sarvaṃ bhasmībhaved yathā || 3.37.100 ||
hareḥ sākṣāt suyogena sarvaṃ bhasmībhavettathā |
śrutvaivaṃ harṣitāścāpi karmaṭhāḥ ṛṣayo hyati || 10 1||
nivṛttā harṣitāścāpi sarve papracchureva tam |
pitāmahaṃ praṇamyaiva smṛtvā śrīpuruṣottam || 1 02||
hareḥ sākṣādatra loke yogo bhavet kathaṃ hi naḥ |
yenārpaṇātmikāṃ sevāṃ kurmo darśaya tadvidhim || 1 03||
kṛtvāpi pravṛttikarma cārpaṇena ca gocare |
harau prāpsyāma ūrdhvordhvaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ yataḥ || 1 04||
brahmovāca tadā lakṣmi tān sarvān tvarita vacaḥ |
satraṃ kurvantu cātraivārādhanātmakameva ha || 105||
tenākṛṣṭo haristūrṇaṃ bhaktyadhīno bhaviṣyati |
āgamiṣyati pratyakṣaḥ sevāṃ vaśca grahīṣyati || 1 06||
śrutvaivaṃ sarvadevādyāścobhaye ca pracakrire |
nāmasaṃkīrtanasatraṃ satyaloke samāhitāḥ || 1 07||
śrutvāhaṃ tāpasānāṃ vai teṣāṃ bhaktisukīrtanam |
āyayau ca tvayā sākaṃ lakṣmi cākṣaradeśataḥ || 1 08||
gocarastatsabhāmadhye nemuste māṃ pareśvaram |
pupūjuścārthanāṃ cakrurnityavāsārthameva tu || 109||
ṛṣimadhye satyaloke siddhamadhye tathā punaḥ |
pitṛmadhye janaloke mānaveṣu kṣitau tathā || 3.37.11 0||
tathāstvevamahaṃ prāha tvayā sākaṃ sadā sthitaḥ |
anādiśrīmokṣanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 11 1||
muktiśrīritināmnā tvaṃ śrīmatī puruṣottamī |
avasataṃ sarvalokeṣvanekarūpadhāriṇau || 11 2||
tataste satramāpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā yayurnijān gṛhān |
pravṛttāḥ pravṛttimāptā nivṛttiṃ nivṛttā api || 1 13||
madarpaṇena nairguṇyaṃ cāptā dhāma prapedire |
anye maharṣayo jātāḥ puṇyātmānaśca tatsthale || 1 14||
evaṃ mayā tvayā sākaṃ prākaṭyaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛtam |
smara manvantarakālaṃ pṛthvyāmāsamahaṃ svayam || 1 15||
evamanye’pyavatārā mama jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
lakśo’pi ca tān sarvān jānāmyahaṃ na cetare || 1 16||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed dhruvām |
divyāṃ ca sukhasampattimaihikīṃ pāralaukikīm || 1 17||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ ekapañcāśattame vatsare svarṇotsave’nādiśrīviṣṇunārāyaṇasya vibhvīśrīsahitasya, dvāpañcāśattame ca vatsare’nādiśrīmokṣanārāyaṇasya muktiśrīsahitasya, prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||

<3.38>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato’jasya gāyatrīvatsare punaḥ |
ādye vārāhakalpe ca manau ca prathame mama || 1 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ |
idānīṃ vartamānasya śivarājñīśriyā tvayā || 2 ||
saha me’trāsti vai prākaṭyaṃ kṣetre’kṣarasaṃjñake |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre kuṃkumavāpikāntike || 3 ||
mahālakṣmīkambharāśrīgṛhe sarvārthapūrite |
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇākhyajanakād vai surāṣṭrake || 4 ||
koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ manaḥpūraṇahetave |
dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya kṛpayā tvāgatasya me || 5 ||
pitrostapobhirugraiścākṛṣṭasyākṣaravāsinaḥ |
prākaṭyaṃ me’tra saṃjātaṃ tvaṃ mayātra nijīkṛtā || 6 ||
koṭyarbudābjakanyābhiḥ sākaṃ nārāyaṇi priye |
athāpi saṃbhaviṣyāmi kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ || 7 ||
tvayaiva sākaṃ kamale kṣetre lomaśavāsite |
mamāvatārā bahavo matsyavārāhakacchapāḥ || 8 ||
kapilasiṃhaturagā haṃsavāmananāradāḥ |
vāsudevaharidattātreyaparśudhararṣabhāḥ || 9 ||

dhanvantaribuddhakṛṣṇakalkimohanikāstathā || 3.38.1 0||
harikṛṣṇanaranārāyaṇakṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ |

yuge yuge’vatārā me vyāsāścāpi yuge yuge |

śvetavyāsaḥ kathāvaktā saṃhitāyā bhaviṣyati || 13||

kāladairghyeṇa saṃkhyātuṃ cānyena naiva śakyate ||18||
koṭiḥ koṭisahasrāṇāmatītā vai svaṃbhuvām |

arthādasaṃkhyāste sarve sṛṣṭipāḥ kālabhakṣaṇāḥ |
akālabhakṣaṇā nārāyaṇāḥ śriyo madātmakāḥ ||3.38.20||

kāśyapīpataye kuṇḍalinīnāthāya te namaḥ |
āpastambādipataye nijākāntāya te namaḥ ||273||
matkuṃjeśāya ca āmajanāyāḥ pataye namaḥ |
