śrīraṃgāyāśokasundarīśrīkāntāya te namaḥ |
dvādaśottarasāhasrayugalātmābhidhāya te ||275||
viśiṣṭasvāmine svīyāsvāmine te namo namaḥ |
śivarājñīlakṣmīśāya nārāyaṇīśāya namaḥ ||276||
dayājayāramāhaimīmanūrjālāḍakībhṛte |
mālatīsuguṇāhaṃsīkastūrīpataye namaḥ ||277||
muktābhuktādhināthāya raktāriktābhṛte namaḥ |
smṛtvā sarvāṇi rūpāṇi madyuktāni prabhostava |
bhavāmyatīva muditā yugalāni sukhāni ca ||278||
anyānyapi tvasaṃkhyāni smaryante kṛpayā tava |
anyānandaṃ samāptāsmi bhūyaḥ kāntāya te namaḥ ||279||
athānyāni caritrāṇi bhaktānāṃ tvadgatātmanām |
mokṣārthāni vṛṣārthāni śrotumicchāmi tadrasā ||3.38.280||
etad yugalaśrīkāntastotraṃ nāmasahasrakam |
dvādaśottaranāmāḍhyaṃ catuḥpumarthadaṃ param ||28 1||
saubhāgyadaṃ vaṃśadaṃ ca lakṣmīdaṃ sampadāṃ pradam |
rājyadaṃ svargadaṃ sarvabhogyadaṃ sveṣṭadaṃ param ||282||
siddhidaṃ puṇyadaṃ mūrtau samādhidaṃ ca pāvanam |
pāpahaṃ mṛtyuhaṃ vighnanāśakaṃ duḥkhanāśakam ||283||
divyabhāvapradaṃ parāmuktibhūprāpakaṃ śubham |
alabhyadaṃ tathārogyapradaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ sadā ||284||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvanāmārthasmaratāṃ tathā |
naranārīsamastānāṃ sarvavāñcchāprapūrakam ||285||
sākṣānmanmukhato jātaṃ lakṣmījaṃ śrīpradaṃ hare |
lakṣmīrahaṃ stavarūpā stavapātraṃ bhavān patiḥ ||286||
āvayoḥ stāvakānāṃ cāvayostulyatvamastviti |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo’ntarātmane ||287||
sarvābhyastava yoṣābhyo namo bhūyo namo namaḥ |
vada me’nyacaritrāṇi tvayi snehakarāṇi vai || 288|||
puruṣottamabhāvasyodbhāvakāni śubhāni ca |
naranārāyaṇādyāste’vatārāḥ santi ye bhuvi ||289||
tava bodhaṃ prakurvanti kayā rītyāvatāriṇaḥ |
vada me tat kṛpāsindho yadi lokopakārakam ||3.38.290||
vināvatārivijñānaṃ nopāsanottamā bhavet |
tasmāt kathaya me kānta kāntāyai kṛpayā prabho ||29 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ tripañcāśattame vatsare’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śrīśivarājñīśrīsahitasya prākaṭyaṃ, yugalasya dvādaśottaraśatādhikasāhasranāmastotramityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||

<3.39>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi naranārāyaṇīkathām |
puruṣottamabodhāḍhyāṃ mamāpārokṣyabodhinīm || 1 ||
ekadā tu viśālāyāṃ darśanārthaṃ maharṣayaḥ |
yayurmama svarūpasya naranārāyaṇasya te || 2 ||
tatra śrīśaṃkaraścāpi samāyātaḥ satīyutaḥ |
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandanaḥ samāyayau || 3 ||
aṃgirādyā maharṣisattamāḥ svataḥprakāśakāḥ |
patnīvrato dvijaścānye lomaśādyāḥ purātanāḥ || 4 ||
tapaḥsatraṃ cikīrṣanto’paśyan dharmasutaṃ śucim |
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ cāpi mattanuṃ tāpasīṃ śubhām || 5 ||
prapūjya vidhivat sarve stotraiḥ saṃstūya vaidikaiḥ |
praṇemurdaṇḍavat bhaktisaṃyutā yogavittamāḥ || 6 ||
jagaduste hṛṣṭahṛdo nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ gurum |
bhavantamekaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ puruṣottamam || 7 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ svayaṃ sākṣāt purāṇaṃ parameśvaram |
śreṣṭhaṃ tapo bhavadyogo bhavajjñānaṃ tapaḥ param || 8 ||
muktidaṃ tat tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ yatra cārādhyate bhavān |
tanno brūhi hare kasmādidaṃ pravartate jagat || 9 ||
ka ātmā kā ca muktirvai saṃsāraḥ ko’sti vai kṛtaḥ |
kiṃ tatparataraṃ brahma sarvaṃ no vaktumarhasi || 3.39.10 ||
iti pṛcchanto munayaḥ prāpaśyan taṃ narāyaṇam |
vihāya tāpasaṃ veṣaṃ parabrahma sanātanam || 1 1||
bhrājamānaṃ ca tejobhirmuktamaṇḍalasevitam |
akṣarabrahmadhāmasthaṃ saśrīvatsaṃ śriyā vṛtam || 12||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam |
tvayā sākaṃ hasantaṃ svasarvāyudhasamanvitam || 1 3||
dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhvādayaḥ sarve lakṣmi kṣaṇaṃ pramugdhatām |
atyānandena magnāste prāpuḥ śrīparameśvare || 14||
atha kṛtvā tirobhāvaṃ divyabhāvasya me tadā |
nārāyaṇastāpaso’bhūd yathā badrītale’bhavat || 15||
tataḥ svasthān munīn sarvānāha tatra narāyaṇaḥ |
adṛśyaṃ mama rūpaṃ tat parameśvarasaṃjñakam || 16||
yasmānmayi rājate’tra prakāśito narāyaṇaḥ |
yaṃ na devā vijānanti yatanto’pi vinā kṛpām || 17||
kṛpayā darśanaṃ prāpya brāhmībhūtā mahattamāḥ |
na saṃsāraṃ prapadyante brahmagā brahmavādinaḥ || 18||
vakṣye bhaktimatāmadya tajjñānaṃ brahmavādinām |
ātmāyaṃ dehināṃ svacchaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 19||
tatra sarvāntaraḥ śrīmadbrahmanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
vartate sa prāṇarūpaḥ so’ntaryāmī pumuttamaḥ ||3.39.20||
asmādakṣaravāsādvai viśvāni ca bhavanti hi |
sa māyayā naijatanūḥ karoti vividhāḥ sṛjau ||21 ||
karmabaddhā hi jīvādyāḥ saṃsaranti punaḥ punaḥ |
akarmabaddhamuktāśca prayānti tatparaṃ padam ||22||
yathā prakāśatamasoḥ sambandho nopapadyate |
tathā saṃsāraharyośca sambandho nopapadyate ||23||
chāyātapau yathā bhinnau tathā saṃsāraśārṅgiṇau |
evamātmā dehināṃ ca bhinnaḥ saṃsārarūpataḥ ||24||
ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī kṛśaḥ sthūlastu yā matiḥ |
sā cāhaṃkārakartṛtvādātmanyāropitā janaiḥ ||25||
tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ karmabandhanaḥ |
ahaṃkārāvivekena karmabandhaṃ karotyayam ||26||
paśyanti ṛṣayo bhaktāḥ paramopāsakā janāḥ |
śuddhātmani nije devaṃ śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram ||27||
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ kālaṃ buddhvātmānaṃ nijaṃ tathā |
hariṇā saṃgato yaśca śāśvatānandabhāg hi saḥ ||28||
svātmānamakṣaraṃ brahma nāvabuddhyati ced yadi |
anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāradāyakam ||29||
rāgadveṣādayo doṣāḥ sarve tvajñānamāśritāḥ |
kārayanti hi karmāṇi puṇyāpuṇyāni dehinām ||3.39.30||
tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ sarvadehasamudbhavaḥ |
tasmād bhāvyaṃ brahmaṇā vai svenātmanā tu sādhubhiḥ ||3 1||
pareśena samaṃ naijaṃ tvaikyaṃ vyāpyaṃ subuddhibhiḥ |
yathā tu bhūmasamparkānnākāśo malino bhavet| ||3 2||
tathā tvantaḥkaraṇotthairbhāvairātmā na lipyate |
yathā svaprabhayā sūryaḥ prakāśate samantataḥ ||33||
tathā jñānamayaścātmā tadyuktaḥ samprakāśate |
jñānarūpastataścāyaṃ cidrūpo bhavavarjitaḥ ||34||
yathā rañjanasānnidhye sphaṭiko rañjano janaiḥ |
lakṣyate ca tathā cāyaṃ bhāvasannidhisadguṇaḥ ||35||
so’hamātmākṣaraḥ śuddho nityo bhakto mayāniśam |
upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||36||
evaṃ jñāne tu sarvatra yadā bhātyasya mādhavaḥ |
bhaktasya śraddadhānasya hariḥ sampadyate tadā ||37||
svasmin sarvātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ bhātyasya vai yadā |
tadā pratyakṣarūpaṃ taṃ svātmanyevābhipaśyati ||38||
yadā sarveṣu bhūteṣu pareśaṃ taṃ prapaśyati |
tadā sarvatra bhaktasya parabrahma vikāsate ||39||
yadātmastho netaradvai svayaṃ kimapi paśyati |
tadā pareṇa sambaddhaḥ parameśaṃ prapaśyati ||3.39.40||
yadā hṛdayakāmā vai vilīyante na santi tu |
tadāsāvamṛtībhūtaḥ parameśaṃ prapaśyati ||41 ||
yadā sarvasthitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapaśyati |
tadā tadyogamāpannastatsvarūpāya kalpate ||42||
yadā paśyati deveśaṃ paramaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum |
māyāmātraṃ gataṃ tasya nāsya brahmātirekitā ||43||
yadā janmajarāduḥkhavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam |
svajñānaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ vartate’sau tadā śivaḥ ||44||
yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve samudre yānti vistṛte |
tathā bhaktā akṣare brahmaṇi yānti hyupāstibhiḥ ||45||
ajñānamugdhā vijñānaṃ nārjayanti tu yāvatā |
ajñānatimirākṛṣṭā na yānti paramaṃ padam ||46||
ātmajñānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ yogo nārāyaṇasya ca |
ubhābhyāṃ śrīhariścāsya paramātmā prakāśate ||47||
hareryogātsamagrāṇyaiśvaryāṇyasya bhavanti ca |
dehe’traivāthavā dehānte’pi hareḥ svanugrahāt ||48||
yattat sarvamataṃ divyamaiśvaryaṃ tadavāpnuyāt |
tadaiśvaryapradātā saḥ sarveṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||49||
sarvabhūteṣu sarvātmā sarvasthaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ |
sarvarūpaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandho’jaro’maraḥ ||3.39.50 ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaḥ so’ntaryāmī śrīsanātanaḥ |
apāṇipādo javano grahītā hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ||51||
acakṣurapi draṣṭā saḥ cākarṇaśca śṛṇotyapi |
vettyayaṃ sarvamevedaṃ na taṃ jānāti kaścana ||52||
parameśaṃ mahānāthaṃ vadanti vimalāśayāḥ |
paśyanti ṛṣayo hetuṃ yadaiśvaryamanuttamam ||53||
viditvā tasya sāyujyaṃ labhante tatra veśitāḥ |
ye tanmāyāmatikrāntā yā cāste bandharūpiṇī ||54||
te labhante paraṃdhāma nirvāṇaṃ hariṇā saha |
prasādāttasya te yānti punarāvṛttimeva na ||55||
etajjñānaṃ putraśiṣyayogibhyo deyameva ha |
mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ śāntipradaṃ vai brahmavittamāḥ ||56||
anyaccāpi praśṛṇuta parameśāttato’bhavat |
kālākhyaḥ puruṣaścāpi pauruṣī prakṛtistathā ||57||
tābhyāṃ pradhānā puruṣastābhyāṃ hiraṇmayo’pyajā |
hiraṇmayī ca tābhyāṃ tu virāḍ vairājiketi ca ||58||
tābhyāṃ tridevatāścāto naranārīmayaṃ jagat |
evaṃ hareḥ sarvamidaṃ tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat ||59||
haristvātmāsti bhūtānāṃ jñātātmā parameśvaraḥ |
dvijāḥ śṛṇuta cāthāpi harericchā hyabhūtpurā ||3.39.60||
māyā sā divyarūpāpi jīvakarmānvitā satī |
sattvakarmātmikā sattvā rajaḥkarmā tu rājasī ||61||
tamaḥkarmayutā sā ca tāmasī karmarūpiṇī |
jīvānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yādṛg rūpaṃ sā tādṛśī janaiḥ ||62||
gīyate raktakācāḍhya tejo raktaṃ yathetivat |
vastutaḥ śuddharūpā sā kintu jīvānuveśitā ||63||
karmānusāraphaladā sā māyā triprakāriṇī |
mūlā śuddhātha viṣamā karmānusārayāyinī ||64||
mahattattvaṃ ca buddhyākhyaṃ prakāśayati vai tataḥ |
mahattattvādahaṃ buddhiścābhimānātmikā tataḥ ||65||
tataḥ ṣoḍaśako gaṇastanmātrendriyamānasaḥ |
tanmātrebhyaśca bhūtāni sthūlāni guṇavanti ca ||66||
sthūlebhyastu jāyante tajjagat khalu |
jaḍātmakaṃ hyapi vyāptaṃ cetanaiḥ kurute kriyāḥ ||67||
karmānuguṇaṃ saraṇaṃ saṃsāro vāsanāmayaḥ |
sāpi kālasya vaśagā hyavivekasamudbhavā ||68||
manaḥsāhāyyamāsādya pravartayati dehinaḥ |
tasmānmano niyamyaiva vāsanāṃ kṣapayed budhaḥ ||69||
kālamāyātītarūpo bhūtvā bhajeta mādhavam |
nāsti tasmātparaṃ kiṃcit taṃ bhajitvā vimucyate ||3.39.70||
nāyaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā |
śakyo hi mānavairjñātumṛte bhaktimanuttamām ||7 1 ||
sa vai samagrabhūtānāmantastiṣṭhati sarvataḥ |
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ jñātvā mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||72||
tasyāntare sarvamidaṃ sa tu sarvāntakaḥ paraḥ |
tameva gṛṇanti śāstrāṇi satyekaṃ parameśvaram ||73 ||
yajanti vividhairyajñairbrāhmaṇāḥ satrakoṭibhiḥ |
dhyāyanti taṃ yogijanā bhajante sādhavo’malāḥ ||74||
sarvadevatanuḥ so’yaṃ dhārmikāstamupāsate |
tebhyo dadāti tatsthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam ||75||
narā nāryo’pi karmasthā bhaktimanto hyakalmaṣāḥ |
pūjayanti ca taṃ bhaktyā te prayānti parāṃ gatim ||76||
ityevamṛṣayo buddhvā taṃ pareśaṃ prabhuṃ harim |
sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ dhyātvā prayāntu paramaṃ padam ||77||
ityuktvā badarīnāthaḥ śivarāji ṛṣīśvarān |
punaśca darśayāmāsa tāpase varṣmaṇi prabhum ||78||
koṭikandarpaśobhāḍhyaṃ śrīsametaṃ parātparam |
anekaiśvaryasañjuṣṭaṃ rājādhirājaśobhinam ||79||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ susundaram |
sarvakāntaṃ sarvadivyalāvaṇyamadhutānvitam ||3.39.8 0||
anantamuktamuktānīsevitaṃ pārameśvaram |
avatārādibhiścāpi vyūhairnutaṃ stutaṃ tathā ||81 ||
parabrahmātmakaṃ divyaṃ sarveśvarādisevitam |
sarvaśrīsaṃbhṛtaṃ dhāmeśvaraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||82||
ṛṣayaste hareḥ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛptāḥ sukhānvitāḥ |
yāvattapaḥphalaṃ prāptā muditāstuṣṭuvuḥ punaḥ ||83||
tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ parabrahma tvaṃ kṛṣṇastvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ parajyotirbhavānakṣaradhāmavān ||84||
tvaṃ hiraṇmayarūpaśca viṣṇustvaṃ vyāpako bhavān |
sarvadevamayastvaṃ ca tāpasastvaṃ pareśvara ||85||
tvā dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyāḥ smastvāṃ prāpya puruṣottamam |
māyāpāraṃ gatāḥ smo’dya kṛpā te’sīmamuktidā ||86||
yadicchayā samāyātāścātra pūrṇo manorathaḥ |
netaracchiṣyate kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ darśanātparam ||87||
alaukikaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ sadaivaṃ bhātu naḥ prati |
ityevameva vāñcchāmo varaṃ dehi varaṃ hi naḥ ||88||
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri stutvā maunaṃ ca tasthire |
tato divyaṃ parabrahmarūpaṃ tatra tiro’bhavat ||89||
ahaṃ vai tāpaso jātaḥ sadyo nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
badaryadhaḥsthitaste ca pupūjurmāṃ tathāvidham ||3.39.90 ||
ājñāmādāya ca yayurbhajanto māṃ nijālayān |
tvaṃ vijānāhi tadrūpaṃ mama nārāyaṇātmakam ||91 ||
tāpasaṃ lokarakṣārthaṃ dharmarakṣākaraṃ sadā |
naranārāyaṇātmānaṃ cāntaryāmiṇameva mām ||92||
puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ ca vijānāhi patiṃ tava |
etajjñānaṃ samagṛhya śaṃkarādyāstato bhuvi ||93 ||
upādidiśuḥ ṛṣayo muktiṃ daduśca sarvataḥ |
dehibhyo brahmadhānyeva mamopāsanakāriṇaḥ ||94||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccaitatsmaraṇādapi muktidam |
sarvānandapradaṃ lakṣmi jñātavyaṃ na yataḥ param ||95||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne badaryāṃ tapo’rthaṃ prāptānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ naranārāyaṇe parabrahmarūpadarśanāt tṛptānāṃ mānavebhyaścopadeśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||

<3.40>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
puruṣottamakāntānāṃ dharmakarmāṇi no vada |
yena gārhasthyadoṣāṇāṃ saṃbhavo na bhavediha || 1 ||
bhavānāste parabrahma vayaṃ brāhmyaḥ striyastava |
divyatā sarvathā yatra doṣaleśo na vidyate || 2 ||
tathāpi gṛhadharmāṇāṃ dehināṃ narayoṣitām |
dharmalābho bhavet tasmād gṛhadharmān hi no vada || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śṛṇvantu sarvamatpriyāḥ |
gṛhadharmān doṣaharān vadāmi śreyasāṃ pradān || 4 ||
gṛhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
putrā bodhyāḥ pañcadevāḥ kriyāśca pūjanaṃ mama || 5 ||
evaṃ yā saṃpravartante nāryo gārhasthyasaṃsthitāḥ |
mayi sarvārpaṇabhāvāstāsāṃ dharmaḥ savaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 ||
dhyāyet patyau hariṃ nityaṃ māṃ patiṃ puruṣottamam |
nāryāṃ dhyāyet sadā lakṣmīṃ śrīṃ satīṃ puruṣottamīm || 7 ||
putreṣu pārṣadān dhyāyet putrīṣu śrīramādikāḥ |
vāhaneṣu garuḍādyān muktān vai bāndhavādiṣu || 8 ||
dhyāyedevaṃ nije dehe śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam |
tasmai samarpayet sarvaṃ nijāntaranivāsine || 9 ||
evaṃ vai karmayogo’yaṃ bhavatīnāmudāhṛtaḥ |
naiṣkarmyabhāvanāyukto mokṣado mama bhaktiyuk || 3.40.1 0||
karmayogeṣu sarveṣu tvayaṃ yogo viśiṣyate |
hareḥ sevātmako yogaḥ karmaṇā manasā girā || 11 ||
harireva sadārādhyo nāmajapādibhistathā |
pradakṣiṇāṃ prakuryācca pratimāṃ mama pūjayet || 12||
mama prāsādikaṃ bhuñjyānmatpādayormano nyaset |
hareragre svanairuccairnṛtyettathā samālapet || 13 ||
karatālādisandhānaiḥ susvarairgāyanaṃ caret |
kathāṃ śṛṇuyāt satataṃ nirmālyaṃ mastake dharet || 14||
arcanīyo namaskāryaḥ sadāhaṃ mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ |
tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkāntamacyutam || 15||
śrīhariṃ māṃ pūjayadhvaṃ prapaśyadhvaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe |
bhaktimatyo harau patyau sarvadā bhavata priyāḥ || 16||
karmayogena satataṃ samārcayata māṃ harim |
yajadhvaṃ māṃ hariṃ lakṣmyaḥ snānabhojanasevanaiḥ || 17||
prātarmatpūrvamutthāya suptasya me’ṅgamardanam |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ brahmapriyāḥ kuruta nityaśaḥ || 1 8||
yatheṣṭaṃ māṃ patiṃ devaṃ cānandayata sevayā |
āśayā nijadehādiśuddhyarthaṃ yāta vai tataḥ || 19||
māṃ smarantyo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ snāta matpādavāribhiḥ |
mannāmakīrtanaṃ cāpi kurvantyastarpaṇaṃ jalaiḥ ||3.40.20||
añjalibhiḥ prakuruta surān saṃsmṛtya vai pitṝn |
namaskuruta vṛddhāṃśca viprān sādhūn satīśca gāḥ ||2 1 ||
daivavṛkṣām̐śca tīrthāni devān namata sarvadā |
snātvā dānāni yogyāni yogyapātrebhya eva tu ||22||
arpayata dhanānnādi vastrabhūṣādyapekṣitam |
darśanāni ca devānāṃ vidhāya ca tato gṛham ||23||
samāyāta ca me sevāṃ snānādyaṃgamayīṃ śubhām |
prakuruta yathāvadvai snāpayatoṣṇavāribhiḥ ||24||
tailasugandhalepādyairmardayitvā yathocitam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||25||
veṣayata svarṇaraupyatārāmbarādibhistathā |
ābhūṣayata bhūṣābhiḥ śṛṃgārayata saddravaiḥ ||26||
sugandhipuṣpahārādyairgandhasārādibhistathā |
dhūpadīpādibhirmāṃ ca keśaprasādhanādibhiḥ ||27||
pūjayastvaṃ bhojayadhvaṃ dugdhapāyasabhojanaiḥ |
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cārpayadhvaṃ premṇā tu me sadā ||28||
mārjayadhvaṃ gṛhasthalīḥ śayyāḥ saṃharatāpi ca |
vāryāharata ca tathā caratādohanaṃ gavām ||29||
tarkadadhyādi kuruta vṛddhānarcayatāpi ca |
pākādikaṃ prakurudhvaṃ bhojayadhvaṃ ca devatāḥ ||3.40.30||
ṛṣīnatithīn viprāṃśca sādhūn bhojayatāpi ca |
gobhyo’rpayata grāsādīn agnibhyo havanādikam ||3 1||
anāthadīnabālādīn bhojayadhvaṃ subhojanam |
paropakāraṃ kuruta sūryaṃ namata sarvadā || 32||
abhyāgatān bhojayadhvaṃ kuruta svāgatādikam |
śṛṃgārayata dehām̐śca nijān bhūṣādibhiḥ sadā ||33||
bhavatyo matpriyāḥ sarvā madātmikā madarthikāḥ |
matprasādamanuprāptā bhavantu bhāvanābharāḥ ||34||
bhuñjantu miṣṭamiṣṭānnaṃ prasannāḥ saṃbhavantu ca |
vṛddhājñāṃ sammānayantu jyeṣṭhājñāṃ ca subhāṣitam ||35||
kuladharmāṃśca rakṣantu jñātidharmāṃstathāparān |
deśadharmāṃśca gṛhṇantu maddharmān mukhyato’dhikān ||36||
vastrādīnāṃ sadāśuddhiṃ kṣālanādyairmṛdādibhiḥ |
prakurvantu sadā lakṣmyo’nusarantu varīyasīḥ |
kathāṃ jñānaṃ kalāṃ cāpi kauśalyaṃ vividhaṃ sadā ||37||
adhiyantu sadā lakṣmyaḥ pākādikakalāstathā |
mātṛsevāḥ svasṛsevā śvaśrūsevāścarantviti |
sapatnīsnehabāhulyaṃ vardhayantu dine dine ||38||
mahīmānān pālayantu satkārayantu bhojanaiḥ |
sarvapradānakaiścāpi bhikṣūn sammānayantvapi ||3 9||
sādhūn sādhvīḥ pūjayantu vaiṣṇavāṃśca viśeṣataḥ |
ānukūlyena bhogāṃśca bhuñjantu mapi cārpitān ||3.40.40||
sandhyāṃ devīṃ ca gāyatrīṃ japantu mayi yojitām |
japaṃ kurvantu mannāmnā smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram ||41||
gṛhakāryāṇi kurvantu vaiśadyāni śubhāni ca |
rakṣantu gṛhavastūni sarvavidhāni cāṃjasā ||42||
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ suveṣādi vidhāpayantu matkṛte |
sevayantu gavādīni govatsādīni bhāvanaiḥ ||43 ||
śukamenāhaṃsacitragaruḍādīn prapāntu ca |
gajavājivṛṣabhādīn prapāntu mahiṣīstathā ||44||
annādiśuddhiṃ kurvantu veṣavārādiśodhanam |
pālayantu sūtakādi saṃskurvantu ca vikṛtīḥ ||45||
gṛhaśuddhiṃ prakurvantu poṣayantu kuṭumbinaḥ |
yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ vardhayantu bhavantu sahanānvitāḥ ||46 ||
dayākṣamākṛpāsevāguṇavatyo bhavantu ca |
paropakāraśālinyo bhavantu sarvadā priyāḥ ||47||
vibhajya svārthayāyinyo bhavantu nispṛhāstathā |
parārthavṛttayaścāpi paramārthaparāyaṇāḥ ||48||
daivapaivyakriyāśraddhāvatyo bhavantu sarvadā |
lokasevāparāścāpi śiṣyāsevāparāyaṇāḥ ||49||
prajāsevāparāścāpyāśīrvādādiparāyaṇāḥ |
śubhāśayāḥ sadā santu parotkarṣapradāyikāḥ ||3.40.50||
parasmṛddhipramuditāḥ svasmṛddhyarpaṇabhāvanāḥ |
aparigrahaśīlāśca bhavantu mayi cārpitāḥ ||5 1 ||
anyāyavarjitā nyāyamagnāḥ śīlavratānvitāḥ |
tṛṣṇāgṛdhnāvihīnāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ ||52||
dharmavaṃśasamāyuktā adharmānvayavarjitāḥ |

māyāvatyo bhavantu svasambandhibāndhavādiṣu |
snehilyaśca sadā santu naijakauṭumbikeṣu ca ||54||
aspṛśyadharmacāriṇyo vadhūrītimupāśritāḥ |
spṛśyadharmābhicāriṇyo mātṛdharmamupāśritāḥ ||65||
bhavantu ca sadā devyo vṛddhāgre nimnatānvitāḥ |
anuccāsanasaṃsthāśca karāñjalisamanvitāḥ ||56||
bhavantu madhurālāpā namrakaṃdharamānasāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā svagṛhakāryaṃ cākṛtaṃ tvagre hyupasthitam ||57||

parasparaṃ janayantu harṣaṃ sahāyyatāpradam ||58||

parasparaṃ sevayantu keśaprasādhanādibhiḥ ||59||
asvāsthye’nyonyasevādi carantu bhāvabhāvitāḥ |
pātrādiśodhanārthaṃ ca dāsīḥ rakṣantu sarvadā ||3.40.60||
dāsīnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bhojyāmbaravetanadānakaiḥ |
yathāyogyaṃ prakurvantu mānadānādibhāvanaiḥ ||6 1 ||
rājasvalyaṃ pālayantu śuddhiṃ rakṣantu daihikīm |
krodhādidoṣajātām̐śca varjayantu hi duḥkhadān ||62||
sukhanāśakarān lobhādikām̐styajantu sarvathā |

rogadān mā bhakṣayantu jāḍyālasyakarānapi |

madyaṃ māṃsaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca stainyaṃ kurvantu mā kvacit |
asatyaṃ cānṛtaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ mā carantu vai ||66||

apriyaṃ kleśadaṃ cāpi krūraṃ vadantu mā kvacit || 67||

ayogyaṃ cāpi mā yāntu pradeśaṃ paramandiram |
tyajantu saṃśayāpannaṃ kurvantu niścayorjitam ||69||
aphalaṃ mānutiṣṭhantu vṛthāvādaṃ vṛthākriyām |
vṛthānidrāṃ ca mā prakurvantu vṛthāṭanaṃ tathā ||3.40.70 ||
vṛthāvighnāni keṣāñcinmā kurvantu kadācana |
paśucaryāṃ mā carantu maurkhyaṃ tyajantu dūrataḥ ||7 1 ||
vicāraṃ ca vivekaṃ ca gṛhṇantu śikṣaṇaṃ sukham |
ānukūlyena tiṣṭhantu śreṣṭhe pūjye ca sādhuṣu ||72||
abhyāsena mano nityaṃ niyamayantu sarvathā |
iṣaṇā duḥkhadā yāśca tāstyajantu samantataḥ ||73 ||
sukhadā caiṣaṇāḥ nāryaḥ saphalayantu dhārmikīḥ |
aviśvāsasthalānāṃ mā viśvāsaṃ prācarantu vai ||74||
anāvaraṇadehāśca mā bhavantu nirambarāḥ |
saubhāgyābhūṣaṇahīnā mā bhavantu kadācana ||75||
nātibhogān prakurvantu rogaduḥkhakarān priyān |
vratahāniṃ nācarantu lābhaṃ tyajantu naiva ca ||76||

mārdavaṃ cāpi naipuṇyaṃ samutsāhaṃ carantu ca ||77||
prītiṃ mitho bhāvayantu tyajantu ca durāgraham |
haṭhaṃ tyajantu viphalaṃ hānidaṃ duḥkhadaṃ tathā ||78||
tavedaṃ na mamedaṃ vai mamedaṃ na taveti ca |
matvā hānikaraṃ naiva kurvantu sve pare’pi ca ||79||
paśyantu nijavat sarvā nārāyaṇasya sevikāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama yad bhavet ||3.40.80||
tatsarvaṃ cāpi paśyantu naijaṃ naijaṃ svakaṃ yathā |
svakameva na pārakyaṃ bhavatyaśca yathā hi tat ||8 1 ||
pakṣapātaṃ na kurvantu sarvabhogyeṣu vai kvacit |
sampatsmṛddhiṃ surakṣantu divyāṃ kṛtvā navāṃ navām ||82||
vyayaṃ kurvantu yogyaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā |
nijajanmadinādau ca dānaṃ kurvantu bhūriśaḥ ||83||
pātivratyaṃ pālayantu patnīvrataidhitaṃ sadā |
devārpaṇaṃ prakurvantu vaiśvadevādikārpaṇam ||84||
nagnānnarān kvacinnaivāvalokayantu satstriyaḥ |
vivādaṃ ca kaliṃ cāpi śāmayantu parotthitam ||86||
jalavahnyoghaviśvāsaṃ mā kurvantu kadācana |
paśūnāṃ tatsamānāṃ ca mā viśvāsaṃ carantu vai ||86||
vañcikānāṃ sahavāsaṃ dhūrtānāṃ cāpi yoṣitām |
mā kurvantu nāstikīnāṃ prasaṃgaṃ dviṣṭayoṣitām ||87||
nītikṣatau na kurvantu cātmaghātaṃ vibhedanam |
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ vāpi cāṃgānāṃ tu vināśanam ||88||
śreyaḥ kurvantu sarveṣāṃ vadhūṭyo jananīdṛśaḥ |
ātmahitaṃ prakurvantu patyurhitaṃ sadā tathā ||89||
mālinyaṃ mā prarakṣantu pātre vastre ca varṣmaṇi |
oṣadhāni prasevantāṃ pathyāni hitadāni ca ||3.40.90||
samājeṣu yathāyogyaṃ prayāntu maṇḍalānvitāḥ |
strīsamāje tvagragaṇyapadārthaṃ prayatantvapi ||91 ||
agragaṇyaguṇāḍhyāśca bhavantu strījanādiṣu |
bālyabhāvān mācarantu vikhelanāni yāni ca ||92||
sukhelanāni gṛhṇantu dyūtaṃ mā svīcarantvapi |
atinidrāṃ cātyaśanaṃ varjayantu ca rogakṛt ||93||
sarvavidhāni bhogyāni bhuñjantāṃ tṛptihetave |
nyāyopetāni sarvāṇi pañcaviṣayakāṇi ca ||94||
yānavāhanaśibikāvimānāni śubhāni ca |
adhiruhya vanoddeśān paśyantu vyomadṛṣṭayaḥ ||95||
jaihvyān rasān samastān vai bhuñjantāṃ ca madarpitān |
spārśanāni sakāmāni cānubhavantu vai mayi ||96||
arpayantu samastāni karmāṇi mayi mādhave |
nyūnaṃ mattaḥ pragṛhṇantu cāpekṣyaṃ sarvameva tu ||97||
madadhīnā api sarvāḥ svatantrāḥ santu nityaśaḥ |
yathāyogyaṃ bahirdṛśo mā bhavantu kadācana ||98||
paragandhasahāścāpi mā bhavantu priyā mama |
lajjānvitāḥ sukhinyaśca bhavantu satataṃ śubhā ||99||
brahmadṛśyo divyadṛśyo bhavantu muktakoṭikāḥ |
bhūvārivahnivāyvādau śuddhiṃ paśyantu cārtavīm || 3.40.1 00||
evaṃvidhān vṛṣān patnyaḥ priyāścarantu śobhanān |
śrāddhadānādisahitān bhaktiyuktān gatipradān || 10 1||
dhanadhānyapradān putraputrīvaṃśapradānapi |
āyuḥkīrtipradām̐ścāpi saubhāgyavardhakānapi || 1 02||
tejaḥpradān saumanasyapradānānandadānapi |
prasannatāpādakānme bhavantu modavārdhayaḥ || 1 03||
sarvasaukhyānvitāścāpi sarvecchātoṣasaṃgatāḥ |
vijayantu sadā sādhvyo mama prāṇapriyāḥ striyaḥ || 1 04||
anyā yā jagati nāryo vartiṣyante yathoditam |
ramaṇyaste puṇyabhūmikhanayo devikā matāḥ || 1 05||
svargaṃ tāsāṃ gṛheṣveva mokṣastāsāṃ kareṣvapi |
saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ tāsāṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāmanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopadiṣṭagṛhastrīkartavyatānirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||

<3.41>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
upavītaṃ rakṣayecca naro nārī samāhitaḥ |
sandhyāṃ kurvīta ca named guruvargaṃ sadā vadhūḥ || 1 ||
upādhyāyaṃ ca pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātaramityapi |
nṛpaṃ mātulaṃ śvaśuraṃ mātāmahapitāmahau || 2 ||
varṇaśreṣṭhaṃ ca pitṛvyaṃ mātāmahīṃ ca mātaram |
pitṛsahodarīṃ gurvīṃ śvaśrūṃ pitāmahīṃ tathā || 3 ||
dhātrīṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ sapatnīṃ ca bhaginīṃ praṇamed vadhūḥ |
anuvartanametāsāṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 4 ||
prapālayecca tā dṛṣṭvottiṣṭhet samabhivādayet |
naitairupaviśet sārdhaṃ vivadennātmakāraṇāt || 5 ||
jīvitārthamapi dveṣād gurūn naivāpamānayet |
udriktāpi gurudveṣakarī vadhūḥ patatyadhaḥ || 6 ||
bhartā bhrātā tathā vidyāpradātā jananī pitā |
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa pañca te guravo’gragāḥ || 7 ||
ātmanaḥ sarvayatnena prāṇatyāgena cāpi vai |
teṣāṃ hitaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śvaśrvāśca śvaśurasya ca || 8 ||
mūtraṃ kṛtvā trirācāmet tathaiva bhojanottaram |
malaṃ tyaktvā snānameva samācaret sukhārthakam || 9 ||
keśānāṃ guptadehasya sparśe prakṣālanaṃ nasaḥ |
kartavyaṃ karṇanābhyādeḥ sparśe’pi caraṇaspṛśau || 3.41.1 0||
agnau śmaśāne kāṣṭhe vā śādvale gomaye na ca |

na kṣetre na bile tīrthe nodyāne nagarāśaye || 12||

gurvyagre prauḍhapādā na bhaved vadhūḥ kadācana || 1 3||

pravartate tatra karṇau pidhātavyau yathānyataḥ || 14||

prayuñjīta sadā vācaṃ madhurāṃ hitakāriṇīm || 15||
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vāpi tathādhyātmikamityapi |
ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ na druhyed vadhūjanaḥ || 16 ||
gurvīvatpratipūjyāśca savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ |
abhyañjanasnāpanādyairgātrasammārdanādibhiḥ ||17||
keśaprasādhanādyaiśca gurvyaḥ sevyā vadhūjanaiḥ |
abhivādyā gurupatnī prādhīyīta śrutīstataḥ || 18||
sāvitrīṃ śrīhariṃ nāma vedāntām̐ścātmaśoṣitān |
adhīyītābhyasennityaṃ brahmaniṣṭhā samāhitā || 19||
oṃkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vyāhṛtīśca tataḥ param |
tato’dhīyīta mannāma śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||3.41.20||
na jīrṇamalavadvastrā bhaved vadhūṭikā kvacit |
sakhyaṃ sakhībhiḥ kuryācca kuryādātmahitaṃ vadhūḥ ||2 1 ||
vayasaḥ karmaṇo’rthasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca |
deśavāgbuddhisārūpyamācarantī gṛhe vaset ||22||
vṛddhairvṛddhābhirutkṛṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ vṛṣameva sā |
niṣeveta na teneyaṃ yāntī duṣyati karhicit ||23 ||
trivargasevikā syācca syācca vibhāgaśālinī |
sā gṛhiṇī sadā proktā svargādisatyadhāriṇī ||24||
dharmasyāyatanaṃ yatnāccharīraṃ paripālayet |
nahi dehaṃ vinā nārāyaṇo’haṃ prāptigocaraḥ |||25||
na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni nānyāhitaṃ caret kvacit |
na devadravyahartrī syād viṣaṃ devasya vai dhanam ||26||
devadrohaṃ na kurvīta gurudrohaṃ tathaiva ca |
svāmidrohaṃ na kurvīta śvaśrūdrohaṃ na cācaret ||27||
anṛtād bahubhogācca parapīḍāvidhāpanāt |
śāpād rogācca vai dīrghādāyuṣyaṃ nāśameti hi ||28||
na saṃvaset sumūrkhābhiḥ pāpābhiśca kvacid vadhūḥ |
sahavāsāt saṃgamādyaiḥ pāpaṃ saṃkramate yataḥ ||29||
na kuryācchuṣkavairāṇi marmabhīndi na coccaret |
bahvībhiśca samaṃ kuryānna virodhaṃ vadhūḥ kvacit ||3.41.30||
na devaguruviprāṇāṃ dīyamānaṃ nivārayet |
na cātmānaṃ praśaṃsecca nindāṃ cāpi vivarjayet |||3 1 ||
na pāpaṃ pāpināṃ brūyānmithyādoṣaṃ na cārpayet |
nāśnīyāt svāminā sārdhaṃ tvekasthālyāṃ kadācana ||32||
na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ sutāṃ śiṣyāṃ tu śikṣayet |
nātmānaṃ cāvamanyeta dainyaṃ ca varjayet sadā ||33||
na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ |
na gālīḥ saṃvadet kvāpi nāślīlāni vadettathā ||34||
naiva svapyācchūnyagehe nirjane vā parāsane |
caityavṛkṣaṃ na vai chindyād gurūnna vañcayet kvacit ||35||

na vyādhidūṣitābhiśca saṃsargaṃ racayed vadhūḥ ||36||
na ninded yoginaḥ siddhān vratino vā yatīṃstathā |
devān devanivāsām̐śca sādhvīḥ satīśca gurvikāḥ ||37||
rātrau tilasamāyuktaṃ dadhi tyajenna bhakṣayet |
nāśnīyāt payasā takraṃ kṛmiduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet ||38||
arthānāmucite pātre dānaṃ dadyāddhi bhūtaye |
nityaṃ dadyājjalānnādi kvacid dadyād vratādiṣu ||39||
dadyādapatyavijayaiśvaryārthaṃ cāpi śobhanam |
harerme cātiprītyarthaṃ dadyādvai brahmavādiṣu ||3.41.40||
dānenopāsitaṃ pātraṃ tārayatyeva sarvathā |
bhaktipūrvaṃ pradātavyaṃ deyapātrapramodakṛt ||41||
bhūmiṃ dadyādikṣuyuktāṃ yavagodhūmaśālinīm |
vidyāṃ dadyāttathā dadyāt suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ maṇīn ||42||
hīrakaṃ ratnabhūṣādi dadyād vastrāṇi kambalān |
annaṃ śākaṃ ca pātrāṇi pradadyānmadhusarpiṣī ||43||
tilān dadyāt prīyatāṃ me hṛṣīkeśaḥ prabhuḥ patiḥ |
evamuktvā yatīn sādhūn sādhvīḥ prapūjya cārpayet ||44||
phalamūlāni pānāni śākāni cauṣadhaṃ tathā |
dadyācchatraṃ tathopānad yadiṣṭaṃ syāt samarpayet ||45||
kanyādānaṃ caret sādhvī rūpāḍhyaguṇaśālini |
kuline yuni samṛddhe vittapūrṇe nare dṛḍhe ||46||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā dātavyā kanyakā nijā |
vikrayo naiva kanyāyāḥ kartavyaḥ śreyasāṃ prahan ||47||
bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dhanaṃ vastraṃ ca dhānyakam |
jāmāturyautakaṃ dattvā sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||48||
yautakena vinā dattā dāsītvamupagacchati |
atyaśane vidūrasthe vyasanāḍhye’tidurjane ||49||
kulahīne ca mūrkhe ca na dātavyā kadācana |
ativṛddhe cātidīne rogiṇi sarvanāśake ||3.41.50||
atikruddhe’pyasantuṣṭe dātavyā na hi kanyakā |
kanyādātrī labhet svargaṃ patiṃ ca parameśvaram ||5 1||
kanyādātā labhet patnīṃ paratra varavarṇinīm |
kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cūllī jalakuṃbhī pramārjanī ||52||
pañcasūnā gṛhasthānāṃ naśyanti pañcasanmakhaiḥ |
jantubhyaḥ saṃpradadyācca dadyāt pitṛbhya ityapi ||53||
yādobhyaśca tathā dadyād dadyād govṛkṣapatriṣu |
devatābhyaḥ pradadyāccātithibhyo’pi yathādhanam |||54||
evaṃ dānena vai doṣā naśyeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ |
dānaṃ śuddhiṃ tathā pātraṃ śuddhaṃ tārayati dhruvam ||55||
pāvakaḥ sarvathā medhyo medhyāśca yoṣitaḥ sadā |
sādhavaścātimedhyāśca devatāste trayo matāḥ ||56||
surāpī vyādhitā dveṣṭrī na kartavyā vadhūḥ kvacit |
virodhena na vai bhāvyaṃ patnyā patyādibhiḥ kvacit ||57||
yatrāvirodho dampatyostrivargastatra varddhate |
mṛte jīvati vā patyau yā nānyamupagacchati ||58||
seha kīrtimavāpnoti modate svagṛhe satī |
strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ kāryameṣa doṣo na vidyate ||59||
ājñāpitaṃ śubhaṃ cāpyaśubhaṃ kuryādasaṃśayā |
bhartṛbhrātṛpitṛjñātiśvaśrūśvaśuradevaraiḥ ||3.41.60||
bandhubhiśca striyaḥ pūjyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ |
saṃyatopaskarā dakṣā hṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī ||6 1||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ kuryāt pādayorvandanaṃ sadā |
hitā bharturdivaṃ gacchediha kīrtiravāpya sā ||62||
krīḍāśarīrasaṃskārasamājotsavadarśanam |

pūjayed vidhinā kāntaṃ ramayed rāmayettathā ||64||
parapākarucirna syādanindyāmantraṇādṛte |
vākpāṇipādacāpalyaṃ varjayedvai vadhūjanaḥ ||65||

daṃbhahetukapāṣaṇḍibakavṛttīśca varjayet ||66||

guruṃ śāstraṃ tathācāryaṃ rājānaṃ strīṃ patiṃ tathā |
nākrāmejjananīṃ śvaśrūṃ tacchāyāṃ ca vivarjayet ||68||
varjayetparaśayyādi paradravyāṇi varjayet |
rasāsvādavatī bhūtvā nānyaṃ naraṃ samāśrayet ||69||
asnehā na bhavet kvāpi guptacārā ca no bhavet |
sauvarṇarājatābjānāṃ śaṃkharajjvādicarmaṇām ||3.41.70||
pātrāṇāmāsanānāṃ ca kāryā śuddhirhi vāriṇā |
uṣṇena sruksruvayośca dhānyānāṃ prokṣaṇena ca ||71||
takṣaṇād dāruśṛṃgāderyajñapātrasya mārjanāt |
trapusīsakatāmrāṇāṃ kṣārāmlodakavāribhiḥ ||72||
bhasmādbhirlohakāṃsyānāṃ bhūśuddhirmārjanādinā |
amedhyāktasya mṛttoyairgandhalepāpakarṣaṇāt ||73||
notsaṃge bhakṣayet bhakṣyān na nagnā ca svapet kvacit |
na dantairnakharomāṇi chindyāt suptaṃ na bodhayet ||74||
kudvāreṇa praviśenna bāhubhyāṃ na nadīṃ taret |

yantracūllīpradīpādidīpane kuśalā bhavet |
sāvadhānā bhaved vāryāharaṇe’dhvani sarvadā ||76||
kūpasarittaṭākāditīre dhyānavatī bhavet |
pādanyāse’pi kṛṣyādau tṛṇādau kuśalā bhavet ||77||
karīṣakāṣṭhaprabhṛtyādāne’pi kuśalā bhavet |
koṇe jīrṇe jantumaye sthale’pi kuśalā bhavet ||78||
mārge yāne’pi ca vadhūrnijaṃ kāntaṃ hyanuvrajet |
sāvadhānā bhavet pṛṣṭhe yathā nānyabhramā bhavet ||79||
putrāpatyādibālānāṃ rakṣaṇe kuśalā bhavet |
pathyāpathyādisaṃjñānā grāhyādau kuśalā bhavet ||3.41.80||
putrān saṃśodhayet sādhvī saṃskārayecchubhairvṛṣaiḥ |
upādiśet sukhān dharmāncāstikyaṃ pālayet sadā ||8 1||
snāyājjalena ca vadhūrvarjayitvā śiraḥ sadā |
tailasnānaṃ tu śiraso vidadhyānnityameva ha ||82||

brahmacintanakaṃ snānaṃ śodhanaṃ cācaret sadā ||83||

yajñīyā ājyapā viprāḥ sādhavastān prabhojayet ||89||

āgnayo’tithayaḥ santaḥ pitaraste’kṣigocarāḥ ||3.41.90||
tān vadhūrbhojayennityaṃ yathāśakti yathādhanam |
gavādīn sevayellakṣmīsampatsaubhāgyavāñcchayā ||91 ||
devatābhyo namaḥ kuryād vṛddhānnityaṃ namettathā |
guruṃ namejjapenmālāṃ mama nāmayutāṃ vadhūḥ || 5 2||
japakāle na bhāṣeta smarecchrīpatimacyutam |
harerārādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ nityamārādhayeddharim ||93||
nivedayennijātmānaṃ vadhūḥ śrīparamātmani |
sandhyāyācchrīhariṃ nityaṃ sarvaśāntipradaṃ patim || 94||
devāyānnaṃ pradadyācca devayajñaḥ sa vai bhavet |
mūrtaye vā jale bhūmyāṃ vaiśvadeve’pi cārpayet ||95||
śeṣaṃ gobhyaḥ śvapacebhyaḥ śvabhyo bhūtebhya ārpayet |
dīnapatitapakṣibhyo bhūtayajñaḥ sa ucyate ||96||
sādhuṃ vipraṃ satīṃ bālān bhojayet pitṛyajñakaḥ |
atithiṃ bhojayet tṛptiṃ kārayet pitṛvat sadā ||97||
abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayedatithīn satīḥ |
bhikṣāṃ ca bhikṣave dadyāt sādhave brahmacāriṇe ||98||
arthibhyo’pi pradadyācca vadhūrvai lobhavarjitā |
mānuṣo’yaṃ yajña ukto mahāśīrvādasādhanam ||99||
mahyaṃ dadyāt sadānnaṃ ca śrīmate paramātmane |
brahmavettre pradadyācca brahmayajñaḥ sa vai mataḥ || 3.41.10 0||
sarvathā bhojanakārye karau prakṣālayet satī |
śuddhipūrvaṃ pradadyādvai tena tṛpyanti devatāḥ || 101 ||
bhojanārthaṃ copaviśet pādau prakṣālya vai karau |
āpośānakriyāṃ kṛtvā prāṇebhyaḥ prārpya vai tataḥ || 1 02||
praśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjyājjuhuyādātmani |
nādyātsūryagrahātpūrvaṃ pratisāyaṃ śaśigrahāt || 1 03||
grahakāle na cāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt samarpayet |
svārthārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yasyā bhogārthaṃ kāmamaithunam || 1 04||
vṛttyarthaṃ ca kalā yasyāstasyāḥ śūnyāntajīvanam |
na dakṣābhimukhī svapyāt paścimābhimukhī na ca || 1 05||
na cākāśe na nagnā vā nānyāsane vadhūḥ satī |
saṃsmarecchrīhariṃ māṃ vai sarvakāryeṣu cānvaham || 1 06||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śivarājñīśriyaṃ hariḥ |
tato’pi vividhānāhācārān vadāmi te śubhāt || 1 ||

navasasyeṣṭirevātra dīrghāyuḥsampradā yataḥ || 2 ||

sati cāgniṃ viśuddhānnairyajeta parameśvaram || 3 ||
daghnā miṣṭāmblamadhurāsvādena payasā tathā |
miṣṭasārānvitenāpi yajeta parameśvaram || 4 ||
pāyasānnaiḥ payaḥpākaiḥ kṣīrairyajeta mādhavam |
ghṛtena ghṛtapakvena ghṛtāktaiśca śubhānnakaiḥ || 5 ||
navanītaiḥ śubhaiḥ sadyojātaiḥ śarkarayānvitaiḥ |
yajeta paramātmānaṃ dugdhapuṭīprapūritaiḥ || 6 ||
pūrikāpolikāyuktairguptapuṭakabhojanaiḥ |
yajeta māṃ hariṃ lakṣmi yena tṛpto bhavāmi ca || 7 ||
śarkarābhiśca khaṇḍādyairmadhubhirguḍakaisaraiḥ |
sadrasaiścāpi māṃ śītapeyairyajeta sarvathā || 8 ||
āmraphalairmiṣṭaphalairyajeta drākṣikāphalaiḥ |
kadalaiścāmṛtaiścāpi nārīkelādipācanaiḥ || 9 ||
śītaphalaiḥ rāyaṇaiśca jambūbhiḥ panasaistathā |
navacirbhaṭakarkaṭībhiryajeta vadhūrhi mām || 3.42.1 0||
mānāvamānau dvāvetau sadā bodhyo viṣāmṛte |
tatsparśābhibhavaṃ prāpya vadhūvargo’vasīdati || 1 1||
tasmād dāsyena bhāvena vartitavyaṃ vadhūjanaiḥ |

svāmipūtāṃ caret sevāṃ dharmapūte vadhūrvaset |
svāmyājñāṃ pālayennityaṃ cājñābhaṃgaṃ na cācaret || 13||

atihāsyamavaṣṭaṃbhaṃ līlāṃ svecchāpravartanam |

rajasvalāṃ sūtikāṃ ca na spṛśenmalavāhinīm |

alpāyurvratavidyāḍhyatvādihīnaprasūstadā |
yato jāyeta tasmādvai balavadgrahagā bhavet || 18||
