śatrusevāparāsaṃgaṃ duṣṭāyogaṃ ca varjayet ||3.42.20||
uttamābhirhi sāṃgatyaṃ paṇḍitābhiśca satkathām |
alubdhābhiśca mitratvaṃ kurvāṇā nāvasīdati ||21 ||
parasaṃgaṃ parihāsyaṃ cāsthāne narayoṣitoḥ |
paraveśmani vāsaṃ ca na kurvīta kadācana || 22||
parāpi hitakartrī ced bāndhavī sā na cetarā |
ahito dehajo vyādhirhitamāraṇyakauṣadham || 23||
bāndhavī yā hitā saiva sa pitā yastu poṣakaḥ |
tanmitraṃ yatra viśvāsaḥ sa deśo yatra jīvyate ||24||
sa bhṛtyo yo vidhibhṛtyastadbījaṃ yatprarohati |
sā bhāryā yā patiniṣṭhā sa putro yaḥ sukhāptaye ||25|||
sā jīvati guṇā yasyā dharmo yasyāḥ sā jīvati |
guṇadharmavihīnāyā niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ ||26||
sā bhāryā yā gṛhe dakṣā pratiprāṇā priyaṃvadā |
hitā bhaktānukūlā ca sarvasaubhāgyavardhinī || 27||
yasya bhāryā niḥsnehākṣī kapaṭā kalahapriyā |
vādapriyānyasaṃsaktā tyaktalajjā vimāninī ||28||
kaśmalā sevayā hīnā sā jarā na jarā jarā |
yasya bhāryā samavṛttirguṇajñā cānugāminī ||29||
patibhāgyālpasantuṣṭā priyabhāvā priyaṃkarī |
patidharmā patyabhinnā sā priyā na priyā priyā ||3.42.30 ||
duṣṭā bhāryā śaṭhaṃ mitraṃ bhṛtyaḥ svārthaparāyaṇaḥ |
sarpo yatra ca tatra syādvāso mṛtyupradaḥ khalu ||3 1 ||
aguṇajñaḥ patiḥ kruddhā sapatnī doṣadāyinī |
sarvasaṃśayinī vāso yatra tatra na śaṃ bhavet ||32||
tyajantu durjanasaṃgaṃ bhajantu sādhusaṃgatim |
kurvantu puṇyamaniśaṃ smarantu māṃ hariṃ patim ||33||
āpadarthe dhanaṃ rakṣed dārān rakṣeddhanādibhiḥ |
patiṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ rakṣed dhanādibhiḥ sadā ||34||
tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe dharmārthaṃ tu kulaṃ tyajet |
dharmaṃ tyajecca haryarthe mokṣārthaṃ sarvamutsṛjet ||35||
varaṃ vāso’raṇyadeśe na tu duṣṭe gṛhe kvacit |
duścaritaṃ gṛhaṃ kleśaḥ pratyakṣanarakāvubhau || 36||
calatyekena pādena tiṣṭhatyekena dhīmatī |
na parīkṣya paraṃ sthānaṃ pūrvamāyatanaṃ tyajet ||37||
tyajeddaśamasadvṛttaṃ vāsaṃ sopadravaṃ tyajet |
kṛpaṇaṃ svāminaṃ māyāmayaṃ duṣṭaṃ naraṃ tyajet ||38||
padasthasyaiva mitrāṇi yāni tāni na cāṃjasā |
arthapadavihīnasya mitrāṇi sārthakāni vai ||39||
āpadrakṣākaraṃ mitraṃ kṣīṇasampatsu kāminī |
durbhikṣādau sahayānā sā bhāryā bhāgyaśālinaḥ ||3.42.40||
drumaṃ kṣīṇaphalaṃ śuṣkaṃ saraḥ patiṃ ca nirdhanam |
chāyā matsyā dharmapatnī na tyajanti kadācana ||41 ||
vihagāḥ sārasāścāpi gaṇikāstān tyajanti vai |
svārthavaśāstathā bodhyā viśvasenna tathāvidhān ||42||
lubdhāṃ dravyapradānena śreṣṭhāmañjalinā tathā |
mūrkhāṃ chandānuvṛttyā ca yāthātathyena paṇḍitām ||43||
sādhvīṃ prasevayā bālāṃ miṣṭavāṇyā jayed vadhūḥ |
sādhvyaśca devatāścāpi tuṣyanti śuddhabhāvanaiḥ ||44||
asatī khādyapānādyaiḥ śaṭhā śāṭhyena tuṣyati |
yasyā yādṛksvabhāvaḥ syāt tasyāṃ tathāviśed vadhūḥ ||45||
nadyaśca nakhinaścāpi śṛṃgiṇaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
rājakulaṃ ca luñcādo viśvāsārhā na sarvathā ||46||
dravyahāniṃ samudvegaṃ gṛhe duścaritaṃ tathā |
avamānaṃ vañcanaṃ ca prakāśayenna vai vadhūḥ ||47||
svāmityāgo hīnasaṃgo vadhūśīlavināśakau |
garvī doṣī vyasanī ca lābhanāśakarāstrayaḥ ||48||
yatra mānaṃ na prītirna vidyā śāntirna sauhṛdam |
patisneho na vai patnyāṃ tad gṛhaṃ tvanalālayam ||49||
bhayahīnaṃ dhanaṃ tvarjyaṃ bhayahīnaṃ ca sauhṛdam |
bhayahīnā tathā prītirnirbhayaḥ svarga eva saḥ ||3.42.50||
dātryā bhāvya na tvadātryā kṣantryā bhāvyaṃ striyā sadā |
śīlinyā ca tathā bhāvyaṃ puṇyārjinyā sukhāya ca ||51||
nagnā rūkṣā bhikṣukī ca kṛpaṇā yācanāparā |
avastheyamadānasya tasmād dātrī bhaved vadhūḥ ||52||
sañcitaṃ yācitaṃ prāptaṃ satkārye yujyate na cet |
caurapārthivapṛthivīhāryaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati ||53||
kadaryāyā dhanaṃ yāti bhūmitaskararājasu |
nāryā daṇḍaḥ pṛthak śayyā patyurdaṇḍo hyasevanam ||54||
durjanā dāsavargāśca paṭahāḥ paśavastathā |
tāḍitā mārdavaṃ yānti duṣṭā strī vyasanī naraḥ ||55||
nadyo nāryaḥ samabhāvā vegavatyo’tinimnagāḥ |
kūlaṃ kulaṃ pātayanti svacchandagatikā yadi ||56||
na tṛptirasti kāmasya putrasya ca dhanasya ca |
sukhasya jīvitasyāpi tāni jitvā bhajeddharim ||57||
śāśvataṃ sādhayed bhāvi devapūjādisādhanaiḥ |
aśāśvataṃ viditvaiva tyaktavyaṃ daihikaṃ tu yat ||58||
dhruvamokṣaṃ parityajya cādhruvaṃ yā hi sevate |
adhruvaṃ nātmanā sārdhaṃ gamiṣyati cared dhruvam ||59||
havirduṣṭakulād grāhyaṃ bālādapi subhāṣitam |
amedhyāt kāñcanaṃ grāhyaṃ mokṣaḥ satpuruṣāttathā ||3.42.60||
sthāneṣveva prayoktavyā bhṛtyā bhūṣāḥ striyo’pi ca |
satī nārī sadaśvaśca vīraḥ satyaparo janaḥ ||61||
anapekṣo na sahate kaṣāghātaṃ tathānṛtam |
vaibhavena vihīnāpi satī nīcaṃ na sevate ||62||
sakṛdduṣṭaṃ punarmitraṃ na sandhīta kadācana |
sandhānāyā bhavenmṛtyurvadhvāstatra viśeṣataḥ ||63||
śatrvapatyaṃ viṣapātraṃ viśvāsapātrameva na |
vipatpradaṃ bhavet kāle viparīte samāgate ||64||
sānukūlaṃ yadā daivaṃ sarvamanyannirarthakam |
sānukūle na daivaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||65||
dhanārjane vyaye vidyārjane prabhojane ratau |
svakāryasādhane tyaktalajjā nārī sukhaṃ labhet ||66||
lajjā rakṣā jalaṃ rājā gururdevālayo nijāḥ |
janā yatra na vartante sthitistatra hi duḥkhadā ||67||
sādhujyotirvido jñānī vṛddhaśca melanaṃ mithaḥ |
snehaścānnaṃ ca vaidyaśca yatra no tatra no vaset ||68||
svajanān pālayet sādhvī vadhūrannāmbarādibhiḥ |
viṣṇuṃ prapūjayennityamāyuḥkīrtibalapradam ||69||
kṣaṇena vibhavo naśyennātmāyattaṃ dhanādikam |
kṣaṇaṃ matvā sādhayedvai mokṣaṃ prasevya māṃ satī ||3.42.70||
vyāghrī jarā ca rogo’riḥ prasahyāgacchato hi tau |
āyurbhinnaghaṭābhaṃ ca jñātvā mokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||71 ||
pitṛvatparapuruṣe paradravyeṣu ghāsavat |
nijavat sarvabhūteṣu yā paśyati satī hi sā |||72|||
dravyavatyāstu mitrāṇi dravyavatyāstu bāndhavāḥ |
dravyavatī supūjyā syād dravyavatī hi paṇḍitā ||73||
śāstrahīnā sadāndhā syāt tasmācchāstravatī bhavet |
śāstracakṣuṣmatī nārī svārājyasukhamedhate ||74||
yayā santoṣito devaḥ patirdāsyaḥ pratipriyāḥ |
kuṭumbanārīvargādyā jitā tena vasundharā ||75||
manastāpaṃ na kurvīta kvāpi vadhūrmahāpadi |
samaprajñā vivekāḍhyā sukhaduḥkhasamā bhavet ||76||
paragṛhaṃ na mantavyaṃ patyurgṛhaṃ nijaṃ gṛham |
yatpatyustannijaṃ sarvaṃ moditavyaṃ vivekataḥ ||77||
cāpalyād vārayed dṛṣṭiṃ mithyāvākyaṃ ca vārayet |
mano nivārayecchāṭhyāt saṃsārāt svāṃ nivārayet ||78||
huṃkāraṃ bhrukuṭīṃ naiva tejayet svajanān prati |
sahastrīvargamālokya rañjayet praṇamed vadhūḥ ||79||
udyogaśca vivekaśca dhairyaṃ śaktiḥ suśīlatā |
utsāhaśceti ṣaṭ nāryāḥ siddhidāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||3.42.80||
mārdavaṃ dāsyabhāvaśca namratā kṣamatā dayā |
prasannatā snigdhatā ca sapta vadhvāḥ sukhapradāḥ ||81 ||
kulaśīlaguṇopetā satyadharmaparāyaṇā |
rūpavatī prasannā ca nāryadhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā ||82||
balābalamatijñātrī sainyādhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā |
iṅgitākārabhāvajñā pratīhārī bhaved ramā ||83||
medhāvinī ca vācālā satyavratā jitendriyā |
bahuśāstrādikuśalā copadeṣṭrī bhaveddhi sā ||84||
buddhimatī paracittalakṣakī tathyavādinī |
kulīnā prabhuśaktyāḍhyā nārī dūtī tu sā matā ||85||
samastaniyamajñā yā tarkaśaktisamucchrayā |
deśakālādivijñā ca dharmādhyakṣā bhaveddhi sā ||86||
mātṛmātāmahīdakṣā kṛtapākapariśramā |
śuddhā śuddhipravijñā ca rasajñā pācikā bhavet ||87||
āyurvedakṛtābhyāsā sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇī |
nidānapaddhatiprajñā bhiṣagvaryā bhaveddhi sā ||88||
vedavedāṅgatattvajñā dhyānahomajapānvitā |
hitāśīrvādavaktrī syād gurvī tathā ca śikṣikā ||89||
ācārajñā niyamajñā deśakālādibodhinī |
kuśalā caturā syādvai lekhikā pāṭhikā guruḥ ||3.42.90||
dvijihvā kleśadā nārī tathodvegakarī śaṭhā |
krūrā ca dāruṇā yā syāt sāpakārakarī matā ||91 ||
duṣṭā strī parihartavyā vidyayālaṃkṛtāpi tu |
durjanī ca vadhūstadvat tyaktavyā vyavahārake ||92||
tulyārthāṃ tulyasāmarthyāṃ marmajñāṃ vyavasāyinīm |
śūrāṃ prabhāvayuktāṃ ca yojayed rājyakarmasu ||93||
nirālasyā ca santuṣṭā sukhadā pratibodhikā |
sukhaduḥkhasamā dhīrā bhṛtyā sarvatra durlabhā ||94||
kṣāntisatyavihinā ca krūrā śaṭhā ca nindikā |
dāṃbhikī gṛdhnabhāvā ca tyaktavyā bhakṣyaluñcikā ||95||
guṇayuktā niyuñjīta gṛhe rājye śubhe sthale |
aguṇāṃ mokṣamārge ca dāsye yuñjīta vā priyām ||96||
satībhiḥ satataṃ rāmā hyāsīta saṅgatau tathā |
asatībhirna cāsīta maitrīṃ no vidadhīta ca ||97||
paṇḍitābhirvanitābhiḥ satyavratābhirityapi |
bandhanasthāpi tiṣṭheta na khalābhiḥ kadācana ||98||
sāvaśeṣāṇi kāryāṇi kartavyāni vadhūjanaiḥ |
apūrṇe tu parityakte hāniḥ svasyā prajāyate ||99||
makṣikāvanmadhu grāhyaṃ patyurvadhvā suyoṣitā |
avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryād bhaktisevādibhiḥ sadā || 3.42.100 ||
rāgaṃ tyajennītivarjyaṃ snehaṃ kuryād vṛṣānvitam |
jñānaṃ kuryādanālasyaṃ yā sā jayejjagattrayam || 10 1||
patyā na vai gṛhaṃ proktaṃ gṛhiṇyā gṛhameva yat |
tasmād gṛhaṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ svāminyā pratimā yathā ||1 02||
kartavyametannāriṇāṃ vadhūnāṃ sujñayoṣitām |
sarvaṃ matvā nijaṃ sevyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ sadācārapradarśanādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||

<3.43>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yadāha parameśvaraḥ |
śivarājñīśriyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadācāraṃ punastataḥ || 1 ||
sādhvīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ śīlaṃ patnīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ patiḥ |
sarvāsāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ lajjā harirbhūṣaṇabhūṣaṇam || 2 ||
yā na sākṣād bhavellakṣmīrlakṣmītulyāpi naiva yā |
yasyā bhāgyaṃ harau lagnaṃ sā vai nārāyaṇī smṛtā || 3 ||
mātā sākṣād bhavellakṣmīḥ pitā yasyā janārdanaḥ |
bhāgyaṃ yasyā harau nāsti sā śocyā harivarjitā || 4 ||
pūrvakṛtaṃ samagraṃ vai kramād bhuṃkte hi dehavān |
garbhaśayyā hi pākārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇā kṛtā || 5 ||
yasmin vayasi yatkāle yathā yasmād vinirmitam |
tat tathāyāti vidhinā noditaṃ nānyathā kvacit || 6 ||
dattaṃ dānaṃ kṛtā vidyā purā kṛtaṃ hi kāmitam |
sarvaṃ tvāyāti kāle vai bhogārthaṃ dehināṃ tviha || 7 ||
karmalabhyaśarīre’tra santi rogā hyanekaśaḥ |
garbhakoṣṭhalikārogaḥ sadā cāste tu yoṣitām || 8 ||
ato vai śāstragarbhiṇyā buddhyā vicārya bhāminī |
sarogāt svaṃ rogaśūnyamātmānaṃ samapādayet || 9 ||
ātmā yasyāḥ sadā satyaśaucena viśadīkṛtaḥ |
sā śuddhā labhate svargaṃ parameśapadaṃ tataḥ || 3.43.10||
bhāvopahṛtahṛdayā tṛṣṇāśvapacīsaṃyutā |
na punāti sahasraiśca snānānāṃ tīrthakarmaṇām || 11 ||
sammāne harṣaṇaṃ nāstyudvego nāsti vimānane |
kṣamā śīlaṃ sadā yatra sā sādhvī sadvadhūrmatā || 12||
vālukākoṭisaṃghāto nadyā bhavati nimnagaḥ |
karmakoṭisusaṃghāto nāryā bhavati nimnagaḥ || 13||
jalacetanasaṃghāto nadyā bhavati tīragaḥ |
śīlacetanasaṃghāto nāryā bhavati pārakṛt || 14||
dūradeśaprasaktānāṃ bhinnakuṭumbayoṣitām |
bhaktyātmakaṃ paraṃ karma kṛṣṇe mayi niyojakam || 15||
sakṛduccaritaṃ nāma yayā harīti bhāvataḥ |
sādhitaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tayā śāśvatamodanam || 16||
yadīcchecchāśvatīṃ prītiṃ śrīpatau mayi mādhave |
anuvṛttiṃ pālayenme sādhanaṃ matparaṃ matam ||17||
sarvabhūteṣu viśvāsaḥ sattvabhāvaḥ svabhāvajaḥ |
harau guptā sadā sevā sādhvyā vṛṣo hi sammataḥ || 18||
malināṃ maladantāṃ ca bahvāśinīṃ ca niṣṭhurām |
sandhyāyāṃ śāyinīṃ nārīṃ śrīmapi tyajati prabhuḥ || 1 9||
bhūlekhinīṃ tṛṇacchetrīṃ dantāśuddhāṃ malāmbarām |
rūkṣakeśīṃ nagnanidrāṃ śrīmapi tyajati prabhuḥ ||3.43.20 ||
dampatyośca striyoḥ paśvoryantrayorveginostathā |
madhyato naiva gantavyaṃ kruddhayoryuddhyatostathā || 21 ||
ṣaṭkarṇā bhidyate gāthā catuḥkarṇā tu dhāryate |
dvikarṇā tu kvacinnaiva prakāśameti vārtikā ||22||
kṣamāyukte jane lokāḥ kalpayanti hi dūṣaṇam |
aśaktiṃ balahīnatvaṃ nirmālyamiva phalgutām || 23||
akṛtajñā hyanāryā ca dīrgharoṣā hyanārjavā |
caturvidhā hi cāṇḍālī jātyā tato’pi pañcamī ||24||
nave vayasi yā śāntā sā śāntā sarvadā vadhūḥ |
dhātukṣaye tu yāvatyaḥ śāntā bhavanti yoṣitaḥ ||25||
dharmo yatra hi sanyāsī tapastīrthārthamudgatam |
satyaṃ yātrākaraṃ cāste kāpaṭyaṃ ca gṛhe sthitam ||26||
dāridryaṃ kalahaścāpi bāndhavā iva yadgṛhe |
hiṃsā patnīsvarūpā ca tadgṛhaṃ yāmyakoṭarā || 27||
kupatau nirvṛttirnāsti kubhāryāyāṃ na nirvṛttiḥ |
kumitre nirbhayatvaṃ na vicāryeti pravartayet ||28||
parānnaṃ ca parasvaṃ ca paraśayyāḥ parastriyaḥ |
parapumān parasaudhaḥ śrīvināśakarā hi te ||29||
adhamāḥ kleśarāgā vai sandhirāgāstu madhyamāḥ |
uttamā mānarāgāśca vadhyo bhavanti bhinnabhāḥ ||3.43.3 0||
adhamā dhanarāgāśca madhyā mānadhanānugāḥ |
uttamā mānamātrasthā vadhvo bhavanti dehinām ||3 1 ||
virahaścāpamānaṃ ca ṛṇaṃ ca duṣṭasevanam |
dāridryaṃ kalahaśceti vināgniṃ dāhakāni ṣaṭ ||32||
asthiraṃ jīvanaṃ dravyaṃ yauvanaṃ ca manastathā |
putradārapatayo’pi hariṃ tataḥ sthiraṃ bhajet| || 33||
ahorātramayaḥ kālo harate dehimaṇḍalam |
kālakālaṃ hariṃ jñātvāśrayenmāṃ puruṣottamam || 34||
yā nije na gurau bhṛtye patyau dīne dayāvatī |
kiṃ tasyā jīvanaṃ loke kākīvad bhogayoṣitaḥ ||35||
yadgṛhe dharmabhaktyādiśūnyaṃ yāpayati kṣaṇam |
bhasrāgṛhaṃ hi tadbodhyaṃ śvāsimāsanivāsadam ||36||
svādapramādaviśvāsaiḥ svārthadāridryamānanaiḥ |
striyo bhraśyanti tasmāt tāstān kuryurdūrataḥ sadā ||37||
tāvadbhayasya bhetavyaṃ yāvadbhayaṃ hyanāgatam|
upasthite bhaye tīvre sthātavyaṃ vai hyabhītavat ||38||
yā dayāṃ na kurute dīne bhṛtye gurau striyām |
mitre patyāvanāthe jīvanaṃ tasyāstu kākavat ||3 9||
parādhīnā mṛtā eva svādhīnā jīvanārthikāḥ |
paropakārakāriṇyo mṛtā api sajīvanāḥ ||3.43.40||
yathā yathā hi nāryo’tra śāstraśīlā bhavanti ca |
tathā tathā sumedhāḥ syurbrahmavādinya ityapi ||41 ||
yathā yathā ca kalyāṇe kurvanti svamatiṃ tathā |
tathā striyo bhavantyeva pūjāpātrāṇi supriyāḥ |||42||
parokṣe kāryahantrī yā pratyakṣe priyavādinī |
varjanīyā prayatnena vallīva cendravāruṇī ||43||
durjanāyāḥ prasaṃgena sunāryapi vinaśyati |
tasmād vadhvā durjanāyāḥ saṃgastyājyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||44||
manaḥprasannatā yatra maṃgalāni hi tatra vai |
nārīprasannatā yatra tatra vāso hi sampadām ||45||
sā strī yā na madaṃ kuryāt sā patnī yā patipriyā |
sukhinī sā hyatṛṣṇā yā vadhūḥ sā vaṃśavardhinī ||46 ||
sādhūnāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā |
mūlānveṣo nātikāryo vadhūnāṃ cauṣadhasya tu ||47||
rājyaśrīḥ kṛtapuṇyāntā śīlaṃ strīsaṃgamāntakam |
kulakīrtiḥ strīśīlāntā kulasyāntaḥ striyo’pi ca ||48||
anāyake na varo vāso na vāpi bahunāyake |
strīnāyake’pi na varo vāso’pi bālanāyake ||49||
pitradhīnā kumāratve patyadhīnā tu yauvane |
putrādhīnā ca vārdhakye satyādhīnā tathāśrame ||3.43.50 ||
lajjādhīnā vyasane ca daivādhīnā tu sampadi |
dānādhīnā tu patnītve yā vadhūḥ sā sukhapradā ||51||
vandhyāṃ mṛtaprajāṃ strīmātaraṃ cāpriyavādinīm |
aputradāṃ prarakṣyaiva putrārthaṃ tvaparāṃ vahet ||52||
arthahīnā bhiyā yuktā kāntādhīnā hi vartate |
arthapūrṇā nirbhayāpi kāntādhīnā hi śasyate ||53||
arthāturāyā dharmo na kāmukāyā bhayaṃ na ca |
cintāturāyāḥ saukhyaṃ na vadhūstāni vivarjayet ||54||
preṣyāyāśca daridrāyāḥ puṃścalyāśca sukhaṃ kutaḥ |
ṛṇavatyā vyādhitāyā vandhyāyāśca sukhaṃ kutaḥ ||55|||
sthānasthitāyāḥ padmāyā mitre varuṇabhāskarau |
sthānacyutāyāstasyāstau kleśaśoṣaṇakārakau ||56||
sthāne sthitāḥ supūjyante nāryo’pi bālakā api |
sthānabhraṣṭā na pūjyante keśā dantā nakhā nṛpāḥ ||57||
anṛṇāyāḥ sukhā nidrā nirbhayāyāḥ sukhā tathā |
avyādhyāśca sukhā nidrā sannayāsinyāḥ sukhā tathā ||58||
asaṃgatāyāḥ puṃsā ca saṃgatāyāśca śārṅgiṇā |
vitṛṣṇāyāḥ sukhā nidrā vadhvā vāpyanyayoṣitām ||59||
jalayogena kamalaṃ samucchrāyaṃ labhed yathā |
balavatsvāminā bhāryā mahatpadaṃ labhettathā ||3.43.6 0||
ācāreṇa kulasyātra deśasya bhāṣaṇena tu |
snehasya cakṣuṣā mūlyaṃ vapuṣā bhojanasya ca ||61 ||
abdhau vṛṣṭerna vai mūlyaṃ tṛpte ca bhojanasya na |
samṛddhe naiva dānasya nīce puṇyasya naiva ca ||62||
dūragatasya hṛdaye snehena vāsa ucyate |
samīpasthasya vaireṇa dūravāsaḥ samucyate ||63 ||
kadaryatvaṃ svaro dīno gātradāridryamūrjitam |
kṛpaṇatvaṃ bhayaṃ ceti cihnāni yācanārthinām ||64||
mahān viṣṇurhi bhagavān yācamāno hi vāmanaḥ |
jāyate tarhi kā cānyārthinī yāti na lāghavam ||65||
vidyādhanaṃ sadā prārjyaṃ sādhutādāyinī satī |
priyākarī gauravasya pradā duḥkhavināśinī ||66||
paramā devatā vidyā divyajñānasya śevadhiḥ |
vadhūrvidyā samā bodhyā gṛhasampatprasādhinī ||67||
sarvadravyāṇi bāhyāni nāśabhītimayāni vai |
ātmadravyaṃ hi vidyāste nāśabhītivivarjitam ||68||
ātmavidyāvatī bhāryā tīrtharūpā na saṃśayaḥ |
tīrthabhuvaḥ sutāḥ putryaḥ pāvanā mokṣabhāginaḥ ||69||
tīrthayogavataḥ puṃsaḥ patyurmokṣo bhavedapi |
tīrthapāvanavastūnāṃ bhoktāraśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||3.43.70||
yānti mokṣapadaṃ bhāryātīrthapuṇyena pāvitāḥ |
yasya bhāryā mahāsādhvī sādhuvrataparāyaṇā ||7 1||
dharmācāraparā nityaṃ vadhūḥ patiparāyaṇā |
supuṇyāṅgī suputrā ca maṃgalārhā ṛtaṃvadā ||72||
śuddhā priyakarī priyavratā patiniṣeviṇī |
jñātrī guṇavatī kathāśrāviṇī bahutāpasī ||73 ||
nityaṃ vai dharmataḥ patnī sahapuṇyakarā śubhā |
patimārgaṃ prayātā ca patidevamakhānvitā ||74||
sadbhāvācca patiṃ naiva dūrayatyeva yā priyā |
yathā chāyā tathābhinnavratadharmaparāyaṇā ||75||
nārīṇāṃ mokṣade pātivratye vrate sthitā sadā |
puṇyā strī yasya bhavati sa vai brahmamayaḥ patiḥ ||76||
savyaṃ pādaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma svapatyurhi yā satī |
manute dakṣapādaṃ ca parabrahmātmakaṃ sadā ||77||
tatpādodakasaṃsnātā brāhmī bhavati bhāminī |
sarvatīrthasamā sarvatīrthavāsā hi sā matā ||78||
makhānāṃ yajanāt puṇyaṃ yādṛśaṃ samprajāyate |
tato’dhikaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ pātivratyena jāyate ||79||
nāsti nāryāḥ pṛthag dharmaḥ patyuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ vinā |
tasmāt kāntasahāyā sā sarvadā sukhadāyinī ||3.43.80 ||
puṇyā puṇyatamā sādhvī viśiṣyate jagattraye |
sā na tyājyā bhavet kvāpi loke’trāpi paratra ca ||81||
yena bhāryā parityaktā sunītā dharmacāriṇī |
daśāṃgadharmastenāpi parityakto bhavediha ||82||
bhartā yāti yadā grāmāntaraṃ tadā tu vai satī |
bhūmau śayanakartrī syācchṛṃgāraṃ na karotyapi ||83||
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ payaḥ pānaṃ dadhi miṣṭaṃ na khādati |
tāmbūlaṃ madhu miṣṭānnaṃ naiva khādati vai satī ||84||
ekaveṇīdharā caikakañcukīvastradhāriṇī |
viyoge cāsamarthā saṃpratīkṣate tadāgamam ||85||
sambandhaḥ puṇyayogena jāyate patinā saha |
nārīṇāṃ hi sadā tīrthaṃ bhartā so’pi striyāstathā ||86||
mithaścāvāhayennityaṃ vācā kāyena karmabhiḥ |
manasā pūjayennityaṃ satyabhāvena vai mithaḥ ||87||
dakṣāṃgaṃ cāpi vāmāṃgaṃ sadā tīrthadvayaṃ hyubhe |
tārayatyeva satataṃ kuṭumbaṃ śatamekakam ||88||
susukhaṃ putrasaubhāgyaṃ sampatsaubhāgyamityapi |
rūpaṃ tejo yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ bhartuḥ striyāḥ prasādataḥ ||89||
nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ bhartuḥ sampat tu sā matā |
tuṣṭe bhartari saṃsāre lokāḥ sarve striyāḥ śubhāḥ ||3.43.90||
patihīnā surūpāpi sampadbhiḥ saṃbhṛtā api |
kutastasyāḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ sutādayaḥ ||91||
durbhāgyaṃ ca mahāduḥkhaṃ pāpā bhuṃkte patiṃ vinā |
tuṣṭe bhartari devādyā ṛṣayo mānavāḥ surāḥ ||92||
pitaraścāpi tuṣṭāḥ syurubhalokasukhapradāḥ |
bhartā nātho gururbhartā devatā daivataiḥ saha || 93||
bhartā tīrthaṃ cā puṇyaṃ ca vadhūnāṃ bhāgyagauravam |
śṛṃgāro bhūṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ varṇasaugandhyamityapi ||94||
patiḥ svargaṃ patirdharmaḥ patiḥ saubhāgyameva ca |
patirvaṃśaḥ patiḥ śobhā vadhūstathā patiṃ prati |||95|||
vinā dharmaṃ vinā bhāryāṃ vinā ca svāminaṃ śubham |
gṛhaṃ vanāyate cāpi śmaśānāyata eva ca ||96 ||
vadhūḥ pativratā yatra patnīvrataḥ patistathā |
sampat snehaśca yatrāsti brahmabhaktiśca yatra vai ||97||
yatra devārhaṇaṃ nityaṃ strīsammānaṃ ca yatra ca |
yatra kanyārakṣaṇaṃ ca yatra mātṛprasevanam ||98||
yatra bālā modate ca yatra nārī pramodate |
yatra vai hṛdayaṃ nāryāḥ phullitaṃ sampramodate ||99||
tatra svargaṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ sampado brahmalokatā |
tasmāllakṣmi brahmapriyā bhavantu śīlatatparāḥ || 3.43.10 0||
matparāḥ sarvadā satyaḥ sadācāraparāyaṇāḥ |
saddharmaparamā nityaṃ devārhaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 101 ||
pātivratyaparā hārivratyaparāśca sarvathā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ sadā || 1 02||
vadhvo mama priyāḥ sarvā gṛhṇantvānandaśevadhim |
bhavatīnāṃ sukhaiḥ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ me śāśvataṃ yataḥ || 103 ||
vadhūdharmāḥ khaḍgadhārasamāḥ santi priyāsthitāḥ |
tān prarakṣya sthitā yūyaṃ madātmikā bhaviṣyatha || 104||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ vadhūpālyācārādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||

<3.44>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śubhām |
vedāyano maharṣiḥ svāṃ bhāryāmakathayat purā || 1 ||
śreṣṭhatamaṃ pravakṣyāmi pātivratyamanuttamam |
vācā sumanasā caiva karmaṇā śṛṇu bhāmini || 2 ||
āgrāyaṇe śṛṇu dharmān vadhvāḥ śreyaskarān mudā |
śuśrūṣāṃ kurute bhartuḥ pratyahaṃ svīyabhāvanaiḥ || 3 ||
kruddhaṃ ca nirdhanaṃ vāpi na tyajet taṃ pativratā |
tasya doṣaṃ na gṛhṇāti tāḍitāpi pratuṣyati || 4 ||
bhartuḥ karmasu sarveṣu puratastiṣṭhate sadā |
kuṣṭhinaṃ vṛndalaṃ vāpi kāntaṃ yā sevate satī || 5 ||
patyulaukaṃ prayātyeva prasādāt svāminaḥ śubham |
patitaṃ vyādhitaṃ kubjaṃ vikalaṃ rogiṇaṃ ca vā || 6 ||
ṣaṇḍhaṃ dharmavihīnaṃ pātakinaṃ vyasanānvitam |
api nāthaṃ tyajennaiva vadhūḥ śreyo yadīcchati || 7 ||
kāntaṃ tyaktvā vrajedanyatkāryārthaṃ snehavarjitā |
sā patyuḥ śāpamāsādya puṃścalītvamavāpnuyāt || 8 ||
gate bhartari śṛṃgāraṃ laulyaṃ ca sevate yadi |
sā tu kāmasya vegena bhraṣṭā bhavejjanāntarāt || 9 ||
yā patiṃ svaṃ parityajya piturgehe vaset sadā |
vidhihīnā dharmahīnā sā nārī śāsanārhaṇā || 3.44.1 0||
gārhasthyaṃ hi parityajya yāṭate’nyatra veśmani |
sā na bhavati sampūrṇā patidevā hyabhāginī || 11 ||
bhartāraṃ ca parityajya mahodyānādivartinī |
śṛṃgārabhūṣāveṣāḍhyā nirghṛṇā sā tu pāpinī || 12||
bhavati puṃścalī nāma yayā tyaktaḥ svakaḥ patiḥ |
pṛthakśayyā vadhūḥ proktā puṃścalī dharmavarjitā || 13||
cakṣurhīnā dharmanetravihīnā pativarjitā |
sarvasthāne patirhyeko bhāryāyā dharmadhṛṅnaraḥ || 14||
piturgehe sthitā kanyā ciraṃ nāśaṃ prayāti sā |
patyurgehe sthitā kāntā ciramāyuṣyamṛcchati || 15||
pativratā mahābhāgā sarvatīrthamayī satī |
devī sarvamayī nityā sarvadharmamayo hi sā || 16||
asadgatiṃ gatāyai ca yasyai kasyaicidapyatha |
dadātyekadinasyāpi puṇyaṃ pativratodbhavam || 17||
piśācinyā bhavenmokṣaḥ pāpaśāntirbhavettathā |
śarīraṃ śīryate’vaśyaṃ pātivratyamupārjayet || 18||
piṃgalā śṛṃgalī nāma dvau kṛmīkarṇamūlayoḥ |
capalaḥ pippalaścaiva dvāvetau nāsikāgrayoḥ || 1 9||
bhṛṃgalī jaṃgalī caito netrayorāntarasthitau |
kṛmayo vai tathā santi sarvāṃgeṣu navā navāḥ ||3.44.20||
taiśca saṃbhakṣyate dehaḥ patidharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
vadhvā vicārya sādhyo’to dharmaḥ pativratātmakaḥ ||21||
tejaḥprabhāvo hyatulaḥ satīnāṃ patidaivataḥ |
dhātā soḍhuṃ samartho na na sūryo na ca pāvakaḥ ||22||
satkārayogyāḥ satyaśca satītvaṃ pūjyate sadā |
kṣamā śāntirbrahmacaryaṃ dayā damaśca sauhṛdam ||23||
prajñā santoṣa aiśvaryamārjavaṃ śuddhatā tathā |
siddhayaḥ kalpalatikāḥ satyā dehe vasanti hi ||24||
guravaḥ pitaraścāpi viṣṇurlakṣmyā samanvitaḥ |
haraśca satyā sahitaḥ sāvitryā saha viśvasṛṭ ||25||
satīgehaṃ samāyānti devāścāgnipurogamāḥ |
mokṣamārgasthitāyāṃ vai yoṣiti gṛhayoṣiti || 26 ||
jñānaudāryasthitāyāṃ ca satīṣu dharmavatsvapi |
sādhuṣvapi gṛhastheṣu nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ || 27||
bhaktasyāpi kuṭumbasya gṛhe vasāmi mādhavaḥ |
samarthāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yatra tatra vasāmi ca || 28 ||
satīgṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ me vai brahmapriyāyutasya ha |
sañcarāmi sadā gehe pātivratyādiśobhite || 29||
īśvarāḥ svāminaḥ sarve darśanārthaṃ prayāntyapi |
pativratāgṛhaṃ yatra nivasāmi narāyaṇi || 3.44.30 ||
rūpasaubhāgyaśṛṅgārasukhaṃ sampattirityapi |
nārīṇāṃ sarvathā kānte sarvasvaṃ śobhate’niśam || 31 ||
kāntā kāntena riktā na tyaktavyā vai kadācana |
tyāgakartā doṣabhāk syāt satīdharmasya lopakṛt || 32||
vinītāṃ vimalāṃ puṇyāṃ vadhūṃ tyaktvā prayāti yaḥ |
tasya puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vṛthā vadhūvilāpanāt || 33 ||
dharmācāraparāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāryāṃ tyaktvā prayāti yaḥ |
sādhvīṃ suguṇāṃ vatsāṃ sa dharmaphalaṃ na vindati || 34||
sarvācāraparā sādhvī puṇyapuñjārjane ratā |
satīvrataratā sevāratā vijñā vinodinī || 35||
jñānaguṇā bhavedbhāryā yasya bhaktimatī śubhā |
mahāsatī ca tadgehe devāstiṣṭhanti sarvadā || 36 ||
pitarastādṛśaṃ putraṃ vadhūṃ cecchanti sarvathā |
puṇyā satī vadhūrgehe vartate satyaśālinī || 37 ||
tatra yajñāśca devāśca tīrthāni puṇyadāni ca |
kāmadughāḥ kalpalatāstatra vasanti sarvadā || 38 ||
tatra sarvāṇi puṇyāni tīrthāni sarito nadāḥ |
tatra lakṣmyo nivasanti sampadaśca vasantyapi || 39 ||
bhāryātīrthe sarvapuṇyaśīlāstiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ |
bhāryāyogena patyuśca pādau tīrthasvarūpiṇau ||3.44.40 ||
satībhāryānivāsena sugārhasthyaṃ sudaivatam |
sarvayajñamayaṃ syādvai sarvavratārthasampradam ||4 1 ||
gṛhasthasya gṛhaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāryā puṇyā pativratā |
yatra tatra pravartante sarve dharmā sanātanāḥ ||42||
dānācārāḥ pravartante utsavāśca mahāsukhāḥ |
bhāryāhīnaṃ vanaṃ vyāghrākulitaṃ duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam ||43 ||
nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasādhanamuttamam |
vane grāme’pyaraṇye vā satītīrthaṃ hi mokṣadam ||44||
nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ sukham|
nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ jñānaṃ tāraṇāya hitāya ca ||41||
dharmabhāryāṃ satīṃ tyaktvā yo’nyatra kurute matim |
gṛhadharmaṃ parityajya phalaṃ kvāsya bhavennanu ||46||
patnīṃ vinā yadā tīrthe śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ śubham |
sarvaṃ prayāti viphalaṃ tasmād vadhūṃ na saṃtyajet ||47||
yathāmṛtapradānena pitṛtṛptiḥ prajāyate |
bhāryādattena piṇḍena tathā tṛptiḥ prajāyate ||48||
gārhasthyasya tu dharmasya bhāryā bhavati svāminī |
tayā vinārpitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ jāyate hi tat ||49||
bhāryā pacati caivānnaṃ svahastenāmṛtopamam |
tadannameva bhuñjanti pitaro hṛṣṭamānasā ||3.44.50 ||
tenaiva tṛptimāyānti santuṣṭāśca bhavanti te |
tasmād bhāryā vinā dharmaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ na siddhyati ||5 1 ||
bhāryā satī vadhūrnityaṃ dharmaṃ sādhayati dhruvam |
yajñāḥ siddhiṃ na cāyānti gṛhiṇīrahite gṛhe ||52||
satyadharmamukhāḥ puṇyā jñānādyāḥ prabalāḥ sutā |
dharmasya te sahāyā vai satīṃ rakṣanti sarvathā ||13||
satī rakṣāparā cāste damaśāntiparāyaṇā |
na tāṃ jetuṃ samartho vai kālo vā yama eva vā ||54||
bhartrā vinā satīṃ kaścinnirīkṣeta yadā janaḥ |
satīnetrāgninā so’pi bhasmībhūto bhavet khalu ||55||
yatra satī mahābhāgā vadhūrvai sarvamaṃgalā |
tasyāḥ satyena santuṣṭā devā varaṃ dadatyapi ||56||
satīṃ yāntīṃ cābhiyanti vahnayo devatā api |
gṛhadevā abhiyanti vanadevyo’bhiyanti ca ||57||
satīṃ yāntīṃ jale snātuṃ jaladevyo’bhiyanti ca |
satīṃ yāntīṃ tīrthayātrāṃ tīrthāni cābhiyantyapi ||58||
satīṃ yāntīṃ devagṛhaṃ devāttāmabhiyanti ca |
satīṃ yāntīṃ vāṭikāyāṃ kṣetradevyo’bhiyanti tām ||59||
satīṃ yāntī yajñabhūmiṃ makhadevyo’bhiyanti tām |
satīṃ yāntīṃ pravāsaṃ ca pṛthvī yāti satīmanu ||3.44.6 0||
satīṃ snāntīṃ prasevante pitryo devyo jalārthikāḥ |
satītanvā jalaṃ tāśca pibanti vastrapīḍitam ||6 1 ||
vadhūryā modate pātivratyena svagṛhe sadā |
svarge’pi tatsukhaṃ nāsti siddhilabhyaṃ satīsukham ||62||
siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca sevante vai pativratām |
satīcchāḥ pūrṇatāṃ yānti yathātathāpi kalpitāḥ ||63 ||
viṣṇurbrahmā haraścendraḥ sūryaścandro yamo guruḥ |
satīṃ namanti sādhvīṃ ca pūjayanti satīṃ ca te ||64||
nijapatnīṃ satīṃ sarve devā icchanti sarvathā |
rājāno’pi diśāṃ pālā bibhyati strīsatībalāt ||65||
satyaṃ vrataṃ bhaved yatra satī sā sarvathā matā |
patyurvrataṃ bhaved yatra satī sā tu pativratā ||66||
brahmavratavatī yā sā satī brāhmī pativratā |
mama caikāntikā yā sā satī śrīpuruṣottamī ||67||
bahupuṇyena labhyo’haṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
śatajanmaśīlakośānmama prāptirbhavediha ||68|||
satīsaṃkalpamātreṇa rogā dūraṃ prayānti ca |
vighnā dūraṃ prayāntyeva gaṇeśo’pi bibheti vai ||69||
yamarājo bhayaṃ caiti kālo gacchati dūrataḥ |
mātaraśca prasannāḥ syuryatra gehe pativratā ||3.44.70||
caṇḍyādyāḥ śāntimāsādya rakṣanti tāḥ satīgṛham |
bālagrahā na cāyānti sīmni satīgṛhasya vai ||71 ||
mārīrogāśca mantrāśca mohabhrāntikarā api |
uccāṭanādyā bhīṃ prāpya varjayanti satīgṛham ||72||
hanumān brahmaśīlo’pi senānīḥ śīlavānapi |
brahmacaryākhyapuruṣaḥ satīṃ namanti dūrataḥ ||73||
vidyudvṛṣṭisamudrāṇāmutpātā bhīṃ prayānti ca |
satīvākyena santo’pi svānurodhaṃ jahatyapi ||74||
pativratāyā vadhvāśca sannidhau ceśvarā api |
parājayaṃ kvacit prāpya satyājñāṃ mānayanti ca ||75||
satīkopena sarpādyāḥ saviṣā yānti bhasmatām |
parvatādyā vilīyante śuṣkāyante’bdhayo’pi ca ||76||
grahā gatiṃ vihāyaiva stabdhā bhavanti daṇḍitāḥ |
kāmādyā mānasā devā layaṃ yānti satībalāt ||77||
vāsanā bhavadā satyāśīrvādena pradahyati |
mahāmāyāvilayaśca jāyate tu satīcchayā ||78||
avagrahaḥ satīkopād vṛṣṭiḥ satīprarañjanāt |
vaṃśarekhā satīśāpānnaśyatyapi jagatsu ca ||79||
satīcchayā navaṃ sarvaṃ jagatpunaḥ prajāyate |
yatra satī vadhūścāste tatrāhaṃ bhagavān svayam ||3.44.80||
virāje dhāmasahito muktādisahitastathā |
virāje pārṣadairyukto virāje dharmasaṃyutaḥ ||81||
virāje bhaktiyuktaśca śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
virāje sampadā yuktaḥ pratyakṣo’haṃ satīgṛhe ||82||
satī sādhvī brahmaparā bhaktā nārāyaṇī hi sā |
pativratā sāttvatī sā mahābhāgavatī matā ||8 3 ||
saccidānandasaṃjño’haṃ nivasāmi satīgṛhe |
tadvaṃśe prakaṭīsaṃbhavāmi cāpi satīcchayā ||84||
prasanno’haṃ sadā bhaktavatsalaḥ śrīsatīgṛhe |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhagavān svayam ||85||
paripūrṇatamaścāsmi tatra kṣatirna vidyate |
nyūnatā naiva bhavati saṃśayo na bhavatyapi || 86 ||
tasya vai saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ gṛhamityapi |
saphalo vaṃśavistāro yasya gehe hariḥ satī || 87||
dharmastasyāpi saphalo kriyāśca saphalāḥ sadā |
prayāsāḥ saphalāḥ sarve yasya gehe hariḥ satī ||88 ||
sadānandāśca kuśalaṃ svāsthyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tathā |
yatra sādhvyo harirdharmo yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ surāḥ ||89 ||
tatra yato bhavet siddhiḥ laukikī pāralaukikī |
yatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitā sādhvī santastatra hariḥ svayam || 3.44.90 ||
kṛtaṃ tena paraṃ puṇyaṃ pūrvajanmani cātulam |
yena prāptā satī bhāryā hariḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 91 ||
satīṃ draṣṭuṃ mukhyadevāḥ santaścāyānti nityaśaḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ gṛhaṃ me śivasaṃjñike || 92 ||
tasmāt paraṃ hi sukṛtaṃ deśasyāsya pravartate |
yatra satyo mama patnyo bhavanti koṭiśo’rbudāḥ | | 93 ||
tvayā nibhālitā lakṣmi svatulyāśca madātmikāḥ |
paripūrṇatamaścāhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ || 94||
vadhūbhiḥ saha saṃrāje divye surāṣṭrake sthale |
ākṣare mama satkṣetre divye kuṃkumanāmake || 95||
sṛṣṭidhāmādhipaścāhaṃ tava bhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ |
lakṣmi vasāmi te’gre ca svavaśastava mandire || 96 ||
aho brahmapriyāḥ sarvā rasaṃ gṛhṇanti me hareḥ |
kṛpayānandasandohaṃ pibanti mama cāmṛtam || 97||
yūyaṃ brahmapriyāḥ parabrahmarūpā madātmikāḥ |
mama dharmaparāḥ santu kalyāṇadā hi yoṣitām || 98 ||
dhanyā kuṃkumavāpīyaṃ dhanyaṃ vyāghravanaṃ tvidam |
dhanyaṃ cāśvasaraścāpi dhanyā bhūśca surāṣṭrikā || 99 ||
dhanyo deśaḥ prajāścāpi vṛkṣāśca vallikāstathā |
dhanyāstṛṇastambavṛkṣāḥ paśavo narayoṣitaḥ | | 3.44.100 ||
dhanyaścāpi samayo’yaṃ dhanyāśca jantavo’pi ca |
yeṣāṃ me śrīhareryogaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe’tra jāyate || 101 ||
yatra dharmaḥ kuṭumbāḍhyo vartate śāśvataḥ sukhaḥ |
yatra muktistathā bhaktiḥ prītiśca santi vai dhruvāḥ || 1 02||
evaṃ matvā narā nāryo dhanyamātmānameva ye |
smariṣyanti satīdharmāste’pi yāsyanti dhāma me || 1 03||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya satīdharmasya vācanāt |
pālanādapi muktiśca siddhiścāpi bhaved dhruvā || 1 04||
vaṃśaḥ sampad yaśo mānaṃ cārogyaṃ ca prabhāvitā |
prabhūtā ceśvarabhāvo bhavantyasya vicāraṇāt || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ satīsatyasāmarthyanirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||

<3.45>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
devadeva kṛpāsindho puruṣottama mādhava |
nirguṇo bhaktiyogaste satyā kāryaḥ kathaṃ tvayi || 1 ||
śrotumicchāmi lokānāṃ hitārthaṃ sarvayoṣitām |
brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhirasmābhiḥ kārya eva yaḥ || 2 ||
tathānyābhiśca yoṣidbhirnaraiścāpi kṛto bhavet |
yathā tathākarṇayituṃ samyagicchāmi tadvada || 3 ||
etāḥ sarvāḥ svasāro me koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ |
śrotumicchanti kāntāstāḥ preritāstābhiratra ha |
pṛcchāmi nirguṇaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tava vadātra naḥ || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
guṇavanti hi karmāṇi saphalāni bhavanti vai |
tānyeva mayi saṃtyaktaphalāni nirguṇāni vai || 5 ||
phalākāṃkṣāyutaṃ karma bandhakṛjjāyate priye |
aphalecchāyutaṃ karma mokṣadaṃ samprajāyate || 6 ||
sāttvikāḥ sattvakarmāṇi kṛtvā yānti divaṃ janāḥ |
rājasā naraloke ca kṛtvā rājasasatkriyāḥ || 7 ||
tāmasāḥ kalmaṣalokān yānti tamolayā janāḥ |
nirguṇaṃ māṃ tu samprāpya mamākṣaraṃ prayānti vai || 8 ||
pañcāgnayo vanevāsā niṣkalmaṣā janāḥ priye |
lokaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ te prayānti phalabhāginaḥ || 9 ||
sanyāsāśramavāsāśca daṇḍādidhāriṇastathā |
jitendriyamanodharmāḥ satyalokaṃ prayānti te || 3.45.10||
aṣṭāṃgayogasampannāḥ svavaśā ūrdhvaretasaḥ |
maharlokaṃ janalokaṃ prayānti gatakalmaṣāḥ ||1 1||
yājñikā yajamānāśca prayāntīndrapadaṃ ciram |
dātāro yānti somasya lokaṃ cāmṛtavarṣiṇam || 12||
vratinastu prayāntyeva sūryalokaṃ sutejasaḥ |
tairthikā vahnilokaṃ cojjvalaṃ prayānti puṇyataḥ || 13||
satyavratāstathā yānti vāruṇaṃ lokamuttamam |
viṣṇubhaktiyutā yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpunarbhavam || 14||
śaṃbhubhaktiyutā yānti nityakailāsamūrdhvagam |
pitṝṇāṃ yājinaḥ putrasukhaiśvaryādivāñcchayā || 15||
dakṣiṇena pathāryamṇā pitṛlokaṃ prayānti te |
smṛtidharmaparāḥ svargaṃ prayānti puṇyakāriṇaḥ || 16||
pañcadevaprapūjāḍhyā divaṃ prayānti daivikam |
prajāpatiyajo yānti dakṣādīṃśca prajāpatīn || 17||
bhūtayajñakarā yānti bhūtāni vividhāni ca |
bhvāditattvopāsakāścāvaraṇeṣu vrajanti vai || 18||
yakṣalokām̐stathā yānti kauberayakṣayājinaḥ |
īśvarāṇāṃ ca yajvāno yāntīśvarapadāni te || 19||
tāpasā badarīṃ yānti śvetadvīpaṃ tu sādhavaḥ |
brahmavratāstu vairājān lokān yānti praśīlinām ||3.45.20||
sādhvyaḥ satīnāṃ lokāṃśca prayānti sūryavarcasaḥ |
lakṣmīlokām̐stathā yānti śrīlokān dharmayoṣitaḥ ||21||
pativratā harerlokān patilokān prayānti ca |
brahmacāriṇya evāpi lokām̐stu brahmacāriṇām ||22||
gaṇikā gaṇalokām̐śca prayānti karmavedinām |
īśabhaktā īśalokān prāṇabhaktā marutsthalīm ||23||
āsurā nirṛtalokān yamalokām̐stu pāpinaḥ |
ārṣāṃllokān saṃyamino yanti tapojanādikān ||24||
vedavidyāratā yānti satyalokaṃ virāgiṇaḥ |
tyāgino yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalāvṛttyūrdhvasaṃsthitam ||25||
aiśvaryayājakā yānti siddhilokān suyoṣitām |
dravyadā vasulokām̐śca bhasmino rudramandiram ||26||
pañcāgnitāpasā yānti cādityamaṇḍalaṃ janāḥ |
kāminaścāndralokaṃ ca śītadānaparāyaṇāḥ ||27||
krūkarmakarā yānti rākṣasānāṃ gṛhāṇi tu |
vāsanāvanta evāpi yānti piśācayoniṣu ||28||
dīpadānādikartāraḥ prayānti vahnimaṇḍalam |
smṛddhidā yānti vai svargaṃ nākṣatraṃ suvilāsavat ||29||
vāṭikākṣetradātāro yānti samrāṭpadaṃ kṣitau |
vidyāvantastathā sārasvataṃ padaṃ prayānti ca ||3.45.30||
dharmasya nāśakā yānti dāruṇaṃ dānavaṃ padam |
adharmiṇo bhavantyeva daityā udvegaśālinaḥ ||3 1||
kruddhāśca krūrakarmāṇo nāgāḥ sarpā bhavanti ca |
jalahānikarā yānti yādasāṃ yonisaṃbhavān ||32||
punarāvartinaḥ sarve lokāḥ satyāntino matāḥ |
karmaṇāṃ sanimittānāṃ mārgo gatāgatātmakaḥ ||33||
tāvanmodaḥ pramodaśca yāvatpuṇyaṃ pravidyate |
kṣīṇe puṇye samāyāti nimnalokaṃ hi kālataḥ ||34||
tasmāllakṣmi kṛtaṃ karmārpaṇīya parameśvare |
karmaphalasya saṃtyāgānnirguṇaṃ jāyate mayi ||35||
bhaktā niṣkāraṇā bhūtvā jñānavairāgyasaṃyutā |
premabhaktyā yutā kṛṣṇaharibhaktajanapriyā ||36||
bhaja me caraṇau haṃsasevitaṃ nirbhayaṃ priye |
mṛtyuryatra na sabalastaṃ māṃ bhaja priye sadā ||37||
bhaktiyogo dvidhā lakṣmi saguṇaścāpi nirguṇaḥ |
saguṇo’sti bahudhā vai nirguṇastvekadhā mataḥ ||38||
bhāvo vibhidyate strīṇāṃ guṇayukto hi sarvadā |
guṇatrikād bhavantyeva bhaktāstribhedaśobhanāḥ ||39||
hiṃsāṃ dambhaṃ ca mātsaryaṃ kapaṭaṃ svārthaśālitām |
ālambya kurute bhāvaṃ kruddhā sā tāmasī matā ||3.45.40||
yaśa aiśvaryaviṣayānabhisandhāya yatnataḥ |
arcayenmāṃ śivarājñi rājasī sā prakīrtitā ||41||
kartavyamiti matvā yā karoti rāgavarjitā |
mokṣārthaṃ bhajate māṃ sā sāttvikī sevikā smṛtā ||42||
duḥkhī svārthī vivekī ca maniṣī bhajate tu mām |
puṇyapātrāṇi vai nāryo nimittena bhajanti mām ||43||
snehena mama bhaktāśca māṃ bhajanti sadā sukhāḥ |
guṇairdoṣaiścāpare’pi māṃ bhajanti smaranti ca ||44||
nirguṇaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tu kurvanti mayi sādhavaḥ |
sādhvyaśca rāgaśūnyā yāstā bhajanti hariṃ varam ||45||
paripūrṇatame sarvakāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇe |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkāntavallabhe ||46||
premagatiravicchinnākhaṇḍitāhetukī śubhā |
sā bhaktirnirguṇā divyā mayi prasannatāphalā || 47||
yaḥ sneho duḥkhanāśārtho na svārtho na nirarthakaḥ |
hareḥ prasannatālabhyastadvatī nirguṇā matā ||48||
bhaktiryathā nirguṇāsti dāsī tathā ca nirguṇā |
nisargapremadhārā yaṃ prati śrīpuruṣottamam ||49||
vahati premarūpā sā nirguṇā mayi yojitā |
ānandātma phalaṃ tṛptiḥ śāśvatī phalamityapi ||3.45.50||
praphullatā phalaṃ samutsāhaḥ phalaṃ pramodanam |
aho aho sthitiryā ca sudhāmiṣṭā viśāradī ||51 ||
pīyūṣarasadātrī ca nirguṇāyāḥ phalaṃ matam |
navavadhvā yuvatyāśca vivāhottarameva yat ||52||
svakāntasaṃgamecchāyā yathā dhārā pravartate |
navānandaḥ pramodaśca praphullatā prasannatā ||53 ||
snehabharaḥ sutṛptiśca santoṣo nirvṛttistathā |
miṣṭaṃ suṣṭhu samastaṃ vai yathā vadhvāḥ prabhāsate ||54||
tathā bhaktimatīnāryā mayi sarvaṃ prabhāsate |
saiṣā vedaprasūrvidyā nirguṇā matsvarūpiṇī ||55||
naiṣā madvyatirekeṇa kvacit kutrāpi jāyate |
saiṣā bhāgavatī vidyā śāśvatī puruṣottamī ||56||
saiṣā prasannatālabhyā mamāntare nivāsataḥ |
nānyasādhanalabhyā vai nirguṇā nirguṇaṃ vinā ||57||
nṛpasneho nṛpakṛpāṃ vinā bhṛtyasya nāsti vai |
tathā mama kṛpāṃ hitvā yogo’yaṃ naiva jāyate ||58||
lakṣaṇaṃ nirguṇānāṃ me bhaktānāṃ śṛṇu padmaje |
ākṣaraṃ cāpi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ śvetabhūtalam ||59||
kṣīrasthānaṃ badrikāṃ vā pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ ca vā |
avyākṛtaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca lakṣmīlokaṃ prakuṇṭhakam |
vairājaṃ veśvarāṇāṃ ca sthānāni vividhānyapi ||3.45.60||
śakradhiṣṇyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ rasādhipatyamityapi |
dikpālatvaṃ yāmyabhāvaṃ yogarddhiṃ vaiśvarottamam ||6 1 ||
camatkārām̐stathā siddhīraiśvaryāṇi mahāntyapi |
nābhilaṣanti ye bhaktā mama pādaprasevakāḥ ||62||
dīyamānaṃ mayā lakṣmi sālokyaṃ cāpi vottamam |
na gṛhṇanti kadācitte matsevānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||63||
sāmīpyaṃ cāpi necchanti premṇa aunyāt kṣateḥ khalu |
viraho’pi saṃgavighnaḥ sparśavighno mahān hi saḥ ||64||
sannikṛṣṭe tu yatprema dūratvaṃ labhate kvacit |
tasmānmatsaṃgataulye na sānnidhyaṃ vartate kvacit ||65||
athāpi dīyamānaṃ ca sārūpyaṃ mānasaṃbhṛtam |
gṛhṇanti naiva bhaktā me samānatvābhimānataḥ ||66||
dāsye samānatā vighno nairapekṣyaṃ ca vighnatā |
mama sevotsukāstasmānna gṛhṇanti sarūpatām ||67||
athaikatvaṃ dīyamānaṃ naiva vāñcchanti māmakāḥ |
dravībhāve vilīnībhāve caikatvaṃ bhavet khalu ||68||
tathāsati kathaṃ saukhyaṃ svāmisevakasaṃbhavam |
dāsīlabhyaṃ sukhaṃ naiva kāntāddharerbhavennanu ||69||
amūrtabhāve tvekatvaṃ bhaktasya saṃbhavennanu |
satyevaṃ yogajaṃ saukhyaṃ mūrtermūrtau kathaṃ bhavet ||3.45.70 ||
sevāsukhaṃ na labhyeta necchatyekatvamityataḥ |
nirapekṣāśca śāntāśca samadarśanasaṃgatāḥ ||7 1 ||
kāntasukhānusukhinyo bhavanti nirguṇāḥ striyaḥ |
nairapekṣyaṃ mahāsaukhyaṃ nairapekṣā hariśritāḥ ||72||
sakāmāstu mahāsaukhyaṃ niṣkāmāyā vidanti na |
niṣkāmo bhaktiyogo vai bhavedātyantikaṃ padam ||73 ||
nirapekṣāḥ priyā nityaṃ māṃ bhajanti prakārakaiḥ |
smṛtyā saṃkīrtanenāpi śravaṇena ca sevayā ||74||
pūjayā vandanenāpi dāsyena sakhyakena ca |
ātmanivedanenāpi premṇā bhaktiṃ caranti ha ||75||
durlabhā bhaktimatyo me madbhāvabhāvanānvitāḥ |
mahatīnāṃ mānabhāvaṃ kurvantyaśca dayāṃ tathā ||76 ||
dīnāsvatha samānāsu maitrīṃ carantya eva yāḥ |
mama pādābjamadhupā mama saṃyogalālasāḥ ||77||
māṃ prasmaranti prāṇeśaṃ yathā proṣitabhartṛkāḥ |
mama smṛteḥ romaharṣo yāsāṃ svedaḥ prajāyate ||78||
ānandāśrukalāścāpi vaivarṇyaṃ premasaṃbhṛtam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇantya eva ca || 79||
divāniśaṃ mayi saktāstā vai bhāgavatītamāḥ |
manmānasyo maddhṛdayā mayyevāṅgasamarpaṇāḥ ||3.45.80||
mayyevānandabhoktryaśca mahābhāgavatītamāḥ |
bhuvi jale’nale vāyau gagane tārakāsu ca ||81 ||
vane’raṇye jaṃgameṣu paśyantyaḥ parameśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca praharṣitāḥ ||82||
vilokayantyaḥ kāminyo rudanti ca vadanti ca |
kvacinnandanti dhāvanti hasanti mārgayanti ca ||83||
gāyanti cāhvayantyugraṃ nṛtyanti ramayanti ca |
viharanti ca jalpanti paśyanti māṃ drumāntare ||84||
kvacittūṣṇīṃ bhavantyetā matsvarūpā madātmikāḥ |
kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛtārthāśca sarvānandapariplutāḥ ||85||
yāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa cānyā yānti kṛtārthatām |
divyā divyakriyā vadhvo divyarūpā hi tā yataḥ ||86||
śāśvatīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ vai na kālo na yamastathā |
na bhūmā na mahārudro daṇḍaṃ dātuṃ kṣamaḥ kvacit ||87||
yāsāṃ vāme gadā kaumudakī dakṣe sudarśanam |
agre śārṅgaṃ dhanuḥ paśce pāñcajanyastu kambukaḥ ||88||
nandakaśca mahākhaḍgaḥ śatacandraḥ purastathā |
iṣavaḥ paritaścāpi chatraṃ cordhve vyavasthitam ||89||
yaṣṭiśca pādayoścāpi pārśve tvaiśvaryakoṭayaḥ |
mūrtau ca siddhayaḥ sarvā mama rakṣanti tāḥ priyāḥ ||3.45.90||
ūrdhvaṃ chatraṃ mahāpadmaṃ chāyāṃ karoti śobhanām |
garuḍaḥ pakṣavātaiśca śramahartā bhavatyapi ||9 1||
yatra yatra gatāḥ satyastatra tatra hariḥ prabhuḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ vicarāmi ca ||92||
tīrthīkaromi bhūbhāgān śrīmatpādābjareṇubhiḥ |
kṣaṇaṃ yatra sthitāḥ satyastatra tīrthāni santi hi ||93||
pāpā mṛtā bhavettatra sāpi yāti parāṃ gatim |
kṛṣṇapriyā vīkṣya dūrānnādhayo vyādhayo’pi ca ||94||
bhūtapretapiśācādyā grahā vighnāśca rākṣasāḥ |
āsurā doṣabhāgāśca palāyante bhayānmama ||95||
nadyo nadāḥ parvatāśca prākārāḥ khātabhūmayaḥ |
gartāśca gahvarāścāpi samudrā vahnayastathā ||96||
mārgaṃ dadati sādhvībhyo nirapekṣābhya eva me |
sādhvīnāṃ jñānaniṣṭhānāṃ viraktānāṃ hi yoṣitām ||97||
madātmikānāṃ tāsāṃ vai pratibandho na kutracit |
śatajanmatapaḥpūtā puṇyapuñjasamanvitā ||98||
saṃgamāsāṃ sā labhate durlabhaṃ puṇyahānibhiḥ |
yatkule mama bhaktā vai jāyate brahmalakṣaṇā ||99||
tatkulaṃ vimalaṃ bodhyaṃ nikṛṣṭamapi cordhvagam |
lakṣmi me bhaktiyuktā tu sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā || 3.45.10 0||
pitṝn daśakulodbhūtānnijām̐śca patipakṣagān |
mātṛpakṣagatām̐ścāpi tāvataścoddharatyapi || 101 ||
api brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ samuddhartuṃ balānvitā |
nirayān pāpabandhām̐śca kṣeptuṃ śaktā tu sā matā || 1 02||
ye yāśca dehavatyo vai sambandhinaśca ye ca yāḥ |
bhṛtyādyāḥ suhṛdaścāpi karmacārāśca ye ca yāḥ || 1 03||
pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaścāpi jantavo maśakādayaḥ |
pipīlikāḥ pataṃgāśca kīṭāśca makṣikādikāḥ || 1 04||
mama bhaktā gṛhe ye yāsteṣāṃ tāsāṃ pramokṣaṇam |
bhavatyeva na sandeho makhatīrthavṛṣairvinā || 1 05||
sādhvīsaṃsargataste’pi tā yānti harimandiram |
maline’pi pradeśe vai bhaktā lokān punāti me || 1 06||
mayi kenāpi bhāvena mano lagnaṃ karoti yā |
yāti madrūpatāṃ sāpi mamābhyāsād yathā tathā ||1 07||
snehakāmabhayakrodhairaikyasauhārdamohanaiḥ |
bhūtvā manmayabhāvā tu yāti madbhavanaṃ satī ||1 08||
snehāt pitarau grāmyāśca kāmād brahmapriyāstathā |
bhayād daityā dānavāśca krodhād raṇāṃgaṇe bhaṭāḥ || 109||
aikyāt kuṭumbino’saṃkhyāḥ sauhārdād ṛṣayo’malāḥ |
mohānnāryaḥ koṭiśaśca bhūtvā manmayabhāvanāḥ || 3.45.11 0||
madrūpaguṇasāmarthyabhāvasaṃlagnamānasāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptā hi māṃ prabhum || 111 ||
tasmāt kenāpi bhāvena mano mayi niveśayet |
satataṃ smaraṇaṃ me syāt tena madbhāvamṛcchati || 11 2||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ nirguṇabhaktiyoganirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||

<3.46>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ viśeṣaṃ bhaktiyojanam |
na māṃ rodhayati khyātirmakho dharmastapo na ca || 1 ||
na yogo na viveko’pi na vratāni yamāstathā |
na tīrthāni ca chandāṃsi pūrtāni niyamā na ca || 2 ||
na dānaṃ dakṣiṇā neṣṭaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ kadācana |
khyātyādibhiḥ prāpyate yat prāpyate sarvameva tat || 3 ||
bhaktyā tu svalpayā lakṣmi bhakteḥ padaṃ tataḥ param |
naibhirbhaktipadaṃ labhyaṃ cāsamarthaiḥ pradhiṣṇyadaiḥ || 4 ||
uddhāriṇī mama bhaktirviśvapāpāddhi pāvanī |
uttāriṇī bhavābdheśca saṃhāriṇī ca karmaṇām || 5 ||
satkāriṇī śreyasāṃ ca dātrī hareḥ padasya ca |
vasantapañcamī bhaktajanānāṃ raṃgadāyinī || 6 ||
kalpalatā snehilānāṃ cintāmaṇistu kāminām |
vidyullatāndhabhaktānāṃ dīpikā śāstragāminām || 7 ||
dīpāvaliḥ sukṛtīnāmutsavī varaśālinām |
vijayā daśamī ceyaṃ jayināṃ damināṃ śubhā || 8 ||
naukā pāragatīcchūnāṃ vimānikāmbarārthinām |
tāpinī śītamagnānāṃ prāṇadājārditārthinām || 9 ||
jīvanī viṣadagdhānāṃ prāpikā śreyaicchatām|
niḥśreṇī cākṣaradhāmno mātā dīkṣāṃ pragṛhṇatām || 3.46.1 0||
bhaktirme nirguṇā vetradharā me yogadā sadā |
brahmadhāmapradā brahmānandadā cānivartinī || 11 ||
śrīḥ pārvatī kamalajā tulasī ca padmā
padmāvatī bhṛgusutāpi ca padminī ca |
rādhā ramā ca virajā ca sarasvatī ca
durgā ramā badarī padmaratī ca lakṣmīḥ || 12||
revā ratiśca lalitā ca jayā ca haṃsī
bhaktiśca mādhavasutā hyatha māṇikī ca |
nārāyaṇī ca suguṇeti ca mañjuleti
jāpāttaranti bhavasāgaramatra nāryaḥ ||13||
nārāyaṇo’kṣarapatiḥ puruṣottamaśca
kṛṣṇo hariśca parameśvara īśvareśaḥ |
svāmī prabhuḥ paramadhāmapatiḥ pareśaḥ
sarvāntarastha iha mānavarūpakṛṣṇaḥ || 14||
śyāmaḥ sitaḥ sakalabhaktapatirhṛdistho
brahmātigo’pi nijabhaktasamūhasaṃsthaḥ |
brahmapriyeśa iti me śubhanāmajāpā
tpāraṃ prayānti tu narā mama bhaktibhājaḥ || 15||
satsaṃgena bhavedeva bhaktyaṃkuraḥ supallavaḥ |
vardhate cātivegena satīsaṃgena siñcitaḥ || 16||
tasmāt satīprasaṃgaṃ vai dehena manasā girā |
kriyayā sevayā sarvārpaṇenāpi kriyāt sadā || 17||
sevāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmi gṛhī tarettathā |
sevayā māṃ parabrahma prāpnuyācchrīpatiṃ harim || 18||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparāyaṇam |
guruṃ santaṃ samāśritya siddhā bhavati mānuṣī || 1 9||
gurvī satīṃ samāśritya sādhvī bhavati mānuṣī |
mānavā vai guruṃ prāpya taranti tu bhavāmbudhim ||3.46.20||
mama dīkṣānvitaḥ syādvai guruścācāryasattamaḥ |
mama sevādhikārī ca sevādhikāriṇī ca vā ||21 ||
sevāvidhiṃ śikṣayedvai śrīkṛṣṇasya mama prabhoḥ |
uttarābhimukhaṃ ramyaṃ kārayenmama mandiram ||22||
sahasrakalaśāḍhyaṃ ca kalaśaikyena cādhikam |
tatra gajāsanaṃ proccaṃ sapīṭhaṃ kumbhamaṇḍitam ||23||
akṣarākhyaṃ saccidānandātmakaṃ svarṇanirmitam |
bahusopānaśobhaṃ ca maṇiratnādibhūṣitam ||24||
mahārharatnairācchannaṃ pṛṣṭhāmbaravirājitam |
āvaraṇāmbarāgraṃ ca tūlyāsanādiśobhitam ||25||
mṛdu pārśvakaśipvādisahitaṃ hemaśobhitam |
upabarhaṇasaṃyuktaṃ samullocādichāyitam ||26||
sacitrakuṇḍaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |
toraṇaiḥ rājitaṃ ramyairgavākṣavāriyantrakaiḥ ||27|
catuḥśālaviśālāgrajālaiḥ prakāśabhāsitam |
prāṃgaṇe ca sabhāśreṣṭhamaṇḍapena suśobhitam ||28||
tulasyā śobhitaṃ ramyaṃ dvipidvayavirājitam |
siṃhavyāghragaruḍādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ purataḥ śubhaiḥ ||29||
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ śṛṃgopari dvāre’bhidhāyutam |
mama nāmāni lekhyāni toraṇeṣu samantataḥ ||3.46.30||
śaṃkhaṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgamālekhyāni ca bhittiṣu |
bāṇā bāṇadharāḥ kośāḥ pārśvayoḥ sarvathā matāḥ ||3 1||
mandirasya pṛṣṭhabhāge śatacandraṃ ca nandakam |
halaṃ ca muśalaṃ cāpi citritavyaṃ śubhātmakam ||32||
gajāsanasya vai pṛṣṭhe pārśve me paṭṭayoṣitaḥ |
tato brahmapriyāścāpi gopyo gāvaśca dāsikāḥ ||3 3||
muktāḥ santastathā sādhvyaḥ satyaśca sādhavo’malāḥ |
avatārāśca gopālāḥ sopāneṣu kapāṭake ||34||
dehalyāṃ kalpavṛkṣāśca stambheṣu ca latāstathā |
kuḍyeṣu gomatī gaṃgā svarṇarekhāśvapaṭṭakam ||35||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ bhadrā yamī sarasvatī |
ālekhyaṃ rāsaramaṇaṃ janmotsavo makhādayaḥ ||36||
daśāvatāracitrāṇi naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ |
puṇyatīrthāni kāryāṇi raṃgairmandiramadhyataḥ ||37||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaraṃ kiśoramūrtikam |
sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulapramāṇaṃ ca māṃ nijam ||38||
śvetacampakavarṇābhaṃ kārayitvābhipūjayet |
pratiṣṭhāvidhināsthāpya guruhastena mandire ||39||
bhaktaḥ paramayā bhaktyā pūjayetparameśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmapriyāpatim ||3.46.40||
bhaktā bhakto’pi ca sadāharniśaṃ matparo bhavet |
matprasāde svarasanāṃ ghrāṇaṃ mattalasīdale ||41 ||
tvacaṃ matsparśane kuryāt karṇau macchravaṇe tathā |
netre maddarśane dadyāt karapādādikaṃ tathā ||42||
dadyāt sevāvidhau me ca hyevaṃ sevāparā bhavet |
bhaktāṃ premabharāṃ tāṃ vai prāhurbhāgavatottamām ||43||
aśvamedhāyutayajñā rājasūyāyutānyapi|
mama sevākalāṃśasya tulyatāṃ yānti naiva ha ||44||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārcāpradarśanam |
sevanaṃ tasya caivāste phaladaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||45||
koṭipāpāni naśyanti gurvācāryasya sevanāt |
dehānte divyamuktā me śvetacampakakāntayaḥ ||46||
gajaṃ nītvā samāyānti netuṃ dhāma mamākṣaram |
vimāne garuḍe cāpi gaje kṛtvā nayanti tām ||47||
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya mama nāma smaret satī |
guruṃ māṃ ca tato natvā mukhakṣālanamācaret ||48||
upaviśyāsane śīghraṃ śvāsaṃ vijitya vai tataḥ |
hastāvutsaṃga ādhāya dhyāyenmāṃ bhaktavallabham ||49||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ cāśīḥparāyaṇam |
svastikāsanamāsīnaṃ dhyāyet suśāntamacyutam ||3.46.50||
brahmapriyābhisahitaṃ paṭṭāṃganābhisevitam |
sarvāṃgasundaraṃ ramyaṃ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitam ||51||
kiśoraṃ śvetarūpaṃ ca tejaḥparidhibhāṣitam |
dhyātvaivaṃ māṃ tato yāyād dehaśuddhyarthamanyataḥ ||52||
aśaucāyāstu viphalāḥ kriyā bhavantyataḥ sadā |
dehaśuddhiṃ jalādyaiśca snānādyairācaret priye ||53||
sattvaśuddhivihīnāyā bhaktirme naiva puṣyati |
mukhaśuddhivihīnāyā japamantrā nirarthakāḥ ||54||
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśūn vasūni ca |
brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca dadāti śuddhiruttamā ||55||
sūryaṃ namennamed vṛddhān vṛddhāḥ satīrnamettathā |
sādhvīrnamet praseveta sādhvīḥ sādhujanānapi ||56||
praṇayeddharibhaktām̐śca devāyatanaprabhṛtīn |
nāmāni cāpi gṛhṇīyāt pāvanāni smarettathā ||57||
sāketā madhunagarī māyā kāśī hyavantinī |
kāñcī suvarṇanagarī purī ca puruṣottamī ||58||
kuṃkumavāpikā caitā mokṣadāḥ praṇamettathā |
śālagrāmo gaṇḍakīgaḥ śaṃbhalo harimandire ||59||
nandigrāmaḥ kosalastho’kṣaragrāmān smarettathā |
daṇḍakaṃ saindhavāraṇyaṃ jambūbhāgaṃ ca puṣkaram ||3.46.60||
utpalāvarttamāraṇyaṃ naimiṣaṃ kurujāṃgalam |
arbudaṃ hemavantaṃ ca vyāghrāraṇyaṃ smarettathā ||61||
tilakaṃ bhālake kuryād raktakuṃkumarājitam |
candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ kuryānmadhye bhāle satī tathā ||62||
mandiraṃ prati gatvā ca ghaṇṭānādaṃ samācaret |
kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ kuryāt smarantī parameśvaram ||63||
jayārāvaṃ tālikāṃ ca vādayantī nametprabhum |
pradīpaṃ ghṛtasaugandhyavāsitaṃ ca pradīpayet ||64||
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavan yoganidrāṃ tyaja prabho |
sevāyāmāgatā cāsmītyevamutthāpayeddharim ||65||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryādaṃgasevāṃ samācaret |
dantadhāvanamarpayya snāpayed gandhavāribhiḥ ||66||
gandhasārādyarpayenme tato vastrāṇi cārpayet |
candanādyairarcayenmāṃ maṃgalārtikyamācaret ||67||
bhrāmayennavavāraṃ me mukhopari pradīpitam |
pañcavarttyaṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ bhrāmayitvā jayaṃ vadet ||68||
nivedya bahupakvānnaṃ dugdhaṃ ca śarkarānvitam |
śṛṃgāraṃ bhāvataḥ kṛtvā vastrabhūṣaṇamaṃgalaiḥ ||69||
ārtikyaṃ hāratorādyaiḥ śṛṃgāryaiva samācaret |
purīlaḍḍunavanītadadhidugdhāni cārpayet ||3.46.70||
pañcabhogān, tato natvā tāmbūlaṃ jalamarpayet |
atha naijaṃ caret kāryaṃ vyāvahārikamutsukā ||71 ||
madhyāhne ca mahābhogān nānārasān samarpayet |
rājabhogārtikaṃ kṛtvā kārayecchayanaṃ mama ||72||
prasādaṃ tulasīyuktaṃ bhuñjīta satataṃ satī |
caturghaṭyavaśeṣe tu dine utthāpayettu mām ||73||
vādyanādena bhāvena phalabhogaṃ samarpayet |
tataḥ sevāṃ mama kuryāt kuryonnaijaṃ kriyādikam ||74||
tataḥ sandhārtikaṃ kuryād dugdhādīni nivedayet |
pradoṣe punarārtikyaṃ bhogaṃ dattveṣṭameva me ||75||
śayanaṃ kārayed ramye rājasevāṃ samācaret |
sarvārpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva mahānandaṃ labhet satī ||76||
evaṃ kṛṣṇaparā sādhvī sevāsaṃlagnamānasā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyaparāyaṇā ||77||
tārayitvā kulaśataṃ yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
mama janmāṣṭamī kāryā rādhāṣṭamī śubhā tathā ||78||
lakṣmīnavamī kāryā ca vratotsavaprapūjanaiḥ |
rāmādityanavamī ca vāmanadvādaśī tathā ||79||
annakūṭotsavaścāpi tathānantacaturdaśī |
caturdaśī nṛsiṃhasya tathā janmadināni me ||3.46.80 ||
śuklā ramāsaptamī ca kārtike vratarūpiṇī |
kartavyā puṇyavatīpūrṇimā caitrasya sotsavā ||81 ||
pañcavarṇasamāyukte sthaṇḍile kārayecchubham |
saptadhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadrākhyaṃ śobhanamaṇḍalam |
dvātriṃśaddalasaṃyuktaṃ karṇikākaisarojjvalam ||82||
karṇikāyāṃ nyasenmāṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsane satī |
ramāṃ rādhā śriyaṃ bhūṃ ca virajāṃ māṇikīṃ ratim ||83||
padmāvatīṃ ca lakṣmīṃ cāmṛtāṃ ca maṃgalāṃ tathā |
durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ haṃsīṃ maṃjulāṃ sadguṇāṃ jayām |
campāṃ kastūrikāṃ haimīṃ śāntāṃ muktāṃ ca devikām ||84||
sthāpayet tatsatīmadhye māṃ svayaṃ bhaktavallabham |
rādhāramāsakhīścānyāḥ pārṣadān sthāpayecca me ||85||
śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ bāṇāṃśca nandakam |
musalaṃ ca halaṃ daṇḍaṃ kaustubhaṃ svastikaṃ tathā ||86||
vanamālāṃ śrīvatsaṃ ca pītāmbaraṃ ca vetrikām |
sthāpayed garuḍaṃ cāpi tālaṃ ca rathaśobhitam ||87||
sumatiṃ dārukaṃ cāpi kumudaṃ kumudākṣakam |
nandaṃ sunandaṃ caṇḍaṃ ca pracaṇḍaṃ ca balaṃ tathā ||88||
prabalaṃ vallabhaṃ cāpi śukaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā |
svaprakāśaṃ ca hemantaṃ bhagavantaṃ diśāṃpatīn ||89||
viśvaksenaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vināyakam |
grahān devān mātṛkāśca brahmapriyādimaṇḍalam ||3.46.90 ||
vītihotraṃ tathā sarvānavatārān samanyaset |
tataḥ sampūjayed bhaktyā satī tvāvāhanādibhiḥ ||91 ||
āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ sugandhi ca |
pañcāmṛtaṃ jalasnānaṃ bhūṣāmbaraṃ ca candanam ||92||
madhuparkaṃ dhūpadīpau gandhaṃ yajñopavītakam |
puṣpākṣatān dravān ramyān kuṃkumaṃ jalamuttamam ||93 ||
ācamanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā |
pradakṣiṇaṃ prārthanāṃ ca daṇḍavacca kṣamāpanam ||94||
nīrājanaṃ namaskāraṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ tato’rpayet |
tataḥ sarvādhidevān vai devīśca pārṣadādikān ||95||
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā bhaktā nārī satīvratā |
ghaṇṭāvādyaraṇadghaṃṭākāṃsyavīṇādikīcakaiḥ ||96||
karatālamṛdaṃgādyaiḥ kīrtanaṃ nartanaṃ kriyāt |
nṛtyeyuḥ śrīhareragre ye bhaktāḥ premavihvalāḥ ||97||
jayaśabdayutāścāpi satkathākhyānatatparāḥ |
sarvā nṛtyaṃ prakuryuśca parīhāraṃ tataśca tāḥ || 98||
śayanaṃ kārayeyuśca māṃ satyo bhaktitatparāḥ |
evaṃ sevāpradhānāyā vadhvā nāryāśca yoṣitaḥ ||99||
sadāṃke’haṃ nivasāmi vasāmi hṛdaye tathā |
sāpi nāke padaṃ dhṛtvā mama dhāma prayāti vai || 3.46.100 ||
yā kāpi ko’pi me pūjāṃ kariṣyati jagattraye |
tāste yāsyanti me dhāmākṣaraṃ catuḥpadārthadam || 101 ||
api māṃ pūjayed bhaktyā saṃsmaret sevayecca vā |
bhojayed rāmayeccāpi śṛṃgārayet praraṃjayet || 1 02||
sahavāsakarī bhūtvā śayane svāpayecca mām |
mardayed vāhayenmāṃ ca hāstayed rāsayedapi || 1 03||
sarvāṃ premamayīṃ bhaktiṃ kuryācca kārayedapi |
sā vai priyā me sahagā brahmapriyā bhaviṣyati || 1 04||
naro vā brahmamuktaḥ syāttathātmavedano hi yaḥ |
divyo vai pārṣadaḥ śaśvatmatsamo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ śrīpuruṣottamayoganirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||

<3.47>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mama yogaṃ parātparam |
nārāyaṇe jagannāthe sarvakāmaphalaprade || 1 ||
mayi kṛṣṇe ratiṃ kuryād yā sā labhet paraṃ padam |
mayi dhyānaparā lakṣmi cāṇḍālyapi hi devatā || 2 ||
gaṇikā mama yogasthā nirguṇā divyavartanā |
adhyātmajñānasampannā haripūjāparāyaṇā || 3 ||
labhate cākṣaraṃ dhāma punarāvṛttivarjitam |
yato jātamidaṃ viśvaṃ yataścaitanyamaśnute || 4 ||
yasmiṃśca vilayaṃ yāti yenāviṣṭaṃ ca jīvati |
nirguṇo’pi paro’nanto guṇavāniva bhāti yaḥ || 5 ||
sadāntarastho yo’haṃ saḥ saṃsārabhayanāśakaḥ |
taṃ māmabhyarcya kānteśaṃ saṃsārāt parimucyate || 6 ||
karmaṇā dehamāpnoti dehī kāmena badhyate |
sa kāmaṃ mayi saṃyujya prāpnuyānmatparaṃ padam || 7 ||
māṃ vinā kāmanāyuktā krodhena cābhibhūyate |
lobhastāṃ praviśatyeva dharmanāśaṃ karotyapi || 8 ||

evaṃ pāpasya mūlaṃ syāccharīraṃ māṃ vinā priye || 9 ||
tasmānmadyogamāsādya doṣānnirguṇakān vrajet |
sarvāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃgṛhya śete yo’kṣaradhāmani || 3.47.1 0||

vratibhistāpasairyogasādhakairjñānayajñakaiḥ |

havyakavyādidāneṣu devatāpitṛrūpadhṛk |
bhuṃkte yo bhagavān māṃ taṃ mokṣadam ṛṣayo viduḥ || 1 3||
dhyātaḥ praṇamito vāpi pūjito vāpi bhaktitaḥ |
dadāmi śāśvataṃ dhāma taṃ māṃ hariṃ samarcayet || 14||
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmeko’haṃ parameśvaraḥ |
jarāmṛtyuvinirmukto mokṣado’smyavyayo hariḥ || 15||
sampūjya mama pādābjaṃ dehino’pi narāyaṇi |
amṛtatvaṃ bhajantyāśu māṃ viddhi puruṣottamam || 16||
ānandamajaraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam |
parātparataraṃ so’haṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 17||
advayaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityamadvitīyamanaupamam |
paripūrṇatamaṃ jñānamayaṃ mokṣasya sādhanam || 18||

yā tūpāste yoginī sā yāti matparamaṃ padam || 1 9||
nirguṇā saṃgarahitā śamādiguṇaśobhanā |
vāsanāvarjitā brāhmī priyā yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||3.47.20 ||
mamāvatārarūpāṇi bhavanti yugalāni vai |
samarthayanti māṃ sarve śāśvatasthānadaṃ harim ||2 1 ||
yasyābhinnamidaṃ sarvaṃ yacceṃgad yacca neṃgati |
tamūrdhvamajaraṃ dhyātvā saṃsārānmucyate satī || 22||

hṛdi paśyati māṃ kāntaṃ sarvānandasukhapradam ||23 ||

aṅgīkaromi sarvasvāṃ lokānugraharūpadhṛk || 24||

anupamo’khilādhārastaṃ māṃ vai śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||25||

taṃ vidyānmāṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamanāmayam ||26||
yasyājñayā jagaccāniruddhaḥ sṛjati rūpavat |
pradyumnaḥ pālakaścāste saṃkarṣaṇo vikarṣati ||27||

taṃ māṃ sarvāṃśadhartāraṃ vidyānmuktiṃ vrajet tataḥ ||28||
yajjñānaṃ bhaktimūlaṃ syānmokṣadaṃ jñānamityapi |
bhaktiḥ karmātmikā snehasevātmikā śubhottamā ||29||

yayā pūrve kṛtāstasyā bhaktirbhaveddharau mayi ||3.47.30||
śāśvataḥ paramo dharmo bhaktileśena śobhate |
śraddhayā parayā yukto mayi bhāgavato bhavet ||3 1 ||
doṣāṇāṃ vilaye buddhiḥ prasannā jāyate sadā |

guṇā eva prajāyante vivartante yato mayi |
tairyuktā ca matiḥ śreṣṭhā prasannā ca viśāradī ||3 3||
sā jñānātmakadhārā ca tadā prāpyo bhavāmyaham |
sā matirjñānarūpā vai mokṣadā mama dhāmadā ||34||
kriyāyogaṃ mayi kṛtvā matinairmalyamarjayet |
sevāyogena māṃ nityaṃ tato dāsī prasevayet ||35||
sādhubhūrvārvahnisūryaviprahṛccitradhātujāḥ |
sādhvīgoyogibuddhyādyāḥ pratimā mama mūrtayaḥ ||36||
devatācaityatīrthādyāḥ pratimāśca vibhūtayaḥ |
etāsu pūjya evāhaṃ patyāviva janārdanaḥ ||37||
karmaṇā manasā vācā bhaktyā sarvagataṃ ca mām |
pūjayed bhaktisaṃyuktā yā sā brāhmī bhaviṣyati ||38||
vadhvā patyau narabhāvo neśabhāvo bhavatyapi |
kāmakrodhādidoṣāṇāṃ darśanād divyatā na vai ||39||
kintu patyau kṛtā syācced divyatā manasā sadā |
vadhvā nārāyaṇadṛṣṭyā sevā sā muktidā bhavet |||3.47.40||
nāryā mūrtau pratimāyāṃ divyadṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā yadi |
sā syāttasyā mokṣadā vai śivaliṃge yathā matiḥ ||41 ||
sādhavaśca tathā sādhvyo mūrtayaḥ pratimā mama |
tāsu dṛṣṭiṃ śubhāṃ divyāṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ samācaret ||42||
pāñcabhautikapratimāścetanāstā mamaiva ha |
tāsāṃ saṃprīṇanāccāhaṃ prasannaḥ saṃbhavāmi hi ||43||
kriyārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra gṛhṇāmi sevanātmakam |
dadāmi sevikāyai tu dhāmākṣaraṃ padaṃ param ||44||
ahiṃsāsatyamakrodho brahmacaryāparigrahau |
anīrṣyā ca dayā śāntiḥ sevā ca sadguṇā ime ||45||
sarvān vinyasya ca mayi mama yogaṃ samācaret |
carācarātmako nāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||46||
matvaiva śrīhariṃ naijaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā bhajet priyā |
yogo’yaṃ sādhyarūpo vai śreṣṭhaḥ sākṣānmadātmakaḥ ||47||
mama prāptisvarūpaḥ sa jānantyenaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ |
doṣān vihāya kṛtvaiva guṇarūpān harau mayi ||48||
ānukūlyena sarveśaṃ kāntaṃ māṃ prabhajet satī |
muktyarthamarcayennityaṃ kriyāyogaparā priyā ||49||
ratā lokahite cāpi svahite ca ratā tathā |
samarcayati māṃ sādhvī divyakriyāvatī hi sā ||3.47.50||
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim |
stotrādyaiḥ stauti māṃ prātaḥ kīrtanairgāyati prabhum ||51 ||
upavāsādibhiścāpi kathāśravaṇacintanaiḥ |
puṣpādyaiścārcanaṃ cāpi kriyā divyā hi sā matā ||52||
bhaktikriyāvatāmevaṃ doṣā naśyanti mūlataḥ |
divyabhāvaṃ prayāntyeva kāmakrodhādayo’pi ca ||53||
matirdivyā bhaveccāpi mokṣadā jñānasaṃbhṛtā |
ekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca ṛte sarvamanityakam ||54||
anityāstu padārthā vai nityastveko hariḥ prabhuḥ |
anityaiḥ sādhanairvai ca nityamekaṃ samāśrayet ||55||
ihāmutra ca bhogeṣu viraktā tu sadā bhavet |
aviraktā hi saṃsārānnivartate na vai kvacit ||56||
śamādiguṇasampannābhyasyenmokṣavibodhanam |
haridhyānaparā syācca viśuddhamatikā bhavet ||57||
sarvatra bhāvayenmāṃ ca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
kṣarākṣarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya kṛṣṇo’hamāsthitaḥ ||58||
iti jñātvā bhajenmāṃ ca sarvatra bhaktimāśritā |
ātmā dvedhā paraścāpyaparaśceti svabhāvataḥ ||59||
paramātmā paraścāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
mamāvatārā bahavo rādhākṛṣṇādayo matāḥ ||3.47.60||
mama mūrteḥ śubhaṃ tejaścātmākṣaro nigadyate |
muktāśca bahavaḥ santi sarve’parā bhavanti te ||6 1||
īśvarāḥ śaktayo devā devyaśca mānavādayaḥ |
sarve cāparajīvāste bhavanti bhavadehinaḥ ||62||
evaṃ cetanavijñānaṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ |
kṛtvā bhajetparaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā satī ||63||
ekaḥ śuddho’kṣaraparaḥ paramātmātmanāṃ patiḥ |
māyākālākṣarapatiścāvatārapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||64||
satāṃ patirmuktapatirbrahmapriyāpatirhariḥ |
satīpatirbhaktapatirbhaktāpatiḥ priyāpatiḥ ||65||
brāhmīpatiḥ sarvapatiḥ svapatiḥ parameśvaraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśceti vibhāvayet ||66||
ekamevādvitīyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma sanātanam |
vedāntavedyaṃ tadvai māṃ viditvākṣaramāvrajet ||67||
eka eva parānando nirguṇaḥ parataḥ paraḥ |
divyaguṇairbhṛto nārāyaṇo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||68 ||
jñānināṃ paramātmāhaṃ hṛdi bhāmi nirantaram |
aṣṭasopānasaṃsiddhā yāti matparamaṃ padam ||6 9||
āhāraśuddhiḥ prathamā dehaśuddhirdvitīyakā |
tṛtīyendriyaśuddhiśca caturthyāntaraśuddhikā ||3.47.7 0 | |
pañcamī tvātmaśuddhirvai ṣaṣṭhī parātmadhāraṇā |
saptamī dhyānavṛttiścāṣṭamī tatraiva lagnatā | |7 1 ||
iti kṛtvāṣṭakaṃ sādhvī māṃ samāsena saṃśrayet |
matprasādāśanā syāddhi cāhāraśuddhireva sā ||72 ||
mama dīkṣāyutā syācca dehaśuddhirmatā hi sā |
indriyāṇi madarthaṃ vai tṛtīyā śuddhireva sā ||73 ||
karaṇāni madarthaṃ cāntarā śuddhirhi sā matā |
ātmārpaṇaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe divyasadguṇaśālitā || 74||
sattvaprakarṣa evātra tvātmaśuddhirmatā hi sā |
nijātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ vibhāvayet sadā satī ||75 ||
muktāṃ nityāṃ mahāmuktāṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ sanātanīm |
ātmaśuddhirhi sā proktā māyāmāyikavarjitā ||76 ||
nijaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ kṛtvā pareśaṃ māṃ ca vāhayet |
dhārayet sthāpayeccāpi mama yogaṃ samācaret || 77 ||
mama dhāraṇayogyāyā rūpe vasāmi cetane |
mama vāsaḥ sa evāsyāḥ parātmadhāraṇā matā || 78 ||
mayi pratyayabhāvasya tvekatānatvameva yat |
sarvānandapravāhasya tvekatānatvameva yat || 79 ||
sarvaprakāśapūrasya caikatānatvameva yat |
sarvacaitanyapūrasya caikatānatvameva yat ||3.47.80 ||
yāvatprajñāpravāhasya caikatānatvameva yat |
avicchinnapravāhasya mayi lagnatvameva yat | |8 1 ||
saptamīdhyānavṛttiḥ sā proktā sopānikā varā |
vṛttīnāṃ śrīharau jāte valayātmalaye’dhike ||8 2||
ākṛṣṭasya cetanasyārpaṇaṃ cābhinnayogitā |
samādhiḥ paramaḥ so’tra śāśvatānandadohanaḥ ||8 3 ||
parameśasvarūpasya nirbhāso yatra vidyate |
svanirbhāso na vai cāste’ṣṭamī sā paramā sthitiḥ ||84 ||
brahmānandamayī mūrtirnijā pareśarūpiṇī |
yadā vibhāsate’śnute sarvān kāmān mayā saha ||85 ||
sukhaṃ tṛptiśca santoṣastuṣṭiścānanda utsavaḥ |
ratiḥ prasannatā modaḥ pramodo rañjanaṃ ca cit ||86 ||
laharī tānatā bhogaḥ sattvaṃ caiśvaryamuttamam |
praphullatā ca pulakaḥ snehaḥ prītirvirāmitā ||87||
ākarṣaṇaṃ ca viśrāntirmahāsuṣuptirityapi |
turyāvasthā nijānandaścetyevaṃ bahunāmabhiḥ ||88||

tāṃ prāpya punarāvṛttirvidyate naiva naiva na ||89||
evamaṣṭāṃgayogena mayoktena narāyaṇi |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ vai vivāhayet ||3.47.90||
haribhaktirdṛḍhā yasyā haripūjā tathottamā |,
tasyā viśuddhiyoginyā mokṣo hastagato’sti vai ||91 ||
harau mayi sthirā syācca samāsīta mayi prabhau |
śreṣṭhāsanaṃ hi tadbodhyaṃ prāṇaṃ māṃ ca samāśrayet ||92||
pratyāharaṇamevāpi mayyeva ca samācaret |
prayātā syātparabrahma punarāvṛttivarjitam ||93||
nijātmani praveśayet parameśaṃ śriyaḥpatim |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sthāpayet satī ||94||
sarvātmānaṃ nijātmānaṃ sarvalokaikakāraṇam |
surūpaṃ kāntikāntaṃ ca tejaḥparidhirājitam ||95||
manogamyaṃ yuvānaṃ ca sarvakāmaprapūrakam |
vikasatpadmapatrākṣaṃ cārukuṇḍalabhūṣitam ||96||
dīrghabāhumudārāṃgaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitam |
pītāmbaradharaṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ yogyaṃ susaṃginam ||97||
hemayajñopavītaṃ ca bibhratsattulasīsrajam |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ hāramaṇikaustubhaśobhitam ||98||
dhyāyenmāṃ paramātmānaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ labhettataḥ |
dhyānātpāpāni naśyanti dhyānānmokṣo bhavedapi ||99||
hariḥ prasīdati dhyānād dhyāne’haṃ samavasthitaḥ |
dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyātṛbhāvaṃ trayamekībhaved yadā || 3.47.100 ||
tadāmṛtatvaṃ bhavati jñānāmṛtaṃ niṣevate |
mahānandaṃ prabhuṃkte ca bhuṃkte brahmāmṛtaṃ sadā || 10 1||
śabdabrahmākṣarabrahmakaraṇabrahma cetyapi |
ātmabrahma parabrahma caikībhavanti tāni vai || 1 02||
mahānandasamudre vai muktiḥ samādhijā hi sā |
ānando vai parabrahma parabrahma hariḥ prabhuḥ || 103||
omityeva parabrahma saccidānanda eva saḥ |
etadabhyāsasaṃyuktā paraṃ mokṣaṃ vrajatyapi || 1 04||
yā tvetacchṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvāpi samāhitā |
sā madaikyaṃ samāpannā haripriyā bhaved dhruvam || 1 05||

<3.48>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
yathā tuṣyati bhagavān parameśaḥ parātparaḥ |
tanmamākhyāhi sarvajña kānta kāruṇyavāridhe || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ saccidānandavigraham |
bhaja sarvātmanā kānte māṃ yadyānandamicchasi || 2 ||
ripavastāṃ na hiṃsanti na bādhante grahādayaḥ |
rākṣasāścāpi nekṣante nārīṃ viṣṇuparāyaṇām || 3 ||
bhaktirdṛḍhā bhaved yasyāḥ pareśe paramātmani |
tasyāḥ śreyāṃsi siddhyanti bhaktiyuktādhikā tataḥ || 4 ||
pādau tau saphalau tasyā yau viṣṇugṛhagāminau |
tau karau saphalau tasyā mama pūjāparau tu yau || 5 ||
te netre saphale tasyāḥ paśyato ye śriyaḥ patim |
sā jihvā maṃgalā tasyā harernāmaparā tu yā || 6 ||
te śrautre saphale tasyāḥ śrīkathāsāragrāhake |
sā tvag vai pāvanī tasyā yā harisparśavedinī || 7 ||
rasanā sā rasavatī yayā prāpto hareḥ rasaḥ |
ghrāṇaṃ puṇyaṃ hi tasyāstad yacchrīmadgandhavedi vai || 8 ||
sā kaṭiryā tu haryarthaṃ guptaṃ haryarthameva ca |
vakṣaścāpyapi haryarthaṃ gaṇḍau haryarthameva yau || 9 ||
kapolaṃ cāpi haryarthaṃ haryarthaṃ jaghanaṃ tathā |
sakthinī cāpi haryarthaṃ jaṅghe haryarthameva ca || 3.48.10 ||
auṣṭhau cāpi tu haryarthaṃ keśā haryarthameva ca |
śayanaṃ cāpi haryarthaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ kṛte || 1 1||
yasyā ramaṇaṃ haryarthaṃ vilāso’pi hareḥ kṛte |
hāvā bhāvāśca haryarthaṃ nṛtyaṃ haryarthamityapi || 1 2||

mānasaṃ cintanaṃ cāpi buddhirharyarthameva yā || 1 3||

kajjalaṃ candanaṃ tailaṃ haryarthaṃ kabarī tathā || 15||

upārjanaṃ vyayaścāpi yatno haryarthameva ca || 19||

gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ sampadaśca sarvaṃ haryarthameva ca ||3.48.20 ||
sutāḥ putryaśca gāvaśca haryarthaṃ vājinastathā |
gajā yānavimānāni yasyā haryarthameva ca ||21 ||
vāṭikā sasyasampaccopaskarāśca hareḥ kṛte |
nimeṣaṃ śvāsarakṣā ca cetano’pi hareḥ kṛte || 22||

utthānamudayaścāpi virāmo’pi hareḥ kṛte || 23||
anāvaraṇabhāvaśca hṛdayaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte |
gopyaṃ mantro rahasyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yasyā hareḥ kṛte ||24||
kalāḥ śikṣābhyasanaṃ ca rāgaḥ śāntirhareḥ kṛte |
ārambhāśca prapūrtiśca pācanaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte ||25||
bhramaṇaṃ vyavahāraśca sphurtiścāsyā hareḥ kṛte |
lobhaḥ kāmaśca saṃkalpaścotsavaśca hareḥ kṛte ||26||

lekhanaṃ khelanaṃ cāpi kauśalyaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte |
cāturyaṃ cāpi cāpalyaṃ divyatāpi hareḥ kṛte ||29||
apyaṃgānāṃ moḍanaṃ ca svedaścottejanaṃ tathā |

bhojanaṃ pānamudgāro dhātulābho hareḥ kṛte |
samayaścāpi saṃketo vāṭaścāpi hareḥ kṛte || 31 ||
mārgaṇaṃ cānveṣaṇaṃ ca pratīkṣaṇaṃ hareḥ kṛte |
ānandecchā harereva haryarthaṃ cāntaraṃ sthalam ||32||
antarbahirhariryasyāḥ snehamūrtirharerhi sā |
satyasāramidaṃ sarvaṃ na kāntaḥ keśavātparaḥ ||33||
asāre khalu saṃsāre sāraḥ kānto harirmahān |
saṃsārapāśāḥ sudṛḍhā abhaktāyā bhavanti te ||34||
bhaktāyāste guṇadā vai vipāśāśca bhavanti vai |
ānandamatulaṃ me ca vaśīkṛtvā samarjayet ||35||
sthānaṃ rūpaṃ tathānandaḥ sukhaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate |
nirdeṣṭuṃ cāpi ca draṣṭuṃ śakyate nākṛtātmabhiḥ ||36||
sarvopādhivinirmuktaścānando’tiśayo hareḥ |
parabrahmamayaṃ bhuktvānandaṃ brāhmī bhavet satī || 37||
tatkathāyāṃ ca ramate satkathāṃ ca karoti yā |
satsaṃgo nityamevāsyāḥ prīto bhavāmi padmaje ||38||
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ me ca kṣuttṛṭpraskhalanādiṣu |
karoti satataṃ yā tu tasyāḥ prīto bhavāmi vai ||39||
yā tu vadhūḥ patiprāṇā patipūjāparāyaṇā |
tasyāstuṣṭaḥ sadā cāsmi dadāmi svapadaṃ priyam ||3.48.40||
asūyārahitā yā tu tathāhaṃkāravarjitā |
dāsībhāvaparā sādhvī tasyāstuṣyāmi sarvathā ||41||
tasmād brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyā madātmikāḥ |
bhajatātra hariṃ kāntaṃ māṃ priyaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham |||42|||
śarīraṃ mṛtyuvāsaṃ vai hāsavāsaṃ hi karmiṇām |
jīvitaṃ cañcalaṃ vidyullolāśca sampadastathā ||43||
rājādibhirdhanaṃ bādhyaṃ smṛddhayaḥ kṣaṇabhaṃgurāḥ |
nidrāḍhyaṃ cāyuṣārdhaṃ copārjanārthaṃ tathārdhakam ||44||
bhogārthaṃ ca tadardhaṃ tu bālyaṃ sauṣuptamityapi |
vicāryeti satī kuryād vayasyeva mamārcanam ||45||
vapurvināśanilayaṃ cāpadāṃ paramaṃ padam |
akasmād bhinnamārgaṃ ca tena bhaktiṃ prasādhayet ||46||
asārabhūte saṃsāre sāre mayi samarpaṇam |
sarvātmanā prakuryādvai jñātvā nārī pramokṣaṇam ||47||
dehayoganivṛttyarthaṃ sadya eva narāyaṇam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajeta māṃ satī ||48||
koṭijanmasahasreṣu sthāvarādiṣu yoṣitaḥ |
saṃbhrāntāyāḥ kathaṃcidvai mānuṣyaṃ samupasthitam ||49||
tatra dānaṃ cārcanaṃ ca janmāntaratapaḥphalam |
bhaktiścāśīrvādaphalaṃ sevā saubhāgyamityapi ||3.48.50||
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya yā hariṃ nārcayet satī |
mūrkhī saiva jaḍabuddhirnārī punarbhaviṣyati ||5 1 ||
tasyāścātīva mūrkhāyā vivekaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati|
ārādhito hariḥ kṛṣṇo dadātyabhimataṃ phalam ||52||
caṇḍālo vā nikṛṣṭo vā malinaḥ pāpavānapi |
gaṇikā vā śīlahīnā vyavāyādiparāyaṇā ||53||
aśuddhā vā sūtikā vā viṣṇubhaktā dvijādhikā |
viṣṇubhaktivihīnā tu dvijāpi śvapacī ca vā ||54||
tasmāddhariṃ prasevyaiva toṣayetparameśvaram |
mayi tuṣṭe’khilaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sarvātmāhaṃ yato’smi ca ||55||
hastipade sarvapadaṃ gagane sārvabhautikam |
anādiśrīharau tadvanmayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||56||
janmamṛtyū prāntabhāgau tannāśo mama sevayā |
dhyātaḥ smṛtaḥ pūjito vā praṇato voddharāmyaham ||57||
saṃsārapāśavicchedaṃ karomi kṛpayā sadā |
mannāmoccāraṇādeva mahāpātakanāśanam ||58||
manmūrteḥ smaraṇādeva brahmabhāvo bhavedapi |
matsatīsevayā mokṣagāmitvaṃ syād drutaṃ priye ||59||
nīyamānā yamabhaṭairaśaktā svavimocane |
apuṇyāpi smarenmāṃ ca tāmuddharāmi kaṣṭataḥ ||3.48.60||
vidrāvya yāmyadūtām̐śca nayāmi matpadaṃ priyām |
smarantī māṃ śaraṇāptāmabalāṃ dīnamānasām ||61 ||
anāthāṃ paravaśagāṃ puṇyapuñjavivarjitām |
ālambavarjitāṃ nirādhārāmuddhārayāmyaham ||62||
yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ yāvadvyādhirna bādhate |
tāvat prasevya māṃ sādhvī muktimārgaṃ hi klṛptayet ||63||
kṛṣṇaḥ sarvātmanā pūjyo dhyeyaśca mādhavaḥ sadā |
hariḥ sevyaḥ sadā sādhvyā prasādanīyaḥ keśavaḥ ||64||
anārādhya jagannāthaṃ brahmapriyāntarasthitam |
paramānandalābho na saṃsevya taṃ sukhaṃ vrajet ||65||
acyutānantagovindakṛṣṇamādhavakeśava |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dāmodara prabho ||66||
hare kṛṣṇa vibho rāma nārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
ṛṣīkeśākṣarātīta parabrahma pareśvara ||67||
puruṣottama mukteśa brahmeśa ca janārdana |
bhagavan vyāpaka svāminnuccārayet satī sadā ||68||
evaṃ māṃ bhajamānāyā dūre nāhaṃ vasāmi vai |
sā mayyahaṃ ca tasyāṃ ca vartāmi sarvadā priye ||69||
nārāyaṇa jagannātha kambharātmaja kāmada |
gopālakṛṣṇatanaya vāsudeva janārdana ||3.48.70||
kānta dānta mahānandaprada śrīparameśvara |
satīnātha satāṃnāthetīrayanti muhurhi yāḥ ||71 ||
tāsāṃ pūjāṃ prakurvanti brahmādyā api devatāḥ |
vanditāstā bhavantyeva sarvatra kamalā yathā ||72||
yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti yā māyāvṛtamānasāḥ |
hṛtpadmasthaṃ naṃ jānanti tāsāṃ hānirmahattamā ||73||
hariḥ śraddhāvatāṃ tuṣyenna dhanairna ca bāndhavaiḥ |
nātmaguṇairna tapasā bhaktyā tuṣyejjanārdanaḥ ||74||
sevayā cātituṣyecca pūjayā smaraṇena ca |
ātmārpaṇena tuṣyecca toṣayantu tataḥ priyāḥ ||75||
putramitrasmṛddhayaśca bahvyo bhavanti sampadaḥ |
haripūjāratānāṃ vai durlabhāḥ santi tā nahi ||76||
ihāmutra sukhavāñcchāvatī sampūjayeddharim |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||77||
na namedviṣṇave yasyā mastakaṃ, mokṣadāyine |
karmaṇāṃ bhedine tasyā deho bodhyo’ghaśevadhiḥ ||78||
haribhaktiyuto deho divyo bodhyaḥ striyā api |
śreṣṭhā bhaktyā bhavantyeva bhaktihīnā kaniṣṭhikāḥ ||79||
pūjanīyāstato lakṣmi yoṣito bhaktisaṃbhṛtāḥ |
sammārjanādibhiryāstu mama śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ||3.48.8 0||
satāṃ samāgamakartryastā yānti paramaṃ padam |
haridharmaratāḥ śāntā haripādābjasevikāḥ ||8 1 ||
harikāryaparāḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇaraṭanatatparāḥ |
romaromasu kṛṣṇasya premanisyandarājitāḥ ||82||
ahaṃ kṛṣṇāpyahaṃ kṛṣṇā ceṣṭā evaṃ samāśritāḥ |
gṛhāṇa vaṃśīṃ kuñje ca samāyāhīti śabditāḥ ||83 ||
ekāntaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇātra rahasyaṃ me pradehi ca |
premarasaṃ mahānandaṃ māṃ prapāyaya kuñjagām ||84||
antarbhāvarasaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃgamotthaṃ prapāyaya |
tādātmyasnehamāpannāṃ kuru spaṣṭāṃ ca kiṃkarīm ||85||
aṃkadāsīṃ rāyanasya sakhīṃ vidhehi mādhava |
nirjanasya sarasaśca vidhehi padminīṃ prabho ||86||
payaḥphenanibharātrervidhehi śāradīṃ vibho |
vasantasya ca vallīṣu vidhehi kokilāṃ hare ||87||
śaityartormāṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā kambalinīṃ vidhehi ca |
sarvayajñasya kāryasya vedīṃ vidhehi māṃ tviha ||88||
viśrāntyarthaṃ kṛpāsindho tūlikāṃ māṃ vidhatsva nu |
agnitaptasya kāntasya śītāṃ kāntāṃ vibhāvaya ||89||
nirālambasamādheśca brahmānandīṃ priyāṃ kuru |
māyāyuktasya kṛṣṇasya muktānikāṃ pujasva mām ||3.48.90||
sarvākṛṣṭasya cittasya magnasthalīṃ vidhāpaya |
premapravāhasaritāṃ sāmudrikīṃ nibhālaya ||91 ||
amānodgatamodasya bhinnamūrtiṃ svakāṃ kuru |
samarasmarayuktasya vāhinīṃ tava māṃ kuru ||92||
kaustubhasya viyuktasyāsanībhūtaṃ ca hṛt kuru |
premabimbādharasyātrādhāralatāṃ suyojaya ||93||
padmapatrāyatanetre netrayorbimbake kuru |
pūrṇāmāvārdhitulyāyāḥ kaumudīśo bhavātra me ||94||
sādhvyā svāmī cakorāyāścandraḥ kṛṣṇo bhavātra me |
śalabhāyāścānalaśca timyāḥ kaṇṭaraso bhava ||95||
cātakyāstu svātivarṣā mayūryā jalado bhava |
navavadhvā varaśreṣṭha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhava ||96 ||
virahāgnipradāvāyā yogivāriprado bhava |
bhavābdhigartamagnāyāḥ karagrāho harirbhava ||97||
netre hṛdi ca manasi cetane nihito bhava |
sarvendriyeṣu sukhadaścāntareṣu sthiro bhava ||98||
ānakhaśikhamāsādya yāvān yāvatsu me vasa |
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri mayi tādātmyayojanam ||99||
yāyād yā sā brahmapriyā haripriyā bhavediha |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya rādhālakṣmīsamā bhavet || 3.48.10 0||
mama tādātmyayogo’yaṃ kalpabhaktyā bhavennanu |
naro nārī ca sampādya madātmakatvamāvrajet || 101 ||
apātraṃ bhaktihīnaṃ vai nāyaṃ pacati tasya vai |
vadhūgītāṃ purā śrutvā sadācāraparā bhavet || 1 02||
satī bhūtvā nirguṇaṃ ca bhaktiyogaṃ tataścaret |
puruṣottamayogaṃ ca prapātya tanmayī bhavet || 10 3||
tataḥ sākṣāt parabrahmayogayuktā bhaved dhruvā |
tayā tādātmyayogo’yaṃ prāpyate matkṛpāvaśāt || 1 04||
sarvā vadhvo bhavantyevaṃ paripūrṇatame mayi |
lokanāryastathā bhūtvā bhaviṣyanti madātmikāḥ || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne akṣarātītatādātmyayoganirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||

<3.49>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kṛpānātha ramānātha sarvānātha satāṃ pate |
yā puṇyapuñjarahitā bubhukṣukoṭikā bhavet || 1 ||
tasyā bījabalārthaṃ vai kiṃ vidheyaṃ bhavediha |
ādyārambhe mumukṣutābhāvasya vada me hare || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pāpāyā api śuddhaye |
kramabhāvaṃ kathayāmi yena cāntapadaṃ labhet || 3 ||
ārtikāle vipatkāle tasyai vācyaṃ balaṃ mama |
smṛto’pi manasā kṛṣṇo vipannāśaṃ karoti vai || 4 ||
sā smarenmāṃ tataścāsyai sakāmāyai vrataṃ śubham |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇākhyaṃ vai vācyaṃ kuryāt tato hi sā || 5 ||
dehaśuddhiṃ pañcagavyairvidadhyācca tataḥ param |
mama prāsādikaṃ vāri pibedācamanīyakam || 6 ||
upavāsaṃ prakuryācca mama pūjanamācaret |
śṛṇuyādvai vadhūgītāṃ mantrān me śṛṇuyāttataḥ || 7 ||
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 8 ||
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt |
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 9 ||
brāhamyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||1 0||
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ |
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako’stu saḥ || 11 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhaktavallabhaḥ |
parabrahmākṣarātīto’vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk || 12||
antaryāmī sadāsmatsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam |
sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi || 13 ||
pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadāvatu |
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ || 14||
parabrahmasvarūpiṇyaḥ parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ |
parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidā || 15||
tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā |
yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajatyapi || 16||
sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradā sadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||17||
śrīkṛṣṇasvāmibhaktāhaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥśrīvallabhaśca śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama || 18||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmīśrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
ityetān sarvamantrāṃśca sārthān saṃśrāvayet guruḥ |
pūjanaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale kārayenmama || 1 9||
pūjāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi vratāṃgaṃ śṛṇu sarvathā |
upavāsadinaṃ grāhyaṃ mārgaśīrṣasya pūrṇimā |
prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhāyāpi tīrthādau jalamarpayet ||20 ||
pitṛbhyaśca gṛhaṃ gatvā nārī nārāyaṇaṃ smaret |
prakṣālya pādāvācamya śuddhāmbaradharā satī |
nityaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā paścāt saṃkalpapūrvakam ||21 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devamarcayed bhaktibhāvataḥ |
jalasya kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā sugandhajalasaṃbhṛtam ||22||
pañcāmṛtāni cādāya sauvarṇaṃ śrīnarāyaṇam |
śuddhapātre nidhāyaiva pañcāmṛtādibhirjalaiḥ ||23||
snāpayeddhārayeccāpi vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca |
arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiścandanaistailakuṃkumaiḥ ||24||
dhūpadīpasunaivedyamūlaphalajalādibhiḥ |
tāmbūlārārtrikastotravandanābhyarthanādibhiḥ ||25||
gītairvādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca saṃhitāpāṭhanādibhiḥ |
saṃkīrtanaṃ prakuryādvai vratakartrī samāhitā ||26||
devasya purataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ caturasrakam |
aratnimātraṃ tatrāgniṃ sthāpayitvā ghṛtādibhiḥ ||27||
caruṇā ca tilādyaiśca juhuyād bhāvataḥ svayam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhyāṃ svāheti sā juhuyāttadā ||28||
aṣṭottaraśatahomān sarvapāpanivṛttaye |
prāyaścittādikaṃ gurvī kārayet tāṃ tataḥ param ||29||
punaḥ pūjāṃ vidhāyaiva parīhāraṃ vidhāpayet |
upacārādi devāya hyarpayed bhaktisaṃyutā ||30||
paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛtaṃ vrataṃ samarpayāmi te prabho |
arghyaṃ dadyādindave’pi namaskuryāt supuṣpakaiḥ ||3 1 ||
akṣatādyaistataḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśāntakam |
saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanādikam ||32||
prātaḥ snātvā satīḥ sādhūn bhojayecca tataḥ svayam |
pūjayitvā patiṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ ca bhojanam ||33||
pāraṇāṃ ca prakurvīta viprām̐śca bhojayedapi |
evaṃ pauṣādimāseṣu saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ caret ||34||
kārtikyāṃ ca prakurvītodyāpanaṃ pūrṇimātithau |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ caturasraṃ sumaṃgalam ||35||
kadalīstambhaśobhāḍhyaṃ navapallavatoraṇam |
kalaśādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca dīpāvalivirājitam ||36||
puṣpamālādisaṃyuktaṃ vitānadhvajamaṇḍitam |
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ pañcavarṇakam ||37||
tanmadhye ratnavāryāḍhyaṃ nūtnaṃ kumbhaṃ nyaset satī |
pañcapallavavastrādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca tadūrdhvake ||38||
tilasthālyāṃ sthāpayenmāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ harim |
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpyābhyarcya gandhādibhiḥ kramāt ||39||
vastrabhūṣādibhiścāpi bhakṣyabhojyādibhistathā |
siṃhāsane sthāpayenmāmārārtrikottaraṃ tataḥ ||40||
kathākīrtanabhajanairdivasaṃ ca prayāpayet |
madhyāhne niśi pūjāṃ ca kārayejjāgaraṃ kriyāt ||41 ||
pare’hni prātareveyaṃ śrīpatiṃ māṃ samarcayet |
sādhvībhyo bhojayeccāpi tato bhojanamācaret ||42||
gurvībhyaḥ sampradadyācca mūrtiṃ tilān tathetarat |
tilahomaṃ prakuryāccārthayellakṣmīnarāyaṇam ||43||
kṛpayā tava deveśa kṛtaṃ sāmvatsaraṃ vratam |
lakṣmīḥ prasannā bhavatu nārāyaṇaḥ prasādavān ||44||
bhaktāṃ māṃ sarvathā naijīṃ kṛtvā gṛhāṇa mādhava |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dehi me tvaṃ kānta śrīpuruṣottama ||45||
phalaṃ samastamevāhaṃ cārpayāmi tvayi prabho |
iti vyāhṛtya dadyācca puṣpāñjaliṃ namettataḥ ||46||
evaṃ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ visarjanaṃ samācaret |
nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇuyācca satsaṃgaṃ ca samācaret ||47||
puṇyapuñjāśrayā bhūtvā sā yāyānme’kṣaraṃ padam |
iha bhuktvā mahābhogān putrapautrasamanvitā ||48||
sarvapāpavinirmuktā kulāyutasamanvitā |
prayāti mama bhavanaṃ yogināmapi durlabham ||49 ||
muktā divyā bhavedatra mama yogena bhāminī |
brāhmī bhavettato brahmapriyā haripriyā tataḥ ||50||
sarvasiddhisamāyuktā sarvaiśvaryādiśālinī |
yathā lakṣmīryathā rādhā tathā syānme priyā tataḥ ||51 ||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
vrataṃ kartumaśaktāyāḥ pāpāyāḥ pāpanāśakam|
vinā prathatnaṃ saralaṃ sulabha sādhanaṃ vad ||52||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
abalāyāstu pāpāyā vratāsamarthayoṣitaḥ |
gurvarpaṇaṃ guruṃ nāvaṃ samāśrityāghanāśanam || 53||
gurutīrthe tu yā snātā śuddhyet sā drutameva ha |
svargiṇī jāyate sadyo mokṣaṃ sveṣṭaṃ ca vindati ||54||
gurutīrthe parā siddhistīrthānāṃ paramaṃ hi tat |
dhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ haristīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ sanātanam ||55||
indriyāṇāṃ vṛttayo vai nivartante tu yatsthale |
manobuddhyośca nirvṛttiryatra saṃjāyate parā ||56||
ātmaśāntirbhaveccāpi sadgurostu pratāpataḥ |
evaṃvidhe gurau tīrthe snāyāt sarvārpaṇena vai ||57||
gakārastvandhakāraḥ syād rakārastannirodhakaḥ | 
gurvī sāsti samarthā vai cāndhakāranirodhikā ||58||
jñānaṃ dadyādātmanastu dhyānaṃ dadyāddharestathā |
vivekaṃ pāpapuṇyānāṃ dadyājjaḍacidorapi ||59||
śubhāśubhānāṃ bhānaṃ ca dadyād doṣanivāraṇam |
mumukṣutāṃ bhāvayecca yā sā gurvī hi tāriṇī ||3.49.60||
śāntiṃ dadyād vicāreṇa prasādena pavitratām |
āśīrvādaṃ susnehena bhāgyaṃ dadyād balena ca ||6 1 ||
smṛddhiṃ dadyāttapobhiśca bhaktyā dadyāddhariṃ tu yā |
mokṣaṃ dadyāt sahagatyā gurvī sā saṃśrayāt sadā ||62||
mantraṃ dadyāddhareryā ca kaṇṭhīṃ dadyācca taulasīm |
