nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||63||
snehaṃ dadyāddharau tasya māhātmyajñānamuttamam |
divyatābhānamādadyāt tāṃ gurvīṃ saṃśrayet satī ||64||
yasyāḥ pādajalaṃ pāpaprakṣālakaṃ bhaved dhruvam ||
yasyāḥ prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ vāsanākṣālakaṃ bhavet ||65||
yasyāḥ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vastraṃ dehayogagataṃ jaḍam |
divyaṃ pavitraṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ vartate śubham ||66||
yasyā deho’sti bhagavaddeha eva na saṃśayaḥ |
yāsti vai nirguṇā nityaṃ nirguṇasya hareḥ priyā ||67||
mahābhāgavatī divyā sarvadātmanivedinī |
tasyāḥ pādarajaścāpi pāpinīnāṃ tu pāvanam ||68||
kṣālakaṃ mūlataścāste mokṣadaṃ jāyate tathā |
rādhālakṣmīsamā gurvī ramāpadmāsamā hi sā ||69||
preṣṭhāpadmāvatītulyā padminīmāṇikīsamā |
kamalāśrīsamā pārśvavartinārāyaṇīsamā||3.49.70||
tasyāḥ keśeṣu bhagavatkeśāḥ santi nivāsitāḥ
brahmarandhre hareḥ randhraṃ mastake mastakaṃ hareḥ ||7 1 ||
bhāle bhālaṃ hareścāsti bhrukuṭau bhrūkuṭirhareḥ |
netrayorharinetre ca karṇau hareśca karṇayoḥ ||72||
medhāyāṃ śrīharermedhā harergaṇḍau ca gaṇḍayoḥ |
kapolayoḥ kapolau ca harernāsā nasi prabhoḥ ||73||
tasyā mukhe ca jihvāyāṃ danteṣu coṣṭhayorhareḥ |
mukhaṃ jihvā ca dantāśca hyoṣṭhau hanau hanūrhareḥ ||74||
tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe hareḥ kaṇṭho harervakṣastu vakṣasi |
bhujayorhastayorbāhvoścāṃguliṣu nakheṣu ca ||75||
harerbhujau karau bāhū cāṃgulyaśca nakhāstathā |
kukṣau kukṣirharestasyā udare hyudaraṃ hareḥ ||76 ||
nābhau nābhirharestasyā jaghane jaghanaṃ hareḥ |
kaṭyāṃ kaṭirharestasyāḥ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaṃ harestathā ||77||
gupte guptaṃ hareścāpi sakthnorharestu sakthinī |
jānvostasyā harerjānū jaṃghe ca jaṃghayorhareḥ ||78||
pādayoḥ phaṇayoścāpi hareḥ pādau phaṇāvapi |
asthiṣu śrīhareḥ santi cāsthīni tvak tvacītyapi ||79||
romasu śrīhareḥ santi romāṇi mānase manaḥ |
indriyāṇīndriyeṣvasyā guṇeṣu ca harerguṇāḥ ||3.49.80||
bhūteṣvasyā harestattvaṃ cāntare cāntaraṃ tathā |
jñānecchāyatnadharmeṣu harerjñānādayastathā ||81||
kriyāyāṃ śrīhareścāsyāḥ kriyāśceṣṭā harestathā |
hasanaṃ gamanaṃ yānaṃ kīrtanaṃ svapanaṃ tathā ||82||
gurvyāḥ sarvaṃ hareścāste tasmād gurvī hi tāriṇī |
mokṣadā bhavapārasthā divyā divyagatipradā ||83||
gurvyā padośca tīrthāni pṛthivī vartate sadā |
jaṃghayorvaruṇo devo jānvoḥ kuberako’sti ca ||84||
sakthnorindraśca śeṣaśca kaṭyāṃ dharmo virājate |
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ udare jaghane vahnidevatā ||85||
nitambayostu nāsatyau vakṣasi śrīhariḥ svayam |
stanayoḥ parvatāścaiva kukṣiṣu sāgarāstathā ||86||
romasvoṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ pārśvayordevatāgaṇāḥ |
kaṇṭhe sarasvatī cāste mukhe lakṣmīrvirājate ||87||
netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca mastake brahma rājate |
hastayoścāpyannapūrṇā durgā cāpi virājate ||88||
hṛdaye dharmavaṃśaśca mānase’syā haripriyāḥ |
puṇyaṃ sādhvyā vacaneṣu śṛṃgāre smṛddhayastathā ||89||
gurvyā prasannatāyāṃ vai bhuktimuktirvirājate |
āśīrvāde ceṣṭasukhaṃ bhāgyamāste ca darśane ||3.49.90||
bhojane yajñabhuk cāste pāne’mṛtaṃ virājate |
rūpe ca śāradā devī lāvaṇye ca sudhāsti vai ||91 ||
pitaro’syāḥ samaudārye maharṣayo vrate tathā |
sādhavo’syā bhāvanāyāṃ bhaktiścātmani rājate || 92||
gāvo’syā hastatalayorvasavo’syāḥ praharṣaṇe |
rudrāścāsyā bhrukuṭau ca bhāskarā gaṇḍayostathā ||93||
oṣṭhayorbhagavanmāyā gurvyā divyā virājate |
gurvyāsane’kṣaraṃ brahma gaṃgā pādukayostathā || 14||
gurvyāḥ śāṭyāṃ mahālakṣmīḥ kañcukyāṃ rādhikāsti ca |
kaṭyambare surāṇyaśca bhūṣāsu śrīramādayaḥ ||95||
yajñopavīte trailokyaṃ yogapaṭṭe’ṣṭasiddhayaḥ |
saubhāgyadravyapuñjeṣu sampado’syā vasanti ca ||96||
gurvyāstvaci ca sarvatra santi sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ |
śarīramadhye sarvatra santi brahmavibhūtayaḥ ||97||
aiśvarye ceśvarāścāsyāścamatkāreṣu mātaraḥ |
brahmavrataṃ ca śīle’syāstādātmye’haṃ pareśvara ||98||
gupte’syāḥ saguṇaṃ brahma sakthnormūle susṛṣṭayaḥ |
rāje’haṃ gururūpāyāṃ gurvī cāhamahaṃ ca sā ||99||
asyā vai sevayoddhāraḥ pāpāyā api jāyate |
api yā gaṇikā vāpi puṃścalī madyapāyinī || 3.49.10 0||
māṃsādā sarvabhakṣyā vā hatyāḍhyā śvapacī ca vā |
gurvyāḥ satsaṃgaśaraṇāśrayasevādibhirhi sā |
pūyate niṣkalmaṣā syād dīvyati prottaratyapi || 10 1||
māyākālakriyāpāśānmuktā muktiṃ prayāti me |
paṭhanācchavaṇāccāsya mama muktiṃ prayāti vai || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ pāpoddhārakalakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataśrīharigurugurvītīrthamahimavarṇananāmā navacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||

<3.50>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
gurutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhūyo’pi vada me pate |
jijñāsā vardhate śrotuṃ sulabhaṃ gurutīrthakam || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
dhanyāsi kṛtakṛtyāsi gurutīrthāvagāhinī |
yoṣitāṃ dayayā lakṣmi śreyaḥkarī yato hyasi || 2 ||
kathayāmi tathā bhūyo gurutīrthaṃ niśāmaya |
sarvapāpaharaṃ cāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ mokṣadāyakam || 3 ||
divyatāpādakaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmātmakaṃ sanātanam |
sarvaiśvaryānvitaṃ śīghraṃ pratyakṣaphaladāyakam || 4 ||
guroḥ prasādāt kamale ihaiva phalabhāg bhavet |
paralokasukhaṃ bhuṃkte mahānandamavānuyāt || 5 ||
guroḥ prasādāt kamale trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate śiṣyairīśalokagatiṃ prati || 6 ||
avyāhatagatimān syād vijñānaṃ vindate tathā |
yaśaḥ kīrti vyavahāraṃ prādhānyaṃ kṛpayā labhet || 7 ||
sūryavat sarvathā guruḥ prakāśako’ndhacakṣuṣām |
somavacchāntidaścāpi prakāśado niśātmake || 8 ||
dīpavad gṛhahṛdaye prabhādo vai guruḥ sadā |
divā sūryaḥ śaśī rātrau dīpo gṛhe guruḥ sadā || 9 ||
prakāśate śiṣyahṛdi gururbrahmaprakāśakṛt |
ato guruḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ jñānadānakaiḥ || 3.50.10 ||
vijñāyaivaṃ guruṃ gurvī sarvabhāvaiḥ prasādayet |
karmabhirmanasā dehairvāṇyā ca sevayā tathā || 11 ||
atrārthe te kathayāmi kathāṃ divyāṃ manoharām |
brahmaputro bhṛgustasya vaṃśe’bhūccyavano muniḥ || 1 2||
kadāhaṃ jñānasampannaḥ syāmityacintayan muhuḥ |
tadarthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāmagamajjñānalabdhaye || 13||
gaṃgāyātrāṃ badarītaścākapilāśramaṃ vyadhāt |
godāvaryāḥ sarasvatyā narmadāyāstathā vyadhāt || 14||
kāyaśca nirmalo jātaḥ sūryatejaḥsamaprabhaḥ |
oṃkāreśvaramāsādya vaṭacchāyāsthito’bhavat || 15||
narmadāyā jalaṃ pītvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaparo’bhavat |
tatra śuśrāva pakṣiṇāṃ bhāṣāṃ vijñānasaṃbhṛtām || 16||
śukaputrā hi catvāraścāsaṃste pitṛnandanāḥ |
ujjvalaśca samujjvalo vijvalaśca kapiñjalaḥ || 17||
ete kuṃjalaśukajāḥ pitṛmātṛparāyaṇāḥ |
phalānyāhṛtya pitṛbhyāṃ dadatyapi ca bhuñjate || 18||
krīḍanti pitṛnikaṭe mātṛsannidhimutsukāḥ |
svapanti ca cyavanasya paśyato nityameva te || 19||
sāyamāgatya te sarve nityaṃ sevāṃ caranti ca |
āgatāste caritvaiva piturnīḍaṃ sukhāvaham ||3.50.20||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ cobhau praṇemuśca phalāni ca |
daduścāpi ca pitṛbhyāṃ mānitāḥ śrāntimāsthitāḥ ||21 ||
sambhāṣitāḥ sevitāśca pakṣavātādibhiśca te |
sevante sma pitarau ca pitarau dadatustadā ||22||
śubhāśīrvacanānyeva tataḥ papraccha tān pitā |
ujjvala tvaṃ cādya kasyāṃ diśāyāṃ vai gato’bhavaḥ ||23||
tatra dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ cāpyapūrvaṃ cenme nivedaya |
śrutvojjvalaḥ praṇamyaiva pitaraṃ prāha tatkathām ||24||
gaṃgādvīpaṃ jagāmādya rājā yatra hi dhārmikaḥ |
divodāso vartate vai satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ |||25||
brāhmīdevī tasya patnī pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
suṣuve guṇarūpāḍhyāṃ suśīlāṃ cārumaṃgalām ||26||
divyādevītivikhyātāṃ kanyāṃ lāvaṇyaśevadhim |
prathame vayasi divyāṃ varayogyāṃ vilokya ca ||27||
pitā kāmarūpadeśarājaṃ citraprasenakam |
āhūya kanyāṃ pradadau citrasenāya dhīmate ||28||
vivāhayajñe rājā sa citraseno mamāra ha |
akṛtāgnipradakṣiṇā kanyā saubhāgyavarjitā ||29||
abhavad vai tadā rājā viprān papraccha kāraṇam |
asyā vivāhasamaye citraseno divaṃ gataḥ ||3.50.30||
asyā vai kīdṛśaṃ karma bhavatyeva bruvantu me |
śrutvā viprāḥ samāhurvai lagnakālastathāvidhaḥ ||21 ||
patimṛtyuśca vā patyuḥ pravrajitā ca rugṇatā |
atha rājā ca kālena tvindraprasthapuraṃ yayau ||32||
indraprasthanṛparūpasenāyemāṃ samārpayat |
rūpaseno’pi vai mṛtyuṃ gato vivāhanakṣaṇe ||33 ||
evaṃ yadā yadā yasmai rājā dadāti kanyakām |
tadbhartā vahnisākṣye vai mṛtyuṃ gacchati satvaram ||34||
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākā varā mṛtyuṃgatāstathā |
kanyā tvāste cākṣatā vai divodāsaḥ śuśoca ha ||35||
tato mantrivaco matvā svayaṃvaraṃ vyadhāpayat |
rājāno bahavastatra samāhūtāḥ samantataḥ ||36||
svayaṃvarasabhāmadhye yadā prāptā kumārikā |
rādhāsamāṃ candramukhīṃ vyalokayan nṛpāstadā ||37||
adattavaramālāyā rūpaṃ vīkṣya tu tāmasāḥ |
rājāno mohamāpannā haraṇārthaṃ samudyatāḥ ||38||
anye tasyāstu rakṣārthaṃ tadaivaṃ samaro’bhavat |
tatra mahān kṣayo jātaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ svayaṃvare ||39||
divyādevī suduḥkhārtā vairāgyaṃ samupāgatā |
yayau vindhyācale taptuṃ tapastatra ruroda sā ||3.50.40||
mayā tasyā rodanaṃ vai śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadantike |
pitastasyāḥ kathaṃ tādṛgbhāgyaṃ rājanyanāśakam ||41 ||
kumāratvaṃ vane vāsaścārdhaṃ vivāhanaṃ tathā |
iti me saṃśayaścāsyāṃ vartate tanniṣūdaya ||42||
śrutvā putravacastatra śukaḥ kuṃjalako jagau |
pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṇu putra hi kānyakam ||43||
sā kanyā pūrvamāsīdvai suvīravaiśyabhāminī |
vārāṇasyāṃ ca nāmnā vai citrā svatantragāminī ||44||
anācāraparā pāpā svairiṇī vyabhicāriṇī |
bhartāraṃ manyate naiva puṇyahīnā tu pāpinī ||45||
kutsayate patiṃ kleśakarī saddharmavarjitā |
paragṛhe vasati bhramatyapi sā gṛhe gṛhe ||46||
paracchidraṃ paśyati drāk sādhunindāparā tathā |
parahāsyakarī duṣṭā sadācāravivarjitā ||47||
suvīreṇa tu vaiśyena gṛhānniṣkāsitā hi sā |
duṣṭānāṃ saṃgatiṃ prāptā dūtīkarma cakāra sā ||48||
kulaṭā ca vyabhicārakarma kārayati parāḥ |
gṛhabhaṃgaṃ kārayati sādhūnāṃ dharmavartmanām ||49||
sādhvīṃ nārīṃ samāhūya dravyadānaiḥ pralobhayet |
manobhaṃgaṃ kārayati vyavāye yojayatyapi ||3.50.50||
sādhūnāṃ sā striyaṃ bhaṅtvāpyanyasmai pradadātyapi |
evaṃ gṛhaśataṃ bhagnaṃ citrayā duṣṭayā purā ||51||
saṃgrāmaṃ sā mahāduṣṭākārayat patiputrakaiḥ |
evaṃ pāpaparā sā tu mṛtā yamapuraṃ gatā ||52||
bhuktvā ca yātanāḥ paścāt karmavipākamāgatā |
sā tvidānīṃ kṛtaṃ karma bhuṃkte roditi bhāminī ||53 ||
yasmād gṛhaśataṃ tasmādasyāḥ śataṃ varāḥ |
ekaviṃśatisahitā vivāhe ca svayaṃvare ||54||
pāpāyāḥ śubhasamaye tatsaṃkhyākā mṛtā varāḥ |
gṛhabhaṃgo na kartavyo yasya kasyāpi dehinaḥ ||55||
parabhaṃge nijabhaṃgo jāyate naiva saṃśayaḥ |
śrutvaivamujjvalaḥ prāha pitaścāsyā mahatkule ||56||
janma kathaṃ ca vai jātaṃ pāpāyā vada me’pi tat |
śrutvā putravacaścāpi kuñjalaḥ prāha putrakam ||57||
dūtī yatrābhavat sā vai tatraikadā tu bhūsuraḥ |
sādhudharmā siddhagatiḥ kucelo daṇḍavān yatiḥ ||58||
kaupīnamātravastraśca citrādvāramupasthitaḥ |
maunī jitendriyo jñānī vrahmabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||59||
tattvadarśī kṣudhātṛṣāvyāptaśca śramitaḥ sukhī |
dūrādhvānapariśrāntaścitrayā sa vilokitaḥ ||3.50.60||
nāmnā kṛṣṇāyanaṃ citrā dṛṣṭvājuhāva taṃ gṛhe |
āsanaṃ ca dadau vāri bhojanaṃ madhuparkakam ||61||
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre sādhuṃ matvā susevanam |
akarot sā prasannaḥ sā āśīrvādaṃ dadau śubham ||62||
rājaputrī bhavatvevaṃ kathayitvā yayau hi saḥ |
atha kālāntare citrā mṛtyuṃgatā tatastviha ||63||
sādhoḥ sevāphalenāpi tadāśīrvādatastathā |
divodāsagṛhe putrī divyādevī vyajāyata ||64||
sā hi dattavattī cānnaṃ jalaṃ sevāṃ tathāsanam |
tasmāt puṇyasya māhātmyād rājaputrī hi vartate ||65||
gṛhabhaṃgādipāpaiśca hyadhavātvaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
sahate vai tataḥ sevā kartavyā satataṃ satām ||66||
guroḥ sevā prakartavyā sādhordharmavratasya ca |
sādhvyāḥ sevā prakartavyā sarvasampatkarī hi sā ||67||
rājaputrā mṛtā ye ye te purā bhāṇḍajātayaḥ |
nārīṇāṃ hārakāścāsan tena pāpena te mṛtāḥ ||68||
govipragurusādhūnāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ purā |
āsam̐ścāpi ca vai tena rājaputratvamāgatāḥ |||69||
ataḥ sevyāḥ sādhavaśca guravaśca sadā hi tāḥ |
parabhaṃgo gṛhabhaṃgo na kartavyaḥ kadācana ||3.50.70||
śrutvojjvalaḥ punastatra papraccha pitaraṃ prati |
kathaṃ sā mucyate śokānmahāduḥkhād vadasva me ||71||
kathaṃ sā labhate mokṣaṃ taṃ copāyaṃ vadasva me |
pitā ca kuñjalaḥ prāha śrutvā putraṃ tamujjvalam ||72||
śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi tasyā duḥkhavināśakam |
sādhanaṃ mokṣaṇasyāpi yena śuddhā bhaviṣyati ||73||
harerdhyānājjapāccāpi vratācca gurusevanāt |
pāpanāśo mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||74||
divyo nārāyaṇaścāste’kṣare dhāmni parātparaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ||75||
kiśoraḥ sarvaśobhāḍhyaḥ śrīkāntaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
māyikākāravarjyaḥ sa divyākārasamanvitaḥ ||76||
divyamukuṭamūrddhā ca divyacakrādiśobhanaḥ |
koṭicandrābhavadanaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ ||77||
sarvabhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyaḥ kaustubhena virājitaḥ |
kamalākṛtasevaśca śrīvatsāṃkena rājitaḥ ||78|||
manohārisvarūpaśca kāntaḥ kāntārhayauvanaḥ |
evaṃ dhyāyet satī nityaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhakam ||79||
hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkṛṣṇamokṣakṛt ||3.50.80||
evaṃ kuryād bhajanaṃ vai japaṃ kuryāddhare iti |
vrataṃ kuryāt pūrṇimāyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam ||81||
udyāpanena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇapūjānvitaṃ śubham |
gurostatra cyavanasya prakuryāt sevanaṃ hi sā ||82||
karmaṇā manasā vācā tadā duḥkhaṃ prahāsyati |
ityuktaṃ sarvamevaitat pakṣyapatyaṃ praṇamya ca ||83||
piturājñāṃ samādāya yatra sā tatra vai yayau |
pakṣibhāṣāṃ parityajya strīvāṇyā tāṃ jagāda ha ||84||
ujjvalaḥ sannidhau gatvā tāpasīṃ cedamabravīt |
kā tvaṃ bhavasi kasyāsi kasmādatra samāgatā ||85||
samācakṣva tvamanaghe tapasaścāpi kāraṇam |
divyādevī samuvāca pakṣyapatyaṃ vilokya sā ||86||
āścaryaṃ mahadāpannā pakṣin śṛṇu yathātatham |
ko bhavān me vadatvatra viśvāso yena jāyate ||87||
pakṣī prāha mahābhāge pakṣyahaṃ tava duḥkhahāḥ |
rudamānāṃ vilokyaitat pṛṣṭaṃ me vada kāraṇam ||88||
yathābalaṃ yatiṣye’haṃ tava duḥkhavināśane |
śrutvā divyādevikā sā jagāda pakṣiṇaṃ prati ||89||
karmaṇāṃ me phalaṃ bhuṃje divodāsasutāsmi ca |
śatādhikā hi patayo mṛtā udvāhanotsave ||3.50.90||
adhavāhaṃ hi tiṣṭhāmi tapo’rthamatra cāgatā |
pāpanāśo bhaved yena tamupāyaṃ karomi ca ||9 1 ||
ujjvalaśca samākarṇya pitroktaṃ prāha yoṣite |
sāpi tathyaṃ hi tanmene prāyaścittamiyeṣa sā ||92||
papraccha pakṣiṇaṃ pūrvakṛtapāpasya niṣkṛtim |
ujjvalaḥ prāha viṣṇorvai dhyānaṃ kuru yathoditam ||93||
japaṃ kuru hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara |
vrataṃ kuru śubhaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ param ||94||
pūrṇimāyāṃ nirāhāraṃ jāgaraṇasamanvitam |
udyāpanasametaṃ ca guroḥ saṃsevanaṃ kuru ||95||
guruścātra cyavano’sti narmadāyāḥ śubhe taṭe |
bhajasva taṃ mahātmānaṃ puṇyapuñjā bhaviṣyasi ||96||
ityuktā jagṛhe sarvaṃ pakṣitaḥ sā śubhodayā |
vrataṃ cakre japaṃ cakre dhyānaṃ cakre harestathā ||97||
cyavanasya vaṭe sevāṃ cakre gatvā gurorhi sā |
dehena manasā vācā sarvārpaṇena kanyakā ||98||
gurostu kṛpayā sādhvī varṣamadhye dadarśa ha |
divyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||99||
ghanaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadādharam |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ || 3.50.1 00||
daṇḍavad dharaṇiṃ prāpya cakāra gadgadābhavat |
uvāca ca hariścāhaṃ kṛpayā tava cāgataḥ || 10 1||
guroḥ prasādalābhena jātaṃ me darśanaṃ tava |
varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāge dadāmi tava vāñchitam || 1 02||
śrutvā sā kanyakā vavre māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt |
tava pādau bhajiṣyāmi kāntabhaktiṃ pradehi me || 1 03||
mokṣe dāsīpadaṃ dehi yadi tuṣṭo’si nātha me |
hariḥ prāhāstvevameva cāyāhi mama dhāma vai || 1 04||
tāvat sāpyabhavad divyādevī lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī |
vimānavaramāsādya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva sā || 1 05||
ujjvalaḥ pitaraṃ prāha vṛttāntaṃ sarvameva ha |
pitā viveda sarvaṃ ca mahimānaṃ gurostadā || 1 06||
cyavanaḥ sarvakāmānāṃ pūrako vaiṣṇavo guruḥ |
sevitaḥ kanyayā tena yātā sā brahmadarśanam || 1 07||
tenaiva divyadehena yātā mokṣapadaṃ satī |
lakṣmīrjātāparā dhāmni dhyānajapavratādibhiḥ || 1 08||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpāpi pāpaśodhitā |
bhūtvā yāyāddharerdhāma lakṣmi kāntā bhavenmama || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe divyādevīmokṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||

<3.51>
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kuñjalastu tataḥ param |
dvitīyaṃ svasutaṃ cāpi papraccha vinayānvitam || 1 ||
samujjvala kimapūrvaṃ dṛṣṭavān śrutavān vada |
śrutvā samujjvalaḥ prāha himavantaṃ giriṃ pitaḥ || 2 ||
āhārārthaṃ pragacchāmi paśyāmi kautukaṃ navam |
mānasaṃ yatsaraścāste tatra dṛṣṭaṃ vadāmi tat || 3 ||
bahuhaṃsasamākīrṇo haṃsa ekaḥ samāgataḥ |
sa ca kṛṣṇo mahātejāḥ kṛṣṇahaṃsānvitaḥ śubhaḥ || 4 ||
trayaścānye’pi śuklāśca cañcupādaistu kṛṣṇakāḥ |
āyayuste caturṇṇāṃ vai patnyo haṃsyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 5 ||
bhayaṃkaryaścordhvakeśyaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā vibhīṣaṇāḥ |
kṛṣṇā haṃsā jale sasnurna sasnuśca trayo’pare || 6 ||
catasro haṃsikāścāpi naiva sasnuḥ sarovare |
kṛṣṇā haṃsā jalāttasmādvinirgatyāyayurdrutam || 7 ||
trayo’nye haṃsakāścāpyāyayuruḍḍīya vindhyakam |
śiṣṭāścatasro haṃsyo’pi vindhyācalamupāyayuḥ || 8 ||
haṃsā haṃsyo mahābhītā babhramuḥ paritastataḥ |
niṣaṇṇā duḥkhadagdhāśca vṛkṣaśākhāsu saṃhitāḥ || 9 ||
tatra kaścit samāyāto lubdhakastu dhanurdharaḥ |
śilāpṛṣṭhe niṣasāda bhillī tataḥ samāgatā || 3.51.1 0||
dvāvetau cyavanau dṛṣṭvā maharṣiṃ taṃ praṇematuḥ |
cyavanasya pādajalaṃ pītvā divyau babhūvatuḥ || 11 ||
vimānavaramāruhya yayatuḥ svargameva tau |
devau divyatamau bhūtvā hṛṣṭau sākṣānmayi hi tau || 12||
atha haṃsāstadoḍḍīya cyavanasyaiva pādayoḥ |
rajassu te samaluṭhan tathā pādajalaṃ papuḥ || 1 3||
cyavanenābhiṣiktāste śvetā babhūvureva ca |
kṛṣṇatvaṃ līnatāṃ prāptaṃ yayuścādṛśyatāṃ tataḥ || 14||
ke tvāsan vai pitarhaṃsāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā hi te purā |
paścāt śvetāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ kva gatāste tataḥ param || 15||
kuñjalastat samākarṇya prāha putraṃ samujjvalam |
śṛṇu putra kathayāmi divyaṃ kathānakaṃ tu tat || 16||
tānyāsan sarvatīrthāni cāṣṭaṣaṣṭimatāni vai |
eteṣu mānavāḥ snātvā pāpāni kṣālayanti ca || 17||
govadhākhyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ strīvadhākhyaṃ tathāvidham |
svāmidrohātmakaṃ pāpaṃ surāpānātmakaṃ tathā || 18||
hemasteyodgataṃ pāpaṃ gurunindātmakaṃ tathā |
bhrūṇahatyā mahāghorā rājadrohastathāvidhaḥ ||19||
mitradrohaśca viśvāsaghātaśca devabhedanam |
vṛtticchedo gocarasya nāśanaṃ vahnidāhanam || 3.51.20||
sādhusādhvīvināśaśca garadānaṃ bhayaṃkaram |
mātāpitṛvadhaścāpi bālikābhoga ityapi ||21 ||
paśuhatyā mātṛsaṃgo viṃśatipātakāni vai |
tathānyāni pātakāni mānavāḥ kṣālayanti hi ||22||
taiḥ pāpaiḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ yānti prāptāni tīrthakāni vai |
tāni pāpāni sarvāṇi kṣālayituṃ nijāni hi || 23||
bhūtvā haṃsasvarūpāṇi gatāni mānasaṃ saraḥ |
snātvā naiva vinaṣṭāni pāpāni tena vai punaḥ ||24||
narmadāyāstīramāptā haṃsāścāsan suduḥkhitāḥ |
pāpaprakṣālanaṃ tīrthaṃ cintayanto drume sthitāḥ ||25||
tairdṛṣṭau divyarūpau ca vyādhīvyādhau divaṃgatau |
parasparaṃ vadamānau cyavanasya gurorbalam ||26||
brahmahatyā gurughātaścāgamyāgamanādikam |
gohatyā ca surāpānaṃ naṣṭaṃ gurorbalāddhi nau ||27||
divyau jātau svargayānau dhanyaṃ pādaṃ gurorbhuvi |
itiśrutvā ca te haṃsāścyavanasyāntikaṃ yayuḥ ||28||
luluṭhuḥ pādarajasi pādavāri papuśca te |
cyavano’pi tadā revatoyaiścāprokṣayaddhi tān ||29||
sarve haṃsāḥ śvetavarṇā bhūtvā natvā muniṃ muhuḥ |
yayuścādṛśyatāṃ tatra haṃsā haṃsyo’pi sarvaśaḥ || 3.51.30||
gurutīrthaṃ pātakānāṃ śāmakaṃ paramottamam |
sarvatīrthāni mānāni gurutīrthe bhavanti vai ||3 1 |
kṛṣṇahaṃsānvitaścaiko yaścāsīt kṛṣṇahaṃsakaḥ |
sarvatīrthasametaḥ sahyabhūt prayāgarājakaḥ ||32||
trayaścānye tu haṃsāste revā godā ca puṣkaram |
haṃsyaścāpi catasrastā gaṃgā ca brahmaputrikā ||33||
sarasvatī ca kāverī hyāsaṃstatra hi haṃsikāḥ |
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gurutīrthaniṣevaṇam ||34||
sarvapāpaharaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vai gurutīrthakam |
atha vai kuñjalaḥ putraṃ papraccha ca tṛtīyakam ||35||
kiṃ vijvala tvayā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ kathayātra me |
vijvalaḥ pitaraṃ prāha nūtnaṃ vilokitaṃ tu yat ||36||
pitaścāhaṃ navalakṣābhidhaṃ vai parvataṃ yayau |
devavṛndaiścāpsarobhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ śubham || 37||
divyavṛkṣaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ phalapuṣpanataiḥ sadā |
yogino navalakṣāṇi vartante yatra parvate ||38||
ānandakānanaṃ nāma vanaṃ tatra prabhāsate |
vimalaṃ ca sarastatra viśālaṃ cāvalokitam ||39||
yādobhirvividhairyuktaṃ haṃsakāraṇḍavādibhiḥ |
kinnaroragagandharvaiścāraṇādyaiḥ suśobhitam ||3.51.40||
vimānaṃ tatra vārīṇāmupari cāmbare śubham |
suvarṇakalaśairyuktaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sahasā kānakam ||41||
chatradaṇḍapatākābhī rājamānaḥ pumān śubhaḥ |
kinnarairapsarobhiśca gandharvādyairmaharṣibhiḥ ||42||
stūyamāno mahāsiddhairdṛṣṭaḥ surūpa uttamaḥ |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāṃgo ratnahārādirājitaḥ ||43||
tatpārśve tvekakāntā ca varānanā suśobhitā |
muktāhārayutā cāpi valayaiḥ kaṃkaṇairyutā ||44||
divyāmbarā suśṛṃgārā yuvatī cārcitā sthitā |
tau dvau hṛṣṭau vimānāccāvarohayatāṃ bhūtale ||45||
snātavantau ca yāvattau mṛtau tāvaddhi tau taṭe |
śavo divyau taṭe staśca tau dvau pṛthak taṭe sthitau ||46||
nāryau dve ca narau dvau ca tāveva vīkṣitau mayā |
tatra vaimānikau dvau yau tau śastreṇa nijau śavau ||47||
bhakṣayāmāsatustatra nārī nārīṃ naro naram |
kṣudhayā pīḍyamānau bhakṣayataḥ piśitaṃ nijam ||48||
anye dve ca striyau tāta cāyāte tvambarāt pṛthak |
hasataḥ khādamānau tāvasmadyoge’pi nārpitam ||49||
annaṃ svalpaṃ jalaṃ svalpaṃ kasmaicittvapinārpitam |
evaṃ tau bhakṣayitvaiva pītvā jalaṃ divaṃ prati ||3.51.50||
gatau vimānamāruhya dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mayā navam |
kimetad vada me tāta svamāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ kutaḥ ||51||
śrutvā putrasya tadvākyaṃ kuñjalaḥ prāha putrakam |
śṛṇu vijvala loko’yaṃ karmabhūmirhi vartate ||52||
puṇyakarmā modate’tra paratra bhojanādibhiḥ |
dattaṃ dānaṃ samāyāti purato yatra yāti saḥ ||53|||
adattaṃ naiva cāyāti svarge’nyatra ca vā gataḥ |
yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ kṣetre tu kṛṣikārakaḥ ||54||
labhate tādṛśaṃ tatra phalaṃ bījasajātikam |
yādṛśaṃ kriyate karma tādṛśaṃ labhyate phalam ||55||
karmadāyādako lokaḥ pūrvakarmavaśānugaḥ |
pūrvaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ caitat phalarūpaṃ niṣevyate ||96 ||
pañca sṛṣṭāni garbhe’sya dehinaḥ karmajāni vai |
yaśovittaṃ jīvikā ca vidyā ca maraṇaṃ tathā ||57||
devatvaṃ vā mānuṣatvaṃ paśutvaṃ pakṣitāthavā |
tiryaktvaṃ sthāvaratvaṃ ca smṛddhayo bhojanādikam ||58|
ātmanā vihitaṃ yādṛk tādṛk samupatiṣṭhati |
pūrvadehakṛtaṃ kaścit kartumalaṃ hi nānyathā ||59|
śubhāśubhaṃ kṛtaṃ karma kartāramanugacchati |
upabhogādṛte tasya nāśa eva na vidyate ||3.51.60 |
suśīghramapi dhāvantaṃ svakarma cānudhāvati |
upatiṣṭhati tiṣṭhantaṃ gacchantamanugacchati ||6 1 |
chāyāvad vartate lagnaṃ bhogaṃ phalaṃ dadāti tat |
yena yatropabhoktavyaṃ daivena tatra nīyate ||62|
karmabhūmiriyaṃ tāta cānyā bhogāya dhūmayaḥ |
colarājaḥ subāhvākhyo dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||63||
ratnāni ca suvarṇāni rājatādīni koṭiśaḥ |
annaṃ jalaṃ ca sulabhaṃ matvā dadau na tattadā ||64||
purodhāścolarājasya jaiministamupādiśat |
śraddhayā vidhivat pātre dehi cānnaṃ dhanādikam ||65||
annadānāt paraṃ nāsti prāṇināṃ tṛptidaṃ drutam |
tasmādannaṃ payoyuktaṃ pradehi kṣatriyarṣabha ||66||
tāraṇāya hitāyaiva sukhasampattihetave |
grāsāgramapi dātavya muṣṭiprasthaṃ ca vā nṛpa ||67||
śraddhayā vā parvadine vipraṃ santaṃ prabhojaya |
ekabhojanalabhyaṃ vai phalaṃ nityaṃ bhunakti hi ||68||
pūrvajanmani dattānnaṃ janmāntare sadā labhet |
nityaṃ prabhujyate dattaṃ dehyannaṃ cāvicārayan ||69||
prāṇarūpaṃ yato’nnaṃ tat pradehi tvaṃ prayatnataḥ |
svarge loke sadā cānnaṃ dattamamṛtamīyate ||3.51.70||
śrutvā nṛpatiḥ papraccha svargaguṇān vadātra me |
jaiminiḥ svargalābhām̐ścākathayad vai subāhave ||71 ||
sarvakāmapradānyudyānāni svarge bhavanti vai |
sarvartuphalapuṣpāṇi vimānāni ca santi vai ||72||
apsarasaśca divyāśca hemaśayyāsanāni ca |
sarvakāmasamṛddhyo vidyante kalpavallijāḥ ||73 ||
na rogā na jarā mṛtyurna śoko na himātapau |
na tatra kṣutpipāsā ca na glāniścāpi vidyate ||74||
evaṃvidhaguṇaṃ svargaṃ doṣām̐statrāpi tān śṛṇu |
atra dattaṃ hi labhyeta nādattaṃ tatra labhyate ||75||
doṣo mahānayaṃ svarge’tiśayo doṣa ityapi |
adattasyātra bhogyasyāsantoṣastatra vai sadā ||76||
anyaśriyaṃ parāṃ dṛṣṭvā samudvegaḥ sadāsti ca |
akasmāt patanaṃ cāpi vāsanāvaśavartitā ||77||
phalabhūmirmatā dyauśca karmabhūmiriyaṃ matā |
tasmādannaṃ pradattaṃ yat tatsvarge bhujyate suraiḥ ||78||
śrutvā nṛpaḥ ṛṣiṃ prāha nirdoṣaṃ vada me padam |
jaiminiścāha bhagavatpadaṃ nirdoṣameva ha ||79||
ābrahmabhavanā lokāḥ sadoṣāḥ karmaṇārjitāḥ |
māyālokāḥ samastā vai doṣavanto guṇātmakāḥ ||3.51.80||
aguṇaṃ tu padaṃ viṣṇornārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ |
bhaktiyogagatāstatra sādhvyo gacchanti sādhavaḥ ||81||
rājā prāha na me svargaṃ gantumicchā pravartate |
yasmādvai patanaṃ tatra gantavyaṃ naiva sarvathā ||82||
dānaphalaṃ ca bhogo vai bhogānte patanaṃ yadi |
dānameva na kartavyaṃ pātaphalaṃ mayā kvacit ||83||
kariṣye dhyānabhaktyādi yajiṣye kamalāpatim |
dāhapralayavarjyaṃ ca gamiṣye paramaṃ padam ||84||
śrutvā taṃ jaiminiścāha rājan dharmo nṛpasya yaḥ |
anicchatāpi kartavyo dānaṃ yajñaḥ pradānakam ||85||
ādāvannaṃ suyajñeṣu jalaṃ tāmbūlamambaram |
kāñcanaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ cetaracca yat ||86||
vaikuṇṭhe’pi phalaṃ bhuṃkte dānadharmasya śāśvatam |
sādhubhyastu vibhāgaikaṃ gogrāsaṃ ca tataḥ param ||87||
bhṛtyādibhyaścaikabhāgaṃ prayacchanti tapodhanāḥ |
evamannasya dānena divyalokagatā api ||88||
kṣudhātṛṣāvihīnāśca nityatṛptā hareḥ sthale |
tiṣṭhanti nānyathā rājan dehyannaṃ dhanamityapi ||89||
dānājjñānaṃ tataḥ siddhistatastṛptiṃ gamiṣyasi |
adāne tvaṃ gataścāpi vaikuṇṭhe kṣudhamāpyasi ||3.51.90||
śrutvā rājā tadā prāha dānaṃ cet tṛptikāraṇam |
yogināṃ ca satāṃ tyāgavatāṃ mokṣe hi kā gatiḥ || 91 ||
adattadānāḥ ṛṣayaḥ karapātrā hi sādhavaḥ |
aparigrahasarvasvā mokṣe tṛptāḥ kathaṃ vada ||92|||
śrutvā prāha ṛṣistaṃ vai jñānabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
mūrtyānandena tṛptāste sadā kṣuttṛḍvivarjitāḥ ||93||
rājā prāha tathaivāhaṃ yatiṣye jñānabhaktimān |
dānaṃ bandhapradaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ niścikāya saḥ ||94||
jñānaṃ kṛtvā tathā svalpāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā mamāra saḥ |
subāhuḥ pramadāyukto vimānodagramāśritaḥ ||95||
yayau svargaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ bhoktaṃ vidhānataḥ |
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ svarṇādidānajam ||96||
kṣudhā jātā mahātīvrā tṛṣāpi ca tathāvidhā |
rājā vai priyayā sārdhaṃ kṣudhātṛṣāprapīḍitaḥ ||97||
svarge ruddhaḥ karmaṇā vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ naiva gacchati |
hṛṣīkeśo dṛśyate na vimānaṃ nordhvamṛcchati || 98||
svarge rājā vyākulo vai jātaḥ kṣudhādipīḍitaḥ |
itaścetaśca vegaiśca dhāvati kṣmādhipastadā ||99||
sarvābharaṇaśobhāṃgaścandanādivibhūṣitaḥ |
apsarobhiḥ sevyamāno devaiśca satkṛto’pi ca ||3.51.1 00||
adattaṃ nāptavān rājāmṛtaṃ cānnaṃ prabhojanam |
jalaṃ ca nāptavān svarge babhrāma pīḍito muhuḥ || 10 1||
bhāryāṃ saṃprāha rājānaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ surāḥ |
bhuñjate’mṛtamevātra dattamannaṃ purā tu yat || 10 2||
annavāripradānaṃ tu na kṛtaṃ bhūtale nṛpa |
kṣudhā māṃ tvāṃ bādhate’tastṛṣā cogrā pravartate || 1 03||
bhojanaṃ salilaṃ cātra labhyate na vimānake |
amṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ nāsti cānyadevagṛhe iva || 1 04||
yāmaḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhojanārthaṃ jalārthaṃ nanu pārthiva |
ityukto bhūpatiḥ rājñyā vimānena drutaṃ kṣitim || 105||
ājagāma vane ramye nandane tatra vai ṛṣim |
dadarśa vāmadevaṃ sa sabhāryo nṛpatistataḥ || 106||
avatīrya namaścakre dattāsane hyupāviśat |
ṛṣikṛtaṃ svāgatādi jagrāhātha nirāmayam || 1 07||
pṛṣṭo rājā jagādarṣiṃ nirāmayo bhavāmi na |
kṣudhā me bādhate cāpi tṛṣā cātīva dāruṇā || 1 08||
tābhyāṃ śāntiṃ na gacchāmi sukhaṃ vindāmi naiva ca |
śrutvaiva vāmadevastaṃ prāha rājan hitaṃ śṛṇu || 1 09||
annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ tvayā dattaṃ na bhūtale |
hariścārādhito naiva naivedyaphalavāribhiḥ || 3.51.11 0||
tena doṣeṇa svarge na vaikuṇṭhe’pi na te kṛte |
bhojanaṃ vidyate rājan sarvamanyat pravidyate || 111 ||
ārādhitastvayā viṣṇurjñānabhaktyā tu śuṣkayā |
tena prāptaṃ tvayā svargaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhojanamantarā || 11 2||
annaṃ tvamṛtarūpeṇa svarge cāvāpyate nṛpa |
vaikuṇṭhe brahmatṛptyātma pīyūṣaṃ prāpyate sadā || 11 3||
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāśca kṣārāmblamadhurāstathā |
snigdhāścopaskarāḥ sarve nānārūpāśca bhūgatāḥ || 114||
dattāḥ sarvā hyavāpyante oṣadhyaḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ |
sādhavaḥ pitaro devā bhojitā yena bhūpate || 1 15||
sa eva bhuṃkte svarge’pi bhojanasya phalāmṛtam |
miṣṭānnapānamevātra dāne dattaṃ na vai tvayā || 1 16||
svaśarīraṃ tvayā puṣṭamannairamṛtasadṛśaiḥ |
adattaṃ ca yatastasmād bhuṃkṣva kṣudhātṛṣāphalam || 1 17||
yadi te kṣutpratīkāro hyabhīṣṭo vartate tadā |
yāhi nandanasarasi snātvā bhuṃkṣva śavaṃ nijam || 1 18||
evamuktaḥ subāhuśca vāmadevaṃ praṇamya tu |
nandanākhyavane gatvā sasnau taṭākavāriṇi ||1 19||
tāvacchavau samutpannau rājño rājñyā hi tau śavau |
nijau tau bhakṣitavantau tṛptau jātau tadā hi tau || 3.51.120||
hasataśca striyau dve ye prajñā śraddhā hi te mate |
dānamārgaṃ parityajya jñānamārge gataṃ nṛpam ||1 21 ||
lobhamārge sthitaṃ bhūpaṃ hasataste hyubhe striyau |
asmadyoge’pi dattaṃ na bhuṃkṣva rājan phalaṃ ciram || 1 22||
atha rājā vāmadevaṃ yayau bhuktvā punarvane |
uddhāro me yathā syādvai tathā vidhehi cārthayat || 123 ||
vāmadevaḥ kare datvā jalaṃ rājñyā nṛpasya ca |
śamyāḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ puṇyamakārayad divaḥpradam || 1 24||
rājā kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ cakre puṇyaṃ gurostu pādayoḥ |
puṇyahīno’bhavacchīghraṃ pāpahīno babhūva ca || 125||
phalamūlānnasalilairviṣṇumapūjayattadā |
tṛpto viṣṇurgurorvākyāt pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata ||1 26||
pārṣadaiḥ sahito divye vimāne ca nṛpīṃ nṛpam |
nītvā pīyūṣasaṃvārdhau vaikuṇṭhamanayat prabhuḥ || 127||
nityatṛptistadā jātā naivedyasalilārpaṇaiḥ |
evaṃ śrutvā vijvalo’bhūt saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sadgurorbalam || 128||
gururmokṣapradātā ca viṣṇutulyo bhavatyapi |
pāpatāpaśamayitā nityatṛptiprado guruḥ || 1 29||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam |
sādhanaṃ cāpi kṛtvaiva brahmalokaṃ vrajejjanaḥ || 3.51.13 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe tīrthānāṃ pāpanāśakaṃ gurupadam, adattānnajaladānakasya subāhunṛpateḥ svaśavabhakṣakasya vāmadevākhyaguroryogānnityatṛptirmokṣāvāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||

<3.52>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kuñjalasturyaputrakam |
kapiñjalaṃ ca papraccha nūtanaṃ kiṃ vilokitam || 1 | |
śrutvā kapiñjalaḥ prāha kailāse dhavale girau |
śivasyāste divyamarthyaṃ mandiraṃ svargasannibham || 2 ||
sevitaṃ puṇyalokaiśca gaṇairgaṇībhiruttamam |
tatrāhaṃ gatavānadya gaṃgāpravāhasannidhau || 3 ||
gaṃgāhrado mahānasti tatra haṃsā vasantyapi |
vāritīre śilāyāṃ hiṃ kanyaikā saṃvilokitā ||4||
āsīnā muktakeśā ca rūpalāvaṇyaśobhitā |
divyālaṃkāraśṛṃgārāmbaraśobhānvitā śubhā || 5 ||
duḥkhākulā roditi sāśrūṇi muñcati dhārayā |
muktāmauktikatulyāni patitāni hradodake || 6 ||
tebhyo bhavanti padmāni hṛdyāni surabhīṇi ca |
netrāśrujāni padmāni tarantyasaṃkhyakāni vai || 7 ||
tāni padmāni cādāya kaścitpuṇyamayo muniḥ |
digvāsā jaṭilo daṇḍī tāpaso bhasmavān kṛśaḥ || 8 ||
pūjayati haraṃ ratneśvaraṃ nṛtyati gāyati |
hasati susvaraṃ cāpi dṛṣṭametanmayādbhutam || 9 ||
pitaḥ kaḥ sa bhavettatra kā sā nārī ca vā bhavet |
nārī praroditi kasmād vada me sarvameva tat || 3.52.1 0||
śrutvā sa kuñjalaḥ putraṃ kapiñjalamuvāca ha |
putra śṛṇu mahādevī tvekadā prāha śaṃkaram || 11 ||
darśayasva mamaivādya kānanaṃ kānanottamam |
mahādevastathāstvāha tataḥ sajjo babhūva ha || 12||
vṛṣabhaṃ cārurohāpi gaṇairdevyā yuto haraḥ |
nandanākhyaṃ praviveśa vanaṃ divyaṃ manoharam || 1 3||
darśayāmāsa devyai tadvanaṃ smṛddhaṃ samantataḥ |
kalpavṛkṣān kalpavallīrdarśayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 14||
pārvatī cākarottatra saṃkalpaṃ kanyakākṛte |
kalpavṛkṣāt tatastūrṇaṃ kanyaikā samajāyata || 15||
svasvarūpā svasamānā yuvatī kamalekṣaṇā |
padmānanā svarṇadehā saprabhā lambamūrdhajā || 16||
sugandhadehā divyā ca bhūṣāmbaravibhūṣitā |
divyaśṛṅgāraśobhāḍhyā vanadevī yathā śubhā || 17||
kanyā nanāma bhaktyā ca pādayoḥ śivayostadā |
pārvatī tāṃ tu putrīṃ svāṃ svīcakāra hi mānasīm || 18||
aśokasundarīnāmnīṃ prāha tāṃ pārvatī tataḥ |
somavaṃśe nahuṣākhyo nṛpaste vai patiḥ sute || 19||
bhaviṣyatīti tasyai sā varaṃ dattvā hi pārvatī |
vane visṛjya kailāsaṃ śaṃbhunā saha cāyayau ||3.52.20||
aśokasundarī reme nandane vanadevatā |
tāmekadā vipracitidaityātmajastu huṇḍakaḥ ||21 ||
dṛṣṭvā kāmena cāviṣṭaḥ patnīṃ kartuṃ samādiśat |
aśokasundarī prāha śivayorasmi kanyakā ||22||
nahuṣo me patirbhāvī pārvatī māṃ jagāda ha |
mā vṛthā tvaṃ prayatasva viparītaṃ bhaviṣyati ||23||
mahāśāpena yokṣyāmi gacchānyatra mahāsura |
śrutvā huṇḍastirobhūtvā cintayāmāsa vai punaḥ ||24||
kathaṃ bhāryā bhavet sā me kapaṭaṃ racayāmi tat |
vicāryetthaṃ devakanyārūpaṃ dadhāra huṇḍakaḥ || 25||
vane tatra tayā sārdhaṃ mitratāṃ kṛtavām̐stataḥ |
āśramaṃ me’tra gaṃgāyāstīre’stīti jagāda tām ||26||
aśokasundarī huṇḍāśramaṃ yayau sukhānvitā |
huṇḍikākanyayā sārdhaṃ nyavasattatra tāpasī ||27||
bhojane śayane cāpi vihāre sahage hi te |
vartete te sakhīrūpe snāne nidrāsthalādiṣu ||28||
rātrau te tvekaśayyāyāṃ supte tatra tu huṇḍikā |
huṇḍakaṃ nararūpaṃ ca vidhāyāśokasundarīm ||29||
kāmabhāvena pasparśa tadā tvaśokasundarī |
aprāptanidrā taṃ jñātvāsuraṃ kapaṭakanyakām || 3.52.30||
uvāca mā spṛśātra tvaṃ bhasma tūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
trasto huṇḍastadā tūrṇaṃ papāta pādayoḥ punaḥ ||3 1 ||
aśokasundarī prāha mama bhartā nṛpo hi saḥ |
āgatyātra vane duṣṭa tava nāśaṃ vidhāsyati ||32||
ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ gaṃgātīre vanāntare |
tāpasī vartate tatrāśokasundarī bhāminī ||33||
atha rājā ailaputra āyuḥ putrārthameva ha |
dattātreyāt prārthayacca suputraṃ sadgurorhareḥ ||34||
dattātreyo varadānaṃ dadau hi putravān bhava |
sarvaguṇaiḥ samupeto vaiṣṇavāṃśena saṃyutaḥ ||35||
putraste sārvabhaumaśca mahendrābho bhaviṣyati |
ityāśiṣaṃ samāsādya tvāyuḥ svarājyamāyayau ||36||
nāgābhidhe pure rājā cendumatyā striyā samam |
reme lebhe ca nahuṣaṃ putraṃ yathoktalakṣaṇam ||37||
huṇḍaśchidraṃ samāsādya putraṃ jahāra cāmbare |
nināya svagṛhe rātrau rākṣasyai cārpayat sutam ||38||
mārayitvā pācayitvā bhojanārthaṃ niveditam |
rākṣasī vikalānāmnī dayāvatī tu bālakam ||39||
rātrau viśiṣṭakuṭyāṃ sā nikṣipya cāgatā drutam |
hariṇaṃ pācayitvā ca bhojayāmāsa huṇḍakam ||3.52.40||
huṇḍastu nirbhayo jāto bālo mayā hi khāditaḥ |
atha vaśiṣṭhaḥ prātaśca dadarśa bālakaṃ śubham ||41 ||
vardhayāmāsa divyaṃ taṃ viṣṇulakṣaṇalakṣitam |
jñānaṃ śastrāṇi śāstrāṇi nītiṃ kalā vṛṣaṃ tathā ||42||
adhyāpayāmāsa bālaṃ rājyayogyaṃ cakāra ha |
indumatyai prātareva nāradaḥ prāha taddine ||43 ||
mā śokaṃ kuru putraste vaśiṣṭhasyāśrame’sti vai |
huṇḍaṃ daityaṃ nāśayitvā vivāhyāśokasundarīm ||44||
śivaputrīpatirbhūtvā gṛhaṃ te cāgamiṣyati |
indropendrasamaḥ putro bhaviṣyati svatejasā ||45||
ityuktvā pūjanaṃ prāpya nārado’ntardadhe tadā |
atha putraṃ ca nahuṣaṃ vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha putraka ||46||
phalānyānaya vanyāni dhanurdhārī prayāhi vai |
rājā tvājñāṃ samādāya yayau vanyārthameva ha ||47||
huṇḍastatrāyayau dṛṣṭvā kumāraṃ devatopamam |
apahartuṃ nāśayituṃ manaścakre hi daityarāṭ ||48||
yuyudhe ca samāgatya nahuṣeṇa samaṃ balī |
nahuṣāya sahasrākṣo dadau śastrāṇi vai tadā ||49||
devā divyāni cāstrāṇi dadustadā hi vai kṣaṇāt |
indro rathaṃ dadau cāpi mātalisaṃyutaṃ śubham ||3.52.50||
viṣṇuścakrāt samutpādya cakraṃ dīptaṃ dadau tadā |
śaṃbhuḥ śūlaṃ dadau cāpi brahmāstraṃ pradadāvajaḥ ||51 ||
yuyudhe nahuṣaḥ so’yaṃ huṇḍena māyinā tadā |
devā devyaśca gandharvā jagurjayaṃ tu nāhuṣam ||52||
huṇḍo jñātvā nijaṃ śatruṃ yuyudhe cātivegataḥ |
tatra sarve dānavāśca yuyudhire cakampire ||53||
sehire dānavā naiva bāṇavarṣaṃ hi nāhuṣam |
mṛtāḥ kecid drutā kecinnaṣṭāḥ kecinmahāhave ||54||
rathasthena tu huṇḍena tāḍito nahuṣastadā |
tribhirdhvajaṃ praciccheda huṇḍasya sāyakairbalī ||55||
caturbhisturagām̐ścāpi chatraṃ tvekena vai tathā |
daśabhiḥ sārathiṃ paścādekena ca bhujaṃ punaḥ ||56||
ciccheda nahuṣastatra śaktiṃ mumoca taddhṛdi |
huṇḍastu patito bhūmau mamāra prāṇatastadā ||57||
devāḥ praharṣaṃ jagmuśca puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ jayaṃ vyadhuḥ |
aśokasundarī śrutvā daityavadhaṃ praharṣitā ||58||
nahuṣaṃ prāpya covāca dharmapatnī bhavāmi te |
samudvahasva māṃ vīra devairhi nirmitā tava ||59||
nahuṣaḥ prāha bhadraṃ te gurorvākyottaraṃ priye |
bhadre tvāmudvahiṣyāmi rathe tiṣṭha mayā saha ||3.52.60||
iti tāṃ rathamārūḍhāṃ nītvā gurvāśramaṃ yayau |
nivedayāmāsa sarvaṃ gurave nṛpabālakaḥ ||6 1|
vaśiṣṭho harṣamāpannastithau lagne śubhe tayoḥ |
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vahnibhūsurasannidhau ||62||
āśīrbhirabhinandyainaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatpuram |
nāgāhvayaṃ puraṃ gururnahuṣo’pi yayau tataḥ ||63||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvā jagāda sarvaceṣṭitam |
āyuścendumatī labdhvā sabhāryaputramuttamam ||64||
mahotsavaṃ pracakrāte putrasyāgamanaṃ prati |
nahuṣo’pi dhanurdhṛtvā mahendrasya rathena vai ||65||
jigāya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvipāṃ sapattanām |
pitaraṃ yājayāmāsa rājasūyādibhistataḥ ||66||
atha devāḥ samāgatya nāgāhvayaṃ purottamam |
abhyaṣiñcanmahātmānaṃ nahuṣaṃ vai narādhipam ||67||
ardhendrapadabhāg jāto nahuṣo vaiṣṇavāṃśavān |
śivaputrīpatiḥ śrīmān gurorbalāt pratāpavān ||68||
vaśiṣṭhasya pratāpena mahendro mānavo’bhavat |
śivāgurvīpratāpena kanyā cāśokasundarī ||69||
ardhendrāṇyabhavat tatra devī yā vanadevatā |
indumatīṃ nijaśvaśrūṃ siṣeve kiṃkarī yathā ||3.52.70 ||
atha gaṃgātaṭe yā tu roditi tāṃ śṛṇu striyam |
huṇḍe mṛte tu tatputro vihuṇḍastapa ācarat ||71 ||
devān hantuṃ kṛtamatistrailokyaṃ hantumudyataḥ |
piturvairaṃ hariṣyāmi haniṣyāmi narān surān ||72||
iti niścitya gaṃgāyāstaṭe sa nandane vane |
yayau yadā tadā viṣṇurnārīrūpo babhūva ha ||73||
mohayituṃ vihuṇḍaṃ taṃ nāśayituṃ tu yuktitaḥ |
tāṃ māyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha tu vihuṇḍakaḥ ||74||
uvāca tāṃ varārohe saṃgamaṃ dehi me’naghe |
māyovāca yadi māṃ tvaṃ bhoktumicchasi cettadā ||75||
saptakoṭimitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ prasaṃpūjaya śaṃkaram |
kāmodāsaṃbhavairdivyaiḥ sugandhairdevadurlabhaiḥ ||76||
tatpuṣpāṇāṃ kṛtāṃ mālāṃ mama kaṇṭhe samarpaya |
tadāhaṃ supriyā bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi tavānagha ||77||
ityuktaścāsuraścāpi mārgayāmāsa taddrumam |
aprāpya tāṃ yayau nārīṃ papraccha taddrumaṃ punaḥ ||78||
nārī prāha drumo vai na tādṛśo vidyate kvacit |
kāmodā vidyate kanyā gaṃgāhrade pratiṣṭhati ||79||
kāmodākhyā tu sā sādhvī yadā hasati vai tadā |
utpadyante hi puṣpāṇi tasyā hāsācchubhāni vai ||3.52.80||
kāmodāni sugandhāni pītāni śobhanāni vai |
tenāpyekena puṣpeṇa yaḥ pūjayati śaṃkaram ||81||
tasyepsitaṃ mahākāmaṃ sampūrayati śaṃkaraḥ |
tasyāstu rodanāccāpi lohitāni sumāni vai ||82||
prabhavanti na vai teṣāṃ sparśaṃ kuryāt kadācana |
rodanotthakusumānāṃ sparśe’niṣṭaṃ yato bhavet ||83||
gaṃgāhrade gaccha tatra prahāsaya ca tāṃ striyam |
yadvā taddhāsyajātāni puṣpāṇi tu bahūnyapi ||84||
gaṃgāpravāhe cāyānti patitāni gṛhāṇa ca |
ityukto dānavo gaṃgāpravāhe samalokayat ||85||
pravāhitāni kāmodārodanotthasumāni vai |
jagrāha tāni sāralyādapūjayacca śaṃkaram ||86||
aniṣṭaṃ tatprajātaṃ vai tena kruddho hi śaṃkaraḥ |
huṃkāramakarot tena dānavo vai mṛto’bhavat ||87||
devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tvevaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
viṣṇurnārīsvarūpaḥ sa tirobhāvaṃ yayau tadā ||88||
devatāḥ suprasannāśca jātā huṇḍasya nāśanāt |
athābdhimathane jātā catasraḥ kanyakāḥ purā ||89||
alakṣmīrvāruṇī kāmodā ca lakṣmīścaturthikā |
uddālakāya cālakṣmīrdattā tadābdhinā tataḥ ||3.52.90||
varuṇāya ca vai devī vāruṇī tvabdhinārpitā |
kāmodā viṣṇave dattā tūlasī yā bhaviṣyati ||9 1||
lakṣmīśca viṣṇave dattā vaikuṇṭhasahavāsinī |
kāmodā sā tvabdhiputrī sudhotthā nāradāt khalu ||92||
śuśrāva viṣṇormānuṣye janma bhāvi punaḥ punaḥ |
kāmodā cāsahamānā viṣṇorviyogameva sā ||93||
ruroda vai muhurgaṃgāmūle gatvā tadaikalā |
rodanāt khalu jātāni raktapuṣpāṇi tāni vai ||94||
tatpūjotthaphalaṃ daityamaraṇaṃ samajāyata |
kāmodāyā hāsyahetuṃ śṛṇu tatkathayāmi vai ||95|||
yadā sā tulasīrūpā tadā viṣṇoḥ prapūjane |
nijapatrāṇi dattvaiva copayuktā bhaviṣyati || 96 ||
tayā saha jagannātho ramiṣyati sadaiva hi |
smṛtvaivaṃ hasati kanyā kāmodā vai kvacit kvacit ||97||
mañjarī hāsyajanyā ca boddhavyā tulasībhave |
tulasyāḥ patramekaṃ vā mañjarīṃ viṣṇave’rpayet ||98||
brahmaṇe śaṃkarāyāpi tadeṣṭaphalabhāg bhavet |
itītthaṃ puṣpapūjotthaphalaṃ bodhyaṃ śubhāvaham ||99||
kapiñjala tathā nārī kāmodā rodanānvitā |
hāsyānvitā ca puṣpāṇāmutpādikā pradarśitā || 3.52.10 0||
vihuṇḍaḥ puṇyahartāpi tubhyaṃ mayā pradarśitaḥ |
evaṃ viṣṇurūpagurostīrthayogena tūlasī || 101 ||
sadā pūjyā ca kāmodā tatpuṇyaṃ pūjyate’pi ca |
puṣpaiśca pūjyate devamaṇḍalaṃ sarvadā suta || 1 02||
gurutīrthaṃ mahatproktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā |
vihuṇḍo nāśamāpanno yayau kailāsameva saḥ || 1 03||
śaṃbhutīrthasya yogena huṇḍopi nṛpayogataḥ |
svargaṃ gato hi tasmādvai gurutīrthaṃ viśiṣyate || 1 04||
kuñjalaḥ kathayitvaivaṃ virarāma nijān sutān |
cyavanastu tadā lakṣmi śrutvā papraccha pakṣiṇam || 1 05||
ko bhavān vartate cātra divyajñānī vihaṃgama |
pakṣī prāha purā cāhaṃ kaśyapasya kulasya vai || 106||
vidyādharasya vai putro dharmaśarmā hi nāmataḥ |
mūrkho’hamabhavaṃ pūrṇaḥ kadācinmadgṛhaṃ prati || 1 07||
siddhāyano maharṣiśca sādhustatra samāgataḥ |
mayā prasevitaḥ so’pi jñānaṃ mahyaṃ dadau śubham || 1 08||
āśīrvādaṃ pradadau me siddhāyanaḥ sa vai ṛṣiḥ |
niḥsaṃgo niḥspṛho bhūtvā caikāntasthānasaṃśrayaḥ ||109||
sarvaprakāśako jñānī sarvadarśī bhaviṣyasi |
ekasthānasthitaścāpi vetsyasi tvaṃ trilokajam || 3.52.11 0||
evaṃ guroḥ prasādena vedmi sarvaṃ trilokajam |
bhavantaṃ cyavanaṃ vedmi sadguruṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 11 1||
kīrabhāve kāraṇaṃ ca mama vacmi niśāmaya |
saṃsargājjāyate pāpaṃ saṃsargāt puṇyamityapi || 1 12||
mayā krītaḥ śukaśiśustasya mugdho’bhavaṃ sadā |
māmevaṃ vadati so’pi tāta māmehi cāsyatām || 113 ||
snānaṃ gaccha mahābhāga devānarcaya cetyapi |
tasya vākyavinodena vismṛtaṃ dharmakarma me || 1 14||
atha vāṭīṃ gataścāhaṃ śākādyarthaṃ tadā gṛhe |
biḍālena hataḥ pakṣī mayāgatya vilokitaḥ || 1 15||
atiduḥkhena tatpaścānmṛto’haṃ śukabhāvanaḥ |
maraṇe śukabhāvo’haṃ śukajanmagato’bhavam || 1 16||
jātismaro bhavāmyatra siddhāyanapratāpataḥ |
nāsti tīrthaṃ gurusamaṃ jñāne mokṣe hi sarvathā || 1 17||
sthalajādudakād bāhyaṃ malaṃ naśyati nāntaram |
gurutīrthāt pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ malaṃ vinaśyati || 1 18||
saṃsāre tāraṇāyaiva jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamamam |
athāhaṃ tartumicchāmi guro cyavana tāraya || 11 9||
ityuktvā pakṣirāṭ putrasahito bhāryayā yutaḥ |
pādayorāgataścāpi cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ || 3.52.1 20||
cyavano bhagavannāmamantraṃ dadau śukāya vai |
jalaṃ ca pāyayāmāsa kṛṣṇanāmnābhimantritam || 1 21||
pakṣiṇaste guruṃ natvā smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ ca mām |
dehām̐styaktvā pārṣadā me bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhamāyayuḥ || 1 22||
divyaṃ taṃ sadguruṃ tīrthaṃ labdhvā mokṣaṃ yayuryataḥ |
sarvatīrthottamaṃ tīrthaṃ gurutīrthaṃ bhavatyapi || 123 ||
naro nārī mokṣadātrī gurvī tīrthasvarūpiṇī |
vadhūrvā cādhavā cāpi bhaktā vai mokṣadāyinī || 124||
tāṃ samāśritya muktiṃ vai prāpaṇīyā hi śāśvatī |
sādhvī devī sevanīyā vadhūbhiḥ pāpanāśinī || 125||
brāhmī brahmapriyā cāpi haripriyā pativratā |
sādhuḥ satpuruṣaścāpi sadguruśca haripriyaḥ || 1 26||
bhuktimuktipradaścāpi sevanīyaḥ sadā janaiḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi cāsya mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ || 1 27||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe nahuṣakathānakaṃ kuñjalaśukakathānakaṃ kāmodākathānakaṃ cyavanakathānakaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||

<3.53>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri yatkṛtvātmā viśuddhyati |
vadhūṭyaḥ sarvathā śuddhiṃ prāpya preyuḥ paraṃ padam || 1 ||
guruṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ vai vidyācchrīparameśvaram |
gurvī lakṣmīsvarūpāṃ ca vidyāt seveta tāṃ vadhūḥ || 2 ||
mānāvamānau dvāvetau tau bodhyau vai viṣāmṛte |
avamāno’mṛtaṃ tatra sammāno viṣameva yat || 3 ||
gurormānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ svasyā amānameva tu |
yā vadhūrvartate nityaṃ nirmānā mānadā tadā || 4 ||
sā labheta sadā mānaṃ mānyā bhavati yoṣitām |
sevayā vaśamāyāti siṃho’pi ca graho’pi ca || 5 ||
sevāvṛttirgurūṇāṃ hi vaśakartrī vadhūkṛte |
putryā vadhvā ca kiṃkaryā dāsyā ca bhṛtyayāpi ca || 6 ||
samāśritayāgantukayā sevayā sādhyate’khilam |
rājñī gurvī śikṣikā vā devī gauḥ rākṣasī ca vā || 7 ||
sevayā svādhīnabhāvā jāyate śrīḥ satī ramā |
gurusevā mahacchastraṃ vaśakārye sahāyadam || 8 ||
tasmādācāravadhvā vai śvaśrūḥ sevā hyamānayā |
patyuḥ sevā devasevā śvaśrvāścājñāprapālanam || 9 ||
gṛhasevāpatyasevā vadhvāḥ pañcavratāni vai |
akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucaṃ vṛddhābhisevanam || 3.53.10||
patyarthaṃ cāpi sarvasvaṃ vadhvāste niyamā matāḥ |
vadhvā gṛhakriyā yajñaścātithyarhā surārcanam || 11 ||
kāntaprasannatābhaktiḥ sandhyā śvaśrūprasannatā |
snānaṃ tu patisevātma yamāḥ dharmārthasādhakāḥ || 1 2||
sadācāraratā śāntā svadharmaparipālikā |
sarvān lokān vinirjitya brahmalokaṃ prayāti sā || 13||
gurūpadeśayuktānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kramavartinām |
abhyutthānādikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇāmaṃ vandanaṃ caret || 14||
aṣṭāṃgairvā ca pañcāgaiḥ praṇipātena pādayoḥ |
triḥpradakṣiṇayogena vandyā gurvī satīvratā || 15||
jyeṣṭhā sarvā vandanīyā vṛddhā vandyā punaḥ punaḥ |
ājñābhaṃgaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 16||
duṣṭāyogaguhāraṇyaṃ kṣudramantropasevanam |
viṣagrahaviḍambādīn varjayet sarvayatnataḥ || 17||
kaitavaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ varjayet satī |
atihāsyamatimānaṃ līlāṃ lajjāvivarjitām || 18||
svecchāvihārametān vai varjayed gurusannidhau |
tadvākyapratikūlaṃ cāpyayuktaṃ cāpi no vadet || 1 9||
aniṣṭaṃ na smaret kvāpi kalahaṃ na smaret kvacit |
ākrośaṃ na prakurvīta vaimanasyaṃ na cācaret ||3.53.20 ||
rasapātrāṇi sarvāṇi pākapātrāṇi vai padā |
bhojyapātrāṇi vastrāṇi na spṛśennāpasārayet ||21 ||
yajñapātrāṇi pūjāyā dravyapātrāṇi vai tathā |
pavitrayogyapātrāṇi gṛhavastūni yāni ca ||22||
mārjanīṃ cullikāṃ vahniṃ phalaśākāni yāni ca |
peyapātrāṇi sarvāṇi śṛṃgārasya dravāṇi ca ||23||
pustakādīni darbhāṃśca puṣpapātrāṇi kajjalam |
hetīn bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi prasādhanāni yāni ca ||24||
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cāranālāni yāni ca |
veśavārādipātrāṇi kāṣṭhādyāsanakāni ca ||25||
vadhūḥ padā spṛśennaiva padā naivāpasārayet |
devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ śvaśrvādidrohamityapi ||26||
grāmadrohaṃ satāṃ drohaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana |
uddhṛtānuṣṇaphenābhiḥ pūtābhirvastracakṣuṣā || 27||
adbhiḥ samācaret sarvaṃ varjayet kaluṣodakam |
gandhavarṇarasairduṣṭamaśucisthānasaṃsthitam || 28 ||
paṅkāśmadūṣitaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ palvalodakam |
saśaivālaṃ tathānyairvā doṣairduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet || 29 ||
jalāharaṇapātre vā haṇḍe gargarikāmukhe |
kṣiptvāñjaliṃ mukhaṃ pādau kṣālayenna kadācana | | 3.53.30 ||
uddhṛtyādhikavāryūrdhvaṃ cocchiṣṭaṃ na kriyāttathā |
mukhe spṛṣṭaṃ pānapātraṃ jalapātre na majjayet || 31 ||
aprakṣālya karau bhojyavastvādīni spṛśenna vai |
pariveṣaṇakāryādi kuryānnākṣālitaiḥ karaiḥ || 3 2||
pākakāryaṃṃ naiva kuryādaśuddhivastradhāriṇī |
agninā ca rasānāṃ ca śuddhiṃ kuryāt sadā vadhūḥ || 33 ||
tṛṇakāṣṭhādivastūnāṃ dṛṣṭyā ca kṣaraṇena ca |
jalasyābhyukṣaṇenāpi śuddhiṃ kuryāt vadhūḥ sadā || 34||
muśalolūkhalasyāpi śuddhiṃ kuryāddhi vāriṇā |
vastrādinā mārjanena śṛṃgāsthidāruśodhanam || 35||
dravyāṇāṃ saṃhatānāṃ tu śodhanaṃ prokṣaṇena vai |
abhuktarāśidhānyānāṃ tvekadeśādidūṣaṇe || 36 ||
tāvanmātraṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayedvai kuśāṃbhasā |
śākamūlaphalādīnāṃ kṣālanena hi śodhanam || 37||
snigdhānāṃ mārjanenaiva rūkṣāṇāṃ tu jalādinā |
mārjanena gṛhaśuddhimullekhanena vā tathā || 38 ||
lepanena kvacid vāriprokṣaṇena ca vāyunā |
gonivāsena śuddhiṃ ca dharāyāḥ saṃvidhācaret || 39 ||
bhūmisthamudakaṃ śuddhaṃ nirmalaṃ medhyagandhitam |
vatsaḥ śuciḥ prasravaṇe dohane prasave’pi ca ||3.53.40 ||
phalapāte tu śakuniḥ ratau bhāryāmukhaṃ śuci |
paṇyaṃ prasāritaṃ śuddhaṃ vāyunā kiraṇena ca ||4 1 ||
śucirākarajaṃ sarvaṃ śvamukhaṃ ca mṛgagṛhe |
chāyā ca vipruṣo viprāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaśca makṣikāḥ ||42||
rajo bhūrvāyuragniśca bālaṃ medhyāni sparśane |
maithune ca malatyāge hyamedhyasparśane tathā ||43 ||
rajasvalādisparśe ca snānācchuddhirudāhṛtā |
vaidyo viśasitā śuddho bhṛtyaḥ śuddhaḥ sadā mataḥ ||44||
gṛhasya paśavo bālāḥ pakṣiṇaśca gṛhāṃgaṇam |
catvaro vedikā vṛkṣāḥ kapāṭaṃ chatramityapi ||45 ||
dolā khaṣṭvā gendukādi śakaṭaṃ mārjanī tathā |
peṣaṇī paṭṭikā sopānāni kīlakamityapi ||46||
śṛṃkhalā paśurajjvaśca jalarajjuśca nāḍikāḥ |
haṇḍādhānī yaṣṭikā matsaradānī ca puttalī ||47||
lekhinī pustikā dīpaḥ pratimā vyajanastathā |
bhūṣāpātraṃ vastrapeṭī ghṛtatailādipātrakam ||48||
gavākṣaṃ candraśālā ca dhanadhānī nṛpastathā |
sādhuryatirbrahmacārī guruḥ śuddhāśca gauḥ sadā ||49|||
vāyunā cātapenāpi svabhāvena hi pāvanāḥ |
dīkṣitāḥ kathakāścāpi karmaṭhāḥ pāvanāḥ sadā ||3.53.50||
khale dhānyaṃ sadā śuddhaṃ samāje mānavāstathā |
utsave ca striyaḥ śuddhāḥ kanyāḥ śuddhāḥ sadā matā ||51 ||
naiṣṭhikānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca rājñīnāṃ guruyoṣitām |
maṇḍalīnāṃ nṛtyagītakartrīṇāṃ dāsayoṣitām ||52||
bālarakṣāprakartrīṇāṃ sairandhrīvārayoṣitām |
śuddhirvai sarvadā bodhyā nāṭyavādyajñayoṣitām ||53||
satye yuge sadā nāryaḥ śuddhāścārtavavarjitāḥ |
yugāntareṣu māsānte rājasvalyena pāvitāḥ ||24||
śuddhyanti sarvadā nāryaḥ snānena ca vratena ca |
rajasvalā spṛśennaiva rajasvalāṃ hi yatnataḥ ||55||
dine caturthake snātvā patiṃ devaṃ hi sevayet |
caturthyāṃ sevane rātrau tvalpāyuḥ samprasūyate ||56||
vidyāhīnaṃ daridraṃ ca pitrasantoṣakārakam |
pañcamyāṃ sevane kanyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putraṃ prasūyate ||57||
saptamyāṃ sevane kanyāmaṣṭamyāṃ sūyate sutam |
navamyāṃ sevane kanyāṃ daśamyāṃ paṇḍitaṃ sutam ||58||
ekādaśyāṃ sutāṃ dvādaśyāṃ dharmavatsutaṃ śubham |
trayodaśyāṃ jaḍāṃ kanyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sutaṃ varam ||59||
pañcadaśyāṃ dharmikanyāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ jñānapāragam |
prasūyate tataḥ śuddhāḥ bhūtvā seveta vai patim ||3.53.60||
rājasvalye tu cāṇḍālaṃ malinaṃ sūyate sadā |
patitīrthapratāpena prajā śuddhā bhavet striyāḥ ||61 ||
yādṛśaṃ patitīrthaṃ syāt prajā bhavati tādṛśī |
kṣetraṃ cāpi bhaved duṣṭaṃ duṣṭā prajā prajāyate ||62||
manaḥśuddhiryādṛśī syātprajā bhavati tādṛśī |
tattvaśuddhiryādṛśī vai tāttvikī śuddhireva sā ||63||
śuddhiḥ svayaṃ śuddhirūpā vartate śuddhapātrake |
aśuddhe pātrake śuddhiḥ śuddhitvaṃ prajahāti vai ||64||
apātre khalu saṃskārāḥ saṃskāratvaṃ jahatyapi |
pārthive varṣmaṇi devā devatvaṃ ca jahatyapi ||65||
nikṛṣṭasya gṛhe satyāḥ satītvaṃ vai vilīyate |
āsurāṇāṃ gṛhe devyā devītvaṃ naśyati dhruvam ||66||
kaulikasya gṛhe rājñyā rājñītvaṃ naiva tiṣṭhati |
vadhvā paragṛhe naiva pātivratyaṃ prarakṣyate ||67||
gaṇikāyā gṛhe naije satītvaṃ naiva tiṣṭhati |
nāstikyā bhaktimattvaṃ ca bhaktāyā nāstikatvakam ||68||
naiva tiṣṭhati vai kvāpi tasmāt patipriyā bhavet |
pativratā bhaved brahmapriyā bhaveddharipriyā ||69||
nārāyaṇapriyā nārī satsaṃginī bhavet sadā |
sādhupriyā bhavenmokṣe na tvasādhupriyā kvacit ||3.53.70||
dharmapriyā bhavennityaṃ nādharmādipriyā bhavet |
vratapriyā bhavet sādhvī nānācārapriyā bhavet ||71||
devapriyā bhaved devī nāsurāṇāṃ priyā bhavet |
śīlapriyā bhavecchaśvanna tvaśīlapriyā bhavet ||72||
śaucapriyā bhavennityaṃ na tvaśaucaratirbhavet |
tapaḥpriyā bhaveddāntā na tvatapaḥpriyā bhavet ||73||
haripriyā bhavennityaṃ na tu hāripriyā bhavet |
brahmapriyā bhavennityaṃ bhramapriyā na vai bhavet ||74||
kṛṣṇapriyā bhavennityaṃ cātmapriyā tathā bhavet |
muktipriyā bhavennityaṃ bhuktipriyā na vai bhavet ||75||
vibhupriyā bhavennityaṃ cālpapriyā na vai bhavet |
dehipriyā bhavennityaṃ dehapriyā na vai bhavet ||76||
parapriyā bhavennityaṃ nāparasya priyā bhavet |
parapuṃsaḥ priyā syācca nāparasya priyā kvacit ||77||
paraḥ pumān hariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasya priyā bhavet ||78||
patirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt tasya priyā sadā bhavet |
ātmanaiva priyā syādvai naiva dehādibhiḥ kvacit ||79||
saiṣā brāhmī sthitirlakṣmi brahmapriyāvibhāvinī |
brāhmī śuddhiśceyameva tāṃ prāpya mayi modate ||3.53.80||
vadhvā vadhūdaśāyāṃ sā prāpaṇīyā vivardhinī |
hareryogasya sevāyāḥ pradāyinī pramokṣiṇī ||81 ||
aśuddho deha evāsāvindriyāṇi tathā ca vai |
indriyārthā aśuddhāśca māyikā mohamātrakāḥ ||82||
vṛttayo’pi tathā bodhyā aśuddhā vai tadutthitāḥ |
bhogāścāpi tathā bodhyā phalaṃ cāśuddhameva ca ||83|
vāsanāpi hyaśuddhā ca tṛṣṇehāśca tathāvidhāḥ |
pravṛttayaśca kāryāṇi hyaśuddhāni bhavanti vai ||84||
guṇāścāpi tathā nityamaśuddhā nirayapradāḥ |
aśuddhaṃ sarvamevaitat kā śuddhistatra labhyate ||85||
śuddhaścaikaḥ svayamātmā paramātmasamanvitaḥ |
paramātmagatāṃ divyāṃ śuddhimicchet samarpaṇaiḥ ||86||
yathā svarṇasya yogena pittalaṃ svarṇasadṛśam |
svarṇamūlyena rājeta pittadeho’pi vai tathā ||87||
hareryogena sauvarṇo hiraṇmayaḥ pumān bhavet |
indriyāṇi samastāni cendravāruṇikārasaiḥ ||88||
miśritāni harau tāni tvarpitāni madhūni vai |
prajāyante hi divyāni śāśvatikāni padmaje ||89||
śāśvataṃ svarūpaṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇayogena buddhyate |
śāśvatānandamagnatvaṃ kṛṣṇakāntena labhyate ||3.53.90||
māyāputrāḥ purā lakṣmi vedhasā vai trayodaśa |
ākūtayaḥ pañca pañca citayo mana ityapi ||91||
ahaṃkārastathā buddhiḥ preritā vai prajepsayā |
sarve cādṛśyadehāste hyuktāḥ sṛjata vai prajāḥ ||92||
tataste nābhyanandanta tadvākyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
tyaktvā cājñāṃ nijaṃ karma doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā hi karmasu ||93||
jugupsantaśca karmāṇi vyaramanta hi sṛṣṭitaḥ |
arthaṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca hitvā te niṣkriyāḥ khalu ||94||
ajanma kāṃkṣamāṇāste cāpravṛttāḥ vyavasthitāḥ |
teṣāṃ tu tamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā brahmā tu kopitaḥ ||95||
prāha tān vai mayā yūyaṃ prajāsarge niyojitāḥ |
prasūyadhvaṃ yajadhvaṃ cetyuktā mayā purā tataḥ ||96||
mama vākyamanādṛtya santatiṃ nābhyanandatha |
tasmād yūyaṃ karmaśīlā bhavatheti sadā śape ||97||
iti śaptā brahmaṇā te karmaśīlāstato’bhavan |
trayodaśaiva te naije vyāpāre vipule sadā ||98||
pravartante divārātrau nivartante na vai kvacit |
jayā nāma surāste vai sarve bhinnapravṛttayaḥ ||99||
ta eva tuṣitā bodhyāḥ satyāsta eva santi ca |
harayaścāpi vaikuṇṭhāḥ sādhyā ādityakā api || 3.53.10 0||
tān sadā cārpayellakṣmi nārāyaṇe pareśvare |
mayi tena hi cādityā mokṣadāḥ saṃbhavanti te || 101 ||
gurvarpaṇaṃ hi devānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ kārayet satī |
vṛttīnāṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca vyāpārāṇāṃ samarpaṇam || 1 02||
gurau mayi prakartavyaṃ tena divyā bhavanti te |
brahmadhāmapradāḥ sarve rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava || 103 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vedhasaḥ vadhūgītāyāṃ gururahasyasadācārakathananāmā tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||

<3.54>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gurorbalaṃ mahattamam |
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ paramojjvalam || 1 ||
jālandhare mahāpīṭhe deśe dāsakriyāparam |
khaśajātikuṭumbaṃ vai nyavasanmāmake pure || 2 ||
viṣṇudāso hi nāmnābhūt khaśo dharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
anivedya viṣṇave ca gurave’pyanivedya saḥ || 3 ||
naiva bhuṃkte’nnavastrādi phalaṃ jalādyapi kvacit |
viṣṇudāsasya vai tatra gururmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
sādhurnāmnā ṛṣidharmo mokṣado bhaktikārakaḥ |
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī trikāladevatārhaṇaḥ || 5 ||
vyavasthāparavṛttiśca triguṇakleśavarjitaḥ |
ayācitānnapatrādivṛttirdigambaraḥ sadā || 6 ||
nadītīre kṛtāvāso vṛkṣādho nirjane sthitaḥ |
nityaṃ vai bhajate nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam || 7 ||
dvandvasahiṣṇurevāyaṃ rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ |
nirīho’pyatiniṣkāmo vṛddho doṣavivarjitaḥ || 8 ||
vāksiddhaścāpi maunī ca jayatyeva ca māṃ sadā |
ārtāścāyānti cārtīnāṃ nāśārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ yadā || 9 ||
āśīrvādairjaladānaiḥ rajodānairvyapohati |
duḥkhāni śaraṇārthināṃ paropakārabhūṣaṇaḥ || 3.54.10 ||
lokāḥ phalāni vastrāṇi miṣṭānnāni dhanāni ca |
agre samarpya tiṣṭhanti prayānti taṃ prapūjya ca || 11 ||
sādhurvastūni naivāyaṃ spṛśati nāpi paśyati |
anye tu bhikṣukā yadvā paśavo vā haranti ca || 1 2||
nirmoho nirmamaścāyaṃ vartate cāpyamāyayā |
evaṃvidhaṃ gurum ṛṣidharmaṃ khaśo niṣevate || 13 ||
khaśapatnī rāmaṇī ca sevate mārjanādibhiḥ |
patrapuṣpādyarpaṇaiśca pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 14||
khaśasyāsīt kanyakā ca nāmnā līlāvatī śubhā |
dvādaśābdā hi sādhoḥ sā sevāyāṃ vartate sadā || 15||
devārthaṃ puṣpavallīnāṃ jalasekādikarmaṇi |
śraddhāvatī bhaktimatī bhaktānāṃ svāgatādiṣu || 16||
sā cājñānavaśā kanyā vṛkṣeṣu jalasecane |
bilavāsāṃ mūṣikāṃ sāpatyāṃ dadarśa nirgatām || 17||
bālabhāvena kanyā sā dhṛtvāpatyāni tāni ca |
dūraṃ gatvā nicikṣepa bālān mātṛviyojitān || 18||
mūṣikā bhayamāpannā tṛṇapuṃjāntare sthitā |
svalpān bālānādadānā kanyāṃ śaśāpa vai tadā || 1 9||
madviyuktāśca me bālā yathā duḥkhagatāstathā |
bhavatī pitṛmātrādiviyuktā duḥkhinī bhava ||3.54.20||
mūṣikāyāstu śāpo’yaṃ dāruṇo vai vyajāyata |
dināntare ca tatpākaphalaṃ prāptaṃ hi kanyayā ||21 ||
kanyā sāyaṃ guruṃ saṃsevya gṛhaṃ yāti yāvatā |
mārge mleccho yuvā kaścitprāpto jagrāha kanyakām || 22||
rorūyamāṇāṃ śīghraṃ tāṃ nināya balavān vanam |
vanād vanāntaraṃ rātrau dūradeśaṃ gato’bhavat ||23 ||
mlecchena svagṛhe dāsī kṛtā sā kanyakā khaśī |
madyaṃ vai pāyitaṃ cāpi māṃsaṃ ca bhojitaṃ tathā || 24||
vyavāyitaṃ tathā pāpaṃ hiṃsādi kāritaṃ muhuḥ |
mlecchakarma samastaṃ vai kāritaṃ tena kanyayā ||25||
mlecchī sā hyabalā cāpyajñātāraṇyasya mārgakam |
naiva jānāti vai nityaṃ śocatyeva gṛhāgamam ||26||
athaikadā pure mlecchotsavo’bhavad vivāhajaḥ |
tatrāyayurgāyikāśca gaṇikāścotsave tadā ||27||
saiṣā khaśī surūpā ca gaṇikāḥ samalokayat |
dāsībhāvena tāmbūlaṃ dadāti nartanādiṣu ||28||
niyojitā hi mlecchena gaṇikāsevanaṃ vyadhāt |
gaṇikā tāṃ samapṛcchat kva te mātā pitā sute ||29||
khaśī śrutvā jagādaiva sarvaṃ vṛttāntakaṃ nijam |
bhāvaṃ jñātvā gamanasya haraṇārthaṃ mano vyadhāt ||3.54.3 0 ||
viśvāsaṃ sampradāyaiva saṃketaṃ cākarot tataḥ |
atha kālāntare saṃketānusāreṇa kanyakām ||3 1 ||
mlecchagṛhāddhi niṣkāsyāprāpayad gaṇikā gṛham |
gaṇikāyāḥ śubhā dāsī tato’bhavaddhi kanyakā ||32||
vyavāyādau pravṛttā cābhavaddharmavivarjitā |
mahāpāpātipāpāni karoti gaṇikāvaśā || 33||
atha kālāntare rugṇābhavadvai gaṇikā hyati |
udarendriyarogārtābhakṣayaccauṣadhānyapi ||34||
naivārogyaṃ labhate vai gaṇikā sā śuśoca ha |
kathaṃ rogo bhaved dūraṃ bhagandarātmako mama ||35||
dāsī khaśī tadovāca gururme’sti mahān prabhuḥ |
samartho roganāśāya vāksiddhistatra yāhi vai ||36||
śrutvaivaṃ gaṇikā jñātvā vṛttāntaṃ tu guroḥ śubham |
sajjā babhūva sahasā dravyakhaśīsamanvitā ||37||
anyā dāsīśca gaṇikā bhāṇḍām̐śca puruṣānapi |
ādāya gaṇikāraṇyamullaṃghya yatra rājate || 38||
sādhustatra nadītīre samāyātātibhāvataḥ |
khaśī līlāvatī cātiprasannābhūddhṛdantare ||39||
sādhuṃ nanāma bhāvena prāptā svaṃ pitaraṃ yathā |
guruṃ devaṃ praṇamyaiva vṛttāntaṃ svaṃ nyavedayat ||3.54.40 ||
gaṇikāyāśca vṛttāntaṃ roganāśārthakaṃ hyapi |
nyavedayattataḥ sādhuḥ prāha karmaphalaṃ tadā ||41 ||
yayā yādṛk kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tayā tādṛk prabhujyate |
līlāvati tvayā bālā mūṣikāyā viyojitāḥ ||42|||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ vāridānārthakāle mūṣikayā tadā |
śaptā tvaṃ ca viyogena pitrorduḥkhaṃ gatā tataḥ ||43||
gaṇikeyaṃ vyavāyena rogaṃ bhuṃkte nikṛṣṭakam |
kintu tvayā mama sevā kṛtā pūrvaṃ phalaṃ hi tat ||44||
kārayāmāsa me prāptiṃ punaścāsyā miṣeṇa vai |
gaṇikeyaṃ cātithīnāṃ sevāparāyaṇābhavat ||45||
bhaktāyāstava yogena madyogaṃ samupāgatā |
sādhuṃ nayati satsaṃgaḥ kusaṃgastu hyasādhukam ||46||
duṣṭaṃ karma duḥkhayati satī sukhayati kriyā |
sādhusaṃgastu puṇyena jāyate nānyathā sute ||47||
tava pāpāni sarvāṇi mārjaye mlecchajāni vai |
gaṇikāyāśca pāpāni mārjaye cāpi putrike ||48||
mamātra sannidhau vāsaṃ parṇaśālāṃ vidhāya vai |
kurvantyatraiva ca vrataṃ kāyaśodhārthamityapi ||49||
ityuktāstāḥ samastāśca vṛkṣādhobhūtale śubhām |
parṇakuṭīṃ vidhāyaiva vāsaṃ cakrurhi sannidhau ||3.54.50||
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ tābhyo dadau ca ṛṣidharmakaḥ |
pañcagavyaṃ vrate cāpyaprāśayad vai dinatrayam ||51||
tato mantrān dadau lakṣmi tābhyaḥ ṛṣivaraḥ śubhān |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||52||
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt |
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||53||
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī ||54||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me |
itimantrān dadau karṇe haste jalaṃ dadau tathā ||55||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
ityuktvā ṛṣidharmaḥ sa jalaṃ vyāmocayad bhuvi ||56||
tāvattatrābhavallakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ ca tacchṛṇu |
līlāvatyāstathā tāsāṃ gaṇikānāṃ śarīrataḥ ||57||
samantato nīlavarṇā niryayuḥ kākapakṣiṇaḥ |
niryayuśca tato ghūkāstataśca maśakā api ||58||
piśācāśca tataścāpi kadrūpāḥ krūravigrahāḥ |
vṛkṇāḥ kṛśāḥ kṣudhitāśca durbalāḥ kāṇakhañjakāḥ ||59||
kuṣṭhinaśca jaḍāścāndhā durgandhā malasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
niryayuśca rudhirāḍhyāḥ sarvāṃgaviṣamāstadā ||3.54.60||
ruruduste ṛṣiṃ vīkṣya nagnāḥ sarve nirāśrayāḥ |
līlāvatī gaṇikādyā āpuścāścaryameva ca ||61 ||
tāstu ṛṣiṃ guruṃ natvā papracchuḥ ke ime guro |
guruḥ prāha sute sarvapāpāni santi vaḥ khalu ||62||
mayā mantrapradānena niṣkāsitāni dehataḥ |
kākā ime śvapacānāṃ saṃgajāni hyaghāni vai ||63||
ghūkāśceme gaṇikātve kṛtānyaghāni santi vai |
maśakā madyapānasya pāpāni santi tāni vai ||64||
piśācāśca bhavatīnāṃ māṃsāśanānyaghāni vai |
tāni sarvāṇi dehebhyo yuṣmākaṃ nirgatāni vai ||65||
rudanti tāni sarvāṇi paśyantvimāni yoṣitaḥ |
pāpānyapi tadā lakṣmi cakrurvai prārthanāṃ mune ||66 ||
nirādhārāṇi sarvāṇi vayaṃ suduḥkhitāni ha |
ṛṣe mokṣaṃ vidhehyatra jaladānena sarvathā ||67||
śrutvā ṛṣirnijaṃ pādaṃ dakṣaṃ prakṣālya teṣu vai |
añjalinā nicikṣepa gṛhītā bindavaśca taiḥ ||68||
pītāḥ sarve bindavaśca tṛptānyaghāni vai tadā |
evamṛṣiḥ punaścāpi cikṣepāpi jalāñjalim ||69||
atha divyasvarūpāste yathā devāstathābhavan |
athāñjaliṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca cikṣepa devatopari ||3.54.70 ||
tūrṇaṃ tryakṣā gaṇāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ śūladhāriṇaḥ |
pāpānyapi puṇyajanā abhavam̐ste sahasraśaḥ ||71 ||
sarve narākṛtayaśca divyarūpadharāḥ śubhāḥ |
ṛṣerājñāṃ samādāya natvā himālayaṃ yayuḥ ||72||
tato meruṃ yayuḥ sarve puṇyajanā hi te’bhavan |
khyātā devagaṇāḥ sarve sādhoreva pratāpataḥ ||73||
atha pāpādiśūnyāśca gaṇikā devatā yathā |
abhavan divyarūpāśca tābhyaḥ pādajalaṃ dadau ||74||
ṛṣeḥ pādajalaṃ pītvā nīrugṇā gaṇikābhavat |
anyāścāpi jalaṃ pītvā naṣṭasaṃsāravāsanāḥ ||75||
yoginyaśca yathā sādhvyastathā sarvāstadābhavan |
rogā nirgatya tūrṇaṃ vai natvā kailāsakaṃ yayuḥ ||76||
sarvā dīkṣāṃ jagṛhuśca sādhvīnāṃ gaṇikā hi tāḥ | |
bhāṇḍāśca jagṛhurdīkṣāṃ sādhūnāṃ tatra vai tadā |||77||
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣarapate vibho ||78||
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakrustatrāśrame ca saṃhitāḥ |
līlāvatyāḥ pitarau ca prāpya putrīṃ sukhānvitau ||79||
babhūvaturhi kamale bhaktau gurupratāpataḥ |
sādhudīkṣāṃ jagṛhatuḥ khaśau tau tatra sa sadguroḥ ||3.54.80||
pāpanāśātmikī vārtā prāsarat sarvatodiśi |
mānavāḥ pāpanāśārthaṃ cāyayuścakitāstadā ||8 1 ||
narānāryo jagṛhuśca dīkṣāṃ śrīvaiṣṇavīm ṛṣeḥ |
tāḥ saṃvidhāya muktām̐śca preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram ||82||
śiṣyāścāpi ca śiṣyāṃśca preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram |
ṛṣeḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa vimānāni cidambarāt ||83||
pārṣadaiḥ sahitānyeva viṣṇumūrtiyutāni vai |
āgatāni ca tānyāruhyaiva yayuḥ paraṃ padam||84||
vaikuṇṭhavāsā abhavan gaṇikādyā gurorbalāt |
līlāvatī tathā tasyāḥ sakhyaḥ pañca tathāparāḥ ||85||
sahasraśo’bhavan dhāmni vaikuṇṭhe śrīharermama |
seyaṃ līlāvatī te’sti kāśīrājasutādhunā ||86||
bhaginī tava cātrāste brahmapriyā vivāhitā |
gaṇikā sā suśīlāste sakhī te’tra samudraje ||87||
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri mama yogena nirguṇaḥ |
ṛṣidharmo nirguṇaśca tadyogena narāḥ striyaḥ ||88||
nirguṇā eva jāyante muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ |
kāmāt krodhād bhayāllobhānmā ye yāḥ paryupāsate ||89||
madbhaktām̐ścāpi sādhūm̐śca gurūn tānuddharāmyaham |
api pāpā durācārā guroryogena pāvanāḥ ||3.54.90 ||
jāyante dhāmavāsāśca kimuta vratināṃ tu me |
gurau vai kṛtasarvasvā gurutīrśenaṣeviṇaḥ ||9 1||
gurau viśvāsamāpannāḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam |
gururdevo guruḥ kṛṣṇo gururdīkṣā hi pāvanī ||92||
gururvrataṃ gururdānaṃ gururyasyā mato hariḥ |
gurutīrthapratāpena bhavābdhiṃ sā taratyapi ||93||
prayāti paramānandaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ hi śāśvatam |
mama vāsamayaṃ divyaṃ sarvadhāmaparaṃ priyam || 94||
sarvatṛptipradaṃ sarvakāmanāpūrakaṃ padam |
na nyūnaṃ vartate tatrāśnute bhogān mayā saha ||95||
vadhvo vāpi vidhavā vā hyadhavā vā nirāśritāḥ |
gurutīrthaṃ paraṃ prāpya mucyante bhavasāgarāt ||96||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt kathanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirdivyagatirdhāmaprāptiḥ prajāyate ||97||
sakāmānāṃ svargalabdhirniṣkāmānāṃ pramokṣaṇam |
matkāmānāṃ mama prāptiḥ puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||98 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe ṛṣidharmamaharṣeryogena līlāvatyāḥ suśīlādīnāṃ ca pāpānāṃ vigame brahmapriyātvaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||

<3.55>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ cānyāṃ supāvanīm |
gurutīrthamayīṃ sarvoddhāriṇīṃ pāpahāriṇīm || 1 ||
saurāṣṭre copaleṣṭāyāṃ nagaryāṃ śvapacī satī |
rakṣānāmnī haribhaktā sumarasya hi bhāminī || 2 ||
avasat sakuṭumbā vai puryā malāpahāriṇī |
malānāṃ hāriṇītvāt sā hyaśuddhā vartate dine || 3 ||
madhyāhne tu tataḥ snātvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā svahastayoḥ |
tato yāti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ vṛkṣamadhye vidhāpitam || 4 ||
kṛtvā sā roṭakaṃ naijaṃ bhojayitvā patiṃ harim |
śune datvā tato bhuṃkte rakṣā santoṣasadguṇā || 5 ||
vicārayati nityaṃ sā gṛhe sthitā daśāṃ nijām |
kathaṃ vai mānave’pyatra śvapacī hyabhavaṃ nvaham || 6 ||
dāridryaṃ sarvadā cāste kaiṃkaryaṃ sarvadā tathā |
malaniṣkāsanaṃ nityaṃ hyaśuddhirnityameva ca ||7||
tiraskāraḥ pratikṣetraṃ cāspṛśyatvaṃ ca sarvadā |
satyapi mānave bhāve pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ mama || 8 ||
bhojanaṃ dṛśyate naiva labhyate na rasānvitam |
ambarāṇi nikṛṣṭāni śṛṃgāro labhyate na ca || 9 ||
gṛhaṃ tu śobhanaṃ naiva bhogyajātaṃ na vidyate |
mānaṃ yaśo na caivāste dhik janma pāpasaṃbhṛtam|| 3.55.10 ||
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ nāsti dhātupātrāṇi santi na |
vibhūṣāḥ santi naivāpi miṣṭānnaṃ vidyate’pi na || 11 ||
dravyaṃ ca nāṇakaṃ nāsti paryaṃko nāsti śobhanaḥ |
suvarṇasya tu vai svapne cāśā nāsti kadācana || 12||
evaṃ me vidyate sarvaṃ vairupyaṃ kalmaṣaṃ tathā |
eko guṇo me śvapacījñātau vai vidyate śubhaḥ || 13 ||
aspṛśyatvāt parapuṃsaḥ sparśo nāsti kadāpi me |
pātivratyaṃ sarvadāsti sahajaṃ sarvato guru || 14||
svajātayo’pi vidyante dūre dūre purāntare |
teṣāṃ nāraṇāṃ yogo’pi naivāsti sparśanaṃ mama || 15||
evaṃ me’sti vrataṃ śīlaṃ puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ sadā |
nirmānatā virāgaśca nirbādhatāpi vidyate || 16||
nadī tvāste pārśvato me snānaṃ nityaṃ bhavatyapi |
gṛhaṃ vane sadā caste nirbandhaṃ vānaprasthavat || 17||
caurāṇāṃ tu bhayaṃ nāsti rājñāṃ bhayaṃ na vidyate |
sukhaṃ svapimi patyā me sākaṃ sevāparāyaṇā || 18||
sādhūnāṃ pārśvamārgeṇa yātānāṃ darśanaṃ kvacit |
jāyate me bhāgyavaśāt sūryasya darśanaṃ sadā || 1 9||
āmadhyāhnaṃ malahārātmakaṃ kāryaṃ na vai tataḥ |
divasārdhaṃ niśāyāṃ ca nivṛttirmama vidyate || 3.55.20 ||
parameśasya nāmnāṃ vai bhajanārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
vidyate me samayaśca lābhāḥ santi tathāvidhāḥ ||21 ||
grāme mahotsave daive mānuṣe vā pravartite |
prasādaḥ prāpyate cāpi pāvano daivamānuṣaḥ ||22||
tatrāpi mama sāphalyaṃ manuṣyasya tu janmanaḥ |
śvapacyā api me śīlaṃ pātivratyaṃ paraṃ khalu ||23||
anyāsāṃ janamadhye ca grāme vā narayoṣitām |
prajāstrīṇāṃ sahavāso dṛśyate śīlanāśakaḥ ||24||
yatra narāstathā nāryo nivasanti mitho’bhitaḥ |
tatra dharmo hanyate vai deśakālabalena ha ||25||
vivāhitānāṃ nārīṇāṃ parapuṃsparśanaṃ tathā |
ekāntasevanaṃ cāpi dharmahaṃ nirayapradam ||26||
yāsāṃ tathāvidhānāṃ vai saṃkarīṇāṃ tu yoṣitām |
adya vai narakaṃ nāsti tāsāṃ vai narakaṃ tataḥ ||27||
janmāntare bhavedeva ihādharmaprayojitam |
mama śvapacīrūpāyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ narakaṃ tviha || 28||
kintu dharmabalenaiva mṛtyūrdhve narakaṃ na vai |
tasmācchreṣṭhā gatiścāste prajānārībhya uttamā ||29||
asmṛddhayo virāgāya samṛddhayo bandhanāya vai |
nairjanyaṃ paralokāya saujanyaṃ bandhanāya vai ||3.55.3 0||
śvapacyahaṃ bandhaśūnyā vicarāmi satī yathā |
rathyāṃ rathyāṃ vicarāmi sādhvī pativratā yathā ||3 1||
nirbhayā me sthitiścāste sukhāḍhyā vyādhivarjitā |
mārjayāmi malagartān vairāgyaṃ ca labhāmyapi ||32||
svamalaṃ sarvalokā vai mārjayanti dine dine |
prātarutthāya sarve’pi kṣālayanti nijaṃ malam ||33||
nāryaścāpatyavatyaśca kṣālayanti hi bālakān |
gṛhamadhye vastramadhye śayyāmadhye kṛtānyapi || 34||
bālamalāni vai sarvā niṣkāsayanti madvidhāḥ |
viśeṣo me tathā tāsāṃ malaśuddhau na vidyate ||35||
sarve vai śvapacā naijadehamalāpasāraṇe |
tasmācchraiṣṭhyaṃ mamaivāste śvapacyāṃ nirupadravam ||36||
rājā syād duḥkhabhāṅnityaṃ rājñī tato’pi duḥkhinī |
kārāgāranibhe saudhe ruddhyamānā bhaṭaiḥ sadā ||37||
śreṣṭhināryo vastravaruthakaiśchannāḥ prayānti ca |
śreṣṭhino’pi sabhayā no bahiryānti vinā bhaṭaiḥ ||38||
evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāste sākṣānnarakaṃ bhuñjate |
ko viśeṣo’sti vai teṣāṃ śvapacyāḥ sannidhāviha ||39||
api tṛṣṇā piśācyeṣāṃ hṛdayāni nikṛntati |
rogāḥ sākṣād yamadūtāḥ śoṣayanti dhanaṃ vapuḥ ||3.55.40||
bhṛtyādhīnā bhṛtyabhṛtyā jāyante dhanino janāḥ |
pāratantryaṃ parāśā ca narakau dvau gṛhasthitau ||41||
svātantryaṃ ca nirāśā ca svargau dvau svakarasthitau |
dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī śuddhā tādṛgdoṣavivarjitā |||42||
ājīvanaṃ svargayuktā cānte’pi svargagāminī |
hariṇī labhate bhojyaṃ vane’pi phalapatravat ||43||
siṃhikā labhate bhojyaṃ mahāraṇye’pi māṃsajam |
śreṣṭhinī labhate bhojyaṃ svādvapi rogasaṃbhṛtam ||44||
śvapacī labhate bhojyaṃ śuṣkaṃ cāpi balapradam |
dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī cāsmi mahāsaukhyasamanvitā ||45||
rājā rājñī tathā cānye hyāyuṣo’ntimabhāgake ||
sannyāsino vānaprasthā jāyante mokṣasiddhaye ||46||
vane paśyāmi tān sarvān bhogarāgavivarjitān |
mādṛśām̐stāpasān sarvān dhanyāhaṃ janmatastathā ||47||
sanyāsinī sadaivāsmi sadaiva patidevatā |
sadaiva śīlayuktā ca bhavāmi śvapacī śubhā ||48||
aho me bandhanaṃ nāsti nāsti me dharmavarjanam |
grāmasevā karomyatra jātiyogyāṃ hitāvahām ||49||
sādhavo brahmavijñānāḥ pāpināṃ pāpakalmaṣān |
upadeśapradānena hṛdo niṣkāsayanti te ||3.55.50||
śvapacī karmavijñānā malināṃ malakalmaṣān |
dehasevāpradānena niṣkāsayāmi garttataḥ ||51||
malaniṣkāsanaṃ kāryaṃ cobhayorvai samaṃ yataḥ |
sanyāsinī bhavāmyeva karmasanyāsinī yathā ||52||
guravaḥ santi loke’tra malanāśakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
ajñānamalanāśena prajñānaṃ dīpayanti te ||53||
ahaṃ bhūtvā nijā gurvī śokamalaṃ jahāmyapi |
svasyā gurvī svayaṃ bhūtvā nirmalā vicarāmi ca ||54||
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ śvapacyā mama mānave |
sukhinyasmi sadā cānyāpekṣayā kṛpayā hareḥ ||55||
nāsti me phalahaḥ kaścid bahūnāṃ saṃgame hi yaḥ |
nāsti me dharmabhaṃgaśca bahūnāṃ saṃgajastu yaḥ ||56||
vinā vanaṃ vane vāso vidyate me sukhāvahaḥ |
ātmaśāntiḥ sadā cāste pravrajyāmantarāpi me ||57||
dhanyāhaṃ dhanyapātraṃ ca sukhapātraṃ yaduttamam |
svapatyā dīyamānaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhuñjāmi sarvakam ||58||
yasyā gṛhe bhavet kleśo vaimanasyaṃ narastriyoḥ |
nityaṃ śaṃkāspadatvaṃ ca rauravaṃ narakaṃ tu tat ||59||
yasya gṛhe bhavet prema saumanasyaṃ narastriyoḥ |
tathā cānabhiśaṃkitvamaindraṃ svargaṃ padaṃ hi tat ||3.55.60||
tādṛśaṃ svargamevātra vidyate śvapacīgṛhe |
drumāśceme mamodyāno vartate ca nadī mama ||61||
sādhvītvaṃ sarvamūrdhanyaṃ vartate mama mokṣadam |
dhanyāhaṃ śvapacī tasmāt sarvasaubhāgyaśālinī ||62||
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ pārśvamārgeṇa gacchataḥ |
jātaṃ vai darśanaṃ sādhorbrahmamagnasya yoginaḥ ||63||
nāmnā caitanyaśīlasya mahāsiddhasya vai prabhoḥ |
rakṣā tūṇaṃ yayau santaṃ prati mārge sthitābhavat ||64||
anamad dūrataḥ sādhuṃ kṛtāñjalirnatānanā |
sādhuḥ prāha sadā śāntimatī mokṣavatī bhava ||65||
divyā devī tathā bhūtvā brahmapriyā sadā bhava |
haribhaktā bhava sādhvī sādhusevākarī bhava ||66||
ityuktvā caitanyaśīlo bhadrāvatīnadītaṭe |
vṛkṣatale’tidūre ca gatvā hyupāviśat kṣaṇam ||67||
nadījale tato gatvā snātvā kṛtvārhaṇaṃ hareḥ |
haraye ca phalaṃ vāri śarkarāṃ ca nivedya saḥ ||68||
śvapacyai tatra yātāyai prasādaṃ dattavān muniḥ |
sāpi prasādamāsādya pataye vinivedya ca ||69||
tataścakhāda śeṣaṃ ca matvā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ param |
atha sādhuḥ pādapādho rātrivāsaṃ vyadhādapi ||3.55.70||
śaityaṃ ca bādhate tasya vīkṣya sā śvapacī dadau |
kāṣṭhāni cāgnidīptyarthaṃ sādhurvahnimadīpayat ||71 ||
mālāṃ cāvartayaccāpi bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha |
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho ||72||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama |
tālikāvādanaiḥ sādhuścakre śrīnāmakīrtanam ||73||
śvapacī svāminā sākaṃ tvāgatya vṛkṣasannidhau |
dūraṃ niṣadya bhajanaṃ tadvidhaṃ pracakāra sā ||74||
bhajanānte ca sādhuṃ taṃ papraccha vinayānvitā |
kuta āgamyate sādho kva nivāso’pi nityadā ||75||
kutra saṃgamyate cāpi kuśalaṃ nvasti sarvathā |
sādhuḥ prāha harergehādāgamyate’tidūrataḥ ||76||
nivāsaḥ śrīharau me’sti gamyate śrīhariṃ prati |
kuśalaṃ sarvathā cāste gurutīrthaprasādataḥ ||77||
rakṣā prāha śubhaṃ sādho gurutīrthaṃ hi kīdṛśam |
yena syāt kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ vada me kṛpayā mune ||78||
sādhuḥ prāha gururviṣṇurgururbrahmā gururharaḥ |
guruḥ svāmī hariḥ sādhurgururmātā patiḥ pitā ||79||
gururjñānapradātā ca pāpahartā gururmahān |
gururmokṣapradātā ca nijātmā paramo guruḥ ||3.55.80||
gurorguruścāntarātmā śrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ |
tadāśrayena pāpānāṃ dhvaṃso mokṣo’pi śāśvataḥ ||81 ||
api pāpasamācāraḥ śvapākaḥ śvapaco’pi vā |
madyamāṃsāśanaścāpi vyavāyamadirāśanaḥ ||82||
mahāpāpātipāpo’pi praśuddhyati guruśrayāt |
na vrataṃ naiva tīrthaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na tatparam ||83||
āptā guroḥ kṛpā yena sadyo mucyeta bandhanāt |
gurormantraṃ harernāmno gṛhṇīyātpāvanaṃ param ||84||
pītvā guroḥ padāmbhojaṃ dhyātvā mūrtiṃ gurorguroḥ |
sevayitvā guruṃ devaṃ prasādayitvā tatkṣaṇam ||85||
sarvasvaṃ prasamarpyaiva sadyo mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
sādhurnaukā gururnaukā harirnaukā satīpatiḥ ||86||
jñānaṃ naukā parānaukā bhaktiśca śaraṇāgatiḥ |
rakṣā papraccha sādhuṃ taṃ dehi me śaraṇāgatim ||87||
dehi mantraṃ śvapacyai me svāmine śvapacāya me |
caitanyaśīlaḥ pūrvaṃ tāṃ pāyayāmāsa vai śubham ||88||
nijaṃ pādajalaṃ tatra nikṣipya śrīharerjalam |
pavitrāṃ pāvanīṃ kṛtvā dadau mantraṃ tataḥ param ||89||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||3.55.90||
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||91||
iti mantrān dadau sādhuḥ śvapacyai śvapacāya ca |
bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa rātryardhaṃ ca tataḥ param ||92||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ sādhoścakrāte dampatī hyubhau |
cāṇḍālatvaṃ vilīnaṃ ca sādhoḥ saṃsevayā tadā ||93||
prātaḥparyantamevābhyāṃ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtam |
prātarhariḥ samāyāto divyavimānarājitaḥ ||94||
pārṣadaiḥ pravarairyukto rādhālakṣmyādirājitaḥ |
sādhuṃ rakṣāṃ sumaraṃ ca hariḥ prāha mamānugāḥ ||95||
trayo’pi mama bhaktāḥ stho divyabhāvamupāgatāḥ |
gurutīrthaprapūtā me cārohata vimānakam ||96||
ityuktāste trayo natvā tyaktvā dehān bhuvastale |
divyau ca pārṣadau bhūtvā pārṣadānī tathāvidhā ||97||
divyā caturbhujā bhūtvā sthitvā vimānakaṃ tadā |
hariṇā saha vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayurmokṣamuttamam ||98||
evaṃ lakṣmi gurutīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ sadya eva ha |
vadhūnāṃ cāpyaśuddhānāṃ śvapākītulyayoṣitām ||99||
mokṣadaṃ cottamaṃ cāste tasmād guruṃ niṣevayet |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 3.55.1 00||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ gurutīrthe caitanyaśīlaguroḥ pratāpāt sumarapatnyāḥ rakṣāśvapacyāḥ patinā saha guruṇā saha ca mokṣaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||

<3.56>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan devadeveśa gurutīrthaṃ parātparam |
kathaṃ vai śreṣṭhatamatāṃ prāptaṃ me vada kāraṇām || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
bhūmiśuddhirvāyunaiva dehaśuddhistu vāriṇā |
manaḥśuddhirvirāgeṇa cātmaśuddhirvivekataḥ || 2 ||
vivekastattvavijñānaṃ tacca gurorvinā na vai |
tūrṇaṃ prakāśadātṛtvād gurustvaṃ paramo mataḥ || 3 ||
andhakāre manuṣyāṇāṃ lakṣeṣvapi pradīpakaḥ |
prakāśakṛd bhavatyeva tathā guruḥ pradīpakaḥ || 4 ||
bahūnāṃ yādasāṃ cābdhau sattve’pi naurhi tārikā |
jagadabdhau dehināṃ sattve’pi gururhi tārakaḥ || 5 ||
tārāṇāṃ gagane nāntaḥ prakāśakastu candramāḥ |
mānavānāṃ tathā nāntaḥ prakāśadastu sadguruḥ || 6 ||
anyairgrahairna vai nāśo niśāyā vigamaḥ kvacit |
anyairjanairna cājñānavigamaḥ sadguruṃ vinā || 7 ||
jalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhūmirijyā yajño vrataṃ ca caityakam |
sadguruṇaiva tīrthāni sañjātāni purā kila || 8 ||
mūrtitīrthaṃ pratimākhyaṃ jñānatīrthaṃ tu pustikā |
tu hyubhe sadguroreva samudbhūte na cānyathā || 9 ||
devā gurubalāḥ sarve mantrā gurubalāstathā |
yogo gurubalaścāpi gurutīrthaṃ tato’dhikam || 3.56.1 0||
gurutvaṃ mama yogena vardhate ca prakāśate |
camatkāramayaṃ cāpi jāyate mama saṃgataḥ || 11 ||
mama saṃgo mama sneho mama bhaktiḥ prasevanam |
mamaiva ca kṛtaṃ yena gurutā tasya śāśvatī || 12||
śāśvato’haṃ gururyasmādanādijñānavān prabhuḥ |
mama yogena bhaktasya śāśvatī gurutā tataḥ || 13||
mūlyavadvastuyogena nirmūlyaṃ mūlyavadbhavet |
dugdhavatsāyutā gauśca bahumūlyā sadā bhavet || 14||
vidyākhanirmānavaśca bahumūlyaḥ prajāyate |
nairmalyabhāhīrako’pi bahumūlyaḥ pragaṇyate || 15||
pittalaṃ svarṇasaṃgena bahumūlyaṃ hi jāyate |
kanyā varayutā loke bahumūlyā supūjyate || 16||
bhṛtyā rājayutāḥ sarve rājamūlyā bhavanti vai |
pātraṃ vastubhṛtaṃ cāpi mūlyavajjāyate priye || 17||
evaṃ bhakto bhaktiyukto mayā yukto viśeṣataḥ |
nairmalyabhāvayuktaśca bahumūlyaḥ prajāyate || 18||
bhṛtyaḥ prasannaḥ sahasā prajākāryaṃ karoti vai |
kārayatyeva sahasā nṛpadvārā tvarāyutaḥ || 19||
na tu rājñaḥ puttalikā prajākāryaṃ karoti hi |
na ca puttalikā kāryaṃ tvaritaṃ kārayatyapi ||3.56.20||
tathā bhṛtyā mama bhaktāḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ |
śaraṇāgatakāryāṇāṃ kartāraḥ sahasā hyapi ||21||
caitanyamūrtayo me vai sādhavo guravo bhuvi |
rājño vai kāryakartāro bhṛtyāścaitanyamūrtayaḥ ||22|
abhidhāya hasitvā ca gṛhitvā sevanādikam |
datvā dānaṃ manuṃ bhānaṃ kurvantīṣṭaṃ hi dehinām ||23|||
śaraṇāgatajīvānāmādhārā guravo yataḥ |
mayā dattaṃ gurubhyo vai padaṃ me’dhikṛtistathrā ||24||
madvad bhavanti pūjyāste loke nārāyaṇā hi te |
yathāhaṃ ca tathā te’pi mama bhaktipravartakāḥ ||25||
tasmātte guravaḥ śreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ gurvātmakaṃ param |
pāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ śīghraṃ kurvanti vāridānataḥ ||26||
ajñānanāśanaṃ śīghraṃ kurvanti mantradānataḥ |
svargādikāṃ mahāsmṛddhimāśīrvādairdahatyapi ||27||
prasādena drutaṃ mokṣapadaṃ sampreṣayantyapi |
līlayā me kvacittūrṇaṃ kārayantīha darśanam |||28||
mama divyasvarūpasya kṛpayā darśanaṃ hṛdi |
tasmānme sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā guravo lakṣmi sarvadā ||29||
bhaktyā me te bhavantyeva śreṣṭhatamāḥ pareśvarāḥ |
bhaktiṃ te kathayāmyatra yayā śreṣṭhatamā hi te ||3.56.30||
gurudevarṣisiddharṣisevanaṃ sādhusaṃgamaḥ |
satkriyāvyasanaṃ cātrāparā bhaktirmatā mama ||31||
mamāṃśānāṃ guruṇāṃ yā sevā sā cāparā mama |
bhaktireva mayā nityaṃ manyate mokṣadāyinī ||32||
prāpya brahmarasaṃ divyaṃ pītvā cānandasaṃbhṛtam |
bhaktā brahmaparābhogāstṛptā bhavanti śāśvatāḥ ||33 ||
brahmarasābhiplutāśca bhavantyakṣararūpiṇaḥ |
yathāgniragnau samprāptastathātmā paramātmani ||34||
brahmarūpakaraṃ nāma hare hare sadā japet |
ahaṃ brahmaparaṃjyotirmāyātattvavivarjitaḥ ||35||
ahaṃ brahma paraṃjyotirjñānavānasmi muktaye |
bhaktyā jñānāḍhyayā labhyo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||36||
dhyānena pūjayā japyaiḥ samyak stotrairyatavrataiḥ |
sevayā premabhaktyā vai prāpyo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||37||
mahataḥ śreyaso mūlaṃ prasavaḥ puṇyasantateḥ |
jīvitasya phalaṃ svādu niyatismaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||38||
sevā snehayutā bodhyā bhaktiḥ sādhanabhūyasī |
bhaktāste mama sevāyāṃ lagnā cābhinnabhāvanaiḥ ||39||
muñcantyaśrūṇi saṃharṣāt saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ |
kṛṣṇakriyāparā nityaṃ snigdhā me vaiṣṇavāḥ sadā ||3.56.40 ||
brahmākṣaraṃ parabrahma śṛṇvan bhāgavatān gṛṇan |
praṇāmapūrvakaṃ bhaktyā kīrtayed vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ||41 ||
me bhaktajanavātsalyaṃ bhaktapūjānumodanam |
bhaktagāthāśrave prītaḥ sa vai bhaktottamo mataḥ ||42||
yena sarvātmanā kṛṣṇe bhaktyā bhāvaḥ samarpitaḥ |
sadguroḥ śaraṇaṃ prāpya mahābhāgavato hi saḥ ||43||
svayaṃ tvabhyarcayenmāṃ vai viṣṇuṃ tathopajīvati |
bahudhā bhaktisampanno mleccho’pi vaiṣṇavo hi saḥ ||44||
sa vai śreṣṭho munirbhaktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hariḥ ||45||
punāti bhagavadbhaktaścāṇḍālo’pi yadṛcchayā |
mama bhakto na cāṇḍālo divyo me pārṣado’sti saḥ ||46||
dayāṃ kuru prapannāya tavāsmīti ca yācate |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dadyādetadvrataṃ hareḥ ||47||
mantrayājisahasrebhyo vedavedāntavit paraḥ |
sarvavedāntavijñebhyo viṣṇubhakto viśiṣyate ||48||
ekāntino divyadehairgacchanti paramaṃ padam |
ekāntena samo viṣṇurviṣṇurbhaktaparāyaṇaḥ ||49||
bhaktā ekāntinaḥ santo viprakoṭyuttamā matāḥ |
priyāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ mama cātipriyā hi te ||3.56.50||
mahābhāgavatāḥ santaḥ sādhavo viprakoṭitaḥ |
brāhmaṇānāmarbudebhyaḥ sadā śreṣṭhatamā matāḥ ||5 1 ||
lokānāṃ guravo viprā viprāṇāṃ vedayājinām |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sādhavo guravo matāḥ ||52||
viprā gṛhanimagnāste śmaśānāni ha bhejire |
sādhavo brahmamagnāste paraṃdhāma prapedire ||53 ||
āpatsvapi sadā yeṣāṃ bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī |
yā prītiradhikā kṛṣṇe viṣṇau sadānapāyinī ||54||
viṣṇuṃ smaran mama bhakto hṛdo na dūrameti saḥ |
dṛḍhabhakto rajjupāśairbaddho baghnāti māṃ mithaḥ ||55||
yo bhaktiṃ vahate viṣṇau tena sarvaṃ prasādhitam |
sa eva sādhurevāsti yenāhaṃ sādhitaḥ priyaḥ |||56||
yajvānaḥ kratumukhyānāṃ vedānāṃ pāragā api |
na tāṃ yānti gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ yāṃ yānti munisattamāḥ |||57||
yaḥ kaścid vaiṣṇavo loke mithyācāro’pyanāśramī |
punāti sakalān lokān yathāhaṃ bhagavān svayam ||58||
ye nṛśaṃsā durātmānaḥ pāpācāraratāstathā |
yānti sthānaṃ paraṃ me te nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||59||
dṛḍhā nārāyaṇe bhaktiḥ sadā yāvyabhicāriṇī |
saiva śāśvatsukhadāsti kiyat svargaṃ tadantike ||3.56.6 0||
bhramitvāpi mahābdhau vai saṃsārākhye’bhito muhuḥ |
pralambya svakaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dharantu yadi cāpyate ||6 1||
na śṛṇoti guṇān divyān śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ |
sa loke badhiro bodhyaḥ sadā pāpaśravo’thavā ||62||
nāmni saṃkīrtite viṣṇoryasya no pulakodgamaḥ |
