sa rājāpi surūpo’pi bodhyo vai kuṇapaḥ śavaḥ ||63||
bhaktimatāṃ narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ ṣaṇḍhadehinām |
mayi niviṣṭamanasāṃ muktirniścayabhāvinī ||64||
pāśahastān yamānāha yamarājo hyahaṃ prabhuḥ |
avaiṣṇavānāṃ pāpānāṃ vaiṣṇavān mā nayantviha ||65||
api yāvaddurācāro bhajate māṃ mayi sthitaḥ |
sādhureva sa vai muktaḥ koṭiviprādhiko guruḥ ||66||
mahābhāgavatā dharmāstasmin sarve vasanti ha |
sarvavidhā tathā śāntistatra vasati padmaje ||67||
dharmārthakāmāścaitasya kiyatīṃ gaṇanāṃ gatāḥ |
muktiścāsya sadā dāsī muktiścāsya kare sthitā ||68||
māyā vā māyikā lokāścaiśvaryāṇi ca siddhayaḥ |
bhujyamānā api naiva bādhante mama yoginaḥ ||69||
kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ vratairdānaiḥ kimanyaiḥ puṇyasādhanaiḥ |
yasya prītirharau jātā tayā cārādhyate prabhuḥ ||3.56.70||
anyairlepaiḥ pradīpādyaiścandanairgandhabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
nāhaṃ tuṣyāmi kamale yathā premṇārpaṇena vai ||71||
saṃsāraviṣavṛkṣasya dve phale hyamṛtopame |
mayi kṛṣṇe parā bhaktirmadbhaktaiśca samāgamaḥ ||72||
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiścādbhirdhanairbhojyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
bhaktyā labhye mayi nāthe vartayenmuktidāyinī ||73||
āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ |
pretāścāsmatkule bhaktaḥ kaścinnastārayiṣyati ||74||
śaraṇaṃ māṃ prapannā ye dhyānajñānavivarjitāḥ |
te’pi mṛtyumatikramya yānti matparamaṃ padam ||75||
muktihetumanādyantaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
yo namet sarvalokasya namasyo jāyate janaḥ |||76||
viṣṇumānandakośaṃ taṃ cāntarasthaṃ prabhuṃ harim|
praṇamet sarvadā bhaktyā cetasā dehayoginā ||77||
yo’ntastiṣṭhan samagrāṇāṃ paśyatīśaḥ śubhāśubham |
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kāntaṃ praṇamet parameśvaram ||78||
helayāpi namaskāraḥ prayuktaścakrapāṇaye |
saṃsārapāśarajjūnāṃ nāśakaḥ samajāyate ||79||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇi |
bhāvakṛtaḥ praṇāmo’pi śvapākaṃ ca punātyapi ||3.56.80 ||
praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau namaskāraṃ carenmudā |
ekapraṇāmamātreṇa yāti matparamaṃ padam ||81||
namaskāreṇa me lakṣmi śāśvatī muktireva ha |
ahaṃ kṛṣṇo namantaṃ vaiṃ tārayāmi bhavārṇavāt ||82|||
āsīno vā śayāno vā tiṣṭhan vā yatra tatra vā |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraṃ japet sadā sudhīḥ ||83||
nārāyaṇeti me nāma jihvāyogyaṃ pravidyate |
tathāpi yāmyaṃ paśyanti gṛhaṃ vaitaṇḍikā janāḥ ||84||
vyāsādayaḥ śaṃkarādyāḥ stuvantaḥ parameśvaram |
matiśramānnivartante madguṇānto na vidyate ||85||
avaśo’pi raṭennāma nārāyaṇeti cāsakṛt |
baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati ||86||
svapne’pi śrīharernāma raṭitaṃ ca śrutaṃ ca vā |
mokṣārthaṃ jāyate tadvai kiṃ punarjāgratastviha ||87||
namaḥ kāntāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śrīharaye namaḥ |
svāmine ca namaśceti vadan mokṣagatiṃ labhet ||88||
kalmāṣāṇāṃ kṣayaḥ syādvai nāmasaṃkīrtanāddhareḥ |
gacchatāṃ dūramadhvānaṃ śrīharerdhāmayojitam ||89||
pātheyaṃ śrīharernāmakīrtanaṃ lakṣmi sarvathā |
vadhvaḥ striyo’tilajjāśca gṛhamadhye sthitā api ||3.56.90 ||
kṛṣṇakānta hare japtvā muktā bhavanti dhāmagāḥ |
jihvāgre vartate yasyā harirityakṣaradvayam ||91||
saṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrtvā sā prayāsyati matpadam |
sahasraduṣkṛtivyāptā dharmakarmavivarjitā ||92||
śuddhimabhīpsamānā ca muktiṃ ca matpadāśrayām |
guptāpi mannāmaparā bhūtvā māṃ sā samarjayet ||93||
aśeṣalokakāntasyārādhanaṃ śrīharermama |
sāraścāsārasaṃsāre yoṣitāṃ sarvathā priye ||94||
dadyād hṛdayabhāvena puṣpāṇyāpastathā phalam |
mahyaṃ tenārcitā devāścārcitaṃ muktamaṇḍalam ||95||
na tatkaroti mātāpi na pitā nāpi bāndhavaḥ |
yat karomi prabhuścāhaṃ santuṣṭaḥ sevayārcitaḥ ||96||
varṇāśramācāravatyā yoṣitā paramaḥ pumān |
ahamārādhye vai lakṣmi sa panthāstoṣako mama ||97||
sampadaiśvaryamāhātmyaiḥ santatyā śraddhayāpi ca |
premabhaktyānvitaiḥ sarvairārādhyo’haṃ bhavāmi vai ||98||
bhaktiṃ vinā vinā snehaṃ vinā prema ca bhāvanām |
nāhaṃ prasannatāṃ yāmi bhāvakṣudhāyuto’smyaham ||99||
pūrve pūrvatarāścāpi gatā me’kṣaramuttamam |
pūrvatamā gatā bhaktyā tathā yāntu striyo’pi ca || 3.56.1 00||
evaṃ māṃ sarvadā kṛṣṇarūpiṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum |
svāminaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ rakṣanti hṛdi sādhavaḥ || 1 01||
ta eva mama yogena santaḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ |
sādhvyaśca guruvargīyāḥ sarvaśreṣṭhatamā matāḥ || 1 02||
madātmakā matsvarūpā madanyūnā narāyaṇāḥ |
avatārā hi me sarve sādhavaḥ satyayoṣitaḥ || 1 03||
sādhvyaḥ sarvā avatāriṇyaśca me tā bhavanti vai |
tasmād gurvyo mama yogānmantradā mokṣadā api || 1 04||
evaṃ nārāyaṇāśri vai guroḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ sadāsti hi |
ahaṃ gururguruścāhaṃ nātra bhedo manāgapi || 105||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ guroḥ śreṣṭhatamatve śrīharisvarūpatāhetunirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||

<3.57>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvavaidikasārakam |
sarvasādhanasādhyo vai bhajanīyaḥ pareśvara || 1 ||
dānaistīrthaistapobhiścādhvaraiḥ paropakāryakaiḥ |
rañjanīyaḥ paramātmā sādhanīyo narāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
ṣaṣṭistīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭistīrthaśatāni ca |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktacaraṇe saṃvasanti hi || 3 ||
prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi tapāṃsi ca vratāni ca |
yāni teṣāṃ samastānāṃ kṛṣṇānusmaraṇaṃ param || 4 ||
pāpadahanavāñcchānāṃ janānāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā |
prāyaścittaṃ tu paramaṃ śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ mama || 5||
muhūrtamapi yaddhyānaṃ śrīhareḥ paramātmānaḥ |
svargadaṃ tad bhavatyeva nityadhyānaṃ tu mokṣadam || 6 ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ vṛttayaśca tāste muktā na saṃśayaḥ || 7 ||
uttiṣṭhan nipatan gacchan pralapan viviśaṃstathā |
bhuñjan pibam̐śca māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yaḥ smarenmukta eva saḥ || 8 ||
sve sve karmaṇi sarvatra vṛttiḥ kāryācyutāśrayā |
tena karma hi tatsarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 9 ||
dhyānaṃ dharmaḥ paraḥ proktastapaḥ paraṃ vrataṃ param |
śaucaṃ paraṃ harerdhyānaṃ dhyānamagnastato bhavet || 3.57.10 ||
nāsti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhyeyaṃ geyaṃ prāpyaṃ paraṃ tataḥ |
tasmād viṣṇorhareḥ kāryaṃ dhyānaṃ pracintanaṃ hṛdi || 11 ||
yad durlabhaṃ paraṃ cāste manaso nāpi gocaram |
tadapyatra harirdhyātaḥ prasannaḥ san dadāti vai || 12||
pramādādapi kṛṣṇasya dhyānaṃ smṛtirnamaskṛtiḥ |
kṛtā satī parabrahmapadaṃ dadāti śāśvatam || 13||
dhyānena sadṛśaṃ cānyannāsti vai pāpaśodhakam |
āgāmidehabījasya dāhakaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 14||
viniṣpannā dhyānasiddhiḥ samādhiṃ cādadhāti vai ||
harau samādhimāpanno mokṣamatra samaśnute || 15||
nijacitte sthite viṣṇau bhaktānāṃ kilbiṣāṇi vai |
dahyanti mūlataścātmā muktabrahma prajāyate || 16||
agniyogāt kanakaṃ vai nirmalaṃ samprajāyate |
hareryogāddhi bhaktātmā brahmadhāmā prajāyate || 17||
gaṃgāsnānasahasreṣu puṣkarasnānakoṭiṣu |
yatpāpaṃ līnatāṃ yāti smṛte naśyati taddharau || 18||
prāṇāyāmasahasraistu yatpāpaṃ līyate hi tat |
dhyānena kṣaṇamātreṇa harerdhyāturvinaśyati || 19||
pāpaṃ kālastathā māyā cāntako yamasevakāḥ |
mṛtyuścāpi na tasyāsti yasyāsti puruṣottamaḥ || 3.57.20||
sā tithistadahorātraṃ sa yogaḥ sa ca candramāḥ |
śakunaṃ lagnametadvai śubhaṃ yatra smṛto hariḥ ||2 1 ||
sā hāniḥ sa ca rogo’sti saiva kṣatirdaridratā |
yatra kṣaṇe gṛhe kṛṣṇo hariḥ smṛto na keśavaḥ ||22||
yasya gehe hariścāste tasya satyayugaḥ sadā |
yasya nāsti harirgehe tasya cānye yugā gṛhe ||23||
hṛdaye yasya no kṛṣṇaścintane no haristathā |
pratimā na gṛhe yasya śmaśānaṃ mānasaṃ gṛham ||24||
yasyāgratastathā pṛṣṭhe cāntare karaṇeṣu ca |
govindaḥ samprabhātyevākṣaraṃ dhāmābhito’sya vai |||25|||
vāsudeve mano yasya pānabhojanakarmasu |
akṣaraṃ dhāma tasyāsti dṛḍhaṃ gamyaṃ hi śāśvatam ||26||
gārhasthyakarmakartāpi vyavahārāvṛto’pi ca |
chinatti pauruṣīṃ māyāṃ keśavārpitatatkriyaḥ ||27||
vighnā dūraṃ prayāntyeva kālaḥ śikhāṃ tyajatyapi |
mṛtyurdṛṣṭiṃ na cāyāti śrīharau hṛdayasthite || 28||
dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ sarvakarmasu |
lābhastasya jayastasya yaddhṛdistho janārdanaḥ || 29||
kīṭapakṣigaṇānāṃ śrīhareḥ prasannatāyujām |
brahmalokagatiścāsti kiṃ punaḥ sevināṃ hareḥ ||3.57.30||
nārāyaṇatarucchāyā nātiśītā na tāpadā |
yāmyadvārapraśamanī sevanīyā sukhārthibhiḥ ||3 1||
vadatastiṣṭhato’nyadvā svecchayā karma kurvataḥ |
na vismareddhariṃ yo vai siddhayogī mato hi saḥ ||32||
dhyeyaḥ sadā gurau mūrtau sādhvyā kānte ravau hariḥ |
yuvā bhūṣāmbaradhārī koṭikāmātisundaraḥ ||33||
nahi dhyānena sadṛśaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśakam |
śvapaco’pi bhavecchuddhaḥ śvapacānnāda ityapi ||34||
viṣṇubhaktiryasya jīve viṣṇuryadātmani sthitaḥ |
sa tārayati saṃsārāccharaṇāgatakoṭikān ||35||
tajjñānaṃ yatra lakṣmīśaḥ sā kathā yatra mādhavaḥ |
tatkarma yatkeśavārthe sā sevā yā śriyaḥ pateḥ ||36||
sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ cintayetprabhum |
tau karau yau hareḥ sevāparāyaṇau satāṃ tathā ||37||
mastakasya phalaṃ kṛṣṇapraṇāmo dhīphalaṃ smṛtiḥ |
hareḥ pūjā pāṇiphalaṃ manaḥphalaṃ matirharau ||18||
vacaḥphalaṃ hare stotraṃ cakṣuḥphalaṃ dṛśirhareḥ |
tvakphalaṃ sparśanaṃ viṣṇordehaphalaṃ prasevanam ||39||
sarvārpaṇaṃ phalaṃ smṛddhermokṣaḥ phalaṃ tu jīvinaḥ |
lokālokasamo rāśiḥ pāpasyāpi vinaśyati ||3.57.40||
śrīhareḥ smaraṇādeva puṇyātmā jāyate janaḥ |
yatkiñcitkurute karma sādhvasādhu śubhāśubham ||41||
kāmikaṃ cākāmikaṃ vā svārthaṃ parārthamityapi |
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kartā tasya na lipyate ||42||
rāṣṭrasya śaraṇaṃ rājā pitaro bālakasya ca |
dharmastu sarvamartyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ hariḥ ||43||
ye namanti smarantīśaṃ pūjayanti ca māṃ sadā |
ta eva tīrtharūpā me’bhinnā mokṣapradāyakāḥ ||44||
śūdraṃ vā bhagavadbhaktaṃ niṣādaṃ śvapacaṃ ca vā |
gaṇikāṃ ghātakaṃ vāpi śreṣṭhaṃ manye hi padmaje ||45||
ādīptaṃ parvataṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante mṛgādayaḥ |
mayā dīptaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante’gharāśayaḥ ||46||
yasya yāvām̐stu viśvāsastasya siddhirhi tāvatī |
anugraho viśeṣo’trāsīmaphalaprado bhavet ||47||
prasannatāyā nānto’sti phalānto’pi na vidyate |
tatra yāvacca yāvām̐śca niyamo nāsti vai harau ||48||
prasanno bhagavān samrāṭ jalamātreṇa tuṣyati |
dadātyamṛtasāmudraṃ svāmī kaḥ svāmino’sti vai ||49||
rājñe tu cūmbanaṃ datvā labhate’rdhāsanaṃ sakhī |
haraye vai tathā datvā labhate me’kṣaraṃ padam ||3.57.50 ||
evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvavadhūbhirīśvarī |
samarpitāsi sahitā so’haṃ sā tvaṃ hariḥ svayam ||51||
harikṛṣṇaprasādena yadi kaścid bhajatyapi |
na nistarati saṃsāraṃ devānāmapi dustaram |||52||
dhyāyedārādhayed viṣṇuṃ sadā nijātmasaṃsthitam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇaprabhuṃ tena mucyeta bandhanāt ||53||
sarvadehividhātāraṃ sarvajñānamanoratim |
sarvagaṃ sadguruṃ viṣṇuṃ sadā dhyāyan pramucyate ||54||
dhāmātītaṃ dhāmasaṃsthaṃ sarvāvatārakāraṇam |
avatārisvarūpaṃ māṃ dhyāyan śīghraṃ pramucyate ||55||
kṛṣṇamanādikṛṣṇaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇam |
vāsudevādyātmakaṃ māṃ dhyāyan śīghraṃ pramucyate ||56||
bhūmānaṃ prakṛteḥ pāraṃ pūruṣaṃ puruṣottamam |
sarveśvareśvaraṃ kāntaṃ māṃ dhyāyan saṃpramucyate ||57||
hiraṇmayaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ vairājaṃ viṣṇumityapi |
antarātmasvarūpaṃ māṃ dhyāyan sadyaḥ pramucyate ||58|||
muktairmuktānikābhiśceśvarairīśvarikādibhiḥ |
avatāraiḥ suraiścāpi dhyātaṃ dhyātvā pramucyate ||59||
saṃsārabandhanānmuktimicchan yaḥ ko’pi dehavān |
stutvā dhyātvā pūjayitvā māṃ hariṃ sampramucyate ||3.57.6 0||
lakṣmi nityaṃ balaṃ prāpyaṃ mama sarvāvatāriṇaḥ |
akṣareśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||6 1 ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ parameśvaram |
antaḥsthitaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyu kariṣyati ||62||
mīnaśūladhvajadhanuḥsvasticakraśarānvitam |
śrīvatsāṃkaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||63||
kambharāśrīsutaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ priyaṃ patim |
gopālajaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||64||
brahmapriyāpatiṃ haripriyāpatiṃ satīpatim |
śrīpatiṃ saṃprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||65||
rādhāramāpatiṃ lakṣmīramāpadmāvatīpatim |
māṇikīśaṃ praprannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||66||
kamalāduḥkhahālakṣmīpatiṃ nārāyaṇīpatim |
śivajeśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||67||
divyādevīpatiṃ kīrāpatiṃ kāmodakāpatim |
suśīleśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||68||
līlāvatīkhaśīnāthaṃ huṇḍikāgaṇikāpatim |
haṃsikeśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||69||
aśokasundarīnāthaṃ vikalendumatīpatim |
bhillīśaṃ saṃprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||3.57.70||
rakṣāprajñāśamīśraddhānāthaṃ muktapatiṃ harim |
mama kāntaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||71||
kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ rāmakṛṣṇaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ janārdanam |
rājarājaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||72||
vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ viṣṇuṃ mādhavaṃ keśavaṃ patim |
kāntakāntaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||73||
kapilaṃ ca hariṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanaṃ śivam |
akṣareśaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||74||
anantaśirasaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanaṃ paraṃ patim |
brahmayoniṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ me mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||75||
premarasaṃ harernityaṃ pibāmi pārśvavartinī |
hareḥ pādaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||76||
harestāmbūlajaṃ miṣṭaṃ rasaṃ sugandhasaṃbhṛtam |
pibāmi taṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||77||
amṛtākhyaṃ prasādaṃ ca nityamāsvādayāmi ca |
oṣṭharasaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||78||
śrīhareḥ śayanaṃ prāptā mahānandaṃ vahāmi ca |
āntarasthaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||79||
ākṣaraṃ balamāptāsmi nityaṃ sukhaṃ gatāsmi ca |
ekātmānaṃ prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||3.57.8 0||
tādātmyasukhamāpannā rahasyānandabhoginī |
tadbhāvaṃ ca prapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||81||
mṛtyoḥ pitā mahākālo yena sṛṣṭo’smi yadvaśaḥ |
taṃ prabhuṃ samprapannāsmi kiṃ māṃ mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||82||
ityevaṃ śrīharerme vai madamāptā priyā mama |
nirbhayā sevate māṃ cāśnute sarvaṃ sukhaṃ mama ||83||
sā dhanyā sā saphalārthā sā ca sarvasukhasthitā |
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasyāḥ stauti yā puruṣottamam ||84||
oṃ namo’kṣaravāsāya muktasevyāya te namaḥ |
oṃ namaśceśvareśāyāvatāreśāya te namaḥ ||85||
oṃ namo muktapataye satāṃ ca pataye namaḥ |
oṃ namo’kṣarapataye muktānīpataye namaḥ ||86||
namaste paramānanda namaste paramākṣara |
namaste nityasarvajña namaste jñānamuktida ||87||
namaste cātmavāsāya namaste puruṣottama |
sarvāntarātmarūpāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||88||
namaste kambharāputra gopālajāya te namaḥ |
namaste śrīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ca te namaḥ ||89||
namaste kuṃkumavāpīnivāsāyābdhiśāyine |
brahmapriyādhipataye haripriyāpriyāya ca ||3.57.90||
jaya satyajagatsākṣin jaya sarvapumarthad |
jaya vedāntavedyastvaṃ jaya kānta manohara ||9 1 ||
jaya sūkṣmacidānanda jaya cittanirañjana |
jaya nātha jaya sarva jaya śāntasanātana ||92||
tvaṃ gurustvaṃ hare kāntatvaṃ svāmī tvaṃ mamādhipaḥ |
dharmajñānādayastvaṃ me tvaṃ me viṣṇuḥ pramokṣadaḥ ||93||
tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ samuddhartā tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ pralumpakaḥ |
tvaṃ śrīḥ puṣṭistvaṃ ca lakṣmīstvaṃ prabhā tvaṃ ca māṇikī ||94||
tvaṃ kṣetrajñaḥ pareśaśca tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ |
tava rūpamidaṃ sarvaṃ parabrahma tvamīśvaraḥ ||95||
avatārātmakamūrtiṃ te bhajanti divaukasaḥ |
bhajane pūjane pāne bhojane puruṣottama ||96||
kṣantumarhasi deveśa yatkṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ mayā |
na śaknomi sadā kartuṃ pūjāṃ samyak kṣamasva mām ||97||
yat kṛtaṃ japahomādi hyasādhyaṃ puruṣottama |
nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ mama matvā nijāṃ māṃ svīkuru prabho ||98||
divārātrau ca sandhyāyāṃ sarvāvasthāsu me prabho |
acalā vai tvayi bhaktistavāṃghriyugale sthitiḥ ||99||
iti stotreṇa māṃ nāthaṃ bhaktyeḍiṣva narāyaṇi |
yadicchasi mamānandaṃ bhaja bhaktyā jagadgurum || 3.57.10 0||
prātarjapedidaṃ stotraṃ smarantaṃ puruṣottamam |
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sampadaṃ ca sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 101 ||
putrārthī labhate putrān baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
kanyārthinī labhet kanyāṃ kanyā śubhaṃ patiṃ labhet || 1 02||
rogād vimucyate rogī nirdhano labhate dhanam |
jātismaratvaṃ medhāvī vidyārthī jñānamarjayet || 1 03||
jaghanyaścāpi mūrdhanyastvasādhuḥ sādhusattamaḥ |
śaṭho’pi satyavāk syācca yaḥ stauti puruṣottamam || 1 04||
sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtā api te sādhavo matāḥ |
yeṣāṃ pravartanaṃ sarvaṃ harimuddiśya jāyate || 1 05||
nāśaucaṃ vidyate tasyā yasyā bhaktiḥ pareśvare |
mano vāg varṣma sarvasvaṃ mayā kṣiptau harau tviha || 1 06||
ārādhya sarvadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sukhapradam |
naro nārī ca vā ṣaṇḍhaḥ prāpnotīha suvāñchitam || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ dhyeyasya śrīhareḥ sarvārpaṇastotrādipradarśananāmā saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||

<3.58>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirviṣṇureveti cintayan |
nārāyaṇi bhavedatra jīvanmukto hi mānavaḥ || 1 ||
ārādhanā balaṃ jīve sañcitaṃ vai pramodadam |
ārādhanāyutaścāyaṃ yāti muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
viṣṇau saktaṃ mano yasya viṣṇumevānupaśyati |
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyestyajet prāṇān yāti tatparamaṃ padam || 3 ||
ārādhanena nāryaśca kṛtvā pāpāni bhasmasāt |
harau magnā brahmakāntā labhante paramāṃ gatim || 4 ||
manthanād dṛśyate hyagnistadvad vai mananāddhariḥ |
dṛśyate gocarasyāgre muktiścātraiva sā matā || 5 ||
vedātra taṃ puruṣaṃ yaṃ cidrūpaṃ tamasaḥ param |
asyāhamitimokṣāya nānyaḥ panthā vimuktaye || 6 ||
yadā sarve nijā bhāvāścārpyante parameśvare |
tadāmṛtatvamāpnoti jīvannevākṣarasthitaḥ || 7 ||
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmāyāpāre’smi sarvathā |
matvaivaṃ paramātmānaṃ tvāśrayenmuktibhāg bhavet || 8 ||
smaraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva praṇāmo bhaktipūrvakam |
pratyekamaśvamedhasya phalādhikaphalapradam || 9 ||
purā vipraḥ kauśiko vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
sāmagānarato nityaṃ karatālasamanvitaḥ || 3.58.1 0||
bhojanāsanaśayyāsu vyavahāre vinodane |
mamaiva caritaṃ śaśvadgāyamāno’bhavanmuhuḥ || 1 1||
devālayaṃ samāsādya parameśvarasannidhau |
agāyata hariṃ tatra tālavarṇalayānvitam || 12||
mūrchanāsvarayogena śrutibhedena bheditam |
tatrainaṃ gāyamānaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā padmākhyabhūsuraḥ || 1 3||
dadāvannaṃ hi bhikṣārthaṃ gāyannāste ca kauśikaḥ |
śṛṇvannāste sa padmākhyo nityaṃ bhikṣāṃ dadāti ca || 14||
kauśikasya tataḥ śiṣyā abhavan bahavaḥ khalu |
sarve gāyanti vai viṣṇoścālaye kauśikānvitāḥ || 15||
mandire mālavo nāma vaiśyastatraiva bhaktimān |
dīpamālāṃ harernityaṃ karoti bhāryayā yutaḥ || 16||
gomayena samālipya hareḥ kṣetraṃ samantataḥ |
bhartrā sahāste suprītā śṛṇvatī gānamuttamam || 17||
evaṃ pativratā pūjākarī bhajati mādhavam |
anye gāyanakuśalā brāhmaṇāśca kuśasthalāt || 18||
pañcāśadvai samāpannā gānārthaṃ harimandiram |
kauśikasyeva gānasya puṣṭiṃ kurvanti te’pi ca || 19||
gānavidyārthatattvajñāḥ śṛṇvanto hyavasam̐stu te |
evaṃ gāyanatattvajñāḥ samavetā hi mandire ||3.58.20||
khyātamāsīt tatra tasya gānaṃ vai kauśikasya tat |
śrutvā rājā kaliṃgo’pi kīrtiṃ gītividāṃ tadā ||21 ||
samāyayau namaskāraṃ cakre prāha tataḥ param |
mama saudhe samāyāntu sarve vai gītikovidāḥ ||22||
kauśiko’pi samāyātu mamaiva mahadālayai |
mama gītiṃ prakurvantu kauśikādyā mamālaye ||23 ||
śṛṇvantu kā prajāścāpi mama sarvāḥ sugītikāḥ |
pāritoṣikavaryāṇi dāsyāmi vetanānyapi ||24||
svarṇahīrakaraupyāṇi pañcaguṇāni vo’dhikam |
tacchrutvā kauśikaḥ prāha kaliṅgaṃ bhūbhṛtaṃ śanaiḥ ||25||
na jihvā me mahārāja vāṇī me’pi na me manaḥ |
hareranyadapīndraṃ vā stauti naiva ca vakṣyati ||26||
anye ca kauśikasyāpi śiṣyāḥ sarve tathāvadan |
vaśiṣṭho gautamaścāpi hariḥ sārasvatastathā ||27||
citraśca citramālyaśca śiśuścocustathaiva te |
na vayaṃ bhagavadbhinnaṃ naraṃ vā devatādikam ||28||
gāyāmo nāpi gāsyāmo vayamekāntino hareḥ |
atha ye śrāvakāścāsan vaiṣṇavāste’pi vai tathā ||29||
pārthivaṃ jagadustatra rājan vayaṃ hi vaiṣṇavāḥ |
dehendriyamanobuddhyahaṃkārātmaguṇā hi naḥ ||3.58.30||
viṣṇuparā nānyaparā vaiṣṇavasyāpi sevinaḥ |
avaiṣṇavasya saṃgaṃ na kurvanti vibhramādapi ||3 1||
viṣṇorvaiṣṇavabhaktasya śṛṇvanti caritāni vai |
śrotrāṇīmāni rājendra tadanyasya na karhicit ||32||
gānakīrtiṃ vayaṃ hareḥ śṛṇumo’nyāṃ na ca stutim |
anyaiḥ saha vyavahāramātraṃ vacma iva tvayā ||33||
na spṛśāmo vaiṣṇavānyaṃ jalaṃ sthalaṃ jaḍaṃ citam |
na vadāmo vaiṣṇavānyaṃ paśyāmo nāpyavaiṣṇavam || 34||
jalānnādi na gṛhṇīmo vaiṣṇavānyasya vai kvacit |
yadi prāptaṃ bhavet syāttad bhuñjāmo vaiṣṇavārpitam ||35||
tacchrutvā pārthivo ruṣṭastvete mamāvamānakāḥ |
prasahya gāpanīyā vai gāyantāmiti cābravīt ||36||
mama bhṛtyān mama kīrti śrāvayantu hi kovidāḥ |
ityājñāṃ vai samākarṇya vaiṣṇavāste dṛḍhavratāḥ ||37||
naiva jagustadā rājā bhṛtyānājñāpayannijān |
gātuṃ nijayaśo bhṛtyā ārebhire nṛpājñayā ||38||
nṛpaścaiva yaśo gātuṃ tadā te vaiṣṇavādayaḥ |
aṅgulyādibhireva drāk śrotrāṇi pidadhustadā ||39||
tato rājā susaṃkruddhaḥ svadeśāt tān vivāsayat |
gāyakāstaṃ parityajya yayurvai diśamuttarām ||3.58.40||
gāyantaḥ śrīharernāma śṛṇvantaḥ parameśvaram |
śrāvayantaśca te nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hi mānuṣān ||41||
himālayaṃ yayuḥ śaitye kāladharmaṃ tato gatāḥ |
viṣṇuḥ prāha samāgatya samāgacchantu māmanu ||42||
bhavanto mama bhaktā hi madarthaṃ tyaktajīvanāḥ |
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuranayattān divaṃ param ||43||
devādyaiḥ pūjitāste ca pitṛbhiścābhivanditāḥ |
brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ śīghraṃ muhūrtenaiva te dvijāḥ ||44||
kauśikādīṃstato dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
pratyudgamya yathāyogyaṃ svāgatenābhyapūjayat ||45||
tato viṣṇurhi bhagavān samādāya nijāśritān |
viṣṇulokaṃ yayau śīghraṃ vāsudevaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||46||
vaikuṇṭhe tatra vai viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
muktaiḥ siddhairviṣṇubhaktaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ ||47||
nārāyaṇasamairdivyaiścaturbāhudharaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
viṣṇucihnasamāpannairdīpyamānairakalmaṣaiḥ ||48||
sanakādyairnāradādyairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ |
virājate sevyamānaḥ sahasradvārasaṃvṛte ||49||
sahasrayojanāyāme divye maṇimaye śubhe |
vimāne vimale citre gajapīṭhāsane hariḥ ||3.58.50 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
kauśikādīn vilokyātha harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||51 ||
ekarūpo hyabhavacca divyagajāsanasthitaḥ |
kauśiketyāha samprītyā svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐stathā ||52|||
jayaghoṣo hi bhaktānāṃ tadāsīd dhāmagarjanaḥ |
bhagavānāha bhaktā me vaikuṇṭhe saṃvasantviti ||53||
matkīrtiśravaṇe yuktā gītitattvārthakovidāḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitārthakīrtanagāyinaḥ ||54||
ananyadevatā bhaktā matsamīpe vasantviti |
mama dhāmni bhavantvatra pārṣadā mama śāśvatāḥ ||55||
kauśiko mālavaścāpi mālavī padmanetrakaḥ |
tathānye gāyakāḥ sarve mama gāyanasevinaḥ ||56||
mayaiva saha nityaṃ vai gāyantu ca vasantu ca |
kauśiko gāyanaṃ me vai karotu vādyasaṃyutam ||57||
mālavo’yaṃ dīpamālāṃ karotu saha bhāryayā |
padmākṣo’yaṃ dhaneśo me bhavatvevānnasampradaḥ ||58||
mama sānnidhyamāptā vai sarve vai lokapūjitāḥ |
athaivaṃ vadati viṣṇau kṣaṇe tatra samāgatāḥ ||59||
vipañcīguṇatattvajñā vādyavidyāviśāradā |
mandaṃ mandasmitā devī madhurākṣarapeśalā ||3.58.60||
śṛṃgāritā gāyamānā lakṣmīrviṣṇuparigrahā |
vṛtā sahasrakoṭisvāṃganābhirvai samantataḥ ||61 ||
tatra smṛtā mahāsādhvī sarasvatī tu śārṅgiṇā |
samāyātā savādyā ca sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanā ||62|||
rādhā ramā ca kamalā māṇikī śrīḥ satī tathā |
padmāvatī ca haṃsī ca maṃjulī sadguṇā tathā ||63||
āyayustatra vai devyo gaṃgā durgā savādyakāḥ |
sāvitrī virajā cāpsaraso nārāyaṇasmṛtāḥ ||64||
urvaśyādyāstadā gītinṛtyalīlāviśāradāḥ |
menakā sahajanyā ca parṇinī puñjikasthalī ||65||
kṛtasthalī ghṛtācī ca viśvācī pūrvacittikā |
anumlocā ca pramlocā manuvaṃtī sukeśikā ||66||
arūpā subhagā bhāsī haṃsā sūtā sarovatī |
kāmalī hyabhayā haṃsapādī ca sumukhī dayā ||67||
anapāyāruṇā varāṃbarā ca vimanuṣyikā |
asiparṇā miśrakeśī śucikālambuṣā ramā || 68||
mārīciścādrikā vidyutparṇā tilottamā jayā |
kṣemā raṃbhā lakṣmaṇā cāsitā manobhavāmbikā ||69||
subāhvī supriyā puṇḍarīkā ca surasā prabhā |
ajagandhā sudatī ca subhujā śāntikā himā ||3.58.70||
muktā devī ca haimī ca puṣpā campā savitrikā |
āyayuścāpi gandharvāḥ smṛtā nārāyaṇena vai |
nāradaḥ parvataścāpi viśvāvasurvareṇyakaḥ ||71||
vasuruciḥ suruciśca varuthaścāpi dāruṇaḥ |
haṃso jyotiṣṭamo madhya ācārastumburustathā ||72||
subāhuśca hahā hūhūḥ parjanyaśca kalistathā |
śāliśirāścitraratho bhīmaśca prayutastathā ||73||
arkaparṇaḥ parṇavān sūryavarcā dhṛtarāṣṭrakaḥ |
gomān suparṇo varuṇaścograsenaśca bhīmakaḥ ||74||
ete cānye’pi vādyādyairanvitāstatra cāyayuḥ |
tumburustatra gandharvaścājñapto mama sannidhau ||75||
lakṣmi tvāṃ gāyikāṃ paśyan neme tvāṃ māṃ tataḥ param |
tatrāsīno yathāyogaṃ nānāmūrchāsamanvitam ||76||
jagau kalapadaṃ hṛṣṭo vipañcīṃ cābhyavādayat |
śreṣṭhaṃ gānaṃ pragāyaiva prasāditaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||77||
dadau ratnāni divyānyābharaṇānyambarāṇi ca |
tumburave hyamūlyāni hṛṣṭaśca tumburustataḥ ||78||||
praśaṃsitaḥ sa hariṇā tumburustatra cāgragaḥ |
anye jaguśca gandharvā bahavastadyathābalam ||79||
yathājñānaṃ yathābhyāsaṃ jagurvādyasvarādibhiḥ |
lebhire te’pi vai tatra pāritoṣikamuttamam ||3.58.80||
tathāpi tumburutulyaṃ na tadvai pāritoṣikam |
apsarasastataḥ sarvāḥ prajagurvādyasādhanāḥ ||8 1||
lakṣmīrjagau tathādevī sarasvatī jagau tataḥ |
uttamaṃ te labdhavatyau pāritoṣikamityapi ||82||
urvaśī prajagau ramyaṃ sarvarañjanakārakam |
anyāścāpi yathāśakti jagurnṛtyasamanvitāḥ ||83||
bhagavān śrīhariścāhaṃ prasannaścābhavaṃ tadā |
dattavān hīrakaratnāmbarabhūṣāsumālikāḥ ||84||
sarve sarvāśca santuṣṭāstato vai nārado jagau |
dattavām̐ścottamaṃ tasmai pāritoṣikamityapi || 85||
manāṅnyūnaṃ tumburostu tena tuṣṭo na nāradaḥ |
gāyane’pi na sampūrṇo yatastāpamavāptavān || 86 | |
cintāmāpedivām̐statra śokākulāntaro’bhavat |
kadāhaṃ gāyanaṃ kṛtvā sarvottamottamottamam | |87 | |
lapsye hareḥ sakāśādvai pāritoṣikamuttamam |
śreṣṭhaṃ tumburuṇā prāptaṃ dhiṅmāṃ mūḍhaṃ vicetasam || 88 ||
iti sañcintayan viprastapa āsthitavān muniḥ |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu nāradaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran | |8 9 ||
tato gītiṃ kalāṃ sarvāṃ tumburorapyavāgamat |
jñātvā sarvaṃ tumburośca jagau nārāyaṇaṃ prati || 3.58.90 ||
bahumanvantare kāle prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
harirnārāyaṇo devastasmai sarvaṃ dadau śubham || 91 | |
pāritoṣikamutkṛṣṭaṃ samaṃ cakre ca tumburoḥ |
evaṃ śrībhagavaddāsī vadhūrnārāyaṇasya vai || 92||
lakṣmīryathā harerarthe sarvārpaṇaṃ cakāra ha |
yathā ca tumburuścāpi nāradaśca yathāpi ca || 93 | |
yathā ca kauśiko vipro yathā padmākṣako dvijaḥ |
yathā ca mālavī patnī mālavaśca patistathā || 94||
yathānye gāyakā viprāḥ kṛtavanto’rpaṇaṃ harau |
tathā sarvārpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ parameśe janārdane || 95 ||
iṃdriyāṇāṃ vṛttayaśca vyāpārāśca kriyāstathā |
madarthameva kartavyāstena tuṣyāmi sarvadā || 96 ||
darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ gāyanādikam |
nṛtyaṃ hāsyaṃ madarthaṃ vai bhaktyā kartavyameva ha || 97 ||
madbhaktebhyaḥ pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ vāri cāmbaram |
gṛhaṃ śayyāsanaṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ vāṭikā sthalam || 98 ||
yathāśakti pradātavyaṃ jāyate toṣaṇāya me |
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ tacca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 99 ||
lakṣmi saṃśravaṇāccāpi mananācchrāvaṇādapi |
phalaṃ nāradatulyaṃ vai prāpyeta nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.58.100 ||
lakṣmītulyaṃ phalaṃ nārī vadhūḥ sarasvatīsamam |
janā gāyakatulyaṃ ca vindeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ kauśikādigāyakadṛṣṭāntena vaiṣṇavottamatvanirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||

<3.59>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
nārāyaṇa hare kānta śrīpate parameśvara |
nāradaḥ kena yogena gānavidyāṃ hi labdhavān || 1 ||
tumburośca samānatvaṃ kadā kāle upeyivān |
pūrvakalpakathāṃ caitāṃ vada me śrīnarāyaṇa || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vistarāttāṃ kathāṃ śubhām |
nāradastata ārabhya vaikuṇṭhācca viniryayau || 3 ||
nirucchrāsena vimanāstumburorgauravaṃ smaran |
tatāpa varṣasāhasraṃ taporāśistato’bhavat || 4 ||
tadāntarīkṣe śuśrāva bhāratīmaśarīriṇīm |
kimarthaṃ nārada caitattapastapasi duścaram || 5 ||
ulūkaṃ paśya gatvā tvaṃ yadi gāne ratā matiḥ |
mānasottaraśaile vai gānabandhuritiśrutam || 6 ||
gaccha śīghraṃ prapaśyainaṃ gānavit tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
ityukto nāradaḥ śīghraṃ gānabandhuṃ jagāma ha || 7 ||
kāmarūpadharaḥ pakṣī kāmasvaro’tidaivataḥ |
śikṣayati sma gānaṃ ca pakṣiṇo dehino’pi ca || 8 ||
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣāstathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
samāsīnāstu parito gānabandhuṃ tadābhavan || 9 ||
gānavidyāṃ samāpannāḥ śikṣitāstena pakṣiṇā |
snigdhakaṇṭhasvarāstatra gāyanti sma kramāttadā || 3.59.1 0||
muniṃ nāradamālokya gānabandhuruvāca ha |
namaste muniśārdūla svāgataṃ te’bhivandanam || 11 ||
kimartha bhagavām̐ścātra kṛpayā vā yadṛcchayā |
dātuṃ vā darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ vada kiṃ karavāṇi te || 12||
nāradastaṃ tadā prāha śṛṇūlūka yathātatham |
mahādbhutaṃ mama vṛttaṃ purā jātaṃ vadāmi te || 13||
atīte kalpake tatrātīte yuge tvahaṃ hareḥ |
sannidhāvagamam̐statra gānaṃ kartuṃ samutsukaḥ || 14||
lakṣmīsamanvito viṣṇuḥ samāhūya ca tumburum |
māṃ vinirdhūya saṃhṛṣṭo hyaśṛṇod gānamuttamam || 15||
tenāhamatiduḥkhārtastapastaptuṃ gato’bhavam |
viṣṇormāhātmyayuktasya gānayogasya vaibhavam || 16||
sañcintyāhaṃ tapo ghoraṃ taptavān vai tataḥ param |
divyavarṣasahasrānte tvāmuddiśyāmbarīṃ giram || 17||
aśṛṇavaṃ gānabandhvabhidhaṃ yāhi matiryadi |
gāne ced vartate tarhi hyulūkaṃ paśya mā ciram || 1 8||
ityahaṃ preritaścātra tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ |
śiṣyaṃ māṃ tvaṃ tato matvā praśikṣaya prapālaya || 19 ||
śrutvaivaṃ gānabandhuśca nāradaṃ prāha kovidaḥ |
atyāścaryamayīṃ gāthāṃ viṣṇubhaktyāśrayāṃ śubhām || 3.59.20 ||
bhuvaneśaitikhyāto rājābhūt pūrvakalpake |
aśvamedhasahasraiśca vājapeyāyutena ca || 21 ||
gavāṃ koṭyarbudenaiva suvarṇapadmakoṭibhiḥ |
vāsasāṃ rathahastīnāṃ kanyāśvānāṃ parārdhakaiḥ || 22||
dānaṃ datvā hi viprebhyaḥ sādhubhyo’pālayaddharām |
agāpayannijāṃ kīrtiṃ gāyakebhyo’pyaharniśam || 23 ||
ye na gāyanti tān kārāgāre dhṛtvāvarudhyati |
mama gānamakurvāṇo vadhyo me itiśāsanam || 24||
mama gānaṃ prakurvantu striyo narāśca nityaśaḥ |
sūtamāgadhasaṃghāśca gītaṃ kurvantu me muhuḥ || 25||
ityājñapya sa rājā vai rājyaṃ svaṃ paryyapālayat |
tasya nṛpasya sāmrājye harimiśraitiśrutaḥ || 26||
brāhmaṇo viṣṇubhakto’bhūd gītiṃ karoti vai hareḥ |
nadīpulīnamāsādya pratimāṃ śrīhareḥ śubhām ||27||
abhyarcyāpi ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ datvā hyagāyata |
atīva snehasaṃyuktastālavarṇalayānvitam || 28 ||
atha rājñaḥ samādeśakartā cāraḥ samāgataḥ |
ājñāpayāmāsa taṃ ca gātuṃ rājño yaśastadā || 29 ||
vipraśca vaiṣṇavaḥ so’pi nāṅgīcakāra tadvacaḥ |
tataścāro brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ gṛhītvā rājasannidhau || 3.59.30 ||
nītvā nyavedayad rājā bhartsayāmāsa taṃ dvijam |
rājyānniryātayāmāsa hṛtvā sarvaṃ dhanādikam || 31 ||
vipro vanāntare gatvābhajacchrīparameśvaram |
rājā cāyuḥkṣayenaiva kāladharmamupeyivān || 3 2||
yatraloke gatastatra kuṃbhīpāke papāta ha |
kṣudhayā ca tṛṣā vyāptastiraskāraiḥ pratoditaḥ || 33 ||
bhuktvā duḥkhāni bahudhā tataḥ svargamupāgataḥ |
kintu tatra vimāne yatprāptaṃ bhojyaṃ jalāmṛtam || 34||
dṛśyamātraṃ jāyate tallīyate grahaṇakṣaṇe |
naiva peyaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ nṛpadevasya jāyate || 35 ||
tena khinnaḥ śuśocāpi svargatasyāpi me tviha |
kṣuttṛṭpravartate bhojyaṃ peyaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ vilīyate || 36 ||
mayā pāpaṃ kṛta kiṃ yatphalaṃ tvetatprabhujyate |
ityevaṃ cintayānasya vyomavāṇī hyajāyata ||37||
tvayā rājanmahatpātaṃ kṛtamajñānamohataḥ |
harimiśraṃ dvijaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaṃ hi gāyakam || 38||
tava gānamakurvantaṃ dattavān daṇḍamulbaṇam |
tvayā hṛtaṃ dhanaṃ tasya vivāsitaśca rājyataḥ || 39 ||
sakṣudhātṛṭsamaveto vaṇe tapaḥ karoti vai |
bhakto’yaṃ vai hareḥ rājam̐stvayā praduḥkhitaḥ kṛtaḥ ||3.59.40 ||
tena pāpena te rājan bhojyaṃ peyaṃ vilīyate |
dānayajñādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ te prajāyate ||41 ||
gītavādyasamopetaṃ gāyamānaṃ hariśritam |
harimitraṃ subhaktaṃ tvaṃ duḥkhitaṃ cākaroryataḥ |||42|||
naṣṭaste svargaloko’pi gaccha parvatakoṭaram |
dhūlīṃ khādan vasa tatra yāvanmanvantaraṃ bhavet ||43 ||
kardamī nāma kīṭastvaṃ tataḥ kālāntare punaḥ |
pāpabhogaṃ prabhuktvaiva mānuṣyaṃ tvaṃ gamiṣyasi ||44||
ityevaṃ sa ca rājā vai bhraṣṭaḥ svargācca koṭaram |
āyayau kardame jātaḥ kardamī jalabhūsthale ||45||
ulūko’haṃ tatra cāpi jijñāsārthaṃ gato’bhavam |
mayā pṛṣṭaḥ sa vṛttāntaṃ jagāda pūrvapāditam ||46||
bhagavadbhaktadrohasya phalaṃ kardamabhakṣitām |
jagādāpi tataścāhaṃ niryayau tasya gahvarāt || 47||
vyomamārge dṛṣṭvavośca vimānaṃ pārṣadānvitam |
gītiyuktaṃ yatra cāste brāhmaṇo harimitrakaḥ ||48 ||
devaiśca pārṣadaiścāpi stūyamāno vimānake |
viṣṇulokaṃ yayau śrīmān mayā so’pi vilokitaḥ ||49||
harergānasya puṇyaṃ tad vaikuṇṭhaṃ prati sadgatiḥ |
tadaiśvaryaprabhāveṇa mano me samupāgatam || 3.59.50 ||
gānavidyāṃ prati tataḥ kinnaraiḥ samupāviśam |
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ gānayogena me tataḥ ||5 1 ||
jihvā vaiśadyamāpannā tato gānamaśikṣayam |
tato’pi bahukālena gānaṃ cāśikṣayaṃ muhuḥ | |52||
gānayogasamāyuktā gatā manvantarā daśa |
gānācāryo’bhavaṃ pūrve gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām ||53 ||
kinnarāṇāṃ gāyakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ narayoṣitām |
apsarasāṃ tathācāryaścābhavaṃ pūrvakalpake ||54||
gāyakānāṃ tadā saṃghā māmācāryamupāgatāḥ |
ye tvidānīṃ nāradātra vartante samupasthitāḥ ||55||
te tu śiṣyapraśiṣyāṇāṃ śākhāsahasrayoginaḥ |
vaṃśavaṃśānuvaṃśyāśca vartante mama śiṣyakāḥ ||56 ||
tapasā naiva śakyā vai gānavidyā hi nārada |
tasmācchrutena sampanno mattastvaṃ gānamāpnuhi ||57||
ityukto nārado lakṣmi praṇipatya namasya mām |
śikṣākrameṇa colūkāt tatra gānamaśikṣata ||58||
kathāyāṃ strīsahasaṃge gīte dyūte ca bhojane |
vyavahāre dravyalābhe cāye vyaye nijārthake ||59||
tyaktalajjo jano yāti jayaṃ lajjāyuto na vai |
na kuṃcitena gūḍhena vastraprāvaraṇādibhiḥ ||3.59.6 0||
hastavikṣepabhāvena vyāditāsyena caiva ha |
niryātajihvāyogena na geyaṃ hi kathaṃcana ||61||
na gāyedūrdhvabāhutve nordhvadṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃcana |
svāṃgaṃ nirīkṣamāṇena paraṃ samprekṣatā tathā ||62||
saṃghaṭṭe ca tathotthāne kaṭisthāne na śasyate |
hrāso roṣastathā kampastathānyatra smṛtiḥ punaḥ ||63||
naitāni śastarūpāṇi gānayoge mahāmate |
naikahastena śakyaṃ syāt tālasaṃghaṭanaṃ mune ||64||
kṣudhārtena bhayārtena tṛṣārtena tathaiva ca |
gānayogo na kartavyo nāndhakāre kathañcana ||65||
evamādīni cānyāni pramādālasyakāni ca |
na kartavyāni vai raṃge gāyatā ca vijānatā ||66||
evaṃ śikṣāṃ samagṛhya vidhinā nārado muniḥ |
aśikṣata tathā gītaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam |67||
tataḥ samastasampanno gītaprastarakādiṣu |
vipañcyādiṣu sampannaḥ sarvasvaravibhāgavit ||68||
ayutāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśat sahasrāṇi śatāni ca |
svarāṇāṃ bhedayogena jñātavān munisattamaḥ ||69||
tato gandharvasaṃghāśca kinnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
munināṃ saha saṃyuktāḥ prītiyuktāstato’bhavan ||3.59.70||
gānabandhuṃ muniḥ prāha prāpya gānamanuttamam |
tvāṃ samāsādya sampannastvaṃ hi gītiviśāradaḥ ||71 ||
guro tava prapūjāyāṃ kimācārya karomi te |
gānabandhustataḥ prāha brahmaṇo divase khalu ||72||
naśyanti manavastatra caturdaśa tathā tvaham |
jīvāmīti varaṃ dehi dakṣiṇāṃ hi mamepsitām ||73||
tāvanme tvāyuṣo bhāvastāvanme paramaṃ śubham |
manasā vāñchitaṃ me syād dakṣiṇā nāradātra vai ||74||
nāradastaṃ tadā prāha bhavatvevaṃ tato’pi ca |
kalpāntare bhavāneva garuḍaśca bhaviṣyati ||75||
svasti te’stu mahāprājña bhagavadvāhanaḥ śubhaḥ |
gamiṣyāmi namaste’stvityuktvā śrīnārado yayau ||76||
nārāyaṇasya vaikuṇṭhaṃ lakṣmi yatra vasāmyaham |
mamāgre gāyanaṃ cakre bahudhaiva sugītikam ||77||
tacchrutvāhamavocaṃ taṃ gānāsampannameva ha |
tumburorna viśiṣṭo’si gītairadyāpi nārada ||78||
gānabandhuṃ samāsādya gānārthajño bhavān nanu |
yadā viśiṣṭo bhavitā tadā tuṣṭo’pi mādhavaḥ ||79||
bhaviṣyāmi kṣitau bhāvye mānave cāvatāriṇi |
tadānīṃ māṃ samāsādya kārayethā yathātatham ||3.59.80||
tadā tvāṃ gītasampannaṃ kariṣyāmi mahāvratam |
tumburośca samaṃ cāpi tathātiśayasaṃyutam ||81 ||
tāvatkālaṃ yathāyogaṃ devagandharvayoniṣu |
śikṣasva tvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ svasti te’stu surāṣṭrake ||82||
śrutvā nārāyaṇavākyaṃ praṇamya nārado harim |
skandhe vipañcīmāsādya sarvalokān cacāra ha ||83||
vāruṇaṃ yāmyamāgneyamaindraṃ kauberamityapi |
vāyavyaṃ ca tathaiśānaṃ sadaḥ saṃprāpya nāradaḥ ||84||
gāyamāno hariṃ samyag vīṇāvādanadakṣakaḥ |
gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghaiḥ pūjyamānastatastataḥ ||85||
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya rātriṃ nināya kālpikīm |
prātaḥ punaścātra kalpe brahmaloke’jamandire ||86||
hāhāhūhūśca gandharvau gītavādyaviśāradau |
brahmaṇo gāyakau divyau nityagāyanatatparau ||87||
tatra tābhyāṃ samāsādya gāyamāno hariṃ prabhum |
gṛhītapāritoṣaśca praṇamya ca pitāmaham ||88||
cacāra sa yathākāmaṃ prayayau tumburorgṛham |
vīṇāmādāya tatrastho hyagāyatāpyaśikṣata ||89||
svarakalpāstu tatrasthāḥ ṣaḍjādyāḥ sapta ye matāḥ |
tānsamagrām̐stumburorvai nāradaḥ samaśikṣata ||3.59.90||
saptasvarāṃganāścāpi nāradaḥ samaśikṣata |
kintu gāyanakāle vai vīṇāyoge hi cāṃganāḥ ||91||
tantryaḥ prapedire naiva yathāyogyodbhavāni vai |
tato’śvapaṭṭasarasi lomaśasyāśrame punaḥ ||92||
gānaṃ cakārāniṣpannaṃ tadāhaṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
avadaṃ tvāṃ priyāṃ nityadivyarūpāṃ hi padmaje ||93||
sarasvatīṃ cāvadaṃ ca śikṣayasva hi nāradam |
viṇāgānasamāyoge tathetyuktvā tataḥ param ||94||
samprahāsā śikṣayāmāsitha lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī |
tato brahmapriyāṇāṃ vai sannidhau gānamācarat ||95||
ukto’sau gāyamāno’pi na svaraṃ vetsi vai mune |
tataḥ svarāṃganāḥ prāpya tantrīyogaṃ ca nāradam ||96||
āhūyāhaṃ gānayogamaśikṣayaṃ tvanuttamam |
tato’tiśayamāpannastumburormunisattamaḥ ||97||
tato nanarta gātvaiva praṇipatya ca māṃ muhuḥ |
mayokto nāradastatra sarvajño’si mamāntikaṃ ||98||
gāyasva jñānayogena jagau cāpi sa nāradaḥ |
tuṣṭo’haṃ nityasānnidhyaṃ dattavānatra cākṣare ||99||
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sa vartate nārado muniḥ |
prāpyottamaṃ pāritoṣikaṃ prasannena cārpitam || 3.59.10 0||
mayaiva tumburoścāpi śreṣṭhatvaṃ cāpi cārpitam |
atha kālāntare kṛṣṇagṛhe gāsyati nāradaḥ || 101 ||
eṣa vo brahmapatnyo’tra prokto gītikramo muneḥ |
gātā krameṇa cānena mama sālokyamāpnuyāt || 1 02||
karmaṇā manasā vācā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
gāyan śṛṇvan māmupaiti tadvai geyaṃ paraṃ matam || 1 03||
ulūko’pi garuḍo’yaṃ vartate’śvasarovare |
gānabandhurmahābhāgaḥ pārṣado gānakṛnmama || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śreṣṭhabhaktadṛṣṭānte vadhūgītāyāṃ nāradasya gānaśikṣārjanagaruḍākhyānanirūpaṇanāmā navapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||

<3.60>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
vaiṣṇavā iti ye proktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
bhāgavatāḥ sāttvatā ye sarvasvātmanivedinaḥ || 1 ||
kāni cihnāni teṣāṃ vai tāsāṃ ca brūhi me prabho |
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ ca bhagavān kiṃ karoṣi hare vibho || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mama bhaktasvarūpiṇīm |
premakathāṃ pāvanīṃ me tādātmyabhāvadhāriṇīm || 3 ||
yatrāste prama bhaktastu tatrāha sarvadā sthitaḥ |
ahameva sadā teṣāṃ tāsāṃ paramadevatā || 4 ||
kīrtyamāne harau nityaṃ romāñco jāyate muhuḥ |
kampaḥ svedastathākṣeṣu dṛśyante jalabindavaḥ || 5 ||
mama bhaktiparānpuṃso nārīrvā vīkṣya vai drutam |
prītirbhavati cāntargā yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 ||
nānyadācchādayed vastraṃ nānyādhīnā bhavet satī |
vaiṣṇavaṃ sāttvataṃ dṛṣṭvā premṇā sammukhasaṃsthitā || 7 ||
praṇāmādi karotyeva śrīkṛṣṇe ve yathā mayi |
bhaktaṃ bhaktāṃ ca vā vīkṣya bhakto bhaktā named drutam || 8 ||
madātmā mama bhaktaḥ sa bhaktā ca bhāminī mama |
jayaṃ labhate trailokye sarvadhāmasu sṛṣṭiṣu || 9 ||
vinā lajjāṃ bhajate māṃ nirākṛtya durītakān |
datte sarvaṃ madarthaṃ vai vaiṣṇavaḥ saḥ sā vaiṣṇavī || 3.60.1 0||
rūkṣākṣarāṇi vai śṛṇvan bhakteritāni vai kvacit |
pramodaṃ labhate tatra na roṣaṃ prakaroti hi ||1 1 ||
praṇāmapūrvakaṃ kṣāntyā gṛhṇīyād guṇameva tu |
vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavī saiva divyadṛṣṭiyutā satī || 1 2||
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ śirasā yā hi dhārayet |
hareḥ sarvamitītyevaṃ matveyaṃ vaiṣṇavī hi sā || 13||
mama kṣetre śubhāneva karoti tu divāniśam |
māṃ sato mama bhaktām̐śca sevate snehasaṃyutaḥ || 14||
pratimāṃ pūjayennityaṃ mama sarvopacārakaiḥ |
karmaṇā manasā vācā sa sā bhaktottamā matā || 15||
roge kaṣṭe’thavāpattau vighne codvejane tathā |
mānatāṃ mama sevāyāḥ satsaṃgasya tathā satām || 16 ||
mandirasya ca sādhūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktayoṣitām |
gurūṇāṃ cāpi sevāyāḥ kuryāt daharniśaṃ ca yaḥ || 17||
brahmapriyāṇāṃ sevāyāstathā kṣetrasya vai śubhām |
annavastrajalādānavastrakṣālanakātmikām || 18||
lepanakṣālanasaṃskāraṇamārjanakātmikām |
pātramajjanarūpāṃ ca gomahiṣīprasevanām || 1 9||
āgantvatithisevāṃ ca sevāṃ bhojanapānadām |
pādasaṃvāhanasevāṃ cāṃgamardanarūpiṇīm ||3.60.20 ||
oṣadhādipradānāṃ ca kāṣṭhāharaṇarūpiṇīm |
yathāśakti yathāyogyāṃ jātyavasthānurūpiṇīm ||21 ||
sevāṃ bhṛtyakriyāṃ dāsīdāsakriyāṃ suśobhanām |
mānatāṃ yaśca yā kuryāt kuryāttathaiva bhṛtyatām ||22||
nārāyaṇaparaṃ yasya yasyāḥ sarvasvameva tu |
satāṃ parāyaṇaṃ yasya yasyāḥ sarvasvameva ca ||23||
dharmārthaṃ cāpi mokṣārthaṃ yayoḥ sarvasvameva ca |
nārāyaṇaparāvetau mahābhāgavatau hi tau ||24||
bhojanārādhanaṃ sarvaṃ yathāśakti karoti yaḥ |
viṣṇubhaktasya vai nityaṃ sa vai bhāgavatottamaḥ ||25||
nārāyaṇaparo bhakto’śnāti yadannameva tat |
harerāsyaṃ samaśnāti tṛpyatyeva hariḥ svayam || 26||
viṣṇubhaktān pūjayed yo bhaktyā vai viṣṇuvannaraḥ |
nārī vā viṣṇusāmīpyaṃ yāti muktiṃ hi śāśvatīm ||27||
anyabhaktasahasrebhyo viṣṇubhakto viśiṣyate |
viṣṇubhaktasahasrebhyo harerbhakto viśiṣyate || 28||
harerbhakto brahmarūpaḥ pareśadhāmago bhavet |
avatārisvarūpasya mamaiva bhaktarāṭ hi saḥ ||29||
atraiva jīvamānāyā muktāyāḥ khalu rakṣaṇam |
karomyahaṃ sadā lakṣmi śṛṇu bhaktākathāṃ parām || 3.60.30||
cidambarābhavad rājñī samrājñī jiṣṇubhūbhṛtaḥ |
saurāṣṭre godale deśe mama bhaktiparāyaṇā ||3 1||
jiṣṇuśaktirhi nidhanaṃ prāpto bhaktyā mamālayam |
yayāvakṣarasaṃjñaṃ ca rājñī rājyamakārayat ||32||
bhaktā brahmaparā devītulyā śaucasamanvitā |
prātarutthāya māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam || 33 ||
parameśaṃ cākṣareśaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
arcayāmāsa satataṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ ||34||
bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ vāridānaṃ puṣpasrajarpaṇam |
gandhādipeṣaṇaṃ cāpi dhūpadravyaprasādhanam ||35||
bhūmerālepanaṃ cāpi haviṣāṃ pācanaṃ tathā |
bhaktikautukasarvasvā svayameva cakāra sā ||36||
śubhā cidambarā nityaṃ vācā nārāyaṇeti ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti bhāṣate muhuḥ || 37||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatparā cāntarātmanā |
arcayāmāsa māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sadā ||38||
viṣṇubhaktānaparām̐śca mahābhāgavatān śubhān |
dānamānārcanairnityaṃ dhanaiḥ ratnairatoṣayat || 39 ||
tataḥ kadācit sā rājñī suṣvāpa pūjanottaram |
dvādaśyāṃ ca niśānte tāṃ pratyakṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||3.60.40||
ahameva svayaṃ lakṣmi sarvaśobhānvito’bhavam |
tayā svapnakṛtāṃ pūjāmaṅgīcakāra sarvaśaḥ ||41 ||
mayā dattāni cihnāni mālāṃ kaṇṭhe hi taulasīm |
bhāle satilakaścandraḥ kauṃkumaḥ śobhanastathā ||42||
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ cāpi karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale tathā |
kaṇṭhe kamalamālāṃ ca bāhvorāyudhalekhikāḥ ||43 ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmarekhāḥ satilakāstathā |
ahaṃ tato’bhavaṃ lakṣmi cādṛśyastatkṣaṇāddhi sā ||44||
unnidrā hyabhavattūrṇa dadarśāṅkitavigrahām |
āścaryaṃ mahadāpannābhavat pramodasaṃbhṛtā | |45 ||
mahābhāgavatī jātā mahāsāttvatikā tathā |
madarthakṛtasarvasvā madartharājyavaibhavā ||46 ||
madarthārpaṇasarvasvā bheje tato hi māṃ satī |
mahāvairāgyamūrtiḥ sā parameśaparāyaṇā || 47||
brahmacaryaparā nityaṃ satsaṃgatiparāyaṇā |
tyaktaviṣayarāgā ca sādhvīvad vartate sadā ||48 ||
ātmanivedinī dāsī kiṃkarīva hi vartate |
atha kālāntare cāhaṃ parīkṣitumupāyayau | |49 ||
airāvatamivācintyaṃ kṛtvā vai garuḍaṃ nijam |
svayaṃ śakro’bhavaṃ cāpi rājñīsaudhamupāgataḥ || 3.60.50 ||
indro’hamasmi bhadraṃ te kiṃ dadāmi varaṃ ca te |
sarvasvargeśvaraścāhaṃ dātuṃ tvāṃ svargamāgataḥ | |5 1 ||
gṛhāṇa nākaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vā māhendraṃ padamuttamam |
te dāsī bhavatu dyauśca bhūśca dāsī sadā tava ||52 ||
gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ subhage vaidhavyaṃ vipravāsaya |
gṛhāṇa śreṣṭhaṃ saubhāgyaṃ manvantarasamaṃ śubham ||53 ||
mā dehaṃ kṣapayerdivyaṃ bhogayogyaṃ sukomalam |
yadṛcchayāgataṃ prāpya sukhinī bhava bhāminī ||54||
vinā kāntaṃ sadā rūkṣaṃ jagad dagdhaṃ hi yoṣitām |
tasmāt kāntaṃ sukāntaṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa puṇyaśālinī ||55 ||
śrutvā cidambarovāca namasyāmīndrayogine |
devatāyai namo me’stu mā doṣaṃ paśya devate ||56 ||
deho’yaṃ mānavaścāste devatā taijasī sadā |
aindrapadasya hantrī ca mānavīyonirulbaṇā ||57 | |
mā manuṣye puṇyahāre manaḥ kṛthāḥ surottama |
mā tathā macchāpadagdho bhava kṣamāṃ vidhehi mām |||58 ||
pūjāṃ prāpya namo labdhvā prayāhi tvaṃ sureśvara |
rājasyo devatā pūyaṃ strīvanto vai svabhāvajāḥ ||59 | |
strīkāmāstatra nāścaryaṃ kintu me tanna rocate |
nāhaṃ tvāmabhisandhāya rājyaṃ karomi bhūtale || 3.60.6 0||
tvayā dattaṃ ca neṣyami yāhi cendra nijālayam |
mama nārāyaṇo nāthastaṃ kāntaṃ prabhajāmi hi || 61 ||
gacchendra mā kṛthāstvatra mama buddhivilopanam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmyaham ||62|
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavānindro vivṛtya cendrarūpatām |
śārṅgacakragadāpadmapāṇirūpo’bhavat svayam ||63 ||
garuḍopari lakṣmīśrīsahito’haṃ hariḥ prabhuḥ |
pratyakṣatāṃ gatastasyāḥ sā tuṣṭāva nanāma mām ||64||
prasīda devadeveśeśvareśvareśvareśvara |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||65||
tvamanādiḥ patirnāthaḥ svāmī kāntaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
aprameyo vibhurviṣṇurgovindaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ ||66 ||
brahmapriyāpatirharipriyāpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ |
tvāṃ prapannāsmi govinda godaleśa priya prabho ||67||
tvāṃ vinā kāṃkṣaye naiva rājyaṃ svargaṃ sukhaṃ param |
nānyā gatistvadanyā me tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama ||68||
satyendrastvaṃ mahendratvaṃ cātmendrastvaṃ pareśvara |
mama sarvendriyāṇāṃ tvāṃ yayārthendraṃ bhajāmi hi ||69||
namāmi prāṇanāthaṃ tvāṃ namāmi cāntarasthitam |
namāmi sukhaśayyāsthaṃ turyapadasuyoginam ||3.60.70||
śrutvā stutimavocaṃ tāṃ kiṃ te hṛdi cikīrṣitam |
tatsarvaṃ te pradāsyāmi vada bhaktāsi me parā ||71 ||
bhaktipriyo’haṃ satataṃ yadicchasi dadāmi tat |
śrutvā cidambarā prāha nityaṃ me mānasaṃ ca hṛt ||72|||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntaparāyaṇam |
vartatāṃ mayi nāthastvaṃ kāntākānto hṛdi sthitaḥ ||73||
yathā hare bhavānāste sarvāntarātmavit prabhuḥ |
tathā bhavāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇa tvadāntarātmabhūyasī ||74||
kṛpayā te yāvadasti pālayiṣyāmi medinīm |
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kratuṃ kṛtvā tarpayiṣyāmi devatāḥ ||75||
vaiṣṇavān pālayiṣyāmi bhavān vasatu me gṛhe |
mama kānto bhavānāste sadā rakṣākaro bhava ||76||
yadvā dhāma nijaṃ nītvā māṃ lakṣmīmaparāṃ kuru |
yatheṣṭaṃ cara gopāla ramāpāla cidaṃ prati ||77||
cidambaroktaṃ śrutvaiva mayā lakṣmi gadā mama |
sarvasaṃhāratejobhiryuktā tasyai samarpitā ||78||
rājyarakṣākarī śatrunāśinī pārśvayāyinī |
sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gadānāṃ yatsvarūpataḥ ||79||
jāyante raṇakāle vai śāparogārināśikāḥ |
tāṃ datvāhaṃ mama sthānaṃ samāyayau kṛpāmayaḥ ||3.60.80|
sāpi pramuditā rāṣṭraṃ godalaṃ pālayatyapi |
sarvavarṇān dharmamārge svasvakarmasvayojayat ||8 1||
gṛhe gṛhe’kārayacca bhaktiṃ śrīpauruṣottamīm |
gṛhe gṛhe haristasthau vedaghoṣo gṛhe gṛhe ||82||
nāmaghoṣo hareścaiva yajñaghoṣaḥ pure pure |
kārayāmāsa yajñām̐śca vaiṣṇavān nṛpanandinī ||83||
cidambarāyāṃ śāstryāṃ ca bhūmirāsīd rasapradā |
satṛṇā rogahīnāśca prajāśca nirupadravāḥ ||84||
durbhikṣādirahitāśca mahotsavotsavāḥ śubhāḥ |
akālamṛtyurnāstyeva vyādhirādhirna vidyate ||886||
evaṃ lakṣmi tayā rājñyā kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hi vaiṣṇavam |
sādhavo rakṣitāścāpi mandireṣu sthale sthale ||86||
santaḥ sampūjitāścāpi vāryambarānnabhojanaiḥ |
satyaḥ sādhvyo rakṣitāśca sevitāḥ satataṃ tayā ||87||
gāvaśca rakṣitāḥ sādhvyāḥ anāthāḥ pālitāstathā |
nityaṃ prātastathā sāyaṃ kāritaṃ bhajanaṃ mama ||88||
maṇḍalyaḥ sthāpitāścāpi bhaktanārījanānvitāḥ |
hare kṛṣṇa hare nārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||89||
hare lakṣmīpate rādhāpate brahmapriyāpate |
evaṃ tayā kāritaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ mama sarvataḥ ||3.60.90||
annasatrāṇi ramyāṇi kāritāni tayā tathā |
jalaprapāḥ kāritāśca vṛkṣacchāyāḥ prakāritāḥ ||9 1 ||
dharmaśālāḥ kāritāśca gośālā kāritāstathā |
vidyālayāḥ kāritāśca brahmavidyālayāstathā ||92||
kṛṣikāryodayāścāpi nadāśca kāritāstayā |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cidambarāsatīkṛtam ||93||
mandiraṃ me śobhate’tra paśya gaganaśṛṃgavat |
nityaṃ prātarhi sā rājñī snātvā sampūjya māṃ tataḥ ||94||
sabhāyāṃ brahmavijñānāṃ samāyāti hi nityaśaḥ |
brahmakathāṃ sadā tatra karoti godalāyanaḥ ||95||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ karoti vācanam |
kīrtanaṃ jāyate paścāt tataścāpi visarjanam ||96||
sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca satsaṃgo jāyate śubhaḥ |
brahmaśīlaparāṇāṃ vai sevā hṛdyā prajāyate ||97||
nityaṃ bhavanti pañcāpi yajñāstasyā hi rāṣṭrake |
ityevaṃ dhyāyamānā māṃ karoti rājyanirvaham ||98||
divyā divyaramātulyā cidambarā haripriyā |
hariṃ patiṃ prabhuṃ prāpya vairāgyavṛttimāśritā ||99||
bhajantāṃ bhagavantaṃ taṃ prāṇeśaṃ parameśvaram |
prayāntu śāśvataṃ dhāma labhantāṃ mudamuttamam || 3.60.10 0||
ityevaṃ sā prajāḥ sarvāḥ śikṣāṃ śrāvayati dhruvām |
dhruvapuṇyaphalāṃ sādhvī divyadehavatī hyabhūt || 10 1||
etādṛśīnāṃ bhaktānāṃ rakṣāṃ karomi sarvadā |
dadāmi pārśvavāsaṃ ca sevāṃ caraṇayostathā || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ mahābhāgavatabhaktacihnāni cidambarārājñyāḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ bhaktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||

<3.61>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktāyā rakṣaṇaṃ tathā |
gadayā ca kṛtaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi cādbhutaṃ mahat || 1 ||
ekadā bhadrako nāma rākṣaso’bdhinivāsakṛt |
śrutvā jñātvā striyā rājyaṃ godalaṃ paścarāṣṭrakam || 2 ||
cidambarāṃ nijāṃ nārīṃ kartumanāḥ sa rākṣasaḥ |
kāmarūpadharo bhūtvā rājanyaśatamohanaḥ || 3 ||
yuvā bhūtvātiramaṇaḥ puṣṭaḥ saundaryarājitaḥ |
klṛptavaiṣṇavatilakaḥ klṛptarākṣasasādhubhiḥ || 4 ||
klṛptaviprajanairyukto yātrāluveṣaśobhitaḥ |
rājasmṛddhiyuto godalākhyaṃ puramupāyayau || 5 ||
kilāsanāyāṃ vāṭyāṃ sa saṃgharūpo hyuvāsa ha |
rājñyā vṛttāntamājñāya rakṣo bhūtvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ || 6 ||
nṛpo yayau rājasaudhaṃ rājñīṃ dadarśa śobhanām |
rājñyā vijñāya rājanyaḥ satkṛtaḥ svāgatādibhiḥ || 7 ||
yayāce sa tato rājñīṃ rājyaṃ cāṅgamohitaḥ |
rājñī nyaṣedhayat tūrṇaṃ gantuṃ rāṣṭrād bahistadā || 8 ||
śīghramājñāpayaccāpi rākṣaso’pi tu vai drutam |
natvā svakān janān nītvā samudraṃ prayayau tataḥ || 9 ||
ekākī tvāgataḥ kālāntare rātrau nṛpīṃ prati |
śayānāṃ tāṃ samuttolya skandhe nināya cāmbare || 3.61.1 0||
prayayau vai drutaṃ rakṣo rājñī connidritā yadā |
dadarśa rākṣasaṃ vyomni svāṃ nayantaṃ satī tadā || 1 1||
sasmāra tāṃ gadāṃ kaumudakīṃ gadā drutaṃ puraḥ |
āgatā ca tato rājñyā tvājñaptā rakṣaṇāya vai || 1 2||
rākṣasaṃ cāpi hantuṃ vai tāvad gadā bhayaṃkarī |
ambare tu samuḍḍīya rakṣaḥskandhe papāta ha || 1 3||
mastake pṛṣṭhabhāge ca bāhvoḥ sakthnośca pādayoḥ |
bhadrakasyāvayaveṣu cotpatyotpatya vai muhuḥ || 14||
jaghāna rākṣasaṃ so’pi pṛthvyāṃ papāta tāḍitaḥ |
mūrchitaścābhavat kilāsanodyānasamīpataḥ || 15||
gadayā sahitā rājño smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram |
saprāṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ tyaktvā nijālayamupāyayau || 16||
rākṣasaḥ prayayau naijaṃ sthānaṃ sāmudramadhyagam |
rājñīrakṣāṃ samākarṇya prajā magnāstadābhavan || 17||
āśīrvādaiḥ prajā rājñīṃ vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
rājñī pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā gadāpūjāṃ cakāra ha || 18||
evaṃ rakṣā kṛtā rājñyā gadayā rākṣasāt tadā |
rākṣaso’pi punaḥ kālāntare cāyāt sasainyakaḥ ||1 9||
āhartuṃ tāṃ nṛpīṃ rājyaṃ naijaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ |
bahubhiḥ sainyabhāgaiḥ saḥ purīmāvṛttya garjanām ||3.61.20||
cakāra vyomamārgeṇa yuddhavādyānyavādayat |
rājñī tuṣṭāva māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gadāṃ pupūja candanaiḥ ||21||
bhojanairhāragandhādyaiḥ rakṣāṃ vavre tataḥ param |
gadotthāya nijasthānādambare sābhavat kṣaṇāt ||22||
koṭisūryāgnisampannā babhūva kṣaṇamātrataḥ |
udvamatsuvahniśikhā sagarjanā muhurmuhuḥ ||23||
rodasī nādayamānā śuśubhe vijayāvahā |
yayau śīghraṃ bhadrakasya sainyaṃ ca bhadrakaṃ prati ||24||
bhadrakaṃ mārayāmāsa mūḍhamāreṇa sā gadā |
tataḥ sainyaṃ gadādevī mārayāmāsa mūḍhavat ||25||
sainyaṃ bhagnaṃ rākṣasānāṃ rākṣaso’pi vimūrchitaḥ |
papāta bhūtale tāvad gadā maunamupasthitā ||26||
rākṣasaḥ prāṇarakṣāṃ ca kṛtvā palāyanaṃ vyadhāt |
sainyaṃ dudrāva śiṣṭaṃ ca jayakāro’bhavat striyāḥ ||27||
sā śāntā ca gadā sthānamāgatya niṣkriyābhavat |
rājñī pupūja vidhinā naivedyādi dadau tathā ||28||
atha kālāntare yāte rākṣasā bahavo’bdhijāḥ |
militvā mantraṇāṃ cakrū rājñīrāṣṭropalabdhaye ||29||
astraśastravidaścānye māyāmantravido’pare |
antardhānavidaścāpi bahurūpavidastathā ||3.61.3 0||
siddhimanto rākṣasāśca rākṣasyo’pi sahasraśaḥ |
yuddhasāmagrikāyuktāścāyayurgodalāṃ purīm ||3 1 ||
vyomamārgeṇa rakṣāṃsi vinedurjayakāṃkṣiṇaḥ |
yuddhaśabdān pracakruścāvādayan dundubhīn muhuḥ ||32||
śaṃkhaśabdān pracakruśca raṇavādyānyavādayan |
kilakilādiśabdānāsphoṭādīm̐śca vyadhustadā ||33||
evaṃ śrutvā rākṣasānāṃ ghoṣān bhayaṃkarān prajāḥ |
santresū rājasainyāni santresuścāti bhūstare ||34||
pradhānādyā nṛpīṃ gatvā jñāpayāmāsurulbaṇam |
upadravaṃ samarārthaṃ rākṣasānāṃ samīhitam || 35||
rājñī śīghraṃ samutthāya snātvā gadāṃ pupūja sā |
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairnīrājanairavardhayat ||36||
gurvī gadā tadā nārīrūpā divyā raṇeśvarī |
bhūtvā sarvāstraśastrādyaiḥ sampannā samuvāca ha ||37||
ahaṃ bhāgavatīśaktiḥ rakṣārthaṃ te’smi yojitā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā ||38||
adyāparādhinaṃ cainaṃ trivāraṃ samupāgatam |
raṇaṃ datvā vividhaṃ ca tato vai prāṇanāśanam ||39||
kariṣye’sya mahārājñi namaste svasti te śubham |
ityuktvā sarvaśaktyāḍhyā raṇeśvarī gadā tadā ||3.61.40 ||
svadehāt suṣuve puṣṭān yoddhṛn raṇāvisahyakān |
yojayāmāsa tān sarvān vyomagatīn gaheśvarān ||41||
kṛtvā sainyāni sāstrāṇi saśastrāṇi ca te’mbare |
uḍḍīya rakṣaḥsainyāni samāskanditavanti vai ||42||
rākṣasā rākṣasīvrātāścāpi peturmaholbaṇāḥ |
śastrairgadābhirdaṇḍaiśca tomarairlohagolakaiḥ ||43||
prastaraiścopalābhiśca bhūśūṇḍīśaktibhirdrumaiḥ |
nārācaiśca śarairbāṇaiḥ khaḍgairbhallaiśca golakaiḥ ||44||
atha dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ sannāhaṃ cātiveginam |
gadeśvarāścābhipeturvyomnā samaradurmadāḥ ||45||
śastrairastrairgolakaiśca gadābhistomarādibhiḥ |
nijaghnuḥ rākṣasān vīrā gadādevīpraṇoditāḥ ||46||
parasparaṃ nijaghnuśca śastrairvividhadhāribhiḥ |
mārayāmāsurugrāste dvibhāgān rākṣasān vyadhuḥ ||47||
kaṇṭhataḥ skandhataścāpi kaṭitaḥ karatastathā |
sakthito bhedayāmāsurnāśayāmāsurāsurān ||48||
cūrṇayāmāsurugrān vai rākṣasān hi gadeśvarāḥ |
pātayāmāsurasubhirviyujyāmbaratastalam ||49||
gale dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ ca cūṣayāmāsurāsurān |
agniṃ vibhāvya rakṣāṃsi jvālayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||3.61.50||
vimardo vai mahāñjāto rakṣasāṃ bhūnipātinām |
tadā sa bhadrakaścakre māyāṃ rākṣasajīvanīm ||51 ||
rakṣāṃsyujjīvayāmāsa sarvaśastrāstrakovidān |
utthāyotthāya te jaghnurgadeśvarān bhaṭān muhuḥ ||52||
māyikān vai gajānuṣṭrān makarān vyāghrabhallukān |
siṃhān jhaṣān śarabhām̐śca dvipino vyālapuṃgavān ||53||
bhūtapretapiśācām̐śca parvatān vaidyutān bhaṭān |
meghaśilāḥ samutpādya māyayā jaghnurīśvarān ||54||
vātavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca rajovṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā |
vahnivṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuścāpi śilāvṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā ||55||
śalabhānāṃ mahāvṛṣṭiṃ vṛścikānāṃ pravarṣaṇam |
vyālānāṃ kṛkalāsānāṃ godhānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||56||
viṣavṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuścāpi raktavṛṣṭiṃ vyadhustathā |
uṣṇodakānāṃ dhārābhiḥ prajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||57||
kardamānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ ca hastināṃ varṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
vṛkṣāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi siṃhānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||58||
agnīnāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi rākṣasānāṃ ca varṣaṇam |
vyadhuste rākṣasāstatra bhayaṃkarapravarṣaṇam ||59||
śastrāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi vyadhurdehavibhedinām |
evaṃ vināśarūpaṃ te cakrū raṇaṃ hi rākṣasāḥ ||3.61.60||
brahmajit kratujiccāpi devāntako narāntakaḥ |
kumbhagartaḥ śaṃkurathaścāyomukhaḥ śatāhvayaḥ ||6 1||
indrajidekacakraśca prāpaṇaśca puruṇḍakaḥ |
cūrṇanābhaścāsilomā kuṃbhamāno mahodakaḥ ||62||
śvalabhastālaketuśca savyāsivyaḥ supuñjikaḥ |
kālanābho yajñahāśca śrāddhādo vajrahāstathā ||63||
vidyutputraśca rasano vapāśo raktakarṇakaḥ |
vṛttākṣāḥ piṅgalāścāpi hyaṣṭadaṃṣṭrā mahodarāḥ ||64||
sthūlaśīrṣā hrasvajaṃghāstāmrasyāścordhvamūrdhajāḥ |
gartākṣā lambajihvoṣṭhā lambabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ ||65||
hatāstatra gadābhiśca ta ete rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
rākṣasyo vikacā brahmadhānā ālambikādikāḥ ||66||
gadotthābhirgadābhiśca hatāstā yuddhabhūmiṣu |
gadāsainyāni māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||67||
smṛtvā smṛtvā nipetuśca rākṣasānāṃ hi mūrdhasu |
cūrṇitāni śirāṃsyeva vakṣāṃsi rakṣasāṃ tadā ||68||
nihanmaḥ sarvarakṣāṃsi yamakṣayāya sarvadā |
notthānāya punaḥ śapāmahe saṃkarṣaṇāhvayā ||69||
ityuktvā mārayāmāsū raṇeśvaryo gadāstadā |
ātyantikaṃ ca nidhanaṃ prapeduḥ rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||3.61.70||
māyayā vṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā vilīnāśca tato’mbare |
pṛthvī rakṣogaṇadehaiḥ śavaiḥ sarvāvṛtābhavat ||71 ||
bhadrakastvāyayau dhartuṃ dhāvan raṇeśvarīṃ gadām |
tamāpatantaṃ parito gadāśataṃ babhūva ha ||72||
mārayāmāsa parito mūḍhamāreṇa bhadrakam |
raktasrāvaṃ cakārāpi vamanaṃ raktajaṃ tathā ||73||
kṛtvā bhagnaśiro vakṣāḥ papāta hāvadan kṣitau |
bhadrako nidhanaṃ yāto rākṣasā ye’pare’bhavan ||74||
raṇaṃ vihāya śataśaḥ palāyanaṃ pracakrire |
gadāḥ pṛṣṭhe patitvaiva jaghnustān jīvadānataḥ ||75||
nipetuste prāṇahīnāḥ prasārya karajānujān |
vyādāyānakukṣīm̐śca kāladharma prapedire ||76||
naiko’pi śeṣatāṃ bheje sarvaṃ śatasahasrakam |
sainyaṃ rākṣasavaryāṇāṃ nidhanaṃ gadayārpitam ||77||
atha rājñī prasasmāra patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām |
śuddhyarthaṃ jīvanārthaṃ ca prajānāṃ raṇabhūmiṣu ||78||
śīghraṃ mayā tadā lakṣmi mama pādajalāmṛtam |
arpitaṃ kalaśe’gādhe cidambarātmake drutam ||79||
sā bhūmau vyomamārgeṇa prajājīvanahetave |
prokṣaṇaṃ pracakāraiṣā prajā jīvantu me mṛtāḥ ||3.61.80||
iti saṃkalpitāstatra raṇe yā yāḥ prajāstadā |
prasahya madhye bhūbhāge nidhanaṃ gamitāśca tāḥ ||81||
tāḥ sarvā jīvanaṃ prāptā nidrotthitā yathā punaḥ |
rākṣasānāṃ tu dehānāṃ gadābhirvahninā tadā ||82||
bhasmatā vai kṛtā tatra mamecchayā hi padmaje |
evaṃ gadāḥ paraṃ kṛtvā raṇaṃ hatvā tu rākṣasān |||83|||
raṇeśvaryaḥ purastānme rājñyāḥ saudhe samāyayuḥ |
āśīrbhirvardhitāstāśca varadānāya noditāḥ ||84||
vavrire tāḥ kanyakā vai patiṃ māṃ parameśvaram |
cidambarāpi muditā raṇeśvarībhireva sā ||85||
sahitā pūjayāmāsa māṃ tadā varamālayā |
raṇeśvaryaḥ sahasraṃ vai varayāmāsureva mām ||86||
gadeśvarāstathā ramyaṃ vavrire varadānakam |
pārṣadā bhavituṃ dhāmni mayā tathāstviti dhruvāḥ ||87||
svīkṛtāḥ pārṣadāḥ sarve yayurdhāma mamākṣaram |
raṇeśvaryastathā lakṣmi mama priyāḥ pare’kṣare ||88||
vartante tāśca vai muktānikāḥ paramadhāmani |
cidambarāpi me bhaktā gadeśvarāya yogine ||89||
mama bhaktāya saumyāya pārṣadāya samastakam |
rājyaṃ datvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama parātparam ||3.61.90||
gadeśvaro mahārājo brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ |
cakāra lakṣavarṣāṇi rājyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmavān ||91||
bhaktiṃ me kārayitvā ca kṛtvā prajāśca vaiṣṇavīḥ |
yajñayāgādikān kṛtvā santṛpya devatā pitṝn ||92||
mama vimānamāruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
taddāyādo’bhavaccāpi yogeśvaro’pi bhaktarāṭ ||93 ||
sādhudharmā sādhuvarmā sādhusādhvīsamarcakaḥ |
mama bhaktiṃ kārayitvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||94||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktasya gauravam |
rakṣaṇaṃ mama bhaktāyā yathā karomi vai tathā ||95||
yatra bhaktā ca bhakto me tatra vasāmi gocaraḥ |
agocaro’thavā tiṣṭhe sāmarthyena hi hetinā ||96||
pārṣadena prabhāveṇa rakṣayāmi mamāśritām |
naro nārī napuṃ vāpi mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||97||
madātmā matkriyaḥ samyag rakṣyate cāntarātmanā |
mayā nivasatā pārśve hṛdaye vāntike puraḥ ||98||
pṛṣṭhe cordhve’dhobhūmau ca madhye cāvayaveṣvapi |
mama vāsena bhaktāyā rakṣā bhavati sarvathā ||99||
vadhvaḥ parādhīnabhāvā mama bhaktā hi tā yadi |
rakṣyante nityadā tābhiḥ sākaṃ sthitena vai mayā || 3.61.10 0||
anāthānāṃ hi nātho’haṃ karomi rakṣaṇaṃ sadā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktiśca rakṣaṇam || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ cidambarārājñyāḥ bhagavadgadayā kṛtaṃ bhadrakādirakṣaḥsaṃghātād rakṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<3.62>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ narāyaṇam |
sarvakriyānvayaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vidyāddhi māṃ tu yā || 1 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ japennityaṃ namenmāṃ puruṣottamam |
svāpe nārāyaṇaṃ yāne gamane māṃ narāyaṇam || 2 ||
sthāne nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ bhojane nārāyaṇaṃ ca mām |
unmeṣe ca nimeṣe ca nārāyaṇaṃ hi māṃ smaret || 3 ||
jāgaraṇe’pi māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namet smarettathā |
bhojyaṃ peyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca namo nārāyaṇeti yā || 4 ||
pāvayitvābhibhuṃkte yā sā yāti paramāṃ gatim |
anyānabhijanām̐ścāpi prāpayatyeva sadgatim || 5 ||
mama nāmasmṛtisaṃkīrtanāḍhyāyāstu yoṣitaḥ |
tvaṃ lakṣmīrmama sarvasvarūpā kṛṣṇasyavallabhā || 6 ||
gṛhe kṣetre tathā vāse tasyā vasasi varṣmaṇi |
ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ me paṭhamānā purendrajā || 7 ||
jayantī janmamūkā sā sārvajñyaṃ ca sarasvatīm |
prāpa pāṇḍityamutkṛṣṭaṃ bṛhaspatisamābhavat || 8 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
ityevaṃ japakartryā vai naipuṇyaṃ jāyate matau || 9 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
iti japaṃ prakurvantyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ susthiraṃ bhavet || 3.62.1 0||
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt |
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava || 11 ||
ityevaṃ japamānāyā nātho nārāyaṇastvaham |
bhūtvā dadāmi me dhāmākṣaraṃ śāśvatamodanam || 1 2||
brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāsmi śāśvatī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me || 13||
ityevaṃ japamānā vai lakṣmīrūpāṃ karomyaham |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ || 14||
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ |
ityevaṃ japamānā vai brahmapriyāṃ karomyaham || 15||
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
ityevaṃ japamānāyā nāśayāmyaghasaṃcayam || 16||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
parabrahmākṣarātīto’vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk || 17||
antaryāmī sadāsmāsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam |
sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi || 18||
pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadāvatu |
ityevaṃ japamānāyai dadāmi kamalāpadam || 19||
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ |
parabrahmasvarūpāśca parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ ||3.62.20 ||
parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidāḥ |
tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā ||21 ||
ityevaṃ japamānā vai muktānīṃ prakaromyaham |
yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajatyapi || 22||
sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradā sadā |
ityevaṃ japamānāyā divyarūpaṃ prajāyate ||23||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
ityevaṃ japamānā sve rūpe’ntarbhāvayāmyaham ||24||
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ itimanum |
japantyāḥ sādhayāmyeva puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||25||
kṛṣṇasyapriyabhaktāhaṃ śrīhariṃḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
śrīkṛṣṇasarvavidyābdhiḥ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama |26|
śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
itimantrān japantyā me nityavāso’sti sā mayi ||27||
ime mantrā mayā lakṣmi svamūrtayaḥ prakāśitāḥ |
matsamā matsvarūpāste madvatkāryārthasādhakāḥ |||28|||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhonāthaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ iti manuḥ |
sarvārthado dvādaśārṇastanmāhātmyaṃ vadāmi te |||29||
vedhaḥputrī samutpannā sarasvatī subālikā |
sarvavidyāparipūrṇā vedavedāṃgasaṃbhṛtā |
tataśca śāradā kanyā cotpannā brahmaṇaḥ sutā ||3.62.30||
sarasvatī vadatyeva saṃskṛtāmuttamāṃ giram |
śāradā na śaśākāpi kṛtopanayanāpi sā |
mūkābhavattadā jihvā spandate naiva yatnataḥ ||3 1||
khinno’bhavad vidhātā ca sāvitrī kheditābhavat |
tato vai śāradā kanyā śuśoca manasā hyati |
yayau sarasvatīpārśvaṃ darśayantī svajihvikām ||32||
sarasvatī vicāryaiva dvādaśākṣaramantravat |
jalaṃ pramantrya pradadau tajjihvāyāṃ tu pāvanam ||33||
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācāryaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’ iti muhuḥ |
jalaṃ pramantrya pradadau tajjihvāyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||34||
tāvattu śāradādevyā vāṇī jihvāgatābhavat |
svaravyañjanavākyāni vedavedāṃgakāni ca ||35||
bhūtabhavyāni sarvāṇi jagau mantrapratāpataḥ |
evaṃ divyābhavadvāṇīyuktā vai śāradā satī ||36||
prasanno’bhūd viśvasṛṭ ca sāvitrī ca sarasvatī |
etadvai kathitaṃ lakṣmi dvādaśākṣaravaibhavam ||37||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ vai paramaṃ padam |
api pāpasamācārā dvādaśākṣaratatparā ||38||
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ me śubhaṃ tvakṣarābhidham |
omityekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan yāti parāṃ gatim ||39||
kṛṣṇe’tidvyakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan golokamṛcchati |
śrīkṛṣṇatryakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japan golokamuttamam ||3.62.40||
vāsudevetimantraṃ vā rādhākṛṣṇeti vā japan |
caturvarṇaṃ manuṃ yāti tvayā kṛtaṃ nijālayam ||41||
oṃ nārāyaṇapañcārṇaṃ japan śvetākṣaraṃ padam |
namo nārāyaṇāye’tijapan brahmākṣaraṃ padam ||42||
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan yātyakṣaraṃ padam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśrīromiti gṛṇan vikuṇṭhakam ||43||
anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’tyapi cākṣaraṃ padam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetidivyamakṣaram ||44||
oṃ māṇikīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti parākṣaram |
padaṃ yāti japan dehi lakṣmi dhāmottamottamam ||45||
oṃ sukhadālakṣmīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’ti matpadam |
prāpnoti japavān bhakto bhaktānī japasaṃyutā ||46||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmī śaraṇaṃ me’ manuṃ tvimam |
manumūrdhanyamutsāhājjapan yāti mamāntaram ||47||
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ, oṃ nārāyaṇāya namaśca |
oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ, oṃ mahāviṣṇave namaḥ ||48||
oṃ viṣṇave namaśce’ti oṃ sadāśivāya namaḥ |
o hiraṇyagarbhāya namaḥ, oṃ śivāya namastathā ||49||
oṃ rāmādityāya namaḥ, oṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaśca |
oṃ kapilāya namaḥ, oṃ śrīharaye namaśca ||3.62.50||
oṃ dattātreyāya namaḥ, omṛṣabhāya namaśca, |
oṃ vāmanāya namaśca, oṃ parśurāmāya namaḥ|||91 ||
oṃ yajñāya namaśca, oṃ sanatkumārāya namaḥ |
oṃ vyāsāya namaśce’ti, oṃ buddhāya nama,stathā ||52||
oṃ naranārāyaṇāya namaḥ, oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ |
oṃ parabrahmaṇe namaḥ, omantaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||53||
oṃ mādhavāya namaśca, oṃ govindāya namaśca |
oṃ keśavāya namaśca, oṃ śrīpataye namaśca ||54||
oṃ svāmine namaśca, omakṣarātītāya namaḥ |
oṃ puruṣottamāya namaḥ, oṃ paramātmane namaḥ ||55||
omanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vidmahe |
gopālakṛṣṇātmajāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ kambharāśrīsutaḥ pracodayāt ||56||
ete mantrāḥ sadā lakṣmi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ |
tattaddhāmapradāḥ sarve pāpatāpapraṇāśakāḥ |
sarvapumarthadāścāpi sarvecchāpūrakāstathā ||57||
sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ cāpi lakṣaṃ koṭirjapā matāḥ |
yathāśraddhaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathāvegaṃ phalapradāḥ ||58||
oṃ śriyai namaḥ, oṃ lakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ ramāyai namaḥ |
oṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ nārāyaṇyai namaśca vai ||59||
oṃ brāhmayaiva namaḥ, oṃ puruṣottamyai namaśca tathā |
oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, oṃ kamalāyai namaḥ, oṃ māyai namaḥ ||3.62.60||
oṃ vāsudevyai namaḥ, oṃ kṛṣṇāyai nama ityapi |
oṃ mādhavyai namaḥ, oṃ parameśvaryai nama iti ||61 ||
oṃ śivāyai namaḥ, omantaryāmiṇyai nama iti |
oṃ mahāvaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, oṃ padmāyai namastathā ||62||
oṃ kambharālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ prajñāyai namastathā, |
oṃ rādhāyai namaśca oṃ brahmapriyāyai namaśca ||63||
oṃ hariṇyai namaḥ, oṃ haripriyāyai namastathā |
oṃ hiraṇyamayyai namaḥ, oṃ kārṣṇavāllabhyai namaḥ ||64||
oṃ pārvatyai namaḥ, oṃ māṇikyāyai nama ityapi |
oṃ sukhadālakṣmyai namaḥ, oṃ śivarājñīśriyai namaḥ ||65||
oṃ nārāyaṇīśriyai namaḥ, oṃ dhāminyai namaḥ |
oṃ sukhadālakṣmyai vidmahe nārāyaṇīśriyai dhīmahi |
tannaḥ śivarājñīśrīḥ pracodayāt ||66||
ā kṛṣṇāya vidmahe vallabhāya dhīmahi
prajñā tannaḥ pracodayāt |
om ācāryāya vidmahe gurave dhīmahi
pārvatī naḥ pracodayāt ||67||
ete mantrāḥ sadā lakṣmi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ |
yāvatpumarthadāḥ sarvasukhavāñcchāprapūrakāḥ ||68||
śataṃ sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ niyutaṃ koṭirityapi |
japtāḥ śraddhānvitāstvāṃ māṃ smṛtvā śāśvatakāmadāḥ ||69||
tvamahaṃ tvamahaṃ lakṣmi so’haṃ so’haṃ japecca yaḥ |
smṛtvā māṃ cāpi tasmai ca tasyai dadāmyahaṃ nijam ||3.62.70||
mamāsanaṃ mama dhāma mamātmānaṃ dadāmi ca |
madbhaktārthaṃ mama sarvaṃ śeṣayāmi na cārpaṇe ||71 ||
bhaja lakṣmi bhaja rādhe māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ patim |
bhaja kānte bhaja cānte prakāśe ca rahasyapi ||72||
bhaja dehe bhaja gehe prāṇapriyaṃ tathāntare |
bhaja gupte bhaja supte śāśvatānandakṛtsukham ||73||
bhajanaṃ bhaktiratyantaṃ premasevā vinodinī |
dravyasampadvāṭikādyairvāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ |
seveta paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ pareśvaram ||74||
pratyakṣaṃ vartamānaṃ māṃ severan vai narāḥ striyaḥ |
ahaṃ divyasvarūpo’smi paramākṣaradhāmagaḥ |
sa evātra bhavāmyadya saurāṣṭre kaṃbharātmajaḥ ||75||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya nandanaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
manvantareṣu vai lakṣmi sthāsyāmyatraiva sarvathā ||76||
pāvano’haṃ gururūpo yathāsmi lomaśastathā |
dhātupāṣāṇamūrtyādau yathāhaṃ nivasāmi vai ||77||
tathā cāsmi vaiṣṇavācāryeṣu svayaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
ye ye gurusthale yogyā abhiṣiktā narāḥ striyaḥ ||78||
teṣu tāsu nivatsyāmi sākaṃ tvayā hi padmaje |
tasmādvai guravo loke divyā mamaiva mūrtayaḥ ||79||
darśanāt sparśanāccapi sevanāt tārakā hi te |
māṃ vinā pṛthivī naiva riktā prajāyate kvacit ||3.62.80 ||
pravāhāṃśāveśarūpaiḥ pravarte’haṃ vasāmi ca |
cetanā mūrtayaḥ sarvā gurvātmikā jagattraye ||8 1 ||
akṣare’haṃ sadā muktamuktānīpatirasmi ca |
goloke’haṃ gopikānāṃ gopānāṃ patirasmi ca ||82||
vaikuṇṭhe’haṃ pārṣadānāṃ pārṣadīnāṃ patistathā |
avyākṛte’pi caivāsmi tathāmṛte bhavāmi ca ||83 ||
śrīpure dhīḥ svayamasmi kailāse śaṃkaro’smi ca |
satye brahmā guruścāsmi pitṛloke tathāryamā ||84||
bṛhaspatiḥ suraloke mānave sādhurasmi ca |
daityānāmuśanāścāsmi brāhmaṇānāṃ vasiṣṭhakaḥ |
sādhvī cāsmi yoṣitāṃ ca narāṇāṃ dhiṣṇyaśobhanaḥ ||85||
sarpāṇāṃ śeṣa evāsmi paśūnāṃ vṛṣabho’smi ca |
yādasāṃ kacchapaścāsmi krūrāṇāṃ śarabho’smi ca ||86||
kalpalatā tu vallīnāṃ śākhināṃ kalpapādapaḥ |
vidyārthināṃ śikṣako’smi vadhūnāṃ patimātṛkā ||87||
evaṃ gururevaṃ sarvatra mama sattāmayaṃ priye |
varte’haṃ sarvadā tatra gurau tīrthottamottame ||88||
guruṃ māṃ gocaraṃ jñātvā yo bhajeta nirantaram |
tasya nānyatra me gaveṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ hi śiṣyate ||89||
gurau sthitvā divyarūpaḥ pratīkṣāmi hi sevinaḥ |
ye yā yathā prapadyante tām̐stām̐stathā bhajāmyapi ||3.62.90 ||
sarvakāmān pūrayāmi śraddhābhāvasamanvitān |
premasnehārdrasaṃdṛbdhān karomi saphalān sadā ||9 1 ||
bāndhavo’haṃ bandhahartā gurau tiṣṭhāmi sarvathā |
bandhāstu vāsanārūpā vāsanā vṛttisaṃbhavā ||92||
vṛttayo yogalabhyāśca saṃyogo bhogyavastujaḥ |
bhogyadravyādyalabdhiśca viyoge vai sahāyinī ||93||
vṛttīnāṃ tena vilayo vāsanāvilayastataḥ |
nirbandhatā bhavettena yatitavyaṃ tathā sadā ||94||
guroryogo hi nirbandho bhāvanāpādakaḥ sadā |
mokṣasthānaprāpakaśca mahānandapradastathā ||95||
divyatāpādakaścāpi satsaṃgaḥ śevadhirguroḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi sadāvāpyo bhavāmi premabhaktitaḥ ||96||
baddhān sarvān mocayāmi nirbandho’haṃ guruḥ priyaḥ |
tārayāmi mahāpāpān narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||97||
paśūn pakṣigaṇān vārinivāsān vanino’pi ca |
drumān vallīstārayāmi surān pitṝn munīnapi ||98||
śaraṇāgatasantrātā bhavāmi bhagavānaham |
kāryaṃ me sukhadānaṃ ca duḥkhāt trāṇaṃ hi dehinām ||99||
tadeva sarvasṛṣṭyādau karomi cāpi sṛṣṭiṣu |
sṛṣṭyante’pi tathaivāhaṃ vidadhāmi prarakṣaṇam || 3.62.10 0||
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā pṛṣṭaṃ priye tvayā |
vadhūgītāmayaṃ jñānaṃ sarvāsāṃ mokṣakṛt priye || 101 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ me vai tādātmyasampradaṃ tathā || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ bahuvidhānāṃ divyamantrāṇāṃ gurorbalasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||

<3.63>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
ke dāsā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇakānta priya kṛpānidhe |
ke bhaktā kīdṛśāścāpi kīdṛśo mahimāpi ca || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
dehasevāvidhātāro mama dāsā hi te matāḥ |
rahasyasevinaḥ śreṣṭhā niḥśaṃkā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ || 2 ||
ahaṃ mānuṣarūpeṇa vicarāmi janaiḥ saha |
janā māṃ vīkṣya laukīyaṃ sevante naiva śaṃkitāḥ || 3 ||
manvate nijavat kāmakrodhasvabhāvasaṃbhṛtam |
na manvate hi bhaktānāṃ saṃkalpapūrakaṃ prabhum || 4 ||
sarvāṇi me caritrāṇi dehajāni śubhāni vai |
smṛtānyapi vīkṣitāni mokṣadāni na saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
tatra saṃśayakartāro na sevante hi māṃ khalāḥ |
adivyaṃ māṃ pramanvānā nindāṃ kurvanti me tataḥ || 6 ||
tena pāpena niraye tiryakṣvapi prayānti ca |
āsuratvaṃ na vai teṣāṃ lakṣmi kvacinnivartate || 7 ||
dāsyaṃ hi kaṭhinaṃ lakṣmi mahat sarvārpaṇātmakam |
naro vā yadi vā nārī dehaṃ daihikamarpayet || 8 ||
niḥśaṃkaṃ cārpayet sarvaṃ taddāsyaṃ cottamottamam |
tarkamūhaṃ saṃśayaṃ vā na madhye kārayet kriyāt || 9 ||
dharmaṃ lajjāṃ vyavahāraṃ na madhye sthāpayenmama |
nārāyaṇakṛto dharmo lajjā nārāyaṇaśritā || 3.63.1 0||
nārāyaṇavyavahāro mokṣadā netare iti |
matvā mama kriyāṃ sarvāṃ dharmātmikīṃ vicintayet || 11 ||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madaśca narma ca |
aślīlaṃ cāghaṭitaṃ ca mama divyaṃ hi sarvathā || 12||
na me kāmo nārakī vai na me krodho hi ghātakī |
na me lobhaḥ pāpabhṛcca na me moho hi vañcakaḥ || 13 ||
na me mado bandhakṛcca na me narma vṛṣojjhitam |
na me’ślīlaṃ kṣudrakṛcca na me’ghaṭitamasti yat || 14||
sarvaṃ divyaṃ kṛtaṃ muktipradaṃ prajāyate hi tat |
tasmād dāsyaṃ hi kaṭhinaṃ kartuṃ sarvairjanairiha || 15||
narā nāryaśca yā dāsyaṃ kartumicchanti me sadā |
taiśca tābhiḥ sadā bhāvyamāśaṃkāvarjitaistathā || 16||
āśaṃkāvarjitābhiśca patnībhirbhāvyamityapi |
lakṣmīrādhāramākāntātulyābhirbhāvyamityapi || 17||
tato dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ nirāvaraṇamuttamam |
sarvaṃ premabhṛtaṃ dāsyaṃ śobhate vardhate’tyati || 18||
bhedabhāvaṃ vinā dāsyaṃ vardhate nityameva ca |
śaṃkā vinā paraṃ dāsyaṃ mahānandapradaṃ bhavet || 19||
parameśe patikṛṣṇe svāmini paramātmani |
kathaṃ śaṃkā kathaṃ prātikūlyaṃ vivekino bhavet ||3.63.20||
yat karoti svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mokṣadaṃ sarvameva tat |
yat karoti svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dharma eva hi puṇyakṛt ||21||
tasmād dāsyaṃ hi tādātmyapradaṃ kāryaṃ satījanaiḥ |
tādātmye cāvaraṇāni bhedakāni priye śṛṇu ||22||
aikyabhāve bhedabhāvaścāvaraṇaṃ hi tanmatam |
ahamanyā hariścānyaśceti bhānaṃ dvitīyakam ||23||
āvaraṇaṃ vighnakartṛ dāsye kṣatiṃ karoti tat |
ahaṃ nārī naraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paraśca puruṣo hyayam ||24||
parāhaṃ ceti bhānaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ tat tṛtīyakam |
hareḥ pārśve sthitāyāśca bhayamanyasya yad bhavet ||25||
tadapyāvaraṇaṃ turyaṃ dāsye kṣatiṃ dadhāti vai |
nāyaṃ vai samayaścāsti pañcamāvaraṇaṃ hi tat |
nātra naiva mano me’sti ṣaṣṭhamāvaraṇaṃ hi tat ||26||
arthārthitvaṃ saptamaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ cāpi vidyate |
mānaṃ dāsye mahadvighnaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ taddhi gadyate || 27||
navamaṃ svārthasiddhiśca rodhikā dāsyakarmaṇaḥ |
daśamaṃ cādivyatā ca rodhikā sevane sadā |||28||
yatheṣṭaviniyogaśca dāsye bhavati padmaje |
sa cennāsti tadā dāsyaṃ cotkṛṣṭaṃ naiva padyate ||29||
svatvaṃ dāsyaṃ tvadīyatvaṃ tatparatvaṃ tadātmatā |
pañcakaṃ dāsyasandṛbdhaṃ śobhate dāsyameva tat ||3.63.30 ||
yathā lakṣmi tava dāsyaṃ śobhate sarvameva ha |
tathā dāsyaṃ narāṇāṃ vā nārīṇāṃ śobhate kṛtam ||3 1||
bhaktiyuktaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ saprema śobhate mayi |
sarvāvaraṇavarjyaṃ sa śobhate modate mayi ||32||
brahmakriyāratā nityaṃ mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ |
śaṃkhacakrādyaṃkitāśca modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||33||
satāṃ sevāparāścāpi sādhvīsevāparāstathā |
viṣṇupūjāparāścāpi modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||34||
harerdāsā hareścāpi priyā haryarthavartinaḥ |
sarvadā mama bhaktyāḍhyā modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||35||
mahotsāhaparāścāpi mahānaivedyabhojanāḥ |
sarvaprasādayoktāro modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||36||
viṣṇorayaṃ yataścāste tasmādvai vaiṣṇavo mama |
nārāyaṇasya me cāste tato nārāyaṇīyakaḥ ||37||
sarveṣāmuttamo bhakto nārāyaṇīya eva ha |
brahmaṇo’yaṃ brāhmabhaktaścākṣarasya tathākṣaraḥ ||38||
kṛṣṇasyāyaṃ kārṣṇabhakto modante mayi vaiṣṇavāḥ |
nārāyaṇīyā brāhmāśca tathākṣarā mamānugāḥ ||39||
brahmarūpadharā bhaktā brāhmaṇāste prakīrtitāḥ |
yataḥ sakāśāt sañjātā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||3.63.40||
sādhavaste sanakādyā guravo brāhmaṇāḥ purā |
viprādīnāṃ guravaste sādhavo brahmayoginaḥ ||41||
brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ pūrvaṃ sanakādyā hi sādhavaḥ |
brahmaśīlā yatayaśca skandaśca hanumām̐stathā ||42||
evamete pratisṛṣṭisādhavo guravaḥ sadā |
śūdrāṇāṃ hi dvijāḥ santi guravo gṛhamedhinām ||43||
dvijādīnāṃ brāhmaṇāśca guravo gṛhamedhinaḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ sādhavaśca guravo mokṣadā yataḥ ||44||
sādhavaḥ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhāḥ surarṣipitṛpūjitāḥ |
surebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā maharṣibhyastathottamāḥ ||45||
pitṛbhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā bhūsurebhyaḥ sadottamāḥ |
trailokye nāsti tacchraiṣṭyaṃ yacchraiṣṭhaṃ satsu vidyate ||46||
satītaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā yatayo brahmadarśanāḥ |
gobhyaśca sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||47||
bhūdevītaścottamāśca santo vai kṣamayānvitāḥ |
mūrtibhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā jñānadānapramokṣaṇaiḥ ||48||
devatāyatanebhyaśca śreṣṭhāḥ santo hi tārakāḥ |
pativratābhyaḥ śreṣṭhāśca santaḥ śrīpatisevinaḥ ||49||
ṣaḍaṃgavediviprebhyaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ santo haripriyāḥ |
vedebhyaḥ sādhuvākyāni śreṣṭhāni kṛṣṇayojanāt ||3.63.50 ||
vedebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā vedāḥ sādhutvasaṃśrayāt |
tīrthebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śīghraṃ pāpavināśanāt ||51 ||
vratebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā yatheṣṭānantapuṇyadāḥ |
pāvakāt sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā māyākalmaṣaśodhakāḥ ||52||
brahmarṣayo’pi sādhūnāṃ pūjayanti padāni vai |
īśvarāḥ kṛṣṇarūpāśca parameśo’hamacyutaḥ ||53||
pūjayāmaḥ sato bhaktān sādhūn sarvasvapāvanān |
santaste sadguṇaiścāḍhyā guṇāḍhyāḥ śreṣṭhino hi te ||54||
santaste brahmarājyena rājānaścakravartinaḥ |
santaste jñānabhaṇḍārā vidvāṃso guravaḥ parāḥ ||55||
ācāryāḥ santa evaite mokṣadā mantradāstathā |
santaste vedavidyādivijñāste brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||56 ||
ṣaṭkarmaniratāḥ santo viprā eva matā mama |
lakṣmi santo mamātmānaścātmāhaṃ vai satāṃ sadā ||57||
satyaśaucakṣāntiyuktā rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ |
brahmavidyāvivekajñā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||58||
agnihotraparāścāpi nityaṃ cātithipūjakāḥ |
pitṛbhaktā mātṛbhaktā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||59||
dayādharmādisaṃyuktāstathā puṇyaparāyaṇāḥ |
śaṃkhacakrādicihnāḍhyāḥ vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||3.63.6 0||
kaṇṭhe mālā taulaseyī dhṛtā yaiścānane hariḥ |
gītiḥ kṛṣṇasya kurvanto vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||6 1 ||
saṃhitāsu ratā nityaṃ makheṣu ca ratāstathā |
sarvadharmeṣvādariṇo vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||62||
pāpāt pāpānmocayanti naiva nindanti mānavān |
dehinaḥ sukhayantyeva vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||63||
gopālakṛṣṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi mām |
ye’rcayanti pratimāṃ me vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||64||
śālagrāmaṃ pūjayanti pūjayantyavatāriṇam |
anādiśrīhariṃ māṃ ca vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||65||
gopālo’yaṃ ca kṛṣṇo’yaṃ rāmādityo’yamacyutaḥ |
ityevaṃ māṃ pūjayanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||66||
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ rūpaṃ me yathā ca siddhapattane |
yathā ca gokule tadvad yathā himālaye’pi ca ||67||
yathā ca nārmade tīre yathā rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ mayā |
tādṛgrūpaṃ pūjayanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||68||
caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadābjagām |
pītāmbarāṃ samuralīṃ vanamālādiśobhanām ||69||
mukuṭena yutāṃ ramyāṃ kaustubhodbhāsitāṃ tathā |
rādhāramādisaṃyuktāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ mama ||3.63.70||
raupyāṃ tāmrodbhavāṃ cāpi paittalīṃ maṇijāṃ tathā |
pratiṣṭhāpyāgamamantrairvedavākyairviśeṣataḥ ||71||
ṣoḍaśopacāramantraiḥ pūjayeyurvidhānataḥ |
premabhaktyā hṛdayena vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ ||72|||
sādhavaste vaiṣṇavā vai manmayāḥ puṇyarūpiṇaḥ |
yathā viṣṇustathā sarve nāntaraṃ vartate manāk ||73||
evaṃ vijñāya rājaśri sādhūn sampūjayet sadā |
ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ sādhuḥ satī cāhaṃ pativratā ||74||
ahaṃ mātā pitā cāhaṃ patiḥ sādhvī ca yoginī |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sādhuḥ svāmī nārāyaṇī tvaham ||75||
rudro rudrīrajaścājī suraḥ surī bhavāmyaham |
sarvabhūteṣu satataṃ vasāmi saṃbhavāmi ca ||76||
patikāmukayā pūjyaścāhaṃ patisvarūpavān |
mokṣakāmukayā pūjyaścāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||77||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kathaṃ kadā bhavān pūjyo vastubhiḥ kaiśca keśava |
vidhinā kena bhagavan patikāmukayā vada ||78||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
caitramāse śuklapakṣe hyekādaśyāṃ prage śubhe |
gatvārāme grahītavyā divyā damanamañjarī ||79||
gurvājñayā prakartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ damanasya vai |
damane tiṣṭhate kāmadevaśca ratisaṃyutaḥ ||3.63.80||
kāmadeva namaste’stu tvaṃ sadā puruṣottamaḥ |
hariṃ kāmaṃ vicinomi kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ||8 1||
gītavāditranirghoṣairānetavyo gṛhaṃ prati |
adhivāsanapūrvaṃ ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||82||
sthāpayitvā hariṃ kāmaṃ ratiṃ ca damanadrumam |
ācchādya śvetavastreṇa pūjayet kanyakā priye ||83||
klīṃ kāmadevāya namo hrīṃ ratyai ca namonamaḥ |
pūrvasyāṃ hrīṃ ca kandarpaṃ pūjayāmi niśāgame ||84||
gandhapuṣpākṣatadhūpadīpanaivedyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
ārārtrikādibhirdaivaṃ pūjayāmi patiṃ prabhum ||85||
madanāya namaḥ prācyāṃ manmathāya namo’gnike |
kandarpāya namo yāmye’naṃgāya namo nairṛte ||86 ||
vāruṇyāṃ mohanāya namaḥ smarāya namo’nile |
kauberyāmīśvarāya namaḥ puṣpabāṇāyeśānyāṃ namaḥ ||87||
sarvadikṣu namaskṛtya māṃ kanyā pūjayet tataḥ |
oṃ kandarpapuruṣāya vidmahe kāmadevāya dhīmahi |
tanno’naṅgaḥ pracodayāt ||88||
iti cāṣṭottaraśatajapān kuryāddhi sannidhau |
namo’stu kāmapataye puṣpaśarāya te namaḥ ||89||
manmathāyānandadātre namo ratikarāya te |
prītidāya namaste’stu sarvabījāya te namaḥ ||3.63.90||
kāntāya kāntarūpāya sarvavāsāya te namaḥ |
puruṣottamarūpāyānaṃgadevāya te namaḥ ||91||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vāñcchitakāmada |
hṛtsthāna pūraya kāmānme prabho kāmeśvarīpriya ||92||
stutvaivaṃ mañjarī vāri dātavye mama pādayoḥ |
gītavāditranṛtyaiśca kartavyaścotsavo mahān ||93||
jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca prātaḥ snātvārcayeddharim |
guruṃ cāpi draviṇādi vastrālaṃkārabhojanam ||94||
dāne’rpayeddhi gurave sahāśnīyācca vaiṣṇavaiḥ |
bhūmidānaṃ dhenudānaṃ mahādānaṃ tu bhūriśaḥ ||95||
sarvadānaṃ tayā dattaṃ mañjaryāḥ pūjanena me |
gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ damanakārcane ||96||
mallikākusumairmāṃ yā vasante kāntamuttamam |
arcayetparayā bhaktyā sā kāntaṃ labhate dhruvam ||97||
madhukaśca damanakaścātiprītikarau hareḥ |
tābhyāmahaṃ pūjito drāk patiṃ dadāmi yoṣite ||98||
kanyāyai ratirūpāyai prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
patiṃ dadāmi tadyogyaṃ kāntaṃ kāntinidhiṃ śubham ||99||
kāmadevasamaṃ ramyaṃ savayaskaṃ madātmakam |
saumyaśīlaṃ ca nīrogaṃ sampadyukta guṇākaram || 3.63.100 ||
prītipātraṃ premapātraṃ dadāmi patimuttamam |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi muktidaṃ bhuktidaṃ vratam || 10 1||
pūjanaṃ mama loke’tra bhajanaṃ cāpi cottamam |
gurutīrthaṃ sādhusādhvīrūpaṃ cāpi tathottamam || 1 02||
dāsadāsīvaiṣṇavādisvarūpāṇi tathā priye |
anāvaraṇasevā ca kathitā mama labdhaye || 1 03||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt karaṇāttathā |
avaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti bhaktā bhakto yathoditam || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparayugasantāne vadhūgītāyāmanāvaraṇasevādāsyasāghusādhvīśraiṣṭhyadamanakavratādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
