<3.64>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa parameśa sanātana |
kasyāṃ tithau kiṃsvarūpo bhavān pūjyaḥ pravedaya || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
pratipaddhanadasyoktā tatra pūjyo’hameva ha |
kuberamūrtirūpo vai dhanado’haṃ bhavāmi hi || 2 ||
lakṣmyāste vai dvitīyāsti tvaṃ pūjyā puruṣottamī |
sarvalakṣmīpradā tvaṃ syā madātmikā narāyaṇī || 3 ||
tṛtīyā pārvatīdevyāstithiḥ proktā śubhā priye |
tatra pūjyā pārvatī tu saubhāgyadā hi sā matā || 4 ||
gaṇeśasya caturthī vai pūjyo vighnaharo hi saḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpo lābhādisamprado’pi saḥ || 5 ||
candrasya pañcamī proktā pūjanīyaḥ śaśī hyaham ||
govṛṣavāṭikādātā bhavāmi cāmṛtānnadaḥ || 6 ||
kārtikasya tithiḥ ṣaṣṭhī kārtikaṃ pūjayettadā |
jayaprado grahahartā bhavāmi kārtikātmakaḥ || 7 ||
saptamī tu raverbodhyā sūryaḥ pūjyastadā priye |
sūryanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tejo dadāmi naikadhā || 8 ||
durgāyāstvaṣṭamī bodhyā durgā pūjyā śubhapradā |
sarvakaṣṭaharā sā ca mama śaktiḥ sanātanī || 9 ||
navamī caiva mātṝṇāṃ pūjyā vai mātaraḥ śubhāḥ |
rakṣākaryo bhavantyeva kṣemaṃkaryo hi vaṃśinām || 3.64.10 ||
yamasya daśamī bodhyā yamaḥ pūjyastadā śubhaḥ |
pāpanirayaduḥkhaghno yamo’haṃ saṃbhavāmi vai || 11 ||
ekādaśī kamalāyāḥ śrīḥ pūjyā tatra sarvathā |
śreyasāṃ padamāpnoti dadāmi śrīṃ samarcine || 1 2||
dvādaśī me mādhavasya pūjito’haṃ tadā priye |
madhu sarvavidhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi rasasaṃbhṛtam || 13 ||
trayodaśī ca kāmasya pūjyo’haṃ tatra sarvadā |
kāmān dadāmi sampūrṇān sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ || 14||
caturdaśī harasyāsti mahādevamayo hyaham |
pūjanīyaḥ smṛddhidaścaiśvaryaprado hi śaṃkaraḥ | | 15 ||
paṃcadaśī vedhaso’sti vedhāḥ pūjyaḥ śubhapradaḥ |
vaṃśavṛddhipradaścāpi pitṛvacchreyasāṃpradaḥ || 1 6||
adhikā tithirācyutī puruṣottamasaṃjñikā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pūjyo’hameva ca || 17||
sarveṣṭasampradaścāsmi parameśaḥ purātanaḥ |
amāvāsyā tu devānāṃ tithiḥ pūjyā hi devatāḥ || 18||
āvāhanaṃ samārabhya visarjanāvadhi dhruvam |
sarvopacāraśobhāḍhyaṃ pūjanaṃ sarvadā matam || 19 ||
snānamambaramābhūṣā mantramālārdracandanam |
dhūpadīpasunaivedyavāritāmbūlatoṣaṇam || 3.64.20 ||
namaḥ kṣamā dakṣiṇā cetyāvaśyakaṃ hi pūjane |
aṣṭottaraśatavastukṛtaṃ prapūjanaṃ bhavet || 21 ||
sarvasampatpradaṃ lakṣmi sarvasiddhipradaṃ tathā |
sarvakāmapradaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet || 22||
evaṃ me mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryād bhaktā prasādinīm |
yayā kṛtayā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prasīdāmi priyaṃkaraḥ || 23 ||

caturvidhaṃ ca naivedyamannaṃ dadyāt sumiṣṭakam || 24||

mantrabhaktividhihīnaṃ pūjitaṃ pūrṇamastu te || 25||
dhanyāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ saubhāgyā dharaṇisthitā |
yāṃ māmaṅgīkṛtya nāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo muktido’sti me || 26 ||
sarvavāsanānirmuktā divyā rāghāsamādya vai |
jātāsmi gauravaṃ prāptā guroḥ pratāpato bhuvi || 27 ||
namaste gurave kṛṣṇātmakāya paramātmane |
pratiṣṭhādivyamūrtistvaṃ guruḥ kṛṣṇo hi tārakaḥ ||28||
sarvānandaprado muktipradastvaṃ me gururhariḥ |
sarvabandhaprahartā ca pāpatāpavināśakaḥ ||29||
brahmakaivalyadātā me paramākṣaradhāmadaḥ |
paramātmasvarūpastvaṃ namaste paramātmane ||3.64.3 0||
dhanyāsmi kṛtakṛtyāsmi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca me |
majjanmani nidāne ca dhanyau tau pitarau mama ||31 ||
yanmayānādibhagavān vallabhaḥ samupārjitaḥ |
tvayā kṛṣṇa viyuktāhaṃ yathā na syāṃ tathā kuru ||32||
dānaṃ tapo vrataṃ bhaktiḥ sevā pūrvaṃ kṛtā mayā |
yayāhaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ vai labdhavatyadya bhūtale || 33 ||
bahupuṇyapratāpena labdhavatī hariṃ gurum |
gurau sannihito viṣṇuḥ svabhakteṣveva sarvathā ||34||
gurāvāste hariśceti mahimānaṃ vibhāvayet |
gururdṛṣṭaḥ praṇamitaḥ snāpitaḥ pūjitastathā ||35||
yajñakoṭisamaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāti gurusevine |
doṣayuktāpi yā nityaṃ bhaktibhāvānvitā satī ||36||
gurvīmūrtiṃ pūjayet sācyutā bhavati dhāmani |
gurvīmūrtirmahāhatyāpāpātipātanāśinī || 37||
smṛtā saṃkīrtitā dhyātā pūjitā ca namaskṛtā |
gurvīdevīpratimā sā dhāmākṣarapradāyinī ||38||
ācāryāṇīṃ satīṃ gurvīṃ sādhvīṃ brāhmīṃ pativratām |
harivratāṃ yoginīṃ ca prāpyāsevya pramucyate || 39||
siṃhīṃ vīkṣya yathā yānti mṛgyo bhayāttathā tviha |
māyāḥ sarvāḥ pāpamayyo gurvīprāptyā viyanti hi ||3.64.40||
namaskaroti yā śiṣyā gurustrīṃ pāvanīṃ satīm |
bhaktyā vā yadi vābhaktyā sā puṇyā muktigāminī ||41||
vaivasvatabhayaṃ nāsti tasyā maraṇajanmanoḥ |
yā karoti satī sevāṃ pūjanaṃ guruyoṣitaḥ ||42||
gandhapādyārghanaivedyairdīpairdhūpairvilepanaiḥ |
gītairvādyaistathā stotrairguvīṃṃ devīṃ prarañjayet ||43||

kalpakoṭyayutānyeṣā ramate mama sadmani ||44||
gurudevanamaskāro bhāvenāpi yayā kṛtaḥ |
sā devī mānuṣe loke mamānugrahapātrikā ||45||
madbhaktibaladarpasthā mama sādhuparāyaṇā |
gurvīsevāparā sādhvī modate mama dhāmani ||46 ||
gurudevapratimāyāṃ lakṣmi sadā vasāmyaham |
padmakoṭisahasraistu viṣṇupūjāphalaṃ tu yat ||47||
gurudevasya pūjāyāṃ phalaṃ tallabhate satī |
na kṛtaṃ martyaloke yairgurudevārcanaṃ janaiḥ ||48||
te mṛtā eva ca muhurjāyante karmabhāginaḥ |
gurudevasya nikaṭe sarvaṃ yāti pavitratām ||49||
bhuktvā guroḥ prasādaṃ ca yajñakoṭiphalaṃ bhavet |
guroḥ pādodakaiḥ pītairhatyākoṭirvinaśyati ||3.64.50 ||
kāśīvāso yugānyaṣṭau dinaikagurusevanāt |
tasmād guroḥ pūjanaṃ vai kartavyaṃ mokṣakāmyayā ||5 1 ||
gurudevasvarūpaḥ śrīpatiryatra hi tiṣṭhati |
tatra devāḥ surāḥ sādhvyaśceśvarāśca vasanti vai ||52||
surāṇāṃ kīrtanaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭibhiryat phalaṃ bhavet |
tatphalaṃ śrīhareścāpi gurośca kīrtanād bhavet ||53 ||
gurudevamukhe hutvā sakṛt piṇḍena tarpitāḥ |
pitarastṛptimāyānti śāśvatīṃ cāmṛtānvitām ||54||
ye pibanti janā vāri guroścaraṇapāvitam |
pañcagavyasahasraistu prāśitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||55||
prāyaścitte samutpanne kiṃ dānaiḥ kimupoṣaṇaiḥ |
cāndrāyaṇaiśca vā kiṃ vai pītvā pādodakaṃ guroḥ ||56||
yo dadāti gurave’tra ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ ca śarkarām |
teneṣṭaṃ sarvamiṣṭānnaisteneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ śataiḥ ||17||
gṛhe’pi vasatastasya tīrthasnānaṃ dine dine |
dīkṣāsya sarvayajñeṣu yena santoṣito guruḥ ||58||
svarge martye ca pātāle guravaḥ santi tārakāḥ |
gurudevasamaṃ nāsti trailokye pāvanaṃ param ||59||
mānuṣe subhage loke saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ |
guroḥ prāptiḥ kṛtā yena yayā vā sevanaṃ guroḥ ||3.64.60||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ vastraṃ dravyaṃ ca bhojanam |
jāyate meruṇā tulyaṃ gurudevasamarpaṇāt ||61||
vidhihīnāpi yā nārī kriyāmantrādivarjitā |
gurubhaktārcayed bhaktyā tasyāḥ śāstroditaṃ phalam ||62||
nivasāmi sadā tatra dehe gurorgurau sadā |
skandhe yāne guruṃ kṛtvā yo’dhvānaṃ vahate janaḥ ||63||
tasya mārgo hyaniruddho mama dhāmno’sti sarvadā |
gurudevasthitiryatra tatra sannihito hariḥ ||64||
tatra tīrthaṃ mahādānaṃ kurukṣetraṃ ca naimiṣam |
puṣkaraṃ ca prayāgaṃ cāpyaśvapaṭṭasarastathā ||65||
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi viṣaturyasarastathā |
tatra nārāyaṇī cāpi tatrerāvatikā nadī ||66||
menakāṃgā ca tatraiva brahmaputrāpi tatra ca |
yatra gurornivāso’sti sarvatīrthāni tatra vai ||67||
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yatkiṃcijjāyate jane |
tatsarvaṃ nirdahatyāśu gurudevaprasevanam ||68||
gurormūrtirharermūtiryatrobhayorhi saṃgamaḥ |
tatra dvāravatī bodhyā muktidā bhaktirācyutī ||69||
gurvarcane na mantrāśca na japo na ca bhāvanā |
na dravyaṃ na hīrakādi nopadā netarattvapi ||3.64.70||
na stutirnāpi dainyaṃ ca premamātramapekṣate |
akṛtyasyāpyabhakṣyasyāpeyasya grahaṇe kṛte ||71 ||
yatpāpaṃ tad vinaśyedvai santuṣṭe śrīgurau harau |
pūjanaṃ kurute gurvyā nityaṃ śiṣyā tu yā satī ||72||
sevanaṃ kurute gurvyāḥ pādasaṃvāhanādikam |
anantottarakālaṃ sā vaidhavyaṃ vindate na vai ||73 ||
kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamāpannā padminī jāyate ramā |
guroḥ chāyāṃ samāśritya dadyād dānāni vai sadā ||74||
na jahyācca guroḥ pārśvaṃ yāmyabhīto janastviha |
guroragre yamadūtā na cāyānti kadācana ||75||
guroḥ sevā hareḥ sevā patyuḥ sevā yayā kṛtā |
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasyā yasyā gehe trayaṃ sadā ||76||
sanniyamyānyato vṛttīrgurudevasya toṣaṇam |
yā kuryānmānavī sādhvī bhaktyā sevāṃ ca pūjanam ||77||
yathāyogyaṃ vastūnāmarpaṇaṃ nivedanaṃ jalam |
śraddhayā gurave datte puṣpe puṣpe’śvamedhajam ||78||
phalaṃ sā vindate śiṣyā sākṣād guruhariśritā |
janmaduḥkhajarārogairmuktā sā mokṣagā matā ||79||
gavāmayutadānena yatphalaṃ prāpyate tviha |
gurave padmamālāṃ vai samarpyeyāddhi tatphalam ||3.64.80||
durlabhaṃ cāpi duṣprāpaṃ trailokye sacarācare |
tadapi prārthitaṃ lakṣmi gurusevā dadāti vai ||8 1||
aiśvaryaṃ santatiṃ jñānaṃ rājyaṃ ca sukhasampadaḥ |
gurukṛpā dadātyeva sevālabhyā hi sā matā ||82||
merumandaratulyāni pāpāni sarvathā layam |
yānti guroḥ sevanāddhi sākṣāddharirgururhi saḥ ||83||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti namaḥ śrīgurave tathā |
uktvā nityaṃ nameddevaṃ guruṃ hariṃ patiṃ prabhum ||84||
vrajet sā paramātmānaṃ dhāmākṣaranivāsinam |
śāśvatānandadātāraṃ hyanāmayapadasthitam ||85||
gurornāma harernāma paṭhate yā muhurmuhuḥ |
yāti sā paramaṃ dhāma punarjanma na vindati ||86||
kule tasyāśca ye jātāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ |
te’pi yānti paraṃ dhāma yayā santoṣito guruḥ ||87||
mahotsaveṣu sarveṣu guruṃ sampūjayet satī |
pūjayitryā gṛhe nityaṃ bhaveyurvai mahotsavāḥ ||88||
āṣāḍhe bhāvanābhijñā pūrṇāyāṃ pūjayed gurum |

snāpayeduṣṇasalilairgandhadravyairvilepayet |

śṛṃgārayecca śṛṃgārairarcayedakṣatādibhiḥ || 91 ||
puṣpacandanamālyaiśca samarcayed guruṃ satī |
vibhūṣā dhārayeccāpi dhūpadīpādi kārayet ||92||
phalāmiṣṭānnapānādi dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ prārpayeccāpi yathāvaibhavamuttamam ||93||
pādāmṛtaṃ pibeccāpi pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret |
gurvyāḥ sadāṅgamardādi kuryācchiṣyā satī śubham ||94||
yāne kṛtvā vāṭikāyāṃ mahodyāne gṛhe tathā |
guruṃ gurvīṃ nayedvāpi toṣayed bhaktisaṃbhṛtā ||95||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ paramaṃ gurum |
evaṃ prasādayet sādhvī vadhūryā śrīnarāyaṇi ||96||
anyā vā svapatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādayeddhi bhāvataḥ |
tathā yā svaguruṃ prasādayedvai sevayā satī ||97||
sarvāstā brahmarūpā vai mokṣagāḥ santi padmaje |
divyā divyasvarūpāśca parāyā divyatāpradāḥ ||98||
svasyāḥ samāgamaṃ prāptā yā yā bhavanti yoṣitaḥ |
tāstā divyāstathā bhūtvā prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ||99||
hariścāhaṃ sadā divyaḥ śaktirdivyā ca me sadā |
sā ca tvaṃ śrīstathā rādhā ramā prajñā ca māṇikī || 3.64.1 00||
lakṣmīrgaṃgā ca virajā padmāvatī ca mādhavī |
evamādyāḥ śaktayo me divyā brahmapriyā hi tāḥ || 101 ||
haripriyā na me bhinnā abhinnāstāḥ sadā mama |
vasanti śaktayaḥ sarvā gurvyāṃ gurau sadā priyāḥ || 1 02||
ahaṃ śaktisahito vai nivasāmi vadhūjane |
svāmijane nivasāmi sādhau patyau vasāmi ca || 1 03||
pūrayāmi manaḥkāmān tattadgurutvamāsthitaḥ |
evaṃ śrīśivarājñīśri māṃ prasevaya mādhavam || 1 04||
paṭhanāchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vandanādapi |
bhāvagrāhādapi muktirbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ sarvatithiṣu harerbhinnarūpasya pūjāgururūpasya sadā pūjā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||

<3.65>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri māhātmyaṃ parameśituḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gururūpiṇaḥ || 1 ||
mamaiva khalu māhātmyaṃ yathāvat pravadāmi te |
na ca tṛpyāmyahaṃ vaktuṃ nārīdayāvaśaṃvadaḥ || 2 ||
nityaṃ sampūjayet sādhvī mokṣasaubhāgyakāṃkṣiṇī |
snāpayeta jalairbhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtena mām || 3 ||
pañcagavyena salilairgandhacandanavāribhiḥ |
candanena sugandhena kuṃkumena gulālakaiḥ || 4 ||
abīreṇa tathā kāśmīreṇa kesaravāribhiḥ |
karpūrośīramiśreṇa lopayenmāṃ draveṇa ca || 5 ||
arcayed ruciraiḥ puṣpairgandhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ |
guggulaṃ goghṛtāktaṃ vai dadenme sannidhau satī || 6 ||
dīpakaṃ ca divārātrau dadyād ghṛtena sundarī |
naivedyaṃ dugdhapānādi kṣīrānnaṃ paramarpayet || 7 ||
evamabhyarcayenmāṃ ca praṇamyābhipraṇamya ca |
oṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇakāntāya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 8 ||
juhuyācca ghṛtābhyaktaistilavrīhiyavādibhiḥ |
tathaiva nāmnā mahyaṃ vai sarvamuktābhitṛptaye || 9 ||
kamalairmama caraṇau pūjayed bhaktivardhinī |
bilvapatrairjānudeśaṃ pūjayenme vilāsinī || 3.65.1 0||
jaghanaṃ me pūjayecca rājacampakapuṣpakaiḥ |
vakṣo me pūjayetsādhvī sthalapadmasupadmakaiḥ || 1 1||,
mastakaṃ pūjayed rāmā mālatyā vṛndayā tathā |
candanena samagraṃ ca śarīraṃ pūjayenmama || 1 2||
dehabuddhiṃ parityajya haribuddhyā prapūjayet |
sarvavidhāṃ mama sevāṃ brahmacaryayutācaret || 1 3||
patnībhirbhartṛvākyena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mama |
vidhavābhirmama vākyānmokṣasaukhyavivṛddhaye || 14||
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ kanyābhiḥ pūjanaṃ mama |
sarvasmṛddhipralābhārthaṃ naraiḥ kāryaṃ prapūjanam || 15||
etādṛśaṃ pūjanaṃ me mokṣadaṃ smṛddhidaṃ priye |
nārīvikrayapāpasya nāśakaṃ pūjanaṃ tvidam || 16||
pūjā bhaktiḥ kathitā te lakṣmi śreṣṭhāṃ ca tāṃ śṛṇu |
mallīnacittā yā bhaktiḥ sā bhaktiḥ paramā matā || 17||
premapravāhamagnāyā madvirahāsahiṣṇutā |
matsvarūpākāracittā bhaktiḥ sā paramottamā || 18||
uttamā cātmanā bhaktirmadhyamā manasā tu sā |
kaniṣṭhā varṣmaṇā bhaktistredhā bhavati mokṣadā || 19||
muktānāmātmanā bhaktiryogināṃ mānasī tathā |
ajñānāṃ dehajā bhaktistredhāpi mokṣadā matā ||3.65.20||
ātmabhaktyā sukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ manasā madhyamaṃ sukham |
dehena vai sukhaṃ svalpaṃ tredhā vibhidyate sukham || 21 ||
ātmanā brahmarūpeṇa hyānandaḥ śāśvato mama |
manasā divyabhāvena hyānando yogasāvadhiḥ ||22||
dehena kriyayānando dehakṣaṇādyapekṣakaḥ |
svārthānandaparā bhaktistāmasī mama sā matā ||23||
ubhayānandagarbhā sā rājasī bhaktirācyutī |
haryānandaparā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī svārthavarjitā ||24||
gurorbhaktirharerbhaktistādātmyena kṛtā yadi |
śīghraṃ sā phaladā lakṣmi sākṣādgururhi vai hariḥ ||25||
bhaktimatyāḥ striyā nityaṃ śāntiṃ kurvanti devatāḥ |
kṣemaṃ kurvanti śaṃbhvādyāḥ svasti yacchanti sādhavaḥ || 26 ||
puṇyaṃ yacchanti ṛṣayaścāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ |
śubhaṃ yānti grahāścāpi śubhaṃ yānti piśācakāḥ ||27||
rākṣasāśca śubhaṃ yānti prasannā munayo’pi ca |
lakṣmīḥ sthirā gṛhe tasyātiṣṭhatyeva sadā śubhā ||28||
rasāstiṣṭhanti tasyā vai madhūni mandire yathā |
miṣṭāmṛtāni tiṣṭhanti sudhā bhaktiyutāgṛhe ||29||
pīyūṣāṇi samastāni tiṣṭhanti ca mahotsavāḥ |
sarvavidhāni svargāṇi tiṣṭhanti bhaktiyuggṛhe ||3.65.30||
bhaktimatī sadā nārī rādhā lakṣmīrmatā mama |
śāradā kamalā kāntā śrīḥ padmā sā matā mama ||3 1||
yā kāpi jātisampannā bhajate māmananyagā |
sā mamaiva priyā bhaktā mokṣe muktānikā bhavet ||32||
yasyā darśanamātreṇa brahmahā api śuddhyati |
tadgṛhaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vāsarūpaṃ varaṃ matam ||33||
yatra bhaktaitādṛśī syānnārī nārāyaṇī śubhā |
iyaṃ sā kamalāmūrtirbhaktā vai pāpahāriṇī ||34||
kaivalyaphaladā sā vai yathā gaṃgā ramā yamī |
tiṣṭhatyetādṛśī bhaktā yatsthāne yatra mandire || 35||
yatkule bhūtale vāpi sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat |
kimatra bahunoktena bhaktā ramā ramā hi sā ||36 ||
ramāṃ matvā mama bhaktāṃ yā namiṣyanti satstriyaḥ |
tāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa brahmaghnī śuddhyati hyapi ||37||
dāsī bhāvena yā tasyāḥ sevanaṃ kurute’balā |
tasyāḥ puṇyaṃ na jānāti brahmāpi khalu padmaje ||38||
śaṃkhacakrānvitāṃ bhaktāṃ pūjayed yā tu vaiṣṇavī |
pūjitaṃ tena vai sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||39||
sa eva divaso dhanyo dhanyā mātāpi tatkulam |
pitā dhanyastathā sādhvyā yayā bhaktā prapūjitā ||3.65.40 ||
sarvā dhanyatamā sādhvyo mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
tāsāṃ darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpaṃ vilīyate ||41 ||
upapāpāni sarvāṇi prakīrṇakāni tāni vai |
sarvāṇyeva vinaśyanti vaiṣṇavīnāṃ hi darśanāt ||42||
pāvakā iva pāvanyo viṣṇubhaktāḥ striyaḥ sadā |
ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ laghu sthūlaṃ nāśayanti hi kalmaṣam ||43||
prāmādikaṃ hi yatpāpaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ tathā |
saṃsargajaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca naśyati drutameva ha ||44||
satīnāṃ darśanāllakṣmi sādhūnāṃ sevanāttathā |
svargaṃ prayānti niṣpāpāḥ pāpiṣṭhā yānti śuddhatām ||45||
saṃsārakarmapāśānāṃ mokṣaṇe vai viśāradī |
pāvanī pāvanānāṃ ca mama bhaktā sadā śubhā ||46||
pratyaha mama bhaktā yā māṃ prasmaratyaharniśam |
sā tu madrūpiṇī bodhyā hariṇī sā na saṃśayaḥ ||47||
bhrājatkarpūraśubhraṃ māṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamīnadhvajadhanurdharam ||48||
pītāmbaraṃ virājantaṃ kaustubhena samujjvalam |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ puṣṭaṃ vanamālādibhūṣitam ||49||
svarṇakuṇḍalabhāvyāptakapolavadanaṃ harim |
valayāṃgadanūpurakirīṭaraśanānvitam ||3.65.50||
prasannavadanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ vibhum |
vāmasakthisthapāṇḍuraśrīcihnapravirājitam ||5 1 ||
sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulordhvamāna pumuttamam |
caturbāhuṃ candraśubhrānanaṃ bhrūśararājitam ||52||
māmanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyati yā satī |
sā bhaktā vaiṣṇavīrūpā śrīrūpā matsvarūpiṇī ||53 ||
tasyāstu darśanenāpi bhaktyā vā bhojanena ca |
pūjanena kamale vai muktigā jāyate sakhī ||54||
tṛṣāturā yathā vāri tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi |
himākulā yathāgniṃ ca tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||55||
yathā patiṃ patidharmā tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi |
bhītā yathā svagoptāraṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||56 ||
lobhavatī yathā dravyaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi |
putrakāmā yathā putraṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||57||
vivāsitā yathā gehaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi |
cātakī ca yathā meghaṃ tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||58||
brahmavettrī yathā brahma tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi |
pitaraśca yathā piṇḍaṃ devā havyaṃ yathādhvare ||59||
ṛṣayaśca yathā mantrān mānavāḥ sampado yathā |
haṃsāśca mānasaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||3.65.60||
kāmukī kāminaṃ yadvad bhaktā bhajantameva yam |
mātāpatyaṃ yathā tadvanmāṃ sā smarati sādhvikā ||61 ||
bhaktimanto yathā kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktiṃ ca vaiṣṇavā yathā |
paśavaśca tṛṇaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||62|||
santo dharmaṃ sādhavaśca kṣamāṃ śreṣṭhī samarhaṇām |
prāṇī prāṇān vadhuścātmā tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||63||
jīvāścāyurbhramarāśca puṣpaṃ sūryaṃ tu cāṭikā |
vallabhā vallabhaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||64||
rātristhāśca yathā jyotiḥ śramārtāḥ śrāntimeva ca |
nidrāṃ jāgariṇo yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||65||
anālasā yathā siddhiṃ kariṇo’raṇyabhūmikām |
siṃhā gāḍhavanaṃ yadvat tadvanmāṃ sā smaratyapi ||66||
sūryakiraṇamāsādya sūryakānte’nalo yathā |
evaṃ sādhvīsusatsaṃgāddharau premavatī bhavet ||67||
candrakiraṇayogena candrakāntaḥ sravetsudhām |
evaṃ vai vaiṣṇavīyogāddharau bhaktistavo bhavet ||68||
kaumudīṃ prāpya ca yathā kumudaṃ saṃvikāsate |
gurvīṃ bhaktāṃ tathā prāpya hṛtpadmaṃ saṃvikāśate ||69||
yathā kīṭī bhramarīṃ ca smṛtvā bhramarī jāyate |
yogasmṛtyā tathā sādhvī smṛtvā māṃ matsamāyate ||3.65.70||
vadhvaśca kāmabuddhyaiva kṛṣṇarūpaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ |
tathā gopī ca māṃ smṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyate ||71||
kāciddhāsyāyate māṃ ca kācit snehāyate ca mām |
kācit spṛhāyate māṃ ca kācit svāmyāyate satī ||72||
premāyate ca kācicca kṛṣṇāyate ca bhāminī |
evaṃ māṃ bhaktiyogena samīpe vindate kṣaṇāt ||73||
sānnidhye’pi sthitaścāhaṃ dūre bhaktiṃ vinā sadā |
bhaktiyogena dṛśyeya bhaktābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||74||
devādyairamṛtaṃ prāptaṃ tathāpi duḥkhino hi te |
bhaktimevāmṛtaṃ prāpya duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ||75||
bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāsādya modate viṣṇusannidhau |
anyatsarvaṃ parityajya mama bhaktiṃ samāśrayet ||76||
prāpya dehaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ kriyate yad vṛthā hi tat |
viṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā naiva saṃsārābdhitarirbhavet ||77||
duḥkhadāvānaladagdhaṃ mama bhaktiḥ praśāmyati |
janmāntare’pi bhaktirme māmakīṃ vidadhāti vai ||78||
bhūtvā ca māmakī dāsī lakṣmīḥ prajāyate tataḥ |
reṇumātramapi bhaktermama dhāma dadāti vai ||79||
śataiśca śrūyate bhaktiḥ sahasrairapi budhyate |
lakṣaiśca bhajyate tatra bhaktā kācid ramā bhavet ||3.65.80||
buddhidā bahavo loke bhajamānastu kaścana |
tatrāpi ca tadātmatvaṃ prāptaḥ koṭigaṇe’dvayaḥ ||8 1 ||
pūjayā hasyate bhaktirjapairhāsayate tathā |
bhaktyā bhaktiḥ śaṃsyate ca mayā bhaktiḥ pragṛhyate ||82||
mūle siktasya vṛkṣasya śākhādalaphalodbhavaḥ |
tathā sikto harirbhaktyā bhaktānandaphalodbhavaḥ || 83||
yasyā vṛttiryādṛśī sā tathā bhaktiṃ karoti vai |
bhajanādeva me lakṣmi phalamagre hyavāpyate ||84||
pānīyahāriṇī yadvad ghaṭe tīre prakarṣaṇe |
cittaṃ dadāti tadvaccenmayi dadāti mucyate ||85||
yathā loke sthitaṃ vyoma bhūtairnaiva hi lipyate |
tathā loke sthitā bhaktā karmabhirnahi lipyate ||86||
divārātrau hi me bhaktā mamānandopajīvinaḥ |
te’trasthā api dhāmasthā divyā muktā hi te matāḥ ||87||
sarvamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ svargaṃ prapātavat |
mama bhaktyadhvaraphalaṃ punarāgamavarjitam ||88||
dṛṣṭamānantyamevāsyā bhakterme matprasādataḥ |
pāṣāṇo jalamadhyastho jalena lipyate na saḥ ||89||
bhakto māyāntarastho’pi māyayā lipyate na saḥ |
me bhaktasyāntare śaityaṃ vinā jalena madvaśāt ||3.65.90||
darduro vasati nīre gandhaṃ vetti na padmajam |
bhramaro’raṇyavāso’bjagandhaṃ pravetti vai sa tu ||91 ||
ahaṃ vasāmi hṛdaye bahirvṛttirna vetti mām |
premabhaktiyuto dūrastho’pi vetti hṛdi sthitam ||92||
gaṃgātaṭe vasantyeke vasantyanye’rbudācale |
māhātmyavit phalaṃ tvatti tathā bhaktiyuto janaḥ ||93||
gardabhaścandanabhāraṃ vahate gandhameti na |
bahiḥsthaścāntarasthaṃ māṃ na vetti naiti matsukham ||94||
mṛgā jighranti rasyāni kastūrīgandhavedinaḥ |
svanābhisthaṃ na jānanti tathā māṃ vai bahirmukhāḥ ||95||
mūrkhāṇāṃ jñānaśūnyānāmupadeśo nirarthakaḥ |
tathā madbhaktiśūnyānāmānando’pi nirarthakaḥ ||96||
sarpapītaṃ payaḥ kṣveḍaṃ śaṭhabhaktistathāvidhā |
andho dīpaṃ vīkṣate na tathā māṃ vai bahirmukhaḥ ||97||
veṣeṇa ca yathā carmaṃ carmaṇā varṣma saṃvṛtam |
varṣmaṇendriyakaṃ yadvattathendriyairhi vāsanā ||98||
tayāvṛtaśca jīvātmā tenāhaṃ vai samāvṛtaḥ |
aṇoraṇīyān cāntaḥstho vasāmyātmā na caiti mām ||99||
dugdhe ghṛtaṃ tile tailaṃ vidyate’haṃ tathā vidhaḥ |
vidye sarvatra māṃ naiva jānanti bahiricchavaḥ || 3.65.10 0||
ekasūtre yadā protā maṇayo mayi tattathā |
sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvathā protāścātmāno na vidanti mām || 10 1||
yathā kāṣṭhādigo vahnirmathanād dṛśyate bahiḥ |
tathā tvātmasthitaścāhaṃ dṛśye bhaktipramanthanāt || 1 02||
yathā dīpāt prabhavanti dīpāścānye hyapekṣitāḥ |
tathā guroḥ prajāyante sarvajñā bhaktimuktigāḥ || 1 03||
yathārkasyodaye jyotiḥ sarvatraiva prakāśate |
tathā bhāgyodaye svāmī guruḥ svayaṃ prakāśate || 104||
yathā vāyuḥ sarvagaśca sarvagandhavahastathā |
gururhariḥ sarvagaśca karmabhaktiphalāvahaḥ || 1 05||
nīraṃ yādṛgrasāḍhyaṃ vai tādṛgraso mukhe bhavet |
ātmā yādṛkpremapūrṇastathānandaraso nije || 106 ||
pṛthvī naikarasairyuktā nānāsasyasvarūpiṇī |
ātmā naikasukhāḍhyaśca nānābrahmasukhānvitaḥ || 1 07||
saccidānandarūpo’yaṃ hyātmā bhakto’timodavān |
mamānandena saṃyukto mahānandī prajāyate || 108||
mamānandaṃ mama bhaktiṃ lakṣmi yā vetti vai hṛdi |
sā bhaktā kamalātulyā mama dhāmābhiyāyinī || 109||
ahaṃ vasāmi sarvatra lokā jānanti naiva mām |
avidyayā na jānanti cābhaktyā na vidanti mām || 3.65.11 0||
sarvakarmāṇi cet kuryurviṣṇudaivatakāni vai |
taireva nirguṇairyogaiścāpnuvanti puraḥsthitam || 11 1||
evamuktaṃ mayā lakṣmi mama sānnidhyamadbhutam |
vicārya prāpya vijñāya bhajitvā māmavāpnuyāt || 1 12||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ bhagavaduktabhaktimāhātmyotkarṣanirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||

<3.66>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri caiko’haṃ bahudhāpi ca |
nāmarūpavibhedena yugabhedena vai tathā || 1 ||
bhaktabhedena ca kāryabhedena saṃbhavāmi vai |
pratyātmaniyataścāsmi sarvajantuṣu sarvadā || 2 ||
madicchā hi mahāmāyā mūlaprakṛtireva sā |
rādhā lakṣmīrmama śaktidvayaṃ madātmakaṃ hi tat || 3 ||
pradhānaṃ triguṇaṃ cāpi mayā tādṛgvidhaṃ kṛtam |
tatra jīvā anantā vai cetanā nivasanti hi || 4 ||
pradhānāt prabhavantyeva bhūtāni dehahetavaḥ |
dehāstasmātprajāyante jīvādīnāṃ gṛhāṇi vai || 5 ||
sattvamāyāmayo viṣṇuścāhaṃ bhavāmi padmaje |
rajomāyāmayo brahmā cāhaṃ bhavāmi padmajaḥ || 6 ||
tamomāyāmayaḥ śaṃbhuścāhaṃ bhavāmi bhālajaḥ |
tatra sarvatra vai cāhaṃ parameśo vasāmi ca || 7 ||
ataḥ sarvagataścāhaṃ tridevasṛṣṭimaṇḍale |
avidyayā na jānanti gūḍhaṃ lokā guhāśayam || 8 ||
vidyayā vai prajānanti sādhavo yatisattamāḥ |
brahmajñānaṃ hi sā vidyāparā yatra mamāśrayaḥ || 9 ||
vedāvasānamevaitad yatrāhaṃ varṇitaḥ priye |
ātmanā cāpyate brahma paraṃ vibhu sanātanam || 3.66.1 0||
manasā cintyate brahma cakṣuṣā dṛśyate tathā |
dehenāśliṣyate brahma kṛpayā prāpyate hariḥ || 1 1||
śuddhena manasā yuktātmanā saṃsevyate hariḥ |
manasā bandhunā grāhyaṃ parabrahma sanātanam || 12||
manasā bandhunā tyājyaṃ māyāyāḥ paṭalaṃ khalu |
manasā bandhunā jīvāstīryante brahmayoginā || 13||
manasā śatruṇā jīvāḥ pātyante viṣayārthinā |
divyena manasā dhyātvā śrīpatiṃ māṃ pareśvaram || 14||
divyāṃ kriyāṃ prakurvan vai kurvannapi na lipyate |
padmapatraṃ yathā nīragataṃ vārbhirna lipyate || 15||
mano māyāgataṃ cāpi madyogi lipyate na vai |
yadā brahmarasaṃ vetti tadānyallavaṇāyate || 16||
yadā bhaktirasaṃ vetti tadānyad garalāyate |
yadā sevārasaṃ vetti rājyaṃ tasya malāyate || 17||
yadā premarasaṃ vetti sarvamanyad ghṛṇāyate |
yadā mūlyaṃ mama vetti sarvaṃ vai kaccarāyate || 18||
yadānandāśanaṃ vetti muktyādyasya na rocate |
mamānandapravāhasthaṃ cānyadvetti na vai yadā || 1 9||
tadā pravāhabhāvena dravatāmeti mānasam |
dravabhaktyā prāpya māṃ tādātmyayogamṛcchati ||3.66.20 ||
guroryogācchāstrayogājjñānaṃ divyamavāpyate |
vijñānaṃ cāpyate’bhyāsaistato jñeyamavāpyate ||21 ||
jñeyo’haṃ paramātmā ca śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
yadā prāptastadā śūnyaṃ māyāmayaṃ prajāyate || 22||
bhāvaśuddhiścāgrapadā manaḥśuddhistataḥ parā |
ātmaśuddhiścordhvapadā tābhiścāvāpyate hariḥ ||23||
nāryo bahuvidhāḥ santi hyāśliṣyanti ca naikadhā |
yathā bhāvaśca sambandhastathā phalaṃ kriyādikam ||24||
āliṅgyate nijā kāntā yathā bhāvastathā phalam |
āliṅgyate harirjīvairyathā bhāvastathā phalam ||25||
samprāpyate yayā buddhyā tathā cāvāpyate phalam |
yathā buddhyā hi māmeti tathā dadāmi vai phalam ||26 ||
śreṣṭhaṃ cātmānandaphalaṃ prāptavyaṃ sevayā sadā |
prasannatāprayojyo vai mahānandā mayārpyate ||27||
prasannatānukūlyena prātikūlyavivarjanāt |
aśaṃkasevayā bhaktyā prasannatā prajāyate ||28||
na sā krayeṇa labhyā vā na vā kṣaṇādibuddhibhiḥ |
na vā tātkālikī prāpyā svārthavṛttyā na labhyate ||29||
na mānena na vai cāturyeṇa naipuṇyakena na |
na sā sveṣṭamanovṛttyā kintu sarvārpaṇe na sā ||3.66.30||
sarvājñāpālanenaiva dainyabhāvena labhyate |
kaiṃkaryeṇa ca dāsyena tadīyatvena labhyate ||3 1||
so’haṃ matvā madīya taṃ tāṃ ca vai tādṛśīṃ satīm |
matvā prasannatāṃ kurve prāpto bhavāmi vai tataḥ ||32||
yenāhamasmi prāptavyastena bhāvyaṃ nivedinā |
svopānaddhāraṇe yadvat pṛthvī niṣkaṇṭakā tathā ||33||
svasmin dāsye’rjite māyā nirbandhā divyatāpradā |
svasmin bhṛtye’rjite māyā svāmitāvirahāsya vai ||34||
svasmin dainye’rjite māyā sattāśūnyāsya sarvathā |
svasmin sarvārpite prāpte māyā nirāśatāṃ vrajet ||35||
buddhirbrahmavidhā syāccenmāyākāryaṃ vilīyate |
māyāmayī tu yā buddhiḥ sā jagajjanmadāyinī ||36||
viṣavallī dugdhasiktā viṣabhāvaṃ na muñcati |
buddhirāsurabhāvā cedāsuratāṃ na muñcati ||37||
śarkarārasapāno’pi nimbaḥ kaṭutaro bhavet |
tathāsurasvabhāvo vai māṃ na kadāpi rocate ||38||
tādṛśānāṃ jagajjānāṃ śāstravrāto nirarthakaḥ |
naiva svabhāvaṃ tyajati satsaṃgaṃ na karotyapi ||39||
bhaktirna rocate yasya sneho naisargiko na ca |
mumukṣutā na yasyāsti nāstikatvaṃ pramodate ||3.66.40||
tasya śāśvatamodāśā vyomapuṣpāyate sadā |
chitvā cāmradrumaṃ kasmāt phalaṃ puṣpaṃ samīyate ||41 ||
bhittvā bhaktiṃ ca sevāṃ ca kathaṃ sukhamavāpyate |
indriyāṇāṃ sukhārthitve vṛthā janma hi dehinaḥ ||42||
chitvā karpūrakhaṇḍāni kutṛṇāni prarakṣati |
rasapuṣpādihīnāni vṛthā yatno’sya tatra vai ||43||
satāṃ sevāṃ vinindyaiva duṣṭasevāṃ karoti ca |
puṇyakarmavihīnāṃ vai vṛthā yatno’sya sarvathā ||44||
svarṇasthālyāṃ vṛṣalena pacyate saramāmiṣam |
naradehe tu pāpena pacyate yamayātanā ||45||
janmarogī vṛthājanmā māyārogī vṛthāmanuḥ |
vṛthāśramo’gṛhakośī vṛthāmṛtyurhariṃ vinā ||46||
vṛthā vāco mahāmūrkhe cāsaṃyame vṛthauṣadham |
hariṃ vinā vṛthā yātrā viḍvāhi janma vai vṛthā ||47||
sarvanāthaṃ hariṃ tyaktvā vānaraṃ sevate tu yaḥ |
tattulyo dehamātrasya poṣako mokṣavarjitaḥ ||48||
vinā bhaktiṃ bahuvidyāgamasyāpi phalaṃ nu kim |
yenātmaśāntirnaivāsti tasmācchāntipradaṃ bhajet ||49||
kiṃ tena lakṣmi dehena candanādiprasevinā |
yena sevāharernaiva naiva satāṃ na mokṣaṇam ||3.66.50 ||
śvapaco’pi yadi bhaktiyuto janmāsya sārthakam |
vipradeho’pi nirbhakto janmāsya nirayapradam ||51||
maṇikaṃkaṇamābaddhvā darpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ yathā |
satāṃ satsaṃgamāsādya vṛthā tadanyasādhanam ||52||
dṛḍhāśritā na gṛhṇanti dattaiśvaryaṃ surādibhiḥ |
dṛḍhabhaktā na gṛhṇanti dattaiśvaryaṃ harerapi ||53||
anicchukasya bhaktasya jayaścāste pade pade |
na taṃ pralobhituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi vai ||54||
icchayā badhyate dehī tṛṣṇayā tu vinaśyati |
dvābhyāmūrdhvasthitāyātra dātuṃ nālaṃ hyapi prabhuḥ ||55||
nityatṛptasya śāntasya dhairyaṃ tyājayituṃ hyalam |
nirbhayasyāpi bhaktasya kaścinnāsti jagattraye ||56||
bhaktaṃ caitādṛśaṃ naijaṃ rañjayituṃ narāyaṇaḥ |
bhavāmyahaṃ dṛśyavacca yena dhyāto bhavāmi ca || 57||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā ca māṃ janāḥ |
sākāraṃ divyarūpaṃ vai śāśvataṃ dhāmagaṃ hi mām ||58||
asaṃkhyadehino bhaktā gatā me paramākṣaram |
pūjāṃ bhaktiṃ divyasevāṃ vidhāya bhṛtyatāṃ tathā ||59||
dāsatāṃ savidhāyāpi pātivratyaṃ vidhāya ca |
vidhāya mama dāsītāṃ gatā nāryo mamākṣaram ||3.66.6 0||
śūnye bhaktirna bhavati bhaktirbhavati sākṛtau |
ādhārarūpe nāthe śrīpatau mayi pareśvare |||6 1 ||
vidhāya premabhaktiṃ vai śrīvanmāṃ svāminaṃ patim |
prāpuḥ pūrvatarā nāryo jārabhāvamupāśritāḥ ||62||
kiṃ punarnijayoṣāśca sarvasvārpaṇasaṃśritāḥ |
tasmāllakṣmi svayaṃ svāmī sākāro’haṃ prabhuḥ patiḥ ||63||
sukhadaḥ śāśvatānandaprado bhūtvā nayāmyapi |
kāsāñciddarśane snehaḥ kāsāñcitsparśane’dhikaḥ ||64||
kāsāñcidramaṇe snehaḥ kāsāñcit svapane’pi ca |
kāsāñcitkāmasaṃbhoge kāsāñcidrāsakarmaṇi ||65||
kāsāñcid bhojane snehaḥ kāsāñcit snānakeliṣu |
kāsāñciccūmbanādau ca kāsāñcittu mahotsave ||66||
kāsāñcitsahavāse ca kāsāñcit tvaviyojane |
kāsāñcinnijaśayyāyāṃ kāsāñcinnarmakarmasu ||67||
kāsāñcittu rahasye vai sneho mayi vibhāvyate |
tāsāṃ sampūrya kāmām̐śca namāmi dhāma me’kṣaram ||68||
guṇī tāṃ guṇavadbhāryāṃ muktānikāṃ vidhāya vai |
nayāmi kāntarūpo’haṃ śāśvatānandadhāma me ||69||
sevāraso hi sākāre labhyate sundarīgaṇaiḥ |
bhaktaiḥ sevārasaḥ pūrṇaḥ prāpyate mayi dhāmani ||3.66.70||
mamaiva hi prasādena romāñcitaśarīriṇī |
nayanānandasalilā muktidāsī vadhūrbhavet ||71 ||
vāṇyā gāyati māṃ dāsī manasā māṃ smaratyapi |
karmaṇā māṃ harṣayati kaṭidānārpaṇādibhiḥ ||72||
pūjājapārcanasevāpādasammardanādibhiḥ | |
rahasyārpaṇabhāvaiśca labhate śāśvataṃ sukham ||73||
sākāre mayi bhaktā me dehabhāvaiḥ prasevayā |
sarvendriyairmahāsaukhyaṃ labhate lokavat sakhī ||74||
vadhūrbhūtvā varaṃ kāntaṃ sevate māṃ patiṃ prabhum |
sarvān kāmān pūrayāmi kāmadvārā hi yoṣitaḥ ||75||
na me kāmo ratirnaiva na me kāmasukhaṃ priye |
pūrṇakāmasya me ratyā kiṃ kāmena prayojanam ||76||
sarvānandaparipūrṇamūrterme nāstyapūrṇatā |
nendriyādhīnatā cāpi kiṃ kāmena prayojanam ||77||
kāmo mayā kṛtaḥ pūrvaḥ karmiṇāṃ sukhalabdhaye |
māyāmayo hi kāmo vai ratirmāyāmayī tathā ||78||
tayā tena na me kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ hi māyikam |
kintu dehavaśā lokā narā nāryo nijāniva ||79||
kāmān bhāvān kalpayanti mayi pūrṇe sanātane |
taistairbhāvaistathā tām̐stāḥ saṃgṛhya kāmabhāvitāḥ ||3.66.80||
kāmadvārāpi me yogaṃ datvā nayāmi dhāma me |
mokṣapadaṃ prāpayāmi kāmināmapi sundarīḥ ||8 1||
kṛpā me tādṛśī bodhyā saṃsāro hi tathāvidhaḥ |
aindriyikā hi me bhaktāḥ saṃmatāḥ santi bhūtale ||82||
vaiṣayikāstathā bhaktāḥ sthale sthale vasanti vai |
ātmikā brahmabhāvāstu kvacitsanti hi paṇḍitāḥ ||83||
ato ye māṃ yathā yānti tathā tān prāpya tadvidhaḥ |
mokṣayogaṃ pradatvaivaṃ nayāmi dhāma me’kṣaram ||84||
prāyaśo yoṣitāṃ siddhiṃ kartuṃ bhavāmi kāmavān |
tāsāṃ kāmaprasaktānāṃ kathamuddharaṇaṃ bhavet ||85||
tasmād dayāvaśo bhūtvā seve kāmīva tāḥ sadā |
divyarūpā vidhāyaiva nayāmi mokṣamuttamam ||86||
vadhūḥ kanyā yuvatīśca vṛddhā vāpi pativratāḥ |
napuṃsakī ca vidhavā sadhavā brahmacāriṇī ||87||
yatinī yoginī sādhvī satī cāryā virāgiṇī |
sanyāsinī vicittā ca tāpasī vānaprasthinī ||88||
tyāginī sāṃkhyayogasthā śaktirvā gaṇikāpi vā |
puṃścalī svairiṇī cāpi kāminī kāmavarjitā ||89||
raṇḍā ṣaṇḍhā ratiśūnyā rajaḥsthā cārajo’nvitā |
gaurī vā rohiṇī cāpi kumārikā śavātmikā ||3.66.90 ||
saṃskṛtā cāsaṃskṛtā vā śuddhāśuddhā ca varjitā |
tyaktā mantravatī cāpi dīkṣitā vā ca nyakkṛtā ||91||
vivāsitā vanahāristrī yadvā śvapacī khasī |
pramadā vā nirmadā vā vyabhicāraparāyaṇā ||92||
muṇḍā vā keśinī vāpi durbhāgyā subhagāthavā |
kubjā hrasvā sendriyā vā nirindriyā hyudāsinī ||93||
yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi sūtikā pāśavī ca vā |
godharmā vā mṛgīdharmā yā vā kā vā bhavatyapi ||94||
kāṣāmbarā vā raktā vā viraktā haridambarā |
dhvajāmbarā vā devī vā daityānī rākṣasī ca vā ||95||
dānavī nāginī nagnā pakṣiṇī jāntavī ca vā |
vārkṣī vā vallikābhāvā śarabhī siṃhikāpi vā ||96||
śvāpadī vā bahupadī pṛṣṭhapadī piśācikā |
ārṣī brāhmī paitṛkī vā mātā vā kṣetrarakṣikā ||97||
pakṣiṇī kinnarī vāpi gāndharvī nartakī ca vā |
veśyā vāpi vyavāyasthā sahasraliṃginī ca vā ||98||
īśvarī vā mānavī vā bhūtī pretī ca ḍākinī |
nikṛṣṭā pāpakartrī vā yā kācinmāmupāgatā ||99||
yathā bhāvena tāṃ labdhvā pāvayitvā nṛpīmapi |
aśuddhāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ kṛtvā nayāmi dhāma me’kṣaram || 3.66.100 ||
tadarthaṃ puṃsvarūpo’haṃ bhavāmi mānavo hariḥ |
samuddhartuṃ yoṣitāṃ vai gaṇām koṭisahasraśaḥ || 101 ||
rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra lakṣmi kāmaguṇo vṛṣaḥ |
māmāsādya hi dharmātmā kāmo bhavati mokṣakṛt || 1 02||
nārīṇāṃ yonisambandhaścotkṛṣṭasnehakārakaḥ |
tathā kṛtvā nayāmyeva nārīḥ sarvā pare’kṣare || 1 03||
śrutvā cāpi paṭhitvedaṃ rahasyaṃ divyatāpradam |
nārāyaṇīyaṃ mokṣāḍhyaṃ dhāma yāsyanti matpadam || 104||
saṃśayaṃ tvatra yā nāryo narā vā yānti tāstu te |
puṇyaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ hitvā hyadho yāsyanti doṣiṇaḥ || 1 05||
apātrāṇāṃ saṃśayā vai bhavanti lokavādinām |
matpātrāṇāṃ saṃśayā no bhavanti divyavedinām || 1 06||
vadhūgītārahasyaṃ vai yaccāste hṛdaye mama |
vadhūmokṣapradaṃ te’tra niḥsaṃkocena bodhitam || 1 07||
vadhūmūlyaṃ mamāvāsādākṛṣṭiḥ priyatāpi ca |
boddhavyaṃ śiṣyate naivādhikaṃ loke hi yoṣitām || 1 08||
kāmabhāvena yuktānāṃ mokṣado’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
nijadharmaṃ prathamaṃ vai puraskṛtya bhajeddharim || 1 09||
nārīdharmo hi ratyāsti kāmadharmaḥ puraskṛtaḥ |
madyoge brahmacaryaṃ tat kāmo nāryāṃ vrataṃ param || 3.66.11 0||
svadharme maraṇaṃ śreyaḥ harerdharmo hi mokṣadaḥ |
svadharme mokṣaṇaṃ syādvai hareyogānna saṃśayaḥ || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ vadhūbhaktirahasyanirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||

<3.67>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ hṛdyaṃ nivedayāmi te |
ahaṃ vai sarvajīvānāṃ sādhāraṇo mahāprabhuḥ || 1 ||
māmārādhyaiva sarve’tra sṛṣṭāvaiśvaryaśālinaḥ |
bhavantyeva tatastebhyo dadāmyaiśvaryamarthitam || 2 ||
yathākarmaphalaṃ deyaṃ nyāyo’yaṃ mama sarvadā |
prasannatā phalaṃ riktaṃ viśeṣo’yaṃ mama gṛhe || 3 ||
paritoṣikarūpā me prasannatā hi sevake |
kāryakare yatnavati prasannatā nisargajā || 4 ||
nāryā nare ca vā sṛṣṭau karomi yatra tatra vā |
pārvatyāṃ cāpi sāmudryāṃ dvīpinyāṃ vānyayoṣiti || 5 ||
hārityāṃ vāpyamaryāṃ vā gauryāṃ paryāṃ ca vā tathā |
rāśiyānyāṃ ca vā brāhmyāṃ raudryāṃ vaninyāṃ yoṣiti || 6 ||.
mānasyāṃ vā tatheśānyāṃ daridrāyāṃ tathā ca vā |
antyajāyāṃ pūrvajāyāṃ madhyajāyāṃ tathāpi vā || 7 ||
dhīvaryāṃ vā śabaryāṃ vā yavanyāṃ vā tathā punaḥ |
piśaṃgyāṃ prācīnakāyāṃ cābriktāyāmathāpi vā || 8 ||
śvetāyāṃ vāpi kṛṣṇāyāṃ citrāyāṃ vāpi yoṣiti |
tathāvidhe nare vāpi bhakte deve tathārṣake || 9 ||
īśvare vāpi mukte vā yatra prasannatā mama |
tatra tatra hi sarveṣāṃ ratnānāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā || 3.67.1 0||
aiśvaryāṇāṃ samastānāṃ siddhīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā |
sampadāṃ ca samastānāmṛddhīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā || 11 ||
ānandānāṃ sukhānāṃ ca pramodānāmasaṃkhyatā |
utsavānāṃ tathotsāhavilāsānāmasaṃkhyatā || 12||
lakṣmīnāṃ śreyasāṃ cāpi bhogyānāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā |
sarveṣāmapi kāmānāṃ tṛptīnāṃ syādasaṃkhyatā ||13||
yatrāhaṃ ca prasannaḥ syāṃ pāritoṣikarūpavān |
tatrākṣaraṃ padaṃ me ca svarg paraṃ vasatyapi || 14||
vada lakṣmi kathaṃkāraṃ nyūnatvaṃ saṃbhavettataḥ |
sarvaṃ divy bhavatyeva sarv sarvottamaṃ mama || 15||
bhaktagṛhaṃ mama gṛhaṃ bhakto’haṃ cāhameva saḥ |
ityevaṃ vartate hṛdyaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ mamaiva ha || 16||
mama sarvaṃ ca bhaktasya bhedo manāṅ na vidyate |
kā māyā kaśca kālo vā prabhurvai manniveśane || 17||
yatrāhaṃ saṃvasāmyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hi tat |
mṛttikāgṛharūpaṃ vai śāśvataṃ tatparaṃ padam || 18||
yatrāhaṃ nāsmi tatsaudhaṃ vimānamapi nārakam |
yatrāhaṃ na vasāmyeṣā bhūmiḥ śmaśānarūpiṇī |
yatrāhaṃ sevito naiva ramaṇī sāpi rākṣasī || 19||
nāśliṣṭo’haṃ yayā lakṣmi sā bhūtī ca piśācinī |
yenāhaṃ vandito naiva samāśliṣṭo na mādhavaḥ ||3.67.20||
sa cātra vidyate bhūto rākṣaso janmakhādakaḥ |
māmāśritya piśācāśca bhavanti devatottamāḥ || 2 1||
piśācinyo’pi māṃ prāpya jāyante brahmayoṣitaḥ |
doṣāḥ piśācāstadvatyaḥ piśācinyo bhavanti vai ||22||
guṇā muktā hi tadvatyo muktānyastā bhavanti vai |
ahaṃbrahmetijñāninyo brahmapatnyo bhavanti vai ||23||
parabrahmaśritāḥ sarvā haripatnyo bhavanti vai |
hariṃ māṃ vai parityajya tapo duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ caret ||24||
pareśena vinā kācinnaiva siddhimavāpnuyāt |
brahmaṇā nirmitā dehā dehadharmā hyanantakāḥ ||25||
brahmadharmā dehadharmā mano dharmāstathāntarāḥ |
lokadharmāstathā tena nirmitāḥ sarvasaukhyadāḥ ||26||
mama dharmāstu nityā vai brahmāpi nirmito mayā |
mama nityān parān dharmānāśritya māṃ prayāti saḥ ||27||
mama prasannatā hyeva dharmo me divyatāpradaḥ |
brahmadharmān susatkṛtya mama dharmān samācaret ||28||
kartavyaṃ vidyate nāsyā mama dharmārthayoṣitaḥ |
svadharmo’yaṃ mama dharmaḥ śuklaśca nirguṇaśca saḥ || 29||
śukladharmeṇa vai stheyaṃ śuklaṃ deyaṃ na me sadā |
svalpaṃ śuklaṃ ca me dattamānantyāya prajāyate ||3.67.30||
śuklaṃ madarthamevātra līlayāpi kṛtaṃ ca vā |
indriyādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ vāpi śuklaṃ dhāmani cāpyate ||3 1||
puṇyaṃ śuklaṃ mama kāryaṃ tadvato’ghaṃ na jāyate |
duḥkhaṃ naiva tathā māyā naiva janma kuto mṛtiḥ ||32||
tasmāt stheyaṃ sadānandapūrṇatayā madāśritaiḥ |
māmanāśritya bandhena karmaṇātra vahanti ye ||33||
bhāraṃ vai vāsanājanyaṃ te bhavanti punaḥ punaḥ |
śākhāmṛgo yathā yāti prativṛkṣaṃ tathā hi saḥ ||34||
nīyate karmaṇā jīvaḥ saṃsāravanayoniṣu |
krīḍārthaṃ kanduko yadvat kṣipyate raṃgabālakaiḥ ||35||
tathāyaṃ karmabhiḥ kṣetre kṣipyate māyike stare |
baddho’śvo na svatantro’sti vihartuṃ yātumeva vā ||36||
karmabaddho na svatantraḥ surarṣipitṛmānuṣe |
manuṣyā bhūtale śreṣṭhāḥ kintu te pakṣavarjitāḥ ||37||
pakṣiṇo vyomagāścāpi hastasādhanavarjitāḥ |
devā divyasvarūpāśca kṣitisthaulyādivarjitāḥ ||38||
nāryo rūpaguṇāḍhyāśca niyāmyāstāstathākṛtāḥ |
vṛddhāḥ pūjyā nirmitāśca kintvadhikāravarjitāḥ ||39||
sādhikārā yuvānaśca dīrghānubhavavarjitāḥ |
gajo hi balavānāste kintu sādhanavarjitaḥ ||3.67.40||
siṃho vai balavān rājā paśustāmasasattamaḥ |
hariṇaḥ pāvanaścāste kintu vanyaḥ paśuḥ kṛtaḥ ||41 ||
viprā vidyānidhayo’pi dāridryaroṣapīḍitāḥ |
kākāḥ śakunacaturāḥ kintu malinayonijāḥ ||42||
maṇayo mauktikāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kintu te durlabhāḥ kṛtāḥ |
kaṭutṛṇāni bahūni miṣṭāni durlabhāni vai ||43||
sulabhā vai kāpuruṣā durlabhāḥ sādhavaḥ priye |
satyaḥ sādhvyo durlabhāśca sulabhā vārayoṣitaḥ ||44||
patrāṇi santi bahūni phalāni durlabhāni vai |
bhoginaḥ santi sulabhā durlabhāstu virāgiṇaḥ ||45||
kīṭakāḥ santi sarvatra phaṇādhrā durlabhāḥ priye |
maraṇaṃ sulabhaṃ lakṣmi cāmṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ bahu ||46||
kalahaḥ sulabho lakṣmi melanaṃ durlabhaṃ bahu |
svārthaḥ sarvatra sulabhaḥ parārtho durlabhaḥ sadā ||47||
bhogastu sulabho lakṣmi mokṣo’sti durlabhaḥ sadā |
pumāṃsaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi pumuttamastu durlabhaḥ ||48||
puruṣaḥ sulabhaścāste durlabhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
nāryaḥ sarvatra labhyante nārāyaṇī tu durlabhā ||49||
udyogaḥ sarvathā prāpyaḥ sevā tu durlabhā priye |
dehastu bahudhā labhyaścātmā vai durlabhaḥ priye ||3.67.50||
gṛhaṃ tu sulabhaṃ labhyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tu durlabham |
garbhastu sulabho lakṣmi hiraṇyagarbho hi durlabhaḥ ||51 ||
khanayaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi brahmaśṛṃgaṃ hi durlabham |
vāsanāḥ sulabhā lakṣmi vāsudevo hi durlabhaḥ ||52||
patayaḥ sulabhā lakṣmi durlabhaḥ śāśvataḥ patiḥ |
svāminaḥ sulabhā loke parasvāmī hi durlabhaḥ ||13||
sarvaṃ vai sulabhaṃ lakṣmi kṛṣṇo’haṃ durlabhaḥ sadā |
māyā vai sulabhā loke māyeśo’haṃ tu durlabhaḥ ||54||
samarthasvāminā lakṣmi karmayonirnirasyate |
karmabaddhaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṛṣṇo’haṃ tārayāmi vai ||55||
toyaṃ sarvatra sulabhaṃ viṣṇupadvāri durlabham |
durlabheṣu samasteṣu viṣṇupadaṃ hi durlabham |||56||
durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhaktimatāṃ karomi sarvathā |
evaṃ kṛtvā sevināṃ me karma sarvaṃ hi muktidam ||57||
vada lakṣmi kṛpā me’tra kāraṇaṃ pāritoṣikam |
tallabdhvā puṇyamutkṛṣṭaṃ mamānandapadaṃ vrajet ||58||
mayi tyāgo durlabho vai tadanyaḥ sulabhaḥ khalu |
mayi nyāso durlabho vai tadanyaḥ sulabhaḥ sadā ||59||
anyārpaṇaṃ tu sulabhaṃ mayyarpaṇaṃ hi durlabham |
anyayatno’pi sulabho madarthaḥ sa tu durlabhaḥ ||3.67.60 ||
anyārthatā hi sulabhā madarthatā hi durlabhā |
anyavadhūtvaṃ sulabhaṃ vadhūtvaṃ mama durlabham ||61 ||
māyikaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ madīyaṃ durlabhaṃ priye |
kṛtaśrayā vijānāti hyaśramāyā na vedanam ||62||
kiyadyatnena labhyo’haṃ jānāti śrīrnarāyaṇī |
satī haimī vijānāti kathaṃ labhyo hi śaṃkaraḥ ||63||
māṇikyāśvī vijānāti kathaṃ dhārmirhi labhyate |
rādhā kṛṣṇā ca kamalā vijānanti pariśramam |||64||
gāyatrī naiva jānāti naiva jānāti cābdhijā |
padmāvatī vijānāti kathaṃ labhyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||65|
labdhakṛpāṃśavanitā na jānāti tapaḥśramam |
jānanti yogino yuktāḥ sādhvyo jānanti tacchramam ||66||
yoginyaśca vijānanti tāpasyo dehaśoṣikāḥ |
tvaṃ lakṣmi kiṃ vijānāsi hanūmatparvate tapaḥ ||67||
kṛtvā śrameṇa labdhavatyasi māṃ puruṣottamam |
mṛtyorvinimaye labhyo bhavāmi nānyathā priye ||68||
bāhyaṃ ca mānasaṃ sarvaṃ madarthaṃ yasya jīvitam |
madarthaṃ tyajanaṃ sarvaṃ sa māṃ prāpnoti vai śramāt ||69||
madarthaṃ yasya sarvasvaṃ yasyā madarthinī kṛtiḥ |
yasyāstyāgā madarthāśca sā māṃ prāpnoti vai śramāt ||3.67.70||
śuddhagehāptakāyā ca yoginī yogiputrikā |
madarthakṛtasarvasvā māṃ prāpnotīva bhārgavī ||71||
yoge māṃ yoginaṃ vetti dhyānaṃ māṃ ca smaratyapi |
madarthakṛtasarvasvā padmevāpnoti sā hi mām ||72||
svalpayatnāpi kalyāṇī madarthavirahāturā |
cidānandamayaṃ māṃ sā hyavāpnotīva mādhavī ||73||
sarvakāmakṛtā yajñā mayyeva sarvasaukhyadāḥ |
nityaṃ saukhyaṃ labhante tā bhaktimatyo mayi sthitāḥ ||74||
sarvākṣarapadaṃ rājyaṃ sarveśvaragataṃ sukham |
sarvāvatārānandādi labhate mama bhāminī ||75||
yasyā matirna bhidyeta madanyakāmanādibhiḥ |
sā māṃ tu durlabhaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā sulabhameti vai ||76||
kṛṣṇasevāparāṃ nārīṃ kālo yamaśca muñcataḥ |
aparādhasahasrāṃ vā karomi doṣavarjitām ||77||
rakṣako’haṃ hṛdayastho bahistiṣṭhāmi satvaram |
durlabho’pi bhavāmyeva sulabho gopaveśmavat ||78||
durlabho’pi bhavāmyeva sulabho vāmano yathā |
sudūro’pi bhavāmyeva nikaṭastho gajārthavat ||79||
adṛśyo’pi bhavāmīva dṛśyo prahlādakāṣṭhagaḥ |
agamyo’pi bhavāmyeva gamyaḥ svapatirīśavat ||3.67.80||
sarvaṃ snehārpaṇāllakṣmi dadāmi vitarāmi ca |
durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ sevikārthaṃ karomi ca ||81||
tvadarthaṃ kriyate sarvaṃ bhaktārthaṃ kriyate tathā |
brahmapriyārthaṃ kriyate sarvaṃ bhaktyā vaśena ha ||82||
ityevaṃ māṃ viditvaiva yā janmāntaṃ karoti sā |
divyaśrīriva sampannā madīyā jāyate’kṣare ||83||
svapanti mohanidrāyāṃ śarīrasukhamohitāḥ |
upadeśena me cedvai jāgṛtiṃ yānti bodhitāḥ ||84||
tadā labhyaṃ patiṃ kāntaṃ māṃ prayānti pumuttamam |
narā nāryaḥ sadā muktā bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ ||85||
divyānandabharā nityaṃ nyūnasaukhyaṃ na vidyate |
paripūrṇaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ tatra loke pravidyate ||86||
manmūrtāviva sākṣācca mayyevānandaśevadhiḥ |
ānandānāṃ pravāhā vai sravante mama mūrtitaḥ ||87||
madbhaktānānandayitvā praviśanti ca te mayi |
manmūrtito hi niryānti prakṛṣṭānandavārdhayaḥ ||88||
madbhaktāsu ciraṃ sthitvā punaścāyānti vai mayi |
ete sarve mahānandā hrāsaṃ vrajanti naiva ha ||89||
nyūnā bhavanti naivāpi sāntā bhavanti naiva ca |
pravāhāṇāṃ pravāhāśca svecchājanyā bhavanti vai ||3.67.90||
akṣayā vardhamānāśca mama mūrtisuyogajāḥ |
brahmānandaḥ sa evāste muktānāṃ mama dhāmani ||91||
bhuṃkṣva taṃ paramānandaṃ sarvābhiḥ saha padmaje |
etāstvatkaragā ālyaḥ sakhyaste svasṛsaṃjñitāḥ |||92||
sapatnyaḥ koṭyabjalakṣārbudā manmayamūrtayaḥ |
tvadabhinnā hi tāḥ sarvā madabhinnā bhavantyapi ||93 ||
tato bhinnā hi me mūrtermadātmikā guṇātmikāḥ |
macchaktayaśca tāḥ sarvā mayājñaptāḥ striyo’bhavan ||94||
māṃ ca prāpya mayā naijasvarūpātmatvamāpitāḥ |
mayā sarvapṛthivyāṃ vai gatvā svayaṃ hi mārgitāḥ ||95||
anviṣya nijakāntātvaṃ prāpitā mama śaktayaḥ |
vadhūdharmān puraskṛtya bhuñjantāṃ nanditaṃ hi mām ||96||
akṣaraṃ cākṣayaṃ cāpyavyayaṃ śāśvatamuttamam |
sarvānandanidhānaṃ māṃ bhuñjantāṃ parameśvaram ||97||
yā kācinmāṃ puraskṛtya kṛtvā māṃ hṛdi sarvathā |
vadhūgītāṃ maduktāṃ ca śrutvā kāntaṃ sanātanam ||98||
icchiṣyanti nijānandaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam |
tāsāṃ prāpto bhaviṣyāmi grahīṣyāmi ca tatkaram ||99||
neṣyāmi paramaṃ dhāma kariṣye svāminīṃ hi tām |
muktānikāṃ brahmapriyāṃ kariṣye tāṃ haripriyām || 3.67.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vadhūgītāyāṃ hareḥ kṛpāsarvasvaphalanirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||

<3.68>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan bhavatā proktā vadhūgītā hi mokṣadā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradākhilā || 1 ||
tasya te kāntavaryasya mantraṃ śrotuṃ samutsukā |
bhavāmi bhavarogāṇāṃ bheṣajaṃ parama manum || 2 ||
śrīhare kena mantreṇa gamyate paramaṃ padam |
tanme brūhi kṛpāsindho sarvāsāṃ mokṣahetave || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mantraṃ mantravaraṃ śubham |
diṣṭyāhaṃ te’tra vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ mama cottamam || 4 ||
na jānanti surāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśceśvarā api |
sargādau proktavām̐ścāhaṃ brahmaṇe parameṣṭhine || 5 ||
vairājāya tathā mahāviṣṇave bhūmna ityapi |
vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya nārāyaṇāya coktavān || 6 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me parātmanaḥ |
īśvarībhirdevikābhiḥ saha pāraṃ na yanti te || 7 ||
tebhyo’rthitāndadau mantrān bhaktoddhāraṇatatparān |
mama rūpasvarūpātmabalaiśvaryasamanvitān || 8 ||
mantro’haṃ mantrarūpo’haṃ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
sakṛduccāraṇātteṣāṃ milatyeva paraṃ padam || 9 ||
bhuktimuktīṣṭadā lakṣmi puraścaraṇamantarā |
maddevatā mamaivaive’vatārā mantrasattamāḥ || 3.68.1 0||
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca mantrāṇāṃ mantraratnaṃ śubhāvaham |
satkṛtsmaraṇamātreṇa dadāti dhāma cākṣaram || 1 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti śaraṇāgatam |
prapāti dharmakāmārthamokṣado manuruttamaḥ || 12||
daśārṇo’yaṃ mahāmantro daśāvatārasaṃyutaḥ |
akāro matsyarūpo’sti nakāro narakeśarī || 13||
dakāro’tra varāhaśca śakāro hayamastakaḥ |
kakāraḥ kṛṣṇarūpaśca ṇakāro vāmanaḥ prabhuḥ || 14||
nakāraḥ paraśudhrak ca rakāro rāmabhūpatiḥ |
yakāro bodhakṛdviṣṇuḥ ṇakāraḥ kalkanāśakaḥ || 15||
evaṃ daśāvatārātmā mantro me sarvakāmadaḥ |
asyoccāraṇamātreṇa paratuṣṭo’smi sarvadā || 16||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānādiśrīstvaṃ mantre virājase |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ virāje puruṣottamaḥ || 17||
yugalārtho’pi mantro’yaṃ yugalānāṃ sukhapradaḥ |
dampatīsukhasampattisaubhāgyarddhipramodadaḥ || 18||
vaṃśavṛddhikaro japto dhanadhānyādivardhakaḥ |
nirvighnabrahmalokādimahānandaprado manuḥ || 19||
ārogyakīrtisattāśrīrājyasvargādisampradaḥ |
mahāmantro yugalātmā sarveṣṭānandapūrakaḥ ||3.68.20 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra mantre rājate tu catuṣṭayam |
anādiśrīḥ svayaṃ rādhā kṛṣṇo golokabhāskaraḥ ||21 ||
anādiśrīśca lakṣmīrvai nārāyaṇo vikuṇṭhagaḥ |
tābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ sametābhyāṃ catuṣṭayayuto manuḥ ||22||
sarvakāmaphalāvāptiprado dhāmapradaḥ paraḥ |
sarvasaubhāgyadaścāpi manuḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||23||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra mantre paraṃ catuṣṭayam |
anādino hi ye muktāḥ śriyo muktānikāgaṇāḥ ||24||
gopā gopyaśca vai tābhiryuktaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
nārāyaṇastathā cāhaṃ catuṣṭayamidaṃ hi tat ||25||
muktamuktānikāyuktanārāyaṇo’hameva ca |
gopagopīyuktakṛṣṇo golokavāsavām̐stathā ||26||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra mantre ṣaṭkaṃ paraṃ sthitam |
aśabda oṃvācakaśca nādo brahmaparastathā ||27||
nādo’syāstīti nādī vai vedaḥ svayaṃ tathā mataḥ |
nādino vai sarvavedā oṃviśiṣṭāḥ sadā śubhāḥ ||28||
śriyaḥ sarvāḥ śaktayaścāṃganā brāhmyo matisthitāḥ |
yidyātmikā hi tā bodhyā brahmavidyātmikā hi tāḥ ||29||
kṛṣṇaśca mokṣadāḥ sarve’vatārāścātra kīrtitāḥ |
nārāścātra samagrāśca santaḥ sādhvyaśca mokṣadāḥ ||3.68.3 0||
tatra sarvatrāyanaṃ vai yasya śrīparamātmanaḥ |
oṃkāre cāpi vedeṣu vidyāsvavatāreṣu ca ||3 1||
sādhusādhvīṣu vāsī yaḥ so’haṃ mantre nirūpitaḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi trayaṃ tatra mantre sthitaṃ vadāmi te ||32||
anādi cākṣaraṃ dhāma śrīkṛṣṇāśceśvarālayāḥ |
nārā brahmāṇḍavrātāśca tatrāyanaṃ karomyaham ||33||
evaṃ sṛṣṭitrayāntaḥsthaścāhaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
sarvakāmapradaścāsmi nibodhārthaṃ parārthakam ||34||
śṛṇu lakṣmi dvyarthamatra jaḍacetanasaṃjñitam |
anādiśrīrmahāmāyā prakṛtiḥ śaktirācyutī ||35||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tatrasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
ityevaṃ tatra mantrārthe jñānadaṃ bodhayedapi ||36||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tatra svatantramarthamityapi |
akāro vāsudevaśca naśca nārāyaṇastathā ||37||
daśca devāḥ samastāśca śrīśca sarvā hi śaktayaḥ |
kṛśca kṛṣṇādyavatārāḥ ṣṇaḥ ṣirā nālajohyajaḥ ||38||
no vā niyāmyamuktādyāḥ raśca ṛṣigaṇāstathā |
yaśca yogīśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ ṇaśca niyāmako’pyaham ||39||
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvamevaitanmantrārthe veśitaṃ priye |
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyaṃ mantrārthaṃ śobhanaṃ śubham ||3.68.40||
ādirjanma ca tadyeṣāṃ nāsti te śāśvatā matāḥ |
śrīśca tvaṃ śāśvatī lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇo’haṃ śāśvatastathā ||41 ||
nṛṣyātmasu nivasāmi śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ manusthitaḥ |
śāśvataścāntaryāmī ca mantrārthaḥ śobhanaḥ śubhaḥ ||42||
śreṣṭho’yaṃ mantramūrdhanyastubhyaṃ me kathito manuḥ |
nāsmātparo bhavenmantraḥ sarvamantrottamottamaḥ ||43 ||
athāparo manurlakṣmīnārāyaṇo’pi me mataḥ |
lakṣmīstvaṃ śrīḥ hariścāhaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||44||
lakṣmaṃ matpātivratyaṃ vai yāsāmastīti tāḥ striyaḥ |
lakṣmyo brahmapriyāḥ sarvā mama patnyastu koṭiśaḥ ||45||
nārā nāryo mama sarvā muktānikā haripriyāḥ |
lakṣmīṣu cāpi nārāsu ayanaṃ mama sarvathā ||46||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ mantrārthaste niveditaḥ |
lakṣmaṃ mattilakaṃ cihnaṃ śaṃkhacakrāṃkanādi ca ||47||
tadvanto lakṣmiṇaḥ sarve bhaktā nārīnarādayaḥ |
tādṛśā ye cetanā vai nārāḥ sarve mamāśritāḥ ||48||
teṣu prāptamayanaṃ me tenāhaṃ mantrahṛdgataḥ |
lāntikarmaphalaṃ yasmāt lāśca brahmāṇḍavāsinaḥ ||49||
kṣamante cāpi puṣyanti kṣāścaiśvaryapareśvarāḥ |
mīyante brahmaloke ye māśca muktādayastathā ||3.68.50||
nārā māyājatattvāni teṣu prāpto’yanaṃ tu yaḥ |
so’haṃ pareśvaro lakṣmi viśiṣṭo mantrahṛdgataḥ ||51||
athāparo manuḥ śrīmannārāyaṇe’ti me mataḥ |
śrayante māṃ cetanāśca jaḍāścāśrayamāgatāḥ ||52||
tadvān śrīmānahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
śrīstvaṃ tadvānahaṃ nārā nāryo me koṭiśastviha ||53||
tvayā sākaṃ pratiṣṭho’haṃ tāsu madhye sadā prabhuḥ |
śrīmānahaṃ jale cāsmi kṣīrode tena vā tathā |||54||
śrīmannāraṃ cākṣaraṃ me dhāma tatra sthitirmama |
tena tayā bhavāmyeva śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||55||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaśceti mantro’yaṃ prāptibodhakaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇavat labhyate yaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||56||
narāṇāṃ cāpi nārīṇāṃ kṛpayā sulabho’smi vai |
puruṣottamamāse’pi sulabhaḥ kṛpayāsmi ca ||57||
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau tathā kalpe kalpe kṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham |
gopīnāṃ sulabhaścāsmi gopānāṃ cānyadehinām ||58||
golokasthaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo yathāhaṃ sulabhaḥ kṣitau |
tathā cākṣaradhāmasthaḥ sulabho’haṃ pareśvaraḥ ||59||
kalpe kalpe bhavāmyatra kṣitau kṛpālabhaḥ svayam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣāttamaḥ ||3.68.60||
evaṃ vai sulabho lakṣmi mantraḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho me’sti rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ mayā hi tat ||61 ||
rādhāyā rañjanādyarthaṃ gopīnāṃ modakārakam |
sarveṣāṃ sulabhaṃ rūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho’pyaham ||62||
svāmī vai vallabhaḥ kāntaḥ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
so’hamākṛṣya madbhaktān nayāmi dhāma me param ||63||
so’haṃ svāmī patiḥ śrīyuk kṛṣṇo brahmaparaḥ prabhuḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaścāhaṃ mantrārthe’smi hariḥ svayam ||64||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
mantroccāraṇamātreṇa parituṣṭo’smi sarvadā ||65||
sarve varṇā āśramāśca narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ |
mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve saṃkarāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ ||66||
nāgāḥ sarpā dānavāśca daityāśca rākṣasā api |
mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve kiṃ punarmānavāḥ kṣitau ||67||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jantavaḥ pādapā api |
dehinaḥ sarva evaite mantrādhikārayoginaḥ ||68||
śrāvito’yaṃ tiraścāṃ hi mokṣado mama vai manuḥ |
yakṣagandharvasūtāśca piśācāḥ kinnarāḥ khagāḥ ||69||
kiṃpuruṣāḥ puṇyajanā bhūtāḥ pretāśca devatāḥ |
vināyakāśca vetālā gaṇāśca gaṇikāstathā ||3.68.70||
yoginyaśca yatinyaśca sādhvyaḥ pativratāstathā |
snuṣā vṛddhāśca bālāśca bālakāḥ stanyapā api ||7 1 ||
vasavaśca ṛṣayaśca rudrāḥ sūryāśca candramāḥ |
kāmaśca manavaścāpi mahendrādyāḥ surā api ||72||
lokapālāśca dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā |
tārakā mānavāścāpi siddhāśca cāraṇāstathā ||73 ||
nṛpāḥ prajā yamaścāpi yamadūtāstatheśvarāḥ |
īśvarāṇyo brahmaśīlāstāmasā rājasāstathā ||74||
sattvavanto dhāmavāsāḥ sarve mantrādhikāriṇaḥ |
guroḥ prāpya paraṃ mantraṃ cātmānaṃ mocayed bhavāt ||75||
mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve mama bhaktā mamāśritāḥ |
śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇānāṃ ca tathaivānanyasevinām ||76||
ananyasādhanānāṃ ca sādhanaṃ mantra uttamaḥ |
ārttānāmāśu phalado japtaḥ sakṛtacca vā muhuḥ ||77||
dīptānāṃ dehināṃ cāpi janmāntaranivārakaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ mokṣadaścāpi mantro mama caturvidhaḥ ||78||
duḥkhī svārthī vivekī vā tadicchuko’dhikāravān |
śaraṇaṃ prāpyāpya manuṃ muktiphalamavāpnuyāt ||79||
dīkṣitaścāpi bhaktaśca nirmānī cāstikaḥ kṛtī |
kṛtajñaḥ śraddhayā yuktaḥ śuśrūṣurdoṣavarjitaḥ ||3.68.80||
mattādātmyakriyāyogyo gṛhṇīyānmanumuttamam |
pāpināmapi vaktavyaḥ śodhako bhavanāśakaḥ ||81 ||

api vyavāyakṛcchuddhyet kiṃ punaḥ śīlamārgagaḥ |||82||
api cauryaparaḥ śuddhyet kiṃ punarnyāyamārgagaḥ |
surāpaścāpi śuddhyedvai kiṃ punarvipradharmavān ||83||
deśakālādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na |
snānadānādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na ||84||
vratotsavādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na ||
nārīnarādiniyamo vidyate grahaṇe’sya na ||85||
gurorgrāhyo vaiṣṇavādvai gurvyāśca niyamo’sya vai ||
grahaṇe sati bhaktena bhāvyaṃ bhaktyā sadā mama ||86||
maccihnāṃkitadehena madīyārādhanena ca |
mayi karmārpaṇenaiva me śaraṇāgatena ca ||87||
mayi phalārpaṇenāpi mayi viśvastavartinā |

anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ pūjayettataḥ ||96||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapāṇinaṃ kamalāpatim |
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastiyutaṃ harim ||97||

pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyaiścāmbarādibhiḥ ||98||

pradakṣiṇairdakṣiṇābhirnṛtyakīrtanagāyanaiḥ ||99||
visarjanādyaiścaivaṃ me kuryāt prapūjanaṃ priye |
dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti sadbhyaḥ satībhya uttamam || 3.68.10 0||
bhojayed rāmayeccāpi rañjayet sevayet tathā |
vaiṣṇavatvena tiṣṭhecca varteta dāsyabhāvataḥ || 10 1||
kuryādvai bhajanaṃ nityaṃ mantrairiṣṭaiḥ sahasrakam |
śatamālā japedvāpi mālāmekāṃ japecca vā || 1 02||
daśavāraṃ japedvāpi nityaṃ prātarniśāmukhe |
madhyāhe’pi japedvāpi mokṣado’haṃ bhavāmi vai || 10 3||
sakāmānāṃ sampadāṃ vai pradātāhaṃ bhavāmi ca |
niṣkāmānāṃ śreyasāṃ vai pradātāhaṃ bhavāmi ca || 1 04||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ me manostava |
japennārī naro vāpi dadyācca dehine’rthine || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāmantrarahasye mantratadarthanyāsādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||

śreṣṭhamuktaṃ tvayā kānta rahasyaṃ manusaṃbhṛtam |
