<3.70>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ grāhayet sadgurormanūn |
sahasraśākhādhyāyī ca sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ || 1 ||
tāpaso vipravaryo’pi na guruḥ syādavaiṣṇavaḥ |
mahābhāgavato yaśca mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
bhaktimārgapradeṣṭā vaiṣṇavo gururbhaved budhaḥ |
ācāryaḥ sadguruḥ sādhurbhavabandhavidārakaḥ || 3 ||
tasmānmantrān hi gṛhṇīyādoṃkārasahitān śuciḥ |
ādau sarvatra mantrāṇāṃ yojayet praṇavaṃ prabhum || 4 ||
oṃkāro’haṃ paravrahma praṇavo mantranāyakaḥ |
omityekākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ caturthyantā mamābhidhā || 5 ||
tataśca dvyakṣaraṃ nāma namaḥ ityevaṃ pūrayedapi |
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanandajāya namaḥ evaṃ vaded guruḥ || 6 ||
mantracatuṣṭayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantradaśakamuttamam |
sapta dvādaśa ca dve ca gāyatryaścottamā mama || 7 ||
trayodaśa tathā mantrāstrayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sadā mama |
trayastriṃśadavatāramantrāḥ śreṣṭhāstathā mama || 8 ||
trayostriṃśacchriyo mantrāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sarve matā mama |
eko vā sarva evāpi hyaneke vā yatheṣṭakam || 9 ||
grāhyā mantrā hi śiṣyeṇa guruḥ parīkṣya vārpayet |
pañcadaśordhvaśatamantradevo’smi hariḥ svayam || 3.70.1 0||
trayastriṃśanmama mantrāścānye madrūpavarṇinaḥ |
rūparūpitādātmyādvai yujyante mayi sarvaśaḥ || 11 ||
yo bhakto yatsvarūpasya tanmantraṃ śṛṇuyād guroḥ |
parabrahmataroḥ śākhāḥ śataṃ ca daśa paṃca ca || 12||
tāni tāni ca rūpāṇi tattanmantraiḥ prapūjya ca |
ārādhya matsvarūpāṇi yāsyantyeva hi māṃ harim || 13||
parabrahmasampradāyāḥ sarve meṃ’gāni padmaje |
madutpannamidaṃ sarvaṃ matto naivātiricyate || 14||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe protā mayīśvarāḥ |
avatārāstathā muktā jīvāḥ protā harau mayi || 15||
avatāriṇya evemāḥ śaktayo mayi saṃsthitāḥ |
sarvā mantrasvarūpiṇyaḥ protā mayi harau prabhau || 16||
itivijñāya mantrāṇāṃ śataṃ paṃcadaśādhikam |
vidvān vijñāya dadyādvai viduṣe tvadhikāriṇe || 17||
sa syād ācāryasamrāṭ vai sarvamantraprado guruḥ |
parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrāṭa nigadyate || 18||
nyūnamantrapradā nyūnā ācāryāste bhavanti vai |
svataḥprakāśobhagavān sthāpyate vai mayā guruḥ || 19||
parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrāṭ manupradaḥ |
sarvamanūpadeṣṭā sa matsvarūpo bhavatyapi ||3.70.20||
tvaṃ lakṣmīśca tathā gurvī sthāpyate vai mayā priye |
parabrahmasampradāyācāryasamrājñī mantradā ||21||
sarvamanūpadeṣṭrī tvaṃ matsvarūpātmikā hyasi |
kiṃ ca lakṣmi śṛṇu cānyanmantre yannāma vidyate ||22||
sa tanmanostathācāryaḥ, madaṃśo vartate sadā |
sā tanmanostathācāryāṇī ca bodhyā madājñayā |||23||
evaṃ manūn niyuñjīta gṛhṇīyācca gurormukhāt| |
sabījo’yaṃ bhavenmantro gurostaijasabhāsuraḥ ||24||
daivabalo gurorbalī manurmokṣaprado bhavet |
śiṣyabalo’dhikaḥ syādvai manurbhuktipramuktidaḥ ||25||
bījaṃ sarvatra mantreṣu kṛṣṇakānto’hameva tu |
nityānapāyinī śaktiḥ śrīrlakṣmīrvidyate manau ||26||
oṃkāro me’bhidhānaṃ śri akārāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ |
ukāraḥ śrīstvamevāsi makāro bhakta eva me ||27||
akāro’haṃ parātmā ca ukāraśceśvarā matāḥ |
makāraśca jīvavṛndā tadātmā oṃ mato mama ||28||
akāraścāniruddhaśca ukārastu pradyamnakaḥ |
makāraḥ saṃkarṣaṇastredhā omityahaṃ śrīhariḥ ||29||
akāraśca svayaṃ viṣṇurukāraḥ śaṃkarastathā |
makāraśca viśvasṛḍ vai tredhāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||3.70.3 0||
akāraścākṣaraṃ brahma ukāro muktakoṭayaḥ |
makāraścāvatārā me tredhāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||3 1 ||
akāro brahmasṛṣṭirme ukāraśceśvarasṛjiḥ |
makāro jīvasṛṣṭiśca tredhāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||32||
akāro’haṃ parabrahma uśca brahmapriyā mama |
maśca haripriyāḥ sarvāstredhāhaṃ paramaḥ prabhuḥ ||33||
ahaṃ svāmī svāminī tvaṃ śeṣā dāsāstathā pare |
evaṃ me vidyate hārdaṃ praṇavārthe hi dāsatā ||34||
dāsā dāsyo mama bhaktāḥ paratantrāḥ sadā mama |
dehendriyamano’haṃdhīguṇā bhaktasya me vaśāḥ ||35||
mayyarpitā hi te divyā mattantrā matprajīvanāḥ |
ato mama padasthasya madicchādhīnavartanam ||36||
mamaiva sarvasaṃkalpāt prārabdhaṃ tasya vidyate |
mamaiva lakṣmi sāmarthyānnālabhyaṃ tasya vidyate ||37||
mayyarpitabharaḥ śrīśe matkarmaiva samācaret |
paramātmā hyahaṃ svāmī bhaktastu dāsa eva me ||38||
icchayā viniyoktavyo bhaved dāso hi sarvadā |
dāsī bhṛtyā kiṃkarī ca niyoktavyā mamāśritā ||39||
mamāhaṃ matsvarūpau vai mama bhaktasya netarau |
tasmād dehādibandhaiḥ sa mukto nityo mamāśrayāt ||3.70.40 ||
kurvannapi hi karmāṇi matkṛtānyeva tāni vai |
na lepaṃ labhate taiśca bhakto me bandhavarjitaḥ ||41 ||
māyā bhaktasya me divyā bhaktaṃ rañjayati dhruvam |
ānandayati divyā sā mokṣārthaṃ yojayatyapi ||42|||
evaṃ lakṣmi mama manormāhātmyamudita tava |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ cākṣarādhipaḥ ||43||
puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ cāvatārī pareśvaraḥ |
parameśvara evāhaṃ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||44||
pūrṇabrahma parabrahma bhagavān sarvakāraṇam |
mamāvatārāḥ kṛṣṇādyā vāsudevādayo’pi ca ||45||
bhūmādayo’pīśvarāśca rādhālakṣmyādiśaktayaḥ |
mamāṃśā viṣṇurudrājā devāścāṃśakalāṃśakāḥ ||46||
mānavādyāstadaṃśāśca tiryañcaḥ pādapāstathā |
kiṃcidaṃśāṃśasaṃbhūtāḥ sṛṣṭayaḥ santi caiva me ||47||
tatra nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ nārā ityātmasaṃhatiḥ |
tatrāyanaṃ karomyeva tato nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||48||
narājjāteṣu tattveṣu vāsī nārāyaṇo’smyaham |
nāre carācare loke’ntaḥstho nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||49||
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
yasmānmattaḥ samutpannaḥ so’haṃ vai parameśvaraḥ ||3.70.50||
yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyaṃ ca yasmāt sarvaṃ pareśvarāt |
amṛtatvasya ceśānaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||5 1 ||
vāsudevo yato bhāti hiraṇyagarbha ityapi |
savitā ca yato bhāti so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||52||
vedādiśca parā vāṇī yasya bhāṣā susaṃskṛtā |
svaro yasya prakaṇṭhādvai so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||53||
paramātmā tu yaścāste māyī ca māyayārcitaḥ |
māyeśo māyayā śūnyaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||54||
pāde sṛṣṭistripāde cākṣaraṃ dhāmāsti yasya vai |
bhūlīlāśrīpatiryo’sti so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||55||
yajñanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ sarvanārāyaṇo’smi ca |
bhinnanārāyaṇarūpaḥ so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||56||
yanmūrtermūrtayaḥ santi viprādyā mānavāḥ surāḥ |
candraḥ sūryo’gnirdyurvidyut so’haṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||57||
etādṛśasya me dāsyaṃ naranārībhirādarāt |
mantraṃ labdhvā prakartavyaṃ rahasyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat ||58|||
viśvataḥ pāṇipādo’haṃ cakṣuṣmān viśvatastathā |
viśvāni bhuvanānyeva dhāmāni tvapi santi me ||59||
evaṃ bṛhatsvarūpo’haṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
īśvaryā vai tvayā sākaṃ divyamaṃgalarūpavān ||3.70.60||
bṛhaddeho mānavarjyo yuvā hariḥ patistava |
reme reme tvayā lakṣmyā śriyā sākaṃ hi śāśvataḥ ||6 1||
ahaṃ jagajjananyā vai kumāro nityayauvanaḥ |
kandarpāṃrbudalāvaṇyastiṣṭhāmi parame pade ||62||
muktisthānaṃ paraṃ vyoma muktamuktānikāśritam |
śāśvatānandasaukhyādisaṃbhṛtaṃ cākṣaraṃ mama ||63||
golokaścāpi vaikuṇṭho’vyākṛto’mṛta ityapi |
bhogārthāni hi dhāmāni mayā kṛtāni santi vai ||64||
hiraṇmayāstathā vairājādyāśca māyikāstathā |
sādāśaivā vaiṣṇavāśca prādhānikāścabhūmayaḥ ||65||
āvaraṇāni sarvāṇi satyādimānavādayaḥ |
pātālāntāśca līlāyāḥ krīḍāsaubhāgyasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||66||
sarve lokā mama krīḍālīlādyarthā mayā kṛtāḥ |
bhoge nityā sthitirme dhāmasvavatārarūpiṇaḥ ||67||
līlāṃ tu saṃhare lakṣmi māyāmayaṃ hi tad yataḥ |
tripādvyāpyakṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ me hi śāśvatam ||68||
tripād vibhūtirnityā sā tatra dhāmāni yāni me |
golokādīni sarvāṇi nityānyeva parāṇi hi ||69||
pādo’syaiśvarajaivādilokā anityasaṃjñakāḥ |
līlātmakā hi te sarve krīḍārthaṃ vai mayā kṛtāḥ ||3.70.70||
nitye’kṣare ca goloke vaikuṇṭhe’vyākṛte’mṛte |
acyutaḥ śāśvato divyaḥ sadā yauvanamāśritaḥ ||71||
tiṣṭhāmyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇaśca tathā nārāyaṇo bhūmā tathā prabhuḥ ||72||
vāsudevaḥ sadā lakṣmi tava rūpaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
muktānikābrahmapriyāharipriyābhiḥ saṃyutaḥ ||73||
rādhāvirajāgopībhirgoloke mama śaktibhiḥ |
lakṣmīhariṇīkamalādisevito vikuṇṭhake ||74||
ramāśrīpārṣadānībhiḥ sevito’vyākṛte prabhuḥ |
vāsudevīpadminībhiḥ sevito’mṛtadhāmani ||75||
muktairgopaiḥ sevakaiśca pārṣadairabhisevitaḥ |
avatārasvarūpo’haṃ bhinnarūpo vasāmi vai ||76||
nityasaṃbhogamīśvaryā śriyā lakṣmyā ca rādhayā |
tvayā ca ramayā vāsudevyā kamalayā saha ||77||
vinde’haṃ sarvadā lakṣmi bhūmyā ca divyayā sadā |
nityā sā tvaṃ jaganmātā mama śrīranapāyinī ||78||
sarvagatā sadā vibhvī hīśānāṃ jagatāṃ sadā |
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāḍhyā sarvato’kṣiśiromukhī ||79||
parameśī jaganmātā nārāyaṇī hiraṇmayī |
tvattanāvāsthitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam ||3.70.80||
jagatsthitilayau syātāṃ tavonmīlanamīlanāt |
sarvasyādyā mahābrāhmī mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī ||8 1 ||
lakṣyālakṣyasvarūpā tvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitā |
vibhūtistvaṃ pare dhāmni rādhā golokavāsinī ||82|||
lakṣmīrvaikuṇṭhavāsā ca ramāvyākṛtavāsinī |
padmāmṛtanivāsā ca vibhūtiścākṣarī mama ||83||
īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokeṣu jīvānāmaṇḍakeṣu ca |
līlaiśvaryavapustvaṃ vai bhavasi bhūmikātmikāḥ ||84||
īśvarāṇāṃ bhūmayaścālayāḥ prāsādakoṭayaḥ |
smṛddhayo vāṭikāḥ kṣetradivyaviṣayabhūmayaḥ ||85||
bhavatyeva bhavatīti līlā me sarvasampadaḥ |
āvaraṇāni tattvāni tvaṃ sādāśaivagāni ca ||86||
vaiṣṇavāni ca tattvāni māyikānyapi yāni ca |
hairaṇmayāni tattvāni vairājādīni yāni ca ||87||
satyādidyunivāsāni mānavānyapi yāni ca |
pātāleṣu tathā yāni tattvāni bhogabhūmayaḥ ||88||
jalabhūtaijasavāyumayāni yāni santi ca |
tāni sarvāṇi te lakṣmi līlārūpāṇi santi vai ||89||
rūparasagandhasparśarūpā tvaṃ svararūpiṇī |
lakṣmīrūpatvamāpannā dhanadravyādināmikā ||3.70.90||
evaṃ jagatsvarūpā tvaṃ jagataḥ śrīḥ śritā himām |
vedā vedyaṃ samastaṃ vai tava rūpaṃ hi padmaje ||91||
strīrūpamakhilaṃ lakṣmi tava rūpaṃ vapustava |
saundaryaṃ śīlamaujjvalyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ mārdavaṃ sukham ||92||
lāvaṇyaṃ cāpi saugandhyaṃ cākarṣaṇaṃ rasādikam |
tavaivaṃ rūpaṃ kamale sarvanārīṣu saṃsthitam ||93||
brāhmī nārāyaṇīśrīścākṣarī muktānikā ramā |
brahmapriyā ca kamalā haripriyā ca māṇikī ||94||
rādhā lakṣmīḥ parāvidyā ramā śrīśca narāyaṇī |
vidyā sarasvatī mātā vaiṣṇavī padminī satī ||95||
padmā ca padmajā cābdhiputrī raṃbhā ca rādhikā |
bhūrlīlā sukhadālakṣmīrhariṇī mādhavīśvarī ||96||
gaurī kārṣṇī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī svāhā svadhā ratiḥ |
sampat smṛddhirvāsudevī virajā ca hiraṇmayī ||97||
bhārgavī śivarājñīśrī rāmā śrīkāntavallabhā |
etāni tava nāmāni sadā prātaḥ paṭheddhi yaḥ ||98||
sa smṛddhiṃ mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ śriyamāpnotyanāśinīm |
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajām ||99||
jyotsnāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ vindate matsvarūpiṇīm |
utkṛṣṭagandharūpādisvarūpāṃ puṣṭivardhinīm || 3.70.100||
tava dātā prabhuḥ śrīmān puruṣottama eva ca |
paranārāyaṇaḥ svāmī vātsalyakaruṇārṇavaḥ || 10 1||
suśīlaḥ subhagaḥ pūrṇakāmaśca sarvaśaktimān |
svargāpavargasukhadaḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvadehinām || 1 02||
so’haṃ me dāsabhaktāya dāsyai sākaṃ tvayāpyaham |
māṃ cārpayāmi deveśi parasparātmaveditām || 1 03||
śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ svāmī śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’haṃ gatiḥ parā || 1 04||
śaraṇaṃ mandiraṃ vāso bandhuḥ pitā patiḥ suhṛt |
mātā bhrātā rakṣitā ca pālako jagatāṃ prabhuḥ || 1 05||
kalyāṇaguṇavān śrīśaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
prākṛtaguṇaśūnyo’haṃ nirguṇo divyamūrtimān || 1 06||
divyāsaṃkhyaguṇaiśvaryarūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutaḥ |
amṛte śāśvate divye’nante’kṣare pare pade || 107||
nivasāmi brahmaloke brahmānandasukhānvite |
atitejomaye śuddhe pralayādivivarjite || 1 08||
asaṃkhye cājare nitye jāgratsvapnādivarjite |
samānādhikarahite’ntādyavirahite śubhe || 1 09||
atisarvotkṛṣṭatejobhṛte cānandasāgare |
yadakṣaraṃ vedavedyaṃ yasmin devāḥ sādhyā niṣeduḥ || 3.70.1 10||
adhiviśve niṣeduśca devā vidustadāsate |
tadakṣaraṃ me paramaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ || 111 ||
yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā ayāsa āsate’bhitaḥ |
te ha nākasya mahimānaṃ viduḥ sādhyayoginaḥ || 1 12||
tiṣṭhāmastatra satataṃ yuvānau śrīnarāyaṇau |
yatra svasāro yuvatyastvadādyā mama vallabhāḥ || 1 13||
tatprāpya na nivartante paramākṣaradhāma me |
etanmokṣapadaṃ divyaṃ prayānti mantravedinaḥ || 1 14||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahāmantragūḍhārthajñānaprāpyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||

<3.71>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tripādvibhūtivistaram |
asaṃkhyātāni dhāmāni śuddhasattvamayāni vai || 1 ||
brahmānandasukhāḍhyāni nityāni tāni santi ha |
nirvikārāṇi sarvāṇi heyādirahitāni ca || 2 ||
divyahiraṇmayānyeva śuddhāni taijasāni ha |
avatārapadāmbhojabhaktimatsevitāni vai || 3 ||
nityamuktairdivyarūpaiḥ puruṣaiḥ strībhirityapi |
vāsitāni vanodyānasaronagaravanti ca || 4 ||
taddhāmānyupabhoktavyānyakṣarabrahmasevinām |
svātmajānandasaukhyāni mandirāṇi bhavanti ca || 5 ||
niḥśreyasāni nirvāṇakaivalyāni ca yāni vai |
śrīśāṃghribhaktisevaikarasabhogayutāni ha || 6 ||
nityamuktā mahādivyā mama pādaprasevinaḥ |
sevikāśca vasantyeteṣveva nityasanātanāḥ || 7 ||
mantrajñāḥ paramāṇyeva yānti dhāmāni tāni vai |
brahmasukhapradānyeva mama yogapradāni vai || 8 ||
tatra tatra sthitaścāhamavatārasvarūpavān |
avatārī tvakṣare vai pare dhāmni bhavāmi ca || 9 ||
mahāmāyā prakṛtiryā sā māṃ stauti punaḥ punaḥ |
namaste’kṣaravāsāya parameśāya te namaḥ || 3.71.1 0||
avatārasvarūpāyāvatāriṇe ca te namaḥ |
māyāhaṃ bhavataḥ śaktirmāyālokāśca te prabho || 11 ||
īśvarāṇāmālayāśca tavaiva bhūmikāstvimāḥ |
tattvāni ca samastāni tavaiva kāryakāṇi vai || 12||
purāṇapuruṣastvaṃ vai sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
śrībhūlīlāramānātha māṇikīmuktikāpate || 13 ||
prajñāpadmāvatīkānta namaste sukhadāpate |
lakṣmīpadmāpate tubhya namo nārāyaṇāya vai || 14||
sarveśvarasvarūpāya sarvadevātmane namaḥ |
anantamūrtaye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa hare namaḥ || 15||
te’cyutāya ca kāntāya parameśāya te namaḥ |
sarvajñāya samastāya gopālātmaja te namaḥ || 16||
sarvasṛṣṭyātmane tubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane |
brahmaṇe jyotiṣe tubhyaṃ namaste śucivarcase || 17||
prasavitre namaḥ pitre sargasthityantahetave |
nārāyaṇāya ca namaḥ sarvātmāntaravartine || 18||
anantadivyaguṇavan namaḥ pumarthadāyine |
vyūharūpāya ca namaḥ pañcāvasthasvarūpiṇe || 1 9||
prasīda bhagavan viṣṇo sarvalokahitāya vai |
ātmāno jñānahīnā vai nirākārā nirindriyāḥ ||3.71.20||
sarvānuṣṭhānarahitā vartante ca nirāśrayāḥ |
teṣāṃ lokām̐śca dehām̐śca dātumarhasi vai mayi ||21 ||
līlāvibhūtiṃ śrīkṛṣṇa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya |
cetanācetanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||22||
paśya līnaṃ māyikaṃ vai mayi suptaṃ prabodhaya |
prakṛtyā vai mayā sārdhaṃ sṛjasva parameśvara || 23||
dharmādharmau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhāvayitvā mayi prabho |
māmadhiṣṭhāya vai līlāṃ śriyā kartuṃ tvamarhasi ||24||
ityevaṃ cārthitaścāhaṃ lakṣmi pūrve hi māyayā |
tasyāmeva hi māyāyāṃ jagat sraṣṭuṃ pracakrame ||25||
svecchayā dhāmamukto vai puruṣo yuyuje tayā |
prakṛtipūruṣaḥ proktastasmāt pradhānapūruṣaḥ || 26||
pradhānaṃ vai mahattattvaṃ buddhirityevamīśvarī |
pradhānapuruṣāttasmādahaṃkāraḥ prajāyate ||27||
so’yaṃ hiraṇyagarbho vai mahāviṣṇurnigadyate |
tasmānmanaḥ prabhavati tanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca ||28||
ṣoḍaśako gaṇaḥ so’yaṃ vairājo nāma pūruṣaḥ |
vairājājjāyanta īśā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||29||
brahmā pṛthvī jalaṃ viṣṇuḥ rudrastejo mahattaram |
prāṇo’nilo’tha hṛdayaṃ gaganaṃ khaṃ vyajāyata ||3.71.3 0||
ebhyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ surā bhūtāśca mānavāḥ |
asurā dānavā daityā nāgāḥ sarpāśca sṛṣṭayaḥ ||3 1||
tiryañco jantavaḥ sarve vyajāyanta yathāyatham |
sarve karmānusāreṇa yujyante yogyayoniṣu ||32||
sadā sthitā hi prakṛtau prabhavantocchayā hareḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi mama līlāṃ māyāmayīṃ vibhāvaya ||33||
tvameva sā mahāmāyā divyā madyogamāśritā |
matsvarūpā mamecchaiva śaktistvaṃ sarvarūpiṇī ||34||
mama cārdhāṃganā brāhmī nārāyaṇī maheśvarī |
mahālakṣmīrvāsudevī vaiṣṇavī kamalā ramā ||35||
rādhā lakṣmīḥ priyā kāntā śrīstvaṃ sukhapradā sadā |
sarvasṛṣṭisthajīvānāmudbhavādividhāyinī ||36||
mama śaktiṃ vinā sṛṣṭernonmeṣo vidyate kvacit |
ato yāvajjagatprāṇamayī tvaṃ parameśvarī ||37||
prāṇāyāḥ prāṇarūpo’haṃ patiste parameśvaraḥ |
sarvasadguṇapūrṇo’haṃ parameśaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||38||
śrīkṛṣṇo’haṃ bhavāmyeva rādhākāmaprapūrtaye |
nārāyaṇo bhavāmyeva lakṣmīkāmaprapūrtaye ||39||
vāsudevo bhavāmyeva paripūrṇastrirūpadhṛk |
pradyumnamūrtistasmādvai sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā ||3.71.40 ||
bhūmnaścāpīśvarāṇāṃ ceśvareśānāṃ prabhuḥ khaniḥ |
kālasyāpi śāsakaśca sṛṣṭiṃ caiśīṃ karoti hi ||41 ||
antaryāmitvamāpanno mahākālānuveśitaḥ |
harerme prabalaiśvaryaṃ mahākālasvarūpadhṛk ||42||
prabalo mama saṃkalpaścaiśvaryaṃ kālakāraṇam |
mahākālasya putro vai kālasaṃjño bhavatyapi ||43||
tadantarbhāvamāsādyāniruddho lokasarjakaḥ |
mama jñānaṃ dadau tasmai nityavedātmakaṃ purā ||44||
aniruddhasyāṃśabhāgā brahmāṇaḥ saṃbhavanti hi |
vāsudevāttataścānyaḥ pradyumnaḥ saṃvyajāyata ||45||
macchaktitejaaiśvaryānvitaḥ pālanakarmakṛt |
aiśīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ pālayati sthitiṃ sañcālayatyayam ||46||
tadaṃśātmā viṣṇurūpaḥ pāti sarvaṃ jaganmuhuḥ |
vāsudevāttato jātaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo vināśakṛt ||47||
vidyābalāstraśastrādiyuto yadaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ |
rudrādyā nāśakarmāṇo bhavanti sṛṣṭilopakāḥ ||48||
evamete madaṃśā vai lakṣmi sadā bhavanti hi |
tadaṃśāścāpi tatpatnyo bhavanti mama vāñcchayā ||49||
matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho’tha vāmanaḥ |
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkiśca te daśa ||3.71.50||
avatārā mama lakṣmi jāyante sarvasṛṣṭiṣu |
mama kāryakarā ete āvaśyakānubhāvinaḥ ||51||
ahaṃ bhavāmyavatārī svecchayā sahitastvayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||52||
mama bhaktyā mama ghāmākṣaraṃ padaṃ prayānti vai |
avatārarūpabhaktyā golokādi prayānti vai ||53 ||
gatvā caiṣu na vai muktā nivartante samā mayā |
matsamānasukhāḥ sarve yathā tvaṃ sukhinastathā ||54||
madicchayā prajāyante lokakalyāṇahetave |
na karmabandhanaṃ janma manmuktānāṃ hi bhūtale ||55||
mama cānucaratvaṃ hi mokṣa eva na cetaraḥ |
mama dāsyaṃ bandhanaṃ vai sadāsukhaṃ sadākṣaram ||56||
punaste mama dhāmasthā yāsyanti dhāma cecchayā |
brahmapriyā mahāmuktā haridāsā nirāmayāḥ ||57||
anye’pi karmabandhasthā mantraṃ labdhvā mamāpi vai |
viṣamiśrāśanaṃ lokasukhaṃ tyaktvā bhajanti cet ||58||
māmeva te prapadyante nāmakīrtanapūjanaiḥ |
bhaktyā tvananyayā māṃ saṃbhajeyuḥ karuṇālayam ||59||
rakṣāmi tānparamātmā bhaktavātsalyaśevadhiḥ |
nayāmi vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma sahasrasūryaraśmini ||3.71.60||
vimāne tāmavasthāpya bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam |
mama mantraprajaptṝn vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇān ||6 1 ||
śrīpateḥ śrīharerme’tra mantroccāraṇamuttamam |
sarvāmṛtamayaṃ divyamauṣadhaṃ paramauṣadham ||62||
sarvodvegādiśamanaṃ māyāpāśaharaṃ param |
hyetadrasāyanaṃ divyaṃ māyāgadaharaṃ śubham ||63||
vidyamāne kṛṣṇamantre mahauṣadhe’tra bhūtale |
mānavā nopagṛhṇanti hāniḥ sā mahatī matā ||64||
pūrvasañcitaduṣṭāste bhramamāyāntare sthitāḥ |
ye pibanti na vai mūḍhā harināmarasāyanam ||65||
haripūjopacāreṇa dhyānena sevayā ca me |
satyadāsyena dānena kāyātmaśuddhisaṃbhavaḥ ||66||
tato vāso hṛdaye me tathātmani nirantaram |
mandiraṃ bhaktahṛdayaṃ kṛtvā nayāmi dhāma me ||67||
lakṣmi brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāstathāparāḥ |
śṛṇvantu mama līlādyā juṣantāṃ māṃ priyaṃ patim ||68||
vrajantu supathaṃ me ca bhāvaiḥ sarvaiḥ samarpitaiḥ |
sevābhirjñānavijñānairdhyānaistapobhirityapi ||69||
vratairyajñaiśca dānaiśca śṛṃgāraiścandanādibhiḥ |
hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca bhajantāṃ māṃ priyaṃ patim ||3.71.70||
paśyantu māṃ ca sarvatra śuṣkeṣvārdreṣu sarvadā |
sthāvareṣu jaṃgameṣu bhūmāvabhreṣu mūrtiṣu ||71 ||
svakāryeṣu paravarṣmasvapi māṃ puruṣottamam |
māmuddiśya dadatvapi dānāni vividhāni ca ||72||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japata māṃ sadā |
yajadhvaṃ māṃ ca manmantraṃ smarantu sārthakaṃ ca mām ||73 ||
pibantu vaiṣṇavarasaṃ mantrāmṛtaṃ pibantu ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāmṛtaṃ pibantu ca ||74||
ājñāmṛtaṃ premarasaṃ sevārasaṃ pibantu ca |
muktirasaṃ kāntarasaṃ kāntāḥ sarvāḥ pibantu ca ||75||
bhaktirasaṃ yogarasaṃ cātmarasaṃ pibantu ca |
brahmarasaṃ dāsyarasaṃ priyarasaṃ pibantu ca ||76||
sneharasaṃ tānarasaṃ sarvarasān pibantu ca |
arcayantu sadā kāntaṃ dhyāyantu madhusūdanam ||77||
gāyantu māṃ mahākṛṣṇaṃ japantu śrīhariṃ sadā |
tapyantāṃ mama toṣārthaṃ maddhyānā matparāyaṇāḥ ||78||
evaṃ yā ye kariṣyanti bhaktiṃ madarthikāṃ bhuvi |
tāste vai mānavādyāstu sarve bhāgavatāḥ parāḥ ||79||
mama prabhāvato lakṣmi pūjāstotramanugṛṇāḥ |
ādhihīnā bhavantyeva bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.71.80||
vītaśokāśca puṇyāśca bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ |
sarvaiśvaryasamāpannāḥ sarvarogādivarjitāḥ ||81 ||
amarā nirjarāścāpi dhanadhānyasamṛddhayaḥ |
mama cātiprasādena putrapautrādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||82||
mama bhaktāgārabhāge hṛdaye cāpi mānase |
satyavrataṃ sadā cāste sarvaratnopadāyakam ||83||
bhaktānāṃ mantrayuktānāṃ gṛhadvāreṣu nityadā |
kalpadrumā bhavantyeva sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||84||
sarvakāmadughā gāvaḥ sacintāmaṇayastathā |
kalpalatāḥ kalpapātrāṇyāsate bhaktamandire ||85||
mama prasādato lakṣmi amarāste bhavanti ca |
sarvasaubhāgyasampannāḥ puṇyamaṃgalaśobhanāḥ ||86||
dānajñānadhyānaparāyaṇā ānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ bhavet ||87||
vaiṣṇavā yatra me bhaktā mama vrataparāyaṇāḥ |
maddhyānā majjapā lakṣmi mama bhāvaparāyaṇāḥ ||88||
eṣāṃ gṛhāṇi divyāni puṇyāni mokṣadānyapi |
tīrthāni samajāyante mamākṣaranibhāni vai ||89||
yadgṛheṣu gadācakradhvajadhanūṃṣi santi me |
śūlamīnaśarasvastikāni cihnāni santi me ||3.71.90||
bhittibhāgeṣu sarveṣu pratimā me bhavanti ca |
gṛhadvāreṣu sarveṣu puṇyasthāneṣu sarvathā ||9 1||
mama līlācaritrāṇāṃ divyacitrāṇi santi ca |
tulasīrādhikālakṣmīmāṇikīpratimāyutaḥ ||92||
prajñāpadmāvatīpadmāsukhadāśrīsamanvitaḥ |
ahaṃ yatra citrito vai bhavāmi parito gṛhe ||93||
abhito vaiṣṇavo bhāvo maṃgalaṃ bahu dṛśyate |
viṣṇubhaktāstathā nāryo bhittiṣu citritāḥ śubhāḥ ||94||
vidyante yatra saudheṣu tīrthāni tadgṛhāṇi me |
jalakrīḍāpratimāśca rādhārāsasya maṇḍalam ||95||
brahmapriyāvivāhasya pratimāścitritā gṛhe |
tadgṛhaṃ divyarūpaṃ me bhaktasya muktitīrthakam ||96||
gobhiryutaṃ ca rūpaṃ me vidyādhyayanacitrakam |
vimānasthaṃ citrakaṃ me yajñadīkṣādicitrakam ||97||
kuṃkumavāpikācitraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro’nvitam |
lomaśāśramasaṃśobhaṃ citraṃ śrīkambharāyutam ||98||
gopālakṛṣṇacitraṃ ca sarvadevādipūjitam |
bhaktarakṣākarāścāpi pratimā me śubhāspadāḥ || 99||
sarvā mokṣapradā lakṣmi tīrthaṃ manmūrtiyuggṛham |
tripañcāśanmūrtayo me’vatāriṇastvayā saha || 3.71.10 0||
sarvāstā mokṣadā yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu santi padmaje |
tadvaṃśavaṃśavaṃśānāṃ mokṣaḥ prajāyate dhruvaḥ || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tripādvibhūtiḥ, māyāprārthanayā kṛtaikapādalīlāvibhūtāvapidivyatādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||

<3.72>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhajanaṃ mama mokṣadam |
kṛṣṇa viṣṇo hare rāma mukunda madhūsūdana || 1 ||
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa puruṣottama keśava |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpate prabho || 2 ||
padmanābhākṣaravartin cātmārāma kṛpānidhe |
vāsudeva muktikeśa śrīdhara śrīpate vibho || 3 ||
rādhāramāpate jiṣṇo prajñāpadmāvatīpate |
śrīda śrīśa śrīnivāsa mokṣakṛnmāṇikīpate || 4 ||
kambharānandana brahmapriyākānta janārdana |
gopālabāla viśveśa sukhadāśrīpate’dhipa || 5 ||
prāṇeśa kāntakānteśa parameśvara mādhava |
ityevamuccarantyo vai nāryo nāmāni me bhuvi || 6 ||
narāścāpi prayāntyeva dhāma me jaraṭhā api |
bālā vṛddhāḥ kumārāśca mama nāmaparāyaṇāḥ || 7 ||
praṇamanti hariṃ māṃ ye gṛhakarmaratā api |
āsane śayane yāne dhyāne jñāne hi māṃ ghavam || 8 ||
krīḍamānāḥ praṇamanti te yānti dhāma me’kṣaram |
divārātrau sumadhuraṃ bruvanti yatra nāma te || 9 ||
kṛṣṇasya dṛśyate bhāvo yatra gṛhe bhuvastale |
viṣṇulokasya samatā mama dhāmnaśca tulyatā || 3.72.1 0||
tadgṛhasya sadā lakṣmīrnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
nāntaraṃ tatra paśyāmi bhaktagṛhe’kṣarālaye || 11 ||
mamoccāraṃ prakurvanti nityaṃ dhāmnyakṣare mama |
tathā pṛthvyāṃ mama nāma gṛṇanti yatra tadgṛham || 12||
divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ bodhyaṃ viśeṣo’tra na vidyate |
ubhayorlokayorbhāvaḥ samastena samānatā || 13||
jarārogabhayaṃ nāsti mṛtyuhīnā yato janāḥ |
yatra mannāmagānaṃ ca manmantraraṭanaṃ tathā || 14||
kimvadhikaṃ vadeyaṃ vai māyā divyā mamāśrayāt |
gāvo divyā hi bhaktasya mahiṣyaśca tathā śubhāḥ || 15||
gṛhodyānāni divyāni gṛhaṃ divyaṃ śubhaṃ sadā |
gṛhopakaraṇānyasya divyāni bhojanānyapi || 16||
gṛhāṃgaṇaṃ sadā divyaṃ putrapautrādayo’pi ca |
sadā bhaktasya divyā vai pātrāṇi ca dhanāni ca || 18 ||
vṛkṣāśca vallikā divyā khaṣṭvādyāstaraṇāni ca |
peṭikāmbarabhūṣādyā divyā bhaktasya me sadā || 18||
bhaktagṛhasya dhūlī ca rajāṃsyapi jalāni ca |
dhānyānyapi ca divyāni yatrāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 9||
api tadgṛhabhoktāraḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo’pi ca |
divyā atithayaścāpi mama prasādapāvitāḥ ||3.72.20||
tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi bhaktabhogyāni sarvathā |
vastūni bhogyajātāni pāvanāni hi pāpinām ||2 1 ||
ityevaṃ vidyate lakṣmi pāvanaṃ mama vāsataḥ |
nirguṇaṃ puṇyadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhaktagṛhādikam ||22|
śṛṇu lakṣmi yayātervai nāhuṣasya kathānakam |
mama bhaktasya loke’tra pāvanaṃ lokamokṣadam ||23||
yayātirbhagavadbhakto hyaśvamedhaśataṃ tathā |
vājapeyaśataṃ cakre vaiṣṇavaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||24||
dadāvanekarūpāṇi dānāni śraddhayā nṛpaḥ |
gavāṃ lakṣasahasrāṇi tathā koṭiśatāni ca ||25||
koṭihomām̐ścakārāpi bhūmidānādikaṃ dadau |
varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi hyaśītirjīvito hi saḥ ||26||
śuśoca vai yayātiḥ sa deho’yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ |
bhasmānto vā viḍanto vā mṛdanto vā bhaviṣyati ||27||
anena cārjyate pāpaṃ narakaṃ ca phalaṃ tataḥ |
anena cārjyate puṇyaṃ svargaṃ rājyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||28||
anena cārjyate bhaktirmokṣo yayā bhaved dhruvaḥ |
tasmāt sa eva sādhyo’tra rājye sthitvā vivekinā ||29||
vicāryetthaṃ harernāmnāmārebhe bhajanaṃ nṛpaḥ |
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ||3.72.30||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dāmodarācyuta |
evaṃ bhajan nijadūtānādideśa śubhaṃ vacaḥ ||3 1||
yāntu dūtā mama rāṣṭraṃ samudrāntaṃ hi maṇḍalam |
ādiśantu prajābhyaśca kurvantu bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||32||
paśyantu paramātmānaṃ gṛṇantu nāmakīrtanam |
pūjayantu hariṃ nityaṃ bhajantāṃ parameśvaram ||33||
karaṃ naiva grahīṣyāmi bhaktaprajābhya eva ha |
nāmāmṛtaṃ harereva kīrtayantu sadā prajāḥ ||34||
dūtādiṣṭāḥ prajāścāpi cakrurvai bhajanaṃ tathā |
dhyāyanti sma hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gāyanti sma janārdanam ||35||
japanti sma ca tapyante yajante sma ca māṃ sadā |
maddhyānā madvyavasitā mama pūjāparāyaṇāḥ ||36||
yāvadbhūmaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva vaiṣṇavaṃ tadā |
matpratāpena sañjātā mānavā ādhivarjitāḥ ||37||
vītaśokāśca puṇyāśca sarvarogavivarjitāḥ |
sarvaiśvaryasamāpannā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ ||38||
putrapautrādisadvaṃśā nirāmayā nirītayaḥ |
gṛhadvāre kalpavṛkṣāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||39||
sarvakāmadughā gāvaścintāmaṇayaścāpi vai |
abhavan rājyavṛddhyādyāḥ sampadaścāvitarkitāḥ ||3.72.40||
sarvasaubhāgyasampannā jñānadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
prajāścāsan supuṇyāśca bhaktipūjāparāyaṇāḥ ||41 ||
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ nṛṇām |
vaiṣṇavā mānavāḥ sarve mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||42||
majjapā madbhaktisevānāmakīrtanatatparāḥ |
sarvatra vaiṣṇavo bhāvo gṛhe vṛkṣe paśuṣvapi ||43||
gṛhe gṛhe mandirāṇi bhāsvanti mama cābhavan |
gṛhabhittiṣu citrāṇi mamaivāsan tvayā saha ||44||
madbhaktābhiśca nārībhirgīyante gītayo mama |
prabhajanti prajā māṃ ca bālavṛddhakumārakāḥ ||45||
gṛhakarmaratā nāryo bhajante māṃ pareśvaram |
āsane śayane yāne pāne sthāne ca bhojane ||46||
krīḍāyāmutsave kāme māṃ bhajanti hariṃ prabhum |
bruvanti śrīharernāma mānayanti sma mokṣadam ||47||
evaṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyaṃ vai bhūtalaṃ sarvato’bhavat |
sarve bhaktiparā lakṣmi mama snehaparāyaṇāḥ ||48||
yayātinopadiṣṭāste sañjātā vaiṣṇavā bhuvi |
jarāmaraṇaśūnyāścābhavan mama prasādataḥ ||49||
mama lokaṃ na te yānti vaiṣṇavā dīrghajīvinaḥ |
ye ca yānti vimānena vaiṣṇavaṃ mama dhāma te ||3.72.50||
apyabdalakṣadehāste vṛddhā api narāḥ striyaḥ |
pañcaviṃśābdikāḥ sarve dṛśyante kṛpayā mama ||51||
sthirakāyāśca sukhino jarārogādivarjitāḥ |
teṣu bhakteṣu sarveṣu viṣṇudūtā hareḥ śritāḥ ||52||
vicaranti tāḍayanti dṛṣṭvā yamasya pārṣadān |
rudantaste tāḍitāśca yāmyā yayuryamaṃ prati ||53||
kathayāmāsurevaite ceṣṭitaṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ kṣitau |
amṛtyubhūtalaṃ jātaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvameva ha ||54||
yayātinā mahābhaktyā vaikuṇṭhābhaṃ kṛtaṃ khalu |
tāḍyante yamadūtā vai viṣṇudūtaiḥ kṣitau yama ||55||
kiṃ kurmo naiva gacchāmo bhūtalaṃ dharmarāja vai |
dharmarājaḥ śrutavām̐śca cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ||56||
asya rājño bhavedantastathā kāryaṃ mayā dhruvam |
rājño nāśe prajāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti kumārgagāḥ ||57||
yāmyamārgaḥ sātithiko bhaviṣyati punastathā |
vicāryetthaṃ yayau viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭhe prārthayat prabhum ||58||
nanāma daṇḍavaccāpi pupūja parameśvaram |
nyavedayaddhariṃ dharmarājo yayātivartanam ||59||
tava bhaktena bhagavan ruddhaḥ panthā yamasya me |
mānavā bhūtale sarve vaiṣṇavāstena vai kṛtāḥ ||3.72.6 0||
tasmāddhare nijabhaktaṃ śīghramatra samāhvaya |
pāpināṃ daṇḍarodho’pi bhaveduddhāṭitastataḥ ||61||
idānīṃ tu bhaktayogāt pāpino’pi vrajanti tat |
dhāma pāpāni nirdhūya riktaṃ yāmyagṛhaṃ mama ||62||
ityarthito hariḥ prāha satyaṃ mama tathāsti tat |
madbhaktānāṃ saṃgamādvai pāpino’pi hi pāvanāḥ ||63||
bhavantyeva na sandeho bhūrvaikuṇṭhasamā hi sā |
kintu bhaktādhīna eva bhavāmi nānyathā yama ||64||
bhaktasyecchāviruddhaṃ yannācarāmi kadācana |
svasti te’stu bhaja māṃ tvaṃ mā bhaktivighnamācara ||65||
yadvā satye brahmaloke yāhi tvaṃ parameṣṭhinam |
nivedaya yathārthaṃ ca sa te buddhiṃ pradāsyati ||66||
ityukto yamarājaśca lakṣmi yayāvajaṃ prati |
nanāma pupūja yamo nyavedayacca tattathā ||67||
śrutvā brahmā yamaṃ prāha bhakto rājā hi vaiṣṇavaḥ |
parābhāvyo na vai syāddhi mā yatnaṃ kuru tatra vai ||68||
kintu te cāsti hṛdayaṃ yāmyamārgaṃ pravartitum |
kuru yatnaṃ tathā dharma yāhīndra prati vai divam ||69||
ardhāsanaṃ mahendrasya rājñe dānāya vedaya |
evaṃ kṛte sadā rājā svarge sthāsyati na kṣitau ||3.72.70||
bhaktirmandā prajāyāṃ ca bhaviṣyati tato yama |
dharmo mandastena mārgastava pūrṇo bhaviṣyati ||71 ||
ityuktaḥ prayayau dharmarājaścendraṃ divaṃ prati |
samāyāntaṃ dharmarājaṃ dadarśa surarāṭ drutam ||72||
samutthāya dadāvardhāsanaṃ papraccha cāgamam |
dharmarājo’bravīt sarvaṃ yayāteścaritaṃ śubham ||73||
nahuṣasyātmajenāpi yayātinā mahītale |
vaiṣṇavena kṛtāḥ sarve vaiṣṇavā dhārmikāḥ khalu ||74||
vaikuṇṭhatulyarūpaṃ vai rājate bhūmimaṇḍalam |
mānavā amarā jātā jarārogavivarjitāḥ ||75||
apāpāḥ satyaśīlāśca krodhādidoṣavarjitāḥ |
bhaktiśīlā dharmaparāḥ samarcanti narāyaṇam ||76 ||
dūrvā vaṭā yathā bhūmau vistāraṃ yānti vaṃśagāḥ |
tathā prajā vistṛtāśca putrapautraiḥ prapautrakaiḥ ||77||
yamamārge na cāyānti yānti vaikuṇṭhameva tāḥ |
kāryahīno’smi sañjāto vyāpāreṇa vivarjitaḥ ||78||
etajjñātvā mahendra tvaṃ prajāyā me’pi vai hitam |
samācāra pravāhasya vedhaḥsargasya vai gatim ||79||
ityuktvā prayayau dharmarājaḥ svasyālayaṃ tataḥ |
mahendro mātaliṃ cāha sārathiṃ yāhi bhūtalam ||3.72.8 0||
nāhuṣaṃ nṛpatiṃ bhaktaṃ yayātiṃ vada madvacaḥ |
ardhāsanaṃ mahendro vai bhavate dāsyate nijam ||8 1||
yāhi svargaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva kalpāntaṃ divi bhūpate |
varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi rājyaṃ bhuktaṃ tvayā nṛpa ||82||
svargaṃ bhuṅkṣva punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ ca tataḥ padam |
putrāste santi catvāro ruruḥ puruḥ kururyaduḥ ||83 ||
tebhyo rājyaṃ samarpyaiva vimānenaihi ca divam |
ilaḥ purūravā vipracitiḥ śivirmanustathā ||84||
sagaro nahuṣaste’pi pitānye ca nareśvarāḥ |
svarge tatra pramodante cāyāhi tvaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||85||
śakreṇa saha modasva svargadharmeṣu saṃsthitaḥ |
nṛpāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi bhūtale tava ||86||
dānayajñavṛṣabhaktibhirgatāni śubhāni ha |
pañcātmakaśarīrasya bhūmau tyāgaṃ vidhāya vai ||87||
divyaṃ rūpaṃ samagṛhya bhuṅkṣva svargasukhāni tu |
śrutvovāca yayātiśca mātale śṛṇu madvacaḥ ||88||
yena kāyena saṃsiddhyet sukṛtaṃ muktisādhanam |
bhaktiśca jāyate kṛṣṇe kathaṃ tyājyaṃ kalevaram ||89||
satyadharmātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ yena kāyena mānavaḥ |
samarjayati muktiṃ ca tat kasmāt saṃvisarjayet ||3.72.90||
ātmā kāyaśca dvāvetau mitrarūpāvubhāvapi |
tasmānnaiva parityājyamātmanā svakalevaram ||91 ||
śrutvaitanmātaliścāha rājan satyaṃ tavoditam |
kintu kālavaśo dehaḥ karmapoṣyaḥ sthitastviha ||92||
bhūtapañcakarūpaśca pārthivastu viśeṣataḥ |
āyuṣyakarmanāśe vai tyaktavyo’yaṃ prasahya vai ||93||
bhavatyeva sadā lokaiḥ sthitireṣā hi vidyate |
jarāsya jāyate paścānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||94||
tasmāt tyājyasvabhāvaṃ vai dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ vraja |
śrutvā prāha yayātirvai mātale sā jarā nanu ||95||
kadotpannā kathaṃ pīḍākarī vada yathātatham |
śrutvā ca mātaliḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan svabhāvajam ||96||
mahākālo hareḥ śaktiḥ śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ |
mahākālasya mṛtyurvai putrī tasyā jarā sutā ||97||
sā māyākṛtatattveṣu samutpattau sahasthitā |
utpannānnirṇītakālānāviśati kṣayaṃkarī ||98||
kṣīyate hi pradhānaṃ vai mahattattvaṃ vināśavat |
ahaṃkāraḥ kṣīyate’pi mano’pi kṣīyate’pi ca ||99||
vairājaḥ kṣīyate cāpīndriyāṇi viṣayāstathā |
bhūtāni cāpi kṣīyante bhautikāni tayā muhuḥ || 3.72.10 0||
rasāḥ poṣaṇakartāraḥ kṣīyante dehasaṃsthitāḥ |
sarasāḥ sarvadehā vai prakāśante prapoṣitāḥ || 101 ||
rasāḥ śukrasvarūpā vai rasādhikye tu yauvanam |
nārīprasaṃgato rājan rasanāśo bhavatyapi || 1 01||
nāryā naraprasaṃgena rasanāśo hi vṛddhatā |
raso vīrya kāmanā tannāśe sarvavṛddhatā || 1 03||
śukraśoṇitayornāśe śūnyadehaḥ prajāyate |
vivarṇo duḥkhasantapto jarāvyāptastadā bhavet || 1 04||
palitaṃ jāyate tena jvaratāpaḥ prajāyate |
nāśamāyānti jīrṇāste maraṇaṃ tattathā dhruvam || 1 05||
iti rājan vicāryaiva dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ vraja |
vimānaṃ cendrasaubhāgyamānītaṃ tvatkṛte mayā || 106||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhagavannāmamantrabhajanena yayāternṛpatya prabhāveṇa sarvaprajāvaiṣṇavītvādinirūpaṇanomā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||

<3.73>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tva yayāteruttarāṇi vai |
mānave divi vā satye viśeṣo naiva vai mṛtau || 1 ||
tasmāddehaṃ vihāyāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi na vai divam |
naiva kāyo vinā prāṇaṃ prāṇā jīvaṃ vinā na ca || 2 ||
jīvo nātmānamṛte ca hyātmā hariṃ vinā na ca |
etatsarva vihāyātra svarga me naiva rocate || 3 ||
yeṣāṃ prasādabhāvena sukhamaśnāmi bhūtale |
tān saṃtyaktvā svargabhogaṃ bhokṣye’haṃ naiva sarvathā || 4 ||
paśya me puṇyabhaktyāḍya kāyaṃ viṃśativarṣavat |
aśītivarṣajīrṇo’haṃ bhaje dehaṃ navaṃ yathā || 5 ||
naiva glānirna me hānirna bhramo vyādhayo na ca |
vardhate dharmabhaktibhyāṃ balavān kāya eva me || 6 ||.
sarvāmṛtamayaṃ divyamoṣadhaṃ bhaktisaṃyutam |
dharmākhyaṃ kriyate cātra pāpavyādhipraṇāśanam || 7 ||
śrīhareḥ kīrtanenaiva kāyo mayā hi śodhitaḥ |
etadrasāyanaṃ nityaṃ pibāmi pācayāmi ca || 8 ||
tena me ca jarāmṛtyū vidyete naiva tadbalāt |
ye pibanti mahābhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanāmarasāyanam || 9 ||
teṣāṃ deho divyarūpo jāyate vai yathā mama |
harerdhyānena bhaktyā ca pūjayā sevayā tathā || 3.73.1 0||
satyena dānapuṇyena mantrajapena mātale |
bhaktisaṃsthāpanenāpi kāyo me’sti nirāmayaḥ || 11 ||
āśīrvādaiḥ satāṃ jāto māyākālādinirbhayaḥ |
hareḥ kṛpāvaśādatra svargātsvargaṃ mamāsti vai || 1 2||
hareḥ pūjopacāreṇa bhaktyā dhyānena kīrtanaiḥ |
satyadānaniyamādyaiḥ kāyo me divyatāṃ gataḥ || 1 3||
nāhaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi svargamatra karomi vai |
yāhi cendraṃ yathārthaṃ vai mayoktaṃ sannivedaya || 14||
śrutvā ca mātalistūrṇaṃ yayāvindraṃ nyavedayat |
indro’pi cintayitvaiva klṛptānāṃ cāparāṃ tataḥ || 15||
vyaracayannṛpaṃ mohayituṃ cāha ca mātalim |
śṛṇu tvaṃ mātale rājā viṣṇubhakto dṛḍho’sti vai || 16||
sa tu bhaktiṃ parityajya divaṃ nāyāsyati kvacit |
kintu sadeha evāsāvāmantraṇīya ādarāt || 17||
vijñāpanīyo vinayairdevādyaiḥ sṛṣṭinītitaḥ |
atha vai mātaliścājñāṃ prāpya yayau nṛpaṃ prati || 18||
rājā cakre ca sammānaṃ mātaliḥ prāha vai sphuṭam |
rājannindro varuṇaśca mamaḥ kuberako’nalaḥ || 1 9||
īśānaścāpyanilaśca nirvṛtaśca guruḥ kaviḥ |
sarve tvāṃ mānayāsurnijadhiṣṇyārhameva ca ||3.73.20||
sarve nivedayāmāsurlokahitārthameva yat |
sadehenāpi vai svarge devahitārthamityapi |||21 ||
āgantavyaṃ tvayā rājannityāmantraṇamasti naḥ |
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā yatheṣṭaṃ ca sammilitvā surādikān ||22||
punargantavyamevātha bhūtale ca yathecchayā |
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ sammānya daivataṃ vacaḥ ||23||
vimānavaramāruhya yayau mātalinā divam |
dikpālānāṃ sabhāyāṃ sa nṛpaḥ sammānitaḥ suraiḥ ||24||
surānnatvā niṣasāda yathārhaṃ ca tataḥ param |
maitrīṃ sāptapadīnāṃ ca kṛtvā parasparaṃ tataḥ ||25||
indro jagāda rājānaṃ śṛṇu rājan hitāvaham |
lokā vai māyayā vyāptā mānavā devatāsurāḥ ||26 ||
tvayā lokā nirjitāśca viṣṇubhaktyā hi bhūtale |
nṛpe dharmayute tasya prajā bhavati dhārmikī ||27||
nṛpe bhakte bhaktiyuktā duṣṭe duṣṭā bhavatyapi |
bhūtalaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma tvayā kṛtaṃ śubhaṃ khalu ||28||
kintu rājan yamamārgaḥ svargamārgo’pi sārgalaḥ |
idānīṃ vartate bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti mānavāḥ ||29||
dikpālānāṃ ca ye lokā nirjanā vai bhavanti yat |
brahmaṇā ca kṛtaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ pravāho’pi niruddhyate ||3.73.30||
devānāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāmāśā luptā bhavatyapi |
vaṃśavistārabhāvāśca pravardhante hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||3 1 ||
sarve yāsyanti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na svargaṃ na yamālayam |
na janaṃ na tapaścāpi na satyaṃ brahmaṇo gṛham ||32||
evaṃ vai vartamāne tu ṛṇānubandhitā nṛpa |
luptaiva syāttato rājan pravāho na yathā kṣayet ||33||
tathā vicārya sarveṣāmānukūlyaṃ vidhehi vai |
icchāmo bhavate dātumapsaroratnamuttamam ||34||
gṛhāṇa bhuṅkṣva bhūlokaṃ yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti tato mārgā yamādīnāmanargalāḥ ||35||
śrutvā prāha yayātirvai nāhaṃ kāpathago nṛpaḥ |
koṭipuṇyottarāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇapriyām ||36||
nimaṃkṣyāmi na saṃsāre sarvathālokite punaḥ |
mama puṇyaṃ vinaśyecca bhaktiḥ syād vyabhicāriṇī ||37||
saṃsārapāramāptasya punarme patanaṃ bhavet |
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kuprasanno bhavenmama || 38||
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ me vyarthaṃ syāt tannecchāmyapsarovarām |
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya sthitastāvat surādayaḥ ||39||
sasmarurviṣṇumīśānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tatra vai drutam |
prāyayurdevavaryāśca pūjitā devatādibhiḥ ||3.73.40||
niṣeduścāsaneṣveva vijñāpitāḥ kathāṃ prati |
śrutvā viṣṇustadā prāha yayātiṃ tu nijānugam ||41 ||
rājan gṛhāṇa devānāṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ yamasya ca |
gṛhāṇa cāpsadoratnaṃ prajāte tādṛśī tadā ||42||
bhaviṣyati mohayuktā dharmādikāryavarjitā |
yamādisṛtayaścāpi bhaviṣyantyapyanargalāḥ ||43||
mama vākyaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ svasti te saṃbhaviṣyati |
brahmaharau tathaivaiva prāhatustaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ||44||
nṛpo natvārthayāmāsa bandhanaṃ pāpameva me |
bhavettasmāt kṛpāsindho samuddhāraṃ kuru prabho ||45||
viṣṇuḥ prāha na te bandho’psarasā vai bhaviṣyati |
karma sarvaṃ tava rājan nirguṇaṃ vai mamājñayā ||46||
tāmasānāṃ rājasānāṃ mohanārthaṃ samācara |
apsaroratnamāsādya kāmabhogān samācara ||47||
muktiste bhavitā rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
asmadvākyaṃ hi vedo’sti vidhirdharmaḥ sa eva saḥ ||48||
asmadvākyavidhānena muktirmuktiḥ śubhā gatiḥ |
asmadvākyavirodhena duḥkhaṃ bandho hyadhogatiḥ ||49||
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ svīcakārāpsarovarām |
devatāḥ pūjayāmāsū rājānaṃ vākyavartinam ||3.73.50||
viṣṇū rakṣākaraṃ mantraṃ dadau naijaṃ tu nirguṇam |
viṣṇuprayojitaścāhaṃ karomi karma yadvidham |||51||
sarvaṃ samarpitaṃ viṣṇau nirbandhaṃ viṣṇave svāhā |
enaṃ mantraṃ tadā labdhvā nītvā cāpsarasaṃ nṛpaḥ ||52||
bindumatīṃ cātha natvā surān viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca |
āyayau bhūtalaṃ rājā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ||53||
reme sākaṃ tayā lakṣmi mohamāpto’bhavattataḥ |
cireṇāyaṃ dharmakarmabhaktyādīn vismṛto’bhavat ||54||
prajā vīkṣya nṛpaṃ tadvad dharmakarmavivarjitāḥ |
cireṇāpyabhavan lakṣmi yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ ||55||
bindumatī ratiputrī cāpsarogaṇamadhyagā |
rājapatnī hi rājānaṃ mohe cikṣepa sarvadā ||56||
kāmabhogaiśca vārdhakyaṃ hyavāpa nṛpa eva saḥ |
satṛṣṇasyāntikād bindumatī cādṛśyatāṃ yayau ||57||
rājā śokaṃ cakārāsyāḥ kṛte cāpi divāniśam |
atha sā dadṛśe rātrau rājānaṃ prati bhāvukī ||58||
vṛddhastvaṃ dṛśyase rājan naiva yogyo’si matkṛte |
yauvanaṃ prāpya vartethāstvāṃ seviṣye tadā nṛpa ||59||
rājā kāmāturaḥ putrānāhūya vākyamāha tat |
turuṃ yaduṃ kuruṃ puruṃ spaṣṭamāha nṛpastadā ||3.73.60||
eko’pi gṛhyatāṃ putrā jarā me’śaktikāriṇī |
dhīro bhūtvā tato naijaṃ tāruṇyaṃ mama dīyatām ||61 ||
mānasaṃ me’tisantaptaṃ stryāsaktaṃ bahucañcalam |
jarāyāścopagrahaṇaṃ kariṣyati sutastu yaḥ ||62||
sa bhunakti tu me rājyaṃ bhuvaṃ sandhārayiṣyati |
vipulā santatistasya yaśaḥ kīrtirbhaviṣyati ||63||
śrutvā putrāstamūcurvai bhavān dharmaparo nṛpa |
kasmātte cāpsaroyogādīdṛśī bhāvanādhamā ||64||
yayātiḥ prāha mohānme bhāvanā cedṛśī sutāḥ |
avaśyaṃbhāvino bhāvā bhavanti prakṛtervaśāḥ ||65||
evaṃ jñātvā prakartavyaṃ yatsukhaṃ mama putrakāḥ |
turuḥ prāha śarīraṃ prāpyate pitṛprasādataḥ ||66||
dharmaḥ sevā ca śuśrūṣā pitrostenaiva jāyate |
tena viṣayabhogaśca jāyate ca yunā sadā ||67||
so’yaṃ me dānakālo na na dāsye yauvanaṃ hi te |
bhavān vṛddhatvamāpanno yogyo’yaṃ samayastathā ||68||
śrutvā rājā śaśāpainaṃ taruṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ tadā |
apadhvastastvayādeśo mamaivaṃ pāpacetana ||69||
tasmāt pāpī bhava tvaṃ vai sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ |
vedācāravihīnaśca brahmaghno madyapo bhava ||3.73.70||
sarvabhakṣaśca durmedhā mlecchācāro bhaviṣyati |
putrāḥ pautrāḥ prapautrādyāstādṛśāste bhavantviti ||71 ||
evaṃ śaptvā turuṃ cāpi niṣkāsya rājyamaṇḍalāt |
yaduṃ prāha pradehi me yauvanaṃ bhuṃkṣva rāṣṭrakam ||72||
yaduḥ prāha na śaknomi dātuṃ te yauvanaṃ nṛpa |
jarāyā hetavaḥ pañca cintā vṛddhastriyastathā ||73||
kadannaṃ nityamadhvā ca śītajāṭharapīḍanam |
sā jarā rocate me na bhogakālo hyayaṃ mama ||74||
śrutvā rājā śaśāpainaṃ rājyahīnaḥ savaṃśajaḥ |
tejohīnaḥ kṣatradharmavarjitaḥ paśupālakaḥ ||75||
bhaviṣyasi na sandeho yāhi rājyād bahirmama |
ityuktvā ca kuruṃ prāha śarmiṣṭhābālakaṃ nṛpaḥ ||76||
dehi me yauvanaṃ putra gṛhāṇa tvaṃ jarāṃ mama |
kuruḥ prāha kariṣyāmi bhajanaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā ||77||
kaḥ pitā ko’tra vai mātā sarve svārthaparā bhuvi |
na kāṃkṣe tava rājyaṃ vai na dāsye yauvanaṃ mama ||78||
ityuktvā pitaraṃ natvā himālayavanaṃ yayau |
tatra tepe tapaścāpi vaiṣṇavo dharmabhaktimān ||79||
kṛṣiṃ cakāra dharmātmā saptakrośamitakṣiteḥ |
halena karṣayāmāsa mahiṣeṇa vṛṣeṇa ca ||3.73.80||
ātithyaṃ sarvadā cakre nūtnadhānyādibhiḥ sadā |
viṣṇurviprasvarūpeṇa yayau kuroḥ kṛṣiṃ prati ||81||
ātithyaṃ ca gṛhītvaiva mokṣapadaṃ dadau tataḥ |
kurukṣetraṃ ca tannāmnā kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇena ha ||82||
sarvamokṣakaraṃ ramyaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśakam |
atha rājā puruṃ prāha dehi me yauvanaṃ suta ||83||
bhuṃkṣva rājyaṃ mayā dattaṃ supuṇyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam |
pururnatvāha rājyaṃ vai bhoktavyaṃ daivayogataḥ||84||
jarāṃ dehi gṛhāṇāpi yauvanaṃ me pitardrutam |
tṛptiṃ yāhi mahārāja yatheṣṭāṃ yauvanena me ||85||
tavaiva yauvanaṃ tvetat tavaivāṃśo’hamasmi ca |
svatvaṃ tavaiva mayyasti gṛhāṇa yauvanaṃ mama ||86||
ityuktvā jalamādāya dadau haste piturjalam |
yauvanaṃ tāmravarṇaṃ vai tūrṇaṃ dehād vyapāsarat ||87||
praviveśa yayātestu śarīre sa ca vai yuvā |
babhūva ca jarā prāptā puruṃ putraṃ piśācinī ||88||
purumāha tato rājā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ |
mama rājyaṃ prabhuṃkṣva tvaṃ mayā dattaṃ mahāmate ||89 ||
yauvanaṃ te’pi cādyaiva punarbhavatu me’pi ca |
viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ putra jarāvyapagamastava ||3.73.9 0||
āvayoryauvanaṃ nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktiprabhāvataḥ |
sarvadāstu jagādaivaṃ putro yuvā babhūva ha ||9 1 ||
yayātiśca yuvā jātaḥ paśya lakṣmi balaṃ mama |
pitṛbhaktibalaṃ cāpi cāpsaraḥsaṃgamaṃ tathā ||9 2||
sarvametat phaladaṃ vai svānurūpaṃ kṣitau matam |
puruḥ rājyaṃ cakārāpi yayātirbhogamāptavān ||93||
dhanūrājyaṃ ca chatraṃ ca gajamaśvaṃ dhanaṃ dharām |
kośaṃ veśaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ gṛham ||94||
dadau rājā hi purave bindumatīpatistadā |
yayāvudyānabhāgaṃ covāsaikānte tayā saha ||95 ||
atha bindumatī prāha śṛṇu tvaddūṣaṇaṃ nṛpa |
śarmiṣṭhā devayānī ca tava bhārye hyubhe hyapi ||96||
anyāśca rājakanyāste bhāryāśataṃ bhavatyapi |
sāpatnakena bhāvena bhavān bhartā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||97||
sasarpo’si mahārāja candanasya drumo yathā |
varamagnipraveśaṃ ca śikharātpatanaṃ varam ||98||
taṃ varaṃ naiva paśyāmi sapatnīviṣasaṃyutam |
ahaṃ rājan prabhoktrī syāṃ tava kāyasya bhūpate ||99 ||
ityarthe pratyayaṃ dehi mama vai svakare nṛpa |
yatra kvāpi nivāsena nātra sapatnikāgṛhe || 3.73.100 ||
rājā dadau pratyayaṃ ca tato vanādiṣu svayam |
yayau sārdhaṃ bindumatyā parvateṣu digantare || 101 ||
vai viṃśatisahasrāṇi varṣāṇyasya gatāni hi |
athāpsaro’bhavad garbhavatī caicchad divaṃ prati || 1 02||
gantumindragṛhaṃ kāmagṛhaṃ piturniveśanam |
rājānaṃ cāpi netuṃ sā mahāgrahaṃ cakāra ha || 103 ||
devānāṃ darśanaṃ rājan kariṣyasi divaṃ vraja |
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ śuśoca vai kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi || 1 04||
sarvaṃ kālena bhavati kālo’yaṃ me hyupāgataḥ |
pṛthvyāstyāge vacanaṃ me satyaṃ kāryaṃ bhavedataḥ || 1 05||
evaṃ vicāryaṃ ca puruṃ jarāyuktaṃ sutaṃ nṛpaḥ |
āhūya nijatāruṇyaṃ dadau jagrāha vai jarām || 1 06||
rājyārthaṃ ca samādiśya bhaktimādiśya vaiṣṇavīm |
prajābhyaśca svajanebhyaścāśīrdatvā yayau divam || 1 07||
bhaktimatyaḥ prajā nārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā ca tatparāḥ |
abhavan saha gantuṃ vai nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 1 08||
divyadeho’bhavad rājā prajā divyāśca koṭiśaḥ |
abjakharvasahasrāṇi janāste parijagmire || 1 09||
svargaṃ gatvā ca tatraiva bindumatīṃ ratigṛhe |
nidhāya vaiṣṇavaiḥ sākaṃ viṣṇunā cānumoditaḥ || 3.73.11 0||
yayātiḥ prayayau viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha |
brahmalokaṃ yayuḥ sarve pūjitāścāmarādibhiḥ || 11 1||
evaṃ bhaktiprabhāvo’sti lakṣmi nirbandhakṛt sadā |
ahaṃ nayāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ param || 1 12||
bhaktaṃ karmasu magnaṃ vai nirbandhaṃ prakaromi ca |
rājā vaikuṇṭhamāsādya neme varāya yojitaḥ || 1 13||
yayāce sarvathā dāsyaṃ mayā dattaṃ hi śāśvatam |
dikpālānāmabhūt kāryaṃ prajāpravāha ityapi || 1 14||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇācca vicintanāt |
dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca bhaktirmokṣo bhavantyapi || 1 15||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yayāteḥ svargataḥ pṛthivyāmadhikabhaktyādilābha iti tasya pṛthivyāstyāgārthamindrakṛtabindumatyāḥ pradānaṃ putrato yauvanapraptiścānte vaikuṇṭhagamana cetyādibhaktiprabhāvavarṇananāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||

<3.74>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ cādhikaṃ mama |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ cāpi nairguṇyadivyatāpradam || 1 ||
kena me tu bhavet prītiḥ kathaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi ca |
tuṣṭena ca mayā tūrṇaṃ divyo vidhīyate’nugaḥ || 2 ||
kathayāmi samāsena śṛṇu tvaṃ parameśvari |
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ yena kṛtaṃ sevā kṛtā yayā || 3 ||
satāṃ ca pūjanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ me pūjanādikam |
mokṣaścodghāṭito yena jñānopadeśakīrtanaiḥ || 4 ||
teṣāṃ tuṣyāmi kamale sādhūnāṃ maṇḍale’smi ca |
sādhūnāṃ toṣaṇāllakṣmi tuṣyāmyahaṃ sadā priye || 5 ||
sajjanānāṃ parivādo mama vidveṣaṇaṃ mahat |
sajjanānāṃ pūjanena pūjito’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
nityabhivādyāḥ santaśca bhojanīyā nirantaram |
sevanīyāḥ sādhavaste pratimā mama mūrtayaḥ || 7 ||
teṣāṃ tuṣyāmi bhaktānāṃ satsevāṃ ye pracakrire |
na teṣāmaśubhaṃ kiñcitkalmaṣaṃ cāpi vidyate || 8 ||
sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ satīṃ devaṃ pūjayennityamutsukaḥ |
pūjitaṃ hi jagattena sadevāsuramānuṣam || 9 ||
tena rūpeṇa pūjāṃ vai gṛhṇāmyahaṃ sadā prabhuḥ |
pūjā mamaiṣā na tvanyā satsu sādhvīṣvahaṃ sthitaḥ|| 3.74.1 0||
yatra pratiṣṭhā me cāste tān vihāyetaraṃ vṛthā |
sābhimānā janā vegāt pūjayantyajñasattamāḥ || 11 ||
nāhaṃ tatpratigṛhṇāmi na sā tuṣṭikarī mama |
mama sambandhamāptā ye teṣāṃ pūjā garīyasī || 12||
cakraṃ me pūjanīyaṃ vai pādau pūjyau sadā mama |
vārāhādyavatārā me pūjanīyāśca sādhavaḥ || 1 3||
cakreṇa nihatā daityāḥ padbhyāṃ krāntā vasundharā |
vārāhādyavatāraiśca hyasurā vinipātitāḥ || 14||
sādhurūpairjanānāṃ ca mokṣadānaṃ dadāmyapi |
sādhvī dharmavatī nārī bhaktaśaktirnigadyate || 15||
tathā dharmo rakṣyate me pitā janma vahāmyaham |
mātā sādhvī sadā bodhyā bhaktirūpā na saṃśayaḥ || 16||
dāsī lakṣmīsvarūpā ca sarvadā mama dhāriṇī |
parituṣṭo bhavāmyeṣāṃ pūjanāt sarvato’dhikaḥ || 17||
teṣu māṃ pūjayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ |
api sādhuṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmacāriṇamāgatam || 18||
natvā datvāhutiṃ bhuñjyādamṛtaṃ taddhi bhojanam |
sādhvīṃ sandhyāmupāsitvā sādhvādityaṃ namettataḥ || 19||
sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāto mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ |
sādhurūpaṃ dharmadevaṃ pālayet svagṛhe sadā || 3.74.20||
satsaṃgaṃ dharmamevāpya pālayed bhaktarāṭ mama |
satāṃ prasannatā me ca yena dharmaḥ sa vai mataḥ ||21||
satāmudvegajananaṃ hyadharmaḥ sa tu me mataḥ |
mama bhaktā na tuṣyanti yena tena nu kiṃ hi me ||22||
yena tuṣyanti me santastadeva mama saddhanam |
kalye hyutthāya satataṃ spraṣṭavyāḥ sādhavo mama ||23||
gāvo ghṛtaṃ dadhi cāhaṃ sarṣapāḥ sādhikāstathā |
spraṣṭavyāḥ prātarutthāya yena kalmaṣanāśanam ||24||
strīghnā goghnāḥ kṛtaghnāśca brahmaghnā gurutalpagāḥ |
śuddhyanti sādhusaṃsparśāt sādhośca sevanānmama ||25||
santo gāvo’nalāḥ sādhvyaḥ spraṣṭavyā na padā dvijāḥ |
pādena sparśane puṇyaṃ spraṣṭuḥ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ||26||
paramānnaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhojane tebhya uttamam |
miṣṭānnaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ śāśvatītṛptidaṃ śubham ||27||
ātithyaṃ satataṃ kuryād dīpaṃ dadyāt satāṃ gṛhe |
sato vandet praseveta hyeṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamo vṛṣaḥ ||28||
api kratuśatairiṣṭvā kṣayaṃ gacchati taddhaviḥ |
na tu naśyanti te dharmāḥ sādhavo yaiḥ pratoṣitāḥ ||29||
yo yajetāśvamedhena vājapeyaśatena ca |
avākśirāvalambeta satraṃ kuryānnirantaram ||3.74.3 0||
na yasya hṛdayaṃ śuddhaṃ sādhavo me na sevitāḥ |
mama sevā kṛtā naiva māyānirayago hi saḥ ||3 1||
sādhusevā śuddhatā ca hṛdayasya hi mokṣade |
śuddhena manasā kṛtvā svalpamapi pramucyate ||32||
śraddadhānena kartavyaṃ gurūṇāṃ vacanaṃ sadā |
satāṃ sevā prakartavyā tejasvī tena jāyate ||33||
ahanyahani yo dadyāt kapilāṃ dvādaśīḥ samāḥ |
māsi māsi ca satreṇa yo yajeta sadā janaḥ ||34||
gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ ca yo dadyājjyeṣṭhapuṣkare |
tato’dhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya tuṣyanti yasya sādhavaḥ ||35||
śrūyante yāni tīrthāni jalasthalamayāni vai |
siddhadevādijuṣṭāni sevitāni maharṣibhiḥ ||36||
abhiṣekaḥ samasteṣāṃ sādhucaraṇavāribhiḥ |
alpaṃ śītaṃ jalaṃ dattaṃ sādhave’nnaṃ samarpitam ||37||
dātuḥ puṇyodakā nāma nadī praite vidhīyate |
akṣayaṃ salilaṃ tatra śītalaṃ hyamṛtaṃ bhavet ||38||
annaṃ tathāmṛtaṃ tatra padyate paralokinaḥ |
anyaccāpi pradattaṃ tatparaloke’bhipadyate ||39||
loke hyucchiṣṭakāḥ prāyo bahucchidrā hi mānavāḥ |
tyaktaśīlasamācārān praviśanti piśācakāḥ ||3.74.40||
mānavā ye satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ |
tān piśācā nāviśanti bhaktān puṇyakṛtānnarān ||41 ||
sādhujano yatra yatra bhunakti devatārpitam |
sādhyā rudrāstathādityā viśvedevāstathāśvinau ||42||
maruto vasavaścāpi pratibhuñjanti tadgatāḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ me harestathā ||43||
muktānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca prasādālaya eva saḥ |
yo bhavet sādhusādhvīnāṃ sevākṛt toṣakṛttathā ||44||
kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma matsādhuśaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
mucyate pāpakoṭibhyaḥ pūto bhavati pāvakaḥ ||45||
pāpinaḥ pāvayet sādhurmama sevājitātmavān |
mama saṃgaṃ sadā kuryāt pāpisaṃgaṃ vivarjayet ||46||
brahmadṛṣṭyārpayed dānaṃ sādhudṛṣṭyārpayettathā |
haridṛṣṭyārpayellakṣmi taddānaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet| ||47||
annadānaṃ vāridānaṃ jñānadānaṃ śubhaṃ param |
abhīdānaṃ brahmadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ parātparam ||48||
ātmadānaṃ sadā deyaṃ tatsamaṃ netarad bhuvi |
dattātreyo hariḥ sādhuḥ śiṣyebhyo brahmanirguṇam ||49||
dāne datvā yayau dhāmākṣaratulyaṃ svakaiḥ saha |
kapilaśca tathā sādhurharirdatvā vivekajam ||3.74.50||
jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ ca śiṣyebhyo yayau dhāma nijaṃ param |
ṛṣabho’pi samādiśya śiṣyebhyo brahma śāśvatam ||51||
hariḥ so’pi yayau dhāma nijaṃ sarvasukhāspadam |
evamanye’pi santaśca yayurdānaparāyaṇāḥ ||52||
brahmadānapradānena śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ padam |
sādhuvratāśca rājāno brahmabhāvaṃ vilokya ca ||53||
adeyamapi dattvaiva brahmaṇe svargiṇo’bhavan |
śibirauśīnaraḥ prāṇān priyasya tanayasya ca ||54||
brahmiṣṭhārthamupākṛtya mahatsvargamito gataḥ |
pratardanaḥ kāśikeśaḥ pradāya tanu vai nijam ||55||
brahmiṣṭhāyātulāṃ kīrtiṃ labdhvā mokṣapadaṃ gataḥ |
rantidevaśca sāṃkṛtyo vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane ||56||
arghyaṃ pūjāṃ pradāyaiva yayau mokṣapadaṃ śubham |
devāvṛdho yayau dhāma dattvā chatraṃ ca kāñcanam ||57||
brahmiṣṭhāya mahāyajñe śataśalākamuttamam |
ambarīṣo’pi rāṣṭraṃ vai dattvā sarvaṃ prabhoḥ kṛte ||58||
brahmalokaṃ yayau bhaktyā mahābhāgavataḥ śubhaḥ |
vṛṣādarbhiśca sarvasvaṃ dattvā dhāma yayau mama ||59||
nimi rāṣṭraṃ haraye me dattvā dhāma yayau mama |
kanyāṃ datvā hyagastyāya vaidarbhirmokṣamāptavān ||3.74.60||
parśurāmaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvā viprebhyastīrthamāvasat |
vāmano’pi kṣitiṃ dattvā viprebhyaśca tataḥ param ||61||
svargaṃ dattvā hi devebhyo yayau dhāma nijaṃ hariḥ |
rāmādityo’pi viprebhyaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvākṣaraṃ yayau ||62||
kanyāmāṃgirase dattvā marutto’pyakṣaraṃ yayau |
mitrasaho vasiṣṭhāya bhāryāṃ dattvā divaṃ yayau ||63||
sahasracityo rājarṣiḥ prāṇān dattvā divaṃ yayau |
śatadyumnaḥ kṣitiṃ dattvā maudgalyāya divaṃ yayau ||64||
śāṇḍilyāya kṣitiṃ dattvā sumanyurdhāma me yayau |
dyutimān pṛthivīṃ dattvā ṛcīkāyākṣaraṃ yayau ||65||
madirāśvaḥ sutāṃ dattvā hiraṇyāyākṣaraṃ yayau |
śāntāṃ datvā lomapādaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgāya svaryayau ||66||
bhagīrathaḥ sutāṃ haṃsīṃ datvā kautsāya svaryayau |
pṛthvyāmanye bhaviṣyanti rājāno dānayoginaḥ ||67||
sādhubhyo dānamarpayya yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
lakṣmi sakhīstava sarvā dattvā mahyaṃ prajeśvarāḥ ||68||
yātā yāsyanti maddhāma nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
matsādhūnāṃ sevakā ye sevikā dharmasaṃyutāḥ ||69||
bhaktiyutā bhāvayutāstādātmyena sthitā mayi |
narā nāryaḥ prayāsyanti mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param ||3.74.70||
dharmādarthādbhayātkāmātkāruṇyātsādhave sadā |
deyaṃ svalpaṃ ca bahu vā taddhi mokṣāya kalpyate ||71 ||
dharmārthaṃ svargalokārthaṃ dātavyaṃ sukhakīrtaye |
punaścāsmācca labdhavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti tatphalam ||72||
evamarthārthinā deyaṃ sādhave’nantasatphalam |
vipatkāle bhaye prāpte nāśe prāpte ca vastunaḥ ||73||
dātavyaṃ vastu sarvasvaṃ sādhave cāphalecchunā |
priyatārthaṃ pradātavyaṃ sakāmaṃ sādhumūrtaye ||74||
dīnāya ca daridrāya dātavyaṃ karuṇānvitam |
sādhave mama bhaktāya viprāyāpi śubhaṃ śubham ||75||
hareḥ prasannatārthaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat |
kartavyaṃ mama caitadvai vicāryetthaṃ samarpayet ||76||
sādhave nirguṇaṃ caitannārāyaṇāya me’pi ca |
dadyānnārāyaṇasyedaṃ nedaṃ mameti nirguṇam ||77||
anantaphaladaṃ tadvai mahānandapradaṃ bhavet |
dhāmni me tatphalaṃ dāsye dadāmi bhūtale’pi ca ||78||
dātre dadāmi cāsaṃkhyānandavārdhiṃ pare’kṣare |
evaṃ lakṣmi satāṃ sevākarturme paramaṃ padam||79||
śāśvataṃ cāyatau cāsti mamaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtam |
svalpaṃ bahutamaṃ kṛtvā dadāmyakṣaradhāmani ||3.74.80||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kīdṛk svalpasya dattasya phalaṃ dadāsi darśaya |
kṛpayā me hare kṛṣṇa pareśvara kṛpāṃ kuru ||8 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
paśya lakṣmi samāyāntaṃ vipraṃ bhaktaṃ mamāntikam |
svalpadānena tasmai vai dāsyāmyahaṃ hyanantakam |||82||
ityukte dīnavad vipro nāmnā paraśucandrakaḥ |
kadaryo gṛhasarvasvaṃ samādāya samāyayau ||83||
patnīputravihīno vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan |
skandhe koṣṭhalikāṃ sthālīkalaśasruksamanvitām ||84||
vahan kaṭyāṃ jīrṇavastraṃ baddhvā yaṣṭiṃ kare dadhan |
tandulān prasthamānām̐śca dhautraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ tathā ||85||
śirastrāṇaṃ dadhan mūrdhni hyetāvanmātrasampadā |
yuto nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa puruṣottamamādhava ||86||
gṛṇan cāgre vastujātaṃ dhṛtvā ca pādayostadā |
rakṣa śaraṇya kṛṣṇa tvaṃ mokṣaṃ dehi pade tava ||87||
ityayācata tandulān dadau ca bharjitān hi tān |
cakāra daṇḍavattatra luloṭha prārpya mastakam ||88||
netre pramīlya ca kṣaṇaṃ suṣvāpa bhūtale puraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||89||
kiṃkaromyasya bhaktasya śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ |
vada lakṣmi mṛtaścāyaṃ prāṇān tyajati sannidhau ||3.74.90||
ityuktvā taṇḍulān svalpān mukhe kṣiptvā hyabhakṣayam |
paśyaitasya phalaṃ cāsmai dadāmi dhāma cākṣaram ||9 1||
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ pārṣadānvitam |
āruroha sa vipro’pi divyadehaḥ kṛpānvitaḥ ||92|||
vimānaṃ vyomamārgeṇa smṛddhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau |
paśya lakṣmi mama dhāmni prāsādo’sya kṛte mayā ||93||
klṛptaḥ smṛddhiyuto bhakṣyabhojyapeyādikānvitaḥ |
divyadṛṣṭyā paśya sarvaṃ smṛddhaṃ phalaṃ mayārpitam ||94||
kāmagaṃ ca vimānaṃ vai tasyārthe cārpitaṃ mayā |
brahmāmṛtaṃ tathānantaṃ cārpitaṃ tāndulaṃ phalam ||95||
peyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ cāpi svarṇāmbarāṇi vai tathā |
śaraṇāgatabhaktasya bhogyārthaṃ cārpitāni vai ||96||
athālokya prasannā śrīrlakṣmīrmumoda cāntare |
vipradehaḥ sarasyeva kṛṣṇecchayā mamajja ha ||97||
svayaṃ gatiyuto bhūtvā vilayaṃ tatra vai gataḥ |
mahāścaryaṃ ca sarvābhyo lakṣmīścoktavatī tvidam ||98||
sarvā brahmapriyādyāścālokayāmāsureva tam |
divyadṛṣṭyā mahimānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ||99||
paśyaivaṃ mahimā me’sti sarvasyāpi mahatphalam |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi tathaiva phalamuttamam || 3.74.1 00||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktasya mahimakathane harestuṣṭisādhanānāṃ varṇanaṃ, kadaryasya paraśucandrakasya viprasyālpadānasyānantaphalaprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||

<3.75>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
