<3.76>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ me tato’dhikam |
bāleṣu cāghaśūnyeṣu hyanātheṣu vasāmyaham || 1 ||
bālānāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuddhaṃ māyājihmatvavarjitam |
vāsanādirahite’smin sādhuvannivasāmyaham || 2 ||
bālāḥ sarve mūrtayo me svacchā ādarśasadṛśāḥ |
brahmāvasthāstato bālā yogāvasthā yathā janāḥ || 3 ||
mūrtyavasthāśca me bālā bālikāścāṣṭavarṣagāḥ |
ete sarve sādhavo vai sanakādyā yathā purā || 4 ||
sādhudharmāḥ sādhavaste gṛhadharmāstu yauvane |
yuvabhāvavihīnāstu sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 5 ||
sādhutvaṃ śīlavartitvaṃ gṛhitvaṃ kāmayogataḥ |
kāmajaye hi sādhutvaṃ kāmino’pi prajāyate || 6 ||
akāmino’pi saṃbhoge kāme gārhasthyameva tat |
na strīyogo na puṃyogo gārhasthye kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 7 ||
ratiprayogo gārhasthyaṃ taddhīnatvaṃ ca sādhutā |
sā ca nāryāṃ nare cāpi bhavenniṣkāmabhāvane || 8 ||
akāmaḥ satyakāmo vai sarvakāmaḥ prajāyate |
sa eva brahma vijñeyo brāhmaṇyaṃ sādhutānvitam || 9 ||
brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ durlabhaṃ śri sādhutvaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā |
matkṛpāto bhavatyeva brahmiṣṭhatā ca sādhutā || 3.76.1 0||
sādhvītā matkṛpātaśca jāyate mokṣadā śubhā |
vaṃśoddhāraṇakartrī ca sādhvītā ca yathā tvayi || 1 1||
satyadharmaratā sādhvyaḥ santo brahmaparāstathā |
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭā haṭhāḍambaravarjitāḥ || 1 2||
dharmalabdhārthabhoktāraḥ parameśasamarpakāḥ |
nirbandhāḥ svacchahṛdayāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 1 3||
guṇakarmatapobhiḥ śri naro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
mālinyaṃ samparityajya nīco’pyuccataro bhavet || 14||
yathā janmāntare śūdraḥ karmaṇā dharmasaṃbhṛtā |
uttare janmani vipro jāyate puṇyayogataḥ|| 15||
tathaikasmin janau cāpi brahmācāraistu brāhmaṇaḥ |
jāyeta brāhmaṇetaro vipro’pi śūdratāṃ vrajet || 16||
śubhāśubhakriyāsaṃgapāpapuṇyabalaṃ mahat |
vivartayati dharmān vai sattvādhiko hi bhūsuraḥ || 17||
rajo’dhiko bhaved rājā tamo’dhikastu śūdrakaḥ |
sattvarajobhyāṃ saṃspṛṣṭo vaiśyo bhavati śobhanaḥ || 18||
rajastamobhyāṃ saṃspṛṣṭo vaiśyo bhavatyaśobhanaḥ |
tamomātrābahulastu ghātakī śvapaco bhavet || 19||
sattvamātrābahulastu vipraḥ sādhuḥ satī bhavet |
brahmayogabahulastu mukto bhavati vai kṣitau ||3.76.20||
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi cotkṛṣṭatvaṃ śubhāvaham |
mama yogaparaścātra nārāyaṇo’pi jāyate ||21 ||
tadyogena tathā cānye nārāyaṇā bhavantyapi |
evaṃ paramparā nārāyaṇānāṃ mama yogataḥ ||22||
bhavatyeva prabhāveṇa mamaiśvaryādilābhataḥ |
nārāyaṇā narāḥ sarve nārāyaṇyaḥ striyastathā ||23||
upāsanayā jāyante mamaiva paramātmanaḥ |
devatā vasavo rudrā jāyante viṣṇavastathā ||24||
upāsanayā jāyante brahmāṇaśceśvarāstathā |
īśvarāṇyaśca jāyante mamopāsanayā rame || 25||
vītarāgā vimucyante karmabhiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ |
yaiśca nārāyaṇāste vai jāyante samanuṣṭhitaiḥ ||26||
tāni sarvāṇi karmāṇi madupāstimayāni hi |
ṛte copāsanāṃ me vai bali karma nāsti vai ||27||
upāsanā sakāmānāṃ kāmanāpūrikā bhavet |
niṣkāmānāmahaṃ smṛddhaḥ smṛddhidātā prasahya vai ||28||
karmaṇā manasā vācā māmupāste hi bhaktimān |
na sajjane ca kartavye bandhanaṃ naiva gacchati ||29||
prāṇayātrātipātādvai viratāḥ śīlayoginaḥ |
tulyadveṣapriyā dāntā mucyante karmabandhanaiḥ ||3.76.30 ||
sarvabhūtadayāvanto viśvāsyāḥ sarvadehinām |
kṛtabhaktisamācārā lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||3 1 ||
svārthaśūnyāḥ parakāryasahāyadā nirāśayā |
dharmalabdhapratuṣṭāśca lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||32||
nārīvargeṣu paśyanti mātṛsvasṛduhitṛvat |
naravargeṣu paśyanti pitṛmātṛsuputravat ||33||
yathoktasādhusevāḍhyā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
astenā bhāgyajīvāśca lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||34||
naijabhogyaratā ye ca dharmakālābhisāriṇaḥ |
agrāmyasukhalubdhāśca hṛccakṣustejasānvitāḥ ||35||
indramārgānusārāścendriyāvaśyātmasaṃsthitāḥ |
mama bhaktau kṛtāvāsā lokāste dhāmagāminaḥ ||36||
akaṣāyakṛto mārgo dānadharmatapomayaḥ |
śīlaśaucadayāḍhyaśca bhaktisevārpaṇānvitaḥ ||37||
āśīḥprasannatādaśca satsaṃgaphalavardhanaḥ |
nairmalyadhīprakarṣāḍhyaḥ sevanīyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ ||38||
ātmahetoḥ parārthe vā narmahāsyāśrayācca vā |
mṛṣābhāvavihīnā ye yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||39||
vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā kāmakārācca ye janāḥ |
bhāṣante nānṛtaṃ te vai yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||3.76.40 ||
miṣṭāṃ vāṇīṃ bādhaśūnyāṃ pāpaleśavivarjitām |
hārdasnehāṃ ye bhāṣante yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||41||
apaiśūnyaratāḥ santo mitrābhedapravartanāḥ |
adrohāḥ ṛtamaitrāśca yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||42||
śāṭhyaśūnyāḥ saumyavācaḥ kopabhāvavivarjitāḥ |
hṛdvidāraṇaśūnyāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||43||
sāntvayuktā hitavācaḥ satyaguṇā hariśritāḥ |
sādhavaḥ sādhvikā lakṣmi yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||44||
manasāpi na vāñcchanti nirjane’pi dhanaṃ param |
nyastaṃ vā militaṃ ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||45||
grāme gṛhe’pi pārakyaṃ nābhivāñcchanti vai kvacit |
ajātaśatravo ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||46||
śrutavanto bhaktimantaḥ satyadayāprapālakāḥ |
nityatuṣṭā virāgāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||47||
maitrīcittaratāḥ śraddhāsnehopakārasammukhāḥ |
phalavipākavijñāste yantyakaṣāyasatpathe ||48||
nyāyyāgrahāḥ svargaśīlāḥ samutthānaparāyaṇāḥ |
ātmaniṣṭhā matparāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||49||
mahāprājñā brahmaparā jñānavijñānabhāvinaḥ |
tarkaśāstraparā ye te yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||3.76.50||
pāpatrāsānvitāścāpi śreyaḥsādhanatatparāḥ |
ānṛṇyābhilaṣukāste yāntyakaṣāyasatpathe ||51 ||
ye tu śuklābhijātīyāścātmadrohavivarjitāḥ |
jantutrāsākarāścāpyabhayadānapradāstayā ||52||
ātmavatsnehabhāvāśca devavatsughaṭāḥ śubhāḥ |
daivācārāḥ saumyabhāvā yāntyakalmaṣasatpathe ||53||
suvṛttāḥ satkarmiṇaśca prāṇidrohavivarjitāḥ |
dīrghāyuṣo bhavantīha yāntyakalmaṣasatpathe ||54||
dātā satāṃ ca satkartā dīnārtakṛpaṇādiṣu |
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānānāṃ dātāmbarādidāyakaḥ ||55||
bhaktiyogakṛtāvāso jñānadānapradāyakaḥ |
śaraṇāgatarakṣaśca yātyakalmaṣasatpathe ||56 ||
pratiśrayān sabhāḥ kūpān kuryāt puṣkariṇī prapāḥ |
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ manaḥ ||57||
sasyajātāni sarvāṇi gāḥ kṣetrāṇi ca kanyakāḥ |
yaśca prītamanā dāne prayacchati ca pātrake ||58||
sarvasvārpaṇakartā vai yātyakalmaṣasatpathe |
devatādvijasādhūnāṃ satīnāṃ pūjakastathā ||59||
namaskartā praśritaśca sarvapriyakaraḥ śuciḥ |
sarvahitaḥ sumukhaśca yathārhasatkriyāparaḥ || 3.76.60||
sanmārgadarśī gurvarcī yātyakalmaṣasatpathe |
sammataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ||61 ||
udāttakulajātīya udāttābhijanastathā |
maitradṛṣṭiḥ pitṛsamo viśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu ||62|||
bhaktimān me mahāpuṇyo yātyakaṣāyasatpathe |
evaṃvidhaḥ sadā lakṣmi nirbādhaṃ sukhamedhate || 63||
eṣa śreṣṭhaḥ satāṃ panthā bādhā yatra na vidyate |
sādhūn vai vedaviduṣaḥ siddhān bhaktiyutāṃstathā ||64||
sevante ye bhāvayutā varjayantyaśubhaṃ sadā |
teṣāṃ śāśvatasaukhyāḍhyaḥ panthā brahmagatipradaḥ ||65||
eṣāṃ samāgamairlakṣmi kalyāṇāni bhavanti vai |
śreyāṃsi sarvarūpāṇi svargāṇyasaṃkhyakāni ca ||66 ||
pratipadyanta evātra satāṃ dharme sthitasya vai |
nṛṇāṃ hitārthamevātra mayā te samudāhṛtam ||67||
hitaṃ cātmā vivekastho nijaṃ jānāti cāntare |
paraṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti vinā sadgurusaṃśrayam ||68||
puṇyaṃ labdhuṃ samicchanti mānavāḥ sarvadā priye |
puṇyahetūnna kurvanti mūḍhāḥ satyapi vaibhave ||69||
satāṃ saṃgānmamasaṃgāt sādhvīsaṃgācchubhaṃ param |
śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavatyeva jānantyeva ca tattathā ||3.76.70 ||
tathāpi pāpabādhābhirbādhitāstarkanimnagāḥ |
abhimānamahāduṣṭagrāsānanagatāḥ sadā ||71 ||
na sevante sataḥ sādhvīrnārcayanti ca māṃ tathā |
viṣayeṣvabhirāgāśca patanti nirayādiṣu ||72||
na taranti pāpaduṣṭā māyānadīṃ manoharām |
nāstikā dānaśūnyāśca bhāvaśūnyāḥ pradūṣakāḥ ||73||
bhaktibhāvavihīnāśca divyabhāvavivarjitāḥ |
duṣṭabhāvayutā nityaṃ dehadṛṣṭiyutāḥ sadā ||74||
nikṛṣṭakarmasu ratāḥ svārthamātraparāyaṇāḥ |
udarendriyasutṛptā bāhyasaukhyābhidṛṣṭayaḥ ||75||
anātmamātraniratā yānti nirayameva te |
ātmamātraratāḥ sādhudharmaratāśca sevakāḥ ||76||
ājñāpālanakartāro yāntyakalmaṣamatpathe |
varṇāstathāśramā lakṣmi ye ke’pi syurnarāḥ striyaḥ ||77||
vṛddhāśīrvādasaubhāgyāḥ prayānti svargameva te |
vadhvaḥ kanyāḥ kumāryo vā svāminyo vā saputrakāḥ ||78||
aputrā vāpi vṛddhāśīrvādasthāḥ svaḥ prayānti tāḥ |
pradhānā vāpi rājāno bhṛtyā vā dīnavartinaḥ || 79||
sasattā vāpyasattā vā nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinaḥ |
ṛjavo namratāsārāḥ svaḥ prayānti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.76.80||
ye’tra loke yaśobhāgāḥ sevakāḥ svargabhāginaḥ |
te gantāraḥ padaṃ cordhvaṃ mamānugrahasaṃbhavāt ||81 ||
sādhuśīlāḥ sādhuvṛttāḥ kṣamiṇaḥ sevinastathā |
sevābhiḥ sukhadātāro dyugatā yānti matpadam ||82||
yeṣāṃ mukhe harernāma hṛdaye śrīhariḥ svayam |
vṛddhājñāvacanāścāpi matpadāśrayiṇo hi te ||83 ||
gosutāsutadātāro vāṭikākṣetrasaudhadāḥ |
kaṭisakthyaṃkadātāro dyugatā yānti matpadam ||84||
gāṃ viprāya sutāṃ kumārāya sutaṃ ca sādhave |
vāṭīṃ devāya me kṣetraṃ saudhaṃ kuṭumbiyogine ||85||
kaṭiṃ balaṃ ca bhītāya śaraṇaṃ sakthi kaṣṭine |
aṃkaṃ dravyaṃ daridrāya datvā yānti divaṃ janāḥ ||86||
tato bhaktiṃ mamāsādya mahyamarpaṇakāriṇaḥ |
ta eva sādhavo yānti matpadaṃ kamalāśritam ||87||
keśauṣṭhagaṇḍadātāro vakṣaḥpṛṣṭhakarapradāḥ |
grīvājaṃghāpādadāśca yānti svargaṃ ca matpadam ||88||
keśān brahmeśaviṣṇūm̐śca datvā sannyāsamāśritāḥ |
prayānti mama bhaktāste svargaṃ tato’mṛtaṃ padam ||89||
oṣṭhau cādeśamantrau ca dattvācāryapadaṃ śritāḥ |
prayānti bhaktimanto me svargaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||3.76.90||
gaṇḍau premasnehabhāvau hārdikau bhaktipūrvakau |
datvā me mama bhaktāḥ śri prayānti svastato’kṣaram ||9 1||
vakṣo viśvāsamevāpi kṛtvā datvā ca taṃ mayi |
viśvasto yāti vai svargaṃ tato matpadamakṣaram ||92||
pṛṣṭhaṃ sāhāyyamārpyaiva paralokapradaṃ śubham |
svarge pūrvaṃ tato bhaktyā yāti maddhāma cottamam ||93||
karau sevāṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca kṛtvā datvārpaṇaṃ mayi |
svargaṃ yāti tato bhaktyā mama dhāma prayāti saḥ ||94||
grīvāṃ sarvasvamevāpi jīvadānamathāpi vā |
prāṇadānaṃ ca me dattvā yāti svargaṃ tato’kṣaram ||95||
jaṃghe sampat kulaṃ cobhe datvā me svaḥ prayāti hi |
tato’rpayya samastaṃ ca mama dhāma prayāti saḥ ||96 ||
pādau dhanaṃ jīvikāṃ ca yo dadāti mahātmane |
svargatvā mama bhaktyā ca prayāti dhāma cākṣaram ||97||
evaṃ dānāni vai lakṣmi jñātvā nāryā nareṇa ca |
yathārthāni ca guptāni deyāni mokṣakāṃkṣayā ||98||
yoṣādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ bahubhāvena vai sadā |
yoṣā māyā samākhyātā yā uṣā rajanīmukhā ||99||
bandhayitrī hi jīvānāṃ sā deyā paramātmane |
svayaṃ māyāvihīnaḥ san prayāti paramaṃ padam || 3.76.10 0||
kanyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ kumārāya sukhapradam |
kanyā tṛṣṇā sukhāśā sā kumārāya parātmane || 101 ||
śārṅgiṇe māraśūnyāya datvātmā dhāma saṃvrajet |
godānaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ goḥ jñānaṃ śrīhareḥ śubham || 1 02||
datvā dātā grahītā ca yātārau dhāma cākṣaram |
ityevaṃ lakṣmi vijñāya māhātmyaṃ mama ye tviha || 1 03||
karmabhūmau prakurvanti vicaranti vimuktaye |
śāśvatānandabhoktāro bhavanti matpadāśraye || 1 04||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra māhātmyaṃ mama yogajam |
adhikaṃ paṭhanāccāpi śravaṇād bhuktimuktidam || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne brāhmaṇyasādhutvaprāpakasādhanāni dhāmagamanasādhanāni cākaṣāyasatpathasādhanāni divyadānādīni hareryogaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||

<3.77>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
sādhvīdharmān samastān vai vaktumarhasi mādhava |
sādhvyaḥ sarvā bhavaddehājjātā māyāparā hi tāḥ || 1 ||
loke’tra vai kathaṃ tābhirvartitavyaṃ nirantaram |
kṛṣṇadhavā hi tyāginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya eva tāḥ || 2 ||
haripriyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇakāntā hi yoṣitaḥ |
brāhmyastāśca mahābhāgavatyaḥ sāttvatya eva tāḥ || 3 ||
sarvathātmanivedinyo varteran kena cādhvanā |
pātivratyaṃ kathaṃ tāsāṃ vinā vivāhitaṃ patim || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tyāgadīkṣitayoṣitām |
dīkṣā vivāha evāsti mayā sākaṃ hi yojitaḥ || 5 ||
oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
iti mantreṇa sā sādhvī vivāhitāgnisannidhau || 6 ||
homaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣitā sā mama mūrtyā samaṃ tadā |
pūjayitvā ca māṃ prāptā niveditāgnimaṇḍape || 7 ||
mama kāṣāyāmbarāṇi svīcakāra ca sā satī |
gurvājñayā ca me kāntā jātāsti dīkṣitakṣaṇāt || 8 ||
ataścāsyāḥ kṛṣṇa eva patiścāsmi narāyaṇaḥ |
vivāhitaiva sā cāste pātivratyaṃ sadā mayi || 9 ||
pālanīyaṃ tayā sādhvyā pāvanyā mama yoṣitā |
mamādhvanā hi gaccheyurvarteram̐śca mamādhvanā || 3.77.10 ||
divyabhaktyā ca varteran mokṣādhvanā sadadhvanā |
sādhusevāṃ prakuryuśca sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ || 1 1||
niṣkāmavṛttyā varteran sevayeyustathaiva ca |
sarvathātmanivedinyo bhaveyurmama mūrtiṣu || 1 2||
sādhvīdharmāḥ strīdharmāste vivāhe ṛṣibhiḥ kṛtāḥ |
sahadharmādicāriṇyo bharturbhavanti lagnake || 13||
tasmāllagnavatī patnī yathā patyurnideśinī |
tathā tyāgavatī sādhvī patyurme’sti nideśinī || 14||
agniṃ sākṣiṇamāsādya guruṃ ca pitarāvapi |
gaṇeśaṃ ca tathā māṃ ca patnī sādhvī same hyubhe || 15||
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ sa vṛṣaḥ samaḥ |
pātnīvratyaṃ tathā patyurharerme ca samaṃ tathā || 16||
sahadharmacarī bharturbhavatyagnyādisannidhau |
sahadharmacaraḥ patnyā bhavatyagnyādisannidhau || 17||
sahadharmacaraṃ kāntamanusmaret sadārpitā |
susvabhāvā suvacanā suvṛttā sukhadarśanā || 18||
ananyacittā sumukhī bhartuḥ sadharmacāriṇī |
bhavet saddharmaparamā bhavet saddharmabhāginī || 19||
devadevaṃ svabhartāraṃ sādhvī nityaṃ vilokayet |
śuśrūṣāṃ paricaryāṃ ca kuryād divyakriyānvitā ||3.77.20||
nānyabhāvā hyavimanāḥ subhāvā sukhadāyinī |
putravaktramivābhīkṣṇaṃ bhartrānanaṃ vilokayet ||21 ||
namet suniyamāḍhyā ca bhartāraṃ dharmacāriṇī |
jñātvā dampatīdharmāṃśca sahadharmān nijāśritān ||22||
matvaiva dharmaparamā bhavet bhartusamavratā |
devadevaṃ hi bhartāraṃ seveta śāntisaṃyutā ||23||
suprasannamukhī bharturbhavedevāpi śikṣitā |
tāḍitoktā paruṣāṇi vaśyā tathāpi nityadā ||24||
nānyaṃ naraṃ spṛśet sādhvī nirīkṣeta na kāmataḥ |
hāsyabhāvādibhiścāpi nānyena saha vartayet ||25||
bhartṛvarjaṃ priyaṃ nāsti yasyā ucchiṣṭameva tat |
bhartṛyuktaṃ priyaṃ sarvaṃ mahāprasāda eva tat ||26||
bhartrājñā bhagavatsvājñā bhartā śrīparameśvaraḥ |
bhartrārohā bhaved yā sā bhavedvai dharmacāriṇī ||27||
daridraṃ vyādhitaṃ dīnaṃ duḥkhitaṃ śramitaṃ mṛdum |
patiṃ kāntamupāste yā sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||28||
putriṇī kanyakā mātā cānapatyā ca niṣphalā |
patipriyā patiprāṇā yā sā syād dharmabhāginī ||29||
dāsyaṃ bhṛtyatvamevāpi kaiṃkaryaṃ kurvatī ca yā |
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ paricaryāṃ kurvatī dharmabhāginī ||3.77.30||
vinītā komalavṛttiḥ snigdhā patyau sthirāśayā |
patyarthakṛtasarvasvā sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||3 1||
na kāmeṣu na bhogeṣu naiśvaryeṣu sukheṣu na |
spṛhā yasyā yathā kānte sā sādhvī dharmabhāginī ||32||
prāgutthānapriyā prātargṛhasevāparāyaṇā |
sammārjanapralepādiśuddhiparā ca yā sadā ||33||
agnikāryaparā cāpi devakāryaparā tathā |
kartavyārthaparā yā syāt sā bhaved dharmabhāginī ||34||
devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ patyurvṛddhajanasya ca |
yathāpekṣaṃ pradattvaiva jalādi toṣayettu yā ||35||
tān sarvān bhojayitvaiva śeṣānnaṃ bhuṃkta eva yā |
tuṣṭapuṣṭakuṭumbā ca sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||36||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau sevamānā natā sadā |
mātṛpitṛparā nityaṃ sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||37||
sādhūn dīnānanāthām̐śca bibhartyannādibhistu yā |
yathāśakti svāmidharmā sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||38||
brahmiṣṭhāvat patisthā yā patyanyaṃ puruṣaṃ kvacit |
api catuḥkhanisthaṃ vai nekṣate baddhanetrikā ||39||
durlabhā tādṛśī loke vinā lakṣmīṃ hṛdi sthitām |
vinā satīṃ śaṃbhuhṛtsthāṃ cādṛśyabhāvamāsthitām ||3.77.40||
vrataṃ carati yā svāmyaṃ duścaraṃ patinoditam |
paticittā patihitā sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ||41||
puṇyametat svargametat tapaścaitad vrataṃ ca tat |
bhartā hyeva paro devo yasyā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||42||
patirdevo hi nārīṇāṃ patirguruḥ patirgatiḥ |
patirbanghuḥ patirbhāgyaṃ patiḥ prāṇaḥ parāyaṇaḥ ||43||
patiprasādaḥ svargo’sti nirayaḥ patyatoṣaṇam |
akāryaṃ cāpyadharmaṃ vā prāṇanāśakaraṃ ca vā ||44||
patirbrūyāt tathā kuryāt pātivratyaṃ paro vṛṣaḥ |
dāridryaṃ vyādhirāpadvā śatrutā śāpadagdhatā ||45||
vicittatvaṃ ca vā patyuḥ sarvaṃ svānuguṇaṃ kriyāt |
subhāgyaṃ sarvamevaitanmatvā seveta vai patim ||46||
evaṃ sarvasvārpaṇā yā vartate patigāminī |
āpaddharmānanuprekṣya sā prātivratyayoginī ||47||
patiścāhaṃ sadā sādhvyā yathā loke vivāhitaḥ |
sādhvī madarthamevātra varteta matparāyaṇā ||48||
madarthasnānaśuddhiśca madarthāmalatānvitā |
madarthaṃ ca kṛtaveṣā madarthaṃ rūpaśālinī ||49||
madarthasarvasaṃskārā sādhvī me vai pativratā |
raktāmbarā madarthaṃ kāṣāyavastrā madarthinī ||3.77.50||
puṇḍracandrādiyuktā ca madarthaṃ gandhayoginī |
madarthaṃ puṣpahārā ca madarthaṃ mālyadhāriṇī ||51||
madarthaṃ kaṇṭhapaddhastabhūṣā sādhvī pativratā |
madarthaṃ bhojanāhārā madarthaṃ pānayoginī ||52||
madarthaṃ kṛtaśṛṃgārā madarthaṃ bhogavāhanā |
madarthaṃ kṛdalaṃkārā sādhvī sā me pativratā ||53||
madarthaṃ keśaveṣā ca madarthaṃ kṛtakañcukī |
madarthaṃ kṛtaśāṭī ca madarthaṃ kaṭivastriṇī ||14||
madarthaṃ karapādā ca madarthakṛtamastakā |
madarthakṛtkabandhā ca madarthāntaracāriṇī ||55||
madarthaguṇabhāvā ca madarthānandavarṣiṇī |
mannāmaguṇamagnā ca sādhvī sā me pativratā ||56||
madarthanityasattvasthā madarthanityarājasī |
madartharodhasaṃyuktā madarthasneharakṣiṇī ||57||
madarthahṛdayā nityaṃ madarthakāmakāriṇī |
evaṃ vai vartamānā yā sā me harivratā satī ||58||
api puṇyamapi dharmaṃ karma cācaraṇaṃ śubham |
yadvānyat kurvatī sādhvī śīlasaubhāgyayoginī ||59||
matparā syānmadviśrāntā matprāṇā mallayānvitā |
manmūrtireva varteta sā sādhvī me harivratā ||3.77.6 0||
madarthatyāgadharmā ca madarthasatyaśālinī |
madarthaṃ ca kṛtasvāpā madarthaṃ jāgrati sthitā ||6 1 ||
madarthaṃ vyāpṛtā cāste madarthaṃ vinivṛttikā |
evaṃ madarthasantoṣā madarthāhiṃsanavratā ||62||
madarthayajñasannyāsā madarthahomasatkriyā |
madarthaṃ brahmacaryasthā madarthaṃ cāparigrahā || 63||
madarthaśaucācārā ca madarthaṃ tapaāsthitā |
madarthaṃ svādhyāyaparā madarthopāsanāyutā ||64||
madarthendriyavyāpārā madarthamānasā sadā |
madarthāhaṃ cantanā ca madarthanirṇayānvitā ||65||
madarthasattvayatnā ca madarthabhāvanāśrayā |
madarthaiśvaryasiddhiśca madarthadhyānasaṃsthitā ||66||
madarthaśuklamārgasthā madarthātithipūjanā |
madarthapācanakāryā madarthāhāragocarā ||67||
madarthagṛhaśālāḍhyā madarthagītikīrtanā |
madarthaṃ nṛtyabhāvasthā madarthaṃ ca kathāśravā ||68||
madarthaṃ ca mahotsāhā madarthatīrthacāriṇī |
madarthaṃ kṛtayātrā ca madarthapuṣpavāṭikā ||69||
madarthaṃ kṛtavyāpārā madarthakrayavikrayā |
madarthaṃ kṛṣiyatnāḍhyā madarthaṃ rāṣṭrarakṣiṇī ||3.77.70||
madarthaṃ sevanaṃ yasyā madarthaṃ bhṛtyatānvitā |
madarthaṃ dāsyamāpannā madarthaṃ sarvasaṃvidhā ||7 1||
madarthagamanādānā madarthālocanānvitā |
evaṃ madarthatāṃ prāptā sādhvī sā me harivratā ||72||
madarthaṃ kārtikavratā madarthaṃ pauṣatāpasī |
madarthaṃ caitrapuṇyāḍhyā madarthaṃ śrāvaṇīsthitā ||73 ||
madarthaṃ dīpadā cāpi madarthaṃ paṃktibhojanā |
madarthaṃ śiṣyatāṃ prāptā madarthaṃ gurutāṃ gatā ||74||
madarthaṃ sarvaśiṣyābhiḥ samanvitāpi sevikā |
gurvī gurupadaṃ prāptā manmūrtiścāpi sā satī ||75||
sādhvī sādhvīsamācārā sā sādhvī me harivratā |
evaṃvidhā tyāgadharmā mama lakṣmi pativratā ||76||
rādhāsakhyastathā lakṣmīsakhyaḥ śrīsakhya ityapi |
māṇikīsakhya evāpi satīsakhyaśca yāḥ śubhāḥ ||77||
sāvitrīsakhya evāpi sītāsakhyaśca yāstathā |
bhaktisakhyaśca yāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇyaśca yā matāḥ ||78||
vāsudevyastathā kārṣṇyo brahmapriyāśca yāstathā |
vaiṣṇavyo bhagavatyaśca brāhmyo muktānya ityapi ||79||
yāstathā pārameśvaryaṃ īśānyaścāpi yoṣitaḥ |
īśvaryaścāpi sarvāstāḥ sādhvyo me vai pativratāḥ ||3.77.80 ||
yāsāṃ yadarthaṃ sarvasvaṃ kāntārthaṃ sarvameva me |
ityanyonyaṃ sādhusādhvībhāvo’haṃ parameśvaraḥ ||81||
māṃ vinā nahi sādhvyastāstā vinā nahi cāsmyaham |
parasparānuyogasthā bhogamuktipradā nṛṇām ||82||
devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ brahmavādinām |
sarveṣāṃ dehinaḥ cāpi bhogadā muktidā vayam ||83||
nibodha lakṣmi māhātmyaṃ te sakhīnāṃ tavāpi ca |
mamāpi mama muktānāṃ māhātmyaṃ cāvadhehi tat ||84||
ahaṃ san bhagavān sākṣātparabrahmapareśvaraḥ |
cit sādhvī tvaṃ satīvargā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||85||
tadyogena sadānando mahānandāsti cāvayoḥ |
śāśvatānanda evāsti tadbhoktā mukta eva ha ||86||
ahaṃ sādhuḥ ramā sādhvī lakṣmīḥ satī sadāsti vai |
śrīḥ sampat māṇikī saukhyaṃ pañcaitad daivataṃ param ||87||
sādhuḥ sarvavidhaṃ saukhyaṃ dadāti ca karoti ca |
sādhvī sarvavidhaṃ saukhyaṃ dadāti ca karoti ca ||88||
satī satyaṃ vartayati sampad bhadratvamuttam |
rakṣatyeva tataḥ saukhyaṃ pravartata hi śāśvatam ||89||
sarvadā muktitulyaṃ vai parabrahmabhṛtaṃ mahat |
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā sādhvī pārabrāhmī satī mama ||3.77.90 ||
sarvānandaparipūrṇā modate svāminā mayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā ||91 ||
dehaścāyaṃ naro nārī nātmā nārī naro’pi vā |
ātmārāmā munayaśca sādhavaḥ sādhvikāstathā | |92||
brahmātmaniṣṭhā madyogā madbhāvā macchrayāstathā |
narā nāryaḥ śeṣabhūtāsteṣu nārāyaṇo’smyaham ||93 ||
naramāśrayati yā sā nārī cātmā madāśritaḥ |
evaṃ sarve tathātmāno nāryaścāśrayadharmataḥ ||94||
āśrayado naraścāhaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ |
evaṃ tattvaṃ viditveha sādhvī saubhāgyayoginī ||95||
mama kāntāṃ viditvā svāṃ pātivratyaṃ sadācaret |
alokakāntā sā sādhvī kṛṣṇakāntā pativratā ||96||
loke yuvā bhavet kānto yuvatyā dehayogataḥ |
ahantu sarvadā kānto garbhe bālye ca yauvane ||97||
vārdhakye maraṇe cāpi prete lokāntare’pi ca |
saṃsāre svargalokādau mokṣe’pi kānta eva ha ||98||
sarvātmanāṃ bhavāmyeva sarvātmanā hi śāśvataḥ |
ātmanyahaṃ sadā cāsmi niyāmako’ntare sthitaḥ ||99||
tathā tatrāpi nityaṃ vai kānto’smi kāntatā mayi |
kāntātvaṃ mama yogena cātmasveva hi vidyate || 3.77.10 0||
evaṃ śāśvatikaḥ kāntaḥ sarvāsāṃ saṃbhavāmyaham |
matkāntyā kāntimanto vai muktāḥ sarve tatheśvarāḥ || 101 ||
devāśca mānavādyāśca tiryañcastaravo’pi ca |
jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi māyā ca māyikā api ||; 102||
matkāntyā kāntimanto ye tāḥ kāntā me nisargataḥ |
evaṃ kāntātmakaṃ sarvaṃ vaidhavyaṃ nāsti vai kvacit || 10 3||
tasmāt sādhvyo bhajeyurmāṃ kāntaṃ saubhāgyayojitāḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ vai sādhvīnāṃ tu mayeritam || 1 04||
sarvātmanāṃ ceritaṃ ca gūḍhaṃ tattvārthasaṃbhṛtam |
tasmānmado na kartavyaḥ pumānahamiti kvacit || 1 05||
ātmāhamiti kṛtvaiva bhajanīyaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ patiḥ paraḥ || 1 06||
sādhvīrahasyametadvai jñātvā ye yāstathā prajāḥ |
maṃsyante cācariṣyanti te prāpsyanti parāṃ gatim || 1 07||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathāpsyanti sukhaṃ cānandamityapi |
mama yogaṃ śāśvataṃ ca nirvāṇapadamuttamam || 108||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne satīsādhvīnāṃ pātivratyaparākāṣṭhādivijñānanirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||

<3.78>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhvīkathāṃ hyanuttamām |
saurāṣṭre jālakapuryāmabhūd gopī sucandrikā || 1 ||
gopaścāsyāḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajatyapi |
bhakto’bhavat sadā snānaparaśca govrajānugaḥ || 2 ||
gopālo gopavāsāśca gopavāsaśca māṃ sadā |
sevate bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai vane vanyādibhiḥ sadā || 3 ||
pāyasairdugdhapākaiśca kṣīrairdadhnā ghṛtādibhiḥ |
navanītena puṣpaiśca jalaiḥ pūjayatīti mām || 4 ||
sa ca jvareṇa vai varṣākāle tyaktvā nijaṃ vapuḥ |
yayau svargaṃ sakāmo me bhakto daurhṛdalakṣaṇām || 5 ||
gopīṃ patnīṃ parityajya hyardhāyurvigame sati |
gopālo vai kṛpayā me vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 6 ||
apsarobhiśca sahito rājate dhenubhiḥ saha |
sarve sarvopakaraṇairbhakṣyabhojyādibhiryute || 7 ||
bhūtale cāsya patnī sā bhaktā me garbhabālakā |
sagarbhāpi nijakāntamanu martuṃ samicchati || 8 ||
pativratā patiṃ vinā duḥkhaṃ soḍhumaśaktikā |
yayau citāṃ svāminaśca tadā lokairnivāritā || 9 ||
garbhasya nāśane gopi pāpaṃ bahuguṇaṃ tava |
patyuḥ svargaṃ tava jātaṃ svargavimānakam || 3.78.10 ||
rakṣa garbhaṃ putravatī bhaviṣyasi samāntare |
patyuḥ pṛṣṭhe maraṇe tu puṇyaṃ vai patiyoṣitaḥ || 11 ||
agarbhāyā bhavatyeva sagarbhāyāstu dūṣaṇam |
tasmānmā kuru ghātaṃ svaṃ sukhinī vasa govraje || 12||
ityevaṃ vāryamāṇāpi papāta patinā saha |
citāyāṃ tāvadevāyaṃ patistasyā vimānagaḥ || 1 3||
dadṛśe vyomamārgeṇa mā maivaṃ gopi mā kuru |
niṣiṣedha svahastenottolayāmāsa tāṃ priyām || 14||
adagdhāṃ tāṃ samāśvāsya dāhaṃ praśāmya tatkṣaṇam |
vimāne tāṃ samāgṛhyopādiśad garbharakṣaṇe || 15||
putrasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā vivāhya ca tataḥ param |
samāyāhi mama svargaṃ mā kṛthāścānuyātrikām || 1 6||
ityuktā sā praśāntā ca sukhinī pativākyagā |
pṛthvyāṃ vimānāt patinā prāpitā śokavarjitā || 17||
citāṃ natvā patiṃ natvā yayau gṛhaṃ hi gopikā |
bhajate māṃ hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa sma ca || 18||
dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ vrataṃ śīlaṃ pālayatyeva gopikā |
suṣuve ca sutaṃ gopī sucandrikā śubhānanam || 1 9||
vavṛdhe bālakaścāpi yuvā jāto vivāhitaḥ |
gopī putrāya ca tato nyavedayat purābhavam ||3.78.20||
sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nijapatyuḥ putro’pi mumude tataḥ |
atha svargaṃ pragantavyaṃ mayā te pitaraṃ prati ||2 1 ||
ityuktvā sā gośakṛtopalipya bhūtalaṃ tataḥ |
upāviśat kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā patiṃ tatyāja varṣma tat ||22|
tāvatpatyurvimānaṃ tad devadevīsamanvitam |
samāyātaṃ vyomataścārohayāmāsureva tām ||23||
sucandrikāṃ jayavākyairvardhayantyo’psarovarāḥ |
gopaputro vadhūyukto vyalokayad vihāyasi ||24||
pitaraṃ devarūpaṃ ca prāṇamanmātaraṃ tataḥ |
vimānaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa gataṃ cāmbaramūrdhani ||25||
vimānasthā mañjughoṣāpsarovarā tu gopikām |
apṛcchat sucandrikāṃ ca bhartuḥ sannidhimeva ha ||26||
kena vratena kalyāṇi kenācāreṇa vardhitā |
gopī vidhūya pāpāni devaloke samāgatā ||27||
vahnyujjvalāmbaradharā svarṇacampakaśobhanā |
jvalamānā ca tejobhirdivyā kathaṃ svarāgatā ||28||
nālpena tapasā gopi dānena niyamena vā |
svargaṃ lokamanuprāptā kathaṃ vada samāgatā ||29||
śrutvā sucandrikā gopī mañjughoṣāṃ samabravīt |
kathaṃ vai prāpyate svargaṃ vada me tatra kāraṇam ||3.78.30||
mañjughoṣā tataḥ prāha gopīṃ śṛṇu ca kāraṇam |
kāṣāyavasanā yā syāt tyāgamārgaparāyaṇā ||3 1||
muṇḍā vā jaṭilā vā syāttathā valkaladhāriṇī |
tāpasī dānaparamā bahudā puṇyaśālinī ||22||
sarvapradātithaye yā sādhave ca mahātmane |
sā svargagā bhavet sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||33||
patirdevaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patireva paro vṛṣaḥ |
patyājñā paramo vedaḥ patyustuṣṭirvṛṣaḥ striyāḥ ||34||
evaṃ yā vartate sādhvī sā svargaṃ vindate’cyutam |
śrutvā prāha tadā gopī śṛṇu vimānavāhini ||25||
nāhaṃ kāṣāyavasanā nāpi tyāgaparāyaṇā |
na muṇḍā na jaṭilā vā nāpi valkaladhāriṇī ||36||
aurṇāmbarādidhartryāsmi nāpi vai tāpasī tathā |
vanavāsā dugdhadānā kintvatithiṃ na vedmyapi ||37||
sādhusevākarī cāsmi gopī gopānuyojitā |
patisevāparā cāsaṃ yena devītvamāgatā || 38||
āhitāni paruṣāṇi kadācinnābruvaṃ patim |
śrīkṛṣṇadevasādhūnāṃ pūjane’haṃ ratābhavam ||39||
patyurgavāṃ sevikā ca śvaśrūśvaśuravartinī |
paiśunye na pravarte ca na kāpaṭya manasyapi ||3.78.40||
asthāne na ca tiṣṭhāmi cāślīlaṃ pravadāmi na |
asadvā hasitaṃ vāpyahitaṃ vā pāpasaṃbhṛtam ||41 ||
rahasyaṃ cārahasyaṃ vā na vai karomi sarvathā |
gavāmarthe nirgataṃ me bhartāraṃ gṛhamāgatam |||42||
jalānnāsanadānādyaiḥ sevayāmi sadānugā |
yadannaṃ rocate nāsya yadbhojyaṃ rocate na ca ||43||
bhakṣyaṃ lehyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca sarvaṃ tad varjayāmyaham |
kuṭumbārthe samagraṃ vai kāryaṃ sadā karomi ca ||44||
maṃgalāni mama sarvavidhāni svāminaḥ kṛte |
aṃjanaṃ rocanāṃ snānaṃ mālyānulepanādikam ||45||
prasādhanaṃ ca niṣkrānte nābhinandāmi bhartari |
notthāpayāmi bhartāraṃ sukhasuptaṃ kvacit khalu ||46||
āntarāṇyapi kāryāṇi karomyahaṃ sukhānvitā |
nāyāsayāmi bharttāraṃ tena tuṣyati me manaḥ ||47||
guptaguhyā sadā cāsmi tadājñāvaśavartinī |
evaṃ prapālya vai patyuścitāyāṃ nidhanottaram ||48||
niviṣṭāpi niṣiddhā cottolitā jīvitāhitā |
pṛthvyāṃ putraṃ savadhūkaṃ sampādya divamāgatā ||49||
evaṃ vai mañjughoṣe’haṃ divametatsamāgatā |
patiḥ prāpto mayā cātra putro me vartate bhuvi ||3.78.50||
etādṛśyo vividhā vai gopyo bhavanti bhūtale |
kṛṣṇagopyaśca tā jātāḥ kalpakalpāntareṣvapi ||5 1||
bhajitvā śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā patim |
evamahaṃ patiṃ devaṃ bhajitvātra samāgatā ||52||
śrutvaivaṃ mañjughoṣā sā prahṛṣṭā praśaśaṃsa tām |
anyā apsarasaścāpi śaśaṃsustāṃ pativratām |||53||
bahukālamuṣitvā ca bhogān bhuktvā hyanekaśaḥ |
satyalokaṃ yayau sādhvī patyā sākaṃ sucandrikā ||54||
sāvitrī cātra cāpṛcchat svargād gacchanti vai surāḥ |
martyalokaṃ cāvaśeṣaṃ bhoktaṃu tvaṃ kathamatra vai ||55||
satyaṃ samāgatā sādhvi vada tatra hi kāraṇam |
sucandrikā ca sāvitrīmuvāca hṛṣṭamānasā ||56||
svarge dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhogātmakaṃ param |
parantvaniyamaṃ taddhi śīlavratavivarjitam ||57||
devānāṃ nāsti vai śīlaṃ na śīlaṃ devayoṣitām |
apsarassu vyavāyaśca vidyate paramo divi ||58||
deveṣu cāpi devīnāṃ prāyaśo’pi tathā vidhā |
rītirvai vidyate tatra sāvitri kiṃ vadāmyaham ||59||
kāmarūpadharā devā devyaścāpi tathāvidhāḥ |
viharanti yatheṣṭaṃ vai maryādāvarjitāḥ khalu ||3.78.60||
pātivratyaṃ na devīṣu patnīvrataṃ na nākiṣu |
evaṃvidhā bhuktaśeṣā vrajanti mānavālayam ||61 ||
pradhāneṣu ca deveṣu patnīvrataṃ na vidyate |
kā kathā cālpadevānāṃ te mṛtā yānti martyakam |||62|||
saṃjñā cāndrī rohiṇī ca paulomī ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ |
etāścānyāḥ svalpasaṃkhyā bhavanti vai pativratāḥ ||6 3 ||
mayā svarge mama patyurvimāne vai pativratam |
pālitaṃ sarvathā nityaṃ yathā pṛthvyāṃ tathā divi ||64||
hareḥ pūjā kṛtā nityaṃ vṛṣaścāpi prapālitaḥ |
ananyanarasaṃspṛśyā bhavāmi pūrvapuṇyataḥ ||65||
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā cāpi sāvitri tadbalādaham |
saha patyā satyalokaṃ cāyātā nānyakāraṇam ||66||
atroṣitvā prayāsyāmi kṛpayā svāminastava |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu jalordhve yat patyurharervratena ca ||67||
ityevaṃ cāvadat sādhvī nyūṣatustatra vai ciram |
tato yayaturvaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇoḥ pādāmbuje hyubhau ||68||
gatvā tatra mahāsādhvī neme lakṣmīṃ haripriyām |
nanāma viṣṇuṃ gopaśca vavandatuśca tau mudā ||69||
pṛṣṭā lakṣmyā kathaṃ sādhvi satyalokādupāgatā |
sucandrikā śriyaṃ prāha kāntabhaktyā samāgatā ||3.78.70 ||
kānto’yaṃ me hi gopālo viṣṇuścāyaṃ pareśvaraḥ |
kāntaṃ bhajāmi nityaṃ vai kāntakāntaṃ ca śāśvatam ||71|||
sādhvīdharmaṃ samāpannā pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
kāntadharmabalenāhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ samupāgatā ||72||
atha tatrāpyuṣitvā sā ciraṃ patyā samanvitā |
yayau golokamevāpi gopī gopena śobhitā ||73||
neme gopī rādhikāṃ ca gopaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nanāma ca |
ūṣatustatra loke tau gopīgopagaṇeṣvapi ||74||
rādhā sucandrikāmāha kathaṃ cātra samāgatā |
vada me kāraṇaṃ gopi kena puṇyena cāgatā ||75||
sucandrikāha rādhāṃ vai kṛṣṇakāntasya sevayā |
kāntasya sevayā kāntakāntasyāpi ca sevayā ||76||
pātivratyena dharmeṇa kṛṣṇadharmeṇa gogṛham |
āgatāhaṃ rādhike’tra sādhvīdharmeṇa yojitā ||77||
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ sarvadharmottamottamaḥ |
kṛṣṇadharmaḥ paro dharmaḥ sādhvīdharmottamottamaḥ ||78||
mayā nityaṃ mama kāntaḥ pūjito gopasattamaḥ |
gopānāmapi gopaśca kṛṣṇaḥ sadā prapūjitāḥ ||79||
tena puṇyena loke’tra cāgatā rādhike tava |
uṣitvā ca ciraṃ paścād yāsyāmyakṣaradhāma vai ||3.78.80||
kṛṣṇājñayā tu sā sādhvī kāntayutoṣitā ciram |
pātivratyaṃ pālayitvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||8 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayaṃ parātparam |
brahmahrade cāplutā ca mahāmuktānikābhavat ||82||
mukto’bhavat patiścāpi brahmabhāvānvitastadā |
māyākāryāṇi sarvāṇi līnāni vai dvayostadā ||83||
ekabhāvāni tattvāni jātāni ca dvayostadā |
ātmatattvaṃ samastaṃ vai samūrtaṃ śobhanaṃ param ||84||
puruṣottamarūpeṇa rūpitaṃ cābhavattadā |
puṃstrībhāvau gatau tatra divyabhāvāvupāgatau ||85||
śrīharestatra sārūpyaṃ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭitābhavat |
sāmīpyaṃ cābhavattatra nematuḥ puruṣottamam ||86||
ūṣatuścākṣare dhāmni japantau puruṣottamam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīparameśvara ||87||
parabrahma hare kṛṣṇa śrīkṛṣṇa puruṣottama |
ityevaṃ tau tato lakṣmi muktau jātau mamākṣare ||88||
pūrvaṃ tau lomaśāt prāptau mama mantrān bhuvastale |
tadbalānmama bhaktiśca vyavardhata tayościrāt ||89||
pativratyaṃ hārivratyaṃ patnīvrataṃ ca śobhanam |
vyavardhata sadā gopyā gopasyāpyuttarottaram ||3.78.90||
me sādhūnāṃ sevayā ca śīlena sarvathā tathā |
sarvalokeṣu me bhaktyā prāptavanto hi māṃ patim ||9 1||
māṇikyā me priyā dhāmni jayā ca lalitā tathā |
papracchustāṃ gopikāṃ vai kathaṃ cātra samāgatā ||92||
sucandrikāha māṇikyāṃ muktāṃ śrīparameśvari | |
patiśuśrūṣayā sādhvīdharmavṛttyā tathā śubhe ||93||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇapātivratyabhaktyā samāgatā |
patirme’yaṃ mahāmukto brahmahrade samaplavāt ||94||
sañjātaścāhamevāpi brahmapriyāsmi sarvathā |
jātā muktānikā sādhvī muktarūpā hi māṇiki ||95||
kṛpālabhyā parāmuktiḥ sarvathā naiva saṃśayaḥ |
satāṃ sevā hi satsaṃgaḥ sevayā puṇyaśevadhiḥ ||96||
puṇyapuñjairvivekaśca bhavedātmaparātmanoḥ |
vivekādātmakalyāṇe pravṛttirjāyate tataḥ ||97||
pāpanāśaḥ pāvanatvaṃ tābhyāṃ bhaktirudeti ca |
bhaktyā ca nāmadhāmādismaraṇaṃ snehasaṃbhṛtam ||98||
snehārpaṇeneṣṭasiddhiḥ savividhā prajāyate |
paramātmā sadeṣṭaścānādinārāyaṇo hariḥ ||99||
so’yaṃ samprāpyate siddhaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇo’tivallabhaḥ |
evaṃ mayā hariḥ kāntaḥ prāpto’trākṣaradhāmani || 3.78.100 ||
ityuktā māṇikī tuṣṭā praśaśaṃsa sucandrikām |
sakhīṃ śīlavatīṃ prāpyānanditā sā babhūva ca || 101 ||
sucandrikā sadā muktā hyuvāsa śrīrivāparā |
haripriyākṣare dhāmni lakṣmi bhaktā priyā mama || 10 2||
ityevaṃ darśitaṃ te’tra sādhvīmāhātmyamuttamam |
sasvāminyā hi bhaktāyā me sādhvyā mokṣakṛtparam || 103 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sucandrikākhyagopyāḥ pātivratyena haripātivratyabhaktyā ca sapatikāyāḥ svargasatyavaikuṇṭhagolokākṣaradhāmagamanamityādisādhvīcamatkāranirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||

<3.79>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
sādhvī pativratā kṛṣṇa gārhasthye vartate yadi |
ṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā vada me kānta saukhyakṛt || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sādhvyā gārhasthyamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
ārādhanīyaḥ satataṃ sa vai ṛddhiṃ dadāti ha || 2 ||
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyāḥ sādhavo dvijāḥ |
vṛddhāścātithayaḥ sādhvyaḥ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ || 3 ||

ṛṣīn pitṛn śrāddhapiṇḍaiścāgnau hutvā samarcayet || 4 ||
payomūlaphalaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryācca bhojayet sataḥ |
dvijebhyo’pyarcayed dravyaṃ bhojanaṃ cāmbarādikam || 5 ||

ṛtvijaṃ snātakaṃ sādhuṃ guruṃ śvaśuramityapi || 6 ||

śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi || 7 ||

sadakṣiṇairaśvamedhaiḥ ṣoḍaśārkāyaṇaistathā ||82||
yojanānāṃ śataṃ dīrghamaraṇyaṃ parvatānvitam |
niṣkaikakaṇṭhapratyagraṃ mahodyānāni cādadam ||83||
tathāpi tajjapuṇyaiśca nāhamatra samāgatā |
vratāni cākaravaṃ ca nittyanaimittikānyapi ||84||
triṃśadagnīnayajaṃ cāṣṭābhistathā ca somakaiḥ |
sarvamedhairnaramedhaiḥ saptabhirdaśabhistathā ||85||
aṣṭottaraśataviśvajidbhistathājamedhakaiḥ |
na cāpi teṣāṃ puṇyaiśca bhagavanniha cāgamam ||86||
gaṃgāyāṃ brahmaputrāyāṃ ceravatyāṃ tathā punaḥ |
menakāṃgāmahānadyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasarasyapi ||87||
śvetavārdhau śītavārdhau nārāyaṇyāṃ tathā punaḥ |
tapastaptavatī cāhaṃ sādhusevāparāyaṇā ||88||
tatra tatra sevitā vai sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇabhūṣaṇāḥ |
sādhvyaśca sevitā santoṣitāḥ sarvapradānakaiḥ ||89||
bhojitāḥ pūjitā dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā deheṣu marditāḥ |
saṃvāhitāḥ pādayośca natāśca paricāritāḥ ||3.79.90||
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||91 ||
evaṃ kīrtanagātāraḥ santaḥ sādhvyo hyanusṛtāḥ |
sādhavo me tatastuṣṭāḥ sādhvyastuṣṭāḥ sadā mama ||92||
viprāśca ṛṣayaścāpyatithayo bhaktiśālinaḥ |
sāttvatā bhagavatyaśca yoginya sampratoṣitāḥ ||93||
pitā pratoṣitaścāpi vaco’nuvartanena vai |
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ mahatībhirāśīrbhiḥ puṇyamāpya ha ||94||.
siddhā sādhvī pāvanī ca divyā jātāsmi tatkṣaṇāt |
divyadehā hariyajñairjātā brahmapriyāsakhī ||95||
priyeṇa patinā sārdhaṃ māyāpāraṃ gatāsti ca |
sādhusādhvībhiruktāsmi yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||96||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ |
sāhaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pareśvara ||97||
imaṃ lokamanuprāptā sevayā toṣalābhayā |
gṛhāṇa me karaṃ kṛṣṇa nivāsaya sadātra mām ||98||
vidhehi svāṃ kiṃkarīṃ māṇikyāsakhīmanuttamām |
ityuktā ca tato lakṣmi mayā sakhī kṛtā ca vaḥ ||99||
sādhusevāsamaṃ nāsti paraṃ kartavyameva ha |
ṛddhidaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi svargadaṃ śāntidaṃ tathā || 3.79.10 0||
ityetat kathitaṃ te’tra dānottaraṃ hi sevanam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhvyāḥ kartavye pūjādānādiḥ, hariprathamanorbrahmaprathāyāḥ patnyāḥ sādhvyāḥ svarge sthityuttaraṃ sādhusādhvīsevāphalaṃ cākṣaradhāmagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||

<3.80>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhusevāphalaṃ param |
pūrṇāyuḥsampradaṃ śaśvat sādhusādhvīprasevanam || 1 ||
ācāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ santaścāritralakṣaṇāḥ |
sādhūnāṃ yad yathāvṛttametadācāralakṣaṇam || 2 ||
apyadṛṣṭaṃ śravādeva santaṃ saddharmacāriṇam |
bhaktikarmāṇi kurvantaṃ prajāḥ smaranti dūragāḥ || 3 ||
satāṃ dharmaṃ pālayedvai yadīcched bhūtimātmanaḥ |
api pāpaśarīrasya pāpaṃ hanti satāṃ vṛṣaḥ || 4 ||
sadācārād bhavetpūrṇamāyuḥ kṛte daśāyutam |
tretāyāmayutavarṣaṃ dvāpare tu sahasrakam || 5 ||
tiṣye śataṃ samāścāpi pūrṇāyurjāyate sadā |
sadācārāt sadā lakṣmīrgṛhe śrīrvasati dhruvā || 6 ||
kīrtiśceha paratrāpi sadācārasya jāyate |
satāṃ prasannatā hetudīrghāyuṣṭve matā mama || 7 ||
anyat sarvaṃ bādhyate vai bādhyate na satāṃ vacaḥ |
mama bhaktiyutāḥ śīlavratinaḥ śāntamūrtayaḥ || 8 ||
mamārādhanakāryāśca sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ |
tārayanti mṛtām̐ścāpi jīvataḥ pāvayanti ca || 9 ||
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat |
yatastrasyanti bhūtāni trāsaścāyurvināśakaḥ || 3.80.1 0||
ye nindakāḥ satāṃ krūrā guruśāstrābhilaṃghinaḥ |
adharmasthā durācārāste bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ || 11 ||
viśālā bhinnamaryādā hiṃsrā viṣayiṇaśca ye |
alpāyuṣo bhavantyeva bhaktihīnāśca nistrapāḥ || 1 2||
sarvalakṣaṇaśūnyo’pi hyudārācāravān janaḥ |
śraddhābhaktiyutaḥ sādhuḥ pūrṇavarṣāṇi jīvati || 1 3||
anasūyuḥ satyavādī krodhaśāṭhyādivarjitaḥ |
ajihmaścāpyahiṃsaśca pūrṇavarṣāṇi jīvati || 14||
loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī malāvṛtaḥ |
asthiramānasaścāpi nehāyurvindate param || 15||
vyabhicārī vyavāyī ca dīrghaṃ naiva hi jīvati |
nahīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke sarvatra vidyate || 16||
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam |
gurudrohī pitṛdrohī sādhudrohī na jīvati || 17||
strīdrohī mātṛdrohī ca devadrohī na jīvati |
vāharāgī nadītāraḥ śastrābhyāsī na jīvati || 18||
surāpāyī cāmiṣādaściraṃ naiva hi jīvati |
vāksāyakavadanaśca marmatudo’tirogavān || 1 9||
śāpadagdhaḥ sāhasī ca ciraṃ naiva hi jīvati |
abhicārī ghātakī ca pūjyapūjāvilopakaḥ ||3.80.20||
śaraṇāgataghātī ca vaśyaghātī ca sarvathā |
viśvāsaghātī bālaghnaściraṃ naiva hi jīvati |||21||
pāśī śūlī muṣkanāśī bhagabandhī ca garbhahāḥ |
ṛtunāśī jantunāśī madhuhāśca na jīvati ||22||
vyādhakarmā tathā cakrī sūnī dīrghaṃ na jīvati |
viṣī bhūtī vāyurogī kṣayī pramehavān kaphī ||23||
śvāsī raktī mandapācī codvejako na jīvati |
prasahyahartā cāgnido vyomayānī na jīvati ||24||
pravāsī satataṃ yaśca pratārakaśca mādakī |
ahiphenavyasanī ca ciraṃ naiva tu jīvati || 25||
mātāpitaramācāryaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ patim |
devaṃ vṛddhaṃ pūrvamevotthāya yaścābhivādayet || 26||
pathyaṃ bhuñjīta satataṃ yaściraṃ sa ca jīvati |
ghṛtādaśca prasādādo dīrghamāyurhi vindati || 27|||
prāṅmukho bhojanaṃ bhuṃkte hyāyuṣyaṃ vindate mahat| |
pathyaghṛtāktānnabhojī dīrghajīvī bhavet khalu ||28||
ārdrapādastu bhuñjāno pūrṇāyurjīvati dhruvam |
catustejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa ālabheta kadācana ||29||
agniṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhuṃ tathā hyāyurna riṣyati |
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati ||3.80.3 0||
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastān pratipadyate |
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ ||3 1||
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyati |
tilasṛṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyati ||32||
abhyasyati tvanadhyāye hyāyustasya prahīyate |
pratyādityaṃ pratyanalaṃ pratigāṃ ca pratistriyam ||33||
ye mehanti ca panthānaṃ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ |
gurunindā dahatyāyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||34||
dīrghajijīviṣurvipraṃ kṣatraṃ sarpaṃ na duḥkhayet |
santaṃ sādhvīṃ satīṃ gāṃ ca devaṃ gharmaṃ na kutsayet ||35||
patitaistu kathāṃ necchet taddarśanaṃ vivarjayet |
tatsaṃsargaṃ na vai kuryāt tadāyurvindate mahat ||36 ||
na divā maithunaṃ gacchenna kanyāṃ na ca bandhakīm |
na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchet tadāyurvindate mahat ||37||
pūjyā vṛddhāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo devā guruttamāḥ |
gṛhe vāsayitavyāste dhanyamāyuṣyameva tat ||38||
mahātmanāmavamānamāyuḥkṣayakaraṃ sadā |
mahātmano’tiguhyāni na vaktavyāni karhicit ||39||
sampraśaṃset satīḥ sādhūn tathāyurvindate mahat |
sandhyāyāṃ na svapet kvāpi japecciraṃ sa jīvati ||3.80.40 ||
kārayecchamaśrukarma prāṅmukha udaṅamukho’thavā |
parivādaṃ na ca brūyāttathāyurvindate mahat ||41 ||
anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā pūjyanindā ca tādṛśī |
anāyuṣyaṃ divāsvapnaṃ pāradāryaṃ tathāvidham ||42||
ācāro bhūtijananaścācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ |
ācārād vardhate hyāyurācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ||46 ||
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmādāyurvivardhate |
satāmāśīrvacanāni dīrghāyuḥsampradāni vai ||44||
mārkaṇḍeyasya dīrghāyurmattvaṃ saptarṣivākyataḥ |
vedhaso vākyataścāpi nidarśanaṃ paraṃ hi tat ||45||
pituḥ krodhānnāciketā mṛtyumavāpa vai tathā |
vānarā rāmacandreṇojjīvitā ye raṇe hatāḥ ||46||
vapurdvedhā bhautakaṃ ca yaśorūpaṃ tathā rame |
bhautikaṃ tvāyurāpekṣaṃ yaśaścācārabandhanam ||47||
āśīrvādaibhautikasya śubhāyurvardhate tviha |
sadācāraiḥ sevayā ca vardhate tu yaśaḥ śubham ||48||
satkarmabhiḥ puṇyapuñjo vardhate yaśasā saha |
bhaktyā dvayaṃ jāyate ca vardhate śāśvataṃ yathā ||49||
kule sādhurbhavet kaścit sādhvī vā brahmayoginī |
kulaṃ tad yaśasā loke dhruvaṃ kīrtiṃ pravindati ||3.80.50||
puṇye kule hi puruṣāḥ khyātācārā bhavanti hi |
pāpe kule tu pāpā vai jāyanta bahudhā khalu |||51|||
sarve’narthā kule yatra jāyante pāpapūruṣāḥ |
akīrtiṃ janayantyeva kīrti te lopayantyapi ||52||
vidvāneko bhavet putro bhaktaḥ kīrtiṃ karoti saḥ |
sadācāraḥ sa evātra tārayatyeva bāndhavān ||53||
sadācārā yadi sādhvī bhavet kanyā vadhūśca vā |
kulaṃ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ ca kṛtvā tārayati dhruvam ||54||
nārāyaṇo hariryasya yasyā hṛdi sthitaḥ prabhuḥ |
tārakastena lokān sā sa vā tārayati dhruvam ||55||
dīrghāyuśca kulaṃ tasya yaśaściraṃ pratiṣṭhati |
muktiścāpi dhruvā tasya tasyāḥ prajāyate śubhāḥ |||56||
daśācāryebhya evātropādhyāyaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate |
daśopādhyāyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pitā bhavati sarvathā ||57||
daśapitṛbhyaśca mātā śreṣṭhā sadā garīyasī |
daśāmātṛsamā gurvī sādhvī satī pativratā ||58||
śīlayuktā brahmacaryaparā brahmapriyā hi sā |
matsvarūpā sadā sādhvī vaiṣṇavī sā narāyaṇī ||59||
kārṣṇī sā mādhavī lakṣmīḥ śaktirvai pauruṣottamī |
sādhurūpaḥ sadā cāhaṃ saṃvarte sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||3.80.60||
sādhavo matsvarūpā vai sādhvyaśca mama śaktayaḥ |
mama dhāmapradāḥ sarve sarvāśca pāvanāḥ priye ||6 1||
sādhubhyastu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu |
sādhusevāsamaṃ nāsti puṇyaṃ tapaśca sarvathā ||62||
dhanāḍhyāstu dhanenaiva sevante pūjyadehinaḥ |
daridrāḥ sādhusevāḍhyā labhante brahma śāśvatam ||63||
dhanāḍhyā yānti vai svargaṃ daridrā yānti dhāma ca |
adhanā varṣmaṇā sevāṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ satām ||64||
upavāsān prakurvanti koṭiyajñaphalapradān |
ato dravyamayād yajñāt sevāyajño viśiṣyate ||65||
sadā tīrthaṃ sevanīyaṃ tārakaṃ cātmanāṃ mudā |
sthūlaṃ tīrthaṃ bhūjalādi sūkṣmaṃ sādhuprasevanam ||66||
divyaṃ tīrthaṃ manaḥśuddhistattīrthāsevanaṃ caret |
manastīrthe tu yaḥ pūtaścātmatīrthe pramucyate ||67||
agādhe vimale śuddhe satyatoye dhṛtahrade |
snātavyaṃ mānase tīrthe sattvamālambya śāśvatam ||68||
tīrthaśaucaṃ pravadāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pramokṣadam |
sādhutvaṃ jāyate yena yena māyāvināśanam ||69||
agrāhitvamanarthitvamārjavaṃ satyamityapi |
ahiṃsā mārdavaṃ śāntirānṛśaṃsyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ ||3.80.70||
nirmamāhaṃkṛtitvaṃ nirdvandvatvaṃ niṣparigrahaḥ |
śucitvaṃ ca guṇā yatra tīrthībhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ||71||
brahmavettā mahattīrthaṃ tārakaṃ pāpanāśakam |
sarvatyāgeṣvabhiratā bhaktijñāḥ samadarśinaḥ ||72||
kaṣāyarahitāḥ śāntāḥ sādhavastīrthabhūṣaṇāḥ |
manaḥśaucaṃ paraṃśaucaṃ snātastatra pramucyate ||73||
nodakaklinnagātro vai snāta ityabhidhīyate |
sa snāto yo damasnātaḥ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||74||
gataṃ naivānuśocanti pratyakṣe nirmamāḥ sadā |
spṛhā notpadyate yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śaucaṃ hi tīrthavat ||75||
niṣkiṃcanatvaṃ dehasya manasaśca prasannatā |
jñānaśaucaṃ cātmanaśca tīrthāni trīṇi caiva ha ||76||
vṛttaśaucaṃ śarīrasya vrataśaucaṃ tu mānasam |
tīrthaśaucamātmanaśca trīṇi mokṣakarāṇi vai ||77||
jñānotpannaṃ paraṃ śaucaṃ brahmajñānajalātmakam |
snāti yo mānase tatra mokṣaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||78||
tattvāropitaśaucastu nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
sevāsadguṇasampannastīrthameva janaḥ sadā ||79||
kīrtanāccaiva tīrthasya snānācca pitṛtarpaṇāt |
sarvapāpāni dahyanti tato yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||3.80.80||
parigrahācca sādhūnāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya manorgrahāt |
bhaktisaritkṛtāplāvāt taranti prākṛtaṃ tamaḥ ||8 1||
sādhavastīrthavaryā vai sādhutā tīrthasattamā |
ubhayoreva yaḥ snāyāt sa siddhiṃ śīghramāpnuyāt ||82||
sadācāraḥ paro dharmastīrthaṃ cottamameva tat |
satāṃ dharmaṃ saha nītvā yāti vyaktiḥ parāṃ gatim ||83||
dharma eko manuṣyāṇāṃ sahāyaḥ pāralaukikaḥ |
sa ced divyaḥ kṛtaścātra sādhūnāṃ sevayā tadā ||84||
mokṣado dhāmadaścāpi śāśvatānandadaḥ paraḥ |
mokṣadharmasamo dharmo mūrdhanyo nāsti sṛṣṭiṣu ||85||
sarvatīrthamayo dharmo mokṣadharmo’sti sādhuṣu |
sādhavaḥ pālitā yena sevitāśca prasāditāḥ ||86||
sarvo dharmaḥ kṛtastena paramātmā prasāditaḥ |
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ ||87||
sādhusevātatparasya paraṃ mokṣapadaṃ bhavet |
yathā nāgapade’nyāni padāni saṃviśanti vai ||88||
tathā sarvāṇi dharmāṇi viśanti sādhusevane |
teṣāṃ sādhusevināṃ vai brahmaloko vidhīyate ||89||
nābhāgenāmbarīṣeṇa gayena citraketunā |
āyunā cānaraṇyena dilīpena ca bhūbhṛtā ||3.80.90||
śibinā mucukundena māndhātrā bharatena ca |
janakena tathā rukmāṃgadenālarkabhṛbhṛtā ||91||
pṛthunā sāgareṇāpi lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā |
ebhiśca rājabhirnityaṃ sādhavaḥ saṃprasevitāḥ ||92||
sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ pūjitāśca paramātmāhamarcitaḥ |
ātmatīrthakṛtasnānāḥ sādhvāśīrvādavardhitāḥ ||93||
sādhudharmaparā bhūtvā prayātāḥ paramāṃ gatim |
sarvendriyāṇāṃ vṛttīnāṃ śāntiryāvanna jāyate ||94||
tāvadbhavati saṃsāro bhavamṛtyupravāhakṛt |
vṛttilaye hi sādhutvaṃ sādhutve muktiruttamā ||95||
nārāyaṇasya dūtā vai sarve santīha sādhavaḥ |
kārayitvā kīrtanāni nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||96||
sādhvyo nārāyaṇasyaiva śaktayaḥ santi tārikāḥ |
kārayitvā hareḥ sevāṃ nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||97||
brahāpriyāḥ samastā ye sādhvyaḥ santi pativratāḥ |
bhāgavatyaśca sāttvatyastattaddeśeṣu līlayā ||98||
madicchayā samutpannā deśakalyāṇahetave |
janatāsu mama bhaktipravartanārthameva tāḥ ||99||
yūyaṃ sarvā mama patnyaḥ samutpannā hi sādhvikāḥ |
sādhvīdharmān pālayantu śrīkṛṣṇe svāmini dhruvāḥ || 3.80.1 00||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi parātmani |
śāśvatāyuṣyabhoginyo mattulyāḥ stho dhruvāḥ sadā || 101 ||
mama dhāmanivāsinyo mama pārśve stha eva ha |
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa bhūsthāḥ stho’tra mayā saha || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dīrghāyuḥpradasādhanaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ ca satāṃ sevānādikamityādinirūpaṇanāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||

<3.81>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sāghusaṃgatisatphalam |
ahaṃ bhadrāvatītīre vihārārthaṃ gato’bhavat || 1 ||
gṛdhrā māṃsāśanāstatra kṣetre tīre’bhavan śatam |
śaucārthaṃ kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā kṣetramadhye gato’bhavam || 2 ||
gṛdhrāṇāṃ madhyato mārgaṃ kṛtvāhamagamaṃ puraḥ |
gṛdhrāste miṣṭaśabdena cocurvākyāni vīkṣya mām || 3 ||
tiṣṭhanto yatra tatraiva viśvastā nirbhayāḥ sukhāḥ |
aho’smākaṃ mahad bhāgyaṃ bhūtale samupasthitam || 4 ||
ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādasmanmadhye samāgataḥ |
sādhurūpaḥ sādhuśīlo muktido muktidastathā || 5 ||
pragṛhṇantu caraṇayoścāsya rajāṃsi pakṣayoḥ |
mūrghni mukhe jalaṃ cāsya kalaśādapi pāvanam || 6 ||
brahmakamaṇḍalūvāri sahasrāṃśe na tatsamam |
mokṣo’smākaṃ bhavitaiva spṛśantvasya pade hyubhe || 7 ||
pakṣābhyāṃ vījayantven śrīkāntaṃ puruṣottamam |
susvaraiḥ kīrtayantven nārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 8 ||
mastakaiḥ praṇamantvenaṃ pāpaprajvālakaṃ harim |
padbhyāṃ tamabhigacchantu pradakṣiṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 9 ||
cakṣurbhyāṃ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vilokayantu satpatim |
santaṃ satāṃ patiṃ sādhvīnāthaṃ pakṣipatiṃ prabhum || 3.81.10 ||
ityevamuccarantaścāyayuḥ samantataśca mām |
nemuḥ pādau pasparśuśca cakruśca darśanaṃ muhuḥ || 11 ||
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ pakṣiyonitaḥ |
ūcuśca vayamāsan vai śūdrā vyādhā hi mānavāḥ || 1 2||
abrahmaṇyā nṛśaṃsāśca kadaryāḥ pāpajīvinaḥ |
apahārakāścaurāśca dveṣṭāro dehināṃ tathā || 1 3||
mithyācārā vyabhicārā parasvaharaṇe ratāḥ |
devapitṛmakhadveṣṭāraśca bhīdā hi dehinām || 14||
dhanadhānyādisampattiṃ dṛṣṭvānyasyerṣyavastathā |
tena pāpena jātāḥ smo gṛdhrajātīyapakṣiṇaḥ || 15||
pakṣiṣu śvapacāḥ sarve durgandhiśavabhakṣiṇaḥ |
nikṛṣṭā nijapāpaistānnaḥ kṛpāṃ kuru coddhara || 16||
vyādhatve’pi vane sādhūn dṛṣṭvā datvā phalāni ca |
āśīrvādān gṛhītvā cārjitavantaḥ supuṇyakam || 17||
tatpuṇyena smṛtirnāsmān vijahāti hare prabho |
ityarthitastadāhaṃ tānavocaṃ saṃgaterbalāt || 18||
satāṃ sevāphalaṃ tvetat prāgjanmasmaraṇaṃ tathā |
mamāpi darśanaṃ cātra tiryagjanmanivārakam || 1 9||
atha yūyaṃ ca rājāno bhaviṣyatha tataḥ param |
viprā bhūtvā tato devāstato brahmarṣayaḥ śubhāḥ ||3.81.20||
satyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā prayāsyathākṣaraṃ mama |
tatra tatra hi sādhūnāṃ samāgamo bhaviṣyati ||21 ||
ityuktāste mayā lakṣmi gṛdhrāḥ sarve mṛtiṃ gatāḥ |
jātāste kṣatriyāḥ sarve mṛtvā viprāstato’bhavan || 22||
tato devāśca ṛṣayastato dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
ityevaṃ sādhusaṃgasya phalaṃ te’bhihitaṃ mayā ||23||
tiraścāmapi yanme’pi darśanaṃ sulabhaṃ hyabhūt |
yenāvāpuḥ padaṃ gṛdhrāḥ pūrṇaṃ brahma sanātanam ||24||
tasmāt samāgamaḥ kāryaḥ pāpināpi satāṃ muhuḥ |
pāpakṣālanamevāpi puṇyaṃ muktiśca saṃbhavet ||25||
ekadā lomaśo bhūmau padbhyāṃ sādhuśatairyutaḥ |
vicacāra hi śreyo’rthaṃ lokānāṃ śuddhikāmyayā ||26||
mārge śrutvā padānāṃ vai śabdān jīvaṭakīṭakaḥ |
adhāvad vāṭadeśādvai bahirgantuṃ tvarānvitaḥ ||27||
lomaśaḥ paripapraccha dṛṣṭvā jīvaṭakīṭakam |
kathaṃ tvaritastrasto’si gamyate kva tvayā vada ||28||
śrutvā jīvaṭakīṭaśca prāhāhaṃ vīkṣya maṇḍalam |
satāṃ tu bahusaṃkhyākaṃ śrutvā pādasvanām̐stathā ||29||
bhayaṃ prāpto mṛtyujātaṃ pādakaccaramardanāt |
dhāvāmi satvaraṃ mārgād yathā bahiḥ prayāmi vai ||3.81.3 0||
gṛhaṃ me vidyate pārśve strīputrādisukhānvitam |
akālamaraṇaṃ me na bhavecchūnye kuṭumbinaḥ ||3 1||
ekalasya mṛtiḥ śūnye kuṭumbarahitasya me |
asadgatipradā syādvai śoceyurmama bāndhavāḥ ||32||
tasmācchīghraṃ pravadāmi mṛtyorduḥkhaṃ paraṃ yataḥ |
tvarayāmi jīvanārthaṃ jīvataḥ sukhamuttamam ||33 ||
lomaśastu samākarṇya jīvaṭaṃ prāha te kutaḥ |
kīṭayonau sukhaṃ cāste duḥkhayonau vadātra me ||34||
duḥkhayonestu maraṇaṃ tava śreyo bhavediha |
nābhijānāsi vai śreṣṭhān sparśabhogasukhottamān ||35||
na ca vetsi rasamiṣṭān yānavāhanasūtsavān |
tasmātpāpe’tra dehe te śreyo vai maraṇaṃ bhavet ||36||
jīvaṭaḥ prāha śrutvaiva lomaśaṃ dīrghadarśinam |
dehī sarvatra susukhī yatra dehe pravartate ||37||
vanaṃ paśyāmi vividhaṃ vividhān dṛśyasaṃbhavān |
kuṭumbaṃ strīsutāḍhyaṃ ca paśyāmi cotsavānvitaḥ ||38||
spṛśāmi strīṃ sutaṃ putrīṃ kuṭumbino’tra bhūtale |
śṛṇomi vividhā gītīścāraṇye svajanādiyuk ||39||
bhakṣayāmi rasān miṣṭān vṛkṣavallīsamudbhavān |
jighrāmi bahudhā gandhān bhuṃjāmi viṣayān bahūn ||3.81.40||
yathādehaṃ viṣayā me vartante cottamottamāḥ |
sakuṭumbo bhavāmyatra kuṭumbaṃ cottamaṃ mama ||41|||
ityākarṇya ṛṣiḥ prāha śṛṇu kīṭa vadāmi te |
alpāyustvaṃ lakṣyase’tra kṛtayatno’pi sarvathā ||42||
mṛtyustava hi nikaṭe dhṛtapāśaḥ pratiṣṭhati |
tasmān mā vaha vāñcchāṃ vā jīvanārthaṃ sukhāya vā ||43 ||
sādhusamāgamaḥ kīṭa bahupuṇyāya kalpate |
mṛtyuste vidyate’vaśyaścādya kṣaṇe na saṃśayaḥ ||44||
yadi me darśanāt kīṭa śreṣṭhaṃ janma samicchasi |
vada te tad dadāmyatra śubhaṃ janma satāṃ balāt ||45||
etān sādhūnnamaskāraṃ kṛtvā yāhi mṛtiṃ tataḥ |
kalyāṇaṃ te kariṣyāmi vada kiṃ te mano’tra ha ||46||
jīvaṭaśca tataḥ prāha yadyevaṃ maraṇaṃ mama |
pārśve mama kuṭumbasya sannidhau mṛtirastu me ||47 ||
mānavaśca tato deho bhavatvatra ca bhūtale |
yena śreyo vividhaṃ me satāṃ yogād bhaviṣyati ||48 ||
ityuktvā tūrṇamevāsau vāṭapārśvamupāgataḥ |
tṛṇamūle kṛtāvāsān kuṭumbinaśca gartagān ||49 ||
ājuhāva drutaṃ kīṭaḥ sammilya tān mṛtiṃ yayau |
tajjīvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa kṣattragarbhe surāṣṭrake ||3.81.50 ||
paurarājyakule jāto rājā prajāniyāmakaḥ |
lomaśaśca tato bhūyo yayāvabdhitaṭe mudā ||5 1 ||
dadarśabhūpaṃ bhūyo’pi jātismaro’rcayanmunim |
jagrāha caraṇau bhaktyā provāca sarvameva tu ||52 ||
ṛṣe te kṛpayā kīṭānnirgatyāsmi nṛpo’bhavan |
nāryo gajāśca turagā uṣṭrā yānāni sampadaḥ |||53 ||
bhavanti mama bhogyāste kṛpayātra guro sadā |
sādhukṛpāphalaṃ caitat prāśnāmi miṣṭamuttamam ||54||
śreṣṭhaśayyātale rājñīsevitaśca svapimyapi |
jāgarmi vanditaḥ sūtādyaiśca devo yathā hariḥ ||55||
dāsyo dāsā hyasaṃkhyā me’mātyāścājñāvahāḥ śubhāḥ |
namaste’stu guro sādho kiṃ karomi vadātra me ||56 ||
śrutvā hṛṣṭo lomaśastaṃ nṛpaṃ vai jīvacandrakam |
prāha rājam̐stvayā rājadehād gantavyameva ha ||57||
bhogā bhuktāstvayā rājan bahudhā me hyanugrahāt |
atha tvaṃ bhava vipro vai śreṣṭhajanma gṛhāṇa ca ||58||
mama te darśanaṃ jātaṃ tadeva sukṛtaṃ punaḥ |
vaiṣṇavastvaṃ bhava mantraṃ gṛhṇa śreyo bhaviṣyati ||59 ||
tyaja mohaṃ kuṭumbasya rājyasya strījanasya ca |
sādhukṛpāṃ gṛhāṇātra mā pramādī bhavātra vai || 3.81.60 ||
ityuktaḥ sa nṛpastūrṇaṃ jagrāha mantramuttamam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||6 1 ||
atha śrīlomaśastatra dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi |
tāvad rājā śarīraṃ svaṃ tatyāja sarvasannidhau || 62 ||
saurāṣṭre cābhavad vipro’kṣarakṣetre’tra cottame |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe cāśvapaṭṭasarontike | |6 3 ||
yogāyano maharṣiḥ sa jātismaro’ti bhaktimān |
janmataḥ siddhimān dharmī brahmiṣṭhaḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ || 64||
atha śrīlomaśastaṃ ca kumāraṃ pratyapadyata |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja mahāmate ||65||
mama yogāt kṣetrayogānmuktiste bhāvinī śubhā |
parameśvarabhakteśca phalaṃ te syānmahottamam ||66||
baṭuḥ sa vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvamantrān ṛṣermukhāt |
jagrāha ca tato naijāṃ jananīṃ tu kalāvatīm ||67||
pitaraṃ cāryaśīlākhyaṃ nanāma bhāvatastadā |
ājñāṃ labdhvā tatastūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ supūjanam ||68||
māmabhigamya ca naijaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā vimānagaḥ |
mama sālokyamagamad brahma dhāma sanātanam ||69||
avāpa sa padaṃ lakṣmi mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param |
sādhoḥ samāgamādevaṃ mokṣapadaṃ hi labhyate ||3.81.70||
sādhavo matpādajuṣaścakṣurdadati cāntaram |
vidhūnvanti ca pāpāni janmahrāsaṃ dadhatyapi ||71||
karmakṣayaṃ kārayanti kṛpayā puṇyaśevadhim |
dadatyapi svānugāya bhaktāya prahitātmane ||72||
bandhanāni vicitrāṇi dṛḍhāni yāni cātmanām |
tāni vibhedayitveha vitaranti śubhāni ca ||73||
svargasukhāni ramyāṇi satyakalpodbhavāni ca |
devatulyāni varṣmāṇi bhogyānīśvarabhāni ca ||74||
śāśvatadivyamūrtiṃ ca kṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
preṣayanti pratāpena naijena mama sādhavaḥ ||75||
sādhvyaścaiva śubhācārā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
svayogamāgatān jīvān preṣayanti padaṃ mama ||76||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vinodinyā viprāyāśca kathāṃ śubhām |
dhārāgrāmanivāsinyā bhaktāyā mama pāvanīm ||77||
pativratā patiṃ sādhvī siṣeve ceśavat sadā |
bhāgavataṃ śatānandanāmānaṃ vipramuttamam ||78||
daśasāhasravarṣāṇi tayorgatāni bhūtale |
brahmaparāyaṇayorvai bhaktayoranapatyayoḥ ||79||
śatānandastvekadāṃ tāṃ patnīṃ prāha śubhāśayaḥ |
kathaṃ sādhvi ṛtusnātā dharmeṇa sevitāpi vai ||3.81.80||
garbhe vaṃśakaraṃ naiva ghārayasyatra me vada |
kāraṇaṃ vā vibhāgyaṃ vā vandhyātvaṃ vāpi vetsi cet ||8 1 ||
mama doṣo’thavā cāste mama bhāgyaṃ na cāsti vā |
kathaṃ putravatī naiva cireṇāpi vilokyase ||82||
śrutvā patnī patiṃ prāha kāraṇaṃ bhaktarāṭ śṛṇu |
garbhavāso mahad duḥkhaṃ jīvasyānalapācane ||83||
janmaduḥkhaṃ dehaduḥkhaṃ mṛtyorduḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
aśuddhiśca punarduḥkhaṃ niraye gamanaṃ punaḥ ||84||
vāsanāpi mahadduḥkhaṃ snehaduḥkhaṃ punastathā |
evaṃ duḥkhāni cālokyānapatyatve paraṃ sukham ||85||
matvā nāhaṃ dhārayāmi garbhaṃ māyāviḍambanam |
śrutvā tāṃ ca patistvāha ṛṇaṃ pitṛkṛtaṃ priye ||86||
yāvannottīryate tāvat pitṝṇāṃ duḥkhamityapi |
mama duḥkhaṃ ca te duḥkhaṃ punnāmanarakodbhavam ||87||
vandhyātvasyāpavādaṃ ca nirvaṃśatvādikiṃkathām |
apākartumapi sādhvī garbhaṃ dhartuṃ tvamarhasi ||88||
śrutvaivaṃ sādhvikā prāha yadyevaṃ kānta saṃśṛṇu |
putrā ye ye bhaveyuste preṣaṇīyā hariṃ prati ||89||
bhaktāḥ syuḥ sādhavaścaite muktiṃ dāsyanti me ca te |
ityevaṃ vāgbandhanena dhārayāmi ca daurhṛdam || 3.81.90||
tathāstviti patiḥ prāha ṛtusnātā ca sevitā |
dadhāra garbhaṃ patitaḥ suṣuve kālataḥ sutam ||91||
vavṛdhe ca śanairbālo bodhitaścātmavid yathā |
mātrā vivekavān putraḥ kṛtopavītasaṃskṛtiḥ ||92||
niveditaśca mahyaṃ vai sādhutvārthaṃ samarpitaḥ |
muktyāyano mayā nāmnā kṛtaḥ sādhurviraktimān || 93 ||
śatānandaḥ prasanno’bhūt putraṃ sādhuṃ vilokya ha |
atha patnīṃ dvitīyaṃ ca garbhaṃ dadhāra kālataḥ ||94||
suṣuve kālataścāpi vardhayāmāsa bhāvataḥ |
bodhayāmāsa vijñānairdadau mahyaṃ ca taṃ sutam ||95||
so’pi sandīkṣito nāmnā brahmāyanaḥ kṛto mayā |
kavirjāto mahān sādhurmokṣamārgaparāyaṇaḥ ||96||
śatānandaśca taṃ vīkṣya prasannaḥ samajāyata |
dadau tṛtīyagarbhaṃ ca patnyai prasannamānasaḥ ||97||
suṣuve sā ca taṃ putraṃ śikṣayāmāsa sevanam |
jñānaṃ gānaṃ dadau mahyaṃ sādhudīkṣārthameva ca ||98||
mayā tu dīkṣito nāmnā premāyanaḥ kṛtaḥ sa ca |
gītikākuśalaḥ sādhuḥ so’pi mokṣaparo’bhavat ||99||
putrāḥ pañcaśatānyevaṃ samajāyanta vai cirāt |
sarve te sādhavo jātā mama dīkṣāparāyaṇāḥ || 3.81.100 ||
divyā divyavihārāśca divyakriyā hi sādhavaḥ |
tīrtharūpāḥ samastāste śīlavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 10 1||
jīvānāṃ mokṣadāḥ sarve jñānadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
mama bhaktiyutāḥ saumyā sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 1 02||
vidyāvantaḥ śīlavanto mama mūrtiparāyaṇāḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre vasantyete hi yoginaḥ || 103||
śatānandasya putrāste mahābhāgavatāstvime |
vartante bhaktikartāraścākṣare kṣetrake mama || 1 04||
athānte śrīśatānandaḥ patnīṃ prāha sutaṃ tu me |
dehyekaṃ vaṃśakartāraṃ mā taṃ sādhuṃ vidhehi vai || 1 05||
ityuktvā brāhmaṇī vinodinī putraṃ tu cāntimam |
viśvāyanaṃ dadau saṃśikṣitaṃ kāntāya padmaje || 1 06||
viśvāyano’bhavannityaṃ gṛhadharmānvito hi saḥ |
vivāhito vaṃśakartā maharṣirlomaśāśrame || 1 07||
mahābhāgavato dīkṣāyuto vedāṃgapāragaḥ |
atha vinodinī ceyaṃ sādhvīdīkṣāsudīkṣitā || 1 08||
amṛtākhyā brahmasakhī vartate tyāgamāśritā |
śatānando’pi sādhutve vartate cāśrame mama || 1 09||
mama sevāparo divyagatimān padmaje sadā |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te’tra vinodinyāḥ kathānakam || 3.81.1 10||
mokṣārthaṃ samavartinyāḥ sarvaputrārpaṇātmakam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mokṣamārgo bhaveddhruvaḥ || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusaṃgatyā gṛdhrāṇāṃ mokṣo jīvaṭakīṭasya mokṣo vinodinyāḥ paṃcaśataputrāṇāṃ sādhutvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||

<3.82>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa prabho vibho |
svairiṇyāścāpi kāminyāḥ puṃścalyāścāpi yoṣitaḥ || 1 ||
savāsanāyāḥ pāpāni naśyeyurvai kathaṃ vada |
kā gatirvāpi tasyāḥ syāt kena śuddhiśca jāyate || 2 ||
kathaṃ vā sadgatiḥ syācca dayāṃ kṛtvā vadasva me |
anāthāyā hi nāthastvaṃ cābalāyā balaṃ bhavān || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ kalyāṇakṛdvacaḥ |
dayayā hi tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tasmād ṛju vadāmi te || 4 ||
saṃgād balācca puṣṭeśca madād rasācca yauvanāt |
jāyante vāsanāstīvrā bhogātmikyo hi kāmanāḥ || 5 ||
ṛtavo dhātavaścāpīndriyadārḍhyaṃ sukheṣaṇā |
uttejakā hi kāmānāṃ tṛṣṇātantuvivardhakāḥ || 6 ||
aṃgānāṃ darśanāddhāsyādekāntasya prasevanāt |
prāyaśo hi vivardhante sparśādeḥ kāmavāsanāḥ || 7 ||
ayogyā api yujyante dehābhyāṃ vai parasparam |
lokaśāstravyavahārān parityajya svatantrataḥ || 8 ||
kāminītvaṃ puṃścalītvaṃ svairiṇītvaṃ tato bhavet |
kāmakāreṇa loke’tra yoṣitāṃ lagnamantarā || 9 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ ca svairatvaṃ strīcalatvaṃ ca kāmitā |
bhavatyevātikāmena tṛṣṇayā māyayāpi ca || 3.82.10 ||
teṣāṃ pāpavināśārthaṃ sādhanāni bahūnyapi |
bhavanti padmaje prāyaścittāni ca vratāni ca || 1 1||
duṣkarāṇi tathā yāmyavedanāni bahūnyapi |
dehadaṇḍāni cānyāni rājadaṇḍāni santyapi || 12||
tyāgāśramāṇi ramyāṇi tāpasāśramaṇāni ca |
tīrthāni vividhānyeva bhavanti śuddhaye’pi ca || 1 3||
tadeteṣāṃ paraṃśreyaḥkaraṃ tu śaraṇāgatiḥ |
naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ cāsti sādhanaṃ cetarat tviha || 14||
pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ dāyakaṃ tathā |
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ tatra vāsanākṣālakaṃ matam || 15||
satsaṃgo jñānadastatra moharāganivārakaḥ |
kṛpā cātmonnatiprāptikāraṇaṃ vai satāṃ matā || 16||
prasādabhojanaṃ pādavāryamṛtādipānakam |
satāṃ sadyaḥ punātyeva pāpakoṭiyutaṃ janam || 17||
santaḥ pratyakṣatīrthāni santaḥ pratyakṣavahnayaḥ |
santaḥ pratyakṣavarṣā ca santaḥ sākṣātsudhāmṛtam || 18||
santaḥ sākṣād dharmadehāḥ santo’haṃ bhagavān svayam |
santo yajñā gocarā vai santo devādhidevatāḥ || 19||
santo vratāni sarvāṇi santo nāvo bhavāmbudhau |
santo’ nārāyaṇāḥ sarve santastejāṃsi śārṅgiṇaḥ || 3.82.20|||
santastapāṃsi sarvāṇi santo brahma hi pāvanam |
santaḥ kāmadughā bodhyāḥ santo vai kalpapādapāḥ ||21 ||
santaśca kalpalatikāḥ santaścintāmaṇīśvarāḥ |
santaścākṣayapātrāṇi puṇyānāṃ dharmakarmaṇām ||22||
santaścāvyayakośāśca śāśvatānandavāridheḥ |
tārakā dhārakāḥ santaḥ pāpānāṃ kṣālakā drutam ||23||
harergṛhāṇi santo vai mūrtayaḥ sādhavo mama |
teṣāṃ samāgamāttūrṇa mahāpāpābdhayo’pi ca ||24||
anale tṛṇavad bhasmībhavanti sparśamātrataḥ |
mahāpāpābhirevātra strībhirnaijaviśuddhaye ||25||
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
mama mantrān śaraṇādipradān sadbhyo’vagamya ca ||26||
mahābhāgyavatīrītyā praseveta sato janān |
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ natiṃ paricaryā ca pūjanam | | 27||
bhojanaṃ mardanaṃ pānaṃ snānaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ hareḥ |
satāṃ cāpi prakuryācca yeṣāṃ svāmī bhavāmyaham || 28 ||
tadā lakṣmi svāmivatpāvanāḥ santo matā mama |
santa iva ca śaraṇāgatāśca sevakāḥ khalu | | 29 ||
sevikāśca bhavantyeva sudivyā nirguṇāstathā |
niṣpāpā pāvanāḥ sarve viṣṇuḥ santaśca sevakāḥ || 3.82.30 ||
ityetatparamaṃ guptaṃ rahasyaṃ mama te priye |
abalānāṃ kṛte coktaṃ sulabhaṃ pāvanaṃ param || 31 ||
yadāśritya satāṃ yogājjāyante vahnisannibhāḥ |
brahmanibhā bhavantyeva nāryo niṣpāpavigrahāḥ || 3 2||
śṛṇu te’tra kathayāmi pratyakṣaṃ te nidarśanam |
vārāṇasī purī lakṣmi śiveśvarasya te pituḥ || 33 ||
yatra gaṇāśca gaṇikāḥ sahasraśaḥ pitustava |
sevakāḥ sevikāścāpi vidyante cāvivāhitāḥ || 34 ||
yatheṣṭakāmacārāśca śivasya bhaktikāriṇaḥ |
svairiṇyaścāpi puṃścalyaḥ kāminyo gaṇikāḥ khalu || 3 5||
vasanti te pituḥ puryāṃ pumāṃse’pi tathāvidhāḥ |
gaṇā bhāṇḍā nartakāśca gāyakā vādakā api || 36 ||
nagnā gaṇāstathā nagnā yoginyo gaṇikāstathā |
yathākāmaṃ pravartante yogiśaṃkarasaṃśrayāḥ | | 37 ||
teṣāṃ tāsāmekadā vai gaṃgāyāstu jale’bhavat |
samājo hi tu naukāsu gānakīrtananartanaiḥ || 38 ||
gaṇikānāṃ nartanāni bhāṇḍānāṃ hasanāni ca |
vṛndalānāṃ ca narmāṇi prāvartanta niśāmukhe || 39 ||
pravṛddhamaṃgalanāmnā jāyate sa mahotsavaḥ |
tatra vai prekṣakā rātrau lakṣaśo mānavā api ||3.82.40 ||
abhavan saṃghaśo vārau naukāsu sarvatodiśi |
kṛtvotsavān sāptadainān vyaramanta pitustava || 41 ||
viśvanāthasvasūpasya mandire nartanādibhiḥ |
athātra bhagavān yogī vātsyāyano mahānṛṣiḥ ||42 ||
ājīvaṃ brahmacaryasthaḥ sādhudharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
ūrdhvaretāḥ śaṃbhuvacca mahāyogīndrasattamaḥ || 43 ||
samājagāma tatraiva dharmāraṇyāt sutīrthakṛt |
vivastro bhānahīnaśca sarvāṃgadhūlidhūsaraḥ | | 44| |
avikāro yuvā cāpi vārdhakyavṛttibhūṣitaḥ |
sarvaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca yasya dṛṣṭau pravartate ||45||
naranārītibhāhīnaḥ svayaṃ sādhuḥ suśobhanaḥ |
dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ gaṇān pūjanatatparān ||46||
gaṇikāśca samastā vai yuvatīrbhūṣitāstathā |
śṛṃgāritā yathā tāśca svairiṇīriva saṃsthitāḥ ||47||
puṃścalīḥ kāminīścāpi sarvaceṣṭāsamanvitāḥ |
utsave te pituḥ prasannatāprāptyai suyatnitāḥ ||48||
vahnikanyā iva ramyā devīriva samujjvalāḥ |
ratnahīrakamauktikādyalaṃkṛtāḥ suśobhanāḥ ||49||
vīkṣya sarvāṃ ṛṣirvātsyāyanaḥ sādhurnanāma ha |
harabhaktānikāḥ sarvā vīkṣya śāntaṃ sthitaṃ munim ||3.82.50||
yuvānaṃ raktapuṣṭaṃ ca nagnaṃ śaṃkarasadṛśam |
dhyānamagnaṃ dehabhānavarjitaṃ sūryabhāsvaram |||5 1 ||
mohotpādakarūpaṃ ca bhogyamānasasaṃśrayam |
puṇyapuñjaṃ sparśamātrāt pāpapuñjapradāhakam ||52||
etādṛśaṃ varaṃ vīkṣya mugdhā niścitya śaṃkaram |
mūrtimantaṃ cāgataṃ vai pasparśuḥ gaṇikāgaṇāḥ ||53||
yadyapi kāmabhāvena mohabhāvena kāścana |
kāścana devabhāvena sādhubhāvena kāścana ||54||
pādau cucumburdevasya ṛṣerligaṃ ca netrayoḥ |
sparśayāmāsuratyarthaṃ menire ca kṛtārthatām ||55||
āścaryaṃ tatra tāsāṃ vai jātaṃ śṛṇu hi padmaje |
ṛṣistu tiṣṭhate stabdho jaḍavat susamādhigaḥ ||56||
yāḥ spṛśanti gaṇikāstaṃ tāsāṃ rājasavṛttayaḥ |
yāścāsan prāksamastāstā vyalīyanta spṛśeḥ ṛṣeḥ ||57||
niṣkāmatāṃ gatāḥ sarvāḥ sattvapūrṇāḥ śubhāśayāḥ |
kāmavṛttivihīnā vai sparśamātrāt kṣaṇāntare ||58||
cāñcalyaṃ sarvathā naṣṭaṃ gaṇikānāṃ samantataḥ |
yonīnāṃ ca vikārā vai vegā nirvegatāṃ yayuḥ ||59||
mānasāni samastānāṃ nirvikārāṇi cābhavan |
saṃkalpā vāsanāḥ kāmā rāgā ratiśca kāmanā ||3.82.60 ||
sarve līnāḥ kṣaṇāt tāsāṃ yogisparśagayoṣitām |
divyāśca dṛṣṭayastāsāmabhavan śaṃbhuyoṣitām ||61 ||
athākāśe mahāścaryaṃ vyalokayam̐stataśca tāḥ |
lakṣaśaśca samudbhūtā vāgurikā hyadhomukhāḥ ||62||
gatāścākāśamārgeṇa gaṃgānugā himālayam |
gaṇikāstatra sañjātāḥ sarvāvaraṇavarjitāḥ ||63||
divyāśca divyadehāśca satīrādhāramā yathā |
tatastāḥ śuddhimāpannāḥ sarvāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ ||64||
antardṛṣṭyā vilokyainaṃ vātsyāyanaṃ hi yoginam |
brahmarūpaṃ pāpanāśakaraṃ sparśena sarvathā ||65||
viditvā taṃ munīndraṃ vai sādhuṃ sādhuvibhūṣaṇam |
natvā spṛṣṭvā punaḥ santaṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ ||66||
sādho puṇyapratāpātte divyā no dṛṣṭayastviha |
dehāścāpi ca divyā no jātāḥ sparśanadarśanāt ||67||
kāmā hṛdayyā naṣṭāśca yuvatītvaṃ hi cañcalam |
sarvaṃ līnaṃ bhavadyogāt pādadhūlipravāhaṇāt ||68||
vayaṃ sarvāḥ pāvitāśca svairiṇyo gaṇikāstviha |
puṃścalyaścāpi kāminyo yathā sādhvyaḥ sma eva ha ||69||
śaṃkarasya prapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ mahotsavasya ca |
prāptaṃ tvadya hi loke’tra hṛndi yannirmalāni naḥ ||3.82.70||
paraṃ pṛcchāma evātra sādho vāgurikāśca yāḥ |
ambare tāḥ samuḍḍīya lakṣaśo vigatāstvitaḥ ||71 ||
kāstāḥ kathaṃ samāyātāḥ kva gatāśca kutaśca tāḥ |
vada nastad yathārthaṃ vai tvaṃ nau nairmalyakārakaḥ ||72||
śrutvā vātsyāyanaḥ prāha sādhvyaḥ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ |
mama sparśo bhavatībhiryena kenāpi karmaṇā ||73||
yena kenāpi bhāvena vihito’trāṃganāstataḥ |
bhavatīnāṃ vāsanā yāḥ kāmapāpātmikāstathā ||74||
tṛṣṇāḥ pāpātmikāścāpi pāpānyasaṃkhyakāni ca |
gaṇikākṛtakarmāṇi tāni sarvāṇi yāni ca ||75||
mama pādasparśanena malliṃgasparśanena ca |
maddhūlidhāraṇenāpi dehebhyo nirgatāni vai ||76||
bhavatīnāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ pāvanatvaṃ vilokya ca |
aśaktāni hi saṃsthātuṃ niryātāni samantataḥ ||77||
tāni sarvāṇi pāpāni vāgulikātmakāni ca |
bhūtvā yātāni sarvāṇi himālaye tu mānasam ||78||
sarastatra bhaviṣyatyaddhā tanmokṣo vilīnatā |
mama yogena sarvāsāṃ pāpāni nirgatāni vai ||79||
atha yūyaṃ samastāśca gṛhṇata mantramuttamam |
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ gaṇikābhyo manuṃ mama ||3.82.80||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
gṛhītvā gaṇikādevyo mantraṃ tūrṇaṃ caturbhujāḥ ||81||
bhūtvā śrīvaiṣṇavīdevyo divyadehāḥ suśobhanāḥ |
nārāyaṇyo vimānaiśca yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||82||
sahasraśo gaṇikāstā haripriyāstato’bhavan |
vartante cākṣaredhāmni mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ||83||
ityevaṃ sādhusaṃgena lakṣmi puṃścalikā api |
sadyaḥ śuddhyati dharmāḍhyā divyā bhavati sevikā ||84||
tasmāt pāpātipāpānāṃ śodhakaṃ sevanaṃ satām |
yena kenāpi bhāvena sevitāḥ śodhayanti te ||85||
athānyā gaṇikāḥ śrutvā cāyayustamṛṣiṃ prati |
śuddhyarthaṃ ca tadā tābhyaḥ kāmaśāstraṃ jagāda ha ||86||
śrāvayitvā śikṣayitvā sevāṃ datvā nijāṃ tataḥ |
tāsāṃ mokṣaṃ cakārāpi vātsyāyano mahānṛṣiḥ ||87||
śaṃkaraśca svayaṃ mūrtimān bhūtvā gocaro’sya ca |
abhavat prāha dhanyo’si gaṇikāmokṣakṛd ṛṣe ||88 ||
sādho sādhusvarūpo’si kāmaṃ kṛtvā sucintitam |
api kāmena naiva tvaṃ lipto’si kāmaśāstrakṛt ||89||
yathāhaṃ dāhakaścāsmi kāmasya jīvako’pi ca |
yathā kṛṣṇo vijetāsti kāmasya ramayannapi ||3.82.90||
tathā tvaṃ ca vijetāsi kāmasya varṇayannapi |
bhava sādho muktidātā pāpaṃ vināśya yoṣitām ||91||
śāstraṃ te tava nāmnaiva khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā śaṃkaro devo tirobhāvaṃ pitā tava ||92||
yayau kāśyāṃ ca sādhuḥ sa vyacacāra mahītale |
mokṣayan jīvajātāni vātsyāyano hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||93||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi |
mahāpāpāni naśyanti mokṣagatirdhruvā bhavet ||94||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ sādhusevanam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyabhāvapradaṃ kathānakam ||95||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svairiṇīkāminīpuṃścalīnāmapi gaṇikānāṃ kāśyāṃ sādhuvātsyāyanasamāgamena pāpanāśottaraṃ muktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||

<3.83>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kena vai hetunā sādhurnārāyaṇo nigadyate |
yadyapi bahavastatra hetavaḥ syurdṛḍhavratāḥ || 1 ||
tathāpi saralaṃ hetuṃ yadvā śreṣṭhamanuttamam |
duṣkaraṃ vāvagantuṃ taṃ samicchāmi tathā vada || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahataśca hetūn bahuvidhānapi |
kṣamā śīlaṃ virāgaśca śāntistathāparigrahaḥ || 3 ||
vaitṛṣṇyaṃ svādaśūnyatvaṃ cātmaniṣṭhatvamityapi |
alolupatā dveṣādirāhityaṃ sarvamitratā || 4 ||
ātmasādhanakartavyaṃ mayi sarvasamarpaṇam |
asneho bandhaśūnyatvaṃ māyākaiṃkaryavarjanam || 5 ||
dehendriyādiyātrātanmātranirvāhaṇārjanam |
pratīkṣā mokṣalokasya mamāhaṃvarjanaṃ tathā || 6 ||
navonmeṣārambhahāniḥ sthairyaṃ cātmani netare |
śīlaṃ manaso nairmalyaṃ sādhutve kāraṇāni vai || 7 ||
paropakāro yasyāsti mokṣamārgapradarśanam |
vrataṃ śīlaṃ ca yasyāsti nārāyaṇārthamuttamam || 8 ||
tapaścograṃ ca yasyāsti māyābandhanavarjitam |
vṛttayaścāpi sarvā vai yasya madgocaraḥ sadā || 9 ||
hyetaccatuṣṭayaṃ lakṣmi sādhutve mukhyakāraṇam |
nahi kāṣāyavastrāṇi nahi cihnāni bāhyataḥ || 3.83.10||
nahi dīkṣā nahi vāsaḥ sādhutve śreṣṭhahetavaḥ |
ātmamokṣavidhātāro māyāmokṣādyabhīpsavaḥ || 1 1||
parabrahmaṇi niṣṇātāstāpasāḥ sādhusattamāḥ |
sādhvyaścāpi satīdharmaparāḥ śīlaparā mama || 12||
rāgaśūnyā bhaktimatyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhvīvibhūṣaṇāḥ |
śarīre bhogaśūnyatvaṃ sādhusopānamādimam || 1 3||
indriyarāgaśūnyatvaṃ sopānaṃ ca dvitīyakam |
antaḥkaraṇavaśatā sopānaṃ ca tṛtīyakam || 14||
ātmanaścārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe sopānaṃ taccaturthakam |
jñāne manmūrtivāsaśca sopānaṃ pañcamaṃ ca tat || 15||
mokṣaphalaprayatnaśca sopānaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva tat |
turyāvasthāsthitirnityaṃ sopānaṃ cāntimaṃ hi tat || 16||
saptasopānamārūḍhaḥ sādhureva saduttamaḥ |
api sādhvyastathācārāḥ sādhvyuttamā matā mama || 17||
ta ete hyuccakakṣāsthāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo mayoditāḥ |
madhyakakṣāgatām̐ścāpi darśayāmi nibodha me || 18||
dehendriyādirāgasthāstajjanyasukhalipsavaḥ |
kintu sarvārpaṇāḥ kṛṣṇe mayi cātmanivedinaḥ || 19||
māyāyā gauṇabalino madbale cottamāspadāḥ |
evaṃvidhā madhyamāste sādhavaḥ sādhvikāḥ priye ||3.83.20||
atha tato’pi nimnasthān śṛṇu lakṣmi madarthakān |
sarvathā rāgayuktāśca dehendriyādiyoginaḥ ||21||
labdhadīkṣā api svārthaparāyaṇā madāśrayāḥ |
kṛtvo’gre māṃ pradarśyāpi tyāgāśramanivāsinaḥ ||22||
tyāgagandhasya mātrāṃ ca svalpāṃ naiva vidanti ca |
tathāpi kaṣṭamāsādya tyāgamārge sthitā iva || 23 ||
vartante ye nimnacittā jālāvṛttā haridhvajāḥ |
ta ete nāmataḥ sarve sādhavo vai bhavanti hi || 24||
yathā kāṣṭhakṛto hastī yathā vyāghraśca carmajaḥ |
tathāmbareṇa yaḥ sādhustrayaste vyarthaśaktayaḥ || 25 ||
ajñānāṃ bhayadāścaite vijñānāmupalā iva |
āśritānāṃ neṣṭadāste trayo viśvāsaghātakāḥ || 26 ||
niścitārthavighātāste samunnativirodhinaḥ |
asatkācasamāścaite saṃgād bhaṃganirūpakāḥ || 27||
tapaḥ śrutaṃ ca śaktiścāpyetat sādhutvalakṣaṇam |
kṣamā bhaktirvirāgaśca sādhutve kāraṇāni vai || 28 ||
etādṛśe tu sādhau vai tṛpte tṛptāḥ surādayaḥ |
yathā hi sulabhe kṣetre phalaṃ vindati karṣukaḥ || 29 ||
tathā samarpya sādhau vai phalaṃ dātā samaśnute |
asādhau dattamevaitanmoghaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.83.30 ||
adannasādhurhantyannamadyamānaṃ ca hanti tam |
taṃ cānnaṃ pāti yaḥ sādhuradannannaṃ ca rakṣati || 31 ||
rakṣaṇaṃ paraloke’pi pātre’rpitaṃ karoti tat |
prabhurhyannamadan sādhurdātāraṃ poṣayatyapi || 3 2||
puṇyena karmaṇā tasmāt satpātre’nnaṃ niyojayet |
yadeva dadataḥ puṇyaṃ tadevaṃ pratigṛhṇataḥ || 23 ||
yadyubhe sādhurūpe vai pātre syātāṃ hi nirmale |
yatra vai sādhavaḥ santi śrutavṛttopayoginaḥ || 34||
tatra dānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate vai sahasradhā |
ye brahmaśuddhāḥ satataṃ śīlaśuddhāśca sādhavaḥ || 35 ||
tapasyabhiratāścāpi bhaktāḥ pūjyatamā hi te |
taiśca sadbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā divya eva na saṃśayaḥ | | 36 ||
tena yātā na muhyanti māyāyāṃ caiśvare sthale |
paraṃ pāraṃ pragacchanti brahmavāhā hi sādhavaḥ | | 37 ||
duranvayaṃ duḥpradharṣaṃ durāpaṃ duratikramam |
sadāśīrvādataḥ sarvamabhyeti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 ||
surāpo bhrūṇahāḥ stenau gurutalpaniṣevaṇaḥ |
sādhunā tīryate sarvamenasaśca pramucyate || 39 ||
sarvapūjyāḥ pūjyadhanā vidyāvanto hi sādhavaḥ |
tapasvino dānaratā bhaktimanto hi tārakāḥ ||3.83.4 0 ||
imaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ ca mokṣasthānamanuttamam |
sādhusevāsukṛtinaḥ prapadyante tu laukikāḥ ||4 1 ||
pūjitāḥ pūjayantyete mānitā mānayantyapi |
prajvālya pāpipāpāni tārayanti hi sādhavaḥ |||42||
yo bhartā sevakaistuṣṭo bhartustuṣṭāśca sevakāḥ |
yatraivaṃ sādhubhāvo’sti tatra kalyāṇakoṭayaḥ ||43||
adbhirgātrānmalamiva tamo’gniprabhayā yathā |
sādhośca sevayā tadvat sarvapāpamapohati ||44||
svasti karoti sarvasya pāvayatyapi dehinaḥ |
etatkriyāparaḥ sādhuḥ śreyaḥkartā jagattraye ||45||
jīvānāṃ muktaye lakṣmi mayā sāma vinirmitam |
sādhavaḥ sāma gāyanti bodhayanti janāniha ||46||
upadiśanti mantrādīn kīrtayanti ca māṃ muhuḥ |
varṇayanti kathāṃ me ca caritrāṇi bahūni ca ||47||
guṇānme mama kāryāṇi nirūpayanti sarvathā |
evaṃ sāmnā gītikābhirvācayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||48||
vidvāṃso māṃ śāstramukhaiḥ prasaṃgāyanti nityadā |
kavayanti ca kavayaḥ stuvanti cārthasādhakāḥ ||49||
evaṃ sāmnā hi bahudhā māmarjayanti mānavāḥ |
sāmnā gurormukhātprāpya māṃ ca dānena sādhayet ||3.83.50 ||
dānaṃ samastabhāvena samarpaṇaṃ niveditā |
ātmasamarpaṇaṃ dānaṃ tenārjayecca māṃ sadā ||51 ||
sādhavo dānayogena cārjayanti dadatyapi |
jñānadānaṃ mantradānaṃ nāmadānaṃ harestathā ||52||
prasādadānaṃ mālādipradānaṃ śikṣaṇārpaṇam |
lābhadānaṃ sukhadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ parātparam ||53||
dadatyabhayaṃ dānaṃ tat tapodānaṃ śubhāspadam |
puṇyadānaṃ prakurvanti sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇaḥ |||54||
kṛpādānaṃ tathā ramyāśīrvādānāṃ pradānakam |
darśanasya pradānaṃ ca sevādānaṃ śubhāvaham ||55||
sadguṇānāṃ pradānaṃ ca tena tena hi sādhavāḥ |
māṃ hariṃ cārjayantyeva bhaktebhyaśca dadatyapi ||56||
dīkṣādānaṃ cātmadānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te |
bhaktidānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā tārayanti janān bhavāt ||57||
antataścāśrayadānaṃ caraṇāmṛtadānakam |
vāgdānaṃ sākṣitādānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te ||58||
manodānaṃ snehadānaṃ pāvitryādipradānakam |
sadācārakriyāśikṣādānaṃ smṛtipradānakam ||59||
kaṇṭhīdānaṃ cihnadānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te |
mūrtidānaṃ pātradānaṃ kṛtvāpi tārayanti te ||3.83.60||
atha bhedaṃ yojayanti dānaṃ sāma ca yatra na |
deho’yaṃ malasaṃyukto malinaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅguraḥ ||6 1||
ātmā śuddho harerbhakto muktiyogyo hi śāśvataḥ |
evaṃ bhedaṃ vivekaṃ vai yojayanti ca sādhavaḥ ||62||
atha daṇḍaṃ vartayanti prāyaścittaṃ vidharmiṇi |
amārgagaṃ janaṃ santo niyamayanti sadvrataiḥ ||63||
prāyaścittaiḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ kriyātmakaiḥ |
dravyavyayātmakairyajñamahotsavaiḥ sukhotsavaiḥ ||64||
annasatrairbhojanādyaiḥ pūjādānārpaṇādibhiḥ |
śreyaskaraistathāyāsairyojayanti viśuddhaye ||65|||
dharmakarmādibhiścāpi yojayanti prasahya tān |
yadvā prabaladaṇḍena niyamayanti sādhavaḥ ||66 ||
yathā pāpāni naśyeyurmokṣaṃ vindeyureva ca |
evaṃ hitātmadaṇḍena yojayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||67||
garviṣṭhānāṃ tu vai krūraṃ daṇḍaṃ kurvanti vai kvacit |
teṣāṃ niṣkalmaṣatārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ cāpi sādhavaḥ ||68||
daivikaṃ vā śubhaṃ daṇḍaṃ prerayanti japādikam |
yena niṣkalmaṣatvaṃ ca prāpya yānti paraṃ padam ||69||
pāpī vā puṇyaśālī vā miśrito vobhayādibhiḥ |
bhaktimān vā hyabhakto vā nāstiko vāstiko’pi vā ||3.83.70||
yaḥ kaścidvā bhaved dehī nayanti śaraṇaṃ puraḥ |
saṃskṛtyopāyabhedaiśca pāvayanti punaḥ punaḥ ||71||
prasādayitvā satataṃ kṛtvā śuddhaṃ sanātanam |
nijatulyaṃ tataḥ santo nayanti dhāma cākṣaram ||72||
evaṃ satāṃ sadā lakṣmi paropakāraśālitā |
apratidānalabhyā vai tayā śuddhyanti dehinaḥ ||73||
yathā cāhaṃ tathā te vai guravo lokatārakāḥ |
ānakhaśikhaṃ santastu pavitrā mama mūrtayaḥ ||74||
yathā vai śarkarākhaṇḍaḥ sarvathā miṣṭasadrasaḥ |
bhāgatyāgo na tatrāsti tathā te sādhavo mama ||75||
yathā vā navanītasya piṇḍaḥ snehātmako’khilaḥ |
bhāgatyāgo na tatrāsti tathā te sādhavo mama ||76||
yathā vā mauktikaḥ śuddhaḥ svaccho vā sphaṭikastathā |
kaustubho vā maṇiryadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||77||
yathā vā kāmadhenurgauryathā dugdhaṃ ca nirjalam |
yathā vā kanakaṃ śuddhaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||78||
yathā cintāmaṇiḥ śreṣṭho yathā kalpataruśca vā |
kalpavallī yathā śreṣṭhā tathā te sādhavo mama ||79||
yathā me hṛdayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yathā mūrtiśca me parā |
yathākṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma tathā te sādhavo mama ||3.83.80||
yathā viṣṇuḥ sadā śuddhaḥ yathā śīlaṃ vratottamam |
yathā śāntirmahaddravyaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||81||
yathā kṣetraṃ kaṇisasyānvitaṃ gauḥ prasavonmukhī |
yathā yajño dakṣiṇāntastathā te sādhavo mama ||82||
yathā vṛkṣāḥ phalāḍhyāśca puṣpāḍhyā vallayo yathā |
camatkārī yathā tyāgī tathā te sādhavo mama ||83||
yathā ratnamayī pṛthvī māyā guṇamayī yathā |
ātmā cāśatrayāḍhyaśca tathā te sādhavo mama ||84||
yathāhaṃ sarvasāmarthyo yathā lakṣmīrhi sampadaḥ |
yathā kṛṣṇātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tathā te sādhavo mama ||85||
yathā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ yathā daṇḍo yamasya ca |
yathā prasannatā viṣṇostathā te sādhavo mama ||86||
yathā śaṃbhukṛtā bhaktiryathā sevā satīkṛtā |
yathā snehaḥ kāmakṛtastathā te sādhavo mama ||87||
yathā kṣamā sādhuniṣṭhā yathā bhaktagataṃ vacaḥ |
dāsyaṃ sādhvīgataṃ yadvat tathā te sādhavo matāḥ ||88||
vrataṃ patnīgataṃ yadvat tṛptirnistṛṣṇagā yathā |
gaṃgāmbhaḥ pāvanaṃ yadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||89||
yathā vaṃśaḥ putragato dānaṃ kanyāgataṃ yathā |
pūjā gaṇeśagā yadvat tathā te sādhavo mama ||3.83.90||
yathāhaṃ sādhurevāsmi sādhvī tvaṃ ca virājase |
yathā yogaścāvayorvai tathā te sādhavo mama ||9 1||
kimvadhikaṃ vedayāmi praśaṃsā nātralabhyate |
bhagavantaḥ sādhavo me bhakto’haṃ sarvathā satām |||92|||
anarpya mama sadbhyo yo bhuṃkte svodarasaṃbharaḥ |
jāyate sa kṛśe deśe kṛśo vai brahmarākṣasaḥ ||93||
sādhūcitaṃ pūjanaṃ cākṛtvā yo modate gṛhe |
svagarvāt so’pi dehānte jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ ||94||
dhanaiśvaryayutaścāpi sevate na sato janān |
nindati cāvajānāti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||95||
guṇābhimānasandṛbdho prājñān paśyati vai sataḥ |
daridrām̐ścāvajānāti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||96||
ajeyānapi sādhūm̐śca tiraskārān karoti yaḥ |
mithyādoṣān prāhiṇoti sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ ||97||
ajātaśatrūn sādhūn yaḥ kleśe yojayatīśvaraḥ |
sampanno’pi mṛtaḥ paścājjāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ ||98||
vidvānapi sataḥ śāntānavamatya jugupsati |
hīyamāno’pi durvṛttaiḥ sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ || 99||
yastu mitramukhaḥ śatrurbhavati śvāsaghātakaḥ |
anāryaścāryavidveṣṭā jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 3.83.100 ||
ayatsu vartamānaśca sato bhāvaṃ viḍambate |
praśaṃsati duṣṭabhāvān jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 101 ||
mahadguṇaistu yo hīno mahat prārthayate’khilam |
sato’vamantā tadyoge jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 1 02||
tapasvinaṃ kṣamāyuktaṃ guruṃ vijñāninaṃ prabhum |
prasahya cāvamantā yo jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ || 103 ||
sādhūn vanecarān vīkṣya nottiṣṭhate purastu yaḥ |
nātmahitaṃ cared yastu jīvan vai rākṣaso hi saḥ || 1 04||
rākṣaso’pi harerbhaktān sādhūnnatvā prasevate |
prasādayati sevābhiścāśīrvādān suvindati || 1 05||
sadguṇān sukhadān lakṣmi yo gṛhṇāti sato janāt |
sa eva jāyate loke sādhurvai sādhuvartanaḥ || 106 ||
na janma nāpi yatnaśca na veṣaḥ sādhutārjakaḥ |
sādhusatsaṃgasevādi kāraṇaṃ sādhutāgrahe || 1 07||
ta eva tārakā lakṣmi darśanāt sparśanādapi |
sevanāt paricaraṇāt taranti dehino bhavāt || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhutve vividhaprayojakakāraṇādi sādhustavanāstavanaphalādi cetikathananāmā tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||

<3.84>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kṛpāsindho jīvabandho cātmaprāṇapate vibho |
karmakṣetre naranārīdehe prāpte śubhāvahe || 1 ||
śreyo’rthinā daridreṇa bhāgyahīnena sarvathā |
yatra naiva tu sādhūnāṃ labhyate’pi samāgamaḥ || 2 ||
tatra kṛtvā vidhiṃ kiṃ ca prāpyeta mokṣaṇaṃ nijam |
ātmakalyāṇavāñcchāvān kalyāṇaṃ labhate katham || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pṛcchasi śobhanam |
karmakṣetramidaṃ cāste labdhvā mānuṣamuttamam || 4 ||
mātuḥ sevāṃ prakurvīta gṛhatīrthasya sarvathā |
yathā yathā nijā mātā prasannā syāttathā tathā || 5 ||
sevayitvā cārjayedvai tadāśiṣaḥ supuṇyadāḥ |
dāridryanāśikāścāpi śreyasāṃ sampradāḥ śubhāḥ || 6 ||
mātuśca sevayā bhāgyaṃ bhāgyahīnasya vardhate |
mātā nārāyaṇī brāhmī śreyaḥ karoti cāśiṣā || 7 ||
evaṃ pituḥ śubhā sevā kartavyā tīrtharūpiṇaḥ |
tadāśīrvādalābhena śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ hi labhyate || 8 ||
bhāgyaṃ bhavedviśālaṃ ca sampannaṃ śreyasā bhṛtam |
athaivaṃ sevayā bhāgyodayena syāt satī matiḥ || 9 ||
śāstrārthacintane yogyā tato jñānaṃ samarjayet |
