jñānottaraṃ vivekaśca tato dhyeyaṃ hariṃ tu mām || 2.84.10 ||
dhyāyīta bhaktiṃ kurvīta mamaiva sarvadā śubhām |
bahudhā yatra nairmalyaṃ sthairyaṃ ca manaso bhavet || 11 ||
nāmajapaṃ prakurvīta hare kṛṣṇa narāyaṇa |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama || 12 ||
evaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ kurvan kārayan bhajanaṃ param |
sakhāyaṃ saṃvidadhīta sakhīn bhaktān vivardhayet| || 13 ||
satsaṃgamaṇḍalaṃ paścāt sthāpayet saṃbhajeta mām |
kīrtanaṃ me sadā kuryāt sāyaṃ caikatra maṇḍalam || 14||
harerbhaktā maṇḍale ye te bodhyāḥ sādhavastadā |
śāstraśravaṇalābhena vṛddhavākyena vā sadā || 1 5||
sādhuguṇān sakhīn prāptvā satsaṃgaṃ vardhayet tataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā viśālaṃ vai vidadhīta svamaṇḍalam || 16 ||
mahāpuṇyapratāpena khalu satsaṃgamaṇḍalāt |
mumukṣutā bhavecchreṣṭhā tato bhaktyā subhāvayā || 17||
bhajitvā mātmakalyāṇaṃ prakurvīta sa bhaktarāṭ |
evaṃ lakṣmi balaṃ naijaṃ sabījaṃ vardhayet sadā || 18||
satsaṃgapoṣakaṃ yena bhuktirmuktirbhavettataḥ |
nāmakīrtanatulyaṃ vai sulabhaṃ sādhanaṃ nahi || 1 9||
alabdhasādhusaṃgasya nāmakīrtanamuttamam |
sādhvī jihvā nijā bodhyā tatsamāgamamācaret || 2.84.20 ||
sādhvī matirnijābodhyā tayā manvīta mādhavam |
manaḥ sādhu nijaṃ bodhyaṃ tena manvīta māṃ sadā ||21 ||
devaḥ sādhuritikṛtvā tena seveta keśavam |
evaṃ saṃgatimāsādya māṃ bhajeta sanātanam || 22 ||
ācāryā vā guravaśca koṭikalyāṇakāriṇaḥ |
evamātmabalenaiva terurbhavārṇavāt svayam || 23 ||
tārayāmāsuranyām̐śca śrīhareḥ kṛpayā tviha |
yatamānaṃ nijaṃ bhaktaṃ sāhāyyavarjitaṃ hariḥ ||24||
svayaṃ tatrāvatīryaiva coṣitvā hṛdaye’pi ca |
bhaktamaṇḍalamadhye vā coṣitvā śreya arpayet || 25||
nahi kīrtanakṛt kaścidaniṣṭaṃ vindati priye |
sa eva tatra sādhurvai kīrtanena prajāyate ||26||
ayi lakṣmi śvapaco’pi gṛhe saṃkīrtayam̐śca mām |
sudūro’pi sādhumanāḥ sādhusnigdho hi sādhuvat || 27||
carmakāro’pi śīlāḍhyo mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāṃ svakarmakṛt ||28||
mleccho’pi śīlayuktaścenmama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāmahiṃsakaḥ ||29 ||
ghātakī vyādha evāpi śīlavratastyajan hatim |
sādhusnigdhaḥ sādhureva kīrtayanmāmahiṃsakaḥ ||2.84.30||
dhvajī cakrī ca vā sādhuḥ sādhusnehaparāyaṇaḥ |
śīlavrato’hiṃsakaśca kīrtayanmāmaharniśam ||3 1 ||
gaṇikā ca vyavāyī ca sādhusnehaparāyaṇau |
sādhūśīlavratau kīrtayantau māṃ kāmavarjitau ||32||
dhīvaraścāpi matsyādaḥ śīlavrato’pyahiṃsakaḥ |
sādhusnehaparaḥ sādhuḥ kīrtayanmāṃ pareśvaram ||33||
jallādo hārakaḥ stenaḥ sādhusnehaparāyaṇāḥ |
śīlavratāḥ karmaśūnyāḥ sādhavaśced raṭanti mām ||34||
bhujiṣyā vṛndalo vāpi sādhū śīlaparau yadā |
sādhusnigdhau kīrtayantau māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam ||35||
bhāṇḍā naṭā nartakāśca kuśīlavāśca sādhavaḥ |
śīlavratāḥ sādhusnigdhāḥ kīrtayantaśca māṃ harim ||36||
bahurūpā narmakārāḥ śavahārāśca sādhavaḥ |
śīlavratāḥ sāghusnigdhāḥ kīrtayantaśca māṃ harim ||37||
sarvādā gaṇikeśāśca godhādāḥ sarpabhojanāḥ |
sādhavaḥ śīlavratinaḥ sādhusnigdhā raṭanti mām ||38||
jālagrāhāḥ piśitādāḥ santyajya krūravartanām |
sādhavaḥ śīlavratinaḥ sādhusnigdhā raṭanti mām || 39||
agnidā garadāḥ śūlapradāḥ pāśapradā api |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||2.84.40||
śastrajīvī cikitsākṛcchavāṃgibhedino yadi |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||41 ||
bhārṣṭrabhaṭṭhīkarāścāpi vanāraṇāvighātinaḥ |
śīlaparāḥ sādhusnigdhāḥ sādhavo hi raṭanti mām |||42|||
unmattaśca vicittaśca śaṭhaḥ svārthī hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhusnigdhāḥ śīlaparā māṃ raṭanti vidurguṇāḥ ||43||
āsurā rākṣasā daityā dānavāḥ pāpino’pi ca |
sādhusnigdhāḥ śīlavantaḥ sādhavo māṃ raṭantyapi ||44||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācādyā raṭanto māṃ hi sādhavaḥ |
śīlaparāḥ sādhuvratāḥ sādhusnigdhāstathā mayi ||45||
mādhukaghnā matsyahārāḥ śakunighnā hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhāḥ karmaśūnyā raṭanti mām ||46||
paśuvāhāḥ pañjariṇo viśvāsaghātakāśca te |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||47||
tiryagvṛttaya ātmastrīraktavikrayiṇo’pi tu |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||48||
yantriṇāścakriṇaścāpi śastriṇaḥ sādhavo hi te |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlāḥ sādhusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||49||
rājabhaṭādhipā nyāyādhipā nṛpā hi sādhavaḥ |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||2.84.50||
muṣkacchedakarā daṃṣṭrāhārāśca liṅgakṛttinaḥ |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sāghusnigdhā hi sāttvikāḥ ||51||
akarmāṇo vikarmāṇo nṛśaṃsā api sādhavaḥ |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sādhusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||52||
daurhṛdanāśakā dhātubhojinaḥ śaucavarjitāḥ |
raṭanto māṃ sādhuśīlā sāghusnigdhā hi sādhavaḥ ||53||
yeṣāṃ vai pañcakaṃ siddhaṃ sādhavaste sadā matāḥ |
niṣkāmatā hyalobhitvaṃ nirmānitvaṃ niḥsvāditā ||54||
niḥsnehitā ca sarvatra santastatpañcavṛttayaḥ |
kāmavāsanāhīnatvaṃ niṣkāmitā yathāyatham ||55||
āvaśyakātiriktecchāhīnatvaṃ lobhavarjitā |
agarvaḥ sarvathā nirmānitvaṃ stabdhatvavarjitā ||56||
prāṇayātrārthabhojyāptirniḥsvāditvaṃ hi tat smṛtam |
evaṃ śīlaparāḥ sādhurbhaktimārgaparāyaṇaḥ ||57||
tarati tārayatyanyān mahābhāgavato hi saḥ |
yeṣāṃ vā pañcakaṃ cānyanmumukṣutvaṃ kathāśrutiḥ ||58||
bhaktasādhoḥ saṃgatiśca sevābhaktipravartanam |
ātmanivedanaṃ ceti pañcavatsādhavo matāḥ ||59||
yeṣāṃ vā pañcakaṃ cānyat prātaḥsnānaprapūjanam |
madhyāhne haraye bhojyanivedanaṃ sadānvaham ||2.84.60||
upārjanasya viṃśāṃśo’rpaṇīyo haraye tathā |
mālikāvartanaṃ nityaṃ cānte tvātmanivedanam ||61||
ta ete sādhavaḥ syuśca gṛhe vane ca nirjane |
samāje vāpi jīvānāṃ tārakāste bhavanti vai ||62||
duṣṭaguṇān vihāyaiva sadguṇānarjayettu yaḥ |
sādhuratra bhavet so’pi bhajate ceddhariṃ sadā ||63||
māyā pāpaṃ pāpavanto jīvā māyāvinaḥ khalu |
māyādurguṇamutsṛtya sadguṇān prāpya madratāḥ ||64||
dharmavaśāśrayā loke sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ |
saṃsāriṇastu ye jīvāḥ sarve durguṇasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||65||
paścātprāpya satāṃ śreṣṭhaguṇān bhavanti sādhavaḥ |
māyāmalena hīnāste santo bhavanti nirmalāḥ ||66||
dīyamānāni ratnāni kambalānyambarāṇi ca |
sampadaḥ sukhabhogyāśca nāvekṣate hṛdāpi yaḥ ||67||
bhogyabhoktṛtvavṛttiśca yasya nāvartate muhuḥ |
sādhuvṛttiḥ sa vijñeyastāpaso doṣatāpanaḥ ||68||
jaihvayaṃ śaiśnyaṃ jitaṃ yena jitaṃ sarvaṃ mahātmanā |
aśrāvyo badhiro yaścāpyaprekṣye netravarjitaḥ ||69||
aspṛśye tvagvihīnaścāpyaghreye ghrāṇavarjitaḥ |
akathye jihvayā hīnaścābhakṣye rasanākṣayaḥ ||2.84.70||
agrāhye hastaśūnyaścāpyagamye pādavarjitaḥ |
atyājye pāyuśūnyaścāpyayogye kāmavarjitaḥ ||71 ||
aliṅgye liṅgaśūnyaśca sarvathā matparāyaṇaḥ |
videhaḥ sādhurevāyaṃ parasyāpi gatipradaḥ ||72||
āsyabhūrmṛgavadyasya śayyā cājagarī yathā |
nidrā ca jalavad yasya kalpanā vyomapuṣpavat ||73||
dehaśchāyāsamo yasya vastujātaṃ tu svapnavat |
smṛddhayo bhasmavad yasya samutsavaḥ śmaśānavat ||74||
astitvaṃ nāstitātulyaṃ sādhuḥ so’yaṃ saduttamaḥ |
yasya sarvaṃ mayi cāste mattulyaḥ sādhureva saḥ ||75||
yathākāśagataṃ cāmbhaṃ vidyudvegāt pravarṣati |
tathā sādhoḥ prasaṃgācca bhaktaḥ snehena varṣati ||76||
yathā meghā vilīyante vāyuvegena cāmbare |
tathā sādhoḥ prasaṃgena līyante pāpakoṭayaḥ ||77||
yathā vai jāgrataḥ svāpnaṃ līyate tatkṣaṇaṃ tathā |
sādhoryogena līyante kaṣāyāstatkṣaṇaṃ rame ||78||
yathā tamovināśo vai sūryabhābhiḥ prajāyate |
tathā sādhoścamatkārairlīyante kalmaṣāṇi vai ||79||
yathā putraprasavena līyante śokakoṭayaḥ |
tathā sādhuprasaṃgena līyante śokakoṭayaḥ ||2.84.80||
yathā lagnaprasaṃge ānandā bhavanti sotsavāḥ |
tathā sādhuprasaṃgena mokṣānandotsavodbhavāḥ ||8 1||
yathā māturdarśanena sukhaṃ bālasya jāyate |
tathā sādhordarśanena sukhaṃ bhaktasya jāyate ||82||
yathā miṣṭānnalābhena modante bālabālikāḥ |
tathā vai sādhulābhena modante bhaktakoṭayaḥ ||83||
yathā varṣartumāsādya kekā vadanti kekinaḥ |
tathā sādhvartumāsādya kīrtayanti harerjanāḥ ||84||
yathaikaputranāśena vṛddhapitrorvidehatā |
tathā satāṃ viyoge tu bhaktānāṃ syād videhatā ||85||
yathā vandhyā putralābhe harṣonmattā prajāyate |
tathā sādhorgṛhe lābhe harṣonmattā mamāśritāḥ ||86||
yathā sugandhasārādyaiḥ praphullaṃ mānasaṃ tathā |
śrīkṛṣṇasādhudharmādyairbhaktamanaḥ praphullati ||87||
yathātīṣṭasya lābhena sarvānandā bhavanti vai |
tathā sādhorāgamane sarvānandā bhavanti hi ||88||
yathā nāṭyagataṃ pātraṃ raṅgaṃ prasannayatyati |
tathā sādhoḥ sevakaśca sādhūn prasannayatyati ||89||
yathā sādhvī hariṃ kāntaṃ sadā prasevate sukhā |
tathā bhakto hariṃ sādhuṃ sevate ca mudā sukhaḥ ||2.84.90||
yathā vyādhasya putrādau snehaḥ sadā prapoṣaṇe |
tathā bhaktasya sādhvādau snehaḥ sadā pramokṣaṇe ||9 1||
yathā gaurvatsamāsādya dadāti dhārayā payaḥ |
bhaktaḥ sādhūn samāsādya sarvasvaṃ pradadāti ha ||92||
yathā vṛkṣā jalaṃ pītvā praphullitā navāṅkurāḥ |
tathā bhaktāḥ sataḥ prāpya bahvārpaṇanavāṃkurāḥ ||93||
yathā nadyaḥ pūravṛddhyā hyunmattā āptumapnidhim |
tathā bhaktā bhaktivṛddhyā hyunmattā āptumīśvaram||94||
yathā ca nāpito rājasevā prāpya pramodate |
tathā bhaktaḥ sādhusevāṃ prāpya sadā pramodate ||95||
yathā yuvā ca yuvatīṃ prāpyaiti tattadātmatām |
tathā bhakto hariṃ sādhuṃ prāpyaiti tattadātmatām ||96||
yathā rājājñayā bhṛtyā vartante namramārgiṇaḥ |
tathā sādhvājñayā bhaktā vartante dharmamārgiṇaḥ ||97||
yathā dīpo rātriyoge prakāśate svayamprabhaḥ |
tathā bhaktaḥ sādhuyoge prakāśate hariprabhaḥ ||98||
yathā pakvaṃ phalaṃ vṛkṣaṃ jahātyeva hi kālataḥ |
tathā pakvaphalo bhakto jahātyeva tu māyikam ||99||
yathā patnī dharmaśīlānusaratyeva satpatim |
tathā sādhvīṃ ca vā sādhumanuvrajati bhaktarāṭ || 2.84.10 0||
nārāyaṇanivāsena yathā nārāyaṇāyate |
tathā sādhutvavāsena vyaktirvai sādhavāyate || 10 1||
yadvadbhaktinivāsena bhakto bhavati mānavaḥ |
lakṣmi sādhutvavāsena sādhurbhavati mānavaḥ || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusamāgamarahitasyāpimokṣopāyāḥ sādhulābhaḥ sādhutvalābhastadvividhatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||

<3.85>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sādhudharmaṃ sanātanam |
dhāryante yena lokāḥ saḥ satāṃ dharmo hariḥ svayam || 1 ||
harerlīlācaritrāṇi smartavyāni sadā mama |
sādhudharmaḥ sadā kṛṣṇo rakṣaṇīyo nije hṛdi || 2 ||
mahāyaśaphalaṃ cāpi sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā |
gavāṃ phalaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ vratānāṃ phalamityapi || 3 ||
etatphalamavāpnoti yo janaḥ sādhudharmavān |
mokṣakāryaṃ sadā sādhornārāyaṇasamāśrayāt || 4 ||
bandhahānistathā kāryaṃ sādhoreva prakīrtitam |
vaktāro bhaktikartāro yeṣāṃ śuddhaṃ ca mānasam || 5 ||
teṣāṃ vyaktaṃ jitā lokāḥ sādhūnā sādhusaṃginā |
mucyate kilbiṣāccāpi na sa pāpena lipyate || 6 ||
dharmaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ sādhusaṃgī śarīravān |
mokṣaṃ tataśca labhate sādhorhareḥ kṛpākaṇāt || 7 ||
mānavāstu sadā lakṣmi bāliśā iva mohanaḥ |
sādhūnnindanti madrūpān yānti te narakān bahūn || 8 ||
krūrāśca mānavā loke dayāhīnāśca ghātakāḥ |
sādhūnnirarthakānmatvā tyajanti bhārarūpiṇaḥ || 9 ||
teṣāṃ gatirna vai syāddhi satī kvāpyathasañcayāt |
asādhunindakāḥ krūrāstāmasādisvavartanaiḥ || 3.85.10 ||
tiryagyonigatān satvān jīvān hiṃsanti mohitāḥ |
kīṭān pipīlikān sarpān vṛścikān paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 11 ||
api cet te śaraṇaṃ vai satāṃ yāntyaghanuttaye |
praseveyuḥ sataścedvai dehena manasā yadi || 12||
tadā pāpaiḥ pramucyante na ceddhiṃsanti vai punaḥ |
satāṃ prasevayā puṇyaṃ jāyate balavattaram || 1 3||
puṇyena śubhasaṃkalpāḥ śanaiścāpi śubhakriyāḥ |
asatkriyāṇāṃ santyāgaḥ satsaṃgātipravīṇatā || 14||
paścāttāpaḥ svakṛtyānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ tapaḥ param |
upavāsādikaṃ bhaktiryajanaṃ dānamarpaṇam || 15 ||
pūjanaṃ devatādīnāṃ japadhyānasukīrtanam |
tīrthayātrā jñānalābhastvevaṃ bhavanti dharmiṇaḥ || 16||
tataḥ svargagatiḥ paścānmokṣagatiḥ prasaṃbhavet |
etat sarvaṃ satāṃ yoge tūrṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate || 17||
santo nārāyaṇāḥ sarve pāpaghnā mokṣadāyinaḥ |
teṣu sadā virāje’haṃ śāśvataḥ puruṣo hariḥ || 18||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
śrīvatsāṃko hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarveśvarādipūjitaḥ || 19||
sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃśliṣṭaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ |
paramātmā hṛdayasthaḥ sarvavyāpī sanātanaḥ || 3.85.20||
nāyakaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmajuṣāmapi |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīgarbhaḥ śrīsahoṣitaḥ ||21||
śārṅgacakrādicihnaśca damaśīlaśamānvitaḥ |
parakrameṇa vīryeṇottamena darśanena ca ||22||
utsāhena pramāṇena dhairyeṇārjavasampadā |
kṛpayā snehabhaktyā ca nijān prati samanvitaḥ ||23||
yogamāyaḥ samastākṣo brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyakaḥ |
bhayahartā bhayārtānāṃ dīnānāṃ pālane rataḥ || 24||
śrutavānarthasampūrṇo varadaśca varārthinām |
parameśo rameśaśca meśo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ||25||
sarvāḥ sukhaṃ saṃśritāśca śarīre mama devatāḥ |
so’haṃ pareśvaraḥ sākṣācchrībhūlīlāramāpatiḥ ||26||
yo hi māṃ draṣṭumicchedvai cāvatārāvatāriṇam |
draṣṭavyāstena me santaḥ sādhvarthāḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||27||
dṛṣṭeṣveteṣvahaṃ dṛṣṭo na me bhedo’tra vidyate |
santo nārāyaṇāḥ sarve iti viddhi mama priye ||28||
so’haṃ śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣo yasya prīto bhavāmi ca |
tasya devagaṇaḥ prītaḥ sarvārthāstasya hastagāḥ || 29||
yaśca māṃ mānave loke saṃśrayiṣyati mānavaḥ |
tasya kīrtirjayaścaiva svargaścātra bhaviṣyati ||3.85.3 0||
dharmāṇāṃ deśikaḥ pūjyaḥ sa bhaviṣyati dharmabhāk |
sādhureva sa mantavyo namaskāryaḥ sadā janaiḥ ||3 1 ||
dharma eva paraḥ sa syād yasminnabhyarhito’smyaham |
so’haṃ prajāhitārthaṃ vai sādhukoṭīrasarjayat ||32||
brahmāyanādīn sarvāṃśca saccidānandaprabhṛtān |
sanatkumāramadhyām̐śca pūrvān pūrvatarānapi ||33 ||
so’haṃ sādhusvarūpo’smi harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
bhagavān sarvarūpāṇāṃ dhartā karttā vināśitā ||34||
vandito’haṃ ca vande taṃ mānito mānayāmyapi |
arhitaścārhayāmyenaṃ pūjitaḥ pūjayāmi tam ||35||
dṛṣṭaḥ paśyāmyajasraṃ taṃ saṃśritaḥ saṃśrayāmi tam |
evaṃ me dhyānakartuśca dhyātāhaṃ satataṃ priye ||36||
evaṃ me’sti vrataṃ nityaṃ tādṛśāḥ sādhavo mama |
sajjanācaritaṃ tvetad vrataṃ me nāparairiha ||37||
tasmāt santo mama rūpāstārakā dehināmiha |
karmaṇā manasā vācā sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||38||
sādhūn dṛṣṭvā mamāpyeva darśanaṃ jātameva hi |
samastāśca surā nityaṃ sādhudehe vasanti vai ||39||
sureśvarastathā viṣṇuścāhaṃ sādhau vasāmi ca |
sarvārāmaḥ surāmo’haṃ rameśaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3.85.40||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre nivasāmi tvayā saha |
brahmapriyābhiḥ sahito haripriyānusevitaḥ ||41||
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ ratiḥ ramā |
bhuktirmuktiḥ śrīrlīlā ca yatra tatrāhameva ca ||42||
mama sādhuṣu vartante sadā kīrtyādayaḥ priye |
nivasāmi sadā teṣu madrūpāḥ sādhavastataḥ ||43||
prabhāvaṃ sādhupūgasya yaśca jānāti sarvathā |
sa tu sārdhaṃ samāśritya prāpya māṃ yāti matpadam ||44||
bhavantyeva ca tasyaiva sarve kāmā yathepsitāḥ |
ye vā nāma raṭantyatra mama lakṣmi samāhitāḥ ||45||
teṣāṃ kīrtanabhaktānāṃ saṃsiddhyanti manorathāḥ |
pūjyāḥ kīrtanabhaktā me tānnamasyāmi cāpyaham ||46||
sārdhaṃ muktaṃ satīṃ sādhvīṃ brahmapriyāṃ haripriyām |
santaṃ cāśvapaṭṭabhūmiṃ ye namanti namāmi tān ||47||
lakṣmīṃ rādhāṃ ramāṃ śrīṃ ca māṇikyāṃ sukhadāṃśriyam |
ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ye namanti namāmi tān ||48||
avatārām̐śca me vyūhān bhaktāṃśca pārṣadānapi |
mūrtīrme ye namasyanti tannamasyāmyahaṃ sadā || 49||
varuṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyuṃ vahniṃ candraṃ balāhakam |
śivaṃ viṣṇumajaṃ devān ye namasyanti tānname ||3.85.50||
durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ bhūmiṃ śāradāṃ virajāṃ tathā |
maṃgalāmamṛtāṃ ye ca namasyanti namāmi tān ||5 1 ||
bṛhaspatiṃ nāradaṃ ca sanatkumāramacyutam |
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ye ca namasyanti namāmi tān ||52||
tapodhanān maharṣīṃśca bhaktidhanān sato janān |
vidyādhanām̐śca viduṣo ye namanti namāmi tān ||53||
abhuktvā daivakarmāṇi kurvate ye prabhupriyāḥ |
santuṣṭāḥ kṣamiṇaḥ santastān namāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||54||
yajñe yajanti ye ceṣṭīrjitendriyāḥ suśāntayaḥ |
prātarbhajanti sāyaṃ ye tānnamāmi suhṛtpriyān ||55||
dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ ca pitarau gāśca guruṃ namāmyaham |
ye vai saṃyaminaḥ śāntā vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ ||56||
asaṃcayāḥ sādhavastān namāmi satataṃ priye |
bhṛtyapoṣā atithīnāmāśrayā vighasāśinaḥ ||57||
satyavāco brahmacārāstānnamāmi sadā sataḥ |
prasannahṛdayāḥ sarvasattveṣu madvivekinaḥ ||58||
svādhyāyadhyānaniratāstānnamāmi sato janān |
guruprasāde madbhaktau yatnavantaḥ sthiravratāḥ ||59||
śuśrūṣavo’nasūyantastānnamasyāmi sajjanān |
suvratā sunayo bhaktā brahmiṣṭhā brahmadāyinaḥ ||3.85.60||
voḍhāro me prasādasya tānnamāmi sadā sataḥ |
bhaikṣacaryāsu niratā dīnā gurukulāśrayāḥ ||61||
nirghṛṇāścācyutadhanā nirmamā gatavāsanāḥ |
brahmavaktāra aiśā ye tānnamāmi sato janān ||62||
ahiṃsāniratāḥ satyavratā dāntā vitṛṣṇakāḥ |
kapotavṛttikā gṛhyāstānnamāmi sato janān ||63||
caturvargasthitāḥ śāntā api niṣkāmayoginaḥ |
śiṣṭācārapravṛttāśca namāmyetān rame sadā ||64||
brāhmaṇā brahmatanavo bhaktiparāḥ supuṇyinaḥ |
sudhābhakṣā vratayuktāstānnamāmi sadāśritān ||65||
ayonīnagniyonīm̐śca brahmayonīn sadudbhavān |
acyutagotrān śrīgotrānnamāmi satataṃ sataḥ ||66||
akṣaraṃ cāpi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam |
avyākṛtapadaṃ ye ca gantumicchava aiśvaram ||67||
vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma vā sādhvāśramān jigamiṣūm̐stathā |
namasyāmi satastān vai sarvānahaṃ hi padmaje ||68||
lokajyeṣṭhān kulajyeṣṭhān tamoghnān lokabhāskarān |
kṛṣṇadhāmapradān sādhūnnamāni bhavapāradān ||69||
pūjārhān hitadhātṛm̐śca sukhadān poṣakāmapi |
rakṣakān kālamāyādernamāmi sajjanān sataḥ ||3.85.70||
atrāmuṣmin sukhadāste harerbhaktā hi sādhavaḥ |
ye sarvātithayo nityaṃ tānnamāmi sadā rame ||71 ||
etādṛśeṣu bhakteṣu sādhuṣu brahmayogiṣu |
anusṛtāścābhiratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ||72||
teṣu śāntiparāsteṣāṃ praśaṃsakāśca sevakāḥ |
anasūyakā bhaktāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ||73||
sarvān sato namaskurvan devān vṛddhān śubhāvahān |
śraddhāvān bhaktimām̐ścāpi durgāṇyatitaratyapi ||74||
tapasvinaḥ sādhavo vai kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ |
bhaktyā prabhāvitātmānastārayantyaghino janān ||75||
mātrāpitrorgurujane bhaktyā vasanti ye janāḥ |
sadāśīrvādanetāro durgāṇyatitaranti te ||76||
yathā tvaṃ vartase lakṣmi vartante sādhavo yathā |
brahmapriyāśca vartante vartante ca haripriyāḥ ||77||
yathā kuṃkumavāpīsthā vartante ca narāḥ striyaḥ |
sarve muktā brahmavāsāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo hi me matāḥ ||78||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu narṣayastādṛśāstathā |
pitaro munayo naiva na surā mānavāstathā ||79||
nānye viprā yathā caite pāvanā matsvarūpiṇaḥ |
kṣetraṃ kukumavāpīyaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma me’sti yat ||3.85.80||
tatrasthāḥ sarvamuktāśca muktānyaḥ śaktayo mama |
sarvā brahmapriyā nāryaḥ sarve muktā narāstviha ||81||
pādapāścāṇḍajā jarāyūjāścānye’pi jantavaḥ |
svedajā vāpi sarve cākṣarakṣetre vasanti ye ||82||
divyā muktā hi te sarve sarvapūjyā bhavanti te |
ta eva sādhavaḥ sarve muktidā vāsamātrataḥ ||83||
kalpadrumasya cāṃgāni sarvāṇi pāvanāni vai |
tathā cākṣarabhūmeśca vāsinaḥ pāvanā hi me ||84||
sādhavaste śaraṇyā vai śaraṇāgatarakṣiṇaḥ |
yathāhaṃ ca tathā te vai dayāpūrṇā vimuktidāḥ ||85||
sarvasvaṃ cāpi dattvaiva rakṣanti śaraṇāgatān |
śṛṇu lakṣmi samākhyānaṃ sādhorvṛṣāyanasya ha ||86||
vṛṣāyano hi sādhurme dīkṣāṃ prāpya vane vasan |
bhajate māṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ||87||
videha iva rājan vai tejasā bhāskaro yathā |
dayayā cābhayadātā jīvānāṃ śreyasi sthitaḥ ||88||
vyāghrāraṇye nimbataroradhovāso virājate |
tatraikadā tu śyenena pātyamānā bhayāturā ||89||
caṭakā śaraṇaṃ prāptā vṛṣāyanākhyayoginam |
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirādhārāṃ trāsādaṃkamupāgatām ||3.85.90||
āśvāsyāha bhayaṃ mā te caṭake’stviha me’ntike |
ityuktvā caṭakā hastatale dhṛtvā tadāsane ||9 1||
agre tāṃ rakṣayāmāsa tāvacchyena uvāca tam |
ṛṣe sādho mama bhakṣyaṃ caṭakeyaṃ pradīyatām ||92||
prayatnānmahato labdhā tyajaināṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ mama |
asyā māṃsaṃ tu me cādya paryāptaṃ syātpratoṣaṇam ||93 ||
kṣudhā me bādhate sādho bhojyaṃ me dīyatāṃ drutam |
mayā hyanusṛtā tveṣā mamaiva bhakṣyarūpiṇī ||94||
sādhunā nātra vayasoḥ sthātavyaṃ madhyapātinā |
audāsīnyasthiteste’tra ko lābho dveṣarāgayoḥ ||95||
samavṛttirbhavet sādhuḥ pakṣapāto na te vṛṣaḥ |
kṣudhito’haṃ cāti sādho’nyathā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ||96||
dayālo tvaṃ dehi bhakṣyaṃ caṭakāṃ mannipātitām |
caṭakāyā rakṣaṇe te me hatyāpāpamāpatet ||97||
mama jīvanadāne tu caṭakādhvaṃsapātakam |
te bhavediti cātrārthe bhavaudāsīnavṛttimān ||98||
ityākarṇya kṣaṇaṃ vṛṣāyanaścintāmavāpa ha |
dvayoścābhayadānaṃ ca vicāryetthamuvāca tam ||99||
vada śyena nijārthaṃ vai yathā te kṣunnivartanam |
bhavedeva tathā kurve muñcāmi caṭakā nahi || 3.85.1 00||
śaraṇaṃ sā jīvanārthaṃ tvāgatā māṃ prarakṣiṇam |
na muñcati mamāṃgāni paśya rakṣārthinīṃ tvimām || 10 1||
tatrāpi vidyate nārī na hantavyā kadācana |
garbhiṇī vidyate cāpi na hantavyā tvayā dvija || 1 02||
phalaṃ mūlaṃ cānnamiṣṭaṃ bhikṣāgataṃ dadāmi te |
ānayāmi tvadarthaṃ vai miṣṭānnaṃ tatprabhakṣaya || 1 03||
śyenaḥ prāha na me kāryaṃ phalamūlairna bhikṣayā |
yastu devena vihito bhakṣyo me caṭakātmakaḥ || 1 04||
māṃsaṃ bhakṣyaṃ śyenajāteḥ rītistveṣā purātanī |
yadi sādho caṭakāyā snehaste pakṣapātavat || 1 05||
tatastvaṃ me prayacchādya svamāṃsaṃ caṭakāmitam |
tulayā tolitaṃ me syātparyāptaṃ nādhikaṃ khalu || 1 06||
vṛṣāyanaḥ prasanno’bhūcchrutvā tūrṇaṃ tamāha ca |
mahānanugrahaścāyaṃ khaga tvayā mayi kṛtaḥ || 1 07||
tataḥ kṛtvā parṇapuṭyau tulāṃ kṛtvā yathocitām |
utkṛtyotkṛtya māṃsaṃ svaṃ śyenārthaṃ samatolayat || 1 08||
caṭakābhāramāṃsaṃ svaṃ dadau śyenāya bāhujam |
śyeno labdhvā prabhuktvā ca pītvā jala vanaṃ yayau || 1 09||
caṭakā rakṣitā jātā prasannābhūt sunirbhayā |
śanaiḥ sā tu ṛṣiṃ natvā pārśve vane yayau tataḥ || 3.85.11 0||
sandhinīṃ pūraṇīṃ śreṣṭhāmoṣadhiṃ prāpya cāyayau |
sādhorhaste dadau patrarasaṃ bāhuḥ prapūritaḥ || 11 1||
yathāpūrvamabhavacca nīruk sāpi tataḥ param |
sevāyāṃ sarvadā sādhoḥ pārśve’vasat supakṣiṇī || 11 2||
phalapatrāṇi cādāya sādhave’rpaṇameva ha |
karoti cātha kālena suṣuve’ṇḍāni pañca ca || 1 13||
sevāphalena te sarve bālā bhūtādivedinaḥ |
trikāladarśinaḥ sarve jātāḥ śvetasvarūpiṇaḥ || 1 14||
dīpotsavīghoṭakākhyā maharṣiṇā hi te kṛtāḥ |
śakunajñāḥ śakuntāste pūjyante daivavedibhiḥ || 1 15||
caṭakā sā tataḥ kāle vārdhakye mṛtyumāgatā |
vimānena yayau svargaṃ jātāpsarovarā śubhā || 1 16||
nāmnā cālambuṣā tvindrasevikā ca tataḥ param |
muktiṃ prāptā brahmaloke sādhoḥ sevāphalena vai || 1 17||
evaṃ paropakārārthadattasarvasvasādhavaḥ |
rakṣanti cāpi mokṣaṃ ca preṣayanti ca dehinaḥ ||1 18||
bhaktānāṃ rakṣitā cānuraktānāṃ śaraṇārthinām |
yaḥ sa sādhurdayāluśca sukhaṃ dadāti vidanti || 1 19||
sādhuvṛtto janaścātra sādhutvamanutiṣṭhati |
kiṃ na prāptaṃ bhavettena madarthatyāgavarṣiṇā || 3.85.120||
vṛṣāyano hi bhagavān vartate’śvasarovare |
yadāśrayeṇa bahavo yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 121 ||
paśya lakṣmi sthitaṃ vāritaṭe dhyāne madarthini |
evaṃ me sādhavo loke bhavanti śreyasāṃ pradāḥ || 122||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhormukhyadharmo nārāyaṇastena sādhutvam | sādhave nārāyaṇanatiḥ, vṛṣāyanena sādhunā caṭakābhāramāṃsaṃ śyenāya datvā caṭakā rakṣitā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||

<3.86>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kiṃ kṛtveha tu rājānaścānye dhanamadāstayā |
balagarvāśca vai lokā aśnuvate paraṃ sukham || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
brahmiṣṭhānāṃ sadā sevā kartavyā sukhamicchatā |
sādhūnnārāyaṇabhaktān vṛddhām̐ścāpyabhipūjayet || 2 ||
paurajānapadām̐ścāpi sādhujanān bahuśrutān |
bhaktyā dānena sevābhirnamaskāraiḥ samarcayet || 3 ||
yathātmānaṃ yathā putrām̐stathā sādhūn prasevayet |
ye cāpyeṣāṃ pūjyatamāstān viśeṣeṇa pūjayet || 4 ||
santaḥ pūjyā namaskāryā mānyā devā yathā bhuvi |
teṣu tuṣṭeṣu rājyādisampadaḥ susukhāḥ sadā || 5 ||
kṛṣṇadhyānaprasaktānāṃ brahmabhaktiṃ prakurvatām |
dharmajñānāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sevāṃ kīrtiṃ samācaret || 6 ||
devaiśca pitṛbhiścāpi gandharvairbrāhmaṇaistathā |
vasubhiśca tathādityai rudraiśca pūjitā yataḥ || 7 ||
adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryudaiṃvataṃ cāpyadaivatam |
yamiccheyuḥ sa devaḥ syād yo naṣṭaḥ sa parābhavet || 8 ||
parivādaprakartāro naśyeyurnātra saṃśayaḥ |
tasmātsādhūnpūjayecceśvarān vai sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 9 ||
ete bhojyāśca pūjyāśca kimicchavaiḥ suvastubhiḥ |
namaskāraiścārpaṇādyai rakṣyāśca pitṛvannṛpaiḥ || 3.86.1 0||
ītīnāṃ cāpi vighnānāṃ śāntiḥ sadbhiḥ prajāyate |
brahmavarcasvinaḥ santo yajñāḥ sākṣād bhavanti vai || 1 1||
brahmiṣṭhaṃ bhaktisampannaṃ dharmaśīlaguṇānvitam |
vāsayeta gṛhe rājā santaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sadā || 1 2||
satāṃ mukhe havirdattaṃ pratigṛhṇanti ceśvarāḥ |
pitaro devatāścāpi muktāstṛpyanti yoginaḥ || 13||
ṛṣayo vasavaḥ siddhā manavo bhāskarāḥ śivāḥ |
surāśca viṣṇavo brahmāṇaśca sādhyā marudgaṇāḥ || 14||
vālakhilyāśca gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ puruṣottamāḥ |
avatārāḥ sata āviśyānnaṃ sukhāḥ prabhuñjate || 15 ||
yatra no bhagavadbhaktā utsave vā mahotsave |
tāḥ sampadastathānandāḥ śmaśānāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 16||
yatrotsaveṣu santaśca vidyante śubhadarśanāḥ |
ta utsavā ūrdhvagatipradāḥ puṇyamayāḥ śubhāḥ ||17||
santaṃ vinā mahārājyaṃ śmaśānaṃ yāmyapuṣṭikṛt |
satā yuktaṃ vanaṃ cāpi divyaṃ golokamuktidam || 18||
sādhuṃ yatra sthale santaṃ viharantaṃ sthitaṃ ca vā |
paśyanti yamadūtāśca nābhiyanti sthalaṃ hi tat || 19||
sādhuṃ janaṃ vilokyaiva vighnā viyanti dūrataḥ |
rogā māyāḥ kālavegāstrastā viyanti dūrataḥ ||3.86.20||
yena yenaiva santo’tra haviṣā tarpitā muhuḥ |
ye santamanuvṛttāśca teṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam ||21||
na te pretya vinaśyanti na te yānti parābhavam |
yadvai satāṃ mukhātprāptaṃ pratigṛhṇanti sadvacaḥ ||22||
pāpino’pi janāste vai na prayānti parābhavam |
yatkiñcid dṛśyate loke śrūyate paṭhyate tathā ||23||
sarvaṃ tacchrīmatāṃ puṇyasatāmāśīrvacobhavam |
bhūmiḥ papraccha pūrvaṃ vai śvetavārāhamīśvaram ||24|||
gṛhiṇāṃ pāpakarmāṇi kena naśyanti mūlataḥ |
vārāhaśca tadovāca dhyātvā śreṣṭhatamaṃ vacaḥ ||25||
sādhūn saṃsevamānānāṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyate |
sādhūn sadā praseveta pavitrān lokadhārakān ||26||
ebhyo bhūtiśca kīrtiśca smṛddhirbuddhiḥ prajāyate |
bhaktiḥ prajāyate tena pāvanī matirīyate ||27||
mahāyajño harerbhaktaḥ sādhureva na saṃśayaḥ |
sādhuṃ seveta satataṃ bhūme sarvavibhūtaye ||28||
viprebhyaśca pare santi guravastūpadeśakāḥ |
gurubhyaścopadeṣṭṝbhya upādhyāyā pare matāḥ ||29||
tebhyaḥ parā sadā cāryā ācāryebhyastu śīlinaḥ |
brahmacārebhya utkṛṣṭā bhaktāḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||3.86.30||
bhaktebhya uttamāḥ santi sadā cātmanivedinaḥ |
ātmārpitebhya utkṛṣṭāḥ sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ ||3 1 ||
apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścāpi te pare |
matto’pi paramāḥ santaḥ satāṃ dāso bhavāmyaham ||32||
sādhavo yaṃ praśaṃsanti sa naro mādhavo bhavet |
sādhūnākrośayati yaḥ parābhavati so’cirāt ||33||
yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaṃ lavaṇaṃ saṃvilīyate |
tathā pāpāni sādhau vai kṣiptāni yanti līnatām ||34||
sādhavo yaṃ praśaṃsanti sa jāto’tra pravardhate |
yaśasā sampadā smṛddhyā puṣṭyā lakṣmyā striyā sutaiḥ ||35||
sādhavaḥ saṃvidantyeva mārgaṃ svargasya vai tathā |
mokṣasyāpi nirayasya karmaṇāṃ ca gatiṃ tathā ||36||
bhāgyānāṃ ca gatiṃ cāpi vidanti sādhavo janāḥ |
āgatānāgate cāpi vidanti janmakarmabhiḥ ||37||
sarveṣāṃ kṣatravargāṇāṃ tejāṃsi prabalāni ca |
brāhmaṇeṣu praśāmyanti brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sādhuṣu || 38||
sādhūn vai sevamānānāṃ rajaḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati |
icchan kīrtiṃ ca bhūtiṃ ca lokām̐ścāpyuttamottamān ||39||
satāṃ cānumate tiṣṭhed rājā śreṣṭhī tathetaraḥ |
janmanaiva camatkārī brahmiṣṭho yastu jāyate ||3.86.40 ||
namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sa sādhuścācyutātmajaḥ |
sarvathā suhṛdaḥ santaḥ śreyo mātravidhāyakāḥ || 41 ||
smṛtibhiḥ kṛṣṇayuktābhirgīrbhiśca maṃgalādibhiḥ |
āśritānāṃ suśreyāṃsi cānudhyāyanti pūjitāḥ | | 42 | |
śrīśca vṛddhiśca tejaśca vibhūtiśca pratāpinī |
lakṣmyaḥ sarvavidhāḥ sādhusaṃkalpena bhavanti hi | | 43 | |
sādhavo vividhāḥ santi durāsadāḥ parārthinaḥ |
kecinnārāyaṇasattvāḥ śīlasattvāśca kecana || 44 ||
vratasattvāstapaḥsattvā dhyānasattvāstathāpare |
vairāgyasattvā vidyādisattvā bhaktibalāḥ pare | | 45 ||
dharmasattvāstathaudāsīnyādimukhyā bhavantyapi |
api sevyāḥ sarvavidhāḥ sāro grāhyo mumukṣuṇā | |46 ||
siṃhasattvāḥ santi kecin mṛgasattvāstathāpare |
sarpasattvāḥ parecāpi kapisattvāstathāpare ||47 ||
agnisattvāstathā cānye jalasattvāstathāpare |
kṣmāsattvā vāyusattvāśca bhayantyevaṃprakāriṇaḥ || 48 | |
asahāḥ siṃhasattvā vai sarvasahā mṛgā iva |
dveṣagarāḥ sarpatulyā hārakāḥ kapisadṛśāḥ | | 49 ||
pāpaghnā vahnisattvāste śāntidā jalasattvinaḥ |
kṣamante kṣmāsamāścāpi guṇagrāhā marutsamāḥ | | 3.86.50 | |
siṃhasarpakapitulyān yāvadarthaṃ samāśrayet |
mokṣārthaṃ cetarān sarvānāśrayenmatimān janaḥ | |5 1 ||
sādhavo hi mahātmāno devānāmapi devatāḥ |
satataṃ pūjayet sādhūn dāsyena paricaryayā || 52 | |
ekadā mālatīdevī papraccha svapatiṃ nṛpam |
citraketuṃ namaskṛtya trailokyapūjitaṃ satī | | 53 | |
kena vṛttena rājam̐stvaṃ trailokyamadhitiṣṭhasi |
śraiṣṭhyametādṛśaṃ kena prāptaṃ brūhi vratena vai | | 54 | |
citraketustu tāṃ prāha sādhusevāvrataṃ mama |
vandhyaṃ dinaṃ na me yāti sādhusevāmṛte kvacit | | 55 ||
agrataḥ sādhavo me vai pṛṣṭhataḥ sādhavo’tra me |
pārśvayoḥ sādhavaḥ santi sabhāyāṃ sādhavaśca me | | 56 | |
yātrāyāṃ sādhavo me ca bhojane cotsavādiṣu |
ārambhe sādhavo me vai vartante brahmaśīlinaḥ | | 57 | |
teṣāṃ dāsyaṃ vrataṃ me’sti tena bṛhadvratena vai |
adhitiṣṭhāmi lokāṃstrīn harerbhaktiṃ karomi ca | |58 ||
anyāni me śṛṇu patni vṛtāni śobhanānyapi |
loke yairmānyatā cāste cāpradhṛṣyatvamityapi ||59 ||
nāsūyāmi kvacit sādhūn sammanye tān yathāsukham |
brahmiṣṭhānnāvajānāmi nāparādhyāmi karhicit ||3.86.60 ||
abhyarcyābhyanupṛcchāmi sevāṃ karomi nityadā |
sadaṇḍavannamaḥ kṛtvā pādau gṛhṇāmi vāri ca ||61 ||
yāmājñāṃ te nirdiśanti vahāmi toṣayāmi tān |
sato nityaṃ śṛṇomyeva kathāmṛtaratān prabhūn ||62||
etacchreṣṭhamamṛtaṃ vai divyaṃ cakṣuśca pāragam |
yad brahmiṣṭhamukhād vākyaṃ śāstraṃ cājñā pravartate ||63||
brahmiṣṭhāstapasā bhaktyā sidhyanti dhībalāḥ sadā |
ātmabalāṃ mama balairyuktāste tārayantyapi ||64||
vasanto brāhmīrvasatīryatayaḥ samadarśanāḥ |
nirvāṇasthā hi te bhūmau śreyapradāḥ sukhapradāḥ ||65||
bhūmistaṃ vai nigirati yo brahmiṣṭhaṃ na sevate |
abhimānaḥ śriyaṃ hanti smṛddhasyāpyalpamedhasaḥ ||66||
abhimānaṃ tato hitvā hitvā rājamadaṃ tathā |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ nityaṃ karomi vai satāṃ mudā ||67||
māṃ ca bhaktaṃ citraketuṃ śrutvā śrutvā hi sādhavaḥ |
bhūbhāgāt svargabhāgācca pātālāt sāgarādapi ||68||
satyalokāt samāyānti nāradādyā hi pāvanāḥ |
dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ mama cāste yaḥ koṭistrīpatirnṛpaḥ ||69||
sādhubhakta iti khyāto yaṃ pratiyanti sādhavaḥ |
yadgṛhaṃ sādhusampannaṃ yannāryaḥ sādhusevikāḥ ||3.86.70||
yo rājā vighasāśyasmi tato dhanyetaro nu kaḥ |
yo yo vai yācate kiṃcid dadāmyeva tu tatkṣaṇam ||71 ||
pratoṣayāmi satataṃ sādhūn viprām̐śca yoginaḥ |
rājyaṃ yathā svendriyārthaṃ sādhvarthaṃ me mataṃ bahu ||72||
brahmiṣṭhārthaṃ mama rājyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ vartate priye |
apīḍayan rājavargaṃ pradadyāṃ sarvamaihikam ||73||
yathā me sādhavaḥ pūjyāstathānu brāhmaṇā api |
ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ ||74||
striyo bālā bālikāścānāthā nirāśrayāstathā |
śaraṇāgatalokāścābhyāgatā bhikṣukāstathā ||75||
anādhārāśca me pūjyā vanino gṛhiṇo’pi ca |
satkarmāṇaḥ sadā pūjyāḥ śrutavanto harerjanāḥ ||76||
ato’nyathā vartamānā daṇḍyāḥ śāstranayena vai |
bhaktidharmaḥ sadācāro jñānaṃ cātmavivecanam ||77||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyamārjavaṃ dama īśitā |
akrodhaścānabhimānaścādroho hrīḥ kṣamā damaḥ ||78||
titikṣā vāsanānāśastṛṣṇānāśaḥ pavitratā |
yasminnetāni dṛśyante na tvakāryāṇi vai priye ||79||
satpātraṃ tadbhavelloke sarvadā mānamarhati |
apūrvaṃ cāpi pūrvaṃ vā pārakyaṃ naijameva vā ||3.86.80||
yadvā viśeṣitaṃ vāpi saṃpratyāgatameva vā |
brahmiṣṭhaṃ śreyasisthaṃ yat tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ||81||
loke bhavanti bahavaścābhimānabharā janāḥ |
asūyādveṣayuktāścāsahamānāḥ parānnarān ||82||
parakhyātiṃ sahante na parasaukhyaṃ paronnatim |
na sahante ca dahyanti tato nindanti sajjanān ||83 ||
aprāmāṇyaṃ satāṃ vākye vaidike lokasammate |
matvātilaṃghanaṃ cāpi kurvanti dharmasetuṣu ||84||
avyavasthāṃ ca kurvanti svayaṃ paṇḍitamāninaḥ |
hetuvādān bruvantaśca satsu drohaṃ prakurvate ||85||
ākroṣṭārastathā śāstraviruddhavādinaḥ khalāḥ |
mūḍhāḥ kaṭukavācaśca narāḥ pāpaparāyaṇāḥ ||86||
svatulyān suhitān sṛtvā śuno’rcayanti vai khalāḥ |
mālati tādṛśā dambhā naraśvāno jagattraye ||87||
kalyāṇaṃ naiva kurvanti nāśayanti nijān parān |
ātmanāśaṃ cāhvayanti te daṇḍyāḥ sarvathā nṛpaiḥ ||88||
yathā śvā bhaṣituṃ caiva khādituṃ cāvasajjate |
tathā te lokamaryādāṃ nāśayituṃ jvalanti vai ||89||
tasmād rājñi lokamelaṃ dharmaṃ cātmahitaṃ śubham |
hṛdayaṃ deśakālau ca vīkṣyājñāṃ vartayejjanaḥ ||3.86.90||
evaṃ nityaṃ vartamānaḥ śāśvatīrvardhate samāḥ |
rājāno vā dhanino vā balino vā janāstviha ||9 1 ||
tathaiva vartamānāścennābhibhavanti vai kvacit |
ṛṇamuktā harerbhaktā bhūtvānte yānti mokṣaṇam ||92|||
ityevaṃ citraketurvai mālatīṃ prāha sāpi tu |
harerbalaṃ paraṃ prāpyāsevatāharniśaṃ sataḥ ||93||
abhajatparamātmānaṃ sevāpūjanakīrtanaiḥ |
naijaṃ karmakalāpaṃ sā cakāra vai satāṃ kṛte ||94||
nṛpājñayā hi satataṃ bheje satpuruṣān śubhān |
bhojanairdānasevābhirjalavastraphalārpaṇaiḥ ||95||
sā ca bhaktyārūḍhabhāvā dadarśa māṃ pareśvaram |
pūjāyāṃ divyarūpaṃ vai caturbāhuṃ vimānagam ||96||
yayāce mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi tvājñāmādāya bhūbhṛtaḥ |
tūrṇaṃ ca bhautikaṃ tyaktvā cāruroha vimānakam ||97||
divyā caturbhujā jātā lakṣmīsakhī śubhānanā |
mālatī vartate dhāmni brahmapriyā narāyaṇī ||98||
evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena rājā sādhurhi citrakṛt |
patyuḥ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena mokṣamārgamavāpa sā ||99||
mokṣagatimavāpyaiva mālatī tu ramāsakhī |
jātā brahmapriyā lakṣmi satsaṃgo yāvadarthakaḥ || 3.86.10 0||
nirdhano vā dhanavām̐śca saguṇo nirguṇo’pi vā |
sādhvāśrayaṃ samālambya bhavatyeva narāyaṇaḥ || 101 ||
madaṃśo bhaktivegena jāyate cordhvakīrtimān |
tārakaḥ sarvalokānāṃ dhārakaḥ sarvadharmiṇām || 1 02||
prāpakaścākṣarasyāpi rakṣakaśca nijāntike |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dhanamadibalagarvinṛpādīnāmapi paramaśreyasi citraketormālityā dṛṣṭāntena sādhupratāpaphalādivarṇananāmā ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||

<3.87>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
brahmaputrā brāhmaṇā ye tanavaste bhavanti me |
pāvanāḥ sarvathā loke sarvavarṇottamā yataḥ || 1 ||
kāmakrodhamahāmohalobhapāśāvṛtāḥ sadā |
nārīvanto gṛhadharmā āśātṛṣṇādisaṃvṛtāḥ || 2 ||
te śreṣṭhā vā nirālambā virāgāḥ sādhavastava |
kāmakrodhādiśūnyāśca tṛṣṇāśādivivarjitāḥ || 3 ||
lobhapāśādiśūnyāśca śubhāḥ sarvāśramottamāḥ |
agṛhadharmā nirdoṣā mokṣamārgaparāyaṇāḥ || 4 ||
santa_ śreṣṭhā dvayormadhye śraiṣṭhyaṃ kutra vada prabho |
ubhe te vai śarīre sto dvayorbhedo’sti vā na vā || 5 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi hitaṃ tathyaṃ pathyaṃ pratyakṣadarśanam |
akāmebhyastu niṣkāmāḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhavanti vai || 6 ||
sastrīkebhyo yatayastu sadā śreṣṭhatamāḥ priyāḥ |
kāmakrodhamahāmohā nārīyoge bhavanti vai || 7 ||
ratipriyā me tanavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhatamāstu na |
śreṣṭhatamāḥ sādhavo me sarvamāyāvivarjitāḥ || 8 ||
māyāvanto gṛhasthā vai nityaṃ nirayayoginaḥ |
śmaśānāni narakāṇi nityaṃ bhajanti nārakāḥ || 9 ||
māyāśūnyā yatayo vai nityaṃ mādhavayoginaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhasamayadvāsān sevante hariyoginaḥ || 3.87.1 0||
tyāgāśramāttu gārhasthyaṃ nimnaṃ bhavati sarvadā |
varṇeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ strīmatsu na tu sarvathā || 1 1||
varṇāśrameṣu vai śreṣṭhatamā me sādhavo mama |
brahmacaryaṃ sadā śreṣṭhaṃ sādhutvaṃ śreṣṭhameva ca || 1 re||
vānaprasthāśramaḥ śreṣṭho manāk na tu ca sādhuvat |
ratipriyā vṛthā mānaṃ vahante nārakā yathā || 1 3||
sannyāsavanmahatsthānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kvāpi na vidyate |
māyā māyikakarmāṇi nikṛṣṭāni svabhāvataḥ || 14||
amāyikavratasthā vai sādhavaḥ sarvato’dhikāḥ |
īśvarā api dārasthāḥ pūjayanti sato janān || 15||
dvijā nṛpāḥ surāścāpi sādhūn prapūjayanti hi |
sevāvṛtticarebhyastu kṛṣikārāḥ sadottamāḥ || 16||
karṣukebhyo rakṣakāśca rakṣakebhyastu tāpasāḥ |
tāpasā brāhmaṇāstebhyo dāravarjyā hi sādhavaḥ || 17||
brahmaparā ātmaparā muktiparā hi sādhavaḥ |
doṣahīnā cordhvavīryā brahmasattvā hi sādhavaḥ || 18||
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sādhavaḥ |
viprāṇāṃ pūjanīyāśca pāvanānāṃ hi pāvanāḥ || 1 9||
tāmasyo me tanavastu rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ |
rājasyo me tanavaśca kṣatriyādyā nijārthinaḥ ||3.87.20||
sātvikyo me tanavaśca vidyāvanto dvijātayaḥ |
nirguṇā divyatanavaḥ sādhavo me pramuktidāḥ ||21||
tataḥ śreṣṭhatamā lakṣmi sādhavo’ti na tu dvijāḥ |
kṣatratejāṃsi sarvāṇi vipratejasi yanti hi ||22||
vipratejāṃsi sarvāṇi sādhutejasi yanti hi |
sādhutejāṃsi sarvāṇi līyante mayi mādhave ||23||
matsadṛśāḥ sadā santo viprāṇāṃ tārakā bhuvi |
pāpaprajvālakāḥ santo mokṣadā dārayoginām || 24||
tapastejo vrataṃ satyaṃ camatkāraḥ suśīlatā |
puṇyaṃ sravanti caitāni nārīyogena dehinaḥ ||25||
sādhūnāṃ tāni sarvāṇi vardhante śīlayoginām |
nārāyaṇā iva santo jāyante vai narāyaṇāḥ ||26|||
tataḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmaṇāśca santaḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ sadā |
brahmā ruṣṭaḥ purā sanatkumārāya hi sādhave ||27||
tolayāmāsa vai śraiṣṭhyaṃ sādhutvabrāhmaṇatvayoḥ |
sādhutvaṃ śreṣṭhatamatāṃ prāptaṃ dvijatvasannidhau || 28 ||
paścātpunaścaikatulāmadhye nyadhāddhi vipratām |
kṣatriyatāṃ vaiśyatāṃ ca śūdratāṃ brahmacāritām || 29 ||
gṛhitāṃ vanitāṃ cāpi tato’nyasyāṃ nyadhādajaḥ |
sādhutvaṃ kevalaṃ satye paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām || 3.87.30 ||
sādhutvaṃ gauravaṃ prāptaṃ saptabhyaścaiva sarvathā |
tasmācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sṛṣṭau sādhutvaṃ mokṣaṇeṣvapi || 31 | |
śreṣṭhaṃ pātraṃ brāhmaṇā vai śreṣṭhatamaṃ tu sādhavaḥ |
mahābhāgavatāḥ śreṣṭhā gṛhiṇasteṣu sādhavaḥ || 32 ||
tyāgavantaḥ sadā śreṣṭhā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
bhāravāhā na vai śreṣṭhā gandhajñā uttamā yathā || 33 ||
tathā dāravahā naiva śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhāstu sādhavaḥ |
lakṣmi cāhaṃ gṛhastho’smi pūjayāmi sato janān || 34||
muktā ye brahmalokasthāḥ sarve te sādhavo mama |
tān japāmi pūjayāmi nārāyaṇanarāyaṇān || 35 ||
vipraviprān brāhmaṇānāṃ brāhmaṇān brahmayoginaḥ |
śīlināṃ śīlinaścāpi yatīnāṃ ca yatīnparān || 36 ||
asvādarasalubdhām̐śca hyanindriyasukhān sataḥ |
apramadāgandhasahān pūjayāmi nirantaram | | 37 ||
na me lakṣmi rocate’yaṃ gṛhāśramo hi kalmaṣī |
bhaktānīnāṃ bhavatīnāmicchayā cābhavaṃ gṛhī || 38 ||
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmi vai |
pratijñā me sadā cāste bhaktecchāpūrako hyaham || 39 | |
kāminīnāṃ kāmadānaiścārtānāṃ cārtināśanaiḥ |
arthārthināmarthadānaiḥ pūrayāmi manorathān ||3.87.4 0 ||
jñānināṃ nirguṇo bhūtvā karomi mokṣaṇaṃ priye |
sādhavo me’vatārā vai teṣu vasāmi nityadā | |4 1 ||
satsu vasāmi yāvām̐śca viśeṣataḥ samastataḥ |
anyatra tu yathākāryaṃ yathājoṣaṃ yathāphalam ||42 | |
tasmācchreṣṭhatamā nityaṃ sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ |
athaikadā svayaṃ viṣṇurlakṣmīyukto yayau vanam ||43 | |
tapaścacāra bahudhā varṣapūgasahasrakam |
sevāyāṃ vartate lakṣmīstāṃ na pasparśa tāpasaḥ ||44||
tadā lakṣmīrnamrabhāvā papraccha parameśvaram |
kathaṃ na spṛśasi viṣṇo kāraṇaṃ nu vadātra me ||45||
viṣṇuḥ prāha vrataśreṣṭhaṃ nārīsparśo na yatra tu |
brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥsiddhipradaṃ parātparam ||46 ||
stryasparśaḥ sādhutā śreṣṭhā sādhutvaṃ tapasāṃ balam |
sādhutve jāyate siddhistapasāṃ cāparājitā ||47||
lakṣmīḥ sandehamāpannā svayaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi san |
nirdoṣo’pi kathaṃ vakti prabhuḥ prākṛtajīvavat ||48||
atha viṣṇustapaḥpūrṇasiddhyuttaraṃ śriyaḥ khalu |
sandehanāśanārthaṃ vai yayau vaikuṇṭhameva tu ||49||
tatra nārāyaṇo devo lakṣmyā sākaṃ virājate |
so’pi nityaṃ sataḥ sādhūn pūjayatyeva yoginaḥ ||3.87.50||
ityevaṃ sampradarśyaiva lakṣmīṃ tato yayau param |
golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadhāma tatra kṛṣṇaḥ sarādhikaḥ ||51 ||
nityaṃ sādhūnarcayatītyevaṃ pradarśya vai tataḥ |
yayau viṣṇuścākṣarākhyaṃ dhāma dhāmottamaṃ param ||52||
tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo brahmapriyānvitaḥ |
sādhūn muktān pūjayati darśayāmāsa tacchriyam ||53||
tato lakṣmyāstu sandeho nivṛtto mūlataḥ khalu |
atha viṣṇurnije rūpe lakṣmīmantarvibhāvya ca ||54||
lakṣmyai sandarśayāmāsa lakṣmyā rūpaṃ sanātanam |
brahācaryasvarūpaṃ yacchīlaṃ sā lakṣmīreva ha ||55||
icchayā vartate nārī vastutaḥ śīlarūpiṇī |
abhinnā bhagavatyeva sā tvaṃ lakṣmi mama priyā ||56||
vartase śīlarūpeti sādhvīrūpeti matpriyā |
brahmaśīlaṃ cāti cāti priyaṃ me nāparaṃ tathā ||57||
tadrūpā tvaṃ priyā nityaṃ netaranme priyaṃ tataḥ |
tvatsvarūpāśca me santaḥ sarve priyatamā mama ||58||
sādhavo hṛdayaṃ me’sti lakṣmīrme hṛdayaṃ tathā |
kaustubho me hṛdaye’sti śrīvatso hṛdaye ca me ||59||
śrīvatsāḥ sādhavo me vai hṛdaye me vasanti hi |
śrīpatiśca yathā cāhaṃ satpatiśca tathāsmi ca ||3.87.60||
premapatiḥ sadā cāsmi śīlapatiḥ sadāsmi ca |
sādhupatiḥ sadā cāsmi lakṣmīpatiḥ sadāsmi ca ||61||
lakṣmi cihnaṃ premarūpaṃ śīlākhyaṃ mayi vartate |
tadyatra vidyate taddhi lakṣmīti parikīrtyate ||62||
tadvatī tvaṃ madicchāsi sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ |
śīlaṃ mama guṇaḥ śaśvat so’haṃ sādhusvarūpavān ||63||
ataḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ santaḥ sarvasṛṣṭibhya eva ha |
kiyanto brāhmaṇāstatra nārīkalmaṣayojitāḥ ||64||
na devā neśvarāścāpi sādhutulyāḥ kathañcana |
narṣayaḥ pārṣadāścāpi nārīyogamupāgatāḥ ||65||
tebhyo me sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhatamā lakṣmi parātparāḥ |
śīlayuktaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tādṛktapastu sādhuṣu ||66||
tasmād vai sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāstava pūjyāḥ sadā rame |
atha te saṃśayo mā syāt kathaṃ śreṣṭhā hi sādhavaḥ ||67||
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre bhaja sādhūn samāgatān |
atithīn tyāgayogām̐śca sammānaya samarhaṇaiḥ ||68||
teṣāmāśīrvacobhiśca paramaṃ śreya īyate |
teṣāṃ prasannatājanyaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaveddhi śāśvatam ||69||
teṣāṃ sevāphalaṃ koṭigolokānandasadṛśam |
jāyate ca tataḥ sarvā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||3.87.70||
sādhusevāṃ prakurvantu toṣayantu sato janān |
nirvikārān mokṣadāṃśca māyāpārakarān gurūn ||7 1 ||
durgā caṇḍī mahākātyāyanī hatvā mahāsurān |
mahiṣādīṃstataḥ śaṃbhuṃ papraccha parameśvarī ||72||
ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ svayaṃ śaṃbho nigadyase |
hiṃsā kṣayakarī sā ca mayā kṛtātidāruṇā ||73 ||
nipātitā hi bahavo vidāritā hi kāśyapāḥ |
dānavāścāsurā daityā ye ye raṇe samāgatāḥ ||74||
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tathā teṣāṃ nārīṇāṃ rodanādikam |
vaidhavyajaṃ ca me pāpaṃ bālānāthanikandanam ||75||
kathaṃ vai parihartavyaṃ mayā kena hi śodhinā |
karmaṇā vā vratenāpi prāyaścittena vā vada ||76||
śrutvā śaṃbhustadā prāha tvaṃ sākṣātpārameśvarī |
divyā brāhmī mahāśaktiryatra pāpaṃ na vidyate ||77||
nityaśuddhasvarūpāsi tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ramā ratiḥ |
tvaṃ māyā tvaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ pāpaṃ te naiva vidyate ||78||
ahaṃ saṃhārakṛd rudro rudrāṇī tvaṃ vināśinī |
mahākālī mahāśaktiḥ pāvanī lokabhakṣiṇī ||79||
matsvarūpā sadā tvaṃ vai brahmāhaṃ parameśvaraḥ |
nārāyaṇī jagaddhātrī śivā puṇyamayī śubhā ||3.87.80||
satī sādhvī vahnirūpā śuddhāsi pauruṣottamī |
tathāpi te manaḥśāntyai lokasaṃgrahahetave ||81 ||
darśayāmi tathā tattvaṃ samācara maheśvari |
pāpakṣālanaśaktaṃ vai tīrthaṃ vrataṃ tapastrayam ||82||
tebhyaśca balavad durge sādhusevanamuttamam |
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ sampratoṣaṇam ||83||
vandanaṃ dāsyamevāpi pādasaṃvāhanādikam |
prasannatākaraṃ sarvaṃ sadyaḥpāpapraṇāśakam ||84||
tat tvaṃ yāhi viśālāṃ ca sādhuryatra svayaṃ hariḥ |
dharmaputraḥ paramātmā nārāyaṇo virājate |||85||
sadā vratī tāpasaśca brahmacārī gururmama |
tatsevayā mahāpāpādīnāṃ nāśo bhaviṣyati ||86||
tatrānye sādhavo divyā mahābhāgavatāḥ sati |
vartante bhaktisampannā darśanānmokṣadāyinaḥ ||87||
pāvanā brahmarūpāśca nityamāyānti tatra ca |
nāradādyāstathā sanatkumārādyā hi sādhavaḥ ||88 ||
lomaśādyāḥ sādhavaśca teṣāṃ darśanasevanāt |
badaryāśramavāsāt syāt sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||89||
ityuktā prāha śaṃbhuṃ tu satī yāmi tavājñayā |
yadi te rocate śaṃbho hyāgantavyaṃ tvayā prabho || 3.87.90 ||
tathāstviti haro matvā yayau devyā samaṃ gaṇaiḥ |
badarīṃ vyomamārgeṇa neme nārāyaṇaṃ gurum || 91 ||
satī neme tato nārāyaṇāya vinivedya tat |
sādhusevātmakaṃ sarvaṃ sevanaṃ pracakāra sā ||92||
nārāyaṇasyāsanasya badaryāḥ sannidhestathā |
bhūbhāgasya sadā prātarmārjanaṃ ca jalārpaṇam || 93||
patrapuṣpārpaṇaṃ mālārpaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ ca darśanam |
japaṃ cetyādi durgā sā pracakāra yathāyatham || 94||
śaṃbhuścāpi maharṣīṇāṃ sevanādi cakāra ha |
sādhūnāṃ ca yathāpekṣaṃ svāgatādi cakāra ha || 95||
evaṃ vai māsamātraṃ śrīnārāyaṇasya sadguroḥ |
satī sevāṃ pracakāra prasanno bhagavān hariḥ || 96 ||
uvāca tāṃ vada durge kathaṃ kiṃ samapekṣase |
durgā prāha kṛpāsindho tavāsmi vaiṣṇavī sutā || 97||
śaṃbhoḥ prāptā mayā dīkṣā pāvanī dīkṣayā sadā |
tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ daityānāṃ nāśakāriṇī || 98||
jātāsmi tena hatyādimahāpāpābhiśaṃkinī |
harājñayā kṣālayituṃ śaraṇaṃ te samāgatā || 99||
sādhornārāyaṇasya śrīhareste sevayā prabho |
sarvapāpāni naśyantu cecchā me hṛdi vartate || 3.87.100 ||
śrutvaivaṃ śrīharirnārāyaṇaḥ prāha śive tvayi |
pāpaleśo na caivāsti brāhmī tvaṃ pārameśvarī || 101 ||
vartase śivaśaktistvaṃ mahāpātakanāśinī |
tathāpi lokalābhārthaṃ karoṣi tādṛśaṃ vratam || 10 2||
tava pāpāni sarvāṇi daityahatyātmakāni vai |
śāntāni pāvanī tvaṃ vai sādhormamaiva darśanāt || 103 ||
sādhvarṣīṇāṃ sevanācca naṣṭānyadyāni te sati |
ityuktvā bhagavānnārāyaṇo vāri dadau tadā || 1 04||
kamaṇḍaloḥ prasādākhyāmṛtaṃ vāri papau satī |
atha śivā śivo naijagaṇaiḥ sākaṃ hariṃ prabhum || 1 05||
prapūjyājñāṃ samādāya kailāsaṃ prati jagmatuḥ |
ityevaṃ śaṃbhunā lakṣmi māhātmyamuttamaṃ satām || 1 06||
sevāyāḥ phalarūpaṃ ca darśitaṃ pāpanāśakam |
svargamokṣapradaṃ bhuktipradaṃ muktipradaṃ tathā || 1 07||
dhanasampatpradaṃ cāpi sādhusevanamuttamam |
vaṃśapradaṃ tārakaṃ ca dāridryaduḥkhanāśakam || 10 8||
ajñānatimiraghnaṃ ca nārāyaṇāptikārakam |
sukhadaṃ dhāmadaṃ cāpi sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ rame || 1 09||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇādvācanādapi |
bhuktiḥ svargaṃ bhaveccāpi muktiḥ syātpārameśvarī || 3.87.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vipragṛhibhyaḥ sādhavaḥ sarvathā śreṣṭhatamā ityarthe viṣṇornidarśanaṃ durgāyā api sādhusevānidarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||

<3.88>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan sādhurūpastvaṃ śrīpate puruṣottama |
itijñātvā praharṣāmi viśeṣato bhavanmukhāt || 1 ||
sādhavastārakā loke sādhvyo’pi bhavatārikāḥ |
viraktāstyāgamārgasthā jīvoddhārapradāḥ sadā || 2 ||
pūjyante te kṛpāleśādasmābhirnityameva ha |
brahmapriyāḥ satāmāśīrvādaiḥ pramuditāḥ sadā || 3 ||
vartāmahe bhavadyogairvividhaiścātilaukikaiḥ |
naḥ puṇyānāṃ na pāro’sti yāsāṃ kānto harirbhavān || 4 ||
athātra jñātumicchāmi sahadharmeti yadvratam |
pāṇigrahaṇataścordhva dampatyoḥ sarvadā matam || 5 ||
so’yaṃ dharmaḥ kīdṛśo’sti kṣaṇikaḥ śāśvato’pi vā |
vaidikaḥ kalpito vāpi caindriyakaṃ athāsuraḥ || 6 ||
atraiva vā paratrāpi dampatyorvartate katham |
karmabhedāttu dampatyormaraṇaṃ yugapannahi || 7 ||
gatiścaikatra nāstyeva sahadharmaḥ kuto bhavet |
aicchiko vā sahadharmo niyato vā prasahya vā || 8 ||
kīdṛśaḥ kiṃphalaśceti nikhilena bravīhi me |
yena śrutena sarvāsāṃ dharmalābho bhavediha || 9 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi sahadharmaṃ sanātanam |
vivāhāgnikṛtasākṣye varo gṛhṇāti yatkaram || 3.88.1 0||
yā dadāti karaṃ naijaṃ varahaste’tiharṣitā |
tayordharmaḥ sahadharmo yāvajjīvanameva ha || 11 ||
svecchayā vā dvayoryoge pitrorvā vāñcchayā tathā |
sambandhināṃ vāñcchayā vā prasahya vā kvacit tathā || 12||
prasahyapūrvasammelād dvayorvā sahadharmakaḥ |
dānadharmaḥ sutāyā vā kumārasya tathā ca vā || 13||
evaṃ pravartate lakṣmi dampatyoḥ sahadharmakaḥ |
dvayoraikyaṃ manobhyāṃ ca tanubhyāṃ karmabhistathā || 14||
guṇairaikyaṃ dhanairaikyaṃ gṛheṇaikyaṃ dvayorapi |
upakaraṇairaikyaṃ ca bhogyairaikyaṃ samastakaiḥ || 1 5||
āhāraiśca vihāraiśca narmamantrānumantraṇaiḥ |
aikyaṃ vratairdānatīrthairaikyaṃ hṛdbhyāṃ tathendriyaiḥ || 16||
aikyaṃ jāgaraṇasvāpairaikyaṃ sāhāyyasevayā |
aikyaṃ prāṇairmamāhaṃbhyāmaikyaṃ snehānubandhanaiḥ ||17||
aikyaṃ cāntarabhāvaiśca bāhyairdvandvaiḥ phalādibhiḥ |
aikyaṃ puṇyādibhiścaiva tathāyavyayarakṣaṇaiḥ || 18||
yānavāhanaśṛṅgārairbhūṣāsvarṇāmbarādibhiḥ |
smṛddhisampatkṣetravāṭīrājyāpaṇādibhistathā || 19|||
aikyaṃ bālasutāpatyairaikyaṃ duḥkhasukhādibhiḥ |
yathāyathaṃ viśeṣaiśca śāntaghorapramūḍhakaiḥ ||3.88.20||
ānandaiśca pramodaiśca mahotsavaiḥ savādibhiḥ |
puṇyaiḥ kāryaiḥ samastaiśca dampatyoraikyameva yat ||21 ||
sahadharmaḥ kathito’yaṃ pātivratyapuraḥsaraḥ |
patnīvratānvitaścāpi sampūrṇaśced dhṛto bhavet| || 22||
dampatyoḥ sahakālena sahayātrā divaṃ prati |
bhavedeva yatheṣṭaṃ vai dharmasāmarthyayogataḥ ||23||
sahadharme kṣatirlakṣmi yāvatī tāvadeva tu |
dvayorvibhinnakālīnaṃ maraṇaṃ ca gatistathā ||24||
vibhinnā ca bhavatyeva yonyantare yathā divi |
lokāntare tathā syācca gatirbhinnā vidharmiṇoḥ ||25||
sahadharmaḥ kṣatyabhāve śāśvatiko bhavet sadā |
ubhau yāta itaḥ svargaṃ tataḥ satyaṃ tataḥ param || 26|||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama |
ubhau sahaiva mokṣaṃ ca vindate sahadharmiṇoḥ ||27||
yadi kṣatiyuto dharmaḥ sahadharmo dhṛto’tra vai |
tadā viyogo dampatyorbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||28||
ataḥ saḥ kṣaṇiko dharmo na tu śāśvatarūpavān |
vaidikaḥ sahadharmo’yaṃ deśakālānusārataḥ ||29||
na cāsti kalpito lakṣmi sāpekṣā kalpanā yataḥ |
apekṣā deśakālādervaiṣamye jāyate yadi ||3.88.30||
sahadharmastadā gauṇaḥ kvacid vipatsu vartate |
naitāvatā tatra hāniḥ prāyaścittena śudhyati ||3 1||
aindriyikaḥ kevalo na pāramārthika ityapi |
ātmārthaḥ sahadharmo’sti loke tu dehamāśritaḥ ||32||
paraloke cātmaniṣṭho mokṣe mukte vyavasthitaḥ |
icchāyā ceddhi dāmpatyaṃ caicchikaṃ tatprakathyate ||3 3||
prasahya yattu dāmpatyaṃ cāsuraṃ tatprakathyate |
dāmpatyaṃ yena kenāpi vartmanāptaṃ taduttaram ||34||
sahadharmaḥ pūrṇarūpaḥ pālitaḥ sa tu śāśvataḥ |
apālitaḥ kṣatimān syād viyogasyaiva kāraṇam ||35||
yathā yāvatpālitaḥ syāt tāvatphalaprado hi saḥ |
kaniṣṭhaḥ pālitaścet sa kaniṣṭhaphalado bhavet ||36||
madhyo madhyamaphaladaścottamaḥ śreṣṭhasatphalaḥ |
sṛṣṭyārambhe yugalāni brahmaṇā nirmitāni vai ||37||
yugalāni samutpādya sahadharmeṇa tatparam |
saha yanti paraṃ lokaṃ mṛtvā mokṣaṃ divaṃ ca vā ||38||
pātivratyabalenaiva patnīvratabalena ca |
atha kālasya daurbalye daurbalyaṃ sahadharmaṇi ||3 9||
daurbalyaṃ sahayoge ca daurbalyaṃ pāralaukikam |
evaṃ hrāse samutpanne bhinnamārgā narāḥ striyaḥ ||3.88.40||
bhinnayonigatā naijakṛtāni bhuñjate’yujaḥ |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sahadharmarahasyakam ||41||
daiviprajāḥ pālayanti nāparāḥ svārthamātragāḥ |
bhinnā mārgā hi tāsāṃ tā bhramanti bhavasāgare ||42||
aparasparasambaddhā aparasparabhāginaḥ |
aparasparadharmajñāḥ śmaśānaśīlino muhuḥ ||43||
lakṣmīrādhāramātulyā viyujyante na karhicit |
satīpadmāprathātulyā viyujyante na karhicit ||44||
māṇikyāśrīratitulyā viyujyante na karhicit |
paulomītūlasītulyā viyujyante kvacit kvacit ||45||
bhṛtyātulyā viyujyante yujyante tu kvacit kvacit |
pārakīsadṛśī naiva yujyate vigatā punaḥ || 46||
evaṃ cakraṃ vartate’tra loke lakṣmi durantakam |
dharmacakraṃ rakṣakaṃ vai yogasya balavad yathā ||47||
tadeva nirbalaṃ sattu yogaṃ rakṣati naiva ca |
viyogastena sarveṣāṃ dampatīnarayoṣitām || 48 ||
adharmaḥ kāraṇaṃ lakṣmi viyoge ṛṇakāritā |
kecid vivāhya tūrṇaṃ vai viyujyante viyanti ca ||49 ||
kecit kālena kecicca madhyakāle’ntime’pare |
viyujyante ṛṇavāhā yathā yeṣāmṛṇaṃ sthitam | | 3.88.50 ||
sva eva kāraṇaṃ tatra yoge viyojane rame |
tasmāccared vṛṣaṃ vīkṣya sahadharmamakhaṇḍitam || 5 1| |
sahadharmaṃ parityajya tyaktvā śāstraṃ gurorvacaḥ |
vyavahāravṛṣaṃ tyaktvā yānti ye vipathena tu ||52||
prayānti nirayaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhadāridryasaṃbhṛtam |
daivaṃ paitryaṃ na kurvanti gṛhasthāḥ svodaraṃbharāḥ || 53 ||
nātithipūjakā ye te yānti nirayamulbaṇam |
dānahīnāḥ śaucahīnā maṃgalācāravarjitāḥ ||54||
kaligrahā rajobhraṣṭāḥ śvavṛttijīvinaśca ye |
rodanakleśakalahavyāptā yānti hyadhogatim || 55||
bhagavannāmaśūnyāśca parocchiṣṭaprabhojinaḥ |
durātmāno mantrahīnā yānti nirayamulbaṇam || 56 ||
kriyāhīnāḥ śrāddhahīnā bhaktihīnā nirīśvarāḥ |
mahotsavādihīnāśca yānti nirayamulbaṇam | |57 ||
patitāśca jaḍonmattāḥ kuṣṭhinaḥ śvitriṇastathā |
klībā yakṣmahatāścāpi pāpā yānti hyadhogatim || 58 ||
cikitsakā devalakā vṛthā niyamadarśakāḥ |
rogiṇo nindakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim | | 59 ||
gāyakā nartakāścāpi kūrdakā vādakāstathā |
kathakā yodhakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim || 3.88.60 | |
bhraṣṭadharmā bhraṣṭavratā bhraṣṭakulakuṭumbakāḥ |
parasaṃkīrṇakā bhaktihīnā yāntyadhamāṃ gatim || 61 ||
homahīnāḥ śrāddhaśūnyā vyabhicāraniṣeviṇaḥ |
nāstikādhyāpakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim || 62 ||
brahmavikrayiṇaścāpi strīvikrayiṇastathā |
pativikretryaśca bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||6 3 ||
sarvasaṃgābhimantāraḥ śavaśaucayutāstathā |
stenāḥ putrījīvinaśca pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||64||
vadhūjīvā mātṛgotrajīvāścājñātajīvanāḥ |
ṛṇino hārakā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||65||
prāṇivikrayakārāśca strīpaṇyādiprajīvanāḥ |
veśyānāthā ajapāśca pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||66||
vratahīnā nijapatnīkleśadāḥ pāśavā janāḥ |
ayuktakāryakartāraḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||67||
parasparaṃ vimantāraḥ parasparaṃ pratārakāḥ |
anarjavaḥ śaṭhā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||68 ||
asāvitrā mṛṣāvāṇijyādiniṣṭhā mṛṣāvṛṣāḥ |
mṛṣāvāco’satyakāryāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||69||
daridrāḥ parabhāgyāśca hiṃsrāḥ kalkayutāḥ khalāḥ |
kalaṃkinaḥ kalaṃkadāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||3.88.70||
kitavāścāvṛttikāśca sarvabhakṣyā vihāriṇaḥ |
dāruṇakarmagā bhaktihīnā yānti hyadhogatim ||71 ||
mithyāśapathinaścāpi māṃsāśanāḥ surāpibāḥ |
avedavratacāritrāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||72||
gurvabhayādikāryārthaṃ varjayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
anṛtavākkriyācittāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ||73||
parasvanāśakāḥ parastryapahārakarā janāḥ |
paiśunyavādinaḥ pāpāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ||74||
prapāśālāsabhāgārachāyāsatrādibhedinaḥ |
anāthapramadābālavṛddhabhītapravañcakāḥ ||75||
sādhusādhvītāpasīvañcakā nirayagāminaḥ |
jīvikāgṛhamitrastrīviśvāsadharmaghātinaḥ ||76||
maryādānyāyasatkarmadānayajñavibhedinaḥ |
kṛtaghnā dūṣakāścāpi janā nirayagāminaḥ ||77||
pākhaṇḍāniṣparīkṣāśca viṣavikrayiṇo janāḥ |
abhicārāgnigaradāḥ pāpā nirayagāminaḥ ||78||
āśāghnāśca pratijñāghnā bhaktighnāḥ śramaghātinaḥ |
bhedakāśca śubhaghnāśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||79||
śastraśalyādiyoktāro gokanyāstrīpraghātinaḥ |
bālajantvādighātāśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||3.88.80||
mārgāṇāṃ rodhakā ye ca kīlaśilāprakaṇṭakaiḥ |
bhṛtyabhaktastrītyajaśca janā nirayagāminaḥ ||81 ||
vṛṣaṇocchedakā nāsābhedakā dantapātakāḥ |
paśūnāṃ duḥkhakartāro ghātakā nirayāyinaḥ ||82||
agoptāro nṛpāścāpi dānahīnā dhaneśvarāḥ |
āśritatyājino mūḍhā narā nirayagā matāḥ ||83||
āśritādīnadattvā ye bhuñjategresarā janāḥ |
ayogyaśāsakāḥ pāpā janā nirayagā matāḥ ||84||
pūjāhīnā devahīnā bhaktihīnā asevinaḥ |
snehahīnā mṛṣācārāḥ pāpā yānti hyadhogatim ||85||
sahadharmā na vai teṣāṃ tāsāṃ vā vai vidharmiṇām |
adharmiṇāṃ tu pāpānāṃ pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ hi tat ||86||
iha loke sukhaṃ nāsti dharmo nāsti vrataṃ na ca |
dānaṃ puṇyaṃ dayā nāsti paśutulyāḥ kathaṃ sukhāḥ ||87||
paraloke’pi te pretā duḥkhino vai bhavanti ca |
aprāptajalabhakṣyānnāḥ kuṭumbādarśinastathā ||88||
ekalāḥ parajālasthā yānti nirayamandiram |
sahadharmaṃ na jānanti tṛṣṇāviṣayavedinaḥ ||89||
paraduḥkhaṃ na jānanti svasaukhyārthaṃ hi tāmasāḥ |
sarpatulyā viṣavāhā yānti nirayamandiram ||3.88.90||
strīrakṣāṃ naiva jānanti gorakṣāṃ na vidanti ca |
dāsadāsīsukhaṃ naivecchanti yānti hyadhogatim ||91 ||
dhanahārā vratahārā dharmahārāḥ pradūṣakāḥ |
satyamasatyaṃ kurvanto yānti pāpā hyaghogatim ||92||
sahadharme na tu tṛptā vidharme ca vahanti ye |
parārthaṃ naiva paśyanti bhaktihīnā hyadhogamāḥ ||93||
jāravad gaṇikāvad ye vartante gṛhavāsinaḥ |
paravatsvārthivad ye ca te sarve vai hyadhogamāḥ ||94||
hiṃsravaccauravaddhūrtavacca kitavavattathā |
kālavanmṛtyuvad ye ca vartante te hyadhogamāḥ ||95||
sahadharmottaraṃ yatra vaimanasyaṃ dvayorgṛhe |
pratyakṣaṃ nirayaṃ tatra paraloke’pi tattathā ||96||
asnehaścāpi vairaṃ ca tiraskāro’vamānanam |
parājayo’tinindā ca pratyakṣanirayāṇi vai ||97||
mahārogo nirdhanatvaṃ kārāgāraniṣevaṇam |
bhojyabhūṣādirāhityaṃ pratyakṣanirayāṇi vai ||98||
anapatyatvamevāpi bahuśatrutvamityapi |
atipariśramajīvitvaṃ sākṣānnirayāṇi vai ||99||
cintāpiśācinī yasya bhāryā piśācinīsamā |
dāridryākhyapiśācaśca rauravaṃ tasya mandiram || 3.88.10 0||
tasmād vicārya medhāvī sahadharmān samācaret |
kṣatīḥ sarvāḥ parityajya kuśalaḥ san sukhī bhavet || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sahadharmasvarūpavarṇanaṃ cāsahadharme nirayagāmitvamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||

<3.89>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
nanu sākṣānnarakāṇi cintāśokakarāṇi vai |
yāni bhavanti tānyatra mamācakṣva hare prabho || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ cintāśokakarāṇi vai |
nistejasvitvakārśyādirogaśoṣakarāṇi ca || 2 ||
yāni sākṣānnarakāṇi duḥkhamātrāṇi santi vai |
saṃbhāvitasya sarvāṇyasaṃbhāvane bhavanti vai || 3 ||
suhṛnmitraṃ vinā patnīṃ vinā kuṭumbamantarā |
videśe yā sthitiḥ sā ca nirayaḥ khalu gocaraḥ || 4 ||
sādhūpacaritaiścāpi kuṭumbināmatoṣaṇam |
dhikkāraścāvamānaṃ ca nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 5 ||
dhanaiśvaryādyadhikaiśca janairjñātijanairapi |
kṛtāvamānasahanaṃ nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 6 ||
svaguṇeṣvadhikeṣvanyāguṇino mānanaṃ bahu |
sannidhāveva jāyeta nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 7 ||
jīvikāmantarā bhikṣālajjābhayena yā kṣudhā |
raktaṃ dahyati nityaṃ sa nirapaścātra gocaraḥ || 8 ||
vivāde śreṣṭhabhāve’pi kaniṣṭhena jito bhavet |
parājayo’yaṃ satataṃ nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 9 ||
kliṣṭā janā bhaveyuśca yasya mitrāṇi nityadā |
duḥkhadā bhayadāścāpi nirayastasya gocaraḥ || 3.89.1 0||
prajñāsaṃbhāvitaścāpi mūrkhairmukhīkṛto janaḥ |
durvṛttairdharṣaṇaṃ yacca nirayaḥ so’tra gocaraḥ || 11 ||
mitramukhaścārisaṃgho vañcanātatparo’bhitaḥ |
tena vai vañcanaṃ cāpi nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 12||
rahasyakuśalaścāpi sarvārthagatiko’pi ca |
tajjñairna pūjyate tasya nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 1 3||
asatsu bahuṣu pārśvagateṣu ca guṇā nijāḥ |
asadbhirdurguṇāyante nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 14||
dhanabuddhiśāstrahīnā api vīkṣya mahājanān |
mahattvāśāgnidagdhā vai nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 15||
kṛtabuddhiṃ kṛtasiddhiṃ kṛtapāṇḍityamānanam |
bāndhavā nābhinandanti nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 16||
svabhāryāyāḥ prātiveśyo balī dhanī yuvāparaḥ |
vartate svānabhipreto nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 17||
yasya vākyasya vai mūlyaṃ yathārthasyāpi naiva hi |
jñātṛmadhye’pi jāyeta nirayaścātra gocaraḥ || 18||
mūrkhamadhye sadā vāso nindakeṣu nivāsanam |
īrṣyāsūyāyugjaneṣu vāso’pi nirayastviha || 1 9||
svāmī cāsañjayitvā yaṃ kṛtye paścāddhanādikam |
nityamarthayate yasmāt tasya vai nirayastviha ||3.89.20||
antargatamabhiprāyaṃ darśayituṃ na śakyate |
jāḍyād bhayācca śaithilyānnirayaścātra gocaraḥ ||21||
nirguṇatve’pi guṇino jetumicchati cerṣyayā |
vīkṣya guṇānna sahate nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||22||
avidvān bhīruralpārtho yaśaścecchati yo mahat |
jvalati cintayā nityaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||23||
cirābhilaṣitaṃ naiva prāpyate yasya duḥkhinaḥ |
prāptaṃ cānyairapahṛtaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||24||
abhiśaptaḥ striyā mātrā vipraiśca sādhubhiśca vai |
ātmadoṣeṇa dhigbhāvaṃ gato yo nirayī tviha ||25||
sādhūn dṛṣṭvā muktajanān gālīdānaṃ karoti yaḥ |
pāpaṃ karoti tasyātra nirayaḥ svālayo mataḥ ||26||
anyaduḥkhādi vīkṣyāpi hartumaśakta eva yaḥ |
śocati dhruvamarthaṃ ca nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||27||
anājñāvartinaḥ putrā nārī vaco’vamāninī |
śiṣyā viruddhācārāśca tasyāsti nirayastviha ||28||
duṣṭadattān prabhuktvaiva jīvati svālayaṃ vinā |
āhiḍyate’ṭavī yena nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||29||
pāpaṃ pravardhate yasya kalyāṇaṃ cāvasīdati |
garhāpātraṃ mato yaśca nirayastasya gocaraḥ || 3.89.30||
śatrūṇāṃ karago yaśca suhṛdebhyo viyojitaḥ |
akasmājjīvanaṃ yasya nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||3 1||
duṣṭāridhyānaniṣṭhasya cāprāpyecchāvatastathā |
cintayānasya pārakyaṃ nirayastasya gocaraḥ ||32||
sarājyasya dhaninaścānapatyatā ca rugṇatā |
akīrtiśca vicittatvaṃ nirayāstviha gocarāḥ ||33||
sādhorjanasya sādhvyāśca bhogecchā nirayastviha |
ācāryāṇāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca dhikkāro nirayastviha ||34||
mandāgniḥ sarvadā dīrgharogāśca nirayāstviha |
yauvane strīrahitatvaṃ kāntahīnatvamityapi ||35||
vaidhavyaṃ ca vidhuratvaṃ gocarā nirayāstviha |
satsu putreṣu bhṛtyatvaṃ parādhīnasvapoṣaṇam ||36||
vārdhakye ca parādhīnatvaṃ ceti nirayāstviha |
anindriyasya dīrghāyuḥ sabalasya daridratā || 37||
dāridrye bahvapatyatvaṃ sākṣādvai nirayāstviha |
aniketanivāsitvaṃ paragṛhanivāsitā ||38||
parabhāgyopajīvitvaṃ sadā bhikṣukavṛttitā |
gṛhasthasyeti loke’tra pratyakṣā nirayā rame ||3 9||
patyurasnehitā nāryāṃ putrā vimārgagāstathā |
kanyānāṃ garbhavattā ca pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||3.89.40 ||
pradhānāmātyavargasya doṣe nigaḍapātanam |
rājñyā rājakumārasya sato deśagurostathā ||41 ||
kārāgāranivāsaśca rājño dvijasya ca striyāḥ |
devajanasya viduṣaḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||42||
apūrṇabhojyalābhaśca hyapūrṇaṃ ca dhanārjanam |
arasaṃ śuṣkamucchiṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ vai nirayastviha ||43||
sati vṛddhe tvapatyānāṃ nāśo’pi nirayastviha |
pretapraveśanādyaṃ ca pratyakṣā yamayātanā ||44||
rājadaṇḍādi kaṣṭaṃ ca pratyakṣā yamayātanā |
ītayaścāpi duḥkhāni pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||45||
sāpatnyaṃ duḥsahaṃ nityaṃ tāḍanaṃ paravaśyatā |
pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ sarvaṃ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||46||
duṣkālāvṛtatā cāgnigarapāśādipātitā |
jalagarttordhvapātāśca pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||47||
śūlaśastrāstraghātāśca rodhanaṃ gahvarādiṣu |
garbhapīḍā prasavārttiḥ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||48||
asahyakāmabhogāśca hyapathyabhojanāśanam |
tridoṣajvarabādhādyāḥ pratyakṣā yamayātanāḥ ||49||
pākāḥ śarīre kledāśca sadā viḍudaraṃ vapuḥ |
śleṣmākaphādisātatyaṃ pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||3.89.50||
aśāntiḥ sarvadā citte tathā deśavivāsanam |
apamṛtyurasahāye pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||51 ||
kevalakanyakāvattvaṃ putraśūnyatvameva ca |
napuṃsakatvaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ pratyakṣo nirayastviha |||52||
śvapacatvaṃ malavāhitvaṃ ca kledādiyogitā |
durgandhālayavattā ca pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||53 ||
udvegaḥ sarvadā citte tṛṣṇājvālādavānalaḥ |
śāntiḥ sukhaṃ na vai yasya pratyakṣo nirayastviha ||54||
bālyaṃ caivātivārdhakyaṃ maithunārūḍhatā tathā |
mṛjjalābhyāṃ na cecchuddhiḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha ||55||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ratiḥ kāmaḥ pratyakṣā nirayāstviha |
vipatkālā hi nirayāḥ sampatkālāḥ sadāmṛtāḥ ||56 ||
snehaḥ svargaṃ nirayastu dveṣa evātra padmaje |
jñānaṃ svargaṃ vivekaśca dyaurgaurdharmaḥ svarājyakam ||57||
santoṣaḥ śāśvataṃ svargaṃ mokṣastu vāsanākṣayaḥ |
ityetat sarvamājñāya tyājyaṃ tyajet subuddhimān || 58 ||
grāhyaṃ samarjayet tuṣṭyā vivekī śreyaāśayaḥ |
sādhuḥ svargo hariḥ svargo bhaktiḥ svargo hi śāśvataḥ ||59||
brahmasthitiḥ paraḥ svargo brahmāptiḥ svargamuttamam |
nirbhayatvaṃ mahat svargaṃ jīvato’pi sadā rame || 3.89.60 ||
śṛṇu caiko bhṛtyapariśramī divākriyāparaḥ |
nityavetanalābhena kṛṣikāryakaro hyabhūt ||6 1 ||
nāmnā viśrāmagupto’sau kṣetre sasyādipoṣakaḥ |
nityaṃ prayāti sa prātaḥ śramaṃ kṣetre karoti ca ||62||
sāyaṃ prāpyaṃ naitikaṃ ca dhanamannaṃ ca karṣukāt |
labdhvā naijaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti dvāraprākāravarjitam || 63 ||
parṇakāṇḍādijanyaṃ ca bhūśayyāśobhanaṃ tathā |
mṛdbhāṇḍadvitriśobhaṃ ca calacullīvirājitam ||64||
asaṃskṛtatripāṣāṇe dhṛtvā bhrāṣṭraṃ ca vahninā |
roṭakaṃ pācayitvā ca bhuktvā lavaṇavāriṇā || 65||
marīcakena saha vā mūlakenāthavāniśam |
kandena vā prabhuktvātha pītvā vāri tadāhṛtam ||66 ||
prakṣālya mṛttikāpātraṃ kṛṣṇanāma japan bhuvi |
svapityevaikacīrṇotthakhaṇḍaprāvaraṇānvitaḥ || 67 ||
nirbhayaścāpi niścintaḥ puṣṭo nīroga udbalaḥ |
na śaityaṃ bādhate cāsya na viṣāktātapo’pi ca ||68 ||
brahmacārī sadā śete sarvacintāvivarjitaḥ |
aparigrahatastasya cauryabhayaṃ na vidyate ||6 9 ||
vinamrasya ca bhṛtyasya śatrubhayaṃ na vidyate |
anicchostasya nidrā vai śāntasyāprātareva tu || 3.89.70 ||
nigāḍhā sā bhavatyeva svāpnacintāvivarjitā |
prātarmānavanādaiśca jāgarti sahasā tataḥ ||7 1 ||
kṛtvā śīghraṃ roṭakaṃ ca saha nītvā prayāti ca |
kṣetraṃ śramayutastatra yathākālaṃ ca khādati ||72||
evaṃ vai vartamānasya sukhino darśanena vai |
sannidhau saṃvasan somacandrākhyo vaṇiguttamaḥ ||73 ||
paropakāracittātmā duḥkhinaṃ gaṇayan hi tam |
karṣukabhṛtyamāhūya dadau dravyaṃ dayāvaśaḥ ||74||
rūpyakadviśataṃ dānaṃ sahāyyaṃ jagṛhe’pi saḥ |
atha cintā samutpannā rakṣaṇārthaṃ gṛhe nije ||75||
yathānyo naiva jānīyāt tathā rarakṣa koṇake |
thūtkārasya sthale dhūlyāṃ khātvā cikṣepa gartake ||76||
nikṣipya ca tato nityaṃ yāti kāryārthameva saḥ |
kṣetre gato’pi smarati dravyaṃ gṛhe surakṣitam ||77||
madhyāhne ca tata āgatyāpi dṛṣṭvā prayāti ca |
sāyamāgatya vīkṣya kṣmāṃ bhuktvā svapiti nityavat ||78||
rātrau nidrāti vai svapne tūrṇaṃ jāgarti śabdane |
cintayā caurahāryasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ vicintakaḥ |||79||
evaṃ nityaṃ sukhā nidrā kṣīṇābhavacchanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
apācanaṃ jāṭhareṇa balakṣayo’pi saṃvṛtaḥ ||3.89.80||
asthairyaṃ mānasasyāpi dravyalagnasya sarvathā |
kārye kṣetre’pi karmālagnatā jātā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||8 1 ||
kāryaṃ sampadyate nyūnaṃ vicittasya dine dine |
tadā vai svāminā pṛṣṭaḥ karṣukeṇa mahātmanā ||82||
kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase bhrānto vihvalo bhūtaveśitaḥ |
kṛṣeḥ karmāpi pūrṇaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi naiva sarvathā ||83||
vetanaṃ naityakaṃ cānnaṃ dāsye nyūnaṃ yathākriyam |
ityuktaḥ sa ca bhṛtyastu kṣaṇaṃ vicintya karṣukam ||84||
prāhātra kāraṇaṃ cāste rūpyakāṇāṃ śatadvayam |
vaṇijārpitamevāste parṇagṛhe mamaiva tat ||85||
taccintācintitaścāhaṃ vibhrāntako bhavāmi ha |
dravyaṃ vai nirayaḥ sākṣānnidrānāśo yato’bhavat ||86||
puṣṭināśaḥ śāntināśaḥ kriyānāśo yato’bhavat |
dravyaṃ sākṣādbhayaṃ cāste mṛtyurdravye pratiṣṭhati ||87||
kālo dravye rājate ca kṣayo dravye virājate |
pratyakṣaṃ narakaṃ dravyaṃ tṛṣṇātantuvivardhakam ||88||
parigraho hi nirayastyāgaḥ svargaṃ paraṃ matam |
śāntirādhyātmikaṃ svargaṃ tyāgo bāhyaṃ svaramṛtam ||89||
dravyaṃ labdhvā mayā svargaṃ nāśitaṃ vā vivāsitam |
tato’haṃ tu yathāpūrvaṃ sukhībhavāmi varjanāt ||3.89.90||
ityuktvā karṣukāyaiva saha nītvā ca karṣukam |
darśayāmāsa koṇe tatpratyakṣaṃ nirayaṃ hyagham ||91 ||
duḥkhaṃ duḥkhakaraṃ śāntiharaṃ śatadvayātmakam |
niṣkāsya gartāt tatsarvaṃ dadau ca vaṇije punaḥ ||92||
dravyaṃ pratyakṣanirayaṃ naiva me rocate vaṇik |
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ nirayaṃ vai dravyarūpaṃ sukhakṣayam || 93||
ityuktvā sampradāyaiva sukhaṃ śete yathāgatam |
punaḥ sukhī hyabhavatsa vitṛṣṇo niṣparigrahaḥ ||94||
sarvasampūrṇakāryāḍhyo yathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat |
tasmāllakṣmi cehaloke duḥkhadā nirayāḥ khalu ||95||
parigrahā hi te sarve duḥkhadā nirayāstviha |
sādhoḥ svargaṃ sadā cāste sahaiva sukhinastataḥ ||96||
nārāyaṇastathā cāhaṃ vasāmi sādhumānase |
mamānandena muditā nijānandena nanditāḥ ||97||
tārayanti janānanyān preṣayantyakṣaraṃ padam |
prajvālayanti pāpāni nirayān praharanti ca ||98||
upādiśanti tattvāni vivekaṃ ca dadatyapi |
bhaktiṃ me kārayitvā ca vidhāya divyabhāvanāḥ ||99||
nārāyaṇasvarūpām̐śca kārayitvākṣaraṃ padam |
prāpayanti subhaktān vai sadā svargapradā hi te || 3.89.10 0||
sevanīyā hi satataṃ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇādapi muktibhāk || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pratyakṣanirayāṇāṃ varṇanam, karṣukabhṛtyadṛṣṭāntena dravyādayaḥ pratyakṣanirayā iti pradarśanam, pratyakṣasvargaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 89 ||

<3.90>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yeṣāṃ svargaṃ hi śāśvatam |
dānadharmayutā nityaṃ devabhaktāḥ śubhāśayāḥ || 1 ||
tapaḥsatyaparāḥ śuddhā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam |
guruśuśrūṣāvadātā vidyāśīlasuśobhanāḥ || 2 ||
pratigrahāgharucayo yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam |
svārthāt kīrterbhayād vyādheḥ kaṣṭād dāridryadūṣaṇāt || 3 ||
jñānāllobhādāśrayācca snehāt sambandhayojanāt |
sahavāsādbhaktimanto yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 4 ||
kṣamādhairyatitikṣāḍhyāḥ satkāryeṣu sadotthitāḥ |
pūjādyācārasampannā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 5 ||
madyamāṃsavyavāyādinivṛttāścauryavarjitāḥ |
devaprasādabhoktāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 6 ||
dharmaśālāprakartāro deśoddhārādikāriṇaḥ |
drumodyānāśramapāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 7 ||
grāmanagarapātāraḥ prajārakṣāvidhāyakāḥ |
āpatsahāyadāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 8 ||
bhūṣāmbarapradātāraścānnapānapradāstathā |
kuṭumbasevakāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 9 ||
hiṃsādrohādinivṛttāḥ soḍhāraścāpadāṃ sadā |
śaraṇasya pradāḥ sarve yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 3.90.10 ||
āśrayadāstathāpekṣyaparyaṃkaśayanapradāḥ |
yānavāhanadātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 11 ||
grāmakṣetrādidātāro gṛhagovṛṣadāstathā |
pātropakaraṇaprādā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 12 ||
vṛddhaṃ guruṃ suraṃ kāntaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ harim |
śuśrūṣayanti sādhvīṃ ca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 13 ||
snehavanto yathāyogyaṃ hitakārāḥ kuṭumbinām |
parārthasādhakāḥ sujñā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 1 4||
dharmāḍhyā mādhavabalā jitatṛṣṇā jitecchavaḥ |
ārādhanaratā dhīrā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 15 ||
aparādhidayāvanto vatsalā mārdavānvitāḥ |
adaṇḍaroṣāḥ śāstrajñā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 16 ||
ātitheyāḥ śaraṇyāśca sahasradāḥ susādhavaḥ |
anekatrāṇakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 17 ||
svarṇarūpyakaratnānāṃ dātāro vāsasāṃ tathā |
mauktikānāṃ pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 18 ||
mahotsaveṣu dravyāṇāṃ vastūnāṃ cārpakāstathā |
yautakādipradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 19 ||
vaivāhikānāṃ vastūnāṃ dīkṣāṃgānāṃ tathā pradāḥ |
dāsadāsīpradāścāpi yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 3.90.20 ||
prapārāmasabhākūpasarasāṃ ca vidhāyakāḥ |
dīrghikāsatrakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 21 | |
kṣetravasatisaudhānāṃ gahvarasaritāṃ tathā |
jalāśayānāṃ dātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 22 ||
kaṇānāṃ dvidalānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ dāyinastathā |
rasānāṃ ca pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 23 ||
miṣṭānnānāṃ phalānāṃ ca kandānāṃ patriṇāṃ tathā |
śākānāṃ ca pradātāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 24||
duḥkhānāṃ hārakā ye ca tāpasantāpanāśakāḥ |
vipadvināśakā lakṣmi yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 25 | |
yatra kvāpi kule jātā api snehasvabhāvinaḥ |
vaṃśavistāravantaśca putrapautrasutānvitāḥ || 26 ||
dayāvantaḥ sādhuśīlā lajjāmaryādayā sthitāḥ |
amṛṣāhṛdayāḥ śāntā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam || 27 ||
parāniṣṭāprakartāro nindādveṣāspṛśo janāḥ |
santuṣṭyā gurusevāḍhyā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||28||
āśīrvādagṛhītāraḥ puṇyakāryaniṣeviṇaḥ |
puṇyasāhāyyakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||29||
pratiṣṭhāyāmalubdhāḥ svagaurave snehavarjitāḥ |
nirmānā dāsavadbhāvā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3.90.30||
nirapekṣā dhanānāṃ ca mahāsantoṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
aparigrahasarvasvā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3 1||
parigrahe sadā cāpyakṛtalambakarānanāḥ |
luñcābhakṣyādiśūnyāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||32||
sarvaghātādiśūnyāśca tathātmaghātavarjitāḥ |
brahmaghātādiśūnyāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||33||
sahadharmasthitā nityaṃ gṛhasthā dharmikarmiṇaḥ |
bhaktidānaparāḥ śuddhā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||34||
śīlavratinaḥ satataṃ vanavratina eva ca |
sannyāsavrataśīlāśca yānti svargraṃ nirāmayam ||35||
kṛtasyāghātakāścāpi viśvāsasyāpyaghātakāḥ |
īṣṭasyāghātakāḥ puṇyā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||36||
lokopakārakārāśca mokṣopakārakārakāḥ |
hitopakārakārāśca yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||37||
śāstropakārakārāśca kalopakārakārakāḥ |
udyogopakārakārā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||38||
navīnayojanāvanto deśavighnanivārakāḥ |
prajāsaukhyaprakartāro yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||39||
aghātā ye sadā santi cāhiṃsāvrataśīlinaḥ |
devāśritāścātmatṛptā yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||3.90.40 ||
aghātayitvā ye santi ghātakākhyā janāstviha |
teṣāṃ saṃgaṃ na kurvanti yānti svargaṃ nirāmayam ||41||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
aghātayitvāpi ca ye ghātakāḥ santi mānavāḥ |
tām̐stān veditumicchāmi pradarśaya hare’tra me |||42||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi tādṛśān mānavānapi |
ahiṃsayitvāpi janā hiṃsakāḥ saṃbhavanti tān ||43||
ghātavaduḥkhado yaḥ syād ghātakaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ |
ghātavat phaladaścāpi ghātakaḥ samprakīrtyate ||44||
bhikṣukaṃ svayamāhūya bhikṣārthe tithivarjitam |
brūyānnāstīti yaḥ kāle vidyād bhikṣuhaṇaṃ tu tam ||45||
nyāyasthitaṃ tu yo rājā daṇḍyaṃ matvā tataḥ param |
vṛttiṃ harati tasmāt sa jīvahā vṛttihārakaḥ ||46||
tṛṣitānāṃ gavāṃ vighnaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ karoti yaḥ |
jalahā goghna evāpi prāṇahā sa bhavediha ||47||
yaśca śāstraṃ niyamām̐śca śāsanaṃ copadeśanam |
hanti cājño dūṣayati nyāyahā śāstrakārahā ||48 ||
nijaputrīṃ yuvatīṃ ca samaye sadṛśe vare |
na prayacchati kanyāhā dharmahā sa bhavediha ||49||
adharmiṣṭhaśca yaḥ sādhudvijapūjyādidehiṣu |
marmabhedaṃ kriyācchokaṃ pūjyahā sa mato bhavet ||3.90.5 0 ||
paṃgorandhasya mūrkhasya nāryāścānāthadehinaḥ |
sarvasvahartā bhavati jīvahā sarvahā tathā ||51 ||
grāmāraṇyavanādau cāśramakṣetragṛhādiṣu |
agnidātā sarvahā vai grāmahā brahmahā mataḥ ||52||
viṣadaścāstranikṣeptā rodhayitā ca mardakaḥ |
pāśado bhayamārgadarśako’niṣṭauṣadhipradaḥ ||53 ||
abhicāraprado mithyākalaṃkado yaśaḥprahā |
rājyahā ca kalāyantrasādhanādyapahārakaḥ ||54||
aṅguṣṭhahā ṛtuhā ca dharmahā yajñahā tathā |
lagnahā pāṭhahā pūjāghātako bhaktighātakaḥ ||55||
garbhahā netrahā hastaghātako liṃgahā tathā |
bījahā muṣkahā jīvyapaśuhāraka iṣṭahā ||56||
gurūṇāṃ dhikpravaktā ca sarve te prāṇaghātinaḥ |
mokṣahā cātmahā prokto nāstiko brahmahā mataḥ ||57||
śīlahā dharmahā proktaḥ pāpakṛt svargahā mataḥ |
satītvadūṣako nārīghnaścokto dharmahā api ||58 ||
brahmaṇaḥ śrīharerbhītiṃ tyaktvā me paramātmanaḥ |
hano bhavanti te tasmāt sarve’pi brahmaghātinaḥ ||59 ||
nirayā yāmyalokā vai teṣāṃ tu śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
pretabhāvāstathā garbhavāsāstiryagbhavādayaḥ ||3.90.6 0 ||
nārakāste narakasthā yatra kvāpi bhavanti vai |
sarvadā duḥkhabhoktāraḥ sukhaleśavivarjitāḥ ||6 1 ||
nahi teṣāmayaṃ lokaḥ svargaṃ naiva kuto’kṣaram |
kintu madbhaktimāsādya taranti kṛpayā cirāt ||62||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
nanu pāpakarāṇāṃ te kṛpā vai jāyate katham |
tatrāpi ghātakānāṃ vai krūrāṇāṃ lokanāśinām ||63 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā me jāyate kṛpā |
kramaṃ te viśadaṃ cātra vakṣyāmi yena mokṣaṇam ||64||
ghātakānāṃ tīvravegavatāṃ śāpā bhavanti vai |
prāṇināṃ śāpaniḥśvāsaiḥ puṇyahānirdrutaṃ bhavet ||65||
śīghraṃ ca duḥkhabhogānāmānantyamupatiṣṭhati |
gṛhaṃ dvārā sutāḥ putryaḥ kuṭumbaṃ paśavo dhanam ||66||
acirādeva naśyanti dāridryaṃ jāyate’saham |
rogā bhayaṃkarāścāpi sarvanāśo’pi jāyate ||67||
annasalilavastrāṇāṃ prāptiḥ sarvā vilīyate |
bhikṣukāḥ kiṃkarā yadvat kadaryāste bhramanti ca ||68||
dhikkārāmaṃgalāḥ sthānahīnā vivāsitāstataḥ |
śvavalloke vibhramanti duḥkhadāridryadharṣitāḥ ||69||
duḥkhānyetāni saṃbhuktvā ciraṃ dhairyavivarjitāḥ |
titikṣārahitā duḥkhadaṇḍairmārdavamāgatāḥ ||3.90.70 ||
śocanti sutarāṃ kvāpi bhāgyaṃ daivaṃ hariṃ tathā |
hṛdaye śaraṇaṃ yānti duḥkhanivārakaṃ prati ||7 1 ||
idaṃ duḥkhamasahyaṃ me līyatāṃ nācare punaḥ |
aho nārāyaṇa duḥkhaṃ mama nāśaya cāsaham ||72||
śaraṇaṃ te patito’smi cāsahyaṃ tvaṃ nivāraya |
dānaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣye satkriyāṃ śubhām ||73 ||
japaṃ sevāṃ satāṃ vāpi kariṣye mānatāṃ hareḥ |
vrataṃ tapo guroścāpi prāyaścittaṃ karomi ca ||74||
ityevaṃ śubhasaṃkalpāḥ prajāyante’vaśasya vai |
rājadaṇḍairlokadaṇḍairdevadaṇḍairvipadgaṇaiḥ ||75||
duḥkhadaṇḍairyāmyadaṇdairmahākaṣṭātikaṣṭakaiḥ |
prajāyante śubhā buddhistato yāti hṛdā harim ||76||
dharmaṃ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ bhaktiṃ japaṃ dānaṃ śubhaṃ prati |
evaṃ śubhaprasaṃgena śubhakriyāvidhāyinā ||77||
manākpuṇyaṃ prāpyate vai pāpadhvaṃso manāṅ manāk |
śanaiḥ puṇyakriyābhiśca suyogāḥ saṃbhavanti ca ||78 ||
satāṃ sevā tīrthasevā paropakāra ārjavam |
bhajanaṃ ghātapāpebhyo bhayaṃ me smaraṇaṃ tathā ||79||
evaṃ cireṇa karaṇairyāti me śaraṇaṃ satām |
sādhavo mama bhaktāśca mantradānaṃ ca mālikām ||3.90.80||
nāmakīrtanabhaktiṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ kārayanti tam |
evaṃ puṇyodaye citte nairmalye ca mumukṣutā ||8 1||
jāyate līyate bubhukṣatā sampadyate śritaḥ |
śiṣyaḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ syācca jijñāsati hariṃ gurum ||82||
kathāsatsaṃgasevābhirvardhate bhajane’niśam |
ārādhanāyāḥ sopānaṃ yathā yathādhirohati ||83||
tathā tathopāsanā me vardhate prabalā sukhā |
evaṃ dagdhāgha eva syāt puṇyaśevadhirityapi ||84||
tato dāsyaṃ mama cāptastataścātmaniveditām |
tataḥ kṛpā me bhavati jāyate paṃktipāvanaḥ ||85||
sādhurvā jāyate bhakto mukto vā jāyate śubhaḥ |
paradhāmārha evāpi jāyate ca maheśvaraḥ ||86||
evaṃ lakṣmi naro nārāyaṇo bhavati sā kṛpā |
kāraṇaṃ tatra boddhavyā mokṣadā manniyojitā ||87||
pāpāḥ pāpatamāścāpi tarantyeva cireṇa ha |
yātanāduḥkhabhogāścāsahyāste gurusadṛśāḥ ||88||
daṇḍā nivartane loke bhavanti hetavaḥ kvacit |
evamārttāḥ prāyaśo māṃ bhajanti bahuduḥkhitāḥ ||89||
arthārthinaśca vai tadvat tarantyapi na saṃśayaḥ |
sādhavastārakāḥ śīghraṃ cen milanti kṛpāvaśāḥ ||3.90.90||
tebhyo datvā manaḥprāṇām̐staranti pāpino’pi ca |
prātaḥ sampūjya sādhūm̐śca vṛddhān praṇamya sarvadā ||9 1||
gurūn samarpya viprām̐śca taranti pāpakoṭitaḥ |
arpayed vastujātaṃ ca toṣayet sādhusattamān ||92||
mama bhaktāḥ śīladharmā niḥspṛhāḥ svādavarjitāḥ |
puṇyābdhayaḥ sādhavo ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||93||
kāmakrodhādirahitāḥ sarvasahā jitendriyāḥ |
tāpasā hitamaitrāśca tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||94||
arāgā jñānavijñānapāragāḥ satyasadvratāḥ |
mokṣamārgaratāḥ santastebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||95||
yeṣāṃ śiṣyāḥ pratīkṣante suvṛṣṭimiva karṣukāḥ |
tebhyo dattaṃ prajāyeta sahasraguṇitaṃ tviha || 96||
śīlacāritrayuktā ye kṛśāyajīvikādayaḥ |
bhikṣukāḥ sādhavo viprāsteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ||97||
svabhaktāḥ svagṛhāvāsāḥ svabalāḥ svāśrayā dvijāḥ |
pāvanāścārthinaścet syusteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ||98||
yasya satrāṇi vidyante baṭavaḥ sādhavo gṛhe |
bhuñjate yasya tasyāpi satre dattaṃ mahāphalam ||99||
hṛtasarvavidhasvāśca bhaktimātraparāyaṇāḥ |
anāthāḥ sādhavo ye syusteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam || 3.90.1 00||
pārāyaṇasthitā yajñasthitā mahotsavasthitāḥ |
tebhyaḥ pūrtyarthamevāpi dattaṃ sarvaṃ mahāphalam || 101 ||
āpatkāle kṛśaprāṇāḥ kṛśadravyāḥ kṛśavratāḥ |
tathāpi sādhuśīlā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 02||
tyāgavantaśca niḥsnehā dambhamānavivarjitāḥ |
sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||1 03||
jāpakā brahmasarvasvā bhaikṣācārāstapasvinaḥ |
santo mṛṣāgandhaśūnyāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 04||
bālāparādhaśūnyāśca cātmāparādhavarjitāḥ |
brahmāparādhaśūnyā ye tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 05||
satāṃ ye tu kṛpāpātrāṇyapi bhaktā harestathā |
sādhvīsantoṣapātrāṇi tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam || 1 06||
ityevaṃ kamale dattvā sādhubhyo dānamuttamam |
annajalāmbarayogyavastvātmakaṃ taret tataḥ || 1 07||
naukā vai sādhavaḥ santi pāpinaḥ prastarāḥ khalu |
sādhunaukāstarantyeva tārayantyapi cāśritān || 1 08||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya ghātapāpapraṇāśanam |
sādhusevāphalaṃ prāpya svargaṃ labheta śāśvatam || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svargagāminaḥ, aghātayitvāpi ghātakinaḥ, kṛpayā kramoddhāraḥ satsevayoddhāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||

<3.91>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca
ghātakināṃ satāṃ yogo yadi naivopajāyate |
kathamuddharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ bhavet kathaya cottamam || 1||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
sādhavaḥ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhā mileyurna tadā bhuvi ||
śreṣṭhatīrtheṣu gantavyamadhvarāvabhṛthe ca vā || 2 ||
kuṃbhasūrye pragantavyaṃ tīrthe snātvā pramucyate |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe gomatītīrthamityapi || 3 ||
svarṇarekhā mahattīrthaṃ nārāyaṇahṛdaḥ svayam ||
hiraṇyāsaṃgamastīrthaṃ somanāthe mahattamam || 4 ||
narmadāsāgarayogaścoṃkāreśvara ityapi ||
śrīśailaścāpi sahyādriḥ paṃpāsarastathottamam || 5 ||
dakṣiṇodadhibhūtīraḥ setuḥ kanyākumārikā ||
godāvarī candrabhāgā kāverī sarayūstathā || 6 ||
gaṃgā ca yamunā brahmaputrā sindhuḥ sarasvatī ||
candravīnā śālavīnā mānapīṃgā tathā sarit || 7 ||
menakāṃgī ca śikṣāṃgī hyaṃgaśikṣāṃgikā tathā |
hoyāṃgahā cāmurā ca vīnā yānākṣikā tathā ||8||
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalākhyasarastathā |
ovī ca terimā dvīnā volgā ca nīparā tathā || 9 ||
nārāyaṇī sarvadīrghā viṣaturyasarovaram |
kaṅgūnadī nāyajīrā cittaṃ tuṃgānikaṃ saraḥ ||3.91.10||
āmajānā sariccāpi miśūrī mīnakaṃjhukī |
sulīvanasaro vinipegaṃ supārayaṃ saraḥ ||11||
erasaraḥ kāruliṃgī tathānyāḥ saritaḥ śubhāḥ |
yatra yatrāhaṃ munibhiḥ saha snātaḥ saritsu vai ||12||
sarovareṣu khāteṣu samudreṣu kṣitau rame  |
tatra tatraiva tīrthasya vidhinā snānatastathā ||13||
ghātapāpani naśyanti punaścennācared yadi |
matpratimāmṛtavārbhiḥ snātaḥ śuddhyati tatkṣaṇāt ||14||
matprasādāśanenāpi mama sevādibhistathā ||
devālayādinirmityā sadyaḥ śuddhyati ghātakaḥ ||15||
mandirādervinirmātā manmūrtisthāpakastathā ||
sādhvarthe prāṇadātā ca dharmārthe prāṇadāyakaḥ ||16||
śuddhyatyeva mahāpāpād ghātakākhyāt samūlataḥ ||
puṣkaraṃ mānasaṃ cāpi himālayo girīśvaraḥ ||17||
badrikāśramatīrthaṃ ca pāvanāni samastataḥ |
mātṛtīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ niṣeveta hyatandritaḥ ||18||
gurutīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ niṣeveta prayatnataḥ ||
kāntatīrthaṃ jñānatīrthaṃ cātmatīrthaṃ tataḥ param ||19||
bhaktitīrthaṃ paraṃ tasmādahaṃ sarvottamottamaḥ ||
māṃ niṣeveta satataṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||3.91.20||
yasya ghātaḥ kṛtastasmai svarṇadānaṃ samarpayet ||
hastidānaṃ rājyadānaṃ grāmadānaṃ samācaret ||21||
vaṃśasya jīvikādānaṃ kanyādānaṃ tathācaret |
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ dadyād ghātavināśakam ||22||
dadyād yadvā svayaṃ svaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ yathānugaṃ yathā |
dāsaṃ yathā yathā śiṣyaṃ yathā krayyaṃ tathārpayet ||23||
tenāpi ghātapāpasya nāśo bhavati padmaje |
yathā toṣo bhavet tacca dadyāt sarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||24||
gṛhaṃ bhūṣāmbarasampatpaśūn dadyāt samastataḥ ||
ghātapāpasya nāśo vai tena saṃjāyate’pi ca ||25||
prabhāsaṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam |
nīlādriṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ kṣetraṃ ca pauruṣottamam ||26||
śuklatīrthaṃ bhṛgutuṅgaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca daṇḍakam |
