vyāghrāraṇyaṃ vipāśāṃ ca karatoyāṃ ca gaṇḍakīm ||27||
karmanāśāṃ devadāruvanaṃ kālaṃjaraṃ tathā |
brahmasaro rāmahṛdaṃ citrakūṭa ca vindhyakam ||28||
evamādīni tīrthāni kṛtvā pāpaṃ vinaśyati |
vikhyāto himavān puṇyaḥ siddhanārāyaṇāśritaḥ ||29||
tatra prāṇī yadi yānti prapūjya devatāmunīn |
śuddhaḥ siddho divaṃ yāyād brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ||3.91.30||
kāmaṃ krodha lobhamohau madaṃ jitvārcya mātaram ||
pitaraṃ ca guruṃ natvā gaṇeśaṃ tīrthamāviśet ||31||
tasya pātakanāśaśca tīrthābhigamanād bhavet |
agamyāni tu tīrthāni smṛtvā pāpamapānudet ||32||
brahma medhyaṃ brahma puṇyaṃ brahma svargyamanuttamam ||
sādhavo brahma cetyuktāḥ pāvanaṃ brahma sarvadā ||33||
tadāśrayaṃ prakuryādvai pāvanāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā ||
devāstu sādhavo yajñamayajanta hariṃ hi mām ||34||
yajñena karmaṇā nityabhajanena ca sevayā ||
sevātmakāni dharmāṇi prathamānyuttamāni ca ||35||
āsam̐stairdharmakāryaiśca māhātmyaṃ prasacanta hai ||
nākaṃ nityānandayuktaṃ dhāma cāpurhi sādhavaḥ ||36||
yatra sādhyā nityamuktā devā vasanti sevakāḥ ||
anādinaśca vai pūrve pūrvatamā vasantyapi ||37||
teṣāmāśrayakaraṇānmuktireva na saṃśayaḥ ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ me lakṣmi śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ ||38||
brahmavidyā bhajanaṃ ca matkathā dhyānamutsavaḥ ||
manmantradānamityebhistārayanti nijāśritān ||39||
śaraṇāgatarakṣā ca mokṣaśca pāpanāśanam |
bhaktilābho brahmaśīlaṃ bhavanti sādhusaṃgamāt ||3.91.40||
idaṃ lakṣmi  mataṃ kaścinmama śrīparamātmanaḥ ||
śṛṇuyāt sa labheddhāma bhajitvā māṃ sataśca me ||41||
santaścāhaṃ nivasāmi viśvapaṭṭasaro’bhitaḥ ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanāmadhṛk ||42||
yatreme lomaśādyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo’pare ||
svataḥprakāśāḥ ṛṣayo vasanti cākṣare tale ||43||
sa deśaḥ pāvano lakṣmi  jalaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñaistyāgena sevayā ||44||
gatiṃ tāṃ na labhedaśvapaṭṭaṃ saṃsevya yāṃ labhet ||
spṛṣṭānyaśvapaṭṭasarojalairgātrāṇi dehinām ||45||
yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhavenmuktirākṣarī me kṛpālavāt |
sarvāṇyaśvapaṭṭasarojalaiḥ kāryāṇi dehinām ||46 ||
karmāṇi te bhuvaṃ tyaktvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
ghātapāpāni sarvāṇi naśyantyaśvasarovare ||47||
yāvadasthi manuṣyasya sarovare’tra tiṣṭhati ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ bhuktvā pramucyate ||48||
cāndrāyaṇasahasrāṇi cāśvapaṭṭajalena vai | |
tulyāni naiva jāyante śreṣṭhaṃ cāśvasarojalam ||49||
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||
lomaśasyāśramaścaite saccidānandarūpiṇaḥ ||3.91.50||
agnau nikṣiptatṛṇavat pāpānyatra sarovare ||
snātasyaiva vinaśyanti mokṣabhāk sa bhavediha ||51||
bhūtānāmiha sarveṣāṃ duḥkhopahatacetasām ||
gatimanveṣyamāṇānāṃ cāśvasaro’dhikā gatiḥ ||52||
anācārāśca ye kecidadharmaśaraṇāśca ye ||
teṣāṃ muktipradaṃ cāśvasarovaraṃ mayāśritam ||53||
aghaiśca prabalairvyāptān pāpinaḥ puruṣādhamān ||
patato narake cāśvasaraḥ smṛtaṃ hi tārayet ||54||
amaṃgalā aśivāśca kalmaṣaiḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ gatāḥ ||
te’śvapaṭṭajale snātvā śivāḥ śuklā bhavanti vai ||55||
kuṃkumavāpikādhūliṃ jano mūrdhnā bibharti yaḥ ||
so’rkarūpastviha bhūtvā yāti brahma sanātanam ||56||
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrānilaḥ spṛśati yaṃ janam ||
tasya pāpmā bahurūpaḥ sadyo naśyati mūlataḥ ||57||
vyasanaiścāpadābhiśca vināśonmukhamānavam ||
darśanādākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ rakṣatyatha punāti tam ||58||
vāṅmanaḥkarmaṇāṃ pāpairgrastaṃ janaṃ tu pāpinam ||
kuṃkumavāpikā tūrṇaṃ smṛtā tārayati dhruvam ||59||
saptāvarān saptaparān pitṝn tārayate saraḥ ||
śrutaṃ pītaṃ vīkṣitaṃ ca spṛṣṭaṃ tathāvagāhitam ||3.91.60||
darśanāt sparśanāt pānācāśvapaṭṭetikīrtanāt ||
punātyapuṇyān puruṣān śataśaśca sahasraśaḥ ||61||
utkrāmadbhiśca yaḥ prāṇaiḥ smaret lomaśīṃ bhūmikām ||
namet hṛdāpi sahasā sa gatiṃ paramāṃ vrajet ||62||
na kālācca bhayaṃ tasya na pāpebhyo yamāttathā |
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnātasyaiva mokṣārthinastviha ||63||
śṛṇu lakṣmi  dvijatvaṃ vipratvaṃ sādhutvamityapi |

ātmastho’haṃ cāntarātmā tīrthatrayaṃ hi tārakam ||

jalabhojanadānādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
naivedyārpaṇagandhāḍhyāmbarakuṃkumasatphalaiḥ||69||
ārārtrikanamaḥ pradakṣiṇastutikṣamāpanaiḥ |

prapāsatrādikaraṇaṃ dānakṣetrādirakṣaṇam |
vṛddhānāṃ mānanaṃ nityaṃ cāśritānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam ||74||
daivaṃ paitryaṃ sādhavaṃ ca satkāryaṃ sveṣṭadaivikam ||
daiśikaṃ jñānadānādi bhaktidānādikaṃ tathā ||75||
evamādīni kurvīta satkāryāṇi śubhāni vai ||

bhuktirmuktiḥ kare tasya kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||77||
purā kaścid dvijāputro nāmnā kṛśāṃga aicchikam |

daṇḍena tāḍayāmāsa tīvraśaṃkuyutena vai ||

tad dṛṣṭvā mahiṣī mātā saśokā putragṛddhinī |
śocantaṃ taṃ sutaṃ prāha mā śucaḥ putra  pāpini ||3.91.80||
nāyaṃ dvijo bhavatyeṣaścāṇḍālo vāhakastava |
dvije dāruṇatā nāsti dvijo maitro bhavet sadā ||81||
dvijaḥ sattvayutaḥ syāddhi dayāvān rakṣakastathā ||
ahiṃsro bhaktisampannaḥ sarveṣvātmasamaḥ śuciḥ ||8||
adoṣe daṇḍapāte tu cāṇḍālo lubdhako’thavā |
pravartate ghātakaśca krūro nirdaya udvṛṣaḥ ||83||
ayaṃ pāpo dayāhīnaḥ svajātiṃ tvanuvartate ||
śrutvaivaṃ dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ mahiṣyāstu kṛśāṃgakaḥ ||84||
papraccha mahiṣīṃ natvā brūhi jānāsi māṃ yadi ||
mātā me brāhmaṇī cāste kena vā dūṣitā bhavet ||85||
cāṇḍālo hi kathaṃ cāhaṃ mahiṣi  śaṃsa me drutam |

kṣetre sasyānvite rātrai śayyāyāṃ te pitustadā |

durguṇāste niṣekādvai vartante ghātamārakāḥ ||

kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha cāṇḍālaścāhaṃ vipratvakāṃkṣayā |
tapāmi dehi vipratvaṃ pitṛdoṣaṃ nivāraya ||95||
mahendraḥ prāha taṃ cāho vipratvaṃ durlabhaṃ tava ||
pitṛdoṣeṇa bījaṃ tvaṃ śuddho bhavituṃ nārhasi ||96||
pravinaṃkṣyasi pratyuta tadupārama yatnataḥ ||
pāvitryaṃ prāpyate cāpi cāṇḍālatvaṃ na naśyati ||97||
evamuktvā yayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgastu sthitastathā ||
tapasyeva nidhanārthaṃ vaipryārthaṃ vā dṛḍhakriyaḥ ||98||
atiṣṭhadekapādenāparaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā |
punaścendraḥ samāgatyovāca virama yatnataḥ ||99||
brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ caitat sāhasena vinaṅkṣyasi |
nahi śakyaṃ niṣekasthaṃ vṛṣalatvaṃ vyapohitum ||3.91.100||
evaṃsthite tapoyatnaḥ śīghraṃ tvaṃ na bhaviṣyasi ||
tiryagyonigataḥ sarvo yadi mānuṣyamṛcchati ||101||
kenacit puṇyayogena cāṇḍālo jāyate purā ||
tataḥ sahasrakālānte śūdratvaṃ vindate muhuḥ ||102||
atha kālāntare vaiśyo muhurbhūtvā tataḥ param ||
kṣatriyaḥ puṇyayogena jāyate ca tataḥ param ||103||
brahmabandhuśca kālena tato vipraḥ prajāyate |
tataḥ kālāntare syācca śrotriyaśca tataḥ param ||104||
vipradharmān pālayitvā titikṣuḥ sādhutāṃ vrajet ||
tatra ceddharṣaśokau ca kāmadveṣau kṛśāṃgakaḥ ||105||
atimānātivādau cāviśete pātyate tu taiḥ ||
tasmātte vṛṣalotthatvaṃ dūraṃ na syāt kadācana ||106||
ityuktvā prayayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgaśca tato dṛḍhaḥ |
sahasravarṣamaparaṃ caikapadā hyatiṣṭhata ||107||
brahmacaryaparaḥ śuddho gṛṇan brahma sanātanam |
athāyayau mahendraśca prāha varaṃ vṛṇu dhruvam ||108||
kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha śīlaṃ me sahasravarṣamuttamam ||
tena me dīyatāṃ vipratvaṃ mahendra na cāparam ||109||
indraḥ prāha paraṃ kāmaṃ vṛṇīṣva mā tu vipratām ||
cāṇḍālabījajātasya vṛthā te’yaṃ pariśramaḥ ||3.91.110||
ityuktvā prayayāvindraḥ kṛśāṃgaśca tataḥ param ||
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prāpyātiṣṭhad varṣasahasrakam ||111||
vāyumātrāśanaḥ kṛśo’bhavacchuṣkastaruryathā |
papātorvyāṃ maraṇāya tāvadindra upāyayau ||11||
jagrāha patitaṃ cainaṃ varadānadayāparaḥ ||
prāha varaṃ vṛṇīṣvātra dadāmi te kṛśāṃgaka  ||113||
kṛśāṃgako varaṃ vavre brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me sadā ||
indraḥ prāha na te tadvai durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ kvacit ||114||
koṭivarṣatapobhiśca prāpyate na tu sarvathā |
brāhmaṇebhyo’nutṛpyante pitaro devatādayaḥ ||115||
bhūdevo brāhmaṇaścāste brāhmaṇyaṃ tava durlabham ||
anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ pūjyatvaṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ ca vā ||116||
kṛśāṃgaḥ prāha cendra  tvaṃ samartho naiva dṛśyase ||
kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhāḍhyaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase katham ||117||
dvijatvaṃ tu tribhirvarṇaiḥ prāpyate guṇakarmabhiḥ |
dvijatvaṃ cāpi vipratvaṃ samānaṃ guṇakarmabhiḥ ||118||
upavītena dvijanmā vijñānena ca vipratā|
brahmayogena tatraiva brāhmaṇatvaṃ prakīrtitam ||119||
niṣṭhayā brahmaṇi brahmiṣṭhatā mokṣe tu sādhutā |
ityevaṃ guṇayogena sarvaṃ bhavati sādhitam ||3.91.120||
vahnipākena . pṛthivī bahuratnottamottamā ||
puṇyapākena dehāśca viprasādhusvarūpiṇaḥ ||121||
guṇaiḥ paśurguṇairyakṣo rākṣaso’pi guṇairiha |
vipro guṇaiḥ kṣatriyādiḥ sādhurguṇaiśca muktarāṭ ||122||
naro nārāyaṇaścāpi karmaguṇaiḥ prajāyate |
śocyastvaṃ naiva jānīṣe brāhmaṇyaṃ dhanamuttamam ||123||
labdhvāpi naiva jānīṣe kṣatro bhavasi mānavān |
na yogyastvaṃ varaṃ dātuṃ yāhi śakra  nijālayam ||124||
vipraguṇān samāsthāya kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām |
tapasā me mātṛdoṣaḥ pitṛdoṣaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ ||125||
brāhmaṇo’smi na sandeho yāhi śakra  nijālayam |
evamukto mahendro vai lakṣmi  dadau varaṃ śubham ||126||
kṛśāṃga  tvaṃ tapobhiśca śuddho’si pāvito’syapi |
kṛśānuragnirūpastvaṃ brahmakṣatrātmako bhava ||127||
sarvapūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā pūjyaḥ surottamaḥ |
viprottamaśca brahmiṣṭho bhava kalpāntareṣvapi ||128||
guṇaistvayārjitaṃ cātra vipratvaṃ ca guṇaistataḥ |
brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ sadā prāptaṃ cāgnitvaṃ prāptameva ha ||129||
ityevaṃ varadānaṃ tu datvā śakro yayau divam |
kṛśāṃgo’bhūt kṛśānuśca hyaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 3.91.130||
kṛśānutīrthamatrāste rame  brahmiṣṭhatāpradam |
sādhutvaṃ pāvanatvaṃ nirlepatvaṃ prāpyate’tra vai ||131||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne ghātakināṃ tīrthayogena pāvanatvaṃ, jaṃgamatīrthaṃ sādhujanādayaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarovare purā dvijāputrasya kṛśāṃgasya vṛṣalodbhavasya cāṇḍālatve’pi tapobhiścendravareṇa brahmiṣṭhatvabrāhmaṇyamayaṃ kṛśānutvaṃ cābhavadityādinirūpaṇanāmā caikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||

<3.92>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vacanādapi |
anyajāteḥ purā jātaṃ tathā loke bhaviṣyati || 1 ||
divodāso mahābhakto’bhavad vārāṇasīnṛpaḥ |
haihayairekadā yuddhe jito yayau prayāgakam || 2 ||
bharadvājaṃ bṛhaspateḥ putramṛṣiṃ nanāma saḥ |
duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa tataḥ ṛṣiḥ pratāpataḥ || 3 ||
putreṣṭyā ca suto jāto divodāsasya yoṣiti |
pratardanaḥ sa gatvā ca yuvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 4 ||
yuyudhe haihayaiḥ sākaṃ parājitāstu haihayāḥ |
palāyanaparā bhṛgoḥ śaraṇaṃ cāśrame gatāḥ || 5 ||
pratardano yayau pṛṣṭhe prāha bhṛguṃ praṇamya ca |
dehi me śatrubhūpālān vītahavyādihaihayān || 6 ||
teṣāṃ vadhād bhaviṣyāmyanṛṇaḥ pituḥ kṛpāṃ kuru |
bhṛguḥ prāha kṛpāviṣṭaḥ kṣatriyā nātra santi vai || 7 ||
pratardanaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtakṛtyo’smi vai bhṛgo |
rājāno’pi ca vīryeṇa svajātiṃ tyājitā mayā || 8 ||
pratardano bhṛguṃ natvā vītahavyaṃ nṛpaṃ dvijam |
vipraṃ bhṛgorvacanena prāṇarakṣaṇahetave || 9 ||
tyaktvā yayau nijāṃ rājadhānīṃ vārāṇasīṃ tataḥ |
bhṛgorvacanamātreṇa vītahavyo’pi haihayaḥ || 3.92.10 ||
bhayena kṣatrabhāvaṃ saṃtyaktvā brahmarṣitāṃ gataḥ |
tasya putro gṛtsamado viprarṣirvaidiko’bhavat || 11 ||
tasya dvijaḥ sutejāśca vihavistasya vai dvijaḥ |
tasya vitatyastasya tu satyastasya śravādvijaḥ || 1 2||
tasya ṛṣistasya putraḥ prakāśastasya vācikaḥ |
tasya pramitirvipraśca tasya ruruḥ suviprakaḥ || 13 ||
tasya śunakastasyaiva śaunako viprasattamaḥ |
evaṃ sādhormaharṣeśca vacanād vipratā tathā || 14||
brahmaṇyatā bhavatyeva dīkṣayāpi bhavettathā |
dīkṣayā trivarṇajātā bhavanti brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 15 ||
sādhavo vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve viprā acyutagotrajāḥ |
evaṃ guṇairvacasā ca dīkṣayā vipratā bhavet || 16 ||
brāhmaṇasya gṛhe tiṣṭhannābālyād yadi saṃskṛtaḥ |
brāhmaṇo jāyate so’pi gṛhītoṃ’ke dvijena saḥ || 17||
stanyapo bālako yena vardhito’nnajalādibhiḥ |
tajjātiṃ samavāpnoti brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇo bhavet || 18||
tapasā ca camatkārairāśīrvādaiśca vai dvijāḥ |
jāyante brāhmaṇāścāpi dharmakarmādiśobhanāḥ || 1 9||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathānyacca samartho vyākaroti hi |
śaṃkareṇa kṛto nandī mānavo’pi gaṇo nijaḥ ||3.92.20 ||
ramābdhijā tu hariṇā kṛtā nārāyaṇī nijā |
viśvāmitreṇa narapaḥ triśaṃkurdevatākṛtaḥ ||2 1||
kṛtā harādyāḥ kṛṣṇena goloke gopikāḥ striyaḥ |
māsi māsi ca sudyumno’bhavannaro’balā tathā ||22||
ardhanārīśvaraḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇuśca mohinī tathā |
narabījaṃ sarvasṛṣṭau sutā suto’pi jāyate || 23||
devaputrā mānavāśca kāśyapyaḥ sarvaśaḥ prajāḥ |
evaṃ bīje’pi vaivarttyaṃ jāyate jātirodhakam || 24||
svedajāścāpi jāyante sarve vijātayaḥ khalu |
jaḍebhyaśca jaḍāścāpi vijātayo bhavantyapi |||25||
tasmājjātirna niyatā sāpekṣā guṇakarmabhiḥ |
sādhutvaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prāptavyaṃ śubhakarmabhiḥ || 26||
śṛṇu lakṣmi nahuṣo’bhūt sarpastenaiva varṣmaṇā |
agastyasya praśāpena vahamānasya taṃ nṛpam ||27||
kalpāṣapādaḥ sahasā vaśiṣṭhaśāpato’bhavat |
rākṣaso dvādaśavarṣāṇyacarat sa vanāntare |||28||
ahalyā cābhavat patyuḥ śāpācchilā punaśca sā |
vṛndābhavattūlasī sā vṛkṣarūpā kṣaṇāntare ||29||
hariḥ śālagrāmarūpaḥ kālī gaurī tathābhavat |
śanaiścaraḥ pannatitvaṃ prāptaścendro biḍālatām ||3.92.3 0||
harirmatsyādirūpaśca vahniḥ suvarṇarūpadhṛk |

śataputrajanako’pi strītvamāpto yathārthataḥ |
punaḥ sā ṛṣibhāryābhūcchataputraprasūrvane || 32||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca

śrotumicchāmi kāntātra kathāṃ tāṃ vada me hare || 33 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
purā bhaṃgāsvano nāma rājarṣirdharmavān śuciḥ |
anapatyaḥ sa putreṣṭiṃ samācarat kratuṃ śubham ||34||
indrapradhānabhāvasyāsattvādindro ruṣā jvalan |

vyacintayanmukhaṃ kīdṛg darśayiṣye pure mama |
śataputrā mama santi tānpravakṣyāmi kintvidam ||3.92.40||
evaṃ sa duḥkhito rājā cāśvamāruhya kṛcchrataḥ |
lajjāṃ vihāya nagarīṃ yayāvaśvena vai ca tam ||41 ||
putrā dārāśca bhṛtyāśca paurā jānapadāstadā |
dṛṣṭvā kiṃ tvidamevetyāścaryaṃ ca vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||42||
sa uvāca mṛgayārthaṃ vanāntarasarovare |
gataḥ snātastāvatāhaṃ strītvamāpanna eva ha ||43||
putrebhyo mama rājyaṃ sampradadāmi vanaṃ tataḥ |
prayāmītyabhidhāyaiva dattvā rājyaṃ yayau vanam ||44||
strīrūpā sā ṛṣeḥ patnī hyabhavat svarvahasya tu |
svarvaharṣeḥ śata putrā rājñyāṃ tasyāṃ tato’bhavat ||45||
sā tānādāya rājyaṃ svaṃ yayau pūrvasutān prati |
prāha yūyaṃ puruṣatve sutāḥ strītve sutāstvime ||46||
ekatra bhujyatāṃ rājyaṃ bhrātṛbhāvena putrakāḥ |
pitṛmātṛvaco matvā rājyaṃ bubhujire saha ||47||
athendrastatra cāgatya bhedayāmāsa pūrvajān |
pitṛputrā rājyayogyāḥ strīputrā na kadācana ||48||
strīputrāḥ santi viprā vai na te’rhanti nṛpāspadam |
tata uttarajānāha bhavantaścottamāḥ khalu ||49||
pūrvajāḥ kṣatriyāḥ santi bhavaddāsā hi te matāḥ |
mā rājyaṃ te prakurvantu rājyayogyā hi bhūsurāḥ || 3.92.50 ||
ityanyonyaṃ kārayitvā vairaṃ yuddhena nāśitāḥ |

indrastvāgatya tāmāha kena duḥkhena rodiṣi |

yuddhena naṣṭaṃ viprendra śocāmi tām̐śca rodimi |

śrutvā rājñī nipapāta pādayoḥ kṣama cāha vai |

varaṃ vṛṇu naratvaṃ nārītvaṃ vā yat prakāṃkṣase |

indraḥ prāha kathaṃ strītve viśeṣābhiniveśanam |

abalā cehate kāntaṃ rāmakaṃ ramaṇotsukam ||65 ||

pūjyante mānamarhanti mohagarvaṃ vidanti ca ||68||

iṣañca kurute sevāṃ nirlajjāstaṃ hi bhuñjate |

sūryodayasya prākaṭyaṃ hyānandasya tu mūrchanā ||89||
śoko mṛtaikaputrasya maurkhyamuṣṭrasya vai tathā |
mārdavaṃ coraṇasyāpi taikṣṇyaṃ kṣurasya vai tathā ||3.92.90||
ete dharmāḥ pramadāsu vartante vai viśeṣataḥ |
pūrve sarge tadā nāryaḥ sādhvyaḥ satya ihābhavan || 91 ||
svayaṃ prajā devasamā āsan yānti divaṃ hi tāḥ |
tato mānavamohārthamasādhvīrviśvamohinīḥ ||92||
brahmāsṛjat kriyāhīnāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ |
śayyāsanamalaṃkāramannapānamanāryatām ||93||
durvāgbhāvaṃ cograratiṃ dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
tairdharmaiḥ rakṣituṃ śakyā naiva nāryaḥ kathaṃcana | |94||
tathāpi lakṣmi jāyante tapovratopavāsanaiḥ |
satāṃ sevādibhirnāryaḥ pavitrā lokapāvanāḥ || 96||
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāḥ sādhvyo bhavanti yogataḥ |
doṣān dagdhvā hṛṣīkāvanmuktā jāyanta eva tāḥ ||96 ||
yatra kvāpi kule jātā viprāśritā dvijāstu tāḥ |
sādhvīdīkṣānvitāstāstu sādhvyaḥ satyo dvijāśca tāḥ || 97| |
yogadīkṣānvitā viprā yoginyastā hi devatāḥ |
sāṃkhyayogānvitāstāstu muktānyo brahmayoṣitaḥ ||98||
hareḥ patnītvamāpannā brāhmaṇyastā haripriyāḥ |
tyāginyastyāgamāpannā brahmapriyāḥ sadā matāḥ ||99||
gopālakanyā brahmāṇaṃ prāpya gāyatrikābhavat |
pūjyā vandyā brāhmaṇī sā brahmāṇī lokamātṛkā || 3.92.100 ||
śvapacasya sutā prāpya vasiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇī śubhā |
ārṣī cārundhatīnāmnī pūjyā pativratābhavat || 101 ||
kanyāstu bahuvarṇānāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya ca gopikāḥ |
kārṣṇyo jātāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā striyaḥ śuddhyanti yogataḥ || 1 02||
rākṣasyo devamāsādya devyo bhavanti sarvathā |
paulomī vai mahendraṃ tu samāsādya hi devatā || 1 03||
devyapi devayānī ca kṣatramāsādya mānavam |
yayātergṛhiṇī bhūtvā mānavī sā vyajāyata || 1 04||
dakṣaputryaśca kāścittu cāndryo devyo’bhavan divi |
dharmapatnyo devatāśca brāhmaṇyaḥ ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ || 1 05||
manupatnyastu mānavyaḥ kāśyapyo bahujātayaḥ |
jātāstasmānna vai strīṇāṃ jātitvaṃ niyataṃ kvacit || 1 06||
kimatra bahunoktena mama patnyo’rvudārbudāḥ |
sarvabhūsvaḥsatyamadvarjanapātāladehijāḥ ||107||
sarvajātisamutpannā madyogād viprajātayaḥ |
yajñopavītadhāriṇyo brahmapriyā ramā iva || 1 08||
bhavatya santi cātraivākṣarakṣetre mayā saha |
brāhmaṇyaḥ sarvapūjyā vai divyā madrūpadhārikāḥ || 1 09||
sarvā vai pārameśvaryaḥ pauruṣottamya īśikāḥ |
pāvanyaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ śrībhūgaṃgā iva priyāḥ || 3.92.11 0||
tasmāllakṣmi mama yogānnārāyaṇī yathā bhavet |
devayogācca devī vai sādhavī sādhuyogataḥ || 111 ||
viprayogācca viprāṇī brāhmaṇī brahmayoginī |
muktayogācca muktānī siddhiḥ siddhaprayogiṇī || 1 12||
gaṇayogācca gaṇikā yogiyogācca yoginī |
īśayogādīśvarāṇi manoryogāttu mānavī || 113 ||
nāryaścaivaṃ prajāyante satyayogāt satī sadā|
tatra sarvatra śreṣṭho’haṃ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 1 14||
mama yogena ca pauruṣottamītvaṃ parātparam |
prāptavyaṃ māṃ bhajitvaiva sādhvītvaṃ sādhusevayā || 1 15||
mokṣa eva bhaved yasmāt tadgṛhaṃ śāśvataṃ sadā |
aśāśvataṃ vihāyaiva śāśvataṃ samupāśrayet || 1 16||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya brāhmītvaṃ ceha jāyate |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi nārāyaṇītvamīyate || 1 17||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nyajātīnāmapi guṇavratācāradīkṣāvaraśāpalagnādiyogena tattajjātiparivartanaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ ca jāyate’trārthe’nekanidarśanāni bhaṅgāsvananṛpasya nārītve nidarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||

<3.93>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmīha saṃsāre durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ vrataiḥ |
tapobhiścāśiṣā cāpi sevayā cārpaṇena ca || 1 ||
brahmayogabalasyāgre balānyanyāni sarvaśaḥ |
nimnāyante brahmacaryabalāgre iva padmaje || 2 ||
kathayāmi kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śīlaprarakṣiṇīm |
śiṣyeṇa yoginā bhāryā guroḥ śīle prarakṣitā || 2 ||
devaśarmāṃbhavad vipro maharṣirvai surāṣṭrake |
tasya patnī rucināmnī rūpeṇa rādhikāsamā || 4 ||
guṇairlakṣmīsamā divyayauvanā devatottamā |
tasyā rūpeṇa conmattā devāḥ siddhāśca mānavāḥ || 5 ||
ajāyanta viśeṣeṇa mahendro mohamāptavān |
vyacintayat sadā tāṃ tu samārabdhuṃ kṣaṇāntare || 6 ||
devaśarmāpi nārīṇāṃ svabhāvajño yathābalam |
rarakṣa tāṃ nijāvāse naikāntaṃ pradadau kvacit || 7 ||
indro muhuḥ samāyātyāśramopānte gaveṣukaḥ |
tasyā lābhārthamevāpi naivālabhata tatkṣaṇam || 8 ||
bibheti vipraśāpādvai dṛṣṭipathaṃ na gacchati |
pracchannaśca prayātyeva rūpāntarairanekadhā || 9 ||
devaśarmā tapoyogājjānātīndraṃ gaveṣiṇam |
kāmukaṃ viharantaṃ ca vanopānte vicāriṇam || 3.93.10 ||
athaikadā ṛṣirlakṣmi vrataṃ kartumanā nijam |
śiṣyamāhūya vipulaṃ dayitaṃ brahmayoginam || 11 ||
samarthaṃ rakṣaṇe cāpi dharmasthaṃ vacanasthitam |
vrate me vartate vṛttiścāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 12||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gamiṣyāmi vratānvitaḥ |
cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā cāgamiṣyāmi vai tataḥ || 13 ||
ruciṃ surūpāṃ patnīṃ me mahendro bhoktumicchati |
nityaṃ rakṣasva cainaṃ tvaṃ śīlabhaṃgo na vai bhavet || 14||
pātivratyaṃ na naśyeccāpramatto bhava cendrakam |
indraścātra samāyāti bahurūpadharo’niśam || 15||
kvacit kirīṭī vajradhṛk kvaciddhanvī ca daṇḍavān |
muhūrtena tu cāṇḍālaḥ śikhī vipro jaṭī vratī || 16||
cīravāsāḥ kvacit sthūlaḥ kṛśo’tithiḥ kvacittathā |
tāpaso gauravarṇo vā śyāmaḥ kvacidvanecaraḥ || 17||
bālo vṛddho vicitto vā kṣatro vaiśyo’pi dāsakaḥ |
śuko vā vāyaso haṃso mṛgo vyāghro bhavatyapi || 18||
rājā devo’thavā daityo bhavatyeva ca mūṣakaḥ |
yathā rucyo bhaved yogastathā pravartate hi saḥ ||1 9||
makṣikā maśakaścāpi puṣpavallī bhavatyapi |
evaṃbhūto mahendraḥ sa dṛśyate yogacakṣuṣā ||3.93.20||
sa tvaṃ yogyo’si rakṣaināṃ cāpramatto hi taṃ prati |
yathā ruciṃ nāvalihet tathendraṃ prati jāgṛhi ||21 ||
vipulaśca gurorvākyaṃ matvā cintāparo’bhavat |
māyāvī vīryavānindro durdharṣo bahurūpadhṛk ||22||
kathaṃ mayā rakṣitavyā gurvī vidhāya cāśramam |
vicārya bahudhā kāyāveśaṃ śreṣṭhamamanyata ||23||
anyairna pauruṣeṇeyaṃ na śakyā rakṣituṃ yataḥ |
so’haṃ yogabalenaināṃ rakṣiṣyāmi vapusthitaḥ ||24||
iti nirṇīya vipulaḥ praviveśa samādhinā |
kalevare gurupatnyā uvāsa ca samāhitaḥ ||25||
asaktaḥ padmapatrasthajalabindusamo’bhavat |
gurvyā dehe nijaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥ |||26||
sthalaṃ tu vyāpakaṃ dehaṃ līnaṃ kṛtvā tu yogataḥ |
sthūlenāpi viveśāsau gurvīdehe’bhitaḥ khalu ||27||
evaṃ viṣṭabhya vipulo hyuvāsa sā viveda na |
cāturmāsyaṃ tu sampūrṇaṃ mātaraṃ so’bhyarakṣata ||28||
uvāsāceṣṭamānaḥ sa chāyevāntarhito’niśam |
indro divyasvarūpaḥ san praviveśa yuvāśramam ||29||
lobhanīyatamo bhūtvā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ |
ruciṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ candrakāntisamadyutim ||3.93.3 0||
komalāṃ yuvatīṃ cāgre dṛṣṭvā mohamavāsṛjat |
sūkṣmātisūkṣmavastrāntopasthadarśanamohitā ||3 1 ||
vismitā cātirūpeṇa ko’sīti vaktumicchukī |
pratyutthātumiyeṣāpi viṣṭabdhā vipulena sā |||32|||
utthātuṃ na śaśākaiva nigṛhītā samādhinā |
indrastāṃ samprahasyāha yuvatīṃ dattamānasām ||32||
tvadarthaṃ tvāgataścātra mahendro devatādhipaḥ |
ratiṃ dehi samāyāhi vimāne śīghrameva me ||34||
kintu sā na śaśākaivotthātuṃ vaktuṃ ca kiṃcana |
vipulaḥ sarvamājñāya dvayostatra viceṣṭitam ||35||
babandha yogabandhaiḥ sa tasyāḥ sarvendriyāṇi ha |
athāceṣṭāṃ nirvikārāṃ dṛṣṭvendro vrīḍito’pi tām || 36||
ehyehīti punaḥ prāha tadā tu vipulaḥ khalu |
śarīrasthaḥ pratyuvāca bhoḥ kimāgamanaṃ tava ||37||
purandaro vicāryaiva nirmanaskottaraṃ tadā |
avaikṣata divyadṛṣṭyā dehasthaṃ vipulaṃ munim ||38||
ghoratapasvinaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāpabhītaḥ purandaraḥ |
pravepatābhavat stabdho jaḍatulyaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ||39||
tūrṇaṃ tu vipulo dehānniṣkramyendraṃ samabravīt |
duṣṭamānasa duṣṭātman pāpabuddhe surādhama ||3.93.40||
mānuṣīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ dharmād bhraṃśayitumanā bhavān |
samāgato’sti daṇḍyo’sti kintu tyajāmi gaccha vai ||41 ||
gautamena bhagāṃkastvaṃ kṛtastadvismṛtaṃ nu kim |
jāne tvāṃ duṣṭaceṣṭaṃ tanmayeyaṃ rakṣyate tataḥ |||42||
yāhi śīghraṃ gururme tvāṃ mā nirdahed ruṣāgninā |
mā kadācitpunaścaivaṃ kuru kṣayanimantraṇam ||43||
amarasyāpi mṛtyurvai tapasākasmiko bhavet |
na devo na ca vipro vā sādhoragre pratiṣṭhati ||44||
sādhuścāhaṃ brahmaśīlo yogo nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ |
guroḥ sevāṃ karomyatra gurvyāśca rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ||45||
brahmacārī bhavāmyeva tava nigrahaṇe kṣamaḥ |
yāhītyuktaśca devendraḥ santrastaḥ prayayau divam | |46||
evaṃ sa vipulo nityaṃ rakṣatyeva hi mātaram |
athaikadā tu sandhyāyāṃ rākṣaso lomamarṣaṇaḥ ||47||
āgatastāṃ satīṃ hartuṃ vipulastatra tiṣṭhati |
tūrṇaṃ gurvī samuttolya skandhe kṛtvāmbare yayau ||48 ||
vipulaḥ sahasā vīkṣyotapātāmbaravartmanā |
jagrāha rākṣasaṃ lomamarṣaṇaṃ ca gale tadā ||49||
pāśaṃ kṛtvā rurodhāsya prāṇān gurvīṃ rarakṣa ca |
rākṣasaśca vyasurbhūtvā papātorvyāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ | |3.93.50 | |
gurvīmuttolya cākāśe śanairurvyāmavātarat |
vipulaḥ praṇanāmāpi mātaraṃ ca rarakṣa ha | |51 | |
athaikadā samudrasthaḥ kapardako mahāsuraḥ |
bhramannākāśamārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā ruciṃ nijāśrame | |52 | |
viharantīṃ vṛkṣamūle jalasecanakāriṇīm |
avātatāra sahasā vyomno mohagataśca tām | |53 ||
prasahya parijagrāha ruciṃ yayau tato’mbare |
vipulo vegataḥ pṛṣṭhe vyomavāṭena cādravat | |54 | |
sahasāgṛhya taṃ duṣṭaṃ kapardakaṃ punarbalāt |
muṣṭighātena śirasi mārayāmāsa naikadhā ||55 ||
brahmarandhaṃ bibhedāsya kapardakasya cāmbare |
mastakaṃ veśathāmāsa galāntare tato’suraḥ ||56 ||
mṛtiṃ yayau nijāṃ gurvīṃ nītvā vyomnā drutaṃ hi saḥ |
vipulaścāyayau parṇakuṭīṃ śānto’bhavattadā || 57 ||
evaṃ rarakṣa tāṃ devīṃ cāturmāsye muhurmuhuḥ |
ekadā sa gurustasya parīkṣārthaṃ surūpiṇī ||58 ||
dvitīyā tu rucirbhūtvā nirjane tu tamomaye |
vipulaṃ parijagrāha dhotraprānte ratīcchayā ||59 ||
vipulaḥ śīlasampanno jñātvā rucyāstu vikṛtim |
svayaṃ pāṣāṇarūpo’bhūd yogaiśvaryeṇa puttalaḥ ||3.93.6 0 ||
athāpi sā ruciḥ samāśliṣat pāṣāṇaputtalam |
tadā vahniṃ puttalādvai dāhakaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram || 61 ||
śīghramutpādayāmāsa vipulaḥ sā dadāha ca |
tatyāja vipulaṃ rucisvarūpo gururutsukaḥ || 62||
evaṃ vai śīlarakṣāyāṃ sāvadhānaṃ suśiṣyakam |
vīkṣya tutoṣa gururāṭ tataścādṛśyatāṃ yayau ||6 3 ||
nedaṃ jānāti vipulo rakṣatyeva ruciṃ sadā |
evaṃ tu vigataṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ gurostataḥ ||64||
vratotthitāya gurave nyavedayat samastakam |
yathā vighnānyāgatāni yathā dūrīkṛtāni ca || 6 5||
tutoṣa gururāṭ samyak śrutvā śīlasya rakṣaṇam |
prāha prīto’smi te śiṣya śīlaṃ rakṣitavān yataḥ ||66 ||
kṛtavān yogarītyā cāviśyāpi strītanau sthitam |
rakṣaṇaṃ duṣṭadevācca rākṣasebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||6 7||
svayaṃ spṛśasi naivāpi spṛhāvatīṃ ruciṃ tathā |
ato’haṃ te prasanno’smi sadā muktaḥ sukhī bhava ||68 ||
yadi tvahaṃ tvāṃ durvṛttamadrākṣaṃ śiṣyasattama |
śapeyaṃ tvāmahaṃ tatra kintu tvaṃ dharmadhairyavān ||69||
vijayaṃ sarvathā prāptaḥ sādhustvameva vartase |
tvādṛśānāṃ sevanācca mokṣo dhruvo bhaviṣyati ||3.93.70||
tvādṛśāḥ sādhavo loke durlabhā mohavarjitāḥ |
svayaṃ prāptā parityaktā rucistvayopalātmanā ||7 1||
svajano puruṣaṃ nāryo bhrāmakaśced bhaveddhi saḥ |
sādhuścet sa bhavet tatra nārī dharme vasettadā ||72||
sādhusaṃgaḥ sādhutāṃ ca karoti śīlarakṣiṇīm |
asādhusaṃgamo hanti satītvaṃ sādhutāṃ tathā ||73||
asādhusaṃgatirdharmanāśinī duḥkhadāyinī |
asatsaṃgo vṛṣaṃ hanti cāvṛṣaṃ satkaroti ca ||74||
adharmāgamato vṛttirbuddhirmano’ghakarmasu |
pravartante tataścātmā kalmaṣeṇa tu hanyate ||75||
tasmāt kuryāt prasatsaṃgaṃ dharmadāṃ sādhusaṃgatim |
satsaṃgaḥ śāśvataḥ kośaḥ satsaṃgaḥ śevadhiḥ paraḥ ||76||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vartanāttathā |
dharmabhaktyādiśīlādyairbhuktimuktirbhavennṛṇām ||77||
ityuktvā virarāmāpi devaśarmā tu padmaje |
vipulo’pi siṣeve ca guruṃ gurvīṃ ca niḥspṛhaḥ ||78||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvabalādhike brahmayogabale rucibrāhmaṇyāḥ śīlarakṣaṇe vipulākhyaśiṣyasya yogino vijayaḥ, indrasya parājayaḥ, lomamarṣaṇakapardakarākṣasayorvināśaḥ, guroḥ prasannatāśīrvādaḥ, sādhutvagauravaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||

<3.94>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mahatāmāśrayāt sadā |
mahattvaṃ cāpi kalyāṇaṃ jāyate dharmarakṣaṇam || 1 ||
satāṃ yogena vai sarvaśreyāṃsi saṃbhavanti hi |
atrārthe te kathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ śubhāspadam || 2 ||
ājanābhamidaṃ varṣaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam |
sahyādreḥ paścimaṃ mātrāgaskarākhyaṃ ca yāvatā || 3 ||
siṃhāraṇyaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ bhūbhāgaṃ tīrthamuttamam |
gokarṇākhyaṃ maharṣīṇāṃ nivāsāḍhyamabhūt purā || 4 ||
sagarasya sutaiḥ khātā pṛthivī paścimā hi sā |
dakṣiṇā pṛthivī khātā hyaṣṭasāhasrayojanā || 5 ||
avaśeṣo’sya khaṇḍasya dve sahasre’vaśiṣyate |
pṛthvīkhātottaraṃ tīrthe gokarṇe cirakālataḥ || 6 ||
sāmudraṃ jalamāpannaṃ bhūmagnā kṣāravāribhiḥ |
tīrthaṃ gokarṇasaṃjñaṃ ca śārabhaṃ tīrthamityapi || 7 ||
siṃhāraṇyaṃ samastaṃ ca jalamagnaṃ tato’bhavat |
sārdhayojanavistāraṃ gokarṇaṃ bhūtalaṃ hyabhūt || 8 ||
gokarṇākhyaṛṣeḥ kṣetraṃ harāvatārarūpiṇaḥ |
tatrāsaṃkhyāni tīrthāni munidevālayāstathā || 9 ||
avasan siddhasaṃghāśca munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ |
nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 3.94.1 0||
tatkṣetre sarvadā lakṣmi prītyā bhūtagaṇaiḥ saha |
devyā ca sakalairdevairnityaṃ vasati śaṃkaraḥ || 11 ||
siddhikāmā vasanti sma munayastatra kecana |
acireṇaiva tatsiddhiṃ prāpnuvanti sma tadbalāt || 12 ||
ambhodhisalile magnaṃ vīkṣyāśramādi bhūtalam |
tapasāṃ nidhayaḥ santastathā prajājanā api || 13 ||
sahyādriṃ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ nilayarthaṃ samāruhan |
vasantastatra te santaḥ sampradhārya parasparam || 14||
uddhāropāyamatyantaśreṣṭhaṃ sādhusamāśrayam |
mahendrādau tapasyantaṃ rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ || 15||
malayācalavāsāśca tathā nīlādrivāsinaḥ |
deśabhūvāsinaścāpi rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ || 16||
śuṣkasumitradharmādyā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ |
yayurdidṛkṣavo rāmaṃ mahendramacalaṃ prati || 17||
atītya subahūn deśān vanāni droṇamāpagāḥ |
āseduracalaśreṣṭhaṃ dadṛśūrāmamaṇḍalam || 18||
praśāntasarvasattvāḍhyaṃ sarvartudrumaśobhitam |
āśramaṃ sampraviśyaiva dadṛśuḥ paraśuprabhum || 1 9||
ajine tu sukhāsīnaṃ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ prabhum |
vavandire mahāmaunaṃ pupūjārghyādibhirharim ||3.94.20||
kṛtātithyānṛṣīn rāmaḥ smitapūrvamabhāṣata |
svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ pāvito’haṃ śubhāgamaiḥ || 21 ||
sevāṃ mamārhām ṛṣayo darśayantu karomi vai |
śrutvā maharṣayaḥ prāhurgokarṇākhyaṃ tu bhūtalam ||22||
khanadbhiḥ sāgarajanyaiḥ patitaṃ sāgarāmbhasi |
utsāritārṇavajalaṃ kṣetraṃ tat sarvapāvanam ||23||
upalabdhumabhīpsāmo bhavatastu kṛpāṃ kuru |
viṣṇoraṃśo bhavānāste sādhuḥ satāṃ balodayaḥ ||24||
bhṛgoḥ putrasyarcikasya jamadagniḥ suto’malaḥ |
tasya tvaṃ brahmadharmāsi samartho’si mahāprabhuḥ ||25|||
tasmāt kartumaśakyaṃ tatte kiñcinnaiva vidyate |
vāñcchitārthapradaṃ tvāṃ cābhiyācituṃ samāgatāḥ ||26 ||
sa tvamātmaprabhāveṇa samutsāryārṇavodakam |
kṣetraṃ gokarṇamityākhyaṃ siṃhāraṇye jale plutam ||27||
dātumarhasi bhagavannaḥ sarvānṛṣisattamān |
iti śrutvā tato rāmaḥ prāha yogyaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||28||
karaṇīyaṃ satāṃ kāryaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
kintu śastrāṇi sannyasya tapaḥ kartuṃ samāgataḥ ||29|||
vinā śastraṃ tadasādhyaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ diśantu mām |
śuṣkādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ prāhuḥ śrutvā rāmoditaṃ hiṃ tam ||3.94.3 0 ||
satāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya śastrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tu yat |
vrataṃ pratijñāṃ dharmaṃ vā satyaṃ poṣayati dhruvam ||3 1 ||
na cyāvayate satyādvā na dharmādvā vratānna vā |
tasmāt sādhurhitārthāya bhavatā grāhyamāyudham || 32||
tapa eva mahattacca kṛtaṃ te’tra bhaviṣyati |
dharma eva mahāṃstena caritaste bhaviṣyati ||33 ||
ityuktaḥ paraśudhrak ca vicārya sādhurakṣaṇam |
paraṃ bhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ saśastraḥ saha cāyayau ||34||
tapastyaktvā satāṃ rakṣātapo dhṛtvāmbare yayau |
sahyādriṃ cāyayau paścānmalayācalamāyayau || 35||
varuṇaṃ tvāhvayāmāsa meghagambhīrayā girā |
ahaṃ munigaṇaiḥ sārdhamāgatastvaddidṛkṣayā || 36||
tasmāt svarūpadhṛk mahyaṃ praceto dehi darśanam |
punaḥ punaścāpi samāhūto yadā na cāyayau ||37||
nistoyamarṇavaṃ kartumiyeṣa ruṣito hariḥ |
ācamya ca dhanurdhṛtvāropya jyāghoṣamācarat || 38||
svarṇapuṃkhaṃ viśikhaṃ ca bhārgavaṃ vahnidaivatam |
samantrāstraṃ mahāghoraṃ sandadhe ca mumoca ha ||3 9||
tataścacāla vasudhā saśailavanakānanā |
prakṣobhaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ sarvalokāśca vārdhayaḥ ||3.94.40||
sadigdāhābhrapaṭalairabhavan saṃvṛtā diśaḥ |
astrāgnijvālitā āpo vināśaṃ prayayustadā ||41 ||
babhūva varuṇo devo garviṣṭho’pi śarāgninā |
dagdhastūrṇaṃ bhasmasādvai samudraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yayau ||42||
tāvad brahmādayastatrāyayustuṣṭuvurīśvaram |
alaṃ cālaṃ hare śāntiṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara ||43||
asādhyaṃ te na vai kiñcicchrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ |
varuṇo dagdhatāṃ yāto jalaṃ naṣṭaṃ prajāyate ||44||
jalahīnaṃ jagat sarvaṃ nāśaṃ kṣaṇāt prayāsyati |
prasīda tvaṃ kṛpāsindho nivārayāstramulbaṇam ||45||
ujjīvaya ca varuṇaṃ jalahetuṃ suraṃ prabho |
namaste rudrarūpāya saṃkarṣaṇāya te namaḥ ||46 ||
mahākālasvarūpāya mṛtyurūpāya te namaḥ |
sarvasaṃhārakṛtkṛṣṇasādhurūpāya te namaḥ ||47||
kṣatrāntakāya devānāṃ hitāya ca namo namaḥ |
satāṃ hitāya rāmāya śrīharaye te namaḥ ||48||
itistuto haristatra vīkṣya devān puraḥsthitān |
śāntimāsādya vahnyastraṃ nijagrāha nivṛttaye ||49||
saṃhṛtyāstraṃ sthito rāmo varuṇo nāśatāṃ gataḥ |
ujjīvanārthaṃ tasyaivāśvinībālau surādayaḥ ||3.94.50 ||
sasmarustūrṇamāyātau brahmājñayā rasauṣadhaiḥ |
vāruṇaṃ bhasmacayanaṃ siṣicatuḥ samantrakaiḥ |||51 ||
varuṇo bhasmatastatrojjīvanaṃ prāpya cotthitaḥ |
kṛtāñjalirbhīta eva papāta rāmapādayoḥ ||52||
uvāca rakṣa māṃ rāma kṛpayā śaraṇāgatam |
aparādhamimaṃ naiva pragaṇayya praśādhi mām |||53||
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ varuṇaṃ rāmaḥ prāha jaleśvaram |
tvattoye medinīṃ pūrvaṃ khanadbhiḥ sagarātmajaiḥ ||24||
adho nipātitaṃ tīrthaṃ gokarṇamṛṣisevitam |
eṣāṃ vāsāya tat kṣetraṃ pradehi pūrvavacchubham ||55||
mā jalaṃ tatra cāyātu yojanānāṃ śatadvaye |
gokarṇe cāpi ca śūrpārake tīrthe kadācana ||56||
bhavatīrthe satītīrthe tīrthe tathā ca śārabhe |
śrutvā varuṇa omityaṃgīkṛtya saṃprapūjya ca ||57||
bhuvaṃ datvā jīvanaṃ ca labdhvā yayau suraiḥ saha |
vyasmayanta tu munayo dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam ||58||
ṛṣayaḥ sthānamāsādya praseduścātiharṣitāḥ |
kṛtakṛtyā bhaśaṃ rāmamāśiṣā samapūjayan ||59||
tairājñapto yayau rāmo mahendraparvataṃ prati |
tattoyaniḥsṛte kṣetre nyūṣurmaharṣayaḥ prajāḥ ||3.94.6 0||
dvīpāścāntarjale te ca vartante tīrtharūpiṇaḥ |
munayo vyomamārgeṇa vicaranti hi yoginaḥ ||61 ||
ityevaṃ sādhuyogena rāmayogena padmaje |
tvatpitā pradadau bhūmiṃ jīvanaṃ varuṇāya ca || 6 2||
hariḥ pradadau tatraiva tīrthalābho bhavatpunaḥ |
sarvaṃ dadāti sādhurvai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samunnatim ||63 ||
paropakāraśīlā vai sādhavo hyanivartinaḥ |
śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ cāpi sādhujanyāṃ hitāvahām | | 64 | |
sūryaputro babhūvāpi cekṣvākurnṛpasattamaḥ |
ayodhyāyāṃ ca tadvaṃśe kuvalāśvo’bhavannṛpaḥ | | 65 | |
dhārmikaśca mahāśūro yajvā sādhuprarakṣakaḥ |
himālayasya nikaṭe hyuttaṃkasyāśramāntike | | 66 | |
dhundhunāmā madhoḥ putro rākṣaso’bhavadulbaṇaḥ |
tannāśārthaṃ kuvalāśvaṃ yuyojottaṃka eva ha | | 67 ||
sajjo’bhavat kuvalāśvo dhundhuṃ nāśayituṃ saruṭ |
sahasrairekaviṃśatyā putrāṇāṃ saha satvaraḥ | | 68 ||
tamāviśattato viṣṇurbhagavān svena tejasā |
uttaṃkasya niyogena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | | 69 | |
divyaiḥ puṣpaiśca taṃ devāḥ samantāt samavākiran |
dhundhuścāsīd vālukāyāmantastale hi bhūtale || 3.94.70 ||
tatra gatvā ca rājā svatanayaiḥ saha bhūtalam |
viśālaṃ khanayāmāsa dhundhurāsāditastale ||7 1 | |
dhundhurmukhena vahniṃ vai hyavāsṛjad bhayaṃkaram |
vahninā kuvalāśvasya putrā dagdhāḥ samastataḥ || 72 ||
trayo dūraṃ sthitāstatrorvaritā jīvasaṃyutāḥ |
kuvalāśvo jalāstreṇa śamayāmāsa cānalam || 73 | |
dhundhuṃ ca mārayāmāsa śaivāstreṇa hiṃ satvaram |
uttaṃkaṃ darśayāmāsa mṛtaṃ taṃ rākṣasaṃ nṛpaḥ ||74| |
uttaṃko’pi prasanno’bhūd varaṃ dadau tu bhūbhṛte |
dadataścākṣayaṃ vittaṃ śatrubhiścāpyadhṛṣyatām ||75||
dharme ratiṃ ca satataṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣaye |
putrāṇāṃ cākṣayān lokān ye cātra rākṣasā hatāḥ | | 76 ||
uttaṃkasya prasādena cāyayurdevatāstadā |
vimānāni samādāya putrāste caikaviṃśatiḥ ||77||
sahasrāṇi divyadehā bhūtvā vimānasaṃsthitāḥ |
yayuḥ svargaṃ paśyatāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ jayanādinām | | 78 ||
evamṛṣeḥ pratāpena rājā vijayamāptavān |
putrāṇāṃ cākṣayaṃ svargaṃ sādhoḥ pratāpato’bhavat ||79 ||
athaivaṃ kuvalāśvasya dṛḍhāśvo jīvavān sutaḥ |
tasya vaṃśe’bhavadrājā satyavrato mahābalaḥ | | 3.94.80 ||
sa ca vidarbhanṛpatervivāhe maṇḍape yayau |
pāṇigrahaṇakāle vai yuddhaṃ kṛtvā mahābalaḥ ||8 1 ||
kāmād balācca mohācca saṃharṣeṇa balena ca |
bhāvino’rthasya ca balād bhāryāṃ jahāra maṇḍapāt ||82||
devān viprānavamatya pāpaṃ vai kṛtavān sa ca |
tena trayyāruṇākhyena pitrā tyakto hyadhārmikaḥ ||83||
kathitaścāpi vāsāya śvapākaiḥ saha vai bahiḥ |
uvāsāpi bahirgatvā śvapākāvasathāntike ||84||
atha dvādaśavarṣāṇi nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ |
viśvāmitrastadā deśe tapaścakāra dāruṇam ||85||
viśvāmitrasya patnī ca bahuputrasamanvitā |
kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya vyakrīṇānmadhyamaṃ sutam ||86||
jñātvā satyavratastadvai mokṣayāmāsa taṃ sutam |
datvā bahūni cānnāni satyabalodbhavāni ca ||87||
evaṃ satyavratastasyā bharaṇaṃ hyakarottadā |
viśvāmitrasya tuṣṭyarthamanukampārthamityapi ||88||
viśvāmitrasuto yaśca mocito gālavo hi saḥ |
maharṣiścābhavacchūro vratabhaktisamanvitaḥ ||89||
tasya vratena bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pratijñayā |
viśvāmitrakalatrādīn satyavrato babhāra ha ||3.94.90||
vasiṣṭhaścābhavad rājye trayyāruṇinṛpasya vai |
ayodhyāyāṃ satyavrate vimanā iva sarvathā ||91||
itihetorvasiṣṭhe vai satyavratasya bhāvanā |
nāsīnmanāgapi tatra bhāvino’rthasya vai balāt ||92||
satyavrato’tha vai roṣād vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ yayau |
bhojyādīni samagrāṇi jahāra bālavattadā ||93||
bhojayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya cātmajān |
vasiṣṭhastaṃ tadā prāha tripāpastvaṃ sadāsi vai ||94||
kanyāstrīharaṇaṃ tvekaṃ cāṇḍālena niveśanam |
mama bhojyādiharaṇaṃ triśaṃkustvaṃ tato mataḥ ||95||
viśvāmitrastu tapasā nivṛtto jñātavānidam |
prasanno’bhūd varaṃ prādād devavat prasukhī bhava ||96||
atha vavre satyavratastriśaṃkuḥ puṇyavānapi |
saśarīro vraje svargaṃ bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ||97||
trayyāruṇau mṛte rājye’bhyaṣicat taṃ triśaṃkukam |
rājyaṃ kṛtvā yayau tena varṣmaṇā divameva saḥ ||98||
miṣatāṃ devatānāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya ca kauśikaḥ |
viśvāmitraḥ saśarīraṃ divamāropayannṛpam ||99||
saṃbhavo’saṃbhavasyāyaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat |
viśvāmitraprasādena triśaṃkurdivi rājate || 3.94.10 0||
pratāpo’yaṃ mahānāste sādhoḥ ṛṣestapasvinaḥ |
tasmādvai sādhavaḥ sevyā uddharttāro hi pāpinām || 101 ||
tasya satyaratā bhāryā suṣuve haricandrakam |
rohitastasya putraśca viśvāmitrakṛpālayāḥ || 1 02||
tāritā bahukaṣṭaiśca viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā |
śāśvatakīrtayo loke kṛtāḥ strīputrabhūbhṛtaḥ || 1 03||
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi sādhorāśrayaṇe sadā |
kalyāṇaṃ vividhaṃ cāpi jāyate mokṣaṇaṃ hyapi || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne paraśurāmāśrayeṇa siṃhāraṇyavāsināṃ sāgaramagnasya gokarṇatīrthasya punarlābhaḥ, uttaṃkarṣeḥ kṛpayā kuvalāśvasya dhundhumāratvam, viśvāmitrasya kṛpayā satyavratākhyatriśaṃkoḥ sadehasvargagāmitvamityādisādhupratāpavarṇananāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||

<3.95>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kiṃ japyaṃ sarvadā kānta bhāminībhiḥ svamuktaye |
kaḥ pūjyaḥ ko namaskāryo vada me strīkṛpāvaśaḥ || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
bhāminībhiḥ sadā japyaṃ śrīkānteti sukhapradam |
mama nāmottamaṃ nāma muktiṃ dadāmi tena vai || 2 ||
vidhavābhirhare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho pate |
itijapyaṃ mama nāma punaḥ punaḥ svamuktaye || 3 ||
kanyakābhiḥ sadā japyaṃ rādhāvaretināma me |
vṛddhābhiḥ sarvadā japyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇeti vai || 4 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti japa uttamaḥ |
sarvābhiḥ pramadābhiśca kartavyaḥ sarvasiddhaye || 5 ||
ahaṃ pūjyo namaskāryaḥ śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥ patiḥ |
svarṇādipratimāyāṃ ca patyāvahaṃ pareśvara || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
sarvadā mānavairyatra vrate mahotsave gṛhe |
mandire devapūjāyāṃ śrāddhe pravāsane tathā || 7 ||
prasthāne vā praveśe vā vivāhe śubhakarmaṇi |
gṛhāraṃbhe kṛṣikārye hyudyame vijayārthini || 8 ||
abhyudaye tathā svāsthye vaimanasye hyaniṣṭake |
śubhāśubhādau kiṃ jāpyaṃ sveṣṭaphalādilabdhaye || 9 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sarvatra lābhadaṃ śāntipuṣṭidaṃ bhayanāśanam |
rakṣākaraṃ śatruvighnanāśakaṃ sādhusammatam || 3.95.1 0||
brahmaśaraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpavināśakam |

āyuṣmān bhavate cainaṃ śrīḥ samupaiti cottamā |

muktānāṃ maṇḍalaiḥ sākaṃ vihitaṃ vāṅmayaṃ tadā |

haripriyādipataye namo namo’vatāriṇe |

namo’ntaryāmiṇe vedanidhaye te namo namaḥ || 17||
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāyāsaṃkhyanāmne ca te namaḥ |
viṣṇave śaṃbhave’jāya trirūpāya ca te namaḥ ||18||
ādityebhyo namaścāpi vasubhyaśca namo namaḥ |
aśvibhyāṃ ca namaḥ sarvasurebhyaśca namo namaḥ || 1 9||
yajñadevebhya evāpi kālāya mṛtyave namaḥ |
viśvadevebhya evāpi pitṛbhyaśca namo namaḥ ||3.95.20 ||
siddhebhyaśca munibhyaśca sādhubhyaśca namo muhuḥ |
gaṇeśvarebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pārṣadebhyo namo namaḥ ||21 ||
sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca devībhyaśca namo namaḥ |
mātṛbhyaśca janakebhyo vṛddhebhyaśca namo namaḥ ||22||
viprebhyaḥ pūjyavargebhyastīrthebhyaśca namo namaḥ |

dikpālebhyaḥ samastebhyo lokapālebhya ānamaḥ || 27||

tāpasebhyaḥ śīladharmibhyo yogibhyo namo namaḥ ||3.95.30 ||

ete brahmasvarūpāstān kīrtayet kīrtivardhanān |
avatārām̐stathā muktānīśvarān kīrtayet surān ||3 2||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramaṃ brahma sarvaśāstraprabodhitam |

vyādhipraśamanaṃ siddhipradaṃ ca puṣṭidaṃ tathā |
kalpaṃ sāyaṃ sadā rātrau kīrtayenmāṃ dine’niśam ||34||
ta ete devatāḥ sarvakāryasiddhipradā nṛṇām |
rakṣanti cābhivarṣanti kāmān puṣṇanti kīrtitāḥ ||355||
