kīrtitāste tatastuṣṭā vyapohantyaśubhaṃ nṛṇām ||36||
evaṃ kalpaṃ samutthāya namaskārān muhuścaret |
nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tasya na mārgapratirodhanam ||37||
aśubhaṃ na bhavettasya śubhaṃ syādvai pade pade |
duḥsvapno na bhavettasya svastimān syātkṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||38||
naśyanti sarvapāpāni supuṇyānyudbhavanti ca |
naśyanti vyādhayo rogāḥ kule svastyayanaṃ caret || 39||
ātmanaśca sutānāṃ ca dārāṇāṃ ca kuṭumbinām |
dhanānāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca rakṣāṃ brahmaśaraḥ kriyāt ||3.95.40||
raṇe naśyanti ripavo vijayaḥ syāt prapāṭhinaḥ |
daive paitrye paṭhanīyaṃ tṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ ||41||
kaṣmalaṃ dūrameva syānnairmalyaṃ ca bhavet sadā |
pravāse śubhakārye ca brahmaśarasya pāṭhanāt ||42||
parā siddhirbhavet sveṣṭakāryāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
na ca rājabhayaṃ tasya śvāpadānāṃ bhayaṃ na ca ||43||
na bhayaṃ śatrutastasya piśācoragarakṣasām |
nāgnyambupavanākāśād bhūkampād grahato bhayam ||44||
yatra brahmaśaraḥ stotraṃ duḥkhaṃ tato vilīyate |
na tatra mriyate bālaḥ sampannāśo na jāyate ||45||
dhanaṃ śevadhiḥ paṭhato gāvo’sya bahuvatsikāḥ |
etādṛśaṃ brahmaśarastotraṃ śaravad rakṣakam ||46||
tubhyaṃ lakṣmi samākhyātaṃ tathyaṃ brahma sanātanam |
hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrutirme vāk sanātanī ||47||
divaṃ yānti surān japtvā mahāviṣṇuṃ tathaiśvarān |
lokān yānti prakīrtyātrāvatārān yānti dhāma ca ||48||
māmanādiṃ hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prakīrtya tu |
mamākṣarapadaṃ yānti lakṣmīṃ prakīrtya sampadaḥ ||49||
japtvā rādhāṃ tathāśvinau rūpaṃ yānti parottamam |
dharmaṃ smṛtvā vṛṣaṃ yānti brahma smṛtvākṣayaṃ sukham ||3.95.5 0 ||
sādhūn smṛtvā paraṃ puṇyaṃ nairvighnyaṃ yānti sarvadā |
japyaṃ brahmaśarastotraṃ sarvakāryārthasiddhaye ||5 1 ||
pūjanīyāḥ sādhavaśca sarvapāpopaśāntaye |
sādhūnāṃ tu paribhavaḥ sādhayedapi ceśvarān ||52||
sādhujanān samprasādya kadācana na riṣyati |
santaḥ pūjyā namaskāryāḥ sevanīyāḥ pareśavat ||53 ||
sādhujaneṣu satataṃ vartitavyaṃ tu dīnavat |
santo lokānimān sarvān dhārayanti dayālavaḥ ||54||
bhaktiyuktā bhajanena rakṣanti śaraṇāgatān |
santo vai bhagavadyogānmahānto dharmasetavaḥ ||55||
strīdhanatyāginaḥ santo vāṇīsaṃyamayoginaḥ |
darśanīyāśca bhūtānāṃ śīlayuktā dhṛtavratāḥ ||56 ||
pramokṣakāśca lokānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pālakāstathā |
lekhakā darśakāścāpi dharmodyamaparāyaṇāḥ ||57||
tapo bhaktirdhanaṃ yeṣāṃ śrīharirvipulaṃ balam |
āśrayāḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sādhavo divyadarśinaḥ ||58||
mokṣakāmāḥ sthitā bhaktau dharme ca dharmasetuṣu |
yān samāśritya jīvanti prajāḥ sarvāśca dehinaḥ ||59||
sādhavo brahmasopānāḥ panthāno muktigāminām |
yajñapuṇyapradātāro bhojanārthaṃ sanātanāḥ ||3.95.6 0 ||
pitṛdevoddhārakāśca havyakavyāgrabhojinaḥ |
āśīrvādena lokām̐rstrīstrāyante māyikād bhayāt ||6 1 ||
sūryāḥ sarvapralokānāṃ netrāṇi netriṇāṃ tathā |
sarvakathāśrūtidhanā nipuṇā mokṣadāyinaḥ ||62||
gatijñāḥ sarvasattvānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ |
ārambhāntādiboddhāro gantāraḥ paramāṃ gatim ||63 ||
parāvarādivijñānā ātmabodhādiśobhanāḥ |
vimuktāḥ pāparahitā dhūtapāpāśritālayāḥ ||64||
nirdvandvā bandhanahīnā arāgrā niṣparigrahāḥ |
mānārhā mānitāḥ sadbhirmahātmabhiḥ pravaiṣṇavaiḥ ||65||
paṃke lepe candane ca samāmiṣṭe kaṭau rase |
kṣaume’jine dukūle ca samā anaśane ratāḥ ||66||
śoṣayeyuśca gātrāṇi tapobhirvidyayā vrataiḥ |
adaivataṃ prakuryuste sadaivataṃ dhanānvitam ||67||
lokānanyān sṛjeyuśca tapobalāddhi sādhavaḥ |
viprāṇāmapi ye viprā devānāmapi devatāḥ ||68||
pramāṇānāṃ pramāṇāni sādhavaḥ śāstrabhūṣaṇāḥ |
yeṣāṃ vṛddhaśca bālaśca nirdhano’pi dhanānvitaḥ ||69||
nārī vāpi naro vāpi samaṃ mānaṃ samarhati |
tapovidyāviśeṣāttu paraṃ mānaṃ samarhati ||3.95.70||
avidvān brahmavidvān vai sādhuḥ pātraṃ mahatparam |
vidvān sādhuḥ parabrahma pāvanaṃ pātramuttamam || 71 ||
avidvām̐ścaiva vidvām̐śca sādhurvai daivataṃ mahat |
śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati ||72||
tathā saṃsāracakre vai sādhuḥ kvāpi na duṣyati |
yajñe havirlihan vahniryathā sādhuḥ praśobhate |||73 ||
viprāṇāṃ tu sahasreṣu saṃbhujatsu mahādhvare |
sādhorasattve vyarthaṃ syāt sādhurnārāyaṇo yataḥ ||74||
sādhavaḥ somasūryādiprapūjyā īśvareśvarāḥ |
sādhūnāṃ vai prapūjāyāmāyuḥ kīrtiryaśo balam ||75||
bhaktirmuktirdaivataṃ ca vardhante’harniśaṃ sadā |
lokālokeśvarāḥ sādhupūjakāḥ saṃbhavanti ha ||76||
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yaśaḥśrīrogaśāntiṣu |
devatāpitṛpūjāsu santoṣyāḥ sādhavo’malāḥ ||77||
sādhavo hi mādhavāste loke cātra paratra ca |
tārayeyurjagat sarvaṃ santuṣṭāḥ śrīpatiryathā ||78||
kaśyapasya gṛhe sādhurvaiṣṇavastāpaso yatiḥ |
praṇadbrahmābhidhaścāsīnmānaso vedhasaḥ sutaḥ ||79||
śīlavrato jaṭī kṛśo mahaiśvaryādisiddhimān |
mālājape’timagnaśca prāyo maunaparāyaṇaḥ ||3.95.80||
mārīcaḥ kaśyapastaṃ tu prātaḥ prasevate sadā |
pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca bhojyapānādikārpaṇaiḥ ||81 ||
sādhuścāyaṃ bhajan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ ca mām |
dhyāne prāyo vartate vai mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||82||
sa svairaṃ carate lokān divyān nāgāṃśca mānuṣān |
punaścāyātyālayaṃ ca kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ||83||
praṇadbrahmaikadā prāha kaśyapaṃ māṃ prabhojaya |
dugdhapākaṃ hyapūpām̐śca kaśyapastamabhojayat ||84||
praṇadbrahma tataḥ prāha kaśyapaṃ sevakaṃ munim |
mamāṃgāni pralimpasva pāyasena muhurmuhuḥ ||85||
kaśyapaḥ kṛtavān sarvaṃ pāyasena vilepanam |
asnāpayat pāyasena praṇadbrahmamahāmunim ||86||
athotthāya praṇadbrahmocchiṣṭena pāyasena tu |
kaśyapasyānanaṃ mūrdhānaṃ cālepayadityapi ||87||
athāntike sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatīmaditiṃ tathā |
hastena samparigṛhyālimpata pāyasena tām ||88|||
mukhe vakṣasi kaṭyāṃ ca sakthnoḥ pṛṣṭhe nitambayoḥ |
vyasṛjacca tatastāṃ sa praṇadbrahma munīśvaraḥ ||89||
athāditiṃ punaḥ prāha pāyasānvitavigrahām |
vaha skandhe nidhāyaiva māṃ bahiḥ sarvasannidhau ||3.95.90||
aditistaṃ nidhāyaiva skandhe yayau bahistadā |
pallatābhistāḍayati munistāṃ bālayauvanām ||91 ||
sāpi sādhujanaṃ skandhe kṛtvā cacāra sarvataḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ cāyayau svagṛhaṃ pratiṃ ||92||
muniḥ sa rājamārgeṇa skandhasthaścāyayau gṛham |
kaśyapasya stokamapi duḥkhaṃ nāsīnna cāditeḥ ||93||
gṛhe tvāgatya munirāṭ patito bhūtale drutam |
skandhāttadā kaśyapaścāditistathānyayoṣitaḥ ||94||
paricaryā pracakruśca prasīda bhagavanniti |
tataḥ sa munirāṭ svastho vilokya kaśyapaṃ tathā ||95||
aditiṃ prāha tuṣṭātmā devamātā bhaviṣyasi |
jitakrodho bhavān yasmāt kaśyapo’sti tatastviha ||96||
pitā sarvaprajānāṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ |
tava vaṃśe sādhavaśca koṭyarbudā hi mādṛśāḥ ||97||
vaṃśoddhārakarāḥ sarve brahmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti tathā dārayujo gṛhādimedhinaḥ ||98||
sarvavidhānyapatyāni bhaviṣyanti tavaiva ha |
puṇyā kīrtistava nityā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||99||
tava vaṃśo hareścāpi prākaṭyāni punaḥ punaḥ |
bhaviṣyanti hi lokānāmuddhārārthaṃ hi kaśyapa || 3.95.10 0||
na tvāṃ jarāṃ vā rogo vāditiṃ cāpi lagiṣyati |
sarvastrīṇāṃ pradhānā tvamadite saṃbhaviṣyasi || 10 1||
eṣaiva te buddhirastu sādhūn prati sadā tava |
ityuktvā virarāmāsau snātvā śuddho babhūva ha || 1 02||
prāhāmṛtaprabhoktāraḥ putrāste devatāḥ śubhāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti pāyasānnaphalabhājaḥ sadādite || 1 03||
anyāsāṃ daivayogena prasādabhāginaḥ kvacit |
bhaviṣyanti tava strīṇāṃ kaśyapatvaṃ sukhī bhava || 1 04||
sarvasmṛddhibhṛtānyeva gṛhāṇi kaśyapasya vai |
bhavantviti muniḥ prāha tattathā tāni cābhavan || 1 05||
evaṃ lakṣmi praṇadbrahmasādhoścāśīrvacāṃsi vai |
sevāśca saṃśayaśūnyāḥ phalitāḥ kaśyapasya ha || 1 06||
aditeḥ phalitāścāpi sādhoḥ sevā hariprasūḥ |
devaprasūraditirvai jāyate nāparā muhuḥ || 1 07||
sādhoḥ sevāphalaṃ lakṣmi bhogamokṣapradaṃ bhavet |
sarvasampatpradaṃ cāpi kāmanāpūrakaṃ bhavet || 1 08||
pūjyante satataṃ sarvaiḥ sādhavo devatādibhiḥ |
mānavaiścāpi lokeśairdikpālaiśceśvarādibhiḥ || 1 09||
ekataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sevanaṃ caikataḥ satām |
satāṃ sevāphalasyāgre’nyāni nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 3.95.110||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya satāṃ sevāphalaṃ labhet |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūjanīyanamaskaraṇīyasādhujanamāhātmye praṇadbrahmasādho
rāśīrvādena sevayā ca kaśyapasyāditeśca devatā
mātrapitṛtvādilabdhiritinirūpaṇanāmā pañca
navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||

<3.96>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
santo harirbhavān dharmaḥ satī mokṣaśca sādhanam |
bhaktiścetyādiṣu kānta pramāṇāni tu kāni vai || 1 ||
nahyapramāṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ hṛdaye cādhyavasyati |
tasmāt prāmāṇikaṃ kartuṃ pramāṇaṃ teṣu kiṃ matam || 2 ||
vada me lokanātha tvaṃ sarvavidyādiśevadhiḥ |
yatra me saṃśayo na syāllokānāṃ tu hitāya vai || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri pramāṇaṃ jyeṣṭhameva tu |
pratyakṣaṃ svena yadvastu tvālocitaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 4 ||
paricayenendriyaiśca sākṣānnirṇāyakaṃ hi tat |
santaḥ śīlavratā bhaktimanto nirvāsanāstathā || 5 ||
parīkṣaṇīyāḥ suptvāpi śayyāyāṃ śīladharmaṇi |
sahavāsena bhaktau ca bhogadānena vāsane || 6 ||
parīkṣaṇīyāḥ santo vai sākṣānna tvanyathā kvacit |
āliṃgane prayāse vā vikṛtiryasya naiva ha || 7 ||
śīlinaste mahāsanto nārāyaṇāḥ svayaṃ tviha |
satataṃ bahudhāyāṃ tu bhaktau yasya śramo na vai || 8 ||
nartane gāyane sevādau ca lajjā na ruddhyati |
bhaktimantaśca te sākṣād boddhavyāḥ sādhavaḥ śubhāḥ || 9 ||
bhogā bahuvidhā deyā ghaṭitānyāstu sādhave |
na bhuṃkte nirmanāśca syāt sākṣāt sādhutvanirṇayaḥ || 3.96.10 ||
vāsanā rasanā liṅgaṃ parīkṣāviṣayādi vai |
pratyakṣaṃ tu bhavettatra nirṇāyakaṃ hitāvaham || 1 1||
gatānugatikā vāṇī na vaktavyā kadācana |
nānumānaṃ hi nirdoṣaṃ sadā saddhenumantarā || 12||
asaddhetusamāpannaṃ niścāyakaṃ na tadbhavet |
harau kṛṣṇe mayi sākṣāccihnānāṃ darśanaṃ mama ||13||
hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi mūrtau cihnādidarśanam |
pratyakṣaṃ tu bhagavattve pramāṇaṃ cātra kīrtitam || 14||
cihnānāṃ tu pramāṇaṃ vai śāstraṃ paramparāgatam |
āptavākyātmakaṃ cāpi tanmūlaṃ vaidikaṃ tathā || 15||
vedāścāpi pramāṇaṃ vai yanmūrteścāyudhaṃ ca yat |
likhitaṃ divyacakṣuṣkairdṛṣṭvā matpārśvavartibhiḥ || 16||
tadāyudhasya rekhā syāt kare yasya ca vā pade |
sa eva bhagavān sa syānmānavādisvarūpadhṛk || 17||
yathāhaṃ matsyaśūlādyairasmi kare pracihnitaḥ |
sākṣād divyasvarūpaśca koṭyabjaśrīramāpatiḥ || 18||
ṣoḍaśacihnavān varte pādayoścāpi varṣmaṇi |
asaṃkhyacihnavānasmi sākṣāccakragadādimān || 1 9||
evaṃ pramāṇairboddhavyo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
dharmo lokavyavahārasaukhyārthaṃ pūjyamānavaiḥ ||3.96.20||
eṣā rītiḥ saraṇīyā cetyevaṃ niścitaḥ sa vai |
dānaṃ paropakaraṇaṃ vivāhaḥ pararakṣaṇam ||21 ||
śuddhirnyāyārjanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ codyamastathā |
ityevamādyā mārgāśca deśakālānusārataḥ ||22||
saukhyārthaṃ cāpyavighnārthaṃ niścito dharma eva saḥ |
āptavākyaṃ cāptakarma dharmarūpaṃ prakāśate ||23||
satī sādhvī sadā bodhyā pātivrapyādisadvṛṣaiḥ |
sahavāsena sā sahavāsinyā buddhyate sadā ||24||
satyaiśvaryāṇi śāstreṣu likhitāni bhavanti vai |
camatkārāstathā yāsu dṛśyante tāḥ satīstriyaḥ ||25||
mokṣaścātmani riktatvaṃ kleśādyaiścātra buddhyate |
sadā śāntiḥ sukhaṃ naijaṃ śāśvataśca tathā bhavet ||26 ||
ityevaṃ sukhalokānāṃ śāśvatānandadāyinām |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi mayāpi ca || 27||
akṣarādisthalānāṃ ca nivāsatvena cārjanam |
mokṣaścaiva śāstrarītyā pratyakṣeṇāpi vai manāk ||2 8||
niścetavyaḥ sadā lakṣmi bhaktyā prāpyaḥ sa vai mataḥ |
jñānamārgeṇa vā bhrāntināśe vijñamayī sthitiḥ ||29||
vijñeyā mokṣarūpā sā śāstraṃ tatra pramāṇakam |
camatkārasamaṃ mānaṃ vidyate nāparaṃ priye |||3.96.3 0||
camatkāre namaskārastatra sarvaṃ vilumpati |
pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vopamānaṃ śabda ityapi ||3 1||
arthāpattiścopalabdhiḥ saṃbhavaścetihāsanam |
ceṣṭā maunaṃ cābhivittiḥ svapnaṃ daivaṃ ca mānasam || 32||
caturdaśāpi mānāni camatkāre layanti vai |
tasmāt siddhisvarūpaṃ vai pramāṇaṃ balavattathā ||33||
pratyakṣaṃ siddhamevāpi siddhyānyathayate punaḥ |
kā vārtā tatra cānyānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ tu padmaje ||34||
sādhujanān prasevasva lakṣmi satkṛtya mānataḥ |
satsu bhuktistathā muktiḥ sadgatiḥ satsu sarvathā ||35||
harirdharmaśca bhaktiśca mokṣaḥ satsu pravartate |
sādhutā ca satītā ca sarvaṃ satsu pravartate ||36||
jñānaṃ sevā mama bhaktirdānaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tathā |
dharmā hyete sarvamūrddhanyāśca santoṣaṇānvitāḥ ||37||
sukhaṃ teṣu pramodaśca teṣvānandaḥ paro mataḥ |
mokṣasteṣu hareryogaḥ sādhuṣveva bhavet priye ||38||
rajasā tamasā vyāptā nāstikāḥ sādhunindakāḥ |
nirayaṃ pratipadyante sādhudharmādyasūyakāḥ ||39||
ye tu sādhūn sādhudharme sevāṃ sādhorupāsate |
satyārjavaparāḥ santaste bhūtvā yānti matpadam ||3.96.40||
dharmabhaktirgatisteṣāṃ matsevopāsanād bhavet |
bhaktimanto mama dhāma prayānti sādhavo hi te ||41 ||
puṇyamātrāḥ svargalokaṃ prayānti gṛhamedhinaḥ |
sādhavaḥ śīlasampannāḥ śiṣṭācārā upāsakāḥ ||42||
pañcānāmaśanaṃ datvā śeṣamaśnanti sādhavaḥ |
gāṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ guruṃ tapasvinam ||43||
vipraṃ vṛddhaṃ dhārmikaṃ ca ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam |
atithīnāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ kuṭumbināṃ ca yoṣitām ||44||
āśritānāṃ śaraṇe cāgatānāṃ rakṣakāśca ye |
guroḥ sevāratāścāpi vṛddhānāṃ sevakāśca ye ||45||
sadā hyekāntaśīlāśca tīrthavāsā haripriyāḥ |
jñānavantaśca santuṣṭāḥ sadā cātaḥ sukhabhṛtāḥ ||46||
vṛddhavacaḥprakartāraḥ svādhyāyaniratāstathā |
nivṛttendriyaviṣayā vinā śrīpuruṣottamam ||47||
vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣyādyabhinandinaḥ |
tvaṃkāravācā rahitāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||48||
yathā lavaṇamambhobhirāplutaṃ pravilīyate |
tathā sadbhyo’rpitaṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ sadyo vinaśyati ||49||
buddhaḥ pāpaṃ na gūheta gūhamānaṃ vivardhate |
kṛtvā sādhuṣu cākhyeyaṃ te tatpraśamayanti hi ||3.96.50||
bhaktiyuktaṃ careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet |
dharmavāṇijakāḥ svargaṃ bhuktvā punaḥ patanti yat ||51 ||
arced devānadambhena sevetāmāyayā sataḥ |
gurūnanusared bhaktyā mokṣārthaṃ dānamācaret ||52||
bhāgyaṃ samarjayed bhaktyā sevayā tapasā vrataiḥ |
bhāgadheyaṃ tato vindetāyatno’pi vinā śramam ||53||
nālābhakāle labhate prayatne’pi kṛte sati |
lābhakāle sataḥ prasevyārjayet tatparaṃ padam ||54||
kṛtaṃ kāle hyanākṛṣṭaṃ svayamāgatya tiṣṭhati |
niṣphalā na bhavet sevāśīrvādaiḥ saha karhicit ||55||
adhītya nītiśāstrāṇi nītiyukto na ced yadi |
adhītaṃ viphalaṃ tasya nirayāṇāṃ pradāyakam ||56||
samprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma kartavyārādhanā mama |
yadi neha kriyāttāṃ cet kṛtamanyattu niṣphalam ||57||
vidyāyukto na cedvidyāmātmārth yojayetyapi |
aśāntaḥ kṛtatṛṣṇaśca vidyā tasya hi niṣphalā ||58||
vidvān śānti parityajya vihāyātmapramokṣaṇam |
lokadṛṣṭyā cedvahati niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvanam ||59||
idaṃ kṛtaṃ kariṣye’pi kurvanti rājasādayaḥ |
sāttvikāścettathāmārgā niṣphalaṃ tatprajīvanam ||3.96.6 0||
paropakāraṃ lokebhyo darśayatyeva mānitam |
svasamebhyaḥ śikṣayitvā vācayatyeva sadyaśaḥ ||61 ||
bhaktimārgaṃ na kurvanti dehikhyātiṃ gatāḥ khalāḥ |
ta eva dharmahantāro bahirdṛśā na cāntare ||62||
yadi vidyāmupāśritya janaḥ śāntiṃ samaśnute |
sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tasya sampannaṃ nādhikaṃ tataḥ ||63||
na vidvān vidyayā hīnaṃ vṛttyarthamupasaṃśrayet |
na vidvān dhanino mūḍhān stuvīta kṣudrakāmyayā ||64||
viduṣaḥ kṣudrakāmā na vidyā kṣudramaterna ca |
nityasantoṣavān vidvān sādhurbrahmapramodavān ||65||
sādhuviduṣoḥ samatā santoṣe cātmadarśane |
satye ca vacane bhaktau brahmiṣṭhatve pareśvare ||66||
athecchati samāraṃbhān sāhāyyaṃ cenna vindati |
ugraṃ tapaḥ samāroheddhyanuptaṃ na prarohati ||67||
dattamāsādyate paścāt sevā smṛddhiṃ dadāti ca |
adroheṇa ca dīrghāyurbhaktyā satāṃ paraṃ padam ||68||
sadbhyo dadyāttu vipulaṃ seveta satataṃ sataḥ |
priyaṃ kuryād dehināṃ ca jayaṃ labdhvākṣaraṃ vrajet ||69||
kaṃjuṣo naiva yāceta daridreṣu vasenna ca |
khalamaitrīṃ na vai kuryāt sādhūn seveta muktaye ||3.96.70||
sukhaṃ cātmasthitaṃ bhuñjyād dāyādaḥ syāt sadā hareḥ |
putro bhavet satāṃ vaśyo mokṣamicchet pare’kṣare ||71||
satīḥ sādhvīrnamaskuryād bhajeta māṃ hariṃ prabhum |
arpayet svasamastaṃ vai mayyeva matparāyaṇaḥ ||72||
anarpitaṃ vinaśyecca viphalaṃ cārjitaṃ śramāt |
samarpya tadvidhāyaiva śāśvataṃ mokṣaṇe labhet ||73||
dānaṃ dharmasya śānteśca pramodasyotsavasya ca |
ānandasya ca kartavyaṃ cāmṛtasyāpi labdhaye ||74||
sevādānaṃ prakartavyaṃ sampadāmapi sarvathā |
gṛhakuṭumbadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tattadāptaye ||75||
satkārye cāśvasītaiva nāsatkārye kadācana |
dharmabuddhāvāśvasīta pravarteta drutaṃ tadā ||76||
dharmaḥ śīghraṃ tvācarito bhaktau manaḥ pravartayet |
bhaktiṃ kurvannavāpnoti putraṃ māṃ parameśvaram ||77||
evamevātmanātmānaṃ prāpayanti hi dhārmikāḥ |
paramātmārjanaṃ syādvai dharmo vai vijayapradaḥ ||78||
pañcabhūtaśarīrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sadṛśātmanām |
yatra dharmo dhruvo naijastatrāhaṃ niyato hariḥ ||79||
sarveṣāṃ tulyabhāvānāṃ dehināṃ dharmavartmanām|
bhaktiḥ sevā mokṣadātryau guroḥ sataḥ piturhareḥ ||3.96.8 0 ||
sādhuvaṃśasya sevā vai śreyaḥ paramamucyate |
vipāpmā ca bhavettadvat sukhameti prasevanāt ||8 1 ||
kalmaṣāṇāṃ nāśakaṃ vai sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ śubham |
ahotpannaṃ varṣmaṇā vendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ tathāntaraiḥ ||82 ||
jñātvājñātvāpi sarvaṃ tallīyate sādhusevayā |
rātrau sandhyādikāle vā jātaṃ japato naśyati ||83 ||
sādhusevā japo me ca kurvāte svastiyoginam |
tiryagyonirvinaśyedvai narakaṃ saṃkarādikam ||84||
na bhayaṃ na maraṇaṃ cākasmikaṃ satprasevayā |
sarvagurustvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smyaham ||85 ||
sarvaprāṇaścāntarātmātmanāṃ patiḥ pareśvaraḥ |
smaraṇīyaḥ sadā lakṣmi tathāvatārakoṭayaḥ ||86||
mahāviṣṇurvāsudevo nārāyaṇo’pi viśvasṛṭ |
viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ satī lakṣmīḥ rādhā sūryaśca candramāḥ ||87||
smaraṇīyā naranārāyaṇau tatpārṣadā api |
yamo dhūmorṇayā sākaṃ gauryā sākaṃ jaleśvaraḥ ||88 ||
ṛddhyā dhaneśvaraścāpi gauḥ surabhirmarudgaṇaḥ |
vālakhilyāḥ ṛṣayaśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ||89||
urvaśī śrīhareḥ putrī smaraṇīyā prage sadā |
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaro’pi ca || 3.96.90 ||
dharmaḥ śrutaṃ tapo dīkṣā bhaktirbṛhaspatistathā |
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi prabhāsaṃ gomatī tathā ||9 1 ||
gaṃgā revā gaṇḍakī ca yamī sarayūrgauttamī |
nārāyaṇī cendratoyā brahmaputrī hiraṇvatī ||92||
puṣkaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca saraścāpi sarasvatī |
merurhimālayo vindhya uralo raivatastathā || 93 ||
mahendro malayaḥ sahyo gandhanamādana ityapi |
samudrāścāpi tattvāni smaraṇīyāni sarvadā || 94||
pāntu sarve divyadevāḥ kīrtitākīrtitā api |
pāntu sarve sādhavaśca sādhvyaḥ pāntu sadā tu mām || 95 ||
kambharāśrīḥ sadā pātu pātu gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ |
pātu māṃ pārvatī devī prajñā pātu ca rādhikā || 96||
brahmapriyāḥ sadā pāntu haripriyāḥ prapāntu ca |
bhagavām̐śca śukaścāpi vallabhaśca prapāntu mām || 97||
patnīvrato brāhmaṇarṣiḥ svataḥprakāśa īśvaraḥ |
lomaśaśca gururvṛddhaḥ sarve pāntu sadā tu mām || 98||
kuṃkumavāpikā devī kṣetraṃ cākṣarasaṃjñakam |
sādhulālāyanādyāśca pāntu māṃ parameśvarāḥ ||99||
ityevaṃ kīrtayānaśca mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ |
stuvam̐śca pratinandam̐śca mucyate sarvatobhayāt || 3.96.1 00||
mamāśritānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃhitāgaditātmanām |
līlāḥ smṛtvā labhante vai paraṃ padaṃ mamākṣaram || 101 ||
madāśritānāṃ nārīṇāṃ sādhvīnāṃ brahmayoṣitām |
smṛtvā divyacamatkārān labhante paramaṃ padam ||1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrīharisatpuruṣadharmasatījanamokṣasādhanabhaktyādiṣu pramāṇānāṃ gatiḥ sādhūnāṃ samāgamo balavatpramāṇaṃ camatkāro balavattamaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 96 ||

<3.97>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mānavena lokavyāyāmaśālinā |
dehayātrāṃ lokayātrāṃ kiṃdharmaḥ san vibhāvayet || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
drohaṃ vihāya stainyaṃ ca tyaktvā vyavāyamityapi |
tyaktvā kāyena pāpāni śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ samācaret| || 2 ||
grāmyavārtā ca pāruṣyaṃ paiśūnyaṃ ca mṛṣāvacaḥ |
vācā catvāri santyajya satyaṃ saṃvyāharet sadā || 3 ||
parasvānāmanākāṃkṣāṃ sarvadehiṣu mitratām |
karmaphalādāvāstikyaṃ manasā dhārayet sadā || 4 ||
vāsanā nodbhāvayecca tṛṣṇāṃ tyajet parigraham |
bhayadaṃ ca vihāyaivātmanā sādhuṃ samāśrayet || 5 ||
sarvasvārpaṇamāsādya navadhābhaktimācaret |
premṇā dhyānena māṃ labdhvā vrajettu paramaṃ padam || 6||
evaṃ sadācarecchreṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ hitaṃ ca satphalam |
aśubhaṃ viparītaṃ ca nācarettu kadācana || 7 ||
mātuḥ sevāṃ pituḥ sevāṃ patyuḥ sevāṃ striyāstathā |
guroḥ sevāṃ gavāṃ sevāṃ kuryād vṛddhasya sevanam || 8 ||
devasevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ satīsevāṃ samācaret |
ātithyaṃ ca paropakārādikaṃ cācaret sadā || 9 ||
bhajanaṃ me prakuryācca dīnasevāṃ samācaret |
lokasevāṃ rāṣṭrasevāṃ prajāsevāṃ samācaret || 3.97.1 0||
tīrthasevāṃ brahmasevāṃ mokṣasevāṃ samācaret |
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tīrthaṃ prasevya sādhumaṇḍalam || 11 ||
ālambāyanasaṃjñaśca maharṣirmokṣamāptavān |
siṃhāraṇye mahātīrthe gokarṇe ṛṣirāṭ svayam || 1 2||
lakṣavarṣāṇyavasat saḥ sādhūnāṃ sevayā sukhī |
daśavarṣo’bhavad yāvattāvat saurāṣṭradeśajaḥ || 1 3||
keśariṇīṃ nijāṃ natvā prasūṃ prāha sa bālakaḥ |
mātarme jāyate cecchā satāṃ samāgame muhuḥ || 14||
anityaḥ khalu saṃsāro mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā |
harerbhaktirdurlabhā ca durlabhaḥ satsamāgamaḥ || 15||
gṛhaṃ ca vāṭikā patnī bāndhavāśca dhanānyapi |
gāvo bhṛtyāśca sulabhāḥ paraṃ bandhanakāriṇaḥ ||16||
durlabhāḥ sādhavo bhaktirnārāyaṇāśrayastathā |
mokṣo’pi durlabho mātaḥ sādhayettān pumān budhaḥ || 17||
evaṃ me vartate buddhiryathā śādhi karomi tat |
mātā prāha sutaṃ dhanyo vartase tvaṃ hi devatā || 18||
ābālyātte tu saṃkalpā vivekasaṃbhṛtāḥ suta |
dhanyāhaṃ jananī te’pi pitā dhanyo’pi te suta || 19||
yatputro bhagavadbhaktiṃ kartumicchasi sevanam |
satāṃ mokṣamavāptuṃ ca matiste dhanyapātriṇī ||3.97.20 ||
adya putra samākarṇya pārameśvaramuttamam |
vivekaṃ te bahupuṇyā bhavāmi mokṣakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||2 1 ||
saṃkalpāste bhavantyeva pūrṇā bhaktau hareḥ śubhāḥ |
sevāyāṃ ca satāṃ putra nairvighnyaṃ te sadāstu ca || 22||
bālyakrīḍādikaṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā yuvatvakalpanām |
rāgādikamanādṛtya mokṣe buddhistavāsti yat ||23||
prasannāhaṃ mama putra tārako’si kuṭumbinām |
mānuṣaṃ janma mokṣārthaṃ tadanyāni bhavābdhaye ||24||
bhavābdhidāni santyajya saphalīkuru mānavam |
vinivedya janakāya labdhvājñāṃ pāragāminīm ||25||
yāhi cāpunarāvṛttilābhāya satpadālayam |
yatra te sādhavo dhīrā śrūyante brahmapāragāḥ ||26 ||
nirguṇā brahmaguṇakā mokṣadā yāhi tatra vai |
smara mā māṃ prasūṃ kvāpi pitaraṃ bāndhavān gṛham ||27||
bandhanāni vicitrāṇi janmabhuvaṃ sakhīṃstathā |
mā smara viṣayān putra mā dhyānaṃ dehi laukike ||28||
mā pravāhe rasānāṃ cāsvādānāṃ pata karhicit |
mā prasaṃgaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ kvāpi te putra jāyatām ||29||
mokṣamārgaśca te putra nirvighno’ntaṃ pravartatām |
mānavasya tu dehasya satsevāyāṃ samarpaṇam ||3.97.30||
sadaiva kuru putra tvaṃ niḥśreyaḥ śubhamāpnuyāḥ |
ante nārāyaṇaprāptiste’stu dhāmni nivāsitā ||3 1 ||
pitaraṃ brahmatāraṃ te pṛṣṭvā yāhi śubhaṃ kuru |
ityuktvā putramūrdhānamajighrad dhanyamānasā ||32||
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa dhairyaṃ cograṃ dadau prasūḥ |
tyāgāśramārthaṃ putrāyāpreṣayat pitaraṃ prati ||33||
putro yayau tu pitaraṃ sukhāsīnaṃ nanāma ca |
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa brahmatārāya yogine ||34||
brahmatāro’pi vipro vai prāha putraṃ śubhātmakam |
aho dhanyo’smi satataṃ yadgṛhe putra īdṛśaḥ ||35||
bhagavadbhaktitānaśca sādhusatsaṃgamānasaḥ |
abhogo bhogakāmādirahito bālyataḥ śubhaḥ ||36||
pūrvapuṇyena vai putro jāyate bhaktimān vratī |
sādhurvirāgavām̐ścāpi naiṣṭhikaścaurdhvaśīlavān ||37||
bhaja putra hariṃ nityaṃ prasevaya satojanān |
gokarṇe tīrthake gatvātmānaṃ mokṣe niveśaya ||38||
saphalaṃ śreṣṭhaphalakaṃ mānavaṃ varṣma saṃkuru |
putravānasmi putreṇa tvādṛśena suyoginā ||39||
śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ yadodeti tadā bhavet |
jijñāsā mokṣamārge vai sādhusevāpathe’pi ca ||3.97.40||
bandhanaṃ tu dṛḍhaṃ sevātmakaṃ kuṭumbibandhuṣu |
chitvā śūro bhavet kaścinmokṣasaṃgarasaṃplutaḥ ||41 ||
kīṭe pataṃgake deve dānave mānave khage |
sarīsṛpe paśau siddhe ṛṣau bhogāḥ samāḥ khalu ||42||
ta eva vārijāḥ kledā bhautikāste prabhojanāḥ |
indriyāṇi samānāni prāṇāstulyāśca vāyujāḥ ||43||
divasāśca samānā vai prayānti dehināṃ tathā |
nidrālavo yatante na mokṣārthaṃ daivavarjitāḥ ||44||
nirayārthāsta evātra paratra santi nirmitāḥ |
mokṣaḥ pumartha ātmārtho’nye dehārthā na muktaye ||45||
trirāśīn yaḥ samuttīryottare tūrye viśettu vai |
sa eva deva evātra ceśvaraḥ so’pi muktarāṭ ||46||
sa eva kṛtakṛtyo’sti sādhurevāsti so’pi ca |
nārāyaṇaḥ sa evāsti tārako gurureva saḥ ||47||
durjayaṃ kāmasaṃkalpaṃ durjeyaṃ strīdhanādikam |
durjeyaṃ mānasaṃ svasya durjayā vāsanā tathā ||48||
tṛṣṇā cāpi ca durjeyā jitā tvayā kṛtātmanā |
jitaṃ yenātra śiśnaṃ ca rasanā yena sañjitā ||49||
manorājo jito yena sarvaṃ jitaṃ jitātmanā |
prāpnuhi vijayaṃ putrāsāre māyāmaye drutam ||3.97.50||
prāpnuhi vijayaṃ pare brahmaṇyapi sanātane |
śreyaste’stu śubhaṃ te’stu pramodaste’stu sūtsavaḥ ||51 ||
śāśvatānandamagnaśca bhava mukto hareḥ pade |
tvāṃ dṛkṣyāmyakṣare dhāmni yuktamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ||52|||
patnīyuto hi tvāṃ putra nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam |
ityuktaḥ kṛtatilakaḥ kṛtasnehaḥ suto’pi ca ||53||
natvā pitroḥ pādajalaṃ pītvā kṛtvā ca maṃgalam |
bhrātṛśataṃ tathā natvā yayau gokarṇatīrthakam ||54||
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
hare rādhāpate lakṣmīpate hare hare prabho ||55||
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kurvan karatālena vai tataḥ |
padbhyāṃ yayau jālikātaḥ somanāthaṃ sutīrthakam ||56||
bhavanāthaṃ śarabhaṃ ca satītīrthaṃ tato yayau |
tatastīrthaṃ ca gokarṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ pupūja sādaram ||57||
divyakarṇābhidhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā tato yayau |
svargalakṣmīmahātīrthaṃ tato brāhmīṃ mahānadīm ||58||
tato gokarṇaśaṃbhuṃ ca ṛṣivāsām̐stato yayau |
nārikeladrumāṇāṃ sa vane vāsaṃ tato’karot ||59||
ārādhanāṃ hareścakre sādhusevāṃ cakāra saḥ |
japaṃ cakāra me nāmnāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||3.97.60 ||
bhajanaṃ pracakāraivaṃ satataṃ māṃ smaram̐stathā |
satāṃ bhikṣānnalābhena dehayātrāṃ nyavartayat ||61 ||
navāyutasamāścāsīdbhikṣānnaparipoṣakaḥ |
tataḥ sahasravarṣāṇi kandamūlāśano’bhavat ||62||
pañcasāhasravarṣāṇi tataḥ śuṣkadalāśanaḥ |
athābhavattato vāyvāhāro’tiṣṭhat samādhigaḥ ||63||
ātmānamātmani dhyāyan yuyuje paramātmanā |
lakṣavarṣe prayāte tu sampūrṇe cāmbarāttataḥ ||64||
viṣṇorvimānamāyātaṃ pārṣadairdivyaśobhanaiḥ |
sahitaṃ tadvilokyāyamālambāyanasādhurāṭ ||65||
vihāya bhautikaṃ tūrṇaṃ divyadeho’bhavattadā |
caturbhujaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādicihnakaḥ ||66 ||
viṣṇoḥ pārṣadavaryaśca natvā ṛṣigaṇān muniḥ |
yayau dhāma harekṛṣṇa vadan vismāpayan janān ||67||
atha prayāṇe ṛṣayaścāstuvan taṃ munīśvaram |
asmānnaya mahābhakta dhāma vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||68||
sa cāha ṛṣayaḥ sarve sajjā bhavantu satvaram |
gatvā vaikuṇṭhamevāhaṃ cāgacchāmi vimānakaiḥ ||69||
sahito bhavato netuṃ pṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam |
omityuktaśca ṛṣibhiryayau tūrṇaṃ harergṛham ||3.97.70||
pārṣadaiḥ satkṛtaścāyaṃ vimānādavatāritaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhe divyasaudhāgrye nyāviśat saudhamuttamam ||71 ||
adṛṣṭvā śrīhariṃ saudhe tūrṇaṃ viniryayau bahiḥ |
mārgayāmāsa taṃ saudhaṃ yatrāste śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||72||
gatvā kṛtvā daṇḍavacca pūjāṃ cakāra vai hṛdā |
jaya nārāyaṇakṛṣṇetyuvācāpi punaḥpunaḥ ||73||
netrāśrūṇi mumocāpi gadgadaścābhavatkṣaṇam |
papāta pādayorviṣṇoḥ papau pādāmṛtaṃ tataḥ ||74||
svāgatena hariṇāsau pṛṣṭo jagāda hṛdgatam |
kṛpayā te prabho prāptaścaraṇau śāśvatau mudā ||75||
gokarṇe nivasantaśca munayo ye tapodhanāḥ |
prayāṇakāle māmāhuḥ sahayānāya dhāma te ||76||
mayā tvabhihitaṃ cāste gatvā tvāyāmi sarvathā |
ājñāṃ hareḥ samādāya sajjā bhavantu sarvaśaḥ ||77||
ityuktāste pratīkṣante vaikuṇṭhāgamanaṃ prati |
yadyājñā te bhaved yāmi cānayāmi tavāntikam ||78||
nārāyaṇastadā prāha yogyaṃ bhakta tvayā kṛtam |
paraṃ nibodha me kiñcit sārāt sārataraṃ param ||79||
mama bhaktiṃ vinā syānna vāso vaikuṇṭhake mama |
gokarṇe santi ṛṣayastapodravyāstapaḥpriyāḥ ||3.97.80||
manonigrahavantaścendriyanigrahiṇastathā |
ātmamātraratā nityaṃ jñānamātraparāyaṇāḥ ||81 ||
vratamātraparāścāti bahavo rāgavarjitāḥ |
yogakriyāparāścāpi śuṣkatapasivartinaḥ ||82||
mama bhaktivihīnāste vinā vai madupāsanam |
kathamarhā bhaveyuścāgamārthaṃ mama dhāma te ||83||
abhaktānāṃ na vaikuṇṭhaṃ yadyapi tapatāṃ sadā |
karmaṭhānāṃ na vaikuṇṭhaṃ hyanārādhanavedinām ||84||
mama dhāmāgame hetuḥ snehabhaktiḥ sadā mama |
mama bhaktasya vai sevā mayi cātmaniveditā ||85||
dhyānaṃ me bhajanaṃ cāpi kīrtanaṃ satataṃ mama |
tapasāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca dānānāṃ mayi cārpaṇam ||86||
sarvakarmārpaṇaṃ cāpi dīkṣāyā grahaṇaṃ mama |
mama mantrasya divyasya grahaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā ||87||
mamārādhanamevāpi vaikuṇṭhāgamane yataḥ |
apakvā ye yoginaste tapanti cirakālinaḥ ||88||
daśalakṣasamāḥ kecit kecillakṣasamāstathā |
anye bahuyugāḥ santi sahasraśaścirāyuṣaḥ ||89||
yāhi tebhyaḥ pradehyenaṃ mantraṃ mokṣapradaṃ mama |
dīkṣāṃ datvā nāmasatraṃ pravartaya mahāmakham ||3.97.90||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo me śaraṇaṃ patiḥ |
mantrametaṃ pradatvātha dīkṣāṃ dehi prasāttvikīm || 91 ||
kaṇṭhe tu taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ mālāṃ ca japamālikām |
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cāpi cakrādyaṃkanamityapi ||92||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama |
rādhālakṣmīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vibho prabho ||93||
evaṃ satataṃ sādhūnāṃ kīrtanaṃ samprakāraya |
divāniśaṃ mahāyajñaṃ tatra tiṣṭhantu dīkṣitāḥ ||94||
yeṣāmārādhanā pūrṇā bhaktiḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati |
tānahaṃ nityadā naijavimānena suvarcasā || 95||
samāneṣye hi vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāhi satraṃ pravartaya |
ityukto bhaktarāṭ natvālambāyano hi pārṣadaḥ ||96||
āyayau divyadehena vimānena purālayam |
gokarṇaṃ tejasā tūrṇaṃ prakāśitaṃ tadābhavat ||97||
dudruvuḥ saṃbhramayuktāḥ ṛṣayastaṃ tu pārṣadam |
sajjībhūtān sato natvādideśa viṣṇubhāṣitam ||98||
nāmasaṃkīrtanasatraṃ kurvantvatra sudīkṣitāḥ |
ṛṣayo’pi tathā cakrurvaikuṇṭhalabdhaye śubhāḥ ||99||
vividuste ca māhātmyaṃ bhakteḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapobalāt |
bhaktā bhūtvā dīkṣitāśca labdhvā te japamālikām || 3.97.1 00||
savādyakīrtanaṃ cakrurdivāniśaṃ hi muktaye |
lakṣaśo munayaścāpi prajālokāstathāpare || 10 1||
śrutvā tatkīrtanaṃ tatra militvā bhajanaṃ vyadhuḥ |
tattīrthaṃ vaikuṇṭhasatranāmnā khyātiṃ gataṃ tataḥ ||1 0 2||
māsānte ye bhaktipakvā jātāsteṣāṃ kṛte hariḥ |
āyayau svavimānena lakṣmīśrīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 03||
ninye sahasrasādhūm̐śca vaikuṇṭhe parameśvaraḥ |
evaṃ māsāntarānte ca trimāsānte’pi kām̐ścana || 1 04||
catuṣpaṃcādimāsānte ninye lakṣajanān hariḥ |
pakvāḥ pakvāḥ prabhūtvā ca ṛṣayo yānti dhāma te || 105||
gokarṇasthāḥ sādhavaste varṣānte sarvaśo gatāḥ |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat || 1 06||
nāmasatraṃ samārabhya devādyā mānavāstataḥ |
gokarṇe tīrthake yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ parameśvaram || 1 07||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi bhaktimāhātmyamuttamam |
sādhoḥ saṃgena bhagavān kārayitvā tu kīrtanam || 1 08||
pāvayitvā tāpasām̐śca ninye dhāmottamaṃ nijam |
varṣānte sādhurevāyaṃ nāmasatraṃ samāpya ca || 10 9||
yayau dhāma harerdivyadeho divyavimānagaḥ |
koṭiśaḥ sādhavastatra siṃhāraṇye tato’bhavan || 3.97.110 ||
viṣṇudhāmasamaṃ dhāma gokarṇaṃ tadabhūnmahat |
evaṃ lakṣmi satāṃ sevā phalatyeva cireṇa ha || 111 ||
satsaṃgo’pi phalatyeva cireṇāpi nṛjanmanām |
tasmāt satāṃ susatsaṃgaḥ kartavyaḥ phalado bhavet || 11 2||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktido’pi ca |
satsaṃgayogo bhavati lakṣmi śāśvatamokṣadaḥ || 11 3||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lokavyāyāmaśālibhirapi satsaṃgena muktirlabhyate tāpasairapi tathetyarthe ālambāyanasādhoḥ saṃgena lakṣādhilakṣamānavānāṃ gokarṇe muktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 97 ||

<3.98>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
mahatyāpadgatasyāpi yathoddhāro drutaṃ bhavet |
tathā me darśaya kṛṣṇakānta lokahitāya vai || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
praṇamāmi sadā sadbhyo yeṣāṃ brahmaparaṃ dhanam |
yeṣāṃ karatale svargo mokṣo’pi vacane sthitaḥ || 2 ||
ye bālā vā yuvāno vā vṛddhā vā sādhavo’malāḥ |
udvahanti harerbhakterdhuraṃ namāmi tānaham || 3 ||
brahmavidyāsu niṣṇātā vinītā vaśamānasāḥ |
brahmabhāṣāḥ śrutavanto vratinaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ || 4 ||
akṣarabrahmarūpāṇāṃ saṃsatsu brahāvādinaḥ |
māṃgalyarūpā rucirā ye tānnamāmi sajjanān || 5 ||
ye teṣāmapi saṃsevyā brahmasadasi cāgragāḥ |
vijñānadhyānasampannāstebhyo’dhispṛhayāmyaham || 6 ||
satsu śuśrūṣamāṇeṣu pretya ceha sukhaṃ mahat |
sarvāpadāṃ vināśaśca ta uddhārakarāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 ||
susaṃskṛtāni cānnāni śītāni salilāni ca |
ramyāṇi cāmbarāṇyebhyo dātavyāni sadā rame || 8 ||
dhanyaḥ syād yaḥ sādhukule janma labheta puṇyavān |
bhaved yaścottare kāle koṭidehipramokṣadaḥ || 9 ||
na me tvattaḥ priyatarā lakṣmi kāpi bhuvastale |
brahmapriyāḥ priyāḥ sarvāḥ santa priyatamā mama || 3.98.1 0||
na me pitarau kamale tathā priyatarau tviha |
yathā me sādhavaḥ śāntāḥ priyottamottamāḥ sadā || 1 1||
mahatyāpadgatasyāpi sādhavo’tra śubhāvahāḥ |
bhajanīyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ surāṇāmapi devatāḥ || 12||
sāttvataśceti māṃ lokāḥ prāhustuṣyāmi tena ca |
satāṃ yogena sādhvīśaṃ māmāhurbhaktikāriṇaḥ || 13||
yathā bhartrāśrayo dharmo nārīṇāṃ vidyate tathā |
sarveṣāṃ tu sadācāraḥ sādhvāśrayo vṛṣo mataḥ || 14||
viprakṣatraviśāṃ cāpi sādhavo guravo matāḥ |
devavat kṛṣṇavat pūjyāḥ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ || 15||
agnivat sevanīyāste brāhmaṇaiḥ sādhavo’malāḥ |
sādhūnāṃ sevanaistiṣṭhed brāhmaṇyaṃ sarvapāvanam ||16||
patyabhāve yathā nārī devaraṃ kurute patim |
prajāstathā sādhvabhāve pratimāṃ kurute prabhum || 17||
ṛjūn sataḥ satyaśīlān sarvaprāṇihite ratān |
suhṛdaḥ sarvajīvānāṃ sādhūn paricaret sadā || 18||
rājā svajanakaṃ yadvad rakṣet sāghujanaṃ tathā |
āśrame cānvavekṣeta kiṃsvidastīti jīvanam || 19||
brahmiṣṭhān brahma ca tathā sarvathā pālayed dhanī |
bhikṣātṛptasatāmāśīrvādānāsādayeddhanī ||3.98.20||
pratiśrutya na dātavyaṃ tadeva narakaṃ mahat |
āśāhanturhi yatpāpaṃ sarvasukṛtanāśakam ||21 ||
hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ cāśāhanturvihanyate |
āśādānaṃ tvaśvamedhayajñapuṇyaṃ karoti vai| ||22||
āśāpūrtirviṣṇuyāgasahasraphaladā bhavet |
tasmādāśāṃ pradāyaitāṃ pūrayecca yathābalam ||23||
ekadā śvapacagṛdhrau śmaśāne militau tadā |
gṛdhraṃ parāsuṃ khādantaṃ papraccha śvapacaḥ śanaiḥ ||24||
kiṃ tvayā vai kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadaśnāsi prapūtikam |
kutsitaṃ mṛtakaṃ cātidurgandhaṃ kleditaṃ tviha ||25||
gṛdhraḥ prāha purā cāhamabhūvaṃ lobhavān dhanī |
pratiśrutyāpi ca dadau naiva vāpūrṇameva vā |
tena pāpena saṃjāto gṛdhraścātra śmaśānagaḥ ||26||
tasmādevaṃ cātiduṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmi bubhukṣitaḥ |
paraṃ te śvāpacaṃ janma kathaṃ jātaṃ nu me vada ||27||
śvapaca prāha pūrve’haṃ dhanadhānyayuto’pi san |
sādhūnāṃ nindakaścāsaṃ brāhmaṇo’pi ghṛṇī sati |||28||
dṛṣṭvā sādhūn dhikkaromi tiraskaromi narma ca |
na dadāmi kvacid bhikṣāṃ vārayāmi paraṃ hyapi ||29||
tena pāpena sarvasvaṃ gṛhadārasutādikam |
naṣṭaṃ vahniprakopena dagdhaṃ dagdho’hamityataḥ ||3.98.3 0||
yamalokaṃ gatastatra yāmyairandhatamisrake |
nikṣiptau bahuvarṣāṇi niṣkāsya netrajihvike ||3 1||
athāhamabhavaṃ vāgurikā viṣṭāmukhī tataḥ |
sarpo’hamabhavaṃ paścād ghūkastato’tha godhikā ||3 2||
tato’smi jātaścāṇḍālaḥ sādhūnāṃ nindanāt khalu |
tasmānna sādhavaḥ kvāpi tiraskāryā hareḥ priyāḥ ||33||
bhikṣā naiṣāṃ vāraṇīyā dānaṃ vāryaṃ na vai kvacit |
teṣāṃ vastu na hartavyaṃ deyaṃ teṣāṃ tu tuṣṭaye ||34||
brahmiṣṭhaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ sādhvībhiśca tathā janaiḥ |
samaṃ vivādo moktavyo dātavyaṃ ca pratiśrutam ||35||
na kāryaṃ nindanaṃ teṣāṃ śravaṇīyaṃ na karhicit |
vipratvasya na vai garvaḥ kartavyaḥ sannidhau satām ||36||
viprā ye gṛhiṇaste tu strīśmaśānaprasevinaḥ |
sādhubhyo nimnamārgasthā vipraiḥ pūjyā hi sādhavaḥ ||37||
ye mūtraklinnasaṃsaktāste vai nirayagāminaḥ |
tānuddhartuṃ samarthāste sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ ||38||
na stenastārayet stenamasteno yaḥ sa tārayet |
na kāmī tārayet kāmādakāmastārayed ratam ||39||
na hartavyaṃ sādhuvastu kṣantavyaṃ teṣu nityaśaḥ |
bālāśca nāvamantavyāḥ kṛpaṇā vāpyaśaktayaḥ ||3.98.40||
āśā kāryā na satataṃ sādhubhyaḥ svārthasādhikā |
naiva sādhūn niyuñjīta bhṛtyavad bhojanāptaye ||41 ||
jalāptaye tathā khaṣṭvāgendukādyupalabdhaye |
āsanārthaṃ ca vāsārthaṃ cāśrayārthaṃ ca mandire ||42||
nāyāse yojayet sādhuṃ yataḥ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati |
sādhuvāse gṛhasthairvai vastavyaṃ nahi karhicit ||43||
satsaṃgārthaṃ pragantavyaṃ kleśārthaṃ nahi karhicit |
nidrārthaṃ malamūtrādityāgārthaṃ vā sadāśrame ||44||
gantavyaṃ naiva naijīyāṃgikakāryanivarttaye |
sādhūnāṃ śāntikāle vā vikṣepaścalatā tathā ||45||
ayogyācāra evāpi kartavyo na kadācana |
sādhūnāṃ sannidhāvuccāsane stheyaṃ na karhicit ||46||
vivādo naiva kartavyo vācā dhanena karmaṇā |
jñānena svasya nirvāhārthaṃ vā balena lobhinā ||47||
duṣṭamānuṣasaṃgena vādaḥ kāryo na sajjanaiḥ |
taddhanāśā na kartavyā vaśe kāryā na sādhavaḥ ||48||
nirīkṣaṇaṃ hi sādhūnāṃ kāryaṃ na daihikaṃ kvacit |
rāgadveṣasvabhāvāḥ svāḥ prayoktavyā na sādhuṣu ||49||
sādhvāśrame grāmyakathāḥ kleśakathā mṛṣākathāḥ |
bhogakathā na kartavyā noccāryaṃ cāpamānakṛt ||3.98.50||
yojanīyo na garvaśca balaṃ sattā na sādhuṣu |
nimnīkāryā na vai santo yataḥ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati |51 ||
ahaṃ jānāmi sādhuḥ kiṃ jānatītyeva garvitā |
kartavyā naiva vai kvāpi garvaḥ patanakāraṇam ||52||
sādhuṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameccānamanaṃ puṇyaghātakam |
svasya kāmādikān doṣān nārīdoṣān nijātmakān ||53||
svasvabhāvasya kāluṣyaṃ na prayuñjīta sādhuṣu |
sādhvāśrame pragantavyaṃ guṇalābhārthameva ha ||54||
bahavaḥ santi loke’tra khaleśvarā janā api |
svasya viṣayatṛptyarthaṃ sparśatṛptyarthamityapi ||55||
dṛṣṭitṛptyarthamevāpi yānti strīsaṃghabhūsthalīm |
mandire cotsave tīrthe yatra strījanamardanam ||56||
sammarde samprayāntyeva līlākhyānakathādiṣu |
doṣān gṛhṇanti tatraiva sādhūnāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ||57||
tena pāpena jātyandhāḥ kuṣṭhinaśca napuṃsakāḥ |
jāyante dīrgharogāśca daridrāḥ kṛpaṇāstathā ||58||
nāryo’pi ca tathāceṣṭā jāyante rogasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
apatyādivihīnāśca dhanadhānyādivarjitāḥ ||59||
tasmād doṣānna gṛhṇīyāt sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi |
guṇāneva hi gṛhṇīyāt sukhadān puṇyadān śubhān ||3.98.60 ||
yathekṣudaṇḍataḥ sūkṣmakaṇṭakām̐ścamarān dalān |
tvakkūrcān saṃvihāyaiva rasaṃ gṛhṇanti mānavāḥ ||6 1 ||
yathā bhojyagatān śāke kṣiptān dagdhamarīcakān |
patrādikān parityajya śākamātraṃ prabhuñjate ||62||
yathā phalagatān bījatvagādīn saṃvihāya vai |
bhuñjate garbhamātraṃ vai rasān cūṣanti dehinaḥ ||63||
yathā vṛkṣagatān doṣām̐styaktvā gṛhṇanti tatphalam |
yathā vallīgatān doṣām̐styaktvā gṛhṇanti puṣpakam ||64||
tathā sādhugatām̐styājyām̐styaktvārjayeta tadguṇān |
evaṃ vai vartamānasya puṇyaprāptiḥ pade pade ||65||
āyurvidyāyaśovṛddhirdhanadhānyarddhisampadām |
anantatvaṃ prajāyeta sādhusadguṇasaṃjuṣām ||66||
sādhavo hi yadā tuṣṭāḥ pratinandanti sevakam |
tadgṛhaṃ saṃbhavatyeva sarvaratnopabṛṃhitam ||67||
putrān pautrān paśūm̐ścāpi bāndhavām̐śca kuṭumbinaḥ |
grāmaṃ janapadaṃ cāpi sādhutuṣṭiḥ prapoṣayet ||68||
sādhujanasya dattena dhruvaṃ svargo hyanuttamaḥ |
mokṣaścārjayituṃ śakyaḥ sādhusevā parā kriyā ||69||
sadbhyo dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitaro’pi ca |
muktāstuṣyanti bhagavān bhuṃkte sādhujaneṣu vai ||3.98.70||
tasmād dānāni deyāni sādhubhyaḥ pravijānatā |
tīrthaṃ sudivyamevāste sādhumūrtiḥ sucetanā ||71 ||
adhamoddhārakāḥ santi sādhavo mama mūrtayaḥ |
anāthānāṃ sanāthāste duḥkhināṃ duḥkhahārakāḥ ||72||
pāpānāṃ kṣālakāścāparādhināṃ doṣanāśakāḥ |
tiraskṛtānāṃ śaraṇapradātāro hi sādhavaḥ ||73||
śṛṇu pūrvakathāṃ vacmi sādhubhistārito dvijaḥ |
himālaye’bhavad ramyamāśramamṛṣisevitam ||74||
ṛṣidhāmāśramaṃ nāma siddharṣivipraśobhitam |
vratibhistāpasaiścāpi niyamibhiśca dīkṣitaiḥ ||75||
kṛtātmabhistathā sādhuyatibhiḥ sanniveśitam |
ṛṣestu dīrghatapaso dvijaśreṣṭhasya yoginaḥ || ||76||
tatra kaścit samāyātaḥ śabaro vanajīvanaḥ |
dadarśarṣigaṇān devakalpām̐staporatān śubhān ||77||
niścikāya tapastaptuṃ papraccha dīrghatāpasam |
dharmaṃ me bhagavan vaktuṃ pravrājayitumarhasi ||78||
śūdro’hṛṃ kartumicchāmi śuśrūṣāṃ te prasīda me |
dīrghatapāstadovāca śūdrastvaṃ vartase yataḥ ||79||
pravrājayituṃ śakyaṃ na hyadhikāravivarjanāt |
āsyatāṃ caivamevātra śuśrūṣāṃ kuru rocate ||3.98.80||
śuśrūṣayā parām̐llokānavāpsyasi vanecara |
ityuktaḥ sa śabaro’pi mumude cāśramāntike ||81||
vṛkṣādhobhāgake naijāṃ sthalīṃ kṛtvā hyuvāsa ha |
bhojanaṃ phalapuṣpādi cakre śuśrūṣaṇamṛṣeḥ ||82||
ekadā svasvabhāvena vanyaṃ śaśaṃ dadhāra saḥ |
mārayitvādanaṃ cakre ṛṣerāśramasannidhau ||83||
athainaṃ hiṃsakaṃ śūdraṃ tatyajuḥ ṛṣayaśca te |
śepuśca rākṣaso bhūtvā bhava duḥkhī vanāntare ||84||
tūrṇaṃ sa rākṣaso bhūtvā vikṛto vyacaradvane |
kṣudhātṛṣātiduḥkhāḍhyo yayau gaṃgātaṭe tataḥ ||85||
tatrānena tapomagnaḥ sādhurbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
nāmnā nārāyaṇamunirdṛṣṭo vaiṣṇavasattamaḥ ||86||
sādhuṃ bhakṣayituṃ tūrṇaṃ rākṣasaḥ prayayau taṭam |
sādhurdṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭyā vyalokayattathā ||87||
jalaṃ cikṣepa śirasi rākṣasasya ca varṣmaṇi |
pavitro bhava dharmātmā duḥkhād virahito bhava ||88||
śāpamukto bhavātraiva sādhorme sannidhau hyaghin |
ityevamuktaḥ śabaro jalasparśena satvaram ||89||
vihāya rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ divyo babhūva mānavaḥ |
atha coddhārakaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇamuniṃ tataḥ ||3.98.90||
siṣeve parayā prītyā pāvanī lokapāvanaḥ |
śūdro’pi sādhuyogena bhaktimānabhavattataḥ ||91 ||
sādhorājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva yayau vanāntaraṃ prati |
bheje nārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||92||
śabaraḥ sa tu dehānte rājyaṃ śreṣṭhamavāptavān |
ujjayinīnṛpo vīravikramo hyabhavaddhi saḥ || 93||
bhuktvā bhogān hareścāpi kṛtvā bhaktiṃ tathottamām |
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mukto babhūva satprasaṃgataḥ ||94||
tatkuṭumbaṃ sāghusevāṃ kṛtvā yayau paraṃ padam |
tasmād gṛdhra sadā sevyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||95||
āgacchātrasamīpe’sti sādhuḥ kṛṣṇastavābhidhaḥ |
tamāśritya bhaviṣyāvo dhūtapāpau hi pāvanau ||96||
ityuktvā lakṣmi yayatuḥ kṛṣṇastavābhidhaṃ prati |
nematustuṣṭuvatuścārthayāmāsatureva ca ||97||
mokṣaṇaṃ cātha sādhustau pāyayāmāsa vāri ca |
prasādaṃ bhojayāmāsa kṛtavān pāvano drutam ||98||
pāpaṃ prajvālayāmāsa śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam |
nāma nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi dadau tūrṇaṃ hi tāvubhau ||99||
bhautikau tu tadā dehau tyaktvā sādhupratāpataḥ |
yayatustau pāpahīnau svargaṃ devau babhūvatuḥ ||3.98.1 0 0||
sādhvāśrayeṇa vai svargaṃ bhuktvā prasādasatphalam |
kālena tau yayatuśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 10 1||
lakṣmītyevaṃ sādhusaṃgo lavamātraṃ kṛto’pi vai |
pāvayatyeva puṇyānāṃ puñjaṃ dadāti satvaram || 1 02||
rājyaṃ svargaṃ dadātyeva mokṣaṇaṃ ca dadātyapi|
prayacchati mahānandaṃ satsaṃgaḥ kṛṣṇayoginām |||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne āpadgatasyāpi sādhusaṃgatiḥ kalyāṇadetyarthe gṛdhraśvapacayoḥ śabarasya ca svargādyuttaraṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||

<3.99>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
satyaṃ tadbhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho |
yatra te sādhavaḥ santi tatra pumarthasiddhayaḥ || 1 ||
ye ca santo nirmalā me patyuḥ priyatamā janāḥ |
teṣāṃ pādarajaścāhaṃ vahāmi śirasā sadā || 2 ||
teṣāmājñāmarthakarīṃ śubhāṃ vāpyathavāśubhām |
vahāmi sarvadānena niḥśaṃkā tava kāraṇāt || 3 ||
satāṃ vāṇī satyapūtā yādṛśī tādṛśī hyapi |
satāṃ vāṇī paro vedo bhavān yatra pratiṣṭhati || 4 ||
maunavrataṃ sadā cāste satāṃ vaikharyanāvṛtam |
santo vinārthaṃ paramaṃ vadantyeva na laukikam || 5 ||
mukhamastīti vaktavyaṃ nisargo’yaṃ na vai satām |
sūkṣmā gatirhi satyasya durjñeyā hyakṛtātmabhiḥ || 6 ||
mūḍharucyanusāreṇa vaktavyaṃ na satā kvacit |
vacane doṣasaṃkrāntistato maunaṃ varaṃ satām || 7 ||
mānavāstādṛśā loke jāyante ca bhavanti ca |
guruścāpyupadeṣṭāpi svamataṃ cedvaded yadi || 8 ||
tadā sa gururāṭ śreṣṭho’nyathājñaḥ parikīrtyate |
etādṛśā bhavantyeva śiṣyā ghoratamovṛtāḥ || 9 ||
svamatamanudveṣṭā vai gururgururna cānyathā |
tasmātte nārakāścātra paratrāpi bhavanti hi || 3.99.1 0||
ataḥ śiṣyābhirevātra śiṣyairvā yanmataṃ matam |
tanmataṃ ced viruddhaṃ vai śāstradharmādibādhakam || 1 1||
tadā na guruṇā grāhyaṃ tyājyāḥ śiṣyāstu tādṛśāḥ |
prāyaśo bahavo loke mṛṣāpaṇḍābhimāninaḥ || 12||
vijñaṃmanyā bhavantyeva śiṣyā guruniyāmakāḥ |
apathe gamyamānāste patantyeva hyadho hyadhaḥ || 13||
asadvāṇī mahāpāpā na vaktavyā kadācana |
tatra sadbhirna vaktavyā kasyacit kiñcidagrataḥ || 14||
varāṃ maunena munayo dīkṣāṃ kurvanti saṃyame |
duruktasya bhayāt kṛṣṇa nābhāṣante vṛthā mṛṣā || 15||
dhārmikā guṇasampannāḥ satyabhaktisamanvitāḥ |
satyopadeśairmunayaḥ prāpayanti paraṃ padam || 16||
duṣkṛtaṃ dārayantyeva śrotṝṇāṃ brahmadānataḥ |
ānandābdhiṃ prārpayanti parameśaprasaṃgadāḥ || 17||
apātraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyāt parīkṣaṇīyaṃ sarvathā |
upadeśo na kartavyaḥ sahasā sthitimantarā || 18||
apātre copadeśāt tatpāpaṃ saṃkramate gurau |
vimṛśya jñānadānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ satyasaṃjuṣā || 1 9||
anṛte cāpyapātre copadeśaḥ svaṃ hinasti hi |
tādṛgbodhaḥ pradātavyo yena satyaṃ prarakṣayet ||3.99.20||
yena sanātano devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasādyate |
etādṛśāḥ satyaśīlāḥ satyanārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||2 1||
satyasanātanabhaktāḥ sādhavo guravo mama |
vasāmi bhagavam̐statra yatra me guravo’malāḥ ||22|||
pūjyante bhavatā sākaṃ subhagā brahmavedinaḥ |
pragalbhā bhaktidakṣāśca śrīharivyavasāyinaḥ ||23||
devabhaktāḥ kṛtajñāśca jitendriyāśca sāttvikāḥ |
puruṣārthaparā divyāḥ santo yatra vasāmyaham ||24||
yatra kānto mama nārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bhavānāste nivasāmi tatra sarvasvadānataḥ ||25||
na vasāmyapumarthāḍhye nāstike kṛtaghātini |
dharmasāṃkarike naiva bhinnasetau vasāmi na ||26||
nṛśaṃse nindake duṣṭe caure guruṣvasūyini |
sādhūnāṃ dveṣiṇi dṛpte naiva vasāmi sarvathā || 27||
alpatejasi sattvena vihīne balavarjite |
kliṣṭe kruddhe na tiṣṭhāmi cāsthire sthitivarjite ||28||
aprārthini svabhāvena vihate’lpapratoṣiṇi |
bahuvyaye vyasanini nāhaṃ vasāmi sarvadā ||29||
dharmāḍhye dharmaviduṣi dānte vṛddhopasevini |
kṣāntipare kṛtakṛtye nivasāmi mahotsave ||3.99.3 0||
satyasvabhāvāsu dāntāsvabalāsu vasāmi ca |
ārjavāḍhyāsu sādhūnāṃ sevikāsu vasāmi ca ||3 1||
dehadvijagurusvāmipūjikāsu vasāmi ca |
malināṃ cāsthirāṃ naijakāryālasāṃ virodhinīm ||32||
pratikūlasthitiṃ bhartuḥ parapakṣasahāyinīm |
alajjāṃ cāsahamānāṃ varjayāmi sadā tvaham || 33||
pāpāmasādhusevāḍhyāṃ kruddhāṃ dhairyavivarjitām |
śaṭhāṃ kalahamūlāṃ ca bahunidrāṃ tyajāmi ca ||34||
satyavratāsu divyāsu guṇasaubhāgyadāsu ca |
pativratāsu śīlāsu vasāmi bhūṣitāsu ca ||35||
yāneṣu sādhuyukteṣu bhaktāsu kanyakāsu ca |
yajñeṣu sādhuyukteṣu mandire ca vasāmyaham ||36||
puṣpeṣu sasyagātreṣu gajeṣu mandurāsu ca |
goṣṭheṣu sādhupādeṣu paṃkajeṣu vasāmyaham ||37||
nadīyuktapradeśeṣu tapasvisiddhayogiṣu |
vṛṣabhe gomaṇḍale ca narendre sajjane tathā ||38||
uccāsane ca havyāde suragobrahmapūjake |
ātithyaśobhane saudhe nityaṃ vasāmi mādhava ||39||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sādhau ca te’nuge |
sādhvyāṃ bhaktajane cāpi vasāmi nityamūrjitā ||3.99.40||
prasannāścādṛśyabhāvā yatra vasāmi keśava |
tvadājñayā vardhayāmi dharmayaśo’rthakāmanaiḥ ||41 ||
bhagavan me rahasyaṃ tu kathayāmīha sarvathā |
sādhavo yatra sevyante tatra vasāmi sarvadā ||42||
sādhavo bhagavadrūpā mama nāthasya mūrtayaḥ |
teṣāṃ sevādilābhārthaṃ tava prasannatāptaye ||43||
nityaṃ vasāmi sādhūnāṃ sevikāyāṃ ca sevake |
yatra gopālakṛṣṇaśca yatra śrīkaṃbharāsatī ||44||
santuṣṭā yatra vai cāste yatra śrīharivallabhaḥ |
tatra vasāmi nityaṃ vai yatra pūjā harestava ||45||
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena bhajante ye janā harim |
svārthabhāvavihīnāstān naiva tyajāmi karhicit ||46||
yatra sādhvannasatrāṇi yatra sādhvāśramāḥ sadā |
yatra satāṃ śubhā sevā tatra vasāmi vṛddhidā ||47||
yatra niṣkapaṭā buddhirvartate sevake jane |
nirdoṣā ca matiryatra tatra vasāmi sarvathā ||48||
gṛhadārasutāputradhanebhyaścādhikāstathā |
yasya santo matāstasya gṛhe vasāmi sarvathā ||49||
patidevaśvaśurebhyo’dhikā yatra hi sādhavaḥ |
pūjyante yoṣitāṃ tāsāṃ gṛhe vasāmi sarvathā ||3.99.50||
sādhūnāṃ raṭaṇaṃ yatra sādhūnāṃ yatra darśanam |
sneho yatra sadā satsu tatra vasāmi sarvathā ||51||
bhagavān bhagavantaśca hariśca sādhavastathā |
svāmī ca sevakā yatra tatra vasāmi sarvadā ||52||
yatra svāmī na me cāste na tadbhaktā hi sādhavaḥ |
sūryavat puṇyayogenodayitvāstaṃ prayāmyaham ||53||
yadgṛhe divaso yāti vinā tvannāmakīrtanam |
tadgṛhaṃ santyajāmyeva mūrchayā pīḍitā satī ||54||
yatra te satpūruṣāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ vidyate na vai |
tadgṛhaṃ gahvaraṃ matvā śmaśānavattyajāmyaham ||55||
yatra sādhujanapādaṃ varṣe’pi naiva dṛśyate |
tadgahaṃ puṇyaśūnyaṃ vai śmaśānavat tyajāmyaham ||56||
yatrotsavo na kṛṣṇasya varṣāntare’pi jāyate |
tadgṛhaṃ santyajāmyeva tavotsavavivarjitam ||57||
yatra bhaktā na te santi vasanti naiva ca kvacit |
tatra me rocate naiva vāsaḥ kardamasāgare ||58||
yatra saudhe mandire vā bhavane devatālaye |
patirnārāyaṇo nāsti tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||59||
yatra svarṇālaye svarṇakośe rājyāsane’pi vā |
nārāyaṇārpaṇaṃ prātarnāsti naiva vasāmyaham ||3.99.6 0 ||
yatra hareḥ pūjanāgre ghṛtadīpo na vidyate |
dhūpaścārārtrikaṃ nāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||6 1 ||
yatra naivedyakaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛte nāsti jalaṃ na ca |
yatra viṣṇujanaḥ kvāpi na bhuṃkte na vasāmyaham ||62||
yatrāṣṭamījayantyāśca trayodaśyā mahotsavaḥ |
ūrje kṛṣṇe na cāstyeva tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||63||
yatrāvatāragāthāste naiva śrūyanta aiśvaram |
pūjanaṃ vā pratimānaṃ nāsti naiva vasāmyaham ||64||
śaṃkhacakrādicihnāni tulasīvṛkṣamityapi |
yatra naiva pravidyante tatra naiva vasāmyaham ||65||
yatra lakṣmyavatārāṇāṃ kathā mūrtirna cāsti ca |
nārāyaṇāvatārāṇāṃ nāpi tatra vasāmi na ||66||
yatra satāṃ na satkāro vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ na ca |
gavāṃ sammānanaṃ nāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||67||
yatra śrāddhaṃ na devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ jīvatāṃ ca vā |
puṇyadānaṃ na yatrāsti tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||68||
yadgṛhe bālakā naiva rakṣyante bhojanādibhiḥ |
uttāpyante striyo yatra tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||69||
paṃktibhedo gṛhe yatra cāśritānāṃ prapīḍanam |
paśūnāṃ rodhanaṃ yatra tatra naiva vasāmi ca ||3.99.70||
gopure yannagarasya nārāyaṇapratikṛtiḥ |
vidyate naiva tatrāpi ciraṃ naiva vasāmyaham ||7 1 ||
yatra sarasvatī lakṣmīrhastikamalamālinī |
rājate candraśālādau tadgṛhe nivasāmi ca ||72||
yatra gaṇeśo nāsti na santi śrīmātaraḥ kṛtāḥ |
bindurūpāstatra naiva vasāmyahaṃ ciraṃ kvacit ||73||
yatra nare ca nāryā ca vaimanasyaṃ sutādiṣu |
bhṛtyasvāmiṣu caudāsīnatā tatra vasāmi na ||74||
yatrāste rakṣakaḥ svāmī bhakṣako dharmavarjitaḥ |
nārāyaṇasya vai dveṣī caurastatra vasāmi na ||75|||
yatra vāṭyāṃ devavṛkṣā vidyante naiva sarvathā |
yajñīyā vallayo vṛkṣā naiva tatra vasāmi na ||76||
yatra kṣetre sasyaśobhe satāṃ vicaraṇaṃ nahi |
tatra kaṇeṣu naivāhaṃ saṃbhavāmyativartinī ||77||
yatra santo na sarasi nadyāṃ nade taḍāgake |
kūpe snānti kvacittatra jale rase vasāmi na ||78||
yatra lokasamāje vā tathā devasamājake |
viduṣāṃ ca samāje na sādhustatra vasāmi na ||79||
yatra rājasamāje vā prajāsamājake tathā |
tīrthe vā nāsti bhaktātmā tasmādapasarāmyaham ||3.99.80||
yā sabhā sādhuśūnyā yā kṛtirharyarpaṇaṃ vinā |
prāptiryā dānaśūnyā ca tato’pyapasarāmyaham ||8 1||
yatrendro vijayo lakṣmīryūpe stambhe gṛhe tathā |
yatra śrīśaḥ svayaṃ cāste tatra vasāmi keśava ||82||
yatra rātrau na dīpo’sti divā nivedanaṃ na ca |
yatra snehyāgamo nāsti tataścāpasarāmyaham ||83||
dāridryaṃ rājate yatra dharmakarmārhaṇādiṣu |
jīrṇadānaṃ ca yatra syāt tato’pyapasarāmyaham ||84||
yatra sītā ca vṛṣabhāḥ pūjyante na kṛṣikṣaṇe |
bhūmirna pūjyate yatra tatra naiva bhavāmyaham ||85||
yatra bhāle na candro’sti kauṃkumaścāndano’pi vā |
saubhāgyabhūṣaṇaṃ nāsti tataścāpasarāmyaham ||86||
yatrāste cābhayadānaṃ mokṣamārgapradarśanam |
bhaktagāthācaritrāṇi tatra vasāmi keśava ||87||
satāṃ śīlasvabhāvānāmaparigrahayoginām |
vāci hṛdi pādayośca vasāmi muditā sadā ||88||
hareḥ pūjāvaśiṣṭe ca jale patre sume kaṇe |
prasāde’nne’mbare dravye vasāmi sarvavastuṣu ||89||
dīkṣite sāttvate bhakte sādhvyāṃ ca brahmayoṣiti |
haryarthaṃ pācikāyāṃ ca nivasāmi hyatandritā ||3.99.90||
patnīvrataḥ sadā tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇo bhavasyataḥ |
maddhastamantarā naiva gṛhṇāsyanyasamarpitam ||91||
tasmāt samarpake tūrṇaṃ nivasāmi niyogataḥ |
nivedako matsvarūpaḥ sevako yo’pi ko’pi vā || 92||
yā vā kā vā sevikā te lakṣmīrūpā na saṃśayaḥ |
sādhavaḥ sevakāste vai sarvathātmanivedinaḥ || 93 ||
teṣu mayāpi vasatiḥ sarvadācaryyate prabho |
harerbhaktāśca ye nārīnarāścāpi bhavanti ca || 94||
devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaśca mānavāḥ |
nāgā daityā rākṣāśca dānavā bhaktikāriṇaḥ || 95||
sādhyā viśve marutaścādityā rudrā vasūttamāḥ |
siddhāśca kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā ||96||
kimpumāṃsaśca gandharvā apsaraso’pi ceśikāḥ |
yoginyo mātaraścāpi śaktayaḥ sādhikāstathā ||97 ||
gaṇikāśca gaṇāścāpi kanyāḥ kumārakāstathā |
yakṣāśca lokapālāśca dikpālāstīrthakoṭayaḥ || 98||
tiryañco vā taijasāśca tāmasā vā catuṣpadāḥ |
kīṭā vā pakṣiṇaścāpi ye ke’pi jaḍacetanāḥ || 99||
tava bhaktyarthamevaite udyatāstatra tatra ca |
śīghraṃ vasāmi gatvaiva karomi pāvanām̐śca tān || 3.99.100 ||
tato gṛhṇāsi taddattaṃ nārāyaṇa karānmama |
etādṛśaṃ nijapatnīvrataṃ nānyatra vidyate || 101 ||
pātivratyaṃ tathā lakṣmyāṃ tadanyatra na vidyate |
santaste sarvadā satyapātivratyānvitāḥ khalu || 10 2||
yathā lakṣmīstathā santaḥ santo lakṣyastava priyāḥ |
ato nigadyase kṛṣṇa lakṣmīkāntaḥ satāṃ patiḥ || 103 ||
ato’haṃ matsapatnīnāṃ satāṃ deheṣu sarvadā |
abhinnā saṃvasāmyeva naitajjānāti cetaraḥ || 1 04||
namastasmai bhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te |
sādhubhyaśca namo lakṣmyai lakṣmyāḍhyebhyo namo’pi ca || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhujaneṣu sadā lakṣmīnivāsaḥ lakṣmīnivāsasthānāni,pāpiprabhatiṣvanivāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||

<3.100>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
parameśa kṛpāsindho sādhūnāṃ paramaṃ dhanam |
muktānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇo devānāṃ daivataṃ param || 1 ||
kṛpayaiva bhavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tra bhūtale |
samāyāsyathavā cānyat kāraṇaṃ vidyate nu kim || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
kṛpātra kāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ śivarājñīpriye sadā |
icchaiva kāraṇaṃ sṛṣṭau mamāgamasya sarvathā || 3 ||
tathāpi niyataṃ hetumudbhāvayāmi cāparam |
yadā yadā samāyāmi sṛṣṭyantare ca kalpake || 4 ||
ādau kvacinmaharṣeśca bhṛgornimittamāpya ha |
samāyāmi muhuśceti bhaktānāmicchayāpi ca || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca
bhṛgoḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jātaṃ yadarthaṃ vai tvayā prabho |
muhurmānuṣabhāve’tra prākaṭyaṃ gṛhyate vada || 6 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ tu kāraṇam |
bhṛgustrīkhyātivadhato bhṛguśāpena mānuṣe || 7 ||
prākaṭyaṃ sarvathā viṣṇorbahuvāraṃ prajāyate |
devakāryārthalagnasya divyaiśvaryasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 8 ||
yugadharme parāvṛtte śithile ca vṛṣe tataḥ |
kartuṃ dharmavyavasthānaṃ jāyate viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 9 ||
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo rājye trilokamaṇḍale |
śāstābhavatpurā rājā daśakoṭisamāstathā || 3.100.1 0||
dvāsaptatilakṣāṇi varṣāṇyanyāni vai tathā |
tathāśītisahasrāṇi samrāṭ nirāmayo’bhavat || 1 1||
tato daśayugaṃ rājā prahlādaścābhavad bhuvaḥ |
tato rājā baliścāsīd daśakoṭisamāstathā || 12||
triṃśallakṣāṇi ca ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi samā bhuvaḥ |
trayaste indrā vikhyātā daityānāmabhavam̐stadā || 1 3||
daityasaṃsthamidaṃ sarvamāsīd rājyaṃ trilokagam |
atrāntare ca saṃgrāmāḥ surāsurakṣayāvahāḥ || 14||
āsan dvādaśa cogrāśca viṣṇuryatra surārthitaḥ |
daityān vyanāśayad divyacakreṇa saṃgato muhuḥ || 15||
vārāhakalpe te sarve saṃgrāmāstān priye śṛṇu |
prathamo nārasiṃhastu hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 16||
dvitīyaścāpi vārāho yatra hato hiraṇyadṛk |
prahlādo nirjitaścāpi tṛtīyo’mṛtamanthane || 17||
virocanaścaturthaśca hato vai tārakāmaye |
tārakā sā bṛhaspateḥ patnī candreṇa cāhṛtā || 18||
tannimittaṃ tu tadyuddhaṃ babhūva romaharṣaṇam |
vāmanena balirbaddho yuddhaṃ mahadabhūttadā || 1 9||
ṣaṣṭhe hyāḍībako jambho hataḥ śakreṇa viṣṇunā |
saptame śaṃbhunā daityāstripurādyā vināśitāḥ ||3.100.20||
aṣṭame cāndhako nighātitaḥ sadaityadānavaḥ |
navame vipracittyādyā lakṣaśaḥ śakrasūditāḥ ||21||
vṛtrāsuro ghātitaśca daśame vajrapāṇinā |
ekādaśe tu rajinā daityāḥ sarve vināśitāḥ ||22||

brahmapriyāṣṭakaṃ tvetat koṭyarbudāṅganottamam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhettathā || 154||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhagavadavatārāṇāṃ sṛṣṭāvāgamane kṛpā vā bhṛgoḥ śāpo nimittaṃ, daityānāṃ dvādaśasaṃgrāmāḥ, padmāvatīramākuṭumbasya prāgvṛttāntādiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 100 ||

<3.101>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan yasya sādhūnāṃ yogastvatra babhūva na |
pretasya tasya coddhāraḥ kathaṃ syād vada taddhitam || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri pretasya pṛṣṭhato janaiḥ |
śrāddhe santo bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ suvastubhiḥ || 2 ||
vastrabhūṣāratnarūpyasuvarṇadhanavāhanaiḥ |
santoṣaṇīyāḥ santaśca viprāśca brahmavedinaḥ || 3 ||
godānāni pradeyāni gāvo vai tārikā sadā |
godānācchāśvatān lokān prāpnuyāt preta utthitaḥ || 4 ||
gaurhi nyāyāgatā dattā sadyastārayate kulam |
māndhātāraṃ purā prāha bṛhaspatiḥ śṛṇuṣva tat || 5 ||
santaṃ prapūjya vipraṃ ca guruṃ prapūjya gāṃ tathā |
pretanāmnā pradadyācca gāṃ pātrāya mahātmane || 6 ||
gaurme mātā pitā cokṣā tatra svargaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
sāyaṃ goṣṭhe vratī sthitvā gosevādiparāyaṇaḥ || 7 ||
prātarutthāya godānaṃ kuryāt smṛtvā paretakam |
pretastūrṇaṃ divaṃ yāti kamale nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
vasedekāṃ niśāṃ gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ |
aikātmyabhāvayukto yaḥ kaluṣāt sa vimucyate || 9 ||
dogdhryaḥ savatsikā deyā prātaḥ sūryasya darśane |
yuvatyo rūpaśālinyo’mṛtagarbhāḥ prarohadāḥ || 3.101.1 0||
eno gāvaḥ praṇudantu svargayānāya santu me |
mātṛvanmāṃ prarakṣantu santvāśīrvādasampradāḥ || 11 ||
roganāśe pare mokṣe svarge smṛddhau sukhe dhane |
gāvaḥ prasannā udayaṃ dadatu śreyasāṃ pade || 12||
sarvadevāśrayāḥ puṇyā diśadhvaṃ gatimuttamām |
ātmanā manasā yuktā dadatvātmārpaṇaṃ phalam || 13||
arghyaṃ vastraṃ suparṇaṃ ca vasu tāvata odanān |
ūrdhvāsyāṃ suprasannāṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dade || 14||
gopradātā samuccārya dadyāt phalaṃ labhet param |
godaḥ śīlīpūjakaśca dātārghasya ca sevakaḥ || 15||
sādhubhaktaḥ pitṛbhakto gurubhaktaḥ surārhakaḥ |
satyaśīlastāpasaśca na syurvai duḥkhinaḥ kvacit || 16||
snānābhyāsī kathāhṛṣṭo brahmabhajanatatparaḥ |
gosevāḍhyaśca catvāro vaiṣṇavā dhāmayoginaḥ || 17||
govratī gopradātā ca gavyāśano gavāyanaḥ |
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bodhyo gomātā viṣṇudaivatā || 18||
devavratī vedavratī govratī sādhusadvratī |
gomedhādivratī cāgryān vindate taijasālayān || 1 9||
kāmadhenupradātātra kāmān sarvān mahotsavān |
havyakavyādibhugdattān bhuṃkte bhaumām̐śca taijasān ||3.101.20 ||
yavān pibed gavyayuktān kṣitau svapyād gavāyane |
śīlī dogdhrīṃ pradadyādgāṃ sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||21 ||
sādhave sādhudīkṣārthaṃṃ putraṃ dadyācchubhakriyam |
tenāpi kṛtapuṇyenoddhriyante pretadehinaḥ ||22||
sādhvyai dadyāt kanyakāṃ ca satīṃ vairāgyaśālinīm |
yuvatīṃ jñānasampannāṃ saṃsāroddhāraśālinīm ||23||
śīlaparāyaṇāṃ gṛhidharmarāgavivarjitām |
tyāgavṛttiṃ tathācāryāṇīsthānaśobhanāṃ śubhām ||24||
rājā dadyāttu gurave dāsīṃ dāsaṃ dvijāya ca |
dvijaputraṃ pradadyācca vipraṃ dadyāt subhūbhṛte ||25||
yo bhavedvai gurutulyo vidyāsatsaṃgaśevadhiḥ |
tādṛcchīlasvabhāvasya dānaṃ kuryād dvijasya ca ||26||
viprakumāradānaṃ tu mataṃ godānasadṛśam |
uddhārako bhavedvipraśceha paratra sarvadā ||27||
vipraputrasya pitre vai dadyāt svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ bahu |
evaṃ viprasutaṃ krītvā dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye ||28||
yajñakāryanirvahārthaṃ pāṭhaśālārthamityapi |
rājyagurutvalābhārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāccānapatyakaḥ ||29||
sutadānaṃ sutādānaṃ godānaṃ svarṇadānakam |
ātmadānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ mokṣadāni matāni vai || 3.101.3 0||
vatsalāṃ sattvasampannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca vibhūṣitām |
gatvā gāṃ ca sutāṃ dāne sarvapuṇyaiḥ suyujyate ||3 1 ||
duḥkhadāridryalokān sa gāṃ datvā naiva gacchati |
dantahīnā valīyuktā līnakṣīrā ṛtukṣayā ||32||
jaraṭhā rogiṇī ruṣṭā duṣṭā deyā na karhicit |
sarvāsu kapilā śreṣṭhā sā dātavyā viśeṣataḥ ||33||
devāḥ sūryaśca vai vṛṣṭiṃ kurvanti yajñatarpitāḥ |
yajñīyaṃ karma gavyaiśca jāyate dugdhasarpiṣā ||34||
prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ tṛptimagacchat sarpiṣā purā |
golokasthagavāṃ paścādasṛjallokamātṛkāḥ ||35||
suvarṇavarṇāḥ kapilāḥ sravantīrdugdhanirjharān |
kṣīrāmṛtaṃ sravantyetā dhenavo jīvabhojanam ||36||
dadau tāśca ṛṣibhyo’tha devebhyaḥ sa prajāpatiḥ |
mānavebhyo dadau cāpi dugdhādhvarādihetave ||37||
viprebhyaḥ pradadau cāpi daivakāryārthasiddhaye |
kapilānāṃ pradānaṃ vai tataḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam ||38||
dugdhadāḥ puṇyadāḥ prāṇapradāḥ pretapramokṣadāḥ |
gāśca datvā sarvakāmapradaḥ syādiha vā pare ||39||
havyaṃ kavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca śāntiṃ yānaṃ tathāmbaram |
vṛddhabālāditṛptiṃ cāpnuyād gopradamānavaḥ ||3.101.40||
gāvaḥ surabhigandhinyastathā guggulagandhayaḥ |
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā lokānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ mahat ||41 ||
na duṣyatyanilo nāgnirna suvarṇaṃ na codadhiḥ |
na dugdhaṃ nāmṛtaṃ nātapo gauḥ sādhurna neśvaraḥ ||42||
gāvo dhanaṃ nityalabhyaṃ gāvaḥ puṣṭiḥ sanātanī |
gāvo lakṣmyāḥ paraṃ mūlaṃ sampadāṃ mūlameva tāḥ ||43||
annaṃ hi paramaṃ gosthaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ |
svāhāvaṣaṭ gosthitau ca goṣu dattaṃ hi śāśvatam ||44||
gāvo yajñaphalaṃ cāpi goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
gobhyo rasāḥ pravardhante bālāḥ pāyasajīvinaḥ ||45||
yāni kāni tu pāpāni svalpānyatikṛtāni vā |
dhenuṃ dadati ye te vai taranti yānti mokṣaṇam ||46 ||
kapilāṃ ye prayacchanti savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām |
sabhūṣāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmubhau lokau jayanti te ||47||
śaṃkarāya purā kṛṣṇo vṛṣabhaṃ pradadau tataḥ |
vṛṣabhasya pradānaṃ vai pravṛttaṃ tūttamaṃ bhuvi ||48||
yuvānamucchritaṃ śvetaṃ bhūriśṛṃgamalaṅakṛtam |
vṛṣabhaṃ ye prayacchanti bhavantyaiśvaryaśālinaḥ ||49||
gāḥ smṛtvā ca hariṃ santaṃ smṛtvā svapyāt sadā niśi |
utthāya tān smareccāpi namasyet puṣṭimāpnuyāt ||3.101.50 ||
aniṣṭaṃ svapnamālakṣya gāṃ muhuḥ samprakīrtayet |
gokarīṣaiḥ pācayecca gomayaiḥ śuddhimācaret ||51 ||
goghṛtena juhuyācca ghṛtena svasti vācayet |
ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtaṃ prāśnīyāt gavāṃ puṣṭimaśnute ||52||
gaurme cāgre sadā cāstu pṛṣṭhe pārśve sadāstu ca |
sarvaratnamayī dhenuṃ tāṃ dadāmi śubhāptaye ||53 ||
gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantu hemaśṛṃgyaḥ payomucaḥ |
surabhyaḥ saurabheyyaśca gāvaḥ paśyantu māṃ sadā ||54||
gāvaḥ satyo devatāśca sādhvyo lakṣmyaḥ pativratāḥ |
santo muktā īśvarāśca guravaḥ sādhavaḥ śurāḥ ||55||
bhaktiḥ puṇyaṃ vṛṣaḥ sevā dattaṃ taptaṃ hyupakṛtam |
mahābhayeṣu rakṣanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ||56 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi paśavo’pi dhenavo bhuvamāgatāḥ |
tapaścakruḥ purā sarvā gacchema śreṣṭhatāmiti ||57||
sarvābhyo dakṣiṇābhyo’pi vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā tviti |
sarvapāpapraṇāśinyo limpāmo dūṣaṇairna ca ||58||
asmadgavyādibhiḥ sarvo janaḥ pūyeta vai tathā |
śakṛtā cāpi mūtreṇa pūtāḥ syuḥ sarvadehinaḥ ||59||
godātāraśca golokaṃ gaccheyuriti padmaje |
tāpasībhyo varān brahmā dadau dhenubhya uttamān ||3.101.60 ||
evaṃ bhavata yoginyo lokām̐stārayateti ca |
sarvathā ca pavitrāḥ stho mokṣadā bhavateti ca ||6 1 ||
lakṣmīrvasatu gośakṛti tān varān dadāmyaham |
evaṃ datvā varān brahmā yayau satyaṃ tataśca tāḥ ||62||
prātarnamasyāḥ pūjyāśca sarvathā puṣṭidāḥ śubhāḥ |
lokakalyāṇakāriṇyo babhūvurbhavatārikāḥ ||63||
samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
saumyāṃ bhūṣāmbarayutāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ||64||
lohitāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā sūryaloke mahīyate |
śabalāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā somaloke mahīyate ||65||
śvetāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā śakraloke mahīyate |
kṛṣṇāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā vahniloke mahīyate ||66 ||
dhūmrāṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā dharmaloke mahīyate |
pāṇḍurāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā vāruṇaṃ lokamaśrute ||67||
vādalavarṇāṃ gāṃ datvā vāyuloke mahīyate |
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ piṃgākṣīṃ datvā kuberatāmiyāt ||68||
pītāṃ datvā tādṛśīṃ tu pitṛloke mahīyate |
karburāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā viśvadevaḥ prajāyate ||69||
gaurīṃ ca tādṛśīṃ datvā vasulokamavāpnuyāt |
pāṇḍukambalavarṇāṃ gāṃ datvā sādhyasuro bhavet ||3.101.70||
viśālapṛṣṭhāṃ datvā gāṃ marullokān prapadyate |
ratnāḍhyāṃ tādṛśīṃ datvā gandharvatāmavāpnuyāt ||71 ||
anaḍvāhaṃ mahokṣaṃ vā sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam |
datvā yuvānaṃ tu loke prajāpatermahīyate ||72||
godātā yāti paramaṃ svargaṃ golokamityapi |
vimānenārkavarṇena vṛṣayānena vāmbare ||73||
svarge taṃ gopradātāraṃ sahasrasurayoṣitaḥ |
sevante satataṃ prātarbodhayanti sukīrtanaiḥ ||74||
yāvanti dhenuromāṇi tāvadvarṣāṇi modate |
dhenudaśca tato bhūmau gobhūpālo bhavatyapi ||75||
ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtadehā ghṛtodbhavāḥ |
ghṛtanadyo ghṛtāvarttāḥ santu me satataṃ gṛhe ||76||
gāvo me hṛdaye nityaṃ gāvo nābhyāṃ tathātmani |
gāvaḥ sarvatra dehe me gāvo vasantu mānase ||77||
ghṛtaṃ tāsāṃ mama dehendriyaprāṇeṣu tiṣṭhati |
gāvaḥ santvagrato me ca pṛṣṭhataḥ santu dhenavaḥ ||78||
sarvataḥ santu gāvo me gomadhye’haṃ vasāmi hi |
evaṃbhāvayamānasya kṣīyante pāpakoṭayaḥ ||79 ||
yatra kānakasaudhāśca svarṇāgamo hyamāpakaḥ |
devyo gāndharvakuśalā yatrāmṛtaṃ samṛddhayaḥ ||3.101.80||
dadhikulyā ghṛtakulyā payaḥkulyāśca yatra ca |
navanītakulyā yatra tatra yānti gavāṃ pradāḥ ||81 ||
sahasragopradātā tu svarge deveśvaro bhavet |
lakṣagodānakṛt samrāṭ trailokyasya bhaved rame ||82||
koṭigodānakartā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mokṣabhāk |
arbudagopradātā tu golokaṃ yāti mokṣabhāg ||83 ||
abjadhenupradātā tvakṣaraṃ dhāma prayāti vai |
daśagodānataḥ preto mucyate sṛṣṭibandhanāt ||84||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ smṛtvā patnīṃ smṛtvā pitāmahān |
godātā tatkulānyekādaśoddhārayati dhruvam ||85||
gāṃ smṛtvā tiladānena jaladānena vāpi ca |
pretasya yamaloke vai nirasyati tu yātanāḥ ||86||
mātaro dugdhadātryo me devavāsā hi dhenavaḥ |
gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantāmiti nityaṃ prakīrtayet ||87||
godānaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ ca śāśvataṃ yataḥ |
kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyeta svargārthaṃ gopradāyinaḥ ||88||
gāvo dāne yamuddiṣṭāstārayanti hi taṃ janam |
dhārayanti bālakām̐śca vardhayanti payo’mṛtaiḥ ||89||
gāvo vai mānave loke svarge satye bhavanti vai |
aiśvare cāpi vaikuṇṭhe goloke ca bhavanti hi ||3.101.90||
akṣare bhūriśṛṃgāśca gāvo’yāso vasanti vai |
gāvo yajñasya yajñatvaṃ daivataṃ dyusadāmapi ||9 1 ||
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ puṇyaṃ parāyaṇam |
gāvaḥ samāsata satraṃ siṣāsantyaḥ śaphām̐stathā ||92||
śṛṃgāṇi cāpi daśame māsi vedhāstato dadau |
tāsāṃ śṛṃgāṇyajāyanta yāsāṃ yādṛṅmatāni vai ||93||
gāvastejo mahad divyaṃ pālayanti susādhavaḥ |
sukṛtinaḥ puṇyabhājo gavāṃ sevāratāḥ surāḥ ||94||
yatra drumā miṣṭarasā madhusrāvaphalānvitāḥ |
madhusugandhipuṣpāśca bhūmirmaṇimayī tathā ||95||
yatra kāñcanabhūbhāgāḥ sukhadāḥ kāmadāstathā |
sarvavidhairutpalaiśca bhānti yatra jalāśayāḥ ||96 ||
kesarā yatra vartante saurabhāḍhyā marudgatāḥ |
ṣaḍrasāḥ phalinaḥ stambāḥ śākāni ca madhūni ca ||97||
muktāphullā vallayaśca saphalāścāmṛtapradāḥ |
sauvarṇā girayo yatra nityanūtanaśobhinaḥ ||98||
navarūpadharā nāryo sevante muktakoṭikāḥ |
sarvakāmāḥ sarasāḥ sarvabhogā bhavanti ca ||99||
yatra cāndanāraṇyāni ramante tatra gopradāḥ |
sarvasaṃkalpasamṛddhā niḥśokā bhāgyavarddhitāḥ || 3.101.1 00||
vimāneṣu vicitreṣu mahodyāneṣu yānti ca |
modante gopradātāra upakrīḍanti sarvaśaḥ || 101 ||
viharanti strījanaiśca pūjyante svargibhistathā |
modaṃ pramodamānandān sukhāni bhuñjate’nvaham || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhūnāṃ yogahīnasya pretasyoddharaṇe godānaṃ heturiti gomāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 101 ||

<3.102>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
gavārādhanasaṃjñaṃ ca vrataṃ kuryurvimuktaye |
pretasya vaṃśajā bhāryā putraḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ || 1 ||
gavāṃ goṣṭhe nivasanaṃ gavāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
gavānvāhāramevāpi gavānvapānamityapi || 2 ||
gavānvaśayanaṃ cāpi goprākprabodhanaṃ tathā |
gosthalīmārjanādyaṃ ca daṃśādīnāṃ nivāraṇam || 3 ||
śādvalaghāsadānaṃ ca gavyāhārastathārhaṇam |
rakṣaṇaṃ sarvathā śaśvad goṣṭhe vāsaḥ sadā tathā || 4 ||
druhyenna manasā vāpi goṣu nityaṃ sukhapradaḥ |
arcayeta ramābuddhyā namaskāraiḥ prapūjayet || 5 ||
tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibet payaḥ |
tryahaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibeduṣṇaṃ vāyubhakṣastryahaṃ bhavet || 6 ||
vahed ghṛtaṃ tu śirasā vahniṃ saṃjuhuyād ghṛtaiḥ |
ghṛtaṃ dadyāttathāśnīyādghṛtena svasti vācayet || 7 ||
gavocchiṣṭayavabhakṣo brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati |
daityaiśca dānavairyuktāḥ prasahya bhojane surāḥ || 8 ||
āśitā nijabhakṣyāṇi tataḥ śuddhyarthameva ha |
gavārādhanasaṃjñaṃ vai vrataṃ māsakṛtaṃ kṛtam || 9 ||
tataḥ śuddhāḥ punardevāḥ saṃsiddhā nijakarmasu |
ato gāvaḥ pavitrāśca pāvanāḥ puṇyadāstathā || 3.102.1 0||
godānaṃ tacchubhaṃ datvā śuddhyati svargamaśnute |
agnimadhye gavāṃ madhye satāṃ madhye vasannapi || 11 ||
vipramadhye satīmadhye vedamadhye vasannapi |
yajñamadhye tīrthamadhye vasan śuddhyati pātakāt || 12||
gāvastuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti putraṃ dhanaṃ patiṃ priyām |
śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri purā śrīstvaṃ svabhāvataḥ || 1 3||
kāntaṃ vapurvinirmāya gomadhye saṃsthitābhavaḥ |
gāvaścāścaryasampannā vīkṣyate rūpasampadam || 14||
papracchustvāṃ kāsi kanye kuto’si rūpasundarī |
kathaṃ cātrāgatā saumye vada cenmanyase hi naḥ || 15||
tadā tvaṃ gāḥ praṇamyaivoditavatī prasāditā |
viṣṇukāntāsmi bhadraṃ vaḥ śrīrnāmāhaṃ hareḥ priyā || 16||
mayābhipannā devādyā modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
sūryaścandro mahendraśca vasavo devakoṭayaḥ || 17||
agnirāpo mayāviṣṭāḥ smṛddhyudbhāvā bhavanti vai |
yānnāviśāmyahaṃ gāvaste vinaśyanti sarvathā || 18||
yatra dharmārthakāmāśca mayā juṣṭā hi tadgṛham |
modapramodaśāntyāḍhyaṃ mahānandabhṛtaṃ bhavet || 1 9||
icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṃ bhavata madyutāḥ |
strīvarge me sadā vastuṃ vāñcchā jātāsmi vai dhruvā ||3.102.20 ||
śrutvā gāvaśca bhavatīṃ prāhustvaṃ cañcalā hyasi |
sarvagāṃ tvāṃ na cecchāmo bhadraṃ te’nyatra gamyatām ||2 1 ||
śrutvā tvaṃ cārthitavatī kathaṃ māṃ nābhinandatha |
mahadugraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā māṃ niṣevanti mānavāḥ || 22||
yakṣā asurā gandharvā īśvarā uragā surāḥ |
kathaṃ māṃ pratigṛhṇīdhvaṃ naiva yūyaṃ hi durlabhām || 23 ||
śrutvaivaṃ dhenavaḥ prāhuścalacittāsi sarvathā |
bahunā tu kimuktena tatastvāṃ varjayāmahe || 24||
śrutvaivaṃ tvaṃ coktavatī cāñcalyaṃ santyajāmyaham |
bhavatīnāṃ kṛte gāvo vastuṃ sthānaṃ prayacchatha | |25||
tato gāvaścoktavatyaḥ śakṛnmūtre vasa dhruvā |
omityavasastvaṃ lakṣmi gavāṃ mūtre ca śakṛti || 26||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ tasmāllakṣmi gṛhaṃ tavāsmi vai |
yatra tvaṃ tatra cāhaṃ ca nivasāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 27||
evaṃ jñātvā mahimānaṃ gāṃ prayacchanti ye janāḥ |
hutaśiṣṭāśinaste vai satriṇo’dhvariṇaśca te || 28||

tato yajñasya yajñatvaṃ gomūlakaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 29||

utpādayanti dhānyāni pravartante makhāśca taiḥ ||3.102.3 0 ||
vahanti vividhān bhārān kṣuttṛṣādiprapīḍitāḥ |
sādhūṃśca dhārayantīha pṛṣṭhe ca śakaṭe’pi ca ||3 1 ||
golokaṃ sannayantyeva dattā dāne paretakam |
tasmāt sthānaṃ gavāmūrdhvaṃ svargāt satyāt tathaiśvarāt ||32||
golokaṃ vai gavāṃ sthānaṃ mama kṛṣṇasya mandiram |
godātā yāti golokaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam || 33||
anyacchṛṇu mahālakṣmi purā devayuge khalu |
aditistu tapastepe viṣṇuḥ putro bhavenmama ||34||
ekapādena tapatīṃ vīkṣya dakṣasutā tadā |
surabhīnāmikā cāpi tapastepe tayā saha ||35||
tadā gatvā svayaṃ brahmāditaye sadvaraṃ dadau |
viṣṇuḥ putraste bhavitā surakāryakaro hariḥ ||36||
surabhyai varadānaṃ ca dattavān viśvasṛṭ tadā |
dakṣasute tāpasi tvaṃ hyamarītvamavāpsyasi ||37||
īśvarītvaṃ ca gopītvamavāpsyasi savaṃśajā |
muktānītvaṃ tathā mokṣadātrītvaṃ saṃvrajiṣyasi || 38||
sṛṣṭitraye pūjyatamopariṣṭācca nivatsyasi |
gopradāstām̐śca golokān gopatervai prasādataḥ ||39||
vāsasthānānyavāpsyanti yatra vasanti dhenavaḥ |
bhūriśṛṃgā yatra gāvo yāsyanti vaṃśajāstathā ||3.102.40||
urugāyasya kṛṣṇasya taddhāma paramaṃ padam |
havyārpaṇādipuṇyena yā vai duhitarastava ||41||
devasevāprakartryaḥ syurnivatsyanti ca tatpade |
manasā cintitā bhogāḥ sampatsyante sukhāstava ||42||
godātṝṇāṃ pare lokāḥ sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ |
na yeṣu kramate mṛtyurna jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ||43||
na dāridryaṃ nāśubhaṃ ca vidyate gopade kvacit |
tatra divyānyaraṇyāni divyāni bhavanāni ca ||44||
vimānāni sudivyāni kāmagāni bhavanti ca |
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyā bhavanti ca ||45||
puṣkariṇyo’mṛtānāṃ ca navanītādrayo’pi ca |
śarkarāmadhususvādāḥ sudhācayā bhavanti ca ||46||
taruṇyo gopikā yatra bhavanti divyabhūṣitāḥ |
godātāraḥ prayāsyanti saurabhi tvatpadaṃ param ||47||
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā sevayā ca satāṃ hareḥ |
dānaiḥ puṇyairdamenāpi satyena tīrthasevanaiḥ ||48||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā rādhābhaktyā viśeṣataḥ |
śakyaḥ samāsādayituṃ golokaḥ kṛṣṇaśobhitaḥ ||49||
gobhakto labhate sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kāmitaṃ śubham |
bhaktāḥ striyo labhante ca kāmitaṃ sarvamuttam ||3.102.5 0||
putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyārthī kanyakāṃ tathā |
vittārthī labhate vittaṃ dharmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt ||5 1||
mokṣārthī prāpnuyānmokṣaṃ sampadarthī tu sampadaḥ |
vidyārthī cāpnuyād vidyāṃ sukhārthī labhate sukham ||52||
rasārthī labhate rasyaṃ dārḍhyārthī dṛḍhatāṃ tathā |
patyarthinī patiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāntārthī sundarīṃ śubhām ||5 3 ||
sutārthī labhate putrīṃ svargārthī svargamāpnuyāt |
gopradātā mahārājyaṃ labhate pārthivaṃ hyapi ||54||
aindraṃ padaṃ sūryapadaṃ cāndraṃ kauberakaṃ padam |
yāmyapadaṃ tathā dharmye vāhnyaṃ caiśamityapi |||55||
kailāsaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ padamityapi |
labheta śreṣṭhagolokaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ labheta ca ||56|||
ārogyaṃ labhate godo yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ labheta ca |
gajavājisurabhīśca labheta gopradaḥ khalu ||57||
rūpaṃ ratnāni vastrāṇi maiṇīn sauvarṇaśevadhim |
labhate gopradātā vai smṛtaṃ godānakālikam ||58||
apamṛtyurvinaśyecca pretatvaṃ dūrato vrajet |
pāpāni saṃpraṇaśyeyurgodātuśca smṛtasya ca ||59||
ityevaṃ varadānāni dadau brahmā hi dhenave |
na kiñcid durlabhaṃ lakṣmi gobhaktasya bhavediha ||3.102.6 0||
siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca sarveśvaryādisampadaḥ |
yāvantaśca camatkārā bhavanti dhenude rame ||6 1||
vedapuṇyaṃ makhapuṇyaṃ kanyāpuṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇā |
bhūmipuṇyaṃ svarṇapuṇyaṃ godānena prajāyate ||62||
godānena samaṃ deyaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇātmakam |
aprāptāyāṃ mūrtimatyāṃ deyā dhenurhi kānakī ||63||
sadā bhūmergavāmarthaṃ deyaṃ suvarṇamityapi |
svarṇaṃ gauḥ pṛthivī ceti trīṇi dānāni padmaje ||64||
pretamuktikarāṇyeva bhavanti nātra saṃśayaḥ |
gāśca bhūmiṃ ca vittaṃ ca datvā pāpī prapūyate ||65||
ajo’gnirvaruṇo meṣaḥ sūryo’śvaḥ prāg vyajāyata |
tattaddānāni vai pretamuktaye’pi bhavanti hi ||66||
kuṃjarāśca mṛgā nāgā mahiṣāścāsurā hi te |
āsurayonimuktyarthaṃ hastyādidānamuttamam ||67||
kukkuṭaśca varāhāśca rākṣasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
rakṣoyonivimuktyarthaṃ tattaddānaṃ praśasyate ||68||
iḍā gāvaḥ payaḥ somo bhūmirajāyataiva ha |
pretādīnāṃ vimuktyarthaṃ gobhūdānaṃ praśasyate ||69||
agnirhi devatā svarṇaṃ devatā śasyate tataḥ |
svarṇadānaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ devadānaṃ śubhapradam ||3.102.70||
agnyabhāve tu kurute vahnisthāneṣu kāṃcanam |
kuśastambe juhotyagniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra ca sthite ||71 ||
viprahaste sādhuhaste darbhastambe’jakarṇake |
apsu kāṣṭhe suvarṇe ca juhotyagnerasannidhau ||72||
hute prītikarīmṛddhiṃ śrīpatiḥ samprayacchati |
nityaṃ dadāti sauvarṇaṃ yathāśakti tu yojanaḥ ||73||
brahmavāyvāgnisomānāṃ sālokyamupayāti saḥ |
mātā pitā sutaśceti gārhasthyaṃ tryātmakaṃ śubham ||74||
gavāṃ svarṇasya pṛthvyāśca dānaṃ tryātmakamuttamam |
śraddhāsnehaścādaraśca tredhātithiprasādakṛt ||75||
tathā bhūgosuvarṇāni paralokapradāni vai |
bhavanaṃ sampado vṛttistredhā saukhyaprasādhanam ||76||
dhenubhūkanakānyevaṃ dāne saukhyapradāni vai |
jñānaṃ śāntiśca nivṛttistrayaścānandahetavaḥ ||77||
dhenukṣitisvarṇakāni mahānandapradāni vai |
bhaktirhariśca mokṣaśca sambaddhāste trayaḥ sadā ||78||
sādhuḥ śīlaṃ kṣamā ceti sambaddhāste trayo’pi ca |
tathā dāne svarṇadhenubhuvo baddhā hi nityaśaḥ ||79||
bhuktidā muktidāścāpi pretoddhārakarāstathā |
svargadāḥ pāpapuñjānāṃ nāśakā puṇyadāstrayaḥ ||3.102.80||
goyajñātma gavāṃ dānaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ tu tarpaṇam |
satāṃ yajñaṃ bhojanaṃ ca datvā sauvarṇadakṣiṇām ||81 ||
nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā nīlapucchāditarpaṇam |
kārayitvābhyarthitasya dānaṃ pretaṃ pramokṣayet ||82||
ityevaṃ kathitā lakṣmi pretamuktiḥ śubhodbhavā |
mokṣaśāstrakṛtaṃ cāpi pārāyaṇaṃ pramocayet ||83||
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi hyakhaṇḍabhajanaṃ mama |
satāṃ karajatoyaṃ ca muktidaṃ pretayonitaḥ ||84||
avabhṛthaṃ pavitraṃ ca snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ śubhe kṣaṇe |
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ ca nideśanam ||85||
muktidaṃ pretayonestu tīrthavāriniṣevaṇam |
yatra kvāpi gataścāpi mucyate bhajanāddhareḥ ||86||
yakṣo vā rākṣaso vāpi bhūtaḥ pretaḥ piśācakaḥ |
sarpo vā paśudeho’pi yāmyo vā vāyudehavān ||87||
ḍākinī vā śākinī vā bhūtī piśācinī ca vā |
vetālinī vā vetālo yatra kvāpi gato’pi vā ||88||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ yadvā prasādaṃ śrīhareśca vā |
labhate vā jalaṃ cāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||89||
santo hi tārakā loke pāpānāṃ nāśakāstathā |
kalmaṣāṇāṃ hārakāśca divyatāmokṣasampradāḥ || 3.102.9 0||
gosvarṇavahnidevebhyaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ santaḥ sadā rame |
satāṃ yogo mama yogaḥ sarvapumarthadaḥ khalu ||9 1||
ekadā puṣkaso nāmnā bhāruṇḍo madyapānakṛt |
māṃsādaḥ śīlahīnaśca steno mṛto vanāntare || 92||
yāmyairnīto yamapūryāṃ narakeṣu nipātitaḥ |
tatpatnyā tu kṛtaṃ tīrthe godānaṃ svarṇamalpitam || 93 ||
pretasya sarvapāpāni dūrībhūtāni tatkṣaṇāt |
pretaḥ svargaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ pāpāni surabhīṃ yayuḥ || 94||
surabhī sāha pāpāni nāśayituṃ tu vedhase |
puṣkasasya tu pāpāni mayi lagnāni dānataḥ || 95||
māyā nāśayitavyāni kutra gatvā pitarvada |
śrutvā brahmāha tāṃ gāṃ ca yāhi sanatkumārakam || 96 ||
sādhuṃ śīlavrataṃ drāk sa nāśayiṣyatyaghāni te |
śrūtvā gatvā surabhyenaṃ sādhuṃ neme tathārthayat ||97||
pāpanāśārthamevāpi sādhuḥ pādajalaṃ dadau |
papau sā surabhī gauśca naṣṭānyaghāni satvaram || 98 ||
tataḥ surabhī brahmāṇaṃ prayayau saṃskṛtā satā |
jagāda ślokān santuṣṭā natvā śrīvedhasaṃ gurum || 99||
dhanyā vai sādhavo loke śīlino rāgavarjitāḥ |
amāyikā divyarūpāḥ pāpanāśo yadāśrayāt || 3.102.100 ||
tīrthānāṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ satīnāṃ ca tapasvinām |
viprāṇāṃ yāni pāpāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 101 ||
pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ ca yoṣitām |
dehināṃ yāni pāpāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 1 02||
rājñāṃ rakṣasāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ yāmyavāsinām |
asadgatīnāṃ pāpāni naśyantyeva hi sādhuṣu || 103 ||
kāmināṃ krodhināṃ cāpi lobhināṃ mohināṃ tathā |
ghātināṃ yāni pādyāni tāni naśyanti sādhuṣu || 1 04||
hatyānāṃ paśumārāṇāṃ krūrāṇāṃ prāṇarodhinām |
viśvāsahaṇāṃ pāpāni naśyantyeva hi sādhuṣu || 105 ||
gaṇikānāṃ puṃścalīnāṃ dhvajināṃ cakriṇāṃ tathā |
śastriṇāṃ cāpi vaidyānāṃ naśyantyaghāni sādhuṣu || 106 ||
śritaghnānāṃ bālaghnānāmagnidānāṃ viṣādinām |
viṣadānāṃ vanaghnānāṃ naśyantyaghāni sādhuṣu || 1 07||
ityuktvā prayayau goṣṭhaṃ lakṣmi surabhī suvratā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya naśyeyuḥ pāpakoṭayaḥ || 108 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gavārādhananāmavrataṃ gośakṛnmūtrayorlakṣmīvāso godānavividhaphalāni pretoddhārakāṇi sādhvāśrayaḥ sarvoddhārakaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kadā kāle pradānena svarṇagobhūmayaḥ phalam |
