nirāśrayā dānapātraṃ yadi bhaktivṛṣānvitā | |43 ||
dānadātā pavitro vai sadā bhavati bhaktimān |
vibhajya ca tato bhuṃkte’mṛtabhojī bhaveddhi saḥ | | 44||
devebhyaḥ sannivedyāttā vighasāśī bhaveddhi saḥ |
etādṛśasya bhavane hyadṛśyā api ṛddhayaḥ || 45 ||
mūrtarūpaṃ paraṃ prāpya modante modayanti tam |
devatāḥ pitaraḥ siddhā yogino yatayastathā | |46 | |
santa īśā īśvarāṇyo ramante dātṛmandire |
apsarasaśca gandharvāḥ surā devyaśca sādhavaḥ ||47 ||
satyaśca bhāgyavatyaśca tathā ca kāmadhenavaḥ |
putrāḥ pautrāḥ sutāḥ putryo gāvaścāsya bhavanti hi ||48 ||
evaṃ dātuḥ kuṭumbaṃ vai sarvaṃ devakulaṃ bhavet |
paśavo devapaśavaḥ sasyāni daivatānyapi ||49 ||
svarṇarūpyādikaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ sudaivatam |
bhāgyānyapi ca sarvāṇi rūpaṃ bhūṣāśca daivatam | | 3.103.50 ||
evaṃ dāturbhavedeva divyaṃ daivaṃ kuṭumbakam |
tasmāllakṣmi pradātavyaṃ svarṇaṃ gauḥ pṛthivī śubhā | | 51 ||
yadi pācanaśaktiḥ syād grahītavyaṃ na cānyathā |
alpaśakteḥ puṇyanāśo bhavatyeva pratigrahāt || 52 ||
saptarṣibhyaḥ purā rājā vṛṣādarbhiḥ samutsukaḥ |
ratnānyadarśayad dātuṃ nāgṛhṇan ṛṣayastadā | |53 | |
vṛṣādarbhiḥ svayaṃ prāha samarthāḥ stha pratigrahe |
pratigrahastārayati vṛṇudhvaṃ vittamuttamam || 54||
suvarṇāni rūpyakāṇi mauktikāni ca hīrakān |
maṇīn śvetagajānaśvān śvetān govṛṣabhām̐stathā ||55 ||
gṛṣṭīścāgnyāḥ kāmadhenūrgrāmān kṣetrāṇi cārpaye |
rājyaṃ rājñīrdāsavargān dāsīdāsye mahāsabhāḥ ||56 ||
prāsādān saritaścādrīn dāsye vanāni sarvaśaḥ |
gṛhṇantu brāhmaṇā me’dya viprāśca sādhavo mama ||57||
adeyaṃ me vidyate na mokṣārthaṃ prayate yataḥ |
datvā pātrebhya evātra lapsye’haṃ śāśvataṃ phalam ||58||
ityevaṃ tvarthayantaṃ vai dānaṃ dātuṃ hyupasthitam |
ṛṣayaḥ prāhuravyagrā dhīrāḥ śāntāḥ pratoṣiṇaḥ ||59||
rājan pratigraho rājñāṃ madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ |
tad dāva iva nirdahyāt prāpto rājaparigrahaḥ ||3.103.60||
apratigrāhyamevātaḥ pretyeha ca sukhepsunā |
rājadhanaṃ pratīcchan vai pāpiṣṭhāṃ labhate gatim ||61||
yat pṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ |
sarvaṃ tannālamekasya tasmād vidvān śame vaset ||62||
utpannasya ruroḥ aṃgaṃ vardhamānasya vardhate |
puruṣasya striyāścāpi tathecchā vardhate sadā ||63||
na talloke dravyamasti yallokān paritarpayet |
samudratṛṣṇaḥ puruṣo na kadāpi pratuṣyati ||64||
kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya kāmo yadopayujyate |
prakāmaḥ sa pravardheta satṛṣṇaścāti vidhyati ||65||
pratigrahe saṃyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam |
parigrahe tapaḥ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||66||
tapaḥsaṃcaya eveha viśiṣṭo dravyasañcayāt |
tasmād rājān dhanaṃ te’stu mā viṣaṃ secaya dvije ||67||
dāvaṃ rājadhanaṃ naivecchāmaḥ śāntā maharṣayaḥ |
svasti te’stu mahārāja yāmo vayaṃ divaṃ punaḥ ||68||
ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarvarṣayo dānagrahaṃ vinā |
vṛṣādarbhistataḥ samyajjñātavān dānaghoratām ||69||
apātre’rpitadānasyāpathyatvaṃ sutarāṃ khalu |
tasmāt pātraṃ hi dānānāṃ puṇyāśrayā dvijāstathā ||3.103.70 ||
santo’pi bhagadbhaktāstebhyo deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
viprā api harerbhaktāstebhyo deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||71 ||
ye lobhaṃ naiva kurvanti svārthamātravivarjitāḥ |
śrīhareḥ pūjakāstebhyo deyaṃ dānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||72 ||
pātrajanaḥ sarvarītyā lobhaṃ sadā vivarjayet |
haraye cārpaṇaṃ matvā gṛhṇīyānnānyathā kvacit ||73 ||
vṛṣādarbhistato lakṣmi prayāge kuṃbhayogake |
dadau dānāni gatvaiva sādhubhyastāni bhāvavān ||74||
athāgataṃ vimānaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhād yāmune taṭe |
gaṃgāyāḥ saṃgame viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ śobhitaṃ tadā ||75||
rājānaṃ pārṣadā nītvā yayurvikuṇṭhadhāma ha |
evaṃ sādhujanānāṃ vai sevayā mokṣaṇaṃ rame ||76||
bhavatyeva na sandehastasmāt pātraṃ samarjayet |
dadyādbhāvena tasmai ca haraye’rpaṇamastviti ||77||
atha dadyācchatradānaṃ copānaddānamityapi |
dhotrakañcukadānaṃ ca śirastrāṇasamarpaṇam ||78||
bhavecchatrapatistena bhavedvimānagastathā |
dadyāt siṃhāsanadānaṃ rājyādhipo bhavettataḥ ||79||
dadyāccāmaradānaṃ ca vetradānaṃ tathārpayet |
dhvajadānaṃ prakuryācca rathadānaṃ carettathā ||3.103.80||
kośadānaṃ prakuryācca kaṇasañcayadānakam |
ikṣukṣetrapradānaṃ ca sasyakṣetrapradānakam ||8 1||
sarovarārpaṇaṃ cāpi śākavāṭīpradānakam |
udyānapuṣpavāṭyāderdānaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ ||82||
śāṭībhūṣākañcukīna kuryād dānāni vai tathā |
khadvāśayyāpradānāni kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||83||
pātragargarikādānaṃ kalaśasthālikārpaṇam |
śṛṃgāravastudānāni dadyāt pretasya muktaye ||84||
udakuṃbhīdugdhakuṃbhīdadhikuṃbhīpradānakam |
jaladroṇīghṛtakuṃbhīkaṇḍanyādisamarpaṇam ||85||
muśalasya pradānaṃ ca mārjanīsampradānakam |
vyajanādeḥ pradānaṃ ca dīpapeṭīpradānakam ||86||
śayyādhrīsampradānaṃ ca pātradhrīsampradānakam |
cullikāpeṣaṇīdānaṃ darvīcīpiṭikārpaṇam ||87||
sandaṃśadānaṃ kāṃgakeśīdānaṃ darpaṇadānakam |
raśanārajjudānāni kārayet pretamuktaye ||88||
jaladānaṃ randhitānnapradānaṃ ca phalārpaṇam |
payaḥpākādidānaṃ ca miṣṭānnānāṃ pradānakam ||89||
godhūmaśālitilānāṃ dānāni vividhāni ca |
kuryād rasamadhukṣārārpaṇaṃ pretasya muktaye ||3.103.90||
mahākambaladānāni mahāmbarapradānakam |
mahāśṛṃgāradānāni kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||91 ||
ekādaśyādipuṇyānāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
vratadānaṃ tapodānaṃ bhaktidānaṃ kathārpaṇam ||92||
japadānaṃ dharmadānaṃ kuryāt pretasya muktaye |
vāyuvāhanadānaṃ ca vahnivāhanadānakam || 93||
jalavāhanadānaṃ ca bhūvāhanapradānakam |
narayānapradānaṃ ca yantravāhanadānakam ||94||
saudhadānaṃ mandirasya dānaṃ prāsādadānakam |
grāmadānaṃ varmadānaṃ kuryāt pretasya muktaye ||95||
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā naije cāśrame saṃvasan ṛṣiḥ |
krīḍan vai dhanuṣā bāṇān jamadagnirmumoca ha ||96||
tānānīya śarān patnī reṇukādāt punaḥ punaḥ |
madhyāhne viṣatāpaśca sūryasyogro’bhavattadā ||97||
dagdhapādā tu sā patnī śanairāyāt patiṃ prati |
muniḥ prāha kathaṃ kānte cirāyate śarāhṛtau ||98||
patnī prāhārkatāpena dagdhāpādā bhavāmi vai |
munistūrṇaṃ samākarṇya śarānmumoca bhāskaram ||99||
sūryastrastaścāyayau ca viprarūpo muniṃ prati |
uvācarṣe hata mā māṃ prasādaye kṣamasva mām || 3.103.100||
muniḥ prāha mama patnyāḥ panthāḥ sukhagamo yathā |
bhavet tāpavihīno vai tathā sūrya vidhāpaya ||10 1||
śrutvā sūryo dadāvasmai chatropānahamāśu vai |
svalpaṃ yānaṃ kāmagaṃ ca bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tathā || 1 02||
pātramakṣayamevāpi kalpachāyāṃ vitānajām |
hāraṃ tāpahāraṃ cāpi tṛptidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ||1 03||
upakaraṇānyanyāni dadau sūryaḥ sukhāni ca |
yayau natvā divaṃ cārko reṇukābhūt sukhāśrayā ||1 04||
apādadagdhā mṛdulā ṛṣiḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ |
evaṃ chatrādidānaṃ vai pravṛttaṃ sūryamūlakam ||1 05||
tattaddānapradānena jīvatāṃ pretadehinām |
duḥkhaśāntirbhavatyeva puṇyena mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 106||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sarvadānaphalaṃ bhavet |
lakṣmi dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ punarāyāti dātari || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhadānaiḥ pretoddhāro bhavati, dānapātraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sādhujanaścetyādau vṛṣādarbheḥ sūryasya ca nidarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||

<3.104>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
gārhasthyaṃ dharmasāraṃ me prabrūhi parameśvara |
smṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā gṛhasthaḥ sutadāravān || 1 ||
kimavaśyaṃ prakartavyaṃ kiṃ kṛtvā ca kṛtaṃ bhavet |
yenānyat sarvakartavyasamāveśaḥ prajāyate || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sādhavaḥ pitaro devā guravaśca maharṣayaḥ |
sādhvyo bhaktā arcanīyā ijyā nityaṃ yathādhanam || 3 ||
annapuṣpapraṇāmādyaistoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca prasādanīyāḥ sādhavaḥ || 4 ||
jalārpaṇena cānnena payomūlaphalairdalaiḥ |
toṣaṇīyā hi pitaraḥ siddhānnaiḥ sadrasādibhiḥ || 5 ||
devārpaṇaṃ kārayecca kuryād devaprapūjanam |
makhaṃ kuryānnityamapi devān santoṣayet sadā || 6 ||
gurūṇāṃ sevanaṃ kuryādājñāṃ vaheta nityadā |
gurvarpaṇaṃ vidadhyācca mātre pitre samarpayet || 7 ||
vṛddhebhyaścārpayediṣṭaṃ praseveta mudā mude |
ṛṣibhyaśca dvijebhyaśca namaskuryāttathārpayet || 8 ||
sāmādhyāyaṃ paṭheccāpi vidyādānaṃ ca kārayet |
sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca dadyādannaṃ jalādikam || 9 ||
āśrayaṃ cāmbaraṃ dadyāt santoṣayennirāśrayām |
bhaktān sampūjayennityaṃ satsaṃgaṃ ca samācaret || 3.104.10||
mokṣamārgaṃ sādhayecca dharmaṃ sañcinuyāt sadā |
gṛhāgatā dehino vai yathā syuḥ sukhinastathā || 1 1||
pravartetāśrayaṃ datvā copakṛtvā pratoṣayet |
harirnārāyaṇaścāyaṃ hyabhyāgato gṛhāgataḥ ||12||
tatra nārāyaṇaścāste tuṣyatvayaṃ janārdanaḥ |
evaṃ svāgatamādadhyāt sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavet| || 13||
bhikṣukebhyaḥ pradadyācca gobhyo dadyāttathā gṛhī |
śvabhyo dadyāt tathā pārāvātebhyaścāpi cārpayet || 14||
yādobhyo’pi pradadyāccānāthebhyo’pi samarpayet |
niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ naktaṃ samarpayet || 15||
nāgasarpādijīvebhyo dadyāt kīṭebhya ityapi |
piṣṭaṃ kaṇān randhitaṃ ca ghāsaṃ patraṃ yathāyatham || 16||
ācāryasya pituḥ sādhoḥ sakhyurāptasya cātitheḥ |
idamasti gṛhe mahyamiti nityaṃ nivedayet || 17||
gṛhasthaḥ kamalākāntaśiṣṭāśī vai sadā bhavet |
patyuḥ sthāne sthitā patnī gṛhiṇī gṛharakṣiṇī || 18||
dharmarakṣākarī nityaṃ sarvadharmān nibhāvayet |
sadā tvaṃ kuru kalyāṇi dānaṃ mānaṃ prasevayet || 19||
āśīrvādādilābhena nārī nārāyaṇī bhavet |
naro nārāyaṇaḥ syād bhūloko golokatāṃ vrajet ||3.104.20||
etad gṛhāmṛtaṃ proktaṃ yat kṛtvā ṛddhimān bhavet |
dharmasāramimaṃ śrutvā yaḥ kuryāt sa divaṃ labhet ||2 1 ||
śṛṇu saṃkṣepataścānyaddhṛdayasthaṃ vibhāvaya |
ahaṃ patisvarūpo’smi nārāyaṇaḥ sadā gṛhe ||22||
tvaṃ śrīrnārīsvarūpāsi patnī gṛhigṛhe sadā |
pārṣadā me sutakanyāsvarūpāḥ santi vai gṛhe ||23 ||
mahīmānā atithayaḥ sādhavo’bhyāgatāśca me |
ityevaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā vai kuṭumbaṃ vartate gṛhe ||24||
kṛṣṇārpaṇasvarūpeṇa sevate sma parasparam |
bhaktyārpaṇaṃ sarvamasya kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||25|||
ta eva viṣayāstāni khāni bhogāsta eva ca |
kalpitā mayi kṛṣṇe syurmokṣadā nirguṇāḥ priye ||26 ||
dharmasāraḥ kathito’yaṃ gṛhāmṛtaphalaḥ śubhaḥ |
ṛddhidaḥ puṇyado bandhavarjito mokṣadaḥ sukhaḥ ||27||
sahasrajanmapuṇyasya jñāyate tattvamīdṛśam |
apātrasya viṣayiṇaḥ kalmaṣiṇastu durgraham ||28||
dehendriyamanobuddhicetanaiḥ sarvathā priye |
tarpaṇīyāḥ sādhavaśca tṛpto bhavāmi tatsthitaḥ ||29||
gṛhavāṭīkṣetravājigajagomahiṣīdhanaiḥ |
toṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaśca jalāmbarānnasevanaiḥ ||3.104.30||
yajasva vividhairyajñairbahvannaiḥ svarṇadakṣiṇaiḥ |
sādhūn sevaya sādhvīśca pitṝn devāṃśca tarpaya ||3 1 ||
brahmapriyā rañjayasva vṛddhām̐śca parisevaya |
āśritān śubhasatkārairarcayasva yathārhataḥ ||35|||
śṛṇu lakṣmyabhavat pūrvaṃ naraśāyo hi taskaraḥ |
patnīputrasametaśca sadā stainyopajīvanaḥ || 33||
siṃhāraṇye vasannityaṃ vasatau yāti vai niśi |
prasahya dhanisaudhādīn bhittvā nītvā dhanāni ca ||34||
annādīni cāmbarāṇi nītvā yāti vane punaḥ |
evaṃ satataṃ cauryeṇa nirvahatyatha tadvane || 35||
sādhuḥ śrīcakrabhāsākhyo vaiṣṇavo viharan pathi |
mimela taṃ naraśāyaṃ cauraṃ sarovarāntike ||36||
cauro vijñāya taṃ sādhuṃ nirdoṣaṃ nirbhayaṃ śubham |
gatvāntikaṃ nanāmātha niṣasāda puraḥ kṣaṇam ||37||
sādhuḥ pītvā jalaṃ tasmai dadau vāri prasādajam |
cauro’pi mānayan bhāgyaṃ tūrṇaṃ papau jalāmṛtam ||38||
pānamātreṇa hṛdayaṃ vyāvartata śubhāśrayam |
pūtaṃ ca mānasaṃ varṣma vivekaḥ samapadyata ||39||
papraccha taṃ pāvanaṃ vai matvā śāntaṃ sukhapradam |
pāpanāśaḥ kathaṃ syādvai sādho darśaya satpatham ||3.104.40 ||
śrutvā śrīcakrabhāsastaṃ prāha cauryaṃ hi laukikam |
vihāya kuru cauryaṃ tvaṃ guṇānāṃ ca satāṃ hareḥ ||41||
sevāṃ sādhorharernityaṃ samācara sadāśayaḥ |
śrutvā papraccha sādhuṃ taṃ naraśāyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||42||
kayā rītyā mayā sevā kartavyā vada me mune |
sādhuḥ prāha vane vanyaiḥ prasevaya samarpitaiḥ ||43||
phalamūlakṛtāhāro bhava cauryaṃ parityaja |
harermūrtiṃ cārcayātra bhajanaṃ satataṃ kuru ||44||
sarvapāpāni naśyeyuścaivaṃ prasevanāddhareḥ |
evamuktaḥ sa vai stenaḥ sādhumāha saro’ntike ||45||
vidyate mama vāso’tra sādho cāgaccha madgṛham |
sevayiṣye bhavantaṃ ca hariṃ tvayā pradarśitam ||46||
nāśameṣyanti pāpāni syuḥ strīputrāśca pāvanāḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ śrīcakrabhāso japannārāyaṇaṃ harim ||47||
savalkalo jaṭāyukto mālāṃ kare dadhanmudā |
vṛddho yayau ttenakuṭīṃ tatstrīputrādisaṃyutām ||48||
dattāsane niṣasāda bhajan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
stenastrīputraputryādyā matvā vṛddhaṃ piturgurum ||49||
jalapātraṃ satphalāni pakvāmrāṇi ca tatkṣaṇam |
nyadhuḥ sādhoḥ samīpe ca bhuṃkṣveti jagadustataḥ ||3.104.50||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruścānanditā mudā muhuḥ |
sādhuḥ phalāni bubhuje papau vāri ca śītalam ||51||
bhuṃjan dadāti madhye ca madhye tebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
strīputrādyāśca dattāni matvā prasādamuttamam ||52||
bhakṣayanti sumiṣṭāni steno’pi bubhuje tataḥ |
sādhurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca smṛtvā nivedya viṣṇave ||53||
bhuṃkte dadāti caitebhyaste bhuktvā cāghavarjitāḥ |
tūrṇaṃ jātāḥ pāvanāśca sevayā sparśanena ca ||54||
hṛdayāni parāvartitāni teṣāṃ sato’ntike |
procuḥ sarve bhagavannaḥ kalyāṇaṃ vai yathā bhavet| ||55||
tathā kuru vane tvatra vasan kuṭyāṃ ca no gṛhe |
sādhustathāstviti prāha covāsa śāntimām̐ściram ||56||
śikṣayāmāsa bhajanaṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇasya me |
rātrau militvā bhajanaṃ kīrtayanti svarānvitāḥ ||57||
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpate vibho ||58||
ityevaṃ kīrtayitvā māṃ svapanti nityameva te|
prātarutthāya bhajanaṃ sādhunā saha te tathā ||59||
kṛtvā yānti saraḥ snānti namaskurvanti bhāskaram |
sādhuṃ natvā mālikāṃ ca pañca japtvā vanaṃ prati ||3.104.60 ||
yānti phalāni cāhartuṃ samāyānti kuṭīṃ nijām |
madhyāhne phalakandādi bharjayitvā tu vahninā ||61 ||
pradatvā gurave tasmai nivedya haraye tu me |
bhojayitvā bhuṃjate te kurvanti bhajanaṃ tataḥ ||62||
sāyaṃ kurvanti bhajanaṃ sevante ca kathāmṛtam |
putrāḥ sādhuṃ prasevante strī sevate divāniśam |||63 ||
steno’pi sevate’bhīkṣṇaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇātmakam |
strīputrādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ yadyat karma stainyātmakaṃ purā ||64||
sarvaṃ niveditaṃ tasmai dhanaṃ ca yatsamāhṛtam |
sādhuḥ sarvaṃ samagṛhya yayau gokarṇatīrthake ||65||
cikṣepa jalamadhye śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vadanniti |
tāvaddravyaṃ samastaṃ tacchrīlakṣmīrūpakanyakā ||66||
bhūtvā sādhuṃ prāha sādhvī tvayā kṛṣṇāya cārpitā |
pāvanī khalu jātāsmi mālinyaṃ vigataṃ mama ||67||
atha caurām̐stathā pūrvadhanino’pi ca pāvanān |
kṛtvā nayāmi kṛṣṇasya caraṇau kṛtyameva me ||68 ||
ityuktvādāya sādhuṃ taṃ yayau lakṣmīśca tadvanam |
yatra te stenakarmāṇaścābhavan te’pi vismitāḥ ||69||
papracchuḥ kanyakāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhuṃ sādhurjagāda tān |
lakṣmīḥ sākṣāt samāyātā netuṃ nārāyaṇagṛham ||3.104.70||
sajjā bhavantu tūrṇaṃ vai yāntu nārāyaṇālayam |
śrutvā modaṃ gatāḥ sajjā bhūtvā natvā guruṃ ca tam ||71 ||
āgate divyaśobhāḍhye vimāne te samāruhan |
yayuḥ sādhorājñayā te pārṣadaiḥ saha sevinaḥ ||72||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhagavaddhāma lakṣmi sādhoḥ samāgamāt |
atha kanyā śrīsvarūpā sādhunā saha cāgragā ||73||
yayau taddhanināṃ saudhān dṛṣṭvā ca dhanino’pi te |
sasaṃbhramāḥ svāgatādyairapūjayan sureśvarīm ||74||
sādhuṃ prāpūjayansarve jñātvā vṛttāntamāditaḥ |
caurahastagatā lakṣmīḥ sādhuhastena cārpitā ||75||
śrīkṛṣṇe divyatāṃ prāptā prāptā kalyāṇahetave |
vijñāya te’pi sādhoścājñayā sajjāstato’bhavan ||76||
mokṣārthaṃ tāvadevāpi vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ mahat |
samāyātaṃ tvambarādvai pārṣadādisamanvitam ||77||
lakṣmīḥ sarvān dhanapām̐śca samādāya vimānake |
sthitvā nītvā yayau natvā sādhuṃ śrīcakrabhāsuram ||78||
golokaṃ dhāma kṛṣṇasya patyurhareḥ parātparam |
evaṃ lakṣmi tvayā pūrvaṃ stenaśreṣṭhikuṭumbinām ||79||
sādhoryogena kalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ yojitayā harau |
sādhuḥ śrīcakrabhāsaśca yayau lomaśabhūmikām ||3.104.80||
tīrthārthaṃ ca samādhau vai niṣasāda yugād yugam |
dadarśa mokṣamārgaṃ sa yathā yānti janāstvitaḥ ||81||
bhittvā svargaṃ maharlokaṃ janaṃ tapaśca satyakam |
jalopari ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti tatra hare puraḥ ||82||
viśrāntiṃ labhate saukhyaṃ svāgatādyaiḥ sumānanam |
haryājñayā tato yānti paravaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||83||
golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃdhāma prayānti ca |
divyadehā divyadharmā vidvāṃso ghanamūrtayaḥ ||84||
praṇavākhyaṃ kiraṇāḍhyaṃ vimānaṃ sampraviśya te |
brahmalokaṃ pravartante brahmakāyā hyanimnagāḥ ||85||
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ |
brahmaloke’kṣaraṃ brahma sarveṣāṃ vai purohitam ||86||
mukteśvaraṃ puraskṛtyānandāmṛtaṃ prabhuṃjate |
ādhipatyaṃ vinā tulyā bhavanti paramātmanā ||87||
rūpaprabhāvavijayaiśvaryasāmarthyasadṛśāḥ |
evaṃvidhaṃ tvamṛtākhyaṃ brahmasatraṃ sanātanam ||88||
apunarmārakaṃ sthānaṃ cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ |
brahmaṇyabhyāsino yuktāḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāsate ||89||
vītarāgā jitaprāṇā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ |
śāntāḥ prāṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ ||3.104.90||
niḥsaṃgā śucayo bhaktā brahmasāyujyagāsmṛtāḥ |
akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ ||91||
teṣāmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ śubhāḥ |
etad brahmapadaṃ divyaṃ paraṃ me vyomni bhāsvaram ||92||
etad gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha |
yasmādeṣāṃ paraṃ vīryaṃ paramāyuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ ||93||
parā śaktiḥ paro dharmaḥ parā vidyā parā dhṛtiḥ |
paraṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ paramaiśvaryamityapi ||94||
tasmāt parataraṃ bhūtaṃ brahmaṇo yanna vidyate |
pare sthito hyeṣa paraḥ sarvārtheṣu tataḥ param ||95||
parabrahma paro bhūtvā prapaśyati na cānyathā |
evaṃ jñānapratiṣṭhatvāt sarvaṃ brahmānupaśyati ||96||
ākṣarakṣetramuktānāmākṣare dhāmni saṃsthitiḥ |
śāśvatī vidyate lakṣmi śāśvatānandadohinī ||97||
satāṃ samāgamo nityaṃ brahmalokapradāyakaḥ |
sarvapāpaharo lakṣmi lakṣmyāḥ śuddhikarastathā ||98||
ātmaśuddhikaraścāpi mokṣaśuddhikarastathā |
jñānaśuddhikaraścopāsanāśuddhikarastathā ||99||
nirvāṇaśuddhidaścāpi śubhaḥ sārvajñyaśodhakaḥ |
ātmaniveditāsaṃśodhakaḥ sevāpraśodhakaḥ || 3.104.1 00||
doṣasaṃśodhakaścāpi māyāsaṃśodhakastathā |
vivekaśodhakaścāpi bandhanānāṃ ca śodhakaḥ || 101 ||
etadamṛtasatraṃ vai brahmasatramadhītya ha |
jāyate brahmadharmātra paratrāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gārhasthyadharmasāre naraśāyataskarasya śrīcakrabhāsasādhuyogena divyalakṣmīdvārā muktiḥ pūrvadhanināmapi muktirbrahmasatravijñānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 104 ||

<3.105>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
dharmāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ cāpi mūlaṃ me vada mādhava |
yadāśrayāt prapuṣṭiṃ saṃprayāti mānavo vṛṣe || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri dharmamūlaṃ sanātanam |
nārāyaṇe yathā lakṣmīḥ śrīkṛṣṇe rādhikā yathā || 2 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe tvaṃ mayi rājase |
viṣṇau lakṣmīryathā cāste gopāle kambharā yathā || 3 ||
sāvitryaje hare durgā siddhirvināyake yathā |
tathā vivāhitā patnī dharmamūlaṃ hi dehinām || 4 ||
pitṛdevātithīnāṃ ca svajanasya gṛhasya ca |
vaṃśasya vaṃśaśākhānāṃ mūlaṃ patnī vivāhitā || 5 ||
alaṃkṛtyodakapūrvāṃ kanyāṃ dadyācchubhe vare |
varārohāṃ yuvatīṃ cānaṅgavāsaśarīriṇīm || 6 ||
abhipretā ca yā yasya kanyābhipreta eva yaḥ |
tayormudā vivāho vai kartavyo hitakṛddhi saḥ || 7 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ cāpi sāttvikānāṃ vidhirhyayam |
dhanena bahudhā krītvā prasahya haraṇaṃ ca vā || 8 ||
na kartavyaṃ kvacillagnaṃ kenacit sukhamicchatī |
niḥśvāsābhihataṃ sarvaṃ dahyatyeva hi yoṣitaḥ || 9 ||
jātastrīvyañjanāṃ bhāryāmudvahecchreya icchatā |
udbhinnayauvanāṃ puṣṭāmudvahetpuṣṭayauvanaḥ || 3.105.1 0||
rājasvalyaṃ vinā naiva kṣatāṃ kuryānnijāṃganām |
athavā cet kāmukī sā snehaspṛśyā nisargajā || 1 1||
svayaṃ patiṃ pragacchecced ramaṇe naiva dūṣaṇam |
patnīcchāmantarā nopayacchet nārīcalo bhavan || 12||
kāmukaḥ svairavṛttaśca dharmaṃ hanti gṛhāśrayam |
prasahyādharma evāste snehakāryo vṛṣo mataḥ || 13||
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahārāṣṭre kṣatriyo jāṃghalāmakhaḥ |
āsīt vavre sa kanyāṃ dvādaśavarṣāṃ surūpiṇīm || 14||
ajātayauvanabhāvāṃ dharmahṛdayayoginīm |
sadvivekayutāṃ rājasvalyottaraṃ patiṃ prati || 15||
kāmadharmaṃ cehamānāṃ nānyathā sā satīvratā |
dharmaṃ kṛtvā puraścāste patisevāparā sadā || 16||
kāmukaśca patistāṃ vai prasahya kāmatṛptaye |
spraṣṭumiyeṣa sā prāha kānta dharmaḥ prabādhate || 17||
nāhaṃ yogyā bhavāmyatra vinā dharmamṛtuṃ pate |
sparśasevāṃ karomyatra kāmasevāṃ pravarjaya || 18||
ityukto’pi patidharmamanāvekṣya hi kāmukaḥ |
prasahya patnīṃ jagrāha satī niḥśvāsamācarat || 19||
niśvāsānmūrtimānagniḥ prādurbabhūva tatkṣaṇam |
ajvālayat patiṃ saudhaṃ smṛddhiṃ copaskarāṇi ca ||3.105.20||
satī śuśoca bahudhā patyau naṣṭe pativratā |
sasmāra dharmaṃ dharmo’pi tadā sākṣāccaturbhujaḥ ||21||
āyayau mā śucaśceti prāha bālāmaninditām |
dharmarakṣākṛte bāle prasanno’smi vṛṣo’smyaham ||22||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mā dharmāccala bhāmini |
dharmo rakṣati rakṣito nāśito nāśayatyapi ||23||
tena nāśitavānasmi tato nāśo’sya cābhavat |
tvayā vai rakṣitastena tvaṃ cābādhā prajīvasi ||24||
vahnistvāṃ na dadāhātra gṛhe bāle balānmama |
varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ vai dadāmyadya hi mā ciram ||25||
śrutvā bālā kundadharmānāmnī tadā varaṃ patim |
vavre kuṭumbakaṃ patyuścāpi sañjīvitaṃ gṛham ||26||
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ dharmajñānayutaṃ patim |
dharmadevastathāstvāha drutaṃ sañjīvitaḥ patiḥ ||27||
kuṭumbasahitaḥ sarvagṛhopakaraṇānvitaḥ |
dharmajñānayutaścāpi mumude cātibhāvavān ||28||
praśaśaṃsa paraṃ dharmaṃ patnyāḥ ṛtujayacchanam |
dharmo yayau tataḥ pūjāṃ labdhvātho jāṃgalāmakhaḥ ||29||
patnīdharmaṃ sadā sampālayāmāsa yathoditam |
satī satyavatī prāpa dagdhamapi nijaṃ patim ||3.105.3 0||
ityevaṃ cāsti maryādā patnīcchānirmitā sadā |
tāṃ rakṣan jāyate puṇyaṃ cānyathā pātakaṃ matam ||3 1 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cānyad yuvatīkanyakāvṛṣam |
trīṇi varṣāṇyudīkṣeta kanyā ṛtumatī satī ||32||
caturthe tvatha samprāpte svayaṃ bhartāramarjayet |
prajā na hīyate tasyā ratiścāpi na hīyate ||33||
ato’nyathā vartamānā bhavedvācyā janasya sā |
tasmād rajasvalādharmaṃ vivāhayenna rakṣayet ||34||
asapiṇḍā nijamāturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ |
ityetāmanugaccheta mānavo niyamo hyayam ||35||
pāṇergrahaṇapūrvaṃ tu yācante vai janā muhuḥ |
varaḥ śreṣṭho miled dadyāttasmai vihāya cāparam ||36||
nāniṣṭāya pradadyādvai na hīnāya na rogiṇe |
nāraye na bibhatsāya na dadyāt krūrakarmaṇe ||37||
nādhārmikāya dadyādvai hiṃsakāya tathā na ca |
na hyeva bhāryā kretavyā na vikrayyā kathaṃcana ||38||
yatreṣṭaṃ tatra deyā syānniḥśulkā saṃvibhūṣitā |
mṛte patyau pradātavyā yatreṣṭaṃ yoṣitaḥ khalu ||39||
vivāhitena cet tyaktā dātavyā tvaparāya sā |
bhāryayā ca parityakto bhāryāmanyāṃ samudvahet ||3.105.40||
mṛtāyāmapi bhāryāyāṃ bhāryāmanyāṃ samudvahet |
devaraṃ praviśedvāpi devaro vā viśet striyam ||41||
dvayoścedānukūlyaṃ syādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
apitṛjāṃ cāmātṛjāṃ vindet mānavīṃ satīm ||42||
agniṃ devaṃ pitaraṃ vā gāṃ parikramya sarvathā |
vṛddhānāṃ sannidhau yadvā mālāṃ samarpya vai mithaḥ ||43||
hastayormelanaṃ vāpi kṛtvā natvā parasparam |
maṇḍape mandire vāpi vivāhayet guroḥ puraḥ ||44||
avirodhena lokānāṃ kuṭumbināṃ nṛpasya ca |
prajānāṃ cāvirodhena dvayorgraho vivāhanam ||45||
prakāśaṃ yaddvayoraikyaṃ cāvirodhena śobhanam |
hṛdayayoḥ sākṣitātra dharmaḥ so’pi purātanaḥ ||46||
aprakāśe garbhavattā ninditā pitṛvarjitā |
dāsīnāmiva vaṃśo na gaṇanāṃ yāti dhārmikīm ||47||
niyogādapi jāyante putrāste pitṛlokitāḥ |
brahmakṣatrā vaṃśakarā dharmaḥ so’pi purātanaḥ ||48||
sādhūnāṃ punarācāro garīyān dharmalakṣaṇaḥ |
pitrājñaptā svaya vṛttā bhartrā yogamupāgatā ||49||
sādhvācāreṇa sā jātā vivāhitā hi sā matā |
bhāryāpatyorhi sambandhaścāmṛtyuściraśobhanaḥ ||3.105.50||
ratisādhāraṇo naiṣastasmāddharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
satimātrārthasambandhaḥ strīpuṃsornahi dhārmikaḥ ||51||
dāyabhāge’pi putro vai gaṇyate vaṃśabhāgavān |
putro na syāttadā putrī dāyabhāgādhikāriṇī ||52|||
putraḥ putrī samau bodhyau dāyabhāge’tikāriṇau |
bahavo’pi sutā yasya putryo’pi ca tathāvidhāḥ ||53||
tasyāpi dāyabhāge syuḥ putrāḥ putryo’dhikāriṇaḥ |
samabhāgāḥ pradātavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||54||
vivāhya dāyabhāgaṃ cādattvā sampreṣayanti ye |
kanyābhāgaprabhoktāraḥ patanti narake hi te ||55||
jīvitārthāya vikrīya kumāraṃ vā kumārikām |
bhuṃjate taddhanaṃ te tu bhuṃjate piśitaṃ tayoḥ ||56||
anyo’pyatha na vikreyo manuṣyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ prajāḥ |
vaśyāṃ kumārīṃ balato vikrīṇīyānna kaścana ||57||
dharmabuddhyā cārpayedvai jāmātre yautakānvitām |
mātuśca yautakaṃ yat syāt kumārībhāga eva saḥ ||58||
dauhitra eva tadrikthamaputrasya piturharet |
putradauhitrayoreva viśeṣo nāsti dharmataḥ ||59||
pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiścāpi śvaśurairatha devaraiḥ |
pūjyā bhūṣayitavyā ca bahukalyāṇamipsubhiḥ ||3.105.60||
pūjyā lālayitavyāśca striyo nityaṃ gṛhasthitāḥ |
ramaṇyo yatra tuṣyanti vasanti tatra sampadaḥ ||61||
siddhayaḥ prativarṣanti sarvān kāmān dadatyapi |
yatra nāryo’vamanyante sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ||62||
naiva bhānti na vardhante vaṃśāḥ śriyā vivarjitāḥ |
strīhetukaḥ sadā śreṣṭho dharmo dyusatyalokadaḥ ||63||
utpādanamapatyasya jātasya paripālanam |
prītyartho lokayātrāyā yāpanaṃ strījane sthitam ||64||
nāsti yajñastādṛśo vai na śrāddhaṃ nopavāsanam |
dharmo yugalasauhārdasamo dyumokṣado’paraḥ ||65||
pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane |
putrāśca sthavire pānti strīrakṣaivaṃ purātanī ||66||
śriya etāḥ striyo nāma satkāryā bhūmimicchatā |
pālitānugṛhitā ca strī śrīreva prakāśate ||67||
atha lakṣmi striyai deyo dāyabhāgo’pi sammataḥ |
putraputrīsamobhāgastaddhanaṃ yoṣitaḥ sadā ||68||
bhartrā tacca dhanaṃ dattaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhoktumarhati |
strīṇāṃ tatpatidāyādyaṃ hyupabhogaphalaṃ matam ||69||
ekasya bahubhāryatve brāhmaṇī sarvathottamā |
snānaṃ prasādhanaṃ bharturdantadhāvanamañjanam ||3.105.70||
havyaṃ kavyaṃ devapūjāṃ bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇī caret |
annaṃ pānaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ||71 ||
brāhmaṇyetāni dadyāt svabhartre sā hi garīyasī |
athavā cānukūlyaṃ tu yathā bhaveddhi yoṣitām ||72||
akleśena pramodena snehena cānuvṛttitaḥ |
tathā seveta viprā vā kṣatriyā vāparāpi vā ||73||
patyurājñāṃ samagṛhya nānyathā tu kathaṃcana |
garbhaśuddhiśca vijñeyā guṇarūpanisargakaiḥ ||74||
apatyaṃ pratibimbaṃ vai piturmātuśca vā bhavet |
tatsvabhāvamapatyaṃ tadvijñeyaṃ śuddhavaṃśajam ||75||
tatra yatra pṛthagbhāvo garbhāśuddhirhi sā matā |
niṣeke saṃkarībhāve vairupyaṃ bālake bhavet ||76||
sānnidhye’niṣṭavastūnāṃ sāṃkaryaṃ jāyate hṛdi |
bīje saṃkramate tacca garbhe tadbhāva udbhavet ||77||
garbhadānaṃ tato’dṛśye rahasye vidhnavarjite |
śāntaśabde śāntaloke śāntapaśvādibhāṣaṇe ||78||
suśāntasarvatattveṣu vidhātavyaṃ na cānyathā |
śuddhavaṃśaprasūtiḥ sā bhavedatra na saṃśayaḥ ||79||
anyaśabdasparśarūparasasvabhāvadūṣaṇam |
prakramate bījadāne pratimādarśanādapi ||3.105.80||
tasmāt patimukhaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyad dṛśyaṃ tadā matam |
prasannahṛdayābhyāṃ ca bhāvyaṃ na tu krudhā ruṣā ||81 ||
na ca mālinyabhāvena bhāvyaṃ sugandhisaṃbhṛtā |
prasannamanasā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ sattvaguṇena ca ||82||
ekāgramanasā bhāvyaṃ dātrā dhātryā ca sarvathā |
sa vaṃśaḥ śuddha eva syāt smartavyaṃ netarat tadā ||83||
nārāyaṇo hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ |
smartavyo dampatībhyāṃ vai bījadāne na cāparaḥ ||84||
yatsmṛtistadguṇā bhāvāḥ prakramante prakṛtayaḥ|
tasmācchreṣṭhaḥ patirdevo devadevo janārdanaḥ ||85||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kathāṃ purātanīṃ śubhām |
pulastyo vedhasaḥ putro dadau dānaṃ yadārtavam ||86||
tadā prītiḥ pulastyasya bhāryā sasmāra rākṣasam |
nirṛtaṃ rāvaṇastena rakṣodharmā vyajāyata ||87||
yadārtave prasasmāra viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
tadbhāvabhāvito jāto bhaktaḥ putro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||88||
pārvatīśaṃkarau pūrve sasmaraturbalānvitam |
senāpatiṃ sutaṃ daityanāśakaṃ vijayapradam ||89||
skandastenābhavad vighnanāśārthaṃ gaṇapo’bhavat |
vairājastriguṇān smṛtvotpādayāmāsa vai trikam || 3.105.90||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ yathā smṛtistathā janiḥ |
carau phale prasāde ca bīje cāśīrvacasyapi ||91 ||
yādṛk smaraṇaṃ rohedvai tādṛśī jāyate prajā |
yadbhāvanā bhaved bhaktiḥ phalaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitam ||92||
kalpavṛkṣe harermūrtau gurau patyau striyāṃ sati |
auṣadhe mantre tapasi yathā bhāvastathā phalam ||93||
vidyāyāmudyame yuddhe kṛṣau bhṛtyakriyāvidhau |
bhautikābhyudaye vege yādṛgyatnastathā phalam ||94||
nṛpe sādhau harau pitroḥ śreṣṭhini svāmini krame |
deve pitari santuṣṭe yathā kṛpā tathā phalam ||95||
śatrau niyāmake sarpe vipre śastriṇi tāpase |
kalahe rodhane nāśe yathā roṣastathā phalam ||96||
bhaktau yoge prārthanāyāṃ sevāyāṃ daivakarmasu |
śāstre bhogye dīrghakārye yathā śāntistathā phalam ||97||
dharme lagne mṛdhe dāne vacane vighnasāraṇe |
caurye mokṣe deśakāle yathā śaighryaṃ tathā phalam ||98||
kāvye nyāye copadeśe cājñāyāṃ cāntime kṣaṇe |
saṃhāre cāpadi prāraṃbhe yathādhīstayā phalam ||99||
kṣetre svarge striyāṃ śiṣye putre kārye hyupārjane |
mantre śāstre racanāyāṃ yathā bījaṃ tathā phalam || 3.105.1 00||
kīrtau ratau vṛṣe vaṃśe sukhe śrame ca bhojane |
kośe’tithau gṛhe svarge yathā bhāryā tathā phalam || 10 1||
tasmāllakṣmi sadā bhāryā pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
viśeṣato hi dharmāṇāṃ mūlaṃ bhavati sarvathā || 1 02||
puruṣārthā hi catvāraścopāyāḥ sādhanāni ca |
yātrāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante siddhyanti nijayoṣitā || 1 03||
kṣetraṃ vai sarvadharmāṇāṃ vāṭikā putrasampadām |
kalpalatā sukhānāṃ ca bhāryā bhavati mūlikā || 1 04||
mandurā sā mano’śvānāmāśrayā prāṇapakṣiṇām |
nauḥ sā saṃsāriṇāṃ patnī yānaṃ sā svargiṇāṃ tathā || 105||
yajñe vaṃśe sukhe duḥkhe puṇye mahotsave save |
gṛhe kārye dhane khyātāvardhāṃganā nijātmikā || 1 06||
paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tathā dharmasamāśrayāt |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi nāryā narasya sarvathā || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvadharmakarmaṇāṃ mūlaṃ vivāhitā patnīti jāṃghalāmakhasya kṣatriyasya kundadharmapatnyāḥ saradharme camatkāraḥ kanyā dānayogyatā varayogyatā dāyabhāgayogyatā bījaśuddhirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||

<3.106>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
yathā patnī tathā putro dharmāśrayaḥ piturmataḥ |
pitā putrasvarūpo’sti pitṛdharmaḥ sute sthitaḥ || 1 ||
pracchanno vā prakāśo vā putraḥ pitā prakīrtitaḥ |
āryatvaṃ dharmaśīlatvaṃ mārdavaṃ vyavasāyitā || 2 ||
bhaktirviveka ete vyañjayanti putramuttamam |
anāryatvamanācāraḥ krūratā niṣkriyātmatā || 3 ||
abhaktiścāvivekaśca kāluṣyaṃ vyañjayanti vai |
pitryaṃ vai bhajate śīlaṃ mātṛjaṃ vobhayaṃ tathā || 4 ||
śuddhayoniprajanmā vai sāṃkaryaṃ bhajate nahi |
jyāyānapi tu śīlena hīno mānaṃ na cārhati || 5 ||
api śūdro’pi śīlāḍhyaḥ sadvṛttaḥ pūjyate janaiḥ |
ākhyātmānamevātra śīlacāritrakarmabhiḥ || 6 ||
ātmā putra aurasaḥ svaḥ pitā svayaṃ sa kathyate |
svakṣetre tu niyogena parajanyo dvitīyakaḥ || 7 ||
svakṣetre cāniyogena pracchannajastṛtīyakaḥ |
ūḍhā garbhavatī bhāryā tajjātastu caturthakaḥ || 8 ||
janmataḥ kenaciddattaḥ pañcamaḥ saḥ pravardhitaḥ |
yauvane dattakatayā gṛhītaḥ ṣaṣṭha ityapi || 9 ||
śiṣyarūpeṇa samprāptaḥ saptamaḥ putra ityapi |
krītaḥ proktastvaṣṭamaścānūḍhājo navamaḥ sutaḥ || 3.106.10||
manojanyo daśamaśca kathito mānasaḥ sutaḥ |
pathi tyakto jātamātro gṛhītaḥ kṛtrimaḥ sutaḥ || 11 ||
ekādaśaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ dauhitro dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ |
putryaścāpi tathā bodhyā dvādaśadhā tu vaṃśajāḥ || 1 2||
saṃskārāścātmavatteṣāṃ svāmivat saṃbhavanti hi |
kānīnako hyanūḍhājo mātṛvarṇaṃ prapadyate || 13||
gaṇikānāmapatyāni mātṛvarṇāni tāni vai |
dāsīnāṃ patihīnānāmapatyāni tu yāni vai || 14||
mātṛvarṇāni bodhyāni svāmivarṇāni vā tathā |
bhikṣādīkṣālabhyabālā acyutagotrakā hi te || 15||
sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ sarve bhavantyacyutagotrakāḥ |
tyāgivargāśca vai putrāḥ putryo nārāyaṇasya ha || 16||
evaṃ vai bhūtale loke vyavasthāsti tu padmaje |
aicchikī tvanyalokeṣu tathaiṣāpi pravartate || 17||
bhāryā caturvidhā lakṣmi prāyaśaḥ saṃbhavanti hi |
patnī vivāhitā proktā dāsī yā tu sahāgatā ||18||
upakurvāṇikā yā tu kañcitkālaṃ gṛhe sthitā |
pracchannayogamāpannā rakṣitā sā tu kīrtitā || 19||
svāmino’pi tathā santi caturdhā padmaje śṛṇu |
vivāhitaḥ patiḥ prokto lagnitaḥ śreṣṭha eva saḥ ||3.106.20||
devarādirgauṇakānto dvitīyaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ |
niyogamāptastṛtīyaścopakurvāṇakaḥ sa hi ||21 ||
pracchannayogamāpanno rakṣitaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ |
prajāstayoryathāyogaṃ nāryā vā ca narasya vā ||22||
vivāde’patyamevātra yamicchet tasya vai hi tat |
deśabhedāt kālabhedād rītibhedāt pṛthagvṛṣaḥ ||23||
dattā kanyā dānarūpā putrī kathaṃ na kalpyate |
kalpyate bhogyarūpā sā tasmād rītirhi kāraṇam ||24||
bhāvanā yādṛśī yatra vyavahāraśca tādṛśaḥ |
bhuktvā krodhena vai tyaktā vairāgyeṇa tathā ca vā ||25||
tyāgenāpi vivekena tyaktā mātṛsamā hi sā |
tasmāllakṣmi mahāmāyāpravāho mūrchanātmakaḥ | | 26||
mūrchanāsu vividhāsu nayanti dehinaḥ sadā |
yathāvidhaḥ pravāho’sti yadā yatra yuge sthale ||27||
tathārītikṛto dharmaḥ sukhadaḥ śāntido bhavet |
devānāṃ rītayaścānyā yogināmitarāśca tāḥ ||28||
mānavānāṃ vibhinnāśca paśvādīnāṃ tathetarāḥ |
yathārītiḥ sa vai dharmo yadyanarthaṃ na cāvahet ||29||
anarthaṃ prāpayanpanthā dharmātmā naiva gaṇyate |
duḥkhado naiva dharmo’sti sukhadaḥ sarvathā vṛṣaḥ ||3.106.30||
artho vṛṣānusañjuṣṭo’nartho’dharmānuyojitaḥ |
kāmo dharmārthasahitastaddhīno na pumarthakaḥ || 31 ||
dharmārthakāmapāraṃ yo yātaḥ sa vindate’kṣaram |
adharmyanarthī viṣayī vindate yamayātanām || 3 2||
kuṭumbādivyavasthāpi puruṣārthaparāyaṇā |
apumarthayutā rītiḥ pāśavī na tu mānuṣī || 33 ||
śāstraṃ śāsanadharmaṃ vai mānuṣādau pravartate |
tiryagyonau na vai śāstraṃ vidyāśūnyatayā khalu || 34||
balaṃ rītiḥ paśūnāṃ tu mohaśceti nibandhanam |
tadādhārāṇi tiryañci yādāṃsi kīṭayonayaḥ || 35||
athaivaṃ vartamānānāṃ bhavapāro na vidyate |
yadṛcchayā satāṃ yoge bhavapāro bhavet kvacit ||36 ||
nahyātmā śakyate hantuṃ tasmāduddhāramācaret |
snehena darśanaṃ sādhoḥ saṃvāsaṃ sevayācaret || 37||
brahmavāsakṛtārambhaṃ sādhuṃ seveta mānavaḥ |
nihatya mānaṃ śokaṃ ca krodhaṃ harṣaṃ ca vāsanām || 38 ||
viśrambhapātraṃ bhūtānāṃ śuciṃ śrīkṛṣṇadaivatam |
ūrdhvabrahmasthitiṃ śāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ priyadarśanam || 3 9||
niḥśeṣitasamāraṃbhaṃ dhyānaniṣṭhaṃ vaśendriyam |
niṣṇātaṃ brahmavidyāyāṃ samanetraṃ dayāparam ||3.106.40 ||
etādṛśaṃ sādhujanaṃ cāśrayet prārthayettathā |
ajñānād yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prakṣālaya jagadguro ||4 1 ||
mokṣamārgasya sopānaṃ pradarśaya jagadguro |
vāsanāgranthimujjvālya pāvaya svān jagadguro ||42 ||
bhaktiṃ pradarśya paramāṃ pramokṣaya jagadguro |
evaṃ vai prārthanāṃ kuryād yathā kuryāt kṛpāṃ tathā ||43 ||
vaktavyaṃ ca satāmagre tavāsmīti punaḥ punaḥ |
karavāṇi yadājñā syāt sarvaṃ kartāsmi duṣkaram ||44||
yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gā yadi svaṃ gṛham |
yajñaṃ dānaṃ sutaṃ vāṭīṃ brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te ||45||
ityevamarthayet sādhuṃ pratoṣayet samarpaṇaiḥ |
aśaṃkayārpayet sarvaṃ muktibhāk sa bhavet khalu ||46||
māyā hi saṃśayaḥ prokto brahmaṇi nāsti saṃśayaḥ |
saṃśayaścet satāṃ yoge sevāyāṃ vacane kṛtau ||47||
kadā muktiḥ kadā śuddhiḥ kathaṃ sevā bhavediha |
kadā śuddhasvarūpasya niṣṭhā vāpi bhavediha ||48||
tasmānniḥsaṃśayo bhūtvā seveta sādhumuttamam |
pāpakṣālanaśaktaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ divyavartanam ||49||
santuṣṭaṃ jñānakośaṃ ca brahmādhānaṃ nirāśrayam|
nirālambaṃ madālambaṃ manmūrtiṃ sevayet sadā ||3.106.50||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi sādhusevāphalaṃ param |
sasvāmipaśupakṣyāptasuhṛdāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yataḥ ||51 ||
āsīt karṇāṭake deśe bhaktimān tāpaso muniḥ |
nāmnā śaṃbhalavāraśca jātyā sūtīyasaṃbhavaḥ ||52||
sa tu nadyāstaṭe vāsaṃ cakāraikala eva ha |
yuvāpi strīṃ vinānaṃgabhogecchuḥ samadhārayat ||53||
tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogān hi dharmataḥ |
yāsyāmyahaṃ tataḥ svargaṃ śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ||54||
vicāryetthaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kartuṃ gṛhādvinirgataḥ |
godāvaryāstaṭe ramye samutsedhasthale śubhe ||55||
grāme satrāśayākhye vai nijāvāsaṃ vyadhāt tataḥ |
ucchraye sa tapaḥ kartuṃ vīkṣyānukūlabhūtalam ||56||
mānavaiḥ kṛtasammāno’nnādibhiḥ sa mano dadhe |
pañcāgniṣu niṣasāda ṣaṇmāsānatha tatparam ||57||
utthito’bhūd varṣamātraṃ tvekapādena tāpasaḥ |
tapaścacāra paramaṃ bhajan viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam ||58||
varṣānte nijapādau sa baddhvā vallyā vaṭadrame |
śākhāyāṃ nimnamūrddhāsau vyalambata samāntaram ||59||
evaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ paścād varṣānte mastakaṃ bhuvi |
nidhāyordhvapado bhūtvā tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||3.106.60||
varṣānte cordhvahasto’bhūdaṃguṣṭhamātratolanaḥ |
animeṣo’rkadṛṣṭiśca tapaścacāra dāruṇam ||61 ||
ṣaṇmāsān tatparaṃ nadyāṃ jalāntare’vasattataḥ |
pañcame vatsare viṣṇurjale matsyasvarūpadhṛk ||62||
āyayau cakracihnāḍhyaścakhāda carma tanmuneḥ |
māṃsaṃ cakhāda ca tathāpi na kampaṃ yayau muniḥ ||63||
viṣṇurmatsyasya vācā taṃ prāha jale’tra vartase |
kastvaṃ kathaṃ sthitastvatra vada ko’rtho’tra te mataḥ ||64||
śrutvā śaṃbhalavārastaṃ matsyamāha śubhāśayam |
tapaḥ karomi saukhyārthaṃ sukhaṃ dharmaphalaṃ yataḥ ||65||
rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ bhāryāḥ sutāḥ putryaśca dhenavaḥ |
dāsā dāsyo vāhanāni labhyante tapasā sadā ||66||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca labhyante gṛhayogataḥ |
bhūtvā gṛhī prayāsyāmi tapaḥ kṛtvā paraṃ padam ||67||
ityukto matsya āhāpi kiṃ te bhogeṣu vāsanā |
tapaḥ kṛtvā phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva mokṣapade pare pade ||68||
anityāḥ santi bhogā vai duḥkhadā bandhanātmakāḥ |
tān vihāya padaṃ yāhi nārāyaṇasya śāśvatam ||69||
śrutvā śaṃbhalavāraśca prāha matsyaṃ tadā punaḥ |
bhavān matsyo yathā jñānī vartase viṣayeṣvapi ||3.106.70||
tathā jñātvāpi viṣayānabhuktvā na nivartanam |
bhuktvā vividhān viṣayān tṛptimāsādya sarvathā ||71 ||
vāsanāyāḥ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato yāyātparaṃ padam |
ityevaṃ sulabhaḥ panthāstadanyaḥ saṃśayātmakaḥ ||72||
sarāgasya gatirnāsti rāgaṃ praśāmayettataḥ |
ato’haṃ tapasārādhya viṣṇuṃ prasādya mādhavam ||73||
vṛttvā bhogān prabhuktvā tān bhaktyā yāsyāmi tatpadam |
śrutvā matsyastadā prāha paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||74||
tapasā te pratuṣṭo’smi nārāyaṇo’smi cāgataḥ |
vṛṇu yatte yatheṣṭaṃ tad dadāmi sarvathā ciram ||75||
munirvavre dhanaṃ rājyaṃ nārīḥ putrān paśūn sutāḥ |
gajāśvavṛṣabhān gāśca puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||76||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha datvā varaṃ tiro’bhavat |
atha śaṃbhalavāro’pi jalād bahirviniryayau ||77||
mālāmāvartayannāmnā nārāyaṇasya vai hareḥ |
uvāsotsedhabhāge ca nadyāstaṭe manohare ||78||
atha satrāśayo grāmo daśasāhasramānavaḥ |
varṣāyāṃ saritaḥ pūraiḥ samāvṛṇot samantataḥ ||79||
jalamagno’bhavaccāpi tadrājā maraṇaṃ yayau |
anye’pi bahavo lokā narā nāryo janāḥ prajāḥ ||3.106.80||
jalaplavena nidhanaṃ yātāḥ pañcasahasriṇaḥ |
tataḥ pare yayurdeśāntare vāsārthameva ca ||81 ||
sahasraṃ mānavāstatra nyūṣurdhairyaprapālitāḥ |
bhaktāḥ sarve tāpasāśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||82||
atha śaṃbhalavāro’pi mānapātraṃ paraṃ śubham |
tadgrāmavāsināṃ tatra cābhavattāpaso yataḥ ||83||
grāmarājyaṃ pracakāra prajābhirmānitastataḥ |
evaṃ rājābhavattatra sahasramānavārcitaḥ ||84||
grāmaprajā dadustasmai kanyakāścaikaviṃśatim |
gāvaḥ paśavo dāsāśca dāsyaḥ prajājanāstathā ||85||
ajāvayo’śvavṛṣabhāḥ sarve tasyābhavam̐stataḥ |
evaṃ sa tapasā rājyaṃ bhogān strīśca sutādikān ||86||
prāpa nārāyaṇabhaktiṃ cakre satāṃ prasevanam |
asya bhaktyā dharmabhṛtyā vyavardhanta prajāḥ punaḥ ||87||
daśasāhasrasaṃkhyordhvā abhavan satranāgarāḥ |
sarvā anena muninā vaiṣṇvyastā kṛtāstathā ||88||
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ śrīharestathā |
akārayad yathāyogyaṃ mandiraṃ cāpyakārayat ||89||
sādhavo’sya gṛhe nityaṃ nivasanti sahasraśaḥ |
bhaktiṃ ca navadhā nityamakārayat sumandire || 3.106.90 ||
athāyaṃ vigate kāle prajāḥ prāha vivekavān |
putrā me cāsate daivācchataṃ pañca tathā striyaḥ || 91 ||
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāśca putryo me dve śate tathā |
gāvaḥ santi sahasrāṇi vṛṣabhā vājinastathā |
śukāśca sārikāścāpi hastinaḥ saramāsutāḥ ||92 ||
dāsā dāsyo bhavantyatra prajā yūyaṃ sukhāstathā |
dharmaḥ kṛtastathā cārthaḥ kāmo dṛṣṭo’tha mokṣaṇam | | 93 ||
kartumicchāmi sahasā datvā rājyaṃ sutāya me |
jyeṣṭhāya ca tato yāsye nārāyaṇākṣaraṃ padam || 94| |
prajāstathāstviti prāhuḥ prāhuścānyacchubhāspadam |
vayaṃ sarvāḥ prayāsyāmaḥ sahaiva paramaṃ padam ||95||
svasvasutān prasaṃsthāpya yathādhikārakarmasu |
evaṃ sammantrya rājāsau samādhau yogamāptavān ||96||
sarvaṃ putre sannidhāya mokṣe vṛttiṃ samādadhat |
rājñyaḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sarvāstatsthale śrīharau tadā || 97||
yojayitvendriyaprāṇān lagnā āsan nijātmasu |
bhajantaḥ śrīpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ priyaṃ prabhuṃ patim ||98||
āyayau tatra vai viṣṇurvimānaiḥ saha pārṣadaiḥ |
prabhāsayan diśaḥ sarvā garjayadbhirdigantarān || 99||
prāha bhaktaṃ śaṃbhalaṃ taṃ samāgaccha vimānake |
natvārcya bhagavantaṃ taṃ prāha śaṃbhalavārakaḥ || 3.106.100 ||
bhagavan kṛpayā sarvāḥ prajā yāstu samutsukāḥ |
āgantuṃ mokṣamevātra sajjāstā naya vai saha || 101 ||
gavāśvavṛṣabhājāścāvayo gāvaḥ śukādayaḥ |
tathānye ye bhavantyatra tava prasādapāvitāḥ || 1 02||
mama putrāśca putryaśca rājñyaścāpi kuṭumbinaḥ |
sajjā ye ye bhavantyatra tāṃstān naya nijaṃ padam || 103 ||
itīcchāṃ me hare kṛṣṇa prapūraya kṛpāṃ kuru |
hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ tava bhaktyā karomyaham || 1 04||
putrāste bhinnajātīyā bhinnanārīsamudbhavāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścānye vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathāpare || 1 05||
bhinnajātīyarājñīnāṃ sutāḥ putrāstathānugāḥ |
dāsā bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye’nye’nyā bhaktimārgagāḥ || 1 06||
ārohantu vimānaṃ me nayāmi mama dhāma tān |
ityuktāḥ sarva evaite ye ye mumukṣavo’bhavan || 1 07||
āruruhurvimānaṃ te navasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve kṛpayā śrīharestadā || 1 08||
āruruhurvimānaṃ tad divyadehāścaturbhujāḥ |
caturbhujyaśca kamalā nāryaḥ śarvāstadābhavan || 1 09||
prajāḥ sarvā āruruhurvimānaṃ divyabhāsvarāḥ |
ekaikaputraṃ santyajya vaṃśabījaṃ yathāyatham || 3.106.11 0||
sarvāḥ prajāstathā rājā rājakuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ |
sarve yayurvimānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ padam || 111 ||
evaṃ śaṃbhalavāro vai sādhurgṛhe sthito’pi san |
tāpaso’pi bhuvo bhogān bhuktvā prapūjya keśavam || 1 12||
yayau padaṃ tu paramaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇāśritaḥ |
bhinnajātīyapatnīnāṃ patiḥ putrādisaṃyutaḥ || 1 13||
evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena kuṭumbaṃ sarvathā rame |
prayāti paramaṃ dhāma yogyāyogye na tatra vai || 1 14||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhogavairāgyavān bhavet |
bhaktyā bhuktiṃ samālabhya muktiṃ vrajed balāddhareḥ ||1 15||
sādhuvṛttyā vrajenmuktiṃ nayenmuktiṃ sahasraśaḥ |
yayā śaṃbhalavāro’sau yayau muktiṃ prajāyutaḥ || 1 16||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhaputrāḥ, vividhapatnyo vividhapatayaḥ, sādhuyoge muktiḥ, sūtajātīyasya śaṃbhalavārasya sādhubhaktasya bhaktyā tapasā rājyasutapaśupakṣyādiprāptyuttaraṃ saprajasya muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||

<3.107>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ sādhoḥ śrīcihnayoginaḥ |
saurāṣṭravāsinaste’tra vadāmi smṛddhimokṣadam || 1 ||
āsīt sādhurmama bhakto kīśādanapurasthitaḥ |
śrīcihnayogītisiddho divyakarmā samādhimān || 2 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ bhajate sma saḥ |
kvacidadṛśyarūpeṇa kvacid dṛśyena vartate || 3 ||
kvacijjale vane vṛkṣe parvate vasati kvacit |
vṛṣṭau tāpe kvaciccābdhitaṭe cāśvasarovare || 4 ||
kvacid vahnā ca vāyau ca kvacid viśati gahvare |
etādṛśaḥ samartho’pi bhajate māṃ nirantaram || 5 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara |
akṣarādhipate lakṣmīpate śrīpuruṣottama || 6 ||
evaṃ māṃ raṭati nityaṃ bhajate ca punaḥ punaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā mālāṃ karoti nityaśaḥ || 7 ||
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjāṃ karoti mama nityadā |
mānase hṛdaye nityaṃ mūrtaṃ paśyati māṃ hi saḥ || 8 ||
sahasraśo lakṣaśaśca mānavā yamupāsate |
kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ santaṃ vīkṣya yat kalpayanti te || 9 ||
sarvaṃ tat phalati teṣāṃ kalpanādeva sannidhau |
nāśīrvādāvaśyakatā sevāvaśyakatā na ca || 3.107.1 0||
evaṃvidhaḥ sa sādhustvekadā kaupīnamātradhṛk |
yadṛcchayā copapanno devānīkanṛpaṃ prati || 11 ||
saurāṣṭrarājo vijñāya santaṃ neme pupūja tam |
svāgataṃ cāsanaṃ datvā madhuparkaṃ dadau tataḥ || 12||
pādāmṛtaṃ jalaṃ labdhvā papau kuṭumbayuṅnṛpaḥ |
kalyāṇadevānīkastrī sahajāśrīriti nṛpī || 1 3||
neme taṃ ca dadau bhojyaṃ miṣṭaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ ghṛtam |
munirjagrāha bhāvena papau vāri tutoṣa ca || 14||
rājā satkṛtya bahudhā muniṃ punarathābravīt |
bhagavan paravantau syo brūhi kiṃ karavāvahai || 15||
yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gā yadi bhāminīm |
yānaṃ sutāṃ sutaṃ saudhaṃ brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te || 16||
idaṃ gṛhamidaṃ rājyamidaṃ dharmāsanaṃ ca te |
nṛpa tvamasi śādhyurvīmahantu paravām̐stvayi || 17||
śrutvā śrīcihnayogī taṃ prāha bhaktaṃ nṛpaṃ dvijam |
na rājyaṃ kāmaye rājanna dhanaṃ bhāminīṃ na ca || 18||
na gāḥ pānaṃ sutāṃ saudhaṃ sutaṃ vā kāmaye nṛpa |
kintu mayā gṛhīto’sti niyamastasya pūrtaye || 1 9||
paricaryo’smi yattābhyāṃ yuvābhyāmaviśaṃkayā |
rājā hṛṣṭo’bhavacchrutvā prāha tathāstu taṃ munim ||3.107.20||
prāveśayad gṛhoddeśaṃ darśanīyamadarśayat |
iyaṃ śayyā bhagavato yathākāmamihoṣyatām || 21 ||
prāsādo’yaṃ ca bhogāśca bhujyantāṃ svīyasampadaḥ |
vrataṃ samyaganutiṣṭha sarvaṃ gṛhāṇa pūrtaye ||22||
kimannaṃ kiṃ jalaṃ cānyat kiṃ kiṃ bhavato’pekṣitam |
yatiṣye prītimāhartuṃ kimupasthāpayāmi ca ||23||
śrutvā munirbhojanaṃ ca yathopapannamuttamam |
pāyasādyaṃ prayacchasvetyāha rājā samānayat ||24||
bubhuje ca jalaṃ pītvā prāha śrīcihnayogirāṭ |
svaptumicchāmi śayyāyāṃ na prabodhyo’smi sarvathā ||25||
saṃvāhitavyau me pādau jāgṛtavyaṃ ca te niśi |
ityuktvā sa prasuṣvāpa divasānekasaptatim ||26||
śuśrūṣāparamau rājñīnṛpau cāhāravarjitau |
babhūvatustataḥ sādhuruttasthau vratamāsthitaḥ ||27||
provāca sa tadā tailābhyaṃgo me rocate’dhunā |
rājñīnṛpau sugandhāḍhyatailābhyaṃgaṃ pracakratuḥ ||28||
kārayāmāsatuḥ snānaṃ bhūṣayāmāsatustathā |
bhojayāmāsatuścāpi sādhuṃ miṣṭānnakāni ca ||29||
miṣṭapākān samagrām̐śca laḍḍukān sarvajātikān |
veśavāraviśeṣām̐śca polikāḥ pūrikādikāḥ ||3.107.30||
rasānnānāprakārām̐śca śākāni vividhāni ca |
dravāṇi sarvarūpāṇi bharjitām̐ca kaṇām̐stathā ||3 1||
kṣārāmlamiṣṭacūrṇāni phalāni vividhāni ca |
āranālāni ramyāṇi rājabhojyāni sarvaśaḥ ||32||
bhojayāmāsatustatra maharṣirbubhuje sukhaḥ |
āha kalyāṇanṛpatiṃ rājñīṃ vahata māṃ vanam ||33 ||
skandhe kṛtvā śibikāyāṃ rājā rājñī mudaṃ gatau |
svarṇarūpyādisaṃśobhamārohayitvā taṃ munim ||34||
ūhaturnagare cāpi nagarānte tathā vane |
dṛṣṭvā prasannamanasau nirvikārau hi sevakau ||35||
prasannaḥ śrīcihnayogī śibikāto hyavātarat |
vimuktvā tau varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brūtāṃ dadānyuvāca tau ||36||
sukumārau ca tau viddhau pādayoḥ skandhayostathā |
paspārśāmṛtakalpābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ cihna yogirāṭ ||37||
susampannau śramahīnau divyadevāviva hyubhau |
sañjātau navarūpau ca tathā ca navayauvanau ||38||
tau muniścāha gamyetāṃ kīśādanaṃ nijaṃ puram |
ahamatra nivatsyāmi vane vrataṃ carāmyapi ||39||
yatkāṃkṣitaṃ yuvayostu sarvaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati |
ityukte nṛparājñyau cāhatustaṃ vai munīśvaram ||3.107.40 ||
aparādhāśca sevāyāṃ jātāścette munīśvara |
kṣantavyāḥ sarva evaite dayāvārdhimahātmanā ||41 ||
tava prītiṃ prasādaṃ cābhikāṃkṣāvaḥ sadā mune |
prāha śrīcihnayogī tu paśyatāṃ rūpamaiśvaram||
prasanno’smi hariścāsmi śrīcihnahṛdayo’smyaham |
śrīvatsavakṣā me nāma lakṣmīpatirbhavāmyaham ||43 ||
sādhurūpo gṛhe te’tra cāgato’smi kṛpāvaśaḥ |
mamāvatāro bhaktānāṃ sadā kalyāṇahetave ||44||
ataścarāmi sādhurvai divyadeho janārdanaḥ |
devānīka prasanno’smi sahajāśri rato’smi ca ||45||
vṛṇutaṃ sadvarān sveṣṭān sevāphalaṃ dadāmi ca |
śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā lakṣmi devānīkaḥ praṇamya tam ||46 ||
prapūjya paramātmānaṃ matvā sukṛtamātmanaḥ |
provāca snehamadvākyairbhagavantaṃ hi māṃ tadā ||47||
prāptaṃ sarvaṃ mayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tavāgamāt |
sevayā pūrṇayā tīrṇaḥ sapatnīkaśca tadbahu ||48 ||
yatprīto’si harekṛṣṇa kulaṃ trātaṃ ca tāritam |
eṣa me’nugrahastatra sevā phalaṃ ca jīvataḥ ||49 ||
etadrājyaphalaṃ caiva bhakteścāpi phalaṃ mama |
kiṃ ca tvaṃ prītimānāsse saṃśayaṃ me nivāraya || 3.107.50 ||
kiṃvrataṃ kīdṛśaṃ kasmādetatsarvamanuṣṭhitam |
śrutvā śrīcihnayogī ca devānīkamuvāca ha ||5 1 ||
śṛṇu bhakta samagraṃ tanmayā yanniścitaṃ svataḥ |
tava vaṃśe bhaviṣyāmi bhagavān bhaktavallabhaḥ ||52||
tvāṃ tathā tava rājñīṃ ca pāvanārthamupāgataḥ |
pāvane bhaktavaṃśe’haṃ tataścāvatarāmi hi ||5 3 ||
sādhurūpaṃ mama rūpaṃ pāvayatyeva mānavān |
sādhurūpeṇa bījaṃ tvāṃ pūtaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ||54 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva vai |
śrīmadgopālabālo’haṃ kaṃbharāśrīsuto hariḥ ||55 ||
bhaviṣyāmīti sevāyāḥ phaladānārthameva ha |
sevāṃ kārayituṃ cātra samāyāto’smi sarvathā ||56 ||
yathoktā mama sevā vai kṛtā tvayā ca yoṣitā |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ snānaṃ bhojanaṃ śibikādhṛtiḥ ||57 ||
sarvaṃ sampāditaṃ me vai tena te vaṃśajāstviha |
paratrāpi tathā sarve bhaviṣyanti sukhānvitāḥ ||58 ||
bhavānapi ca golokaṃ kālāntare gamiṣyati |
sabhāryastvaṃ mahānandaṃ dhāmno me’pi labhiṣyasi ||59 ||
patnīvratasya viprasya brāhmaṇyaṃ vartate tava |
tvadvaśe rājalakṣmyāśca rājatā brahmatā punaḥ ||3.107.6 0 ||
brāhmaṇyaṃ mama vāsena dhruvaṃ sadā bhaviṣyati |
brahmiṣṭhatve maharṣitvaṃ tapasvitā ca sādhutā || 61 ||
muktatā divyatā cāpi kṛṣṇatā mokṣadātṛtā |
sarvapūjyatvamevāpi sarvaratnasamudratā ||62||
sarvasaubhāgyakhanitā sarvaiśvaryāḍhyatā tathā |
śrīlakṣmīśāradābhūtisampadāśrayatā sadā ||63||
etatsarvaṃ mama vāsād bhaviṣyati purā kule |
ityuktvā bhagavān so’haṃ datvā hāraṃ tu kānakam ||64||
maṇimālāṃ tathā datvā datvā mantraṃ paraṃ manum |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||65||
pātraṃ tathākṣayaṃ datvā datvā cakraṃ sudarśanam |
adṛśyatāṃ gataścāhaṃ devānīko yayau gṛham ||66||
svarṇavarṇān suprāsādān prākāraṃ kānakaṃ tathā |
kalpodyānāvṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīkṣyāpsaroyutaṃ nijam ||67||
mandiraṃ ca tathā divyavimānena suśobhitam |
dāsadāsīgaṇān divyān śaṃkhacakrādicihnitān ||68||
kāmadhenūśca parito gaurīrlakṣmīśca kanyakāḥ |
prajā vaikuṇṭhatulyāśca hastinaścāṣṭadantinaḥ ||69||
aśvān śvetān śyāmakarṇān haṃsān śvetān vihaṃgamān |
rathān sūryaśaśivrātasaṃśobhān vyomagāminaḥ ||3.107.70||
pārṣadān viṣṇurūpām̐śca devānīko mumoda ha |
yajñakuṇḍān maṇḍapām̐śca maharṣīn sādhumaṇḍalam ||71||
sādhujanān lakṣaśaśca devān sarvān dadarśa ha |
svarṇanadī pārśvataśca yāntīṃ dadarśa bhaktarāṭ ||72||
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā lakṣmi devānīko’bhavattathā |
mahendra iva nṛpatiḥ svarāḍ rājñī ramā yathā ||73||
kṛpayā mama yogena dhāmākṣaraṃ vyajāyata |
kīśādanaṃ nagaraṃ tacchrīśāyanaṃ vyajāyata ||74||
devānīko mahāścaryaṃ jagāma taṃ ca māṃ prabhum |
abhajat parayā prītyā saṃsmaran sādhurūpiṇam ||75||
athāhaṃ gatakālena jāto’smi bhaktavatsalaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ nāthaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||76||
evaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena prasaṃgena harestathā |
sevakasya kulaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva hareḥ kulam ||77||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kānto’si sarvanātho’si parameśaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ |
akulasya kulaṃ nāsti śrīharestava śārṅgiṇaḥ ||78||
tathāpi mānave loke vaṃśamūlā paramparā |
pravartate’taste kṛṣṇa tāmicchāmi praveditum ||79||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā sṛṣṭerahaṃ nārāyaṇo’bhavam |
mamāṃgebhyo’bhavan brahmaviṣṇurudrasurādayaḥ ||3.107.80||
sṛṣṭyādau ca tadā nārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ |
mukhapiṇḍād brāhmaṇaḥ śrīpatnīvrato babhūva ha ||81 ||
pativratākhyā bhāryāsya yugalaṃ tadbabhūva ha |
parameṣṭhisamāyuṣyaṃ vṛṣamūrtyātmakaṃ hi tat ||82||
pūrvapitāmahākhyaṃ me lakṣmi nibodha cādimam |
patnīvratasya vai putro brahmavratastu mānasaḥ ||83||
śīlavratāsya bhāryā ca babhūva mānasī ca sā |
parameṣṭhisamāyuṣyau tāvubhau vyūhakoṭijau ||84||
vāsudevo vāsudevī yau tāvubhau babhūvatuḥ |
tayoḥ śiṣyā lakṣaśo’pi svataḥprakāśayoginā ||85||
nibhālitā abhavam̐śca saurāṣṭre sarvatodiśi |
brahmavratasya vai putro brāhmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||86||
nāmnā kalyāṇadevānīkastu kīśādaneśvaraḥ |
sahajāśrīsaṃjñayā ca bhāryayā yug babhūva ha ||87||
vedhaḥpūrvārdhasamayāyuṣyau tau ca babhūvatuḥ |
bhūmānārāyaṇo yo’sau bhaumānikīśriyā yutaḥ ||88||
brahmāṇḍe’trājñayā me vai prādurbhūto hi tāvimau |
tābhyāṃ śrīcihnayogītisvarūpeṇa satā mayā ||89||
āśīrvādaḥ pradatto vai prākaṭyārthaṃ kule mama |
atha kalyāṇadevānīkasya putro’pi mānasaḥ ||3.107.90||
kṛṣṇamukuṭamaṇyātmā cānartanṛpapūjitaḥ |
picudevānīkanāmā nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ||91||
vabhūva mukuṭakalgyā miṣṭādevyā putro’tra ha |
vedhaḥpūrvārdhasamayāyuṣyau tvetau babhūvatuḥ ||92||
picudevānīkaputro mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
śrīmān gopālakṛṣṇākhyo daśakalpāyureva ha ||93||
mahālakṣmyā kaṃbharāśrīdevyā yuto babhūva ha |
khaṭvāṃgadanṛpasyārthe varadānāya cāgatau ||94||
etau tu pitarau matvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
mānaso’hamabhavaṃ suputraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||95||
koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca patiḥ prabhuḥ |
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīśaścāvatārī parātparaḥ ||96||
bhavāmi śivarājñīśri kāntaste kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ |
ahaṃ, mama pitā, tasya pitā, tasya pitā tathā ||97||
tatpitā, tatpitā, tasya pitā caite tu pūrvajāḥ |
sarve nārāyaṇā nārāyaṇāṃśā matsvarūpiṇaḥ ||98||
nārāyaṇyo mātaraśca sarvā madātmikāḥ khalu |
kimu tadbahunoktena lakṣmi jānāsi sarvathā ||99||
ahaṃ sarvātmako bhūtvā līlāṃ vistārayāmi tām |
vaṃśasya śravaṇātpāṭhād bhuktirmuktirdhruvā bhavet || 3.107.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kalyāṇadevānīkabhaktasya sevāparīkṣā, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparamparānirdeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||

<3.108>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan lokatattveṣu magnānāṃ dehināṃ kvacit |
bādhāyāmupapannāyāṃ kiṃ japyaṃ vada me’tra tat || 1 ||
anāthānāṃ śaraṇyaṃ kiṃ daivataṃ rakṣakaṃ ca kim |
balāśrayaṃ ca śubhadaṃ paramaṃ kiṃ vṛṣātmakam || 2 ||
āpadvināśakaṃ cāghakṣālakaṃ muktidaṃ param |
vāsanādhvaṃsakaṃ māyāgranthipāśavikartanam || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmasahasrakam |
puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ japannaman hariṃ ca mām || 4 ||
pūjayan sarvadā bhaktyā paṭhan sañcintayam̐śca mām |
sarvātmasusthitaṃ dhyāyan sarvabādhāḥ samuttaret || 5 ||
śaraṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ nidhiṃ dharmāśrayaṃ prabhum |
sūṣṭitrayodbhāvakaṃ ca trikālāvādhyamacyutam || 6 ||
divyasampatkalpamūrtiṃ camatkārādisaṃbhṛtam |
sarvaiśvaryabhagavantaṃ bhaktyā saṃkīrtayeddhi mām || 7 ||
divyākṣarādisaṃsevyatejovārdhipradaṃ prabhum |
śāśvatānandapūrāṇāṃ gamakaṃ parameśvaram || 8 ||
pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ ca parabrahma parātparam |
muktānāṃ bhāgyarūpaṃ ceśvarāṇāmīśitātmakam || 9 ||
surāṇāṃ suratādhānamṛṣīṇāmārṣatājuṣam |
satīsādhvīsatyabhāvasnehasevāvratātmakam || 3.108.1 0||
kāmapūraṃ divyaśaktisāmarthyabaladāyinam |
antakāle sakhāyaṃ cotkramaṇe sahayāyinam || 11 ||
sarvādhāraṃ suhṛdaṃ taṃ śrīhariṃ māṃ japet sadā |
kāntaṃ śāntaṃ hṛtsu bhāntaṃ puraḥsthitaṃ ca māṃ namet || 12||
yogakṣemakuśalādipradāturme hareḥ rame |
divyanāmasahasraṃ yat sarvāghabhayanāśanam || 13 ||
līlaiśvaryaguṇakarmanisargarūparūpitam |
mukteśvararṣidevādyairgītaṃ vadāmi siddhidam || 14 ||
asya śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmastavasya tu |
ṛṣiḥ sarveśvaro lakṣmi tvahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 15 ||
chando’nuṣṭup paro devo’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
ākṣarākhyomahāmuktomuktānīśo hi bījakam | | 16 | |
śrībhūlīlāramārādhālakṣmīmāṇikya eva ca |
śaktayo hṛdayaṃ śrīmatpuruṣottamasāma ca || 17 ||
gopālakambharābālaḥ kīlakaṃ cāstramācyutam |
padmāvatīramāpadmāsvāmine ca vaṣaṭ namaḥ || 18 ||
śūlamīnadhvajadhanurbāṇadhro’strāya phaṭ svāhā |
sarvabādhānivṛttyarthaṃ jape’sya viniyojanam || 19 ||
brahmaloke virājantaṃ juṣṭaṃ brahmiṣṭhamaṇḍalaiḥ |
brahmapriyāsvāminaṃ taṃ dhyāye sarvāntarasthitam || 3.108.20 ||
divye lomaśakṣetre vai viharantaṃ manoharam |
mandahāsaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vicintaye || 21 ||
puṣṭaṃ priyaṃ kāmadaṃ ca duḥkhahaṃ sukhadaṃ prabhum |
catvāriṃśadūrdhvaśatakāntaṃ smarāmi mokṣadam | | 22 ||
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ ceṣṭapradaṃ sarvapradaṃ harim |

api ślokaikapāṭhena pāṭho’syāpi kṛto bhavet |
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāramayaṃ ślokaṃ vadāmi te ||149||
namāmi sṛṣṭitrayasaṃvidhāyine
bhajāmi koṭyarbudaśaktiśāline |
dhyāyāmi cātmāntarasanniyāmine’
rpayāmisarvatvamathātmavedine || 3.108.150||
namo’nantasvarūpāya namo’saṃkhyapramūrtaye |
namo yugalarūpāya namaḥ śrīparamātmane || 151 ||
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālajanuṣe namaḥ || 152||
namo’nāthādhināthāya namaḥ kāntākṛpālave |
namo dharmādhigoptre te bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 153||
śivarājñīsvāmine te nārāyaṇīśvarāya ca |
ramāpadmāvatīśāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ || 154||
namo brahmapriyeśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya ca te namaḥ |
sarvajñadeśikeśāyācāryeśvarāya te namaḥ || 155||
stavaścāyaṃ paṭhitaścārpitastvayi phalāptaye |
sarvadastvaṃ pāhi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo namaḥ || 156||
sahasrapāṭhataścāsya puraścaraṇamācaret |
mahāpado vinaśyanti mahāsaukhyaṃ bhaveddhruvam || 157||
vijñānaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ vardhate’sya prapāṭhanāt |
sārvajñyakalpatā syācca kṛṣṇasya karuṇākaṇāt || 158||
rājā pradhānaḥ pṛthivīpradhānaḥ
svargapradhāno dhanadapradhānaḥ |
vidyāpradhāno’rhaṇatāpradhāno
bhavet stavasyāsya supāṭhakṛjjanaḥ ||159||
nityamekaprapāṭhena sarvakāmasamṛddhimān |
jāyate me kṛpāleśāllakṣmi tadgṛhamāvasa ||3.108.160||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvabādhānāśakaṃ sarveṣṭadaṃ śrīpuruṣottamasāmākhyamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmasahasrastotrakathananāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||

<3.109>
śrīnārayiṇīśrīruvoca
bhagavan prāptamutkṛṣṭaṃ stotraṃ te bhavapāradam |
bādhānāśakaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param || 1 ||
karmaṭhāḥ stotrapāṭhena kṛtakarmaphalaṃ prabho |
bhuktvā yāntyathavā cāpyabhuktvā mokṣaṃ prayānti te || 2 ||
yadi bhuktvā prayāntyeva kva kīdṛg bhuñjate phalam |
kasya vā karmaṇaḥ kīdṛg bhuktvā phalaṃ prayānti te || 3 ||
satkarmiṇāṃ tu ye lokāstām̐śced bhuktvā prayanti vai |
brūhi te kīdṛśā yatra mohaḥ punarna jāyate || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vakṣyāmi satphalānyapi |
jñātāni ca punarmohaṃ ganturnādadhate param || 5 ||
tapaḥ karma hi mūrdhanyaṃ karmaṇāṃ bhavate sadā |
svargaḥ śreṣṭho hi tapasā labhyate kīrtisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 6 ||
dīrghāyuṣyaṃ śreṣṭhabhogā labhyante ca tapobalāt |
sampado rūpamārogyaṃ vidyā vijñānamuttamam || 7 ||
ādhipatyaṃ paraṃ dravyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vaṃśavistaraḥ |
labhyante tapasā śreṣṭhadevatvaṃ tapasāpyate || 8 ||
tāpasaḥ sarvametadvai bhuktvā ciraṃ tapaḥphalam |
paścāt stotraphalaṃ bhuṃkte brahmaloke hi śāśvate || 9 ||
maunavrataṃ tapaḥ proktaṃ pālitaṃ yena tasya tu |
vāksiddhirjāyate cājñāpradatvaṃ jāyate tathā || 3.109.1 0||
bahūnāmupadeṣṭā syād gururācārya ityapi |
rājagururbhaveccāpi senāpatistathā bhavet || 11 ||
dharmaśāstā bhaveccāpi niyāmakastathā bhavet |
atra loke svargaloke phalaṃ bhuktvā stavasya ca || 12||
phalaṃ bhoktuṃ prayātyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ |
dānakartā bhavet svarge deveśo bhūtale dhanī || 13||
rājā bhavedupabhogān bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ labhet |
parame’kṣarasaṃjñe vai rājate sarvasaukhyabhāg || 14||
brahmacaryavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapa ānandavarjanam |
cirāyuḥ sa bhavelloke balī puṣṭo dṛḍho yuvā || 15||
apradhṛṣyo’parābhāvyo bhaved brahmasameśvaraḥ |
phalaṃ bahusamā bhuktvā tataḥ stotraphalaṃ labhet || 16||
brahmalokaṃ prayātyeva modate brahmavedibhiḥ |
ahiṃsāpi tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ niyamākhyaṃ nigadyate || 17||
aduḥkhaṃ sukhamātraṃ ca labhate svarahiṃsakaḥ |
sukhaṃ tatra paraṃ bhuktvā tataḥ stotraphalaṃ labhet || 18||
yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ modate brahmavādibhiḥ |
dīkṣā dharmayutā tapoyuktā tapaḥ paraṃ matam || 19||
dīkṣito bhaktiyuktaśca pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ labhet |
bārhaspatyapadaṃ cāpi mahācāryapadaṃ labhet ||3.109.20||
pūjanīyakule janma satāṃ kule’cyutagṛhe |
labhate dīkṣitastatra bhuktvā bhogān tataḥ param ||21||
stotraphalaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṃkte’kṣare me dhāmasattame |
phalamūlāśanaṃ cāpi tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nigadyate ||22||
tatphalaṃ rājyamāsādya svargaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravindati |
parṇāśanaḥ payobhakṣā yānti svargaṃ samṛddhidam ||23||
phalaṃ bhuktvā tato yānti stotraphalaṃ madakṣaram |
svarṇadānena sāmrājyaṃ cakravartitvamityapi || 14||
yatra kvāpi labhelloke tato’kṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ |
stotraphalaṃ tatra bhuṃkte śāśvatānandaśevadhim ||25||
guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sevā tapaḥ paraṃ nigadyate |
sevayā labhyate vidyā prasannatāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ ||26||
puṇyaṃ sarvottamaṃ svargaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ taddhi labhyate |
mātāpitrośca vṛddhānāṃ patyuḥ patnyāḥ kuṭumbinām ||27||
gavāṃ satāṃ surāṇāṃ cātithīnāṃ paravāsinām |
rugṇānāṃ cāpyanāthānāṃ dīnānāṃ sevanaṃ śubham || 28||
tapo vai paramaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ sarvottamaṃ sukham |
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke sarvaṃ vindati sevayā || 29||
sārvajñyaṃ sevayā prāpya svargaloke mahīyate |
svarge satye phalaṃ bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ pravidanti ||3.109.3 0||
śāśvatānandasampūrṇasukhānāṃ sevitā bhavet |
akṣare parame dhāmni mahāmukto bhavet sadā ||3 1 ||
śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu yaścātra dadyāt pitṛbhya uttamam |
kavyaṃ havyaṃ dvijātibhyo bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇādikam ||32||
phalaṃ svargaṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā pitṛlokaṃ pragacchati |
tatra ciraṃ phalaṃ bhuktvā stotraphalaṃ tato labhet ||33||
satyalokaṃ vihāyaivākṣaraṃ lokaṃ prayāti saḥ |
atra santatibāhulyaṃ śrāddhakarturbhavatyapi ||34||
vaiṣṇavaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ syād bhajitvā parameśvaram |
naivedyaṃ ye samarpyāpi nityaṃ prapūjya bhāvataḥ ||35||
stotrasyāsya pratāpenākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāti ca |
evaṃ vaṃśapravaṃśā vai śrāddhadātuḥ prajā rame ||36 ||
prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma stotravaktā pramodate |
pramodante vaṃśajāśca sahavāsāḥ sadākṣare ||37||
gavāṃ prasevayā yāti svargaṃ satyaṃ tataḥ param |
golokaṃ paramaṃ yāti stotrapuṇyena cākṣaram ||38||
striyastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā labhante cottamān varān |
viprāṇītvaṃ ca devītvaṃ yānti stotreṇa cākṣaram ||39||
vāyvāhārastapaḥkartā labhed yajñaphalaṃ divam |
stotreṇa ca tato yāti paramākṣaramuttamam ||3.109.40||
nityasnāyī buddhimān syānmedhāvī sphurtimān janaḥ |
prāṇāyāmaparo yāti svargaṃ stotreṇa cākṣaram ||41||
sthaṇḍile śayanāḍhyastu labhate mandirāṇi vai |
rājayogyāni vai svarge stotreṇa yāti cākṣaram ||42||
cīravalkalavastrāḍhyaḥ praiti bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca |
śayyāsanāni ramyāṇi labhate ca tataḥ param ||43||
stotreṇa yāti me dhāmākṣaraṃ modaṃ pravindati |
agnisnātaḥ prayātyeva sūryalokaṃ tataḥ param ||44||
vahnilokaṃ tataḥ stotrabalād yātyakṣaraṃ padam |
rasānāṃ niyame yāti saubhāgyaṃ svargamuttamam ||45||
anāmiṣādaḥ svaryāti cirāyurjāyate divi |
tataḥ stotreṇa vai dhāmākṣaraṃ yāti sukhāspadam ||46||
udavāsī nṛpaḥ syācca samudrādhipatirbhavet |
bhūtvā ca varuṇaḥ stotrabalād dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ ||47||
satyavratī prayātyeva svargaṃ stotreṇa cākṣaram |
pānīyadānamātreṇa svarge’mṛtādano bhavet ||48||
annado’pi prayātyeva svargaṃ bhogāḍhyamuttamam |
kāmabhogān prabhuktvā stotreṇa yātyakṣaraṃ padam ||49||
sāntvadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yāti satyaṃ padaṃ śubham |
devaśuśrūṣayā yāti siddhalokaṃ tu vaidhasam ||3.109.50||
stotreṇa ca tato yātyakṣaraṃ matparamaṃ padam |
dīpadātā divyadṛṣṭirbhavatyeva susiddhimān ||51||
satyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā stavena yāti cākṣaram |
ādarśādipradātā ca vairājyameti satpadam ||52||
gandhamālyādidānena gāndharvaṃ caiti rājasam |
pañcakeśākṣaurakarmā vaṃśavistāravān bhavet ||53||
kanyādānavidhātā tu svargaṃ vairājasatpadam |
labhate caiśvaraṃ bhāvaṃ dāsīdāsasahasrakam ||54||
alaṃkārān mahābhogān divyān prāsādasattamān |
yajñaiścānaśanādyaiśca svargaṃ pitṛpadaṃ tathā ||55||
phalapuṣpādidānena tūdyānādipatirbhavet |
tiladhenupradātā tu vasulokaṃ prayāti vai ||56||
bhūmidātāvyākṛtaṃ ca dhāma yāti sukhāspadam |
dhuryadānena ca vasulokaṃ yāti sukhāśrayam ||57||
chatradānena caiśatvaṃ kailāse labhate janaḥ |
upānaho pradānena yānavimānavān bhavet ||58||
gandhadānena surabhirbhavedīśvarakoṭikaḥ |
sapuṣpaphalavṛkṣasya dātāmṛtapadaṃ vrajet ||59||
rasadātāmṛtaṃ dhāma gacchedīśvarakoṭikaḥ |
sragdhūpalepadānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate param ||3.109.60 ||
śayyādānavidhātā vai golokaṃ yāti bhaktarāṭ |
tatra tatra mahānandān bhuktvā stotreṇa cākṣaram ||6 1 ||
prayātyeva pratāpānme lakṣmi dhāmottamottamam |
taḍāgasya pradātā vai prayātyamṛtadhāma saḥ ||62||
tatra bhogānparān bhuktvā stotreṇa yāti cākṣaram |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dātṛ sarovarārpaṇam ||63||
taḍāgena pradeśasya śriyo yānti vikāsatām |
caturdaśastaravāsāḥ saṃśrayanti jalāśayam ||64||
agnihotraphalaṃ svargagodānasya phalaṃ tathā |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ cātirātrayajñaphalaṃ tathā ||65||
vājimedhaphalaṃ cāpi labhate sarasaḥ pradaḥ |
gāvaḥ santo janāḥ pakṣivarāḥ prāṇapradhāriṇaḥ ||66||
paśavaḥ pādapā vāri pibanti jantavo’pi ca |
vibhramanti taṭe tatra snānti ca kṣālayanti ca ||67||
evaṃ taḍāgadāturvai phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet |
sarvadāneṣu vai jyeṣṭhaṃ pānīyaṃ śāntidaṃ param ||68||
jaladātāmṛtabhoktā jāyate caiśvare pade |
virajāyāstaṭe sthitvā ciraṃ golokameti ca ||69||
bhuktvā bhogān subahudhā tataḥ stotreṇa cākṣaram |
prayātyeva prabhakto me stotraphalaṃ parākṣaram ||3.109.70||
atha vṛkṣapradātā ca divyavṛndāvanaṃ śubham |
golokasthaṃ sametyeva gulmadātā latārpakaḥ ||71 ||
vallīprado vaṃśadātā tṛṇado yāti tatpadam |
devalokaṃ śubhaṃ bhuktvā pitṛlokaṃ prayāti ca ||72||
vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaiḥ suragaṇān pitṝn phalaiḥ rasādibhiḥ |
atithīn chāyayā patraiḥ prāṇinaḥ pūjayanti vai ||73||
dadatyāśrayamutkṛṣṭaṃ dehibhyo vṛkṣajātayaḥ |
bṛkṣadaṃ putravad vṛkṣāstārayanti paratra tu ||74||
vṛkṣaropī ceṣṭayajñaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
svarge satye ca vairāje’mṛte’vyākṛtadhāmani ||75||
vaikuṇṭhe cāpi goloke mahīyante’timodinaḥ |
te’pi lakṣmi stavenaiva prayāntyakṣaramuttamam ||76||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo datvābhayaṃ pare’kṣare |
prāpnotyeva stavenāpi śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet ||77||
vyasaneṣvapi lokānāmanugrahaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ |
duḥkhahā vyasanakṣeptā svargaṃ yāti sukhāspadam ||78||
yaccābhilaṣitaṃ dadyāt tṛṣitāyābhiyācate |
dattaṃ tūrṇamupayuktaṃ grahītā toṣaṇaṃ vrajet ||79||
śreṣṭhaṃ taddānamevātra dātāramupagacchati |
svarṇadānaṃ dhenudānaṃ pṛthivīdānamuttamam ||3.109.80||
prāsādadānaṃ kanyāyā dānaṃ vidyāpradānakam |
annavāripradānaṃ ca bhūṣāmbarapradānakam ||81||
gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ śṛṃgāradānakam |
yānavāhanadānaṃ cābhayadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||82||
viśvāsadānaṃ dravyāṇāṃ dānaṃ kumāradānakam |
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ gajānāṃ ca vājināṃ dānamuttamam ||83||
chatrāsanādidānaṃ ca vetradānaṃ paraṃ matam |
siṃhāsanapradānaṃ ca gajāsanapradānakam ||84||
jñānadānaṃ bhaktidānaṃ puruṣārthapradānakam |
kāmadānāni caitāni pavitrāṇyuttamāni ca ||85||
sādhubhyo daivatavadbhyo dattānyetāni padmaje |
nityadā khalu dātāraṃ pāpāt pramokṣayanti hi ||86||
puṇyapuñjairyojayanti nayanti divamuttamam |
satyalokaṃ ca vairājān lokān nayanti tāni ha ||87||
viṣṇulokān sadāśivalokān nayanti tāni ha |
māyālokānīśalokān golokān prāpayanti ca ||88||
lakṣmīlokān muktalokān śrīlokān prāpayanti ca |
avyākṛtāmṛtadhāmaviśeṣān prāpayanti ca ||89||
pārṣadānāṃ mahālokānnārīlokānnayanti ca |
sādhvīlokān satīlokān dātāraṃ prāpayanti ca ||3.109.90||
vahnilokān dharmalokān candralokānnayanti ca |
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yacca syād dayitaṃ priyam ||91 ||
tattad deyaṃ supātrāya phalamakṣayadaṃ hi tat |
priyakṛllabhate nityaṃ priyaṃ priyaprado bhavet ||92||
priyo bhavati bhūtānāmiha cāpi paratra ca |
amitramapi dīnaṃ ceccharaṇaiṣiṇamāgatam ||93||
vyasane yo’nugṛhṇāti sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ |
kṛśāyādhītavidyāya vṛttikṣīṇāya sīdate ||94||
dadyāt kaṣṭaṃ nāśayecca sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ |
satkarmaparamān sādhūn putradārakuṭumbinaḥ ||95||
ayācamānān dadyācca sarvopāyaiḥ pratuṣṭaye |
lālasā naiva bhogeṣu svargeṣvapi prakurvate ||96||
nityatuṣṭā nirāśāśca kṛtāvasathavāsinaḥ |
brahmaparā pradātavyāḥ sarvasmṛddhibhirādarāt ||97||
yadi te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ pradāpitam |
dattaṃ tat koṭipuṇyānāṃ pradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ||98||
dhārmikā bhaktimanto vai vidvāṃso vratino janāḥ |
tāpasāḥ śīlayogāśca dāntāḥ pātrāṇi sādhavaḥ ||99||
teṣu dattaṃ mahāyajño nityaṃ brahmamakho bhavet |
viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyaścānṛṇyasampradaḥ sadā || 3.109.10 0||
kupyanti naiva cālābhe lubhyanti na tṛṇeṣvapi |
tuṣyanti sukhino dṛṣṭvā modante varddhayanti ca || 10 1||
nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ smaranti kīrtanaiḥ sadā |
sādhavo brāhmaṇā brahmadharāśca ṛtvijo’malāḥ || 102||
purohitāstathācāryāstādṛśyaḥ sādhvikāḥ striyaḥ |
mātaraḥ putrakalyāṇakartryaḥ pūjyatamāśca yāḥ || 1 03||
vittādinā sadā pūjyā namaskāryā yathāyatham |
dātavyāścarddhibhirnityaṃ devā devyo hi tā matāḥ ||1 04||
yathā svāmyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke sanātanaḥ |
tathā svāmyāśrayo dharmo dānātmā devatāśrayaḥ || 1 05||
sādhubhyaḥ prathamaṃ dadyād brahmavidbhyaḥ śubhaṃ muhuḥ |
anāthebhyastato dadyād bhikṣukebhyastataḥ param || 1 06||
viprebhyaśca tato dadyānnārībhyaśca tataḥ param |
brāhmaṇebhyastato dadyādanyebhyaśca tataḥ param || 1 07||
dāsādibhyastato dadyādevaṃ dātā pramodate |
dānaphalaṃ ca lokeṣu bhuktvā brahma prayātyanu || 1 08||
puruṣottamasāmākhyastotreṇaityakṣaraṃ padam |
sarvadānaphalaṃ saukhyaṃ modamānandamutsavam || 1 09||
labhate śāśvatamūrtirbrahmasāyujyamāsthitaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya brahmasāyujyabhāg bhavet || 3.109.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dānaphalabhogottaraṃ puruṣottamasāmajapaphalamakṣaradhāmasthaśāśvatānandātmakaṃ bhuṃkte dātetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 109 ||

<3.110>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
vidyā cācaraṇaṃ lakṣmi janma dīkṣā śubhāśrayaḥ |
ete yatra pravidyante dānapātraṃ taduttamam || 1 ||
yācate yatpradattaṃ tacchreya eva nigadyate |
ayācate pradattaṃ tu dānaṃ svasvatvavarjitam || 2 ||
brahmiṣṭho dānapātraṃ vai sādhuḥ pātraprabhūṣaṇam |
labdhvā sādhuḥ suvidvān yat prīṇāti devatā gurūn || 3 ||
yācanā sarvathā lakṣmi nikṛṣṭodvegakāriṇī |
prakāśadasyuryācamāno bhavatyevāghakṛddhi saḥ || 4 ||
yācanā tu bhavenmṛtyurmṛtyureva tu yācanā |
sā tu duḥkhapradā tasmād yācato dānameva na || 5 ||
dātṛtvaṃ jīvanaṃ proktaṃ yācate dīyate yadi |
jīvanaṃ śreya evāsti dātā śreyaśca vindati || 6 ||
grahītā śreyasā yukto bhavatyeva tathādharmaḥ |
uttamo vai pradātā syāttasmāddānaṃ praśasyate || 7 ||
yācate dīyamānenānṛśaṃsatvaṃ vibhāvyate |
ayācate tu dānena svargaphalaṃ vibhāvyate || 8 ||
pūjyā hi jñānavijñānatapobhaktiyutā janāḥ |
yoginaḥ sādhavaḥ pūjyāstebhyo deyaṃ samastakam || 9 ||
dattamatithaye vidyāvate śīlavate’rthine |
akṣayaṃ vai phalaṃ tasya jāyate śāśvataṃ divam || 3.110.10||
yeṣāṃ śiṣyāḥ sutā dārāḥ pratīkṣante’nnavāriṇī |
tebhyo dattaṃ prabhuñjānāstretāgniṃ prīṇayanti te ||1 1 ||
sādhubhyo brahmacāribhyo dattaṃ prabhuñjate tu te |
brahmāgniṃ te prīṇayanti savanaṃ paramaṃ hi tat || 12||
madhyandinaṃ tu savanaṃ bhikṣukebhyo’rpaṇaṃ sadā |
devebhyaścāpi pitṛbhyo’rpaṇaṃ tadvaiśvadaivikam || 1 3||
savanaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ tad yajñāstrayo divaṃpradāḥ |
nārāyaṇāya mahyaṃ yad dattaṃ divyamakho hi saḥ || 14||
ātmārpaṇātmako lakṣmi kartavyo’yaṃ vijānatā |
adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃvibhāgo’nuyāyinām || 15||
sevā tuṣṭirdamastyāgo yajñā bhavanti sāttvikāḥ |
ta ete’vabhṛthāyante śraddhāpūtāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ || 16||
pāpakṛtāṃ janānāṃ na pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ |
tasmād dravyamaye yajñe dātavyaṃ pāpanāśanam || 17||
yadi gṛhṇanti santo’sya pāpinaḥ pāvanaṃ hi tat |
pāpaprakṣālanaśaktaṃ pātrabalāt prajāyate || 18||
brāhmaṇām̐starpayed dravyaistattadiṣṭatamārparṇaiḥ |
maitrān sādhūn vedavidaḥ śīlavratatapojuṣaḥ || 1 9||
tarpayed bahudhā dānaiḥ svādvannairdakṣiṇādibhiḥ |
prajāvato bhaktajanān prajāvān jāyate hi ke ||3.110.20||
yāvataḥ sādhudharmān vai santaḥ saṃvardhayanti hi |
te bhartavyā bahudānairjīvakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||21 ||
dhenavo vṛṣabhā bhūṣā ambarāṇi dhanāni ca |
ājyānyannāni yānāni chātraṃ vāsāṃsyupānahau ||22||
aśvavanti ca yānāni veśmāni śayanāni ca |
ete deyāḥ sādhusadbhyaḥ svargadā mokṣadā hi te ||23||
dātā pāpairvinirmuktaḥ pūtaḥ svargaṃ prayāti hi |
upachannaṃ prakāśaṃ vā vṛttyā sādhūn prapālayet ||24||
rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalabhāk sa bhaved dhruvaḥ |
yogaṃ kṣemaṃ vindate’pi śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ padam ||29||
sādhavo yaṃ na śaṃsanti tanna kuryāt kadācana |
dadyādvai mahato bhogān kṣudbhayaṃ praṇudet satām ||26||
yatra deśe prapaśyanti svādubhojyāni bālakāḥ |
prapaśyantyeva nāśnanti sa deśo’ghamalātmakaḥ ||27||
yatra deśe sādhavaścānāthāḥ striyaśca bālakāḥ |
kṣudhā sīdanti deśaḥ sa nāśamāyāti sarvathā ||28||
krośantyo yatra vai deśe dhriyante tarasā striyaḥ |
gāvaścāpi prajāścāpi sa deśo maraṇonmukhaḥ ||29||
tasmādabhayadānākhyaṃ dānaṃ paramakaṃ matam |
abhayasya pradātā vai yāti cābhayamakṣaram ||3.110.30||
puruṣottamasāmnaścodgātā yātyabhayākṣaram |
pṛthivīdānakṛllakṣmi yāti kṣmāmakṣarātmikām ||3 1||
dattātra kṣmā divyarūpaṃ dhṛtvottiṣṭhati cākṣare |
acalā cākṣayā dogdhrī divyakāmādipūraṇī ||32||
ratnavāsāṃsi ramyāṇi sudhāvrīhiyavāmṛtān |
sarvavidhānyamṛtāni labhate bhūmido’kṣare ||33||
bhūmidaḥ sarvalokeṣu śāśvatīredhate samāḥ |
yāvadbhūmerihāyuśca tāvadbhūmida edhate ||34||
bhūmiṃ daduśca ye dāne bhūmiṃ te bhuñjate parām |
bhūmirbhūtirmahālakṣmīrdātāraṃ kurute priyam ||35||
yathādānaṃ tathā bhogo dānaṃ śrīḥ paramā matā |
api pāpasamācāre brahmaghne bhaktivarjite ||36||
kṣitiḥ kṣiptā punātyeva grahītā sādhubhistu cet |
sā manyate dhanyabhāgyaṃ sādhuhastagatā satī ||37||
dātāraṃ kurute śuddhaṃ svāpatyaṃ jananī yathā |
pṛthvyā nāmāsti dharmākhyaṃ priyadatteti sārthakam ||38||
bhūmiṃ tu sādhave datvā bhūmiṃ divyāṃ pravindate |
yaḥ sādhorbhūmimādatte na bhūmiṃ vindate hi saḥ ||39||
sādhorbhūmiḥ śasyate’tra sā tu nārāyaṇī matā |
pāpī gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate ||3.110.40 ||
yo yajetāśvamedhena dadyādvā sādhave mahīm |
mahīdānaṃ praśastaṃ śāśvatānandaphalapradam ||41 ||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca |
sarvametad dattavān syād yo dadāti vasundharām ||42||

sādhudaivatapūjā ca etā bhavanti bhūmide ||43 ||
dātṛniḥśreyase yuktā śreyaḥ paraṃ dadāti sā |
yathā jananī putraṃ svaṃ kṣīreṇa bharate’nvaham ||44||
tathā puṣṇāti dātāraṃ sarvagandharasairmahī |
mṛtyuḥ kālo yamadaṇḍo māyā vahnirjvaro hyariḥ ||45||
pāśo bādhāśca vighnāśca bhayaṃ durītamityapi |
akasmātā ītayaśca nopasarpanti bhūmidam ||46||
pitṝn devān maharṣīṃśca siddhān yogijanān satīḥ |
sādhvīryuktān brahmakāntāḥ santarpayati bhūmidaḥ ||47||
kṛśāya vṛttihīnāyānāthāya sīdate kṣitim |
jīvikājananīṃ datvā sarvasatrī bhavejjanaḥ ||48||
yathā dhenuḥ svavatsaṃ vai yacchati vatsalā payaḥ |
poṣayatyeva tadvat kṣmā dātāraṃ poṣayatyati ||49||
sasasyāṃ vā sabījāṃ vā sakaṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ cārpayati bhaved brahmā sa dānakṛt ||3.110.50||
yathā candramaso vṛddhiḥ śukle pratyahameva ha |
tathā bhūdaḥ parāṃ vṛddhiṃ sasye sasye pravindati ||51||
pṛthvī mūrtimatī prāha pṛthvīsvāmina eva sā |
māmādāya ca māṃ datta datvā māṃ māmavāpsyatha ||52||
prāyaścittaṃ mahīdānaṃ punātyubhayato daśa |
sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa hi puṇyakṛt ||53||
sa dātā sa makhī sādhuryo dadāti vasundharām |
yathā sasyāni rohanti tathā kṣmādasya kāmanāḥ ||54||
bhūmirmātā pitā lakṣmīrannaṃ jīvanamityapi |
bhūmau bhavanti puṣṭāśca niṣṭhāṃ vrajanti vai bhuvi ||55||
ādityā varuṇā rudrā brahmāṇo viṣṇavo’nalāḥ |
vasavaḥ śaśino devā bhūmiṃ datvābhavan surāḥ ||56||
suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam |
dadannetān sādhave’tra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||57||
bharturniḥśreyase yattā pativratārdhadehinī |
bhūdānamācaret tena bhartā yātyakṣarama padam ||58||
ratnopakīrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ sarvakāmaguṇānvitām |
dadyād rājādhirājaḥ syāt puṇyaḥ svarge mahīyate ||59||
sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ mahīṃ kāmapravarṣiṇīm |
kanyāṃ vaṃśakarīṃ sādhvīṃ dadan svarge mahīyate ||3.110.60||
madhusarpiḥpravāhiṇyaḥ payodadhivahāstathā |
saritastarpayantīha pare tu vasudhāpradam ||61||
mahīṃ śastrajitāṃ datvā yuddhapāpaṃ vyapohati |
na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante svarge modanta eva te ||62||
bhūtiṃ cecchan pradadyād kṣmāṃ puṇyāmṛddhirasānvitām |
sāgarān saritaḥ śailān kānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ||63||
taḍāgānyudapānāni srotāṃsi ca sarāṃsi ca |
snehān sarvarasāṃścaiva dadāti vasudhāṃ dadan ||64||
oṣadhīrvīryasampannā nagān puṣpaphalānvitān |
kānanopalaśailām̐śca dhātūn khanīśca sarvathā ||65||
jīvikāṃ sarvajīvānāṃ dadāti vasudhāṃ dadan |
ikṣubhiḥ santatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmaśālinīm ||66||

dadāti yo’kṣayalokān labhate sa mahāsukhān ||67||
bhūmisatraṃ bhavettasya sarvakaluṣanāśakam |
satāṃ loke pare divye sadbhirdātā mahīyate ||68||
śataṃ divyā yoṣito’pi divyamālāvibhūṣitāḥ |
sampadaścopatiṣṭhanti brahmaloke dharāpradam ||69||
śaṃkhabhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ varāśvāvaravāhanam |
dharmapuṇyāni puṣpāṇi hiraṇyanicayām̐stathā ||3.110.70||
ājñāṃ sadāpratihatāṃ jayaśabdān vasūni ca |
hiraṇyapuṣpāścauṣadhīn kuśakāñcanaśādvalāḥ ||71||
amṛtaprasavāṃ bhūmiṃ bhūtiṃ kṣmādaḥ prapadyate |
nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ||72||
nāsti satyasamo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ |
nāsti sādhusamaṃ pātraṃ nāsti mokṣasamaṃ sukham ||73||
nāsti muktipradaṃ stotraṃ puruṣottamasāmavat |
dānakṛt stotravaktā ca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||74||
dānaphalaṃ paraṃ bhuktvā svarge satye tathaiśvare |
divyaloke tato yāti stavāddhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||75||
yathā bhūmistathā cānnaṃ śasyate dānarūpakam |
lokayātrā bhavatyanne prāṇā anne pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||76||
annaṃ tat prathamaṃ brahma jīvakaṃ tṛptidaṃ sadā |
annabhūrjaskara śaktipradaṃ dhārakameva tat ||77||
tāpasā bhikṣavaḥ santo gṛhiṇo’nne pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
kṣudhitāyānnadātā tu paratra nidhimān dhruvaḥ ||78||
atithiṃ cāgataṃ śīghraṃ jalānnaiḥ pūjayed gṛhī |
annado labhate svarge ceha vāmṛtamuttamam ||79||
annaṃ śvapāke śuniṃ vā dattaṃ na vipraṇaśyati |
dadyādadṛṣṭapūrvāya sa mahaddharmamāpnuyāt ||3.110.80||
pitṝn devānṛṣīn viprān sādhūn nārīranāthakān |
atithīn prīṇayatyannaistasya puṇyamanantakam ||8 1 ||
annadānaṃ sarvavarṇe śasyate puṇyadaṃ hi tat |
na pṛcched gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśamityapi ||82||
bhikṣukāya pradadyādvai yācito’nnaṃ samuttamam |
annadasyānnasasyāni sarvadā phaladāni vai ||83||
bhavanti cehāmutrāpi sudhāsvāduphalāni hi |
pitaro’pi pratīkṣante kule’nnado bhaveddhi naḥ ||84||
santo viprā anāthāśca vyaṃgā annasya bhikṣavaḥ |
satkṛtāśca nivartante datvā puṇyāni daivatam ||85||
nityaṃ miṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ |
annadaḥ paśumān putrī dhanavān bhogavānapi ||86 ||
prāṇavān rūpavām̐ścāpi jāyate pūjyate suraiḥ |
kṣetraṃ kṣudhāyutaṃ pātraṃ tatropyate prarohati ||87||
pratyakṣaṃ prītijananaṃ cāmṛtaṃ puṇyasatphalam |
bhokturdāturbhavatyeva jīvanāṃkurameva ha ||88||
dhātumūlaṃ kāmamūlaṃ garbhamūlaṃ sadānnakam |
prasavaścāpi dharmārthau roganāśo’nnato matāḥ ||89||
anne bhūḥ svaḥ satyalokaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti padmaje |
annābhāve prabhidyante śarīre pañcadhātavaḥ ||3.110.90||
balaṃ rūpaṃ praśaktyādyā naśyantyannanirodhanāt |
utsavāśca vivāhāśca yajñāścānnairbhavanti hi ||9 1 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yacca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam |
jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ cāpi puṣṭitattvamapekṣate ||92||
api yantrāṇi tailāpo’pekṣante kā kathātmanaḥ |
bhavanāni prakāśante divi cānnapradātmanām ||93||
tārāsaṃsthāni jāyante candraśubhrāṇi tāni vā |
taruṇādityavarṇāni kiṃkiṇījālavanti ca ||94||
anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalacarāṇi ca |
vaidūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca ||95||
sarvakāmaphaladāśca vallīvṛkṣāśca teṣvapi |
vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāḥ santi teṣu ca ||96||
ghoṣavanti vimānāni labhyante bhavaneṣvapi |
bhakṣyabhojyamayāḥ śailā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ||97||
kṣīranadyo dadhinadyo ghṛtanadyo’tra santi ca |
prāsādā divyakāntāśca suśayyāḥ kāñcanojjvalāḥ ||98||
devyo manoharā yogyāḥ prāpyante tatra mandire |
annadānāṃ sadā lakṣmīrvardhate’mṛtavarṣiṇī ||99||
sudhānadyaḥ prasravanti pīyūṣavārdhayastathā |
evaṃ bhuktvā śubhān lokān yathāpuṇyamataḥ param || 3.110.1 00||
puruṣottamasāmnā vai lakṣmi yāti padaṃ mama |
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ bhuṃkte kāmān mayā saha || 101 ||
sādhūn viprām̐starpayedvai sarpiṣā pāyasena ca |
kṛsaraiḥ polikādyābhiḥ sūpodanaiśca tarpayet || 10 2||
tilapakvānnakairbhakṣyaiḥ phāṇitaiḥ pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
śākaiḥ phalairmūlakaiśca kandairdalaiśca saktukaiḥ || 1 03||
rājamāṣaiśca miṣṭānnairlaḍḍukaistarpayet sataḥ |
dakṣiṇāyāṃ svarṇadānaṃ rūpyakaṃ cārpayettathā || 104||

śāśvataṃ paramānandaṃ bhuṃkte lakṣmi mayā saha || 1 05||
