<3.111>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jalaṃ tu jīvanaṃ sadā |
jaladānaṃ jīvadānaṃ kīrtitaṃ cāmṛtātmakam || 1 ||
śītalaṃ madhuraṃ vāri miṣṭaṃ kṛtvā sugandhayuk |
śārkaraṃ pāyayet sādhūn viprānanyām̐stṛṣānvitām || 2 ||
prapāḥ kuryāt kārayecca pāyayet sujalāni vai |
kūpān vāpītaḍāgām̐śca kārayellokatṛptidān || 3 ||
jaladānaṃ rasadānaṃ pare loke prapadyate |
ardhaṃ pāpasya harati jalaṃ dattaṃ sutṛptidam || 4 ||
jalaṃ sākṣisvarūpaṃ ca varuṇātma pradīvyati |
cetanaṃ brahma vāryāste deyaṃ puṇyatamaṃ jalam || 5 ||
gāvo viprāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo’nye dehino’pi ca |
yasya khāte pibantyaṃbhastārayanti kulāni te || 6 ||
yathā vāri tathā puṇyaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt prabhakṣaṇe |
sādhudvijātithibhyo’pi rūpavān rasavān bhavet || 7 ||
phalaṃ puṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ snehaṃ cāmṛtaṃ labhate divi |
balaṃ gāśca mahiṣīśca labhate ghṛtadānakṛt || 8 ||
dadyād dāne pāyasaṃ ca sarpirdadyād viśeṣataḥ |
ghṛtadāturgṛhaṃ rakṣoyamādyā dharṣayanti na || 9 ||
pipāsayā na mriyate karakāvāridānakṛt |
śakaṭasya pradātuśca bhavanti vāhanāni vai || 3.111.1 0||
svargayānāni ramyāṇi vimānāni śubhāni ca |
upānatsaṃpradātuśca naśyanti kaṇṭakāḥ sadā || 11 ||
śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ bhavati tasya vai |
tiladānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṛbhojyāḥ śubhāstilāḥ || 12||
sarvasatrairyajate sa yastilān samprayacchati |
pauṣṭikān rūpadām̐ścāpi tathā pāpavināśakān || 1 3||
yatra ghṛtaṃ vrīhirnāsti nāsti phalāni pāyasam |
tatra tilaiḥ prahotavyaṃ tṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ || 14||
tiladasyāmṛtaṃ svargaṃ copatiṣṭhati sarvadā |
tiladātānnadaḥ proktaḥ phaladaścāpi kathyate ||15||
evaṃ lakṣmi bhūmidātā yajñaṣaṣṭhāṃśamṛcchati |
na sīdati sa kṛcchreṣu na ca durgāṇi gacchati || 1 6||
śītavātātapasahāṃ gṛhabhūmiṃ suśobhitām |
yo datte modate svarge puṇyānte’pi na cālyate || 17||
pratiśrayapradātā vai svarge yāti pramodate |
dharmaśālāvidhātā ca svargaloke pramodate || 18||
yasya saudhe pāṭhaśālā sādhuśālā gavāṃ kulam |
sa dātā svaśca vairājaṃ prādhānikaṃ gṛhaṃ labhet || 19||
āśatāni kulānyeva tārayatyāśrayapradaḥ |
kṣetradaḥ satatāṃ lakṣmīṃ ratnado vaṃśavistaram ||3.111.20||
udyānadaḥ phalarasān tīrthado mokṣamuttamam |
godo yāti tu golokaṃ viprado brahma cākṣaram ||21 ||
kumārado bhūmalokaṃ kanyādaḥ śrīsthalīṃ śubhām |
dāsīprado’psarolokaṃ dīpadaḥ sūryasannidhim ||22||
ghṛtadaḥ somalokaṃ ca dugdhado’mṛtadhāma ca |
ratnado’vyākṛtaṃ dhāma strīdo viṣṇupadaṃ param ||23 ||
gṛhadaḥ satyalokaṃ ca ṛddhidaḥ prākṛtaṃ sthalam |
bhūṣādo vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prayāti śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||24||
godaḥ prāṇapradaḥ proktaḥ śaraṇyasya pradastathā |
gosahasrāṇi daśa yo dadātīndratvamṛcchati ||25||
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ mahatsthānaṃ kaṇadaḥ samagacchati |
lomaśaśca guruḥ prāha prāṇadānaṃ paraṃ matam || 26||
yena prāṇāḥ prarakṣyante prāṇadānaṃ hi tanmatam |
annenāpi jalenāpi tathauṣadhādibhiḥ kvacit ||27||
śaraṇenābhayenāpyāśrayeṇa prāṇarakṣaṇam |
tāni dānāni kamale prāṇadānāni sarvadā ||28||
dātavyāni cirāyuṣṭvaphalāni svargadāni ca |
jalaṃ surāṇāmamṛtaṃ jāyate dattamatra yat ||29||
nāgānāṃ tat sudhārūpaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhātmakam |
vatsānāṃ cāpi bālānāṃ jalaṃ dugdhātmakaṃ bhavet ||3.111.3 0||
jaladānaṃ sadā dadyād yadīcched bhūtimātmanaḥ |
dānānyetāni dhanyāni cāyuṣyāṇi sukhāni ca ||3 1 ||
sarvakāmapradānyeva pretyānandapradāni ca |
etaddānāni datvātra bhogān bhuktvā triviṣṭape ||32||
uṣitvā cirakalpām̐ścākṣaraṃ stotrāt prayāti ca |
puruṣottamasāmnaśca phalaṃ tvakṣaradhāma vai ||33|||
nijadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ gṛhiṇā tyāgine śubham |
sarvaṃ tyaktvā sādhave svārpaṇakartākṣare pade ||34||
modate brahmavidbhakto mukto bhūtvā nirantakaḥ |
pūrve nṛpāstathā viprāḥ svārpaṇaṃ tyāgine rame ||35||
gurave cārpaṇaṃ cakrurnaijaṃ tyāgāśramāya ha |
bhūtvā vanī tato nyāsī gacchedvai paramaṃ padam ||36||
puruṣottamasāmnā vai labhetākṣaradhāma ca |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ dīrghaśīlasya brāhmaṇasya vai ||37||
śatruṃjayāyāḥ saritastaṭe grāme virāmaṇe |
dīrghaśīlo’bhavadvipro vasantye’pi bhūsurāḥ || 38||
atha prāha yamaḥ kaṃcid dūtaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ nijam |
yāhi virāmaṇaṃ dīrghaśīlaṃ samānaya ||39||
bhāradvājaṃ gotrataśca snānapūjāvivarjitam |
nāstikaṃ nindakaṃ śāstramṛṣāvādinameva tam ||3.111.40||
mā cānyamānayethāstvaṃ nāmnā gotreṇa sadṛśam |
dānaśīlaṃ dīrghaśīlaṃ vasantaṃ vai virāmaṇe ||41 ||
sa gatvā tvānayad dūto niṣiddhaṃ dānaśīlinam |
grāme kolāhalo jāto mṛto vai dīrghaśīlavān ||42||
sambandhinaḥ suhṛdaścāyayustadubhayorgṛham |
bhrāntā nyavartayam̐ścāpi dṛṣṭvā jīvantamekakam ||43||
kecidāhuryamadūto’smābhirdṛṣṭo bhayaṃkaraḥ |
dīrghaśīlaṃ sunītvaiva gacchan vyomagatistvaran ||44||
śrutvā trāsaṃ jagāmāpi nāstiko maraṇaṃ nijam |
antike tvāgataṃ kintu dūto vismṛtya māṃ param ||45||
āstikaṃ hṛtavāneva tato dānaṃ karomi ca |
dattavān drutamevāyaṃ gotilāmbarabhūṣaṇam ||46||
gṛhaṃ ghṛtaṃ subhojyānnaṃ jajāpa ca punaḥ punaḥ |
puruṣottamasāmāpi bhīyukto maraṇasya saḥ ||47||
tatpuṇyaṃ bahudhā jātaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam |
pratīkṣate yamadūtaṃ tvāyāsyantaṃ muhurdiśam ||48||
atha saṃyaminīpuryāṃ gataścāstikabhūsuraḥ |
dṛṣṭo yamena dharmeṇa nataścotthāya pūjitaḥ ||49||
madhuparkādibhiḥ samyak satkṛto vanditastathā |
bhojitaścāmṛtānnaiśca kṣamāṃ prati tato’rthitaḥ ||3.111.50 ||
atha dharmanṛpo dūtaṃ prāha nāyaṃ sa daṇḍabhāk |
pūjito nīyatāmeṣaḥ so’nya ānīyatāmiti |||51||
evamukte tu vacane tvāstikaḥ prāha dharmajam |
nirviṇṇo’haṃ śeṣakālaṃ vaseyamiti sarvadā ||52||
nāhamicchāmi duḥkhāḍhye dehe nivasituṃ yama |
dharmān śrāvaya bhadraṃ te yān prapālyāpyate sukham |||53||
dharmarājastataḥ prāha śṛṇu tattvaṃ hi bhūsura |
bhūmidānaṃ sarvadānasamaṃ sarvasukhapradam ||54||
gṛhadānaṃ sarvasādhyasādhanaiścopabṛṃhitam |
sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ svargapradaṃ vipra paraṃ matam ||55||
udyānavāṭikādānaṃ rasadānaṃ paraṃ matam |
sarvarasānavāpnoti phalapuṣpādanāni ca ||56||
taṭākasaritāṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tṛptipradaṃ matam |
godānaṃ paramaṃ vipra svargamokṣapradaṃ matam ||57||
vaitaraṇītārakaṃ ca māyābandhananāśakam |
bhavābdhitārakaṃ pāpakṣālakaṃ hi gavārpaṇam ||58||
svargadānaṃ bhūṣaṇādisamarpaṇaṃ paraṃ matam |
śṛṃgārāmbaradānaṃ ca smṛddhidaṃ paramaṃ matam ||59||
kanyādānaṃ ca dāmpatyapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ divampradam |
dāsadāsīpradānaṃ ca dhanadānaṃ tathā śubham ||3.111.6 0 ||
sarvagārhasthyabhogānāṃ sampādakaṃ tu nāṇakam |
tiladānaṃ ghṛtadānaṃ dīpadānaṃ paraṃ tathā ||61 ||
śarkarāgūḍadānaṃ ca yavagodhūmadānakam|
chatropānatpradānaṃ ca svargarājyapradaṃ matam ||62||
tāni sarvāṇi deyāni deyaṃ cābhayadānakam |
mokṣadānaṃ paratamaṃ sarvebhyo vai viśiṣyate ||63 ||
vipra tvayā pradattāni bahūnīmāni sarvathā |
puṇyavānasi samyak tvaṃ kuru śreyo hi dehinām ||64||
puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ japa punarmuhuḥ |
mokṣadaṃ śāśvatānandapradaṃ mokṣapramodadam ||65||
nityasukhapradaṃ pāpadhvaṃsakaṃ cākṣarapradam |
puruṣottamasāmnastu pāṭhakaṃ pūrvapāpinam ||66||
daṇḍaṃ nāhaṃ dadāmyatra pāvanaḥ sa tu kīrtyate |
adaṇḍyo me bhaved vipra mahāpāpyapi pāṭhakaḥ ||67||
yāhi vipra sukhenaiva kṣantavyaścāpi dharmarāṭ |
ityukto dīrghaśīlaśca dūtena saha satvaram ||68||
natvā dharmaṃ cāyayau vai nijaṃ dehaṃ vineśa ha |
prasannā bāndhavā jātā vipro dānāni vai dadau ||69||
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ cānte japtvā stotraṃ mama priyam |
puruṣottamasāmākhyaṃ sarvabādhānivartakam ||3.111.70||
yamadūto nāstikaṃ taṃ nītvāyayau yamaṃ prati |
daṇḍāyāvedayāmāsa citraguptaṃ tu dharmarāṭ ||71||
dṛṣṭvāha citragupto’pi puṇyaṃ vivardhate’sya vai |
pāpānyadyāni sarvāṇi durītāni kṛtāni tu ||72||
vilīnāni samagrāṇi puruṣottamasāmataḥ |
puṇyapuñjāḥ pravardhante sarvadānādibhistviha ||73||
tato daṇḍyo’sti nāyaṃ vai pūjanīyo’sti sarvathā |
śrutvā śrīdharmarājo’pi pupūja dīrghaśīlinam ||74||
bhayena puṇyakartāraṃ japtāraṃ stavanasya ca |
arghyaṃ cācamanaṃ pādaprakṣālanajalaṃ dadau ||75||
svāgataṃ cārhaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ madhuparkādikaṃ dadau |
kṛtvā ca saṃvidaṃ tena visasarja tadā hi saḥ ||76 ||
papraccha dharmarājaṃ taṃ kṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ kathaṃ mama |
nāstiko’haṃ nindakaścāgharmī pāpī bhavāmi ca ||77||
tathāpi naiva daṇḍo me mahāścaryamidaṃ mama |
vada me dharmarāja tvaṃ kathaṃ daṇḍo na vai mama ||78||
śrutvāha dharmarājastaṃ kṛtaṃ tu bhujyate sadā |
niyamo’sti sadā loke prajvalitaṃ na bhujyate ||79||
annaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ yānaṃ śayanaṃ pāpakaṃ vṛṣaḥ |
prajvalitā na bhujyante te pāpaṃ jvalitaṃ dvija ||3.111.80||
puruṣottamasāmākhyastotrapāṭhena sarvathā |
dānānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ codbhūtaṃ tava bhūsura ||81||
bhuṃkṣva puṇyaṃ kṣitau dīrghamuṣitvā svastataḥ param |
tataḥ satyaṃ ca vairājaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param ||82||
tato’kṣaraṃ śāśvataṃ ca yāhi bhuṃkṣva mahāsukham |
puruṣottamabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate na vai ||83||
kālamāyāpāpakarmabhayā naśyanti sarvathā |
puruṣottamabhakteṣu nādhikāro’sti me’pi ca ||84||
pūrvanāstikavipro’sau papraccha ca tato yamam |
gatvā tatra mayā yadyat kartavyaṃ tad vadātra me ||85||
yathāśakti kariṣyāmi kārayiṣyāmi śobhanam |
śrutvāha yamarājo’pi vipraṃ dharmamayaṃ vṛṣam ||86 ||
śṛṇu vipra prakartavyaṃ mandiraṃ paramātmanaḥ |
sthāpanīyo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyā saha ||87||
sevāḥ sarvavidhāścāsya karaṇīyā yathākṣaṇam |
bhojanīyāḥ sādhavaśca sevanīyā nirantaram ||88||
pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca dānaiśca sarvavastubhiḥ |
doṣaṇīyāḥ sadā santo mokṣadā bhavatārakāḥ ||89||
mandire dīpadānaṃ ca jalaprasravaṇārpaṇam |
na vedanārpaṇaṃ cāpi pūjādravyārpaṇaṃ tathā ||3.111.90||
yānavāhanadānaṃ ca vāṭikodyānakārpaṇam |
dhvajārpaṇaṃ kalaśānāmarpaṇaṃ pātrakārpaṇam ||91 ||
śayyārpaṇaṃ rasānāmarpaṇaṃ gandhārpaṇaṃ tathā |
svarṇabhūṣārpaṇaṃ divyāmbarādyarpaṇamityapi ||92||
śākapatrārpaṇaṃ cāpi tāmbūlakādikārpaṇam |
vyajanādyarpaṇaṃ cāpi kambalādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||93||
pūjāpravāhavastūnāṃ dravyāṇāmarpaṇaṃ tathā |
vāditrāṇāṃ śubhaṃ dānaṃ veṣāṇāmarpaṇa tathā ||94||
mahāsthālyādidānaṃ ca gargarīdānamityapi |
paryaṃkādipradānaṃ ca mahāsanasamarpaṇam ||95||
govājigajadānaṃ ca vṛṣabhārpaṇamityapi |
maṇiratnādidānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mandire sadā ||96||
dātavyaṃ gurave sarvaṃ ceṣṭadevārhaṇāya vai |
dāsīdāsapradānaṃ ca sabhāśālāpradānakam ||97||
kūpavāpītaḍāgādidānaṃ kāryaṃ tu mandire |
chatracāmaradānaṃ tu siṃhāsanādikārpaṇam ||98||
pustakārpaṇamevāpi peṭikādyarpaṇaṃ tathā |
kaṇānāmarpanaṃ cāpi godhūmataṇḍulārpaṇam ||99||
evaṃvidhāni dānāni jalānnasahitāni vai |
dātavyāni viśeṣeṇa gṛhiṇā bhūsureṇa ha || 3.111.100 ||
snānaṃ sandhyājapaṃ bhaktiṃ stotrapāṭhaṃ samācaret |
mokṣadaṃ cātmavijñānaṃ brahmavidyāṃ paṭhettathā || 101 ||
pitroḥ prasevanaṃ kuryāt paropakāramityapi |
brahmaśīlo bhaveccāpi bhaktiśīlo bhavettathā || 102||
rāgahīno bhaveccāpi doṣān pravarjayet sadā |
viṣṇupūjāṃ prakuryācca mokṣaśāstrarato bhavet || 103||
kīrtayet satataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |
dhyāyettaṃ śrīpatiṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ muktapatiṃ harim || 1 04||
vandeta śrīparameśaṃ puruṣottamasāmagaḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā sukarmāṇi puṇyāni mokṣadāni ca || 1 05||
jitvā māyāṃ tathā kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jitvākṣaraṃ vrajet |
ityevaṃ vipra gatvā tvaṃ kuru devārcanaṃ sadā || 1 06||
pitrarcanaṃ satāṃ pūjāṃ vidhehi svātmavat sadā |
vijayaste sadā bhāvī svarge satye tathākṣare || 1 07||
ityuktaḥ padmaje vipro yayau gṛhaṃ cakāra tat |
ante svargāṇyanekāni bhuktvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau || 1 08||
śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvāpi kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā |
bhūtvā mamāśritaḥ prāṇī labhate me’kṣaraṃ rame || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jaladānabhūdānavividhadānakartuḥ puruṣottamasāmajāpakasya dīrghaśīlasyāstikasya dīrghaśīlasya nāstikasyāpi yamadvāropadeśo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||

<3.112>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśriṃ tvaṃ gaurdeyā vidhinā sadā |
gaurbodhyā trividhā śreṣṭhā pṛthvī dhenuḥ sarasvatī || 1 ||
śiṣyāya deyā vidyāgaurbrāhmīvidyā mumukṣave |
kalājñānaṃ śilpine ca, bhautikaṃ rasavedine || 2 ||
khajñānaṃ gaṇakāyāpi nāryai pākakalāmapi |
śāstrajñānaṃ ca viduṣe deyaṃ gobhūsamaṃ hi tat || 3 ||
dhenudānaṃ pradātavyaṃ mātaro dhenavaḥ sadā |
vṛddhimākāṃkṣatā nityaṃ gāvaḥ kāryāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || 4 ||
santāḍyā nahi pādena devyaḥ pūjyāḥ sumaṅgalāḥ |
govāhakā gavādāśca rākṣasā nirayaṃgamāḥ || 5 ||
tṛṣitāḥ kṣudhitā gāvo janaṃ hanyuḥ sabāndhavam |
pitṛsadmāni saudhāśca devatāyatanāni ca || 6 ||
pūyante śakṛtā yāsāṃ pūtaṃ kimadhikaṃ tataḥ |
ghāsamuṣṭiṃ cānnamuṣṭiṃ varṣaṃ dadyād gave tu yaḥ || 7 ||
akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ vrataṃ tat sārvakāmikam |
phalaṃ putrān yaśo’rthāśca śriyaṃ cāpyadhigacchati || 8 ||
vinaśyatyaśubhaṃ tasya duḥsvapnaṃ naiva jāyate |
duṣṭāya gaurna dātavyā lubdhāya nāstikāya na || 9 ||
vatse dayārahitāya krūrāya ghātine’pi ca |
ghāsasevārahitāya na dātavyā kadācana || 3.112.1 0||
gṛhasthānarahitāya tṛṇādirahitāya ca |
bhaktidharmavihīnāya na dātavyā kadācana || 1 1||
sādhave bahuputrāya bhikṣave devatārthine |
kṣetravate pradātavyā tṛṇasevākṛte ca gauḥ || 1 2||
gosevā gurusevā ca pitṛsevā sadā rame |
ghnanti pāpaprapuñjāni tārayanti samarpakān || 1 3||
satāṃ samāgamo lakṣmi tathā tārayati dhruvaḥ |
alābhe tu gavāṃ dadyād ghṛtadhenuṃ śubhāvahām || 14||
tasyaitā ghṛtavāhinyaḥ kṣaranti vatsalā iva |
ghṛtālābhe kṣīradhenuṃ dadyādutsāhaśraddhayā || 15||
sa kaṣṭāttārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate |
kṣīrālābhe tiladhenuṃ dadyāttilaiḥ pramodate || 16||
tilālābhe phaladhenuṃ dadyāt phalaiḥ pramodate |
phalālābhe kaṇadhenuṃ dadyādannaiḥ pramodate || 17||
annālābhe gūḍadhenuṃ dadyānmiṣṭaiḥ pramodate |
gūḍābhāve’mbaradhenuṃ dadyād vastraiḥ pramodate || 18||
sarvābhāve jaladhenuṃ dadyānnadīṣu modate |
ekāpi kapilā dattāmṛtāpagāsya jāyate || 19||
apyekā sādhave dattā devatārcanayoginī |
prāpayatyevākṣaraṃ me dātāraṃ dhāma śāśvatam ||3.112.20||
gopradātā yatra yāti lokāste nityamodinaḥ |
na tatra kramate kālo na jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ||21 ||
aśubhaṃ tatra nāste ca na vyādhirna ca vai klamaḥ |
yadicchantyupatiṣṭhanti gavāṃ puṇyabalena vai ||22||
kāmagāḥ kāmacāriṇyo gāvastatropayanti ca |
vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi sarito ghṛtadugdhamayāstathā ||23||
gṛhāṇi parvatāścāraṇyāni vanāni yanti ca |
manojñamiṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca rasopetaṃ prapadyate ||24||
tatra sarvasahāḥ kṣāntā godātāraḥ prayānti ha |
guruśuśrūṣakā yānti dānino’tithipūjakāḥ ||25||
na pāpā goprahartāraḥ puṇyalokaṃ prayanti vai |
dāyadravyeṇa gāṃ krītvā prayacchecchreyasāṃ kṛte ||26||
śramāptanāṇakaiḥ krītvārpayenmokṣārthameva tu |
dyūte jitvā dhanaṃ tena krītvā dadyāt svarāptaye ||27||
dāyabhāgāṃ ca gāṃ dadyād dadyād dānāgatāṃ ca vā |
satyavratasya godātuḥ sahasragosamaṃ phalam ||28||
nityaṃ prātarnamed gāṃ ca tṛṇagrāsām̐stathārpayet |
jalaṃ prapāyayed yaśca rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||29||
anāhāro’grabhaktaṃ yo gave dadyāddhi govratī |
varṣeṇa gosahasrasya phalaṃ labhate sevayā ||3.112.3 0||
ekabhakto hi gāṃ krītvā dadyādvai gurave sa tu |
tasyā yāvanti romāṇi tāvadgophalamāpnuyāt ||3 1||
yastvātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ krītvā prayacchati |
romṇi romṇi dhenudāturlokā bhavanti cākṣayāḥ ||32||
araṇye gāṃ bhūsuraṃ ca sādhuṃ yastrāyatīti saḥ |
aśvamedhakratostulyaṃ phalaṃ labhate modate ||33||
mṛtyukāle yathecchāsya bhaved divyavibhūtigā |
tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti paritrāṇena rakṣakaḥ ||34||
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ dakṣiṇā ca gavā saha |
dātavyā vai yathāśakti smṛddhidā pāvanī sadā ||35||
daridro nirdhanaścaivāparigrahastu yo bhavet |
kuryād vrataṃ vratānyeva labheta sa paraṃ padam ||36||
indriyāṇāṃ niyamo vai vrataṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ rame |
jitendriyo brahmabhakto brahmaloke pramodate ||37 ||
damaḥ sukhaprado dāntā nirvṛttā viṣayavrajāt |
pratyāhṛtya manovegaṃ brahmaṇi yānti pāvitāḥ ||38||
vikrameṇa ca tapasā yajñairdānaiḥ prasevayā |
bhaktyā śāntyā vidyayā ca santi lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ||39||
ṛṣilokān devalokān siddhalokān gavāṃ gṛhān |
muktalokānīśalokān śīlavratāḥ prayānti hi ||3.112.40||
adhyāpako homakartā gurusevāparastathā |
satīsādhvīpūjakaśca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||41 ||
bhaktau dharme vrate śūrā dāne’dhyayanakarmaṇi |
yajane saṃgare śuśrūṣāyāṃ copārjane’pi ca ||42||
dame śūrāḥ ṛte jñāne’raṇye tyāge gṛhe’pi ca |
śame ca niyame śāntāvārjave śūrakarmiṇaḥ ||43 ||
gurormātuḥ pituḥ patyuḥ śuśrūṣāyāṃ tathāpare |
bhaikṣye’tithau tapasyeva śūrāḥ santi ca kecana ||44||
sarve yāntyaiśvarān lokān yathākarmaphalabhṛtān |
satyavratino bhaktāśca yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||45||
ājanmamaraṇād yastu brahmacārī bhavediha |
na tasya kiñcidaprāpyaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai yathā ||46||
brahmacaryaṃ dahed doṣān sarvapāpānyupāsitam |
brahmadhāmagataḥ syādvai brahmacārī balaidhitaḥ ||47||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi gurumācāryamacyutam |
sevate yastasya dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ padam ||48||
nābījaṃ jāyate kiñcinna bījena vinā phalam |
yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam ||49||
bījaṃ puruṣākaro vai sevātmako vṛṣātmakaḥ |
kṣetraṃ sadguravo mātā pitā gaudaivateśvaraḥ ||3.112.50||
bhaktaśca karṣuko yādṛg vapate caiti tādṛśam |
śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā ||51||
kṛtaṃ labhate sarvatra svargaṃ svargasukhāni ca |
rūpaṃ bhāgyaṃ prasaubhāgyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca ||52||
tārakāstridaśāḥ siddhā yakṣāścandrārkamārutāḥ |
sarve kṛtena dharmeṇa mānuṣyād devatāṃ gatāḥ ||53||
nādātāraṃ bhajantyarthā niṣkriyaṃ na bhajantyapi |
apuṇyaṃ na bhajantyarthā bhajanti tvarthakāriṇam ||54||
akṛtvā mānuṣaṃ yatnaṃ daivamātraṃ pratīkṣate |
na tasya siddhiḥ kamale klībapatnyā ivobhaye ||55||
sevāyāṃ śūratā yasya balaṃ śīlamayaṃ tathā |
yatno daivaṃ yasya cāste siddhistasyāñjalisthitā ||56||
na kevalaṃ rame daivaṃ puṣṇātyavati rakṣati |
nijayatnasamāyuktaṃ daivaṃ sādhu vivardhate ||57||
niḥsnehaḥ khalu vai dīpaḥ svayameva praśāmyati |
vinā puṇyaṃ vinā yatnaṃ bhāgyaṃ svayaṃ praśāmyati ||58||
tasmāllakṣmi sadā yatnaḥ kartavyastapasi vrate |
puṇye dāne’rjane bhaktau sevāyāṃ bhūtimicchatā ||59||
dhanaṃ vipulaṃ bhogāṃśca yoṣito bhojanāni ca |
puṇyahīno na vai bhoktuṃ samartho jāyate kvacit ||3.112.60||
vyayaśīlaṃ dānaśīlaṃ copaiti vipulaṃ dhanam |
pūrvadattena cāyāti vinā yatnaṃ kvacit priye ||61 ||
dātavyaṃ sarvathā sarvaṃ yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet |
dānasyaiva phalaṃ bhuṃkte loko’yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ ||62||
nādattā prāpyate lakṣmīrnādattā prāpyate priyā |
nādattā prāpyate dhenurnādattā prāpyate mahī ||63||
nādattā prāpyate buddhirnādattā smṛddhirāpyate |
nākṛtā prāpyate sevā nādattaṃ prāpyate sukham ||64||
nākṛtaṃ prāpyate cāyurnādattaṃ rājyamāpyate |
nādattaṃ cāpyate lakṣmi sukhamaindriyikaṃ bahu ||65||
tasmād dānāni deyāni bhūṣāmbaragṛhāṇi ca |
bhojyapreyaprabhogyāni yāni sveṣṭatamāni vai ||66||
mayā sṛṣṭīḥ samutpādyāvatāreśvaradevatāḥ |
kanyādānaistoṣitā vai tatphalaṃ stryarbudābjakam ||67||
yadyapyahaṃ samartho’smi nityapuṇyāśrayo hariḥ |
mamāṃgāt pramadya vāmājjāyante’rbudakoṭayaḥ ||68||
na me dānaphalāpekṣā samarthasya parātmanaḥ |
tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ nidarśanaṃ pradarśitam ||69||
sarvaṃ jagaccharīraṃ me narā nāryo’rdhamūrtayaḥ |
narā nārāyaṇārdhā me nāryo me’rdhāṃganāstathā ||3.112.70 ||
evaṃ saṃsāranirvāho dānenāsādyate phalam |
taponiyamasaṃyuktāḥ sādhavaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ||71 ||
phalaṃ prāpya bhavantyeva nārāyaṇasameśvarāḥ |
yena lokāstrayaḥ sṛṣṭā mayā śrīpatinā purā ||72||
so’haṃ tapāmi kṣīrode badaryāṃ ca ciraṃ rame |
so’haṃ kṛtvā darśayāmi kurvantu tapa uttamam ||73||
vāmano’haṃ kṣitiṃ prāpya parśurāmastathā pṛthuḥ |
dānaṃ pṛthvyāścakāraiva rāmādityo’pi vai purā ||74||
śikṣayāmāsa bhagavān bhūtvāpi dānamuttamam |
prajābhyo yajñakāryaiśca yajñanārāyaṇo’pyaham ||75||
mayā rādhā pradattā vai śrīkṛṣṇāya madātmane |
nārāyaṇī tathā dattā nārāyaṇātmane tu me ||76||
bhūrdattā ca varāhāya śrīrdattā viṣṇave purā |
lakṣmīrmahāviṣṇave ca sāvitrī brahmaṇe’rpitā ||77||
prakṛtiryā mūlarūpā puruṣāya purārpitā |
evaṃ kṛtvā saṃkalanaṃ dānarītiḥ pravartitā ||78||
tasmāllakṣmi dānaphalaṃ pramodāḥ sarva eva ha |
yena yena śarīreṇa yadyad dānaṃ karoti yaḥ ||79||
tena tena śarīreṇa tattat phalamupāśnute |
yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham ||3.112.80||
tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhuṃkte kartā tu tatphalam |
cakṣurdadyānmanodadyād vācaṃ dadyādṛtaṃbharām ||81||
ātmānaṃ sampradadyādvai seveta satataṃ gurum |
evaṃ dānaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ dehaṃ dadyād yathocitam ||82||
evamapi pradānena taratyabdhiṃ hi karmaṇām |
śṛṇvatra kathayāmyeva jñānena dānamuttamam ||83||
yatphalaṃ brahmalokākhyaṃ prāptā brahmasatī purā |
yoginyāsīd brahmasatī brāhmaṇī sā kumārikā ||84||
somanāthe śubhe tīrthe bhajamānā tu śaṃkaram |
yuvatī ca surūpā ca śīlayuktā tapodhanā ||85||
sarasvatyāṃ karotyeṣā triṣavaṇaṃ japādikam |
tairthikāḥ sūryatulyāṃ tāṃ paśyanti yanti mugdhatām ||86 ||
sā na dṛṣṭiṃ dadātyeva kvāpi kutrāpi sarvathā |
ekadā tāṃ tu saṃvīkṣya daityaḥ sthaṇḍilaghoṣakaḥ ||87||
ujjahāra balenaiva vyomnābdhau nijamandiram |
tasyā bhogaṃ prasahyāpi cakre vai brahmayoṣitaḥ ||88||
sāpyanāthā ca nirviṇṇā jñātrī dehavirāgiṇī |
śokaṃ tathāpyaśokaṃ ca mene cātmapratiṣṭhatā ||89||
śīlaṃ vrataṃ sadā rakṣyaṃ tadbhaṃgaḥ śoka eva saḥ |
āpatkāle na ced rakṣā deho’haṃ netyaśocanam ||3.112.90||
vivekena śarīrādvai bhinnātmānamamanyata |
dehaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā matvā śokaṃ jahau parāśrayā ||91||
evaṃ vidhāṃ tu tāṃ vīkṣya daityaḥ papraccha tāṃ muhuḥ |
kathaṃ na kuruṣe śokaṃ pradharṣitāpi bhāmini ||92||
sā tu prāha malino’yaṃ deho vai dharṣitastvayā |
nāhaṃ pradharṣitā daitya śuddhāhaṃ cetanātmikā ||93||
tvayi nārāyaṇaścāste brahma yatparamaḥ prabhuḥ |
tadadhiṣṭhitadehena bhukto deho na cetanaḥ ||94||
tvamajño vartase daitya nāhamajñāpadi sthitā |
śocanīyaḥ sadā dehastaṃ śocāmyavaśā katham ||95||
ātmā na strī pumānnaiva pṛthvīpāṣāṇarūpiṇau |
dehau tathābhidhāno vai tatra kā paridevanā ||96||
śrutvaivaṃ sthaṇḍilaghoṣastvāścaryaṃ paramaṃ yayau |
jñānamāsādya ca tato yayāce karmaṇaḥ kṣamām ||97||
tāṃ skandhe sve nidhāyaiva somanāthaṃ samānayat |
jñānayogena daityo’pi tapobhaktiṃ cakāra ha ||98||
tasyā yogena tapasā śuddho bhūtvā harasya saḥ |
kālena gaṇatāṃ prāpto yayau kailāsamuttam ||99||
brahmasatī śuśocāpi yatra me paravaśyatā |
tatrādhīnābhavaṃ cābdhau daityahastagatā tadā || 3.112.1 00||
jñānāgninā mayā pāpaṃ jvālitaṃ kintu laukikam |
prāyaścittaṃ vidhātavyaṃ na lupyeta vṛṣo yathā || 101 ||
sā yayau yoginaṃ śāntaṃ kirīṭinaṃ harāśritam |
papraccha śaucaṃ śīlasya kirīṭyuvāca tāṃ tadā || 1 02||
rūpaṃ te vidyate sādhvi śaṃkarasyāpi mohakam |
tasmāt punaḥ punarvighnaṃ te bhaviṣyati yauvane || 1 03||
tasmādāśraya kāntaṃ tvaṃ sveṣṭaṃ brahmavidaṃ janam |
yena vighnavilopaḥ syāt pāpaṃ śāntaṃ bhavettataḥ || 1 04||
dehaśuddhyā tathā caivodvāhena vidhināpi ca |
prāyaścittaṃ tavaiva syād rājasvalyaṃ ca śodhakam || 1 05||
ityuktā sā jñānakośā bhaktā tameva yoginam |
kirīṭyākhyaṃ patiṃ vavre guruṃ patiṃ cakāra sā || 1 06||
dīkṣāṃ jagrāha gārhasthyaśobhanāṃ śaṃkarāntike |
pārvatyā kṛtatilakā dattasaubhāgyacandrikā || 1 07||
samarthā yoginī jātā divyā śaṃbhoḥ śubhāśiṣā |
evaṃ dehenārpitā sā gaṇapatnī suyoginī || 1 08||
divyā sāmarthyasampannā vyavartata hi śāśvatī |
ekadā śaṃbhunā sākaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ gatā satī || 1 09||
tayā dāsīsvarūpā sā nītā brahmasatī saha |
nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha sa ca bhāminī || 3.112.1 10||
satyā niveditā mahyaṃ sā muktā saṃbabhūva ha |
divyarūpeṇa vai nityā ramayā saha rājate || 11 1||
brāhmīsatītināmnaiva patnī me sābhavattataḥ |
apareṇāpi rūpeṇa kirīṭasyāpi bhāminī || 1 12||
vartate nityakailāse modate śaṃbhusevikā |
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi rahasyaṃ te’rpaṇe vidhau || 1 13||
dehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ labhyate cennarāyaṇaḥ |
nārāyaṇapradātā ca labhyate mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 14||
dehadānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ sārvakālikam |
anyairyo bhujyate deho bhujyatāṃ paramātmanā || 1 15||
tadarpaṇena vai lakṣmi lakṣmītāṃ labhate satī |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirgatirbhavet || 1 16||
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tvetat kathitaṃ te purābhavat |
tataścānyā rūpavatyaścārpaṇaṃ cakrurātmanām || 1 17||
nārāyaṇe’bhavan sādhvyaḥ koṭiśo vai śubhāṃganāḥ |
mama yogena saṃsāraṃ tīrtvā brahmapadaṃ yayuḥ || 1 18||
brahmapriyāśca tāḥ sarvā vartante’tra tavāgrataḥ |
brahmapriyāsu yoginyo muktānyo divyavigrahāḥ || 11 9||
apātrābhyo na dātavyaṃ jñānametannarāyaṇi |
śrutvā ca nindikābhyaśca na dātavyaṃ kadācana || 3.112.1 20||
mokṣārthakṛtasarvasvābhyo dātavyaṃ śubhaṃ tvidam |
yatprāpya matpadaṃ divyaṃ labhante māmanuśritāḥ || 121 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne godānagokalpadānavividhavratācārārpaṇaphalanirūpaṇe brahmasatyā yoginyā dehadānanidarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||

<3.113>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tapāṃsi vividhāni vai |
kevalāni tathā bhaktiyutāni pravadāmi te || 1 ||
yatkṛtena bhavet svargaṃ puṇyaṃ ca sampado’malāḥ |
bhaktiyuktena tenaiva labhyate dhāma me’kṣaram || 2 ||
audāryaṃ paramaṃ proktaṃ tapo vyayātmakaṃ sadā |
dhanaṃ dadyād vanaṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ dadyācchubhāśrayam || 3 ||
kulaṃ dadyāt kaṇān dadyādaudārye dānamāsthitam |
udārasya bhavelloko dānināṃ dhanadādhikaḥ || 4 ||
bhaktiyuktaṃ mahaudāryaṃ mama dhāmapradaṃ bhavet |
sthaṇḍile śayanaṃ nityaṃ tapaḥ paramakaṃ matam || 5 ||
tasya phalaṃ mahat svarge prāsādāḥ svarṇaśobhanāḥ |
śayanāni ca ramyāṇi jāyante’mṛtadānyapi || 6 ||
cīravalkaladhāritvaṃ tapaḥ paraṃ prakathyate |
phalaṃ tasya bhaved ramyavāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca || 7 ||
yogacittaṃ tapaḥśreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ vimānakāni vai |
vāhanāni tathā divyāḥ siddhayaḥ svargavāsitā || 8 ||
agnitāpastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ rājyaṃ divaṃ bhavet |
rasānāṃ varjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapastasya phalaṃ śubham || 9 ||
saubhāgyaṃ tu bhavennāryā gṛhaṃ rasābhipūritam |
anāmiṣaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ vaṃśasutādikam || 3.113.1 0||
avākśirā vased yaśca tasyendrapadamuttamam |
udavāsaṃ vased yaśca candraloko’sya satphalam || 11 ||
brahmacārī bhaved yaḥ sa brahmalokaṃ prayāti vai |
pādyamāsanamannaṃ ca jalamāśrayamityapi || 1 2||
dadyādatithaye yajñaḥ pañcāṃgo’yaṃ tapaḥ param |
etāni bhaktiyuktāni mamākṣarapradāni vai || 13 ||
devārthe ca gavārthe ca gurvarthe vīraśāyanam |
tapaḥ prāṇapradānaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ param || 14||
maunaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ proktaṃ cādrohaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ |
anindā cāvitaṇḍā ca tapaḥ paramakaṃ matam || 15||
tenāvicchinnagatikaścājñāpako bhaved divi |
upavāsastapaḥ śreṣṭhamupabhogāḥ phalaṃ matam || 16||
saṃyamena tu śīlena dīrghāyurbalavān bhavet |
ahiṃsā ca tapaḥ śreṣṭhamaiśvaryārogyarūpadā || 17||
phalamūlāśanaṃ cāpi tapo rājyapradaṃ matam |
parṇādasya bhavet svargaṃ vighasāśī hariṃ vrajet || 18||
prāyopaveśinaḥ syādvai sarvatra sukhamuttamam |
śākadaḥ śākavān syācca mahodyānasamanvitaḥ || 19||
goprado dhenumān syācca tṛṇādo’mṛtabhāg bhavet |
snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ tapaḥ phalaṃ param ||3.113.20 ||
divyāḥ striyo bhavantyasya trikālasnāyinaḥ kila |
vāyvāhāraḥ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ yajñaphalaṃ bhavet ||21||
satyavrataṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ svargaṃ ratnānvitaṃ bhavet |
dīkṣā tapaḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ kulaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ bhavet ||22||
jalāśanaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā sudhāśanaṃ phalam |
agnihotraṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ cāgnilokaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ||23||
mantrajāpastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svargottamaṃ phalaṃ matam ||24||
dīkṣopavāsaḥ kamale tapaḥ svargapradaṃ matam |
abhiṣekastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gurutvāpādakaṃ hi tat ||25||
vidyārjanaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ sa vindati |
mānasaṃ tu caran dharmaṃ dharmalokaṃ samaśnute ||26||
tṛṣṇānāśastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ vaikuṇṭhasadṛśam |
pūjanaṃ ca tapo nityaṃ yāyād golokadhāma saḥ ||27||
pitā brahmā prasūḥ pṛthvī gururbrahma sanātanam |
trayaḥ santoṣitā yena sarvaṃ tena kṛtaṃ tapaḥ ||28||
sarve dharmāḥ kṛtāstena vratānyapi kṛtāni ca |
bhaktyā yuktāni caitāni mamākṣarapradāni vai ||29||
nāryā kṛtāḥ sarvadharmāḥ patiryayā prasāditaḥ |
patināpi kṛtā dharmā yena patnī pratoṣitā ||3.113.3 0||
rājñā sarve kṛtā dharmā yena prajāḥ pratoṣitāḥ |
prajābhiśca kṛtā dharmā yābhirnārāyaṇo’rcitaḥ ||3 1||
hiṃsakasya vṛthā mantro makho vṛthā hyadakṣiṇaḥ |
vinā mantraṃ vṛthā homaḥ satyahīnaṃ vrataṃ mṛṣā ||32||
bhāvaṃ vinā vṛthā sevopāstirvṛthā hariṃ vinā |
śīlaṃ vinā vṛthā dharmo vṛthāstitvaṃ sukhaṃ vinā ||33||
sādhuṃ vinā vṛthā dānaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā vṛthā janiḥ |
vṛthā gṛhaṃ vinā lakṣmīṃ vinā mokṣaṃ vṛthā mṛtiḥ ||34||
vinā pātraṃ vṛthā jñānaṃ jayaṃ vinā vṛthā mṛdhaḥ |
vṛthā sarvaṃ vinā snehaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā vṛthārjanam ||35||
santaṃ vinā vṛthā vāsaḥ puṣṭiḥ prasūṃ vinā mṛṣā |
vṛthā dṛṣṭirvinā devaṃ vṛthā karṇo vinā kathām ||36||
vṛthā tvak śrīhareḥ sparśaṃ vinā rūpavatī hyapi |
vṛthā jihvā vinā kṛṣṇaprasādastharasādanam ||37||
vṛthā vāk kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇaguṇānāmantarā tathā |
vṛthā ghrāṇaṃ harergandhaṃ vinā dhīḥ smaraṇaṃ vinā ||38||
dehatattvāni sarvāṇi nirarthakāni māṃ vinā |
balaṃ vyarthaṃ dhṛtirvyarthā yaśo vyarthaṃ ca māṃ vinā ||39||
vidyā ca vāgmitā tarkabuddhirmatiśca śemuṣī |
vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ vinā cārādhanaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||3.113.40||
ṣaṇḍhe yadvad bhavennārī yuvatyapi ca niṣphalā |
tathā sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ vai ṣaṇḍhe mayā nirākṛte ||41 ||
māṃ vinā ca tathā lakṣmi mama santaṃ vinā tu yat |
rājyaṃ smṛddhaṃ kulaṃ mānaṃ prāṇānte niṣphalāyate ||42||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ purātanīṃ vaivartabhūbhṛtaḥ |
pūrveṇa tapasā rājyamāsamudrāntamasya yat ||43||
smṛddhamāsīt samagraṃ vai tvekacakraṃ hi śāsanam |
vyomavārtāvahā dūtāścāsan rājye’sya cetanāḥ ||44||
śāsakāni ca śāstrāṇi naisargikāṇi cābhavan |
tejasāṃ supravāhāśca bhāskarāścābhavan sadā ||45||
śrāvakā vyomadūtāśca rāṣṭre’sya sarvato’bhavan |
jaladūtā jalayāneṣvadhovāhāstathābhavan ||46||
vimānānyabhavam̐ścāsya lokāntaragatānyapi |
sarvaṃ puṇyapratāpena mānavaṃ daivamityapi ||47||
tādātmyamiva cāpannaṃ rājye tasya tadābhavat |
jaḍaṃ cetanarūpāḍhyaṃ karmacāraṃ sadābhavat ||48||
smṛtismarābhavadvṛṣṭiramṛtaṃ ca smṛtismaram |
smṛtismarāṇi sasyāni smṛtismarāḥ samṛddhayaḥ ||49||
smṛtismarā yoṣitaśca dāsā dāsyaḥ smṛtismarāḥ |
upatiṣṭhanti bhogyāni smṛtismarāṇi cāsya vai ||3.113.50||
etādṛśo’bhavat siddho vaivarto nāma bhūpatiḥ |
rājñī tasyaikadā prāha nāmnā kālaṃdharā satī ||51||
rājan yatheśvaraścāste bhūtale’dyāsamo bhavān |
tapasā cārjitaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇuneva tvayā kṣitau ||52||
tathāpi śvetadugdhābhaṃ vartate sāramantarā |
uddhṛtanavanītaṃ vai yathā dugdhaṃ tathā tvidam ||53||
vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā santaṃ vṛṣaṃ vinā |
vinā yajñaṃ vinā dānaṃ vinābhyāgatasatkṛtim ||54||
vinā bhaktiṃ hareścāpi niḥsāraṃ bhāsate mama |
tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja bhaktān prasevaya ||55||
ātmamokṣavṛṣaṃ kṛtvā yāsyasyevaṃ paraṃ padam |
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūnātho mene naiva priyoditam ||56||
sa siṣedhaiva sarvaṃ tannāstikyena punaḥ punaḥ |
na devo mānavaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sādhurvā kasyacit pradaḥ ||57||
tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ tadanyattu mṛṣātmakam |
tapasaiva gamiṣyāmi svargaṃ svargottamaṃ punaḥ ||58||
idaṃ svargaṃ kṣitāvāste dvitīyaṃ tārakāmayam |
saṃlapsyāmi tapasaiva mā cintāṃ kuru bhāmini ||59||
ityevaṃ mānabhānena bhrānto nāgaṇayat priyām |
nāstikyena ciraṃ kālaṃ yāpayāmāsa rājyakṛt ||3.113.60||
athāyuṣyasya vigame bhuktapuṇye hyaśeṣite |
niryayau nijadehādvai kālapāśapraṇoditaḥ ||61||
sahāyā nābhavannasya kecit kālāddhi rakṣaṇe |
prajā rājñyaḥ pradhānāśca putrāḥ putryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||62||
tasthureva vilokyaiva rudantaḥ śokasamplutāḥ |
nāstikasyāsya tatkāle na devā guravo na ca ||63||
nāyayuḥ sādhavaścāpi pretaṃ netuṃ paratra ha |
na dharmo nāpi puṇyaṃ ca na devyo nāpi sadgatiḥ ||64||
mṛtaṃ netuṃ nāyayurvai bhraṣṭaṃ rājyācca dehataḥ |
gatirogho’bhavattasya vinā puṇyaṃ pare sthale ||65||
nendriyādhiṣṭhitaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śaktaṃ gantuṃ tadābhavat |
na mano’haṃmatiprāṇā gantuṃ ca prabhavo’bhavan ||66||
dehānnirgatya jaḍavat saudhāgre sa sthito’bhavat |
pratīkṣate tu puṇyārthaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmaṃ paretakam ||67||
nāstikasya na vai svargaṃ nāyaṃ lokaḥ kathaṃ paraḥ |
devayāno’sya naivāsti dhūmrayāno’pi nāsti ca ||68||
agatirmūrchito mṛtvā duḥkhitaṃ svamamanyata |
śuśoca na mayā dattaṃ jalānnaṃ na makhaḥ kṛtaḥ ||69||
nopakāraḥ kṛtaḥ kvāpi na santaścāpyupāsitāḥ |
na devārhaṇanaivedyastavanādi kṛtaṃ mayā ||3.113.70||
anāthā rakṣitā naiva toṣitā nāpi bhikṣukāḥ |
nābhyāgatāḥ pūjitāśca sādhvyaḥ satyo na satkṛtāḥ ||71||
na godānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ bhūdānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mayā |
sarvarddhisaṃbhṛtaścāhaṃ kṛtavānna kutarkitaḥ ||72||
adya puṇyavihīnasya gatirme nāsti sarvathā |
nopatiṣṭhanti yānāni vimānāni mamāpi vai ||73||
vikṛto naiva tiṣṭhanti pūrvaṃ yā mama cābhavan |
śastrāṇi nopatiṣṭhanti cetanāni yathābhavan ||74||
sāmrājyarddhiḥ parā sattā lupteva naiva dṛśyate |
gataṃ sākaṃ sthūlatattvairvarṣmaṇā saha yogi tat ||75||
sūkṣmayogi kṛtaṃ naiva nāyāti ca sahāyadam |
kṛtaṃ vai labhyate sarvaṃ tapo me vyayatāṃ gatam ||76||
sthūlaṃ mataṃ nāsti sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇaṃ kevalaṃ tu yat |
niḥsāmarthyaṃ vartate’dya kiṃ tena me gatiśca kā ||77||
turyo nopāsito devaḥ kā gatirme’dya tiṣṭhati |
na cāpi yamadūtā me dṛṣṭipathaṃ patantyapi ||78||
yenāhaṃ dharmarājasya purīṃ gacchāmi noditaḥ |
nāstikasya gatirnāsti nāstyakṛtasya sarvathā ||79||
subhagā vā vibhagā vā naikā naivāparā gatiḥ |
aho pretaśarīraṃ me bhāvyaṃ tadapi nāsti vai ||3.113.80||
vāyurūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhūtapretātmakaṃ na ca |
na cakṣurme pūrṇamatra na karṇau na ca jihvikā ||81||
na pādau nāpi hastau ca śaktihīno bhavāmi ha |
manomātraṃ bhavāmyadya sarvasāmarthyavarjitaḥ ||82||
yathā kalalabhāvasya garbhasthasya tathā gatiḥ |
bhānaṃ me nirvikalpābhaṃ taccāpi bhāvanojjhitam ||83||
svapne me darśanaṃ dātuṃ vaktuṃ cāpi na vā prabhuḥ |
yena patnyai kathayāmi gatyarthaṃ puṇyadānakam ||84||
aho nāsti gatiścādya samrājo bhūpatermama |
gataṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva pratāraṇena muṣṇatā ||85||
patnyā me kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ smara nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
taṃ smarāmi prabhuṃ cādyādhamoddhāraṃ sa tārayet ||86||
ityevaṃ manasi kṛtvā nirvikalpe dadhāra mām |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||87||
yathā yathā sa dadhyau māṃ tathā tathā tadāntaraḥ |
prakāśaḥ samabhūttasya tatra mayoditaṃ tadā ||88||
adṛśyena svarūpeṇa yathā vyomagirā tathā |
puṇyaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ naiva tathāparam ||89||
gatistena ca ruddhā te yāmyā gatiśca te na vai |
tādṛk pāpaṃ tvayā naiva kṛtaṃ yāmyagatirbhavet ||3.113.90||
tasmād garbhaṃ tava patnyāḥ punaryāyā hi devarāt |
tava bhrātānujo rājñīṃ spṛśet putro bhaviṣyasi ||91 ||
karasparśena putrasyotpattiryugānusāriṇī |
bhavatyeveti tādṛk tvaṃ bhava putro’nujasya ha ||92||
nijakṣetre tataḥ kṛtvā bhajanaṃ dānapūrvakam |
makhān kṛtvā sādhupūjāṃ paropakṛtimuttamām ||93||
godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca svarṇadānamanuttamam |
datvā kṛtvā vratānyeva jātismaro’tha vai ciram ||94||
bhuktvā bhogān bhajitvā māṃ tato yāsyasi mokṣaṇam |
yāhi svapne tava patnyāstathā tavānujasya ca ||95||
kaivarttasya tataḥ putraḥ kathayitvā tathā bhava |
evamuktvā virarāma garbhavāṇī tadāmbare ||96||
vaivarttaḥ śaktiyug bhūtvā rātrau svapne jagāma ha |
anujāya tathā rājñyai tathyaṃ nyavedayat tataḥ ||97||
kaivartena kareṇāpi spṛṣṭā rājñī ṛtūttarā |
kālaṃdharābhidhānā sā garbhavatī babhūva ha ||98||
suṣuve cāpi kālena sutaṃ jātismaraṃ hi tam |
so’pi bālyādeva padme bhaktiṃ cakāra śārṅgiṇaḥ ||99||
dānāni pradadau sarvavidhāni nijamuktaye |
makhām̐śca kārayāmāsa taḍāgāni samantataḥ || 3.113.10 0||
annasatrāṇi ramyāṇi prapāsthānāni sarvaśaḥ |
dharmaśālā vedaśālāḥ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 101 ||
gobhūhiraṇyadānāni dadau kanyārpaṇāni ca |
gṛhadānāni devānāmālayān pracakāra ha || 1 02||
mama lakṣmi mandirāṇi racayāmāsa tatra ca |
sādhuvāsān kārayitvā sevayāmāsa cātmanā || 10 3||
evaṃ rāṣṭraṃ samagraṃ vai tato bhaktiyutaṃ śuci |
saṃvidhāya prabhuktvā ca bhogān bahuvidhān sukhān || 1 04||
saṃvartto nāma rājarṣirbhūtvā tyaktvā vapurnijam |
yayau cānte mama bhaktyā dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam || 1 05||
tasmād dānāni deyāni sevanīyāśca sādhavaḥ |
pūjanīyā devatāśca makhāḥ kāryā yathādhanam || 1 06||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt karaṇāttathā |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ divyagatiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vividhatapasāṃ phalāni, tānyeva bhaktiyuktāni mokṣadāni, vaivartanṛpasyanāstikyena gatyabhāve nijapatnyāṃ devarāt punarjanma, tata āstikakarmabhirbhaktyā ca mokṣa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||

<3.114>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri sādhvāśrayeṇa mokṣaṇam |
sādhvāśrayeṇa vai rakṣāṃ jīvanaṃ ca tathā śubham || 1 ||
āsīd romapado nāma paśupālo vanottame |
ojasvatyāstaṭe deśe saurāṣṭre siṃhasevite || 2 ||
romapādaḥ paśuvadvai vartate dharmavarjitaḥ |
na snānaṃ bhajanaṃ dānaṃ karoti gṛhadharmyapi || 3 ||
dugdhadadhyannavanyādyaiḥ prāṇayātrāṃ karoti ca |
vanyapaśūn mārayitvā māṃsādanaṃ karotyapi || 4 ||
anyasattākamannādi dūraṃ gatvā niśāmukhe |
kṣetrādibhyaścānayati cauryaṃ karoti vai muhuḥ || 5 ||
evamadharmamārgasya putro’bhavad vṛṣaṃgamaḥ |
vavṛdhe sa yuvā jāto mahiṣīpālako’bhavat || 6 ||
pitrā sākaṃ kadācit sa yayau vane paśuvrataḥ |
pitrā tvāsāditastatra hariṇaḥ sañcaran vane || 7 ||
śvabhiḥ pitrā kṛṣṇamṛgo nipātito vane’ntike |
vṛṣagamo’pi pitrā yuk tūrṇaṃ yayau mṛgaṃ prati || 8 ||
mṛgasya mriyamāṇasya śvabhirvipāṭitasya ha |
krandamānasya duḥkhaṃ ca pādānāṃ bhūmighātanam || 9 ||
vīkṣya dayāparo bhūtvā trāsaṃ paraṃ jagāma saḥ |
kampaṃ cāti jagāmāpi tatyāja taṃ mṛgaṃ hi saḥ ||3.114.1 0||
jagṛhe na mṛgaṃ tatra nisargadayayārditaḥ |
nāhaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayiṣye mārayiṣyāmi na kvacit || 1 1||
pāpaṃ cedṛk prasahyaiva prāṇānāṃ tyājanātmakam |
kaḥ kuryādudarasyārthe mānavo nirdayo yathā || 1 2||
ityevaṃ dayayā yuktastatyāja prāṇihiṃsanam |
vṛṣaṃgamastato yātaḥ kvacidvai kārtike svayam || 1 3||
somanāthasya tīrthārthaṃ sasnau dadarśa śaṃkaram |
ātmakṛtaṃ ca tatpāpaṃ harāya sannyavedayat ||14||
pāpaṃ tasya vinaṣṭaṃ ca śuddhirjātā hṛdo’sya ca |
sādhavastatra cāyātā dṛṣṭāstena natāstataḥ || 15||
pūjitāḥ sevitāścaiṣāṃ satsaṃgaśca kṛtastathā |
prāpto mantra oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatirmama || 16||
tulasyā mālikā prāptā bhaktiḥ prāptā śubhāśrayā |
anivedya śrīharaye bhoktavyaṃ na kadācana ||17||
sādhusatībhyo dātavyaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā |
sevanīyāḥ sādhavaśca bhajanīyo janārdanaḥ || 18||
evaṃ labdhvā sa niyamān nijagṛhamupāyayau |
vartate sā tathaivāpi bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam || 19||
sādhavastatra cāyānti varṣe sakṛd vanāntare |
sevāṃ labdhvā prayāntyeva grāmāntaraṃ vanāntaram ||3.114.20||
vṛṣaṃgamo’pi cānnasya roṭakasya pradānakam |
payasāścāpi dadhnaśca dānaṃ karoti vai tadā ||21 ||
evaṃ dānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ bahvasyātivyajāyata |
athaivaṃ prāptakālo’sya pitā mṛtyumupāgataḥ ||22||
yamadūtāḥ śastrahastā āyayurvai bhayaṃkarāḥ |
cukrośa bahudhā trasto mārayantīti vai muhuḥ || 23||
mocayantu ca māṃ ke’pi yāmyebhyo bāndhavā mama |
mama nāḍīstroṭayanti praharanti ca mudgaraiḥ ||24||
rakṣayantu janā māṃ vai māṃ gṛhiṇi prarakṣaya |
putra māṃ rakṣaya dīnaṃ tāḍyamānaṃ yamānugaiḥ || 25||
ityevaṃ krośamānaṃ taṃ putra uvāca re pitaḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smara rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ||26|||
japa mantraṃ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatirmama |
ityevaṃ pradadau mantraṃ pitre lakṣmi sa putrakaḥ ||27||
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho |
hare viṣṇo hare svāmin śrīpate puruṣottama ||28||
evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ cakre tāvad dūtā bhayaṃ gatāḥ |
visṛjya pitaraṃ tasthurdūre ca jagadurmithaḥ ||29||
asmadbhāgo hyayaṃ gopaḥ putreṇa vipramocitaḥ |
mantra datvā harerasmai bhajanena ca pāvitaḥ ||3.114.30||
ityevaṃ pravadantyeva yamadūtā yadā tadā |
sādhūnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra yadṛcchayā samāgatam ||3 1 ||
putraḥ svāgatasammānaṃ pracakāra ca satvaram |
sādhavo vīkṣya kālāntaṃ dadau vāri prasādajam ||32||
pitā papau haristāvat samāyāto gajasthitaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ svayameva ha ||33||
romapādaṃ viniṣkāsya dehānninye paraṃ padam |
putrayogena sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ cāntakālikam ||34||
piturjātaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca dānaphalaṃ subhaktiyuk |
evaṃ lakṣmi bhaktiyogād bhaktayogāt kṣaṇāntare ||35||
pāpināmapi mokṣaḥ syāt kāryo’taḥ satsamāgamaḥ |
vṛṣaṃgamo’pi dehānte mama dhāma gato hyanu ||36||
śṛṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi rakṣaṇaṃ sādhusaṃgataḥ |
āsīdeko mahān cauro nagrabhaṃgo’tidāruṇaḥ ||37||
viṃśaticaurayug rātrau sahetiluṇṭati gṛhān |
yeṣāṃ śrutaṃ mahādravyaṃ tacchidraṃ cintayatyatha ||38||
prāpte’nukūlasamaye cauryaṃ karoti dāruṇam |
mārayitvā tāḍayitvā mardayitvā janān dhanam ||39||
svarṇarūpyamayaṃ ratnamayaṃ harati modate |
evaṃ vai vartamānasyaikadā kāryavaśād dine ||3.114.40||
rājasaudhe svarṇabhūṣānirmātā svarṇakārakaḥ |
ciramitraṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ rājapathe tadā ||41||
nagrabhaṃgo’pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā saharṣo militaḥ pathi |
kuśalaṃ cāpi papracchodyogaṃ papraccha vai tataḥ ||42||
svarṇakāraḥ samastaṃ svaṃ vṛttāntaṃ prāha taṃ nijam |
adya māse tu nṛpaterbhūṣāracanakāryakṛt ||43||
gacchāmi rājasaudhaṃ ca yatrāste svarṇakoṭikam |
mauktikānāṃ sahasrāṇi ratnānāmayutānyapi ||44||
yatra kośe bhavantyeva tatpārśve śubhamandire |
svarṇaśilpāḥ svarṇakārāḥ kurmastvābharaṇāni vai ||45||
nagrabhaṃgastataḥ prāha yadi te rocate vacaḥ |
kathayāntaḥpraveśasya rātrimārgaṃ tu nirjanam ||46||
corayāmi suvarṇādi bhāgaṃ dāsyāmi te’pi ca |
ityuktaḥ svarṇakāro vai darśayāmāsa tatpatham ||47||
sthānaṃ ca niḥsṛtiṃ cāpi guptadvārāṇi yāni ca |
upayuktāni śastrāṇi dṛḍhahetīnadarśayat ||48||
yuktaguptahārikāṃ cādarśayannirgamaṃ tathā |
tato rātrau svasārthena nagrabhaṃgo viveśa tam ||49||
saudhaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇarūpyaratnamauktikamuttamam |
corayitvā cāti gupto dudrāvālakṣito janaiḥ ||3.114.50||
datvā sarvaṃ sahāyebhyo’preṣayattān vanāntare |
bhūgarte tad vinikṣeptuṃ samādiśad drutaṃ nijān ||51||
sa tu śramāpanodārthaṃ gañjāpānārthamutsukaḥ |
śanairbrāhme muhūrte vai yayau śrīnagarād bahiḥ ||52||
yatrāsan sādhavaḥ śaivā gañjāpānāgnitāpasāḥ| |
tatra gatvā yayāce vai pānaṃ tāmālagāñjikam ||53||
neme bhaktyā kṛtrimayā cakāra daṇḍavattathā |
niṣasāda samīpe ca mudrāmupāyanaṃ dadau ||54||
sādhavo’pi yathā bhaktaṃ tathā matvānusevakam |
labdhvā mudrāṃ ca pūjāyāṃ dadustasmai tamālakam ||55||
papau nidrāṃ kṛtavām̐śca prātaḥ sūryodayaṃ prati |
jajāgāra tatastatra tasthau mādhyandināvadhi ||56||
bhojanādi cakāraiva śramaṃ cāpanudattathā |
sārthacaurāḥ samastāste garte nikṣipya taddhanam ||57||
yayuste vanamārgeṇa nijagrāmaṃ hi yojanam |
tāvannṛpagṛhe vyaktaṃ jātaṃ cauryaṃ dhanasya tat ||58||
pādacikitsakān kṛtvā cāgre rājñastu sainikāḥ |
caurān mārgayituṃ prātarnirgatāḥ śastradhāriṇaḥ ||59||
śrīnagarādaśvavārāḥ saha pādacikitsakaiḥ |
vane gatvā jagṛhustān gacchataḥ kheṭakaṃ nijam ||3.114.60 ||
tāḍayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cānayāmāsureva tān |
nṛpaṃ prati tathā kārāgāre rurudhurulbaṇān ||61 ||
atha sādhuprasaṃgena nagrabhaṃgastu rakṣitaḥ |
rājaikagārikaścāpi rājabhaṭairna lakṣitaḥ ||62||
anye caurā nigaḍeṣu nikṣiptā daṇḍitā hatāḥ |
śrutvāyaṃ nagrabhaṃgastu jīvanaṃ sādhusaṃgataḥ ||63||
nirbādhaṃ vai nijaṃ matvā sādhūnaprārthayanmudā |
sādhudharmo mayā pālyo dīkṣā grāhyā ca sādhavī ||64||
sādhusevā prakartavyā sādhurbhavāmi cādyataḥ |
vacmyahaṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ me kṛtyaṃ sādhujanāgrataḥ ||65||
caurye bahuvidhaṃ cāhaṃ kṛtavānasmi vai muhuḥ |
taddoṣaiśca yathā mukto bhavāmi kuruto’naghāḥ ||66||
śaraṇāgatarakṣārthamudyatāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā |
teṣāṃ prasaṃgataścāhaṃ jīvāmyanye mṛtāḥ kila ||67||
tasmādvairāgyamāsādya bhajāmi parameśvaram |
sādhusevāṃ kariṣye’pi sādhurbhūtvā nirantaram ||68||
ityarthitāḥ sādhavaste cidambarāyanādayaḥ |
prāyaścittaṃ kārayitvā kṣālayitvāghasañcayān ||69||
pāvayitvā nagrabhaṃgaṃ dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ vyadhuḥ |
so’pi pāpavinirmukto nāmnā bhāgavatāyanaḥ ||3.114.70||
bhakto’bhavat sadā sādhuścābhajanmāṃ pareśvaram |
sādhusevāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā tīrthārthaṃ cākṣarasthalīm ||71 ||
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīṃ mokṣaṃ yayau sarastaṭe |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sādhusaṃgena rakṣaṇam ||72||
svātmārpaṇena mokṣaśca mayā tasya kṛto’tra vai |
athānyatte kathayāmi kathānakaṃ purābhavam ||73||
āsīt purā mahāsādhuḥ śukāyano’tidhārmikaḥ |
bhajate māṃ sadā rātridinaṃ śroparameśvaram ||74||
aparigrahasarvasvo digvāsā matparāyaṇaḥ |
āmravṛkṣatale vāsaṃ kurute bhojanaṃ phalaiḥ ||75||
vanyaiḥ patrairdalaiḥ kandaiḥ kusumairvahate’danam |
kuṃkumavāpikāpūrve vane vasati sarvadā ||76||
śaityaṃ tāpaṃ ca sahate vṛṣṭiṃ sahate kṣuttṛṣām |
nityaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ prātaḥ snātvā ca kurute saraḥ ||77||
evaṃ madhyāhnake bhikṣāmekabhuktāṃ karoti ca |
sāyaṃ me kīrtanaṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā svāpaṃ karoti ca ||78||
mūrtiṃ me tvāmravṛkṣasya stambe citramayīṃ sadā |
saṃrakṣati prapūjyaināṃ dhyāyati hṛdaye’nvaham ||79||
āmravaṇaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ priyaṃ cāsya sadābhavat |
so’pi cāmraphalānyeva nivedayati me muhuḥ ||3.114.80||
evaṃ vai vartamānasya cāmravṛkṣaprapoṣiṇaḥ |
ekadā daivayogena vane vahnirvyajāyata ||81||
tṛṇapuñjāḥ stambapuñjāḥ patrapuñjāstathauṣadhiḥ |
jvalitā jvālayā sarvā vṛkṣāśca jvalitāstadā ||82||
nijasthānasya niyataścāmro’pi jvalitastadā |
tato vahniḥ samantādvai prajajvālātivegataḥ ||83||
vāyunā preritastīkṣṇo bhayaṃkaro’tidāruṇaḥ |
sādhuścāyaṃ sthito dhyāne’cintayanmāṃ hariṃ tadā ||84||
mayā tvākāśavāṇyā vai bodhitaḥ sa muhurmuhuḥ |
yāhi dūraṃ vihāyaitān vṛkṣān dagdho’tra mā bhava ||85||
sa cāha vāṇīṃ naivāhaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi cāśrayān |
yatrāhaṃ sarvathā naijaṃ sthānaṃ ca jīvanaṃ gṛham ||86||
āśrayaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ prāpnomi tām̐styajāmi na |
ime me bāndhavāḥ sarve pitaro vāpi bālakāḥ ||87||
mātaro vallikāḥ sarvāstāḥ kathaṃ cotsṛjāmi vai |
nāhaṃ kṛtaghnaḥ svārthaśca nāhaṃ pāpo bhavāmi ca ||88||
yeṣāṃ phalaiḥ sujīvāmi yacchāyāyāṃ vasāmi ca |
yadrasaiḥ poṣaṇaṃ yāmi tām̐styaktvā kva prayāmyaham ||89||
neme bandhanakartāro jaḍā vijātayastvime |
na me kuṭumbinaḥ kintu kṛtasevā ime mama ||3.114.90||
tādṛśān sevakān nityaṃ paropakāraśālinaḥ |
divāniśaṃ sahāyām̐śca madāśrayāniva sthitān ||9 1 ||
sadguṇaśālino vanyān kathaṃ dagdhvā prayāmyaham |
dagdho bhavāmi cātraiva nāhaṃ yāsyāmi cāparam ||92||
sādhuścāhaṃ titikṣuśca titikṣavo drumā ime |
sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣāśca tām̐styaktvā na vrajāmyataḥ ||93||
yadvā tadvā bhavatvatra bhasma vā jīvanaṃ ca vā |
sahayogena bhāvyaṃ vai sahapoṣyeṇa sādhunā ||94||
ityuktvā noccacālāpi nottasthau dhairyaśevadhiḥ |
brahmadhyātā niṣasāda yathā tathaiva cāsthitaḥ ||95||
dayā snehaśca sādhūnāṃ mahān dharmo bhavet sadā |
samarthamupajīvyemaṃ tyajeyaṃ kakṣamadya vai ||96||
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣa drumānimān ||97||
ityevaṃ śrāvayan vāṇīṃ sādhurjajāpa mānase |
māṃ dhyātvā ca tadā pratyayaikatānena bhāvataḥ ||98||
athāgnirdāhayāmāsa pārśvabhāgaṃ hi yoginaḥ |
pādau hastau jaṭāṃ skandhau romāṇi carma sarvataḥ ||99||
tathāpi māṃ bhajam̐stasmāt sthānāccacāla naiva ha |
athāhaṃ taṃ satyasādhuṃ śaraṇāgatarakṣakam || 3.114.10 0||
dehādyanādaradharmaṃ cātmaniṣṭhāparāyaṇam |
bhaktaṃ me ca videhaṃ taṃ jñātvāvocaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu ||1. 1 ||
prasanno’smi virāgātte sādhudharmasamanvitān |
dayādharmasya bāhulyād bhakterme mānase sthiteḥ || 1 02||
varaṃ vṛṇu samartho’smi so’haṃ sākṣānnarāyaṇaḥ |
yaṃ tvaṃ vidvan dhyāyasi vai yadarthaṃ tvaṃ niveditaḥ ||1 03||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ tava vṛttāntakaṃ dṛṣṭvā pratoṣitaḥ || 1 04||
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva sādho tvaṃ dadāmi sarvamiṣṭakam |
sādhuśca manasā vavre vṛkṣasya ca vanasya ca || 1 05||
saṃbhavaṃ rasasampannaṃ yatharddhaṃ prāk tathaiva ha |
ahaṃ jñātvā dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ tatsādhau parasaukhyadām || 1 06||
prīto’haṃ cāmṛtadṛṣṭyā siktavān cāmramuttamam |
sarvān drumān vallikāśca kṣetraṃ vanaṃ samastakam || 1 07||
siktavān pīyūṣadṛṣṭyojjīvayaṃ vanamuttamam |
tataḥ phalāni patrāṇi śākhāḥ puṣpāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 1 08||
vane pūrvasthiteścāpi smṛddhāni cābhavan punaḥ |
vahniḥ śāntiṃ gataḥ sarvo bhasmāpi tatra nāsti ca || 1 09||
sarvaṃ vahnikṛtaṃ karma līnaṃ matkṛtirudgatā |
evaṃ divyaṃ vanaṃ cāmravaṇaṃ jātaṃ saro’ntike || 3.114.1 10||
bhāgavatāyanaṃ sādhuṃ bhaktimantaṃ samāśritam |
sarvārthasiddhimāpat tadvanaṃ tathā satastu yaḥ || 11 1||
āśritaḥ sa labhet siddhiṃ sādhunā kalpitāṃ śubhām |
sādhuḥ so’yaṃ bhāgavatāyano me dhāmni rājate || 11 2||
muktiṃ gato hi kālena kṛpayā bhajanena me |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 13||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhvāśrayeṇa romapādapaśupālasya mokṣaṇaṃ, nagrabhaṃgākhyacaurasya sādhusamāgamena rājabhayād rakṣaṇam, āmravaṇavṛkṣādinām vahnidagdhānāṃ bhāgavatāyanasādhusahavāsena punarujjīvanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||

<3.115>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
ahaṃ jātā bahuvāraṃ sṛṣṭau vai bhavatā saha |
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇī śrīśca bhārgavī mādhavī ramā || 1 ||
vṛndā ca tulasī śivarājñīśrīḥ kamalā pramā |
padmā vidyāparā padmāvatī śatasahasraśaḥ || 2 ||
mama rūpāṇi loke’tra vidyante śrīhare prabho |
jijñāsā me samutpannā mahālakṣmīḥ kadā katham || 3 ||
samutpannā ca kinnāmnī pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
yadyapyahaṃ vijānāmi śvaśrūṃ me jananīṃ tava || 4 ||
mahālakṣmīṃ cātha gajānanāṃ surāṣṭrake’parām |
camatkārapure jātāṃ kṣīrodasāgarodbhavām || 5 ||
dvitīyāṃ tāṃ vijānāmi tathā mahāhiraṇmayīm |
tṛtīyāṃ tāṃ vijānāmi tadanyā yadi bhūsthitā || 6 ||
mahākāryakarī cāste cet tāṃ mahyaṃ prakīrtaya |
yāṃ śrutvā sampraharṣāmi yadbalaṃ ca camatkṛtim || 7 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi vartamānāṃ tu bhūtale |
camatkārakarīṃ pūjyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 8 ||
kāñcanyāṃ tu nagaryā sā mātā vai rājate satī |
purā śaṃbhormohanārthaṃ kāmadevaḥ samāyayau || 9 ||
kailāse daivakāryārthaṃ śaṃkareṇa sa bhasmitaḥ |
citrakarmā gaṇo bhasma kiñcid dhṛtvā tu puttalam || 3.115.1 0||
racayāmāsa tatraivāveśayāmāsa jīvanam |
bālakaścetanaḥ so’pi sañjāto roṣavānati || 1 1||
śatarudrīyapāṭhī ca papāṭha śaṃkarāntike |
śaṃbhurbhūtvā prasannastaṃ varārthaṃ prāha vai tadā || 1 2||
varaṃ vavre sa me rājyaṃ trailokye syādakaṇṭakam |
pratiyoddhrastraśastrāṇi vṛthā bhavantu sarvathā || 1 3||
mamāstraśastramantrāśca mā bhavantu vṛthā kvacit |
tathetyāha tadā śaṃbhuḥ rājyamasmai tathā dadau || 14||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ bhavatvakaṇṭakam |
tadā vīkṣya svayaṃ brahmā bhaṇḍāsuretināmataḥ || 15||
bhaṇḍāsphoṭo hyayaṃ jāta iti matvā jagāda ha |
athāyaṃ rudrabhālasya krodhānalāt prabharjitaḥ ||16||
bhasmotpannaḥ punastasmād rudrajo dānavo’bhavat |
vavṛdhe śīghramevāsau śukraṃ samāhvayat gurum || 17||
mayaṃ samāhvayat pūjāṃ cakre tayostataḥ punaḥ |
mayaṃ taṃ śilpinaṃ prāha purātanī purī tu yā || 18||
daityeśvarāṇāṃ cāste tāṃ bhagnāṃ punarnavāṃ kuru |
tacchrutvā tu mayo gatvā cakre navaṃ puraṃ hi tat || 19||
yatra sthitvā tu daityena trailokyaṃ śāsitaṃ purā |
tatrābhiṣiktaḥ śukreṇa daiteyaiḥ sa mahābalaiḥ ||3.115.20||
śuśubhe parayā smṛddhyā tejobhiśca balādibhiḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuryaṃ vai kirīṭaṃ prāk dadhāra ha ||21 ||
kirīṭaṃ taṃ sajīvaṃ cāvināśyaṃ śukradhāritam |
dadhau bhaṇḍaścāmare dve sajīve śaktiśobhite ||22||
na rogo na ca duḥkhāni jāyante yanniṣevaṇāt |
ātapatraṃ dadhau yasya chāyāsthān nāstrakoṭayaḥ ||23||
bādhante na vināśo na parājayo na jāyate |
vijayākhyaṃ dhanuḥ śaṃkhaṃ ripughnaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||24||
siṃhāsanaṃ taijasaṃ cākṣayaśauryaṃ dadau kaviḥ |
evaṃ rājā samāvṛttastasyāṣṭau tu mahābalāḥ ||25||
pradhānāḥ sainyapūjyāścābhavan trilokigāminaḥ |
indraśatruramitraghno vidyunmālī vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||26||
ugrakarmogradhanvā ca vijayaḥ śrutipāragaḥ |
sarve vai vedaśāstrajñāḥ karmakāṇḍaparāyaṇāḥ ||27||
yuddhaviśāradā māyāviśāradāḥ pratāpinaḥ |
atha daityaṃ viśukraṃ sa dakṣāṃsena sasarja ha ||28||
vāmāṃsena viṣāṃgaṃ sa sasarja duṣṭaśekharam |
dhūminīṃ bhaginīṃ cāpi kaṇṭhāt sasarja bhaṇḍakaḥ ||29||
sumohinī kumudvatī citrāṃgī sundarī tathā |
catasro vanitāstasya daityaputryo’rpitāstadā ||3.115.30||
syandanāsturagā nāgā vimānāni sahasraśaḥ |
sambabhūvurjitalokāḥ śukrācāryamatānugāḥ ||31 ||
bhaṇḍo babhūva bhakto’sau śaṃkarasya sadaityakaḥ |
gṛhe gṛhe rudrayajñāstadā cāsan samantataḥ ||32||
ṛco yajūm̐ṣi sāmāni tantrāṇi ca pratigraham |
pravartante sma daityānāṃ samūhe’pi tathādhvare ||33||
tadā yajñeṣu daityānāṃ bubhujurhavyabhojinaḥ |
bhrātṛbhyāmugravīryābhyāṃ pradhānaiśca balaistathā ||34||
diśo jigāya sarvāśca reje mahendravattadā |
brahmāṇḍaṃ khaṇḍayāmāsa śauryavīryasamucchritaḥ ||35||
bahuvāraṃ devatādyā nirjitā raṇamūrdhani |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstaṃ dṛṣṭvā dīptatejasam ||36||
palāyanaparāḥ sarve sve sve dhāmni sadāvasan |
kecitpātālagarbheṣu kecidambudhivāriṣu ||37||
kecid digantakoṇeṣu kecit kuñjeṣu bhūbhṛtām |
vilīnā bhṛśavitrastā viceruśchannaveṣiṇaḥ ||38||
pitṝn siddhānsādhyadevān nāgān yajñān digīśvarān |
brahmāṇaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca rudraṃ vajriṇamityapi ||39||
matvā tṛṇāyitān sarvān lokān bhaṇḍaḥ śaśāsa ha |
evaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtavato bhaṇḍasya jitakāśinaḥ ||3.115.40||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyatītāni tataḥ param |
hīyamānabalān devān samprekṣya kamalāpatiḥ ||41||
ugraṃ bhaṇḍāsuraṃ hantuṃ trailokyaṃ cāpi rakṣitum |
sasarja sahasā māyāṃ svātmarūpāṃ vimohinīm ||42|||
nijarūpā lalitā sā babhūva paradevatā |
mahālakṣmīḥ svayaṃ yāsti kaṃbharā jananī mama ||43||
pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇapariṣkṛtacaturbhujā |
sā mātā paramā śaktiḥ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī ||44||
yā mahāvaiṣṇavī daityavrātavilayakāriṇī |
tāmuvāca harirmāyāṃ bhaṇḍaṃ daityaṃ niṣūdaya ||45||
evamājñāṃ samāsādya sā yayāce’psarogaṇam |
harirdadāvapsarasaḥ sāpi viśvācikādibhiḥ ||46||
yayau yā himagiriṃ yatrāste bhaṇḍakāsuraḥ |
tatra sā tu mahālakṣmīrmūle campakaśākhinaḥ ||47||
nivāsamakarod ramyaṃ gāyantīṃ madhurasvaram |
śrutvā daityaścāgatastāṃ yayāce madanāturaḥ ||48||
sāpi hāvām̐stathā bhāvān ceṣṭā vārtāśca mañjulāḥ |
kṛtvāharaddhi daityānāṃ manāṃsi bhaṇḍakasya ca ||49||
visasmarustadā bhaṇḍo daityāḥ sāyaṃ śrīśaṃkaram |
sandhyāṃ stotraṃ pūjanaṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ sevanādikam ||3.115.50||
vijahuste yajñakāryaṃ tathā sarvaṃ śubhāvaham |
evaṃ śukraṃ nijācāryaṃ visasmaśca pūjanam ||51||
iyaṃ devī mohayitvā rurodha daityapuṃgavān |
avamānahataḥ śukraḥ kopito’bhūttadā muhuḥ ||52||
daityānāha na vai yogyā bhavanto rājyaṛddhaye |
patantu pararājyādvai mado vo yātu saṃkṣayam ||53||
jaḍībhūtānasurām̐śca māyākṛtān vilokya tu |
indrādyāḥ kṛtasannāhāstapo’rthaṃ yamunāṃ yayuḥ ||54||
makhamāraṃbhayāmāsurvaiṣṇavaṃ baladaṃ śubham |
nārāyaṇyā mahālakṣmyāḥ pūjāṃ cakrurhi devatāḥ ||55||
ugre tapasi saṃsthānā japadhyānaparāyaṇā |
ananyamānasā lakṣmīḥ sāvadhānā babhūva sā ||56 ||
bahvabdeṣu vyatīteṣu svayaṃ śukraḥ purohitaḥ |
daityānāha bhavatāṃ vai vināśārthaṃ surādayaḥ ||57||
yajñaṃ dhyānaṃ tapaścāpi kurvanta yamunātaṭe |
jātimātraṃ hi bhavatāṃ haniṣyati surādayaḥ ||58||
hariḥ sarvān bhavatpakṣān haniṣyatyacirāt khalu |
tenaiva nirmitā māyā mahālakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ||59||
tasyāṃ mugdhān bhavataśca vīkṣyendrādyāstapanti vai |
gatvā śīghraṃ tatra vighnaṃ samācarata vai drutam ||3.115.60 ||
śrutvā bhaṇḍāsurayuktā daityā yuddhaviśāradāḥ |
yamunātaṭamāsādya vighnaṃ cakrurmahāraṇam ||61 ||
tapovighnakarān daityān vīkṣya bhaktārthakāriṇī |
mahālakṣmīrakarodvai mahāprākāramujjvalam ||62||
alaṃghyaṃ dānavaidaityairindraprasthābhidhaṃ dṛḍham |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍakaścāpi viṣaṇṇaḥ svapuraṃ yayau ||63||
śrutavarmā sakhā bhaṇḍaṃ prāha rājan vacaḥ śṛṇu |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ rājyaṃ tava śivārpitam ||64||
tato’ntastava rājyasya kālo’yaṃ śivanoditaḥ |
aśakyapratikāryo’yaṃ tasmāt kālaṃ prayāpaya ||65||
kāle tu bhogaḥ kartavyaḥ kāle nivṛttiruttamā |
ityupadeśaṃ saṃśrutvā vireme bhaṇḍakāsuraḥ ||66||
devatā indraprasthe vai viśāle vanavistare |
kuṇḍaṃ suyogyavistāraṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ nidhāya ca ||67||
kṛtvā dṛḍhāṃ pratijñāṃ vai mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjya ca |
parito havanaṃ cakruḥ prītyarthaṃ tu śriyā hareḥ ||68||
brahmabhūtā bhaviṣyāmo bhokṣyāmo vā triviṣṭapam |
ityevaṃ havanaṃ cakrustāvat prādurbabhūva ha ||69||
cakrākāraṃ mahattejastanmadhye pārameśvarī |
jaganmātā jīvadātrī nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ||3.115.70||
vyūhatejomayī brahmānandinī harisundarī |
pāśāṃkuśekṣukodaṇḍapadmamālā lasatkarā ||71 ||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mumuhurdevāḥ praṇemurvigatajvarāḥ |
tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīmahālakṣmīṃ lalitāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ prasūm ||72||
jaya lakṣmi jaganmātarjaya lakṣmi parātpare |
jaya kalyāṇanilaye jaya sarvakalātmike ||73||
jaya brāhmi mahālakṣmi brahmātmike parātmike |
jaya nārāyaṇi śānte jaya śrīlalite rame ||74||
jaya śrīvijaye devīśvari śrīde jayarddhide |
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāyai sahasrānanalocane ||75||
namaḥ sahasrahastābjapādapaṃkajaśobhite |
aṇoraṇutare lakṣmi mahato’pi mahīyasi ||76||
atalaṃ te smṛtau pādau vitalaṃ jānunī tava |
rasātalaṃ kaṭiste ca kukṣiste pṛthivī matā ||77||
hṛdayaṃ bhuvaḥ svaste’stu mukhaṃ satyaṃ śiro matam |
dṛśaścandrārkadahanā diśaḥ karṇā bhujāḥ surāḥ ||78||
marutastu tavocchvāsā vācaste śrutayo matāḥ |
krīḍā te lokaracanā sakhā te parameśvaraḥ ||79||
āhāraste sadānando vāsaste hṛdaye hareḥ |
dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpāṇi rūpāṇi bhuvanāni te ||3.115.80||
śiroruhā ghanāste vai tārakāḥ kusumāni te |
dharmādyā bāhavaste ca kālādyā hetayastava ||81 ||
yamāśca niyamāścāpi karapādanakhāstava |
stanau svāhāsvadhākārau sarvajīvanadugdhadau ||82||
prāṇāyāmastava śvāso rasanā te sarasvatī |
mahīruhāste’ṅgaruhāḥ prabhātaṃ vasanaṃ tava ||83||
ādau dayā dharmapatnī sasarja nikhilāḥ prajāḥ |
hṛtsthā tvaṃ vyāpinī lakṣmīrmohinī tvaṃ tathā parā ||84||
idānīṃ dṛśyase brāhmī nārāyaṇī priyaṃkarī |
namastasyai mahālakṣmyai gajamukhyai namo namaḥ ||85||
sarvaśaktyai sarvadhātryai mahālakṣmyai namo namaḥ |
yā sasarja virājaṃ ca tato’jaṃ viṣṇumīśvaram ||86||
rudraṃ tathā surāgryām̐śca tasyai lakṣmyai namo namaḥ |
triguṇāyai nirguṇāyai hariṇyai te namo namaḥ ||87||
yantratantrātmikāyai te jaganmātre namo namaḥ |
vāgvibhūtyai gurutanvyai mahālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||88||
kaṃbharāyai sarvavidyābharāyai te namo namaḥ |
jayālalitāpāñcālīramātanvai namo namaḥ ||89||
padmāvatīramāhaṃsīsuguṇājñāśriyai namaḥ |
namaḥ stutā prasannaivaṃ chandayāmāsa sadvaraiḥ ||3.115.90||
devāḥ prāhuśca tuṣṭā ced bhaṇḍāsuraṃ vināśaya |
durdharaṃ jīvitaṃ saukhyaṃ dehi te śaraṇārthinaḥ ||91||
mahālakṣmīḥ samuvāca muditāḥ santu nirbhayāḥ |
bhaṇḍāsuraṃ nāśayiṣye lalitāhaṃ mahāsatī ||92||
stāvakā me bhaviṣyanti śrīyaśodharmasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
vidyāvinayasampannā nirogā dīrghajīvinaḥ ||93||
putramitrakalatrāḍhyā bhaviṣyanti susampadaḥ |
itilabdhavarā devāḥ satraṃ cakruḥ prapūrṇakam ||94||
atha sā lalitā lakṣmīrvaramālāṃ karotthitām |
anādiśrīmahāviṣṇusvarūpāya parātmane ||95||
tatraiva paśyatāṃ sarvasurāṇāṃ cārpayad gale |
devadundubhayo nedurjayaśabdāstadābhavan ||96||
gītayaścābhavaṃstatrāpsarasāṃ surayoṣitām |
nanṛtuścāpsarasaśca jagurgāndharvasattamāḥ ||97||
ṛṣayaḥ stavanaṃ cakrurāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ |
sādhavo namanaṃ cakruḥ sevāṃ cakruśca pārṣadāḥ ||98||
lakṣmyādyāḥ pūjanaṃ cakrurdampatyoścendraprasthake |
yautakāni daduścāpi bhūṣaṇāni dhanāni ca ||99 ||
ratnāni vividhānyeva dampatībhyāṃ surādayaḥ |
bhojanāni vyadhustatra vivāhānte surādayaḥ || 3.115.10 0||
atha brahmā prajagāda bhaṇḍāsurakṣayāya tu |
mahālakṣmīṃ lalitākhyāṃ parabrahmahariṃ tathā || 10 1||
dharmasya rakṣaṇārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca |
tadā tūrṇaṃ mahālakṣmīrnārāyaṇājñayā tadā || 1 02||
sasmāra divyahetīṃśca cakrādīn divyavigrahān |
āyayurmūrtimantaste tasthuśca purato hareḥ || 1 03||
jagrāha tān mahālakṣmīḥ sarvakāmākṣiṇī satī |
sarvakāmapradasya śrīnārāyaṇasya cājñayā || 104||
sarvadevān sahāyām̐ścādṛśyanārāyaṇānvitān |
nītvā daityānnāśayituṃ pratasthe jayavardhitā || 105||
sainyāni pārṣadānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ dyusadāṃ tathā |
devīnāṃ cāpi siddhānāṃ niryayuḥ sajjahetayaḥ || 1 06||
sahasraśo gavāśvāśca siṃhāḥ śārdūlakāḥ khagāḥ |
vṛṣabhāḥ śarabhāścāpi haṃsāśca garuḍāstathā || 1 07||
vimānāni sahasrāṇi yānāni ca rathāstathā |
sāyudhāḥ kalpajāścendraprasthād viniryayustadā || 1 08||
mahālakṣmīmahāsainyaṃ śrīlakṣmīkamalānvitam |
durgāsatīmahācaṇḍīdevīkoṭisamanvitam || 1 09||
divyaṃ cāvyāhatagati niryayau tvambareṇa tat |
divyāstraśastramantrādyairvardhitaṃ rakṣitaṃ tathā || 3.115.11 0||
gaganaṃ satyalokāntaṃ śabditaṃ sainyagarjaṃnaiḥ |
sarve nārāyaṇāśceśāḥ śrutvā tūrṇaṃ samāyayuḥ || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kāmadevabhasmata utpannasya bhaṇḍāsurasya nāśārthamindraprasthāgatadevānāṃ makhe prādurbhūtalalitāmahālakṣmī sainyasannāhādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 115 ||

<3.116>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri tataḥ sainyāni yoṣitām |
mātṝṇāṃ divyadehānāṃ rejire ca viniryayuḥ || 1 ||
mahākṣmīstathā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ca śāradā |
durgā gaṅgā yamī revā rādhā ramā ca padminī || 2 ||
kamalā śrīḥ pāśavatī ramā māṇikī maṃjulā |
sukhadā kaṃbharālakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā vijayā jayā || 3 ||
suparṇā mādhavī haṃsī bhārgavī suguṇā satī |
nārāyaṇī vāsudevī hariṇī ca hiraṇmayī || 4 ||
śārdūlavāhanā mattā gajānanā ca haṃsinī |
viśvā bhūtiḥ piṃgalākṣī kāmākṣī vallabhā dayā || 5 ||
kārṣṇī vṛndā vaiṣṇavī ca jyoṣṭrī kāmadughānaghā |
bhūrdyaurdhariṇī dhātrī ca bhāratī kariṇī kṛtiḥ || 6 ||
brāhmī raudrī revatī ca māheśvarī kumārikā |
śākrī saurī nairṛtī ca saumyā śikhaṇḍinī śivā || 7 ||
vārāhī nārasiṃhī ca balā raktā sunandinī |
śakunī revatī kālī jayantī cāditistathā || 8 ||
śyāmā vināyakī siddhiḥ ṛddhiśca vinatā svadhā |
uṣā svāhā vaṣaṭkārā jyeṣṭhālakṣmīśca muktikā || 9 ||
māyā ratirmaṃgalā cāmṛtā ṣaṣṭiśca mānasā |
śāntirekādaśī haimī corjaskā puruṣottamī || 3.116.1 0||
etāḥ sarvā hi vaiṣṇavyo mūrdhanyā yoddhṛnāśikāḥ |
tathāparāśca śāṃkaryo kātaro niryayū raṇe || 11 ||
śāṃkarī mālinī caṇḍī vāyavyā dūtikā khagā |
cāmuṇḍā ca śatānandā calacchikhā supicchalā || 1 2||
balā cātibalā mātṛnandā nandāparājitā |
mahākālī bhairavī ca karālī ca gaṇī tathā || 1 3||
mṛtyurmārī mahāmārī ditirghaṭodarī danuḥ |
ulūkī karṇamoṭī ca vajrahastā kapālikā || 14||
piśācī rākṣasī kheṭā bhṛśuṇḍī lāṃgalī tathā |
dhūmrā karālinī caikavīrodumbarī kukkuṭī || 15||
kekarī pretayānā ca krauṃcī śailamukhī sakhī |
kapardinī kāmarūpā rocanā keśinī tathā || 16||
daṃṣṭrālolkāmukhī dhūmraśikhā kṣvelā prakampinī |
sarpakarṇī viśokā ca nikuṃbhā bagalāmukhī || 17||
mākarī kacchapī citrā koṇā ca lāṃgalāvatī |
ayomukhī krodhanā cāśanī hūṃkāriṇī tathā || 18||
mahādevī rudrasaṭā kātyāyanī karālinī |
gaurī sāṃkarṣiṇī devī prāleyī bhūtaḍāmarī || 19||
sṛṣṭigarbhā mahāmāyā khaṭīyārī ca pāśinī |
etāścānyāstamobhūṣā rudrāṇyo niryayurmṛdhe || 3.116.20||
atha sarvāḥ pārameṣṭhyo brahmāṇyaścāpi niryayuḥ |
saṃkrāntayaḥ susiddhānyaḥ siddhayaḥ brahmasārasāḥ || 21 ||
daṇḍanāthā mantranāthā dhūmorṇā mantranāyikā |
śyāmalā yantriṇī ghanaśyāmā saṃgītayoginī ||22||
tripurā cakranāthā ca sāmrājī cakravartinī |
mahāvidyāmnāyanāthā vaidikī simagāstathā ||23||
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā |
vārāhī caiva māhendrī caṇḍikā śoṇavigrahā ||24||
kṣobhiṇī drāviṇī cākarṣiṇī vaśaṃkarī tathā |
unmādinī khecarā ca yaṣṭirmahāṃkuśā tathā ||25||
sarvabījādhivāsinyaścānyāstattvādiśaktayaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyākā niryayuryuddhadurmadāḥ ||26||
mātrākarṣaṇikā devyaścittākarṣaṇikāstathā |
ātmākarṣaṇikāścāpi śarīrākarṣikāstathā ||27||
anaṃgalekhā sarvajṛṃbhaṇā mṛtyupradāyinī |
sarvavyādhiharā rakṣānāmnī rahasyayoginī ||28||
vaśinī jīvanī vahnivāsinī kulasundarī |
śoṣiṇī ca ratiḥ prītiḥ kāntiḥ śāntiśca tuṣṭikā ||29||
puṣṭiḥ śraddhā ca bhūḥ pramāthinī ca nāgavīthikā |
mātaṃgī siddhalakṣmīśca durgāmbā potriṇī tathā ||3.116.30||
yakṣiṇī śaṃkhinī cāpi lākinī hākinī tathā |
śākinī ḍākinī dhātunāthā vārtālikāndhinī ||3 1||
etā anyā arbudābjāḥ śaktayo niryayurmṛdhe |
athendro’psarasaścāpi sādhyāśca viśvadevatāḥ ||32||
viśvakarmā mayo’gniśca rudrāḥ piśācakāstathā |
rākṣasāścāpi gandharvā mitrāśca kinnarāstathā ||33||
vidyādhrāścāpi govindo bhagavān kamalāpatiḥ |
brahmāśviputrau gaṇakā dhanvantariśca vāsukiḥ ||34||
nāgāśca bhūsurāścāpi purohitāśca niryayuḥ |
tadā mṛdaṃgamurajāḥ paṭaho’tukulīgaṇāḥ || 35||
selukā jhallarī rāndyā huḍukā huḍḍukā gharāḥ |
ānakāḥ paṇavāścāpi gomukhāścārdhacandrikāḥ ||36||
yavamadhyā mardalāśca ḍiṇḍimā jharjharāstathā |
varītāścoddhakāścāpi tuhuṇḍā barbarāstathā ||37||
hum̐kārā bherayaścāpi dadhvanuḥ samarodyame |
sarvāśeṣāstraśastraiśca hetibhirmantrakoṭibhiḥ ||38||
sahitāḥ sarvayoddhryaśca rathavājigajādibhiḥ |
mahāyānavimānaiścāyayurbhaṇḍāsurasthalīm ||39||
ambaraṃ sainyasamvyāptaṃ yuddhaghoṣasamanvitam |
vīkṣyāsurāstadā tresurlalitāgamasaṃbhramāt ||3.116.40||
tadāsurāṇāmabhavannarīṣṭāni pade pade |
akāla iva nirbhinnā bhittayo daityapattane ||41||
ghūrṇamānāḥ patanti sma maholkā gaganasthalāt |
bhūkampo hṛtkampanāni tadābhavan punaḥ punaḥ ||42||
dhvajāgravartinaḥ kaṃkā gṛdhrā bakāḥ khagāstathā |
ādityamaṇḍale cakraṃ nāśasūcakamāsa ca ||43||
vāmāṃgāni narāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ dakṣāṃgabhūmayaḥ |
sphuritānyabhavam̐statra dṛśyante ketavo’mbare ||44||
daityastrīṇāṃ ca vibhraṣṭā akāle bhūṣaṇasrajaḥ |
darpaṇānāṃ varmaṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ khaḍgasampadām ||45||
maṇīnāmambarāṇāṃ ca mālinyamabhavattadā |
apatan vedimadhyeṣu bindavaḥ śoṇitāmbhasām ||46||
utpātān vīkṣya santrastā daityāḥ prāhurhi bhaṇḍakam |
bhaṇḍo’pi krodhamāpannaścāhūya mantriṇau tadā ||47||
sabhāyāṃ mantraṇāṃ śīghraṃ cakre yuddhāvalambinīm |
viśukraśca viṣaṃgaśca mantriṇo buddhidāyinau ||48||
tathā sāmantadaityendrā ājñārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ |
avocata viśukraśca sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ||49||
surādyā labdhakālāścāsrākṣuḥ strīṃ balagarvitām |
sajjīkṛtya ca tāṃ devāstayā sākaṃ samāgatāḥ ||3.116.50||
asmān jetuṃ samāyātā hā kaṣṭaṃ vidhinoditam |
abalā jeṣyate’smām̐ścet parihāsāya tad bhavet ||51 ||
asmākaṃ vijayāyādya strījātirabhidhāvati |
yadyapi strī bhavecchatrurhantavyā vijigīṣubhiḥ ||52||
sakacagrahamākṛṣya sānetavyā sadāsikā |
tavaiva ceṭikābhāvaṃ sā duṣṭā saṃśrayiṣyati ||53||
evamuktvā sa bhaṇḍasya krodhaṃ tatra vyavīvṛdhat |
viṣaṃgaśca tataḥ prāha buddhiyuktaṃ sukhāvaham ||54||
sarvaṃ vicārya kartavyaṃ vivekaḥ paramā gatiḥ |
avivekena yatkāryaṃ vināśāyopapadyate ||55||
cārairbalābale jñeye jayasiddhimabhīpsatā |
tiryagityapi nārīti kṣudrā cetyapi rājabhiḥ ||56||
nāvajñā vairiṇāṃ kāryā śaktiḥ sarvatra vidyate |
śaktireva hi sarvatra kāraṇaṃ vijayaśriyaḥ ||57||
keyaṃ ca kiṃbalā kiṃsahāyiketi vicāryatām |
śrutvaivaṃ tu viṣaṃgasya bhaṇḍaḥ prāha ruṣānvitam ||58||
are vidvan matiṃ tyaktvā kimevaṃ śaṃkase striyam |
laliteyaṃ mayā cārairjñātā balavivarjitā ||59||
māyayā strīkadambaṃ sā kṛtvotpādya samāgatā |
nāsti bhayaṃ hi me tasyā dhṛtvānayantu māṃ prati ||3.116.60||
trailokyālaṃghimahimā bhaṇḍaḥ kena vijīyate |
mayā pradaṇḍitā devāḥ śvasituṃ prabhavo’pi na ||6 1 ||
pātāle’bdhau gahvareṣu pracchannāste vasanti vai |
na jānanti striyo mūḍhā vṛthā kalpitasāhasā ||62||
vināśamanudhāvanti hyakāryakṛtadarpikāḥ |
athavā tāḥ puraskṛtya yadyāgacchanti nākinaḥ ||63||
sarve saṃbhūya śaṃbhvādyāstān sampeṣṭumahaṃ kṣamaḥ |
malakaśca kuraṇḍaśca karaṭako balāhakaḥ ||64||
vikaṭaḥ karkaṭakaśca humbako halamallucaḥ |
karkaśaḥ kukkuraścāpi jṛṃbhaṇo ghoṣakastathā ||65||
śirālakaḥ kūpakaśca laḍuno mārakastathā |
viṣeṇaśca parūṣaśca draghaṇaḥ kollaṭastathā ||66||
dāsero mūṣako mahāṇḍaśca kubhāṇḍakastathā|
ete daityā hiraṇyākṣahiraṇyakaśipuprabhāḥ ||67||
teṣāmagre sahasrākṣauhiṇyaḥ syurbhasmaśeṣitāḥ |
māyāvilāsā nāryāstu hāsyā samarasīmani ||68||
tasmāttāṃ keśapāśena dhṛtvānayantu māṃ prati |
anyāḥ sarvāśca gṛhṇantu yathāprāptāṃ nijāṃ nijām ||69||
kuṭilākṣottiṣṭha sainyaṃ sannāhya samantataḥ |
ityābhāṣya camūnāthaṃ sahasratritayādhipam ||3.116.70||
kuṭilākṣaṃ mahāsattvaṃ bhaṇḍaścāntaḥpuraṃ yayau |
tataḥ sajjāḥ kilārāvāḥ samanahyanta dānavāḥ ||71||
paṭṭiśairmudgaraiścāpi bhiṃdurairbhiṇḍipālakaiḥ |
druhaṇaiśca bhūśuṇḍībhiḥ kuṭhārairmusalairapi |||72||
gadābhiśca śataghnībhistriśikhairviśikhairapi |
ardhacakrairmahācakrairdhanurbhiḥ śārṅgadhanvibhiḥ ||73||
daṇḍaiḥ kṣepaṇikāśastrairvajrabāṇairdṛṣadvaraiḥ |

evaṃvidhairāyudhaiste sajjā daityā viniryayuḥ ||75||
sannaddhanijahastāgrā varmitā daityakoṭayaḥ |
aśvārohā gajārohā gardabhārohiṇastathā ||76||
uṣṭrārohā vṛkārohāḥ śunakārohiṇastathā |
kākārohāstathā gṛdhrārohā vyāghrādirohiṇaḥ ||77||

sūkarārohiṇo vyālārohiṇaḥ pretavāhanāḥ ||78||
yānavimānagāścāpi pracelurlalitāṃ prati |

daśākṣauhiṇikāyuktaṃ prāhiṇollalitāṃ prati |
kuṭilākṣastālajaṃghastālabhujastālakaṭiḥ ||3.116.80||
ete bhaṇḍapurasyaiva rarakṣurgopurāṇi vai |
catvāriṃśadakṣauhiṇikānvitāstasthurulbaṇāḥ ||81 ||
ekākṣauhiṇikāṃ naijamandirasyābhito’karot |

dodhūyamānairasibhirnipetuḥ strīmahārṇave ||89||

akṣohiṇyaḥ samagrāstā lakṣmīsainyairvibheditāḥ |
