puṣṭikāmaḥ prakurvīta bhūmisaṃsthāṃ dhṛtestulām |
tolayitvā kṣaṇaṃ tatra vandeta parameśvarīm ||74||
namaste te mahālakṣmi dhārmiki dharmasākṣiṇi |
sanātani sarvapāpanāśinī puṇyadāyinī ||75||
svarṇabhare kambhare tvaṃ rūpyabhare pramuktide |
rasāḍhye rasade devi mātarlakṣmi tule namaḥ ||76||
tvayā dhṛtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ sarvadānaphalaprade |
hareḥ priye mama śuddhiṃ prakāraya samarpitā ||77||
ityuktvā cāvatīryātha gurave’rddhaṃ nivedayet |
ṛtvigbhyo vai paramardhaṃ dadyādudakapūrvakam ||78||
gurave grāmaratnāni ṛtvigbhyaścārpayettathā |
teṣāṃ tadājñayā svarṇādyanyebhyo’pi paraṃ diśet ||79||
dīnānāthanirādhārān satīsādhvīsuyoṣitaḥ |
bālāṃśca bālikāścāpi samarcya sādhusajjanān ||3.125.80 ||
brāhmaṇān bhikṣukān viprān brahmiṣṭhān pārṣadānprabhūn |
dānapātrāṇi tatra syurye ye tāṃstān tato’param ||81||
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ śarkarādi bhaktyā sampūjya cārpayet |
na ciraṃ dhārayed gehe dhanaṃ dānārthatolitam ||82||
prokṣitaṃ kalpitaṃ vāpi svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ dhanaṃ ca vā |
tiṣṭhed bhayāvahaṃ yasmācchokavyādhikaraṃ bhavet ||83||
śīghraṃ parasvīkaraṇācchreyaḥ prāpnoti dānavān |
svagṛhe dānapūtaṃ yad devasvaṃ vipranāṇakam ||84||
sādhutvaṃ ca satītvaṃ ca vidhavāsvaṃ pracoritam |
dhanaṃ yattannijīyaṃ svaṃ nāśayitvaiva gacchati ||85||
upabhuktaṃ na saukhyāya rogāya sajjate hi tat |
kulahāniphalaṃ tasya nirvaṃśatvakaraṃ hi tat ||86||
tasmād devadhanaṃ sādhudhanaṃ vipradhanaṃ tathā |
dharmadhanaṃ na vai bhakṣyaṃ dīnanārīdhanaṃ ca vā ||87||
na vā sthāpyaṃ dhane naije sarvanāśaphalaṃ yataḥ |
śuktako’bhūt purā vipro devasādhuprapūjakaḥ ||88||
sādhubhiḥ saha devasya pratimādiprapūjane |
bhaktārpitaṃ dhanaṃ bhuṃkte ḍhabbukaṃ śarkarādikam ||89||
pakṣapātena nityaṃ sa bhuṃkte’datvodaraṃbharaḥ |
tena pāpena tasyābhūt puṇyakṣayaḥ samantataḥ ||3.125.90||
pratyuta pāpavān jāto dāridryaduḥkhaduḥkhitaḥ |
gṛhalakṣmīrvinaṣṭā ca patnī naṣṭā sutādayaḥ ||9 1 ||
kṣetraṃ ca vāṭikā naṣṭā ṛṇavān samajāyata |
kṣudhāvṛto’tidīnaśca bhikṣukaḥ samajāyata ||92||
netrahīno dharmahīno bubhukṣitaḥ pade pade |
pāpavṛttiścābhavacca mṛtyumukhaṃ gato’bhavat ||93 ||
yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya śvapacatvaṃ tato gataḥ |
kālāntare punastiryagyonyādau samajāyata ||94||
evaṃ lakṣmi dhanaṃ sādhvyā devyā devasya yoginaḥ |
hānidaṃ na gṛhe rakṣyaṃ samūlāpahṛtipradam ||95||
tulādānaṃ hi vidhinā nijabhāraṃ dhanādikam |
evaṃ dadyād yo manujo mahendrādipadaṃ labhet ||96||
lokapālādhināthaḥ syāt śāśvataṃ svargamṛcchati |
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā ||97||
pūjyamāno devatābhirbhuktvā svargaṃ mahāciram |
satyalokaṃ mahālakṣmīlokaṃ śrīnagaraṃ vrajet ||98||
viṣṇupuraṃ harerlokaṃ golokaṃ sa vrajettathā |
bhaktimān yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ satpadaṃ labhet ||99||
dīyamānaṃ mahādānaṃ prapaśyati praśaṃsati |
nivedayati lokebhyaḥ kālāntare smaratyapi || 3.125.10 0||
śṛṇoti vā prapaṭhati bhaktibhāvayuto janaḥ |
nārī vā bhaktiyuktā sā rājā rājñī sakhā sakhī ||1 01 ||
vipro viprāṇikā cānyā dāsī dāso’paro’pi vā |
taddaśāṃśaṃ phalaṃ tatra labhate dānaśaṃsakaḥ || 102||
svarge dānaphalaṃ bhuktvā bhaktyā yāsyati matpadam |
tulādānaphalaṃ caivaṃ viśiṣyate samastataḥ || 103 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahādānaṣoḍaśakeṣu tulāpuruṣadānavidhinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 125 ||

<3.126>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādānaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñakam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyapradaṃ deyaṃ śubhāptaye || 1 ||
pavitraṃ divasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tulāpuruṣadānavat |
ṛtviṅmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣāpātrāmbarāṇi ca || 2 ||
saṃgṛhyopoṣitaḥ prātardevāvāhanamācaret |
puṇyāhaṃ vācayet vipraiḥ kārayitvādhivāsanam || 3 ||
pratimāṃ kānakīṃ dharmadevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
kuṃbhaṃ tu kānakaṃ tadvad rājataṃ maṇḍape nyaset || 4 ||
dvisaptatyaṃgulocchrāyāṃ hemapaṃkajagarbhakam |
tribhāgahīnavistāraṃ ghṛtakṣīrādipūritam || 5 ||
ratnapallavataṇḍulavastraphalābhiśobhitam |
tatpārśve sthāpayed dātrīṃ sūcīṃ ca hemanālakam || 6 ||
pīṭhakaṃ bahirādityaṃ vastraṃ tathopavītakam |
haimaṃ daṇḍaṃ pidhānaṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ śubhaṃ navam || 7 ||
muktāvalīṃ padmarāgān sthāpayed ghaṭasannidhau |
tiladroṇānvitasthālīṃ sthāpayecca ghaṭopari || 8 ||

maṃgalairvedamantraiśca brahmaghoṣaiḥ stavaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 9 ||
prokṣitaḥ snāpitaḥ sarvauṣadhivāribhirādarāt |
yajamānaḥ śuklamālyāmbaradhṛg bhūṣaṇānvitaḥ || 3.126.1 0||
kusumāñjalimābaddhyoccārayet stavanaṃ namaḥ |
namo’kṣarādhināthāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te ||1 1 ||
namo nityahiraṇyāya hiraṇyavarṇine namaḥ |

sarve lokāstava garbhe vyāpakasya vyavasthitāḥ || 16||
sarve devāstava dehe mādhavasya vyavasthitāḥ |
sarvā devyastava dehe lakṣmyātmakasya saṃsthitāḥ || 17||
namaste viśvarūpāya pareśatanave namaḥ |
namaste bhuvanākāra bhuvanādhāra te namaḥ || 18||
bhuvanāśraya sarvātman namaste garbharūpiṇe |
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya brahmagarbhāya te namaḥ ||1 9||
sampadgarbhasvarūpāya puṇyagarbhāya te namaḥ |
muktigarbhāya kṛṣṇāya svargagarbhāya te namaḥ ||3.126.20||
tridevā yasya garbhe syustasmai devāya te namaḥ |
sarvātmā śrīharistvaṃ vai bhūte bhūte vyavasthitaḥ ||21 ||
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātman māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt |
evaṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ stavanaṃ kānakaṃ tataḥ ||22||
muṣṭibhyāṃ parisaṃgṛhya dharmarājacaturmukhau |
jānumadhye śiraḥ kṛtvā tiṣṭheducchvāsapaṃcakam ||23||
tadā kuryād dvijastatra saṃskārān vaidikān śubhān |
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā ||24||

gītamaṃgalamantrādyaistata utthāpayed guruḥ |
jātakarmādisaṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ ṣoḍaśo’pi ca ||26||

carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya te namaḥ |
sākṣirūpāya devāya brahmarūpāya te namaḥ ||3.126.3 0||
yathāhaṃ janitaḥ pūrvaṃ martyadharmā tathā punaḥ |
tvadgarbhajananāccāhaṃ divyadeho bhavāmi ca ||31||
ityabhyarthayamānastu caturbhiḥ kalaśairdvijāḥ |
snāpayeyuryajamānaṃ mantrāśīrvādatatparāḥ ||32||
adyajātasya te’ṅgāni cābhiprekṣyāmahe vayam |

bhaktimān muktimān cānte śāśvatānandabhāg bhava ||34||

parameṣṭhipadaṃ bhuktvā bhaved vairājyarājyavān |

yāti vai cākṣaraṃ dhāmānādinaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||44||
lalitāśrīmahālakṣmyā nārāyaṇyāḥ padāmbuje |

prāpyāśnute sarvakāmān saha nārāyaṇena saḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ tad bhuktimuktipradaṃ rame ||46||
pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ vaṃśapradaṃ putrasutāpradam |
nārakāṇāṃ tārakaṃ ca sarvavighnavināśakam ||47||
ariṣṭānāṃ nāśakaṃ ca tathā durbhāgyanāśakam |

bhūṣāmbaradhanaratnasvarṇarajatahīrakān |

vasvādityamarudrudranidhisiddhisamāśritam |

nityakailāsalokaṃ vā golokaṃ prāpya śāśvatam ||3.126.1 0 0||
tatrānantasamayaṃ saḥ prāpayitvā pitāmahān |
jananīkulavaṃśām̐śca sahasrāṇi kuṭumbinaḥ ||1 0 1||
tārayitvākṣaraṃdhāma prayāti dānakṛjjanaḥ |
yaḥ śṛṇoti prapaṭhati smaratyeva vidhiṃ tvimam || 1 02||
tasya puṇyaṃ hi dānasya jāyate svargamuttamam |
anyasmai dānakāryasya matiṃ dadāti yo’pi ca || 103||
tasya svargaṃ bhavedante puṇyabhāgena rājyabhāg |
punardānaṃ paraṃ datvā yāti vai paramaṃ padam || 1 04||
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri brahmāṇḍadānakaṃ param |
kathitaṃ te bhuktimuktipradaṃ parapadapradam || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mahādāneṣu hiraṇyagarbhadānasya brahmāṇḍadānasya ca vidhernirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 126 ||

<3.127>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca

godhūmānāṃ samudāye kalpastambādiśobhite |
atha paścimabhāge’pi pārijātadrumaṃ śubham || 1 9||

gogopavṛṣayuktāṃ ca jalavāpīsamanvitām ||26||

ratnapallavavastrāḍhyān phalavārisamanvitān ||27||

tathā samastadhānyāni cāṣṭādaśavidhāni vai ||3.127.3 0 ||
yathāśakti nyasettatra maṇḍape pādapāntike |
godhūmān taṇḍulān kaṅgūḥ jvārikā barjarām̐stathā ||3 1 ||
baṇṭikā śīṇikā mudgān caṇakān rājamāṣakān |

atha homām̐śca kuṇḍāgnāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ caret ||35||

suvarṇasya gaṇeśaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ prapūjayet || 36||
kuryānmūrterharerme’dhivāsanaṃ sadrumasya ca |

tvameva parameśo’si nārāyaṇo’si mādhavaḥ ||41 ||
saṃkarṣaṇo’niruddhastvaṃ pradyumnastvaṃ vibhāsi ca |
sūryaścandro’gnirindrastvaṃ jāṭharastvaṃ sanātanaḥ ||42||
brahmaṇo mānasodyāneśvarastvaṃ ca vanaspatiḥ |
mūrtarūpo’pyamūrto’si bījavṛkṣātmako’si ca ||43||
naranārīsvarūpo’si mahālakṣmīyuto’si ca |
sanātanasvarūpo’si sṛṣṭirakṣaṇanāśakṛt ||44||
santānavallikāvṛkṣairyuto’smān pāhi sarvataḥ |
svargaṃ dehi vibhūtīśca pradehi sampadaḥ śubhāḥ ||45||
siddhīrdehi vimānāni vaṃśoddhāraṃ tathā kuru |
pitṝṇāṃ mokṣadastvaṃ vai teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ vidhehi ca ||46||
ante śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇasya padaṃ dehi mahāsukham |
evamabhyarthya taṃ dadyād gurave kalpapādapam ||47||
caturbhyaścātha ṛtvigbhyaḥ santānādīn samarpayet |
anyadānāni sarvāṇi sādhubhyaśca dvijātaye ||48||
dadyāt prabhojanaṃ ramyaṃ kārayed bhikṣuyoginām |
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta dadyāddhanaṃ yathocitam ||49||

namaskuryāt prasādyaiva visarjayettataḥ svayam ||3.127.50||
prasādabhojanaṃ kuryādevaṃ dānapradaḥ pumān |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaścāśvamedhāyutodbhavam ||91 ||

śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mahādānaṃ tathāparam |

samarcayeddhariṃ māṃ cāvatārānīśvarīstathā |

caturdaśabhavanāni vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭirityapi ||75||

brahmadhāma vṛṣo gāvo dadatveva ca me śubham ||3.127.80||
iti samprārthya sauvarṇīṃ dhenuṃ śrīgurave’rpayet |
nandīśvaraṃ pradadyācca dharmamūrtiṃ sate tathā ||8 1 ||
ṛtvigbhyo dhenumekaikāṃ dadyāt śṛṃgāritāṃ śubhām |
anyagāvaḥ pradadyācca viprebhyo’pi yathocitam ||82||
naikā bahubhyo dātavyā kleśadā syāttataḥ khalu |
bahvyastvekasya dātavyā dhīmatārogyavṛddhaye ||83||
sarvābhūṣaṇayuktāśca dātavyā gurave śubhāḥ |

svarṇarajatarūpyāṇi deyāni bhikṣukādiṣu ||85||

śrāvayecchṛṇuyāddhenukathāṃ kuryājjapaṃ hareḥ ||86||

<3.128>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri mahādānaṃ tathāvidham |
hiraṇyakāmadhenostat sarvasaṃkalpasādhakam || 1 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kuṇḍatoraṇaśobhanam |
āsanaiścopakaraṇairhavyairvahnyādibhiryutam || 2 ||
lokapālān devatāśca parameśaṃ ramāpatim |
lakṣmīḥ sarvāstathāvāhya pūjāṃ homaṃ ca kārayet || 3 ||
yajamānastatastatrādhivāsanaṃ samācaret |
puṇyavedastavaghoṣān viprāḥ kuryuśca sādhavaḥ || 4 ||
kāṃcanasyātiśuddhasya dhenuṃ vatsāṃ ca kārayet |
uttamāṃ palasāhasrīṃ tadardhena tu madhyamām || 5 ||
kanīyasīṃ tadardhena tripalādūrdhvamityapi |
kārayitvā maṇḍape tāmānāyya mṛgacarmaṇi || 6 ||
vedyāṃ guḍopari sthāpya mahāratnādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
śṛṃgakhurapṛṣṭhavaṃśe svarṇabhūṣādibhistathā || 7 ||
lalāṭe kuṃkumādyaiśca pūjayettāṃ savatsikām |
kuṃbhāṣṭakaṃ ratnapatrajalataṇḍulaśobhitam || 8 ||
sthāpayenmaṇḍape tatra dhānyānyaṣṭādaśāpi ca |
ikṣudaṇḍāṣṭakaṃ tadvat phalāni vividhāni ca || 9 ||
pātrāṇi dohapātraṃ ca rajjuṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ śubhām |
khānapātraṃ rasyaghāsaṃ sthāpayenmaṇḍape tathā || 3.128.10||
kauśeyāmbarayugalaṃ bhūṣāchatrapradīpakān |
kuṇḍalacāmaraghaṇṭāsvarṇaśṛṃgādikāstathā || 11 ||
vibhūṣā rūpyakhurikāḥ sarvarasān nyasecchubhān |
haridrāṃ phalapuṣpāṇi kastūrīṃ candanaṃ tathā || 12||
karpūraṃ śarkarāḥ saumyaṃ vitānakaṃ tathāmbaram |
evaṃ sarvāḥ śubhā divyāḥ sāmagrīstīrthavāri ca || 1 3||
darbhaṃ cākṣatakām̐ścāpi tulasīpatrakāṇi ca |
saṃsthāpya maṇḍape tatra yajamānaḥ śuciḥ svayam || 14||
puṣpahastaḥ pūjayed gāṃ vipro vedān samuccaret |
maṃgalaiḥ stavanairyuktaḥ triḥpradakṣiṇamācaret || 15 ||
stavanaṃ ca prakuryādvai tiṣṭhan gosannidhau tadā |
mātastvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ mandiraṃ sarvayoginām || 16 ||
dehināṃ tāriṇī tvaṃ vai śaktīnāmāśrayāśubhā |
svargamārgapradā mokṣapradā sampatpradāsi ca || 17||

mokṣadātri harernityaṃ prītikari namo’stu te || 19||
kānakī tvaṃ hariṇī tvaṃ hiraṇyā tvaṃ ca candrikā |

gamiṣyantyapare pretāḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ pradānataḥ ||27||

dīnānāthasatīsādhvīsādhubālān prabhojayet ||3 1 ||

savatsāṃ gāṃ pradadyācca tatrāśaktastu vatsikām ||3 3||
vatsikādānakaraṇe’pyaśakto mānavastu yaḥ |

uccaiḥśravase devāśvarūpiṇe te namo namaḥ ||58||

aśvatthasāmyarūpāya mahāśvāya ca te namaḥ ||59||

dadyād bhāvabharo bhūtvā bhojayedannakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||67||

śṛṇuyādvā kathāṃ cemāṃ so’pi yātyarkasadgṛham ||69||
vācayecchrāvayeccāpi so’pi yātyarkasannidhim |
abhinandanadaścāpi yāti svargaṃ sukhāśrayam ||3.128.70||
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādānaṃ puṇyamaśvarathātmakam |
puṇyaṃ dinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ||7 1 ||
vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayecca pūjāvastūni cāharet |
lokapālān devatāśca parabrahmāvatārakān ||72||
īśvarānīśvariṇīścāvāhayenmaṇḍape śubhe |
aṣṭādaśa ca dhānyāni pātrāṇi ca dhanāni ca ||73||

gaṇeśādyām̐stathā devān śrīpatiṃ māṃ janārdanam ||74||
bālakṛṣṇaṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ brahmapriyāṃ haripriyāḥ |
āvāhayetpūjayecca suvarṇarathamāharet ||75||
aśvasaptakayuktaṃ ca catuścakraṃ tato’dhikam |

anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ kamalāyutam ||77||
sthāpayedrathamadhye paṭṭarājñīsamanvitam |
pārṣadānme sthāpayecca chatracāmaraśobhitān ||78||
vetradharān hetidharān pūjāsevanatatparān |
sādhūn sādhvīḥ sthāpayecca rathe matpārśvatastathā ||79||
devarṣipitṛsaṃghātān sthāpayed rathasattame |
mahālakṣmīṃ kaṃbharāṃ ca śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ||3.128.80||
santuṣṭāṃ sthāpayeccāpi sarvā devīḥ śubhāśrayāḥ |
lalitāṃ sthāpayettatra sarvaśaktisamanvitām ||8 1||
ratnāni hīrakān hārān svarṇabhūṣā rathe nyaset |

ṣoḍaśa vā caturo vā saratnapallavākṣatān ||83||

kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktān pūjayedbhāvataḥ surān ||84||

kuryād yathānyavastūnyāhared dānārthameva ca ||85||

śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ kṛtvā me havanaṃ ghṛtaiḥ ||3.128.90 ||
athānyaphalapuṣpādyaistato rathaṃ pradakṣiṇam |
kṛtvārthayed rathaṃ māṃ cābhedena śrīpadaṃ prabhum ||9 1 ||
namo dhāmābhigataye namo nārāyaṇāya te |

mahākālo mahāmṛtyuścāyane ṛtavo hyarāḥ |

pitṝṇāṃ me kuṭumbānāṃ mokṣaṃ kuru rathottama |
divyo vimānarūpastvaṃ bhūtvā nayākṣaraṃ padam ||96||
muktāstava dhvaje santi dhāmākṣaraṃ tu paṭṭake |
īśvarā daṇḍadehe ca varūthe śaktayo’khilāḥ ||97||
antarbhāge svargalokā madhye nārāyaṇo hariḥ |
parito devatāḥ sarvā sarve devā bahiḥsthitāḥ ||98||
adhaḥ saptatalavāsāścakrayośca yamo vṛṣaḥ |
agre puṇyaṃ tathā bhaktirguravaste vasanti ca ||99||

ityuktvā gurave deyo rathaścānyadhanānyapi || 3.128.100 ||

upadeṣṭānumantā ca phalaṃ tulyaṃ hi vindati |

<3.129>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmyatra hemahastirathārpaṇam |
yatpradānād divyapadaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ labhate janaḥ || 1 ||
puṇyadinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham |
vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ havyavastūnyupanyasecca maṇḍape || 2 ||
āsanāni jalaghaṭān viprānāhūya tatra ca |
tīrthānyāvāhayeccāpi tathā puṇyāhavācanam || 3 ||
maṃgalāni samastāni gāpayed yajamānakaḥ |
devatāvāhanaṃ kuryāt pūjayecca yathāvidhi || 4 ||
hemahastirathaṃ puṣpākāraṃ maṇyādimaṇḍitam |
valabhībhirvicitrābhiḥ kārayed daśacakrakam || 5 ||
sadhvajaṃ savarūthaṃ ca sopaskaraṃ suśobhanam |
chatracāmararatnāḍhyaṃ vetradharādiśobhitam || 6 ||
candradarpaṇapūrvasthaprabhāśobhāvirājitam |
vyāghracarmaṇi śārdūlacarmaṇi sthāpayettilān || 7 ||
tatra rathaṃ sthāpayecca deyavastūni cāpi vai |
rathe nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sthāpayenmāṃ ramāpatim || 8 ||
avatārānīśanīśca māṇikyāṃ duḥkhahāśriyam |
rādhikāṃ ca prabhāṃ pāśavatīṃ lakṣmī jayāṃ ramām || 9 ||
lalitāṃ kamalāṃ padmāṃ padminīṃ tulasīṃ satīm |
sāvitrīṃ kaṃbharāṃ līlāṃ gāyatrīṃ mañjulāṃ bhuvam || 3.129.1 0||
mahālakṣmīṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ ca mādhavīm |
bhārgavīṃ suguṇāṃ haṃsīṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivām̐stayā || 1 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃśrīkṛṣṇamādhavam |

ṣoḍaśaghaṭasaṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśagobhiranvitam |
ṣoḍaśahemamātaṃgairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ || 18||
svarṇakūthakṛtapṛṣṭhaiḥ svarṇadantasucakrakaiḥ |

kvaṇaddhaṃṭāsvaraśobhairyuktaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ śubham |
pūjayecchrīhariṃ tatrasthitaṃ māṃ devatādikān ||3.129.20||
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca triḥkṛtvā namaskārādi vai caret |

namaste brahmarūpāya nārāyaṇāśritāya ca |

vastūni hīrakaratnādīni pūjārthakāni ca |
candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi sarvopakaraṇāni ca ||41||
maṇḍape sthāpayettatra jalakuṃbhān saratnakān |
sadalān saphalām̐ścāpi pañca sauvarṇadhātujān ||42||

yathāśakti ca bhojyānnamiṣṭānnāni ca sannyaset ||43||
vastrābhūṣaṇadravyāṇi dānārthāni ca sannyaset |
sāradārumayān pañca kārayitvā halān śubhān ||44||
dhurayuktān rajjunaddhān sitāsitādhraśobhitān |
muṣṭikṛṣṭiyutān ramyān vṛṣabhaiḥ puruṣairyutān ||45||
daṇḍaraśmyādiyuktām̐śca kāñcanān rājatām̐śca vā |
pañcapalāt samārabhyāsahasrādipalāvadhi ||46||
kārayitvā halānevaṃ vṛṣabhān daśa tadyujaḥ |
dhurandharān kārayitvā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitān ||47||
rūpyapādāgratilakān raktakauśeyajhullikān |
muktāhārāḍhyasatkaṇṭhān ghurghurādivibhūṣaṇān ||48||
svarṇaśṛṃgān suśobhāḍhyān maṇḍape cādhivāsayet |
śakaṭāni suyogyāni yathāśakti prakārayet ||49||
kharvaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ ca sasyaśālinam |
gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ ca vā vāṭīṃ svarṇapātre prakārayet ||3.129.50||
rakṣayettatra sānnidhye maṇḍape ca tataḥ param |
svastipuṇyāhavācaśca vācayed viprakovidaiḥ ||51||
āvāhayeddhariṃ māṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣikaraṃ tathā |
kārṣṇīṃ rādhāṃ mahālakṣmīmāvāhayecca karṣiṇīm ||92||
avatārām̐stathā muktānīśvarīrdevatāḥ surān |
dharaṇyādityarudrādīn lokapālān samāhvayet ||53||
samidbhistilamiṣṭaiśca phalairdalaiśca pāyasaiḥ |
vahnau homām̐ścaredaṣṭottaraśataṃ smaram̐śca mām ||54|||
dharaṇyādityarudrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ nirvapeccarum |
gururdadyāttathā tebhyaḥ pālāśasamidho ghṛtam ||55||
kṛṣṇatilāḥ śarkarāśca vrīhīm̐ścāpi phalāni ca |
pṛthvī sākṣānmahālakṣmīḥ sitā lakṣmīḥ pratuṣyati ||56 ||
dharaṇyāḥ putrikā devī sitā pṛthvīvidāriṇī |
dārikā putrikā cāpi garbhaṃ bhittvotthitā hi sā ||57||
tasyai deyaṃ pāyasaṃ vai tuṣṭaye havane tadā |
homottaraṃ vipradāmpatyaṃ samāhūya pūjayet| ||58||
divyāmbaravibhūṣādyairhemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ pūjayecca yathocitapradānakaiḥ ||59||
maṇḍape’ṣṭādaśadhānyānyapi dhenuṃ payasvinīm |
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ cekṣudaṇḍādiśobhitāṃ nyaset ||3.129.60||
halān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
prārthayet paramātmānaṃ halasthaṃ māṃ vidāriṇam ||61||
sitāsitāyāṃ sitādhre śivaśceṣāsthito halī |

vṛṣabheṣu dharmadevo bhaktiryaṣṭyāṃ sthitāsti ca |
sarvatra śrīhariścāste namaste parameśvara ||63||
sarvadevā ghurāḍhye ca tvayyāsate ca te namaḥ |
bhūvanaspatimūlānāṃ rasajñāṃ cintaye sitām ||64||
kṛṣṇāya kṛṣikārāya namaḥ śrīhaladhāriṇe |
halātmane brahmaṇe te vyāpakāya namo namaḥ ||65||
dāne’rpito bhavānatra pañcalāṅgalarūpadhṛk |
svargaṃ satyaṃ mahārājyaṃ vairājyaṃ bhaumamityapi ||66||
dehi me tatphalātmāpi tathānte mokṣaṇaṃ param |
ityevamuktvā natvā ca mukhe pañcalāṃgalān ||67||
arpayed vṛṣabhādyuktānupaskaraṇaśobhitān |
anyānyapi ca dānāni dadyād bhikṣujaneṣu vai ||68||
viprebhyaśca yathāyogyamṛtvigbhyaścārpayettathā |
pañcalāṅgalakṛṣyarhāṃ pañcaśatavighāṭikām ||69||
bhūmiṃ yadvā nyūnabhāgāṃ saha dadyāt savāṭikām |
svarṇabhūmiṃ ca vā dadyād gṛhaṃ dadyāddhi śāntaye ||3.129.70||
annajalādikaṃ dadyād dāne yathādhanaṃ tadā |
bhojanāni tatastatra kārayed dvijayoginaḥ ||71 ||
sādhvīsādhubālabālāpāṃgāndhādyabalājanān |
evaṃ dadyād yathāśaktidānaṃ pāpavināśakam ||72||
svargadaṃ syād rājyadaṃ syāt parameṣṭhipadapradam |
bhūmau yāvanti sasyāni tāvadyugāni vai divi ||73 ||
modate sakuṭumbaśca tato yāti hareḥ padam |
pitṝṇāmuddharaṇaṃ ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||74||
pañcalāṅgaladānena puṇyaṃ vai pañcakalpajam |
jāyate tena vai svarge muhurdivaspatirbhavet ||75||
gobhūmihalavṛṣabhārpako vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tādṛśaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||76||
atha lakṣmi dharādvīpamahādānaṃ vadāmi te |
pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ cāpyamāṃgalyanāśakaṃ sukham ||77||
puṇyadinaṃ samāsādya maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham |
kuṇḍaṃ vedīṃ kārayecca sthāpayejjalabhṛdghaṭān ||78||
saratnapallavavastrān aṣṭasauvarṇakāritān |
dānayogyāni vastūni homayogyāni yāni ca ||79||
pūjāyogyāni sarvāṇi sarvadhānyāni sannyaset |
haimīṃ kṣitiṃ jambudvīpātmikāṃ sīmādriśobhitām ||3.129.80||
madhye meruyutāṃ ramyāṃ navakhaṇḍasamanvitām |
sāgarairveṣṭitāṃ cānte nadīnadasaro’nvitām ||81 ||
sarvaratnakhaniyuktāṃ vārāhadevapārśvagām |
hemnaḥ palasahasreṇa tadardhena tadaṃśakaiḥ ||82||
pañcapalairūrdhvameva kārayitvā nyaseddhi tām |
madhye māṃ śrīhariṃ tatra sthāpayecchrīramāpatim ||83||
avatārānmama muktān muktānikā nyasettathā |
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāstathābalāḥ ||84||
īśvarānīśvarāṇīśca devāndevīḥ ṛṣīṃstathā |
mahālakṣmīṃ śrīgopālakṛṣṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||85||
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi mandiraṃ me śubhaṃ tathā |
lomaśasyāśramaṃ cāpi kārayitvā nyasettathā ||86||
bhūṣācchādanavastrāṇi dhanāni vividhāni ca |
bhojyānnadānayogyāni sthāpayettatra maṇḍape ||87||
siṃhacarma nyasettatra mṛgacarma nyasecca vā |
tileṣu tatra dhānyāni rasām̐śca śarkarāḥ śubhāḥ ||88||
phalānyapi nyaseccāpi kauśeyaṃ ca vitānakam |
āvāhayellokapālān diśāṃ pālān sureśvarān ||89||
adhivāsanamākuryācchuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣiteḥ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||3.129.90||
pūjayetprārthayeccāpi bhāvanābhāvitāntaraḥ |
namaste sarvalokātman kṣityātman bhagavan hare ||9 1 ||
tvaṃ kṣitistvaṃ dharitrī tvaṃ dhātrī pāhi vasundhare |
vasumatyai namaste’tra vasūn dehi ca me sadā ||92||
anantaśeṣamūrddhasthānantāyai te namo namaḥ |
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā tvaṃ narāyaṇī ||13||
gāyatrī tvaṃ śivā tvaṃ ca māṇikyā tvaṃ mamāntike |
duḥkhahā tvaṃ ca lokānāṃ garbhadhātrī ca pāhi mām ||94||
tvaṃ jyotsnā tvaṃ prabhā buddhirmedhā viśvaṃbharā satī |
dhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ kṣamā kṣauṇiḥ pṛthvī rasā ca janmadā ||95||
pāhi svargaṃ mahadrājyaṃ dehi me śāśvataṃ padam |
pitṝnmokṣagatānsarvān vidhehi cārpitā satī || 96||
evaṃ natvārpayet kṣmāṃ tāṃ sauvarṇāṃ gurave sate |
viprebhyo’rdhāṃ pradadyād vā ratnānyanyāpi capi vai ||97||
bhojayedatha bhikṣūm̐śca satīḥ sādhūn samāgatān |
dadyād dānāni dhānyāni vastrāṇi ca phalāni ca ||98||
homaṃ prakārayedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sukhapradam |
pāpaṃ naśyati tenaiva puṇyaṃ dānena labhyate ||99||
sampadṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ yāti dharādānapradaḥ pumān |
vimānenārkavarṇena pitruddhārasamanvitaḥ || 3.129.1 00||
prayāti śrīpuraṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ ca śāśvatam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya muktadeho’bhijāyate || 101 ||
vairājarājyaṃ bhuktvā ca yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mahādānaṃ dharātmakam || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne hemahastirathamahādānapañcalāṃgalakamahādānahemadharāmahādānanirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 129 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ mahādānamataḥ param |
viśvasudarśanacakramahādānaṃ mahattamam || 1 ||
śreṣṭhaṃ palasahasreṇa tadardhena tu madhyamam |
tadardhena kaniṣṭhaṃ vā kārayeccakramujjvalam || 2 ||
ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāṣṭanemiṃ rūpyakapaṭṭarājitam |
viṃśatiphalataścordhvaṃ kārayeccakramuttamam || 3 ||
tannābhau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ racayecchubham |
caturbhujaṃ samukuṭaṃ caturāyudhaśobhitam || 4 ||
ādyanemau brahmapriyeśvarīrhi kānakīḥ śubhāḥ |
vinyasyed rādhikāṃ lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ padmāvatīṃ satīm || 5 ||
māṇikyāṃ lalitāṃ haimīṃ jayāṃ ceti mama priyāḥ |
dvitīyanemau tadvattu pūrvato jalaśāyinam || 6 ||
kambharāśrīyutaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaṃ prabhum |
pativratāyutaṃ patnīvrataṃ guruṃ narāyaṇam || 7 ||
lomaśaṃ kuṃkumavāpīsahitaṃ sadguruṃ śubham |
sāvitrīsahitaṃ cājaṃ śivāyuktaṃ śivaṃ tathā || 8 ||
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ narasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanam |
rāmaṃ parśudharaṃ rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ buddhaṃ ca kalkinam || 9 ||
tṛtīyanemau mātṛkāḥ sapta vasvaṣṭakaṃ tathā |
gaṇeśaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ ca kārayed vāhanānvitam || 3.130.1 0||
caturthe dvādaśādityān vedām̐ścatura ityapi |
pañcame pañcabhūtāni rudrāścaikādaśāpi ca || 11 ||
lokapālāṣṭakaṃ ṣaṣṭhe diṅmātaṅgām̐śca kārayet |
saptame’strāṇi sarvāṇi svastikādīni cāpi vai || 1 2||
aṣṭasiddhīraṣṭame cāṣṭaiśvaryāṇi ca vinyaset |
evaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ kārayitvā tu maṇḍape || 13||
kārite kadalīstaṃbhādyaiśca mahati cānayet |
vedikāsannidhau cakraṃ kṛṣṇājinatilopari || 14||
vinyasyet sarvasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanāni ca |
tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni rasām̐śca lavaṇādikān || 15||
pūrṇakuṃbhāṣṭakaṃ cāpi ratnamaṇyambarāṇi ca |
mālekṣuphalapuṣpāṇi dānavastūni yāni ca || 16||
bhojyapeyāni śreṣṭhāni śarkarāśca dhanāni ca |
gāṃ kanyāṃ tulasīṃ cāpi rakṣayedanalaṃ tathā || 17||
tato maṃgalavādyāni vādayet snānaśuddhimān |
śuklāmbaradharo bhūtvā yajamānastu maṇḍape || 18||
āsane copaviṣṭaśca ṛtvigbhiḥ saha sādaram |
ācamanādikaṃ kṛtvā cāvāhya devatāstataḥ || 19||
vidhinā pūjayitvāthāṣṭottaraṃ homakām̐ścaret |
kṛtvādhivāsanaṃ cāpi puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||3.130.20||
pradakṣiṇaṃ homacakraṃ kṛtvā samprārthayedapi |
namaḥ ṣaṭackrarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||21||
viśvacakrasvarūpāya sudarśanāya te namaḥ |
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇahastāṅgulisthita ||22||
namaste pāpapuñjānāṃ jvālakāya dayājuṣe |
hemacakrapradānena bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pradehi me ||23 ||
paramānandamūrte te namo nārāyaṇātmane |
tejomayāya divyāyāsurapāṭanaśaktaye ||24||
hṛdayasthāya ca guṇātītāya te namo namaḥ |
nārāyaṇe sthitaṃ cakraṃ cakramadhye hariḥ sthitaḥ ||25||
dvayormadhye mahālakṣmīstasyai devyai namo namaḥ |
āyudhaṃ bhaktarakṣārthaṃ vartase māṃ prapāhi ca ||26 ||
evamuccārya gurave dadyāccakraṃ sudarśanam |
anyāni dānayogyāni dvijātibhyo’rpayettathā ||27||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca yoṣidbhyo’pyarpayettathā |
bālebhyo bālikābhyaśca dadyād dānāni vai tadā ||28||
bhojayet sarvabhojyāni ārārtrikaṃ tathācaret |
parihāraṃ prakuryācca visṛjed bhūsurādikān ||29||
evaṃ pradātā cakrasya mucyate bhavabandhanāt |
viṣṇuloke pare svarge satye vairājabhūstare ||3.130.30||
bhuktvā bhogānanantām̐śca bhūtvā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhalokamāsādya caturbāhuḥ sanātanaḥ ||3 1 ||
ciraṃ vasettato yāti golokaṃ dhāma cottamam |
tato brahmapuraṃ yāti cākṣaraṃ dhāma me param ||32||
nityaṃ vai kānakaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ hariśritam |
kārayitvā gṛhe bhaktaḥ pūjayet kusumākṣataiḥ ||3 3||
viśvacakraṃ taret so’pi hareścakrasya pūjanāt |
sudarśanaṃ gṛhe yasya tasyāghacakrakāṇi tu ||34||
naśyantyeva na jāyante jāyante puṇyaparvatāḥ |
rakṣāṃ karoti satataṃ gṛhasthaṃ vai sudarśanam ||35||
vardhayatyeva cāyuṣyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyam |
sāmrājyacakraṃ yadvāpi cakravartitvamityapi ||36 ||
atha te śivarājñīśri kathayāmi tathottamam |
māhātmyaṃ mama cakrasya rahasyaṃ sarvato’dhikam ||37||
yasya dehe gṛhe haste vastre vāṭyāṃ ca vastuṣu |
sudarśanaṃ bhaveccakraṃ tatra pāpaṃ na tiṣṭhati ||38||
yāmyadūtā na cāyānti rākṣasā vidravanti ca |
bhūtapretapiśācādyāḥ palāyante’pi dūrataḥ ||39||
rogā jvarādikāḥ sarve na tiṣṭhanti kadācana |
vāsanā nirmūlatāṃ ca gacchatyeva sudarśanāt ||3.130.40||
rājadevādibādhāśca naśyantyeva sudarśanāt |
sarpavṛścikabādhāśca viṣāṇyanyāni yāni ca ||41 ||
naśyanti tejasā tūrṇaṃ sudarśanasya śārṅgiṇaḥ |
ṛddhayaḥ sarvathā tatra nivasanti surakṣitāḥ ||42||
bālagrahādayaścāpi pīḍayanti na tadgṛhe |
akālamaraṇaṃ tatra jāyate na sudarśanāt ||43||
anapatyagṛhaṃ naiva bhaved yatra sudarśanam |
utpātā na bhavantyeva yatra sudarśanaṃ mama ||44||
akasmātā na ca syuśca yatra me vai sudarśanam |
vijayaḥ sarvadā syācca sarvathā me sudarśanāt ||45||
cauravyāghrabhayādyāśca naiva jāyanta eva tu |
jalavahnibhayāścāpi bhūkampabhayamityapi ||46||
naiva tatra prajāyante yatra me’sti sudarśanam |
garbhasrāvabhayaṃ cāpi strauvaidhavyabhayādikam ||47||
sampannāśabhayaṃ naiva prajāyante sudarśanāt |
kleśā naiva prajāyante jantubhayaṃ na jāyate ||48||
śastrabhayaṃ bhavennaiva ghātabhayaṃ na jāyate |
grahapīḍā bhavennaiva yatra me’sti sudarśanam ||49||
rūpasaundaryasaubhāgyasamṛddhisadrasādikam |
sudarśanapratāpena jāyate’cintitaṃ bahu ||3.130.50||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā cakraṃ mālācakraṃ mahattamam |
svarṇamālā tulasyā vā mālikā cakramuttamam ||51 ||
brahmacakramidaṃ proktaṃ sudarśanaṃ hi tatparam |

pūjayitvā candanādyairmālikāṃ hṛdayaṃgamām |
śrīharerhṛdaye cāste mālā sphāṭikasaṃbhavā ||6 1||
taulasīmālikā haste lakṣmīto mānatāṃ gatā |
seyaṃ lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīrmālikā malanāśinī |||2||
svargamālāpradā bhuktimuktipradā samujjvalā |
aṣṭottaraśatamaṇiśobhitā svargatantunā ||6 3||
sphāṭikena suramyeṇa meruṇā rājatena vā |

saccidānandarūpā sā mālā deyā vidhānataḥ |
saṃsthāpya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale kalaśopari ||65||
śarkarādiyutā deyā gomukhī vastraśobhitā |
āsanena yutā deyā pracchādanapaṭānvitā ||66||
phalasugandhayuktā ca pradeyā divyapārikā |
divyamaṇisusampannā hīratantuvirājitā ||67||
sadakṣiṇā pradeyā vai dhanadhānyasamanvitā |
mṛgājine ghaṭe sthālyāṃ vinyasya mālikāṃ ca tām ||68||
śrīharerme pratimāyāḥ kare datvā prapūjayet |
candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ snāpayenmālikāṃ mama ||619||
candanādyaiḥ pūjayitvā punarhaste tu me’rpayet |
ārārtrikaṃ dhūpadīpau kṛtvā natvā ca māṃ tataḥ ||3.130.70||
naivedyaṃ me samapyāpi mālāyai bhojayettataḥ |
cid devī mālikā me’sti lalitā lalanā mama ||71 ||
sadāśaktirmahādivyā sarvapuṇyapradāyinī |
svastikena saha dadyād dhanadhānyādibhiḥ saha ||72||
gurave vai namaskṛtya dadyānnatvā punaḥ punaḥ |
prārthayed gurave tatra mālādānaṃ karomi yat ||73||
tena puṇyena me kṛṣṇaparamātmā prasīdatām |
mālayā rādhayā lakṣmyā rakṣyo’haṃ sarvadā tathā ||74||
mama pāpāni naśyantu mālādānena sadguro |
mādhavo mālayā nityaṃ prasanno me’stu saukhyadaḥ ||75||
ityevaṃ mālikācakraṃ dadyād dāne bhayāpaham |
mālācaturthabhāgaṃ ca yatra vai saptaviṃśatiḥ ||76||
maṇayaḥ syuḥ śubhaṃ vā rakṣakaṃ dadyātu rājatam |
vā vikalpaśca sandehastasmād rakṣati saṃkhyayā ||77||
so’yaṃ vārakṣakastasyāḥ sutastamapi cārpayet |
mālādānaṃ mahādānaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam ||78||
mālayā nityajāpaḥ syānnārāyaṇasya me priye |
tena duṣṭāni pāpāni naśyantyeva kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||79||
mayi nyastasamagrasya japato nāsti pātakam |
cakradvayamidaṃ proktaṃ dadato nāsti pātakam ||3.130.80 ||
mahācakradvayaṃ proktaṃ sudarśanaṃ ca mālikā |
mālikā bhavahantrī ca daityaghnaṃ tu sudarśanam ||8 1 ||
athāpi ca tṛtīyaṃ vai cakraṃ cāṃgulibhūṣaṇam |
svarṇabhūṣormikācakraṃ dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2||
ūrmikāsampradātā vai samrāḍ bhavati bhūtale |
sarvām̐gulīyakadātā svarge rājā bhavatyapi ||8 3 ||
ūrmikāṃgulīyakādipradātā viśvasṛṭ bhavet |
svarṇarūpyādibhiḥ kṛtvā pūjayitvā guruṃ dvijam ||87||
sādhuṃ satīṃ mahāsādhvīṃ pativratāṃ ca sadgurum |
ācāryaṃ vedavidvāṃsaṃ sādhuṃ nārāyaṇātmajam |85||
acyutagotrakaṃ vāpi namaskṛtyārpayettataḥ |
ūrmikāṃṅgulīyakāni pūjayitvā sukuṃkumaiḥ ||86 ||
arpayeddakṣahastena cāṃguṣṭheyaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam |
tatrāste sarvadā svarṇahāriṇī kamalā ramā ||87||

saṃsārasāgarajanyormibhyo rakṣa sadā hi mām ||88||
mama haste sadā svarṇe bhavatyeva ca mokṣaṇam |
dehi me bhagavannāmayute bhagavati priye ||89||
pāpapuñjāni sarvāṇi mama vināśya cormike |
brahmānandormisaṃmagnaṃ kuru māṃ kṛṣṇavallabhe ||3.130.90||
ityabhyarcya ca samprārthya dadyād dāne śubhormikām |
trivalīṃ pañcavalikāṃ saptavalīṃ suśobhanām ||9 1||
svarṇamātrakṛtāṃ ramyāmekāṃ vā daśa vā tathā |
viṃśatiṃ vā samarthaśced dadyād dāne dvijātaye ||92||
sādhave viṣṇubhaktāya pradadyācca subhaktitaḥ |
caturthaṃ valayaṃ haste kaṭakaṃ vā suvarṇajam ||93||
cakratulyaṃ ratnanaddhaṃ maṇihīrakaśobhitam |
mauktikamāṇikyanaddhaṃ khacitaṃ kaustubhena ca ||94||
siṃhāsanaṃ pradadyācca sarvadāridryanāśakam |
sarvasampatpradaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ patnīpradaṃ tathā ||95||
svargarājyapradaṃ cāpi satyalokapradaṃ tathā |
brahmalokapradaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ tathā ||96||
evaṃ lakṣmi pradadyāttu pādaprakoṣṭhabhūṣaṇam |
kāmbikāṃ kadalīṃ cāpi śṛṃkhalā baṃgaḍīṃ tathā ||97||
svarṇarajatanirmāṇaṃ samaṇiyoktikānvitām |
sarvaśobhāsyadāṃ cāpi kiṃkiṇījālaniḥsvanām ||98||
evaṃ lakṣmi tathā dadyān natthikāṃ svarṇavālikām |
suvarṇavartulavālīṃ saratnāṃ śobhanāṃ diśet ||99||
etāni sarvacakrāṇi proktāni te mayā priye |
dātavyāni yathāśakti dāne puṇyakarāṇi vai || 3.130.10 0||
svargadāni mahāsmṛddhipradāni mokṣadānyapi |
dāridryarogavaimatyanāśakāni sukhāni ca || 10 1||
divyavaṃśapravaṃśādivistārakārakāṇi ca |
divyanārīpatiputrasaubhāgyavardhakāni ca || 1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāccānumodanāt |
dānānyetāni sarvāṇi bhuktimuktipradāni vai || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne viśvasudarśanamahācakradānasya mālikāmahācakradānasya vārakṣakadānasya ūrmikāṃgulīyakāṃgadakaṭakaśṛṃkhalābiṃgiḍīkaṃkaṇanatthikādimahācakradānānāṃ ca nirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 130 ||

<3.131>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri mahādānamanuttamam |
mahākalpalatākhyaṃ ca dānaṃ suvarṇavallikam || 1 ||
puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham |
vediṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayecca sthāpayeddhavanārthakam || 2 ||

dānavastūnyupādāya maṇḍape tatra sannyaset || 3 ||
ṛtvija_ sarvasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam|
āsaneṣu ca devānāṃ nārāyaṇasya me śriyaḥ || 4 ||

maṇḍape tatra sauvarṇīrdaśa kalpākhyavallikāḥ || 5 ||

ratnāṃśukādisaṃyuktā bhūṣitāḥ śobhitāstathā || 6 ||
vidyādharībhiḥ saṃyuktāḥ suparṇaiḥ śobhitāstathā |
prativalli prakuryācca dikpālāṣṭakayoṣitaḥ || 7 ||
śarkarāparvate vallī sarvāścābhyadhirohayet |
aindrīṃ hastisthitāṃ śaktimāgneyīṃ meṣasaṃsthitām || 8 ||
yāmyāṃ mahiṣīniṣṭhāṃ ca nairṛtiṃ gardabhīsthitām |
vāruṇīṃ makarasthāṃ ca vāyavīṃ hariṇīsthitām || 9 ||
kauberīṃ svarṇayānasthāmīśānīṃ vṛṣabhasthitām |
tathā ṣoḍaśadhānyāni sthāpayet tatra maṇḍape || 3.131.10 ||
lakṣmīṃ śivāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ māṇikyāṃ duḥkhahātmām |
kambharāśrīmahālakṣmīṃ santuṣṭā bhaginīṃ hareḥ || 11 ||

āsahasramitasvarṇaiḥ kṛtvā nyaseddhi maṇḍape || 12||

prārthayettā vallikāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitāḥ |
vināśinībhyaḥ pāpānāṃ pālinībhyaḥ svasañjuṣām || 15||
namo’stu phaladābhyaśca kalpābhyo vai namo namaḥ |
sarvasampatpradābhyaśca sarvarddhibhyo namo namaḥ || 16||
mahālakṣmīsvarūpābhyaḥ sarvātmikābhyo vai namaḥ |
svargāmṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ ca vairājaṃ ca gavāyanam || 17 ||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma vitarantu ca naḥ sadā |
bhavatyo dānarūpāśca dattā rakṣantu naḥ sadā || 18||
iti prārthya punaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ samarpayet |
gurave sādhave cārdhamardhāścānyebhya eva tu || 19||

taddhi dadyād bhikṣukebhyo’nāthahīnebhya ityapi ||3.131.20 ||

bālośca bālikāścāpi bhojayeccārpayeddhanam ||21 ||

evaṃ kalpalatādānaṃ kuryāttasya phalaṃ bahu || 22||

āvāhayed vedikāgre pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ||29||

yādṛśī ceṣyate patnī yathāsāmagrikānvitā ||3.131.3 0||
tādṛśī sā tu kartavyā śṛṃgāradravyaśobhitā |

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kṛṣṇakānta mama kānta śrutaṃ dānamahatphalam |
puṇye dine pradātavyaṃ yaduktaṃ bhavatā prabho || 1 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yatra bhūtale |

dāturjanmadinaṃ cāpi śreṣṭhaṃ dātuḥ kṛte matam || 4 ||
kalpanāmnā ca divasāḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhavantyapi |
brahmaṇo māsadivasāḥ śreṣṭhā bhavanti dānake || 5 ||
māsāhatriṃśannāmāni kathayāmi nibodha me |

tṛtīyo vāmadevastu turyo rāthantarābhidhaḥ || 7 ||

navamaḥ sadyanāmā ceśānastu daśamo mataḥ |
ekadaśastamonāmā sārasvato dvayaṃdaśa || 9 ||
trayodaśa udānākhyo gāruḍastu caturdaśaḥ |
pañcadaśastu kaumāryaḥ ṣoḍaśo nārasiṃhakaḥ || 3.133.10 ||
saptadaśaḥ samānākhyaścāgneyo’ṣṭādaśātmakaḥ |
ekonaviṃśaḥ somākhyo viṃśatirmānavo mataḥ || 1 1||
tatpumānekaviṃśaśca divaso brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |

aṣṭāviṃśastu gaurīti navaviṃśo maheśvaraḥ |
triṃśastu pitṛkalpo vai yā kuhūrbrahmaṇo matā || 14||
eteṣu yāni bhagavaddināni śrīdināni ca |
śivādināmatithayaḥ puṇyāstā dānakariṇaḥ || 15||
harerjanmadinānyeva hariṇījanmarāśayaḥ |
puṇyāḥ santi vratāhāśca dānayogyāḥ sadā rame || 16||
nahi kartuṃ samarthā vai sarve kṣudrahṛdo janāḥ |
kurvantyudāramanaso dānānyuktāni yāni ha || 17||
yadā yasya bhaved buddhirdānadharmaparāyaṇā |
tadā tasmin dine kāryaṃ dānaṃ dātrā tu satvaram || 18||
gatā śraddhā gataḥ kālo gata utsāha ityapi |
gataṃ pātraṃ gataṃ vastu punarnāyāsyati kvacit || 19||
gatvarāḥ sampadaḥ sarvā gatvaraṃ jīvanaṃ tathā |
gatvarāścāpi saṃkalpāstān satkārye niyojayet ||3.133.20||
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māmakṣarapatiṃ prabhum |
avatārānīśvarām̐śca surānṛṣīn sutoṣayet |||2 1 ||
grahān santoṣayed dānairlakṣmi mama svarūpiṇaḥ |
sarvakāmāptaye nityaṃ grahaṃ śāntaṃ vidhāpayet ||22||
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samācaret |
nijāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā vaṃśecchuḥ sukhabhāvanaḥ ||23||
puṇye’hni viprakathite kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
grahān grahādidevām̐śca saṃsthāpya homamācaret ||24||
grahayajño’yutahomo lakṣahomastathā mataḥ |
koṭihomastathā cāpi yathākāryabalānukṛt ||25||
ayutenāhutīnāṃ tu navagrahamakho mataḥ |
gartasyottarapūrveṇa vitastidvayavistṛtām || 26||
vipradvayāvṛtāṃ vediṃ vitasyucchrayaśobhanām |
caturasrāmudaṅmukhāṃ kṛtvāgninayanaṃ tataḥ ||27||
āvāhayet surām̐stasyāṃ sūryaṃ somaṃ ca maṃgalam |
budhaṃ guruṃ kaviṃ śanaiścaraṃ rāhuṃ ca ketukam ||28||
madhye sūryaṃ dakṣiṇe maṃgalaṃ guruṃ tathottare |
budhaṃ pūrvottare śukraṃ pūrve saṃsthāpayettathā || 29||
dakṣapūrve candramasaṃ śaniṃ tu paścime tathā |
rāhuṃ tu dakṣapaśce tu ketuṃ paścottare tathā ||3.133.3 0||
taṇḍuleṣu sthāpayedvā tathopadevatāḥ śubhāḥ |
sūryasyeśaṃ śaśinaśca pārvatīṃ copadevatām ||3 1||
skandaṃ bhaumasya ca hariṃ budhasyāpyupadevatām |
brahmāṇaṃ ca gurorindraṃ śukrasyāpyupadevatām ||32||
yamaṃ śanestathā rāhoḥ kālaṃ tathopadevatām |
citraguptaṃ ca ketorvai sthāpayedupadevatām ||33||
atha pratyupadevām̐śca sthāpayettatra tatra ca |
kramādagniṃ jalaṃ pṛthvīṃ viṣṇumindraṃ śacīṃ tathā ||34||
prajāpatiṃ bhoginaśca brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayecca tān |
vināyakaṃ ca durgāṃ ca vāyumākāśamityapi ||35||
āvāhayed vyāhṛtibhistathaivāśvikumārakau |
dhyāyedraviṃ raktavarṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ raktamityapi ||36||
somaśukrau śvetavarṇau budhagurū tu piṃgalau |
śanirāhū kṛṣṇavarṇau dhūmraṃ ketuṃ smarettadā ||37||
grahavarṇāni deyāni puṣṇāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca |
surabhirdhūpa evātra vitānakaṃ tathopari ||38||
phalapuṣpādi pūjārhaṃ sarvaṃ dadyāt samarhaṇe |
guḍaudanaṃ tu sūryāya somāya ghṛtapāyasam ||39||
maṃgalāya tu saṃyāvaṃ budhāya kṣīrakullarīm |
dadhyodanaṃ tu gurave śukrāya tu guḍaudanam ||3.133.40||
śanaiścarāya kṛśarāṃ māṣām̐stu rāhave tathā |
citraudanaṃ tu ketubhyastataḥ samarcayet surān ||41 ||
prāguttareṇa kalaśaṃ dadhyakṣatasamanvitam |
cūtapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalavastrayugānvitam ||42||
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed varuṇaṃ nyaset |
tīrthāni ca samudrām̐ścāvāhayet tatra vai jale ||43||
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkacatvarahradagokulāt |
mṛdamānīya ca sarvauṣadhivārisamanvitām ||44||
snānārthaṃ vinyaset tatra yajamānasya bhūsuraḥ |
homaṃ samācaret sarpiryavavrīhitilādibhiḥ ||45 ||
arkaḥ pālāśakhadirāvapāmārgaśca pippalaḥ |
audumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ||46||
ekaikasyāṣṭakaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatimeva vā |
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā ca samidhā tathā ||47||
tatkāṇḍān prādeśamātrānaśākhānapalāśinaḥ |
kalpayet samidhastatra juhuyād devamantrataḥ ||48||
pakvaṃ caruṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ samidhaṃ bhakṣyaprabhṛti |
daśāhutīḥ prahutvā juhuyād vyāhṛtibhistathā ||49||
mantritaṃ ca caruṃ tasmai tasmai devāya cārpayet |
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt snāpayet yajamānakam ||3.133.50||
surāstvāmabhirakṣantu sarve ye cātra pūjitāḥ |
tathānye pūjanārhāśca tvāmavantu samantataḥ ||5 1 ||
iti snapitaḥ sastrīko yajamānastu dakṣiṇām |
dadad viprebhya evāpi gṛhebhyaścāpi tāṃ yathā ||52||
sūryāya kapilāṃ dhenuṃ śaṃkhaṃ candrāya cārpayet |
bhaumāya vṛṣabhaṃ raktaṃ budhāya kanakaṃ diśet ||53|||
gurave pītavastraṃ ca śukrāya śvetavājinam |
kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ śanaye dadyādāyasaṃ rāhave tathā ||54||
chāgaṃ dadyāt keśavāyāthavā gāvastu yāvatām |
suvarṇaṃ vā pradadyācca gururyathā pratuṣyati ||55||
deye vastuni devasya mamārādhanapūrvakam |
dānaṃ śreṣṭhatamapuṇyapradaṃ prajāyate rame ||56||
mātastvaṃ pṛthvīrūpā dhenuḥ kṛṣṇasya vatsalā |
puṇyā pāpaharā me’stu nityāṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||57||
śaṃkhastvaṃ puṇyapuñjānāṃ mūrtirmaṃgalarūpiṇī |
kṛṣṇahastasthito nityaṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me’niśam ||58||
dharmadevo vṛṣaḥ kṛṣṇamūrtau pratiṣṭhate bhavān |
sarvānandapramodānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ dadhātu mām ||59||
kanaka tvaṃ vahniputra hemabījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
anantapuṇyaphaladaṃ śāntimṛddhiṃ prayaccha me ||3.133.6 0||
pītāmbaraṃ sadā śreṣṭhaṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham |
śāntiṃ ca sampadaṃ dehi kuru māṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ||61 ||
hayagrīvo bhavān viṣṇuramṛtauṣadhivīryapaḥ |
dehi me cāmṛtaṃ śāntiṃ māṇikyāśvīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||62||
kṛṣṇe go tvaṃ kṛṣṇapatnī kārṣṇī nārī vyajāyathāḥ |
kṛṣṇasya dhāriṇī cāste māṃ prapoṣaya nityadā ||6 3||
dhātūnāmāyasaṃ dāsaḥ sarvakiṃkarakāryakṛt |
sitāśarādideva tvaṃ nityāṃ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||64||
chāga tvaṃ kālarūpo’si svapne dṛṣṭo bhayāvahaḥ |
vahnivāha sadā śāntiṃ me prayaccha prapūjitaḥ ||65||
gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpā vai sarveśvarasurāśrayāḥ |
sarvoddhārasamarthāśca śriyai me santu sarvathā || 66||
śayye kṛṣṇena saṃbhuktā pāvanī tvaṃ sutapradā |
sampatpradāstu me nityamaśūnyāstu mama striyā ||67||
sarvaratnāni devānāṃ vāsātmakāni vai yataḥ |
ratnavāsaṃ gṛhe me’tra prakurvantvarpitāni ha ||68||
bhūmidānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ tathā suvarṇadānakam |
annarddhiṃ ca dhanarddhiṃ ca kurutaṃ me samarpite ||69||
ityabhyarthya ca samprārthya dāne dadyād viśeṣataḥ |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate ||3.133.70||
yastu pīḍākaro nityamalpavittasya vā grahaḥ |
taṃ tu yatnena sampūjya toṣayeccheṣasaṃyutam ||71||
varmavaccopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati pūjanāt |
sampūrṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||72||
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādikriyādiṣu |
nirvidhnārthaṃ praśāntyarthaṃ kuryādudvegaśāntidam ||73||
navagrahamakhaṃ bhakto’yutahomātmakaṃ śubham |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakamahādhvaram ||74||
prārthayed yajamāno’tra māṃ devānīśvarān satīḥ |
yajamānastīrthajalaiḥ snāpito vedavijjanaiḥ ||75||
snāpayitṛdvijā dadyurāśīrvādān surakṣakān |
anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nārāyaṇīyutaḥ ||76||
muktamuktānikāyuktastvāṃ sadā rakṣatu dhruvam |
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyukto nārāyaṇaḥ śriyā saha ||77||
vāsudevādayo vyūhā rakṣantu tvāṃ prapūjakam |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca mahendrādyā digīśvarāḥ ||78||
dharmapatnyaḥ samagrāśca sūryādyāśca navagrahāḥ |
vasavo nidhayo rudrāḥ ṛṣayo munayo vṛṣāḥ ||79||
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ |
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasā gaṇāḥ ||3.133.80 ||
bhūtapretapiśācādyā rudrā gaṇā gaṇeśvarāḥ |
yoginyaḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ śastrāstravāhanāni ca ||81 ||
ratnauṣadhāni vighnāśca kālaḥ kālasya vaṃśajāḥ |
sarve’pi kālāvayavāstīrthāni nikhilānyapi ||82||
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu rakṣantu vardhayantvapi |
evamāśīrvardhitaśca śuklāmbaradharo’rpayet ||83||
dakṣiṇā vividhāḥ sarvā viprebhyo gurave sate |
bhojayed bahudhā viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ ||84||
bālām̐śca bālikām̐ścāpi dīnāndhakṛpaṇām̐stathā |
bhikṣukān daivavṛttīṃśca miṣṭānnapāyasādibhiḥ ||85||
homānayutasaṃkhyākān kārayed viprapuṃgavaiḥ |
yadvā svayaṃ prakuryācca brahmaśīlavratānvitaḥ ||86||
tataḥ kuryāt parihāraṃ grahādhvarasya sarvathā |
grahaśāntirbhavettena pīḍā naśyet sukhī bhavet ||87||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne puṇyatamadinapradarśanaṃ grahaśāntipūjādipradarśanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 133 ||

<3.134>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lakṣahomagrahādhvaram |
sarvakāmapradaṃ sarvavighnaśāntikaraṃ sukham || 1 ||
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
grahatārābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam || 2 ||
gṛhasyottarapūrveṇa maṇḍapaṃ kārayennavam |
dvādaśahastavistāraṃ caturasramudaṅmukham || 3 ||
daśahastamaṣṭahastaṃ ca vā prakārayettu tam |
prāgudakplavanāṃ bhūmiṃ kārayet sarvarakṣiṇīm || 4 ||
kuṇḍaṃ samekhalaṃ kuryāccaturasraṃ sayonikam |
prāguttare maṇḍapādhobhāge raṃgādirañjitam || 5 ||
caturaṃgulavistārāṃ mekhalāṃ tadvaducchrayām |
dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāyataṃ śubham || 6 ||
lakṣahome racayedvai kuṇḍaṃ śobhāvahaṃ tathā |
tasya cottarapūrveṇa vitastitrayamānakam || 7 ||
prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tacca caturasraṃ samantataḥ |
viṣkambhādhocchritaṃ kāryaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ śilpakarmaṇā || 8 ||
saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapratrayasamāvratam |
dvyaṅgulordhvaḥ prathamastu vapraḥ kāryaḥ śubhāvahaḥ || 9 ||
vapradvayaṃ cāṃgulordhvaṃ pratyekaṃ vai tathopari |
daśāṃgulocchritā bhittiḥ sthaṇḍile vai tathopari || 3.134.1 0||
tatra tvāvāhayet devān puṣpataṇḍulakāsane |
sūryādīnadhidevādīṃstathā pratyadhidevatāḥ || 11 ||
garutmānadhikastatra sampūjyaḥ śriyamicchatā |
viṣṇubhakto mahābhakto viṣapāpaharo’si vai || 1 2||
sukhado viṣṇubhaktānāṃ śāntimṛddhiṃ prayaccha me |
kuṃbhamāmantrya vidhinā lakṣahomān samācaret || 13||
samitsaṃkhyādhikān homān samācaretpraśāntaye |
ghṛtakuṃbhavasordhārāṃ pātayedanalopari || 14||
audumbaryā bāhumārgadīrghayā juhuyāt sruvā |
śrāvayet sūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramaindavam || 15||
mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭhasāma ca vācayet |
snānayed yajamānaṃ ca svastivācanamuccaret || 16||
sudadyād dakṣiṇāścāpi bhūyasīḥ śāntacetasā |
ṛtvigbhyaśca caturbhyo vā dvābhyāṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 17| |
bhakṣyabhojyāni dānāni goratnāni tathārpayet |
śayanāni savastrāṇi haimāni kaṭakāni ca || 18||
kaṇāṃgulipavitrāṇi kaṇṭhahārān suvarṇajān |
bhūṣaṇāni dhanaṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cācaret || 19||
annadānaṃ prakuryācca subhikṣavarṣadāyakam |
sādhūn viprān bālabālā bhojayed vividhānnakam ||3.134.20||
annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ |
yaṣṭāraṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ ||21 ||
sakāmo lakṣahomām̐śca kṛtveṣṭakāmamāpnuyāt |
putrārthī labhate putrān dhanārthī labhate dhanam ||22||
bhāryārthī śobhanāṃ bhāryāṃ patyarthinī patiṃ priyam |
bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt ||23 ||
mānaṃ labhate mānārthī prādhānyaṃ lokavanditam |
vijayārthī jayaṃ cāpi labhate sārvakālikam ||24||
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ caiśvaryaṃ siddhimityapi |
taṃ taṃ labhate yajñena grahāṇāṃ samanugrahāt ||25|||
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yajñaṃ sa parabrahma gacchati |
tatra bhuṃkte parān bhogān sukhamānantyamaśnute ||26||
atha nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śṛṇu yajñaṃ tatodhikam |
asmācchataguṇo yajñaḥ koṭihomaḥ prajāyate ||27||
āhutibhiḥ śraddhayā ca dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalena ca |
maṇḍape grahadevānāvāhayedupadevatāḥ ||28||
pratyupadevānāvāhya śuddhisnānādi cācaret |
koṭihome caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ ||29||
yonivakradvayopetaṃ kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ trimekhalam |
prathamā dvyaṅgulordhvā tryaṅgulordhvā tu dvitīyakā ||3.134.30 ||
ucchrāyavistarābhyāṃ tu tṛtīyā caturaṃgulā |
vitastimātrā yoniśca ṣaṭsaptāṃgulavistṛtā ||31 ||
kūrmapṛṣṭhonnatā madhye pārśvayoścāṅgulocchritā |
gajoṣṭhasadṛśī tadvadāyatā chidraśobhitā ||32||
aśvatthapatratulyābhākṛtirekhādirājitā |
vedī caturvitastiḥ syāccaturasrā trivapriṇī ||33||
vaprapramāṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vedyucchrayo’pi tadvidhaḥ |
maṇḍapaḥ ṣoḍaśahastaścaturmukhaḥ suśobhitaḥ ||34||
maṇḍape pūrvagadvāre bahvṛcaṃ sthāpayed dvijam |
yajurvidaṃ dakṣiṇe ca paścime sāmavedinam ||35||
uttare’tharvavijñaṃ ca tathāṣṭau homakārthinaḥ |
evaṃ dvādaśa viduṣaḥ pūjayed bhaktisaṃbhṛtaḥ ||36||
kuṃkumākṣatabhūṣādyairvastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
rātrisūktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ pavamānaṃ sumaṃgalam || 37||
śāntipāṭhaṃ vācayet prāṅbahvṛcānanataḥ purā |
śāntaṃ śākraṃ ca saumyaṃ ca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ śāntimeva ca ||38||
pāṭhayed dakṣiṇaviprānanād yajurvido hyatha |
suparṇaṃ cāpi vairājamāgneyaṃ rudrasaṃhitām ||39||
jyeṣṭhaṃ sāma tathā śāntiṃ paṭhedvai paścimo dvijaḥ |
śāntiṃ sūktaṃ ca sauraṃ ca tathā śākunakaṃ param ||3.134.40||
pauṣṭikaṃ ca mahārājyamuttarasthaḥ paṭhed dvijaḥ |
pañcabhiḥ saptabhiścātra homaḥ kāryo dvijottamaiḥ ||41 ||
vasordhārāvidhānaṃ ca daśottaraṃ hi pūrvataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā koṭihomān sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||42||
viṣṇupadaṃ vrajeccāpi padamindrasya gacchati |
vairājaṃ ca padaṃ labdhvā yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||43||
aśvamedhādhvarāṇāṃ yaścāṣṭādaśasahasrakam |
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti koṭihomāt tadaśnute ||44||
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi bhrūṇahatyārbudāni ca |
koṭihomādhvareṇaiva naśyanti mama yogataḥ ||45||
grahayajñatrayaṃ kuryād yastu prasannatāṃ mama |
icchan so’pi vrajecchāntiṃ pīḍānāṃ me prabhāvataḥ ||46||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayecca smaredapi |
na tasya grahapīḍā syād vartamānā tu naśyati ||47||
grahayajñatrayaṃ gehe likhitaṃ yasya vidyate |
na pīḍā tatra bālānāṃ na rogo na ca bandhanam ||48||
śṛṇu lakṣmi grahamūrtīryathā kāryāḥ suvarṇajāḥ |
padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ ||49||
saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuśca dvibhujaśca kirīṭavān |
kuṇḍalāḍhyaḥ saparidhiḥ sūryaḥ kāryaḥ prabhānvitaḥ ||3.134.50 ||
śvetaḥ śvetāmbaradharaḥ śvetāśvaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ |
gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī ||51 ||
raktamālyāmbaradharaḥ śaktiśūlagadādimān |
caturbhujaḥ śvetaromā varado maṃgalo mataḥ ||52||
pītamālyāmbaradharaḥ karṇikārasamaprabhaḥ |
khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ ||53||
bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca pītaḥ śvetaḥ kramāttathā |
caturbhujau daṇḍinau ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalū ||54||
indranīlaprabhaḥ śūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ |
śaradhanuṣyadhārī ca kartavyo vai śanaiścaraḥ ||55||
nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuḥ kṛṣṇaprabho mataḥ |
dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadāyutā ruṣānvitāḥ ||56||
gṛdhrāsanāḥ ketavaḥ kartavyāśca varadāstathā |
sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā ūrdhve’ṣṭayukśatāṃgulāḥ ||57||
śṛṇulakṣmi purā vaiśyo dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān |
lohāṃgāraitināmnābhavad deśe tu mālave ||58||
vyāpāreṇa mahāśreṣṭhī rājyakośābhirakṣakaḥ |
deśaprajādravyapātā dravyadātābhavattathā ||59||
yasyābhavan gṛhe vājigajāśca vāṭikāstathā |
udyānāni vicitrāṇi bhavanāni śubhāni ca ||3.134.60 ||
svarṇasiṃhāsanānyeva kalaśāḥ svarṇarājatāḥ |
nāryaḥ sauvarṇabhūṣāḍhyā ratnahārāvalīyutāḥ ||61 ||
vimānenārkatulyena viharanti pare’mbare |
dāsā dāsyaḥ śataṃ yasya bhṛtyā lakṣaṃ tu nityaśaḥ ||62||
karmacārā bhavantyasya dravyopārjanatatparāḥ |
prajārājāmātyavargeṣvasya mānaṃ mataṃ bahu ||63||
sarvamāsācchubhaṃ kintu grahā duṣṭā yadāsya tu |
duṣṭasthāne śaniścānye’bhavam̐staiḥ pīḍito hyayam ||64||
rogī jāto mṛtaprāyo lakṣmīrdravyāṇi bhūbhṛtā |
luṇṭhitāni samagrāṇi putrāḥ kārāgṛhe kṛtāḥ ||65||
bhavanāni cāgnidagdhānyeva jānāti vai tadā |
vyāpārāḥ sarva evaite naṣṭaprāyāstadābhavan ||66||
kalaṃkena yaśohānirjātāsyāpi prajāsvapi |
samantato mahākaṣṭaṃ samāyātaṃ bhunakti saḥ ||67||
athāsyāsīd gururvipro maharṣiścāmṛṣāyanaḥ |
yogī trikāladarśī ca vedavid grahapūjakaḥ ||68||
nārāyaṇasya bhakto’pi vrataśīlopaśobhitaḥ |
sādhuḥ sāttvikabhāvāḍhyaḥ satyavrato’tividyakaḥ ||69||
lauhāṃgāraṃ nijyaśiṣyaṃ śrutvā kaṣṭapramagnakam |
draṣṭuṃ gṛhe samāyātaḥ kṛpayā preritastadā ||3.134.70 ||
vīkṣya śiṣyaṃ kaṣṭamagnaṃ naṣṭadravyaṃ vinā yaśaḥ |
putradaṇḍaṃ tathā rogaṃ dayāṃ parāmavāptavān ||71 ||
prāha lohāṃgārakaṃ taṃ kuru śāntiṃ grahasya vai |
gṛhaśāntyā grahamakhaiḥ kaṣṭaṃ dūraṃ gamiṣyati ||72||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
bhajānanyamanaskastvaṃ paraṃ saukhyamavāpsyasi ||73||
ityuktaḥ so’pi sahasā bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ |
tathaiveti samagṛhya kārayāmāsa maṇḍapam ||74||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmūrjamāse kuṇḍaṃ cakāra śobhanam |
grahamūrtīḥ kānakīśca mama mūrtiṃ ca kānakīm ||75||
tvayā lakṣmyā ca sahitāṃ cakārātipraśobhanām |
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārādyabhiśobhitavigrahām ||76||
adhidevān pratyadhidevatāśca maṇḍape tataḥ |
āsaneṣvāvāhayāmāsārcayāmāsa vaidhataḥ ||77||
aṣṭottaraśataviprān vavre japārthameva saḥ |
koṭijapān vedavidbhiḥ kārayāmāsa sarvathā ||78||
pūjānte pradadau dānaṃ guptaṃ pṛthvyāḥ pragartataḥ |
niṣkāsya lakṣasauvarṇamudrāṇāṃ lakṣyavarjitam ||79||
aprakāśaṃ yadāsīttad ratnamāṇikyahīrakān |
dadau dāne tu viprebhyo gogajāśvādikaṃ tathā ||3.134.80||
naivedyāni yathoktāni dadau peyāni yāni ca |
devebhyo balidānāni sāttvikāni dadau tathā ||81 ||
bhojayāmāsa viprām̐śca sādhūn sādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ |
bālām̐śca bālikāścapi dīnakṛpaṇaduḥkhinaḥ ||82||
nirāśritān nirdhanām̐śca kaṃgālām̐śca daridrakān |
puṇyān puṇyajanām̐ścāpi bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||83||
sarvaṃ cakāra vidhinā pūjanaṃ mama te’pi ca |
grahaśāntyā yajñapuṇyairmama te ca prasādataḥ ||84||
lohāṃgārasya dehādvai rogo’naśyad drutaṃ tadā |
svasthobhavattato rājā dayāmagno’bhavacca tam ||85||
samāhūya dadau mānaṃ pūrvato’bhyadhikaṃ bahu |
mahāmātyapadaṃ tasmai prāyacchad devalādhipaḥ ||86||
prajāścāpi namaścakrurmānayāmāsurādarāt |
putrān rājā svayaṃ kārāgārādamocayattadā ||87||
atha caurāśca bhagnāśāstrastā rājyabhayaṃ gatāḥ |
coritaṃ sarmamevāpi cikṣipurniśi catvare ||88||
prakāśaṃ prajayā prātardṛṣṭaṃ cāsmai niveditam |
prāptaṃ sarva dhanaṃ cāpi grahaśāntyā tadā rame ||89||
evaṃ sā prāpya sarvaṃ tat kalpayāmāsa dānakam |
svarṇaṃ ratnāni māṇikyaṃ hīrakān rūpyakāṇi ca ||3.134.90||
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mahāyajñaṃ samārebhe dvijātibhiḥ |
sarvaṃ pratyāgataṃ dravyaṃ dadau sa dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ ||91||
ahaṃ prasanno hyabhavaṃ tasya tasya gurostathā |
dadau svadarśanaṃ lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ hyavabhṛthe ||92||
varārthaṃ deśitaḥ so’pi varaṃ vavre hi bhṛtyatām |
mayoktaṃ kuru ramyaṃ me mandiraṃ māṃ ca mandire ||93||
pratiṣṭhāpya sadā sevāṃ bhṛtyatāṃ kuru sarvathā |
kṛtvā tūrṇaṃ sa evaṃ vai dāsyaṃ cakre kuṭumbavān ||94||
ātmaniveditāṃ cakre bheje māṃ puruṣottamam |
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhūtvā rājānaṃ devalābhidham ||95||
vaiṣṇavaṃ pracakārāpi prajāśca vaiṣṇavīstathā |
cakāra nijayogena bhaktimatīḥ śubhakriyāḥ ||96||
lakṣavarṣaṃ kṣitau sthitvā svargaṃ bhuktvā yugāṣṭakam |
satyalokaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ vairājaṃ tu parārdhakam ||97||
bhuktvā vaikuṇṭhamevāpi yayau me tvakṣaraṃ padam |
pūrvakalpe mahālakṣmi katheyaṃ sampravartitā ||98 ||
adya me vartate dhāmni pārṣadaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ |
evaṃ grahādhvaraṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||99||
duḥkhanāśe sukhaṃ modaṃ pramodaṃ labhate’nvaham |
aniṣṭānāṃ vināśaṃ ca sveṣṭānāṃ labhate sthitim ||3.134.1 00 ||
nityaṃ rājan pūjayed yastasya śāntirhi śāśvatī |
grahapīḍā na jāyeta yakṣarakṣobhavāpi na ||1 01 ||
caurakālakṛtā nāpi nāpi devakṛtāpi ca |
grahe śaktipradātāhaṃ rakṣāmi vaiṣṇavaṃ mama ||1 02||
śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt |
grahaśāntisamāṃ śāntiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne grahamakhe lakṣajapahomakoṭijapahomādividhiḥ, lohāṃ gārakavaiśyasya sarvasvanāśottaraṃ grahaśāntyā punarlabdhirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 134 ||

<3.135>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ purā dakṣeṇa vanditā |
prākaṭyāni lalitāyā lakṣmyoścoktavatī svayam || 1 ||
dakṣaḥ papraccha mātaste prākaṭyānyatra bhūtale |
kāni kutra ca vartante vartsyante tāni me vada || 2 ||
yatpūjābalataścāhaṃ vighnān vināśaye sadā |
grahadoṣān karmadoṣān vināśaye tavārhaṇāt || 3 ||
tadā tvaṃ nijapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ coktavatī śubham |
lalitākhyamahālakṣmyāḥ pūjakasyāśubhāni vai || 4 ||
vinaṃkṣyanti na sandeho mama pūjāprakāriṇaḥ |
yāni yāni svarūpāṇi yatra yatra bhavanti ca || 5 ||
tāni vakṣyāmi te dakṣaprajāpate niśāmaya |
ahaṃ tvakṣaradhāmasthā śrīdevī puruṣottamau || 6 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇī śrīparameśvarī |
brahmamuktānikā brāhmī kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī ramā || 7 ||
vāsudevī ca vairājī hiraṇyā hariṇī prabhā |
mahālakṣmīḥ kaṃbharāśrīrlalitā kamalā calā || 8 ||
īśvarī vaiṣṇavī cāndrī hiraṇmayī ca devatā |
ārṣī siddhā yoginī ca sādhvī satī pativratā || 9 ||
prabhvī dhāmā jayā bhaumī maheśī bhūrnarāyaṇī |
pāśavatī ca māṇikyā mārūpā śrīharipriyā ||3.135.1 0||
duḥkhahā śivarājñīśrī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī satī |
brahmapriyā brahmadhāmni mahālakṣmīśca śrīpure || 11 ||
lakṣmīḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca mahālakṣmīstu raivate |
vyāghreśvarī māhiṣe ca gokarṇe dhenukarṇikā || 1 2||
santuṣṭā cākṣare kṣetre camatkāre tu mādhavī |
vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī ||1 3||
prayāge lalitā cāsmi kāmākṣī gandhamādane |
mānase kumudā devī viśvakāyā cidambare || 14||
gomante gomatīnāmnī mandarādrau tu kāmagā |
madotkaṭā caitrarathe jayantī vārahāhvaye ||15||
gaurīnāmnī kānyakubje raṃbhā tu malayācale |
ekāmrake kīrtimatī viśvā viśveśvare’smi ca ||1 6||
puṣkare puruhūtāsmi kedāre mārgadāsmi ca |
himācale ca nandāsmi bilvake bilvapatrikā ||17||
sthāneśvare bhavānyasmi śrīśaile padminī sadā |
bhadrā bhadreśvare cāsmi jayā vārāhaparvate || 18||
kāmalā kamalābhūmau raudrī ca rudrakoṭike |
kālī kālaṃjare cāsmi markoṭe mukuṭeśvarī ||19||
mahāliṃge kapilāsmi śivalige jalapriyā |
śālagrāme mahādevī māyāpuryāṃ kumārikā ||3.135.20||
santāne kāñcikāpuryāṃ lalitā durgapattane |
utpalākṣī sahasrākṣe kalamākṣe mahotpalā ||21 ||
gaṃgāyāṃ maṃgalā durgā vimalā puruṣottame |
vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane ||22||
nārāyaṇī supārśve’smi vikūṭe bhadrasundarī |
vipule vipulānāmnī kalyāṇī malayācale ||23||
koṭitīrthe koṭavī ca sugandhā mādhave vane |
kubjāmrake trisandhyāsmi gaṃgādvāre ratipriyā ||24|||
śivakuṇḍe sunandāsmi nandinī devikātaṭe |
rukmavarṇā dvāravatyāṃ rādhā vṛndāvane’smi ca ||25||
madhurāyāṃ devakanyā pātāle parameśvarī |
citrakūṭe tu sītāsmi vindhye vindhyācalī tathā ||26 ||
sahyādrāvekavīrāsmi harmacandre tu candrikā |
ramaṇā rāmatīrthe’smi yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī ||27||
karavīre mahālakṣmīrumādevī vināyake |
aromā vaijanāthe’smi mahākāle maheśvarī ||28||
abhayāsmi coṣṇatīrthe amṛtā vindhyakandare |
māṇḍavye māṇḍavīnāmnī svāhā māheśvare pure ||29 ||
chāgale’smi pracaṇḍāhaṃ caṇḍikā makarandake |
someśvare varārohā prabhāse puṣkarāvatī ||3.135.3 0||
sarasvatyāṃ devamātā pārā pārātaṭe’smi ca |
mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṃgaleśvarī ||3 1 ||
siṃhāraṇye siṃhikāsmi kārtikeye yaśaskarī |
utpalāvartake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṃgame ||32||
mātā lakṣmīḥ siddhapure aṅganā pulahāśrame |
jālandhare viśvamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate ||33 ||
devadāruvane puṣṭirmedhā kāśmiramaṇḍale |
himādrau bhīmikādevī puṣṭirviśveśvare’smi ca ||34||
kapālamocane śuddhirmātā kāyāvarohaṇe |
śaṃkhoddhāre dharādevī dhṛtiḥ piṇḍārake’smi ca ||35||
māṇikyānartake nārāyaṇīśrīrasmi nāgare |
kālāsmi candrabhāgāyāmacchode śivakāriṇī ||36||
veṇāyāmamṛtānāmnī badaryāmurvaśī tathā |
oṣadhiścottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā ||37||
manmathā hemakūṭe tu mukuṭe satyavādinī |
aśvatthe vandanīyāsmi nidhiśca śravaṇālaye ||38||
gāyatrī brahmaṇā sākaṃ pārvatī śivasannidhau |
devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmāsye’smi sarasvatī ||39|||
sūryabimbe prabhā dhairye pāśavatī tu vaiṣṇavī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’smi sukhadā ramā ||3.135.40||
arundhatī satī cāsmi tilottamāpsarogaṇe |
citte brahmakalā cāsmi kāntā kānteṣu sarvaśaḥ ||41 ||
bhaṃgā nīlagirāvasmi vijayāsāmabhūtale |
kāmarūpe ca kāmākṣyā brahmadeśa irāsmi ca ||42||
khāsīneṣu brahmaputrī patatkāye tu pāvanī |
śyāmā śyāmapradeśe’smi prācīne menakāṃginī ||43 ||
uccīne yāgaśikṣāṃgī tryaṃguleṣu tu kāramī |
kārākāre kṛṣṇavarṇā elune khanirasmi ca ||44||
mūkī maṃgolake cāsmi khiṃgane mañcchikāsmi ca |
stenāvāse pāraśavī rāśiputrī tu rāśane ||45||
uralā coralādrau ca raktā cāraktabhūtale |
nārāyaṇī sudāne’smi cālpā cālpe ca parvate ||46||
iṅgitajñā ketumāle parī cāsmi balāyate |
hāritī piṃgadeśe ca amarī kiṃpumātmake ||47||
rākarī mānakaṃgau ca parīnārī tu dakṣake |
saṃhārā najare’drau ca kāmarūpā kamāraṇe ||48||
māsāmbā sāmbaśaile’smi kalihārā tu mitrape |
trihotre hotriṇī cāsmi jhambe māṃjhāmbikāsmi ca ||49||
navadeśe maṇikāntā uṣṭrālaye mahordhvikā |
kalagaralī śvānāyāṃ cāliśī kvāthaparvate ||3.135.50||
evamādisvarūpaiśca bhūtale saṃvasāmyaham |
dakṣa sarvatra matpūjāṃ kuru bhuktipramuktidām ||51 ||
ityāha śrīmahālakṣmīstadā dakṣaṃ prajāpatim |
ataste tu mahālakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ sarvaśāntikṛt ||52||
pūjāyāṃ sarvanāmāni dve śate tava yo japet |
sarvāśca siddhayastasyopatiṣṭhantu yatheṣṭadāḥ ||53||
grahāṇāṃ cāpi yakṣāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ vairiṇāṃ tathā |
kaṣṭāni yāntu nāśaṃ vai tava śāntimakhādibhiḥ ||54||
maṇḍapaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kamalākāramuttamam |
vartulaṃ kārayitvā yaḥ kuṇḍaṃ kamalavattathā ||55||
śatadvayena saṃsmṛtya nāmnāṃ tvāṃ parameśvarīm |
taṇḍuleṣu samāvāhya pūjayet kamalādibhiḥ ||56||
tasya pīḍā samastā vai nāśameṣyanti madvarāt |
homān kṛtvāṣṭasaṃkhyān vai pratyekanāmasaṃyutān ||57||
ghṛtapāyasamiṣṭānnaistato dadyānmahāhutim |
ghṛtadhārābhirevāpi phalairvrīhyādibhistathā ||58||
nārikelaphalādyaiśca samidbhiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ |
yastasya mānaseṣṭaṃ yat tatsarvaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ||59||
rājyaṃ svargaśca mokṣaśca sarvaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati |
strīputrapatilābhādirdhanakīrtī bhaviṣyataḥ ||3.135.60 ||
suvidhānaṃ tatra vacmi lakṣmīyajñe yathāyatham |
śataṃ ca viṃśatiścāpi hastānāṃ parimaṇḍalam ||61 ||
maṇḍapārthaṃ tu gṛhṇīyād daśastaṃbhamayaṃ śubham |
maṇḍapaṃ racayettatra caturdvāraiḥ suśobhitam ||62||
toraṇaiḥ suvitānena vartulaśikhareṇa ca |
sauvarṇakalaśaiścāpi dhvajena śobhitena ca ||63 ||
raktavastradhvajenāpi śobhitaṃ kārayecchubham |
paritastava śastrāṇi toraṇeṣu likhettathā ||64||
aṣṭādaśa vibhinnāni pūrvato dakṣiṇakramāt |
khaḍgaṃ carma karavālaṃ daṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ paviṃ dhanuḥ ||65||
paraśuṃ ca śaraṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śaṃkhaṃ mahāṃkuśam |
kamalaṃ mālikāṃ śaktiṃ kṣepaṇīṃ cābhayaṃ tathā ||66||
evametānyāyudhāni toraṇeṣu nidhāpayet |
pratistambhaṃ kalaśām̐śca dhvajānapi vidhāpayet ||67||
dvāraśākhāsvaṣṭadevīḥ sthāpayeccāṅgadevatāḥ |
pūrvaśākhādvaye śrīṃ ca māṇikyāṃ sthāpayettathā ||68 ||
dakṣiṇe ca ramāṃ pāśavatīṃ saṃsthāpayettathā |
paścime maṃgalāṃ caivāmṛtāṃ saṃsthāpayettathā ||69||
uttare tu vijayāṃ ca jayāṃ saṃsthāpayettathā |
madhyastambheṣu caiśāne durgāṃ satīṃ ca vinyaset ||3.135.70 ||
agnistambhadvaye svāhāṃ svadhāṃ cāvāsayettathā |
nairṛte saṃhāriṇīṃ ca vaśinīṃ sthāpayettathā ||71 ||
vāyavye śāradāṃ vāṇīṃ sthāpayecchobhanāṃ śubhām |
sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā yamīm ||72||
vaiṣṇavīṃ ca varāhīṃ caṇḍikāmaindrīṃ ca vāruṇīm |
bhuvaṃ saṃjñāṃ kaumudīṃ ca nandāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ ramām ||73||
santuṣṭāṃ ṣoḍaśaśaktiḥ sthāpayettu vitānake |
stambhāntaracarusthāneṣvatiśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ||74||
dvihastāḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyāḥ pūjayettīrthavāribhiḥ |
kuṃkumākṣatatailādyaiḥ sugandhicandanādibhiḥ ||75||
kuṇḍaṃ tu vartule hastadaśakaṃ vai yathā bhavet |
tathā ṣoḍaśadalavat padmarūpaṃ vidhāpayet ||76||
sayoniṃ kārayettatra mekhalātrikamityapi |
lakṣahomān koṭihomān kārayediṣṭasiddhidān ||77||
dve śate tava rūpāṇi cāvāhayed prapūjayet |
mahālakṣmīṃ tava mūrtiṃ pronnatāṃ tu śubhānanām ||78||
ṣaṭpañcāśadaṅgulāṃ samukuṭāṃ hārarājitām |
svarṇasiṃhāsanasthāṃ vai kānakīṃ vānyadhātujām ||79||
kārayet tatsakhīnāṃ tu yathāyogyāṃ prakārayet |
pañcāmṛtaistīrthajalaiḥ saṃsnāpya parameśvarīm ||3.135.80||
gandhasugandhaśṛṃgārairvibhūṣābhiścidambaraiḥ |
kusumābharaṇairdehāvayavānāṃ suśobhanaiḥ ||81 ||
candanākṣatatulasīkastūrīgandhasārakaiḥ |
pūjayitvā vividhāni naivedyāni samarpayet ||82||
miṣṭānnāni samastāni pāyasānnāni yāni ca |
miṣṭarasān śākabhājā naivedye vai samarpayet ||83||
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyādārārtrikaṃ tataścaret |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prārthayet praṇamettathā ||84||
janmahantri bhavahantri rogahantri pareśvari |
vāsudevi kṛṣṇadevi mahālakṣmi namo’stu te ||85||
pārabrāhmi sarvabhūtahṛdayasthe parātpare |
sarvadevīsvarūpe te rakṣayitri namo muhuḥ ||86 ||
tava bhaktasya me kaṣṭaṃ daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ tathā |
karmajaṃ kālajaṃ vāpi prārabdhajaṃ grahotthitam ||87||
svabhāvajaṃ mānasaṃ vā yadasti jāyate’thavā |
janiṣyate ca yatkaṣṭaṃ śāpād drohātpramādataḥ ||88 ||
ajñānāccāpi vai yacca duṣprārabdhaṃ ca me bhavet| |
avaṃśatvaṃ cāputratvaṃ niḥstrīkatvaṃ vimānatā ||89||
sarvaṃ rogabhayaṃ cāpi mama nāśaṃ prayātu tat |
saukhyaṃ tavaiva kṛpayā modo bhavatu cāniśam ||3.135.90 ||
śāśvataṃ śrīpuraṃ svargaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padamastu me |
ante’kṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma mamāstu paramaṃ padam ||91 ||
ityabhyarthya kusumānāmaṃjaliṃ vitarettataḥ |
aparādhān kṣantumevārādhayitvā mahāsatīm ||92||
visarjayet tathā dāsīścopadevīvisarjayet |
dadyācca devatāṃ lakṣmīṃ gurave brahmamūrtaye ||9 3 ||
mandire sthāpayedvāpi mahālakṣmīṃ sthire dṛḍhe |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sahitāṃ ca vā ||94||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇena mahāviṣṇvātmanā yutām |
sthāpayet svarṇaśikharaiḥ śobhite devatālaye ||95||
suvarṇamudrādānāni rūpyakām̐ścārpayettathā |
māṇikyahīrakaratnabhūṣāvastrāṇi cārpayet ||96||
miṣṭānnāni diśeścāpi nārīvastrāṇi cārpayet |
ramyaśṛṃgārabhūṣāścopakaraṇāni cārpayet ||97||
dhanadhānyāni sarvāṇi gṛhadānāni kārayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā parihāraṃ tato bhojanamācaret ||98 ||
bhojayet sādhuviprām̐śca dīnāndhakṛpaṇām̐stathā |
bālān prabālikāścāpi yoṣito’nāthanirdhanīḥ ||99||
sataḥ satīśca sādhvīśca bhojayetpūjayettathā |
nityaṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayecca bhojayet vidhinā tathā || 3.135.100 ||
evaṃ karturna vai duḥkhaṃ santāpo vā bhavet kvacit |
bhuktiḥ sampanmahāmuktiḥ sāmrājyaṃ ca bhavet sadā || 101 ||
akhaṇḍānandabhoktṛtvaṃ devīvṛndādhikāntatā |
bhavet kṛṣṇasamānatvaṃ śrīpate kṛpayā śriyāḥ ||1 02||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tavārhaṇaṃ praśāntidam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mahāsaukhyaṃ bhavet sadā || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dakṣaprajāpataye mahālakṣmyuktāni svīyāni śatadvayanāmarūpāṇi lakṣmīmakhe śāntipūjā mahālakṣmīpratimā tanmaṇḍalādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 135 ||

<3.136>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lakṣmīnāmnāṃ śatadvayam |
purā japtvā samārādhya tapaḥ kṛtvā tavopari || 1 ||
acchodā nāma pitṝṇāṃ kanyakā mānasī śubhā |
amāvasuṃ hi balinaṃ patiṃ prāptavatī tataḥ || 2 ||
pitṝṇāṃ ca mahālakṣmyā āśīrvādamavāpa sā |
matsyayonisamutpannā vasoḥ rājñaḥ suvīryajā || 3 ||
kanyakā dhīvarapoṣyā sasyavatī bhaviṣyasi |
parāśarasya vīryeṇa putramekamavāpsyasi || 4 ||
dvīpe tu badarīprāye bādarāyaṇamacyutam |
viṣṇormātā svayaṃ bhūtvā tataḥ paraṃ vivāhitā || 5 ||
samudrāṃśena bhūpena śantanunā suputriṇī |
bhaviṣyasi sutau citrāṃgadavicitravīryakau || 6 ||
utpādya ca tataḥ pitṛlokaṃ prayāsyasi drutam |
prauṣṭhapadyaṣṭakārūpā pitṛloke bhaviṣyasi || 7 ||
nāmnā satyavatī loke pitṛloke tathāṣṭakā |
āyurārogyadā nityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradā || 8 ||
bhaviṣyasi tataścāpi nadītvaṃ saṃvrajiṣyasi |
acchodānāmataścāpi pitruddhārakarī sadā || 9 ||
ityevaṃ sā pitṛkanyā lakṣmīśāntivratena vai |
khyātimatī vyāsamātā varadānamavāpa ha || 3.136.10 ||
gīyate dve śate nāmnāṃ yenāṣṭamyāṃ ca pūjane |
godāne śrāddhadāne vā bahuputro bhaveddhi saḥ || 11 ||
dve śate te tathā lakṣmi tīrthānyapi bhavanti ca |
sṛṣṭitraye’pi tatrāpi snātā brahmādhigacchati || 12||
pitarastasya santṛptāstaranti brahma yāntyapi |
atha cānye barhiṣadaḥ pulastyasya sutā divi ||1 3||
pitaraḥ śataśaḥ santi tāsāṃ kanyā tu mānasī |
pīvarī nāmataḥ sādhvī cakre lakṣmi vrataṃ tava ||14||
lakṣmīśāntikaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ tapaśca dāruṇam |
tvāṃ labdhvā gocarāṃ divyāṃ harikṛṣṇayutāṃ vane ||15||
varaṃ cāvāpa tatraiva tvattaḥ patimatī bhava |
patiste śukradevo vai mahāyogī bhaviṣyati || 16||
vyāsasutastasya bhāryā bhavatī mānasīṃ sutām |
kṛtvīnāmnīṃ lapsyase ca yoginīṃ divyaśobhanām ||17||
dāsyasi tvaṃ sutāṃ rājñe pāñcāleśāya vai tataḥ |
putrāste’pi ca catvāraḥ kṛtvyanujā maheśvarāḥ ||18||
kṛṣṇo gauraḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhurbhaviṣyanti pramuktidāḥ |
patiputrādisahitā cireṇa mokṣameṣyasi ||19||
ityevaṃ pīvarī prāptā varadānaṃ tava vratāt |
atha cānye pitaro’pi marīcigarbhanāminaḥ ||3.136.20 ||
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yaśodā nāmataḥ śubhā |
kṛtvā vrataṃ tava lakṣmi patnī hyaṃśumato’bhavat ||21 ||
jananyapi dilīpasya bhagīrathapitāmahī |
ajāyata tataḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ gatāpi sundarī ||22||
athājyapānāṃ kanyāpi nāmnā tu virajā purā |
lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā nahuṣasya priyābhavat ||23||
yayāterjananī sā ca aikāṣṭakābhavattataḥ |
brahmalokagatā tatra modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||24||
atha mānasapitṝṇāṃ kanyā tu narmadā satī |
lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā nadīrūpā pramodate ||25||
pramodate sadā svarge pitṛloke’pi modate |
pūjyate triṣu lokeṣu harernarmapradā sakhī ||26||
atha gauḥ pitṛkanyāpi lakṣmīśāntivratena vai |
śukrasya dayitā patnī sādhyamātā virājate |||27|||
evaṃ svarge tathā satye bhūtale’pi sthalesthale |
lakṣmīśāntivratenaiva modante sampadarddhibhiḥ ||28||
atha lakṣmi śukaputrī nāmnā kṛtvī tu yoginī |
pitṛmānasakanyāyāḥ pīvaryāḥ putrikā purā ||29||
lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ cakre nārāyaṇasamanvitam |
putrārthaṃ tatpatiścāpi pañcālādhipatirnṛpaḥ ||3.136.3 0||
anagho nāma vaibhrājo hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramām |
lakṣmīśāntivratenaiva toṣayāmāsa vai tataḥ ||3 1 ||
lakṣmījanārdanau tuṣṭau prāhatustau varāya ca |
vavrāte tau varaṃ putraṃ nārāyaṇasamaṃ tadā ||32||
pāragaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ dhārmikaṃ yoginaṃ varam |
sarvabhūtarutajñaṃ ca mahābalaparākramam ||33||
evamastviti cārpayya varadānaṃ tirogatau |
so’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasya putro’bhavattadā ||34||

tasya bhāryābhavallakṣmīrnāmnā sannatirityatha ||35||
viśvakseno’bhavattasyāḥ putro’pi bhagavān svayam |
evaṃ lakṣmīvratapuṇyaṃ mahāphalapradaṃ sadā ||36||

lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā devahūtī tato’bhavat ||37||

āyuṃ dṛḍhāyumaśvāyuṃ dhanāyuṃ sadhṛtiṃ vasum ||42|||
śucividyaṃ śatāyuṃ ca tato divaṃ yayau hi sā |

lakṣmīśāntivrataṃ kṛtvā yayātiṃ prāpa satpatim |
śukraputrī devayānī cakre lakṣmīvrataṃ tataḥ ||45||
guruputraṃ kacaṃ daityavṛkairattamajīvayat |
punardaityairmadirāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ pāyitaṃ kacam ||46||

dadāvudarasthāyāpi devayānyāḥ śubhāgrahāt ||47||

sañjīvanīṃ svaśiṣyebhyo’dhyāpayāmāsa tadbalāt ||48||

yā jitā raṇasaṃgrāme jyāmaghena snuṣā kṛtā ||3.136.50||

dīrghatamasaḥ saṃlebhe brāhmaṇān rājyabhoginaḥ |

śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saubhāgyaśayanaṃ tvapi |

tvāmārādhya naro nārī bhaktyā kiṃ kiṃ na vindati |
ārādhanaṃ vrataṃ te tad vakṣyāmyatra hitāvaham ||73||

tayā sahaiva māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sampūjayet prage ||75||

bhūṣaṇāni samastāni śṛṃgārāṇi samarpayet |

snuṣāśca bāndhavāścāpi yaśo kīrtiśca sampadaḥ |

prātarutthāpayed devau pūjayed vidhinā tataḥ |

saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ suvarṇacaraṇadvayam |

evaṃ samvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛtīyāyāṃ samācaret |

jyeṣṭhe mandārakusumaṃ vṛndāpatraṃ śucau tathā || 1 05||
śrāvaṇe dadhi dadyācca nabhasye tu kuśodakam |
kṣīramāśvayuje māsi kārtike navanītakam || 1 06||
mārge māse dvidalāṃ ca pauṣe ghṛtaṃ saśarkaram |
