tulasīkamalādīni sarvamāse matāni vai |
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī kumārī vidhavāpi vā || 1 08||
vratānte śayanaṃ dadyāt sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau haimau śayane sthāpayettataḥ || 1 09||
dānaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya sādhave vā supūjine |
dhānyālaṃkāragodānaṃ dhanaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||3.136.1 1 0||
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyak saubhāgyaśayanavratam |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti padaṃ cānantamaśnute || 111 ||
yastu dvādaśavarṣāṇi saubhāgyaśayanavratam |
karoti strī naro vāpi devyanugrahalālitau || 1 12||
pūjyamānau vasetāṃ svaḥ yāvatkalpāyutatrayam |
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi pradadyādatha vā matim ||1 1 3|||
so’pi deveśvaro bhūtvā svarge vasenna saṃśayaḥ |
bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnoti śāśvatānandasampadaḥ || 1 14||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lakṣmīśatadvayanāmajapena pitṛkanyakādīnāṃ sveṣṭaphalāvāptiḥ, lakṣmīsaubhāgyaśayanavratavidhiścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||

<3.137>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ tava |
ghaṭalakṣmīvratinastu kramāt saptadivaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
bhūloko’yaṃ divaṃ proktaḥ sampatsukhapramodanaiḥ |
bhuvarloko’pi ca divaṃ siddhimatāṃ hi yoginām || 2 ||
svargādayo divaṃ santi satyāntāḥ sarva eva te |
devalokā hi saptaite yato divyagatipradāḥ || 3 ||
paryāyeṇa tu sarveṣāmādhipatyaṃ tava vratāt |
ghaṭalakṣmīvratādeva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
iha loke śubhaṃ rūpamāyuḥ saubhāgyamuttamam |
lakṣmīśca vipulā sampajjāyate te vratādiha || 5 ||
śṛṇu cātra kathāṃ divyāmagastyasya mahātmanaḥ |
purā vahniḥ samājñapto mahendreṇa suradviṣām || 6 ||
vināśārthaṃ tato vahnirdadāha koṭidānavān |
nirdagdhebhyo’vaśiṣṭā ye dānavāstu sahasraśaḥ || 7 ||
palāyamānāstrastāśca samudraṃ viviśuḥ khalāḥ |
tārakaḥ kamalākṣaśca kāladaṃṣṭraḥ parāvasuḥ || 8 ||
virocanaśca te cābdhau sanniveśamakurvata |
aśaktāste ceti matvā vahninā samupekṣitāḥ || 9 ||
atha kālāntare daityā balamavāpya vai punaḥ |
sampīḍayanti te devān manuṣyān saha jaṃgamān || 3.137.1 0||
viprān sādhūn prasampīḍya praviśanti punarjalam |
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi vīrāḥ pañca ca sapta ca || 11 ||
jaladurgabalāllakṣmi pīḍayanti jagattrayam |
tataḥ punarmahendro’pi vahnaye samupādiśat || 12||
acirād daityanāśārthamabdhireṣa viśuṣyatu |
yasmādasmaddviṣāmeṣaḥ śaraṇaṃ varuṇālayaḥ 13||
tasmād bhavān drutamasya kṣayaṃ vidhātu śoṣaṇāt |
agniḥ prāha tataḥ śukraṃ samudraśoṣaṇaṃ prati ||14||
adharma eva devendra sāgarasya praśoṣaṇam |
asya yojanamātre’pi jīvakoṭiśatāni vai || 15 ||
nivasanti hi jīvānāṃ mahān prasaṃkṣayo bhavet |
pāpaṃ cāsīmakaṃ syānme tatkathaṃ prakaromyaham ||1 6||
evaṃ śrutvā mahendrastu prāha roṣād vacastadā |
na dharmādharmasaṃśleṣaṃ prāpnuvantyamarā divi || 17||
bhavān dāhakaro devaḥ pāpalepavivarjitaḥ |
tathāpi nājñāṃ vahase śaṣāmi mānuṣo bhava ||18 ||
athāha pavanaṃ cendrastvaṃ praśoṣaya sāgaram |
pavano’pi tathā prāha pāpakṛtyaṃ karomi na || 1 9||
tadendrastaṃ śaśāpāpi bhava tvaṃ mānuṣo’nila |
evaṃ śāpaṃ gatau tau ca vaśiṣṭhāgastyanāmakau ||3.137.20 ||
vahnirjāto’gastyamunirvāyurvasiṣṭha eva ca |
kuṃbhād dvau sahajātau vai mitrāvaruṇavīryataḥ ||21 ||
urvaśī śrīnaranārāyaṇaputryapsarovarā |
mitreṇāmantritā kāmād gacchantī cāmbare yadā ||22||
paścād dṛṣṭā varuṇena dhṛtā kāmārthamityapi |
kintu sā satyamārgasthā varuṇaṃ nābhyanandata ||23||
mitreṇāhaṃ vṛtā pūrvaṃ tasya bhāryā bhavāmi ha |
te bhāryā dharmato nāsmi hyadhunā varuṇa prabho ||24||
āha tāṃ varuṇaścittaṃ mayi nyasya pragamyatām |
sāpi mitraṃ gatā mitraḥ śuśrāva ca tayoditam ||25||
cittanyāsaṃ samākarṇya kruddhastatyāja tāṃ tadā |
veśyādharmaṃ śritavatī dvābhyāṃ tyaktā hi sā yayau ||26||
saṃkalpajaṃ dhātumugraṃ mitraśca varuṇo’pi ca |
urvaśīdarśanotthaṃ vai ghaṭamadhye sasarjatuḥ ||27||
etasminneva kāle tu niminā śrīvasiṣṭhakaḥ |
śapto videhabhāvatve videhaḥ san ghaṭe sthitaḥ ||28 ||
agastyo’pīndraśāpena ghaṭe tatra sthito’bhavat |
agniragastyo ghaṭata utpannastatra bālakaḥ ||29||
vāyurvaśiṣṭho ghaṭata utpannastatra bālakaḥ |
varuṇāṃśo’gastyakaśca mitrāṃśastu vasiṣṭhakaḥ ||3.137.30 ||
utpannau jātamātrau tau jātismarau pravedinau |
cakratuḥ śāpamuktyarthaṃ ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ hyubhau ||3 1 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstabhaiḥ kārayāmāsatuśca tau |
hāratoraṇamālābhirvastrapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ ||32||
mṛttikākalaśādyaiśca kuṇḍavedībhiranvitam |
homasāmagrikāyuktaṃ kāṣṭhāsanādirājitam ||33 ||
pūjopahārayuktaṃ ca svarṇakalaśarājitam |
mṛttikāyā ghaṭaṃ vāriyutaṃ svayonimuttamam ||34||
maṇḍape cānayāmāsatuśca dvau tau pupūjatuḥ |
mātaraṃ śrīmahālakṣmīmāhvayāmāsatuśca tau ||35||
sthāpayāmāsatustatra ghaṭe sauvarṇakāritām |
pañcāmṛtairjalaiścāpi snāpayāmāsatustataḥ ||36|||
bhūṣayāmāsatuḥ śṛṃgārayāmāsaturīśvarīm |
veṣayāmāsatū raktāmbarādyairmātaraṃ hi tām ||37||
pūjayāmāsatuḥ puṣpākṣatakuṃkumakajjalaiḥ |
sarvavastubhirabhyarcyārārtrikaṃ cakratustathā ||38||
miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca bhojayāmāsaturmudā |
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cāpyarpayāmāsaturādarāt ||39||
suvarṇakalaśaṃ pārśve mālyavastravibhūṣitam |
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapātrasamanvitam ||3.137.40||
tilapatraphalayuktaṃ sthāpayāmāsatuśca tau |
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ paramaṃ brahma śāśvatam ||41 ||
anādiśrīhariṃ māṃ sthāpayāmāsaturatra ca |
dhānyāni vastrabhūṣāśca pātraratnāni sarvathā ||42|||
vinyasya pūjayāmāsatuśca gāṃ vatsikāyutām |
sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ śṛṃgakhuraiḥ suvarṇajām ||43 ||
sakāṃsyadohapātrāḍhyāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām |
pūjayāmāsatuścāpi puṣpāñjaliṃ nyavāpatuḥ ||44||
tataḥ prasannā mātā śrīghaṭalakṣmīrmahāsatī |
pratyakṣābhūttayoragre varārthaṃ tau nyayojayat ||45||
vavrāte tau varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mātastava prasādataḥ |
janmano’smād bhavenmuktirmānuṣāttat tathā kuru ||46||
lakṣmīḥ prāha tadāgastyaṃ daityā vasanti vāridhau |
abdhipānottaraṃ muktirmānuṣātte bhaviṣyati ||47||
vasiṣṭho’yaṃ divyadehastvayā sākaṃ bhaviṣyati |
lakṣmīḥ prāha punaścāpi varārthaṃ ca tadā muniḥ ||48||
vasiṣṭhaḥ samprayayāce ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ śubham |
agastyodayadivase prātaḥ śuklatilādibhiḥ ||49||
tīrthajalaiḥ snānamāptaḥ śuklāmbaradharo gṛhī |
mṛdghaṭe vā svarṇaghaṭe lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ pūjayettu yaḥ ||3.137.50||
śrīhariṃ ca vasiṣṭhaṃ cāgastiṃ ca pūjayettu yaḥ |
āsaptarātraṃ vāpi ca saptadaśasamāśca vā ||51 ||
pūjayedarghamapyatra dadyāttasya kramāt khalu |
bhūrloke ca bhuvarloke svarge mahari vai jane ||52||
tapoloke satyaloke vāso bhavecciraṃ khalu |
kalpaṃ kalpaṃ prabhuktvā sa bhogān yāyāttato’kṣaram ||53||
saptārghyakartā prāpnuyāt saptalokān samṛddhikān |
namo lakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai viṣṇupatnyai namo namaḥ ||54||
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa sarveśi dehi saukhyāni sarvaśaḥ |
namo nārāyaṇāya śrīpataye haraye namaḥ ||55||
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa bhagavan dehi saukhyāni sarvaśaḥ |
kāśapuṣpapratīkāśāvagnimārutasaṃbhavau ||56||
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrau kuṃbhayonī namo’stu vām |
evamarghyaṃ ca pūjāṃ ca puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ||57||
tasya lokāḥ śāśvatāste lakṣmi bhavantu sarvadā |
yāvadāyuśca yaḥ kuryāttasya vāso’kṣare bhavet ||58||
ityarthitā vaśiṣṭhena kuṃbhalakṣmīḥ prasūstadā |
tathāstviti prāha tābhyāṃ śīghraṃ līnābhavat prasūḥ ||59||
munī kṛtvā parihāraṃ tepaturduścaraṃ tapaḥ |
tataḥ kālena daityānāṃ vīkṣyopadravamulbaṇam ||3.137.60||
agastyaḥ pītavānabdhiṃ daityā nāśaṃ yayustadā |
indrādidevavṛndena hatā naṣṭāḥ suradviṣaḥ ||61 ||
tato devāḥ prasannā vai brahmādyāścāyayurmunī |
yatra tapastepāte tau varārthaṃ preritau ca taiḥ ||62||
agastyaśca varaṃ vavre yadabhīṣṭaṃ tadābhavat |
yāvad brahmasahasrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ ||63||
vaimānikau bhaviṣyāvo dvāvāvāṃ svargagāminau |
vasiṣṭhaḥ saptamadhye syādagastyo dakṣiṇāpathe ||64||
asmattārodaye kuryād yaḥ kaścit pūjanaṃ tu nau |
sa saptalokasamrāḍ vai paryāyeṇa bhavediti ||65||
devāḥ prāhustathāstveva yayuste ca yathāgatam |
vasiṣṭhāgastyakau cāpi malayādrau gatau tadā ||66||
tataḥ kālāntare’gastyaṃ parśurāmaḥ pratāpavān |
samudrasya prapānārthaṃ sarṣigaṇo nyavedayat| ||67||
gokarṇatīrthabhūmyarthaṃ tadāgastyaḥ punaḥ papau |
evaṃ kṛtvā mahatkāryaṃ svargaṃ yayatustau munī ||68||
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi ghaṭalakṣmīvrataṃ tava |
saptadinaṃ phalāhārātmakaṃ pūjātmakaṃ tava ||69||
agastyasyodaye kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
evaṃ lakṣmi tava pūjāṃ bhādrapade’ṣṭamīdine ||3.137.70 ||
mārgaśīrṣe ca vaiśākhe ūrje vā śuklapakṣake |
maṇḍapodyānasaṃyuktāmudyāpanasamanvitām ||71 ||
kariṣyanti narā nāryo yāsyanti te parāṃ gatim |
pañcagavyena kṣīreṇa puṣpagandhodakena ca ||72||
madhunā snāpayettvāṃ sampūjayet phalapuṣpakaiḥ |
śṛṃgārayed veṣayecca vibhūṣayennīrājayet ||73||
bhojayecca tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt sumūrtaye |
kṣamāṃ yāceta ca namet prārthayed gurave’rpayet ||74||
mahālakṣmyai namaḥ pādau tava gulphau namaḥ śriyai |
śokahantryai namo jaṅghe ramāyai jānunī namaḥ ||75||
ūrū maṃgalakāriṇyai vakṣaḥsthalyai namaḥ kaṭim |
padmāyai nama udaramuraḥ kāmaśriyai namaḥ ||76||
karau saubhāgyalakṣmyai te bāhūdaramukhaṃ śriyai |
kamalāyai namo nāsāṃ padminyai locane namaḥ ||77||
puṣṭyai lalāṭamalakān hiraṇyāyai śiro namaḥ |
hariṇyai sukhadālakṣmyai lalitāyai namo namaḥ ||78||
nārāyaṇyai vāsudevyai sampadāyai namo’stu te |
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ dehi me mātarīśvari ||79||
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyavratena tava padmaje |
mameṣṭaṃ sarvamevāstu kṛpayā tava cābdhije ||3.137.80||
gītamaṃgalanirghoṣān kārayed yajamānakaḥ |
suvāsinyaḥ kanyakāśca kuryurgītāni tatra ca ||8 1 ||
pūjayeyū raktavastrai raktamālyānulepanaiḥ |
kusumairakṣatairvārbhirnamaskāraiḥ prabhojanaiḥ ||82||
sindūrakuṃkumatailasārakastūrikāñjanaiḥ |
evaṃ sampūjya tāṃ mūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave śubhām ||83 ||
guruṃ sampūjayeccāpi kamalaiścandanādibhiḥ |
parihāraṃ tataḥ kuryād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||84||
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyalakṣmīvratamidaṃ param |
yaḥ kuryāttasya māṃgalyaṃ bahudhā vai vased gṛhe ||85||
sarvapāpavināśaśca saubhāgyārogyavardhanam |
sarvāmodapramodeṣṭānandasaukhyapradaṃ vratam |||86||
athāpyanyad vrataṃ lakṣmi vadāmi sāṃkhyayaugikam |
sāṃkhyayogakṛtadīkṣāyutāṃ tvāṃ tatra pūjayet ||87||
pūrṇimāyāṃ tathā caikādaśyāṃ śukle tu pakṣake |
sarvamāseṣu sauvarṇāṃ kṛtvā lakṣmīṃ śubhānanām ||88||
raktāmbarāṃ raktalepāṃ raktacandanacarcitām |
pāṭalāṃ tvāṃ rattavarṇāsane samyak prapūjayet ||89||
raktakuṃkumasalilaiḥ snāpayet tvāṃ vibhūṣayet |
raktapuṣpāmbarai raktahārai raktgphalādibhiḥ ||3.137.90 ||
raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjayecca raktāṃ nārāyaṇe mayi |
bhojayetpūjayeccāpi nīrājayennamettathā ||91 ||
prārthayed pūjikā tvāṃ ca sāṃkhyayogavratasthitā |
raktavastre mahālakṣmi rakte nārāyaṇe sthite ||92||
svāsthyaṃ tyāgaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hareryogaṃ pradehi me |
anyebhyaśca viraktāhaṃ raktāhaṃ śrīpatau prabhau |||93||
sāṃkhyayogamahālakṣmīvrataṃ te’tra karomyaham |
anena mama saubhāgyaṃ taveva bhavatāddharau ||94||
sarvavighnavināśo’stu sarvānandā bhavantu me |
sarve rasāḥ sarvaśreyaḥkalyāṇāni bhavantu me ||95||
ityabhyarthya diśellakṣmīṃ gurave kānakīṃ tathā |
ratnabhūṣāmbaradhānyapātrādīni samarpayet ||96||
evaṃ vrataṃ prakartryāstu harerdāsyaṃ prapadyate |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhastagatā nārāyaṇāśrayāt ||97||
sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ sāṃkhyayaugavrataṃ tvidam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyadehapradaṃ haripriyam ||98||
haripriyā bhavet sādhvī vratakartrī videhinī |
camatkāramayī divyākṣaradhāmagatā bhavet ||99||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne ghaṭalakṣmīvratasyāgastyakṛtasya sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyalakṣmīvratasya, sāṃkhyayogalakṣmīvratasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 137 ||

<3.138>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
rasakalyāṇalalitāvrataṃ lakṣmi ca te śṛṇu |
dvādaśyāṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 1 ||
pūrayed bahudhānyaiśca kalaśān sthāpayecchubhān |
madhyame kalaśe sthāpyā sauvarṇī bhūṣaṇānvitā || 2 ||
rasakalyāṇalalitālakṣmīḥ rasapradāyinī |
māghamāse śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ lalitāṃ śriyam || 3 ||
snāpayenmadhunā cekṣurasena ca ghṛtena ca |
dadhnā dugdhena ca tīrthajalaiḥ saṃsnāpayettataḥ || 4 ||
bhūṣāmbarāṇi dadyācca candanākṣatakuṃkumam |
śṛṃgāradravyamevāpi diśet puṣpādikāni ca || 5 ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathārpayet |
prārthayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet || 6 ||
evaṃ sampūjya vidhivat sādhūn viprān prapūjayet| |
pūjayed dvijadāmpatyaṃ dadyād dānaṃ dhanādikam || 7 ||
bhojayedannapānādyairmadhureṇa rasena ca |
suvarṇakamalaṃ vastrayugalaṃ kalaśaṃ diśet || 8 ||
kalaśaṃ śarkarāpūrṇaṃ rasapūrṇaṃ diśecca vā |
rasaṃ vidyād ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi madhu ca śarkarām || 9 ||
laḍḍukān bhojayeccāpi saṃyāvamatha pūrikāḥ |
ghārikāmapyapūpām̐śca piṣṭāpūpām̐śca maṇḍakān ||3.138.1 0||
kṣīraṃ śākaṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhyannaṃ bhojayettathā |
kamale mādhavi lakṣmi mātaḥ rame samudraje ||1 1 ||
bhadre jaye kambhare śri mahālakṣmi sukhaṃ kuru |
padmini padmaje kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇi narāyaṇi ||12||
ādye śrīlalite kṛṣṇapriye brāhmi namo’stu te |
vāsudevi mahādevi hiraṇye dhanarūpiṇi ||13||
sarvarase sarvasukhe sarvakalyāṇadāyini |
sampadaṃ modamatyantaṃ dehi me tvadvratena vai ||14||
evamabhyarcya sauvarṇāṃ lakṣmīṃ rasapradāyinīm |
rasakalyāṇalalitāṃ dāne śrīgurave diśet ||15||
pañcaratnādisahitāmaṅguṣṭhamātranirmitām |
caturbhujāṃ cakraśaṃkhamālāpūjāsamanvitām || 16||
tathā gomithunaṃ dadyād viprāya tu mahātmane |
sālaṃkāraṃ savastraṃ ca sadohaṃ dugdhadaṃ śubham || 17||
anena vidhinā yastu rasakalyāṇinīśriyaḥ |
vrataṃ kuryāt sa pāpebhyastat kṣaṇādeva mucyate || 18||
navārbudasahasrāṇi samāḥ svarge mahīyate |
suvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ lakṣmīṃ māsi māsi dadannṛpaḥ || 1 9||
agniṣṭomasahasrasya phalaṃ svarge samaśnute |
nārī kanyā ca kurute vidhavā vā satī ca yā ||3.138.20 ||
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ prāpya saubhāgyārogyamāpnuyāt |
matidātāpi vai svarge modate devatāgṛhe ||21 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ cānyat tavaiva daśamīdine |
āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe vai cāturmāsyāgrage dine ||22||
prātareva samutthāya snātvā dhyāyeddhariṃ prabhum |
tataścārdrānandalakṣmīṃ sauvarṇīṃ pūjayed vratī ||23||
aṃguṣṭhamātrāṃ sadvastrāṃ bhūṣāśṛṃgāraśobhitām |
nārāyaṇīśriyaṃ darbhagandhodakaiḥ sucandanaiḥ ||24||
snāpayecchuklapuṣpaiśca kuṃkumākṣatabhojanaiḥ |
naivedyairbhojayeccāpi nīrājayet kṣamāpayet ||25||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sahitāṃ śriyam |
prārthayedbhāvahṛdayaiḥ sveṣṭadaṃ sveṣṭadāṃ tadā ||26||
mahālakṣmyai namaḥ pādau mahāviṣṇo namo’stu te |
śokahantryai namo jaṅghe sukhadāya namo’stu te ||27||
kamalāyai namaścorū ānandāya namo hare |
īśvariṇyai namaḥ kaṭiṃ sampatpradāya te namaḥ ||28||
mādhavyai ca namo nābhau svarṇavarṇāya te namaḥ |
stanau poṣaṇakāriṇyai namo viśvaṃbharāya te ||29||
kaṇṭhe namaḥ sarasvatyai nīlakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ |
karau kamaladhāriṇyai nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||3.138.30 ||
bāhū namo rakṣayitryai sudarśanadharāya ca |
cāndryai candrānane naumi hariṃ vahnimukhāya ca ||3 1 ||
netre kṛpāpravarṣiṇyai karuṇānilayāya ca |
bhruvau namaḥ kṣemadāyai kuśalakāriṇe namaḥ ||32|||
lalāṭe dhanarūpāyai svarṇavarṇāya te namaḥ |
mukuṭe sarvaratnāyai sakaustubhāya te namaḥ ||33||
sarvakāyau sarvavāsau sarvaiśvaryasamanvitau |
sarvakāmapradau vande ārdrāśryānandamādhavau ||34||
sampadā copakaraṇairdhanairdhānyai rasādibhiḥ |
bhūṣāmbarādibhiścāpi gṛhamārdraṃ prapūritam ||35||
kurutaṃ strīdāsadāsībhṛtyāpatyasuśobhitam |
divyasādhanaśobhaṃ ca dhenuvājigajānvitam ||36||
udyānavāṭīkṣetrāḍhyaṃ yaśomānapravardhitam |
yānavimānavāhāḍhyaṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyasatprajam ||37||
modapramodasaukhyāḍhyaṃ samutsāhotsavānvitam |
vādyagītimahāsatradānapānasamanvitam ||38||
dharmakarmādhvarayuktaṃ nityaṃ ca bahudakṣiṇam |
vighnaśūnyaṃ pañcayajñaparaṃ kurutaṃ madgṛham ||39||
snuṣābhiḥ parito ramyāṃ sādhusādhvīvirājitam |
parameśamahābhaktipravāhitaṃ nirantaram ||3.138.40||
ante divyarasāḍhye vāmakṣare vasatiṃ ca me |
evamabhyarthya ca puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā visarjayet ||41 ||
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cārdrānandau śrīgurave diśet |
ratnahīrakadhānyāni dvijātibhyo diśettathā ||42||
bhojayed bālabālādyā diśecca dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ |
śaṃkhacakre sakaṭake svastikāṃkuśacāmarān ||43||
dadyāt satpuruṣāyāpi miṣṭānnāmbarakāṇi ca |
ghṛtapātrāṇi pātrāṇi sahiraṇyakāni sandiśet ||44||
śarkarāsaktupātrāṇi caturmāsaṃ diśettathā |
tilapātrāṇi pūrṇāni rasapātrāṇi yāni ca ||45||
gandhodakaṃ puṣpavāri candanaṃ kuṃkumodakam |
apakvaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca gośṛṃgodakamityapi ||46||
tulasīṃ kamalaṃ dadyāccāturmāsye sadārcane |
dāne sarvaṃ pradadyācca vadeccāpi śriyāḥ puraḥ ||47||
lakṣmi me prīyatāṃ nityaṃ pāpanāśāya mādhavī |
saubhāgyāya prasannāstu lalite me sukhāya ca ||48||
evamuktvā diśet sarvaṃ kārtike daśamīdine |
hiraṇyakamalaṃ datvā caikādaśyāṃ prage punaḥ ||49||
pūjayitvā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuryād diśed dvijātaye |
satūlāvaraṇāṃ śayyāṃ lakṣmīrme prīyatāmiti ||3.138.50 ||
ārdrānanaramānārāyaṇavrataṃ tvidaṃ mahat |
tenehāmutra ca sadānandamāpnoti sampadaḥ ||51 ||
bhuktvā svargān cirasthām̐śca paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt |
śroturvaktuśca saṃsmartuścāpyānando bhaved dhruvaḥ ||52||
gṛhe sve mahadānandaśatāni cānubhūya ca |
bhūyo lakṣmīpadaṃ yāti śrīpuraṃ dhāma caiśvaram ||53||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ te’nyacchāradeyavratottamam |
bṛhaspatestu divase kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ tava ||54||
maṇḍapaṃ subhagaṃ kṛtvā toraṇādisamanvitam |
sauvarṇakalaśairdhānyaiścāsanādibhirūrjitam ||55||
tanmadhye kārayed ramyaṃ gajāsanaṃ suvarṇajam |
tatra pīṭhe sthāpayecca śāradākhyāṃ ramāṃ satīm ||56||
dvibhujāṃ lalitālakṣmīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
vīṇākamalahastāṃ ca mukuṭādisuśobhanām ||57||
atha pārśve sthāpayecca gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm |
vādyayuktāṃ divyarūpāṃ vedapustakadhāriṇīm ||58||
evaṃ devītrayaṃ tatra pūjayed gandhakuṃkumaiḥ |
akṣataiḥ śvetapuṣpādyairdhūpadīpādivastubhiḥ |||59||
kṣīraṃ ca pāyasaṃ siddhānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ bhojayettathā |
miṣṭavāri sugandhāḍhyaṃ pāyayecchītalaṃ tathā ||3.138.60||
tāmbūlakaṃ pradadyācca nīrājanaṃ tataścaret |
prārthayecchāradālakṣmīṃ vāṇī me prīyatāmiti ||61 ||
kṛpayā te bhaviṣyāmi vidyāvārinidhiḥ paraḥ |
rasanāgre mama nityaṃ sarasvatī vasatvapi ||62||
iha loke sadānandamavāpnuyāṃ tathā kuru |
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi śastrāṇi gītanṛtyādikaṃ ca yat ||63||
na vihīnaṃ tvayā vāṇi tathā me santu siddhayaḥ |
vāṇī medhā dharā puṣṭirgaurī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ ||64||
etābhiḥ pāhi cāṣṭābhistanūbhirmāṃ narāyaṇi |
evaṃ samprārthya dānāni dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā ||65||
bhojayed bālabālāśca sādhusādhvīśca yoṣitaḥ |
dhanavastrāṇi dadyācca kamaṇḍaluṃ ca pustakam ||66||
vādyadānaṃ prakurvīta śṛṃgārābharaṇārpaṇam |
parihāraṃ prakurvīta gurave śriyamarpayet ||67||
maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaśca ca vai vratī |
guruvāre pratimāsaṃ māsāstrayodaśa vratam ||68||
sandhyāyāṃ ca tathā maunaṃ rakṣan vratī samācaret |
nāntarā bhojanaṃ kuryāt samāpte ca vrate tataḥ ||69||
udyāpanaṃ paraṃ kuryānmahotsavasamanvitam |
vastrayugmaṃ striyai dadyād viprāyai bhojanānvitam ||3.138.70||
godānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ ca kuryād yathādhanaṃ vratī |
anena vidhinā kṛtvā pāyasādi prabhojanam ||71 ||
vidyāvān dhanavān miṣṭakaṇṭho vratī prajāyate |
śāradāyāḥ prasādena brahmaloke mahīyate ||72||
naro nārī kumārī vā kurute śāradāvratam |
brahmaloke vased brāhmī yāvatkalpāyutatrayam ||73 ||
vidyādānaṃ prakuryād yo vrataṃ kṛtvā dhanārpaṇaiḥ |
vidvān vidyāṃ pradadyācca śāradāvratavāṃśca yaḥ ||74||
vidyādharapure so’pi vaset kalpāyutatrayam |
ante lakṣmīpuraṃ yāti brahmākṣaraṃ vrajettataḥ ||75||
athānyatte śubhaṃ lakṣmi kalyāṇīkamalāvratam |
aśeṣayajñaphaladamaśeṣāghavināśanam ||76||
aśeṣaduṣṭaśamanamaśeṣasurapūjitam |
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam ||77||
daivataṃ daivatānāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ purātanam |
māghaśuklaikādaśikāvrataṃ kalyāṇadaṃ śubham ||78||
ghṛtenābhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā daśamyāṃ ca tilairjalaiḥ |
snātvā prātarharikṛṣṇaṃ pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ||79||
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pādayornamaḥ |
sarvātmane namaḥ ke ca vaikuṇṭhāya namo mukhe ||3.138.80||
śrīvatsadhāriṇe vakṣaḥsthale namo muhurmuhuḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavaradānapradhāriṇe ||8 1 ||
namo bāhuṣu sarveṣūdare dāmodarāya ca |
meḍhre namaḥ sukhadāya ūrvoḥ saubhāgyadāya ca ||82||
jānvornamo bhūtadhrāya jaṃghayormokṣadāya ca |
pādayoḥ pāpanāśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ||83||
namaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇyai kamalāyai namo namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīlalitālakṣmyai jayālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||84||
namaḥ śrīmāṇikīlakṣmyai nārāyaṇīśriyai namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīsukhadālakṣmyai śivarājñīśriyai namaḥ |||85||
namaḥ śrīpārvatīlakṣmyai kāntāpramāśriyai namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyai mahālakṣmīśriyai namaḥ ||86||
namaḥ śrīsantuṣṭilakṣmyai kārṣṇīśriyai namo namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīrādhikālakṣmyai ramālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||87||
evaṃ natvā ca govindaṃ śriyaṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ |
sarvopacārakaiścobhau kalyāṇadau prapūjayet ||88||
gandhairmālyairdhūpadīpairbhakṣyairnānāvidhairapi |
jalaistāmbūlakaiścārārtrikaiḥ puṣpārpaṇaistathā ||89||
prīyatāṃ mama gopālaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
prīyatāṃ mama kalyāṇīmahālakṣmīnarāyaṇī ||3.138.90||
evamuccārya śayane sthāpayet parameśvarī |
madhyāhne pūjayeccāpi bhojayecca niśāmukhe ||91 ||
sotsavaṃ pūjayeccāpi bhojayet pāyasādikam |
suptvā caikādaśīprātarutthāya snānamācaret ||92||
pūjayed vidhinā lakṣmīṃ kalyāṇīṃ maṇḍape śubhe |
sarvatobhadrake ramye maṇḍale viṣṇunā saha ||93 ||
pūjayitvā ca godāne śayyādānaṃ ghaṭārpaṇam |
lakṣmyarpaṇaṃ ratnabhūṣāmbarapātradhanārpaṇam ||94||
dhānyabhojanabhogyādyarpaṇaṃ kuryād vratī prage |
bhojayechrīmahālakṣmīṃ dugdhaṃ phalādikaṃ śubham ||95||
madhyāhne pūjayeccāpi bhojayet pāyasādikam |
sāyaṃ sampūjayeccāpi rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ||96||
dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāpi prapūjya vidhinā diśet |
gurave sādhave sādhvyai dānāni ca dvijātaye ||97||
bhojayet sumṛṣṭamiṣṭānnāni viprān satastathā |
bālakān bālikā nārīḥ sādhūn saṃbhojayettathā ||98||
dadyād dānāni bahūni parihāraṃ tataścaret |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmimāṃ vadet ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccānumodanāt |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kalyāṇāni bahūni ca || 3.138.1 00||
purājanmani cābhīrīkanyā kalyāṇinīvratam |
kṛtvā nārāyaṇaputrī ūrvaśī samajāyata || 101 ||
purā vaiśyakuṭumbotthā pulomakanyakā tvidam |
vrataṃ kṛtvā mahendrāṇī vyajāyata diveśvarī || 10 2||
purā kṛtvā vrataṃ caitat suraputro dvijastataḥ |
sūryo babhūva svargeśaḥ sahasraraśmivān prabhuḥ ||1 03||
tasmāt kalyāṇikālakṣmīvrataṃ sveṣṭottamapradam |
māghe dinatrayaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakalyāṇasampradam || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne rasakalyāṇalalitāvratasya, ārdrānandaramānārāyaṇavratasya, śāradeyavratasya, kalyāṇīkamalāvratasya ca nirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 38||

<3.139>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
āgatānāṃ hi śokānāmapanodārthameva yat |
vrataṃ syāttatkathayātra dayayā me hare prabho || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
puṇye cāśvayuje māsi śukle dvādaśikāvratam |
śokanāśārthamevāsti viśokadvādaśīvratam || 2 ||
daśamyāṃ laghubhug bhūtvā pṛthvīśayanamācaret |
brahmacārī bhaveccāpi prātarutthāya māṃ smaret || 3 ||
snātvā sampūjayenmāṃ caikādaśyāṃ vratamācaran |
nirāhāraḥ phalāhāraścaikabhojī ca vā bhavet || 4 ||
aśokalalitāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśobhitām |
kārayitvā pūjayitvā bhojayitvā gajāsane || 5 ||
svāpayejjāgaraṃ kuryānmaṇḍape kadalīkṛte |
dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā saṃpūjayetpunaḥ || 6 ||
snānaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ kuryāt pañcagavyajalairapi |
pītāmbaradharo lakṣmīṃ pūjayecchrīśamutpalaiḥ || 7 ||
viśokāyai namaḥ pādau varadāyai tu jaṅghayoḥ |
jānvoḥ śriyai namaścāpi sakthnorabdhijayoṣite || 8 ||
gupte viśokakartryai ca kaṭyāṃ māyai namo namaḥ |
udare poṣayitryai ca namo bhāyai ca pārśvayoḥ || 9 ||
nābhau namaḥ sarvadhartryai hṛdaye’rdhāśriyai namaḥ |
kaṇṭhe vāṇyai namo vakṣaḥsthale kāntāśriyai namaḥ || 3.139.10 ||
bāhvornamo rakṣayitryai lalitāyai tu hastayoḥ |
cāndryai mukhe namaścāpi kamalāyai tu netrayoḥ || 11 ||
nāsāyāṃ surabhidevyai lalāṭe mohinīśriyai |
karṇayorvyāpikāyai te namo mūrdhni mahāśriyai || 12||
maṇḍale sthaṇḍile lakṣmīpratimāsannidhau harim |
svarṇamūrtiṃ pūjayecca śrīpatiṃ māṃ viśokinam || 1 3||
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pādayornamaḥ |
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kāntāya jaṃghayoste namo namaḥ || 14||
namaḥ śrīvāsudevāya jānvoste ca namo namaḥ |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti sakthnoste bhagavannamaḥ || 15||
namaścānandarūpāya meḍhre te ca namo namaḥ |
namaḥ kaṭyāṃ naranārāyaṇāya te namo namaḥ ||16||
udare te namo viśvaṃbharāya bhagavannamaḥ |
pārśvayoḥ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ namo namaḥ namo namaḥ || 17||
nābhau te padmanābhāya hṛdaye haṃsayogine |
kaṇṭhe te nīlakaṇṭhāya vakṣasi brahmaṇe namaḥ ||18||
bāhvoścakradharāyāpi karayoḥ śaṃkhadhāriṇe |
mukhe rūpābhirūpāya netrayoḥ kamalākṣiṇe || 1 9||
nāsāyāṃ sarvagandhāya lalāṭe gururūpiṇe |
karṇayoḥ śrutikartre te namo mūrdhni śikhāvate ||3.139.20 ||
ityabhyarcyāpi govindaṃ phalamālyānulepanaiḥ |
śūrpaṃ saṃsthāpya purato lakṣmīṃ māṃ tatra sannyaset ||21 ||
namo mokṣapramodānāṃ dātṛbhyāṃ sarvasampadām |
namaḥ śokaparihārakartṛbhyāṃ sarvadā namaḥ |||22|
viśokau duḥkhanāśāya viśokau varadau ca me |
viśokau mama sampattyai viśokau sarvasiddhaye ||23||
bhavatāṃ mama śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ nāśakau prabhū |
śuklāmbaraiḥ samāveṣṭya śūrpaṃ sampūjayet phalaiḥ ||24||
vastrairnānāvidhaistadvat suvarṇakamalena ca |
pūjayitvā bhojayecca dugdhapākādikaṃ śubham ||25||
trikālaṃ pūjayeccāpi kamalairbhojayedapi |
rajanyāṃ ca vratī śītaṃ darbhodakaṃ pibecchuci ||26||
tatastu jāgaraṃ gītanṛtyavādyānvitaṃ caret |
prātaḥ prapūjayellakṣmīmaśokāṃ śrīpatiṃ tathā ||27||
dampatīṃ pūjayeccāpi viprāṇāṃ vidhinā tataḥ |
vastrabhūṣābhojyapātraśṛṃgāraśāṭikā diśet ||28||
dhanadānāni ratnānāṃ dhenūnāmarpaṇāni ca |
yathāśakti prakuryācca bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||29||
sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayecca dadyādannāni sarvataḥ |
parihāraṃ prakuryācca dakṣiṇaḥ pradiśettathā ||3.139.30 ||
anena vidhinā kuryād viśokālalitāvratam |
viśokādvādaśīrūpaṃ śokā naśyanti tasya vai ||31 ||
dhenudānaṃ sopadhānaśayyādānaṃ dhanārpaṇam |
prakuryācca lalitāśrīlakṣmīṃ stuvīta bhāvataḥ ||32||
yathā na lakṣmīḥ sampacca māṃ parityajya gacchati |
tathā surūpatārogyamaśokaḥ santu me sadā ||33 ||
yathā bhaktirbhavedagryā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhe mama |
yathā kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaḥ salakṣmīko mama gṛhe ||34||
sadā vasettathā śūrpalakṣmīdānaṃ karomi ca |
suvarṇakamalaṃ ramyaṃ karavīraṃ ca kuṃkumam ||35||
ketakīṃ sinduvāraṃ ca mallikāṃ kesaraṃ tathā |
kajjalaṃ cālaktakaṃ ca candanaṃ ca kadambakam ||36||
rañjanaṃ gandhitailaṃ ca gandhasāraṃ dadāmi ca |
sarvaśṛṃgārapuṣpāṇi dadāmi saukhyahetave ||37||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇātkaraṇādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva viśokalalitāvratāt ||38||
atha kṛṣṇalālanākhyaṃ vrataṃ vacmi ca te rame |
vibhūtayo bhavantyeva kṛṣṇalālanasadvratāt ||39||
kārtike caitrake vaiśākhake mārge ca phālgune |
āṣāḍhe śuklake dinatrayātmakaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ||3.139.40||
sulaghubhug daśamyāṃ tu rātrau śīlavratī bhavet |
kṛtvā sāyantanīṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ vratī ||41 ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraṃ kariṣye’haṃ vrataṃ tviti |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti prātarutthāya cintayet ||42||
snātvaikādaśikāprātarmaṇḍape pūjayet prabhum |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ||43||
śuklapuṣpākṣatavārikuṃkumacandanādibhiḥ |
namo vibhūtaye pādau namo’śokāya jānunī ||44||
namaḥ kṛṣṇayetyūrū ca viśvamūrte namaḥ kaṭim |
kandarpāya namo meḍhraṃ phalaṃ nārāyaṇāya ca ||45||
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ vāsudevāya ca stanau |
mādhavāyetyuro viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhamutkaṇṭhine namaḥ ||46||
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśān keśavāyeti mastakam |
pṛṣṭhaṃ śārṅgadharāyeti śravaṇau śrutivedine ||47||
haraye śaṃkhacakrāsigadājalajapāṇaye |
śiraḥ sarvātmane tasmai nama ityabhipūjanam ||48||
matsyamutpalasaṃyuktaṃ haimaṃ kṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ |
udakuṃbhe nyasettacca dāne prapūjya vai diśet ||49|||
guḍapātraṃ tilairyuktaṃ sitavastrābhiveṣṭitam |
phalāni vividhānyeva dāne prapūjya cārpayet ||3.139.50||
ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca vibhūtiśrīśrīkṛṣṇayoḥ |
naivedyāni vicitrāṇi prātarmadhye niśāmukhe ||51 ||
datvā prasvāpayeccāpi gītavāditrakotsavaiḥ |
jāgaraṇaṃ vratī kuryāt prātaḥ snātvā prapūjyet |||52||
dvādaśyāṃ prārthayeccāpi padmaṃ dadyād dvijāya tu |
udakuṃbhaṃ saratnaṃ ca gāṃ dadyād gurave tathā ||53||
yathā na mucyase kṛṣṇa sadā sarvavibhūtibhiḥ |
tathā māmuddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||54||
śayyāṃ dadyād dhanaṃ dadyād grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhādikam |
guruṃ sampūjya vidhivad bhūṣāvastrāṇi cārpayet |||55||
adhanaḥ pūjayetpuṣpairbhojanānnaṃ diśed vratī |
anena vidhinā yastu kṛṣṇalālanasadvratam ||56||
vibhūtisampradaṃ kuryāttasyarddhayaḥ pade pade |
pāpāni tasya naśyanti pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam ||57||
janmanāṃ śatasāhasraṃ na śokaphalabhāg bhavet |
na tu vyādhirbhavettasya na dāridryaṃ na bandhanam ||58 ||
yāvad yugasahasrāṇāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet |
tāvat svarge vaseccāpi bhūpatiḥ saḥ punarbhavet ||59||
vrataṃ kṛtvā harerdhāma prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
sarvān kāmānaśnute ca kṛṣṇena hariṇā saha ||3.139.60||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kalpe rathantare’bhūllubdhako hyaghī |
paruṣākhyaḥ sa māṃsado durgandhaścātipāpavān ||61 ||
bhāryāpyasyātiduṣṭā ca vyabhicāraparāyaṇā |
jīvahiṃsāparau tau tvekadā vane sarovarāt ||62||
padmānyādāya bahūni vikrayārthaṃ tu vaidiśam |
nagaraṃ yayatuścāpi vikrayo na vyajāyata ||63||
nirāśau tāvatā rātrau kṣudhitau śramitāvubhau |
prāsādasannidhau mārge suptau śuśruvatuḥ śanaiḥ ||64||
maṇḍape śrīhareḥ pūjāśabdān veśyākṛtān śubhān |
māghe rātrau śuklapakṣe caikādaśyāṃ varāṃganā ||656||
gaṇikānaṃgavatīti jagau tadā sugītikāḥ |
pūjayitvā tadā rātrau dānaṃ dadau tu sā bahu ||66 ||
gurave sādhave vedaviprāya śayanādikam |
lavaṇācalamevāpi mūrtiṃ viṣṇostu kānakīm ||67||
dhanānyapi bahūni ca dhānyāni vividhāni ca |
alaṃkṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ sauvarṇāmbarapādapam ||68||
tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tatastābhyāmidaṃ hi pariniścitam |
imāni kamalānyatra pūjāyāṃ dadva eva ha ||69||
evaṃ bhaktyā dattavantau veśyāpi ca dhanaṃ śatam |
dātuṃ samārabhatāpi tau tu jagrahaturna tat ||3.139.70||
dattamannaṃ bhojanārthaṃ tau tu jagrahaturna tat |
prasaṃgādupavāsasya māhātmyaṃ saṃviditya vai ||71 ||
jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtavantau prātardvādaśikābhavat |
prabhāte veśyā dattā śayyā salavaṇācalā ||72||
gṛhāṇi gurave bhaktyā viprebhyo dvādaśāpi ca |
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā gāvaśca vatsikāyutāḥ ||73||
bhojanaṃ ca suhṛnmitradīnāndhakṛpaṇaiḥ samam |
lubdhakena tathā nāryā dṛṣṭametatprapūjanam ||74||
śrīharerdvādaśikāyāṃ prasādaḥ śarkarātmakaḥ |
caraṇāmṛtasalilaṃ gṛhītaṃ ca tataḥ param ||75||
yayatuḥ svagṛhaṃ tau ca veśyāpi svagṛhaṃ gatā |
bhaktimantastrayaste vai kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||76||
puṣkaraprārpaṇāttatra keśavārpaṇasatphalāt |
vinaṣṭāśeṣapāpaśca puṇyavān lubdhakaḥ sa tu ||77||
puṣkaravāhano rājābhavat puṣkarakhaṇḍake |
rājño nāmnā mahākhaṇḍaḥ puṣkarākhyo’bhavat purā ||78||
bhaktyā tuṣṭena hariṇā kṛṣṇalālanasadvratāt |
vratasantuṣṭayā lakṣmyā vibhūtyā bhūbhṛte’rpitam ||79||
kamalaṃ kāñcanaṃ ramyaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmagaṃ param |
lokaiḥ samastairnagaravāsibhiḥ kamalena saḥ ||3.139.80||
vimānākhyena nākaṃ sadvīpāni vyacarannṛpaḥ |
saptamaḥ puṣkarasyāsya dvīpaḥ puṣkaranāmakaḥ ||81||
puṣpavāhananāmāpi puṣkarāsana ityapi |
khyātiṃ prāpa tathā rājñī nārīsahasrapūjitā |||82||
nāmnā lāvaṇyavatīti babhūva kamalāsamā |
putrāstasyāmayutaṃ sambabhūvuḥ puṣkarasya vai ||83||
yā ca veśyā sāpi jātā sapatnī bhūbhṛto vadhūḥ |
dehānte nṛpatiścāpi lavaṇyā ca priyā hyubhau ||84||
yayatuścākṣaraṃ dhāma mama lakṣmi paraṃ padam |
sapatnī yā tu veśyābhūt sā tyaktvā yoṣito vapuḥ ||85||
kāmadevasya vai patnī prītiḥ ratyāḥ sapatnikā |
lokeṣvānandajananī vyajāyata sureśvarī ||86||
kṛṣṇalālanasaṃjñaṃ ca vibhūtidvādaśīvratam |
puṣkarapuṣpasaṃjñaṃ vā vratametadudīritam ||87||
yathākathañcitkamale kamalairdvādaśī tithiḥ |
hariṃ prapūjya kartavyā deyaṃ dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||88||
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā diśed yathādhanam |
suvarṇakamalaṃ yadvā deyaṃ padmaṃ jalodbhavam ||89||
deyaṃ vā sthalakamalaṃ kamaleśaḥ prasīdati |
dadāti sārvabhaumaṃ ca rājyaṃ svargaṃ divaṃ param ||3.139.90 ||
satyaṃ dadāti vā sauraṃ cāndraṃ brāhmaṃ padaṃ ca vā |
vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi padaṃ śrīpuramityapi ||91 ||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāpi golokaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ tathāmṛtam |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma brahmadhāma dadātyapi ||92||
ahaṃ vibhūtinātho’smi dadāmi pūjakāya vai |
anantaguṇakaṃ lakṣmi vibhūtidvādaśīvrataiḥ ||93||
cakravartinṛpā lakṣmi ye ye bhavanti bhūtale |
jātāḥ pūrveṣu kalpeṣu vibhūtidvādaśīvrataiḥ ||94||
kamalaṃ kamalāsthānaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tu mayā saha |
kamalasya pradānena kamalāsahitastvaham ||95||
vasāmi dātari cāpi mamāṃśena cirāyuṣi |
cakracihnaṃ pradadāmi kare vai cakravartinaḥ ||96||
madhyāṃgulidvayoḥ śaṃkhau śeṣāṇāṃ cakrakāṣṭakam |
sākṣānnārāyaṇasyaivaṃ santi cakrāṇi padmaje ||97||
padmaṃ kare pade padmaṃ cakraṃ vā cakravartinaḥ |
evaṃ kare dhvajacihnaṃ dhvajadāturdadāmi vai ||98||
triśūlārpaṇakartuśca triśūlaṃ pradadāmi ca |
dhanuṣyadātuḥ saśaraṃ dhanuṣyaṃ pradadāmi ca ||99||
matsyadātuḥ kare matsyaṃ dadāmi sarvaśobhanam |
svastikasya pradātuśca svastikaṃ pradadāmi ca || 3.139.10 0||
suvarṇānāṃ dhvajādīnāṃ dātre dadāmi sarvathā |
sasāgarāṃ pṛthivīṃ vai cakravartitvamityapi || 101 ||
yasya dakṣakare syuśca dhvajaḥ śūlo dhanuḥ śaraḥ |
mīnaḥ svastika ete ṣaṭ so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 1 02||
lakṣmi sādhusvarūpeṇa hṛdaye tvāṃ nidhāya ca |
vāmasakthni pāṇḍurābhāṃ dhṛtvā vasāmi bhūtale || 1 03||
adṛśyā tvaṃ janairlakṣmi matsevāyā virājase |
tadā sādhusvarūpe cādhunā tvaṃ pṛthageva yā || 1 04||
tvaṃ vibhūtisvarūpāsi vratairvibhūtidāyinī |
vāmahaste daṇḍadīrgharekhā me| dharmabodhinī || 1 05||
pādayorubhayorurdhvarekhe me vyāpike dvayoḥ |
dhāmasṛṣṭyorantarātmabodhinyau te’pi tadvidhe || 1 06||
madbhaktasya kṛpayā me cihnametad bhavedapi |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya vibhūtiphalamāpnuyāt || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne viśokalalitādvādaśīvratasya, vibhūtilalitākṛṣṇalālanavratasya ca nirūpaṇam puṣkaravāhanākhyasya cakravartino dṛṣṭāntaḥ cakravarticihnāni ceti nirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 139 ||

<3.140>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
bhagavan pāvanānyeva vratāni kathitāni me |
navanavāni cānyāni śiṣṭānyapi nivedaya || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
bahūni santi kamale vratāni mokṣadānyapi |
bhuktidānyapi bahudhā vadāmi śṛṇu tānyapi || 2 ||
phalecchayā vihitāni bhogadāni bhavanti vai |
mama prasannatārthaṃ tu kṛtāni mokṣadāni hi || 3 ||
samvatsaraṃ naktabhojī naktavrataṃ samīritam |
kārtikādvā hyaṣāḍhādvā samārabheta tadvratī || 4 ||
ekādaśīṃ samārabhya varṣe pūrṇe tu dhenuyuk |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ haimaṃ dadyācchrīgurave’rpaṇe || 5 ||
susādhūn bhojayeccāpi vratodyāpanamācaret |
vastradānāni dadyācca viṣṇuloke sa modate || 6 ||
ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kuryānmadhyāhne bhojanātmakam |
devāya sarvaṃ prārpyaiva bhuñjīta nānyayā kvacit ||7||
varṣavrataṃ bhavedetad varṣānte ca mahotsavam |
udyāpanaṃ kārayecca vṛṣabhaṃ kānakaṃ diśet ||8||
bhojanāni diśeccāpi sādhubhyo gāṃ diśedapi |
ekāntaravrataṃ cāpi varṣamātraṃ prapālayet || 9 ||
ekāntaritabhojī syād vratānte ca mahotsavam |
svarṇapadmaṃ diśed dāne hyudyāpanaṃ samācaret || 3.140.1 0||
śarkarāpūrṇapātraṃ ca dadyāt prabhojayet sataḥ |
vratī yāti mahāpuṇyaṃ cānte’pi vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 11 ||
cāturmāsye varjayecca dehābhyaṃgaṃ sutailajam |
abhyaṃgavarjanaṃ tvedat vrataṃ proktaṃ tapaḥ param || 12||
vratānte tailadānādi dadyācca bhojanyānyapi |
mama prītikaraṃ tvetattena yāti hareḥ padam || 1 3||
rasānāṃ varjanaṃ cāpi rasavrataṃ prakīrtitam |
madhunārikelavāridadhikṣīraghṛtaikṣavam ||14||
varjayed vatsarānte vā hyudyāpanaṃ samācaret |
rasadānādi dadyācca sūkṣmavastrāṇi cārpayet || 15||
kāmavrataṃ prakuryācca sadā śokavināśakam |
cāturmāsye brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ sadā bhavet || 1 6||
pūrṇe vrate kāṃcanasyāśokavṛkṣaṃ samarpayet |
ikṣuṃ samarpayeccāpi vastrāṇyapi samarpayet || 17||
udyāpanaṃ caredbhuktvā bhogān viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet| |
nakhānāṃ kartanaṃ cāturmāsye vratī hi varjayet || 18||
keśānāṃ vapanaṃ cāpi cāturmāsye vivarjayet |
akartanasaṃjñaṃ caitad vrataṃ kṛtvā mahotsavam || 1 9||
kuryādudyāpanaṃ cānte bhojayet pāyasaṃ sataḥ |
kānakānnakhakeśām̐śca dāne dadyād dvijātaye ||3.140.20|||
saumyāṃ mūrtiṃ mama lakṣmi tava pratidinaṃ diśet |
māsaparyantamevaitat saumyavrataṃ prakīrtitam ||21 ||
vaikuṇṭhe saumyamuktaḥ syādatra vai candramā bhavet |
bahudānāni ratnānāṃ dadyāttu śrāvaṇāntake ||22||
kārtike kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ gṛhopaskaraśobhitām |
dadyāt sampūjya gurave saubhāgyavratamucyate ||23 ||
viṣṇormūrtiṃ śriyā mūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave tadā |
anyadānāni kurvīta śrīhariḥ prīyatāmiti || 24||
sārasvataṃ vrataṃ kuryāt sandhyāyāṃ maunameva tu |
samvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ tilān ghaṭam ||25||
vastrayugmaṃ ca pātraṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ dadyād dvijāyate |
godānaṃ gurave dadyāt pustakānāṃ pradānakam ||26||
sārasvatavrataṃ cedaṃ vidyārūpādidāyakam |
atha sampadvrataṃ kuryāt pañcamyāṃ mādhavīṃ satīm ||27||
lakṣmīṃ nityaṃ pūjayecca varṣānte hemapadmakam |
kamalaṃ gurave dadyāddhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ savatsikām ||28||
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīvān janmajanmasu |
nityaṃ vai mārjayet sarvaṃ mandiraṃ śrīpate prabhoḥ ||29||
varṣānte pradiśeddhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ jalaghaṭaṃ tathā |
janmāyutaṃ sa rājā syāttato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||3.140.30 ||
etadāyurvrataṃ nāma pāpamārjanakārakam |
atha kīrtirvrataṃ kuryādekabhuktaṃ sadācaret ||3 1 ||
varṣānte dhenudaśakaṃ dadyād vṛkṣaṃ hiraṇmayam |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ syācca bhūtikīrtiphalaṃ bhavet ||32||
atha sāmavrataṃ proktaṃ nityaṃ stotraṃ prakīrtayet |
hareragre trikālaṃ vai tiladānaṃ ca nityadā ||33||
puṣpākṣatapradānaṃ ca haraye pūjanārthakam |
samvatsarānte pūrṇe ca hemapadmaṃ diśenmahat ||34||
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ tiladhenuṃ dadyādyāti paraṃ padam |
atha vīravrataṃ kuryānnavamyāmekabhuktakaḥ ||35||
kanyakā bhojayed varṣaṃ varṣānte hemakañcukīḥ |
śāṭīrhaimaṃ keśariṇaṃ dadyācchrīgurave tathā ||36||
kanyakābhyo yathāyogyabhūṣāmbarādi cārpayet |
janmārbudaṃ surūpaḥ syāccānte dhāma harervrajet ||37||
samvatsaraṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ payovratī bhavettathā |
samānte pañcadhenūśca dogdhrīrdadyāt savatsikāḥ ||38||
vāsāṃsi ca piśaṃgāni jalakuṃbhayutāni ca |
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam ||39||
pitṛśrāddhaṃ kārayecca pitṛvratamidaṃ matam |
atha caitrādimāseṣu caturṣu śītalaṃ jalam ||3.140.40||
pāyayet sarvalokāṃśca vratānte maṇikaṃ diśet |
annavastrāṇi dadyācca tilapātraṃ suvarṇakam ||41 ||
jalānandavrataṃ tvetat kalpānto bhūpatirbhavet |
atha kuryād dhṛtivrataṃ pratyahaṃ śrīhariṃ tu mām ||42||
pañcāmṛtena subhagaṃ snapanaṃ kārayettataḥ |
varṣānte śaṃkhadānaṃ ca kuryād yāti hareḥ padam ||43||
mā hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni varṣānte vratakṛjjanaḥ |
godānaṃ hemahariṇapradānaṃ cācaret tvidam ||44||
ahiṃsāvratametena kalpānto bhūpatirbhavet |
atha māghasnānameva kuryācchītena vāriṇā ||45||
sūryaṃ nityaṃ pūjayecca dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye |
dhānyavastravibhūṣādi sūryavrataṃ taducyate ||46 ||
cāturmāsye mahāviṣṇuṃ mahālakṣmīṃ ca pūjayet |
godānaṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi yathāśakti diśed vratī ||47||
sa vaiṣṇavapadaṃ yāti viṣṇuvratamidaṃ śubham |
atha vrataṃ śīlanāma śīlārogyaphalapradam ||48||
varṣaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahmacaryaṃ pālayet strīḥ naro’pi vā |
ghṛtadhenuḥ pradadyācca puṣpamālāḥ sadārpayet ||49||
susādhūn ghṛtamutkṛṣṭaṃ pāyasaṃ bhojayettathā |
udyāpanaṃ vatsarānte kuryād dhānyadhanaṃ diśet ||3.140.50 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ |
atha varṣaṃ na bhuñjīta tailaṃ yacchetpradīpakam ||51 ||
svarṇaṃ dīpaṃ kāñcanaṃ ca cakraṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
vastrayugmaṃ pradadeta yāti brahmapadaṃ hi saḥ ||52||
dīpavratamidaṃ proktaṃ dīptidaṃ rūpadaṃ tathā |
atha kārtikamārabhya naktaṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam ||53||
varṣānte gāṃ pradadyācca pāyasākhyavrataṃ tvidam |
kalyāṇakārakaṃ pṛthvyā rājyapradaṃ pramokṣadam ||54||
atha gandhānulepādi varjayed vatsaraṃ sadā |
nirgandhākhyaṃ vrataṃ proktaṃ varṣānte gandhadānakam ||55||
atha kāntivrataṃ kuryād godānaṃ pratyahaṃ diśet |
lavaṇaṃ naiva bhuñjīta samvatsaraṃ tataḥ param ||56||
udyāpanaṃ prakuryācca kāntikīrtiphalapradam |
rājā bhūtvā kalpapūrṇaṃ viṣṇuloke vased dhruve ||57||
brahmavrataṃ tataḥ kuryād brahmāṇḍaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham |
svalpaṃ tilasamāyuktaṃ puṇye dine dvijāyate ||58||
dadyāt tridivasān tilāśano bhaved vratī tathā |
mālyavastravibhūṣāṇāṃ dānaṃ kuryād vratī param ||59||
brahmalokaṃ prayātyeṣo nirvāṇapadamāpnuyāt |
śaktitastripalādūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrtitam ||3.140.60||
atha dhenuvrataṃ kuryāt tryahaṃ payovratī bhavet |
kāñcanaṃ ca vṛṣaṃ dhenuṃ dadetobhayatomukhīm ||61 ||
taṇḍulān samprayacchecca palordhvaṃ kānakaṃ vṛṣam |
datvā brahmapadaṃ yāti golokaṃ dhenusadvratāt || 62||
atha kalpavrataṃ kuryāt palordhvaṃ kalpapādapam |
kṛtvā dadyāt sādhave ca taṇḍulān dvidalānvitān ||63||
kalpadānena kalpānte svargād gacchati matpadam |
atha māsopavāsī syāt prayacchenmahiṣīṃ śubhām ||64||
dogdhrīṃ śrīgurave caitanmāhiṣaṃ vratamucyate |
dadyād viṃśatipalordhvaṃ pṛthivīṃ kāñcanīṃ śubhām ||65||
dharāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ tvaikabhojī dine bhavet |
saptakalpaśatānyeva vasati śrīśamandire ||66||
tato yātyakṣaraṃ dhāma dharāvratakaraḥ pumān |
madbhakto māṃ prayātyeva pārṣadaḥ san prasevate ||67||
māghe caitre guḍaṃ dadyād guḍavrataparāyaṇaḥ |
guḍabhojī guḍapāyī tilairguḍaiḥ prapūjayet ||68||
māṃ lakṣmīṃ ca guḍadāne dadyād guḍamayīṃ guḍam |
guḍavratamidaṃ proktaṃ muktidaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||69||
atha pakṣopavāsī syāt kapilāyugalaṃ diśet |
udyāpanaṃ prakuryācca paramānandakārakam ||3.140.70||
kalpānte rājarājaḥ syāt kapilāvratameva tat |
atha varṣaṃ caikabhojī nityabhojyajalapradaḥ ||71 ||
viṣṇuloke vasedante prāptivratamidaṃ matam |
naktāśī cāṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ ||72|||
svargaṃ yāti tataścānte brahmapadaṃ prayāti saḥ |

kāryarūpā nadī cāste mūrtiḥ śrīpuruṣottame ||97||

sāgarāḥ sāgaratulyasarāṃsi saritastathā |

maharṣayaḥ pitaraśca siddhāśca sādhavo’malāḥ || 3.141.1 00||
satyaḥ sādhvyaścakradharyaścakradharāśca pārṣadāḥ |
māmanādimupāsante śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 101 ||
siddhikṣetraṃ mahaccaitaddhāmakṣetraṃ parātparam |
idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ satyamidaṃ sukham || 1 02||
idaṃ puṇyamidaṃ dharmyaṃ pāvanaṃ kārṣṇyamuttamam |
śrutvāpyetattīrthatīrthaṃ nākapṛṣṭhe sumodate || 1 03||
jātismaratvaṃ labhate sarvasmaratvamityapi |
traikālikaṃ pravetti yat sārvajñyaṃ cāpi vindati || 1 04||

<3.142>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
nārāyaṇa jagatkānta sarvarakṣaka sarvaga |
kathaṃ trikālajaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayati mānavo bhuvi || 1 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
parameśa kṛpāsindho kṛte dharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ |
tretāyāṃ ca tato’pyanye bhavatā pūrvamīritāḥ || 1 ||

pravartamānā dharmārthakāmamokṣān prayanti vai || 2 ||
mantrānnāmāni bhaktiṃ ca kurvāṇāste kathaṃvidhāḥ |
satyahīnā api muktiṃ vrajiṣyanti divaṃ ca vā || 3 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ satyadharmāstu muktidāḥ |
tretādharmāḥ svabhāvātta mahaiśvaryapradatvataḥ || 4 ||
pradadatyaiśvarān lokān bhaumavairājavaiṣṇavān |
dvāparasya vṛṣā lakṣmi nikṛṣṭā kalmaṣaspṛśaḥ || 5 ||
tannāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo bhavāmi dvāpare muhuḥ |
mama yogena pāpā vai taranti sādhusaṃgamāt || 6 ||
śṛṇu dvāparadharmāṇi hrāsaṃ gatāni pūrvataḥ |
yatra bhaktipradhānā vai taranti netare janāḥ || 7 ||
tretāsiddhayaḥ sarvāstu naśyanti dvāpare yuge |
lobhau dhairyarahitatvaṃ vāṇijyaṃ kapaṭānvitam || 8 ||
atattvaniścayaścāpi varṇānāṃ dhvaṃsa ityapi |
viparyayastu sarveṣu karmaṇāṃ svasvayoginām || 9 ||
yātrā vadhaḥ paro daṇḍo māno darpo balaṃ kṣatiḥ |
akṣamā ca rajastamo bhūyo dvāparake yuge ||3.143.1 0||
āśramāścāpi dharmārthāḥ saṃkīryante vṛṣāvarāḥ |
śrutiśāstreṣu vaimatyaṃ bahutarkakṛtārthatā ||1 1 ||
dvaidhamutpadyate tena niścayo nādhigamyate |
anirṇītārthayogena dharmatattvaṃ hasatyapi ||1 2||
vaimatyena kṛto dharmo vyākūlaścāvasīdati |
vedaścaturdhā kṛṣṇena vyāsena vyasyate tataḥ ||1 3||
ṛṣiputraiḥ punarvedā bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ |
saṃhitā nūtanāścāpi jāyante tu maharṣibhiḥ ||14||
dvāpareṣu pravartante bhinnārthaistaiḥ svadarśanaiḥ |
evamādhvaryavaṃ karma prasthānairvividhaistataḥ ||15||
vikalpaiḥ saṃkṣayaiścāpi gauṇairmukhyaiḥ prakāṇḍakaiḥ |
vibhinnaguṇakaṃ tatra tatra deśe pravartate ||16 ||
evaṃ śraddhā ca viśvāso dhāraṇā bhāvanārhaṇā |
naśyanti kālayogena satyaṃ cāpi vinaśyati ||17||
niyāmyatvaṃ sthitiścātra nītirnaśyanti chadminī |
kāpaṭyaṃ cāpyasatyaṃ ca pratāritvaṃ vivardhate ||18||
evaṃ viparyayotpannā kudṛṣṭirdvāpare bhavet |
maraṇaṃ vighnajātāni jāyante ca muhurmuhuḥ ||19||
upadravā vyādhayaśca cintāścākasmikodbhavāḥ |
viṣayābhisandhayaśca jāyante dvāpare’dhikāḥ ||3.143.20 ||
vṛkṣagulmauṣadhayaśca prasahya tu yathābalam |
svakīyāśca prakurvanti prajāstu dvāpare tadā ||21 ||
oṣadhayo vilokyaitat praviṣṭāstu dharāṃ prati |
phālakṛṣṭāḥ prarohanti dvāpare vai tataḥ param ||22||
madhye tu dvāpare tatra nārohantyoṣadhīgaṇāḥ |
vinā bījaṃ tadā bījakṛṣiḥ samantato bhavet ||23||
bījaṃ mūlaṃ ca śākhāṃ ca kandaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca nālakam |
phalaṃ patraṃ mañjarīṃ ca granthiṃ tadaṃkuraṃ ca vā ||24||
jaṭāṃ tvacaṃ ca kāṇḍaṃ ca ropayanti tadā kṣitau |
tadvaṃśā oṣadhayastā jāyante dvāpare tataḥ ||25||
jīvikā tadadhīnā ca sarveṣāṃ jāyate tadā |
vyāpārāścauṣadhīnāṃ ca jāyante dvāpare tataḥ ||26||
anyathā jīvitaṃ tāsāṃ nāsti tretāyugātyaye |
vārtāvṛttiṃ kṛṣiṃ cāpi vāṇijyaṃ cāśrayanti te || 27||
hastodbhavā āpaścāpi bhavanti bhūkhanestadā |
kūpāśca dīrghikāścāpi pravartante tadābhitaḥ ||28||
svatvayuktā balinaśca prajāyante’dhipāstadā |
durbalā janahīnāśca svatvahīnā bhavanti ca ||29||
luṭyante balibhirvṛkṣavallīprabhṛtijīvikāḥ |
striyaḥ kṣetrāṇi putryaśca sutā dhanāni dhenavaḥ ||3.143.30 ||
maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ brahmā kṣatraṃ mahābalam |
kṣatāt trātuṃ prajāmūrdhni sthāpayatyeva bhūbhṛtam ||3 1 ||
varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāṃ ca karoti nirbhayāṃ tadā |
avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ vyādhiḥ pravartante’bhitastadā ||32||
dharmasargo yathā cāste tathā cādharmasargakaḥ |
samatulo dvāpare vai mānaveṣu pravartate ||33 ||
ardhadvāparaparyantaṃ tretādharmāḥ kvacit kvacit |
vidyante te’pi naśyanti dvāparārdhe gate sati ||34||
satyaṃ cānṛtasahitaṃ cāsteyaṃ steyamiśritam |
ahiṃsā hiṃsayā miśrā śīlaṃ duḥśīlayojitam ||35||
parigraho lobhayukto nītiranyāyasaṃspṛśā |
śaucaṃ cāśaucasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ santoṣastṛṣṇikānvitaḥ ||36||
tapaḥ praśaṃsāsaṃbhinnaṃ svādhyāyo dhanakāmanaḥ |
īśadhyānaṃ kaṣṭanāśārthakaṃ bhaktirnijārthikī ||37||
sutadārādikaṃ cārdhasvārthaṃ cārdhavṛṣārthakam |
bhṛtyāstathāvidhāścārdhasvārthāścārdhaparārthakāḥ ||38 ||
rājāno’pi nijasyārdhasvārthāścārdhaparārthakāḥ |
ṛṣayopi tathā cārdhasvārthatapaḥparāyaṇāḥ ||39||
dvāpare samprajāyante sambandhāścārdhanaijikāḥ |
dharmakāryāṇi yajñāśca svārdhārthasādhakārthakāḥ ||3.143.40||
vṛṣṭyā cārdhaṃ kūpajalairardhaṃ bhojyānnamīyate |
dvāparottarabhāge vai niścitāyurna vidyate ||41||
vṛddhe jīvati putrādyā mriyante’rdhānṛtā yataḥ |
vṛkṣāścārdhāḥ phalantyeva vallikāśca striyastathā ||42||
puruṣāścārdhadhṛtayo bhavanti dvāparārdhake |
ardhaviśvāsino lokā mitho vyavaharanti ca ||43||
jāyamāne śubhe kārye tadarthaṃ phalati dhruvam |
nadīvegāstathārdhāpaḥ ṛtavaścārdhasatphalāḥ ||44||
tretārdhāyuṣyajanatāḥ kvacit kvacidbhavanti ca |
saṃkalpāt satyayuge vai sṛṣṭirasti sthale sthale ||45||
tretāyāṃ darśanāccāpi sṛṣṭirītiḥ pravartate |
tretānte sparśanāt sṛṣṭirdvāpare mithunādapi ||46||
dvāparārdhe gate sṛṣṭirmithunād viphalā kvacit |
evaṃ sarvā hi khanayo bījādhānyo bhavanti vai ||47||
puruṣā moghavīryāśca vāsanārdhapravartanāḥ |
viṣayārdhakṛtasnehāḥ pravartante’rdharāgataḥ ||48||
ardharugṇāḥ prajāścāpi balārdhavatya ityatha |
ardhahrasvāḥ pūrvataśca pravartante dvaye yuge ||49||
mantrāścārdhaṃ phalantyeva guravaścārdhabodhinaḥ |
dānaṃ vrataṃ dayā dharmaścārdhabhāvaṃ bhajanti vai ||3.143.50||
śiṣyāścārdhanideśasthā vartante’rdhasvamāninaḥ |
nāryaścārdhaṃ pātivratyaṃ samāsthāya vadhūṭikāḥ ||51 ||
kuṭumbaṃ sarvamevātra dvāpare’rdhārthasādhakam |
āśramāścārdhavṛṣiṇo varṇāścārdhanijaprathāḥ |||52||
devāścārdhaphaladāśca svāmino’rdhasurakṣiṇaḥ |
yuddheṣu cārdhavijayaścārdhabhaṭāḥ ṛtaṃjayāḥ ||53 ||
pradhānāścārdhagauṇāśca rājyaṃ cārdhaṃ prakāśate |
bhāgyaṃ cārdhaṃ phalatyeva nirṇayo’rdhaṛtaṃbharaḥ ||54||
ardharasāḥ prajāyante pūrṇarasāḍhyamūlinaḥ |
dvāpare śapathāścāpi lakṣmi cārdhayathārthakāḥ ||55||
vacanāni śreṣṭhināṃ ca tathaivārdhasthirāṇi ca |
viśvāso mahatāṃ cāpi tathaivārdhakṛtāspadaḥ ||56||
satyalokāddhi siddhanāmardhāḥ sarvatra gāminaḥ |
pitaraścāpi tadvacca bhavanti cārdhagāminaḥ ||57||
surāścāpi tathā bhūmau samāyāntyardhasaṃkhyayā |
pātālādisthitāścāpi tathaivārdhavihāriṇaḥ ||58||
aśaktāḥ sarvaśastatra dvāpare’rdhaprajā rame |
oṣadhayaścārdhabalā bhiṣajo’rdhaparīkṣakāḥ ||59||
daivajñāścārdhaboddhāraścikitsārdhāścikitsakāḥ |
yantratantrāṇi cārdhāni tathārdhakāryadāni vai ||3.143.60||
madhye bhagnāni jāyante’ntarāle lambayanti ca |
vārdhakyādārḍhyabhāve’pi kṣīṇadarśanaśaktayaḥ ||61 ||
kṣīṇādānagatiprāyāḥ kṣīṇānandā bhavanti ca |
kṣīṇaśravaṇasparśādyāḥ kṣīṇāsvādanagandhinaḥ ||62||
kṣīṇasattvārdhabalino dvāpare saṃbhavanti ca |
satyagṛhaṃ surāvāsā gurukulāni dhārmikā ||63||
prāyaśo’rdhaṃ vinaśyanti dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau |
yajñaśālā utsavāśca devālayāśca sādhavaḥ ||64||
satyamānasaratnāni satyatīrthāni yāni ca |
ardhaṃ tāni vinaśyanti dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau ||65||
pavitratārdhanāśā ca spṛśyāspṛśyārdhanāśanam |
vandyāvandyārdhanāśaśca pūjyapūjārdhanāśanam ||66||
bhogyabhogārdhanāśaśca peyapānārdhanāśanam |
dhyeyadhyānārdhanāśaśca dvāpare’rdhe gate kṣitau ||67||
puruṣārthārdhanāśaśca kalpitārdhavināśanam |
dārḍhyaṃ cārdhāstitvaphalaṃ prārbhāścārdhagocarāḥ | |68||
medhā cārdhavicārā ca yatnaścārdhaphalāvahaḥ |
mitrāṇi cārdhabhāvāni dāsyaṃ cārdhaṃ pravartate ||69||
paśavaścārdhaviśvāsāḥ pakṣiṇaścārdhasevinaḥ |
bhāṣāṇāmardhavijñānaṃ dvāpare’rdhe gate bhavet ||3.143.70||
ardhākarṣaṇarūpāṇi cārdhākarṣaṇaśaktayaḥ |
snehāspadādi cārdhāni dvāparerdhe gate kṣitau ||71 ||
rājyadaṇḍairniyamitāḥ prajāstiṣṭhanti nītigāḥ |
prakāśaṃ cārdhamevāpi karma tatkarma gaṇyate ||72||
pracchannaṃ gaṇyate naiva cārdhaṃ dvāparibhirjanaiḥ |
daivabhayaṃ prayātyeva dvāpare’rdhaṃ prajāsu vai ||73||
pāpabhayaṃ tathā cārdhaṃ gaṇyate naiva tadyuge |
drohabhayaṃ tathā mithyābhayaṃ cārdhaṃ na gaṇyate ||74||
asatkarmabhayaṃ naiva gaṇyate’ghaṃ na manyate |
ardhamevaṃ jāyate vai dvāpare’rdhe hi padmaje ||75||
taṃ raścottarakāle tu tryaṃśaṃ satyaṃ prajīvati |
tribhāgāścāpi satyādernaśyantyeva dvaye’ntime ||76||
dvāpare’nte caturthāṃśāyuṣyavanto hi dehinaḥ |
sahasrārdhaṃ samāraṃbhe tadardhaṃ madhyadvāpare ||77||
tadardhaṃ tryaṃśake yāte caturthāṃśe tadardhakam |
āyurvai hrāsamāpannaṃ sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ rame ||78||
aṣṭatālā mānavā vai satye bhavanti cocchritāḥ |
tretāyāṃ te ṣaṭṭālordhvā dvāparaṃ caturūrdhvakāḥ ||79||
dvāparārdhe tadardhāśca tato’rdhā daśahastakāḥ |
vṛkṣāścaturguṇordhvāśca hastinaśca drumārdhakāḥ ||3.143.80||
hastyardhordhvā ghoṭakāśca tadasamā govṛṣādayaḥ |
dvāpare te bhavantyeva bale tryaṃśavivarjitāḥ ||81 ||
dvāparānte nirbalāśca prāraṃbhāccaturaṃśinaḥ |
siddhimantastu ye santi te bhavantyūrdhadīrghakāḥ ||82||
punarhrasvāḥ svalpadehāstato’lpaparīṇāhakāḥ |
bhojanaṃ tu daśamāṇaṃ pañcamāṇaṃ tato’rdhakam ||83||
māṇamātraṃ tadardhaṃ ca dvāparānte bhavettadā |
divase tu pravāso vai satyayuge’mbare’sti ca ||84||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu pṛthvyāṃ dvīpāntare’pi ca |
tretāyāṃ tu pravāso vai vimānāpekṣa eva ha ||85||
divase ca tadā yānti mānavāḥ śatayojanam |
dvāpare tu tadardhaṃ ca dvāparārdhe tadardhakam ||86||
dvāparānte tadardhaṃ ca tato’rdhaṃ ca tataḥ param |
evaṃ hrasvaśarīrāṇāṃ pādakramo vikuñcitaḥ ||87||
prāṇāyāmairvinā teṣāṃ vyomagatirna vidyate |
bhvādhārā bhūnivāsaśca bhūkramā bhūprabhojinaḥ ||88||
evaṃ bhūmātarastatra dvāparānte prajā rame |
kṣudhātṛṣātitāpāḍhyā dvāpare’nte janā rame ||89||
asadāḍhyāḥ śāṭhyayuktāḥ svārthāhaṃkārasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
kalmaṣairbahubhiryuktā jāyante dvāpare’ntake ||3.143.90||
kṣudracittā dhairyahīnā gāmbhīryavarjitāstathā |
jāyante mānavā lakṣmi dvāpare’nte samastataḥ ||91 ||
striyaḥ śrīvarjitāścāpi maryādārdhavihantrikāḥ |
nijārdhasvatvamamatāhaṃkāragarvitāstathā ||92||
bhavantyeva kleśadāśca tathārdhadharmavarjitāḥ |
śriyastato varjayanti lakṣmyo viyanti tadgṛhāt ||93||
sampadaścāpasaranti ṛddhayo’pasaranti ca |
śiṣṭāśca sampadābhāsā bhavanti vai kusampadaḥ ||94||
janāḥ śiṣṭāḥ svaśiṣṭatvaṃ tyajanti dvāpare’rdhakam |
dvāparānte na śiṣṭatvaṃ kalmaṣairhanyate hi tat ||95||
kālaścāpi purā yaḥ sa kleśārdhātmā pravartate |
kāladūtā bhavaneṣu parābhavanti mānavān ||96||
vahnayo vāmabhāgārdhaṃ gatvā yānti pradakṣiṇam |
dvāpare’nte’rpitaṃ dravyaṃ pūjārthaṃ līyate’rdhakam ||97||
naijaṃ sarvaṃ bhaved dvedhā paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ parārthakam |
parabhāvena sambhinnaṃ cittaṃ naijaṃ hi dvāparam ||98||
evaṃ lakṣmi vividhān vai dharmān śrayanti mānavāḥ |
pāpaṃ cārdhaṃ tathā cārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ kurvanti tatprajāḥ ||99||
arthaṃ kāmaṃ cehamānāḥ prajā hrāsaṃ vrajantyapi |
tatra mantraṃ japenme ca gāyatryākhyaṃ nirantaram || 3.143.1 00||
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrīghanaśyāmāya vidmahe |
nīlakaṇṭhāya dhīmahi, tanno hariḥ pracodayāt || 10 1||
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrībālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe |
anādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi, tannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāt || 1 02||
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, śrīnārāṇāya vidmahe |
vāsudevāya dhīmahi, tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt || 1 03||
oṃ śrībrahmapriyāvallabhāya svāhā namaḥ japet |
oṃśrīharipriyāvallabhāya namaḥ japet tathā || 1 04||
ṣaṭlakṣajapakartā vai taratyeva bhavārṇavāt |
dvāpare mantramenaṃ vai tato japet pramuktaye ||1 051||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate |
rādhāpate parabrahma gopīpate jayāpate ||1 06||
lalitāśrīpate prajñāpate padmāvatīpate |
sukhadāśrīpate lakṣmīpate śrīmāṇikīpate ||1 07||
haṃsagaruḍavāraṇaturagādhipate prabho |
satāṃpate satīsādhvīpate sarvapate vibho ||1 08||
bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa tārayāsmān bhavārṇavāt |
dvāparād ghorarūpādvai cāntimasamayātmakāt ||1 09||
ityarthayed bhagavantaṃ parameśaṃ sanātanam |
pūjayenmāṃ dhārayecca hṛdaye mayi cārpayet || 3.143.110 ||
evaṃ mokṣaṃ dvāpare’nte cāpnuyurmānavā rame |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi saṃhitāyā mamāpi ca || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dvāparayugadharmakarmasvabhāvāstathāvidhamānavānāṃ mokṣārthaṃ mantrādibhajanapradarśanamitinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 143 ||

<3.144>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
yugadharmā hare nityā āhosvit parivartinaḥ |
yuge’nye cānyayugajā pravartante na vā vṛṣāḥ || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
yugadharmā rame nityā yugo dharmātmako hi saḥ |
kintu baliṣṭhapuruṣairvivartyante’nyayaugikāḥ || 2 ||
kalmaṣāḥ kalidharmā vai vivartyante ṛtaṃbharaiḥ |
dehadharmā vivartyante baliṣṭhairyogibhistathā || 3 ||
kāladharmā vivartyante satībhiḥ sādhvikādibhiḥ |
doṣadharmā vivartyante siddhaiśca sādhubhistathā || 4 ||
deśadharmā vivartyante samarthācāryapuṃgavaiḥ |
prajādharmā vivartyante rājabhiśca praśāsakaiḥ || 5 ||
yatidharmā vivartyante camatkāryavatārakaiḥ |
kanyādharmā vivartyante samājairlokapūjitaiḥ || 6 ||
utsavādyā vivartyante siddhavāgbhirjanairiha |
varṇadharmā vivartyante varṇāgryanītivedibhiḥ || 7 ||
āśrayāḥ parivartyante tyāgividehibhirjanaiḥ |
mānasāni vivartyante tvākarṣaṇaparairjanaiḥ || 8 ||
satyadharmā yatra satyaṃ puruṣe tatra santi vai |
tretādharmā rajoyuktaṃ sattvaṃ yatra pravartate || 9 ||
dvāparasya rajoyuktaṃ tamo manāk pravartate |
kalerdharmāstāmasā vai tamo yatra pravartate || 3.144.1 0||
sāttvike sattvadharmā vai tāmase kaliyojitāḥ |
sattvarajoyute tretārajastamoyute dvikaḥ || 11 ||
kṛte yuge catuṣpādvai lakṣmi dharmaḥ pravartate |
prāpyate bhagavām̐stena dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ || 1 2||
dharmo hi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pūjā kṛṣṇo hi tarpaṇam |
homaḥ sandhyā tathā dhyānaṃ dhāraṇā sakalaṃ hariḥ ||1 3||
pādā dharmasya catvāraḥ satyaṃ dānaṃ tapo dayā |
dharmapātā hariścāhaṃ pādāḥ satyādayo mama || 14||
tretāyuge tripāddharmaḥ satyadānadayātmakaḥ |
yajñayāgādayaḥ sarvaṃ tretāyāmapyahaṃ rame ||15||
dvāpare dvicaraṇaśca dānadayātmakastvaham |
kalau dānaṃ pādamekaṃ dānātmako’smyahaṃ rame || 1 6||
satye śveto bhavāmyeva tretāyāṃ raktavarṇavān |
dvāpare’haṃ piśaṃgaśca kalau kṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham || 17||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti vartante puruṣe guṇāḥ |
pūruṣanoditāste’pi parivartanta ātmasu || 18||
prabhūtaṃ tu yadā sattvaṃ manobuddhīndriyāṇi ca |
tadā kṛtayugaṃ vidyājjñāne tapasi yadratiḥ ||1 9||
yadā karmasu kāmyeṣu śaktiryaśasi dehinām |
tadā tretā hṛdaye vai rajobhūtirmato bahiḥ ||3.144.20||
yadā lobhastvasantoṣo māno daṃbhaśca matsaraḥ |
kāmyakarmaratiścāpi dvāparaṃ tadrajastamaḥ ||21 ||
yadā sadānṛtaṃ nidrā hiṃsā kleśaśca tandrikā |
śokamohau bhayaṃ dainyaṃ tiṣyastadā tamo mataḥ ||22||
dvāpare vigate lakṣmi janāḥ kaṭukabhāṣiṇaḥ |
kāmapradhānabhāvāśca deśā dasyuviśeṣakāḥ ||23||
dharmāḥ pākhaṇḍapūrṇāśca prajābhakṣā nṛpāstadā |
śiśnodarasparśatṛpāḥ prajā bhūbhṛta ārthikāḥ ||24||
avratā baṭavo’śaucā vibhavaśca kuṭumbinaḥ |
tapasvino grāmavāsā nyāsino hyarthalolupāḥ ||25||
mahāhārā mahātṛṣṇāḥ kalau tu sādhavastadā |
tyajanti svāminaṃ bhṛtyāstāpasastyajati vratam ||26||
śūdrāstu pratigṛhṇanti vaiśyāstapaḥparāyaṇāḥ |
udvignāśca janāstiṣye piśācasadṛśīprajāḥ ||27||
anyāyabhojakā devātithipūjāvivarjitāḥ |
strīparāstu narāḥ sarve pitryudakavivarjitāḥ ||28 ||
bahuprajālpabhāgyāśca bhavantyeva kalau striyaḥ |
śiraḥkaṇḍūyanaparā ājñāṃ bhindanti sarvathā ||29||
tathā māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ cāpi tapasvinām |
sādhayanti svārthaparāḥ pāpena vyākulendriyāḥ ||3.144.30 ||
kalau pramādako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca |
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ ||3 1 ||
anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhāṃ durācārairduriṣṭakāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ mānavānāṃ tu sambandhāḥ sarvajātiṣu ||32||
śayanāsanabhojyāni caikakīrṇāni sarvathā |
bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā sādhuhatyā sthale sthale ||33||
svalpāyuṣye’pi mriyante kramaṃ vinā kuṭumbinaḥ |
alpatejobalāścāpyanṛtaprāyā adhārmikāḥ ||34||
rājavṛttisthitāścaurāḥ kāmācārāśca pārthivāḥ |
ekapatnyo na śiṣyanti vardhante cābhicārikāḥ ||35||
kāṣāyiṇaśca niḥkacchā vṛttyarthaṃ daivaliṅginaḥ |
upahṛtya parānnādi sādhayanti nijārthakam ||36||
śvapacā rājyakartāro viprāsteṣāṃ hi sevakāḥ |
sevante śvapacān viprāḥ śrutabhāgyabalākṣayāḥ ||37||
vedaśāstrāgamadharmā vighnarūpāḥ kalau rame |
utsāditā bhavantyeva dharmasaṃkaratātra vai ||38||
yajñā naiva bhavantyeva vivāhā na tadā kalau |
manaḥprasannatāheturdāmpatye sveṣṭacāritā ||39||
mlecchācāraṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ kalau śreṣṭhaṃ vadanti hi |
citravarṣī tadā devaḥ sasyānāṃ citrapākatā ||3.144.40 ||
sarve lobhavaṇigvṛttāḥ kapaṭaivikrayārthinaḥ |
nāvyāhṛtakrūravākyo nārjavī nānasūyakaḥ ||41||
nopakārī na ca pratyupakārī pāpake yuge |
nṛpaśūnyā vasumatī na ca dhānyadhanāvṛtā ||42||
nindakāśca patitāśca kalau bhavanti sarvathā |
maṇḍalāni bhavantyeva deśeṣu nagareṣu ca ||43||
rājakāryakarāṇyeva dharmaghnāni kalau yuge |
alpodakā cālpaphalā vasuhīnā vasundharā ||44||
goptāraścāpyagoptāro luṇṭakāścāpyaśāsakāḥ |
hartāraḥ paravittānāṃ parastrīputrayoṣitām ||45||
sāhasrapriyaduṣṭāśāḥ pranaṣṭacetanā janāḥ |
mukhe miṣṭā hṛdi duṣṭā bhavanti suhṛdaḥ kalau ||46||
caurāścaurasvahartāro harturhartā kalau paraḥ |
kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayanti kalau hi tān ||47||
bahavaścaiva panthānaḥ sampradāyāḥ kalau yuge |
pracchannādharmabhoktāro bahiśceṣṭapradarśinaḥ ||48||
devasādhuyatiyogisādhvīdhanānnabhoginaḥ |
kṣuttṛptā mānavā puṣṭiṃ kurvanti kupathasya vai ||49||
satye śatābdiko dharmastretāyāṃ vārṣikaḥ sa tu |
dvāpare māsikaḥ so’pi kalau cāhnika eva saḥ ||3.144.50||
āhnikaṃ cāpi dharmaṃ taṃ jahatyeva kalau janāḥ |
vyākulāśca paribhrāntāḥ parasparabhayārditāḥ ||51||
svān prāṇān parirakṣanto niṣkāruṇyāḥ sudukhitāḥ |
nirmaryādā nirākrāntā niḥsnehā nirapatrapāḥ ||52||
udyamavarjitāścāpi māṃsāhārā janāḥ kalau |
samudratīravāsāśca matsyāhārāstu sarvathā ||53||
aniketā valkalāḍhyā bhūśayyā mānavāstadā |
paśavo mānavā daivāḥ pakṣiṇo jalacāriṇaḥ ||54||
samavṛttāḥ prāyaśo vai kalau sāṃkaryabhoginaḥ |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇastatra prerayāmi nijāśritān ||55 ||
divyadehān pārṣadānme ṛṣirūpān hi tāpasān |
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya te vasanti hyagocarāḥ ||5 6 ||
parvateṣu śubhācārā vanyamūlaphalāśinaḥ |
yugalāni prajāyante tebhyo dharmamayāni ca ||57||
sarvaiśvaryasamarthāni vedabhaktiyutāni ca |
mamāvatārairbahavo hanyante duṣṭajātayaḥ ||58||
ativātātivṛṣṭyādyairnaśyanti cābdhitīragāḥ |
tato vanānāmṛṣayo mama putrāśca pārṣadāḥ ||59|||
pravartante kārtavīryā bhūmau santānakāriṇaḥ |
evaṃ kṛtasya santānaḥ kaleścaiva kṣayastathā ||3.144.60||
kṛtasya yogyatāyuktā jāyante pārṣadarṣayaḥ |
upabhogasamarthāśca divyadehāḥ ṛtavratāḥ ||61 ||
vairāgyayoginaḥ sarve cātmabodhaparāstathā |
santuṣṭāstapaāsthāśca dharmiṣṭhā bhaktiśīlinaḥ ||62||
saptarṣayastadā svargādāgatyaiṣu vasanti ca |
satyaṃ saptarṣayo dharmaṃ kathayantīha teṣu ca ||63||
tiṣṭhanti ye kalau siddhā adṛṣṭā viharanti ca |
prakāśaṃ te samāyānti hyācāryāste bhavanti hi ||64||
guravo lokarakṣārhāḥ prajāsu viharanti ca |
yogyabrahmamahāvaṃśotthebhyo rājyaṃ dadatyapi ||656||
evaṃ kṛtaṃ yugaṃ lakṣmi punastatra pravartate |
tvaṃ kalau kṣīṇatāṃ yātā satye punaḥ pravardhase ||66||
śuddhiṃ tvaṃ labhase lakṣmi sādhusādhvīsamāgamāt |
āsurī yātudhānī ca paiśācī yakṣarākṣasī ||67||
tiṣyā tvaṃ satyarūpā vai daivī lakṣmīḥ prajāyase |
yugalāni tadā satye prāyaśo gṛhadharmiṇaḥ ||68||
yatitulyāśca yatayo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ |
akāmāścātiniṣkāmā ātmānandavihāriṇaḥ ||69||
saṃkalpamātrayogāśca strīdṛṣṭimātrayoginaḥ |
mānasyaśca prajāścāpi putrapautrādayaḥ punaḥ ||3.144.70 ||
sādhusādhvīsvarūpāste bhavanti cāgate kṛte |
devāsuramanuṣyāśca yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||71 ||
dharmavratāḥ prajāyante satyayugabalāddhi te |
pariṇāhocchraye tulyā jāyante pūrvavatpunaḥ ||72||
bale yoge tathaiśvarye sampatsu ca samādhiṣu |
vyomagatau jalagatau jāyante pūrvavatpunaḥ ||73 ||
medhāyāṃ ca vikāse ca bhautikeṣu yathā purā |
tathā kṛte prajāyante mama saṃkalpanoditāḥ ||74||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi dhenavaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ |
taravaḥ kalpataravo vallikāḥ kalpavallikāḥ ||75||
mānavā divyadehāśca yoṣito divyayoṣitaḥ |
tathā kṛte prajāyante yathā pūrve kṛte’bhavan ||76 ||
kintu lakṣmi brāhmasaṃjñānmuhūrtāt prātarūnakam |
prātaḥkālāt saṃgavaśca tato madhyāhnakaṃ tathā ||77||
tato’parārdhārdhakālaḥ sāyaṃ nyūnabalaṃ tataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtā yugāḥ sarve pūrvapūrvatarūnakāḥ ||78||
manāksvalpabalāścāpi manāk hrāsapramarditāḥ |
uttarottarahrāsayuktāstatastulyā na sarvathā ||79||
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhasthasatyādvai pare satyayugāstataḥ |
nyūnabalā bhavantyeva nādisatyasamā hi te ||3.144.80||
mama yogabalaṃ pūrṇaṃ yatra tatrādisadṛśāḥ |
mannyūnabalavadvyaktau nyūnabalaṃ kṛtaṃ yugam ||81 ||
evameva vijānīhi madvinā nirbalaṃ jagat |
yatrāhaṃ tatra sarvatra gārhasthye’pi hi sādhutā || 82||
yatra nāhaṃ tatra lakṣmi sādhutve’pi na sādhutā |
yasmin kasmin yuge lakṣmi yenāhaṃ samupārjitaḥ |||83||
tenārjitaḥ satyayugaḥ sarvaṃ tenārjitaṃ priyam |
lakṣmi santaḥ pravakṣyāmi sādhūnatha tataśca vai ||84||
saṃyujya brahmaṇā hyantastena santaḥ pracakṣate |
santaṃ śrīparamātmānaṃ tanvanti ye prajāsu ca ||85||
santaste sādhnuvanti svakāryaṃ mokṣātmakaṃ tathā |
pareṣāṃ mokṣakāryaṃ ca sādhayanti ha sādhavaḥ ||86 ||
divyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ lakṣmi sādhanāt sādhurucyate |
brahmaṇi caraṇāllakṣmi brahmacārī sa eva saḥ ||87||
gurorhitaḥ svahitakṛt satye hite sadā rataḥ |
sādhurvai brahmacārī ca hitakṛt sādhusattamaḥ ||88 ||
kāraṇāt sādhanāccaiva gṛhasthaḥ sādhurucyate |
satyayuge gṛhasthāste sādhutulyā hi sādhavaḥ ||89||
tāpasāste tathāraṇye vaikhānasā hi sādhavaḥ |
yatamānā yatayaśca sādhavo yogasādhanāt ||3.144.90 ||
dharmaścoccagatiḥ proktaḥ kuśalānāṃ pradāyakaḥ |
nārāyaṇena ṛṣiṇā brahmaṇā nirmito vṛṣaḥ ||91 ||
dārāgnihotrapūjādirvarṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ |
sadbhirācaritastasyācchiṣṭācāraḥ sa ucyate ||92|||
śiṣṭā me pārṣadāḥ putrāḥ śiṣyā maharṣayastathā |
śiṣyante ye’tra dharmārthaṃ lokasantānakāriṇaḥ || 93 ||
pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ śiṣṭairācaryate punaḥ punaḥ |
pūrvaiḥ pūrvairmatatvācca śiṣṭācāraḥ sa śāśvataḥ ||94||
dānaṃ satyaṃ tapo bhaktirvidyejyā pūjanaṃ damaḥ |
aṣṭaitāni caritrāṇi śiṣṭācāro hi sammataḥ ||95||
brahmacaryaṃ tapo maunaṃ nirāhāratvamityapi |
sevanaṃ nijapitrośca gurorāśrayaṇaṃ tathā ||96||
ṣaṭkametatsādhudharmo gṛhasthāḥ sādhavastataḥ |
māyāpravāhamāsādya no vahate taratyapi ||97||
tārakaḥ sādhurevāyaṃ gṛhastho’pi hi sajjanaḥ |
śiṣṭācārapravṛddhaśca vṛṣo vai sādhusammataḥ ||98||
karmaṇāṃ mayi nyāsastu sannyāsaḥ sādhudharmakaḥ |
brahmastotraṃ vidhistotraṃ guṇastotraṃ harermama ||99||
pravartyante pūrvarītyā śiṣṭaiḥ sadbhiḥ sudhārmikaiḥ |
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaśceti catuṣṭayam ||3.144.1 00||
sāṃsiddhikāni yeṣāṃ vai sādhavaḥ ṛṣayaśca te |
ṛṣante paramaṃ brahma tataste ṛṣayo mataḥ ||1 01 ||
gatyarthādṛṣaterdhātoḥ sārthakatvaṃ hi sādhuṣu |
īśvarāṇāṃ sutā ye ca mānasāścaurasāstathā || 1 02||
ṛṣiputrāḥ ṛṣīkāśca ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ |
brahmaputrā brāhmaṇāśca kṣatriyāśca viśastathā || 103||
ṛṣiputrāḥ ṛṣayaste lokasantānahetavaḥ |
ityevaṃ lakṣmi bahudhā satyadharmā hi sādhavaḥ ||1 04||
satye punaḥ pravartante gṛhasthā api sādhavaḥ |
teṣāmāśrayaṇānmokṣo bhuktiśca jāyate dhruvam ||1 05||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāt sādhusaṃgateḥ |
phalaṃ bhuktimokṣarūpaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 06||
sarveṣvapi yugeṣveva guṇaścaiko mahān rame |
kṛṣṇasya me kīrtanādvai bhavedeva hi mokṣaṇam ||1 07||
kṛte yajñe harirlabhyastretāyāṃ japato’rjyate |
dvāpare sevayā prāpyo hariḥ kalau tu kīrtanāt || 1 08||
kalirdoṣanidhistatra guṇo hariprakīrtanam |
dvāparo’rdhadurito’pi guṇavān mama janmataḥ || 1 09||
satyādau nātijanmāhaṃ sarvāḥ sādhuprajāyataḥ |
bhavāmyahaṃ kalau bhūyaścānyayugavyapekṣayā ||3.144.1 1 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yugadharmāṇāṃ parivartanavivecanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 144||

<3.145>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kīrtanaṃ te kathaṃ kāryaṃ vada me bhagavam̐stathā |
yayā prahvībhāvanayā bhavettava prasannatā || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
kīrtanaṃ me susvareṇa miṣṭagarbheṇa cācaret |
savādyena tathā gatirītyā saṃgītakena ca || 2 ||
tālītālena ca nṛtyenāpi kiṃkiṇikādibhiḥ |
anekarāgarāgiṇyādibhirmāṃ kīrtayed rame || 3 ||
gāndharvaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena saṃśṛṇu |
saptasvarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanāstvekaviṃśatiḥ || 4 ||
tānāścaikonapañcāśadityetat svaramaṇḍalam |
ṣaḍjarṣabhau ca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā || 5 ||
dhaivataśca niṣādaśca svarāste saptakīrtitāḥ |
sauvīrā madhyamā hariṇāśca grāmāstrayo hi te || 6 ||
mūrchanāste vadāmyatra divyā mūrchāvidhāyikāḥ |
hayamedhā hreṣiṇī vai prathamā parikīrtitā || 7 ||
agniṣṭomā tu cāgneyī dvitīyā parikīrtitā |
vājapeyā tṛtīyā tu śyenī sā parikīrtitā || 8 ||
rājasūyā rāṇikā sā caturthī parikīrtitā |
yavarātā vaṃśinī sā pañcamī parikīrtitā || 9 ||
jātaraupī suvarṇī sā ṣaṣṭhī mūrchā prakīrtitā |
gosavanā rāṃbhaṇī sā saptamī mūrchanā matā ||3.145.1 0 ||
jhaṃjhāvātī varṣiṇī sāṣṭamī vai mūrchanā matā |
brahmadānā garjinī sā navamī mūrchanā matā || 11 ||
prājāpatyā lālinī sā daśamī mūrchanā matā |
dāgayākṣī tu kṣautī saikadaśī mūrchanā matā || 12 ||
pānakrāntā bhaṣiṇī tu dvādaśī mūrchanā hi sā |
mṛgākrāntā citkarī sā trayodaśī hi mūrchanā ||1 3 ||
viṣṇukrāntā dhāriṇī sā caturdaśī hi mūrchanā |
santakokilikā conmādinī pañcadaśī tu sā ||14||
sūryakrāntā kālarohiṇikā ṣoḍaśī caiva sā |
sarvatobhadrikā modamādinī sāptadāśikī ||15||
pūrvabhadrā bālakaṇṭhī cāṣṭādaśī hi mūrchanā |
ālambuṣī hāṃsinī sā navadaśī hi mūrchanā ||16||
sāgarā vijayā kokilikī viśā manoharā |
nāradī mānavī ceti mūrchanāścaikaviṃśikī || 17||
anyāścāpi bhavantyeva gauṇyo vai mūrchanāḥ priye |
mānavyaścāpi pākṣiṇyaḥ pākṣavyaścāpyanekaśaḥ ||18 ||
sarvāstāḥ śāradā vetti sarasvatī ca bhāratī |
brāhmyo gāṇyaśca paryaścāpsaryo māyūrakīvidhāḥ ||19 ||
yākṣyaḥ kainnaryaśca hāṃsyo nāginyaścāpi vāḍavāḥ |
paitryo daivyastathā kṣautyastāḍinyo bhauṃkinīvidhāḥ ||3.145.20|||
mainākyaḥ paikya evāpi śaukyaḥ kilāyikāstathā |
etā yathāyathaṃ buddhvā gāyikā gītimācaret |||1 ||
hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ plutaṃ jñātvā svaraṃ gāne prayojayet |
atha tānān prayuñjīta pravāhe satataṃ muhuḥ ||22||
tānāḥ starā iti proktāḥ pravāhe kṣaṇayoginaḥ |

brahmatānaḥ prathamastu garbhatāno dvitīyakaḥ |
vyajyaḥ sañcaraṇo’ṇuśca yogaścārohaṇastathā ||24||

kumāro vāmanaścāpi dvistaro vikṛtastathā ||25||
dṛḍho dugdhaḥ kalāpaścāvarttakaśca taraṃgakaḥ |
nimnaḥ samaścordhvakaśca tiryak tathaiva kātaraḥ ||26||

bahumūlaśca hastaśca vartulaścocchrayastathā ||28||

skandaḥ kākuḥ puṣkalaśca ropaḥ santārakastathā |
taraṇiḥ saṃgamaścāti vigamaḥ kṣepaṇo mṛdhaḥ || 3.145.30||
prokṣaṇo miśraṇaścāpi galikaḥ kartanastathā |

nāmānyetāni bhidyante kalpe kalpe caturyuge |

purā śrīnārado yogī gītyarthaṃ māmupāgataḥ |

cintāmaṇistathā hāraścakraṃ sudarśanaṃ mama |

tataḥ śrīnārado jātaścāvatāroṃ’śarūpakaḥ |

sabhāyāṃ nāradaścāpi praśaśaṃsa kṛpāṃ tava |
yayā praśikṣitā vidyā tāṃ tvāṃ śaśaṃsa sarvathā ||51 ||
tata ārabhya patnyo me gītirītiḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
samabhyasan sakāśātte’psarasaścāpi padmaje ||52||
prāvartata tato vidyā saṃsāre bahudhā priye |
śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā sakāśātte’vidat kalām ||53||
kīrtanasya tato nṛtyaṃ cakāra gītiśobhitam |
prasannena mayā tasmai dattaṃ yogavibhūṣaṇam ||54||
smara lakṣmi purā sarvaṃ bhavatyā yat pravidyate |
ityuktā ca prasasmāra sarvaṃ dadarśa cātmani ||55||
saṃgītaśālāṃ mahatīṃ sahasrayojanāyatām |
śrīpure caiśvare dhāmni bhinnakakṣāsahasrikām ||56||
dadarśa tatra cātmānaṃ sahasrarūpadhāriṇīm |
śikṣikāṃ śikṣaṇārūḍhām vādyasaṃgītakāriṇīm ||57||
śikṣyante tatra gopyaśca pārṣadānyaśca muktayaḥ |
brahmapriyāstatheśānyaśceśvarāṇyaśca kanyakāḥ ||58||
ālāpām̐stāḥ prakurvantyaḥ śikṣyante cāpsarogaṇāḥ |
devyaśca siddhayaścāpi yoginyaḥ śāradāgaṇāḥ ||59||
gāyatryaścāpi sāvitryo brāhmyaśca devakanyakāḥ |
gandharvyaścāpi yakṣāṇyaḥ kinnaryaśca parīgaṇāḥ ||3.145.60||
śiṣyante dhanadānārtho bhaktānyaḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ |
gandharvāstatra śikṣyante bahavaḥ pūrvasṛṣṭijāḥ ||6 1 ||
daityakumārikāścāpi dānavyo’suraputrikāḥ |
mānavyaścārṣya ākalpajīvinyaścāpi kanyakāḥ ||62||
śikṣyante gītaśālāyāṃ śikṣikāṃ ca nijāmapi |
nāgakanyāḥ samastāśca dadarśa śikṣaṇārthinīḥ ||63 ||
evaṃ vilokya sahasā divyavidyālayān svayam |
mahāścaryaṃ gatā tatra pūjitā sarvadaivataiḥ ||64||
sarvāsāṃ goravīsthāne sthitāṃ svāṃ kṛtakāriṇīm |
amanyatātimānārhāṃ mahimānaṃ viveda ca ||65||
tatra patiṃ tu māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gāyantaṃ gītikāmapi |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya prabhuṃ nijam ||66||
utthāya pādayorlakṣmīḥ patitā vyājahāra ha |
namaste bhagavan kṛṣṇa svāṃganānugrahānvita ||67||
kṛpāsindho hare kānta darśitaṃ me’tigauravam |
paśyāmi sarvamevaitat kṛpayā te janārdana ||68||
śrīpure’smi śikṣikā vai saṃgītagītikāriṇī |
yā yā nāryo narā loke gandharvā devayoṣitaḥ ||69||
śāradāśca sarasvatyaḥ śiṣyā me santi te khalu |
śikṣante koṭiśo mattaḥ sarvāḥ saṃgītamandire ||3.145.70 ||
matsvarūpāt prabhavanti svarā grāmāśca mūrchanāḥ |
brahmaṇyeva vilīyante yathāhaṃ hṛdaye sthitā ||71 ||
etat sarvaṃ mayi cāste gītīcchā vartate mama |
yadyājñā gāyanaṃ sarvāṃgopāṃgādisamanvitam |||72||
kartumicchāmi sarvābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ parameśvara |
ityuktaḥ śrīpatiścāhaṃ kamale’karaṇaṃ śubham ||73||
maṇḍapaṃ suviśālaṃ cāsanāni cāpyayojayam |
vāditrāṇi samāhṛtyāsthāpayaṃ maṇḍape śubhe ||74||
lakṣmyādyāśca bhavatyo vai sarvā brahmapriyāḥ śubhāḥ |
āyayurmaṇḍape tatra yathāvatsthānamāsthitāḥ ||75||
cakruḥ saṃgītakaṃ lakṣmi prasanno’haṃ tato’bhavam |
varadānaṃ dadau cāpi bhūtale tu punaḥ punaḥ ||76||
kariṣyatha susaṃgītaṃ mama patnyo bhaviṣyatha |
itisatyena kamale cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||77||
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāstathā striyāḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bhavatya santi matpriyāḥ ||78||
ityevaṃ jāyamānāyāṃ vārtāyāṃ divyadarśane |
tirobhavattadā sarvaṃ vyadṛśyatāśvasārasam ||79||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mandiraṃ kānakaṃ nijam |
yathāsthitāṃ mandire tāṃ svāṃ sakhīḥ kāntamityapi ||3.145.8 0||
vilokya mumude lakṣmīrmahāścaryaparābhavat |
harṣapūrṇā samutthāya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||81||
āśliṣya saṃgītikāṃ ca pracakāra mudānvitā |
virarāma tato lakṣmīrnārāyaṇo haristadā ||82||
jalaṃ pātuṃ samīyeṣa lakṣmīrjalaṃ dadau tataḥ |
māṇikyāśrīḥ sumiṣṭānnaṃ cakre sūpaudanaṃ tathā ||83||
bubhuje śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇī jalaṃ dadau |
padmāvatī dadau tāmbūlakaṃ prajñā ca naktakam ||84||
virarāma prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paryaṃke svarṇanirmite |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre lakṣmīḥ padmāvatī tathā ||85||
prajñā ca māṇikī dehasaṃvāhanaṃ pracakratuḥ |
anyā brahmapriyāścāpi svasvagṛhe hariṃ patim ||86||
tathaiva sevayāmāsurharirviśrāntimāpa ha |
tataḥ sarvā jagṛhuśca prasādabhojanāni vai ||87||
jalapānāni cakruśca madhyāhne modamuttamam |
prāpuḥ patikṛpāleśaṃ gṛhakāryāṇi cakrire ||88||
ityevaṃ śivarājñīśri pūrvavṛttaṃ mayā tu te |
kathitaṃ sarvamevātra gītavādyādiyogajam ||89||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt kīrtanādapi |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pralabheta sarvānandabhṛto bhavet ||3.145.90||
kīrtanaṃ ye kariṣyanti smṛtvā māṃ tvāṃ haripriyāḥ |
brahmapriyāstathā lakṣmi tariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||91||
dehaṃ kṛtvā viyuktaṃ vai jñānena māyikaṃ tu yaḥ |
indriyāṇi pṛthakkṛtvā kṛtvā divyanavāni ca ||92||
āntarīṃ bhāvanāṃ divyāṃ kṛtvā dagdhvā ca vāsanām |
praṇavānvitasaṃgītaṃ mama divyacaritrakam ||93||
ātmanā brahmarūpeṇa yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ |
devo daityo’thavā yakṣo rākṣaso’sura eva vā ||94||
sarpaḥ paśuḥ patatrī ca kinnaro guhyako’pi vā |
hutvātmānaṃ cidānande mayi yogaṃ vidhāya ca ||95||
nāmakīrtiṃ mama lakṣmi kariṣyanti tu ye’pare |
te sarve mama bhaktyaiva lapsyante paramaṃ padam ||96||
mama mūrteḥ smaraṇena kṛtaṃ kīrtanamalpakam |
divyaṃ prajāyate lakṣmi mokṣadaṃ pāpanāśakam ||97||
sarvātmanā mayā caikībhūya kuryāddhi kīrtanam |
saphalaṃ tad bhavedeva pūrṇānandapradāyakam ||98||
tīvravegavatāṃ tīvraphaladaṃ kīrtanaṃ mama |
nṛtyāmyahaṃ tadā lakṣmi yadā nṛtyanti gāyikāḥ ||99||
gāndharvaiḥ saha gāyāmi na māṃ paśyanti carmiṇaḥ |
pramodaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ vardhayāmyarjayāmi ca ||3.145.1 00 ||
snehaṃ pravardhya tānante nayāmi cākṣaraṃ padam |
prasahya te samāyānti na māṃ tyajanti kāmadam ||1 01 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃkīrtane saṃgītikāsvaragrāmamūrchanoddeśo lakṣmyāḥ saṃgītaśālādivyadarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ|| 145 ||

<3.146>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya gāyakasya me |
japato me’bhidhānāni divyatā cātra jāyate || 1 ||
yatra me gāyanaṃ lakṣmi bhajanaṃ mama kīrtanam |
mahotpātā na vai tatra jāyante’pi kadācana || 2 ||
mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ mahotpātā bhavanti vai |
teṣāṃ śāntiḥ prakartavyānyathā naśyanti mānavāḥ || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
mahotpāteṣu jāteṣu kā śāntisteṣu vidyate |
sarvadehihitārthaṃ me brūhi śāntiṃ tathāvidhām || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahotpātā divyāntarikṣabhūmijāḥ |
jāyante yatra ye teṣāṃ śāntiṃ vadāmi tattvataḥ || 5 ||
saumyā śāntistu divyeṣu hyantarikṣeṣu cābhayā |
vaiṣṇavī śāntiriṣṭā ca bhaumotpāteṣu padmaje || 6 ||
vijigīṣuḥ paraṃ śatruṃ bhūtikāmaśca yo bhavet |
parairabhicāritaśca śatrunāśecchukaśca yaḥ || 7 ||
mahadbhayavināśārthamabhayāṃ śāntimācaret |
sādhubhiścāpi vipraiśca kārayecchāntimuttamām || 8 ||
rājayakṣmābhibhūtastu kṣatakṣīṇo’tirogavān |
yajñakāmo dharmakāmaḥ saumyāṃ śāntiṃ prakārayet || 9 ||
bhūkampe’nnavināśe ca durbhikṣe cātivarṣaṇe |
śalabhādibhayotpanne caurapramattaje bhaye ||1 0||
śāntiṃ tu vaiṣṇavīṃ tatra viṣṇubhaktaḥ prakārayet |
paśūnāṃ māraṇe prāpte narāṇāmapi māraṇe || 11 ||
dehināṃ dāruṇe mṛtyau raudrīṃ śāntiṃ vidhāpayet |
yajñaṃ ca havanaṃ cāpi cared rudrādipūjanam || 12||
vedanāśe śāstranāśe nāstikeṣu janeṣu ca |
apūjyapūjane jāte brāhmīṃ śāntiṃ samācaret || 1 3||
parameṣṭhiprapūjādi kārayed vedavedibhiḥ |
bhaviṣyatyabhiṣeke ca paracakrabhaye’pi ca || 14||
svarāṣṭrabhede’rivadhe raudrīṃ śāntiṃ prakārayet |
tryahātirikte pavane jhaṃjhāvāte’tidāruṇe ||15||
sarvavigarhite bhakṣye vātaje vikṛte bhaye |
vyādhau vā vātaje jāte vāyavīṃ śāntimācaret ||16||
anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte cātivṛṣṭibhaye’pi ca |
vikṛtivarṣaṇe jāte vikṛte ca jalāśaye || 17||
jalotpanne bhaye tatra vāruṇīṃ śāntimācaret |
abhiśāpabhaye jāte mantraśāpabhaye’pi ca ||18||
mithyāśāpabhaye prāpte bhārgavīṃ śāntimācaret |
jāte prasavavaikṛtye garbharoge ca prasrave || 19||
śuṣke ca prasave kuryācchāntiṃ prājāpatīṃ rame |
upaskārāṇāṃ vaikṛtye bhavanānāṃ tathā rame ||20||
śakaṭānāṃ vāhanānāṃ tvāṣṭrīṃ śāntiṃ samācaret |
bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ ca vikṛtau ca bhaye’pi ca ||21 ||
vināśe cājīvane ca kaumārīṃ śāntimācaret |
dāvabhaye vahnibhaye tvāgneyo śāntimācaret ||22||
ājñābhaṃge tu sañjāte jāte bhṛtyādisaṃkṣaye |
aśvādīnāṃ vikāre tu rogātmake hyupasthite ||23||
gītikādau vikāre ca kaṇṭhādipatane’pi ca |
galaroge vraṇādau ca gāndharvīṃ śāntimācaret ||24||
gajānāṃ tu vikāre’pi śāntimāṅgīrasīṃ caret |
piśācādibhaye jāte bhūtapretādivalgane ||25||
ḍākinyādikṛte kaṣṭe nairṛtīṃ śāntimācaret |
apamṛtyubhaye prāpte duḥsvapne cāvalokite ||26||
nārake vā tādṛśe vā prāpte duḥkhe yamādibhiḥ |
asadgatau yāmyavāse yāmyāṃ śāntiṃ vidhāpayet ||27||
dhananāśe dravyanāśe bhūṣāratnādināśane |
sampadāṃ ca vināśe tu kauberīṃ śāntimācaret ||28||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ cāpi sasyānāṃ kandānāṃ phalināṃ tathā |
vallīnāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca mūlānāṃ phalavaikṛtau ||29||
arthānāṃ bhūtiyogānāṃ nāśe śāntiṃ tu pārthivīm |
kārayed vedavidbhistāṃ śāntikarmābhivedibhiḥ ||3 0||
prathame dinayāme ca rātrau vā samupadrave |
haste svātau ca citrāyāmāditye cāśvine tathā ||31||
aryamṇi cāpi jāte vā tathānyopadraveṣu ca |
adbhuteṣvapi jāteṣu vāyavīṃ śāntimācaret ||32||
dvitīye dinayāme tu rātrau vā samupadrave |
puṣyāgre ca viśākhāsu pitryāsu bharaṇīṣu ca ||33||
utpāteṣu tathā bhāgye tvāgneyīṃ śāntimācaret |
tṛtīye dinayāme ca rātrau ca samupadrave ||34||
rohiṇyāṃ vaiṣṇave brāhme vāsave vaiśvadaivate |
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca tathā maitrye hyupadraveṣu sarvathā ||35||
aindrīṃ śāntiṃ kārayecca viprairmantrapravedibhiḥ |
caturthe dinamāne tu rātrau vā samupadrave ||36||
sārpe pauṣṇe tathārdrāyāmahirbudhnye ca dāruṇe |
mūle varuṇadaivatye vārūṇīṃ śāntimācaret ||37||
mitramaṇḍalavelāsu jāyamāne hyupadrave |
adbhuteṣu vicitreṣu śāntidvayaṃ prakārayet ||38||
śāntirvarma bhavatyeva rakṣatyupadravāditaḥ |
śāntiḥ patnī hi dharmasya dakṣasya duhitā matā ||39||
dharmayuktā mayā cāpi yuktā balena yojitā |
mama śaktisvarūpā ca madbalenābhiveśitā ||40||
tattaddevabalaiḥ puṣṭā haratyadyānyupadravān |
upaghātāḥ palāyante śāntināmakakarmabhiḥ ||41 ||
janāpacārānniyatamaparajyanti devatāḥ |
devanāmaparāgācca hyupasargaḥ pravartate ||42||
divyāntarikṣabhaumākhyastacchāntistatra śāntidā |
graharkṣavaikṛto divyaścopasargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||43||
ulkāpāto diśāṃ dāhaḥ pariveṣastathaiva ca |
gandharvanagaraṃ cāpi vṛṣṭistu vikṛtā tathā ||44||
raktavṛṣṭirviṣatāpaścāntarikṣopasargakāḥ |
carasthirabhavau bhaumo bhūkampaścāpi bhūmijaḥ ||45||

bhaume tvalpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ cireṇa sa vipacyate ||46||
abhrajo madhyaphalado madhyakālaphalapradaḥ |
adbhute tu samutpanne yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śivā bhavet ||47||
saptāhābhyantare jñeyamadbhutaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet |
adbhutānāṃ nivṛttistu vināśāntyā na jāyate ||48||
tribhirvaṣairadbhutaṃ syāt sumahadbhayakāraṇam |

pākamāyāti putreṣu tathā kośe ca vāhane |
ṛtusvabhāvājjāyante hyadbhutā upasargakāḥ ||50||

vajrāśanimahīkampāsasthanirghātanisvanāḥ |

ṛkṣolkāpātakaluṣaṃ kapilārkendumaṇḍalam |

diśo dhūmāndhakārāśca sanabhovanaparvatāḥ |
uccaiḥ sūryodayāstau ca hemante cecchubhāvahāḥ ||59||
divyastrīrūpagandharvavimānādbhutadarśanam |

lokānāṃ viṣṇuvasvīndraviśvakarmasamudbhavam ||70||

devapreṣyānṛpapreṣyādevastrīṇāṃ nṛpastriyāḥ ||71 ||

devatāgataduḥkheṣu śrutivettā purohitaḥ ||72||
