agnau tato nityameva bhojayed brāhmaṇān sataḥ ||74||
sādhūn sādhvīrmiṣṭabhojyamiṣṭapānaiḥ sadakṣiṇam |
prāpte’ṣṭame dine dhenubhūratnadānamācaret ||75||
kāṃcanāni pradadyācca grahaśāntiṃ samāpayet |
śāntipāṭhān kārayitvā pāpaṃ samupaśāmayet ||76||
evaṃ kṛte tu te vighnāḥ śāntiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ |
athānagnirdīpyate ced rāṣṭre yasya nirindhanaḥ ||77||
na dīpyate cendhanavān tadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍyate nṛpaiḥ |
prajvaledapsu māṃsaṃ vā tathārdraṃ vāpi kiñcana ||78||
prākārastoraṇaṃ dvāraṃ nṛpaveśma surālayam |
etāni yatra dīpyante tatra rājño bhayaṃ bhavet ||79||
vidyutā vā pradahyante tadāpi nṛpaterbhayam |
svāmino vā bhayaṃ tatra yatrāgniścāsthale bhavet ||80||
anaiśāni tamāṃsi syurvinā pāṃsurajāṃsi ca |
dhūmaścānagnijo yatra tatra vidyānmahābhayam ||81 ||
taḍit tvanamre gagane bhayaṃ syād ṛkṣavarjite |
divā satāre gagane bhayaṃ tathaiva jāyate ||82||
grahanakṣatravaikṛtye tāraviṣamadarśane |
puravāhanayāneṣu catuṣpānmṛgapakṣiṣu ||83||
āyudheṣu ca dīpteṣu dhūmāyatsu tathaiva ca |
nirgamastu ca kośāttu saṃgrāmastumulo bhavet ||84||
vināgniṃ visphuliṃgāśca dṛśyante yatra kutracit |
svabhāvāccāpi pūryante dhanūm̐ṣi vikṛtāni ca ||85||
vikāraścāyudhānāṃ syāt tatra saṃgrāmamādiśet |
trirātropoṣitastatra juhuyādvai purohitaḥ ||86||
samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarṣapaiśca ghṛtena ca |
agnimantrairhavanena śāntisteṣāṃ prajāyate ||87||
sādhūn satīrbrāhmaṇām̐śca bālām̐śca bālikāḥ striyaḥ |
bhojayet pūjayed devān mahotsavaṃ prakārayet ||88||
suvarṇaṃṃ dhanaratnāni dadyād gā bhuvamambaram |
agnijopadravāṇāṃ śastrāṇāṃ śāntistadā bhavet ||89||
pureṣu yeṣu dṛśyante pāde pāde pragāminaḥ |
rudanto vā hasanto vā sravanto vā rasān bahūn ||90||
arogāśca vinā vātaṃ śākhāṃ muñcanti vai drumāḥ |
phalaṃ mūlaṃ tathā kālaṃ darśayanti trihāyanā ||91 ||
evaṃ vai svaṃ darśayanti phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathāntare |
kṣīraṃ snehaṃ tathā raktaṃ madhu toyaṃ sravanti ca ||92||
śuṣyantyarogāḥ sahasā śuṣkā rohanti vā punaḥ |
uttiṣṭhantīha patitāḥ patanti ca tathotthitāḥ ||93 ||
evaṃ tatra phalaṃ lakṣmi śṛṇu bhinnaṃ vadāmi te |
rodane vyādhirāyāti hasane deśaviplavaḥ ||94||
śākhāprapatane syādvai saṃgrāmo yodhṛnāśakaḥ |
bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ kuryād bālavallī prapuṣpitā ||95||
svarāṣṭrabhedaṃ kurute phalapuṣpamathāntare |
kṣayaḥ syād gokṣīre cāpi snehe durbhikṣamāpatet ||96||
vāhanāpacayo madye rakte saṃgrāma āpatet |
madhusrāve bhaved vyādhirjalasrāve na varṣati ||97||
arogaśoṣitā vṛkṣā durbhikṣaṃ sūcayanti vai |
śuṣkeṣu samprarohastu vīryamannaṃ hinasti ca ||98||
utthāne patitānāṃ ca bhayaṃ bhedakaraṃ bhavet |
sthānāt sthānaṃ tu gamane deśabhaṃgastadā bhavet ||99||
jvalatsvapi tu vṛkṣeṣu rudatsyapi dhanakṣayam |
etat pūjitavṛkṣeṣu sarvaṃ rājño vipadyate ||1 0 0||
puṣpe phale vā vikṛte rājñau mṛtyuṃ drumo diśet |
evaṃ vṛkṣeṣu jāteṣu śīghramācchādya taddrumān ||1 01 ||
gandhamālyādibhiḥ sarvān bhūṣayetpūjayettathā |
vṛkṣopari mahacchatraṃ kuryāt pāpopaśāntaye || 1 02||
śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ śivāmabhyarcayed drumeṣu vai |
paśuṃ cānnaṃ tvarpayecca rudraśāntiṃ prakārayet || 10 3||
rudrebhya iti vṛkṣeṣu hutvā rudro japettataḥ |
pāyasājyamadhvāḍhyaiḥ prapūjya bhūdānamācaret ||104||
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ prakuryācca rudraśāntistato bhavet |
evaṃ lakṣmi prajārājabhayaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohati ||1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne daivāntarikṣabhaumotpātānāṃ śāntikarmācārādikathananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 146 ||

<3.147>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirdurbhikṣādibhayaṃ matam |

utpātāste śāntimāpya phaladā na bhavanti vai || 3.147.10 ||

śvetāmbarayutā gāśca dadyācchrīgurave tathā |

yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||25||
rādhālakṣmīprabhāpāravatīnāṃ pūjanaṃ caret |
māṇikyāduḥkhahālakṣmīmahālakṣmīprapūjanam ||26||
lalitāyamunāgaṃgāratibhaktiprapūjanam |

nodyamānānyapi pṛṣṭhe yānti tatra mahadbhayam |
vāhyamānā na vāhyante vāhyante nātyanāhatāḥ || 3.147.30 ||
acalāśca calantyeva na calanti calāni ca |
ākāśe tūryanādāśca gītagāndharvaniḥsvanāḥ |||3 1 ||

pradoṣe kukkuṭo vāśeddhemante yatra kokilaḥ ||42|||
arkodaye tvabhimukhī śivā rauti bhayaṃ diśet |
gṛhaṃ kapotaḥ praviśet kravyādo mūrdhni līyate ||43||
makṣikāśca madhu kuryurmṛtyurgṛhapaterbhavet |
prākāradvārageheṣu toraṇāpaṇavīthiṣu ||44||
ketucchatrāyudhādyeṣu kravyādaḥ prapatet yadi |
jāyante vātha valmīkā madhu vā syandate yadi ||45 ||
sa deśau nāśamāyāti rājā ca mriyate tathā |

dṛśyante’saṃkhyakā yatra kṣunmārabhayamāpatet |
kāṣṭholmukāsthiśṛṃgāḍhyāḥ śvāno markaṭavedanāḥ ||47||

kākā dhānyakhale dhānyamukhāḥ patanti vā pure ||48||

pipīlikāpravāsaśca pāṣāṇo lavaṇaṃ tathā ||94||
kṣuvanaṃ gokṣuvanaṃ ca vandhyā rajakaścāpriyam |
abhimiled yadi mārge na gacchettatra vai kvacit ||95||
maraṇaṃ vā mahāduḥkhaṃ kāryāsiddhirviḍambanā |
vāmāṃgāni puruṣasya nāryā dakṣāṃgakāni tu |||96||
sphureyuryadi vidyādvai mahāpattiṃ vināśanam |
gamane yaṣṭikāpātaḥ śastrapāto’thavā bhavet ||97||
mukuṭādeḥ prapāto vā patanasyaiva sūcakaḥ |
patanaṃ svasya harmyāgre sopānādau ca vā yadi ||98||
parājayo bhavettūrṇaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkhamityapi |
evaṃ jāteṣu tatkālaṃ śāntikarmāṇi cācaret ||99||
viṣṇuyāgaṃ rudrayāgaṃ devapūjāṃ grahārcanam |
japadānavratādyaṃ ca kuryācchāntirbhaveddhruvā || 3.147.100 ||

śṛṇu nārāyāṇīśri tvaṃ hṛdutthavaikṛtāni tu |
śarīrotthāni cānyāni śakunasphuraṇāni ca || 1 ||
śarīre sphurite mūrghni pṛthvīlābho bhavedapi |
lalāṭe sthānavṛddhiḥ syānbhrūnasoḥ priyasaṃgamaḥ || 2 ||
netrasphurtau bhṛtyalābho dṛgupānte dhanāgamaḥ |
ūrdhve madhye cāpagamo dravyasyaiva prajāyate || 3 ||
dṛṅmūle sphurite lakṣmi jayaḥ śīghraṃ bhavediti |
adhaḥsphurtau striyā bhogaḥ śravaṇānte priyā śrutiḥ || 4 ||
nāsikāyāṃ prītisaukhyaṃ prajāptiradharoṣṭhaje |
kaṇṭhasphurtau bhogalabdhirbhogavṛddhistathāṃsayoḥ || 6 ||
bāhvoḥ sphurtau suhṛtsneho hastayostu dhanāgamaḥ |
pṛṣṭhasphutau na vijayo vakṣaḥsphurtau jayo bhavet || 6 ||
kukṣisphurtau prītilābhaḥ stane strīprasavo bhavet |
nābhisphurtau sthānahānirantrasphurtau dhanāgamaḥ || 7 ||
jānusandhau paraiḥ sandhirbalibhiśca samāgamaḥ |
jaṅghāsphurtau khaṇḍabhāgevināśaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
pādayoḥ sphuraṇe lakṣmi dhiṣṇyasthānamavāpnuyāt |
pādatalasphure cādhvapravāso lābhakṛd bhavet || 9 ||
vāme nāryā sadā lābhā dakṣe puṃsaḥ sphurādayaḥ |
alābhadā viparyastā bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 3.148.10 ||
aniṣṭasphurtijanane havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā |
suvarṇena prakartavyaṃ dānaṃ ca bhojanādikam || 11 ||
śāntistatra vaiṣṇavī vā raudrī kāryā sukhāptaye |
atha hṛdutthavikṛtākārān nidrāmayān śṛṇu || 1 2||
aniṣṭān duṣṭaphaladān dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ prakārayet |
nābhiṃ vinānyagātreṣu tṛṇavṛkṣāṃkurodbhavaḥ || 1 3||
cūrṇanaṃ mūrdhni kāṃsyānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ nagnatā tathā |
malināmbaradhāritvamabhyaṃgaḥ paṅkamardanam || 14||
paṃke ca magnatā coccaiḥ pāto dolādhirohaṇam |
arjanaṃ pakvalauhānāmaśvānāṃ māraṇaṃ tathā || 15||
raktapuṣpadrumāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalasyādhirohaṇam |
varāharkṣakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ tathā cārohaṇakriyā || 1 6||
bhakṣaṇaṃ pakvamāṃsānāṃ tailasya kṛsarasya ca |
nartanaṃ hasanaṃ cāpi vivāho gītamityapi || 17||
tantrīvādyavihīnānāṃ vādyānāmabhivādanam |
sroto’vagāhanaṃ cāpi snānaṃ gomayavāribhiḥ || 18 ||
paṃkena snānamevāpi dhūlītoyena vāpi ca |
mātuḥ praveśo jaṭhare citārohaṇamityapi || 1 9||
indradhvajābhipatanaṃ patanaṃ candrasūryayoḥ |
divyāntarikṣabhaumānāmutpātānāṃ ca darśanam ||3.148.20 ||
devadvijātibhūpālagurūṇāṃ krodhanaṃ tathā |
āliṅganaṃ kumārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu maithunam ||21 ||
hāniścāpi svagātrāṇāṃ virekavamanādikam |
dakṣiṇāśābhigamanaṃ vyādhinābhibhavo’pi ca ||22||
puṇyahāniḥ phalahāniḥ svapne gṛhasya mārjanam |
gṛhasya patanaṃ krīḍā piśācairvānaraiḥ saha ||23||
ṛkṣakravyādakunaraiḥ kustrībhī ramaṇaṃ tathā |
parādabhibhavaścāpi parācca duḥkhasaṃbhavaḥ ||24||
kāṣāyāmbaradhāritvaṃ kāṣāyistrīsamāgamaḥ |
snehapānaṃ snehamagnatā raktapuṣpalepanam ||25||
bhojanānāṃ bhraṣṭatā ca kāṣṭhānāṃ darśanaṃ tathā |
gantrīṇāṃ mārgabhraṃśaśca bahusaṃyāvabhojanam ||26||
veśyānāṃ darśanaṃ tāsāṃ stanyapānaṃ tathā khalu |
śataghnīnāṃ sphoṭanādi tathocchiṣṭādibhojanam ||27||
raṃgakāragṛhāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ ghātakasya ca |
taḍāgānāṃ pravāheṣu patanaṃ sasyadāhanam ||28||
kalahaśca jalairnaukābharaṇaṃ cāndhadarśanam |
kālīkaṭyāṃ niṣadanaṃ hyupānat mastake sthitam ||29||
viruddhākṣaravinyāsā pravāse nijadarśanam |
citramūrtyadṛśyatā ca gaṇeśaśavamastakam ||3.148.30||
uṣṭrasya darśanaṃ bhojyabhakṣaṇe vighnatā tathā |
muṇḍanaṃ cābdhipatanaṃ liṃgād raktasravastathā ||3 1||
jīrṇāmbaradharatvaṃ ca gurorviprasya kruddhatā |
bhaṣamāṇaśvāvalokaḥ phaṇādhragrahaṇaṃ mṛtiḥ ||32||
candraśālāditaścāpi śilāsu patanaṃ tathā |
vanimārjārāvalokaḥ kṛṣṇapuṃkṛtalakṣyakam ||33||
niśānaṃ dhūṣkṛtīnāṃ ca mṛṣāyudhasya sphoṭanam |
takrakṛsarāprāśaśca vastūnāṃ vigamo’pi ca ||34||
śatrūṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi viṣṭāyāṃ pādapātanam |
ṣaṭapadīyajantūnāṃ ca viṣṭhāyāṃ darśanaṃ tathā ||35||
yavanādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ karṇanāsikayośca kartanam |
nagnaṃ svadarśanaṃ tailāktaṃ raktastrīsuyojanam ||36||
mukuṭādeḥ paścabhāge vivartanaṃ prapātanam |
śikhāprapātanaṃ kalgeḥ prapātanaṃ datāmapi ||37||
liṃgasya patanaṃ cāpi patnīprajvalanaṃ tathā |
galapāśāvalokaśca tāḍane maraṇaṃ tathā ||38||
gostrīvadhādikaṃ svapne mahotpātādidarśanam |
pitṝṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi paradeśapalāyanam ||39||
sarvaiḥ kṛtastiraskāraḥ śavādhirohaṇaṃ tathā |
śatrubhiśca dhṛtaścāpi dravyasya tu bhuvastalāt ||3.148.40||
bhūtvā pipīlikā yānaṃ vṛścikā vā tathāvidham |
patnyāḥ palāyanaṃ cāpi sarvasvanāśasūcakam ||41 ||
kanyāvaidhavyabhāvaśca devālayavināśanam |
raktasrāvo raktarogaḥ kṣayarogasya darśanam ||42||
mṛtagarbhaprasavaśca garbhiṇīmaraṇaṃ tathā |
vimānapatanaṃ cāpi śakaṭībhaṃga ityapi ||43||
vyāghradhṛtiḥ siṃhakṛtaṃ māraṇaṃ svasya vai vane |
makarairdharṣaṇaṃ cāpi gahvare patanaṃ tathā ||44||
khāte rodhastathā naije bhavane rodhanaṃ tathā |
pādayorbandhanaṃ cāpi vidāyaṃ bahubhirjanaiḥ ||45||
cāṇḍālībhoga evāpi cāṇḍālabhoga ityapi |
bhūtānāṃ darśanaṃ svapne bhayadāraṇyadarśanam ||46 ||
hiṃsrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi vahnimadhye praveśanam |
yānena svargagamanaṃ śmaśānagamanaṃ tathā | | 47 ||
yāmyāvalokanaṃ cāpi kālapuruṣadarśanam |
pretasya darśanaṃ svapne pāśadharasya darśanam | |48 ||
rājadūtasyāvaloko garuḍasyāpi darśanam |
tulasībhakṣaṇaṃ cāpi gomayairbhūvilepanam ||49 | |
jhaṃjhāvātenohyamānatvaṃ ca yantreṇa karṣaṇam |
samāje karcanaṃ cāpi pādaiḥ pradalanaṃ tathā | |3.148.5 0 ||
vamanaṃ raktakamiśraṃ vamane kīṭadarśanam |
kṛṣṇasarpasya daṃśaśca bhojane kṛmidarśanam | |5 1 ||
adrīṇāṃ cālanaṃ cāpi bhavanānāṃ ca cālanam |
kanyānāṃ bālasūtiśca strīṇāṃ vikṛtasūtitā || 52 ||
narāṇāṃ śmaśruprapātaḥ strīṇāṃ śmaśruprarohaṇam |
narāṇāṃ strīveṣavattvaṃ strīṇāṃ puruṣaveṣitā ||5 3 ||
astanītvaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ stanayuktatā |
svapne ced dṛśyate tvetad deśahānirmahābhayam || 54||
rājā svapne hato dṛṣṭo rājyanāśo bhaveddhruvam |
vṛkṣāṇāṃ gamanaṃ cāpi vallīnāṃ gamanaṃ tathā || 55 ||
kanyānāṃ gamanaṃ cāpi videśaṃ prati dṛśyate |
lakṣmīhāniśca durbhikṣaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | |5 6||
saritāṃ gamanaṃ cāpyudvelatābdheḥ samantataḥ |
jalena pralayastatra khaṇḍasya ca kṣiterapi ||57||
pṛthivyā vā pralayaḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
devālayānāṃ gamanaṃ cādrīṇāṃ gamanaṃ tathā ||58 ||
śilāsainyavihāraśca deśanāśaphalo bhavet |
durge śabdāstu jāyante’jñātā bhayāvahā yadi ||59 ||
durganāśabhayaṃ tatra rājyanāśabhayaṃ bhavet |
kakṣāsu garjanā rātrāvākasmikī bhaved yadi || 3.148.60 ||
rogavyāptirmahāmārī prajānāśo’ti jāyate |
hasanti gṛhakoṇeṣu vānarāḥ ṛkṣakā yadi || 61 ||
gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ bhavedeva māsānte nātra saṃśayaḥ |
muṇḍī raktāmbaraḥ svapne dṛśyate daṇḍadhṛg yadi || 62 ||
maraṇaṃ tatra jāyeta vināśaḥ sampadāmapi |
vanadevyo yatra śuṣkāḥ kṣīṇāśca vṛddhakanyakāḥ || 63 | |
sagarbhā śuṣkadehāśca dṛśyante svapnake yadi |
bhagnapādāśca khañjyaśca vṛkṇyaḥ śṛṃgakakudmikāḥ || 64||
anāvṛṣṭihatā lokā mriyante’tra na saṃśayaḥ |
gāvo yatra viśasyante mlecchaiḥ svapne’valokyate ||65||
tatra mlecchopadravāśca jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ |
kravyādā yatra dṛśyante nagaropari yūthaśaḥ ||66||
nagarasya vināśaḥ syād rakṣā rudramakhairbhavet |
ujjvalā ujjalāḥ kanyā rudanti yānti yatsthalāt ||67||
tatra vidyāvināśaḥ syādudyogānāṃ vināśanam |
kalākauśalyanāśaśca dāridryaṃ raṃkatāpatet ||68||
vidhavānāṃ maṇḍalāni dṛśyante yatra cābhitaḥ |
kabandhānāṃ maṇḍalāni tatra nāśo hi saṃgarāt ||69||
anṛtau paśavo yatra skhalanti pāśavīṣu vai |
dharmabhaṃgo bhaved deśe mlecchācāravivardhanam ||3.148.70||
evamādīni cānyāni kuṣṭhādidarśanaṃ tathā |
duḥsvapnāni bhaveyuśca drāk teṣāṃ kathanaṃ varam ||71 ||
bhūyaḥ prasvāpanaṃ cāpi kalkasnānaṃ tilairapi |
homovahnau brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ pūjā surārcanam ||72||
stutiḥ śrīharikṛṣṇasya vāsudevasya pūjanam |
nāgendramokṣaśravaṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya pūjanam ||73||
rudrayāgo viṣṇuyāgaścotsavo harikīrtanam |
kārayet svagṛhe lakṣmī kathāṃ nārāyaṇāśritām ||74||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ mahat |
bhaye mahati samprāpte kāraṇīyaṃ bhayāpaham ||75||
svapnaṃ tu prathame yāme samvatsare phalapradam |
ṣaḍbhirmāsairdvitīye tu tribhirmāsaistṛtīyake ||76||
caturthe māsamātreṇa prātardaśāhakṛtphalam |
svapnadvaye śubhāśubhe rātrau syātāṃ tadā phalam ||77||
paścād dṛṣṭasya jāyeta prāgdṛṣṭaṃ lopamīyate |
eteṣāmasatāṃ svapne darśane tannivāraṇam ||78||
grahayajñaṃ viṣṇuyajñaṃ rudrayajñaṃ satīmakham |
pitṛyajñaṃ bhojyayajñaṃ dānapuṇyaṃ samācaret ||79||
rājñā dharmaprasaktena prajānāṃ ca hitepsunā |
grahayajñāḥ prakartavyā lakṣahomasamanvitāḥ ||3.148.80||
nadīnāṃ saṃgame cāpi devānāmagratastathā |
taṭākasannidhau daivatīrthe bhūmiṃ parīkṣayet ||81 ||
khanet kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ cāṣṭottarasahasrakam |
havanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śāntistena prajāyate ||82||
dviguṇaṃ lakṣahome ca koṭihome caturguṇam |
aṣṭau vai ṛtvijaḥ kāryā mūlakṣīraphalāśanāḥ ||83||
ratnāni dānayogyāni maṇḍape sannidhāpayet |
gāyatryā daśasāhasraṃ mānastokena ṣaḍguṇaḥ ||84||
triṃśad grahādimantraiśca catvāro viṣṇudaivataiḥ |
kuṣmāṇḍairjuhuyāt pañca kusumādyaistu ṣoḍaśa ||85||
hotavyā daśasāhasraṃ bādarairjātavedasi |
śriyo mantreṇa hotavyāḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ||86||
śeṣāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi hotavyāstvindradaivataiḥ |
hutvā śatasahasraṃ tu puṣyasnānaṃ samācaret ||87||
kuṃbhaiḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃjñaiśca sahiraṇyaiḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ |
snāpayed yajamānaṃ tu tataḥ śāntirbhaved dhruvam ||88||
hastyaśvarathayānāni bhūmivastradhanāni ca |
anaḍudgośataṃ dadyāt ṛtvijāṃ cātra dakṣiṇām ||89||
māse pūrṇasamāptau tu lakṣahomaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
koṭihomavidhānaṃ tu śṛṇu lakṣmi nadītaṭe ||3.148.90||
ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa tatra dīkṣā sāmvatsarī matā |
caitre vā kārtike homāraṃbhaṃ kṛtvā tu vatsaram ||91 ||
kārayet yajamānastu payobhakṣī phalāśanaḥ |
yavādivrīhayo māṣāstilāśca sarṣapāstathā ||92||
pālāśāḥ samidhaḥ śastā vasordhārā tathopari |
ādyamāse tu ṛtvigbhyo dadyādvai kṣīrabhojanam ||93||
dvitīye kṛsarāṃ dadyāddharmakāmārthasādhinīm |
tṛtīye māsi saṃyāvaṃ caturthe modakān śubhān ||94||
pañcame dadhibhaktaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhe tu saktubhojanam |
pūpām̐śca saptame dadyādaṣṭame ghṛtapūpakān ||95||
miṣṭaudanaṃ ca navame daśame yavamiṣṭakam |
ekādaśe māṣavaṭān dvādaśe ṣaḍrasān diśet ||96||
ahatavāsāḥ saṃvīto dinārdhaṃ juhuyācchuciḥ |
indrādyādisurāṇāṃ ca prīṇanaṃ sārvakāmikam ||97||
sarvadānāni devānāmagniṣṭomaṃ ca kārayet |
vidhinā kārayettatra pūrṇāhutiṃ śate śate ||98||
sahasre dviguṇā deyā yāvacchatasahasrakam |
puroḍāśo devatābhyo deyaḥ samarcayed dvijān ||99||
surān pitṝn tarpayecca piṇḍārpaṇairvidhānataḥ |
homānte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttulā śikyadvayānvitām || 3.148.10 0||
badhvātmānaṃ tolayecca patnīṃ ca tolayettathā |
suvarṇena rajatena śarkarābhiśca hīrakaiḥ ||1 01 ||
dadyād dānaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ syād vighnanāśakam |
prīyatāṃ śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ sarvayajñeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 02||
ityuktyā praṇamed viprān bhojayellakṣamānavān |
sarvopaghātā naśyanti puṇyānyasya bhavanti ca ||1 03||
na śocejjanmamaraṇe kṛtākṛtavicāraṇe |
yathāśakti prakuryādvā grahādimakhamuttamam || 1 04||
sarvatīrthavidhānasya sarvayajñavidheḥ phalam |
evaṃ kṛtvāpnuyāllakṣmi śravaṇātpaṭhanādapi || 1 05||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne duḥsvapnādyupaghāta tacchāntyarthakagrahayajñādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 148 ||

<3.149>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri svapne dṛṣṭe śubhe śubham |
phale sañjāyate draṣṭuḥ punarnidrāṃ na cācaret || 1 ||
śailaprāsādanāgāśvavṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ śubham |
drumāṇāṃ śvetapuṣpāṇāmārohaṇaṃ śubhaṃ matam || 2 ||
drumatṛṇodbhavo nābhau tathaiva bahubāhutā |
tathaiva bahuśīrṣatvaṃ phalitadrusamudbhavaḥ || 3 ||
śuklamālyāmbaradhṛtiḥ sarvāgaparimārjanam |
candrārkatārakāsparśaḥ śakradhvajādhiliṃganam || 4 ||
śakradhvajocchrāyakarma śatrūṇāṃ vadhadarśanam |
bhūmyambudhīnāṃ grasanaṃ vāde dyute mṛdhe jayaḥ || 5 ||
bhakṣaṇaṃ cārdramāṃsānāṃ matsyānāṃ pāyasasya ca |
darśanaṃ rudhirasyāpi snānaṃ vā rudhireṇa ca || 6 ||
surārudhiramadyānāṃ pānaṃ kṣīrasya cāpi vai |
antrairvā veṣṭanaṃ bhūmau nirmalavyomadarśanam || 7 ||
mukhena dohanaṃ gośca mahiṣyā hastiyoṣitaḥ |
siṃhīnāṃ vaḍavānāṃ ca vyāghrīṇāṃ dohanaṃ śubham || 8 ||
prasādo devasādhūnāṃ gurūṇāṃ yogyayoginām |
viprāṇāṃ ca prasādo’pi satīnāṃ dharmayoṣitām || 9 ||
aṃbhasā tvabhiṣekaśca gavāṃ śṛṃgāśritena vā |
cāndrajalena vā gaṃgājalena vyomavāriṇā || 3.149.1 0||
so’yaṃ rājyaprado bodhyaścābhiṣekaḥ śubhāvahaḥ |
svapne rājyābhiṣekaśca ghiṣṇyābhiṣeka uttamaḥ || 1 1||
chedanaṃ śirasaścāpi vighnanāśābhibodhakam |
labdhiśca rājyacihnānāṃ tantrīvādyabhivādanam ||1 2||
tathodakānāṃ taraṇaṃ tathā viṣamalaṃghanam |
kareṇuvaḍavānāṃ ca gavāṃ ca prasavo gṛhe ||1 3||
ārohaṇamathāśvānāṃ hastināṃ rohaṇaṃ tathā |
vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ cāpi vimānārohaṇaṃ śubham || 1 4||
varastrīṇāṃ tathā lābhaścāliṃganaṃ suyoṣitaḥ |
suvarṇaiḥ pūjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dehe viṣṭhānulepanam || 15 ||
jīvatāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ pitrorgurūṇāṃ darśanaṃ satām |
sādhvīnāṃ svapriyāyāśca darśanaṃ saumyamuttamam || 1 6||
darśanaṃ devatānāṃ ca vimalānāṃ tu yoginām |
vārīṇāṃ nirmalānāṃ cotsavānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham | | 17 | |
vṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpaiśca yuktānāṃ darśanaṃ varam |
vallīnāṃ darśanaṃ śreṣṭhamudyānānāṃ śubhapradam | | 18 ||
vāṭikānāṃ sasasyānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ śubham |
sajalānāṃ ca saritāṃ meghānāṃ sarasāṃ tathā | | 19 ||
darśanaṃ cāpi haṃsānāṃ pikānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham |
cātakānāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ garuḍānāṃ ca darśanam | | 3.149.20 | |
menānāṃ citrapakṣāṇāṃ śuklānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham |
hariṇānāṃ hanūmatāṃ gavayānāṃ ca darśanam || 21 ||
khaḍgamṛgāṇāṃ ca tathā gaṇḍakānāṃ ca darśanam |
śubhadaṃ raktasarpāṇāṃ daṃśanaṃ darśanaṃ varam || 25 ||
nāṇakānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ca darśanam |
bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca hārāṇāṃ divyāmbarāṇāṃ darśanam | | 23 ||
śubhaṃ candanakuṃkumākṣatadarbhādidarśanam |
cāpi śṛṃgāravastūnāṃ māṃgalikādidarśanam || 24||
gaṇikādarśanaṃ nṛtyakāriṇīdarśanaṃ tathā |
rājñīnāṃ darśanaṃ devīdarśanaṃ brāhmaṇīkṣaṇam || 25 ||
kanyakādarśanaṃ sādhudarśanaṃ devadarśanam |
mandirālayabhavanānāṃ tu vai darśanaṃ śubham || 26 ||
bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi divyaprāsādadarśanam |
ārārtrikādyutsavānāṃ darśanaṃ kīrtanaśravaḥ || 27 ||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi maṇḍapādipradarśanam |
pūjyānāṃ darśanaṃ svapne pūjyaiḥ pādābhimardanam || 28 ||
guruṇā cāpi pitrā vā nijadehābhimardanam |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi sarvakāryajayapradam || 29 ||
gaṇeśadarśanaṃ cāpi hareḥ pārṣadadarśanam |
varayātrādarśanaṃ ca yajñayāgādidarśanam || 3.149.30 ||
pratiṣṭhotsavavīkṣā ca sammānaṃ prajayā kṛtam |
strīvargairakṣatādyaiśca vardhanaṃ cāśiṣā muhuḥ | | 31 ||
svarṇāmbarādidhṛtikā divyamālādidhāraṇam |
lekhanaṃ pūjanaṃ priyāratipradarśanaṃ tathā || 32 ||
puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi śubhakṛt svapnavīkṣitam |
ityevamādivīkṣā vai svapne sarvārthasādhikā ||33||

saphalā vai bhaved yātrā prajānāṃ nṛpaterapi ||34||
sādhūnāṃ cāpi nārīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ saphalā bhavet |
aduḥkhā ceṣṭaphaladā ṛddhidā ca bhavettathā ||35||
śvetāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūrṇakuṃbhāstathābalāḥ |
kanyakā bhūṣaṇaśobhā jalajāḥ pakṣiṇastathā ||36||
sagarbhā śapharī māṃsaṃ mātsyāśca yugalaṃ vadhūḥ |
gāvasturaṃgamā nāgā buddha ekaḥ paśurvṛṣaḥ ||37||
ajastveko vararājastridaśāḥ suhṛdaḥ striyaḥ |
viprāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ saśikhāśca sapuṇḍrakāḥ ||38||
vahniḥ prakāśito jvālāyuto rājā ca sadguruḥ |
vidvān dharmī vratī śreṣṭhī nirdaṃbho dānadakṣiṇaḥ ||39||
gaṇikā ca satī sādhvī dūrvā cārdraṃ ca gomayam |
rukma rūpyaṃ ca tāmraṃ ca māṇikyaratnahīrakāḥ ||3.149.40 ||
mauktikāni sphaṭikāni bhūṣaṇāni navāmbaram |
navaṃ yānaṃ navā strīśca navaṃ vāhanamityapi ||41 ||
navānnaṃ ca yavāḥ siddhārthakā oṣadhamityapi |
nṛyānaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ ca svarṇarājatavastukam ||42||
devaratho vādyagītinṛtyamaṇḍalamutsavaḥ |
khaṅgaṃ chatraṃ patākā ca niśānaṃ bherikādikam ||43||
āyudhāni mṛdaścāpi sasyābhāraḥ phalidrumaḥ |
rājacihnāni sarvāṇyācāryacihnāni yāni ca ||44||
ghṛtaṃ dadhi payaścāpi phalāni vividhāni ca |
sabhūṣo mānyapuruṣo svastikaṃ vardhamānakam ||45||
tāmbūladarśanaṃ cāpi nandyāvartaṃ ca kaustubhaḥ |
hārāḥ pātrāṇi ramyāṇi vāditravādanaśravaḥ ||46||
gāndhāraṣaḍjaṛṣabhāḥ svarā miṣṭāśca gītikāḥ |
pṛṣṭhe vāyupravāhāścānukūlāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||47||
kravyādāḥ susvarāścāpi meghānāṃ garjanāstathā |
vidyataḥ śakracāpaṃ ca gajabṛṃhaṇamityapi ||48 ||
prasannatā śubhaśrutiḥ pūjyānāmabhivandanam |
gurvāśīrvādavācaśca manastuṣṭirmanaḥpriyam ||49||
ekataḥ sarvacihnāni manasastuṣṭirekataḥ |
maṃgalānāṃ kuṃkumānāmakṣatānāṃ ca darśanam ||3.149.50 ||
gauḥ savatsā cāśvavāro hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ityapi |
menā śukaḥ sārikāśca kokilo maṇḍukadhvaniḥ ||51 ||
pitrorvacaḥ pṛṣṭhataśca gurorvākyaṃ tathāvidham |
candrakaḥ puṣpahārādiḥ patraṃ dalaṃ ca bhojanam ||52||
miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi pūjakaḥ kathakastathā |
sevakaḥ śreṣṭhabhakto’pi dadhi dīpaḥ sudhūpakaḥ ||53|||
vedaghoṣāḥ stavanāni bālānāṃ khelanādikam |
kanyakānāṃ narmahāsyaṃ vadhūṭīnāṃ nirīkṣaṇam ||54||
tālikāvādanaṃ cāpi jayaśabdaśravastathā |
samājasaṃghasanmānaṃ cāhvānaṃ tu prasanmukhāt ||55||
godhūmāṃkuraśaṣpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ pūrṇapātrakam |
namaskāro harṣanādo daivādabbhrakaṇāgamaḥ ||56||
puṣpāṇāṃ patanaṃ cāpi mañjarīṇāṃ drumāttathā |
yātrākāle svaśirasi maṃgalaṃ lābhasūcakam ||57||
lājānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāpi pūjāsthālīpradarśanam |
uḍḍayanaṃ hayānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ jayasūcakam ||58||
śubhavārtāśravaṇaṃ ca devagurvāgamo hutam |
dhvajānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi devavādyaśravastathā ||59||
gālavādyaśravaścāpi navapallavadarśanam |
mudrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi saubhāgyāḍhyāṅganekṣaṇam ||3.149.60 ||

ājñāvacanamevāpi nārāyaṇābhidhāśravaḥ ||61||
samastajātibhūtānāṃ bālyapoṣaṇabhojanam |

kaṇādyādi bhakṣayantaṃ samātṛkaṃ hi darśanam |
grāmagrahapaśupakṣijīvānāṃ ratikarma ca ||63||

caityadrumā dhvajāyuktāścaityabhautikabhūmayaḥ ||65||

sugandhivārisekaśca maṃgalāyatano hi saḥ |
pādukādarśanaṃ cāpi gurormūrteḥ pradarśanam ||67||
samudradarśanaṃ cāpi saritāṃ pūradarśanam |
divyakumāravīkṣā ca divyakumārikekṣaṇam ||68 ||
navīnayantravīkṣā ca gurumantrāgamastathā |
ākhyānaśravaṇaṃ cāpi pūrvajasmaraṇaṃ tathā ||69||
avatārasmṛtiścāpi mahotsavādidarśanam |
pakvaphalāni sarvāṇi saśākhāpakvakānyapi ||3.149.70||
saśimbikaṇiśāḍhyāśca stambāḥ śākhāśca vai drumāḥ |
navapallavaśobhāśca darśane sampadāṃ pradāḥ ||71 ||
masīpātrānmasīprasravaṇaṃ masyāḥ prapātanam |
kuṃkumakṣaraṇaṃ cāpi nitambasphuraṇaṃ tathā ||72||
upadārpaṇamevāpi dravyasthālārpaṇādikam |
sarvaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca yātrāyāṃ mukhe kavalarūpi ca ||73||
maṃgalaṃ jāyate lābhapradaṃ jayapradaṃ tathā |
siṃhacarma mṛgacarma vyāghragajādicarmakam ||74||
svarṇapaṭṭaḥ paṭṭikā ca ghaṇṭā siṃhasya garjanā |
hastināṃ cinninādāśca maṃgalāni bhavanti hi ||75||
haste dravyārpaṇaṃ tvanyaiḥ kṛtaṃ ratnārpaṇādikam |
kuṃkumākṣatadānaṃ ca tālikādānamityapi ||76||
karapradānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca manodānaṃ tathottamam |
etādṛśeṣu yogyeṣu maṃgaleṣu tu maṃgalam ||77||
jayo lābho vardhanaṃ sammānaṃ sthānaṃ yaśo balam |
udayaśconnatirlakṣmīḥ sukhamṛddhirapatyakam ||78||

śatrurnīco duṣṭajano dṛśyate cedbhayapradaḥ ||3.149.80||
musaladhāravarṣā tu pratilomā na śobhanā |

śastrādeḥ patanaṃ copakaraṇāderdurantakṛt ||83||
nirgatasya dvāradeśe śirasaścābhighātitā |
padāgrāghātanaṃ cāpi kṣuvanaṃ kutsapraśnatā ||84||

skhalanaṃ vāhanānāṃ ca vastrasaṃgastu kīlake ||85||
dhvaje kravyādasya duṣṭaṃ niṣadanaṃ hi duḥkhadam |
kva yāsi tiṣṭha mā gaccha pṛṣṭhato gacchaśabdatā ||86||
kiṃ te gatasya tatra syādityevamadhikṣiptatā |
bāhyaśabdastrāsayukto bhinnabhairavajarjaraḥ ||87||
aniṣṭāḥ śāpaśabdāśca duḥkhāmaṃgalakāriṇaḥ |
purataḥ śabda ehīti śasyate na tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||88||
raktāni cāpi bhāṇḍāni mṛtaṃ śṛṃgi śavaṃ tathā |
tuṣabhasmakapālāsthibhinnabhāṇḍāmbarāṇi ca ||89||

cāṇḍālaḥ śvapacaścāpi jallādāḥ pāśadhāriṇaḥ ||3.149.90||
tathaivoddhṛtasārāṇi piṇyākādīni yāni ca |
khaṇḍitāni phalādīni keśabandhanacarmakam ||91||
ayaḥ paṃkaḥ ṣaṇḍha unmattaśca kaṃgāla ityapi |
vikīrṇakeśā rujārtā gairikāmbaramityapi ||92||
tailākto malino muṇḍī nagno’gārastathendhanam |
kārpāsaṃ ca tṛṇaṃ śuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca gomayam ||93||
dhānyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cauṣadhāni bhraṣṭāni dūṣitāni ca |
kadaryadarśanaṃ cāpi klinnavastupradarśanam ||94||
hastenākarṣaṇaṃ paścād vastūnāṃ vismṛtistathā |
cauryaṃ copakaraṇānāṃ vigamo mukhyavastunaḥ ||95||
avamānaṃ cāśrupātaḥ skhalanaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ svapiḥ |
jvaro nirodhaścakrāderbhaṃgo hetisravastathā ||96||
gudāviṣṭhādarśanaṃ ca tathā śaṣpādidarśanam |
evamādīni sarvāṇi duḥkhadāni prayāṇake ||97||
prayāṇāraṃbhasamaye mahīmānāgamastathā |
pradhānāgama evāpi vighnakṛd vighnaduḥkhadaḥ ||98||
evamādīni vijñāya gacchennaiva nivartayet |
harerme pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kālāntare pravāsayet ||99||
śāntikarma prakartavyaṃ homo japaḥ prapūjanam |
bhojanaṃ sādhuviprāṇāṃ dānāni ca mahotsavaḥ || 3.149.10 0||
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā |
ṛṣīṇāṃ yajanaṃ cāpi bhautikānāṃ sutṛptatā || 101 ||
evamādīni kāryāṇi nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ |
kathāyajñāḥ prakartavyāḥ śāntikarmāṇi yāni ca ||1 02||
lakṣmi caivaṃ kṛte nāśaṃ yānti duritakāni ha |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi duritāni viyanti vai |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi śāntikarmādibhiḥ sadā ||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yātrārthaprayāṇe śubhaśakunasvapnādīni viparītānāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ pūjāśāntiyajñādiścetinirdeśanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 149 ||

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
vanastho’raṇyavāsaśca parvatādisthito’pi vā |
agrāmastho nirjanastho mucyetopadravāt katham || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu tvaṃ śivarājñīśri vanastho’dristhito’pi vā |
nirjanastho’pi kaṣṭārto mucyate smaraṇānmama || 2 ||

tvadbhaktā bahavaḥ santi balavān śīghrapuṣṭidaḥ |
sahāyadaḥ kaṣṭaharaḥ ko’sti me kṛpayā vada || 4 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
tvaritaṃ smṛtamātro’pi vinā sevāṃ prapūjanam |
vinā cārādhanāṃ bhaktiṃ hanūmān kaṣṭanāśakaḥ || 5 ||
paropakāro dharmo’sti śaraṇyatvaṃ hanūmataḥ |
avyājaduḥkhahantṛtvaṃ hanūmati virājate || 6 ||
dhūpamātreṇa cāyāti stotramātreṇa dṛśyate |
smṛtimātreṇa cāgatya karotyāśrayavāñcchitam || 7 ||
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ ḍākinyādikuyoṣitām |
bālavyomagrahāṇāṃ ca hanūmān harate rujam || 8 ||

brahmaṇo balamāsādya bhaktibalasamanvitam |
hanūmān kurute kāryaṃ tapassu te sahāyadaḥ || 3.150.10||
adṛśyo’pi marudrūpaḥ samāgatya drutaṃ prabhuḥ |

kṛtyā vīrāśca rogāśca tāpā niśācarādayaḥ |
kaṣṭāni ca kabandhāśca pretāśca brahmarākṣasāḥ ||17||

svalpavitto’pi yo dadyāt prayatnena nijaṃ dhanam |
devārthe ca makhārthe ca satyarthe yataye sate ||72||
viṣṇubhaktāya puṇyārthe brahmaniṣṭhāya sādhave |
tad dravyaṃ padmasaṃjñaṃ vai padmanidhipatirhi saḥ ||73||
svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ dravyaṃ sarvasvaṃ vai nijaṃ dhanam |
yātrānirvāhamātraṃ tu vihāya yaḥ samarpayet| ||74||
devādibhyo dhanaṃ tasya mahāpadmanidhirmatam |
sāttvikaṃ taddhanaṃ proktaṃ dātāpi sāttviko hi saḥ ||75||
asaṃkhyaṃ paraloke’sya dhanaṃ lakṣmīḥ karoti vai |
madbhaktārthaṃ prasannātvaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai dadāsi hi ||76||
tasmād vai devabhaktānāṃ nirlobhānāmamū nidhī |
akṣayau divyanāmānau padmākṛpāprapūritau ||77||
śṛṇu vai makaraṃ vacmi dravyaṃ kleśairupārjitam |
svayaṃ svārthaparo bhuṃkte dāne dadāti naiva hi ||78||
dadyād vivṛddhaye varṣe kusīdārthaṃ pralobhavān |
navāṃ navāṃ ca maitrīṃ vai kṛtvā jīrṇāṃ vihāya tu ||79||
evaṃ dravyasya nāśo vai pūrvapūrvaiḥ prajāyate |
khaḍgabāṇādiśastrāṇāṃ saṃgrahe’pi vinaśyati ||3.151.80 ||
adānakaṃ svārthamātraṃ dravyaṃ tanmākaro nidhiḥ |
maraṇe sati sarvasvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ tatparairbhavet ||81 ||
śṛṇu vai kacchapaṃ lakṣmi bahuyatnaiḥ samarjitam |
na bhuṃkte na dadātyeva lobhena viśvasenna ca ||82||
kṣipatyeva hi bhūgarte koṣe nirupayogi tat |
sañcite tvekapuruṣaṃ maraṇānte parairapi ||83||
rājabhiścauralokairvā hriyate kacchapaṃ hi tat |
mākaraṃ rājasaṃ proktaṃ kācchapaṃ tāmasaṃ sadā ||84||
mākaraṃ tvardhapāpaṃ ca kācchapaṃ pūrṇapāpakam |
śṛṇu lakṣmi mukundaṃ ca nidhiṃ yatnaiḥ samarjayet ||85||
kintu kośe pṛthivyāṃ vā nikṣipyāpi punaḥ punaḥ |
uddhṛtyoddhṛtya veśyāsu nartakīgāyikāsu ca ||86||
bhāṇḍeṣu vyasane kleśe vyayaṃ karoti nityadā |
evaṃ pāpaparā sampad dravyaṃ mukundanāmakam ||87||
pāpakṛñcāpi vai bodhyo mukundakośabhṛnnidhiḥ |
śṛṇu nandaṃ nidhiṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi padmaje hi te ||88||
rajastamomahānandī hyādhāraḥ syāt kulasya vai |
sarve kuṭumbino dravyaṃ bhuñjate premabhāvataḥ ||89||
stutayaścāpi jāyante bahubhāryā bhavanti ca |
svārthārthaṃ dravyabhogaśca paropakṛtaye’pi ca ||3.151.90||
pūrvamitreṣu śaithilyaṃ prītimanyaiḥ karoti ca |
evaṃvidhaṃ nijaṃ dravyaṃ nandanidhyātmakaṃ hi tat ||91 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi nīlaṃ nidhiṃ tathottaram |
nīlena svadhanenāpi sāttviko vai bhavet sadā ||92|||
vastradhānyādisaṃgrāhī taḍāgādi karoti ca |
tripauruṣo nidhiścāyaṃ tvāmrārāmādi kārayet ||93||
dharmakāryaṃ karotyevodyānaṃ dadāti viṣṇave |
śaṃkhaṃ nidhiṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi vipatpradam ||94||
ekasyaiva dhanaṃ śaṃkhaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃkte dhanāntakam |
na kulaṃ na ca vaṃśo’pi bhuṃkte yasya dhanaṃ rame ||95||
kadannabhuk parijano na ca śobhanavastradhṛk |
svārthapoṣaṇamātrecchurdadyātparanare vṛthā ||96||
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāśaṃkhaṃ nidhiṃ bhogārthameva na |
pareṣveva hi vartante dhanāni na gṛhe manāk ||97||
evaṃ bodhyā hi nidhayo jñātvā tān vyayamācaret |
tīrthadevasatāṃ kārye sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||98||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sarvamahāpāpādināśopāyānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ, navanidhīnāṃ
dhanaviniyogādiprayojyanāmakatvaṃ ceti kathananāmā ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||

<3.152>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pāpoddhārakarān sutān |
dharmasya balayuktān vai yadāśrayena mokṣaṇam || 1 ||
dharmadevāttu kāmaṃ vai śraddhā tu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojitaḥ kāmo mokṣāya parikalpate || 2 ||
dharmadevāttu darpaṃ vai śrīḥ putraṃ suṣuve śubham |
madarthaṃ yojito darpo mokṣāya parikalpate || 3 ||
dharmadevāttu niyamaṃ dhṛtistu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 4 ||
dharmadevāttathā tuṣṭiḥ santoṣaṃ suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 5 ||
dharmadevāttathā puṣṭirlobhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojito lobho mokṣāya parikalpate || 6 ||
dharmadevāttathā medhā śrutaṃ tu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojitaścāyaṃ mokṣāya parikalpate || 7 ||
dharmadevāttathā putraṃ daṇḍaṃ tu suṣuve kriyā |
madarthaṃ yojito daṇḍo mokṣāya parikalpate || 8 ||
daṇḍānujaṃ nayaṃ cāpi vinayaṃ ca nayānujam |
trayaste yojitā matto mokṣāyaite bhavanti vai || 9 ||
dharmadevāttathā buddhirbodhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojito bodho mokṣāya parikalpate ||3.152.1 0||
dharmadevāttathā lajjā sunayaṃ suṣuve sutam |
sunayo yojitaḥ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 11 ||
dharmadevāttathā vapurvyavasāyamasūyata |
madarthaṃ vyavasāyaśca yojito mokṣado bhavet ||12||
dharmadevāttathā śāntiḥ kṣemaṃ tu suṣuve sutam |
madarthaṃ yojitaḥ kṣemo mokṣāya parikalpate || 13||
dharmadevāttathā siddhiḥ sukhaṃ tu suṣuve sutam |
sukhastu yojitaḥ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 14||
dharmadevāttathā kīrtiḥ suṣuve ca yaśaḥ sutam |
yaśaḥ saṃyojitaṃ kṛṣṇe mokṣāya parikalpate || 15||
dharmapautrāśca vai sarve madarthaṃ yadi yojitāḥ |
te sarve’pi tu mokṣāya bhavanti pāpanāśakāḥ ||1 6||
kāmaputro mahānando harṣaputro’timānakaḥ |
niyamasya virāmastu santoṣasya tu tarpaṇaḥ || 17||
lobhasya sañcayaḥ putraḥ śrutasya nirṇayaḥ sutaḥ |
daṇḍasya kṛcchrasaṃjñaśca nayasya vardhanaḥ sutaḥ || 18||
vinayasya sutaścābhyudayo bodhasya śantanuḥ |
sunayasya sutastejo vyavasāyasya āyakaḥ ||1 9||
kṣemasya rakṣaṇaṃ putraḥ sukhasya modasaṃjñakaḥ |
yaśasaścotsavaḥ putraḥ pautrā dharmasya vai mayi ||3.152.20 ||
yojitā mokṣadāḥ sarve pāpānāṃ nāśakā rame |
satāṃ yogena yoktavyā divyāste tārayanti vai ||21 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi pāpadān vai puṇyakṣayakarānapi |
adharmasya sutān duṣṭakriyācārapravartakān ||22||
hiṃsā patnī tvadharmasya tasyāṃ jajñe’nṛtaṃ sutaḥ |
asatyamanṛtaṃ proktaṃ duḥkhadaṃ pāpakāri tat ||23||
tasya svasā nirṛtiśca tatsutau narakaṃ bhayam |
māyā ca vedanā ceti kanyake dve tathā mate ||24||
māyāsutastathā mṛtyuḥ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ |
vedanāyāḥ sutaścāpi duḥkhākhyaḥ samajāyata ||25||
mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire |
nirṛtiḥ saṃprajajñe ca vināśaṃ duḥsahaṃ sutam ||26||
brahmā tu nirṛteḥ putraṃ duḥsahaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kṛśam |
kākasvanaṃ nimnamukhaṃ samuvāca vaco hitam ||27||
mā tvaṃ khāda jagaccedaṃ vṛttiṃ dadāmi te suta |
adhārmikasya vāsaste vāso bhavatu sarvadā ||28||
paryuṣitaṃ sakīṭaṃ ca tathā śvabhiravekṣitam |
bhagnabhāṇḍagataṃ cāpi mukhavātopasaṃhatam ||29||
ucchiṣṭaṃ svinnamevāpi cāvalīḍhamasaṃskṛtam |
udakyopahataṃ bhuktamudakyā tava tad bhavet ||3.152.30 ||
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattamasnātairyadavajñayā |
tyaktaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca sarvaṃ te mayā yakṣa samarpitam ||3 1 ||
paṃktibhede ca kapaṭe pākabhede pratāraṇe |
kalahe ca kumele ca bhavitā vasatistava ||32||
apoṣyamāṇe vṛddhe ca baddhe gavi hyapoṣite |
bālānāṃ poṣaṇahīne gṛhe vāsaḥ sadā tava ||33||
vṛthopavāsino martyān dyūtastrīvyasanasthitān |
baiḍālavṛttikām̐ścāpi śaṭhānabhibhaviṣyasi ||34||
duḥkhadānāṃ tu pāpānāṃ tathā viśvāsaghātinām |
śaraṇārthiviruddhānāṃ gṛhe vāsaḥ sadā tava ||35||
tvayā gehe nirdaye vai sadā stheyaṃ hi duḥsaha |
na stheyaṃ dhārmike gehe devagehe kadācana ||36||
yaḥ saṃskṛtādo vidhinā śucirantastathā bahiḥ |
alolupo jitakāmastadgehaṃ cāpavarjaya ||37||
yatra maitrī gṛhe bālavṛddhayoṣinnareṣu ca |
tathā svajanavargeṣu gṛhaṃ taccāpi varjaya ||38||
yoṣito’bhiratā yatra na bahirgamanotsukāḥ |
lajjānvitāḥ sadā gehaṃ yakṣa tatparivarjaya ||39||
vayaḥsambandhayogyāni śayanānyaśanāni ca |
yatra gehe satāṃ sevā tadgṛhaṃ tvaṃ vivarjaya ||3.152.40||
yatra kāruṇikā nityaṃ sādhukarmasvavasthitāḥ |
sāmānyopaskarairyuktāstadgṛhaṃ saṃvivarjaya ||41 ||
yatrāsanasthāḥ sahasottiṣṭhanti gurusannidhau |
vṛddhānāṃ sannidhau cāpi tadgṛhaṃ saṃvivarjaya ||42||
tarugulmādibhirdvāraṃ na viddhaṃ yasya veśmanaḥ |
udyānaśobhaṃ bhavanaṃ śreyastatparivarjaya ||43||
yatra puṃsāṃ marmabhedo jāyate na dhvanirgṛhe |
vāṇī vā tādṛśī nāsti tadgṛhaṃ parivarjaya ||44||
devatāpitṛmartyānāmatithīnāṃ ca pūjanam |
tatprasādāśanaṃ yatra tadgṛhaṃ parivarjaya ||45||
satyavākyān kṣamāśīlānahiṃsrānnānutāpinaḥ |
puruṣānpramadāścāpi tyajethāścānasūyakān ||46||
bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe yuktāmasatstrīsaṃgavarjitām |
kuṭumbabhartṛśeṣānnapuṣṭāṃ ca tyaja yoṣitam ||47||
brāhmaṇaṃ vedavijñānaṃ sāttvikaṃ devapūjakam |
adhvarādiparaṃ tuṣṭaṃ śāntaṃ tyaja sadā śubham ||48||
kṣatriyaṃ rakṣakaṃ cāpi dātāraṃ dharmamārgagam |
nyāyamātraparaṃ bhaktaṃ tyaja duḥsaha sadbalam ||49||
vaiśyaṃ tu vyavasāyasthaṃ satyadharmaparāyaṇam |
ahiṃsakaṃ dānaparaṃ bhaktaṃ gosevakaṃ tyaja ||3.152.50||
śūdraṃ sevāparaṃ bhaktaṃ śāntiṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ tyaja |
patnī patiryatra ratau parasparasahāyinau ||51 ||
dharmaparau mokṣaparau tadgṛhaṃ sarvathā tyaja |
yatra putro guroḥ pūjāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā pituḥ ||52||
patnī ca bhartuḥ kurute tatra duḥsaha mā vasa |
prātaḥ sāyaṃ kṛtalepaṃ devapūjābhisaṃskṛtam ||53||
gṛhaṃ satāṃ pādapūtaṃ na tvaṃ śaknoṣi vīkṣitum |
bhāskarādṛṣṭaśayyāni nityāgnisalilāni ca ||54||
sūryāvalokadīpāni dānadvārarddhimanti ca |
satāṃ prasādapātrāṇi lakṣmyā gehāni bhājanam ||55||
yatra nārāyaṇaścāpi lakṣmīścāpi prapūjyate |
yatra vai sādhavaḥ sādhvyastatrālakṣmībhayaṃ kutaḥ ||56||
yatrokṣā candanaṃ vīṇā ādarśo madhusarpiṣī |
miṣṭājyatāmrapātrāṇi tadgṛhaṃ na tavāśrayaḥ ||57||
yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā yatra mādakavallikāḥ |
bhāryā vivāhaśūnyā ca valmīka tatra saṃvasa ||58||
yatra gṛhe narāḥ pañca strītrayaṃ gotrayaṃ tathā |
andhakāro niragniśca tadgrahaṃ vasatistava ||59||
ekacchāgaṃ dvivāleyaṃ trigavaṃ pañcamāhiṣam |
ṣaḍaśvaṃ saptamātaṃgaṃ gṛhaṃ śoṣaya duḥsaha ||3.152.60 ||
kuddāladātrapitakaṃ tadvat sthālyādi bhājanam |
sarvāṇyupakaraṇāni musalolūkhalau tathā ||61 ||
strīṇāṃ khaṭvī tathā cānyat kṣiptaṃ yatra ca tatra ca |
amārjitaṃ ca malinaṃ gṛhaṃ tava pratiśrayam ||62||
musalolūkhale strīṇāmāsanaṃ cāpyudumbare |
avaskare mantraṇaṃ ca tadgṛhe vasa duḥsaha || 63 ||
laṃghyante yatra dhānyāni pakvāpakvāni veśmani |
tadvacchātrāṇi tatra tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ cara duḥsaha ||64||
sthālīpidhāne yatrāgnirdatto darvīphalena vā |
gṛhe tatra hi riṣṭānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ samāśrayaḥ ||65||
mānuṣāsthi gṛhe yasya divārātraṃ mṛtasthitiḥ |
tatra duḥsaha vāsaste tathānyeṣāṃ ca rakṣasām || 66||
yatra padmamahāpadmau yuvatī modakāśinī |
vṛṣabhairāvatau yatra tadgṛhaṃ tyaja sarvathā ||67||
aśastrā devatā yatra saśastraścāhavaṃ vinā |
kalpyante manujairarcyāstat parityaja mandiram ||68||
paurajānapadā yatra prākprasiddhamahotsavāḥ |
kriyante pūrvavadgehe tatra gṛhe na saṃvasa ||69||
śūrpavātaghaṭo’mbhobhiḥ snānaṃ vastrāmbuvipruṣaiḥ |
nakhāgrasalilaiścāpi tān yāhi hatalakṣaṇān ||3.152.70 ||
deśācārayutaṃ jñātidharmayutaṃ ca sotsavam |
japahomaparaṃ devamaṃgaleṣṭiyutaṃ gṛham ||71 ||
śaucācārayute lokaśasyaṃ pūjyaṃ sadāśrayam |
gṛhaṃ mā spṛśa tatratyān mā vilokaya duḥsaha ||72||
ityevaṃ duḥsahasyādau lakṣmi brahmā dadau gṛham |
nivāsārthaṃ hyadharmasya sahayug duḥsaho’bhavat ||73||
duḥsahasyābhavadbhāryā malinīnāma nāmataḥ |
kaliputrī kalahajñā kleśadharmāvalambinī ||74||
tasyāḥ putrā aṣṭasaṃkhyāḥ kanyāścāṣṭau bhayapradāḥ |
dantākṛṣṭistathoktiśca parivartastṛtīyakaḥ ||75||
aṅgadhṛk śakuniścāpi gaṇḍaprāntaratistathā |
garbhahā sasyahā ceti kanyānāmānyapi śṛṇu ||76||
niyojikā tu prathamā dvitīyā tu virodhinī |
svayaṃhārakarī cāpi bhrāmaṇī ṛtuhāriṇī ||77||
smṛtihantrī bījahantrī vidveṣiṇī tathāṣṭamī |
bhayadāstāstadeteṣāṃ tāsāṃ kāryāṇi me śṛṇu ||78||
dantākṛṣṭiḥ prasūtānāṃ bālānāṃ daśanasthitaḥ |
karoti sa jvarotpādaṃ tacchāntiḥ sitasarṣapaiḥ |
śayanasyoparikṣiptaiḥ kṣaumavastravidhāraṇāt ||79||
tathoktināmako vakti duḥsahasyāstu saṃsthitiḥ |
tacchāntyarthaṃ tu māṃgalyaṃ kīrtanīyo janārdanaḥ ||3.152.80||
parivartaḥ karotyeva garbhāṇāṃ parivartanam |
rakṣāṃ kurvīta rakṣoghnamantraiśca sitasarṣapaiḥ ||81 ||
aṅgadhṛk sphuraṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ cāṃgānāṃ prakaroti vai |
kuśaistasyāṃkasaṃsparśānnivṛttirjāyate tadā ||82||
kākādipakṣisaṃsthaśca śakuniḥ śakunaṃ sadā |
karoti duṣṭamevātra kāryatyāgo nivartanam ||83||
gaṇḍakālakṣaṇānte ca gaṇḍaprānto vasatyapi |
sarvārambhān prahantyeva devastutyā nivāraṇam ||84||
gomūtrasarṣapasnānaistadṛkṣagrahapūjanaiḥ |
dhamotsavādikaraṇairgaṇḍavān yāti vai layam ||85||
garbhahā garbhanāśī vai nityaṃ śaucād vinaśyati |
daivamālyādirakṣādimantrebhyaḥ sa tu naśyati ||86||
sasyahā kṣetrabhūbhāge sasyarddhimupahanti ca |
tasmād rakṣāṃ prakurvīta jīrṇopānadvidhāraṇāt ||87||
tathāpasavyagamanāccāṇḍālasya praveśanāt |
bahirbalipradānācca satāṃ caraṇavāsanāt ||88||
cauryavyavāyamadyādau niyojikā tu mānavān |
niyojayati tacchāntiṃ kuryāt sādhusamāgamāt| ||89||
dīkṣādigrahaṇāddharmād vratāttīrthaniṣevaṇāt |
virodhinī kurute vai dampatyośca virodhanam ||3.152.90||
bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ pitroḥ putraiḥ parasparaṃ sadā |
tasyāḥ śāntiṃ prakurvīta śāstrācāraniṣevaṇāt ||91 ||
svayaṃhārakarī kanyā dhānyaṃ khalāddharatyapi |
gobhyaḥ payastathā sarpiḥ payaso’pi haratyapi ||92||
samṛddhimṛddhimaddravyādapahanti mahānasāt |
ardhasiddhaṃ tathānnaṃ ca yadannāgārasaṃsthitam |||93||
saṃpariveṣitaṃ cānnaṃ sārdha bhuṃkte ca bhuṃjatā |
uccheṣaṇa manuṣyāṇāṃ haratyannaṃ hi sā tathā ||94||
karmāntāgāraśālābhyaḥ siddharddhiṃ sā haratyapi |
gostrīstanebhyaśca payaḥ kṣīrahartrī tadaiva sā ||95||
dadhno ghṛtaṃ tilāttailaṃ surāgārāt tathā surām |
rāgaṃ kusuṃbhakādīnāṃ kārpāsāt sūtramityapi ||96||
tacchāntyarthaṃ prakuryācca dvandvaṃ śikhaṇḍinoḥ śubham |
kṛtrimāṃ ca striyaṃ tatra gṛhe nyaset sthale’pi ca ||97||
rakṣāmantraṃ tathā lakṣmyā rakṣāmantraṃ samuccaret |
lakṣmi lakṣmi mahālakṣmi lalite kambhare sati |
hārikāṃ hana duṣṭāṃ tvaṃ hārikā nāśametu ca ||98||
iti prārthya gṛhe bhasma sthale goṣṭhe nidhāpayet |
homāgnidevatādhūpabhasmādibhirvinaśyati ||99||
udvegaṃ janayatyanyā hyekasthānanivāsinaḥ |
puruṣasya tu duḥkhadā bhrāmaṇī sā bhavatyapi ||3.152.1 00 ||
tasyātha rakṣāṃ kurvīta vikṣiptaiḥ sitasarṣapaiḥ |
āsane śayane corvyāṃ yatrāste sa tu mānavaḥ || 101 ||
atha puṣpaṃ haratyanyā strīṇāṃ sā ṛṇahāriṇī |
kurvīta tīrthadevaukaścaityaparvatasānuṣu || 1 02||
nadīsaṃgamakhāteṣu snapanaṃ tatpraśāntaye |
cikitsāśaḥ prayuñjīta varauṣadhamṛtupradam || 1 03||
smṛtiṃ harati nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ smṛtihā hi sā |
viviktadeśasevitvācchrīharerbhajanāttathā || 1 04||
snigdhabhojanapānāñca tasyāścopaśamo bhavet |
bījāhāpariṇī cānyā vīryaṃ rajo haratyapi || 1 05||
hareḥ prasādamedhyānnabhojanaistīrthayātrayā |
tasyāścopaśamaḥ prokto haste kāmaphaladhṛteḥ || 1 06||
dveṣiṇī dveṣamādadhyācchāntyarthaṃ juhuyāttilān |
madhukṣīravṛtāktāṃśca mitravindeṣṭimācaret || 1 07||
eteṣāṃ tu kumārāṇāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca padmaje |
anyānyapi hyapatyāni vacmi nāmakriyādikam ||1 08 ||
dantākṛṣṭeḥ kanyake dve vijalpā kalahā tathā |
ubhe kleśaprade śāntiḥ kartavyā homakarmaṇā || 1 09||
dūrvāṃkurānmadhughṛtakṣīrāktān balikarmaṇi |
vikṣipejjuhuyāccaivānalaṃ mitraṃ ca kīrtayet || 3.152.110 ||
tathokteḥ kālajihākhyaḥ putro’sādhūn prabādhate |
parivartasutau dvau tu virūpavikṛtau rame || 111 ||
tau tu vṛkṣāgraparikhāprākārāṃbhodhisaśrayau |
garbhahānikarau tasmād garbhiṇī nābhirohayet || 11 2||
vṛkṣamaṭṭaṃ parikhāṃ ca prākāraṃ ca mahodadhim |
aṅgadhṛgaḥ suto lakṣmi piśuno nāma nāmataḥ || 11 3||
so’sthimajjāgataḥ puṃsāṃ balamarttyajitātmanām |
śakuneḥ pañcaputrāśca śyenaḥ kākaḥ kapotakaḥ || 1 14||
gṛdhraścolūka ityete śyeno mṛtyuprado mataḥ |
kaḥ kālakaraścāpi hyulūko rākṣasapradaḥ ||1 15||
gṛddho vyādhipradaścāpi kapoto yamamārgadaḥ |
tasya śyenādayo yasya nilīyeyuḥ śirasyatha || 11 6||
narastadvarjayed gehaṃ kapotākrāntamastakam |
śyenaḥ kapoto gṛdhraśca kākolūkau gṛhe rame || 1 17||
praviṣṭaḥ kathayedantaṃ vasatāṃ tatra veśmani |
svapne’pi hi kapotāderdarśanaṃ nahi śasyate || 1 18||
gaṇḍaprāntarateḥ putrā rājasvalyanivāsinaḥ |
śrāddhaparvanivāsāśca nābhigacchettadā striyam || 11 9||
garbhahasya suto nighno mehinī cāpi kanyakā |
praviśya garbhamattyeko bhuktvā mohayate’parā || 3.152.120 ||
jāyante bālakāstasmānmaṇḍukāḥ kacchapāḥ sṛpāḥ |
purīṣaṃ vā bhavatyeva tasmād garbhavatī satī || 121 ||
śmaśānakaṭabhūmiṃ catuṣpathaṃ varjayenniśi |
vṛkṣacchāyāṃ varjayeccottarīyaṃ na parityajet || 1 22||
śasyahasya sutaścaikaḥ kṣudrako hanti ṛddhikām |
amaṃgalyadine vaptuḥ kṣetraṃ phalati naiva ha || 123||
niyojikāyāḥ kanyāśca mattonmattā pramattikā |
navā ceti viśantyetā nāśāya sarvadehinām || 1 24||
adharmādyairyojayanti parastrīnarasaṃgame |
virodhinyāstrayaḥ putrā nodako grāhakastathā ||1 25||
tamaḥpracchādakaśceti hyācāravarjite gṛhe |
paiśunyaṃ kurute tvādyo gṛhṇāti grāhako hi tat || 1 26||
tṛtīyastamasā krodhaṃ janayantyatiduḥkhadāḥ |
svayaṃhāryāstrayaḥ putrāścauryeṇa janitā rame || 127||
sarvahāryardhahārī ca vīryahārī tathaiva ca |
anācāragṛhe kleśagṛhe vasanti te sadā || 128||
bhrāmaṇyāḥ kākajaṃghākhyaḥ putro dharmavivarjite |
ramate gāyati cāpi bhunakti hāsyameti ca || 129||
kanyātrayaṃ ca kucahā vyaṃjanahā ca jātahā |
yasyā na kriyate lokaḥ samyag vaivāhiko vidhiḥ || 3.152.1 30||
kālātīto’thavā tasyā haratyekā kucadvayam |
vṛddhiśrāddhamadatvā ca tathānarcya ca mātaram || 131 ||
vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyā harati vyaṃjanaṃ parā |
tṛtīyā tvamvagnimadhye vidhūpe sūtikāgṛhe || 1 32||
adīpaśastramusalebhūtisarṣapavarjite |
praviśya jātamapatyaṃ harate tadvinaśyati || 133||
sā jātahāriṇī nāma sughorā piśitāśanā |
tasmāt surakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yatnataḥ sūtikāgṛhe || 1 34||
smṛtihāputrako nāmnā pracaṇḍaścāttukāmanaḥ |
līkāśca caṇḍaputrāste sarve cāṇḍālayonayaḥ ||1 35||
līkāstvadharmavaṃśaṃ vai vāsayanti haranti ca |
bījahā bījanāśārthaṃ yatate śuddhivarjite ||1 36||
vidveṣiṇīsutau puṃsāmapakāraprakāśakau |
ekastu svaguṇān loke prakāśayati pāpyapi || 1 37|||
dvitīyastu guṇān maitrīṃ lokasthāmapakarṣati |
ityete dausahāḥ sarve yaiḥ prajāḥ kaṣṭamāpnuyuḥ || 1 38||
teṣāṃ śāntiḥ prakartavyā tattadbalikriyārhaṇaiḥ |
makhai raudrairvaiṣṇavaiśca daivairbhautaiśca cāṇḍikaiḥ || 1 301||
hareḥ sampūjanairbhaktyā vratairārādhanairapi |
satāṃ sevāviśeṣaiśca camatkārisadarhaṇaiḥ || 3.152.140||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāṣānāṃ pāpanāśanam |
śāntyādikarmabhiścāpi prasaṃgād riṣṭakāni ca ||141 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne dharmavaṃśavarṇanamadharmavaṃśavarṇanaṃ duḥsahasya nivāsasthānāni duḥsahavaṃśānāmupadravādivarṇanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 152 ||

<3.153>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
yātrāyāṃ kā diśā śreṣṭhā kaniṣṭhā kā kadā matā |
prasthānaṃ ca kadā śreṣṭhaṃ kadā kiṃ karma śobhanam || 1 ||
aśobhanaṃ kadā syācca nakṣatravārayuktithau |
tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva lokakalyāṇahetave || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
kṛttikā tvagnidaivatyā rohiṇī brahmadevatā |
mṛgaśirā somadevā cārdrā tu rudradevatā || 3 ||
punarvasuḥ sūryadevā puṣyaṃ tu gurudaivatam |
aśleṣā sarpadaivatyā maghā tu pitṛdevatā || 4 ||
pūrvāphālgunikā bodhyā padmaje bhagadevatā |
uttarāphālgunī bodhyā padmaje’ryamadevatā || 5 ||
hastā savitṛdevā ca citrā tu tvaṣṭradevatā |
svātī tu vāyudaivatyā viśākhendrāgnidevatā || 6 ||
anurādhā mitradevā jyeṣṭhā tu śakradevatā |
mūlā nirṛtidaivatyā pūrvāṣāḍhāpyadevatā || 7 ||
uttarāṣāḍhikā vaiśvadevatā parikīrtitā |
abhijit brahmadaivā ca śravaṇā viṣṇudevatā || 8 ||
dhaniṣṭhā vasudevā vāruṇadevā śatabhiṣā |
ajadevā pūrvabhādrottarabhādrāhirbudhnikā || 9 ||
puṣādevā revatī cāśvinīdevā tathāśvinī |
bharaṇī yamadevā ca proktāste ṛkṣadevatāḥ || 3.153.10 ||
brahmāṇī saṃsthitā pūrve pratipannavamītithau |
māheśvarī cottare ca dvitīyādaśamītithau || 11 ||
pañcamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ vārāhī dakṣiṇe sthitā |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ cāpi caturdaśyāmindrāṇī paścime sthitā || 12||
saptamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca cāmuṇḍā vāyukāṣṭhikā |
aṣṭamyamāvāsyadine lakṣmīstvīśānagā matā || 1 3||
ekādaśyāṃ trayodaśyāmagnikoṇe tu vaiṣṇavī |
dvādaśyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ tu kaumārī nairṛte satī ||14||
yoginīsammukhe naiva gamanādi prakārayet |
aśvinī revatī cāpi mṛgā mūlā punarvasuḥ || 15||
puṣyā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā prasthāne śreṣṭhatāpradāḥ |
hastyādipañcaṛkṣāṇi hyuttarātrayamityapi ||16||
aśvinī rohiṇī puṣyā dhaniṣṭhā ca punarvasuḥ |
vastraprāvaraṇe śreṣṭhā saubhāgyavardhakā api || 17||
kṛttikā bharaṇyaśleṣā maghā mūlā viśākhinī |
tisraḥ pūrvā adhovaktrā adhaḥkāryāṇi tatra vai ||18||
vāpīkūpataḍāgādibhūmikhanipragahvaram |
devāgārasya khananaṃ nidhānakhananaṃ tṛṇam ||19||
gaṇitaṃ jyotiṣārambhaṃ khanibilapraveśanam |
kuryāttānyeva siddhyanti cādhaḥkāryāṇi sarvathā ||3.153.20||
revatī cāśvinī citrā svātī hastā punarvasuḥ |
anurādhā mṛgo jyeṣṭhā hyetāḥ pārśvamukhā matāḥ ||21 ||
gajoṣṭrāśvabalīvardadamanaṃ mahiṣasya goḥ |
bījānāṃ vapanaṃ kuryānnāvādīnāṃ pravāhaṇam ||22||
cakrayantrarathānāṃ ca gamanaṃ cāgamādikam |
rohiṇyārdrā tathā puṣyā dhaniṣṭhā cottarātrayam ||23||
śatabhīṣā śravaṇaṃ ca nava tūrdhvamukhā matāḥ |
āsu rājyābhiṣekaṃ ca paṭṭabandhaṃ prakārayet ||24||
ūrdhvamukhānyucchritāni sarvāṇyetāsu kārayet |
caturthī tvaśubhā ṣaṣṭhī cāṣṭamī navamī tathā ||25||
amāvāsyā pūrṇimā ca dvādaśī ca caturdaśī |
atha śubhā pratipattu kṛṣṇā budhe dvitīyakā ||26||
tṛtīyā maṃgalayuktā caturthī śanivāsare |
gurau tu pañcamī, ṣaṣṭhī śubhā maṃgalaśukrayoḥ ||27||
saptamī budhasomasthāṣṭamī maṃgalasūryagā |
navamī somavārasthā daśamī guruvārikā ||28||
ekādaśī guruvyāptā dvādaśī budhavāsare |
trayodaśī śukrabhaumau śanau śreṣṭhā caturdaśī ||29||
paurṇamāsyapyamāvāsyā śreṣṭhā bodhyā bṛhaspatau |
dvādaśīṃ dahati sūryaḥ śaśī tvekādaśī dahet ||3.153.30||
bhaumo dahecca daśamīṃ navamīṃ tu budho dahet |
gururdahati cāṣṭamīṃ saptamīṃ bhārgavo dahet ||3 1 ||
śanaiścaro dahetṣaṣṭhīṃ gamanaṃ cāsu nāsti vai |
pratipannavamīṣveva caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ||32||
budhavāre ca prasthānaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet |
meṣe karkaṭake ṣaṣṭhī kanyāyāṃ mithune’ṣṭamī ||33 ||
vṛṣe kuṃbhe caturthī ca dvādaśī makare tule |
daśamī vṛścike siṃhe dhanurmīne caturdaśī ||34||
etā dagdhā na gantavyaṃ dehijīvādimānavaiḥ |
viśākhātrayamāditye pūrvāṣāḍhātraye śaśī ||349||
dhaniṣṭhātritayaṃ bhaume budhe tu revatītrayam |
rohiṇyāditrayaṃ gurau śukre puṣyatrayaṃ rame ||36||
śanaiścare varjayecca tūttarāphālgunītrayam |
eṣa autpātiko yogo mṛtyurogādikārakaḥ ||37||
mūle’rkaḥ śravaṇe candraḥ proṣṭhapadyuttare kujaḥ |
kṛttikāsu budhaścaiva gurau lakṣmi punarvasuḥ ||38||
pūrvaphālgunikā śukre svātiścaiva śanaiścare |
ete hyamṛtayogāḥ syuḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakāḥ ||39||
viṣkaṃbhe ghaṭikāḥ pañca śūle sapta prakīrtitāḥ |
ṣaḍgaṇḍe cātigaṇḍe ca nava vyāghātavajrayoḥ ||3.153.40 ||
vyatīpāte parīghe ca vaidhṛte ca dine dine |
varjanīyā mṛtyuyogā hyete kāryavināśakāḥ ||41 ||
haste’rkaśca guruḥ puṣye hyanurādhābudhe śubhā |
rohiṇī tu śanau śreṣṭhā some ca śatabhīṣaṇā ||42||
śukre tu revatī śreṣṭhā hyaśvinī maṃgale śubhā |
ete te siddhiyogāḥ syuḥ sarvadoṣavināśakāḥ |||43|||
bhārgave bharaṇī cāpi some citrā tu padmaje |
bhaume caivottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā tu budhe yadā ||44||
gurau śatabhiṣā cāpi śukre vai rohiṇī tathā |
śanau tu revatī cāpi viṣayogā hi te matāḥ ||45||
puṣyaḥ punarvasuścaiva revatī cāpi citrikā |
śravaṇā ca dhaniṣṭhā ca hastāśvinī mṛgā tathā ||46||
śatabhīṣā cāpi yogyā jātakarmādikarmaṇām |
viśākhā cottarā tisro maghārdrā bharaṇī tathā ||47||
aśleṣā kṛttikā caitāḥ prasthāne maraṇapradāḥ |
ṣaḍāditye daśā bodhyāḥ some pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ ||48||
aṣṭau tu maṃgale bodhyā budhe saptadaśa smṛtāḥ |
śanaiścare daśa bodhyā gurāvekonaviṃśatiḥ ||49||
rāhau dvādaśavarṣāṇi hyekaviṃśatirbhārgave |
raverdaśā duḥkhadā syādudveganṛpanāśakṛt ||3.153.50||
vibhūtidā somadaśā sukhamiṣṭānnadā tathā |
duḥkhapradā bhaumadaśā rājyādeḥ syād vināśinī |||51 ||
divyastrīdā budhadaśā rājyadā koṣavṛddhidā |
śanerdaśā rājyanāśabandhuduḥkhakarī bhavet ||52||
gurordaśā rājyadā syāt sukhadharmādidāyinī |
rāhordaśā rājyanāśavyādhidā duḥkhadā bhavet ||53||
hastyaśvadā śukradaśā rājyastrīlābhadā bhavet |
meṣamaṃgārakakṣetraṃ vṛṣaṃ śukrasya kīrtitam ||54||
mithunasya budhaḥ kṣetraṃ somaḥ karkaṭakasya ca |
sūryakṣetraṃ bhavet siṃhaḥ kanyākṣetraṃ budhasya ca ||55||
bhārgavasya tulākṣetraṃ vṛściko maṃgalasya ca |
dhanurbṛhaspateḥ kṣetraṃ śanermakarakuṃbhakau ||56||
mīnaḥ suragurośceti kṣetreṣṭaṃ lābhadaṃ kraye |
paurṇamāsyādvayaṃ yatra pūrvāṣāḍhādvayaṃ bhavet ||57||
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe |
aśvinī revatī citrā dhaniṣṭhā syādalaṃkṛtau ||58||
mṛgāhikapimārjāraśvānaḥ śūkarapakṣiṇaḥ |
nakulo mūṣikaścaiva yātrāyāṃ dakṣiṇe śubhāḥ ||59||
viprakanyā śavaṃ hastī śaṃkho bherī vasundharā |
veṇuḥ strī pūrṇakumbhaśca yātrāyāṃ śubhadarśanāḥ ||3.153.60||
jambukoṣṭrakharādyāśca yātrāyāṃ vāmake śubhāḥ |
kārpāsauṣadhitailāni pakvāṃgārabhujaṃgamāḥ ||61 ||
muktakeśī raktamālā nagnaścāśubhalakṣaṇāḥ |
hikkā pūrve phaladā cāgneye santāpaśokadā ||62||
dakṣiṇe hānidā śokasantāpadā tu nirṛte |
miṣṭānnadā paścime tu vāyavye’rthapradā matā ||63||
uttare kalahā ceśāne tu mṛtyupradā bhavet |
sūryaṃ narasvarūpaṃ tu vilikhya tasya ṛkṣakam ||64||
tadāditrayamāstheyaṃ mastake trayamānane |
ekaikaṃ skandhayorbāhuyugme ca hastayornyaset ||65||
hṛdaye pañca nābhau tvekaṃ guhye caikamityapi |
ekaikaṃ jānuke śiṣṭāni tu pāde niyojayet ||66||
caraṇasthena ṛkṣeṇa tvalpāyurjāyate naraḥ |
videśagamanaṃ jānau guhyasthe paradāravān ||67||
nābhisthenālpasantuṣṭo hṛtsthena tu maheśvaraḥ |
pāṇisthena bhaveccauraḥ sthānabhraṣṭo bhaved bhuje ||68||
skandhasthena dhanapatirmukhe miṣṭānnamāpnuyāt |
mastake paṭṭavastrāḍhyaśceti tadṛkṣavatphalam ||69||
saptamopacayaścandraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śukle dvitīyajaḥ |
pañcamo navamaścāpi lābhadaḥ saṃbhavatvapi ||3.153.70||
candrasya dvādaśāvasthā bhavanti śṛṇu padmaje |
āśvinyāstu samārabhya tritriṛkṣeṣu vai daśā ||71||
sārdhadvayeṣu bodhyā prathamā tu pravāsadā |
dvitīyā hānidā cāpi tṛtīyā mṛtyudā matā ||72||
caturthī jayadā hāsyapradā tu pañcamī daśā |
ṣaṣṭhī krīḍāratidā saptamī sukhamodadā ||73||
aṣṭamī śokadā bhogapradā tu navamī daśā |
daśamī jvaradā kampapradā caikādaśī daśā ||74||
susthitidā dvādaśī ca daśātulyaṃ phalaṃ matam |
janmasthaḥ kurute tuṣṭiṃ dvitīye sukhanāśakaḥ ||75||
tṛtīye rājyasammānaṃ caturthe kalahapradaḥ |
pañcame strīpradaḥ ṣaṣṭhe dhanadhānyaprado bhavet ||76||
saptame ratipūjādo’ṣṭame prāṇasandehakṛt |
navame koṣasañcayaprado daśame siddhidaḥ ||77||
ekādaśe jayadaśca dvādaśe mṛtyudaḥ śaśī |
kṛttikādau pūrvayātrāṃ saptakṣāṇi tu saṃvrajet ||78||
maghādau dakṣiṇe gacchedanurādhādau paścime |
dhaniṣṭhādisaptasu yātrottare śreṣṭhā matā sadā ||79||
aśvinī revatī citrā dhaniṣṭhā veṣadhāraṇe |
mṛgāśvicitrāpuṣyāśca mūlā hastā śubhāstu vai ||3.153.80||
kanyāpradāne yātrāyāṃ pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu |
śukracandrau tu janmasthau śubhadau sarvadā matau ||8 1 ||
candrabudhaguruśukrāḥ śubhadā vai dvitīyake |
tṛtīye bhaumamandārkaśaśāṃkāḥ śubhadā matāḥ ||82||
budhaścaturthake śreṣṭhaḥ śukragurū tu pañcamau |
candraketū tathā śreṣṭhau paccamau parikīrtitau ||83||
śaniścārkaśca bhaumaśca ṣaṣṭhe śreṣṭhā matāḥ sadā |
guruścandraḥ saptame ca budhaḥ śukrastathāṣṭame ||84||
navame tu guruḥ śreṣṭho daśame’rkārkicandrakāḥ |
ekādaśe grahāḥ sarve dvādaśe budhabhārgavau ||85||
siṃhena makaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kanyayā meṣa uttamaḥ |
tulayā saha mīnastu kuṃbhena saha karkaṭaḥ ||86||
dhanuṣā vṛṣabhaḥ śreṣṭho mithunena tu vṛścikaḥ |
evaṃ prītyai bhavatyeva sarvaṃ śubhaphalapradam ||87||
udayādeva cārabhya sūryo rāśau pratiṣṭhati |
ahni ṣaṭsu niśi ṣaṭsu rātrīṣu saṃpravartate ||88 ||
ghaṭikāḥ pañca mīne ca meṣe cāpi tathāvidhāḥ |
vṛṣe kuṃbhe catasraśca tisro mithune nakrake ||89 ||
pañca cāpe karkaṭe ca ṣaṭ siṃhe vṛścike tathā |
sapta tule ca kanyāyāṃ ghaṭikā parikīrtitāḥ ||3.153.90 ||
meṣalagne bhaved vandhyā vṛṣe bhavati kāminī |
mithune subhagā kanyā veśyā bhavati karkaṭe ||9 1 ||
siṃhe caivālpaputrā sā kanyāyāṃ rūpasaṃyutā |
tulāyāṃ rūpamaiśvaryaṃ vṛścike karkaśā bhavet ||9 2||
saubhāgyaṃ dhanuṣi syācca makare nīcagāminī |
kuṃbhe caivālpaputrā ca mīne vairāgyasaṃyutā ||93||
tulā karkaṭako meṣo makaraḥ sthiracāriṇaḥ |
pañcānano vṛṣaḥ kumbho vṛścikaśca sthirā matāḥ ||94||
kanyā dhanuśca mīnaśca mithunaṃ dvisvabhāvinaḥ |
yātrā cireṇa kartavyā praveṣṭavyaṃ sthireṇa ha || 95 ||
devasthāpanavaivāhyaṃ dvisvabhāvena kārayet |
nandā bhadrā jayā śreṣṭhā riktā varjyā tithiḥ sadā ||96 ||
nandā pratipat ṣaṣṭhī caikādaśīti tithitrayam |
bhadrā dvitīyā saptamī dvādaśīti tithitrayam ||97||
jayāṣṭamī tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī tithitrayam |
riktā caturthī navamī caturdaśī tithitrayam ||98 ||
pūrṇā pañcamī daśamī pūrṇimā tāḥ śubhā matāḥ |
budhaścaro guruḥ kṣipro mṛduḥ śukro ravirdhruvaḥ ||99||
śaniśca dāruṇo bhauma ugraḥ śaśī samo’pi ca |
carakṣipraiḥ prayātavyaṃ praveṣṭavyaṃ mṛdudhruvaiḥ || 3.153.100 ||
dāruṇograiśca yoddhavyaṃ vijayaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ |
nṛpābhiṣeko’gnikāryaṃ somavāre praśasyate || 101 ||
some tule prayāṇaṃ ca gṛhaṃ ca bhavanādikam |
saināpatyaṃ śauryayuddhaṃ śastrābhyāsaḥ kuje śubhaḥ || 10 2||
siddhikāryaṃ ca mantraśca yātrā ceti budhe śubhāḥ |
paṭhanaṃ devapūjā ca vastrādyābharaṇaṃ gurau || 103 ||
kanyādānaṃ gajārohaḥ strīsaṃgo bhārgave śubhāḥ |
sthāpyaṃ gṛhapraveśaśca gajabandhaḥ śanau śubhāḥ || 1 04||
ityevaṃ sarvamālakṣya kāryārambhaṃ pravartayet |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi paṭhanācchravaṇād rame || 1 05||
nakṣatrāṇi ca yoginyastithayo yogakā api |
daśāścāpi śakunāni hikkā sthānāni vai tathā || 1 06||
lagnāni ghaṭikā sarvaṃ matsvarūpaṃ vibhāvaya |
yathāpuṇyaṃ dehino vai tathā samupatiṣṭhate || 1 07||
ahaṃ lakṣmi smṛtastatra pūjito bhojito’pi ca |
sevito vanditaḥ prasāditaśca paricāritaḥ || 1 08||
karomi sarvaṃ sadbhāgyaṃ duḥsthaṃ susthaṃ karomi ca |
māṃ vijñāya ca sarvatra kāryadhvaṃso na vidyate || 10 9||
sarvaṃ bhaktasya saphalaṃ nāstikasya tu niṣphalam |
ātmavataḥ phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cānātmanaḥ kaniṣṭhakam || 3.153.110 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nakṣatrayoginītithiyogadaśāśakunahikkāsthānalagnaghaṭikāviśeṣe kāryākāryaphalāphalādinirūpaṇanāmā tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 153 ||

<3.154>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarojinīkathāṃ śubhām |
purā kanyābhavat kuṃbhakārasya kardamārthinī || 1 ||
ghaṭādisarvabhāṇḍānāṃ racanāya tu mṛttikām |
samānayati yogyāṃ ca gardabhādyaistu vāhanaiḥ || 2 ||
mātrā pitrā samaṃ bhrātrā kvacit svasrā kumārikā |
varayogyāpi sā naiveyeṣa vai varituṃ tataḥ || 3 ||
pitṛgṛhe’vasat sādhvī brahmacaryaparāyaṇā |
vṛddhasevāparā cāpi śīladharmaparāyaṇā || 4 ||
vyavasāye nije raktā tuṣṭā svalpaiśca vastubhiḥ |
nirdhanasya gṛhe bhūtā tato vāñcchā na vardhate || 5 ||
svabhāvatoṣayuktā vai vartate sādhvikā yathā |
atha kāle gatā mātā nāmnā ghoṇāvatī jvaram || 6 ||
samāsādya yayau svargaṃ sarojinī śuśoca ha |
mātṛsamaṃ sukhaṃ nāsti nāstyādhāraḥ prasūprakhaḥ || 7 ||
kanyānāṃ sarvadā mātā svargaṃ gṛhe virājate |
api nirdhanabālānāṃ dhanaṃ mātā paraṃ matam || 8 ||
adatvā nijabālāyai bhuṃkte pibati no prasūḥ |
asmṛtvā na dinaṃ yāti māturnijodbhavātmajān || 9 ||
vismṛtau vāpi nidrāyāṃ samāhvayati bālakān |
devavat poṣaṇaṃ mātā karoti sevate nijān || 3.154.10 ||
māturutsaṃga evāste’mṛtaṃ vai pakṣiṇāmapi |
aṇḍānyapi prapuṣyanti sadā mātrudaroṣmaṇā || 11 ||
viyoge kṣaṇamātraṃ vā mātā sukhaṃ na vindati |
sā mātā svargagā cādya pitā vṛddho bhavatyapi || 1 2||
so’pi putrādhīnavṛttirgamiṣyatyapyato divam |
tato mayā sadā stheyaṃ bhrātṛjāyākare bhavet || 13|
asnehena nivāso’pi nirayo’tra hi gocaraḥ |
kiṃ kāryaṃ vai mayā tvadya kartavyaṃ kiṃ tathottare || 14||
ityevaṃ nityameveyaṃ śocatyeva virāgiṇī |
atha dvādaśake śrāddhe mahīmānāḥ samāyayuḥ || 135||
sambandhināṃ ca sambandhavanto’pi jñātiyoginaḥ |
tatraikena kṛtā vāñcchā sarojinyarthameva ha || 16||
pitā niveditastasyā so’pi prasvīcakāra tat |
vāgdānena pradattā sā kanyakā kuṃbhakāriṇe || 17||
nāmnā nāladharāyeti pitrā cakraidhasaṃjñinā |
atha yogye kṣaṇe kanyā vivāhitā sumaṃgalaiḥ || 18||
kanyāpi sā prasannābhūcchokaṃ tatyāja sarvathā |
yayau gṛhaṃ svāmino vai bhogān bhuṃkte sukhasthitā ||1 9||
kintu śārīracihnāni kanyāyāḥ kāntahāni vai |
śmaśruścauṣṭhasya dairghyaṃ ca tathā cipiṭanāsikā ||3.154.20||
kekarākṣī padāṃguṣṭhānāmike spṛśato na kṣmām |
etādṛśī gṛhāyātā yadā patyustadā kṣaṇāt || 21 ||
patirjvaraṃ samāpede kṛśatāṃ prāpya vai mṛtaḥ |
vidhavā sā ca sañjātā śārīracihnadoṣataḥ ||22||
atha pitṛgṛhaṃ prāptā bhrātṛbhiścābhirakṣitā |
anapatyā nirādhārā śocati sma nijāṃ muhuḥ ||23 ||
varṣottare punaścānyakuṃbhakāreṇa cārthitā |
pitrā vivāhitā sāpi punaḥ patyurgṛhaṃ yayau ||24|||
sukhaṃ bhuṃkte’dhikaṃ sā tu pūrvato’pi sukhigṛhe |
kintu cihnapratāpena grahadoṣaistathā punaḥ |||5||
patistasyā dvitīyo’pi mṛto nāmnā hi ratnakaḥ |
anapatyaiva sā taṃ ca śuśoca satpatiṃ muhuḥ ||26||
bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ śuśocāpi punaḥ pitṛgṛhaṃ yayau |
pitāpi pūrṇakālaḥ san mṛtyuvaśaṃ tato gataḥ ||27|||
bhrātradhīnābhavat sāpi sarojinī tataḥ param |
varṣottaraṃ tṛtīyena kuṃbhakāreṇa vāñchitā ||28||
bhrātrārpitā yayau tasyāḥ patyurgṛhaṃ sarojinī |
sukhaṃ prāptā pūrvato’pi viśeṣaṃ tatra vatsaram || 29||
tṛtīyo’pi mṛto lāladāsākhyaḥ svapatistataḥ |
śuśocātīva manasā bhāgyaṃ dhikkurvatī hi sā || 3.154.3 0||
atha bhrātṛgṛhaṃ prāptā duḥkhena vartate sadā |
punarvarṣāntare cānyakuṃbhakāreṇa cārthitā ||3 1||
vidhinā svāgrajadattā yayau patyurgṛhaṃ hi sā |
varṣamātraṃ sukhaṃ prāptā caturtho’pi patirmṛtaḥ ||32||
punarbhrātṛgṛhaṃ prāptā nirapatyātiduḥkhitā |
parādhīnā ca divasān duḥkhān nirgamayatyapi ||33||
athaikadā bhrātṛjāyā dideśa kaccarārthinī |
āmapātrāṇi paktuṃ vai kaccarendhanahetave |||34||
yāhi sīmni cendhanāni samidhaḥ patrakaccaram |
kāṇḍakāṣṭhāni nālāni bhraṣṭryarthaṃ tvaṃ samānaya ||35||
sarojinī jvarārtābhūttadaiva śītadūṣitā |
niṣiṣedha pragantuṃ ca suptābhavad bhuvastale || 36||
atha kruddhā bhrātṛjāyā gālīdānaṃ cakāra ha |
sā śrutvā na pratyuvāca yato jvarābhiduḥkhinī ||37||
āhūtāpi na cāyāti yadā sarojinī tadā |
bhrātṛjāyā kuṭīṃ gatvā dhṛtvā haste sarojinīm ||38||
vicakarṣa balāccāpi dideśāhartumindhanam |
na yāsyāmīti cukrośa sarojinī jvarānvitā ||39||
tatāḍa bhrātṛjāyāṃ ca sāpi tatāḍa tāṃ mithaḥ |
keśākeśi tayoryuddhaṃ sākrośaṃ samabhūttadā ||3.154.40||
pārśvavāsāḥ praśrutvāpi militāstadgṛhe’bhavan |
kuṭumbinaḥ samāyātā grāmīṇāḥ suhṛdo’pi ca ||41 ||
sarve sāmnā vividhena kleśaṃ śāntaṃ pracakrire |
atha vairaṃ tayorjātaṃ nityaṃ netraruṣādhikam ||42||
netrayoścāpi yuddhaṃ vai jāyate nityaśastataḥ |
vācāṃ yuddhaṃ gālikābhiḥ kalahaścāpi jāyate ||43||
evaṃ dineṣu yāteṣu bhrātā kālavaśaṃ gataḥ |
rakṣitāsyā naiva cāsti bhrātṛjāyā suputriṇī ||44||
prasahya tāṃ gṛhānniṣkāsayāmāsa nijāttataḥ |
sāpi prauḍhasthitistyaktvā grāmaṃ nadītaṭe’svapat ||45||
svapnaṃ dadarśa tatraiva duḥkhahetuṃ purākṛtam |
svāṃ dadarśa ghātakartrīṃ niṣādinīṃ purābhave ||46||
svagṛhe vikrayārthaṃ sā hanti vai barkaraṃ tvajam |
bahūn sā barkarān hatvā karoti codarabhṛtim ||47||
evaṃvidhāṃ ghātakinīṃ svāṃ vilokya mṛtābhavat |
yamapūryāṃ tato yātā bhuktvā duḥkhāni tatra ca ||48||
piśācinī tato bhūtvā sahasravarṣameva ha |
kuṃbhakāragṛhe jātā sarojinī bhavāmyaham ||49||
ityevaṃ svapnameveyaṃ dṛṣṭavatī nadītaṭe |
samuttasthau tataśceyaṃ karmaphalaṃ bubodha ha ||3.154.50||
pūrvakṛtaṃ hi paścādvai prāpyate sarvadehibhiḥ |
mayā pūrve hatāścājāstena naśyanti me varāḥ ||51 ||
patayo me sarva eva mriyante mama karmabhiḥ |
ato mayā bhikṣukinyā bhūtvā gantavyameva ha ||52|||
vicāryetthaṃ karmapīḍāṃ grahapīḍāṃ svabhāvajām |
pīḍāṃ pūrvaphalaṃ matvā sādhvyāśramaṃ vane yayau ||53|||
yatra sannyāsinī divyā rājate śrīsatīśvarī |
sahasraśiṣyāsaṃyuktā vaiṣṇavī brahmacāriṇī ||54||
divyatejomayī mūrtirdarśanātpāpanāśinī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ||55||
dūraśravaṇadṛṣṭyādicamatkārayutā śubhā |
paraduḥkhaharā yogābhyāsaparā jitendriyā ||56||
yadāśrame na puruṣāḥ praviśanti kadācana |
kāściddhomaparā yajñopavītinyaśca kanyakāḥ ||57||
kāściddhyānaparāḥ santi mālājapaparāyaṇāḥ |
kāścittapaḥparā sādhvyo jaṭāsamastaśobhanāḥ ||58||
nirambarā vṛkṣaśālaparāścarmaparāstathā |
patravaṃśakaṭavastrāḥ kambalādiparāstathā ||59||
sarvābrahmaparāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kṛṣṇavratānvitāḥ |
sākṣāt kṛṣṇe kṛtasnehā muktimārgaparāyaṇāḥ ||3.154.60 ||
vāyusūryaśaśidevā vahnayo’pi spṛśanti na |
sakanyāste pravartante tāsāṃ vāseṣu sevakāḥ ||61 ||
vairaṃ mṛge mṛgarāje svābhāvikaṃ na yatra vai |
kāmakrodhādayo yatra nijabhāvaṃ tyajanti vai ||62||
yuvatvaṃ yatra nāstyeva vidyamānaṃ tu sāttvikam |
nirguṇatvaṃ bhajate’tra satīnāmāśrame śubhe ||63||
rājasvalyaṃ satīnāṃ vai tapasā līnatāṃ gatam |
divyadehā virājante devyo yathā cidambare ||64||
jalavahnibāṣpakuṇḍā yatra śītoṣṇayoginaḥ |
siddhayo yatra vartante vacaḥsaṃkalpamānase ||65||
kāścid devyo gahvarasthāḥ kāścit kuṭīgatā api |
kāścid vyomakṛtāvāsā viharantyapi cāmbare ||66||
kāścid vedasya vetryaśca kāścit karmaṭhikā api |
kāścit sāmaparāḥ satyaḥ kāścidṛcāṃ prabodhikāḥ ||67||
kāścid jñānaparā nityaṃ bahurūpadharāstathā |
samādhisthā aparāśca rājante sādhvikā iti ||68 ||
tatra gatvā virūpākṣī kumukhī dīrghakādharā |
romajaṃghā cipiṭikānāsā cipiṭapādikā ||69||
sthūlaghoṇā raktakeśā sūkṣamukhī kṛśastanī |
sarojinī kuṃbhakāraputrī nirāśrayā satī ||3.154.70||
āśramasyaiva godvāre bhramanti yatra vai mṛgāḥ |
tatra rajomayībhūmau luloṭha mahimānvitā ||71 ||
pāvanī sā dhūlikā vai śarīre marditā tayā |
tāṃ vīkṣya pāvanīṃ bhaktāṃ kintu cāṃgairamaṃgalām |||72||
yuvatīṃ duḥkhinīṃ lakṣmi kanyakāścābhisaṃyayuḥ |
sarvābhyo yuvatī natvā sahāśramāntaraṃ yayau ||73||
yatra sā rājate sādhvī śrīsatīśvariṇī guruḥ |
namaskṛtya rurodāpi papāta gurupādayoḥ ||74||
dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaparāṃ dīnāṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā satīśvarī |
mā bhaiṣṭeti jagādenāṃ valkalāni dadau tathā ||75||
pṛṣṭā hyudantaviṣaye jñātvā virāgamāśritā |
rakṣitā ca satīmadhye dehaśuddhiṃ prakāritā ||76||
vrataṃ dattavatī tasyai satīśvarī tu māsikam |
pañcāgnitapanaṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ phalamūlakam ||77||
japanaṃ mama mantrasya nityaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||78||
ityevaṃ sā jajāpaiva caikāgramanasā sadā |
triṃśatsahasrajāpaiśca māsānte śrīsatīśvarī ||79||
tuṣṭā cāhūya tāmāha piba vāri prasādajam |
sarojinī papau vāri śrīkṛṣṇapūjanāmṛtam ||3.154.80||
tāvat sā divyarūpā vai sūryatulyā vyajāyata |
yathā lakṣmīryathā durgā yathā sāvitrikā śacī ||81||
divyaśaktimahaiśvaryacamatkārayutābhavat |
divyacakṣurdivyakarṇadivyamānasampadā ||82||
vyadyotata satīmadhye yathā muktānikā parā |
śarīraṃ sarvamevābhūd divyapadminikā yathā ||83||
sadrekhāsarvaśreṣṭhāṃgacihnaśobhaṃ śubhaṃ param |
vyomagāmi kṛpālabdhaṃ śarīraṃ saṃvyajāyata ||84||
kuṃbhakartrī kṛpayā vai brahmadhartrī babhūva ha |
atha sā sevate nityaṃ satīśvarīṃ tu gauravīm ||85||
tapoyogena divyena cājñayā puṇyapuñjakaiḥ |
sevābhiścāpi bahvībhistoṣayāmāsa gauravīm ||86||
satīśvarī tataścaināṃ papraccha vada mānasam |
kimiṣṭaṃ te brahmadhartri dadāmi tava mānasam ||87||
sarojinī tadā prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo me’stu pareśvaraḥ ||88||
lakṣmyāḥ pādatale sthitvā seviṣye parameśvaram |
yatra lakṣmīstatra cāhaṃ vasāmi sahayoginī ||891||
vinā lakṣmīpatiṃ kāntaṃ nānyanme rocate hṛdi |
muktiṃ tāmeva vāñcchāmi sevārūpāṃ hi dāsikām ||3.154.90||
sāhaṃ prāptyā bhaviṣyāmi kṛtakṛtyā tathā kuru |
tathāstviti tadā prāha satīśvarī sarojinīm ||91 ||
dadau tasyai mahāmantradvayaṃ japārthameva ha |
oṃ mahālakṣmyai vidmahe viṣṇupatnyai ca dhīmahi |
tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt ||92||
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi |
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt ||93||
prāpya mantrāvubhau nityaṃ jajāpa sā pupūja tau |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau nityaṃ dhyānasevāparāyaṇā ||94||
varṣānte suprasannau tau pratyakṣagocarau puraḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau jātāvūcatuśca sarojinīm ||95||
vada kiṃ te manasyatra vartate dvandva eva tat |
śrutvā nanāma bhāvena varayāmāsa taṃ varam ||96||
lakṣmīpādatale sthitvā sevayāmi sadā harim |
tathāstviti prāhatuśca jagṛhatuḥ sarojinīm ||97||
rūpadvayaṃ sarojinyāścakratuḥ śrīrameśvarau |
kamalaṃ nālapuṣpāḍhyaṃ divyaṃ sugandhi caikakam ||98 ||
dvitīyaṃ kanyakārūpaṃ padminītyeva bhāṣitam |
padminīṃ tāṃ haristatra jagrāha svakareṇa vai ||99||
patnīṃ lakṣmīsamāṃ divyāṃ lakṣmīsvasṛsvarūpiṇīm |
sarojinī vallikā ca jalamadhye tato’bhavat || 3.154.10 0||
nālakamalapatrāḍhyā lakṣmīstatrāvasat sadā |
lakṣmyāścaraṇasevāḍhyā sarojinī sadābhavat ||1 01 ||
tadārabhya sadā lakṣmīḥ rājate kamale rame |
lakṣmīpādarajaḥpūtā sevate śrīnarāyaṇam ||1 02||
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā bhaktyā sarojinī purābhavat |
kuṃbhakartrī gurorbhaktyā brahmadhartrī tato’bhavat ||1 03||
satīśvarīgurorbhaktyā grahādyāśca nirābhavan |
dehacihnāni sarvāṇi yāni durbhāgyadānyapi ||1 04||
tāni vyāvṛttimāsādya divyarūpāṇyatho’bhavan |
ityevaṃ sarvadā bhaktyā satāṃ sevābhiranvaham || 1 05||
sādhvīnāṃ brahmavetrīṇāṃ kṛpayā divyatāṃ vrajet |
pāpāni darśanādeva naśyanti sādhuyoginā ||1 06||
labhyante sevayā divyaguṇāḥ paramamokṣadāḥ |
kālakarmādayaścāpi vighnā ye duḥkhakāriṇaḥ ||1 07||
sarve te vilayaṃ yānti guroḥ sevāphalena vai |
duṣṭā grahāḥ sukhāścaiva kālā duṣṭāḥ sukhāstathā || 1 08||
kubhāgyaṃ subhagaṃ syācca deho bhaumo’pi dīvyati |
anāyuṣyaṃ cirāyuṣyaṃ dāridryaṃ dhanitāṃ vrajet || 1 09||
pāpāni puṇyabhāvaṃ ca prayāntyeva hi sevayā |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇādapi tatphalam || 3.154.110 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saro
jinyāḥ kuṃbhakāraputryāḥ pūrvajanmapāpena catuṣpatimaraṇottaraṃ
vairāgyeṇa śrīsatīśvarīsādhvyāśrame gamanaṃ, tatra śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇabhaktyā gurusevayā ca grahadoṣaśārīradoṣanāśottaraṃ śrīlakṣmyāśrayāyāḥ kamalinīvallikāyāstathā padminyākhyaramāyāḥ svarūpaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 154 ||

<3.155>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
manavo ye bhavatoktāḥ kimeśā lokapūjitāḥ |
caturdaśeti teṣāṃ cotpattiṃ kṛṣṇa vadātra me || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
manavo vai madaṃśāste kalpe kalpe caturdaśa |
bhavanti sarvarājyeśā dharmapravartakā api || 2 ||
nyāyapravartakāścāpi caturdaśastarādhipāḥ |
mayaiva kalpitāḥ sarve vartante nijakarmasu || 3 ||
svāyaṃbhuvaḥ svārociṣa auttamastāmasastathā |
raivataścākṣuṣaścāpi vaivasvatastu saptamaḥ || 4 ||
sāvarṇirdakṣasāvarṇirbrahmasāvarṇirityapi |
dharmasāvarṇiśca rudrasāvarṇirdvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 ||
devasāvarṇistathendrasāvarṇivaiṃ caturdaśaḥ |
pratyekasya manorāyuḥ sādhikāstvekasaptatiḥ || 6 ||
caturdaśamanūnāṃ tu sahasrasādhikā sthitiḥ |
sahasrasādhikāścāpi dinamekaṃ tu vedhasaḥ || 7 ||
sahasrasādhikāścānyā rātrirekā ca vedhasaḥ |
sādhikādvayasāhasrānte prātaḥ sṛṣṭidānavā || 8 ||
pātālāt svargaparyantā daśalokātmikī bhavet |
pūrve bahusabhā devanadyāstaṭe tu vaiṣṇavam || 9 ||
yāgaṃ cakāra dharmātmā dharmatapā mahānṛṣiḥ |
nāmnā dharmatapāstasya prasanno’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ || 3.155.10 ||
varadānaṃ dadau tasya vāñcchānusāramuttamam |
pravṛttāvapi nivṛttiṃ vāñchitāṃ tena śobhanām || 11 ||
mayā tapaḥphalaṃ yajñaphalaṃ manvantarasthalam |
prathamaṃ dattamasmai vai so’yaṃ svāyaṃbhuvo’bhavat || 12||
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putraḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ |
śatarūpāṃ satīṃ nārīṃ patnītve jagṛhe sa ca || 13||
priyavratottānapādau tayoḥ putrau babhūvatuḥ |
atha vipro vāraṇākhyo varaṇāsaritastaṭe || 14||
tasya buddhiriyaṃ tvāsīd drakṣyāmyahaṃ vasundharām |
tāvattasya gṛhe sādhurvyomago’tithirāyayau || 15||
nāmnā khākhapadastasmai bhojanaṃ pradadau dvijaḥ |
yātrārthaṃ ca manaścakre tadā sādhuruvāca tam || 1 6||
mantrauṣadhīliptapādo bhūtvā vihara golakam |
ityuktvā piṣṭamevāsyauṣadhaṃ pādadvaye dadau || 17||
sahasraṃ yojanānāṃ hi dinārdhenāmbare dvijaḥ |
yayau tuṣārabhūmyadrau jalapṛthvyāmavātarat || 18||
kṣālito’bhūtpādalepaḥ paramauṣadhikodbhavaḥ |
gantuṃ cākāśamārgeṇāsamartho bhūtale sthitaḥ || 19||
taṃ dadarśāpsarovaryā varūthinītināmataḥ |
mumoha cintayāmāsa sevāṃ kartuṃ hṛdantare ||3.155.20||
puro gatvā cātibhaktyā dharmeṇa ca vratena ca |
śīlenāpi satīrītyā sevayāmāsa taṃ hi sā ||21 ||
dvijastuṣṭo varadānaṃ dadau tasyai prajāvatī |
bhava putravatī pautravatī trailokyapūjitā |||22||
ityāśiṣaṃ pradatvaiva dvijaḥ sasmāra māṃ tathā |
vahniṃ prāha praṇipatya gārhapatyamupāṃśunā ||23||
brahmarūpaḥ kṛṣṇarūpo rakṣako bhava cānala |
yathāhamadya svaṃ gehaṃ paśyeyaṃ sati bhāskare ||24||
yathā vai sādhavaḥ santaścābhyāgatāḥ prasevitāḥ |
yathā ca vaidikaṃ karma svakāle nojjhitaṃ mayā ||25||
yathā ca na paradravye paradārāsu me matiḥ |
yayā nārāyaṇo nityaṃ pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||26||
tena satyena māṃ vahne svaṃ gṛhaṃ prāpayātha vai |
evaṃ tu vadatastasya gārhapatyānalaḥ svayam ||27||
āyayau purato meṣātmakaḥ pakṣānvitastataḥ |
dvijaścāruhya tatpṛṣṭhe prāpa naijaṃ gṛhaṃ drutam ||28||
varūthinyapi taṃ vipraṃ natvāśīrvādasaṃyutā |
prāpa divyaṃ sugandharvaṃ devakeliṃ tu nāmataḥ ||29||
tasmād garbhaṃ dadhārāpi viprāśīrvādavarcasam |
jajñe sa bālo dyutimān jvalanniva vibhāvasuḥ ||3.155.30 ||
svarocibhiryato bhāti svarocirnāmato’bhavat |
svarociśca vimānenāmbare vinirjagāma ha ||3 1 ||
manoramā sarid yābhūt kanyakendīvarasya vai |
gandharvasya purā devī vaiṣṇavī tapasābhavat ||32||
sāptasārasvate kṣetre sarasvatī manoramā |
sarayūsaṃgamā sādhvī cakame sā svarociṣam ||33||
prārthayāmāsa patnyarthaṃ dharmeṇa vinayena tam |
patiṃ kṛtvā tena sākaṃ tadgṛhaṃ prayayau sarit ||34||
tayā sākaṃ vimānena vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca |
vicarannaikadāraṇye mṛgīṃ dadarśa śobhanām ||35||
divyāṃ divyaguṇopetāṃ nirbhayāṃ niścalasthitām |
samīpe cāgatāṃ tāṃ ca pasparśa dakṣapāṇinā ||36||
mṛgī sā tu tirobhūya jātā divyā hi devatā |
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭaḥ kā tvamityabhyabhāṣata ||37||
sā cāsmai kathayāmāsa vanasyāsyāsmi devatā |
ahaṃ ca prārthitā devaiḥ preṣitā tvāṃ prati sthitā || 38||
utpādanīyo hi manustvayā mayi mahāmate |
ityuktaḥ svarocireva jagrāha tāṃ nijapriyām ||39||
tasyāṃ ca janayāmāsa putraṃ tejasvinaṃ tadā |
tatkṣaṇājjātamātrasya devavādyāni sasvanuḥ ||3.155.40 ||
jagurgandharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ |
pitā bālasya svanāmnā nāma svārociṣaṃ vyadhāt ||41||
svārociṣo manurlakṣmi bhavitā dvitīyo manuḥ |
padminī nāma yā vidyā lakṣmīryasyāstu devatā ||42||
yadādhārāśca nidhayastāmadhyagāt samastataḥ |
yayā tu jñāyate bhūmau padmādinidhayaḥ sphuṭāḥ ||43||
devatānāṃ prasādena sādhusaṃsevanena ca |
nidhibhiścārpitaṃ vittaṃ mānuṣye’pi vivardhate ||44||
padmaścāpi mahāpadmo makaraḥ kacchapastathā |
mukundo nandakaścāpi nīlaḥ śaṃkhaśca te manoḥ ||45||
gṛhe evābhavannityaṃ sarvecchāparipūrakāḥ |
dravyaṃ ratnāni śastrāṇi rasā vādyaṃ ca dhātavaḥ ||46||
dhānyāni bhogaśṛṃgārā manordivyāḥ sadābhavan |
atha lakṣmi manuṃ cāpi tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu śobhanam ||47||
uttānapādaputro’bhūduttamo nāma nāmataḥ |
surucyāstanayaḥ khyāto babhau bhānuparākramaḥ ||48||
bābhravyāṃ bahulāṃ nāma copayeme sa dharmavit |
viṣṇubhaktiparaḥ so’pi tayā sākaṃ tu saṃyayau ||49||
śeṣanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ pupūja śrīnarāyaṇam |
śeṣaṃ cāpi pupūjāsau śeṣaputrīṃ pupūja ha ||3.155.50 ||
dadāvābhūṣaṇānyasyai kalyāṇyai sā tutoṣa ha |
kalyāṇī śeṣaputrī ca dadāvāśīrvacaḥ śubham ||51 ||
tava putro mahāvīryo patnyāmasyāṃ bhaviṣyati |
manvantareśvaro dhīmānavyāhatasucakrakaḥ |22||
tato rājño’bhavat kāle prāpte putrottamaḥ sutaḥ |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha ||13||
auttamaśceti munayo nāma cakruḥ samāgatāḥ |
uttamasya sutaḥ so’yaṃ nāmnā khyātaḥ sadauttamaḥ ||54||
manutve sthāpayiṣyanti tamenamṛṣayaḥ surāḥ |
atha lakṣmi caturthaṃ tu manuṃ vakṣyāmi taṃ śṛṇu ||55||
rājābhūd bhuvi vikhyātaḥ svarāṣṭro nāma vīryavān |
tapastepe bahukālaṃ vitastāpuline hi saḥ ||96||
tasya bhāryā satī rājñī yoginī rūpadhāriṇī |
mṛgī bhūtvā vane cāste nityaṃ rājñastu sannidhau ||57||
brahmacaryaparo rājā śuśrāva vyomaśāradām |
rājam̐stapobalenāsyāmutpalāyāṃ striyāṃ tava ||568||
putro divyo hi bhavitā manurnāmnā hi tāmasaḥ |
tataścāsyai dehi bījaṃ lokopakārakāraṇāt ||59||
śrutvaivaṃ ca ṛtumatyai cotpalāyai nṛpo dadau |
saṃgamaṃ sparśamātraṃ vai garbhamāpotpalāvatī ||3.155.60 ||
tataḥ sā suṣuve putraṃ mṛgīdehotpalāvatī |
tatastasyarṣayaḥ sarve sametya kānane tadā ||61 ||
avekṣya mātaraṃ tāṃ tu tāmasīṃ hariṇīṃ khalu |
tāmaso’yaṃ bhavatveva nāmnā manuścaturthakaḥ ||62||
so’yaṃ putro’pi sahasā samārādhya hi bhāskaram |
avāpya divyānyastrāṇi sasaṃhārāṇyaśeṣataḥ ||63||
rājiṣyate manurbhūtvā tāmasākhyo manuḥ rame |
atha lakṣmi manuṃ cāpi pañcamaṃ śṛṇu vacmi te ||64||
ṛṣirāsīnmahābhāgaḥ ṛtavāgiti nāmataḥ |
revatyante’bhavattasya durbhāgyo rogavardhanaḥ ||65||
putro tenāpi ṛṣirāḍ dīrgharogamavāpa ha |
ṛtavāg revatīṃ prāha tava yogena me sutaḥ ||66||
duḥśīlo rogadā jātaḥ patasvāśu hi revati |
tenaivaṃ vyāhṛte śāpe revatyṛkṣaṃ papāta ha ||67||
saurāṣṭre kumudādrau vai vastrāpathe mama sthale |
kumudādriśca tatpātāt khyāto raivatako’bhavat ||68||
raivatādrau revatī sā kanyā jātā sarovare |
pramuco nāma munirāṭ kanyāṃ cāśramasannidhau ||69||
navotpannāṃ hi jagrāha poṣayāmāsa putrikām |
atha kālāntare tatra durgamo nāma bhūpatiḥ ||3.155.70||
āyayau cāhvayāmāsa priyāṃ ceti hi revatīm |
pramuco nijaputrīṃ tāṃ durgamāya dadau tadā ||71 ||
tatra tapaḥprabhāveṇa revatyṛkṣaṃ yathāmbare |
somayogi vyadhāt prāgvajjāmātaramathābravīt ||72||
audvāhikaṃ te bhūpāla kathyatāṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham |
rājāharṣe prasādātte manuṃ putraṃ vṛṇomyaham ||73||
ṛṣiḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ manuste tanayo bhavet |
tāmādāya yayau rājā cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||74||
snātvā māṃ saṃprapūjyaiva natvā ca lomaśaṃ munim |
durgamo durganagaraṃ yayau gaṃgāvatītaṭe ||75||
tataścājāyata putro revatyāṃ raivato manuḥ |
kalpāntare sūryaputro revanto’pi bhaviṣyati ||76||
evaṃ lakṣmi raivato’yaṃ bhavitā pañcamo manuḥ |
kathitaste tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ manuṃ śṛṇu vadāmyaham ||77||
pūrvajanmani jāto’sau cakṣuṣaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
cākṣuṣatvamatastasya janmanyasminnapi priye ||78||
jātismaraḥ sa jāto’tra māturutsaṃgamāsthitaḥ |
avanīndrakṣatriyasya giribhadrākhyayoṣitaḥ ||79||
giribhadrāśayanāttamādade jātahāriṇī |
rājño vikrāntanāmnaśca haiminiyoṣito gṛhe ||3.155.80||
nyasya taṃ tatrajanmānaṃ bālaṃ cādāya niryayau |
rājabālaṃ bodhavipragṛhe nyasya tadarbhakam ||8 1 ||
viprabālaṃ jahārāpi bhakṣayāmāsa rākṣasī |
evaṃ rājagṛhe rājñīparyaṃke vardhito’pi saḥ ||82||
ānandanāmnā vikhyāto’bhavattatho’rthamānasaḥ |
tapastepe cātitīvraṃ brahmā tvāgatya sannidhau ||83||
cākṣuṣetyāha taṃ brahmā tapaso vinivartayan |
manuṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vyadhāt so’yaṃ bhavitā ṣaṣṭhako manuḥ ||84||
atha lakṣmi saptakaṃ te manuṃ vadāmi saṃśṛṇu |
sūryabhāryā viśvakarmasutā saṃjñeti viśrutā ||85||
vaivasvataṃ śubhaṃ putraṃ tasyāmajanayat raviḥ |
vaivasvato hyayaṃ lakṣmi bhavitā saptamo manuḥ ||86||
pūrvasavarṇajātatvāt sāvarṇiriti viśrutaḥ |
athāṣṭamaṃ manuṃ vacmi śṛṇu nārāyaṇi priye ||87||
svārociṣe’ntare pūrve rājābhūt surathābhidhaḥ |
jagāma sa vanaṃ duḥkhī śatrubhiḥ samare jitaḥ ||88||
athāyayau tatra duḥkhī vaiśyaḥ samādhināmakaḥ |
rājā taṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha kinnu śocasi ||89||
uvāca nṛpatiṃ vaiśyastava rājye’bhavaṃ sukhī |
putradārairnirasto’dha dhanalobhādasādhubhiḥ ||3.155.90||
vihīnaśca dhanairdāraiḥ putrairādāya me dhanam |
vayamabhyāgato duḥkhī nirastaścāptabandhubhiḥ ||91||
so’haṃ na vedmi putrāṇāṃ kuśalākuśalāsthitim |
nārīṇāṃ svajanānāṃ ca kanyānāṃ ca kuṭumbinām |||92||
kinnu teṣāṃ gṛhe kṣemamakṣemaṃ kinnu sāmpratam |
kathante kinnu sadvṛttā durvṛttāḥ kinnu me sutāḥ ||92||
rājā prāha nirasto yairbhavān dārasutādibhiḥ |
teṣu kiṃ bhavataḥ snehamanubadhnāti mānasam ||94||
vaiśya āha evametat tathāpi duḥkhadaṃ manaḥ |
kiṃ karomi hi māyāpi manasteṣu pradhāvati ||95||
yaiḥ santyajya pitṛsnehaṃ dhanalubdhairnirākṛtaḥ |
patisvajanahārdaṃ ca hārditeṣvapi me manaḥ ||96||
jānāmi viparītām̐stān jānannapi tyajāmi na |
yatpremapravaṇaṃ cittaṃ viguṇeṣvapi bandhuṣu ||97||
teṣāṃ kṛte me niḥśvāsā daurmanasyaṃ ca jāyate |
karomi kiṃ yanna manasteṣvaprītiṣu niṣṭhuram ||98||
divāndhāḥ prāṇinaḥ kecid rātrāvandhāstathāpare |
keciddivā tathā rātrau prāṇinastulyadṛṣṭayaḥ ||99||
jñānavanto’pi jāyante mohāndhā duḥkhaduḥkhinaḥ |
niḥsvārthāḥ paśavaścāpi pakṣiṇo’pi tathāvidhāḥ ||3.155.1 0 0||
kliśyanti dāraputrārthaṃ tulyā mṛgāśca mānavāḥ |
māyayā mamatāgarte mohāvartte bhramanti vai || 101 ||
saiṣā tu viṣṇubhaktānāṃ varadā muktaye matā |
sā vidyā paramā mukterhetubhūtā sanātanī ||1 02||
saṃsārabandhahetuḥ sā hyabhaktānāṃ vimohinī |
nityā sā jagadambā vai jagadātmā bhaviṣyati || 1 03||
yoganidrātmikā cāpi viṣṇukṣetre pravartate |
tapasā sādhyate māyā mokṣadātrī bhavatyapi || 1 04||
ityevaṃ nṛpa vaiśyau tau saha vai jñānakāriṇau |
tepaturvai tapastīvraṃ lakṣmīṃ smṛtvā narāyaṇam || 1 05||
darśanaṃ ca dadau tābhyāṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇānvitā |
varadānaṃ dadau rājñe mṛtvā janma labhiṣyasi || 1 06||
sūryāt sāvarṇiko nāma manurbhavān bhaviṣyasi |
vaiśyo’yaṃ jñānavān sampatsukhavām̐śca bhaviṣyati || 1 07||
iti datvā tayorlakṣmīryathābhilaṣitaṃ varam |
babhūvāntarhitā sadyo bhaktyā tābhyāmabhiṣṭutā ||1 08||
evaṃ lakṣmyā varaṃ prāpya surathaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ |
sūryaputraḥ sa sāvarṇirbhavitā manuraṣṭamaḥ ||1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’ṣṭamanūnāṃ janmādivarṇananāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 155 ||

<3.156>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ manuṃ tu navamaṃ priye |
abhūd rājā dhanavarmā svalparājyaḥ surāṣṭrake || 1 ||
mahānti cānyarājyāni vīkṣyodvegamanāḥ sadā |
nāha bhūṣādhibhūpo’smi svalpabhūpo’smi kharvaṭī || 2 ||
vinā kīrtiṃ ca sāmrājyaṃ śāntirme hṛdaye na vai |
tasmād yatnaṃ karomyeva sāmrājyasya kṛte’niśam || 3 ||
vicāryetthaṃ nijagrāmāt sapatnīputrabāndhavaḥ |
yayāvaśvapaṭṭatīraṃ yātrārthaṃ tapase tathā || 4 ||
lomaśasyāśramaṃ gatvā nanāma pādayoḥ puraḥ |
dattāsane niṣasāda pṛṣṭhaśca kuśalaṃ prati || 5 ||
lomaśaṃ pratyuvācāsau kuśalaṃ kṛpayā tava |
grāmaḥ putrāḥ sutāḥ patnī gāvaḥ kṣetrāṇi karṣukāḥ || 6 ||
sarve vai svastimanto’tra bhavataḥ kṛpayā guro |
hṛdayaṃ cāpyatṛptaṃ me grāmarājyena kṣudravat || 7 ||
samīhate mahadrājyaṃ tatprāptyarthaṃ vrataṃ vada |
śrutvā śrīlomaśastasmai dehaśuddhivrataṃ tu prāk || 8 ||
datvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ supuṇyadam |
prāhātrāmravaṇe vṛkṣatale cārādhaya prabhum || 9 ||
sutapāḥ sujapaścāpi subhaktiściradhairyavān |
sapatnīkaḥ suputrādiḥ kuru śreṣṭhaṃ tapo nṛpa || 3.156.10||
aniketā kandamūlaphalāhārā arāgiṇaḥ |
bhūśayānā brahmaśīlā aparigrahavartinaḥ || 1 1||
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānāstripūjākāriṇo’nvaham |
