om anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 12||
itimantraparāḥ sarve vatsaraṃ pratapantviha |
tato varṣāparaṃ lakṣmīgāyatrījāpakāstviha || 1 3||
oṃ mahālakṣmyai ca vidmahe viṣṇupatnyai ca dhīmahi |
tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāditi vasantu vatsaram || 14||
iṣṭasiddhistūrṇameva śrīhariḥ sampradāsyati |
ityuktāste guruṃ natvā prapūjya śuddhabhāvataḥ ||15||
aśvapaṭṭasarovārau snātvā cāmravaṇaṃ yayuḥ |
māsaṃ varṣaṃ tathānyārdhaṃ vyatīyustapatāṃ vane || 16||
prasanno’haṃ tadā lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ jagāma tān |
gocaraścābhavaṃ cāgre dhanavarmāpa saṃmudam ||17||
kuṭumbaṃ yasya sarvaṃ ca sasaṃbhramaṃ nanāma mām |
mayeṣṭavaradānārthaṃ prerito nṛpatirdrutam || 18||
prapūjya svāgatarītyā yayāce varamuttamam |
sarvamānavarājānāmadhikaṃ rājyamuttamam || 1 9||
mayā tathāstviti dattaṃ sāmrājyaṃ manuviśrutam |
bhavitā tvaṃ dhanavarman sakuṭumbo manurmahān ||3.156.20||
dakṣaputro hi sāvarṇo bhāvī yo navamo manuḥ |
dakṣasāvarṇināmā vai ekasaptatisādhikaḥ ||21||
tāvatkālaṃ svargaloke vasa svatantramaṇḍalaḥ |
ityuktamātre tatraiva vimānaṃ sūryasannibham ||22||
devāpsarobhi rāghuṣṭaṃ śobhanaṃ tvāyayau bhuvi |
tāvanme kṛpayā rājā sakuṭumbo mṛtiṃ yayau ||23||
devadeho yayau svargaṃ svatantratārakādhipaḥ |
bhavitā dakṣasāvarṇiḥ prāpte kāle manurhi saḥ ||24||
iti te kathito lakṣmi manurvai navamo’pyatha |
kathayāmi daśamaṃ te manuṃ brahmasavarṇakam ||25||
brahmasāvarṇināmānaṃ pūrvaṃ tu jaḍaviprakam |
bālakṛṣṇasaraḥprānte vasantaṃ matirāsa ha ||26||
tapaḥ karomi vipulaṃ kiṃ vipratve sukhaṃ tviha |
rājye sukhaṃ paraṃ cāste sarvabhogaprapūritam ||27||
vicāryetthaṃ jaḍavipro nāmnā balīśvaraḥ svayam |
daśavarṣāṇi satataṃ jalavāsāḥ sarovare ||28||
abhavad dhyāyamāno māṃ śrīpatiṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum |
so’haṃ samādhisaṃsthaṃ taṃ matsyabhakṣitanāḍikam |||29|||
śaivālāvṛtasarvāsthipañjaraṃ mama bhaktakam |
uddhartuṃ ca tvayā sākaṃ hyagamaṃ tasya sannidhau ||3.156.30||
mayā cāntaḥpraviśyaivotthāpitaḥ sa balīśvaraḥ |
na tasya vidyate carma nāḍīvrātendriyāṇi ca ||31 ||
kathaṃ paśyecchṛṇuyācca spṛśed vadet kathaṃ hi saḥ |
kathaṃ tiṣṭhet pracalecca prāṇasañcaraṇaṃ kutaḥ ||3||
raktaṃ nāsti na ca majjodaraṃ santi na kukṣayaḥ |
evaṃbhūtaṃ tu māṃ bhaktaṃ brahmarandhre mayi sthitam || 33||
praviśya cāsya dehe tatpañjare dhātavaḥ kṛtāḥ |
mayā puṣṭiṃ gamitāśca snāyūmajjādayo’bhavan ||34||
nāḍyaścāpi mayā sarvāstatraiva nūtanīkṛtāḥ |
raktaṃ prapūritaṃ tatra keśāḥ prarohitāstaṭaḥ ||35||
carmāvanaddho deho’syendriyaprāṇamano’nvitaḥ |
sampannaḥ sa samādhestu hṛdyāgatya bahiryayau ||36||
utthitaḥ sa jalād yāvanmāṃ dadarśa puraḥsthitam |
śrīyutaṃ paramātmānaṃ yojayantaṃ varāya tam ||37||
so’pi vīkṣya hariṃ māṃ tu tapaḥphalamayācata |
pupūja jalamātreṇa hṛdayena ca vai muhuḥ ||38||
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa siddhipate jagatpate |
māyāpate patīnāṃ ca pate rājapate prabho ||39||
mahārājyaṃ dehi me’tra brāhmaṇyaṃ cāpi sarvadā |
tathāstviti mayā datto varastasmai mahātmane ||3.156.40||
patitaḥ pādayonaśca kamalāni śubhāni ca |
ārpayat pādayornaśca papau pādāmṛtaṃ ca naḥ ||41 ||
āvābhyāmarpitaṃ bhojyaṃ kṣīrātmakaṃ hi kalpitam |
bubhuje jalapānaṃ ca kṛtvā tūrṇaṃ videhavat ||42||
tyaktvā dehaṃ vimānena mayā sākaṃ tvayā tathā |
ambaraṃ cājagāmaiva divyadeho hi bhaktarāṭ ||43||
mayārpitaḥ sa devebhyo devaloke vasatyapi |
atha kālāntare prāpya putratāṃ vedhasaḥ sa ca ||44||
brahmasāvarṇisaṃjñaḥ sa manuḥ svayaṃ bhaviṣyati |
mama pūjāpratāpena tapasā manutāṃ parām ||45||
avāpsyati sa vai lakṣmi brāhmaṇyanṛpatānvitaḥ |
athaikādaśakaṃ vakṣye manuṃ lakṣmi niśāmaya ||46||
dharmasāvarṇināmānaṃ devānīkakuṭumbinam |
āsīt pūrve vaiśyavarṇaṃ karṣuko dharmatatparaḥ ||47||
ānandavarṇītināmnā khyātaḥ surāṣṭradeśajaḥ |
karoti bhagavadbhaktiṃ yatate brahmacaryake ||48||
ūrdhvaretāḥ sadā cāste vyāghrāraṇye vasatyapi |
soḍhubhārāsarittīre śiṃśapādrumasevanaḥ ||49||
vairāgyeṇa sa mahatā kurute śrīharerjapam |
śarkarākandamātrādo’bhavattatra samā daśa ||3.156.50||
tatastapobhirugraiścārādhayatyacyutaṃ hi mām |
nidrāṃ na labhate māyāṃ mohinīṃ ca tyajatyapi ||51 ||
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa jagatprabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||52|||
evaṃ raṭati nityaṃ sa japati śrīnarāyaṇam |
viṃśatirhi samāstasya japato niryayuḥ sukhāḥ ||53||
tataḥ sa karṣuko devānīko dhyānaparo’bhavat |
śāradyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ vai cāndratejo’tiśobhite ||54||
vane subhūtale tatra śiśapāvṛkṣasannidhau |
pūrṇacandrānanaṃ divyaṃ māṃ sa dadarśa cāgatam ||55||
utthāya sahasā vaiśyaḥ papāta mama pādayoḥ |
pupūja śubhapuṣpādyaiḥ śārkarakandamūlakaiḥ ||56||
mayā pravartitaḥ so’pi varārthaṃ so’pyayācata |
brāhmaṇyaṃ cāpi devatvaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ ca sampadaḥ ||57||
tathāstviti mayā cokto nivāritaḥ tapaḥśramāt |
aśvapaṭṭamahākṣetraṃ yayau śrīlomaśāśramam ||58||
ahaṃ cādṛśyabhāvaśca svadhāma prajagāma ha |
devānīko’bhajanmāṃ ca vasan ṛṣikule tataḥ ||59||
kālena dehamutsṛjya yayau satyaṃśubhaṃ padam|
brahmaṇo lokamevāsau dharmagṛhe supuṇyavān ||3.156.60||
dharmaputro’bhavad vipro mānaso dharmasaṃgṛhī |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yadvaṃśe mama pūrvajāḥ ||6 1 ||
tava pūjyā vasantyeva saurāṣṭre bahuvistare |
jālāyane tu sauvīre sārakaṭe tu gairike ||62||
gokṣure kṣārapāṭe ca pūrvajā me vasanti vai |
dharmaputraḥ sa devānīkaḥ svayaṃ puṇyapuñjakaiḥ ||63||
madicchayā hi vipratvaṃ dharmasāvarṇitāmapi |
prāpyaiva bhavitā caikādaśo manurnṛpeśvaraḥ ||64||
tāvatkālaṃ satyaloke dharmagṛhe virājate |
atha lakṣmi dvādaśaṃ ca manuṃ vacmi śṛṇu priye ||65||
abrikte bhūtale nārāyaṇyāstīre’vasad ghṛṇī |
ghṛṇeṣikākhyaḥ śūdraśca dharmakarmavivarjitaḥ ||66||
kuṭumbapoṣaṇaparo matsyavṛttirviśeṣataḥ |
tasyaikadābhavad vṛṣṭirudvelāni jalāni tu ||67||
nārāyaṇyā mahānadyāścābdhivat prasṛtāniha |
gṛhaṃ grāmaṃ pravāhyaiva ninyuḥ pūre’sya vai tadā ||68||
strīputrasahitaḥ śūdraḥ prohyamāṇo gṛhānvitaḥ |
jalamadhye’bhavattatra naukāyāmiva vai tadā ||69||
gṛhaṃ kāṣṭhakṛtaṃ svalpaṃ samūlaṃ tarati jale |
mānatāṃ sa tadā cakre rudrasya svāvanārthikām ||3.156.70||
yadyahaṃ jīvamāsādya labheyaṃ svagṛhasthalīm |
sānvayo rudrapūjā vai kariṣye sarvadā śubhām ||71 ||
matsyān vivarjayiṣye ca kariṣye nāpi hiṃsanam |
vartayiṣye rudrabhaktyā vanyamūlaphalādibhiḥ ||72||
dharmamātraṃ kariṣye ca rakṣatu māṃ satīpatiḥ |
ityevaṃ mānatāṃ kṛtvā sakuṭumbo gṛhe jale ||73||
bhajanaṃ pracakārāsau rudrasya matsvarūpiṇaḥ |
hara kaṣṭaṃ hara duḥkhaṃ rakṣa prāṇān satīpate ||74||
mahādeva mahākāla brahmaviṣṇusvarūpavan |
jaya śaṃbho jaya rudra jaya śrīpārvatīpate ||75||
jayāntakāla rakṣa tvaṃ tvadīyo’smi prajīvaya |
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre tallīnaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ ||76||
rudrecchayāsya vāristhaṃ taradgṛhaṃ taṭaṃ yayau |
pūrāṇāṃ vigame so’pi gṛhānnirgatya bhūtalam ||77||
avatīrya yayau dūraṃ yatrāste śrīvanaṃ puram |
bhikṣayodarayātrāṃ ca tadā śākādibhirvyadhāt ||78||
tataḥ pārśve’raṇyabhāge yayau kuṭumbaśobhitaḥ |
rudramārādhayāmāsa varjayitvā svadurguṇān ||79||
pañcasamvatsaraḥ kālaścaivaṃ tvasya jagāma ha |
phalamūlāśanasyaiva tāvadrudraḥ samāyayau ||3.156.80||
satīyuto’tisaumyaśca vanī yogī yathā mahān |
prāha ghṛṇin kathaṃ cāste vane kiṃ te samīhitam ||81 ||
rudro’haṃ vada ceṣṭaṃ te dadāmi toṣitastvayā |
ghṛṇeṣikastadā vavre putratvaṃ rājyamityapi ||82||
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha pūjāṃ labdhvā tiro’bhavat |
ghṛṇeṣikaśca varṣānte jvareṇa sakuṭumbakaḥ ||83||
dehaṃ tyaktvā yayau divyagaṇo bhūtvā kilāsakam |
yatra rudro mahādevo virājate satīpatiḥ ||84||
rudraputro’bhavattatra rudragṛhe’vasat sadā |
bhavitā rudrasāvarṇirmanuḥ sāmrājyabhogavān ||85||
ityevaṃ te kathito’yaṃ manurdvādaśasaṃkhyakaḥ |
trayodaśaṃ manuṃ devasāvarṇiṃ śṛṇu padmaje ||86||
brāhmaṇo’bhūt purā ketumāle dīnānadītaṭe |
vaiṣṇavo yajñabhāgāditatparo devapūjakaḥ ||87||
ṣoḍaśādyupacārai saḥ sūryaṃ viṣṇuṃ satīṃ haram |
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayatyeva tarpayatyeva vai pitṝn ||88||
yajñe devān ghṛtādyaiśca tarpayatyeva nityadā |
tasya cāhaṃ prasannaśca yajñe tadgocaro’bhavam ||89||
varārthaṃ rodhayāmāsa yayāce sa varottamam |
sāmrājyaṃ tava pūjārthaṃ devapūjārthamityapi ||3.156.90||
ante brahmapadaṃ cāpi pradehi me’dhvarāyaṇa |
tathāstviti mayā datto varastasmai mahātmane ||91 ||
sudharmanāmne tasmai vai varaṃ datvā tiro’bhavam |
so’pi dehaṃ parityajya ruceḥ prajāpatergṛhe ||92||
mālinyāṃ putra evāsau jāto devābhidhaḥ khalu |
raucyaḥ sa bhavitā lakṣmi devasāvarṇināmakaḥ ||93||
devatāśca militvaiva manutve sthāpanaṃ tadā |
kariṣyantyasya devasya trayodaśasya vai manoḥ ||94||
rucirvai brahmaṇaḥ putro brahmacaryamuvāsa ha |
pitarastaṃ tadā prāhurgārhasthyaṃ kuru putraka ||95||
putreṇa pitṝṇāṃ syādvai proddhārastṛptirityapi |
tataḥ śrāddhaṃ cakārāsau gārhasthyaṃ pracakāra ha ||96||
mālinyāṃ ca sutaṃ raucyaṃ janayāmāsa vai manum |
trayodaśo manuḥ so’yaṃ bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||97||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne navamāditrayodaśamanūnāṃ prāgjanmajanmacaritrāṇāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 156 ||

<3.157>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
ruciḥ prajāpatirvijño hyanicchannapi bhāminīm|
gārhasthyaṃ parijagrāha vistarāt tad vadasva me || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā gārhasthyamāptavān |
sādhudharmān rarakṣāpi gṛhadharmānavāptavān || 2 ||
nirmamo nirahaṃkāro mitaśāyī mitāśanaḥ |
vartate sma rucirlakṣmi sarvasaṃgavivarjitaḥ || 3 ||
anagnimaniketaṃ tamekāhāramanāśramam |
vimuktasaṃgaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā procustatpitaro rucim || 4 ||
vatsa kasmād bhavānnaiva karoti dārasaṃgraham |
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ sukhadaṃ dharmyaṃ svargādisādhanam || 5 ||
ṛṇahaṃ mokṣadaṃ vaṃśayaśolābhapradaṃ śubham |
bandhavināśanaṃ sarvavāsanākṣayakāriṇam || 6 ||
sadāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca satāmapi |
ṛṣīṇāmatithīnāṃ ca sevābhiḥ svargamāpnuyāt || 7 ||
sa tvaṃ daivamṛṇaṃ pitṛṛṇaṃ ṛṣiṛṇaṃ tathā |
avāpnoṣi vinā dārān bandhanaṃ ca dine dine || 8 ||
sutotpattiṃ vinā putra devasantarpaṇaṃ vinā |
ṛṣitṛptiṃ vinā naiva prayāsyasi parāṃ gatim || 9 ||
kleśo dāragrahe yo’sti vinā dārān tato’dhikaḥ |
aihikaśca paratrāpi tasmāt putra gṛhī bhava ||3.157.1 0||
adārasyāpyayajñasya vaṃśavirahitasya ca |
mṛtasya nirayaḥ syādvai tasmātputra gṛhī bhava || 1 1||
śrutvā ruciḥ pratyuvāca pitṝn dharmyaṃ vacaḥ śubham |
manye’haṃ pitaro vo’stu namo yathā vadāmi tat || 12||
brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ brahmatulyaṃ ca muktidam |
muktimicchāmi tenāhaṃ svargaṃ me naiva rocate ||1 3||
ityevaṃ kṛtabodhasya mama dāraprasaṃgrahaḥ |
pāpakleśātiduḥkhārttivyādhyadhogatido mataḥ ||14||
ātmendriyāditattvānāṃ nigraho mokṣado mataḥ |
dāragrahe sa na syācca kāmarāgābhipūrite || 15||
kardamo dārayogottho vāsanātmā vivardhate |
anekabhavasaṃbhūtaḥ karmapaṃko’pi tuṣyati || 16||
kardamitaścāyamātmā brahmatīrthāplavādibhiḥ |
bhāvanābhaktitoyādyai prakṣālyo vai vivekibhiḥ ||17||
kṣālayāmi purālagnaṃ kardamaṃ vāsanāmayam |
yogyaṃ karomi pitaro brahmacaryaparastvaham ||18||
bhavatāṃ tu samuddhārī mayā kartuṃ hi śakyate |
brahmacaryabalenaiva bandhaṃ doṣān jahāmi ca ||1 9||
ityuktāḥ pitaraḥ prāhuḥ putra yuktaṃ hi tattathā |
mokṣamārgo brahmacaryaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||3.157.20||
mārge vighnāḥ purā prāptāḥ pāpāśubhadurītikāḥ |
ahaṃmamatvamāyādyāḥ karmāṇyasaṃkhyakānyapi ||21 ||
purākṛtāni sarvāṇi bhogāya kalpitāni ca |
puṇyāpuṇyāni cātraiva kṣālanīyāni sarvathā ||22||
tāni bhuñjan kṣālayam̐śca navaṃ kurvan sunirguṇam |
sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ kṛṣṇe bandhaṃ jahan vimuktaye ||23||
yo yātrāṃ vartayatyatra tasya bandho na jāyate |
prākkṛtasya samāptiśca phalaṃ nirvighnamokṣaṇam ||24||
evaṃ prakṣālanaṃ yuktaṃ krameṇa karmaṇāṃ suta |
nāyaṃ vai gaṇyate putrāvivekaḥ pāpapaṃkadaḥ ||25||
tasmād dārānvito bhūtvā bhuṃkṣva tyaja vimocaya |
upakāraṃ paraṃ kṛtvā yāhi śāśvatamakṣaram ||26||
itipitṛvacaḥ śrutvā rucirāha pitāmahān |
karmamārgo’styavidyā vai tatra mā yojayantu mām ||27||
ajñānaṃ cāpi karmāpi narakaṃ tulyameva tat |
naiṣkarmyaṃ procyate siddhirnairṣkarmyaṃ sādhayāmyaham ||28||
śrutvaitat pitarastasya satyaṃ jagaduruttaram |
karma tādṛk prakartavyaṃ yena vidyā samarjyate ||29||
vidyayā vilayaṃ yāyādavidyājñānasaṃjñikā |
vihitākaraṇāt putrāvidyājñānaṃ prapuṣyati ||3.157.30||
vihitākaraṇaṃ cānyatkaraṇaṃ bandhadaṃ bhavet |
vihitākaraṇe cet syāt saṃyamaḥ so’pi dharmahā ||31 ||
sa na syānmuktaye kintu cānte’dhogatikārakaḥ |
prakṣālanaṃ na pāpānāṃ pratyutārjanameva tat ||22||
vihitākaraṇodbhūtaiḥ pāpaiḥ sarvaṃ pradahyati |
pratyavāyānudbhavārthaṃ vihitaṃ tvācarecchubham ||33||
brahmacaryottaraṃ putra gārhasthyaṃ vihitaṃ yataḥ |
tatkarma yadi nirayo viṣavad viṣahārakam ||34||
gārhasthyaviṣayogena pratyavāyaviṣaṃ jahi |
gārhasthyaṃ samanuṣṭhāya vaninā tadviṣaṃ jahi ||35||
sannyāsena tataḥ putra vaniviṣaṃ sadā jahi |
brahmātmārpaṇalābhena dehendriyādikaṃ jahi |||36|||
paramātmaprasaṃgena svātmabhāvaṃ tato jahi |
evaṃ kramaṃ samāruhya paramārohaṇaṃ kuru ||37||
ityuktvā pitaraḥ sarve’dṛśyā yayurnijālayam |
rucirmanasā sañcintya bhāryārthaṃ matimādadhāt ||38||
brahmāṇaṃ pitaraṃ smṛtvā tapo vyadhāt punarbahu |
brahmā tvāgatyāha ruciṃ bhavitā tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ ||39||
prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā sutān labdhvā kṛtvā ca vaidikī kriyāḥ |
cāturāśramyamāsthāya saṃsthāpya ca prajāsu tat ||3.157.40||
dārayogottaraṃ karmaphalaṃ bhuktvā navaṃ navam |
pitṛtṛptiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā parāṃ siddhimavāpsyasi ||41 ||
tuṣṭāste pitaraḥ patnīṃ sutān dāsyanti cepsitān |
ājñāṃkite prasantuṣṭāḥ kinna dadyaḥ pitāmahāḥ |||42||
iti vākyaṃ vedhaso’pi lakṣmi śrutvā ruciḥ svayam |
tuṣṭāva vedhasaṃ cāpi pupūja jalapuṣpakaiḥ ||43||
brahmā tiro’bhavattatra nadītīre rucistataḥ |
pitṝn santarpya tuṣṭāva praṇato bhaktigauravaḥ ||44||
namasye śrīharikṛṣṇaṃ śāśvataṃ vai pitāmaham |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||45||
namasye śrībrahmadhāmākṣaraṃ muktān maheśvarān |
namasye sarvaśaktyaiśvaryāṇi guṇān pitāmahān ||46||
hetīn samastabhūtīśca vibhūtīrīśvarīṃstathā |
muktānikā avatārān mātṝm̐śca śrīramādikāḥ ||47||
namasye vyūhasaṃjñām̐śca namasye ca virājakān |
namasye satyalokasthān sādhūn brahmavidaḥ sataḥ ||48||
namasye tān śrāddhapitṝn śrāddhe ye cādhidevatāḥ |
devairapi ca tarpyante ye śrāddhe tānnamāmyaham ||49||
namasye’haṃ ca tān svarge tarpyante ye maharṣibhiḥ |
tathā siddhajanaiścāpi tarpyante tānnamāmyaham ||3.157.50||
guhyakairapi yercyante ṛddhyarthaṃ tānnamāmyaham |
namasye’haṃ ca tān pitṝn ye’rcyante mānavairbhuvi ||51 ||
namasye’haṃ ca tān pitṝn sveṣṭalokapradāyinaḥ |
ye’rcyante śraddhayā vipraiḥ śrāddhakarmasu tarpitāḥ ||||2||
prājāpatyapadadātṝn namasye vanitarpitāḥ |
tānnamasye naiṣṭhikānāṃ phaladātṝn prapūjitān ||53||
rājanyatarpitān pitṝnnamasye makhapūjitān |
vaiśyaprapūjitān pitṝn namasye kavyabhojanān ||54||
śūdrārcitānnamasye tān sukālino’nnapūjitān |
āsurārcitapitṝm̐śca ravadhāhārānnamāmi ca ||55||
pātālavāsino yān ye tarpyante śrāddhakarmasu |
svadhāhārān namasye’haṃ rāsātalaiḥ prapūjitān ||56||
bhogairaśeṣairnāgādyaiḥ sarvaiścāpi prapūjitān |
pitṝnnamasye dyusthām̐ścāntarikṣāsthān mahīsthitān ||57||
vimānasthān mūrtarūpān pitṝnnamāmi sarvadā |
yogijanaiḥ pūjitām̐stān kleśamuktipradān śubhān ||58||
pitṝm̐stām̐śca namasye’haṃ mūrtān svadhābhujaḥ sadā |
kāmyaphalapradān sarvān svargasthān mokṣadānapi ||59||
tṛpyantvicchāvatāṃ kāmapradāḥ suratvaputradāḥ |
aindrasaurapadadāśca paśusvagṛhaśaktidāḥ ||3.157.60||
candre sūrye raśmivāsā vimānasthā jalānnakaiḥ |
gandharasādibhiḥ sarve tṛpyantāṃ cāmṛtapradāḥ ||61 ||
agnau hutānnabhoktāro havirbhujo’pi ye’pare |
vipradehanivāsāśca sādhudehanivāsinaḥ ||62||
piṇḍādāstṛptimāyāntu mayārpitāpkalādibhiḥ |
kṛṣṇatilaiḥ śākapatraiḥ prīṇitā yantu te mudam ||63||
kavyādāścāmarapūjyāḥ puṣpagandhānnabhojanaiḥ |
tṛptimāyāntu te sarve pitaraḥ svargadāyinaḥ ||64||
pratyahaṃ pūjitā māsapūjitā ye’ṣṭakāsu ca |
samānte’bhyudaye pūjyāstṛpyantu pitaro’pi me ||65||
śvetā viprārcitāsvārkavarṇāḥ kṣatriyapūjitāḥ |
svarṇavarṇā vaiśyapūjyā nīlāḥ śūdraprapūjitāḥ ||66||
puṣpagandharasairdhūpaistoyānnaphalapatrakaiḥ |
agnihutena cājyena tṛptiṃ yāntu nato’smi tān ||67||
devapūrvāḥ kavyabhujo bhūtisrajo bhavanti ye |
bhūtapretāsurarakṣaugrapitṝn namāmyapi ||68||
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāstathā |
te’pi tṛptiṃ prapadyantāṃ tarpitāḥ śraddhayā mayā ||69||
prācīṃ rakṣantvagniṣvāttā yāmyāṃ barhiṣadastathā |
pratīcīmājyapā rakṣantvudīcīṃ somapā mama ||3.157.70||
rakṣobhūtapiśācebhyo duṣṭābhicāramantrataḥ |
āsurapretadehibhyo yamo rakṣatu māṃ sadā ||71||
ekatriṃśatpitṛgaṇāstuṣṭā yacchantu me hitam |
viśvā viśvabhujo dharmā dhanyāḥ śubhānanāstathā ||72||
ārādhyā bhūtidā bhūtikṛtaśca bhūtayo nava |
kalyāṇāḥ kalyatāḥ kartāraśca kalpatvahetavaḥ ||73||
kalyatarāśrayāśceti ṣaṭṭepitṛgaṇāstathā |
varā vareṇyā varadāḥ puṣṭidāstuṣṭidāstathā ||74||
dhātāro viśvapātāraḥ sapta pitṛgaṇāśca te |
mahāntaśca mahātmāno mahitāśca mahābalāḥ ||75||
mahimavantaityete pañca pitṛgaṇāstathā |
sukhadā dhanadaścāpi dharmadā bhūtidāstathā ||76||
gaṇāścatvāra evāpi sarve tuṣyantu me’rcitāḥ |
evaṃ vai stuvatastasya rucestu tejasāṃ cayaḥ ||77||
samutthitaḥ purataśca taṃ tuṣṭāva rucistadā |
amūrtānarcitānatra tejomayānupasthitān ||78||
namasyāmi dhyānagamyān pitṝm̐stān divyavigrahān |
indrādīśān dakṣamārīcarṣinetṝn namāmi ca ||79||
manumunīndracandrārkeśvarān pitṝnnamāmi ca |
jalevāsān grahanakṣatreśān vāyvagnipūjitān ||3.157.80||
nabhaḥsthān bhūsvargavāsān namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ |
devarṣijanakām̐ścāpyakṣayyadātṝn namāmi ca ||81 ||
prajeśāya kaśyapāya somāya varuṇāya ca |
yogeśvarebhyaḥ siddhebhyaḥ sadbhyo namāmi sāñjaliḥ ||82||
saptalokagaṇebhyaśca svayaṃbhūparameṣṭhine |
somadhrebhyaśca namaḥ somāya ca namo namaḥ ||83 ||
agnirūpān yoginaśca namasyāmyadhvarasthitān |
tejaḥsthān somasūryāgnimūrtīnnamāmi vai pitṝn ||84||
vrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ siddhān brahmacaryaparāyaṇān |
namāmi satyalokasthānīśvarānāvṛtisthitān ||85||
vairājān vaiṣṇavān bhaumān śrīpurasthāḥ śrīyoṣitaḥ |
avyākṛtāmṛtasthām̐śca golokasthān namāni ca ||86||
vaikuṇṭhasthānakṣarasthānavatārān namāmi ca |
avatāriṇīśca sarvā muktānikā namāmi ca ||87||
muktām̐śca pārṣadān sarvānaiśvaryāṇi namāmi ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīvallabham prabhum ||88||
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca mātṝrharipriyāstathā |
hetīn guṇān vibhūtīṃśca namāmi prasīdantu me ||89||
itistutāste pitarastejaso niryayuḥ śubhāḥ |
niveditānnapuṣpādyairyuktāśca purataḥ sthitāḥ ||3.157.90||
punarnatāstu te prāhuḥ putra patnīyuto bhava |
tasyāṃ sutaste bhavitā raucyo nāma mahāmanuḥ ||9 1 ||
anye sutā bhaviṣyanti te’pi te pṛthivībhujaḥ |
tvaṃ ca prajāpatirbhūtvā prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā caturvidhāḥ ||92||
kṣīṇādhikāro bhakto naḥ siddhimāpsyasi muktigām |
etatstotrapravaktṛm̐śca kariṣyāmaḥ samṛddhigān ||93||
etatstotraprapāṭhena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī |
vikale’pi kṛte śrāddhe saguṇaṃ stotrakīrtanāt ||94||
ityukte sahasā lakṣmi nadīmadhyāt pramlocanā |
apsarā vai samuttasthau sakanyā śubhadarśanā ||95||
varuṇasya tu putrasya puṣkarasya priyā hi sā |
uvāca taṃ ruciṃ ruce bhāryāṃ gṛhāṇa matsutām ||96||
mayā dattāṃ mama putrīṃ manurasyāṃ bhaviṣyati |
tatheti ruciṇoktā sā mālinīṃ putrikāṃ dadau ||97||
ruciḥ pāṇiṃ prajagrāha putrastasyāṃ tato’bhavat |
raucyo devo manuḥ so’yaṃ bhavitā vai trayodaśaḥ ||98||
mahābhāgavato bhakto’dhikārānte vimokṣyate |
etatpavitramanaghaṃ pitrākhyānārcanādikam ||99||
paṭhitvā mucyate kaṣṭād vibhūtyā yujyate tathā |
lakṣmi bhuktiṃ labhetātra muktiṃ cānte labhedapi || 3.157.1 00||
pitṛpūjāphalaṃ cāpi vaṃśaṃ svargaṃ labhedapi |
sampallakṣmīṃ labhetāpi paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 101 ||
dharmavṛddhiṃ tathārogyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyādikaṃ labhet |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti pitṛprasannatārjitān ||1 02||
sarvānandapramodām̐śca sarvasaukhyāni cāśnute |
gārhasthyaṃ nirguṇaṃ tasya jāyate pitṛbhaktitaḥ ||1 0 3|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne ruciprajāpateḥ pitṛdarśanaṃ stavanaṃ gārhasthyārthamādeśo gārhasthyaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 157 ||

<3.158>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vacmi manuṃ caturdaśam |
indrasāvarṇināmānaṃ bhautyaṃ bhūte sutaṃ śubham || 1 ||
babhūvāṅgirasaḥ śiṣyo bhūtirnāmnātikopanaḥ |
caṇḍaḥ śāpapradaścālpepyarthe kaṭhoravāg ruṣā || 2 ||
evaṃvidhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā bhītyā tasyāśramāntike |
ke’pi naiva prayāntyeva devā api tu bibhyati || 3 ||
ata eva mātariśvā na vavāvatiniṣṭhuraḥ |
nātipāpaṃ raviścakre parjanyo nātikardamam || 4 ||
nātiśītaṃ ca śītāṃśurvahnirnātīva dahyati |
api vṛkṣāstato bhītā vallayaśca tṛṇādayaḥ || 5 ||
anṛtāvapi puṣpādi phalādismṛddhayo’niśam |
bhavantyeva ca vartante ṛtavo’pi tadāśrame || 6 ||
jalāni saritastasyāśramasamīpagāni vai |
kamaṇḍalugatāścāpi bhavanti tadbhayād rame || 7 ||
evaṃvidho hi bhūtiḥ so’napatyaḥ putrakāmyayā |
tapastepe bahukālaṃ śītavātānalāhataḥ || 8 ||
yatāhāraḥ kṛśo’bhūccānavāpyāpi yathepsitam |
nyavartata tapasaḥ so’bhavanmāṃ parameśvaram || 9 ||
tamekadāgrajo bhrātā suvarcākhyo nije makhe |
samājuhāva tenāsau yiyāsurnijaśiṣyakam || 3.158.1 0||
śāntidharmābhidhaṃ cāha gacchāmi cāgrajādhvaram |
prati jāgaraṇaṃ vahnestvayā kāryaṃ mamāśrame || 11 ||
yathāgnirna śamaṃ yāyāttathāśramaṃ ca bhālaya |
itiśiṣyaṃ samājñāpya bhrāturyajñaṃ yayau hi saḥ || 12||
atha śāntiḥ samitpuṣpaphalādyarthaṃ vanaṃ yayau |
āgatya cāśramasevāṃ kurute mārjanādikam || 13|||
yāvatsamitpradānārthaṃ vahniśālāṃ yayau hi saḥ |
tāvacchānto’nalastaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā cintāparo’bhavat || 14||
bhūterbhayāccātibhītaḥ śuśocātyantaduḥkhitaḥ |
kiṃ karomi mayā kiṃ ca pratipattavyamatra vai || 15||
praśāntāgnimimaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ yadi paśyati me guruḥ |
tato māṃ viṣame tūrṇaṃ vyasane sa niyokṣyati || 16||
yadanyamagnimatrāhamagnisthāne karomi cet |
guruḥ pratyakṣadṛg jñātvā māṃ bhasma prakariṣyati || 17||
so’haṃ jāto gurostasya nimittaṃ kopaśāpayoḥ |
dṛṣṭvā praśāntamanalaṃ nūnaṃ śapsyati māṃ guruḥ || 18||
athavā pāvakaḥ kruddho’vaśyaṃ dhakṣyati māṃ tadā |
astu jātaṃ tu tajjātaṃ nājātaṃ tad bhaviṣyati || 19||
upāyastatra kartavyo’parādhasya praśāntaye |
yasyāparādhastasyaivābhyarthanā tu kṣamātmikā ||3.158.20||
kartavyātra mayā so’yaṃ dharmo’tra prathamo mama |
vicāryetthaṃ sa matimān vahristotraṃ jagau tadā ||21 ||
śaraṇaṃ pāvakaṃ gatvā tvekacittaḥ stavaṃ vyadhāt |
oṃ namo’nantaśaktyugraśaktyātmane hareḥ prabhoḥ ||22||
oṃ namaḥ sarvalokānāṃ makhasādhanamūrtaye |
ekadvipañcadhiṣṭyāya rājasūye ṣaḍātmane ||23||
pratyakṣadevarūpāya namaste devavṛttaye |
sarvavarṣmavatāṃ śukrarūpāya baline namaḥ ||24||
tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvadevānāmīśvarāṇāṃ harerapi |
tvaṃ pākaḥ sarvabhūtānāmannānāṃ rasināṃ tathā |||25||
hutaṃ havirbhakṣayam̐stvaṃ meghatvāya karoṣi vai |
vṛṣṭirūpaṃ tu tad bhūtvauṣadhivrātān prapuṣyati |||26|||
tatphalādyairbhūtavāsāḥ sukhaṃ jīvanti jantavaḥ |
tatsamidbhirjanā yajñān prakurvanti surā api ||27||
daityāśca rākṣasāścāpi tvadādhārā vibhāvaso |
jarāyūjāścāṇḍajāśca svedajā bhūmijā api || 28||
āpyāyante tvayā sarve saṃvṛdhyante tvayānala |
saṃrakṣyante tvayā sarve tathā māṃ parirakṣaya |||29||
deveṣu taijasatvaṃ vai kānti siddheṣu vai bhavān |
viṣaṃ nāgeṣu cāsse tvaṃ vāyubhāgaḥ patatriṣu ||3.158.30||
manujeṣu paśupakṣigaṇe krodho bhavānapi |
avaṣṭaṃbhaśca taruṣu kāṭhinyaṃ tvaṃ kṣitāvapi ||3 1 ||
jale dravo bhavāneva javo bhavān hi vāyuṣu |
vyāpakastvaṃ nabhasyeva sarvaṃbhūtāntarasthitaḥ ||32||
tvamekastrividhaścāpyaṣṭadhā sahasradhāpi ca |
svāhāsvadhādibhirbhoktā havyakavyasya vai bhavān || 33||
hetiṣvāpi bhavāneva dhārāsu saṃvirājate |
jātavedo namastubhyaṃ piṃgākṣa te namo’stu ca ||34||
hutāśana namaste’stu namaste havyavāhana |
pāvakādya namaste’stu namaste viśvapāvaka ||35||
pākakartarnamaste’stu poṣṭaste ca namo namaḥ |
tvaṃ jyotistvaṃ mahādityo vibhāvaso namo’stu te ||36||
hiraṇyaretā vahnistvaṃ saptajihva namo’stu te |
kālī karālī ca manojavā ca lohitā tathā || 37||
dhūmrā sphullaṃginī viśvā saptajihvāḥ śubhāstava |
kālaniṣṭhākarī cādyā dvitīyā pralayaṃkarī ||38||
tṛtīyā laghimākāryā caturthī kāmakāriṇī |
pañcamī rogadā ṣaṣṭhī sarvapudgalakāriṇī ||39||
saptamī śarmadā jvālā tābhyaḥ pāhi mahābhayāt |
piṃgākṣa lohitagrīva kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ hutāśana ||3.158.40 ||
trāhi māṃ bhayato vahne kṛśāno havyavāhana |
sāmudravāḍavākhyastvaṃ jāṭharastvaṃ tu pācanaḥ ||41 ||
vaiśvānaraḥ somapastvaṃ havirbhuk pāhi māṃ bhayāt |
tavārcibhiḥ spṛṣṭametad dravyaṃ śuci prajāyate ||42||
bhasmanā te śuci sarvaṃ māṃ śuciṃ tva vidhāpaya |
pitā putra tathā māṃ tvaṃ rakṣa prāptabhayādiha ||43||
prakāśaṃ svayamāyāhi bhaktasyātra kṛte’nala |
yathā māṃ na gururbhūtirdahecchāpena rakṣaya ||44||
evaṃ stuto’nalastasya śānteragre sumūrtimān |
prītaścāgatyāha śāntiṃ bhayaṃ mā te gurormama ||45||
tuṣṭo’smi tava bhaktyāhaṃ stotreṇāpi varaṃ vṛṇu |
śāntiḥ prāha bhayahīno bhavāmi tava darśanāt ||46||
gururbhūtiḥ samāgatya tvāṃ paśyatu dhiṣṇyagam |
aputrasya guroḥ putro viśiṣṭaśca bhavatvapi ||47||
ityukto’naladevaśca prāha prasannatānvitaḥ |
gurvarthaṃ varadānaṃ te nātmārthaṃ ca tvayārthitam ||48||
tato’dhikaṃ prasanno’smi tathāstviti dadāmyaham |
manvantarādhipaḥ putro bhautyo nāma gurostava ||49||
caturdaśo mahendrādisthāpyaḥ prājño bhaviṣyati |
guruḥ śāntipriyaścāpi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||3.158.50 ||
ahaṃ kuṇḍe bhavāmyeva jvālāyuktaḥ samitsu ca |
etatstotreṇa me stotā niṣpāpo yajñapuṇyabhāg ||51 ||
upadravavihīnaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktvā bhagavānagniḥ kuṇḍe tatrāvasaddhasan ||52||
athājagāma bhūtiśca sauhārdapūrito’bhavat |
papraccha śiṣyaṃ hetuṃ ca sauhārdasya śamasya ca ||53||
śāntiḥ sarvaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ yathāvat prāha bhūtaye |
prasannaḥ sa gururbhūtvā vedān śiṣyāya vai dadau ||54||
bhautyo nāma manuḥ putro bhūtestatrāpyajāyata |
śucirindrastathā devā bhautyaṃ manuṃ ca jagṛhuḥ |||55||
indrasāvarṇināmānaṃ manvantaraṃ ca devatāḥ |
pupūjuḥ sarvathā tatra puṣpākṣatasucandanaiḥ ||56||
evaṃ lakṣmi bhavitāyamindrasāvarṇināmakaḥ |
sāyaṃ tato manuḥ so’yaṃ kathitaste caturdaśaḥ ||57||
manūn śrutvā śivarājñīlakṣmi santatimuttamām |
sarvakāmān dhanaṃ jñānaṃ buddhiṃ bhāryāṃ surūpiṇīm ||58||
ārogyaṃ ca balaṃ pautraṃ putraṃ māhātmyamuttamam |
śubhaṃ matiṃ jayaṃ jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ ca labhate bahu ||59||
arināśaṃ surāṇāṃ ca prasannatāṃ pravindati |
pāpebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo mucyate śravaṇādapi ||3.158.60||
śrutaṃ dharmaṃ ca sammānaṃ sveṣṭaṃ labhate sampadaḥ |
gāḥ pṛthivīṃ nṛpatitvaṃ pradhānatvaṃ ca vindati ||61||
āyuṣyamudayaṃ cāpi vairāgyaṃ labhate tataḥ |
ādhyātmikyunnatiṃ svargaṃ śrīmattvaṃ labhate tathā ||62|
manavastu madaṃśāste mayā nivāsitā rame |
tatpūjā mama pūjaiva tatkathā matkathā matā ||63||
tatra tejo mayā kṣiptaṃ cakravartitvadāyakam |
ārādhanena me te vai bhaktā me manavo’bhavan ||64||
bhaviṣyantyapare cāpi kalpāntareṣu te’pi ca |
babhūvuścāpi ye te’pi madaṃśā manavo matāḥ ||65||
manvādyatithayaḥ sarvāvratātmikāḥ supuṇyadāḥ |
pavitrā dānakartṝṇāṃ svargadā bhūpatitvadāḥ ||66||
iti lakṣmi mayā prokto manūnāmudbhavastava |
brūhi kiṃ śrotumicchā te vartate tad vadāmi hi ||67||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne caturdaśasya manorākhyānamitinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 158 ||

<3.159>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
tṛptāhaṃ bhavato vākyāmṛtaiḥ śāśvatamodinī |
vihartuṃ vai vimānena yāsyāmo yadi rocase || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sarvabrahmapriyāścāpi haripriyāstathāparāḥ |
sajjā bhavantu vai sarvā yāsyāmo himavadgirim || 2 ||
ityuktāstāḥ samastā vai sajjāstūrṇaṃ śriyā saha |
abhavan kṛtaśṛṃgārā āruruhurvimānakam || 3 ||
atyutsāhayutā nāryo kāntena hariṇā saha |
ākṣareṇa vimānena yayurdeśān vilokitum || 4 ||
catuṣṭilādriṃ saṃvīkṣyānartadeśān vilokya ca |
camatkārapuraṃ nārāyaṇīśrīgirimīkṣya ca || 5 ||
suvarṇadvīpamīkṣyāpi samudraṃ pravilaṃghya ca |
nārāyaṇasaro vīkṣya kacchamullaṃghya sindhukīm || 6 ||
nadīṃ snātvā pāvayitvā vīkṣya śilavatparvatam |
indukuśaṃ pravīkṣyāmi kārukāraṃ pravīkṣya ca || 7 ||
śrīnagaraṃ kaśyapāraṃ vīkṣya himādrimāyayuḥ |
saptasindhuparvatām̐śca vīkṣya nandāsatīṃ yayuḥ || 8 ||
tayā sampūjitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇā brahmapriyādikāḥ |
prāpya pūjāṃ tayā dattāṃ tāmāśliṣya hṛdambujaiḥ || 9 ||
nandāṃ devīṃ pāvayitvā samaikṣanta vanāni tāḥ |
gaṃgāṃ suśobhitāṃ cāpi samaikṣanta sulambitām ||3.159.1 0||
gandharvādyaiḥ samākīrṇāṃ nityaṃ devādisevitām |
surebhamadasaṃsiktāṃ samantāddhastirājitām || 1 1||
tapasviśaraṇopetāṃ devabrāhmaṇasevitām |
sitahaṃsāvalicchannāṃ kāśacāmararājitām || 11 ||
puṇyāṃ suśītalāṃ hṛdyāṃ manasāṃ prītivardhinīm |

dhanyo’smi kṛtakṛtyo’smītyuktvā pupūja kāraṇam |
pūjāṃ kṛtvābhavattatrādṛśyo mūrtau bhujaṅgamaḥ ||39||
parameśastato’pyagre himādrerbhavanaṃ yayau |
sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaprabhāyuktaṃ samṛddhikam ||3.160.40||
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ sarvabhojyasamanvitam |
sarvapeyayutaṃ divyaṃ komalāsanaśobhitam ||41 ||
sarvasugandhasaṃvyāptaṃ kalpalatābhiśobhitam |
sarvakāmapradaṃ dāsadāsīkoṭisamanvitam ||42||
svarṇahīrakaratnānāṃ siṃhāsanena rājitam |
tasminnyaṣādayatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi menakā ||43||
pupūja parayā prītyārārtrikaṃ pracakāra ca |
haristatrāmṛtabhojyaṃ gṛhītvā copadādikam ||44||
pāvayitvālayaṃ cādrestvājñayāgre’mbare yayau |
vimānena drutaṃ prāpa kedāraṃ śikharaṃ śubham ||45||
kedāreśo mahādevaḥ śrīpateḥ purato’bhavat |
pupūja paramātmānaṃ brahmapriyādisaṃyutam ||46||
bahuratnādibhiścāpi phalapuṣpādibhistathā |
labdhvā pūjāṃ hariścāgre yayau kailāsaparvatam ||47||
tripurārisevitaṃ ca kalpadrumasamanvitam |
śaṃkaraḥ sarvagaṇayuk satīyug vīkṣya mādhavam ||48||
samīpe cājagāmāpi pupūja parameśvaram |
kubero guhyakaiḥ sākaṃ pupūja śrīpatiṃ harim ||49||
sarvaratnaiḥ phalapuṣpaiḥ prāpya pūjāṃ haristataḥ |
saugandhikaṃ giriṃ vīkṣya suvelaṃ parvataṃ tathā ||3.160.50||
candraprabhaṃ giriṃ cāpi divyamacchodakaṃ saraḥ |
caitrarathaṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya sarvauṣadhiṃ giriṃ tathā ||51 ||
divyāraṇyaṃ viśokākhyaṃ vīkṣya kakudminaṃ girim |
vaidyutaṃ ca giriṃ vīkṣya vaibhrājaṃ ca vanaṃ tataḥ ||52||
aruṇaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya śailodaṃ ca sarastataḥ |
gauraṃ tu parvataṃ vīkṣya saraḥ kāñcanavālukam ||53||
rājataṃ bhrājamānaṃ vai himādriṃ bhūmimaṇḍalam |
ūrdhvaṃ cābbhrasamudraṃ vai vīkṣamāṇāḥ puro yayuḥ ||54|| 
parvatānāṃ śreṇikāśca dṛṣṭvā śrīmānasaṃ saraḥ |
vyalokayan vimānasthā kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ suharṣitāḥ ||55||
kṛṣṇena sākaṃ tattīre cāvateruḥ samantataḥ |
srasnustāḥ svāminā sākaṃ cakruśca jalakhelanam ||56||
snapayanti snāpayanti samāśliṣyanti mādhavam |
harṣayanti modayanti snānti modanta ityapi ||57||
ānandayanti kāntaṃ śrīhariṇā hṛdi saṃdhṛtāḥ |
ānanditāḥ kāntamayyo rañjayanti priyaṃ striyaḥ ||58||
patiṃ vividhaceṣṭābhī rañjayanti tadaṅganāḥ |
kamalāni samādāya kānte tā yojayanti vai ||59||
kāścidātāḍayan kāntamudakaiḥ karatāḍitaiḥ |
tāḍyamānāśca kāntena prītimatyo’bhavam̐stadā ||3.160.60 ||
adṛśyanta tadā lakṣmyaḥ śvāsanṛtyatpayodharāḥ |
kāntāmbutāḍanocchīrṇakeśapāśanibandhanāḥ ||61 ||
snātāḥ śītāpadeśena kāścitkāntaṃ samāśliṣat |
evaṃ kāntaṃ rāmayitvā ramayitvā tataḥ striyaḥ ||62||
niryayurmaṇḍayanti sma gātrāṇi taṭamāsthitāḥ |
śṛṃgārayanti gātrāṇi bhūṣayanti vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||63||
sajjā bhūtvā vimānasthā babhūvuḥ pativāñcchayā |
vimānena tataḥ sarvā dhavalaṃ girimāyayuḥ ||64||
tataśca vanaśobhāḍhyaṃ hanumatparvataṃ yayuḥ |
hanūmatā pūjitaśca śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||65||
lakṣmyā sampūjitaścāpi hanūmān tapasaḥ sthitau |
sahāyakṛt parvate’pi purā rakṣākaraḥ kapiḥ ||66||
tato vimānamārgeṇa yayurgagāṃ tu kāñcanīm |
jalāni tatra pītvaiva śiveśvarapurīṃ yayuḥ ||67||
vārāṇasīṃ mahāśreṣṭhāṃ pāvanīṃ varaṇānvitām |
gaṃgāṃ suśobhanāṃ prāpya dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ śivam |
viśveśvaragṛhe sarvā rātriṃ ninyuḥ sukhānvitām ||68||
śaṃkareṇa tu kṛṣṇasya sammānaṃ bahudhā kṛtam |
bhojanācchādanādyaiśca pānaiḥ saṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||69||
śayanaiḥ sukhabhogādyaiḥ prasāditaḥ pareśvara |
vaikuṇḍasadṛśe harmye rātriṃ nināya mādhavaḥ ||3.160.70||
pūjāṃ prāpya bhojanādi kṛtvā vidāyamālabhat |
vimānena drutaṃ vindhyācalaṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param ||71 ||
saptapuṭaṃ parvataṃ ca bhṛgukacchaṃ śriyāḥ puram |
gopanāthaṃ tato vīkṣya nijāṃ lomaśabhūmikām ||72||
nagarīmāyayuḥ sarvā viśrāntimāpuruttamām |
atha sāyaṃ sthitāḥ svāmināthasya purataḥ striyaḥ ||73||
bhojanādi vidhāyaiva papracchuḥ parameśvaram |
ratnānīmāni sarvāṇi hīrakādīni keśava ||74||
kadā kasmāt prajātāni himālayārpitāni vai |
bhautikāni hi sarvāṇi na tu divyāni santi vai ||75||
kaustubhāderleśamātradivyataiteṣu nāsti yat |
maṇiratnakathāṃ śrotumicchāmahe vayaṃ prabho ||76||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne himādrikṛtapūjāṃ pragṛhya kedārakailāsamānasarohanūmatparvatakāśīvindhyasaptapuṭabhṛgukacchagopanāthādīn vīkṣya hareḥ lomaśavāpikāgamanaṃ brahmapriyāṇāṃ bhautikahīrakādyutpattijijñāsā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 160 ||

<3.161>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇuta brahmakāntā yad pṛṣṭaṃ ratnasamudbhavam |
pūrvākhyānaṃ vadāmyatra balaprabalabhaktajam || 1 ||

balaśca prabalaścāpi dvau teṣu samatiṣṭhataḥ || 2 ||
śrīmallalitālakṣmyāstau dhāmni śrīpurasaṃjñake |
mayā tau preṣitau divyau pārṣadau dvārapālakau || 3 ||
śrīlalitāmahālakṣmyā cārthitau māṃ prati dhruvau |
mayājñaptau yayatustau śrīpurākhyaṃ śriyaḥ puram || 4 ||

saśastrau cānalasau ca svāmibhaktiparāyaṇau || 5 ||
samukuṭau śubhaveṣau maṇiratnādibhūṣitau |
tejaḥparidhivṛttāsyau saumyau paṃkajalocanau || 6 ||
atha nityaṃ lalitāyāḥ sakhyo dāsyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
prātaścārghyādi cādāya samāyānti śriyā gṛham || 7 ||
divye śrīnirjhare snātvā kṛṣṇodyānasumāni ca |
nūtanāni sugandhīni samādāya prayānti ca || 8 ||

kāścidaśokapuṣpāṇi kāścit kundakalīḥ śubhāḥ || 9 ||
kāścit śrīkusumānyeva pārijātasumāni ca |
kāścicchṛṅgārapuṣpāṇi kāścittu kamalāni vai || 3.161.10 ||

nītvā kāścidyūthikānāṃ gucchānāṃ kusumāni ca || 11 ||

śanairyāntu śanairyāntu sammarde mācarantviha ||23||

jayāprajñāpāśavatīmāṇikyādisakhījanāt |

madgopure niyuktaśca ruṣā śāpamavāptavān ||49 ||

āsureṇa tu bhāvena roṣeṇa sahito janu |

ākāritāstatra devā daityāśca dānavāḥ khagāḥ |
maharṣayaśca pitaro mānavā vṛkṣavallayaḥ || 92||
yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi piśācā bhūtayonayaḥ |
kuṣmāṇḍāḥ kinnarā nāgā gandharvā bhoginastathā |||93||
sarpā āsuramūrdhanyā apsarasastathāpagāḥ |
samudrāśca tathāraṇyānyapi bhūbhṛta ucchrayāḥ || 94||
meghāśca vidyutaścāpi khanayaścauṣadhivrajāḥ |
tattvānyāmantritānyevāyayustatra mahādhvare || 95||
yajñakāryaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ pravartitam |
balo dadau samidhrūpaṃ nijaṃ tatra tadā kṣaṇe || 96 ||
niṣasādādhvareyāvat prokṣito vardhinījalaiḥ |
tāvat samitsvarūpaḥ sa mahānadrisamo’bhavat || 97||
mahāpuṃjo yathāvṛkṣavallīsasyodbhavo’bhavat |
vrīhipuṣpaphalāḍhyaśca ghṛtamiṣṭaraso’bhavat ||98 ||
na jñāyate prāṇirūpo havyarūpo’bhavattadā |
sarvahavyāni cādrau vai dṛśyante tatra vai tadā ||99||
havyasya parvatākāraṃ balaṃ matvā vivartitam |
kṛtvā tu pāvanaṃ prokṣya devā homaṃ vyadhustadā || 3.161.100 ||
vahnāvāhutayastasya lakṣaśo vai tadābhavan |
bījakaṇājyaphalasadrasātmikā sugandhayaḥ || 101 ||
tasya viśuddhasattvasya balasyāvayavāḥ śubhāḥ |
vahnau samidhaḥ kṣiptāstā ratnabījāni cābhavan || 102||
sūryacandrasamābhāni bījāni kuṇḍake tadā |
dṛṣṭvā surādayastām̐śca jagṛhurmūlyavedinaḥ || 103||
devānāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ pavanāśinām |
mānavānāṃ maharṣīṇāmadhvariṇāṃ samantataḥ || 1 04||
ratnabījamayo grāhaḥ sumahānabhavattadā |
kuṇḍād gṛhṇanti devādyā utplutyāmbaramārgataḥ || 1 05||
saṃpragṛhya dūraṃ yānti vimānairvai nijān gṛhān |
parasparāvakarṣaiśca sammardo’bhūttadā mahān || 1 06||
ambare ratnabījārthamāskandanaṃ mahatvabhūt |
āskandite vyomamārgāt peturbījāni yāni ca || 1 07||
vegātpatatāṃ vimānairhastābhyāṃ patitāni ca |
parvateṣu samudreṣu saritsu kānaneṣvapi ||1 08 ||
vṛkṣeṣu meghamārgeṣu bhūmau sarovareṣvapi |
tattadguṇaiśca bījāni ratnāni cābhavam̐stadā || 109 ||
ādheyaguṇayuktāni vividhāni tadābhavan |
ityevaṃ ratnajātānāmudbhavo vaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.161.11 0 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne valākhyapārṣadasya śrīpuradhāmno jayādibhiḥ parasparaśāpena patanaṃ baladaityasya yajñe samitsvarūpiṇaḥ kāyatattvebhyo ratnānāmutpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 161 ||

<3.162>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇvantu śrīramādyāśca jayādyā mama vai priyāḥ |
tāni ratnāni sarvāṇi mahāguṇāni santi vai || 1 ||
bhūtarakṣoviṣavyālavyādhighnānyavahānyapi |
bhavanti guṇayuktāni tathaiva viguṇānyapi || 2 ||
vajrā muktāḥ padmarāgā marakatā maṇīśvarāḥ |
indranīlāśca vaidūryāḥ puṣparāgāśca jātayaḥ || 3 ||
karketanāḥ sapulakā rudhirāḥ sphaṭikāstathā |
vidrumā mauktikāḥ kācā maṇayaste bhavanti vai || 4 ||
ākāraṃ ca tathā varṇaṃ guṇaṃ doṣaṃ ca tatphalam |
parīkṣya mūlyameteṣāṃ nirṇīyate na cānyathā || 5 ||
kulagneṣūpayujyante yāni copahate’hani |
doṣāḍhyāni bhavantyeva viyojayanti sampadā || 6 ||
tasmāt parīkṣya ratnāni gṛhṇīyād dhārayedapi |
śubhe kāle śubhānyeva parāṃ śriyaṃ tato labhet || 7 ||
vajramaṇiḥ samasteṣu mahāprabhāvavān bhavet |
balāsthisamidbījāni nipeturyatra tatra ca || 8 ||
vajrāṇi vajranāmāni jātāni vividhāni ca |
haimamātaṃgasaurāṣṭrāḥ pauṇḍrakaliṃgakosalāḥ || 9 ||
veṇātaṭāśca sauvīrā deśā vajrodbhavānvitāḥ |
ātāmrā himaśailotthā mātaṃgotthāḥ kapīśinaḥ || 3.162.1 0|||
saurāṣṭrajāstu tāmrāste śyāmāḥ puṇḍrabhavā matāḥ |
kaliṃgotthāḥ svarṇavarṇāḥ pītaprabhāstu kosale || 11 ||
veṇātaṭīyāḥ śaśibhāḥ sauvīre meghakāntayaḥ |
samyak sama tu pārśveṣu guṇavadvarṇavallaghu || 1 re||
rekhābindukākapadakalaṃkatruṭivarjitam |
paramāṇumātramapi vajraṃ vajrottamaṃ hi tat || 1 3||
yadi tīkṣṇāgradhāraṃ tat tasmin devasamāśrayaḥ |
lābhadaṃ cāvitathaṃ tat sarvasaukhyapradaṃ dhṛtam || 14||
yathāvarṇastathā devanivāsastaijaso yathā |
tathāmūlyaṃ tathā devābhidhānaṃ cāpi kalpyate || 15||
varṇabhedena vajreṣu bhinnā devā vasanti hi |
haritsu harirevāste śveteṣu varuṇaḥ svayam || 16||
pīteṣu śakraevāste piṅgeṣu tu hutāśanaḥ |
śyāmeṣu pitaraḥ santi tāmreṣu marutastathā ||17||
vipraḥ kumudasphaṭikaśaṃkhābhaṃ dhārayeddhitam |
kṣatriyaḥ śaśababhrvakṣisadṛśaṃ dhārayenmaṇim || 18||
vaiśyaḥ kadalīdalabhaṃ dhārayelābhadaṃ maṇim |
śūdraḥ svacchakaravālanibhaṃ sandhārayenmaṇi || 1 9||
japāvidrumaśoṇaṃ vā haridrārasasannibham |
dvau vajravarṇau rājāno dhārayeyurhitapradau ||3.162.20 ||
sarvaraṅgamayaṃ vajraṃ rājā vai dhārayenmaṇim |
adharottaravṛtto’pi bahuvarṇayuto maṇiḥ |||1 ||
rājayogyo netareṣāṃ varṇānāṃ kaṣṭado hi saḥ |
vajro vibhūtirguṇināmanyeṣāṃ vyasanapradaḥ ||22||
yasya śṛṃgaṃ dalitaṃ vā viśīrṇaṃ lokyate yadi |
saguṇo’pi na vai dhāryaḥ śreyo’rthibhiḥ kadācana ||23||
viśīrṇasphuṭitaśṛṃgo malapṛṣatamadhyakaḥ |
vajraḥ śriyaṃ nāśayati na rakṣyo bhavane kvacit ||24||
yadekadeśo raktābho yadvā lohitavarṇavān |
sa kuryānmṛtyurevāyaṃ maṇirdhāryo na vai kvacit ||25||
koṭyaḥ pārśvāni dhārāśca ṣaḍaṣṭau dvādaśeti ca |
uttaṃgasamatīkṣṇāgrā vajrasyākarajā guṇāḥ ||26||
ṣaṭkoṭiśuddhamamalaṃ prasphuṭatīkṣṇadhārakam |
laghu varṇānvitaṃ doṣaśūnyaṃ tathā supārśvakam ||27||
indrāyudhāṃśuraṃgāḍhyakṛtābhivyomamaṇḍalam |
durlabhaṃ dhārayed vajramāyuḥstrīdhanavardhakam |||28| |
sampadgopaśudhānyānāṃ sampadāṃ ca pravardhakam |
vyālavahniviṣavyāghrataskarāmbubhayāpaham ||29||
ātharvaṇābhicārāṇāṃ dūrānnivartakaṃ maṇim |
viṃśatitaṇḍulabhāraṃ vajraṃ guṇāgryamūlyakam |||3.162.30||
guṇaiḥ prabhayā snehena gurutvenāṃśahīnakam |
vajraṃ nyūnaṃ mataṃ tadvai mūlye lābhe sukhādiṣu ||3 1 ||
ardhe tvardhaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pādaṃ pādaguṇaṃ bhavet |
pādārdhaguṇakaṃ cāpi mūlye pādārdhakaṃ bhavet ||32||
triṃśadbhāgaṃ śatāṃśaṃ cāśītibhāgaṃ tathā hyapi |
sahasrabhāgaṃ vajra syāt sūkṣmaṃ guṇe’pi śaktimat |||33||
aṣṭābhiḥ sarṣapaiścāpi vajrāṇāṃ gurutā bhavet |
yattu sarvaguṇairyuktaṃ vajraṃ tarati vāriṣu ||34||
ratnavarge samaste’pi dhāraṇaṃ tasya vidyate |
svalpamātrāpi gurutā dhāraṇe tvanumīyate ||35 ||
kartavyaṃ dhāraṇaṃ tasmāt paramāṇorapi dhruvam |
alpo’pi doṣavān vajro daśāṃśamūlyavān bhavet ||36||
prakaṭānekadoṣastu śatāṃśamūlyavān bhavet |
bahudoṣasya vajrasya mūlyaṃ svalpaṃ vibhūṣaṇe ||37||
sannahya dhāryate tādṛk sadoṣaṃ laghuhānidam |
alaṃ sadoṣavajrasya bhūṣāyāṃ dhāraṇaṃ hyapi |||38 ||
nāryā vajramadhāryaṃ vai saguṇaṃ hyapi karhicit |
putraprasavamicchantyā naiva dhāryaṃ kadācana || 39 ||
dhāryaṃ tu dīrghaṃ cipiṭaṃ hrasvaṃ vajraṃ ca nirguṇam |
ayasā puṣparāgeṇa tathā gomedakena ca ||3.162.40 ||
vaidūryeṇa sphaṭikena kācaiścāpi pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
pratirūpāṇi jāyante kuśalairvajrasannibhāḥ ||41 ||
kṣārollekhanaśālābhisteṣāṃ kāryaṃ parīkṣaṇam |
pṛthivyāṃ yāni ratnāni ye cānye lohadhātavaḥ |||42||
sarvāṇi vilikhed vajraṃ tacca tairna vilikhyate |
gurutā sarvaratnānāṃ śreṣṭhatve ca prabhācchatā ||43 ||
kāraṇaṃ vajrake heturlaghutā ca prabhācchatā |
vajrajātirajātiṃ vai vilikhanti samantataḥ | |44||
vajreṇa likhyate vajraṃ vajraṃ nānyena likhyate |
vajrāṇi muktāmaṇayo ye ca kecana jātayaḥ ||45 ||
na teṣāṃ pratibaddhānāṃ bhā bhavatyūrdhvagāminī |
tiryakkṣatatvāt keṣāṃcit kathañcid yadi dṛśyate ||46||
tiryagālikhyamānānāṃ sā pārśveṣu vihanyate |
viśīrṇakoṭivajro vivarṇaḥ sarekhabindukaḥ ||47||
sendrāyudhaścet putrādīn dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti saḥ |
vidyutprabhamindravajraṃ dadhāno nṛpatiḥ khalu ||48 ||
parākrameṇa tasyaiva sāmrājyaṃ labhate bhuvi |
kathitaṃ vajraratnaṃ vo brahmapriyāstataḥ param ||49 ||
muktāphalātmakaṃ ratnaṃ kathayāmi nibodhata |
acchāḥ svacchāḥ sāndrabhāśca malabhāśca pṛthak pṛthak ||3.162.50 ||
hastimedhakroḍaśaṃkhamīnāhiśuktiveṇujāḥ |
pṛdhvīsalilajā muktā maṇayaḥ saṃbhavanti vai ||51 ||
śuktyudbhavaṃ muktakaṃ tu śreṣṭhaṃ sarveṣu gaṇyate |
śuktyudbhavaṃ bhaved vedhyaṃ śeṣāṇyavedhyakāni hi | | 52||
veṇuhastimatsyasūtaṃ śaṃkhajaṃ ca varāhajam |
bhāsāhīnaṃ yadyapi syānmaṃgalaṃ tat praśasyate ||5 3 ||
śaṃkhodbhavaṃ gajotthaṃ ca muktāratnaṃ kaniṣṭhakam |
gajakuṃbhamadhyavarṇaṃ pītaṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ tathā |||54||
vṛhatkoṇapalamānaṃ śāṃkhaṃ cāpi kaniṣṭhakam |
śreṣṭhāḥ śaṃkhā hastinaśca śuddhavaṃśyāstu ye matāḥ || 55 ||
teṣu vṛttāni pītāni jāyante niṣprabhāṇyapi |
mīneṣu yāni jāyante suvṛttāni laghūnyapi ||56||
atisūkṣmāṇi pāṭhīnapṛṣṭhavarṇāni tāni ca |
matsyānaneṣu jāyante payodhermadhyataḥ khalu || 57||
vārāhadaṃṣṭrāprabhāvaṃ daṃṣṭrāṃkurasamānabham |
bhūtalotthaṃ ca muktākhyaṃ kvacit tādṛṅ mataṃ śubham || 58 ||
upalotthaṃ ca tadvarṇaṃ vaṃśotthaṃ tatsamānabham |
veṇavo’pi bhavyajanairbhogyāḥ sarvatra naiva te || 59 ||
bhujaṃgajāni ratnāni vṛttāni cojjvalāni ca |
dhautānīva bhavantyeva khaḍgadhārāprabhāṇi ca || 3.162.6 0||
bhaujaṃgamamauttikadhṛk puṇyavān tejasānvitaḥ |
rājyaśrīmān bhavedeva prabhāvāḍhyo bhavedapi || 61 ||
ratnamūlyasya jijñāsuḥ śubhe muhūrtake khalu |
rakṣitaṃ sumahat kṛtvā sthāpayed bhavanopari || 62||
tadāmbare mahāghoṣā bherīnādā bhavanti hi |
vidyuto visphuraṇāni ghanāścāpi bhavanti hi || 63||
etādṛśaṃ mauktikaṃ tu yatra koṣe gṛhe’sti vā |
na tatra sarpā vighnāni yātudhānāśca nādhayaḥ ||64||
upasargā vyādhayo na yatra bhujaṃgamauktikam |
atha meghodbhavaṃ yat syānmauktikaṃ tattu devatāḥ || 65||
vyomamārgāddharantyeva tvādityārcisamaprabham |
rātrau bhāti divāvattad yatrāste prabhayā svayā || 6 6||
etādṛśasya ratnasya mūlyaṃ svarṇamayī mahī |
api naiva suparyāptā yatastat svarṇaratnadam || 67||
yasyāgre ratnametat syād bhuṃkte sa kṣitimaṇḍalam |
prajānāṃ nṛpateścāpi vardhante bhāgyakāntayaḥ ||68||
yojanānāṃ sahasreṣu hyanarthā yānti naiva tu |
etādṛśāni muktāni balasya dantarūpikāḥ ||69||
samidho yāḥ kṛtāstatrādhvare tābhyastadā tadā |
bījāni yāni jātāni vicitravarṇākāni vai | |3.162.70 ||
samudrāṇāṃ jale yāni nipetuḥ śuddhakāni hi |
candrāṃśukāntiramyāṇi śuktijāni hi tāni vai ||7 1 ||
dvīpe tu saiṃhale tāni saurāṣṭre tāmraparṇake |
pāraśave pāraloke kaubere pāṇḍyadeśake |||72 ||
hāṭake hemake ceti jāyante śuktijāni vai |
śuktyutthaṃ nātinikṛṣṭavarṇaṃ guṇaprabhāyutam | |73 ||
saṃsthānamānayuktaṃ ca jāyate vardhanādiṣu |
vardhane pārasīke ca pātāle siṃhale’pi ca ||74||
śuktijasyaikasya muktāphalasya śāṇayoginaḥ |
mūlyaṃ mudrāḥ sahasre dve rājatyaḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||75 ||
māṣārdhahīnaratnasya daśāṃśahīnamūlyakam |
māṣakatrayaguru yat sahasradvayamūlyakam | |76 ||
sārdhadvayamāṣakasya mūlyaṃ sārdhasahasrakam |
māṣakadvayaguru yanmūlyaṃ sahasramudrakam | |77| |
sārdhamāṣakaguru yanmūlyaṃ pañcaśatāni vai |
ṣaḍguñjāguru yad ratnaṃ tasya sārdhaśatadvayam | | 78 ||
caturguñjāguru yattanmūlyaṃ śatadvayaṃ matam |
guñjādvayaguru yat tanmūlyaṃ śataṃ mataṃ tathā ||79 ||
guñjaikagurumūlyaṃ tu pañcāśanmudrikāḥ khalu |
ṣoḍaśaguñjādharaṇaṃ dārvikākhyaṃ bhaveddhi tat | |3.162.8 0 ||
triṃśadgruñjādharaṇaṃ tu śikyaṃ ratnaṃ taducyate |
nikṛṣṭāni tu ratnāni triṃśanmūlyāni tāni vā | |8 1 ||
viṃśatimūlyakānyeva daśamūlyāni vā tathā |
athāsya saṃparīkṣā tu bhāṇḍe jāmbīrajaṃ rasam |||882||
nikṣipya pacyate ratnaṃ ghṛṣyate piṇḍamūlakaiḥ |
sarekhaṃ syāt kṛtrimaṃ tannikṛṣṭaṃ vā bhavet kila | |8 3 ||
mṛllipte puṭake madhye nikṣipya cānale pacet |
dugdhe tataśca payasi ghṛte punarjaleṣu ca ||84||
tato vastrairgharṣaṇena guṇakāntiyutaṃ bhavet |
tacchreṣṭhaṃ satyameveti mauktikaṃ kṣativarjitam ||85 ||
śvetakācasamaṃ hemanaddhaṃ dhāryeta bhūṣaṇam |
kṛtrimaṃ ceti sandehe kāryaṃ punaḥ parīkṣaṇam ||8 6 | |
uṣṇe salavaṇe snehe niśāṃ tad vāsayejjale |
vrīhibhirmardanīyaṃ tacchuṣkavastrāntarīkṛtam ||87||
yadi nāyāti vaivarṇyaṃ vijñeyaṃ tadakṛtrimam |
sitaṃ pramāṇavat snigdhaṃ guru svacchaṃ sunirmalam | |88 ||
tejo’dhikaṃ suvṛttaṃ ca mauktikaṃ guṇavaddhi tat |
nāsya bhartārameko’pi doṣo’narthaṃ upaiti vā ||89||
evaṃ muktāmaṇayo vai mayoktā vo haripriyāḥ |
padmarāgān pravakṣyāmi śṛṇutaitān yathodbhavāna ||3.162.90 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vajramaṇermuktamaṇeścotpattimūlyaśraiṣṭhyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 162 ||

<3.163>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sūryadevo balasyāsṛksamidhaṃ prāpya bījakam |
yayāvākāśamārgeṇa laṃkādhipo rurodha tam || 1 ||
samudre cāpi rāvaṇagaṃgāyāṃ bījakāni vai |
nipetustajjaratnāni jātāni dīptimanti ha || 2 ||
ujjvalāścārurāgāste padyarāgā hi toyajāḥ |
saugandhikotthā guṇinaḥ kuruvindodbhavāstathā || 3 ||
sphāṭikajāḥ prabhāvanto bahuvarṇāstathāpare |
jātā bandhūkaguñjendragopajapāsṛksannibhāḥ || 4 ||
dāḍimakiṃśukapuṣpasindūrotpalasannibhāḥ |
padmakuṃkumalākṣājarasavarṇāḥ prabhāyutāḥ || 5 ||
rāge sāndrāḥ svaprabhayā bhānti ye sphuṭamadhyinaḥ |
sphāṭikajāḥ sūryabhābhiḥ pārśvāni rañjayanti te || 6 ||
kusuṃbhanīlamiśrābhā ugraraktāmbujaprabhāḥ |
anye puṣkarapuṣpābhā hiṃgulavattviṣo’pare || 7 ||
cakorapīkasārasanetrabhāścāpare’pi ca |
kokanadottamapuṣpatviṣaścānye bhavantyapi || 8 ||
prabhāvakāṭhinyagurutvakaiḥ prāyaḥ samā ime |
sphāṭikajāḥ padmarāgāḥ nīlaraktaprabhāyutāḥ || 9 ||
ete saugandhikotthāstu maṇayaḥ prāyaśaḥ samāḥ |
etebhyo raṃgato nyūnā maṇayaḥ kuruvindajāḥ || 3.163.1 0||
nirarciṣo’ntarbahulā nātiprabhāvaśālinaḥ |
tatsadṛśā āndhradeśe tumburudeśake tathā || 11 ||
sadharmāṇaḥ prajāyante svalpamūlyā hi te matāḥ |
raṃgādhikyaṃ gururevaṃ ca snigdhatā samatācchatā || 12 ||
arciṣmattā mahattā ca maṇīnāṃ śraiṣṭhyabodhakāḥ |
ye tu karkarasadṛśāśchidramalādiyoginaḥ || 13 ||
prabhāhīnāḥ saparuṣā vivarṇāste na cottamāḥ |
sadoṣaṃ maṇimābaddhya śokacintāmayām̐stathā || 14||
mṛtyuṃ duḥkhaṃ vittanāśaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ|
padmarāgasamā vijātīyā bhavanti pañca ca || 15||
kalasapurajāścāpi tumburudeśajāstathā |
muktapāṇīyajātāśca siṃhalotthāḥ śrīpūrṇakā || 16||
kalasotthāstuṣayogā bhavanti maṇayo hi te |
tāmravarṇāstumburutthā kṛṣṇāḥ siṃhaladeśajāḥ || 17||

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
kānta bhagavatā proktā manavo ye caturdaśa |
teṣu tavāvatārā ye tān sakāryān vadasva me || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu śrīśivarājñīśri tatra daityavināśakān |
avatārān kathayāmi sahetūn dharmarakṣakān || 2 ||
svāyaṃbhuvo manuścādya indraśca viśvabhuk tadā |
tathā daityo bāṣkaliśca tapastepe sa dāruṇam || 3 ||

jayānamitān śukrām̐śca yāmān devān vaśe vyadhāt || 5 ||

sudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ prerayad raṇamūrdhani || 6 ||

ṛṣabhaṃ cārvavīraṃ ca dambholimapyapīḍayat || 9 ||
saptarṣīn tuṣitān pārāvatān devānapīḍayat |
manuputrān caikalaṃ ca vinataṃ vidyutaṃ ravim || 3.164.10 ||

śvetahastisvarūpaṃ vai sapakṣaṃ parvataprabham || 12 ||

ahamamārayaṃ dantaiḥ śuṇḍhābhyāṃ pādamardanaiḥ |

devāṃstān yodhayitvā sa svavaśān praṇayiṣyati || 18 ||

śuciṃ suketuṃ suvalaṃ devāvṛdhaṃ sumitrakam || 19 ||

mahājalāntare gatvā dānavo vāsameṣyati |||3.164.20 ||
tadārthito’haṃ manunā bhaviṣyāmi jalāntare |
matsyarūpo hi bhagavān mārayiṣyāmi lambakam ||2 1 ||
tṛtīyaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama matsyasvarūpadhṛk |
caturthasya manostāmasākhyasya samaye bhuvi || 22||

jānujaṃghaṃ nirbhayaṃ ca navakhyātiṃ nayaṃ tathā |
vivikṣipaṃ priyabhṛtyaṃ haviṣkandhiṃ kṛtaṃ tathā || 24||

pañcamaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama haṃsasvarūpadhṛk |
cākṣuṣasya tu ṣaṣṭhasya manostu samaye tataḥ || 35||
mahākālo mahādaityo devaduḥkhaprado’bhavat |
indraṃ manojavākhyaṃ sa jitvā manoḥ sutānapi || 36 ||
uruṃ puruṃ śatadyumnaṃ tāpasaṃ satyabāhukam |
kṛtimagniṣṇumatirātraṃ ca sudyumnakaṃ naram | |37 ||
etān jitvā tathā devānāryān bhāvyān pralekhakān |
pṛthukān prasutām̐ścāpi tathā jitvā ṛṣīnapi || 38 ||
haviṣmantaṃ ca sutanuṃ svadhāmānaṃ ca vairājam |
abhimānaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ ca madhuśriyaṃ hi sapta tān || 39 ||
jitvā trailokyarājyaṃ vai mahākālaḥ kariṣyati |
tadā lokaiḥ prārthito’haṃ hayagrīvasvarūpadhṛk ||3.164.40 ||
bhūtvā daityaṃ mahākālaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi padmaje |
ṣaṣṭho’yamavatāro me hayagrīvasvarūpavān ||41 ||
saptame ca manau vaivasvate lakṣmi mahān khalaḥ |
hiraṇyākṣo mahādaityo jigāya sarvadevatāḥ ||42 ||
maruddevām̐stathādityān vasūn sādhyān gaṇām̐stathā |
viśvedevānaśvinau ca rudrānāṅgirasān surān ||43 ||
tathā tejasvināmānaṃ cendraṃ jigāya daityarāṭ |
ṛṣīṃśca pīḍayāmāsa bharadvājaṃ ca gautamam ||44||
viśvāmitraṃ kaśyapaṃ ca jamadagniṃ vaśiṣṭhakam |
atriṃ ceti tathā manoḥ putrān vaśe cakāra ha ||45||
ikṣvākuṃ ca laviṣyantaṃ nediṣṭaṃ nāmakaṃ nabham |
pāṃśuṃ viṣṭiṃ ca sarjātiṃ karūṣakaṃ pṛṣadhrakam | | 46 ||
sudyumnaṃ ceti sarvān vaiṣṇavām̐ścakre nijānugāna |
tadā tu bhaktayā pṛthvyā prārthito’haṃ hariḥ svayam || 47 ||
vārāharūpavān hiṃsiṣyāmi hiraṇyanetrakam |
saptamo’yaṃ cāvatāro vārāho bhvādirakṣakaḥ || 48||
aṣṭame ca manau sāvarṇyākhye cendro balirnṛpaḥ |
virocanasuto daityo mahābhakto babhūva ha ||49||
tadvaśe ca tadā devā amṛtābhāḥ sutāpasāḥ |
mukhyāśceti gaṇāḥ sarve vartante sma balādiva ||3.164.50||
aśvatthāmā kṛpo vyāso gālavo dīptimānapi |
ṛṣyaśṛṃgaḥ parśurāmaḥ ṛṣayaste’pi tadvaśe || 51 ||
sāvarṇestu sutā arvavīro vijayaḥ satyavāk |
kṛtirnirdehaḥ sagatirvariṣṭhaśca gariṣṭhakaḥ ||52||
vācaśceti baleḥ sarve vaśyāśca duḥkhino yadā |
tadāhaṃ devaṛṣibhiścārthito vāmanākṛtiḥ ||53||
bhūtvā ca yācako vipro grahīṣye śakradhiṣṇyakam |
baliṃ mokṣaṃ preṣayiṣye divaṃ dāsyāmi jiṣṇave ||54||
aṣṭamo’yaṃ me’vatārastrivikramo hi padmaje |
navame dakṣasāvarṇau manau tu kālakākṣakaḥ ||55 ||
devaśatrurvaśe ninye cendramadbhutanāmakam |
kārtikeyāṃśamindraṃ taṃ tathā manoḥ sutānimān ||56||
dhṛṣṭaketuṃ dīptiketuṃ padmahastaṃ nirākṛtim |
pṛthuśravasamṛcikaṃ bṛhaddyumnaṃ bṛhadguṇam ||57||
tathā ninye vaśe saptarṣīṃśca medhātithiṃ vasum |
jyotiṣmantaṃ sabalaṃ ca dyutiṃ kavyaṃ ca havyakam ||58||
tathā pārān sudharmākhyān marīcigarbhakān surān |
tadāhamarthito devaiḥ padmanābho bhavāmi ca ||59||
kālakākṣaṃ haniṣyāmi kariṣyāmi sukhān surān |
navamo’yaṃ padmanābho’vatāro me hi padmaje || 3.164.60 ||
daśame brahmasāvarṇau baliśatrurmahāsuraḥ |
śāntināmakamindraṃ ca saptarṣīn vaśamānayat ||6 1 ||
āpomūrtiṃ haviṣmantaṃ satyaṃ sukṛtinaṃ tathā |
nābhāgaṃ cāpratimaṃ ca vasiṣṭhaṃ ceti tānṛṣīn ||62||
manoḥ putrān sukṣetraṃ ca bhūmisenaṃ jayadratham |
anamitraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca śatānīkaṃ suparvakam ||63 ||
suvīryamauttamaujaskaṃ vaśe ninye mahāsuraḥ |
sukhāsīnānniruddhām̐śca prāṇān devān vaśe vyadhāt ||64||
devaistadārthitaścāhaṃ harirūpadharaḥ svayam |
gadayā baliśatruṃ taṃ ghātayiṣyāmi vai rame ||65 ||
daśamo’yaṃ harirūpo’vatāro mama padmaje |
ekādaśe dharmasāvaṇau mano vṛṣamindrakam ||66 ||
daśagrīvo mahādaityo vaśaṃ cakāra devatāḥ |
vihaṃgamān kāmagamānnirmāṇarucikām̐stathā ||67||
ekaikarucikām̐ścāpi devānatha manoḥ sutān |
sarvatragaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ devānīkaṃ puruṃ gurum ||68||
kṣetravarṇaṃ dṛḍheṣuṃ cārdrakaṃ ca putrakaṃ tathā |
saptarṣīṃśca vaśe cakre’gnitejasaṃ haviṣyakam ||69||
viśvaṃ viṣṇuṃ vistaraṃ ca haviṣmantaṃ ca vāruṇam |
ṛṣibhiḥ prārthitaścāhaṃ śrīrūpo mohakārakaḥ ||3.164.70 ||
bhūtvā mugdhaṃ harantaṃ māṃ haniṣyāmi mahāsuram |
ekādaśo’vatāro me śrīnārīrūpavān rame ||71 ||
dvādaśe rudrasāvaṇau ṛtadhāmānamindrakam |
tārakākhyo’suraśreṣṭho vaśe cakāra vai svayam |||72|||
manoḥ putrān devavantamupadevaṃ vidūratham |
devaśreṣṭhaṃ mitravantaṃ mitradevaṃ savīryakam ||73 ||
mitrabinduṃ mitravāhaṃ pravāhaṃ ceti vai tathā |
devān svadharmaṇaścāpi rohitakān haritakān ||74||
surārīn sutapasaśca saptarṣīnityapīti ca |
tapasvinaṃ sutapasaṃ tapomūrtiṃ taporatim ||75 ||
tapodhṛtiṃ dyutiṃ vidyutiṃ ceti vai tataḥ surāḥ |
cakrire prārthanāṃ me ca tārakasya samāptaye ||76||
tārako’pi śaṃkarasya varadānānmahābalaḥ |
naro vai cetanaṃ tattvaṃ nārī māyā jaḍaṃ tu tat ||77||
tābhyāṃ mṛtyurna me syādvai varaṃ labdhvā nirāmayaḥ |
jigāya sarvabhūtāni rājyaṃ cakre trilokajam ||78||
tato’haṃ tasya nāśāya napuṃsakatvamāptavān |
tena rūpeṇa kamale nāśayiṣye hi tārakam ||79||
napuṃsakahariścāyamavatāro navīnakaḥ |
napuṃsakātmikī sṛṣṭistato’bhavanmaduttarā ||3.164.8 0 ||
dvādaśaścāvatāro’yaṃ mama lakṣmi prakīrtitaḥ |
napuṃsakahariṃ dhyātvā bhajitvā mānavāstadā ||8 1 ||
yāsyanti paramāṃ muktiṃ strīpuṃliṃgavivarjitām |
trayodaśe devasāvarṇau raucye tu divaspatim ||82||
indraṃ vaśe cakārāpi daityaṣṭiṭṭibhasaṃjñakaḥ |
manoḥ putrān citrasenaṃ tapodharmarataṃ dhṛtim ||83||
vicitraṃ gharmapaṃ kṣetravṛttiṃ dṛḍhaṃ sunetrakam |
vaśe cakre tatharṣīṃśca sunayaṃ tattvadarśinam ||84||
dhṛtimantamavyayaṃ ca niśārūpaṃ nirutsukam |
nirmāṇaṃ cetyatha devān svaromakān svadharmakān ||85||
svakarmakānamarām̐śca vaśe cakre tu ṭiṭṭibhaḥ |
meruvāsaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ taṃ nāśayituṃ surādayaḥ ||86 ||
prārthayan māṃ mayā dīrghaṃ rūpaṃ māyūrakaṃ dhṛtam |
māyūrakeṇa rūpeṇa ghātayiṣyāmi ṭiṭṭibham ||87||
trayodaśo’vatāro’yaṃ mama lakṣmi prakīrtitaḥ |
māyūro’haṃ mahārājaḥ pūjāṃ prāpsye tadā yuge ||88 ||
caturdaśendrasāvarṇau bhautye śucirmahāsuraḥ |
indro bhūtvā sārvarājyaṃ pracakāra trilokajam ||89||
manoḥ putrān gabhīraṃ ca dhṛṣṭamūruṃ tarasvinam |
abhimānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca grāhaṃ jiṣṇuṃ pravīrakam ||3.164.90 ||
durlabhaṃ saṃkrandanaṃ ca vaśe tān sa cakāra ha |
saptarṣīnagnibāhuṃ cāgnidhraṃ śuciṃ ca māgadham ||91 ||
śukramajitaṃ muktaṃ ca vaśe cakāre sa svayam |
cākṣuṣān karmaṭhām̐ścāpi pavitrān bhrājinaḥ surān | |92||
vācāvṛthān devagaṇān vaśe cakre tathā svayam |
sāyaṃkāle hariścāhaṃ prārthito brahmaṇā yadā ||93 ||
pralayāya vināśāyāsurasyendrasya vai tathā |
sudarśanena cakreṇa ghātayiṣyāmi śakrakam ||94||
sudarśanahariścāyamavatāro mamāntimaḥ |
kalpānte kathito lakṣmi madhye’nye bahavo’pi ca ||95|||
kāryavaśād bhavantyeva me’vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ |
yasya haste’thavā pādatale matsyo dhanurdhvajaḥ ||96|||
śaraḥ śūlaṃ svastiko vā cakraṃ padmaṃ ghaṭo’pi vā |
so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādasmi pracchannarūpavān || 97||
vartāmi sādhudharmāhaṃ sādhukarmā samastavid |
saiśvaryaścāpyanaiśvaryo divyo’pyadivyavartanaḥ ||98 ||
saṃgāt samāgamād yogād darśanāt sparśanādapi |
sahavāsāt smaraṇādvā sevanānmuktido dhruvam || 99|||
bhāgyavanto dehino māṃ jñātvā prasādya sevayā |
mokṣamārge cārjayanti mamānandamalaukikam || 3.164.10 0||
abhāmyāstu manuṣyaṃ māṃ matvā yānti vidūrataḥ |
āsurāste pāpavanto maherṣyavo’parādhinaḥ || 10 1||
muktimārgasthitāścāpi yāsyanti nirayān bahūn |
cihnaiścāpi ca sārvajñyaistathā divyaguṇādibhiḥ || 10 2||
māṃ viditvāśrayiṣyanti ye te yāsyanti me’kṣaram |
narā nāryaśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śūdrayonayaḥ || 10 3||
apyadharmaparāścāpi madyogāt pāvanā hi te |
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mānaṃ madaśca matsaraḥ || 1 04||
durguṇāḥ puṇyapāpe ca nirguṇā mama yogataḥ |
yena kenāpi bhāvena yujyante ye mayā saha || 1 05||
nityayuktā hi te jātā viyujyante na karhicit |
mama yogo mokṣado vai suramānavarakṣasām || 106||
śūdrapakṣipaśūnāṃ ca daityadānavayoṣitām |
mayā saṃkalpamātreṇa tāryante tvaṇḍarāśayaḥ || 107||
mama manāk suyogena pūyante pāpakarmiṇaḥ |
yā kriyā pāpanāmno sā kṛtā mayi tu pāvanī || 108||
svatantro’haṃ mamāmnāyā upadiśanti vai vṛṣān |
ayaṃ vṛṣo bhavatvevaṃ dhārayāmi vṛṣo hi saḥ || 10 9||
avṛṣo’pi vṛṣaḥ syānme saṃkalpādvā vṛṣo’vṛṣaḥ |
vicāryetthaṃ prasevante māṃ mūrtaṃ parameśvaram | | 3.164.110 ||
teṣāṃ muktiḥ kare tvāste’mutrātra sarvakarmasu |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasyādhyāyasya mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne caturdaśamanvantareṣu hareścaturdaśāvatāraprayojanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭayadhika śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 164 ||

<3.165>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
jīvatā tu janenātra satkāryaṃ kīdṛśaṃ śubham |
kartavyaṃ yena sarvatra paratra sa sukhī bhavet || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
mama pūjā prakartavyā paratra parasaukhyadā |
pitṛpūjā prakartavyā devapūjā tayā śubhā || 2 ||
dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prakartavyaṃ jīvacchrāddhaṃ tathā śubham |
yatkṛteneha hastena labhyate’mutra tatphalam || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
jīvacchrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kīdṛk kartavyaṃ tadvidhiṃ vada |
tatra yadyatpradātavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ me prabho vada || 4 ||
śrīpukṣottama uvāca 
devālaye satāṃ vāse maṭhe ceśvarasannidhau |
vidyālaye yajñabhūmau parvate ca nadītaṭe || 5 ||
vane tīrthe caityadeśe pāvane ca sthale’pi vā |
svagṛhe nūtane kuryājjīvacchrāddhaṃ sukhapradam || 6 ||
yadā tu cintayeddharmaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyamādarāt |
śraddhayā svakareṇaiva hṛdā bhāvanayārpyate || 7 ||
śrāddhaṃ tat sarvathā bodhyaṃ pañcadhā tatprakīrtyate |
pārabrāhmikaṃ ca paitryaṃ daivamaiśvaraṃ bhautikam || 8 ||
bālye vā yauvane vāpi vārdhakye mṛtisannidhau |
yadākadācitkartavyaṃ pañcadhāpi śubhairjanaiḥ || 9 ||
jīvacchrāddhe kṛte jīvo jīvanneva vimucyate |
karma kurvannakurvan vā hyajñānī jñānavānapi || 3.165.10 ||
śrotriyaścāpyaśrotriyaścāturvarṇyo hi mānavaḥ |
āśramastho’pi vā tyāgī kuryācchrāddhaṃ hi pañcadhā || 11 ||
paraṃbrahma hariṃ smṛtvā mandireṣu mahatsu tu |
haraye nityanaivedyaṃ dadyājjīvan jano bhuvi || 1 2|||
śrīkṛṣṇāya mahānaivedyakaṃ dadyānnavaṃ navam |
ṣaṭapañcāśadbhogarūpaṃ jīvanmokṣe phalāya tat || 1 3||
nityaṃ prātarbhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ha |
mudgalaḍukadugdhādi śarkarāṃ cārpayettathā || 14||
nāgavallīdalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyāttu tṛptaye |
tatphalaṃ paraloke syāt svasmai dātre’kṣayaṃ sukham || 15||
madhyāhne’pi pradadyācca miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca |
ghṛtājyaśarkarāktāni pakvānnāni samarpayet || 16||
śākāni dvidalāḥ sūpaṃ bhaktaṃ vividhapācitam |
polikāḥ pūrikāḥ dugdhapākaṃ kṣīrādi cārpayet ||17||
āranālāni ramyāṇi veṣavārayutāni ca |
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni coṣyāṇyapi phalāni ca || 18||
kandapuṣpadalapatragranthīn dadyāttu bhojane |
devadevāya kṛṣṇāya sarvaśrīsahitāya vai || 1 9||
nityamevaṃ rājabhogān dadyāt svarṇādinirmite |
sthāle pātre ca pātreṣu pratyakṣaṃ śrāddhameva tat || 3.165.20 ||
jīvatā jīvikā dattā vṛttirūpā tu śārṅgiṇe |
phalatyevākṣare dhāmni goloke śrīpure’pi sā ||21 ||
parameśāya dattaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam |
prāpyate muktabhāve’pi pratyarpitaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā ||22||
goloke vāpi vaikuṇṭhe’vyākṛte’pyamṛte’pi ca |
dattamatra tadīśāyānantaguṇamavāpyate ||23||
evaṃ jalāni miṣṭāni śītāni madhurāṇi ca |
dātavyāni śrīharaye sarvartuvāñcchitāni ca || 24|||
vṛttyātmakāni dattāni prāpyante tāni tṛptaye |
evaṃ lakṣmi pradeyāni mukhavāsāni śuddhaye |||25||
tānyapi tvaṅalavaṃgailākapūrravīṭikāstathā |
pūgīcūrṇakhadirādicūrṇamiṣṭaphalāni ca ||26||
athotthānasamaye’pi jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ tathā |
bhojanārthaṃ pradeyāni coṣṇaśītāni yāni ca ||re7||
ghṛtapakvāni sarvāṇi tailapakvāni yāni ca |
vahnipakvāni sarvāṇi sūryapakvāni yāni ca ||28||
ṛtupakvāni bhakṣyāṇi sugandhirasavanti ca |
pradeyāni śrīharaye tṛtīyaprahare sadā ||29||
sāyaṃ bhojanapānārthaṃ pūrikāḥ polikāstathā |
dugdhaṃ śākaṃ cāranālaṃ dadyācchrīharaye jalam ||3.165.30||
nityameva pradadyādvai vṛttyarthaṃ vāṭikāṃ diśet |
kṣetrāṇi cārpayet saudhaṃ bhavanāni tathārpayet ||3 1 ||
grāmān gṛhaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ dadyājjīvanavṛttidām |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||3||

tatsarvamaiśvaraṃ proktaṃ dattaṃ pratiphalāya tat |

anvādhāya yathāśāstraṃ parigṛhya ca sarvataḥ |
paristīrya yathāśāstraṃ pāramparyakramāgatam ||48||

oṃ bhūrnamo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śārṅgiṇe |

oṃ bhuvaścāvatārebhyaḥ svāhā īśvarebhyastathā ||52||
oṃ svarnamo jīvasṛṣṭibhyaḥ pitṛdevatādibhyaḥ |
oṃ svaḥ svāhā jīvasṛṣṭibhyaḥ pitṛdevatādibhyaḥ ||53||
oṃ bhūrvedhase’stu namaḥ oṃ bhūrvedhase svāhā |
oṃ bhuvarviṣṇave namaḥ oṃ bhuvarviṣṇave svāhā ||54||
oṃ svaḥ śaṃkarāya namaḥ oṃ svaḥ śaṃkarāya svāhā |
oṃ mahaḥ sureśāya namaḥ oṃ mahaḥ sureśāya svāhā ||55||
oṃ janaḥ pitṛbhyo namaḥ oṃ janaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā |
oṃ tapaḥ prakṛtaye namaḥ oṃ tapaḥ prakṛtaye svāhā ||26||
oṃ satyaṃ haraye namaḥ oṃ satyaṃ haraye svāhā |
oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ devāya kṛṣṇāya bhūrnamaḥ ||57||
oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇāya bhū svāhā |
oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇasya patnyai bhūrnamaḥ svāhā ||58||
oṃ kṛṣṇadharāṃ me gopāya ghrāṇe gandhaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyai bhūḥ svāhā |
oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ haraye bhuvo namaḥ ||59||
oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ haraye bhuvaḥ svāhā |
oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ hareḥ patnyai bhuvo namaḥ ||3.165.60||
oṃ hare jalaṃ me gopāya jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ hareḥ patnyai bhuvaḥ svāhā |
oṃ pareśāgniṃ me gopāya netre rūpaṃ pareśāya svaro namaḥ ||61 ||
oṃ pareśāgni me gopāya netre rūpaṃ pareśāyasvaḥ svāhā |
oṃ pareśāgni me gopāya netre rūpapareśapatnyai svaroṃ namaḥ ||62||
oṃ pareśāgniṃ me gopāya netrerūpaṃ pareśapatnyai svaḥ svāhā |
oṃ brahma vāyu me gopāya tvaci sparśaṃ brahmaṇe devāya maharnamaḥ ||63 ||
oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya
tvaci sparśaṃ brahmaṇe devāya mahaḥ svāhā |
oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya
tvaci sparśaṃ brahmapatnyai maharoṃ namaḥ || 64||
oṃ brahma vāyuṃ me gopāya
tvaci sparśaṃ brahmapatnyai mahaḥ svāhā |

oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya

oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya
śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomapatnyai jano namaḥ || 66||
oṃ paravyoma suṣiraṃ me gopāya
śrotre śabdaṃ paravyomapatnyai janaḥ svāhā |
oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya

oṃ mukteśarajau me gopāya
dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mucośāya tapaḥ svāhā |
oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya
dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mukteśapatnyai tapo namaḥ | | 68 | |
oṃ mukteśarajo me gopāya
dravye tṛṣṇāṃ mukteśapatnyai tapaḥ svāhā |
oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya

oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya
śraddhāṃ dharme bālakṛṣṇāya satyaṃ svāhā |
oṃ bālakṛṣṇa satyaṃ me gopāya

oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya
ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapataye jīvanaṃ svāhā |
oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya
ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapatepatnyai namaḥ svāhā | |72||
oṃ jīvapate jīvanaṃ me gopāya
ceṣṭaṃ paratra jīvapatipatnyai jīvanaṃ svāhā |
o parabrahmaṇe namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamāya svāhā ||73||
oṃ pitre namaḥ pitre svāhā prapitre namaḥ prapitre svāhā |
oṃ prapitāmahāya namaḥ prapitāmahāya svāhā ||74||
oṃ bhūtebhyo namo bhūtebhyaḥ svāhā |
oṃ sūkṣmebhyo namo mātrābhyaḥ svāhā ||75||
omindriyebhyo nama indriyebhyaḥ svāhā |
oṃ prāṇebhyo namaḥ prāṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||76||
omantaḥkaraṇebhyo namo’ntaḥkaraṇebhyaḥ svāhā |
omātmane nama ātmane svāhā ||77||
oṃ kṛṣṇa dharāṃ ye chindhi ghrāṇe gandhaṃ
chindhi me’ghaṃ bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhā ||78||
evaṃ pṛthak pṛthak hutvā kevalena ghṛtena vai
sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā ||79||
mahālakṣmīṃ ghṛtenaiva śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak |
prāṇādibhiśca juhuyād ghṛtenaiva ca kevalam ||3.165.80 ||
oṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo’mṛtaṃ juhomi |
harirmāviśa pradāhāya prāṇāya svāhā |
prāṇādhipataye śrīharaye parabrahmaṇe kṛṣṇāya svāhā ||81 ||
oṃ bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhā bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā |
evaṃ krameṇa juhūyāt śrāddhoktaṃ ca yathāyatham ||82||
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt tṛptaye paramātmanaḥ |
paramātmapatnyāścāpi tṛptaye cārpayettataḥ ||83||
samāpyaivaṃ surān pitṝn svaṃ nāmnā cāpi vai diśet |
bhūtādīn sampradadyācca ṛṇavadbhyastathārpayet ||84||
anṛṇī ca tato bhūtvā yogīndrān bhojayed bahūn |
sādhūn sataḥ satīḥ sādhvīrbhojayed bālabālikāḥ ||85||
bāndhavān bhojayeccāpi divyān gurūn prabhojayet |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ vastrābharaṇakambalān ||86||
vāhanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ kāṃsyatāmrādibhājanam |
haimaṃ ca rājataṃ dhenuṃ tilān kṣetraṃ ca vaibhavān ||87||
dāsīdāsagaṇām̐ścāpi dadyācca dakṣiṇāmapi |
piṇḍaṃ ca surasaṃ dadyāt pṛthagaṣṭaprakārataḥ ||88||
tryahaṃ śrīviṣṇave dadyāccaruṃ ca kṣīrabhojanam |
mṛte kuryānna kuryādvā jīvan kuryānmṛto labhet ||89||
evaṃ kṛtvā mṛtasyātra śaucāśaucaṃ na vidyate |
jīvanmukto yataḥ so’sti tasya vai sūtakaṃ nahi ||3.165.90||
dāhakānāṃ snānamātraṃ sūtakaṃ nādhikaṃ tataḥ |
tadvaṃśe kanyakā putro yaḥ ko’pi vaṃśavardhanaḥ ||91 ||
so’pi mukto bhavatyeva pitruddhārakaro bhavet |
mucyante jīvataḥ śrāddhāt pitaro narakādapi ||92||
mucyate karmaṇānena mātāpitṛṛṇādayam |
kālaṃ prāpte gartavāso dahanaṃ jalavāhanam ||93||
yadbhavet sarvamevāsya mokṣārthaṃ doṣavarjitam |
svenaiva svakṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tasmādṛṇaṃ vilīyate ||94||
bhautikaṃ gopaśubhyaśca dadyācchukādipakṣiṇe |
kīṭapataṃgaprāṇibhyo matsyādibhyo diśedapi ||95||
vṛkṣādibhyo dadedvāri kaṇān dehibhya ityapi |
bhikṣukebhyo’rpayedannaṃ vastraṃ pātraṃ samarpayet ||96||
yathāśakti diśed yastu svena hastena sarvathā |
mṛtasyāsya dvādaśāhapratīkṣā naiva vidyate ||97||
yāti śīghraṃ vimānena puṇyaloke vṛṣesthitaḥ |
ātivāhikadevāstaṃ yadvā nayanti cordhvagāḥ ||98||
evaṃ lakṣmi prakartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ jīvatpradānakam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ syāttat svakaropārjitārpaṇam ||99||
svenahastena pacanaṃ svena hastena bhakṣaṇam |
svena hastenārjanaṃ ca svena hastena dānakam ||3.165.1 00||
yaḥ karoti jayatyatra paratrāpi jayatyapi |
etacchravaṇataścāpi tathāpuṇyayuto bhavet || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jīvacchrāddhavidhinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 165 ||

śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ ceti dvayaṃ loke pravartate |
sudhāmṛtaṃ garaṃ viṣaṃ rasyaṃ taddvayameva hi || 1 ||
arasya tadbhavedvā na bhaveccet kīdṛśaṃ hare |
yaj jñātvāyaṃ lokajano virajyeta dadhīta vā || 2 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
samudramathane pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ mahāviṣam |
papau śrīśaṃkaro yogī tamastuvan maharṣayaḥ || 3 ||
atyugraṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ bhagavan hara |
tvayā surakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛpānidhe || 4 ||
samartho’si maheśo’si rakṣako’si viṣādana |
sadā jaya suyogim̐stvaṃ brahmāsi saṃgavarjitaḥ || 5 ||
śrutvaivaṃ prahasan śaṃbhurviṣaṃ prāhetaranmunīn |
na viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃsāro viṣamulbaṇam || 6 ||
saṃharet tadviṣaṃ yastu sa samartho hyanena kim |
yogī sarvaprayatnena saṃharenmāyikaṃ viṣam || 7 ||
māyikasya ye viṣasya hartāraste hi śaṃkarā |
śaṃ kurvanti guravo vā devāḥ santo’tinirmalāḥ || 8 ||
yogino vā mahātmānaḥ śāntidā mokṣadā hi te |
saṃsāraviṣahartāraḥ samarthāste hi sādhavaḥ || 9 ||
sanakādyāḥ sādhavaste śukādyā yoginastathā |
satyaśca brahmacāriṇyo vāsanākṣayakārikāḥ || 3.166.1 0||
saṃsāro’yaṃ dvividho’sti mūrtaścāmūrta ityapi |
mūrto vai dampatīrūpo’mūrtastu vāsanātmakaḥ || 11 ||
mithyājñānaṃ vāsanāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ vāsanābalāt |
gārhasthyaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ ca bhogavattvaṃ sarāgiṇām || 1 2||
rāge dveṣaḥ sakhārūpaḥ sāhāyyado’pyaniṣṭake |
etau dvau bhavato doṣau pravartakau nivartakau || 1 3||
saguṇā sā pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca kriyākarī |
sakriyasya bhavedādyakṣaṇasambandha udbhavaḥ || 14||
vṛddhiḥ puṣṭirdṛḍhatā ca hrāsaḥ kṣayo layādikam |
punaḥ karmānusāreṇodbhavo layāntako bhavet || 15||
evaṃ saṃsāracakre’tre bhramannapi vivekavān |
rāgadveṣādirahito mukto bhavati bandhanāt || 1 6||
garāṇi santi bahūni vadāmi śṛṇu padmaje |
miṣṭaṃ garaṃ kuṭumbasyābhimānaṃ janmato bhavet ||17||
mātā pitā sakhā bandhuścābhimānaṃ mahad garam |
gṛhaṃ me vāṭikā me ca kṣetraṃ me peṭikā ca me || 18||
dhanaṃ me ca suvarṇaṃ me’mbaraṃ me garamuttamam |
mānyaṃ mama vaco nitya maduktaṃ satyameva tat || 19||
agryaṃ vākyaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ mamaiva mānyameva tat |
vijayo me niścayo me mānyo nānyasya kasyacit || 3.166.20 ||
nirṇītaṃ ca mayā yat tat svīkāryaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ |
garaṃ caitanmahatproktaṃ yanmadena prapīḍyate ||21 ||
balaṃ viṣaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ kleśada yuddhakṛddhi tat |
kalājñānaṃ garaṃ cāpi sampadgaraṃ nu nāśakṛt ||22||
viṣayāstu garaṃ lakṣmi mahānirayapātinaḥ |
viṣayā viṣamevāsti yadāveśo’pratikriyaḥ || 23 ||
tṛṣṇā viṣaṃ paraṃ lakṣmi rāgo viṣaṃ mahattaram |
dveṣo viṣaṃ vahnirūpaṃ cintā garaṃ tu nāśakṛt ||24||
kāmo garaṃ samastānāṃ viṣāṇāṃ viṣamulbaṇam |
nirayotthaṃ nirayāṇāṃ pradaṃ nirayavāsadam || 25||
moho viṣaṃ tathāniṣṭakaraṃ duḥkhapradaṃ mahat| |
mugdhaḥ kṛtyaṃ na jānāti mohadagdho vinaśyati || 26 ||
sattā viṣaṃ paraṃ cāste rājyaṃ viṣaṃ tu mārakam |
jihvāśiśnodaragṛdhnā viṣaṃ kālaprakūṭakam ||27|||
nāstikatvaṃ guroḥ pitroravamānaṃ viṣaṃ guru |
hanyate yena sahasādhogatiṃ nāśameti ca || 28 ||
śāpo viṣaṃ duḥkhitānāṃ satāmasnigdhatā viṣam |
adharmaśca viṣaṃ svargadāhakaṃ bhūtināśakam || 29 ||
nindā cauryaṃ balātkāro viṣāṇīmāni mūlataḥ |
nikṛntanāni karturvai vināśakāni cācirāt || 3.166.30 ||
matsaro’sahanaṃ cerṣyā netraṃ hṛnmānasaṃ tu taiḥ |
nijaṃ nijaṃ tu bhavanaṃ kṛtaṃ ca dahyate pumān || 31 ||
evaṃ viṣairāvṛto’yaṃ cāvidyāpariveṣṭitaḥ |
nārakī sarvathā cāste viṣametad durantakam || 32 ||
udbhijjaḥ svedajaścāpi tathāṇḍajo jarāyujaḥ |
tyāgābhāvād bhramantyevājñānavāsanakarmabhiḥ || 33 ||
ṣāṭkauśikaṃ sagaraṃ ca bhajatyeva kalevaram |
prathamaṃ pitṛto janma bījadānātmakaṃ matam || 34||
garbhājjanma dvitīyaṃ ca bālarūpaṃ tu tanmatam |
tṛtīyaṃ brahmasūtrācca vivāhāśca caturthakam || 35||
pañcamaṃ sarvasannyāsāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu maraṇottaram |
saptamaṃ mokṣabhāktvaṃ ca tato janma na vidyate ||36||
baijikaṃ pāśavaṃ cāpi mānavaṃ karmabandhanam |
ācyutaṃ praitakaṃ cāpyapunarbhavaṃ hi saptamam || 37||
evametāni janmāni viṣāktāni bhavanti hi |

paśuvad bhrūṇajanmāptaṃ pāśavaṃ bālajanma tat |
manuṃ mantraṃ ca gāyatrīṃ yajñopavītamityapi || 39 ||
mānavām̐śca vṛṣāneti mānavaṃ janma ceti tat |
vivāhaḥ karmabandhaśca kārāgārasamā sthitiḥ ||3.166.40 ||
karmabandhanarūpaṃ tajjanma dāmpatyarūpakam |
sarvaṃ tyaktvā virāgaḥ san sanyāsaṃ labhate tu yaḥ ||41 ||
tasya janmācyutaṃ proktaṃ hareḥ śaraṇayāyinaḥ |
dehatyāge pretabhāve sūkṣmaśarīrayogakṛt |||42|||
dharmādharmayuto dehī bhramatyeveti janma tat |
praitakaṃ procyate punarbhavārthaṃ yatra tatra vā ||43||
mokṣārthaṃ nirguṇāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā ṛṇāni ca |
chitvā bandhān saṃvilīya vināśya garalāni ca ||44||
yaḥ prayāti harerdhāmāpunarbhavaṃ hi janma tat |
anuttaraviṣādaḥ sa mahāmṛtāda eva saḥ ||45||
saptamaṃ janma cāsādya maraṇaṃ nāsya vidyate |
evaṃ lakṣmi ṣaḍviṣāṇi viśālāni bhavanti vai ||46||
krūrāṇi dāhakānyeva pācakāni samantataḥ |
garbhe duḥkhānyanekāni yonimārge’pi vai tathā ||47||
bhūtale cāpi śayyāyāṃ kaumāre yauvane tataḥ |
bhoge yoge vyavahāre vārdhake pāravaśyage ||48||
aśaktau nirdhane roge maraṇe pretake tathā |
yāmye khanau viṣāktāni duḥkhānyeva vivekinaḥ ||49||
tiryakṣu mānave yākṣe paiśāce rākṣase sure |
pitṛgaṇe bhogavatsu gāndharve cāpsarogaṇe ||3.166.50||
aindre brāhme prākṛte vairāje prajāpatigṛhe |

chinnamūlataruryadvat tvavaśaḥ patati kṣitau ||54||

kṛṣṇo dhāryastvacāṃ yoge viṣṇurdhāryo rasāśraye |

draṣṭavyo’haṃ tato lakṣmi śrotavyo’haṃ tathā hariḥ ||66||
ghrātavyaśca rasitavyaḥ sparśitavyo’hameva ca |
mantavyaścāpi boddhavyo’haṃkartavyo’pyahaṃ hariḥ ||67||
cetayitavya evāhaṃ vaktavyo’haṃ tathā prabhuḥ |
ādātavyaśca gantavyaḥ sargāyitavya ityaham ||68 ||
ānandayitavya evāhaṃ tattve tattve sthito’smyaham |
prāṇe prayāṇe yāne ca pāne sthairye sthito’smyaham ||69||
sarvātmānaṃ carantaṃ māṃ samupāsīta cātmavān |

prasannaṃ harimīśeśaṃ sahasthaṃ sahajaṃ prabhum |

cāparokṣaṃ viditvaivāmṛtatvaṃ tvāpnuyād bṛhat |
jñānamevābhyasennityaṃ madgocaraṃ pradhānataḥ ||74||

evaṃ sa muktaḥ saṃsārād duḥkhaviṣādivarjitaḥ ||77||

brahmaśīlo mama dhyānaṃ kuryād guroḥ prasaṃgamāt |
mayi tattānatābhāvaṃ prānte mallīnatāmapi ||3.166.80 ||
vindatyeva hi madbhakto garaṃ tvasyāmṛtaṃ bhavet |
evaṃ garāṇi sarvāṇi cāmṛtānyasya bhānti ha ||8 1 ||
bhūtāni sūkṣmamātrāṇi viṣayā viṣayodbhavāḥ |
aguṇāśca guṇāścāpi kriyā garāṇi yāni tu |||82||
tāni sarvāṇyamṛtāni kalpitāni pare mayi |
evaṃ vai viṣapo bhaktaḥ samartho netaraḥ kvacit| ||83|||
pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ ca tejaśca dhartuṃ śakto hyayaṃ bhavet |
vāyuṃ vyoma tathā dhartuṃ cāṣṭāvṛttīstatheśvarān ||84||
dhartuṃ śakto bhaveccāyaṃ prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ hyapi |
kālaṃ dhartuṃ samarthaśca bhavet tadātmako mama ||85||
akṣarātmā bhaveccāpi muktān dhartuṃ prabhurhyapi |
yathāhaṃ tu tathā so’yaṃ prāraṃbhāvananāśanam ||86||
kartuṃ jāyeta śakto madātmakaiśvarabhāvavān |
pārameśapadaṃ prāpya sarvaṃ kartuṃ prabhurbhavet ||87||

aviṣaṃ vā cograviṣaṃ bhuktvā viṣaṃ vināśayet ||88||
aviṣāḥ sādhavaḥ proktā ugraviṣo haristvaham |
sādhusaṃgānmama pānānnirviṣo jāyate viṣī ||89||

prasādena drutaṃ muktiḥ pratijñaiṣā rame mama ||3.166.90||
garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo’pi vā |
vṛddho vā mucyate dehī prasādātparamātmanaḥ ||91 ||
aṇḍajaścodbhijja uta svedajo’pi pramucyate |
jarājo vā naro nārī mucyate me prasādavān ||92||
mamaivāṃśā dehino’pi mama yogaviśeṣiṇaḥ |
mama bhāvena sampannāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||93||

kṛpāpātrāṇi taranti saṃsāraviṣasāgaram ||94||
yathā tailaṃ jalayoge taratyevordhvamudgatam |
tathā dehī kṛṣṇayoge taratyevordhvamudgataḥ ||95||
yathā vahniḥ svabhāvena yātyūrdhvamedhito hyati |
tathā dehī subhaktyā me yātyūrdhvaṃ vardhito hyati ||96||
yathā yogī mahaiśvaryairbrahmadvāraṃ prayāti vai |
tathā so’yaṃ mamaiśvaryaiḥ parabrahma prayāti hi ||97||
yathā gopī hyajaṃ prāpya gāyatrītvamupāgamat |
tathā gopo hariṃ prāpya golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||98||
yathā lakṣmīrhariṃ prāpya hṛdaye vāsamāpa sā |
tathā bhakto hariṃ prāpyākṣare vāsamavāpnuyāt ||99||
yathā māyā hariṃ prāpya harau sā pravilīyate |
tathā bhakto hariṃ prāpya harau sampravilīyate || 3.166.100 ||
yathā patnī kāntalagnā pṛthaktve naiva vetti saḥ |
tathā bhakto harau lagno bhedaṃ naijaṃ na vetti ca ||1 01 ||
yathā tu śarkarā dugdhe rasatāmupayāti ca |
tathā kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇakarmā bhaktau dugdhatvamṛcchati ||1 02||
yathā snigdhaṃ mānasaṃ vai snehapātre milatyapi |

yathānandaḥ pramodaśca sukhānyātmani cāpṛthak |
tathā bhakto divyarūpaḥ paramātmani cāpṛthak || 1 04||
ityevaṃ te mayā lakṣmi viṣahāratvamīritam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohati || 1 05||
