ātmanastu purāhaṃkāreṇa yuddhamavartata |
ahaṃkāreṇa deho’yaṃ nijarājyātmakaḥ kṛtaḥ || 13||
sugandhaśca hṛtastena sarvo’pi nijarājyajaḥ |
durgandhaścāvaśiṣṭaśca mṛtyudo duḥkhado garaḥ || 14||
cidātmā vīkṣya duṣkṛtyaṃ jñānanāśātmakaṃ hyapi |
anātmyācaraṇaṃ vīkṣya śastraṃ vivekamādadhe ||15||
ahaṃkārasya duṣṭasyāvāsṛjanmṛtyudasya tat |
vadhyamāno’pyahaṃkāraḥ śastreṇa cātiveginā || 1 6||
viveśa pṛthivīṃ tyaktvā jalabhāgaṃ nirāmayam |
surasaśca hṛtastena sarvo’pi nijarājyajaḥ || 17||
druṣṭaraso’vaśiṣṭaśca mṛtyudo duḥkhado garaḥ |
ātmā śastraṃ punastasyāvāsṛjad vadhahetave || 18||
vadhyamāno viveśāhaṃkāro jyotiḥpradeśakam |
tatra rūpaṃ surūpaṃ ca jagrāha nijarājyagam ||1 9||
kurūpaṃ cāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca cidātmā punareva ca |
tīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ vivekākhyamasya cāvāsṛjattataḥ ||3.169.20||
tāḍyamāno’pyahaṃkāro viveśa vāyubhūstaram |
tatra sparśaṃ suṣṭusaṃjñaṃ jagrāha nijarājyagam ||21||
kusparśaścāvaśiṣṭo vai taṃ vilokya punastathā |
śastraṃ cāvāsṛjattasya vināśārthamathāpi saḥ |||22||
ahaṃkāro’viśad vyoma śabdaṃ jagrāha tadgatam |
kuśabdaścāvaśiṣṭaśca vīkṣya taṃ tu punastathā ||23||
cidātmā śastramāgṛhya mārayāmāsa yāvatā |
ahaṃkāro viveśāpi cidātmani nirāśritaḥ ||24||
cidātmā ca gururbhūtvopādideśāpyahaṃkṛtim |
ahaṃ brahmasvarūpo’smītyahaṃkāro’pi tad dadhau ||25||
tato brahmasvarūpasyābhimatyā brahmatāṃ yayau |
māyiko’pi gurorvākyādupāstyā brahmatāṃ yayau || 26||
cidātmā taṃ vivekena jaghānāpi na vai hatim |
yayau cātmasthitastasmājjāto mṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ||27||
svasvabhāvaṃ parityajya cidātmarūpatāṃ gataḥ |
avadhyabhāvamāsādya divyāhaṃbhāvamāśritaḥ ||28||
buddhiṃ divyāṃ samāśritya paramātmānamāptavān |
avadhyaḥ sa sadā jāto divyabuddhyātmasaṃsthitaḥ ||29||
parameśa parābhaktyā muktabhāvamupāgataḥ |
muktānāṃ divyatattvānāṃ vyāghāto naiva jāyate ||3.169.30||
evaṃ lakṣmi vināśo vai mṛtyorbhavati cārpaṇāt |
ātmārpaṇaṃ samastānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca karmaṇām || 31 ||
vṛttīnāṃ cātmanā sākaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ hi nirguṇam |
nirguṇe mayi nāstyeva mṛtyurlokābhiduḥkhadaḥ ||32||
vyādhayo dvividhā lakṣmi śārīrā mānasāstathā |
teṣāṃ parasparaṃ janma parasparamapekṣiṇām ||33|||
vātapittakaphānāṃ tu vaiṣamye dehajā hi te |
avaiṣamye svasthabhāvaścārogyaṃ gīyate hi tat ||34||
oṣadhena yathāmṛdyaṃ mṛdyate tadvirodhinā |
uṣṇena mṛdyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇyaṃ ca mṛdyate ||35||
mānase’pi tathā doṣe mṛdustīkṣṇena mṛdyate |
harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ||36||
sattvarajastamasāṃ cet sāmyaṃ svāsthyaṃ tadātmanaḥ |
vaiṣamyaṃ vyādhirevāyaṃ tatra mardanamiṣyate ||37||
duḥkhavān yatate saukhye sukhī duḥkhaṃ smaratyapi |
guṇajau tāvubhau bhāvau mānasau na tu cātmanaḥ ||38||
tathāpi vegamāsādya vahate tatpravāhaṇe |
saṃgaṃ ca labhate dehī manute mānasānnije ||39||
yadi cellabhate prajñāṃ purāṇīṃ sadgurormukhāt |
saccidānandabhāvāṃ svāṃ mano nāśaṃ tadecchati ||3.169.40||
yatate tadvināśārthaṃ prajñāśastreṇa cātmanaḥ |
ātmā yoddhā svayaṃ syācca brahmarathe niṣadya vai ||41 ||
pārabrahmapadaṃ lakṣmi tadā cātmā vijeṣyati |
bāhyaṃ sarvopakaraṇaṃ vaiśyaṃ dravyaṃ samutsṛjet |||082||
asaṃgaścāparigrahastataḥ siddhiṃ pralapsyate |
mameti jāyate yāvanmṛtyustāvadupasthitaḥ ||43||
na mameti yadā bhāvo mṛtyustasya gato mṛtim |
so’haṃ brahmeti tasyaiva śāśvataṃ samprakāśate ||44||
etādṛśasya tu vivekino lakṣmi hyasīmakam |
brahmāṇḍarājyamasyāsti jaṃgamasthāvarātmakam ||45||
tathāpi nāsya mamatā mṛtyustaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati |
mṛtyumūrdhapadaṃ kṛtvā sa yātā brahma śāśvatam ||46||
kāmaṃ vai vasato lakṣmi vane vanyena jīvataḥ |
mamatāmatyajatastu mṛtyuḥ keśeṣu tiṣṭhati ||47||
bāhyāntarāṇāṃ mamatāṃ māyāṃ vīkṣyāntarātmanā |
antarbrahmasvarūpeṇa sthāturmuktirmahābhayāt ||48||
sarvāḥ pravṛttayo loke kāmodbhāvyā bhavanti tāḥ |
vicāryākāmago bhūtvā yadi saṃharate manaḥ ||49||
kāraṇasyaiva saṃhārād bhūyo’bhyāsabalaidhitaḥ |
māyāpravāhamuttīrya yāti brahmasanātanam ||3.169.50||
sāramārgaṃ pralambeta dānaṃ vrataṃ tapo makham |
sāramapi hyasāraṃ cākāmaṃ kṛtvānusañcaret ||5 1 ||
haryarpaṇaṃ mahāsāraṃ kṛtvā yadvānusañcaret |
sarvaṃ tasyottaraṇāya bhaveduta sahāyakṛt ||52||
nigraho mokṣabījaṃ vai pragraho bhavabījakam |
śṛṇu lakṣmi purāgāthāṃ vṛttāṃ jīvātmano yathā ||53||
ātmā sukhī svayaṃ pārśvasthitaṃ papraccha caikadā |
abhimānaṃ sukhe vighnakartāraṃ balinaṃ muhuḥ ||54||
kathaṃ kena vināśaste yadi satyavrato bhavān |
vad me yena prayate tvannāśe sukhavānaham ||55||
tadāhaṃkārapuruṣaḥ śmaśrubalaṃ pradarśayan |
saroṣaṃ dehinaṃ prāha śṛṇu satyaṃ vadāmi tat ||56||
na kaścinmama nāśaṃ vai kartumatra bhavotthitaḥ |
ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ yadvā mahābhāgavataṃ janam ||57||
nāhaṃ śakyaḥ saṃgavatā hantu bhūtena kenacit |
yadbalena hanyate tadbalaṃ praharaṇaṃ ca vā |||58||
na māṃ hantuṃ samarthaṃ vai yāvattvena bhavatyuta |
bījapuṣṭikaraṃ syād yat punaḥ prādurbhavāmyaham |||59|||
yajñādyairdakṣiṇāḍhyairmāṃ hantu prayatate yadi |
dharmecchāsya mama puṣṭistayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||3.169.60||
japena cāpi maunena māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi |
sāhaṃbhāvo’tra puṣṭirme tayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||61 ||
vedāntairjñānamārgairvā māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi |
mayā hatetyahaṃpuṣṭistayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||62||
sannyāsena virāgeṇa māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi |
pramādo’nyatra puṣṭirme tayā prādurbhavāmyaham ||63||
pramādino bahiścittāḥ piśunāḥ kalahotsukāḥ |
sannyāsino’pi vartante devasandūṣitāśayāḥ ||64||
dhṛtyā brahmavratenāpi māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi |
jayābhimānabījākhyapuṣṭyā punarbhavāmyaham ||65||
tapasaiśvaryalabdhyā māṃ prahantuṃ yatate yadi |
madhumatyādibhiścamatkṛtibhiryāṃgasiddhibhiḥ ||66||
bījātmikābhiratyarthapuṣṭyā punarbhavāmyaham |
mokṣārthaṃ sādhanaiścāpi māṃ hantuṃ yatate yadi ||67||
tamajñaṃ sādhanatuṣṭaṃ nṛtyāmi ca hasāmi ca |
evaṃvidhābhilaṣiṇāmavadhyo’haṃ sanātanaḥ ||68||
mamatvaṃ viparīte vā sveṣṭe manāg bhaved yadi |
tatrāhaṃ jīvanaṃ labdhvā bhavāmi bhavabandhakṛt ||69||
mamatā manaso bhāvo manonāśe vinaśyati |
kācabhāve kṣiterdoṣā vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||3.169.70||
tathāpi bhagnatābhāvaḥ kācasyāpi na naśyati |
tathātmano mamatātmā bhāvo’ntato na naśyati ||71 ||
pralayaṃ tu samāsādya pṛthvī jale vilīyate |
evaṃkrameṇa tattvānāṃ mahattattve layo bhavet| ||72||
manasaśca laye māyālaye jīvatvarodhane |
ātmatvabhāsane mṛtyurmama syādapunarbhavaḥ ||73||
ātmāvabhāsaḥ sahasā parameśakṛpāvaśaḥ |
tadarpaṇena sarvasya mama nāśo yato mataḥ ||74||
evamuktaḥ purā cātmābhimānena garīyasā |
so’yaṃ lakṣmi yatetaiva parameśe mayi dhruve ||75||
sarvārpaṇādibhāvena tadāhantā vinaśyati |
mamatā līyate cāpi patitā paramātmani ||76||
lavaṇasya yathā pāte samudre līnatā sadā |
na praroho bhavet kvāpi tathā kṛṣṇo’sya nāṃkuram ||77||
jñātvaivaṃ yatate sādhuḥ sarvātmārpaṇamuttamam |
dehendriyamanaḥprāṇāhaṃkāramahatāmapi ||78 ||
sattvarajastamasāṃ ca saccidānandadharmaṇām |
astitvasyārpaṇaṃ cāpi sarvārpaṇaṃ karoti hi ||79||
mayyarpaṇena bhaktānāṃ sarvaṃ madyogataḥ kila |
matsvarūpaṃ bhavatyeva na tadbandhāya jāyate ||3.169.80 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi mama bhaktasya vai kathām |
bhakto nāmnā sādhubhāvāyanaścātra sarastaṭe ||81 ||
saṃkucya vṛttīḥ sarvāstu samādhau saṃsthito’bhavat |
tāvattasya samīpastho’haṃkārapuruṣo’bhavat ||82||
vikarālaścograrūpaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo’tipuṣṭimān |
hasannuvāca taṃ sādhubhāvāyanaṃ hṛdantare ||835||
kastvaṃ kasmādito māṃ vai niṣkāsayasi madgṛhāt |
vrate cāhamahaṃkāro puṇyaviṣayasaṃsthitaḥ ||84||
dāne cāhamahaṃkāraḥ svargadharmavyavasthitaḥ |
yajñe cāhamahaṃkāraḥ kartṛvṛttivyavasthitaḥ ||85||
dakṣiṇāviṣayaścāpi yajamānatvasaṃsthitaḥ |
tīrthe cāhamahaṃkāraḥ pāvitryaviṣayasthitaḥ ||86||
sevāyāmapyahaṃkāraḥ karomītyeva saṃsthitaḥ |
jape cāhamahaṃkāro’ghanāśavṛttimāsthitaḥ ||87||
brahmacarye’pyahaṃkāro vratī cāhamitisthitaḥ |
vidyāyāmapyahaṃkāro vidvāniti vyavasthitaḥ ||88 ||
vairāgye cāpyahaṃkāro hyadoṣo’hamiti sthitaḥ |
sannyāse cāpyahaṃkāraḥ saṃsārakṣapaṇo nvaham ||89||
dhyāne cāpi hyahaṃbhāvo dhyātāhaṃ yogavānaham |
samādhāvapyahaṃkāraścaiśvaro’haṃ vimāyikaḥ ||3.169.90||
evaṃ me vigame caike’pare pakṣe tu jīvanam |
vartate ceti tasmānna mṛto bhavāmi karhicit ||9 1 ||
ekenārpaṇabhāvena gacchāmi cārpite śraye |
puṇyaṃ karma phalaṃ bhaktiścātmā vṛttiśca mānasam ||92||
arpitāni matiścāhaṃ yadi śrīparamātmani |
tadā sarve pragacchāmo’rpaṇāśraye śubhāśraye ||93||
arpitāraṃ vihāyaiva gacchāmo dānakarmaṇā |
tasmāt sādho’rpaya buddhiṃ māyāṃ triguṇaśobhanām ||94||
avidyāṃ ca tathā vidyāṃ mahattattvaṃ vṛṣāśrayam |
dharmādikān sarvabhāvān mānasaṃ cāpi dharmavat ||95||
indriyāṇi samastāni devatā vṛttīrantaram |
bāhyaṃ ca karaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanmātrāṇi ca gocarān ||96||
viṣayān pañcabhūtāni bhautikāni gṛhāṇi ca |
golakān tatphalaṃ cāpi guṇān karmāṇi yāni ca ||97||
sarvāṇi ceṣaṇāḥ sarvā vāsanāścāpi bhāvanāḥ |
sambandhām̐śca tathā sarvasaṃskārānapi cārpaya ||98||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktyārpaṇaṃ kuru |
tadāhaṃ svakuṭumbena yuto yāsyāmi nānyathā ||99||
śrutvaivaṃ sahasā mitraṃ matvotthāya samādhitaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi samarpaṇam || 3.169.100 ||
sarvasya karmakāṇḍasyākarot sādhubhavāyanaḥ |
madbhāḥva sarvathā bhūtvārpayaccātmaniveditām || 101 ||
evaṃ yogasamādhyādīṃstyaktvā śrīpauruṣottamīm |
sevātmikāṃ kriyāṃ sarvāṃ nārāyaṇe samārpayat ||1 02||
abhimānastadā tasya vilīnaḥ paramātmani |
nityamukto’bhavat so’pi madātmākṣaravāsakṛt || 1 03||
evaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ lakṣmi sādhanaṃ duḥkhanāśanam |
mokṣasya sādhanaṃ caitanmamārpaṇaṃ samastataḥ || 1 04||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya nirmamatvaṃ prajāyate |
anādimuktatā cāpi jāyate vartanāttathā || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mṛtyupradakāraṇāni tadvināśasādhanaṃ sādhubhāvāya narṣidṛṣṭāntenābhimānasya kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhayānāśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 169 ||

<3.170>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
muktidharmān kṛṣṇakānta mohacchedanakārakān |
jīvānāmanukampārthaṃ vadatrā sarvasammatān || 1 ||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ sarvasakhīsamanvitā |
siddhidān muktidān dharmān vakṣyāmi hitakāriṇaḥ || 2 ||
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ vyoma saccidānandalakṣaṇam |
muktisthānaṃ paradhāma mamāsti lakṣmi vetsi tat || 3 ||
mayā śrīkṛṣṇarūpeṇa golokaḥ sevyate sadā |
rādhādigopikāvṛndaiḥ sevitena nijātmanā || 4 ||
prathamaṃ paramaṃdhāma dvitīyaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam |
golokastṛtīyaṃ dhāma muktisthānaṃ mamāsti tat || 5 ||
vaikuṇṭhe tu caturthe vai nārāyaṇo vasāmyaham |
lakṣmyādibhiḥ pārṣadādyaiḥ sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 6 ||
pañcame vāsudevo’haṃ saṃkarṣaṇādibhiḥ saha |
vasāmyavyākṛte dhāmni muktisthāne sadā priye || 7 ||
ṣaṣṭhe’mṛtākhye loke’haṃ bhūmā nāmnā vasāmi ca |
īśvarāṇāṃ nyāyakartā mahārājādhirājakaḥ || 8 ||
saptame śrīpuradhāmni vasāmi lalitāpatiḥ |
mahālakṣmīpūjito’haṃ mahāviṣṇusvarūpadhṛk || 9 ||
yeyaṃ śrīkambharālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇasaṃyutā |
bhūtale vartate cādya mātā me bhāgyaśālinī || 3.170.10 ||
aṣṭame prākṛte dhāmni māyāmaye tu pauruṣe |
nivasāmi patiścāhaṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣātmakaḥ || 11 ||
mahāpuruṣarūpasya muktisthānaṃ hi tattathā |
sādāśaivaṃ navamaṃ ca nityakailāsanāmakam || 12||
vaiṣṇavaṃ daśamaṃ dhāma śrīviṣṇurūpasevitam |
vairājaṃ dhāma vai caikādaśaṃ tvīśvarakoṭikam || 1 3||
dvādaśaṃ mātsyamevāpi kaurmaṃ trayodaśaṃ tathā |
caturdaśaṃ tu vārāhaṃ paścadaśaṃ tu kāpilam ||14||
ṣoḍaśaṃ cāpi hāreyaṃ vāsudevīyakaṃ tataḥ |
aṣṭādaśaṃ tu pārthaṃ vai dāttātreyaṃ tataḥ param || 15||
viṃśaṃ haṃsāśritaṃ dhāmaikaviṃśaṃ nārasiṃhakam |
ārṣabhaṃ dvāviṃśakaṃ ca trayoviṃśaṃ tu vāmanam || 16||
caturviṃśaṃ parśurāmāśrayaṃ yājñaṃ tataḥ param |
rāmadhāma tataścāpi saptaviṃśaṃ kumāravat || 17||
aṣṭāviṃśaṃ hāyagrīvaṃ nāradaṃ tu tataḥ param |
triṃśaṃ tu rājarājāḍhyaṃ vyāsasya tvekatriṃśakam || 18||
bauddhaṃ dvātriṃśakaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tu mohinīśritam |
nāpuṃsakaṃ catustriṃśaṃ tathāsaṃkhyāni cākṣare || 1 9||
akṣarasya pradeśeṣu sīmasvetāni santi vai |
bahūni me svarūpāṇi cāvatārāstathā rame ||3.170.20||
anantāśca tato dhāmānyapyanantāni santi me |
bhaktānāṃ bhāvanāpūrtyai kṛtāni tāni tattathā || 21 ||
muktisthānāni sarvāṇi yathābhakti yathāsthiti |
prāpyante mānavaistānyupāsanābalibhiḥ priye ||22|
evamanyāni loke’tra bhavanti ca bahūnyapi |
jalāvaraṇavaikuṇṭhaṃ satyaṃ dhāmāpi vedhasaḥ || 23||
badaryāśramamevāpi naranārāyaṇasya me |
tataḥsthānaṃ śubhaṃ muktipradaṃ laukikamuktidam ||24||
śvetadvīpābhidhaṃ dhāma nirannamuktasevitam |
śeṣe yatrāhamevāsse lakṣmīrevādisevitaḥ || 25||
cāndraṃ sthānaṃ tathā sauraṃ sthānaṃ me yatra rājate |
mūrtirhiraṇmayī divyā vahnau cāpi tathā sthitā ||26||
kauberaṃ cāpi yāmyaṃ ca mārutamaindramityapi |
aiśānaṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ śaivaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ jale ||27||
merau sthānānyasaṃkhyāni muktitulyasukhāni vai |
pātāleṣu tathā santi sthānāni sukhadānyapi ||28||
aihikamuktiyogyāni bhavanti tāni padmaje |
sāntāni tāni sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍasthāni yāni vai ||29||
cirasthasukhadānyeva muktitulyāni santi hi |
aiśvarāṇyapi dhāmāni sāntāni pralaye khalu ||3.170.30 ||
prākṛtāni samastāni nāśayogyāni tāni hi |
ciramuktipraśastāni bhavanti mama vāñcchayā ||31 ||
vinākṣarapadaṃ lakṣmi bṛhaddhāma vināpare |
lokāḥ sthānāni divyāni kāśante’ntarbhavanti ca ||32||
parabrahmasvarūpo’haṃ yadā bhavāmi yogavān |
rādhāyukto ramāyuktastadā dhāmāni matkṛte ||33||
sarvāṇyāvirbhavantyeva brahmato’kṣaradhāmani |
brahmātmakāni sarvāṇi brahmāntāni hi padmaje ||34||
kvaciccākṣaradhāmāpi mayi sarvaṃ vilīyate |
paradhāmasthite’nādiparabrahmaṇi svāmini ||35||
paradhāma sadā me’sti yato’kṣarādayo muhuḥ |
āvirbhavanti kāśante muktānāṃ koṭayo’pi ca ||36||
mamāśritāśca vā ye tu mamāvatāramāśritāḥ |
mameśvarānāśritā vā mama mūrtimupāśritāḥ ||37||
mamāṃśānāśritā ye vā madvibhūtimupāśritāḥ |
matsādhūnāśritā ye vā macchaktiṃ samupāśritāḥ ||38||
madbhaktidhyānaniratā mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ |
matsādhusevane saktā matsādhvīsevane tathā ||39||
matkalāmāśritā ye vā madāveśamupāśritāḥ |
madvaṃśamāśritā ye ca mama patnīrupāśritāḥ ||3.170.40||
madarthamātmasarvasvaniveditvamupāśritāḥ |
te sarve mama mārgasthā mama mārgamupāśritāḥ ||41 ||
mama mārge pravṛttāśca mama mārge pragāmiṇaḥ |
mama snehabharāḥ sarve mama sānnidhyamāgatāḥ |||42||
mama muktiṃ prayāntyeva mayā maddhāma prāpitāḥ |
kramamārgādhirūḍhāste prayānti paramaṃ padam ||43||
mānavāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro munayastathā |
santaḥ siddhāḥ satpuruṣāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ ||44||
ātmanivedino ye ca vaiṣṇavā matsuyoginaḥ |
teṣāmāśrayamāptā ye te sarve kramaśaḥ khalu ||45||
madaṃśopāsanāśaktyā māmeṣyanti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
muktidharmaḥ kramavām̐śca puṣṭo bhavati tairiha ||46||
sākṣānmāṃ ye cāśrayanti vedasaṃhitayā vidaḥ |
teṣāṃ kramaṃ vinā prāptirdhāmnaḥ purasya me bhavet ||47||
evaṃ vai bahavo yātā māmupāśritya matpadam |
matsvarūpopāsakāstu kramād yāsyanti matpadam ||48||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā loke muktimārgaḥ kṛpākṛtaḥ |
taṃ sṛtvā laṃghayiṣyanti bhavāraṇyaṃ mamāśritāḥ ||49||
ekadāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe śrīmānaso muniḥ |
niṣaṇṇo brahmavṛkṣādho bhūtale prajapan harim ||3.170.50||
dadarśa yogipuruṣaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam |
sarvatattvārthakuśalaṃ sukhaduḥkhavivekinam ||51 ||
jātismaraṃ puṇyapāpakovidaṃ cātmavedinam |
jñātāraṃ ca gatīnāṃ vai karmaṇāṃ dehivartinām ||52||
carantaṃ muktavat siddhaṃ praśāntaṃ ca jitendriyam |
dīpyamānaṃ śriyā brāhmyāntardhānavidyāvedinam ||53||
tathādṛśyairbhāgavatairbhaktairyāntaṃ śanairanu |
śrīmānasaḥ samutthāya yoginaṃ prāṇamat puraḥ ||54||
svāgatādyaiścidānandābhidhaṃ taṃ paryatoṣayat |
bhāvena śraddhayā bhaktyā sevayā tuṣṭa eva saḥ ||546||
cidānandaḥ samuvāca yogyaṃ śrīmānasaṃ munim |
śṛṇu sādho kṛpayātra vadāmi kṛṣṇapreritaḥ ||56||
kṛṣṇasyaiva jagat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ parikalpitam |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ sarvaṃ muktaye divyatāptaye ||57||
kṛṣṇaṃ vihāya cānyasmai yojitaṃ laukikāptaye |
laukikāptipradaṃ syāttanna tu śāśvatamuktaye ||68||
vividhaiḥ karmabhirlokāḥ puṇyayogaiśca kevalaiḥ |
prayāntyeva śubhāṃ martyā devalokādisaṃsthitim ||59||
na tatra sukhamatyantaṃ na tatra śāśvatī sthitiḥ |
sthānāttu mahato bhraṃśo duḥkhalabdhāt punaḥ punaḥ ||3.170.60 ||
aśubhā gatayaḥ prāptāstādṛśyaśca mayā tvayā |
purā bahvyo nipātāntāḥ kaṣṭāḥ pāpābhisaṃbhṛtāḥ ||61 ||
kāmakrodhamahāmohatṛṣṇārāgādisaṃbhṛtāḥ |
yatra muhurhi maraṇaṃ mananaṃ yatra vai muhuḥ ||62||
āhārā vividhā bhuktāḥ pītāḥ stanā asakhyakāḥ |
mātaro vividhā dṛṣṭāḥ pitaro’pi pṛthagvidhāḥ ||63||
sukhāni ca vicitrāṇi narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā |
duḥkhānyapi vicitrāṇi rodanāni bahūnyapi ||64||
vakṣaḥkuṭṭāni bahudhā kṛtāni tatra tatra ca |
śirastāḍanamevāpi cātmaghātā hyanekadhā ||65||
priyairvivāsā bahudhā saṃvāsāścāpriyaiḥ saha |
duḥkhāptānāṃ sañcitānāṃ dhanānāṃ nāśanāni ca ||66||
avamānāḥ sukaṣṭāśca nṛpebhyaḥ svajanāditaḥ |
śārīrā mānasā vāpi vedanāścātidāruṇāḥ ||67||
tiraskārāścograrūpā vadhā bandhāśca dāruṇāḥ |
pāravaśyātikaṣṭāni rogakaṣṭāni vai tathā ||68||
yātanā yamajāścāpi niraye patanānyapi |
janmarogāśca bahavo jarārogāśca dāruṇāḥ ||69||
vyasanāni samastāni trāsadāni muhurmuhuḥ |
loke’sminnanubhūtāni dvandvajāni mayā tvayā ||3.170.70 ||
tvayānādikṛṣṇayogāt tyaktaṃ jālaṃ hi mānasam |
daihikaṃ ca sadā tyaktaṃ śrīharau paramātmani ||71 ||
sukhī cāsse’tra parame pāvane caraṇe hareḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarakṣetre mokṣade divyamuktavat ||72||
ahaṃ vicārya ca sarva paraṃ vairāgyamāptavān |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādamupāśritaḥ ||73 ||
lokatantraṃ tyaktavām̐śca duḥkhārttaḥ sādhuvṛttimān |
sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ cānubhūya tvimaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ ||74||
tataḥ siddhimavāpāpi prasādātparamātmanaḥ |
athāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaṃ prabhum ||75||
dṛṣṭvā natvā pūjayitvā prayāmi paramaṃ padam |
nāhaṃ punarihāgantā tīrthaṃ kṛtvā prayāmyaham ||76||
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punaḥ siddhirdivyā me’tra vyajāyata |
āsiddherāprajāsargādātmano’pi gatīḥ śubhāḥ ||77||
nopalabdhāsmyuttare vai tatheyaṃ siddhiruttamā |
śubhaṃ sarvaṃ mayā nyastaṃ nārāyaṇe parātmani ||78||
na me tataḥ śubhaṃ cāpi bhoktavyamavaśiṣyate |
itaḥ paraṃ gamiṣyāmi śrīhareḥ paramaṃ padam ||79||
parabrahmapadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ |
nāhaṃ punarihāgantā sṛṣṭilokaṃ hi dukhadam ||3.170.80||
tvāṃ divyaṃ tu paraṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā gurorhareriha |
prīto’smi te cātmavedin brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||8 1 ||
kālo’yaṃ vidyate śubhro bhakte’rpayituṃ mānasam |
ātmanivedibhaktasya sevayā sarvamāpyate ||82||
prasādena mahāmuktirāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
yathā tvaṃ syāḥ prasanno’tra tathā sevāṃ pradarśaya ||83||
bhṛśaṃ prīto’smi bhavato bhaktyopāsanayā hareḥ |
paripṛcchasva bhāṣeyaṃ sarvaṃ yattava vāñcchitam ||84||
bahu manye ca te bhaktiṃ bhṛśaṃ tvāṃ pūjayāmi ca |
yenāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyo’smi kiṃ dadāmi drutaṃ vada ||85||
ityuktaḥ śrīmānaso’pi prapūjya taṃ suvastubhiḥ |
cidānandaṃ divyajanaṃ papraccha bahudhāmatim ||86||
kathaṃ dehaḥ kṣayameti kathaṃ dehaḥ prapadyate |
kathaṃ dehī saṃsaram̐śca saṃsārātparimucyate ||87||
kathaṃ māyā līyate ca kathaṃ māyāṃ prapadyate |
ekaṃ dehaṃ parityajya kathamanyaṃ prapadyate ||88||
kathaṃ nijārjite cātmā śubhāśubhe bhunakti ca |
śubhāśubhe prabhuktvā ca kathaṃ brahmābhipadyate ||89||
videhasyāsya jīvasya karma kva vā pratiṣṭhati |
karmaṇāṃ phalanāśārthaṃ kasyāśraya upāsyate ||3.170.90||
kathaṃ kena pratāpena divyatātra samarthyate |
kathaṃ vā nityamuktatvaṃ kathaṃ vākṣaravāsitā ||91 ||
kathaṃ sārūpyamevāpi bhavettāni nirūpaya |
ityevaṃ lakṣmi papraccha cidānandaṃ hi mānasaḥ ||92||
cidānandastu kṛpayā smṛtvā māṃ parameśvaram |
sarvān praśnān yathāyuktān vicāryottaramāha ha ||93||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmeṣu vividhadhāmnāṃ nirdeśaḥ śrīmānasacidānandayoginormithaḥ praśnāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 170 ||

<3.171>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
evaṃ sampreritaścidānando yogī pratāpavān |
śrīmānasaṃ sarvapraśnottarāṇyāha kramād rame || 1 ||
ānupūrvyeṇa kamale tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu |
āyuḥkarāṇi karmāṇi yāvad dehī prasevate || 2 ||
tāvadāyuḥprasandhānaṃ cehaiva jāyate’gragam |
puṇyaṃ sabhājanasevā sādhusevā śubhāśiṣaḥ || 3 ||
dānaṃdamaścendriyāṇāṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ śubham |
yogābhyāso bhajanaṃ ca sarvāṇyāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 4 ||
vahnisevauṣadhasevāpyahiṃsā ghṛtabhojanam |
vighasāśitvamityetānyāyurvṛddhikarāṇi vai || 5 ||
satītīrthaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ surārcanam |
arāgitvaṃ hyabhogitvaṃ caitānyāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 6 ||
ṛṣyarpaṇaṃ tathā devārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tathā |
nityamuktārpaṇaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ cāyuḥkarāṇi vai || 7 ||
svargiṇā saha maitrī ca ravargāyuḥsampradā bhavet |
evamāyuryaśodātṛ sevate karma bhāgyavān || 8 ||
āyuḥkṣayaparītātmā viparītāni sevate |
buddhirvyāvartate tasya vināśe samupasthite || 9 ||
balaṃ śaktiṃ samāśritya garvaṃ cāpyabhimānakam |
atyantaṃ bhogamādatte viruddhamapyanātmavān || 3.171.1 0||
niṣevate’tikaṣṭāni bhuṃkte’dhikāni śaktitaḥ |
duṣṭānnāmiṣapānāni viruddhāni mitho guṇe || 11 ||
bhuṃkte’mitāni gurūṇi hyajīrṇe’pi punaḥ punaḥ |
balātirekaṃ vyāyāmaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātisevate ||1 2|
satataṃ dhanalobhācca bhāravāhitvamṛcchati |
vegavāho bhavatyeva nitarāṃ jayakāṃkṣayā || 13||
vikṛtaiśca rasairyuktamannamatyaśnute jane |
mūtramalādivegaṃ ca ruṇaddhi karmapāśitaḥ || 14||
yogyāṃ nidrāṃ sevate na divā nidrāṃ prasevate |
ādatte cāpyapakvām̐śca rasān rasanayāhataḥ || 15||
rogavyādhimayo bhūtvā dehakṣayaṃ pravindati |
atirugṇo’pyanutsāhaḥ parājito’tikaṣṭakaiḥ || 1 6||
dhairyaṃ vihāya sahasā maraṇābhimukho bhavet |
api cedbandhanādīni viparītāni vindate || 17||
evaṃvidhairviparītaiḥ śarīraṃ cyavate drutam |
uṣmāruddhaḥ kūpitaśca vāyunā cātivegitāḥ || 18||
bandhān vicchidya sahasā prāṇān kṣipati koṣṭhalāt |
bhinatti marmasthānāni jīvasvāsthyakarāṇyapi || 1 9||
tataḥ sadyo jñānanāśe jīvaḥ pracyavate sthalāt |
kṣaraṃ dehaṃ tyajatyatra sthūlaṃ sūkṣmābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ||3.171.20 ||
jātimaraṇasaṃvijñaḥ punaścānyatra yāti hi |
anye paśyanti taṃ yāntaṃ tyajantaṃ sthūlavarṣma ca ||21||
tathāpi naiva vairāgyaṃ labhante na bhajanti mām |
mriyante tattathaivaite tyajanti sarvamatra ca ||22||
labhante maraṇe pīḍāṃ marmaṇāṃ ghātanādiṣu |
garbhasaṃkramaṇe cāpi labhante vedanāṃ tathā ||23||
janmakṛtāṃ dehakṛtāṃ punarmaraṇayojitām |
labhante vedanāṃ jīvāḥ pārastasyā na vidyate ||24||
yadā dehaṃ jahātyeva nirucchvāsaśca dṛśyate |
sa nirūṣmā nirucchvāso niḥśrīko hatacetanaḥ ||25||
mayā ca brahmaṇā tyakto mṛtātmetyucyate tadā |
srotobhiryairvijānāti cendriyārthān śarīrabhṛt ||26||
teṣāṃ prāṇanirodhena srotasāṃ pralayo bhavet |
srotasāṃ marmavāsānāṃ bhinneṣu marmasu priyaḥ ||27||
apriyo jāyate gacchan nābhijānāti kiñcana |
prāṇayuktaḥ sūkṣmadehasahitastrirucchvasya ca ||28||
niṣkrāman kampayatyāśu sthūlaṃ manāgacetanam |
kāyāt pracyuta evāsau karmabhiḥ svaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||29||
amitaiḥ pāpakaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sahitaḥ sūkṣmadehavān |
prayāti gatimanyāṃ sa tredhā klṛptāṃ yathākṛtām ||3.171.30||
puṇyapāpasamaprāptāṃ gatiṃ prayāti mānavīm |
ihaivoccāvacān bhogān prāpnotyeva svakarmabhiḥ ||3 1 ||
aśubhaiḥ karmabhirlokā hyarvāggatiṃ prayānti vai |
niraye yatra pacyante karmaphalaiḥ prayānti tam ||32||
puṇyabhājastūrdhvagatiṃ tārāmayīṃ prayānti ha |
candramaṇḍalamevāpi sūryamaṇḍalamityapi ||33||
evamādyāni ramyāṇi bhuktvā puṇyakṣaye punaḥ |
cyavante pṛthivīṃ yānti punarjanma punarmṛtim ||34||
punaḥ svargaṃ vā narakaṃ prayānti karmayojitāḥ |
na ca svarge’pi santoṣo dṛṣṭvā dīptatamāṃ śriyam ||35||
nīcoccamadhyamā devāḥ spṛhayanti haranti ca |
vicāryetthaṃ buddhimām̐stu sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ harau prabhau ||36||
kṛtvārpaṇaṃ prayātyeva divyo bhūtvākṣaraṃ padam |
netraṃ netrasya vṛttiṃ ca golakaṃ devatāṃ tathā ||37||
viṣayaṃ rūpamevāpi jñānaṃ bodhaṃ ca veditām |
mananaṃ nirṇayaṃ cābhimatiṃ bhogaṃ samastakam ||38||
tathātmānaṃ ca saṃskārān smaraṇaṃ cāpi keśave |
ātmaniveditaṃ sarvaniveditaṃ vidhāya ca ||39||
sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ tathā divyaṃ vidhāya vā vihāya ca |
saṃyogaṃ prakṛtestyakttvā brahmayogaṃ nidhāya ca ||3.171.40||
vāsanāṃ sarvathā dagdhā mama bhāvanayā rame |
prayātyeva parabrahma māṃ hariṃ puruṣottamam ||41||
evaṃ dehatrayaṃ tyaktvā labhate brahmaśāśvatam |
sarvagandhādiviṣayān bahiḥsrotāṃsi sarvathā |||42|||
antaḥsrotāṃsi tadvacca phalaṃ bhogaṃ tathā mayi |
sarvaṃ nyasya trikaṃ tyaktvā yāti māṃ parameśvaram ||43||
karmakṣaye sthūladehakṣayo bhavati padmaje |
puṇyāpuṇyakṣaye sūkṣmadehakṣayaḥ prajāyate ||44||
brahmānandapravāheṇa vāsanākṣaya eva ca |
vāsanā liṃgadeho’yaṃ mama bhāvena līyate ||45||
ajñānākhyakāraṇasya dehasya vilayo’pi ca |
śṛṇu dehasya vai prāptirātmanastu yathā bhavet ||46||
saccidānandarūpasyādevasyādehinastathā |
kāraṇairvividhairlakṣmi dehayogaḥ prajāyate ||47||
ātmāyaṃ svacchadivyo’sti sa yatrāste’kṣare’thavā |
akṣarasya pradeśe vā sīmni māyārthasannidhau ||48||
sannidhidharmamādatte sphaṭikavat svabhāvataḥ |
ta eva dharmā pārakyāḥ pārakyairyāti vācyatām ||49||
kāśapravṛttiniyamā māyādharmā bhavanti tān |
labdhvā prakāśitaścāhaṃ pravṛtto niyamānvitāḥ ||3.171.50||
ityevaṃ manute cātmā māyātattvādivṛttibhiḥ |
nirṇayaṃ cābhimānaṃ vā cintanaṃ mananaṃ ca vā ||51 ||
māyāprabhātmakaṃ naijaprabhātmakaṃ sa vetti vai |
vedanaṃ naijamevāpi miśraṃ māyāprabhātmakam ||52||
miśraṇaṃ cāsya bhrāntiścāvidyājñānābhidhaṃ hi tat |
tena pravartate cātmā puṇyapāpātmakarmasu ||53||
śubhāśubhāni jāyante karmāṇi māyayāsya tu |
śubhāśubhānāṃ lepaśca jāyate’sya pravedane ||54||
jñāne lepāttatprajanyasaṃskāreṣvapi lepitā |
saṃskāre dharmarūpe yo lepaḥ sa svaccharūpiṇi ||55||
ādhāre jāyate jīve tairjīvaḥ saṃsaratyapi |
sveṣṭabhogādilabdhyarthaṃ sūkṣmayukto’pi cehate ||56||
tena sūkṣmaiḥ sameto’yaṃ labhate sthūlabhautikam |
sthūlaṃ jāḍyaṃ samāsādya sthūlaiḥ pakvo’tijāḍyavān ||57||
sthūlabhāvairbhogavām̐śca karmalubdho bhavatyasau |
prāpya prāpya ca karmāṇi kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||58||
bhuṃkte bhogān bhogamayān bhāgyasaṃskāradān punaḥ |
labhate ca phalaṃ dīrghaṃ cirasevyaṃ ca taistataḥ ||59||
anekajanmabhoktavyaṃ cākṣayaṃ labhate phalam |
evaṃ lakṣmi hyasaṃgo’pi cākarṣaṇasvabhāvataḥ ||3.171.60||
ākṛṣya cānyadharmān sa svārājyaṃ sthāpayatyapi |
arājā ca balī rājyamāhṛtya rājyavān yathā ||61 ||
tathāyaṃ jāyate dehī samākarṣaṇayogavān |
amāyo’pi māyiko’yaṃ jāyate na nivartate ||62||
gāḍhād gāḍhataraṃ bhāvaṃ prapadyate na mucyate |
carmakāro yathā kuṇḍaṃ durgandhaṃ hyapi nojjhati ||63||
carmolbāvṛta evāsau duṣṭaṃ dehaṃ na muñcati |
śubhaṃ tathāśubhaṃ karma miśraṃ vāyaṃ prapadyate ||64||
yathā prasūyamānastu phalī dadyāt phalaṃ bahu |
tathāsya syād bahu puṇyaṃ sattvena manasā kṛtam ||65||
pāpaṃ cāpi tathā caiti pāpena manasā kṛtam |
manoyutastataścāyaṃ mahālasaḥ pravartate ||66||
manobhṛtyo yathā cāsmai dadāti bhuṃkta eva saḥ |
punaścecchati bhogāṃśca tāvadāyurnivartate ||67||
kāmanāpreritaścāyaṃ garbhavāse praṇīyate |
manasā puṇyapāpaiśca garbhe svapiti nirbalaḥ ||68||
śukraṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kalalaṃ dehapūrvajam |
garbhāśaye samāpnoti śubhāśubhādisadṛśam ||69||
kaścid viśati kalale pūrvakarmānusārataḥ |
kaścidviśati budbude svasya karmānusārataḥ ||3.171.70||
kaścidviśati māṃse ca kaścit peśyāṃ svakarmataḥ |
kaścit karaṇḍe viśati kaścidaṃgāḍhyaputtale ||71||
kaścit pratyaṃgamūrtau ca kaścid bhrūṇe viśatyapi |
pūrvakarmānusāreṇa drutaṃ vā yadi vā ciram ||72||
prasūnālaprapuṣṭe vai kālenoṣṇyādipoṣite |
saprāṇe puttale jīvo viśatyeva svakarmataḥ ||73||
saukṣmyādavyaktabhāvācca jīvaḥ sūkṣmaśarīravān |
viśatyevāntaraklṛpte karmaṇā tatra sajjate ||74||
tatra brahma mahaccāste bījasyāpi prarakṣakam |
bījabījaṃ parabrahma nivasāmi sahāpyaham ||75||
kartā kārayitā poṣṭā dhātāvitā nibhālakaḥ |
sākṣī cāsaṃgavān tasya karmaphalapradāyakaḥ ||76||
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ cāhaṃ bījabījaḥ sanātanaḥ |
āpūrakāṇāṃ tattvānāṃ prerayitā vasāmi ca ||77||
prāṇendriyādijīvāturmayā jīvanti jantavaḥ |
sa jīvaḥ sarvagātrāṇi garbhasyāviśya vai tadā ||78||
dadhāti prajñayā sadyaḥ prāṇādhāre vyavasthitaḥ |
tena spandayate’ṅgādi sajīvo’yaṃ nigadyate ||79||
yathā svarṇadravaḥ svalpaḥ kṛtsnāṃ tāmrasya puttalīm |
karoti vai svarṇamayīṃ tathā jīvamayīṃ tanum ||3.171.80||
karoti cetanaścāyamidaṃ jīvapraveśanam |
yathā vahnirlohapiṇḍe praviśya svasvarūpayet ||81||
tathā jaḍe praviśyāyaṃ caitanyena nirūpayet |
yayā gṛhe pradīpo’pi dīpyamānaḥ prakāśate ||82||
ekasthānasthitaścāpi svaṃ cānyaṃ prati kāśate |
evaṃ hṛtstho’pi puruṣastridehaṃ prati kāśate |||83 ||
pūrvakṛtaṃ garbhayogyaṃ tatrolbe bhuṃkta ā nava |
daśame karmaṇāṃ tatra pūrvasya janmanastathā ||84||
jñānaṃ prajāyate cāpi tato bahiḥ prayāti saḥ |
garbhakarma kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ bālyakarma samāgatam ||85||
bhogārthaṃ tena vaśago bālo bhuṃkte kṛtaṃ nijam |
atha yuvā jāyamāno nisargaviṣayecchukaḥ ||86||
pravartate’tiviṣaye pāpaṃ punaḥ prajāyate |
nivartate viṣayebhyaḥ puṇyamasya prajāyate ||87||
dānaṃ vrataṃ brahmacaryaṃ sevā brahmapradhāraṇam |
damaḥ śāntirdayā tīrthaṃ vrataṃ ca saṃyamo yamaḥ ||88||
vyalīkānācaraṇaṃ ca parasvānāṃ vivarjanam |
mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣā devatātithipūjanam ||89||
gurupūjāpyahiṃsā ca śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ |
śubhānāṃ cācaraṇaṃ ca satāṃ vṛttena vartanam ||3.171.90||
etāni yadi kurvīta dharmaḥ puṣṭaḥ prajāyate |
dharmaḥ saṃrakṣitaścainaṃ pāti vaṃśaṃ tathā divam ||91 ||
satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvīta kuryāt satsu dhruvāṃ sthitim |
ācāraṃ pālayet sarvaṃ yatra śāntirnirantarā ||92||
enaṃ dharmaṃ pālayed yo na sa durgatimāpnuyāt |
udayaṃ labhate nityaṃ dharmasya cetanasya ca ||93||
ācārā niyamā uktā abhyudayārthameva ha |
evaṃ niyamyate loko gurubhiḥ śāstravedibhiḥ ||94||
niyame vartamānaśca dehī yogī bhavediha |
viṣavidyāvidaṃ naiva viṣaṃ spṛśati vai tathā ||95||
niyame vartamānaṃ saṃsāraḥ spṛśati naiva ha |
yoge sthitaṃ na spṛśati māyā karma phalāni ca ||96||
yogī mukto jīvanmukto bhūtvā dehātpramucyate |
sarvalokeṣu yogastho mukto dehī viśiṣyate ||97||
guruḥ sa mokṣado loke saṃgahīno yato hi saḥ |
śubhaṃ ced dharmamārgeṇa samarjitaṃ tu dehinā ||98 ||
śubhabhogottaraṃ yadvā kālena mahatāthavā |
saṃsārāttaraṇaṃ cāsya sādhuyogena saṃbhavet ||99||
pāpabhogottaraṃ yadvā paśupakṣyādijanmasu |
satāṃ yogena sahasā pāpanāśaḥ prajāyate || 3.171.10 0||
yānavāhanachāyādau patrapuṣpādiyogataḥ |
satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena puṇyamasya prajāyate ||1 01 ||
tataḥ sajjanmanā prāptiḥ svargasya vā parasya vā |
tataścaiśvaralokasya tato mokṣaṃ prayāti vā ||1 02||
evaṃ lakṣmi kṛtaṃ prāptaṃ bhuktvā karma pramucyate |
purā sṛṣṭau mamaivādeśataḥ pumān hyajāyata ||1 03||
śarīramātmanaḥ kṛtvā sa trailokyaṃ samasṛjat |
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ ceti prakṛtiṃ triguṇātmikām ||1 04||
mama māyāsvarūpāṃ ca sṛṣṭvā puṃse tadā dadau |
prakṛtiḥ sā śarīrāṇāṃ yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat ||1 05||
māyāśabalaḥ puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ cāsṛjat tataḥ |
puṃyogena pradhānācca tattvāni vividhāni vai ||1 06||
hiraṣmayasvarūpāṇi hyajāyanta tato virāṭ |
tato brahmā tato devā mānavādyā imāḥ prajāḥ || 1 07||
māyāmayamidaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaraṃ tatparamakṣaram |
amṛtaṃ dhāma ca tadūrdhvaṃ paraṃdhāma me sthitam ||1 08||
mayādiṣṭā īśvarāstu sṛṣṭimīśvarakoṭikām |
asṛjan tatsamīkṣyāpi brahmāsṛjaccaturvidhān || 1 09||
teṣāṃ kālaparimāṇaṃ vidhāya ca pitāmahaḥ |
sarjanaṃ pralayaṃ cāpyakalpayat sukhahetave || 3.171.11 0||
sukhaṃ tu duḥkhasammiśraṃ kāyamamedhyamityapi |
dehāḥ sarve nāśamukhāḥ saṃsāro ghorakaṣṭadaḥ ||1 11 ||
jātimaraṇayogāḍhyo dustaro’tiviḍambibhiḥ |
asaṃgaiḥ sujayaścāpi satāṃ saṃgayutairapi || 11 2||
nirvidyante vivekaiśca mārgamāṇāḥ paraṃpadam |
ta eva prāptametadvai varṣma tyaktvā prayānti vai ||1 1 3||
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi te’tra dehasya mokṣaṇam |
yathā ca dehalabdhiśca mokṣaprāptiryathā ca tat || 1 14||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmeṣu dehakṣayakāraṇāni dehaprāptikāraṇāni dehānmuktikāraṇāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya || 171 ||

<3.172>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā māyālayo yathā prajāyate |
vidyayā tīryate janturavidyāṃ jayate yataḥ || 1 ||
brahmavidyā parāvidyā cātmavidyā hi yā matā |
paramātmopāsanayā hyavidyā sā viśīryate || 2 ||
nirṇayaḥ snehasahito mananaṃ ca tathāvidham |
māhātmyajñānasahitaṃ cintanaṃ śrīharestathā || 3 ||
svarūpavedanaṃ sampadabhimatyā yutaṃ muhuḥ |
vidyātmakaṃ parabrahmaprāpakaṃ tannigadyate || 4 ||
sā vidyā tu yayā parabrahmādhigamyate rame |
avidyāṃ sā nirasyaiva parabrahma dadāti hi || 5 ||
suvarṇasya viśuddhirvai caturbhirjāyate yathā |
śilayā chedanaiścāpi tāpanaiścābhighātanaiḥ || 6 ||
ātmano’pi tathā māyāvigamaścaturarjanaiḥ |
satsaṃgena ca jñānena vairāgyeṇa prabhaktibhiḥ || 7 ||
satsaṃgena guṇānāṃ vai pravāhasya nirodhanam |
vijñānena saṃskārāṇāṃ śanaiḥ śanairvivartanam || 8 ||
vairāgyeṇa vāsanānāṃ kṣayo harau pravartanam |
snehabhaktyā harau saktirasaṃgo māyayā tataḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ māyāvigamaḥ syāllakṣmi kṛpayā sadguroḥ |
anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasya māyālopo drutaṃ bhavet || 3.172.10 ||
harervāsena māyāyā nivṛttistu nijātmani |
siṃhavāsena sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ vigamo yathā || 11 ||
nṛpavāsena kṣudrāṇāṃ dehināṃ vigamo yathā |
mṛtyuvāsena dehasthakaraṇānāṃ gamo yathā ||1 2||
bilādvai sarpavāsena mūṣakāṇāṃ gamo yathā |
bhayavāsenotsavānāṃ hṛdayādvigamo yathā ||1 3||
udvegānāṃ vigamaśca mahotsave yathā bhavet |
tathā harernivāsena māyāyā vigamo bhavet || 14||
ahaṃ yatra vasāmyeva tatra māyā na tiṣṭhati |
mama bhakte nivasāmi māyā tatra na vidyate || 15||
yaḥ syādekāyane kṛṣṇe līno brahma vicintayan |
tūṣṇīṃ sarvavikārebhyo madanyannaiva dhārayan || 1 6||
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ parityajet sa tared bhavabandhanāt |
adrohaśca kṣamāvām̐śca śāntacitto jitendriyaḥ || 17||
dainyadveṣavihīnaśca nirbhayo brahmaṇo’rjane |
jitacitto jitabhāvo bhakto me mucyate rame || 18||
sarvajīveṣu nijavacchuddhabhāvanayā yutaḥ |
anahaṃbhāvamānādiḥ sarvato mukta eva saḥ || 19||
jīvane maraṇe sthairye duḥkhe sukhe ca mūrchane |
lābhe’lābhe priye dveṣye samo yaḥ sa hi mucyate |||3.172.20||
na kasyacit spṛhayati nāvajānāti kañcana |
nirdvandvo vītarāgādiḥ sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ||21 ||
ajātaśatrurnirbandhuranapatyo’pyabhāryakaḥ |
tyaktadharmārthakāmaśca nirākāṃkṣī pramucyate ||22|
puṇyāpuṇyāvarahitaḥ prārabdhamātrayāpakaḥ |
dehārambhakatattvānāṃ kṣayavān śāntacittakaḥ |||23||
advaitaśrīharau juṣṭaḥ premabhāvena sevayā |
ātmaveditvamāpanno madātmā sa vimucyate ||24||
āśālayo divyadṛṣṭirjagatpaśyedaśāśvatam |
aśvatthasadṛśaṃ janmamṛtyujarāsamanvitam ||25|||
vairāgyaśāntabhāvādyairupeto doṣavarjitaḥ |
ātmabandhaṃ prajahāti mokṣaṃ yātyacirāt sa vai || 26||
divyagandharasasparśaśabdarūpapramodinam |
māyāmūrtivihīnaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣipraṃ pramucyate ||27||
asthūlaṃ cāpyasūkṣmaṃ cākāraṇaṃ tatparaṃ prabhum |
aguṇaṃ guṇabhoktāraṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā drāk pramucyate |||28|||
vimucya sarvakāmāṃśca buddhyā cāntarbhavānapi |
mama bhāvānvito bhaktaḥ śanairnirvāṇamṛcchati |||29|||
bāhmābhyantarasaṃskārairmukto dvandvavivarjitaḥ |
niṣparigraha evāyaṃ niḥsaṃgo mukta eva saḥ ||3.172.30||
tāpaso mama bhāvāḍhyaścānyasaṃskāravarjitaḥ |
brahma sanātanaṃ labdhvā nityamakṣaramūrdhvagam ||3 1 ||
śāntaḥ san māṃ samabhyeti paravrahma parātparam |
ātmanyātmānaṃ sa māṃ vai paśyan yāti paraṃ padam || 32||
sarvendriyāṇi saṃhṛtya vṛttīrmanasi dhārayet |
mano’haṃbhāvane dhṛtvāhaṃ buddhau dhārayettataḥ || 33||
buddhiṃ niyamya satataṃ smaraṇaṃ ca tathāvidham |
saṃskāreṣu pradhārya saṃskārān juhuyādātmani || 34||
ātmānaṃ juhuyāt kṛṣṇe’nādau śrīpuruṣottame |
evaṃ madyogamāpanno nityamuktāya kalpate ||35||
etādṛśaḥ paraḥ sādhurekāntaśīla eva saḥ |
bhavan paśyannije rūpe māṃ madānandamaśnute ||36||
antaścakṣuḥsahitena prakāśenānivartinā |
paśyatyātmani cātmānaṃ māṃ patiṃ puruṣottamam ||37||
evaṃ lagno nijātmanātmānaṃ māṃ tatra paśyati |
yathā hi puruṣaḥ svapne svaṃ vai paśyatyasāviti || 38||
tathāyaṃ sve svarūpe māṃ sādhvātmānaṃ prapaśyati |
dehe snātasya tu yathā lagnaṃ jalapaṭaṃ tu yat ||39||
niṣkṛṣya kuśalaḥ kaścit tatpṛthak cet pradarśayet |
dehaṃ cāpi tathākṛṣya sūkṣmād bhinnaṃ pradarśayet ||3.172.40||
sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇādākṛṣya pṛthaktayā pradarśayet |
kāraṇaṃ cāpi māyātaḥ pṛthakkṛtvā pradarśayet ||41 ||
māyāṃ jīvāt pṛthakkṛtvā tathā kaścit pradarśayet |
jīvaṃ hareḥ pṛthakkṛtya tathā yogī pradarśayet |||42||
ātmānaṃ vai pṛthakkṛtya yathā yogī pradarśayet |
tathā māṃ paramātmānaṃ pṛthakkṛtya pradarśayet ||43||
tathāpi sa na yuktātmā pṛthag bhūmno bhaveddhi mat |
vyāpako’haṃ samastānāṃ tasyāpyaiśvaryarodhakaḥ ||44||
taṃ mayyantaḥprabhāvyaiva niyāmayāmi sarvathā |
māmāpanno mama mukto mamaiśvaryāṇi cāśnute ||45||
māyāsya vinivṛttā vai māṃ yātaḥ so’kṣare pare |
tatra māyā vidyate na yathā tatra tathātra na ||46||
yatra kvāpi vartamāno madbhakto hyastyamāyikaḥ |
nirguṇo divyaguṇavān nirvāṇapadabhājanaḥ ||47||
yadā hi yuktamātmānaṃ mayā paśyati dehabhṛt |
na tasyeheśvaraḥ kaścit trailokyasyāpi sa prabhuḥ ||48||
ekadhā bhavati dvedhā tredhā daśadhā sahasradhā |
anyānyāśca tanū ramyā yatheṣṭaṃ pratipadyate ||49||
na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ śoka ityapi |
devānāmapi devatvaṃ so’yaṃ kārayate vaśī ||3.172.50||
parabrahma hyavāpnoti hitvā videhabhāvanām |
brahmabhāvaṃ gatasyāsya nāśabhayaṃ na jāyate ||5 1 ||
kliśyamāneṣu naṣṭeṣu bhūteṣvasya na vai bhayam |
na kleśairduḥkhaśokaiśca ghoraiḥ saṃgādikodbhavaiḥ ||52||
vicālyate na yuktātmā niḥspṛhaḥ śāntisaṃbhṛtaḥ |
nainaṃ mṛtyurvidhyati vai nainaṃ kālo grasatyapi |||53||
nātaḥ sukhataraṃ kiñcilloke’syānyad vilokyate |
samyag yuktvā nijātmānaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe pratiṣṭhate ||54||
vinivṛttatṛṣāduḥkhaḥ sukhaṃ svapiti cātmani |
rūpaṃ yatheṣṭamabhyeti hitvemāṃ mānuṣīṃ tanum ||55||
tato muktena nirvedaḥ kartavyo na vidhīyate |
ātmadraṣṭā spṛhayate naiva bhogānmahaiśvarān ||56||
ātmaniṣṭho mahāmukto jīvanmukto videhavān |
niṣīdennagare cāpi mano bāhyaṃ na muñcati ||57||
nagarābhyantare tiṣṭhannijāvasathe saṃvaset |
mano naivāvasathe’pi bāhyaṃ mukto vimuñcati ||58||
yatra kuṭyāṃ vaseccāpi pārśve mano na muñcati |
yatra dehe vasatyeva tatrāpi svamano bahiḥ ||59||
dehātmake’pi viṣaye kṣaṇaṃ naivāpi muñcati |
indriyeṣu golakeṣu tanmātreṣu na muñcati || 3.172.60||
mūlādhārādicakreṣu manaḥ kṣaṇaṃ na muñcati |
sūkṣme’pi cānyatattve’pi kṣaṇaṃ mano na muñcati ||61 ||
kāye trividhe sarvatra vāsanāvarjito yataḥ |
antare bahirekātmā māṃ hariṃ paripaśyati ||62||
paripūrṇaṃ yato’syātra sarvaṃ tena sa sadṛśam |
paripūrṇatamaṃ māṃ vai lokayatyeva netarat ||63||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ |
sarvataḥ śrutimān bhūtvaitādṛśaṃ māṃ prapaśyati ||64||
dhārayannapi dehaṃ svaṃ caṣṭe vai brahma kevalam |
ātmānaṃ cāpya vimānaṃ pramodasaṃbhṛtastadā ||65||
vimānamāśrayaṃ kṛtvā mokṣaṃ yāti tato mayi |
naitadetatsuvijñeyaṃ vyāmiśreṇāntarātmanā ||66||
kriyāvatāṃ devaloko jñānināṃ vyoma śāśvatam |
siddhānāṃ satyabhavanaṃ bhaktānāṃ brahma śāśvatam ||67||
parā hi sā gatirlakṣmi yattad brahma sanātanam |
yatrāmṛtatvaṃ kuśalaṃ sukhaṃ pramodanaṃ sadā || 68||
imaṃ sādhanamāśritya pāpāḥ striyo’ntimasthitāḥ |
sarve yānti parāṃ prāptiṃ kiṃ vai punarbahuśrutāḥ ||69||
ye svadharmaniratāḥ sādhubhaktāḥ parārthinaḥ |
brahmavido naiṣṭhikāśca nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||3.172.70||
mama lokātparaṃ tvanyat sukhaṃ kiñcinna vidyate |
jñātvā tyaktvā ca sammohaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt ||71 ||
etanmāyāvilayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ te pradarśitam |
mamaiva sādhyasya yogād yujyate parame pade ||72||
nāsya lakṣmi tṛṣā cāste māṃ vihāyānyagocarā |
tata eva hi bhakto’sau rājate matpare pade ||73||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharmaṃ māyāvilayanasādhanaṃ parabrahmadhāmaprāpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 172 ||

<3.173>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ dampatyoryoginoḥ purā |
samvādaṃ kathayāmyatra śravaṇārhaṃ gatipradam || 1 ||
purā śrutiphalānāmnī yoginī yoginaṃ patim |
sadvidyāyananāmānaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam || 2 ||
papraccha saṃśayārūḍhā lokaśikṣārthameva sā |
dehatrayasamādhisthā varte’haṃ nātha sarvadā || 3 ||
patisevāparā cāpi varte’haṃ harisevinī |
dehadharmaparā trāpi varte’haṃ kāmadharmiṇī || 4 ||
devasevāparā cāpi varte’haṃ śuddhabhāvanā |
mokṣajñānaparāsaṅgā varte’haṃ patibodhitā || 5 ||
athāpi mānasaṃ kānta dehaviṣayamārgagam |
kvacit kvacid dhātupuṣṭyā pravartate hi nimnagam || 6 ||
adhaḥsrotasvabhāvaṃ tanmānasaṃ māṃ vikarṣati |
ūrdhvasrotovatī nātha bhaviṣyāmi kadā tataḥ || 7 ||
kadā muktiṃ gamiṣyāmi kadā vai śāśvataṃ sukham |
kaṃ vā lokaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ kāntaṃ tu samāśritā || 8 ||
bhavānāste tyaktakarmā yogyapi kāmavānapi |
bhāryā tvananyagatikā bhartāramantarā sadā || 9 ||
sāhaṃ yogaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca patiyogena vai vṛṣam |
pālayāmi tathāpyeṣā karmabandhanatā mama || 3.173.1 0||
na bhogayogamāpannaḥ kaścinmokṣaṃ pravindate |
nātha tvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ tat kathaṃ karmaṇā mokṣaṇam || 11 ||
bhāryāḥ patikṛtām̐llokānāpnuvantīti naḥ śrutam |
patiścellokahīno’tra bhāryāyāstatra kā gatiḥ || 1 2||
tvādṛśaṃ patimāsādya kā gamiṣyāmi vai gatim |
itipṛṣṭo muniśreṣṭhaḥ sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ || 1 3||
prāha śrutiphalāṃ patnīṃ śāntātmā tu hṛdā hasan |
na me kāmo na me bandho dehadharmo na me mataḥ || 14||
nāyamātmā bhavet patnī nāyamātmā patiḥ smṛtaḥ |
puṃso dehaḥ patiśceti nārīdehastu patnikā || 15||
eva loke vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ so’yaṃ bhavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
saṃsārabandhanaṃ cāpi dāmpatyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 1 6||
sāpatyakatvaṃ tato’pi bandhanāya prakalpyate |
kāmā yogo vāsanādyā dehadharmā na cātmanaḥ || 17||
paśya tvaṃ māṃ divyadehaṃ nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam |
patirbrahmā patirviṣṇuḥ patirdevo maheśvaraḥ || 18||
patiṃ matvā parabrahma sevate sā pramucyate |
gopyaḥ kāmāt pramucyante pratikalpaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 19||
śrīkṛṣṇasya prayogeṇa lakṣmīrnārāyaṇasya ca |
evaṃ māṃ tvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ matvā sevaya bhāmini ||3.173.20||
tadā lokaṃ yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ prāpsyase dhruvam |
nairguṇyaṃ vā samāśritya bhaja māṃ parameśvaram || 21 ||
tadā tvaṃ brahmanirvāṇaṃ hyavāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktvā nijadehāt sa yogī kāmaṃ surūpiṇam ||22||
pṛthakkṛtvā dadāhaiva kāmo bhasmanibho’bhavat |
kāmapiṇḍaṃ susampannaṃ dadau patnyai tu nirguṇam ||23||
tatsparśenābhavad divyo muktaḥ sumūrta eva saḥ |
kāmo divyasvarūpo’bhūt sadvidyāyanavāñcchayā ||24||
camatkāraṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutiphalāha taṃ patim |
aho nātha jitāmarṣa jitakāma jitendriya ||25||
jitasarvasva tvayātse divyaṃ jānāmi sāmpratam |
śaṃkā me kāmanājanyā nivṛttā divyadarśanāt ||26||
paśyāmi tvāṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ caturbhujātmakaṃ prabhum |
kriyāḥ sarvāśca te divyāḥ prapaśyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||27||
cāñcalyaṃ mama vigataṃ strībuddhiścādya nirgatā |
divyāṃ ratiṃ samāsādya divyā bhavāmi te balāt ||28||
vada me tu yathāyogyā tathā jñānaṃ sukhāvaham |
ityuktvā sā praṇanāma kāmo’pi divyamūrtimān |||29||
viveśa sahasā dehe sadvidyāyanavāñcchayā |
vīkṣya śrutiphalā tatra niḥsaṃśayābhavattataḥ ||3.173.30||
yathā kṛṣṇe tathā bhakte divyāste dehavartinaḥ |
bhavantyeva guṇāḥ sarve durguṇā api sadguṇāḥ ||3 1 ||
kāmaḥ snehaḥ sukhaṃ sevā poṣaṇaṃ ramaṇaṃ śubham |
yojitāḥ śrīharau bhakte divyā bhavanti sādhuṣu ||32||
ye saṃgāḥ strīputrabandhuputrokuṭumbiṣu kṛtāḥ |
ta eva sādhuṣu kṛtā mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam ||33 ||
yogī patirmayā prāpto dhanyāhaṃ divyatāṃ gatā |
dehakriyā na me cāsti divyāhaṃ nāsmi bhāminī ||34||
ātmāhaṃ naiva yoṣidvai muktāhaṃ nityamodinī |
deho dehārthasampannaścātmātmārthavibhūṣitaḥ ||375||
dvayoḥ panthā vibhinno’sti kā naisargikavedanā |
evaṃ brahmasvarūpā sā kṣaṇamātreṇa bhāminī ||36||
brāhmaṇī brahmavettrī ca sampannā saṃgavarjitā |
āhaivaṃ jñānamāpannāṃ patnīṃ vidyāyanastataḥ || 37||
subhage dehasaṃlagnā kriyā sarvā na cātmani |
grāhyaṃ dṛśyaṃ bhavet karma karmajñānendriyairiha || 38||
dehātmā karmakarmeti vyavasyatīti bandhanam |
mohaṃ tatrāpi cāpnoti karmapradhānabhāvataḥ ||39||
jñānahīno janaḥ sarvo dehabandhanamohavān |
naiṣkarmyaṃ nāsya jāyeta yāvaddehābhimānitā ||3.173.40||
dehendriyairmānasādyaiḥ śubhāśubhāni vindati |
janmabhogajarāvyādhikarāṇi bandhadāni ca ||41||
tattvānāṃ vai svabhāvo’sti naiṣkarmye na vasanti vai |
tiṣṭhanti karmayuktāni bhūteṣu karma vartate ||42||
dehabhedān prāpayanti karmāṇi sargajāni vai |
agnihotrādikaṃ vipre vedādhyayanamityapi ||3 ||
śāsanaṃ kṣatriye vaiśye vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣirityapi |
sevā śūdre brahmaśīle svādhyāyo havanādikam ||44||
sadāre satkṛtirdānaṃ copārjanaṃ prapoṣaṇam |
vanye vane vanyavṛttiḥ sādhau bhikṣāṭanādikam ||49||
brahmaśīlanamevāpi naiṣkarmyaṃ naiva vidyate |
naisargikī cañcaleyaṃ prakṛtirdeharūpiṇī ||46||
vikṛtayaścañcalāśca mānasaṃ cañcalaṃ tathā |
buddhirindriyastabakaścittaṃ viṣayacañcalam ||47||
saṃskārāḥ kośavallolā jñānadhārāpi cañcalā |
jñānecchākṛtibhāvāśca dveṣādyā gocarāśritāḥ ||48||
viṣayānanujīvanti cāñcalyaṃ dharmaṇi sthitam |
kriyāsvabhāva sarvaṃ vai tattvajaṃ markaṭaṃ tvidam |||49|||
kathaṃ kriyāvihīnaṃ sattiṣṭhecchāntipralabdhaye |
tasmāttatparivṛttyarthaṃ niścāñcalyaṃ samāśrayet ||3.173.50||
niścaṃcalapraveśena niścañcalatāṃ vrajet |
sarvatra paripūrṇaṃ tatparabrahma tathāvidham ||51 ||
niścañcalaṃ sadā saumye saumyaṃ tadarthamāśrayet |
karmaṇā manasā vācā hṛdātmanā samastakaiḥ ||52||
evaṃ yathā nivātasthaḥ kusūlastho nirodhitaḥ |
cañcalo’pi pradīpo vai svayaṃ mūrcchā hi tailajaḥ ||53||
gacchatyeva tathā syācca cāñcalyarahitaḥ kṣaṇam |
layaṃ gacchecca vā tatrāmbare niṣkriyatāṃ vrajet ||54|
evaṃ cāyaṃ cañcalaiścāvṛto’pi cetanaḥ svayam |
cidambare nirodhaṃ tu samprāpya niṣkriyo bhavet ||55|
sthiro bhavecca maṇivanmaṇipradīpabhāsamaḥ |
naisargikaprabhāyukto maṇidīpo yathā sthiraḥ ||56|
vāyustailaṃ bhavedvā na bhavet tadapi bhāyutaḥ |
vartate sarvadā kāntipradastathāyamacyutaḥ ||67|
vāyutulyā hi viṣayāḥ saumye dehasthitāḥ sadā |
bhujyante vā na bhujyante maṇistu nirapekṣakaḥ |||58|
dehadharmāstathā patni bhujyante vā na vāpi ca |
ātmā maṇistu te me’pi nirapekṣo na karmavān ||19|
parabrahma samāsādya kathaṃ lokān viśaṃkase |
kva gamiṣyāmītiśaṃkāṃ tyaja mukte pareśvari ||3.173.60 ||
ahaṃ brahma sadā cāsmi yāsyāmi ca paraṃ padam |
jñānopāsanabhaktyādyaistvaṃ mayā saha yāsyasi ||6 1||
gṛhadharmā hi dharmāste nādharmā na hi nārakāḥ |
ṛtudharmā manodharmā madyoge divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||62||
jñānayogena yogena brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ |
divyo’haṃ mama yogena tvaṃ patni divyatāṃ gatā ||6 3 ||
etāṃ guptāṃ tu paramāṃ sarahasyāṃ nijāṃ sthitim |
mokṣadāṃ bandhanahīnāṃ ko bhoktā cābhidhāsyati ||64||
abhoktuḥ paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ daśāṃ bhoktā na vindati |
kutaḥ prābhikathayed yā mayā te’bhihitā priye ||65||
rakṣāṃsi sarvavighnāni bhavanti sarvadehinām |
brahmamārge svargamārge tāni tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ||66||
ātmasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ samāśritya mayā priye |
rakṣāṃsi kāmarūpāṇi vaśe kṛtāni sarvathā ||67||
bhruvormadhye gurordhyānaṃ labdhaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
yatra tatparamaṃ brahmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||68||
sarvadā dṛśyate bhārye taṃ bhajasvātinirguṇā |
iḍā ca piṅgalā cāpi suṣumṇā sṛtayastvimāḥ ||69||
yathā priyayā saṃgamya brahmādayo’pi devatāḥ |
yadakṣaraparaṃ kṛṣṇamupāsate maharṣayaḥ ||3.173.70||
vidvāṃsaḥ suvratāḥ śāntā jitārthā yamupāsate |
tamupāssva sadā subhru tyaja daihikacintanam ||71 ||
ghrāṇena na tadāghreya nāsvādyaṃ cāpi jihvayā |
sparśanena tadaspṛśyaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyameva na ||72||
śravaṇācca paraṃ tadvai parabrahma prasevaya |
ātmanā manasā sākaṃ buddhyā brahmagṛhītayā ||73 ||
prāpyate kṛpayā tasya tatparabrahma sevaya |
agandhamarasasparśamarūpaṃ śabdavarjitam ||74||
yataḥ pravartate tantraṃ yatra punaḥ pratiṣṭhati |
pravartante ca marutaḥ prāṇādyā yadvyapekṣayā ||75||
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |
bhajasva bhāmini svāmyuttamaṃ śrīpatimacyutam ||76||
nāhaṃ patirna bhāryā tvaṃ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
āvayorātmanordivye bhaja taṃ puruṣottamam ||77||
hṛdi prāṇaṃ gude’pānaṃ samānaṃ nābhisaṃsthitam |
udānaṃ kaṇṭhadeśasthaṃ vyānaṃ sarvaśarīragam ||78||
vijitvā teṣu cātmānaṃ parameśaṃ vibhāvaya |
saptadhāgnirvaiśvānaraḥ prāṇeṣu dehacāriṣu ||79||
ghrātā ghrāṇena ghreyaṃ vai gandhaṃ pṛthvyāṃ samaśnute |
pātā rasanayā peyaṃ rasaṃ jale samaśnute ||3.173.80||
draṣṭā netreṇa dṛśyaṃ tu rūpaṃ tejasi cāśnute |
spraṣṭā tvacā spṛśyaṃ sparśaṃ mārute vai samaśnute ||81 ||
śrotā karṇena śravyaṃ śabdamākāśe samaśnute |
mantā manasā mantavyaṃ viṣayaṃ manute nijam ||82||
boddhā buddhyā tu boddhavyaṃ viṣayaṃ bodhayatyapi |
ātmā parātmanā sarvaṃ bhuṃkte bhoktavyameva tat ||83||
parātmanā tu yad bhuktaṃ divyaṃ tanna tu laukikam |
laukikaṃ syād bandhanāya divyaṃ mokṣāya cārpitam ||84||
anenaiva prakāreṇa caraṇābhyāṃ gatiḥ kriyā |
hastābhyāṃ cāpyupādānaṃ vācā saṃvādaśabdanam ||85||
pāyunotsarga upasthenānandānubhavādikam |
gantādātā ca vaktā visraṣṭānandayitā hi saḥ ||86||
vaiśvānaro’ntarātmā hi paramātmā karoti tat |
nāhaṃ kartā na tvaṃ kartrī tato na karmabandhanam ||87||
vijñātṛtvābhimānaṃ vai parātmani samarpayet |
bhoktṛtvābhimatiṃ cāpi parātmani samarpayet ||88||
evaṃbhāve naro nāhaṃ nārī na tvaṃ kadāpi vai |
yaścāhaṃ sa eva tu tvaṃ dvāvāvāṃ parame sthitau ||89||
paramātmātiriktatvaṃ nāvayorasti kiñcana |
ātmā tvaṃ ca tathātmāhaṃ paramātmani tiṣṭhataḥ ||3.173.90||
yatra tiṣṭhāva etasmin dhāryaṃ sarvaṃ samarpitam |
evaṃ sati kuto me te karmāpi cāvaśiṣyate || 91 ||
niṣkarmātmani deveśe sarvaṃ parisamarpyate |
satyevaṃ tasya yo lokaḥ sa loko’pyāvayoḥ sadā ||92||
paraṃ padaṃ cidākāśo’kṣaradhāma hi śāśvatam |
parabrahmaṇa evāsti tadasti cāvayorapi ||93||
yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
tatrāhaṃ cāpi tatra tvaṃ gamiṣyāvo na saṃśayaḥ ||94||
bhaja tvaṃ taṃ parātmānaṃ patyātmakaṃ prabhuṃ patim |
tyaja dainyaṃ saṃśayaṃ ca bhayaṃ nimnagatipradam ||95||
gṛhṇa jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ nirāmayām |
nirbhayā paramasyaiva dhāmno dātrīṃ vidhehi vai ||96||
ityuktā sā nijapatnī śrutiphalātivedinī |
harṣaṃ tu paramaṃ lebhe brahmabodhābhimodinī ||97||
nanāma pādayoḥ patyurlakṣmi lakṣmīrivābhavat |
divyā madarpaṇenaiva kriyāṇāṃ sarvathā tataḥ ||98||
śrutivad vartate nityaṃ bhajate māṃ pareśvaram |
labhate paramānandaṃ brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||99||
gṛhayuktāpi satataṃ gṛhālubdhā tato’bhavat |
patiyuktāpi satataṃ kṛṣṇayuktā sadābhavat || 3.173.10 0||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrutiphalāpatnyāḥ sadvidyāyanarṣiṃ patiṃ prati kṛtasya kvalokagamānādipraśnasya naiṣkarmyasarvasamarpaṇavidhayā parabrahmalokagatirityādipratyuttaramitinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 173 ||

<3.174>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ yathā dehaṃ prapadyate |
kevalātmāpi karmāḍhyaḥ kathayāmi yathātatham || 1 ||
ātmāmbare karmabhiḥ svaiḥ sūkṣmeṇa saha vartate |
saṃkalpājjāyate harṣastena kāme pravartate || 2 ||
śukraśoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭastataḥ prāṇaḥ pravartate |
prāṇena vidhṛte śukre tatrāpānaḥ pravartate || 3 ||
apānāt preryate śukraṃ rajaścākarṣayatyapi |
samānastena miśre ca jāyate bījatādharaḥ || 4 ||
udānaścodare garbhaṃ prati nayati miśraṇam |
nālārthaṃ miśraṇaṃ sthāne nābhau yojayati dhruvam || 5 ||
vyānaśca miśraṇe tatra vyāpnoti pākahetave |
pakvaṃ cāpatyarūpaṃ vai puṣṭaṃ nālena yoṣitaḥ || 6 ||
janma prāpya bahiryāti ṣāṭkauśikaṃ hi tanmatam |
mātṛto romalohitamāṃsāni santi tatra ha || 7 ||
pitṛtaḥ snāyvasthimajjā santi tatra balānvitāḥ |
evaṃvidhe bhautike’tra dehe māyā nirucyate || 8 ||
deho māyātmanaḥ proktā nirdeho’māyikaḥ sa tu |
māṃ yāti nityadā cendriyādyairātmā prapuṣṭaye || 9 ||
ahaṃ dehaḥ poṣyadharmo māyārūpo’smi tena vai |
mama dehasya sattvena jīvātmāsti samaśnute || 3.174.1 0||
tasmāddehaḥ sadā māyā sarvaviṣayamodikā |
ātmā svakarmaṇā prāṇairdehabandhaṃ prapadyate || 11 ||
caturhotraṃ varṣma cetaddhotā bandhanamṛcchati |
karaṇaṃ karma kartā ca mukta etaccatuṣṭayam || 12||
catvāra ete hotāraḥ pratyekaṃ sapta sapta vai |
ghrāṇaṃ jihvā ca cakṣuśca tvak śrotraṃ mana ityapi ||1 3||
buddhiścetikaraṇāni saptaite guṇahetavaḥ |
gandho rasaśca rūpaṃ ca sparśaḥ śabdaśca vai tathā || 14||
mantavyaṃ cāpi boddhavyaṃ karmaite karmahetavaḥ |
ghrātā bhakṣayitā draṣṭā spraṣṭā śrotā tathā hyapi ||15||
mantā boddhā ca kartāraḥ saptaite kartṛhetavaḥ |
evaṃvidhā nijān bhāvān bhakṣayanti ca juhvati || 16||
saptasveteṣvasaṃgo yaḥ saptadhā mukta eva ha |
kāraṇādivihīno’haṃ karmālipto bhavāmyaham || 17||
kartṛtvaṃ me na caivāsti tasmānmuktaḥ sadāsmyaham |
ahaṃmamatvahīno’haṃ muktabhāvaṃ bhajāmyaham || 18||
anyathā tu caturhotro māyābaddho bhavāmyaham |
adannannāni cāvidvān mamatvena vihanyate || 1 9||
dehārthe bhakṣayannannaṃ poṣayan mamatānvitaḥ |
anātmabhakṣaṇaṃ kurvanmāyayāyaṃ vihanyate ||3.174.20 ||
māyā tṛṣṇā tṛṣārūpā viṣayāṇāṃ vivardhate |
apeyapānaṃ kurvaṃśca māyayāyaṃ vihanyate ||21 ||
apeyaṃ nārpitaṃ deve hyabhakṣyaṃ cāniveditam |
yadvāpeyaṃ rasyametad daihyamaindriyikaṃ jalam ||22||
abhakṣyaṃ svādu caitadvai daihyaṃ bhautikamityapi |
ātmārthe pācayannāyaṃ badhyate na tu mucyate ||23||
manasā gamyate sūkṣmaṃ bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ śubhāśubham |
vācā vā cakṣuṣā cāpi śrotreṇa ca tvacāpi ca ||24||
jihvayā gṛhyate yacca ghrāṇena yattu gṛhyate |
kareṇa padbhyāṃ liṃgena pāyunā yacca gamyate ||25||
buddhyā cittena cāhaṃkāreṇa yadbāhyagolakaiḥ |
gṛhyate bhujyate vyastaiḥ samastairvāpi yad yadā ||26||
svapne jāgrati cānte vā madhye cādau ca yad yadā |
sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca svārthaṃ māyāmayaṃ hi tat ||27||
pacyamānaṃ dehinaṃ vai hanti pāśakaśādibhiḥ |
tatsarvaṃ tyajyate svārthaṃ vihāya paramātmani ||28||
bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ bhavatyeva tadeva khalu nirguṇam |
evaṃ nirguṇayogajñaṃ jñānavahniḥ pravartate |||29||
sarvabhasmakaraścāpi māyābandhananāśakaḥ |
hareryogamakhaścāpi sarvasvatyāgadakṣiṇaḥ ||3.174.3 0||
satsevāvabhṛthasnāno mokṣanadyavagāhanaḥ |
na tasya vidyate cāyaṃ saṃsāro bhakṣyapānajaḥ || 31 ||
sakriyo vartamāno’pi niṣkriyaḥ sa tu pūruṣaḥ |
puruṣottamayogena koṭimokṣaprado’tra saḥ ||32||
kāminyā vartamāno’pi kāmanāsya na māyikī |
patyā ca vartamānāyā ratirnāsyāstu māyikī ||33 ||
ātmārthaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārthaṃ paravrahmārthameva ha |
dehāntaragamaḥ svārthaḥ śubhāśubhaprabhogakṛt ||34||
kṛṣṇārthaḥ sarvathā lakṣmi parabrahmālayapradaḥ |
svārthe tṛṣṇāmaye jīve savāsane sarāgake ||35||
karma tiṣṭhati pūrvārjyaṃ madāśrayeṇa naśyati |
mayi sarvārpaṇenaiva karmaphalaṃ vinaśyati ||36||
sādhūnāṃ mama mūrteścāśrayeṇa divyatā bhavet |
yathā yathā mama yogastathā tathā hi divyatā ||37||
puṃyogena yathā patnyā divyatā laukikī śubhā |
sūryayogenāmbarasya divyatā suprabhānvitā ||38||
svarṇayogena tāmrāṇāṃ divyatā ramaṇīyatā |
guṇayogena lokānāṃ divyatā vidyayā kṛtā ||39||
veṣayogena rājñāṃ ca divyatālaṃkṛtikṛtā |
svarṇayogena devānāṃ puṇyena pitṛvargiṇām ||3.174.40 ||
aiśvaryeṇa tu siddhānāṃ tapobhiśca tapasvinām |
śiṣyāṇāṃ dāsavargāṇāṃ divyatā sevayā kṛtā ||41 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ gītikābhiḥ sādhūnāṃ tvacyutārpaṇāt |
divyatā tu satīnāṃ vai satyena ca vratena ca ||42||
brahmavratena sarvatra divyatā brahmacāriṇām |
īśvarāṇāṃ padaprāptyā muktānāṃ mama yogataḥ ||43||
divyatā sarvadā cāste lakṣmīnāṃ tu mamāṃgataḥ |
mama sā divyatā lakṣmi śāśvatī svanisargagā ||44||
etādṛśaṃ tu māṃ prāpya bhakto me divyatānvitaḥ |
śāśvatīṃ divyatāṃ prāpya modate mama dhāmani ||45||
māyendriyāntaḥkaraṇabhūtamātrādayo’sya ca |
mama yogena divyāste tato nārāyaṇo hyaham ||46||
mama yogena vai jīvā anantāḥ śivatāṃ gatāḥ |
madyogena narā bhaktyā nārāyaṇāstvasaṃkhyakāḥ ||47||
jātāścāpi ca jāyante vaikuṇṭhavāsino hi te |
golokavāsinaścāpi paradhāmanivāsinaḥ ||48||
akṣare vāsakartārastathānyadhāmavāsinaḥ |
īśalokanivāsāśca māyālokanivāsinaḥ ||49||
viṣṇurūpā viṣṇavaśca jāyante’saṃkhyakoṭayaḥ |
brahmāṇaścāpi jāyante vairājāścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||3.174.50||
pradhānapuruṣāścāpi jāyante’nantasaṃkhyakāḥ |
muktāścāpi prajāyante’nantasaṃkhyā hi dhāmagāḥ ||51 ||
gāyantyapi pramodante nṛtyanti harṣitā harau |
kā tatra tu kathā lakṣmi māyāyāḥ sparśaleśikā ||52||
māyāpi modate tatra māmāsādya maheśvarī |
ākṣarī paramā vidyā māyāpi parivartate ||93||
evaṃ divyavidhānaṃ yo jānāti bhaktarāḍ yadi |
asya yogaḥ sadā divyastatra kā paridevanā ||54||
evaṃ mama pratāpena yogātmakena divyatā |
sarvotkṛṣṭā bhavatyeva nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ||55||
ekaḥ śāstā hṛdayasthaḥ so’haṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
mayā yukto mama bhakto vahatyatha karoti ca ||56||
eko gururhṛdayasthaḥ so’haṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
mayānuśikṣito bhakto vahatyatha karoti ca ||57||
eko bandhurhṛdayasthaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
tena mayānuśiṣṭo’yaṃ vahatyatha karoti ca ||58||
ekaḥ svāmī hṛdayastho’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
tena mayānusaṃśliṣṭo bhaktaścānandamaśnute |||59||
ekaścāntarniyantāhaṃ paramātmā hṛdi sthitaḥ |
mayā saṃpreritaścāyaṃ pravartate karoti ca ||3.174.60 ||
ekaḥ śrotā bhakṣayitā boddhā mantāhameva ha |
ghrātā spraṣṭā tathā draṣṭā rasayitāhameva ha ||61 ||
ānandayitā grahitā gantotsraṣṭāhameva ca |
mayānubhukta evāyaṃ bhuṃkte vetti pramodate ||62||
ahaṃ guruḥ parabrahma mayi vāso’sya sarvathā |
gurvarpaṇavidhātāyaṃ karmaṇā nahi lipyate |||63||
evamasya bhavedatra jīvato jīvamuktatā |
dehānte mama dhāmnyeva syādasya nityamuktatā ||64||
ahaṃ dadāmyakhaṇḍaṃ me dhāmākṣaraṃ sukhāśrayam |
nityaṃ cāsya bhavet sarvasaukhyāḍhyākṣaravāsitā ||65||
mama dhyānena mukto’yaṃ matsārūpyaṃ prapadyate |
madaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi labhate madanugrahāt ||66||
eṣā brāhmī mahāvidyā lakṣmi te’tra niveditā |
yāṃ prāpyaiva naro nārī brahmarūpaḥ prajāyate ||67||
etadarthaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ mama vidyātra golake |
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma dakārākhyā pravartitā ||68||
śreyaḥpradāṃ ca tāṃ prāpyāsuradevarṣibhoginaḥ |
prāpya te prādravan sarve yathāsvabhāvamādarāt ||69||
nānāvyavasitāḥ sarve sarpadevarṣidānavāḥ |
dakāraṃ vividhaṃ matvā yathāsvabhāvamāsthitāḥ ||3.174.70||
sarpāṇāṃ tu dakāreṇa daṃśane bhāva udgataḥ |
pravṛttastvasurāṇāṃ vai dambhabhāvaḥ svabhāvajaḥ ||71 ||
devānāṃ tu tadā dāne bhāvanābhūt svabhāvajā |
maharṣīṇāṃ svabhāvāttu dame’bhūd bhāvanā tadā ||72||
satāṃ tadanu bhāvastu dayāyā samajāyata |
mānavānāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tato bhāvo vyajāyata ||73||
nārīṇāṃ darśane bhāvo dakāreṇa vyajāyata |
śṛṃgāramācarantyeva sarvāgryaṃ tāḥ svabhāvajam ||74||
rājñāṃ tu dohane bhāvaḥ pṛthvyā rāṣṭrasya cāpyabhūt| |
rakṣasāṃ cāpi daityānāṃ daṇḍe bhāvo vyajāyata ||75||
gurūṇāṃ tu dakṣabhāve bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat |
karmiṇāṃ daivabhāve tu bhāgye’bhūd vyavasāyinām ||76||
kṛpaṇānāṃ dainyabhāvo dakāreṇa svabhāvajaḥ |
īśvarāṇāṃ divyabhāvaḥ svabhāvajastato’bhavat ||77||
piśācānāṃ tu durgandhe bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat |
kitavānāṃ tu duṣṭatve bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat ||78||
ācāryāṇāṃ deśanāyāṃ bhāvaḥ svabhāvajo’bhavat |
dānavānāṃ dorbalatve digjaye bhāvanābhavat ||79||
gṛhasthānāṃ daurhṛdatve suputre bhāvanābhavat |
paśūnāṃ dantaviṣaye bhakṣye sā bhāvanābhavat ||3.174.80 ||
pitṝṇāṃ darśaparvādiśrāddhe bhāvastato’bhavat |
prajānāṃ deśavasatau bhāvanā dotthitābhavat ||8 1 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi vividhā vai dabrahmabhāvanāstadā |
svabhāvajā hi sarveṣāmabhavat karmakāriṇī ||82||
keṣāmapi na tvabhūtsā divyamokṣābhigāminī |
tato mayā punarbrahma hyupadiṣṭaṃ sa ityapi ||83||
sakāreṇa mumukṣūṇāṃ sādhusevā svabhāvajā |
gṛhasthānāṃ sādhubhāvo mokṣadaścetyabhūttadā ||84||
sannyāsaḥ sarvakarmādidharmāṇāṃ ca tato’bhavat |
satyaṃ vrataṃ satyadharmaḥ satyalokaḥ sadātmatā ||85||
sanātanatvamevāpi saccidānandatā tathā |
sarvātmakatvaṃ sākāramūrtitvaṃ saguṇatvakam ||86||
saubhāgyaṃ sumanaskatvaṃ satītvaṃ samatā tathā |
samadarśitvamevāpi sāragrāhitvamityapi ||87||
siddhimattvaṃ srāvaśūnyabrahmacaryavrataṃ tathā |
sureśvarārhaṇaṃ sevā śrīhareḥ sarvadarśinaḥ ||88||
so’haṃ japastathā sauropāsanā tu hiraṇmayī |
sanātanārṣavṛttiśca sāyujyaṃ sārṣṭimityapi ||89||
sālokyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ sahabhāvo’pi sarvathā |
svāmisevakabhāvaścetyevaṃ dharmān sakārajān ||3.174.90||
jagṛhurmānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro’pi ca |
munayo bhaktajīvāśca mokṣamārgaṃ hi jagṛhuḥ ||9 1 ||
śravaṇaṃ sevanaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ samarpaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ |
evaṃ guruṃ parabrahma mokṣadaṃ prāpyate tataḥ ||92||
nijātmānaṃ brahmabhāvāpannaṃ matvā tu bhejire |
parameśaṃ nijasthaṃ ca samanubhūya bhejire ||93||
evaṃ lakṣmi jīvaloko yathāsvabhāvamātmanaḥ |
guroḥ sakāśāllabdhvāpi santamasantamaśnute ||94||
śubhena vicaran lokaḥ śubhacārī prajāyate |
brahmacārī sadaivaiṣo ya indriyajaye rataḥ ||95||
pāpena vicaran lokaḥ pāpacārī bhavatyuta |
kāmacārī tu kāmena ya indriyasukhe rataḥ ||96||
dharmacārī tu dharmeṇa yajñayāgādike rataḥ |
puṇyacārī tu tapasā yastu vratādare rataḥ ||97||
apetavratakarmā tu kevalaṃ brahmaṇi sthitaḥ |
brahmarūpaścaran loke brahmaniṣṭho bhavatyapi ||98 ||
brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ brahmaśīlaḥ sadā sukhī |
brahmaiva samidhaścāsya brahmāgnirbrahmasaṃbhavaḥ ||99||
sarvaṃ brahma samavāpya parabrahmādhigacchati |
ātmā brahma gururbrahma sa brahmaṇi samasthitaḥ || 3.174.100 ||
samāhitaḥ pare tatra brahmaṇi brahmaśīlavān |
parabrahma brahmacaryaṃ tadrato māṃ prapadyate || 101 ||
naro vāpi tathā nārī napuṃ vā na mānavaḥ |
yaḥ ko’pi syājjātigantā jātismaraḥ pravittimān || 10 2||
parabrahma samavāpya modate hi mayā saha |
atra vā tatra vāpyasya kriyāḥ sarvā hi mokṣadāḥ || 10 3||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyaṃsaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharme yathādehaprāptiḥ śubhāśubhakarmabhogo brahmāvāptiḥ karmapratiṣṭhānaṃ phalārpaṇaṃ divyatālābho nityamuktatākṣaravāsitā sārūpyāvagamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catusaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 174 ||

<3.175>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
ityevaṃ padmaje patnīṃ śratiphalāṃ patiḥ svayam |
sadvidyāyanasaṃjño vai prāha muktivṛṣān bahūn || 1 ||
prāhaivaṃ cāpi saṃsāravāridhiṃ gādhatojjhitam |
indriyajhaṣasaṃjīvaṃ taraṃgāntarvilolitam || 2 ||
bhūtanaukākṛtamārgaṃ viṣayāśānusandhitam |
tanmātrāhāramatsyāḍhyaṃ śokaharṣādimārutam || 3 ||
kāmakrodhādimakaraṃ mohabhramādidigbhramam |
rāgadveṣādikāvarttaṃ vāsanājalaśaityadam || 4 ||
apāraṃ puṇyapāpādikarmākhyataraṇānvitam |
samatītya hareryogāt praviṣṭo’smyaparāṃ sthalīm || 5 ||
divyāṃ divyaguṇopetāṃ divyagomadvirājitām |
śāśvatīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ vai nirbhayāṃ nigamocitām || 6 ||
sukhamayyo yatra nadyo yatrānandabhṛto drumāḥ |
pramodakalpalatikā yatra sneharasālayāḥ || 7 ||
yatrotsavāḥ svāminā vai sarvasadguṇaśālinā |
nityayauvanasaundaryavātsalyapremaśālinā || 8 ||
nāsti tasmāt sukhado’nyo nāstyanyatra sukhaṃ tvidam |
na taṃ samprāpya śoko’sti na duḥkhaṃ na bhayaṃ tathā || 9 ||
na tatrānityabījaṃ vai na triśākho’sti tatra ha |
na saptāpyupaśākhāśca nāntaśākhāśca ṣoḍaśa || 3.175.10 ||
nātra jaṭilāḥ ṛṣayo mānasāhvānayoginaḥ |
na vaṃśastambavāṭyaśca na gotrocchrayabhūtalam ||1 1||
na kaṇṭakāstīkṣṇadhārāḥ kaṃkarā na ca tatra vai |
nātapaḥ sauramūlottho na śaityaṃ candrikākṛtam || 12||
na dhūmaścāpi vāhneyo na chāyāpi vitānajā |
na meghāstatra mehāśca pañcāgnayo na santi ca || 1 3||
na raṃgāḥ saṃgamiśrotthā na ca śṛṃgārarāśinaḥ |
na tatra pāśavaṃ kṣetraṃ pāśāstatra na rodhinaḥ || 14||
padmarāgādimaṇayo na ca tatra bhavanti hi |
pañcaraṃgāṇi puṣpāṇi trirasāni phalāni ca || 15||
na tatra santi vṛkṣāśca pādapāḥ santi tatra te |
padmarāgā madhurasā haṃsā vasanti tatra ha || 16||
mauktikāhāratṛptāste so’haṃ so’haṃ pravādinaḥ |
anāvṛtāḥ prabhāstatra bhavanti sīmavarjitāḥ || 17||
bhūriśṛṃgāstatra gāvo bhavanti kāmapūritāḥ |
nārāyaṇyo mahāsatyo bhavanti tāpahārikāḥ || 18||
kṛṣṇadevā atithayo bhavanti vyomavāsinaḥ |
dīkṣitāścekṣitāścāpi svāminā nityadarśinā || 19||
nityotsavāḥ sakhīnāṃ vai tatra bhavanti śāśvatāḥ |
iṣṭapatiprayogeṣu vilāsāstṛptivarjitāḥ ||3.175.20||
akampāṃ cāvikārāṃ cākṣarīṃ sthalīṃ parātparām |
prapanno’smīti sadvidyāyanaḥ śrutiphalāṃ jagau ||21 ||
hā3u hā3u praphullitaḥ smaran śubhasthalīm |
jagau punaḥpunaḥ prāha sthalīṃ śrutiphalāṃ smaran ||22||
nanarta cāpi tālena vadannupadiśannapi |
ārdrabhāvaṃ prāpa cāpi śrutiphalāntike tadā ||23||
svastho bhūtvā punaḥ prāha dhanyā tvaṃ parameśvarī |
yo’haṃ sā tvaṃ so’haṃ sa tvaṃ hyayamātmā pareśvaraḥ ||24|||
ye’dhigacchanti santastaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti bhayaṃ kvacit |
ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca tiryak ca sthalyā nānto’dhigamyate |||25|||
hareḥ pādapāraṇyāni santi divyāni tatra vai |
yatra trimukhī pramadā hyavāṅmukhī na rohati ||26||
girayāḥ parvatānāśca santo vasanti tatra ha |
snānti brahmavahānadyāṃ saṃgame pārameśvare ||27||
snānatṛptāḥ kṛśāśāśca suvratā devabhāsurāḥ |
ātmanyātmānamāviśya parātmānamupāsate |||28|||
viharanti ramante’tra pādapāraṇyavedinaḥ |
etādṛśaṃ padāraṇyaṃ brahmiṣṭhā vividuḥ param ||29|||
prāpto’haṃ mama yogena tvaṃ prāptā śrutisatphale |
vidyāyanaṃ parabrahma prāpto’smi nirbhayo’smi ca ||3.175.30 ||
rūkṣaṃ gandhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi rūkṣaṃ rasaṃ na vedmi ca |
rūkṣaṃ rūpaṃ na paśyāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||3 1 ||
rūkṣaṃ sparśaṃ na spṛśāmi rūkṣaṃ śabdaṃ śṛṇomi na |
rūkṣaṃ na saṃkalpayāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||32||
kāmaye nāpyaniṣṭaṃ ca dveṣyaṃ tatra na vidyate |
brahmajāle nivasāmi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||33||
brahmayajñe juhomyeva parameśe samastakam |
pārthivaṃ vā jalīyaṃ vā brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||34||
taijasaṃ vāyavīyaṃ vā gaganīyaṃ guṇādikam |
saukṣmyaṃ vā cāntaraṃ vāpi karma vā saṃvidaṃ ca vā |||35||
svabhāvaṃ vā kṛtrimaṃ vā jaḍaṃ vā cetanaṃ ca vā |
caitanyaṃ vā juhomyeva brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||36||
kṣaraṃ svabhāvaṃ hutvaivākṣarabhāvena cācyute |
juhomi māṃ vimukto’smi brahmānandapariplutaḥ ||37||
samasya sarvabhūteṣu nirmāyasya jitātmanaḥ |
samantātparimuktasya bhayaṃ me vidyate na vai ||38||
sadbhireva hi saṃvāso muktaireva samāgamaḥ |
bhaktaistādātmyabhāvaśca śrīharau cāpyabhinnatā ||39||
evaṃ labdhvā parān lābhān pramodamemi sarvathā |
śrutiphale phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ svāde sadvidyayāplutaḥ ||3.175.40||
evaṃ patnīṃ brahmarūpāmupadeśena sarvathā |
lakṣmi cakre śrutiphalāṃ sadvidyāyana eva ha ||41 ||
athaikadālarkanāmā mahābhāgavato nṛpaḥ |
madālasāyāḥ putro vai jitvā vai sakalāṃ mahīm |||42||
vṛkṣādhobhūtale sthitvā śāntyarthaṃ sa mano dadhe |
cintayāmāsa śāntyarthaṃ jitā vai sakalā mahī ||43||
niṣitairmārgaṇaiḥ śastraistathāpi śāntireva na |
mano vai capalaṃ duṣṭaṃ tajjitvā śāntimuttamām ||44||
prāpsyāmīti śaraistīkṣṇaireṣaḥ chinadmi mānasam |
indriyāṇi karaṇāni chinadmi mārgaṇairiha ||45||
vicāryetthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmān bāṇān dhanuṣi sandadhe |
manaḥ samūrtaṃ bhūtvātha tadagre samupasthitam ||46||
bāṇānāmaviṣayaṃ tat prāhālarkaṃ tu padmaje |
neme bāṇā haniṣyanti māmalarka nirāvaram ||47||
niṣphalāste parāvṛttya bhetsyanti tvāṃ mariṣyasi |
anyān bāṇān pramuñcasva yairahaṃ syāṃ niṣūditam ||48||
śrutvālarkaḥ pratyuvāca manastvaṃ ghrāṇasaṃyutam |
bahūn gandhān pragṛhṇāsi tatsahāyaṃ tu jīvasi ||49||
tataḥ ghrāṇaṃ haniṣyāmi tīkṣṇabāṇaiśca te mṛtiḥ |
ghrāṇaṃ śrutvā tadālarkaṃ pratyuvāca hi nirbhayam |||50||
neme bāṇāstava rājan māṃ haniṣyantyagocaram |
pratyāvṛtya tava marma bhetsyanti tvaṃ mariṣyasi ||51 ||
anyān bāṇān pramuñcasva yaistvaṃ māṃ sūdayiṣyasi |
śrutvālarkastataḥ prāha jihveyaṃ hi sahāyadā ||52||
manasaḥ priyasatkartrī rasadānena sarvadā |
tatheyaṃ tvak priyakartrī sparśadānena vai sadā ||53||
tathedaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāsmai śabdārjanasahāyadam |
tathedaṃ netramevāpi rūpārjanasahāyakṛt |||94|||
tathaivemāni sarvāṇi liṃgādīnyaparāṇi ca |
indriyāṇi manaso vai sāhāyyakāni santi hi ||55|||
iyaṃ buddhirmano dattaṃ gṛhṇāti cauryakarmiṇī |
ahaṃkāro’pi teṣvatra milito’śnāti garvavān ||56||
tānetān sarvathā sūkṣmairhaniṣyāmi prasāyakaiḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ sarvasahitā buddhiralarkamāha yat ||57||
naite bāṇāstavālarka spṛkṣyantyapi ca naḥ kvacit |
sthūlā hyete vayaṃ sūkṣmā na sparśo na mṛteḥ kathā ||58||
viphalāśca vivṛttāste tvāṃ haniṣyanti roṣiṇaḥ |
mumocāpi tadā bāṇān pratyāvṛttāśca te’phalāḥ ||59||
alarkaṃ tu prajaghnuste’larko mūrchāṃ jagāma ha |
sasmāra śrīhariṃ māṃ sa dattātreyasvarūpiṇam ||3.175.60||
āvirbhūya mayā tasmai jīvanaṃ dattameva ha |
bāṇā niṣkāsitā dehāt samutthito’bhavaddhi saḥ ||61 ||
dadau bāṇānahaṃ tasmai caikāgryabalarūpiṇaḥ |
draṣṭṛdṛśyādyanāraktān svarūpamātraniṣṭhitān ||62||
yogabāṇānmama mantrairyutān brahmāstrayojitān |
muktāstraplāvitān sūkṣmānāntarān so’pi tān śitān ||63 ||
prāpyātmanā mumocāśu sarvendriyādikān prati |
nijaghnuste drutaṃ sarvān kecit palāyitā hyapi ||64||
tān punaḥ pāśabaddhām̐śca kṛtvā samādhiraśmibhiḥ |
brahmahrade nicikṣepa te ca tatra layaṃ yayuḥ ||65||
atha divyāni bhūtvaivālarkaṃ muktaṃ siṣevire |
tato divyasvarūpaḥ san siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ ||66||
mātrā sākaṃ bhrātṛbhiśca saha mokṣaṃ jagāma ha |
vadannevaṃ hyupadeśaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi vivekadam ||67||
aho sarvamadhruvaṃ vai bāhyaṃ bāṇairvinirjitam |
daihyamanuṣṭhitaṃ sarvamadyāvadhi na cāntaram ||68||
sadguroḥ kṛpayā tvadya jitāni doṣavanti tu |
indriyādīni sarvāṇi guṇavanti tu vai pṛthak ||69||
brahmahrade vinikṣipya divyatāṃ prāpitāni ha |
tathā divyasvarūpo’haṃ bhūtvā bhajāmi keśavam ||3.175.70||
sarvārpaṇaṃ vinā nāsti cānyatra vai sukhaṃ kvacit |
kṛṣṇe svātmārpaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ sukhamāpyate ||71 ||
śāśvato vijayaścāpi māyākṛte raṇe bhavet |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe yoganiṣevayā || 72|
evaṃ lakṣmi nṛpo’larkaḥ śāntiṃ jagāma śāśvatīm |
śrutiphalāpi śāntiṃ vai jagāma patisevayā ||73 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi triśatrūn vai triguṇān sarvataḥ sthitān |
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti māyāpreritabandhadān ||74||
trayaste ripavo loke trirāvṛttā navāpi te |
praharṣaḥ prītirānandastraprayaste sattvabālakāḥ ||75|||
tṛṣṇā krodho dveṣaveśastrayaste tu rajodbhavāḥ |
śramastandrā ca mohaśca trayaste tu tamobhavāḥ ||76||
navaite śatravo dehe cetanaṃ rodhayanti hi |
svasvabhāveṣu nityaṃ vai kevalaṃ kurvate na tam ||77||
kaivalyagoṣṭhī puruṣo yadā tān jetumicchati |
puraṃ hātumutsahate tadā tānarpayenmayi ||78||
ta eva vijitā yāvattāvanmuktaḥ prajāyate |
lobho nāma mahān doṣo yadi naiva jito bhavet ||79||
anyeṣāṃ vijaye lakṣmi naiṣphalyaṃ tṛṣṇayā bhavet| |
yatprayukto janaḥ kvāpivai tṛṣṇyaṃ naiva vindati ||3.175.80||
tṛṣṇārtta iha nimnāni dhāvamānaḥ patatyapi |
budhyate nāpyakāryaṃ hi nimnānnimnaṃ prasevate ||81 ||
tataścintā bhayadā ca rājasī ca gatistataḥ |
tāmasī ca tato bhūyo jāyate karma cehate ||82||
janmakarmakṣaye mṛtyuḥ punarjanma punarmṛtiḥ |
lobhajaye tu vaitṛṣṇyaṃ mahāsukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ||83||
sāmrājyaṃ cātmanastattu brahmānandapradaṃ tataḥ |
mahārājyaṃ divyarājaṃ parabrahmapriyātmakam ||84||
rājā pareśvaraḥ kṛṣṇastadrājyaṃ mama rājyakam |
manute tu yathāvadvai rājā vātmā bhavan svayam ||85||
yadi cetparamātmānaṃ satyaṃ nṛpaṃ vihāya vai |
jīvo rājā bhavatyevaṃ nirmūlo bhrāmako hi saḥ ||86||
kimatra rājyaṃ jīvasya pitṛpaitāmahāgatam |
pṛthvī vā pārthivaṃ varṣma karma vā dharma eva vā ||87||
yadbhogastadbhavedrājyaṃ yatsattā nṛpatiḥ sa vai |
na rājyaṃ vai śarīre’sti na rājyaṃ mānase’pi ca ||88||
na rājyaṃ cendriyavarge na rājyaṃ viṣayeṣvapi |
sarvādhīno jīva eva jīvādhīnāṃ na te matāḥ ||89||
kuto rājyaṃ hi jīvasya rājatvaṃ vā vṛṣe’pi ca |
naikāntato hyadhīnāste jīvasya santi karhicit| ||3.175.9 0 ||
tato rājyaṃ tvanavāpya tyaktvā ca viṣayaṃ mṛṣā |
rājānaṃ paramātmānaṃ samāśritya sukhī bhavet ||91||
antavatyaḥ sadāvasthāḥ karmajanyā hi dehajā |
bhautikyaścāpi tādṛśyastatra rājyaṃ na cātmanaḥ ||92||
mamedamiti manvāno mṛṣā tadavalambate |
apṛṣṭvā taṃ yadā yāti nāśaṃ tadāvabuddhyate ||9 3 ||
na me rājyaṃ na me kiñcinna me dehaḥ kuto’param |
evaṃ matvā divyarājyaṃ cinuyājjñānavāñjanaḥ ||94||
na svārthaṃ gandhamaśnīyādbhūmiḥ sā vaśamāgatā |
na svārthaṃ rasamādadyādāpastā vaśamāgatāḥ ||95||
na svārthaṃ rūpamādadyāttejastad vaśamāgatam |
na svārthaṃ sparśamādadyād vāyuḥ sa vaśamāgataḥ ||96||
na svārthaṃ śabdamādadyād vyoma tad vaśamāgatam |
na svārthaṃ mananaṃ kurvaṃ mano me vaśamāgatam ||97||
na svārthaṃ mama yatno’sti hyātmā me vaśamāgataḥ |
devārthaṃ cāpyatithyarthaṃ bhūtārthaṃ ca pitrarthakam ||98||
samārambhā mama sarve’rpaṇaṃ mokṣārthamityapi |
brahmārpaṇaṃ mama sarvaṃ dharmo’pi muktaye mama ||99||
evaṃ matvā jano lakṣmi mucyate bhavasāgarāt |
evamuktvā nijapatnyai sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ ||3.175.1 00 ||
punarāha śrutiphale tathā vartāmi sarvadā |
vipro’smi cāpi mukto’smi gṛhasthadharmako’smi ca || 101 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇo’smi ca |
nāhamasmi yathā māṃ tvaṃ paśyasi kāmanāyutam || 1 02||
rājyaṃ śrīkamaleśasya sarvaṃ mayi tvayi kṣitau |
tathābuddhirbhavatī ca vetsyatīdaṃ na cānyathā || 103 ||
dhanaṃ nārāyaṇo me’sti tenāhaṃ dhanavān priye |
ekaḥ panthāḥ parabrahma yena gacchanti tadvidaḥ || 1 04||
gṛheṣu vanavāseṣu guruvāseṣu bhikṣuṣu |
tathānyeṣu nivāseṣu rājyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ || 105||
tatra sthitvā vidāyaṃ ca labdhvā gantavyamuttaram |
divyasthalaṃ divyadhāma madhye nānyasthalād bhayam ||1 06||
śrutiphale priye bhārye brahmiṣṭhe brahmavādini |
sadvidyāyanayogena paralokabhayaṃ na te ||1 07||
madbhāvabhāvaniratā mamaivātmānameṣyasi |
ahamātmā parātmānaṃ samprāpto’smi na saṃśayaḥ ||108||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne muktidharme saṃsāravāridhitaraṇavijñānādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 175 ||

<3.176>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śrutiphalā punaḥ śrutvā papraccha svāminaṃ punaḥ |
kṛtārthāsmi tathāpyeṣa gahano jñānamārgaṇaḥ || 1 ||
nedamalpātmanā śakyaṃ vedituṃ vartituṃ ca vā |
bahu cālpaṃ ca saṃkṣiptaṃ muktidharmaṃ vadātra me || 2 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi sadvidyāyanarṣiḥ śrutvā priyāvacaḥ |
sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi hitakṛtprāha vai sphuṭam || 3 ||
araṇiḥ strībuddhirūpā guruḥ patiḥ paro’raṇiḥ |
tapaḥśrate’bhimathnīto jñānāgnirjāyate tataḥ || 4 ||
buddhirnārī naraścātmā dampatīti nigadyate |
tayorāntaravāsaśca paramātmā paro guruḥ || 5 ||
sarvakriyābhirātmātmā toṣaṇīyo janārdanaḥ |
nārīdehasthitābhyāṃ nṛsthābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ tu vā sadā || 6 ||
eṣā saṃkṣepato vidyā brahmavidyā mayoditā |
sā tvaṃ bhavasi nityaiva muktā buddhyā pravardhitā || 7 ||
ahaṃ bhavāmi muktaśca buddhyā saṃvardhitaḥ sadā |
patiścātmā priyā buddhistābhyāṃ brahmābhigamyate || 8 ||
śrutiphalā bhaved buddhiḥ sadvidyāyanaścetanaḥ |
tayorātmā parabrahma lakṣmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 9 ||
māmupāśritya vijñānaṃ muktaṃ divyaṃ prajāyate
sadvidyāyanakaścātmā mahāmuktaḥ prajāyate || 3.176.1 0||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi guruśiṣyakathāṃ śubhām |
muktistotāyanākhyasya guroḥ śikṣāṃ sutaṃ prati || 11 ||
siddhiveśāyanaḥ śiṣyaḥ papraccha svaguruṃ priye |
kiṃsvicchreyaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ paraḥ kaścāparaśca kaḥ || 12||
kutaścāhaṃ kutastvaṃ ca kiṃ satyaṃ paramaṃ sukham |
kuto jātāni bhūtāni kena jīvanti jantavaḥ || 13 ||
kiṃ satyaṃ ca tapaḥ kiṃ ca ke guṇāḥ sadbhirīritāḥ |
ke panthānaḥ śivāḥ syuśca kiṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ matam || 14||
etat sarvaṃ brūhi vidvan yena muktiḥ prajāyate |
saṃsārabhīravo lokā mokṣakāmā bhavanti ca || 15 ||
guravastārakāḥ santi mokṣadā vai dayālavaḥ |
śaraṇāgatasaṃrakṣākartāraḥ pāvanā yataḥ || 16 ||
muktisrotāyanaḥ śrutvā siddhiveśāyanasya tat |
mumukṣānvitakośāya śiṣyāyopādideśa ha || 17||
śṛṇu siddhiveśa sarvaṃ kathayāmi yathātatham |
parameśopāsanā vai paraṃ śreyo mataṃ mama || 18||
paraḥ sa eva bhagavān sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
parabrahma paramātmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 19 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamādhavaḥ |
māyākṣarādiśāstā cāvatārakāraṇaṃ prabhuḥ ||3.176.20||
sādhusvabhāvāḥ sannyāsāḥ svarūpāṇi harestathā |
sādhavaścāvatārāśceśvarā vyūhāśca te’parāḥ ||2 1 ||
aparaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma muktāścāpyaparā hi te |
aparāścāpi sarve ye mumukṣavastato’pi ca |||22||
ātmānaścāparāḥ sarve bubhukṣavaḥ satṛṣṇakāḥ |
ātmatattvaṃ paraṃ proktamanātma tvaparaṃ sadā || 23||
ahaṃ jāto hyahaṃkāro mahattattvāt trimāyikaḥ |
tvaṃbhāvo’pi tato jāto bhedadṛṣṭyā hyanātmani || 24||
ahaṃ tvaṃ ceti nirdeśo māyiko na tu cātmanaḥ |
jāyamānaṃ mahattattvamahaṃkāramavāsṛjat | | 25 ||
ahaṃkārādbhedabhāvo bhrāntirūpo’sti sarvathā |
tattyāge’hantvamamatātyāge nijātmanaḥ sukham || 26 | |
paramātmanārpitaṃ bhuṃkte cātmā tatparamaṃ sukham |

satyaṃ sukhaṃ hi tatproktaṃ bhagavadyogajaṃ sadā |
na nāśyaṃ nāpi hāryaṃ ca na kṣayyaṃ na viśīryate | | 28 ||
etādṛśaṃ mahānandasandohātmakameva tat |
tallabdhvānyannirmanaskaṃ nīrasaṃ jāyate’tra vai | | 29 ||
taddātā bhagavān sākṣācchrīhariḥ parameśvaraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpatiracyutaḥ || 3.176.30 | |
tato’vatārā jāyante hīśvarā api vai tataḥ |
īśvaryaścāpi tasmādvai māyā tataḥ prajāyate | | 31 ||
ṛṣayaśca tathā devā mānavāḥ sthāvarādayaḥ |
khanayaṃścāpi sarvā vai sarvabhūtāni dehinaḥ | | 32| |
jāyante śrīhareste vai jīvanti tatpraveśitāḥ |
āpūrakeṇa tattvena māyayā sanniveśitāḥ | | 33 | |
parāpmanāntaravyāptā jīvanti tu cirāciram |

yāvadbhavanti karmotthādṛṣṭāni tāvadeva te |
jīvanti cātha tannāśe mriyante dehinaḥ sadā | | 35| |
satyaṃ brahma tu paramaṃ satyā muktiḥ sadā matā |
satya ātmā cidānandaḥ satyā śrīranapāyinī | | 26 | |
satyaḥ dharmaḥ satāṃ nityo mokṣado yo nigadyate |
tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ hi sādhutvaṃ sannyāsastapa uttamam || 37 ||
sāmarthye sati sahanaṃ paramaṃ tapa ucyate |
jñānaṃ vidyā tapaḥ proktaṃ mokṣadaṃ tat sadā bhavet| || 38 | |
yo vetti brahmasaṃvāsaṃ vivāsaṃ prakṛtestathā |

yo na kāmayate kiñcinna kiñcidabhimanyate |
iha loke sthitaścaiva brahmabhūyāya kalpate | | 3.176.40 ||
cidānandasya parame kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi |
kṛtvā samarpaṇaṃ tiṣṭhenmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | |4 1 | |
purā brahmarṣibhirbrahmā pṛṣṭo naiḥśreyase pare |
kathaṃ karma kriyāt sādhu kathaṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||42 ||
ke panthāna śivā naśca kau mārgau dakṣiṇottarau |
śrutvā jagāda tān brahmā gurusevāṃ sadā kriyāt ||43||
guravo mokṣadātāraḥ santaḥ sādhujanāḥ śubhāḥ |
pāpaprakṣālakāḥ sarve puṇyaśevadhidāyinaḥ ||44||
hite cāpreritā ye syuste santo guravo’malāḥ |
tairdattā ye copadeśā grāhyāste te guṇā matāḥ ||45||
sattve cittve tathānande puṣṭiṃ yaiścetano vrajet |

guṇaiḥ sampreritaścātmā kriyāt karma sukhāvaham |
paralokapradaṃ yadvā paradhāmapradaṃ śubham ||47||
paradhāmaprada karma sādhu sādhuttamaṃ matam |
paralokapradaṃ karma sādhu sādhutaraṃ matam ||48||
iha dharmayutaṃ karma satkarma sādhu kathyate |
brahma satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ ca gurusevanam ||49||

tīrthasevā satāṃ sevā pitṛsevā hi pāvanī ||3.176.50 ||
ātmajñānaṃ harerjñānaṃ bhaktiḥ kilbiṣanāśinī |

śraddhālakṣaṇamityevaṃ dharmaṃ jñātvā caranti tam |

śivāḥ sarve te panthāno hariḥ śivatamaḥ sadā ||57||

daṃdaśūkāḥ kṛmayaśca kīṭā vihaṃgamāstathā |
aṇḍajā jantavaścāpi bahupadāścatuṣpadāḥ || 3.176.100 ||
unmattā badhirā mūkāḥ pāparogāvṛttāśca ye |
arvāksrotasa ityete magnāstamasi tāmasāḥ ||1 01 ||
evamete guṇavṛttā bhavanti dehinaḥ khalu |
satāṃ yogena loke’smin yathākathaṃcideva ha || 10 2||
puṇyavatāṃ prasaṃgena samāyāntyūrdhvamāśrayāt |
caṇḍālādyāḥ pāpapūrṇā ghātakā hiṃsakāśca vā || 103|
jāyante te’pi ca punardharmayogena śobhanām |
yonimāsādya paryāyādūrdhvamāyānti vai kvacit || 1 04||
viprarṣayaḥ surāḥ santo munayaḥ sukhimānavāḥ |
tatau yānti divaṃ dharmaḥ sattveneśvaravāsitām || 1 05||
bhaktyā samarpaṇenāpi sevayā kṛpayāthavā |
mokṣapadaṃ prayāntyeva cireṇa śaraṇāgatāḥ || 10 6||.
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmi dehādiyojanam |
siddhiveśāyanāyaiva muktisrotāyanena vai || 1 07|
labdhvā vimalavijñānaṃ śāntimavāpa cottamām |
śiṣyo divyatamāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ cāvāpa pārameśvarīm || 108 |
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃkṣiptamuktidharmāṇāṃ dehadharmāṇāṃ māyikādīnāṃ ca nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||

<3.177>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
uktaṃ māyodbhavaṃ sargaṃ jānam̐llakṣmi na muhyati |
sarvataḥ pāṇipādo yaḥ sarvato’kṣiśiromukhaḥ || 19
sarvataḥ śrutimān yaśca taṃ jānan vai pramucyate |
mahāprabhāvaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ || 2 |
sarveśānaḥ sarvajyotiṣprado’cyutaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
prasannaḥ śrīhariścāhaṃ māṃ jñātvā saṃpramucyate || 3 ||
viṣṇurevādisarge’haṃ svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃkaro’pi ca |
bhavāmiti ca māṃ jñātvā mucyante brahmabhāvinaḥ || 4 |
adhyātmajñānatṛptānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām |

śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā cāpi pañcamī |

rūpaṃ tatrādhibhūtaṃ ca ravistatrādhidaivatam |
jalaṃ caturthaṃ bhūtaṃ ca rasanādhyātmamucyate || 1 4||
raso’dhibhūtaṃ tatrātha candramāścādhidaivatam |
kṣitirbhūtaṃ pañcamaṃ ca ghrāṇaścādhyātmamucyate || 1 5||
gandho’dhibhūtaṃ tatraiva vāyustatrādhidaivatam |
pādāvadhyātmamityeva gantavyamadhibhūtakam || 1 6||
adhidaivatamevātra viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ |
arvāggatimadapānī pāyuradhyātmamucyate || 1 7||
visargo’dhibhūtameva mitrastatrādhidaivatam |
prajanaḥ sarvalokānāmupastho’dhyātmamucyate || 18 ||
śukraṃ rajo’dhibhūtaṃ ca daivataṃ tu prajāpatiḥ |
hastāvadhyātmamevātrādhibhūtaṃ karma caiva hi | | 19 ||
śakro’dhidaivataṃ tatra bodhyamādānakārakam |
vaiśvadevī ca yā pūrvā vāk sādhyātmamihocyate || 3.177.20 ||
vaktavyamadhibhūtaṃ ca vahnistatrādhidaivatam |
adhyātmaṃ mana evāpi saṃkalpaścādhibhūtakam || 21 ||
candramāścādhidevaśca manorājyaṃ hi tanmatam |
ahaṃkārastathādhyātmaṃ sarvasaṃsārakārakaḥ || 22||
abhimāno’dhibhūtaṃ ca rudrastatrādhidaivatam |
cittamadhyātmamityeva vāsudevo’dhidaivatam || 23 ||

buddhiradhyātmamevāpi sarveṣāṃ mahatī prasūḥ || 24||
adhibhūtaṃ tu boddhavyaṃ brahmā tatrādhidaivatam |
caturthaṃ daivatānāṃ ca daivataṃ parameśvaraḥ || 25 ||
so’haṃ sarvanivāso’smi sarvadevādhidaivatam |
etajjñātvā trayaṃ tyaktvā caturthaṃ toṣayet tribhiḥ || 26||

guṇādiṣu hyanāsaṃgo brahmacaryā madarpaṇam ||27|||

tatra sthitaścetano’yaṃ sarvato mukta eva saḥ ||98 ||

sarvabhūtātmadarśī ca brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||29|||
sarvendriyanirodhena hyadhyātmāgniḥ samidhyate |
prakāśate cidātmā ca prasannātmā pravardhate ||3.177.30 ||
svayaṃjyotiḥ parajyotiḥ sarvatejāṃsyatītya saḥ |
māyācakraṃ kālacakraṃ karmacakraṃ vyatītya ca |||31 ||
jagat sarvamatikramya tyaktvā dustyajapūruṣam |
brahma vyoma cidākāśaṃ prāpnoti sthānamūrdhagam ||32||
