brahmahrade kṛtasnāno divyasajātiśobhanaḥ ||3 2|||
sarvajña iva saṃśobhan tvekadhā bahudhā bhavan |
modate cākṣare dhāmni ramate svāmini dhruve ||34||
taṃ muktā viprasaṃghāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ |
pitaro mānavā bhūtāḥ sadā stuvanti muktaye || 35||
ahaṃ brahmaparaḥ svāmī mattaḥ paro na vidyate |
rājādhirāja sarveṣāṃ yuktānāṃ paramo hariḥ ||26||36
sādhavo rakṣitā yena muktā bhaktāśca rakṣitāḥ |
te’smiṃlloke pramodante sukhaṃ pretya ca bhuñjate ||37 ||
sannyāsī jñānibhakto vai prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim |
nirdvandvo bhaktimān snehī mayi māmeva gacchati ||38|||
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṃskāraiḥ sarvadvandvavivarjitaḥ |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||9||
catvāra āśramāḥ santi sarve gārhasthyajīvinaḥ |
gārhasthyāntagamana vai śreyastatra pratiṣṭhataḥ ||3.177.40 ||
sapatnīkasya tu pañcamahāyajñā vimuktaye |
devatātithiśiṣṭāśī vighasāśī na lipyate ||41 ||
vaiṣṇavīṃ dhārayenmālāṃ dīkṣāṃ bhikṣāṃ matiṃ striyam |
adhītya māṃ svakarmāṇi kurvannapi vimucyate ||42||
gṛhastho vā nivṛttau vā ya icchenmokṣamātmanaḥ |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo datvā naiṣkarmyamācaret ||43|||
sarvabhūtasukho maitraḥ sarvendriyayato muniḥ |
haryarpitasvavyāpāraḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||44||
lābhena yo na vai hṛṣyennālābhe vimanā bhavet |
abhipūjitalābhād yo jugupsāṃ yāti mānase ||45||
asaṃrodhena bhūtānāṃ pravarteta nirantaram |
pratiśrayārthaṃ seveta nirvighnāṃ pārvatīṃ guhām ||46 ||
pūtābhirbuddhibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ naijaṃ kurvīta mokṣavit |
viśvāsyaḥ śrīhareścāyaṃ jāyeta mokṣamarjayet ||47 ||
gṛhadharmāśritaścāpi vijñānicaritaṃ caret |
amūḍho mūḍharūpeṇa cared bhaktiṃ mamottamām ||48 ||
ya eva vratasampanno mucyate sarvabandhanaiḥ |
dhyāyenmāṃ kāntamāsthāya mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||49||
yo na kāmayate kiñcinna kiñcidavamanyate |
iha lokasya evāpi brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||3.177.50 ||
tyaktvā guṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ karma śrīparamātmani |
snehena mayi saṃsakto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||51 ||
ucchvāsamātramapi yo hyantakāle smareddharim |
sa māṃ tadopasaṃgamya hyamṛtatvāya kalpate ||52||
nimeṣamātramapi cet saṃyamyātmānamātmani |
bhajate māṃ mayā dṛṣṭo hyamṛtatvāya kalpate ||53 ||
iha loke janāḥ kecidicchanti dharmameva ha |
kecijjñānaṃ ca vijñānaṃ kecidvirāgameva ha ||54||
kecid deśaṃ ca vā kālaṃ kecid daivaṃ vadantyapi |
kecit snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ kecidasnānamityapi | |55 ||
anye tvāhāramevāpi pare cānaśanaṃ tathā |
karmaṇyeva ratāścānye śānto ratāstathāpare ||5 6 ||
kecinmuktiṃ praśaṃsanti kecid bhogān pṛthagvidhān |

upāsanaṃ pare cāpi kecid yajñaparāyaṇāḥ |

sadbhāvaṃ cāpare dhyānaṃ kecittapaḥ prakurvate ||9 9 ||

sannyāsamapare cāpi bhṛgoḥ pātaṃ tathāpare ||3.177.6 0 ||

anye nirdvandvavāsaṃ ca tathānye yāvadarpaṇam || 61 ||

bhoktavyaṃ ceha vānyatra nābhuktaṃ tad vinaśyati |
bhogārthaṃ dehasambandhaḥ saṃsārastena vai dhruvaḥ || 64||
teṣveteṣu tu vijñānaṃ niḥśreya iti sarvathā |

āśīryuktāni karmāṇi cānyāni kurvate tu ye |

upabhuṃkte samastaṃ saḥ kintu puṣkarapatravat ||67||

jalabinduryathāsaṃgī patrastho’pi na lipyate ||68||

sarvārpaṇayuto bhaktaḥ pralipto’pi na lipyate ||69||
sahasraṇāpi durmedhā na bodhamadhigacchati |

yāvad rathapathastāvad gantavyaṃ rathavarṣmaṇā ||71 ||
kṣīṇe rathapade cāgre gantavyaṃ rathinātmanā |
padasṛtau ca līnāyāṃ gantavyaṃ haṃsagāminā ||72||
garuḍagāminā hastigāminā vyomagāminā |
sarvatra gāminā cāpi gantavyaṃ guruśārṅgiṇā ||73 ||
yāvajjalaṃ tu bāhubhyāṃ nāvā vāgre sareddhrade |
pāraṃ prāpya tato nāvamutsṛjya yānataḥ saret ||74||
bhūtalaṃ sarvamullaṅghya vimānenāgrataḥ saret |

māyāmayaṃ samutsṛjya mukto gacchetparāṃ gatim ||76 ||

bhaktirasaḥ puṣṭikṛcca taiḥ puṣṭo yāti matpadam ||77||
yaddurāpaṃ ca durdṛśyaṃ durādharṣaṃ duranvayam |
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ sevayā kṛpayā ca me ||78 ||
dhyānayogena śuddhena bhaktyā premāḍhyayā tathā |
āpnuvanti mahātmāno madīyaṃ lokamuttamam ||79||
mama dhyānaṃ dhruvaṃ kṛtvā prasannamatayo janāḥ |
śāśvatānandasampūrṇaṃ māṃ prayāntyātmadarśinaḥ ||3.177.80||
karma vai maraṇaṃ proktaṃ naiṣkarmyamamṛtaṃ matam |
ya evamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ cākṣaraṃ sukham ||81 ||
vaśyamātmasthamāsvādya māṃ veda na mṛto bhavet |
amṛtāśanamāsādyāmṛto bhavati muktarāṭ ||82||
vyatītya sarvasaṃskārān saṃyamyātmānamātmani |
parabrahma viditvātra paratra tatpadaṃ vrajet ||83 ||
prasāde khalu sattvasya sādhusevāratirbhavet |
prasādaṃ prāpya sādhūnāṃ sādhupatiṃ labheddharim ||84||

viraktānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ gatireṣā sanātanī ||885|||
bhaktimatāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ saiva gatiḥ sanātanī |
ityevaṃ lakṣmi ṛṣirāṭ sadvidyāyananāmakaḥ ||86||
śrutiphalāṃ bahukathāṃ kathayāmāsa muktaye |
śrutiphalā tu papraccha kathaṃ bandhe pratiṣṭhase ||87||
vidyāyanastataḥ prāha dharmo hyeṣa yugārthinaḥ |
api kīṭapataṃgānāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāmapi ||88||
sarīsṛpāṇāṃ dharmo’yaṃ patnyāstu bharaṇaṃ priye |

satāṃ nityaṃ kāṃkṣitaṃ yannaijānāṃ paripālanam |

mānasastatra vai drāk ca putrastasyā vyajāyata ||98||
nirvāṇākhyaḥ śāśvato vai dīkṣitaḥ sahasā tayā |

nirmohinīṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ vaikhānasasutāṃ śubhām |
pariṇeme tato lakṣmi śrutiphalāyutaḥ patiḥ || 3.177.10 0||
sadvidyāyanaṛṣirāṭ kṛtvā samādhimuttamam |
yayau brahmapadaṃ divyaṃ mama dhāma paraṃ sukham || 101 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mananāddhāraṇādapi |
nirbandho jīvavānmukto bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||1 02||

<3.178>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
7vṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām |
gṛhasthasya sadā cātmanivedinaḥ pramuktidām || 1 ||
āsīd bhakto bhikṣuko me bhikṣāyano munīśvaraḥ |
ayācitāñjalināmnī bhāryā tasyābhavacchubhā || 2 ||
bhikṣāyanastriṣavaṇaṃ snāti nityaṃ sarovare |
aśvapaṭṭe ca tatpatnī jalaṃ cādāya mandire || 3 ||
karoti mama pūjāṃ vai nityaṃ triṣavaṇe sthitā |
evaṃ tayorhi dampatyormandire mama sarvadā || 4 ||
pūjayatormama mūrtiṃ vṛttistu jīvikātmikā |
nirvahate bhaktalokairdattairannajalāmbaraiḥ || 5 ||
prātaḥ prapūjya tau māṃ ca mandirasya prasevanam |
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ dhūpadānaṃ dīpaprakāśanam || 6 ||
puṣpādyāharaṇaṃ cāpi pācanaṃ pātramarṣaṇam |
ārārtrikaṃ tathā sthālanivedanaṃ jalārpaṇam || 7 ||
tāmbūladānakaṃ cāpi kuruto’tha visarjanam |
nityamevaṃ cātmaniveditvaṃ kuruta ādarāt || 8 ||
ahamābhyāṃ pratyahaṃ vai bhikṣāyogaṃ karomi ca |
kaścid bhaktaḥ samāgatya yātrālurvā paro’pi vā || 9 ||
arpayatyeva bhojyādi praṇirbṛhatastāvubhau |
santuṣṭau mama bhaktau tau yadṛcchālābhatoṣiṇau || 3.178.10 ||
gārhasthyadharmamevāpi samācarata ādarāt |
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho nātmārthametayoḥ || 11 ||
māṃ harimurarīkṛtya matvā cāntaḥsthitaṃ sadā |
kurutaḥ sarvakāryāṇi dehajānītarāṇi ca || 12||
bhojanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tailābhyaṃgaṃ śaṅgārakam |
sadveṣaṃ cotsavaṃ cāpi pramodaṃ ramaṇaṃ tathā || 1 3||
sarvaṃ māmeva saṃsmṛtya kuruto divyadṛṣṭitaḥ |
ātmārpaṇaṃ vinā kvāpi naivācarata aicchikam || 14||
vyavasāyo’pi sarvo vai madātmakastayorabhūt |
yadā bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇatastau kavale kavale harim || 15||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ smarataśca tau |
śayyāyāṃ cāpi dolāyāṃ prayāse cetare’pi ca || 1 6||
māṃ smṛtvaiva pravartete na māṃ vihāya karhicit |
ātape mama prītyarthaṃ jalakaṭādibandhanam || 17||
śītavāripradpānādi madarthaṃ kurutaḥ sadā |
śaitye coṣṇasalilaṃ ca tathoṣṇabhojanādikam || 18||
madarthe tau hi kurutaścorṇavastrādikārpaṇam |
varṣāyāṃ chatradānādi caikādaśyāṃ ca jāgaram || 1 9||
vrateṣu phalapuṣpāṇāṃ madarthānayana tathā |
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ vādyaśabda tālaṃ ca rañjanādikam || 3.178.20 ||
madarthaṃ kuruto nitya kathāṃ ca kuruto mama |
evaṃ vai vartamānau tau kathāṃ saṃśṛṇuto mama ||21 ||
kāmo vai nirayo loke vāsanāmūlako mataḥ |
kāmināṃ naiva mokṣo’sti tasmāt kāmaṃ parityajet ||22||
ayācitāñjaliḥ patnī śrutvā papraccha taṃ munim |
bhūdeva bhikṣukaścāsse patirme bhavatārakaḥ ||23||
sandehaṃ kathayā jātaṃ pṛcchāmi taṃ nivartaya |
kāmanā narakaṃ proktaṃ kāmināṃ muktireva na ||24||
āvāṃ gārhasthyadharmasthau kāmastatra tu vidyate |
kathaṃkāraṃ bhavenmuktistyājyastasmānmanobhavaḥ ||25 ||
bhikṣāyanastu tacchrutvovāca patnīṃ nijāṃ priyām |
satyaṃ bhārye nirayā vai lokāḥ sarve tu māyikāḥ ||26||
haryarpaṇamṛte patni haryarpaṇe tu nirguṇāḥ |
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca tyaktavyo lobha ityapi || 27||
nārāyaṇe pare tattve nirguṇatāṃ bhajeddhi saḥ |
svātmasukhārthamevāyaṃ bandhano nirayapradaḥ ||28||
parātmanyarpito bhārye paramātmaprasaṃgadaḥ |
hareḥ prasaṃgato bhārye māyā tatra vinaśyati ||29||
amāyikāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhavantyeva hi nirguṇāḥ |
yathā śākādikaṃ sarvaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ salilaṃ phalam ||3.178.30||
māyikaṃ bhautikaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam |
tathā cakṣuḥ karo vakṣaḥ pādau kaṭirmanastathā ||3 1||
haryarpitaṃ kriyādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhavati nirguṇam |
āvābhyāṃ śrīharernityaṃ pūjane sevane priye ||32||
dehendriyasvabhāvādyā arpyante nirguṇā hi te |
tato nāsti nirayo naḥ kintu dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||33|||
tena sevādidharmeṇa puṇyaṃ hareḥ prasaṃgataḥ |
bhikṣuko’haṃ bhikṣukī tvaṃ bhikṣā hareḥ sadā hi nau ||34||
āvayorbhikṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
tadyogenāvayośceṣṭā kṛṣṇātmikā tu nirguṇā ||35||
tasmāt patni sarvakārye smara kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram |
na māṃ na tvāṃ kintu kṛṣṇaṃ śleṣe viśleṣaṇe’pi ca ||36||
evaṃ naivāsti loke’tra dehe vā bandhanaṃ tava |
mamāpi bandhanaṃ nāsti parārthakarmaṇoḥ priye ||37||
ityevaṃ bodhyamānāpi lakṣmi sā munibhikṣukī |
sādhvī viśvāsamāpannā manāgapi ca vai tataḥ ||38||
punaḥ sañcintayāmāsa kāmo’yaṃ kalmaṣātmakaḥ |
pāpamevāsti nirayaprado duḥkhaprado’pi ca ||39||
evaṃ cintayate nityaṃ bhajate māṃ satī sadā |
ekadāhaṃ tayoḥ sākṣādabhavaṃ netragocaraḥ ||3.178.40 ||
tasyāḥ śaṃkāvināśārthaṃ cāspṛśaṃ svakareṇa tām |
sā mumoha svarūpe me sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhite ||41 ||
samāściṣattūrṇameva māṃ mugdhā patisannidhau |
mayā tasyai vinā bhogaṃ sparśamātreṇa sarvathā ||42||
sarvānandāḥ pradattā vai sukhinī sā parābhavat |
divyābhavattata ārabhyaiva niṣkāmabhāvanā ||43 ||
saṃkalpaḥ kāmanājanyastasyā naṣṭo’ntarāt sadā |
niṣkāmā sā muktarūpā brahmavratorjitābhavat ||44||
bhikṣuko’pi tayā spṛṣṭo niṣkāmaḥ sarvathābhavat |
brahmaśīlavratau tau tu tadārabhyārkabhāsvarau ||45||
vilakṣaṇau devapūjyau lokapūjyau babhūvatuḥ |
evaṃ nityaṃ sevayā me mayā niṣkāminau kṛtau ||46||
mama yogena nāryo’pi narāścāpi hyakāminaḥ |
bhavantyeveti te sarve prayānti paramaṃ padam ||47||
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptau divyavimānasaṃsthitau |
muktarūpau tu tau bhūtvā yayaturdhāma me’kṣaram ||48||
evaṃ lakṣmi cātmanivedinoḥ strīnarayoriha |
sarvadoṣānnāśayāmi guṇān divyān karomi ca ||49||
sarvaṃ kartuṃ samarthasya dayāloḥ paramātmanaḥ |
bhaktāya tvāgamo loke bhaktān santārayāmi vai ||3.178.5 0 ||
bhikṣā bahuvidhā lakṣmi dātavyā pataye tu me |
sarvā sā nirguṇā tena jāyate mama yogataḥ ||5 1||
samākarṇaya kamale vividhāṃ kathayāmi te |
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ svasya sarvaṃ bhikṣātmakaṃ matam |||52||
svapne jāgrati sauṣupte turye muktau yadiṣṭakam |
anarpitaṃ na vai grāhyaṃ mahyaṃ datvā samālabhet ||53 ||
bhojanaṃ rāsanaṃ sarvaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ diśenmayi |
pānaṃ svādu yadiṣṭaṃ ca dadyānmahyaṃ mamāśrayī ||54||
vastrāṇi yāni ramyāṇi veṣāśca bhūṣaṇādikam |
svarṇarūpyahīrakādi ratnāni cārpayenmayi ||55||
abhyaṃgādi sugandhādi kajjalādi diśenmayi |
mukuṭādi śayanādi gendukādi ca me’rpayet |||56||
vitānādi cāsanādi yānādyapi ca me’rpayet |
mandirādi vāhanādi vimānādi ca me’rpayet ||57||
dhūpadīpādi puṣpādi candanādīni me’rpayet |
gajavājigavādīni dāsadāsīśca me’rpayet ||58||
rūpāṇi sarvaramyāṇi śabdān śrāvyām̐śca me’rpayet |
sparśān sarvavidhām̐ścāpi grāhyān sarvāṃśca me’payet |||59 ||
gantavyān sukhabhājaścānanditavyām̐śca me’rpayet |
miṣṭānnāni samagrāṇi tulasīmañjarīrdiśet ||3.178.60 ||
tailasārān karpūrādi dadyānmahyaṃ tu bhikṣave |
putraṃ putrīṃ patiṃ patnīṃ sarvasvaṃ me’rpayet sadā || 61 ||
mahyaṃ sarvāṇyāyughāni sarvayantrāṇi me’rpayet |
yajñayāgādikāryāṇi havanādīni me’rpayet || 62||
arpayenme’pi sasyāni kaṇiśām̐śca kaṇām̐stathā |
miṣṭarasāḍhyauṣadhīśca madhvādīni ca me’rpayet ||63 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭikalāścāpi navavastūni me’rpayet |
prakāśaṃ cāprakāśaṃ ca sarvaṃ mahyaṃ diśejjanaḥ ||64||
āyaścotpādanaṃ sarvaṃ vṛddhirdravyasya vastunaḥ |
hārdikaṃ daihikaṃ cāpyaindriyakaṃ me samarpayet ||65||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vāri mahyaṃ datvā suyojayet |
vidyāṃ jñānaṃ vivekaṃ ca kauśalyaṃ guṇaśālitām ||66||
nyāyaṃ paropakāraṃ ca sarvaṃ mahyaṃ samarpayet |
saṃkalpā viphalā ye ca ye cānte phaladāyinaḥ ||67||
kṛtayaścāpi yatnāśca tānme sarvān samarpayet |
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni sarvāṇyapi balāni ca || 68||
avasthāścāpi sarvāśca camatkārāḥ samastakāḥ |
saundaryaguṇayogāśca tānme sarvān samarpayet || 69 ||
ahaṃ parārtho bhavatāṃ bhikṣuścānantasaṃkhyadaḥ |
gṛhītvā pradadāmyeva śāśvataṃ bhikṣayārthitam ||3.178.70||
rājyaṃ svargaṃ divyalokān bhogām̐śca sampado navāḥ |
sukhāni cotsavānmodān harṣān pratidadāmyaham ||71 ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ cāmbarāṇi bhavanānyuttamāni ca |
godhanaṃ dāsadāsīśca putrān putrīrdadāmyaham |||02||
dhiṣṇyaṃ cāpi ca māhendraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamityapi |
dikpālatvaṃ caiśvaraṃ vā vairājaṃ padamuttamam ||73||
aiśaṃ vā lokapālatvaṃ maharṣitvaṃ guroḥ padam |
dhrauvyaṃ vā sauramevāpi cāndraṃ rājyaṃ dadāmyaham ||74||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram |
śrīpuraṃ brahmalokaṃ vā paraṃdhāma dadāmyaham ||75||
bhikṣayāmi bhavadbhyo’haṃ sarvaṃ me rocate sadā |
dāne labhe bhunajmyetad bhuktvā dadāmyanantakam ||76||
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ śubhaṃ cāpyaśubhaṃ saṃbhikṣayāmyaham |
aniṣṭaṃ janatādattaṃ labdhveṣṭaṃ pratisandade ||77||
alābhaṃ prāpya lābhātmaṃ phalaṃ pratidadāmyaham |
svalpaṃ prāpya ca bahudhā yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham ||78||
lakṣmīṃ dadāmi vipulāṃ sampadaścātivarculāḥ |
śaktīrdadāmi bahudhā jayaṃ dadāmi nityadā ||79||
madīyaṃ yadbhavet sarvaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai dadāmyaham |
yo mahyaṃ prārpayet sarvaṃ mama bhūtvā ca vartate ||3.178.80||
lakṣmītyevaṃ samartho’smi sarvaṃ dātumanantakam |
bhikṣukāścenmadarthaṃ vai bhikṣayantyarpayanti ca ||8 1 ||
tataśca bhuñjate tebhyaḥ phalaṃ dadāmyanantakam |
bahavo nāma rājāno viprāścarṣaya ityamī ||82||
tapaso’nte tu bhikṣayāmāsurmāmeva putrakam |
putro’bhavaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ muhurvai bhikṣito mudhā ||83||
gaṇeśo’haṃ śaṃkarasya hariḥ kṛṣṇo vṛṣasya ca |
aditervāmanaścāpi kapilaḥ kardamasya ca ||84||
vasudevasya gopālo nābheḥ ṛṣabha ityapi |
kaṃbharāyā anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi ca ||85||
datto’trerjamadagneśca parśurāmastathābhavam |
rāmaḥ śatarathasyāpi kumāro brahmaṇastathā ||86||
evamādyāni janmāni bhikṣārūpāṇi tāni vai |
bhikṣāyāṃ vartate sarvaṃ bhikṣāyāṃ cāhamityapi ||87||
bhikṣukā me’tivātsalyapātrāṇi mama rūpiṇaḥ |
bhikṣāyāṃ bhṛguṇā dattā bhārgavī tvaṃ pareśvarī ||88|
padmāpi bhikṣayā labdhā nārāyaṇo tathaiva ca |
duḥkhahāśrīstathā labdhā lakṣmīśca māṇikī tathā ||89 ||
prajñā padmāvatī labdhā bhikṣāyā kamalā ramā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhogavān mokṣavān bhavet || 3.178.90 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhikṣā
yanarṣeḥ ayācitāñjalināmabhāryāyā gārhasthye’pi śrīharyarpaṇakriyādibhirmuktirbhikṣāmahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 178 ||

<3.179>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi bhāvukākhye pure vaiśyo hyanāthakaḥ |
ābālyānmṛtajanako jananīpoṣito hyamum || 1 ||
mātā nityāśrayānāmnī putraṃ tu veśinaṃ sadā |
pālayatyekameveyaṃ vaṃśavṛddhipramūlakam || 9 ||
nityaṃ sā vidhavā kṛṣṇamandire viprasannidho |
kathāṃ śrotuṃ prayātyeva yayā duḥkhaṃ praṇaśyati | 9 ||
kathājñānena sahasā dhairyaṃ prajāyate śubham |
tāpā naśyanti duḥkhāni cintālayo bhavatyati || 4 ||
sā saṃhitāṃ praśuśrāva lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidham |
varṣadvayaṃ praśuśrāva sarvākhyānāni bhāminī || 5 ||
kathāstā vividhāḥ śrutvā brahmarūpā vyajāyata |
satī sādhvīdharmayuttā vartate sā videhinī || 6 ||
nityāśrayeti svanāmno’rthaṃ viveda tato hi sā |
nitye harau svāmideve tvāśrayo mama vidyate || 7 ||
hariḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ svāmī patnī tasya bhavāmyaham |
sevanīyaḥ sadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 8 ||
gopālabālakaḥ sākṣāt kambharānandano’vyayaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjalakṣmīnāṃ patiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ || 9 ||
sa eva nijabhaktānāṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ |
bhuktimuktipradaḥ svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ || 3.179.10 ||
evaṃ jñānaṃ samāpannā vrataṃ tapasi saṃsthitā |
cakre’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiprasevanam || 11 ||
tayā vai tāmrapatre me kāritā pratimā śubhā |
tatpūjā vai vrataṃ nityaṃ pālitaṃ svārpaṇātmakam || 12 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi yathāsevāṃ kṛtavatī tu sābhavat |
prātarutthāya pṛthvyāṃ sā oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 13 ||
itināmnāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japati mālayā |
tato dhyānaṃ mama mūrteḥ karoti śayane sthitā || 14||
pādau jaṃghe jānunī ca sakthinī jaghanādikam |
kaṭi nābhimudaraṃ ca vakṣaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dvipārśvakam || 15||
kaṇṭhaṃ mukhaṃ kapolau ca gaṇḍau bhālaṃ ca cakṣuṣī |
karṇau śikhāṃ dhyāyatīti tataḥ snānaṃ karoti sā || 16||
anāthamātā bhaktā me’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
nāmajapaṃ karotyeva snāne vārighaṭaṃ tu sā || 17||
sūryāya pitṛbhyaścāpi dadāti dyunivāsine |
tulasīpatrapuṣpāṇi stambebhyaḥ svayameva hi ||18||
ācitvā candanaṃ ghṛṣṭvā nīravā cāyāti vai gṛham |
mūrtiṃ me tvāsane nyasyāvāhanaṃ cāsanādikam ||1 9||
pādyamarghyamācamanīyakaṃ jalaṃ dadāti me |
jalena candanenāpi vāriṇā kusumaistathā ||3.179.20|||
vinā pañcāmṛtaṃ pañcāmṛtanāmnārcayatyapi |
vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ cāmalakaṃ bhūṣaṇārthakam ||21 ||
taṇḍulān sarvaśṛṃgārārthaṃ ca kuṃkumamuttamam |
arpayatyeva me sādhvī dhūpaṃ candanacūrṇajam ||22||
dīpaṃ tailenārpayati naivedyaṃ caṇakādikam |
phalaṃ vā tilapātraṃ vā gūḍaṃ vā prātareva sā ||23||
dadātyapi yathālabdhaṃ jalaṃ tathārpayatyapi |
nīrājanaṃ karotyeva ghaṇṭīnādaprapūrvakam ||24||
pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ stutiṃ visarjanaṃ śubham |
puṣpāñjaliprapūrvaṃ ca karotyevaṃ sadā prage || 25||
tato vai gṛhakāryaṃ sā karoti bālalālanam |
bālasya rakṣaṇaṃ stanyadānaṃ bālasya bhojanam ||26||
bhṛtyatālabdhasantuṣṭā poṣaṇaṃ sā karoti vai |
annavastrādisantuṣṭā patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasevate ||27||
tato dāsīsvarūpā sā bhṛtyā bhṛtyatvakarmaṇe |
yāti śreṣṭhigṛhe pātramañjanādividhitsayā ||28|||
bhṛtyākāryaṃ vinirvartya madhyāhne’nnaphalādikam |
prāpyate śreṣṭhibhāryātastadādāya gṛhaṃ nijam ||29||
samāyāti madbhajanānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
nityaṃ śreṣṭhikuṭumbaṃ tacchṛṇoti nāmakīrtanam ||3.179.3 0||
madbhaktaṃ tadabhūt sarvaṃ śreṣṭhī vṛddho’pi rūpaśaḥ |
kālena nidhanaṃ yātastadā nityāśrayā gṛhe ||3 1 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti dhunyamācarat |
ahaṃ tayā samākṛṣṭo yayau vai śreṣṭhino’ntikam |||32||
sākṣādabhavaṃ tasyāgre tasyāścāgre striyāstathā |
divyaṃ me marśanaṃ datvā ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ hi tam ||3 3||
vimānena sudivyena kuṭumbaṃ tad vyalokayam |
sarvaṃ madbhaktimajjātaṃ tayā hyanāthayā rame ||34||
madhyāhne hyevameveyaṃ nityaṃ śreṣṭhigṛhakriyām |
kṛtvāyāti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bhojayitvā nijaṃ sutam ||35||
dugdhaṃ saṃpāyayitvā ca bhuṃkte kṛṣṇasmṛtisthitā |
sāyaṃ nirājanaṃ cāpi karoti bhajanaṃ mama ||36||
bhojanaṃ sā tato datvā mahyaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ hyapi |
svapiti bālakaṃ kṛtvā pārśve’pare ca māmapi ||37||
evaṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ nityāśrayā tu vaiṣṇavī |
bālo’pi mātṛbhaktiṃ vai dṛṣṭvā bhaktatamo’bhavat ||38||
yathā mātā tathā putraḥ saṃskṛtaścātmavedanaḥ |
mahābhāgavato bālye rome’rhaṇādikhelanaiḥ ||39||
kṛtrimāṃ mṛttikāmūrtiṃ saṃsthāpyavālukāsane |
kardamādicandanādyaiḥ pupūja pratimāṃ mama ||3.179.40||
tṛṇapatrāṇi bhūsthāni dhṛtvārpayati bhāvataḥ |
puṣpāṇīti pramatvaiva mātṛvat salilaṃ tathā ||41 ||
mṛttikābhagnapātrādau samarpayati sādaram |
bhojanaṃ nimbapakvasatphalaṃ cānyad dadāti ca ||42||
pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca karoti mālikāṃ tathā |
kṣamāṃ samprārthayatyeva dayāṃ prasannatāṃ hareḥ ||43||
visarjayati sarvaṃ tat tato mitraiḥ sahāpi ca |
ramate tu gṛhāgre vai bhajannārāyaṇaṃ tu mām ||44||
evaṃ kāle gate so’pi yuvābhavatprabhaktarāṭ |
mātāpi bhajate māṃ ca prasanno’haṃ tayostadā ||45||
abhavaṃ cāgatastatra viprarūpadharo hariḥ |
bhikṣāṃ tatrārthayāmāsa nityāśrayā tu māṃ tadā ||46||
dadau vai roṭakaṃ tvekaṃ takraṃ dadau prabhuktaye |
ahaṃ gṛhāṃgaṇe tatra niṣadya bhuktavān manāk ||47||
ardhaṃ tu roṭakaṃ tasmai bālāya cārpayaṃ tathā |
takraṃ pradadau svalpaṃ ca dugdhaṃ tatkṛtavānaham ||48||
yuvā putro vismitaścovāca tvamātaraṃ muhuḥ |
mātastakramidaṃ dugdhaṃ jātaṃ vipraprasādataḥ ||49||
roṭako’yaṃ miṣṭamiśro ghṛtākto’pi vyajāyata |
so’yamataścamatkārī vidyate brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||3.179.50||
mātāścaryaṃ paraṃ śrutvā mugdhā vyalokayat prabhum |
dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭiṃ samprayojya tāvaccaturbhujo’bhavam ||51||
divyo divyāvayavaśca divyasarvāṃgabhūṣaṇaḥ |
divyacihno’bhavaṃ lakṣmīsahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||52||
tadā sā māṃ vilokyaiva śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram |
papāta pādayorme ca trāyasva vyājahāra ca ||53 ||
putraḥ keśīsaṃjñakaśca jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram |
anāthanāthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ papāta pādayormama ||54|||
tuṣṭāva māṃ bālakaśca mātā tuṣṭāva vihvalā |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛpāsindho hyanāthanātha mādhava ||55||
tava svo bhavasaṃsārāt tāraya śrīrhare pate |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamatprabho ||56 ||
bhavatā viprarūpeṇa tāritau mātṛputrakau |
anāthānāṃ bhavān nāthaśceti satyaṃ vacastava ||57||
mayā kathā hi bahudhā śrutā te parameśvara |
virāgaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sevito’si janārdana ||58 ||
jñānaṃ prāpya patiṃ jñātvā tvāṃ bhajāmi ca nityadā |
bālo’yaṃ bhavato nātha tvaṃ nibhālaya putrakam ||59||
māṃ dhāmākṣarasaṃjñaṃ te naya śrīpuruṣottama |
svāmin kānta suhṛd bandho rakṣaka śrīhare’va mām || 3.179.60 ||
ityevamuktvā sā lakṣmi puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau mayi |
pādau jagrāha me cāpi ruroda premavihvalā || 61 ||
plāvitau mama pādau tu tadaśrubhistayā rame |
putro’pi cātmanivedī premāśrūṇi mumoca ha ||62|||
muktiṃ dehi kṛpāsindho parameśa śriyaḥ pate |
ityuvāca karau dhṛtvā vakṣo vakṣo niyujya ca || 63 ||
āśliṣṭavān yathā putraḥ pitaraṃ tattathā sa mām |
mayāśrūṇi pramuktāni putraṃ bhaktatamaṃ prati || 64||
sa tairāpluta evābhūd divyadṛṣṭistato’bhavat |
nibhālitā ca tanmātā kṛpādṛṣṭyā mayā rame || 671||
sāpi divyā divyadṛṣṭistadā tūrṇaṃ vyavartata |
trikālajñau kṛpayā me nirbandho siddhisaṃśritau ||66 ||
lakṣmīvanmuktavat tau tu jātau divyavihāriṇau |
divyopakaraṇaistatra saṃkalpitaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ || 67||
pūjayāmāsaturmāṃ ca mumucaturna māṃ hi tau |
atra vāsaṃ kuru kṛṣṇetyāhatustau muhurmuhuḥ || 68 ||
yadvā naya nau sahaivetyeva jagadatustadā |
ahaṃ rūpaṃ susaṃkucya viprarūpaḥ punastadā ||69||
abhavaṃ tau siṣevāte vyajanena karaistathā |
ahaṃ vicārya muktiṃ vai tayordivyasvarūpiṇau ||3.179.7 0 ||
sahaiva nītvā sūryābhe vimāne cādhyarohayam |
putraṃ tu keśinaṃ prasūṃ nityāśrayāṃ hyanāthinīm ||7 1 ||
prāpayāmāsa tūrṇaṃ me dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam |
evaṃ lakṣmi hyanāthānāṃ nātho’haṃ bhavatārakaḥ ||72||
vallabho’smi prabhaktānāṃ mokṣadaḥ sudayāvaśaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavecchubhā ||73||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne anāthāyā nityāśrayāyāstatputrasya keśinaśca bhāgavatīṃ bhaktiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavatā dattaṃ darśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 179 ||

<3.180>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ cānyāṃ mama bhaktasya śobhanām |
māyākhye nagare tvāsīd bhakto me vyāghrasaṃjñakaḥ || 1 ||
ābālyād daivabhāvaśca sādhuṣu snehavān śuciḥ |
yatayo ye samāyānti vaiṣṇavā nyāsinīpi ca || 2 ||
darśanārthaṃ prayātyeva sādhūnāṃ śīghrameva saḥ |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vārisamānayanamityapi || 3 ||
karoti pātraśuddhyādi mārjanaṃ ca sadāśrame |
prasādaṃ ca samaśnāti sevate ca sataḥ sadā || 4 ||
evaṃ bhaktiyuto bhakto mahāśīrvādamāpa ha |
ciraṃ jīva ciraṃ tiṣṭha sukhī bhava samṛddhimān || 5 ||
athāyaṃ sādhusevāyāṃ vartamāno’pi caikadā |
bālabhāvena lobhena patitāṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalām || 6 ||
jagrāha cauryarūpeṇa vāsudevavibhūṣaṇam |
sādhavastu gatāścānyagrāmaṃ vyāghrastu śṛṃkhalām || 7 ||
mārjanādau labdhavām̐ścāprakāśe’rakṣayaddhi tām |
ānīya svagṛhe svarṇaśṛṃkhalāṃ nidadhe puṭe || 8 ||
naiva jānāti kaścidvai tathāyaṃ samarakṣayat |
mātā vai tvasya peṭāyāṃ naiva jānāti śṛṃkhalām || 9 ||
pitāpi cāraṇo nāmnā kūṭadevo na śṛṃkhalām |
jānāti tadvidhāṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalāṃ kāṣṭhapeṭake || 3.180.1 0||
dhṛtāṃ svayaṃ vijānāti cāprakāśe prapaśyati |
punaśca tatra peṭāyāṃ guptāṃ tāṃ nidadhāti ca || 11 ||
atha sādhuḥ śyāmanāmā viṣṇumūrteḥ prapūjakaḥ |
grāmāntare tu pūjāyāṃ yāvadicchati śṛṃkhalām || 1 2||
adṛṣṭvā pūjane kāle’tarkayat patitā bhavet |
pṛcchāṃ cākārayad bhaktairdvārā māyāpure muhuḥ || 1 3||
vyāghraṃ bhaktāḥ samapṛcchan vyāghro dṛṣṭā na ceti vai |
pratyuttaraṃ dadau tebhyo lobhena ca bhayena ca || 1 4||
evamasatyabhāvasya vyāghrasya cauryapāpataḥ |
svarṇacaurasya karayodvayaścāṃgulikāsu tu || 1 5||
galatkuṣṭhānyabhavam̐ścāṃguṣṭhayorapi sarvathā |
śarīra śvetakuṣṭhāścābhavan cauryāghajaṃ phalam || 16 ||
bhajate bhagavantaṃ māṃ tathauṣadhaṃ karotyapi |
kuṣṭhā naiva vilīyante duḥkhī cātīva so’bhavat || 17 ||
sādhusevāphalabhāk ca svarṇacauryāghabhāgapi |
śuśrāva sa kathāṃ lakṣmīsaṃhitāyāśca tatra ha || 18 ||
śrutavān svarṇacauryasya phalaṃ kuṣṭho bhavediti |
prāyaścittaṃ tasya cāpi śrutavān svarṇadānakam || 19 ||
brahmakṛcchravrataṃ cāpi brahmakūrcavrataṃ tathā |
saptāhikaṃ prakuryāccet svarṇasteyī pramucyate || 3.180.2 0 ||
athāyaṃ cāprakāśe vai chadmanodarapīḍanam |
bahiḥ prakāśayitvaiva brahmakūrcavrataṃ vyadhāt || 21 ||
papau vāri dine tvādye khadirapatrapācitam |
dvitīye tu papau vāri kiṃśukapuṣpapācitam || 22||
tṛtīye tu papau vāri bilvapatraprapācitam |
caturthe tu papau vāri padmaphalaprapācitam || 23 ||
pañcame tu papau vāri hyudumbaraprapācitam |
ṣaṣṭhe papau darbhapatrapācitaṃ ca tataḥ param || 24||
upoṣaṇaṃ saptame tu cakāra māṃ bhajan muhuḥ |
ārādhanā cakārāpi mūrtyagre mama cāghahām || 25 ||
hare svarṇaṃ mayā cāptaṃ mārjanaṃ tatra kurvatā |
tatpāpa kuṣṭharūpaṃ vai lagnaṃ me tatkṣamāpaya | | 26 ||
svarṇamālāṃ pradāsyāmi tasmai tu sādhave punaḥ |
brahma kūrcavratenāpi prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā || 27 ||
rogo’yaṃ me nāśametu bhaktārthaṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru |
trāhi pāhi jagannātha śrīhare puruṣottama || 28 ||
pāpyuddhāraprakartastvaṃ bhaktaṃ māṃ parirakṣaya |
evaṃ māṃ cārthayāmāsātyarthamaśrūṇi vāhayan | | 29 | |
cintayāmāsa maraṇaṃ yadā kuṣṭho na naśyati |
suṣvāpaivaṃ cintayānaḥ svapne’haṃ tasya sannidhau | | 3.180.30 | |
darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ me śaṃkhacakragadādharam |
hasannahaṃ jagādainaṃ bhakta śocasi kiṃ vada | | 31 ||
sa āha māṃ kṛpāsindho lobhāt svarṇasya śṛṃkhalā |
sādhorviṣṇormayā cāptā patitā bhūtale tu sā || 32 ||
rakṣitā me gṛhe cāste phalaṃ bhunajmi kuṣṭhakam |
śrutvā kathāṃ svarṇacauryaprāyaścittaṃ mayā kṛtam ||33||
brahmakūrcavrataṃ kṛṣṇa pāpaṃ nāśaya me prabho |
ityevaṃ prārthayāmāsa tato’haṃ tasya sannidhau || 34||
svapnaṃ vilupya sahasā jāgare taṃ samānayam |
so’pi tatrotthitastūrṇaṃ māṃ vilokya pareśvaram ||35||
premagadgadapūrṇo’bhūttuṣṭāva daṇḍavattathā |
nanarta premapūrṇaśca yayāce ca kṣamāṃ tathā ||36||
tato’haṃ tasya doṣasya nuttaye taṃ jagāda ha |
svarṇasya śṛṃkhalā mahyaṃ dehi te’ghaṃ gataṃ khalu ||37||
atha vyāghro dadau mahyaṃ samutthāya tu śṛṃkhalām |
mayā dhṛtā svakaṇṭhe sā tāvat sā śṛṃkhalā tadā ||38||
te sādhavo yatra gatā abhavam̐statra tatsthale |
mūrtikaṇṭhe gatā cāsīt sādhustu dṛṣṭavām̐śca tām ||39||
jaharṣa tāṃ svarṇamālāṃ vilokya ca muhurmuhuḥ |
kathayāmāsa sarvebhyaścamatkāraṃ hareḥ param ||3.180.40 ||
bhaktārthaṃ bhagavāneva yogaṃ kṣemaṃ karoti hi |
sampadi vipadi cāpi cintayatyeva bhaktakam ||41 ||
yo yasya vai bhaved bhaktastadarthaṃ bhagavān svayam |
bhagavattvaṃ dadātyeva naijaiśvaryaṃ samastakam ||4 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi pareśasya kṛpayā vyāghrabhaktarāṭ |
drāgeva kuṣṭhatāhīno jātaḥ pāpavivarjitaḥ ||43||
subhago rūpavām̐ścāpi yathāpūrvaṃ vyajāyata |
tasmādahaṃ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo rakṣāmi cāśritam ||44||
pāpinaṃ vā kalmaṣāḍhyaṃ māyādoṣābhisaṃplutam |
vāsanāśatakoṭyāḍhyaṃ dharmakarmādivarjitam ||45||
api māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ madarthatyaktajīvitam |
madarthasarvavyāpāraṃ madarthadhyānapūjanam ||46 ||
mayi sarvasvārpaṇaṃ ca rakṣāmi sarvathā janam |
śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm ||47||
dhanagrāme’bhavad vipro grāmayājaka uttamaḥ |
uttamākhyaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ karmakāṇḍapradhānakaḥ ||48||
sarvavarṇajanānāṃ vai karmakāṇḍaprasādhakaḥ |
nṛpasyāpi guruḥ so’pi nṛpakāryaṃ karoti ca ||49||
nṛpānnaṃ vai guru proktaṃ caurāṇāmannamityapi |
adātṝṇāṃ janānāṃ ca patitānāṃ tathā guru ||3.180.50||
bhuktaṃ na jīryati lakṣmi pītaṃ cāpi na jīryati |
vastrapātrādikaṃ dāne gṛhītaṃ nāpi jīryati ||51 ||
śayyāgosvarṇadānādiḥ parigraho na jīryati |
grāmayājakaevāsāvuttamo nāma bhūsuraḥ ||52||
lobhena sarvavarṇānāmagrāhayaddhanādikam |
bhuṃkte pibati cāśnāti ramate modate gṛhe ||53||
sampattiścāsya vai śreṣṭhābhavannṛpādhikā gṛhe |
ratnahārāḥ svarṇamālāḥ svarṇaparyaṃkakāsanam ||54||
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi dāsā dāsyo hyanekaśaḥ |
gomahiṣyādikāścāpi gajavājirathādayaḥ ||55||
sarvamasyābhavad ṛddhaṃ putrāḥ putryo’pi saukhyadāḥ |
bhāryāpi bhaktisampannā dharmayutā pativratā ||56||
athāsya dānabhāreṇa pāpināṃ dravyasañcayaiḥ |
pāpināmannapānādyairjalodaraṃ daro’bhavat ||57|||
udaraṃ pīḍyate tena mahodaraṃ hi lambate |
pacyate nahi bhuktaṃ vā pītaṃ jīryati naiva ca ||58||
sukhaṃ nāsya kṣaṇaṃ cāpi jāyate ṛddhibhistadā |
vaidyāśramān yayau rogaśāntyarthaṃ ca tathāpyapi ||59||
auṣadhānāṃ prayogeṣu bahuṣvapi jalodaram |
naṣṭaṃ naiva hi pratyuta vyavardhata dine dine ||3.180.60||
athaikadā yayau devāyanarṣiṃ prati bhūsuraḥ |
nyavedayannijaṃ rogaṃ sādhave prapraṇamya saḥ ||6 1 ||
sādhurdadau harernāma mālāṃ ca tulasījanim |
ohare śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa māṃ nirujaṃ kuru ||62||
iti jāpaṃ bhūsurāyopādideśa sahasrakam |
nityameveti so’pyevaṃ jajāpa pratyahaṃ mudā ||63||
bhajate māṃ sadā so’yaṃ roganāśārthameva ha |
ārto bhajate māṃ nitya vaibhavī bhajate na vai ||64||
vaibhavyārto bhajate māṃ svārthārthaṃ so’bhajad yathā |
evaṃ varṣottare kāle bhaktiṃ prakurvataḥ puraḥ ||65||
dayayāhaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau rogapraśāntaye |
sādhūnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā yayau tasya gṛhaṃ prati ||66||
so’pi rogapraśāntyarthaṃ bhojanādi dadau mudā |
svarṇarūpyāmbarādyaṃ ca sādhubhyo vividhaṃ dadau ||67||
prārthayāmāsa cātyarthaṃ rogaśāntyarthamityapi |
ahaṃ sādhugururbhūtvā hastaṃ tasyodare’dadham ||68||
camatkāro yathā syādvai tathāsyodaratastadā |
jalodaro mahān rogo mūrtimān samapāsarat ||69||
kadrūpaḥ sabhayaścāpi dudrāva ca dadhāva ca |
gato rogo bhūsuraśca svastho’bhavat kṣaṇāntare ||3.180.70 ||
jalaṃ śuṣkaṃ tadā jātaṃ jāṭharaścābhavacchubhaḥ |
vayaṃ sarve sādhavastu śīghramadṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ ||71 ||
so’pi vijñāya māṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tato’bhajan muhuḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhakto nirāmayastadā kṛtaḥ ||72||
so’pi cānte yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ me paramātmanaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyārogyaṃ bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam ||73 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kuṣṭhino vyāghrākhyasya svarṇacaurasya cāraṇabhaktasya kuṣṭhitānāśanam uttamākhyasya grāmayājakaviprasya bhaktasya jalodaranāśanaṃ bhagavaddarśanaṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 180 ||

<3.181>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ virālasya kathāṃ śubhām |
virālanāmako bhakto māñjuṣṭhagrāmavāsakṛt || 1 ||
abhūt kuṭumbasahito dhanāḍhyo vaiśya eva saḥ |
annānāṃ cāmbarāṇāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ vikrayādikṛt || 2 ||
lakṣādhidravyavān dharmī sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ |
yena nirmāpitā ramyā dharmaśālātiśobhanā || 3 ||
yatrātithayaścāgatya viśrāntiṃ yānti sādhavaḥ |
pravāsino yatayaśca sādhvyo yātrālavastathā || 4 ||
yenānnasatraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca tatra nirmāpitaṃ śubham |
yatra miṣṭaṃ rasayuktamannaṃ dugdhaṃ tathaudanam || 5 ||
pūrikāḥ sūpaśākādi labhante bhikṣavaḥ sadā |
bhuñjate śataśo nityaṃ dadātyāśīrvacāṃsi ca || 6 ||
nityaṃ virālavaiśyo’pi svahastena tu dakṣiṇām |
dānaṃ dadāti bālebhyo’nāthebhyaḥ strībhya ityapi || 7 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo kīrtanaṃ kārayatyapi |
pūjanaṃ me karotyevaṃ kārayatyapi pratyaham || 8 ||
putrāstasyābhavan pañca putryaḥ sapta striyāvubhe |
sarve te māṃ pūjayanti śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 9 ||
sāyaṃ militvā me’gre te kīrtanaṃ vidadhatyapi |
kathāṃ kurvanti ca ramyāṃ śṛṇvanti ca parasparam || 3.181.10 ||
evaṃ vai puṇyayuktasya virālasya susampadaḥ |
anatiprāptavṛddhatve rājayakṣmā daro’bhavat || 11 ||
nityaṃ vivardhamānena rogeṇa śuṣkatāṃ gataḥ |
oṣadhāni bahūnyeva kṛtāni mānatāstathā || 1 2||
kṛtā bahvyaḥ sādhavaśca tadarthama sevitā hyati |
rogo nāśaṃ na ca yāti śreṣṭhī cintāparo’bhavat || 13 ||
kuṭumbaṃ cintayā grastaṃ pitā pūjyo mariṣyati |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ rakṣārthama tu pituḥ khalu || 14||
evaṃ vicintayatāṃ tu kuṃkumavāpikā śubhā |
tīrthaṃ rogaharaṃ cāste sākṣād yatra śriyaḥ patiḥ || 15||
ityevaṃ mānasaṃ jātaṃ tataste janakena vai |
sahitāḥ prayayustīrthamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram || 1 6||
kīrtayanto mama nāma smaranto māṃ prabhuṃ tathā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rogaharaṃ harim || 17||
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ samāgatya ca te tataḥ |
niṣedurvaṭavṛkṣādho māṃ smaranto jalaṃ papuḥ || 18||
akṣayyaghāṭamāsādya sasnuḥ sarve prabhāviṇaḥ |
dānāni svarṇarūpyāṇi cāmbarāṇi dadustadā || 19 ||
pātrāṇyannāni miṣṭāni kambalāni dadustathā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ prīyatāmiti ||3.181.20 ||
athāhaṃ bhaktimālokya viprarūpadharo hariḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ jagāma tasya sannidhau ||21 ||
kṣayī virālanāmā sa matvā tīrthamṛtiṃ tadā |
sasmāra māṃ svahṛdaye nārāyaṇaḥ prarakṣatu ||22||
mayā gatvā sannidhau vai pṛṣṭo virālakastadā |
kutaḥ kasmāt kathaṃ cātra samāyāto’si bho dhanin ||23||
kathaṃ rogaḥ kiyatkālād vartate tava tīrthakṛt |
virālako’tikaṣṭena mṛtyuṃ smṛtvā ruroda ha |||24||
śuśoca bahudhā tatra papraccha māṃ tu bhūsuram |
namaste vipra vṛddho’si yadi jānāsi daivatam ||25||
vada me bahupuṇyasya kathaṃ rogo vyajāyata |
nātra janmani bhūdeva pātakaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā ||26||
puṇyadānāni bahudhā kṛtāni vividhāni vai ||
ābālyāt sādhusevyasmi śrīhareḥ pūjako’smi ca ||27||
kuṭumbaṃ me bhaktiyutaṃ parameśe sadāsti vai |
vratāni bhaktiyuktāni karomi sakuṭumbakaḥ ||28||
tathāpi kṣayarogo me kathaṃ prāptaḥ pradarśaya |
śrutvāhaṃ viprarūpastu virālasya samastakam ||29||
vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajanmīyaṃ samuvāca hi padmaje |
śṛṇu śreṣṭhin supuṇyo’si sarvathā cātra janmani ||3.181.3 0 ||
purā kṛtaṃ tu yatkarma kenāpi na viyujyate |
pūrvajanmani viprastvaṃ nāmnā gaṃgeśvaro’bhavaḥ || 31 ||
sābhramatītaṭe puṇye viṣṇostu mandire’bhavaḥ |
pūjakastatra vai pārśve sasyakṣetrāṇi vāṭikāḥ ||32||
āsan vaiśyasya ramyāśca vaiśyastu mṛtimāptavān |
tatpatnī mandire dāsī bhūtvā sevāṃ tato’karot || 33 ||
gāśca vṛṣāśca sā tatra mandire pradadau satī |
kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāścāpi mandire pradadau tathā ||34||
aśaktā sā kṛṣiṃ kartuṃ bhūtvā bhṛtyā tu mandire |
avasaddevaśaraṇe tvadādhārā nirāśrayā || 35||
govṛṣāṇāṃ tṛṇādyaiḥ sā sevanaṃ dohanādikam |
karotyeva tathā vāryāharaṇaṃ mārjanādikam ||3 6||
gaṃgeśvarasya te sevāṃ karotyājñāsuvartinī |
dhānyaśākaphalādīni jāyante yāni bhūmiṣu || 37||
tānyāhṛtya ca prathamaṃ dadāti bhūsurāya te |
tvaṃ prapācya sumiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ viṣṇave sadā || 38||
datvā tasyai prasādaṃ ca tato jagrahithādanam |
puṣpahārādikaṃ bhṛtyā kṛtvārpayati viṣṇave || 39||
evaṃ sā sevate nityaṃ tvāṃ tathā viṣṇumīśvaram |
niśchadmā bhaktiyuktā ca sarvārpaṇā vṛṣānvitā ||3.181.40 ||
atha tvaṃ rasanālubdho miṣṭānnaṃ prakaroṣi yat |
nivedya viṣṇave śreṣṭhaṃ pracchannaṃ mandirāntare ||41 ||
bhuktvā tṛptiṃ samāsādya tato dadāsi yoṣite |
bhṛtyāyai tadapi rūkṣamannaṃ godhūmapolikāḥ ||42||
evaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānnityaṃ pakṣapātaṃ tu dātari |
dātre deyaṃ tu prathamaṃ tat tvayā na kṛtaṃ tadā || 43 ||
paṃktibhedaḥ kṛtastatra tatpāpaṃ te purābhavat |
ekadā vṛṣṭibāhulye sābhramatyā mahājalam ||44||
kṣetraṃ ca vaṭikāṃ cāpi mandiraṃ vyāpya cāgatam |
udvelaṃ tu mahāvegaṃ vyavardhata druta hi tat ||45|||
gāvaśca vṛṣabhā bhṛtyā mandirasyocchraye sthale |
jagatyāṃ susthale sarve’dhyarohan subhayārditāḥ ||46 ||
bhṛtyā sā karṣukī bhītā tvāṃ vavalge jalāgate |
āśliṣṭā tvāṃ jīvanārthaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇalālasā ||47||
tvaṃ tathā sā karṣukī vai ratnamālā ca ghenavaḥ |
vṛṣāśceti jīvanārthaṃ sasmarurmāṃ tu mūrtigām ||48||
vyacintayaṃ tadā cāhaṃ rakṣārthaṃ bhaktayoginām |
kintu śreṣṭhin cāntakāle samāgate’pi dehinaḥ ||49||
mano malinaṃ prabalaṃ durnirgrāhyaṃ savāsanam |
nāryā dehasya saṃsparśe vikṛtiṃ vindati drutam ||3.181.50 ||
tatte manastadā tatra vikṛtiṃ prajagāma ha |
vāripūre samāśleṣe kāmanādharṣito bhavān ||51 ||
mayā jñātvā parityakto bhṛtyāpi varjitā tadā |
rakṣārthamāgatenāpi rakṣā te tatra na kṛtā ||52||
dharmanāśaṃ vilokyāhaṃ rakṣāṃ na kṛtavān dvija |
pūravegena karṣukyā saha tvaṃ vāhito’bhavaḥ ||53||
gāvaśca vṛṣabhāścāpi pūre tatra pravāhitāḥ |
mṛtāḥ sarve puṇyayuktā manākpāpasamanvitāḥ ||54||
gaṃgeśvaro bhavān vipraḥ paṃktibhedakarastadā |
idānīṃ tvaṃ hareḥ sevāpuṇyavān dhanavānkila ||55||
kṣetradeyaṃ karṣukī ca bhṛtyā te gṛhiṇī kila |
dvitīyā tava patnīyaṃ brāhmaṇī yā tava mṛteḥ ||56||
anantaraṃ mṛtā śokāt seyaṃ śreṣṭhin virājate |
pañca putrā vṛṣāste vai ye mṛtāḥ pūravāriṣu ||57||
sapta putrya imāḥ śreṣṭhin gāvau mṛtāśca vāriṣu |
mama pūjāphalenaiṣā sampat smṛddhirhi vartate ||58||
rogo’yaṃ paṃktibhedena svārthamiṣṭānnabhojinaḥ |
tavādya vartate śreṣṭhin niśchadmeyaṃ tu modate ||59||
karṣukī kṣetravāṭyādidānapuṇyaṃ samaśnute |
brāhmaṇī dharmapuṇyaṃ tu pātivratyaṃ samaśnute ||3.181.60 ||
devadhanaṃ paśavaśca mānuṣyaṃ bhuñjate sukham |
pūjakastvaṃ dhanadhānyaratnastrīvaṃśasaṃyutaḥ ||6 1 ||
paṃktibhedasya pāpasya kṣayarogaṃ phalaṃ gataḥ |
ahaṃ te ca kuṭumbasya bhaktiyogena vai punaḥ ||62||
tīrthāgatasya mokṣārthaṃ samāyāto’smi mādhavaḥ |
vada virālaka tvaṃ me mokṣaṃ vā tu nīrugṇatām |||33||
kimicchasīti dāsye’tra viprarūpadharo hariḥ |
pāpaṃ pracchannabhojyasya kṣayaṃ neṣyāmi sarvathā ||64||
nirāmayo bhava śreṣṭhin mokṣago vā bhavātra vai |
śrutvaivaṃ sahasā hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya puruṣottamam ||65||
māṃ papraccha sa loke’trāyuṣyaṃ me vartate na vā |
so’hamāha na te cāyuvidyate’taḥ paraṃ manāk ||66||
kintu bhakto’si madvāse cāgato’syapi tairthikaḥ |
roganāśecchayā tasmāt kṛpayā te dadāmi tat ||67||
āyurvā mokṣaṇaṃ vāpi hyubhayaṃ cāpi vāñcchasi |
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhīn harāmi śaraṇārthinaḥ ||68||
ityuktaḥ śreṣṭhivaryo’sau viprarūpāya me tadā |
dattvāsanaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ jalaṃ phalāni ca ||69||
kastūrīṃ kuṃkumaṃ cāpi karpūraṃ kesarām̐stathā |
candanaṃ gandhasārām̐śca ratnahārām̐stathottamān ||3.181.70||
puṣpahārān kambalāni mukuṭaṃ kaṭake tathā |
kuṇḍale cormikāścāpi śṛṃkhalāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||71 ||
sugandhasārān chatraṃ ca cāmare svarṇapāduke |
upadā vividhāścāpi putrān putrīḥ striyāvubhe ||72||
sarvaṃ śreṣṭhī tadā lakṣmi cārpayāmāsa me dhanam |
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā tavāsmīti jagāda ha ||73||
trāhi pāhi dayāsindho yatheṣṭaṃ kuru te’smi vai |
ityevamuktavān virālakastadāhamacyutaḥ ||74|||
prāha taṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhin nīrogī bhava satvaram |
varṣamātraṃ bhūtale tvaṃ tiṣṭha tataśca mokṣaṇam ||75||
yāsyasyeva na sandehastīrthaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ vraja |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patirmama ||76||
mantramenaṃ japa nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajasva vallabham |
smara māṃ nityadā śreṣṭhin pañcatīrthī vidhehi ca ||77||
nityaṃ satāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ kuru |
devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathā kuru||78||
dānaṃ ca havanaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ me’rhaṇaṃ kuru |
asāre cātra saṃsāre sāraṃ sevā hareḥ sadā ||79||
satāṃ sevā paraṃ sāraṃ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam |
mama sevā mokṣadā vai vāsanākṣayiṇī satām ||3.181.80||
satāṃ sevābalenātra vāsanā layameti ha |
anantajanmapāpānāṃ nāśopāyaḥ sadarhaṇam ||81||
prārabdhānāṃ daridrāṇāṃ nāśakṛcca sadarhaṇam |
vighnānāṃ rogajālānāṃ nāśakṛcca sadarhaṇam ||82||
santaścintāmaṇitulyāḥ prayacchanti sucintitam |
santaḥ kalpaprataravo dadatyarthitamuttamam ||83||
santo vai kalpavallyaścāmṛtaṃ phalaṃ dadatyapi |
sādhavaḥ kāmagāvaste duhanti śāśvataṃ sukham ||84||
santaḥ siddhipradāścāpi sampadāṃ ca pradā hi te |
āśīrvādaiḥ svalpabhāgyaṃ bahubhāgyaṃ dadhatyapi ||85||
divyatāṃ mama yogena prāpayantyakṣaraṃ padam |
yāmyadūtān vārayanti santaste hṛdayaṃ mama ||86||
prajvālayanti pāpāni puṇyāni vardhayantyapi |
saubhāgyāni cārpayanti haranti cāpado hi te ||87||
teṣāṃ sevā sadā śreṣṭhin kuru prasādadāyinīm |
pañcayajñān sadā saumyān vidhehyapi ca bhāvataḥ ||88||
gosevāṃ dharmasevāṃ ca kuru svargapradāyinīm |
ātmajñāne kathāsevāṃ sadā prāpnuhi gaṅgaka ||89||
mamārādhanamevāpi sadā vidhehi bhāvavān |
ante te darśanaṃ datvā neṣye dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||3.181.90||
brahmahatyāsurāpānavyavāyāścauryamityapi |
bhrūṇahatyetipāpānāṃ yāmye niṣkṛtirityapi ||9 1 ||
sādhusevā kṛtā yena prāptā prasannatā tathā |
āśīrvaco yena labdhaṃ sarvārpaṇena satsu yat ||92||
teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tu pāpānāṃ dagdhatā jāyate drutam |
niṣkṛtiḥ sarvathā sādhoḥ sevātulyā na cāparā ||93||
yāmyaloko nāsya lakṣmi sevāmagnasya vai satām |
api kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ śvapacā ghātakā api ||94||
gaṇikā hārakāścāpi satsevābhiḥ samuddhṛtāḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi vṛkṣāśca vallikā drumāḥ ||95||
sādhuyogena kamale paraṃ śreyaḥ prabhejire |
kṛṣṇabhaktermahāmārgaḥ sādhuṣveva pravartate ||96||
sādhubhyaḥ sarvalokeṣu pravartate tataḥ param |
lokāstaranti saṃsāraṃ pāraṃ prayānti tasya ca ||97||
mama lokaṃ prayāntyeva satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ |
bhuktvā svargānyanantāni tathaiśvarapadānyapi ||98||
modante cāpi vaikuṇṭhe goloke’kṣaradhāmani |
evaṃ mayopadiṣṭaḥ sa virālako’hi bhaktarāṭ ||99||
madājñayā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ santoṣavān dhanī |
bheje māṃ sarvathā tatra varṣānte mṛtyumāptavān ||3.181.1 0 0||
sādhusevāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
evaṃ lakṣmi vrajeddhāma śrotā vaktāsya bhāvavān || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne virālanāmakasya vaiśyasya prāgjanmakathā, kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre śrīhareḥ prāptiḥ, tasya rājayakṣmanāśaḥ, muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 181 ||

<3.182>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
ākarṇaya kathāṃ nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tathāparām |
āsīt karṇapure rājā pṛthvīdharābhidhaḥ purā || 1 ||
khaṇḍarājyaṃ pālayan sa prajāṃ rarakṣa dharmataḥ |
prātaryasyāṃgaṇe nityaṃ bhikṣukāstu śatādhikāḥ || 2 ||
tṛpyanti tvannalābhena hyanāthā bālabālikāḥ |
hyanāthā vidhavāścāpi bhuṃjate’syānnasatrake || 3 ||
viṣṇostu mandire gatvā rājā pṛthvīdharaḥ svayam |
nārāyaṇasya mūrtervai pūjanaṃ tulasīdalaiḥ || 4 ||
sahasraikamitairnityaṃ karoti viṣṇave namaḥ |
vadan dhyāyan smaran māṃ vai śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 5 ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā |
nīrājanaṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat| || 6 ||
śatarūpyakadānaṃ cāmbarāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā |
ekāṃ gāṃ ca dadātyeva dāne nityaṃ tataḥ param || 7 ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ śrīharaye datvā yāti nijālayam |
evaṃ māṃ bhajate nityaṃ manniveditabhojanaḥ || 8 ||
vartate sma sadā bhakto hiṃsāvyavāyavarjitaḥ |
yasya puṇyaṃ purājanmakṛtaṃ tasya tu bhaktatā || 9 ||
dharme matiśca bhavati satyapi rājyavaibhave |
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā pṛthvīdharaḥ kṛtvā śubhāhnikam || 3.182.1 0||
yāti nyāyālayaṃ tatra dadātyeva ca nirṇayam |
atha sāyaṃ nityameva kathāṃ śṛṇoti māmakīm || 11 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ satāṃ sabhāgataḥ |
santo’sya sādhavo dhīrāḥ chindanti saṃśayān bahūn || 12||
satāṃ pādajalānāṃ ca pānaṃ gṛhṇāti bhūpatiḥ |
kathānte kīrtanaṃ vādyasahitaṃ prakaroti saḥ ||13||
sahasraśo janā nāryo narāḥ kurvanti kīrtanam |
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare || 14||
hare viṣṇo hare jiṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇa hare hare |
evaṃvidhaṃ bhajanaṃ te satālādyaṃ pracakrire || 15||
atha santaḥ prayāntyeva maṭheṣu ca nṛpastataḥ |
sāyaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā sadbhojanaṃ tataḥ || 16||
dhyānamagno bhavatyeva mālāmāvartayanmama |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyevaṃ japanmuhuḥ || 17||
svapityeveti rājāpi sādhucaryāṃ prasevate |
asya rājñī madhuvindānāmnī bhaktā tu vaiṣṇavī || 18||
pātivratyānvitā yadvat sādhvī viprā satī yathā |
bhajate māṃ parātmānaṃ matvā saṃsāramulbaṇam ||1 9||
bandhanaṃ duḥkhadoṣāḍhyaṃ vāsanāvāsitaṃ kṣayam |
nityaṃ tu paramātmānaṃ muktiṃ cātmānameva sā ||3.182.20||
manute mokṣadātṝm̐śca sato janān prasevate |
śāntaśīlā nṛpavatsā bhajate māṃ janārdanam ||21 ||
yathā rājā tathā lakṣmi prajā guṇavatī bhavet |
asya putrādayaścāpi bhejire māṃ śriyaḥ patim ||22||
prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarvavarṇā bhajante sma ca māṃ tathā |
dānaṃ kurvanti ca japaṃ kurvanti sma prasevanam ||23||
satāṃ ca sādhuvāsādau mārjanādi dadhatyapi |
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ nirantaram ||24||
prasanno bhagavānnāste parjanyaścāpi varṣati |
sampadaḥ sampramodante yathā lakṣmyaḥ sacetanāḥ ||25||
dhenavaḥ kāmavarṣiṇyo vṛkṣāśca phaladāyinaḥ |
sasyāni kaṇadānyeva rasadā ca rasābhavat ||26|5
mama bhaktasya tasya śri ripavo nābhavam̐stathā |
ītayo nābhavam̐ścāpi sukhāḍhyaḥ so’bhavannṛpaḥ || 27||
tasya putro’bhavat kāle janmāndhaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ |
janmotsavāḥ kṛtāstena yathākālaṃ sutaḥ sa tu ||28||
netre noddhāṭayatyeva janmāndho vidito’bhavat |
rājñā viṣṇoranuṣṭhānaṃ kṛtaṃ vai vaiṣṇave makhe ||29|||
cakṣuṣoruddhāṭanārthaṃ sūryacandraprapūjanam |
ghṛtasya dīpadānaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ devamandire ||3.182.30||
kṛtaṃ ca vatsaraṃ tasya gataṃ cāndhye tato nṛpaḥ |
āśāṃ vihāya sahasā tapasyeva mano’karot ||3 1 ||
rājasaudhaṃ vihāyaivodyāne vṛkṣaghaṭāntare |
chāyāyāṃ cāsanaṃ kṛtvā niṣasāda tapasyayam ||3 2||
mālāmāvartayatyeṣo raṭan kṛṣṇanarāyāṇam |
phalāhāro’bhavad rājā tvekabhukto hi nirjane ||33||
śālagrāmaṃ puro dhṛtvā bhajate māṃ smaratyapi |
valkalāmbara evāpi mṛgacarmāsanastathā ||34||
sarvabhogavihīnaśca putranetrasamīhanaḥ |
divārātrau bhajate māṃ tatrāśrame drumālaye |||35|||
varṣā śaityamātapaṃ ca sahate bhajate ca mām |
pūjāṃ karoti bhāvena śālagrāmasya me nṛpaḥ ||36 ||
karoti triṣavaṇaṃ ca sūryaṃ namaskaroti ca |
pañcakeśī pitṛpūjī samvatsaraṃ vyavartata ||37||
evaṃ varṣottare rājā rātrau dhyātvā tu māṃ muhuḥ |
astaut kṛṣṇa tava nāma hariḥ duḥkhaharaṃ hi tat ||38||
kathaṃ bhaktasya me duḥkhaṃ naiva harasi mādhava |
kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śakto’si sarvathā ||39||
puṇyaṃ yattattava kṛṣṇa prasannatā hyanugrahaḥ |
pāpaṃ yattattava kṛṣṇa prātikūlyaṃ hyudāsitā ||3.182.40||
yadi bhaktaṃ prati caivamaudāsīnyaṃ pradarśyase |
kā gatistarhi bhaktasya tyaktasya rakṣakena vai ||41||
rakṣāṃ kuru sutasyāpi cakṣurdānena mādhava |
pāpaṃ vidhūya tasyaiva sadṛṣṭiṃ taṃ vidhāpaya ||42||
ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre śrutvāhaṃ prārthanāṃ drutam |
tapo vilokya putrasya netrārthaṃ tvāgato’bhavam ||43||
jaṭilo daṇḍavān sādhurbhasmākto mṛgacarmavān |
kamaṇḍaluṃ kare dhṛtvādṛśye vai vṛkṣamaṇḍale ||44||
hare nārāyaṇa viṣṇo vadan satsannidhau yayau |
jayo’stu yoginaḥ kṣitipatestāpasaveṣiṇaḥ ||45||
ityahaṃ śabdamuccārya kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śubham |
dadau tasmai sa rājāpi vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||46||
ākasmikaḥ sādhuveṣaścātithiḥ kuta āgataḥ |
bhavedvā me manaḥpūrtikaro divyo’yamacyutaḥ || 47||
atithiḥ pūjanīyo vai sādhustatra viśeṣataḥ|
vicāryetthaṃ samutthāya rājā papāta pādayoḥ ||48||
āsanaṃ pradadau cārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ dadau tathā |
pūjanaṃ pracakārāpi puṣpagandhaphalādibhiḥ ||49||
namaskāraṃ vidhāyātha papracchāgamanaṃ prati |
dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ sādhujanasya darśanāt ||3.182.50||
tīrtharūpaṃ paraṃ vāri prāptaṃ yasya kamaṇḍaloḥ |
darśanaṃ pāvanaṃ labdhaṃ sarvendriyapavitrakṛt ||51||
sparśanaṃ pāpahāraṃ ca labdhaṃ sādhupadasya ha |
sevanaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca lapsye’dya bhāgyavaibhavāt |||52||
kṛpayā cāpi ca divyānugrahāt puṇyasañcayāt| |
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya tasthāvagre kṛtāñjaliḥ | ||53||
ahaṃ sādhusvarūpaścāvadaṃ śreyoyuto bhava |
kuśalaṃ te bhūpa kiṃvā brūhi tapasi kāraṇam |||54||
rājovāca hi sādhūnāṃ kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama |
putravān dhanavānasmi bhaktimānasmi sādhuṣu ||55||
tathāpyakuśalaṃ cāste putraḥ paśyati naiva me |
janmāndho vidyate sādho vad kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavet ||56||
tasya vai dṛṣṭimatvārthaṃ tapaḥ karomi mādhave |
ārādhanātmakaṃ nānyakāṃkṣā me vartate prabho ||57||
putro’cakṣurbhaved yasya rājyamandhaṃ tu tasya vai |
anandhasya gṛhe cāndhyaṃ vaṃśe cāndhyaṃ hi duḥkhadam | |58||
āndhyametat kathaṃ dūraṃ yāyājjānāsi darśaya |
kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmyevaṃ sādhoste’tra samāgamāt ||59||
sādhūnāṃ vacanaṃ divyaṃ satyārthaṃ siddhidaṃ sadā |
sādhūnāṃ hṛdayaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ khalu ||3.182.60|||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sevanaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā |
sarvāśāpūrakaḥ sādhoranugrāhaḥ samarjitaḥ ||61 ||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau lakṣmi cāhaṃ tadāvadam |
śṛṇu rājam̐stava putraḥ pūrvajanmani tāpasaḥ ||62||
yathāhaṃ tāpasaveṣastathā sa tāpaso’bhavat |
nāmnā durvoḍhako vipro daridro rājyavāñchayā ||63||
akarot sa tapo revātaṭe tīrthe tu śuklake |
bahavo yatra cāyānti yānti tīrthārthimānavāḥ ||64||
narā nāryastatra tīrthe snānti prayānti pārśvataḥ |
durvoḍhakaḥ prapaśyan vai tapaḥsthale pratiṣṭhati ||65||
balavaccendriyaṃ lakṣmi mānasaṃ balavattathā |
viṣaye purato yāte cāgate cañcalaṃ bhavet ||66||
tannirodhastāpasena kartavyaḥ sarvadā rame |
indriyāṇāṃ manasaścāniroghe niṣphalaṃ tapaḥ ||67||
pramāthi mānasaṃ kasmin kṣaṇe neṣyati duṣpatham |
niścayaścāpi viśvāso nāsti tanmanasaḥ sadā ||68||
ekadā tvaṃ svayaṃ rājā tīrthārthaṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ |
yathāpekṣitavastvāḍhyaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ ||69||
gato revāṃ prati śuklatīrthaṃ snātuṃ tu parvaṇi |
yatrāyaṃ tāpasaḥ sādhurviprastapati tatsthale ||3.182.70||
manāg dūre cāmravaṇe tvaṃ nivāsaṃ tadākaroḥ |
jñātvā tapasvinaṃ sādhuṃ jaṭilaṃ tvaṃ ca tatpuraḥ ||71 ||
sapatnīko namaskāramakaroḥ pūjanaṃ tathā |
phalādikaṃ cārpayaśca rājñī ca bhāvapūritā ||72||
sādhoścaraṇau prakṣālya jalaṃ papau tava priyā |
rūpayauvanasaundaryapuṣṭiśṛṃgāraśālinīm |||73 ||
vīkṣya tāṃ moha utpanno viprasyāsya tapasvinaḥ |
sakāmaṃ cāpi pracchannaṃ cakṣurdvayaṃ prayojitam ||74||
tena vipreṇa śiṣyāyāṃ rājñyāṃ tadā tu tīrthake |
puṇyāyāṃ sevikāyāṃ ca tathaiva rājamātari ||75||
sakāmastapasi dṛbdho rājyārthaṃ lālasānvitaḥ |
ajitendriyacittaśca dṛṣṭipāpaṃ tadā vyadhāt ||76||
bhavanti khalu jātyandhā janmāndhā rāgiṇastu te |
parastriyāṃ tu ye mugdhā duṣṭacakṣuḥ prayuñjate ||77||
evametasya viprasya tāpasasya tadā khalu |
rūpasaundaryamugdhasya mohapāpaṃ tadā hyabhūt ||78||
tasmānmohānudbhavārthaṃ rūpavatyaḥ striyaḥ sadā |
dharmarakṣārthamevāpi darśayanti mukhaṃ nahi ||79||
lajjāvastraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ mukhopari prakāśane |
sadā rakṣanti sannāryaḥ pātivratyādiguptaye ||3.182.80||
darśanaṃ mohakṛttasmāddarśanaṃ na dadatyapi |
asūryampaśyāstiṣṭhanti prāvaraṇena cāvṛtāḥ ||8 1 ||
atha rājan tāpasaḥ sa kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ |
tava putro hyayaṃ jāto yasyāṃ mugdhastadgarbhajaḥ ||82||
tapaḥphalaṃ rājyametallabdhaṃ tena mahātmanā |
duṣṭacakṣurdṛṣṭiphalaṃ janmākhyaṃ labdhameva ca ||83||
tapasā te prabhaktasya pūjādibhiḥ pratoṣitaḥ |
samāyāto’smi bhagavān śālagrāme tu yaḥ sthitaḥ ||84||
so’haṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo bhavāmi te hyabhīṣṭadaḥ |
brūhi rājan dadāmyatra yatte manasi rocate ||85||
bhaktārthaṃ tvāgato’smyatra yadicchasi dadāmi te |
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ pṛthvīdharābhidhastadā ||86||
yayāce sutadṛṣṭiṃ ca bhaktiṃ me pādayostathā |
ante dhāmākṣaraṃ cāpi vaṃśaṃ ca bhaktameva ha ||87||
śrutvāhaṃ pradadau tasmai tathāstvevaṃ bhaviṣyati |
jalaṃ kamaṇḍalordatvā tirobhāvaṃ tataḥ sthalāt ||88||
rājā prasannacittastu tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ vidhāya ca |
yayau savalkalo naijaṃ grāmasthaṃ bhavanaṃ prati ||89||
prajābhiḥ pūjitaścāpi lakṣito varapātrakaḥ |
prāptamanorathaścāpi jayaśabdaiḥ pravardhitaḥ ||3.182.90 ||
yayau svabhavanaṃ tāvad vādyāni cottamāni vai |
avādyanta samantāttu rājñī prasannatāṃ hyagāt ||9 1 ||
rājā sutaṃ prati gatvā mayā dattaṃ jalaṃ drutam |
putranetre dadau netraṃ jalasparśāt sadṛṣṭikam ||92||
dakṣaṃ hyabhūt tato vāmaṃ jalasparśāt sadṛṣṭikam |
jātaṃ mahotsavaścāsīttapaḥphalaṃ samarjitam ||93||
atha putro yuvā jāto jātismaro hi sarvadā |
duṣṭacakṣuḥphalaṃ naijaṃ smaratyeva sadā tataḥ || 94||
mahābhāgavataḥ so’pi jāto dharmasamanvitaḥ |
nāmnā citradhvajo rājā sādhubhaktaḥ pratāpavān ||95 ||
bhajate māṃ sadā lakṣmi rājyaṃ pitrā samarpitam |
sañcālayati nītyā vai prajāstoṣayatyeva saḥ ||9 6 ||
pitāsya nidhanaṃ yāto vimānena tadāpyaham |
svadhāmākṣaramevainaṃ prāpayāmāsa vaiṣṇavam || 97||
evaṃ mayā svabhaktasya tapasā hyedhitasya ca |
icchāpūrtiḥ kṛtā putracakṣurdānena viṣṇunā ||98||
bhaktānāṃ sarvathā lakṣmi cāndhyaṃ bāhyaṃ ca vāntaram |
nāśayāmi prasanno’haṃ bhaktivaśyo bhavan bhuvi ||99||
ātmaprakāśaṃ divyaṃ ca dadāmi jñānaśevadhim |
yena māyātamastīrtvā prayānti paramaṃ padam || 3.182.10 0||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇād bhajanānmama |
bhuktimuktirbhaveccāpi sampat saukhyaṃ pramokṣaṇam || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pṛthvīdharābhidhanṛpaterjanmāndhaputrasya prāgjanmavṛttāntaṃ bhagavatākṛtasadṛṣṭikatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 182 ||

<3.183>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śatrūṃjayānadītaṭe |
āsīd bhaktaḥ sāgarākhyaḥ śūdro’raṇyaprapālakaḥ || 1 ||
saputraparivāro’yaṃ saśastro’raṇyarakṣaṇam |
karoti pālikātāne pālikārājyayojitaḥ || 2 ||
ekadāraṇyabhāgeṣu pālikātānajo nṛpaḥ |
yayau vai mṛgayārthaṃ saḥ parimeyasubhṛtyayuk || 3 ||
araṇyaṃ tatpraviṣṭo’yaṃ rājā ca sāgaraṃ tu tam |
bhṛtyaṃ ninye saha tatra mṛgādimārgadarśakam || 4 ||
śūdro’pyayaṃ harerbhakto hiṃsāṃ naiva karoti saḥ |
ahiṃsako hi rājānaṃ hiṃsāpāpabhayāt khalu || 5 ||
udvāṭaṃ mṛgaśūnyaṃ vai pradeśaṃ prati nītavān |
atra mṛgāḥ samāyānti prayānti ca vasantyapi || 6 ||
ityuktvā nītavān kṣmeśaṃ vanapālābhidhaṃ nṛpam |
yatra jalaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ pradeśāścāpi sundarāḥ || 7 ||
kvacit kvacijjanavāsāstaṃ pradeśaṃ tu nītavān |
āsāyaṃ tu samāraṇye’ṭavīto’pyaṭavīṃ bhraman || 8 ||
atra mṛgastatra mṛgaścetyevaṃ sampradarśayan |
rājānaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa japan śrīpuruṣottamam || 9 ||
āntare prārthayan māṃ vai kṣamasva bhagavanmama |
aparādhaṃ nṛpeṇātra sārdhaṃ vai mṛgayodbhavam || 3.183.1 0||
nāhamicchāmi vanajān mṛgān hantuṃ svayaṃ kvacit |
anyadvārā tathā hiṃsā kārayituṃ kvacit prabho || 11 ||
ato mayā nṛpaścāyamudvāṭena praṇīyate |
yatra mṛgā na prāpyante hiṃsā me na yathā bhavet || 12||
hiṃsāpāpaṃ naiva syāttattathā rakṣa hi mādhava |
kaścidvanyaḥ paśustvatra mārge naiva milennṛpam || 13 ||
antaryāmiṃstathā sarvaṃ vidhehi klṛptanaṃ prabho |
evaṃ māṃ prārthayan bhaktaḥ śūdro’pi dharmavān śuciḥ ||14||
yātyagre taṃ nṛpaṃ karṣan mṛgavāso’tra tatra ca |
varṇanaṃ bahudhā kurvan rājan khaḍgo’tra vai bhavet || 15||
atra citramṛgaḥ syācca śṛṃgī sṛmaraścātra tu |
gavayaścātra śaśako geṇḍuko vā bhavediha || 16||
tarakṣurvā kṛṣṇamṛgo varāho vā bhavediha |
evamāśāṃ bandhayam̐śca yātyagre’gre samutsukaḥ ||17||
jalaṃ phalāni rājñeścārpayatyapi prasevate |
tathāpi sa tu rājā na tuṣṭimeti mṛgān vinā || 18||
evaṃ sāyaṃ samayo vai vanāntare vyajāyata |
mṛgālabdhau nṛpaścāpi nirāśo’pyabhavattadā ||1 9 ||
sarve te’staṃgate cārke viśaśramurvanāntare |
sarastaṭe vaṭādho vai bubhukṣitā nirāśayāḥ ||3.183.20||
athātra bhāgyayogena vanecarastadā paraḥ |
araṇyaṃ svaṃ bhramitvaiva svagṛhaṃ pratiyāti yaḥ ||21 ||
sa tatra vaṭavṛkṣādhaḥ śrutvā śabdām̐stu mānavān |
pārśvasṛtyā nirgato’pi vaṭāśrayaṃ samāyayau |||22||
apaśyattatra rājānaṃ parimeyajanānvitam |
nanāma bhāvataścaitān tasthau papraccha taṃ nṛpam ||23 ||
kathaṃ rājannatra rātrau viśrāmaścādya vidyate |
dāsavargasya kāryaṃ cettiṣṭhāmi sevanājñayā ||24||
dāso’haṃ vanamārgajño vanyajño vanavāsakṛt |
vane sarvaṃ vijānāmi nṛpājñāṃ vitarāmi ca ||25||
śrutvā rājā tu vṛttāntaṃ dinacaryāṃ ca niṣphalām |
mṛṣāmṛgayābhramaṇaṃ sarvaṃ jagāda vai tadā ||26||
atha śrutvā dakṣagarvo’paro vanecaro nṛpam |
rājannaitadvanaṃ tādṛṅ mṛgādhivāsitaṃ kvacit ||27||
kenāyaṃ darśitaḥ panthāḥ kevalakleśadāyakaḥ |
vane’tra na mṛgāḥ santi kāṣṭhahārā bhramanti yat ||28||
mṛgāṇāṃ tu vanaṃ cānyad dakṣiṇe saritastaṭe |
vartate tatra mṛgayāsāphalyaṃ jāyate sadā ||29||
kenacid bhrāmitastvaṃ vai rājannatra pravartase |
vṛthāprayāso bhavato vane’tra kaṣṭameva ha ||3.183.3 0||
evamuktastadā rājā jñātavān svapratāraṇam |
sāgareṇa hi śūdreṇa kṛtaṃ vṛthāṭanaṃ prati ||3 1 ||
aho viśvāsaghātā vai mānavā nṛpatiṃ kvacit |
vimārge samprakṛṣyaiva nayanti maraṇaṃ prati |||32|||
viśvāso naiva kartavyo vane gṛhe raṇe tathā |
ajñātānāṃ kvacid bhūpairviśvāse kaṣṭamāpnuyāt ||33||
sāgareṇa vayaṃ cātra pratāritā mṛgārthinaḥ |
amṛgāḍhye vane dūraṃ bhrāmitā niṣphalīkṛtāḥ ||34||
so’yaṃ daṇḍasya pātraṃ vai vidyate chadmavṛttavān |
tyaktavyo daṇḍadānena śikṣā deyā mayātra ha ||35|||
evaṃ vicārya nṛpatirdakṣagarvābhidhaṃ param |
vanecaraṃ tadā prāha tiṣṭha vā yāhi te gṛham ||36||
prātaścātra samāyāhi mṛgayārthaṃ vane saha |
dāsye’haṃ cepsitaṃ te vai pāritoṣikamuttamam ||37||
mṛgayāṇāṃ sulābhe vai nānyathā yāhi tiṣṭha vā |
dakṣagarvo namaskṛtyāvaśyakatāṃ pradarśya ca ||38||
yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ rātrau nāyāt prātaśca tatsthalam |
rājāpi krodhamāpannaḥ prātareva tu sāgaram ||39||
papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ tvatra vane māṃ nītavān vada |
mṛgayā yatra naivāsti vṛthāraṇye bhramo’bhavat ||3.183.40 ||
duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ tvetattasmāddaṇḍyo’si sarvathā |
māsikaṃ vetanaṃ tvaṃ vai prāpnosi mama kośataḥ ||41 ||
ahaṃ pratāritaścātra tvayā bhṛtyena vai yataḥ |
tato’haṃ prakaromyatra daṇḍaṃ te kapaṭārthinam ||42||
ityuktvā bhūpatiścānyān bhṛtyānāha drutaṃ vacaḥ |
pāṣāṇairasya duṣṭasya prakoṣṭhau pādayoriha ||43|||
cūrṇayantu nikṣipantu vaṭo’dho duṣṭamānavam |
ityuktāste pare bhṛtyā bhaṭā āsan praroṣiṇaḥ ||44||
te dhṛtvā prastarān kaṣṭām̐ścūrṇayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ |
pādayorghūṭike cobhe bhaṅktvā taṃ vaṭamūlake ||45||
prakṣipya prayayuḥ sarve sanṛpāste tataḥ sthalāt |
mṛgayārthaṃ cāparaṃ vai vanaṃ garvānvitāḥ khalāḥ ||46||
athāyaṃ sāgarastatra matvā daivāt samāgatam |
kaṣṭaṃ ruroda bahudhā smṛtvā māṃ puruṣottamam ||47||
kathaṃ he bhagavannatra bhaktarakṣāṃ karoṣi na |
pāpināṃ tu tathā nāśaṃ kṛṣṇa kathaṃ karoṣi na ||48||
hiṃsāyāṃ tu mahatpāpaṃ viditvā mṛgarakṣayā |
mayā rājā tūdvāraṃ vai pravartito dayālunā ||49||
tvadbhakto’haṃ dayāsindho dayāvān mṛgabālakān |
mṛgān hantuṃ kathaṃkāraṃ nayāmi hiṃsakaṃ nṛpam ||3.183.50 ||
ahiṃsāyāḥ phalaṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ prāptaṃ mayādya tat |
kaṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇa tvayā cāpi sahyate svāśritasya yat ||51 ||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tvetad bhaktarakṣāṃ karoṣi na |
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho ||52||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jiṣṇo’vanaṃ kuru |
vane vaṭe’tra gahane yadi nāyāsyasi drutam ||53 ||
kaścijjano’pi divase tadā me mṛtyuratra vai |
bhaveccaraṇakaṣṭena jalaṃ kaścinna dāsyati ||54||
prāṇāvane prayāsyanti gatirduṣṭā bhaviṣyati |
kuṭumbino me naivāpi vetsyanti mṛtyumatra me ||55||
harenātha harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa prabho hare |
hare śrīkambharāputra rādhāpate ramāpate ||56||
śīghramāyāhi kamalāpate lakṣmīpate prabho |
padmāvatīpate prajñāpate śrīmāṇikīpate ||57||
muktapate brahmapate sṛṣṭipate jagatpate |
bhaktapate dīnapate brahmapriyāpate hare ||58||
śīghramāyāhi bhagavan bhaktarakṣārthadehavān |
saurāṣṭrādhipate śrīmadgopālabālakaprabho ||59||
kathaṃkāramidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ pādasandhipracūrṇajam |
sahe vai bhagavannatra prāṇā mūrchā prayānti vai ||3.183.60||
ityuktā māṃ praṇamyaiva mūrchābhāvamupāgataḥ |
lakṣmi yāvat sāgaro me bhaktastāvadahaṃ drutam ||61 ||
tatpārśve prayayau śīghraṃ vanecarasvarūpavān |
patrāṇi sandhinīvallyā nītvā tadrasamuttamam ||62||
niṣkāsyāṅgulibhistatra dadau bhagnapradeśayoḥ |
tāvat praghūṭike cāpi prakoṣṭhau sandhitau drutam ||63||
asthinī ca yathāpūrvaṃ jātau svasthau nīrugṇakau |
saśaktau cāpi raktāḍhyau mayā spṛṣṭau punaḥ punaḥ ||64||
mūrchāyā vāraṇaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ bhaktasya vai mayā |
utthāpitaśca kaṣṭaṃ tad dūrīkṛtaṃ samastataḥ ||65||
bhojitaḥ suprasādaṃ ca jalaṃ tadā prapāyitaḥ |
snehitaḥ premadṛṣṭyā ca prāpitaśca gṛhaṃ nijam ||66 ||
vanecarasvarūpaṃ māṃ pupūja bahubhāvataḥ |
gṛhe ramyāsanaṃ datvā paricaryāṃ cakāra me ||67||
tasya patnī hīrukāpi putrāḥ putryaśca sevanam |
cakrurme bahudhā lakṣmi madhyāhne bhojanādibhiḥ ||68||
mayā bhuktaṃ jalaṃ pītaṃ sevā cāṃgīkṛtā tathā |
pādasammardanagātramardanādisvarūpiṇī ||69||
athāyaṃ sāgaro bhaktaḥ papraccha māṃ nijaṃ prati |
hare nātha kṛpāsindho kaṣṭametat kathaṃ mama ||3.183.70 ||
pādabhañjanarūpaṃ vai kena pāpena cāgatam |
na hiṃsitā mayā jīvā na māṃsamadirādikam ||71 ||
spṛśyate’pi harekṛṣṇa nāsatyaṃ kriyate kvacit| |
na cauryaṃ pāradāryaṃ vā kriyate vai kadācana ||72||
prāṇirakṣākṛte tvetat pratāraṇaṃ nṛpasya tu |
kṛtaṃ mayā prabho nātra pāpaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ bhavet ||73 ||
kathaṃ me pādahananaṃ kathaṃ kaṣṭaṃ janasya te |
vada nātha yathārthaṃ me karma vā tādṛśaṃ bhavet ||74||
atra janmani naivāhaṃ kṛtavānna smarāmyapi |
ajñātena kṛtaṃ cet syād vada me saṃśayāpaham ||75||
tadāhaṃ kamale tasmai nyavedayaṃ purākṛtam |
nātra janmani tasyābhūt karma krūraṃ hi tādṛśam ||76||
tato’haṃ kathayāmāsa śṛṇu sāgara prākkṛtam |
tvamāsīrvai hastipako rājño gajasya rakṣakaḥ ||77||
asya rājñaḥ piturdharmapālasya gajarakṣakaḥ |
nāmnā dharodarastvaṃ vai śūdraḥ kuṭumbavāniha ||78 ||
bhṛtyatāṃ vidadhan hastipālane tvekadā bhavān |
gajasya tu madaprākaṭye yuvānaṃ gajaṃ tadā ||79||
unmādinaṃ vaśaṃ kartuṃ prayatnaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt |
gokṣurādyairlohajaiśca nyastaiḥ pādataleṣu vai ||3.183.80||
tathā lohārgalaiścāpi lohaśṛṃkhalikādibhiḥ |
bhallaiścograiśca vaṃśaiśca dīrghaiśca lohajaiḥ phalaiḥ ||8 1 ||
pādau vibhidya kariṇaḥ kṛtvā śaktivihīnakam |
gatiśūnyaṃ gataṃ tatra bhavān rurodha sarvathā |||82 ||
adhikaṃ pādayostasya mūḍhamāramamārayat |
bhagnamasthi gajasyāpi pādasyaikasya vai tadā ||83 ||
athāpyutthātukāmaṃ taṃ hastinaṃ tu bhavān punaḥ |
lohadaṇḍaiścāgrapade mārayāmāsa nirdayaḥ ||84||
asthi dvitīyapādasya cūrṇatāṃ pārśvato’gamat |
evaṃ pādadvayāsthinī bhagne te krūratāvaśāt ||85 ||
hastinā tvaṃ tadā śapto rakṣako mārako bhavān |
mamaiva tu kareṇaiva bhagnapādo bhaviṣyasi ||86 ||
sa tvaṃ kālena nidhanaṃ gato’si sāgaro’dya vai |
hastī ca nidhanaṃ prāpro rājaputro’yamasti saḥ ||87||
vanapālābhidhaḥ so’yaṃ bhagnapādaḥ purā gajaḥ |
rājādya vartate tvaṃ cāraṇyapālo’dya vartase ||88 ||
tava pādau tena bhagnau purābhagnasya tatphalam |
mā śokaṃ kuru bhakto’si rakṣito’si mayādya vai ||89||
na kṛtaṃ tu purā karma kaṃcit tyajati dehinam |
tvayā prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ karma phalarūpeṇa bhaktaka ||3.183.90||
kintu bhaktyā mayā rakṣā kṛtā cāhiṃsayā tava |
rājño’parādhaḥ svalpo’pi nimitto’tra vyajāyata ||91 ||
araṇye pādabhaṃge te mā śokaṃ kartumarhasi |
bhaja māṃ paramātmānaṃ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||92||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāccaturbhujo’smi cāgataḥ |
yāhi tvadyaiva rājānaṃ sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ samāgatam ||93||
vada me sarvavṛttāntaṃ rakṣākaraṃ sukhapradam |
so’pi śrutvā nṛpo me saṃbhajanaṃ vai kariṣyati ||94||
tava yogena muktiṃ vai kariṣyāmi nṛpasya ha |
mā bhayaṃ kuru bhaktendra tvayā sākaṃ bhavāmyaham ||95||
ityuktvā bhagavām̐statra tirodadhe tu padmaje |
bhakto yayau niśāyāṃ tu nṛpagṛhaṃ smaran harim ||96||
rājñe sarvaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa śobhanam |
śrutvā rājā vismito’bhūd yayāce ca kṣamāṃ muhuḥ ||97||
bhaktarakṣākaraṃ māṃ ca tuṣṭāva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
viditvā prāgjanma naijaṃ gajātmakaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||98||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya matvā dehaṃ tu gatvaram |
bhakto bhūtvā prabheje māṃ kuṭumbasahito nṛpaḥ ||99||
pitā ca bāndhavāścāpi bhejire māṃ tataḥ sadā |
kṛtvā rājyaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā yathākṣaṇam || 3.183.100 ||
prāpuste māṃ parameśaṃ śrīdhāmākṣarasatpadam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya lakṣmi bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāgarākhyaśūdrasya bhagnapādasya bhagavatkṛtanīrujapādatvaṃ tatpūrvabhavavṛttāntaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||

<3.184>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vṛkṇadevasya pāvanīm |
bhaktasya me kathāṃ pūrve jātāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 ||
dhruvālaye tu nagare jātyā śūdro’tidharmavān |
vṛkṇadevābhidhāno’bhūd bhṛtyaḥ sandeśahārakaḥ || 2 ||
bhāvaśūrābhidhānasya nṛpaternāstikasya vai |
vṛkṇadevo mama bhakto bhāvaśūrastu nāstikaḥ || 3 ||
dvayornityaṃ mitrayostu vivādaḥ parijāyate |
vṛkṇadevaḥ sadā vakti bhaja rājan prabhuṃ harim || 4 ||
bhāvaśūraḥ prativakti bhaja bhāgyaṃ ca karma ca |
vṛkṇadevo vrate prāpte mahotsave nṛpaṃ muhuḥ || 5 ||
vakti dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca dharmakāryaṃ vidhehi vai |
rājā sarvaṃ manyate vai mṛṣā dānaṃ ca pūjanam || 6 ||
na svargaṃ nāpi puṇyaṃ vā nāsti dharmādikaṃ tathā |
svabhāvājjāyate sarvaṃ yathākṣetraṃ tathodbhavaḥ || 7 ||
yena kenāpi bījena rājñyā tu janitaḥ sutaḥ |
rājā prajāyate tadvad vaṃśānukāriṇī sthitiḥ || 8 ||
rājabījaṃ daridrāyāṃ jātaṃ dīnaḥ prajāyate |
svabhāvo vā nijaṃ karma bhāgyaṃ sarvatra tiṣṭhati || 9 ||
abhāgyasya kṛte naiva rājyaṃ samupatiṣṭhate |
rājyabhāgyasya dāridryaṃ naiva kvāpyupatiṣṭhati || 3.184.10 ||
sūryasya kiraṇaṃ vārau praviṣṭaṃ śītatā vrajet |
śītaṃ jalaṃ mahāvahneḥ prasaṃgāduṣṇatāṃ vrajet || 11 ||
pṛthvījanyaṃ samastaṃ vai pṛthvyāṃ pṛthvītvameti hi |
evaṃ khaniprabhāveṇa nisargeṇa mahān laghuḥ || 12|||
jāyate vai yathāklṛpta bhaktestatra na gauravam |
bhāgyasya gauravaṃ yadvā karmaṇaścāsti gauravam || 1 3||
karma nisargajanyaṃ vai svabhāvavat pravartate |
dvipado dvābhyāṃ yātyeva caturbhistu catuṣpadaḥ || 14||
śatapādaḥ śatenaiva tathā klṛptiḥ gatistathā |
gajo bhuṃkte dvyānanābhyāṃ vṛkṣaḥ sahasramūlakaiḥ || 15||
ṣaḍānanaiḥ kārtikastu brahmācaturmukhaistathā |
yathā klṛptistathā grāso vāḍavāgnestu sāgaraḥ || 1 6||
deśe kāle kṛtaṃ karma bhāgyarūpaṃ prajāyate |
tena rājyaṃ sukhaṃ svaṃrga pitṛvaṃśāgataṃ milet || 17||
bhaktestatra na hetutvaṃ vṛkṇadeva nibodha tat |
ityevaṃ nṛpatirnityaṃ vṛkṇadevaṃ nirasyati || 18||
athaivaṃ puṣkale kāle yāte nṛpatirekadā |
papraccha vṛkṇadevaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ vṛkṇo’si me vada || 1 9||
yadi bhaktiḥ kāraṇaṃ vai sukhe svaṣṭe tadā bhavān |
kathaṃ bhakteḥ pratāpena vṛkṇatvaṃ na jahāti vai ||3.184.20 ||
vṛkṇadevastataḥ prāha bhāvaśūraṃ nṛpaṃ prati |
vṛkṇatvaṃ karmaṇā jātaṃ bhaktyā mārṣṭuṃ hi śakyate ||21 ||
rājannārāyaṇo viṣṇurbhaktecchāpūrako’sti hi |
bhaktaścecchati sāmrājyaṃ dadātyeva hariḥ prabhuḥ ||22||
bhaktaścecchati cārogyaṃ dadātyeva narāyaṇaḥ |
yān yān kāmān kāmayate pūrayatyeva tān hariḥ ||23||
sakāmasya tu kāmānāṃ pūrakaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
akāmasya mahānandapradātā parameśvaraḥ |||24||
satyaṃ vai vartate sarvaṃ bhaktyā tuṣyati mādhavaḥ |
pratoṣito hariḥ sarvaṃ dadātyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||25||
bhāvaśūrastadā prāha sarvaṃ mṛṣā prabhāṣase |
na vṛkṇatvaṃ tiroyāti svāsthyaṃ nāṃke pratiṣṭhate ||26||
bhaktau me nāsti viśvāso yathā karmaṇi vartate |
tathāpi vṛkṇadevātra paṇaṃ kiñcitkaromi vai ||27||
ahaṃ rājāsmyavṛkṇastvaṃ bhṛtyo vṛkṇaḥ pravartase |
karmaṇā niyataṃ tvetannaitad viparivartate ||28||
yadi bhaktibalaṃ heturbhaved viparivartane |
avṛkṇavṛkṇabhāvasyāvayorvinimayo’stviha ||29||
tadā bhaktibalaṃ matvā kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ |
anyathā te vacaḥ satyaṃ naiva manye kathaṃcana ||3.184.30||
ityevaṃ nṛpatervākyaṃ śrutvā vṛkṇo’pi māṃ prabhum |
sasmāra parayā bhaktyā sannidhau nṛpatestadā || 31 ||
prakāśe sarvalokānāṃ vyājahāra nṛpo yathā |
tathā bhavatu sarvātmannevaṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ ||32||
vṛkṇadevasya bhaktyaiva snehena vaśatāṃ gataḥ |
ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā guptastiṣṭham̐statraiva vṛkṇatām ||33||
vṛkṇadevasya cākṛṣya nṛpahastadvaye’kṣipam |
rājā tūrṇaṃ tadā vṛkṇo’bhavat prakoṣṭhayostathā ||34||
kaphoṇikayoḥ kubjaścābhavaścākṛṣṭanāḍikaḥ |
śuṣkakāṣṭhāyitaṃ hastadvayaṃ tānāyitaṃ drutam ||35||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra bhūmipatervyajāyata |
vṛkṇadevasya hasto tu vṛkṇatāvarjitau drutam ||36||
abhavatāṃ yathākāryakarau nirbandhanāḍikau |
suraktāḍhyau puṣṭiyuktau yatheṣṭakāryakāriṇau ||37||
etādṛśaṃ mahāścaryaṃ vīkṣya siṣmiyire janāḥ |
rājā mene’tivādasya phalaṃ nāstikatodbhavam ||38||
bhaktiṃ mene tathā satyāṃ karmaṇāṃ parivartinīm |
bhakterbalaṃ paraṃ mene nāstikyaṃ pramumoca saḥ ||39||
evaṃ vai vṛkṇatārogo janmajo’sya mayā rame |
tadā bhaktergauravārthaṃ taddvayoḥ parivartitaḥ ||3.184.40 ||
atha rājābhavadbhaktastyaktvā garvaṃ tu karmaṇaḥ |
svabhāvasya tathā garvaṃ tatyāja vṛkṇatābalāt ||41 ||
atha rājñī śīladharmānāmnī śuśoca vai tadā|
putraputryaśca bhṛtyāśca prajāśca śuśucurhyati ||42|||
vṛkṇadevo’pi nṛpatiṃ vīkṣya vṛkṇaṃ śuśoca ha |
prārthayat paramātmānaṃ rājño rogasya nuttaye ||43||
rājāpi vṛkṇadevānme mantraṃ jagrāha vai tadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||44||
jajāpa mālikāmātramaṣṭottaraśataṃ tadā |
tāvadahaṃ bhaktarakṣākṛt prādurabhavaṃ kṣaṇāt ||446||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavaijayantīdharaḥ prabhuḥ |
śrīlakṣmīsahitastūrṇaṃ brahmatejo’ntare’mbare ||46||
rājā dadarśa māṃ divyaṃ vṛkṇadevo dadarśa mām |
prajāḥ sarvāstadā māṃ cālokayāmāsurīśvaram ||47||
jayakāraṃ jagaduśca nemustuṣṭuvuracyutam |
menire dhanyabhāgyaṃ ca darśanaṃ yatparātmanaḥ ||48||
ekabhaktasya yogena bahūnāṃ darśanaṃ hyabhūt| |
mayā divyaṃ tu madrūpaṃ tirobhāvya śubhaṃ vapuḥ ||49||
kṛtvā rājñaḥ sannidhau ca gatvā spṛṣṭo nṛpastadā |
nāstikyaṃ sahasā naṣṭaṃ rājā dharmaparo’bhavat ||3.184.50 ||
yathā bhaktastathā rājā dhārmikau tau babhūvatuḥ |
rājā prajādayaḥ sarve paraṃ modaṃ prapedire ||51||
ānandamutsavaṃ cakrurmama darśanalābhataḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ sarve pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||52||
atha bhṛtyo vṛkṇadevaḥ papraccha māṃ tataḥ prabhum |
kathaṃ me vṛkṇatā cāsīt kathaṃ gatā vadātra me ||53||
tadāhaṃ kamale sarvaṃ vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajanmajam |
śrāvayāmāsa bhaktebhyo vṛkṇatādāyakaṃ hyagham ||54||
pūrvamāsīd bhavān kīśabhikṣukaḥ kīśarakṣakaḥ |
vānarān khelayitvā ca vasatau ca prajājanāt ||55||
grāmīṇebhyo’nnavastrādyairlabdhairvṛttiṃ samācarat |
bhallukau dvau nakulāśca pañca sapta tu vānarāḥ ||56||
dvau sarpau vṛścikā aṣṭau vaśe te hyabhavaṃstadā |
teṣāṃ khelaviśeṣaistvaṃ kuṭumbavṛttimācaraḥ ||57||
kuṭumbinaste sarve’pi tattajjantupraśikṣakāḥ |
āsam̐ste’pi ca tān jantūn khelayitvāmbarānnakam |||58||
upārjayam̐stadā vṛttiṃ jīvikāṃ cābhyavartayan |
evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu grāmānte saṃsthiteṣu ca ||59||
rātrau supteṣu sarveṣu vṛko’raṇyāt samāgataḥ |
tasya gandhaṃ viditvaiva vānaraḥ prathama drutam ||3.184.60 ||
aplavata bhayāttasyāpatattava tu vakṣasi |
hastau kīśasya te bhāle netrayoḥ patitau tadā || 61 ||
nakhaiścarma lalāṭasya bhinnābhavattadā tava |
tvaṃ sahasā nidrito’pi bhayaṃ matvā paraṃ paśum ||62||
apaśyan taṃ nijaṃ kīśaṃ lohayaṣṭyā hyatāḍayaḥ |
bhagnau tvagrapadau tasya tāvattu bhalluko’pi ca ||63||
bhayaśabdaṃ sampracakre paśavo’nye’pi cukruśuḥ |
tvayotthātha bhayaṃ prāpya vīkṣito bhayakṛd vanī ||64||
vṛkaḥ krūro vānarādo nātidūre hyupasthitaḥ |
ākrośaṃ tvaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā tīkṣṇakuntena taṃ vṛkam ||65||
pradhāvya bhedayāmāsithaiva tvaṃ hṛdaye tadā |
papātāpi mamārāpi vṛkastvaṃ nirbhayo’bhavaḥ ||66||
bhallukādyāḥ prāṇinaste nirbhayāśca tadābhavan |
vānarasya sadā naijabandhanasthasya vai tadā ||67||
vinā vicāraṃ sahasā pādau bhagnau ruṣā tvayā |
vānaraścāti vai kaṣṭaṃ prāpa tatra tavāśritaḥ ||68||
śaraṇasthāśritaścāpi jīvikāsādhanaṃ tathā |
putravat pālitaścāpi lohadaṇḍena tāḍitaḥ ||69||
hastayorbhañjitastasya kaṣṭākrośanakāriṇaḥ |
vastrakhaṇḍauṣadhādyaiśca pādaprasevanaṃ kṛtam ||3.184.70||
māsānte cāgrapādau tau nīrujau samajāyatām |
kintu bhugnau vṛkṇarūpau vakrau sadā hyatiṣṭhatām ||71 ||
tatphalaṃ tu tvayā labdhaṃ cātra janmani vṛkṇatām |
idānīṃ yāvadevaitad duḥkhaṃ te tad vyajāyata ||72||
athāpi tvaṃ vānarasya bhallukasya ca khelane |
pūrvayugodbhavāṃ gāthāṃ jāmbavato hanūmataḥ ||73||
agāyathā yuddharūpāṃ droṇādryuddharaṇānvitām |
mama sambandharūpāṃ vai bhaktibhāvasamanvitām ||74||
tena kīrtanapuṇyena vṛkṇo’pi tvaṃ susampadā |
yukto bhavasi rājño’syāśraye’pi dhanavānasi ||75||
bhaktimān vartase cātra bhaktiṃ kārayasi dhruvām |
bhaktibalaṃ tu te jātaṃ yenāhaṃ te vaśe’smi vai ||76||
āgatastava rakṣārthaṃ vṛkṇatā vāritā tava |
śṛṇu cāyaṃ nṛpo yo’yaṃ vṛko mṛto vyajāyata ||77||
so’yaṃ sākaṃ tvayā cāste rājā nāstikabhāvavān |
dveṣavān dharmakāryādau vartate prāk svabhāvataḥ ||78||
vṛkasyaiva nimittena kīśasya karabhagnatā |
abhavat tatphalaṃ cārdhaṃ vṛkasyaiva bhavediti ||79||
rājño’sya vṛkṇatā prāptā tava pāpaṃ nṛpe gatam |
śṛṇu cāpi vṛkaścāyaṃ kathaṃ vai nṛpatāṃ gataḥ ||3.184.80||
tṛtīye prāgbhave cāyaṃ krodhī vipro’bhavattadā |
nāmnā prāṇadharaścāpi lokāḥ prāṇaharaṃ jaguḥ ||81 ||
udvejanaḥ kleśadaśca dharme karmaṇi cotsave |
vivāhe vācane dāne balād gṛhṇāti cādhikam ||82||
atṛptaścātivādena haṭhena kalināpi ca |
dhanaṃ cānnaṃ vastujātaṃ prasahyādatta eva saḥ ||83||
tapasvyapi tapastasya krodhena niṣphalaṃ yathā |
tathābhavat satṛṣṇasya krodhitasya vṛthā tapaḥ ||84||
tathāpi devapūjādyairleśena tapasāpi ca |
tathaiva pāpapuñjena mṛto yamālayaṃ yayau ||85||
citraguptaḥ śubhaṃ cāsyāśubhaṃ nyavedayattadā |
pūrvaṃ kiṃ te prabhoktavyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vada pāraye ||86||
ityevaṃ yamarājasya śrutvā vacotiroṣavān |
jagād prathamaṃ pāpaṃ bhoktavyaṃ tu mayā yama ||87||
tato yāmyāni duḥkhāni bhoktuṃ yamena yojitaḥ |
bhuktvā nirayaduḥkhāni śeṣeṇa vṛkatāṃ gataḥ ||88||
tatra tava kareṇāsya maraṇaṃ samajāyata |
puṇyaiḥ pūrvakṛtairasya rājyaṃ svalpaṃ hi vartate ||89||
svabhāvāḥ prāgjanmajātāstyajyante naiva kenacit |
pūrvasvabhāvadoṣeṇa kalahaścāsya rocate ||3.184.90||
tathāpi vṛkṇadeva tvaṃ nibodhayasi pratyaham |
bhaktyarthaṃ śubhavākyādyaistenāsya vardhate śubham ||91||
śanaiḥ phalaṃ drumādau vai śanairghṛtaṃ payasyapi |
śanaiḥ putraphalaṃ patnyāṃ śanaiḥ saṃskāraśodhanam ||92||
śanairjñānaṃ śanairvidyā śanairdravyārjanādikam |
śanaiḥ samāgamai raṃgo jāyate’bhyāsavartinām ||93||
evaṃ rājño’sya kālena puṇyaṃ cāpi pravartate |
pāpaṃ vṛkṇatvamātraṃ ca vartate’dya manāgapi ||94||
tathāpi bhaktayogena bhaktiyogena me tathā |
mama yogena sarvaṃ tatpāpaṃ vināśameṣyati ||95||
śvaprātaścāsya nṛpatervṛkṇabhāvo gamiṣyati |
krauryaṃ nāstikatā cāpi sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||96||
aikāntiko mama bhakto bhaviṣyati yathā bhavān |
ubhayoścāpi me dhāmavāso’nte vai bhaviṣyati ||97||
vānarādyā ime putrā vṛkṇa te krūrabhāvanāḥ |
idānīṃ mānavā jātāste’pi yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ||98||
ityevaṃ varadānaṃ vai datvāhaṃ ca tiro’bhavam |
śvojāte prātarevāsya rājñastu vṛkṇatā gatā || 99||
bhajanaṃ me cakārāti hare kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
kālena me dhāma divyaṃ bhāvaśūro nṛpo yayau || 3.184.10 0||
vṛkṇadevādayaścāpi muktiṃ kālena te yayuḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi prabhaktasya rakṣāṃ karomi nityadā || 101 ||
bhaktayogena jīvānāṃ kalyāṇaṃ jāyate dhruvam |
bhaktayogena bhaktiḥ syānmama yogastathā bhavet| || 1 02||
pāpanāśo bhaveccāpi satsaṃgaḥ śevadhirnṛṇām |
svalpaḥ kṛto’pi phalati śroturvaktuśca mokṣadaḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vṛkṇadevākhyabhaktasya bhaktyā vṛkṇatānāśo bhaktayogena bhāvaśūranṛpatermokṣaṇaṃ prāgjanmavṛttāntādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 184 ||

<3.185>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām |
nāmnā mañjulakeśasya halavādgrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 ||
halavānagare lakṣmi vipro mañjulakeśavān |
vartate syātibhakto me dharme’tyantakṛtaśramaḥ || 2 ||
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī trisandhyāvandanārhaṇaḥ |
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca satīmarkaṃ prage’rcayan || 3 ||
stotrapāṭhaṃ prakurvaṃśca nityamarthayate harim |
harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo tvadbhaktiḥ sarvadāstu me || 4 ||
māhātmyaṃ ca tava śreṣṭhamekāntikī tu dāsatā |
bhakteṣu te tathā kṛṣṇa tvayi doṣamatirna me || 5 ||
tvadekāntikabhaktānāṃ satāṃ saṃgo’stu me sadā |
darśanaṃ sarvadā cāstu mūrtīnāṃ te satāmapi || 6 ||
dharme matirdṛḍhā me’stu vyavasāyo mamāstu me |
madyamāṃsādikasparśo’pi me māstu kadācana || 7 ||
abhakṣyāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ me palāṇḍorlaśunasya ca |
māstu māstu tathā caurye mano me cañcalaṃ kvacit || 8 ||
nindane tava bhaktānāṃ pravṛttirme ca māstvapi |
devānāṃ nindane cāpi saṃkalpo’pi ca māstu me || 9 ||
āsurāṇāṃ nāstikānāṃ saṃgo māstvapi me kvacit |
rāgo’pi viṣaye māstu snehastvayi sadāstu me || 3.185.1 0||
ātmaniveditā kṛṣṇa tvayi cāstu sadā mama |
pātivratyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tvayi sadāstu me ||1 1 ||
evaṃ kuṭumbasahito nityamarthayate hi mat |
agālitaṃ jalaṃ naiva pibatyapyaniveditam || 12||
annaṃ phalādikaṃ naiva bhunaktyapyaniveditam |
vastrāmbaravibhūṣādi na yuṃkte’pyaniveditam || 1 3||
yānaṃ vāhanamevāpi na yuṃkte cāniveditam |
śṛṃgāraṃ copakaraṇaṃ yattad bhogyaṃ nivedya vai || 14||
upayuṃkte nijārthe vai mahābhāgavato yathā |
karoti pūjanaṃ nityaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya saḥ || 15||
bhikṣārthaṃ ca tato yāti nagare prāpya bhikṣitam |
gṛhamāgatya tat pacyaṃ pācayitvā nivedya me ||1 6||
bhuṃkte kuṭumbasahitastulasīpatrasaṃyutam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayatyapi || 17||
prajājanān cāgatāṃśca śrāvayatyeva cāśrame |
patnīyuto’yaṃ bhūdevo lakṣmi putrādisaṃyutaḥ || 18||
mahābhāgavato dharmaṃ dṛḍhaṃ sampālayatyatha |
kvacij jñātijanā jñātibhojane cāhvayantyapi || 19||
vipraṃ taṃ kintu vipro’sau bhuṃkte na jñātibhojanam
agālitairjalaiścāpyasaṃskṛtānnādi randhitam ||3.185.20||
matvā bhuṃkte na tatrāpi palāṇḍavādipradūṣitam |
laśunādivimiśraṃ vā bhuṃkte naiva kadācana ||21||
itihetorjñātijanā śoṣaṃ kurvanti taṃ prati |
sa ca mañjulakeśo vai sahate sarvameva ha ||22||
athaikadā svasambandhigṛhe yayau tu mañjulaḥ |
sambandhinastu taṃ prāhurbhavadarthaṃ tu śuddhimat ||23 ||
pācayitvā bhojanaṃ vai dāsyāmo bhuṅkṣva tṛptidam |
viśvāsayitvaiva tato randhitānne manāgapi ||24||
surāṃ daduste jñātvaiva ruṣānvitāḥ subhojane |
mañjulakeśo gandhena jñātvā pātrasthabhojane ||246 ||
surāsammiśraṇaṃ svalpaṃ śarkarākesarānvitam |
tatyāja bhojanaṃ tadvai jalaṃ tatyāja tadgṛhe ||26||
viśvāsaghātaruṣṭaśca śaśāpa mañjulastadā |
yo’yaṃ surāṃ dadau mahyaṃ viśvāsya bhojanena vai ||27||
so’yaṃ vicitto bhavatu pramattonmatta eva ca |
evamukte tu sahasā janānāṃ sannidhau tadā ||28||
mañjulaputraśvaśuro vicittonmattatāṃ gataḥ |
bhrāntacitto’bhavattūrṇaṃ maryādāṃ parihāya ca ||29|||
vāṇīṃ duṣṭāṃ tathā ceṣṭāṃ duṣṭāṃ nirambarāṃ vyadhāt |
nāmnā pāśupateśākhyaḥ śvaśuraḥ śāpadaṇḍitaḥ ||3.185.30||
vimanā bhraṣṭabhānaścopadravaṃ bahudhākarot |
janānāṃ sannidhau tiṣṭhan vivastraśca pramehati ||3 1||
rauti nṛtyati tālaiśca kūrdatyapi ca dhāvati |
ākrośati prahasati cāsambaddhaṃ pragāyati |||32|||
pātravastrāṇi samprāpya vibhidya sphoṭayatyapi |
avācyavācaṃ vadati ceṣṭāṃ karoti pāśavīm ||33||
evaṃ vai śāpadoṣeṇa vaicittyaṃ sahasā gataḥ |
upadravān bahuśastu karotyatarkitānapi || 34||
kuṭumbaṃ bahudhā tasyodvignaṃ jātamupadravāt |
prārthayāmāsa vipraṃ taṃ śāpanivṛttaye tadā ||35||
āha mañjulakeśo’pi tyajantvabhakṣyabhakṣaṇam |
kurvantu śuddhimevāpi prāyaścittaṃ vrataṃ mahat ||36||
brahmakūrcākhyamevātaḥ śuddhyuttaraṃ makhaṃ śubham |
vaiṣṇavaṃ samprakurvantu godānāni dadatvapi ||37||
mantrām̐śca vaiṣṇavām̐statra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha |
gṛhṇantu bhaktikāryārthaṃ tataḥ svāsthyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||38||
evaṃ tu kathitāḥ pāśupateśasya kuṭumbinaḥ |
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ tatyajuścakrurbrahmakūrcakam ||39||
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca makhaṃ cakrurdadurdānāni sadgavām |
omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||3.185.40||
itimantraṃ tathā cānyān mantrām̐śca jagṛhustadā |
vaiṣṇavāste ca sañjātā harekṛṣṇa japanti ca ||41 ||
sarvametat kṛtaṃ cāpi vaicittyaṃ na nivartate |
tadā mañjulakeśo’pi nirāhāro’tibhaktimān ||42||
saptāhaṃ cāsane tiṣṭhan bālakṛṣṇajapān vyadhāt |
prārthayāmāsa cātyarthaṃ sambandhinaḥ sametya ca ||43||
athāhaṃ bhaktarakṣārthaṃ bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai |
yayāvadṛśyarūpaśca śuśrāva kīrtanādikam ||44||
saptāhe tu vyapagate’ṣṭame dine prage’rcane |
ārārtrikottāraṇe’haṃ śālagrāme svarūpavān ||45||
divyarūpaṃ mama tebhyo’darśayaṃ śrīprasevitam |
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svarṇahārālirājitam ||46 ||
divyaveṣaṃ bhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ kirīṭavaraśobhitam |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ cāśīḥpradaṃ śubham ||47||
prasannavadanaṃ kāntaṃ rakṣārthaṃ samupāgatam |
etādṛśaṃ tu te māṃ saṃvīkṣya mohamupāyayuḥ ||48||
lagnāsteṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe cittavṛttayaḥ |
indriyāṇi samastāni līnāni mayi bhāsure ||49||
yathā samādhimāptāste tathā lagnāstadābhavan |
mūrterme paramānandaṃ prāpuste’labhyamuttamam ||3.185.50||
sukhitā me sukhenaiva brahmānandayujo’bhavan |
madanyasmṛtiśūnyāśca svarūpamātravedinaḥ ||51 ||
abhavam̐ste yathā muktā dhāmasthāḥ sthiracetanāḥ |
evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ datvā kṛtvā tejolayaṃ tataḥ ||52|||
sādhurūpo’bhavaṃ tūrṇaṃ kāṣāyāmbaradhṛṅamuniḥ |
mālāṃ kare dadhan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjapan ||53|||
śrāvayan bhagavannāma cetayan bahirānayan |
te sarve matsvaraṃ śrutvottasthuḥ samādhibhāvataḥ ||54||
agre vilokayāmāsuḥ sādhurūpaṃ hariṃ tu mām |
praṇemuḥ premayuktāste vihvalā divyamānasāḥ||55||
śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti japanto māmupāyayuḥ |
cakrire daṇḍavat sarve nipetuḥ pādayośca me |||96||
mukhaṃ samādhau yad dṛṣṭaṃ tad dṛṣṭvā sādhuveṣiṇaḥ |
aujjvalyaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā prasannatāṃ ca tām ||57||
yuvatvaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā niścikyuḥ prabhurāgataḥ |
sādhurūpo rakṣaṇārthaṃ bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai ||58|||
arghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca śreṣṭhāsanaṃ jalaṃ daduḥ |
phalaṃ ca bhojanaṃ yogyaṃ hṛdayāni ca te daduḥ ||59||
sarvasvamarpaṇaṃ cakrurnipetuḥ pādayormuhuḥ |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakrurbhujābhyāṃ māṃ samāśliṣan ||3.185.60||
prakṣālya payasā pādau dugdhaṃ papuśca te tadā |
dhanyāḥ sma bhaktayogena bhagavantamupāgatāḥ ||61 ||
dhanyo mañjulakeśo’yaṃ bhaktaḥ putrīpateḥ pitā |
dhanyo’smākaṃ ca jāmātā yatpitā haritatparaḥ ||62||
dhanyā putrī satī sādhvī kṛṣṇalīlābhidhānikā |
yasyāḥ śvaśuro bhagavatprasannatāṃ samārjayat ||63 ||
aho bhaktaprasaṃgena śatānāṃ tu kuṭumbinām |
sambandhināṃ śatānāṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ jāyate dhruvam ||64||
yatra bhakto bhāgavato grāme’pi vasati prabhuḥ |
grāmīṇāste bhaktayogānmuktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ ||65||
yatra bhakto bhaved grāme tatra pāpāni dehinām |
naiva tiṣṭhanti kamale naśyanti bhaktakīrtanaiḥ ||66||
yatra bhaktasya sañcāro mārge vāṭyāṃ gṛhāntike |
tatra vighnāni naśyanti māṃgalyaṃ tu pade pade ||67||
yadgrāme bhaktavasatistasya sīmno’ntare sthale |
