yāmyadūtā bhayaṃ prāptāḥ praviśanti na vai kvacit ||68||
yatra bhaktanivāso vai bhūtale vā jale’mbare |
tattīrthaṃ sarvathā pāpidehināṃ tārakaṃ śubham ||69 ||
yatra bhaktastatra devāḥ samāyānti samarhitāḥ |
muktā nārāyaṇo lakṣmyaḥ samāyānti vasanti ca ||3.185.70 ||
siddhayaścāpi yogāścaiśvaryāṇi vividhānyapi |
vasanti bhaktasārthāste smṛddhayaḥ kalpapādapāḥ ||71 ||
vasavaḥ pārṣadāścāpi bhaktagṛhe vasanti ca |
jaṃgamaṃ cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ bhakto bhavati sarvathā ||72||
jayastatra śriyastatra rasāstatra maharddhayaḥ |
dharmastatra mahāmokṣo yatra bhakto virājate ||73|||
bhaktāparādhakartāro bhaktasya kṛpayā hi te |
pāpā api supuṇyāḥ syurbhaktā dayālavo yataḥ ||74||
asmākaṃ pāpabhāgyaṃ vai puṇyātmakaṃ vyavartata |
adya bhaktaprasaṃgena dhanyo bhaktasamāgamaḥ ||75||
dveṣiṇāmapi muktirvai śrīkṛṣṇena vidhīyate |
tathā no dveṣiṇāṃ muktirmañjukeśena kāryate ||76||
adya yajño’pi saphalo dānāni saphalāni ca |
brahmakūrcavrataṃ cāpi saphalaṃ saphalaṃ januḥ ||77||
saphalāḥ smṛddhayo’smākaṃ cakṣūṃṣi saphalānyapi |
yeṣāṃ gehe hariḥ sākṣāt sādhurūpo virājase ||78||
pāpaṃ kṣamasva bhagavan madyapānādijaṃ tu naḥ |
bhaktāparādhaṃ bhagavan kṣamasva puruṣottama ||79||
śāpo mañjulakeśena dattaḥ pāśupateśake |
vṛddhe conmattatārūpo nivartyatāṃ ramāpate ||3.185.80 ||
yathā svāsthyaṃ bhavedasya vilīyeta vicittatā |
tathā sādho harekṛṣṇa śīghraṃ kṛpāṃ vidhehi naḥ ||81 ||
evaṃ te cārthayāmāsurmañjukeśo’pi māṃ tadā |
pāśupateśavaicittyanāśārthamārthayanmuhuḥ |||82||
śrutvā bhaktasya vāñcchārthaṃ datvā kamaṇḍalorjalam |
pāyayitvā drutaṃ pāśupateśaṃ viprameva ca ||83||
vaicittyaṃ nāśayāmāsa tadāhaṃ kamale drutam |
atha svastho’bhavat so’pi sahasā bhānavān śuciḥ ||84||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre me tato daṇḍavannamaḥ |
gadgadākṣaravāṇyā ca kṣamasveti jagāda ha ||85||
mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāpārāvāra kṛṣṇeti cāha mām |
mayā dhairyaṃ pradattaḥ sa pupūja paramādarāt ||86||
sāghuyogyaṃ samastaṃ vai dadau hṛdyaṃ tu bhāvanam |
evaṃ vicittatāṃ tasya bhaktayogādapāharam ||87||
bhaktiṃ pradattavām̐ścāpi mantraṃ ca dattavām̐stadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||88||
agṛhṇam̐ste mantramimaṃ jepuśca paramādarāt |
grāmīṇāśca camatkāraṃ sādhuṃ śrutvā samāyayuḥ ||89||
sahasraśo janā lakṣmi viprādyā vīkṣya māṃ tathā |
camatkāraṃ śubhaṃ sākṣād vīkṣya mā śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||3.185.90||
sarve mantreṇa ca mayā saṃskṛtāste tu vaiṣṇavāḥ |
bhūtvā māṃ bhejire lakṣmi mayāśīrvādayojitāḥ ||91 ||
athāhaṃ sampradāyaiva majjukeśāya sadvaram |
yathecchasi tathā sarvaṃ vacanātte bhaviṣyati || 92||
ayaṃ pāśupateśo’pi kuṭumbasahitaḥ khalu |
bhaktyā me cāntakāle vai muktimeṣyati cottamām ||93||
atra grāme tu ye bhaktā bhajiṣyanti pareśvaram |
te te siddhīḥ susaṃsiddhāḥ prāpsyanti pāramārthikīm ||94||
atra yāmyā na yāsyanti vighnā yāsyanti dūrataḥ |
bhaktiścātra pratāpātte bhakta lokeṣu vatsyati ||95||
ityuktvāhaṃ sādhurūpaṃ saṃjahāra tiro’bhavam |
bhaktāste bhaktimāpannā bhajitvā māṃ tato’ntime ||96||
samaye ca vimānena pārṣadaiḥ saha pārṣadāḥ |
bhūtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ me te yayurlakṣmi suvarculāḥ ||97||
mañjukeśo’pi bhakto me yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
tadyogena manuṣyāśca pare’pi padavīṃ parām ||98||
nārāyaṇasya śaraṇaṃ vaikuṇṭhādau yayustathā |
evaṃ bhaktasya kamale duḥkhahā sarvadāsmyaham ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva śrīharerme pratāpataḥ || 3.185.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mañjulakeśākhyabhaktavipraśāpenonmattatā prāptasya pāśupateśaviprasya bhagavatā śāpamokṣaṇaṃ paramamokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 185 | |

<3.186>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm |
vairāḍhyagrāmavāsasya nāmnā bāṇāṃgaṇasya tu || 1 ||
bāṇāṃgaṇo’bhavacchūdro hyasacchūdro dhvajīśvaraḥ |
madyaṃ karoti vṛkṣāṇāṃ rasānāṃ bahudhā sa hi || 2 ||
vaṃśaparamparāprāptaṃ kurute karma nityadā |
vikrayaṃ ca krayaṃ kṛtvā kuṭumbaṃ nirvahatyapi || 3 ||
athaikadā yayau sārthasaṃghātaṃ prāpya raivatam |
tīrthaṃ kartuṃ tathā kartuṃ vikrayaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam || 4 ||
sahasraśo janā yānti kārtike revatācalam |
saurāṣṭre vāmane tīrthe nārāyaṇahrade tathā || 5 ||
revatīkuṇḍake cāpi bhaveśvare mṛgīsthale |
dāmodare nārasiṃhe svayaṃbhūparameṣṭhini || 6 ||
rādhālaye svarṇarekhānadyāṃ śrīhanumatsthale |
gaṃgāyāṃ cāpi cāmbāyāṃ dattapāde vane vane || 7 ||
sītāvane rāmavane pūrvajāmbūvane tathā |
boriyādroṇikāsthalyāṃ kāṣṭhahārivane tathā || 8 ||
devasarovare cāmravaṇe bhaveśvare punaḥ |
kumudācalamāvṛtya pradakṣiṇaṃ dadhatyapi || 9 ||
bāṇāṃgaṇo’pi madyāni vikretuṃ śakaṭānvitaḥ |
ayutāyutasaṃkhyākairmānavaiḥ saha yāti ha || 3.186.10 ||
tāmasā ye rudrabhaktāḥ śāktā vā bhairavāśritāḥ |
madyaṃ pibanti bahudhā tīrthaṃ kurvanti kārtike || 11 ||
sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi gṛhasthā yatino’pi ca |
vaiṣṇavā api tīrthārthaṃ yānti pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā || 1 2||
ṛṣayaḥ sādhavaḥ satyaḥ kathāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ |
lakṣmyā nārāyaṇasyāpi satyāśca śaṃkarasya ca || 1 3||
sarasvatyā vedhasaśca gāyatryā raivatasya ca |
revatyā vāmanasyāpi satīnāṃ ca satāmapi || 14||
dvijāśca paṇḍitāścāpi kurvanti ca sthale sthale |
paṇḍitāścāpi vidvāṃso vṛddhāśca yoginastathā || 15||
yoginyo mātaraścāpi gāyanti kīrtanāni ca |
bāṇāṃgaṇo divyadṛṣṭyā bhaktyā pānaṃ dadāti ca || 1 6||
ye tvāyānti nijānasaḥ samīpe bhikṣukā janāḥ |
tebhyo dadāti pānāni puṇyadṛṣṭyā ca sevayā || 17||
atha rātrau tathā prātaḥ śṛṇoti kīrtanāni ca |
bhajanāni vividhāni divyāni mokṣadāni ca || 18||
kathāyāṃ tatra vaiṣṇavyāṃ śuśrāva viṣṇukīrtitām |
vāṇīṃ dharmātmikāṃ lakṣmi bhaktyanvitāṃ hitāvahām || 1 9||
tīrthaṃ sadā prakartavyaṃ saṃsāraṃ tartumicchukaiḥ |
tīrthaṃ dvedhā bhavatyeva pṛthvyāṃ dvayaṃ hi labhyate ||3.186.20||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti tīrthadvayaṃ bhuvi sthitam |
sthāvaraṃ jalatīrthādi parvatādi ca mandiram ||21 ||
arcā vanānyaraṇyāni vṛkṣāścaityāśca bhūmikāḥ |
janmasthānāni devānāṃ satāṃ janmādibhūmayaḥ ||22|||
tapaḥsthānāni viprāṇāṃ rajāṃsi gosthalāni ca |
tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi sthāvarāṇi bhavanti hi ||23||
teṣu gatvā snānapānāvagāhanavilokanaiḥ |
taranti mānavāḥ śuddhabhāvāḥ sthāvarasevinaḥ ||24||
sthāvarebhyaḥ prathamaṃ vai pāpāni prajvalanti hi |
tataḥ puṇyodayaścāpi tato bhaktirudeti ca ||25||
bhaktyā ca devatātuṣṭistuṣṭyā devādidarśanam |
sākṣād divyaṃ jāyate vai divyatā ca tato bhavet ||26||
divyabhāvanayā bhakto vairāgyaṃ labhate’bhitaḥ |
snehaṃ labhate cotkṛṣṭaṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ pravindati ||27||
parābhaktyā bhavenmokṣaḥ śanaiḥ kālāntare’pi ca |
tīvrasaṃvegino mokṣaḥ śīghraṃ sthāvarato’pi vai ||28||
bhavet kvacit kasyacittu sarveṣāṃ natu mokṣaṇam |
tasmāt sthāvaratīrthāni na śīghramokṣadāni hi ||29||
mandamadhyādivegānāṃ śraddhāmāndye tu mandatā |
mokṣe’pi jāyate lakṣmi cirapāvanalabdhitaḥ ||3.186.30||
tataḥ sthāvaratīrthebhyo jaṃgamānyuttamāni vai |
mātātra jaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||3 1 ||
patistīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca satītīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam |
ṛṣitīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca sādhvītīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||32||
sādhutīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca yogitīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam |
saṃghatīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca yātrātīrthaṃ ca jaṃgamam ||33 ||
bhaktatīrthaṃ jaṃgamaṃ ca tapasvitīrthamuttamam |
ātmanivedibhaktastu tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi jaṃgamam ||34||
hareraṃśā devatāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
satīlakṣmīsarasvatyastīrthāni jaṃgamāni hi ||35||
yoginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyastīrthāni jaṃgamāni ca |
kāmadughā dhenavaśca mānavā vrataśīlinaḥ ||36||
brahmacaryaparā māṃsamadyadoṣavivarjitāḥ |
dharmāḍhyāśca janā bhaktāstīrthāni jaṃgamāni vai ||37||
punanti darśanādete sparśātprasevanāttathā |
yeṣu madyaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ pāparūpaṃ na vidyate ||38||
ahiṃsāvratamāsthāya bhajante parameśvaram |
satyaṃ vrataṃ samāsthāya kurvanti kīrtanaṃ kathāḥ ||39||
asteyavratamāsthāya dānaṃ kurvanti vastunaḥ |
brahmacaryaṃ prapālyaiva sevante gurusattamān ||3.186.40 ||
dayāṃ vrataṃ samāsthāyānāthasevāṃ dadhatyapi |
ācāryasevanaṃ guroḥ sevanaṃ dharmasaṃyutam ||41||
sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ kurvanti dhārmikā janāḥ |
dehabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva sevante brahmabhāvanāḥ ||42||
ātmabhāvena sevante prabhubhāvena vai tathā |
mokṣabhāvena sevante muktabhāvena vai tathā ||43||
evaṃ prasevitaṃ lakṣmi jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamam |
āśu dhunoti pāpāni mokṣamāśu dadātyapi ||44||
dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā natāścāpi pūjitā bhojitāstathā |
pāyitā vāhitāścāpi sammarditāśca carcitāḥ ||45||
prasāditāścāmbaritāḥ śṛṃgāritāśca sādhavaḥ |
ramitāścānanditāśca hāsitāḥ kīrtitāstathā ||46||
ārpitā āditāścāpi saṃvāhitāśca śāyitāḥ |
bhūṣitā vanditāścāpi sevitā dhāritā hṛdi ||47||
sambandhitāḥ saṃsargitā āśliṣṭā nijavakṣasi |
nīrājitā hāritāśca sugandhitā dravādibhiḥ ||48||
snāpitāḥ snehitāścāpi punantyāśu hi sādhavaḥ |
vāsitā kṣamitāścāpi smṛtā ācāmitā hyapi ||49||
dhūpitā dīpitāścāpi kuṃkumitāśca candritāḥ |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtāścāpi daṇḍavatpraṇatāstathā ||3.186.50||
hṛdaye sve dhṛtāścāpi punantyāśu hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhutīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ||51||
agnitīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ vai sūryatīrthaṃ tathāvidham |
sādhutīrtha pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ paṃktipāvanam ||52||
sādhuprasādaḥ puṇyāḍhyaḥ sarvapāpavināśakṛt |
sāghusparśo mahādīkṣā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||53||
sādhudarśanamevāpīndriyapāpapraṇāśakam |
sādhūpadeśastīrthaṃ tu cātmakalmaṣanāśakam ||54||
sādhusaṃkalpa evāste hareḥ saṃkalpa uttamaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye cāhaṃ lakṣmi vasāmi sarvathā ||55||
sādhūnāṃ caraṇe sarvatīrthāni nivasanti vai |
sādhūnāṃ jaṃghayoḥ sarvapuṇyāni nivasanti ca ||56||
jānvostu vai satāṃ sarvayajñā vasanti puṇyadā |
sādhusakthnoḥ sarvadevā vasanti devikāstathā ||57||
sādhugupte cāsti śīlaṃ vratāni ca tapāṃsi ca |
sādhukaṭyāṃ siddhayaśca vasanti sarvasampadaḥ ||58||
sādhūdare sarvarṣayo vasanti jaṭhare’nalāḥ |
sādhornābhau nivasanti yogaiśvaryāṇi sarvathā ||59 ||
sādhorvakṣasi pitaro nivasanti sudhārmikāḥ |
pārśvayośca satāṃ sarvadānāni nivasanti vai ||3.186.60||
kukṣyoḥ satāṃ nivasanti sāgarāḥ sarva eva ca |
sādhornitambayoḥ sarvadhiṣṇyāni nivasanti ha ||6 1 ||
sādhoḥ pṛṣṭhe meruśailaḥ sarvāśrayo vasatyapi |
sādhostu skandhayoḥ sarvabalāni nivasantyapi ||62||
sādhoḥ kaṇṭhe brahmadhāma vasatyapi parātparam |
bāhvoḥ satāṃ mahendrādyā dikpālā nivasanti vai ||63||
sādhoḥ kaphoṇikayostu vyūhā vasanti nityaśaḥ |
sādhostu karayorlakṣmi śriyaḥ sarvā vasanti ca ||64||
sādhorhastatalayostu bhuktirmuktiśca vartataḥ |
sādhoraṅgulikāsaṅghe candrasūryādayo grahāḥ ||65||
sāghornāḍīsu sarvāsu nadyaḥ sarvā vasanti ca |
sādhoḥ romasu sarveṣu vasanti kalpapādapāḥ ||66||
sādhorgrīvāpṛṣṭhabhāge mahārudro virājate |
sādhārmale mahāmāyā sādhorvīrye hiraṇmayaḥ ||67||
puruṣo rājate lakṣmi māyāpāśavivarjitaḥ |
sādhostu karmaṇorlakṣmi cidākāśo virājate ||68||
sādhościbuke kamalā rājate smṛddhidāyinī |
sādhoroṣṭhe divyavibhūtayo vasanti sarvadā ||69||
sādhormukhe’hamasmyeva sarvakāryapravartakaḥ |
jihvāyāṃ tu satāṃ sarve vedā vasanti madgiraḥ ||3.186.70||
nāsikāyāṃ satāṃ bhūmā vairājaśca virājataḥ |
kapolayoḥ satāṃ vaikuṇṭhaśca goloka ityubhau ||71 ||
gaṇḍayośca satāṃ mahāpuruṣaśca sadāśivaḥ |
bhrukuṭau tu mahākālaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo virājate ||72||
netrayorbrahmavidyā ca sākṣātkāro’pi vartataḥ |
lalāṭe brahmatejaśca sarvadhāmāni santi ca ||73||
mastake tvakṣaraṃ brahma brahmarandhre paraḥ pumān |
keśeṣu sarvamuktāśca sādhūnāṃ nivasanti hi ||74||
icchāyāṃ śaktayaḥ sarvā mānase īśvarāḥ satām |
buddhāvupāsanā cāste citte brahmapriyāḥ satām ||75||
sādhau śrībhagavānnāste nirvāṇaḥ sādhusaṃgatau |
sādhoḥ prasannatāyāṃ vai sarvasvargāṇi santi hi ||76||
sādhoḥ śayane pralayāḥ prabodhane tu sṛṣṭayaḥ |
samādhayaḥ suṣuptau tu dhyāne brahmapadaṃ satām ||77||
viveke copaniṣado mālikāyāṃ sudarśanam |
brahmaśastraṃ tu vijñāne nārāyaṇāstramātmani ||78||
sarvāsthiṣvamṛtahradā virājante satāṃ sadā |
sādhormūrtau divyabhāvāḥ kalpalatāstu pattale ||79||
vakṣormadhye dharmavaṃśaḥ panthānau stanayorubhau |
āsane tu satāṃ sarvadevatānāṃ tu pīṭhikāḥ ||3.186.80||
kriyāyāṃ sarvadevyaśca vasanti hi satāṃ sadā |
bhajane ca satāṃ tatra harestoṣo hi vartate ||81||
ityevaṃ vai kathāṃ ramyāṃ śuśrāva sa dhvajīśvaraḥ |
madyavikrayapāpaṃ ca jñātavān śāstravākyataḥ ||82||
so’yaṃ śuśoca hṛdaye madyavikrayaṇaṃ mayā |
tyaktavyaṃ sarvadā cānyodyamo grāhyo vikalmaṣaḥ ||83||
kulālasya yathā madyaṃ tathā mṛtpātraghaṭṭanā |
kāryaṃ saṃvidyate tasmāt tyājyaṃ pāpaṃ tu madyakam ||84||
vicāryetthaṃ santadāsaṃ sādhuṃ bhaktiparāyaṇam |
nārāyaṇahrade snātvā prārthayāmāsa madyapaḥ ||85||
sādho kulālakarmāsmi madyapo madyakārakaḥ |
adya śrutvā kathāṃ snātvā nārāyaṇahrade tvaham ||86||
bhavaccharaṇamāpannaḥ śuddhaṃ kuru dhunotvagham |
śrutvaivaṃ santadāsastu dadau vai vaiṣṇavaṃ jalam ||87||
prasādaṃ pradadau cāpi brahmakūrcavrataṃ dadau |
dadau mantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mālāṃ ca taulasīṃ dadau ||88||
sakuṭumbasya tu bāṇāṃgaṇāya śaraṇārthine |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||89||
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa namo’stu te |
itikīrtanamantraṃ ca dadau cakre suvaiṣṇavam ||3.186.90 ||
āśīrvādaṃ dadāvasmai gururharirmiliṣyati |
āśīrvādaṃ paraṃ prāpya bāṇāṃgaṇo nijālayam ||91 ||
prayayau cāpi tatyāja madyasya vyavasāyakam |
mṛttikāpātranirmāṇavyavasāyaṃ cakāra ha ||92||
bheje māṃ paramātmānaṃ nityaṃ karoti kīrtanam |
kuṭumbasahitastasya snehibhaktasya vai mayā ||93||
bhaktirdṛṣṭā parā śuddhisahitā nityameva hi |
bhajate māṃ me nivedya bhuṃkte pāti yunakti ca ||94||
cāturmāsyavrataṃ cakre sakuṭumbaḥ phalādibhuk |
kārtike pūjanaṃ codyāpanaṃ cakre yathāvratam ||95||
ekādaśyāṃ ca vai rātrau cakre jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāhaṃ prasanno’smai svadarśanam ||96||
dadau lakṣmi śriyā yuktaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ |
vīkṣya māṃ daṇḍavaccakre pupūja paramādarāt ||97||
kuṭumbasahito me ca śaraṇaṃ patito muhuḥ |
prārthayāmāsa ca tadā samuddhara bhavārṇavāt ||98||
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa samuddhara bhavārṇavāt |
athāhaṃ me caraṇasya vāri pāne dadau tadā ||99||
papau kuṭumbasahitaḥ puṇyātmā hyabhavattadā |
nivṛttabandhanastūrṇaṃ muktyarthaṃ naddhamānasaḥ || 3.186.10 0||
tvarito’bhūttadā lakṣmi dehamatyājayaṃ tvaham |
vimānavaramevainamadhyārohayamāśritam || 10 1||
apreṣayaṃ mama dhāmākṣaraṃ taṃ pārṣadaiḥ saha |
athāsyāpi kuṭumbaṃ vai yathāyuṣyakṣayāgate || 1 02||
anayaṃ kramaśo dhāmākṣaraṃ me sadvacaḥsthitaḥ |
evaṃ bhaktasya tasyaiva satāṃ yogena kalmaṣam ||1 03||
prajvālya sarvamevāsmai dadau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
bāṇāṃgaṇo yayau mokṣaṃ kuṭumbaṃ cottarottaram || 1 04||
mokṣaṃ yayau vaiṣṇavaṃ tad bhūtvā pāvanamakṣaram |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bāṇāṃgaṇākhyasya madyavikretuḥ sādhusamāgamena bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛtaḥ sādhoḥ mūrtervibhūtayaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikaḥ śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 186 ||

<3.187>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ tathā cānyakathāṃ śubhām |
dhavalākhye pure tvāsīccarmakāro mṛtādanaḥ || 1 ||
grāmopaśalyavāsaśca mṛtānāṃ khuriṇāṃ sadā |
paśūnāṃ grāmamadhyāt sa śavānāmapahārakaḥ || 2 ||
carmaśuddhikaraścāpyaspṛśyo dūre pratiṣṭhati |
mṛtamāṃsādanaścāsīt sakuṭumbaḥ sadā hyaghī || 3 ||
kvacid vasatimāsādya kṛtvā tu carmavikrayam |
prāptadhanena godhūmādyannaṃ śākaphalādikam || 4 ||
krītaṃ svagṛhamānāyya pācayitvā bhunaktyapi |
kvaciccāraṇyamārjāraiḥ śṛgālaiḥ śaśakaistathā || 5 ||
vārāhaiśca tarakṣvādyaiḥ kvacit kacchapamatsyakaiḥ |
vidadhāti kuṭumbasya bhojanaṃ piśitāśanaḥ || 6 ||
evaṃ jātyā karmaṇā ca bhojanenātikilbiṣī |
mṛtādanākhyaścarmakṛd dūre tyājyo’vasat sadā || 7 ||
athaikadā tu varṣāyāṃ patitāyāmaharniśam |
jalapūraṃ samāyātaṃ bahuvegaṃ samantataḥ || 8 ||
tatraike prāṇino jīvā uhyante vaninastadā |
mṛtāśca jīvinaścāpi grāmyāśca paśavo’pi ca || 9 ||
ye caranti tṛṇakṣetre gocare te’pi kecana |
pūravegena varṣāyāṃ gṛhaṃ mantuṃ na śekire ||3.187.1 0||
ekā gauḥ pūravegena cohyamānā tu jīvitā |
carmakārasya vāsasyocchrāyasyaiva samīpataḥ || 11 ||
jalaiścākṛṣyamāṇā sā nirgatā vīkṣitā tadā |
carmakāreṇa dayayoddhartuṃ gāṃ vai samīhitam ||12||
mṛtādanaḥ svayaṃ puṣṭastartuṃ śakto balī dṛḍhaḥ |
śatahastamitāṃ rajjuṃ kaṭyāṃ badhvā jale’patat ||1 3||
rajjuprāntaṃ dvitoyaṃ tu datvā doṣṣu kuṭumbinām |
aparāṃ ca dṛḍhāṃ rajjuṃ mukulitāṃ gale’kṣipat ||14||
patitvā sahasā vārivege vahati yatra gauḥ |
tīrtvā vegena tasyāstu nimnabhāge puro’bhavat || 15||
pūreṇa cohyate dhenuścarmakāro’pi cohyate |
tīrasthā rajukādhrā ye te’nudhāvanti taṃ taṭam ||1 6||
taratā carmakāreṇa hastasya lāghavena vai |
mukulitāyā rajjvāstu prānto dhenugale kṛtaḥ || 17||
granthiḥ kṛtā ca sahasā śṛṃgayornihitā tu sā |
rajjuṃ kṛtvā lambamānāṃ prāntaṃ kaṭyāṃ babandha saḥ || 18||
atha kuṭumbinaḥ prāhākarṣayantu balāditi |
kuṭumbibhiśca sā rajjurākṛṣṭā svakaradhṛtā || 1 9||
carmakāraḥ pūravegāt taṭamākarṣito’bhavat |
dhenuścāpi kaṭirajjuvaddhā cākarṣitābhavat ||3.187.20||
tīraṃ prati samākṛṣṭā militvā tu kuṭumbibhiḥ |
carmakāreṇa sahitā sajīvā tīramāgamat ||21||
tadā gauḥ prāṇasaṃrakṣātuṣṭāśīrvādamāha tān |
bhavatāṃ sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni mama rakṣaṇāt ||22||
godāne yatphalaṃ gojīvane yacca phalaṃ mahat |
gosevāyāṃ phalaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ bhavatāṃ bhavet ||23||
prasūyamānādhenvāśca dāne yat phalamucyate |
tatphalaṃ bhavatāmastu mama prāṇaprarakṣaṇāt ||24||
svarṇadhenuphalaṃ yacca kapilādhenujaṃ phalam |
gomedhe ca phalaṃ yat tadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||25||
pṛthvīrakṣāphalaṃ yacca prajārakṣāphalaṃ tu yat |
kanyārakṣāphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||26||
satīrakṣāphalaṃ yacca bālarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat |
viprarakṣāphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||27||
sādhurakṣāphalaṃ yacca devarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat |
śaraṇāgatarakṣotthaṃ vastadastu mamāvanāt ||28||
bhītarakṣāphalaṃ yacca prāṇarakṣāphalaṃ ca yat |
mokṣadānaphalaṃ yattadastu vo mama rakṣaṇāt ||29||
dharmarakṣāphalaṃ yacca garbharakṣāphalaṃ ca yat |
mātṛsevāphalaṃ yacca vo’stu tanmama rakṣaṇāt ||3.187.30||
devapūjāphalaṃ yacca mṛtyutrāṇaphalaṃ ca yat |
gaṃgātīrthaphalaṃ yattad vo’stu mama prarakṣaṇāt ||3 1 ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni paśuhiṃsodbhavāni ca |
māṃsabhakṣaṇapāpāni līyantāṃ mama rakṣaṇāt ||32||
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sādhvarthe ca satīkṛte |
devārthe prāṇadātustu sarvapāpavināśanam ||33||
madarthe prāṇadā yūyaṃ madarthe kṛtajīvanāḥ |
mama rakṣākarā yūyaṃ jīvantu ṛddhisevitāḥ ||34||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mahāsmṛddhiṃ bhuñjantu svargasadṛśīm |
vaṃśo vo’stu sadā bhakto bhaktimān gavi gopātau ||35||
gopāle gopikākānte govinde gopabālake |
gopālabālake sneho goloke vasatiśca vaḥ ||36||
ityevaṃ gaurdadau tebhyaścāśīrvādām̐stadā śubhān |
kampamānā bhayodvignā śītārttā kṣudhitā tathā ||37||
atha śanaiśca tāṃ dhenuṃ sagarbhāṃ cāśrayecchukīm |
nināya carmakāraḥ sa svālaye tāṃ rarakṣa ha ||38||
dadau ghāsottamagrāsān siṣeve tṛṇavāribhiḥ |
nāsyāḥ kaścit samāyāti svāmī netuṃ na vidyate || 39||
tataḥ sā carmakārasya gṛhe vāsaṃ vyadhācca gauḥ |
tṛṇānyattvā pārśvabhūmau sāyamāgatya tiṣṭhati ||3.187.40||
carmakāro nijāṃ matvā sevate tu yathābalam |
daridro’pi yatitvāpi go’rthaṃ tṛṇaṃ jalaṃ muhuḥ ||41 ||
ānayatyeva kṣetrādvā vanādvā dūrabhūmitaḥ |
evaṃ prasevamānasya mṛtādanasya tasya hi ||42||
gosevāyāḥ phalaṃ dhenorāśīrvādaphalaṃ tathā |
prāptaṃ tenaikadā prātaḥ preritastu mṛtādanaḥ ||43||
adya gṛhaṃ vilimpāmi gauramṛdā ca śakṛtā |
vicāryetthaṃ striyā sākaṃ nītvā sītāṃ khanitrikām ||44||
vaṃśapātradvayaṃ cāpi mṛdamāhartumeva ha |
nadītīraṃ yayau yatra gauramṛd labhyate śubhā ||45||
sītayā ca khanitreṇa garte khanati mṛttikām |
vitastimātraṃ khanitaṃ tīre pārśvagabhūstaram ||46||
tāvaccarustāmradhātoḥ svarṇarūpyakasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
nirgato bhūtalamadhyācchobhano daivavāñcchayā ||47||
mṛtādanena śīghraṃ vai tasmāt svarṇasya mudrikāḥ |
niṣkāsya vaṃśapātre mṛttikāguptāśca vai gṛham ||48||
ānītā pañcapātrāṇi na tu jānāti kaścana |
gṛhāntare tu vivare sarvāḥ kṣiptāḥ sugopitāḥ ||49||
gosevāyāḥ phalaṃ matvā sevate gāṃ sabhāryakaḥ |
tāmrapātraṃ tu garte vai yathāsīt tattathā punaḥ ||3.187.50||
riktaṃ nidhāya saṃgopya mṛdbhirgṛhaṃ gato hi saḥ |
yathāpekṣaṃ nāṇakena bhuṃkte sukhāni sarvathā ||5 1 ||
bhuṃkte bhojanapānāni vastrāṇi modakāni ca |
yathānye naiva jānīyustathā bhuṃkte’rjitaṃ dhanam ||52||
tena pathā samāyātānatithīn sevate’pi ca |
goṣṭhe sthitān drumacchāyāpradeśe sevate’tithīn ||53||
phalāni śarkarāścāpi madhuparkaṃ dadātyapi |
vastraṃ jalaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ dadāti caṇakādikam ||54||
ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ pakvaṃ ca vahnināpi yat |
sūryapakvamṛtupakvamannaṃ dadāti sādhave ||55||
yogyaṃ dadāti nāyogyaṃ sevate sādhuyoginaḥ |
kuṭumbaṃ sevate sādhūn śṛṇoti bhajanāni ca ||56||
kathāṃ śṛṇoti me ramyāṃ sādhūktāṃ pāvanīṃ parām |
ahiṃsā paramo dharmo vighasāśī pramucyate ||57||
māṃsādanaṃ mahatpāpaṃ yāmyapurīprayojakam |
matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsāśī kadāpi naiva mucyate ||58||
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇād bhraṣṭo na yāti mokṣaṇaṃ kvacit |
yāmyadūtāḥ pīḍayanti randhayanti yamālaye ||59||
taṃ tu māṃsādanaṃ nityaṃ pācayanti mahānale |
nikṛntanti mārayanti narake pātayanti ca ||3.187.60||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cauryaṃ vyavāyaśceti kalmaṣam |
bhayaṃkaraṃ mahāghoraṃ kartavyaṃ naiva mānavaiḥ ||61 ||
janma cedaṃ mānavaṃ vai mokṣāya labhyate bhuvi |
mokṣaḥ sādhyo mānavairvai tyājyā doṣā aghāni ca ||62|||
bahuṣvapi tu deheṣu pakṣiṣu ca paśuṣvapi |
madyamāṃsādayo bhuktāstatpāpānto na vidyate ||63||
asmin vai mānave bhāve puṇyaṃ kāryaṃ divaṃpradam |
bhaktiḥ kāryā hareścāpi mokṣo gamyaḥ pare’kṣare ||64||
evaṃ kathāṃ pāvanīṃ ca carmakāraḥ śṛṇoti vai |
tato’sya jātā sahasā mumukṣā sādhusaṃgataḥ ||65||
niyamān jagṛhe cāhiṃsāṃ ca māṃsādivarjanam |
annabhojitvamevāpi nityaṃ śrīharisevanam ||66||
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ gavāṃ sevanaṃ pāpavarjanam |
dānaṃ yathārhaṃ pātrāya bhagavatkīrttanaṃ tathā ||67||
vratotsavām̐śca devānāṃ cāturmāsyavratāni ca |
evaṃvidhān sa niyamān jagrāha mokṣadān sadā ||68||
atha sādhurdharmaśālāyano nāmnāṭavīṃ bhraman |
nirambaraḥ samāyātaścarmakāragṛhāntikam ||69||
dadarśainaṃ carmakāro yoginaṃ yogamānasam |
smarantaṃ paramātmānaṃ japamālānvitaṃ śubham ||3.187.70 ||
digambaraṃ praśāntaṃ ca nirvikāraṃ sthirāśayam |
śīlavrataṃ rāgaśūnyaṃ surūpaṃ jaṭilaṃ munim ||71 ||
carmakārastu taṃ gatvā praṇāmamakaronmudā |
svāgataṃ te mahābhāga sādho jayo’stu te sadā ||72||
āyāhi mama vāse’tra carmakāro’smi jātitaḥ |
yadi tvaṃ manyase sādho gṛhaṃ pāvaya me’nagha ||73||
śrutvā śālāyanaḥ prāha kalyāṇaṃ satyavādinaḥ |
tavāstu sādhubhaktasya bhaktasya bhagavānapi ||74||
vaśībhavati divyātmā tatra sādhostu kā kathā |
pāvanā bhagavadbhaktā api cāṇḍālayonayaḥ ||75||
carmakārāḥ prajāḥ sarvāścarmanaddhā bhavanti hi |
carmagarbhe carmayonau prajāyante hi carmataḥ ||76||
carmasnānaṃ kārayanti carma śṛṃgārayanti ca |
carmaṇyeva ca tailādyaiḥ kurvanti mardanādikam ||77||
bhūṣāmbarāṇi dehāya carmiṇe cārpayantyapi |
carmamayaṃ jagat sarva ko nāsti carmakārakaḥ ||78||
brahmā carmakāraścāste tatputrāścarmakārakāḥ |
bhakta tvaṃ carmakāro’si carmakārasya vaṃśajaḥ ||79||
prajānāṃ carmakāratve viśeṣo nāsti kaścana |
mugdhā ye carmaviṣaye carmakārā hi te matāḥ ||3.187.80||
amugdhāścarmaviṣaye brahmākārā hi te matāḥ |
sādhavo brahmasadanā brahmākārā bṛhatpriyāḥ ||81 ||
ātmāyaṃ vidyate yāvad dehe sa carmakārakaḥ |
adeho jāyate bhaktyā mokṣo sa brahmakārakaḥ ||82||
ahamātmā sādhurūpo brahmarūpo bhavāmi ha |
harerbhaktyā snehamayyā brahmākāro bhavāmyaham ||83||
bhakta tvaṃ sādhuyogena brahmākāro bhavasyapi |
sādhubhaktāḥ sādhurūpāḥ sādhukāriṇa eva te ||84||
sādhvarthaṃ yasya sarvasvaṃ brahmātmā cocyate hi saḥ |
sa eva pāparahitaḥ puṇyātmā paṃktipāvanaḥ ||85||
ityevamuktvā sādhuḥ sa yayau tasyālayaṃ tadā |
carmakāro bhaktarājaścakre’sya svāgataṃ śubham ||86||
āsanaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ pādaprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt |
papau pādāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbasahito hi saḥ ||87||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre dehasammardanaṃ tathā |
madhuparkaṃ dadau miṣṭaṃ śarkarāṃ saktumityapi ||88||
dadau phalāni śreṣṭhāni pakvāni vividhāni ca |
jalaṃ ca śayanaṃ cāpi dadau viśrāntihetave ||89||
putrāḥ putryo dampatī ca sarvaṃ dehasya mardanam |
bhojayitvā pracakrurvai mārgaśramanivṛttaye || 3.187.90||
sādhurnidrāṃ parāṃ lebhe sarve cakruśca mardanam |
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi vyajanenānilārpaṇam ||9 1 ||
evaṃ sevāṃ pracakruste dharmaśālāyanasya vai |
dharmaśālāyano nidrāṃ kṛtvā ca bubudhe tadā ||92||
jalaṃ pītvā niṣasādāsane mālājapānvitaḥ |
mṛtādanādyāścāgre’sya niṣedurbhaktibhāvataḥ ||93||
sādhuḥ prāha sadā bhaktiḥ kartavyā paramātmanaḥ |
gosevā sādhusevā ca kartavyā muktaye tviha ||94||
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ divyaṃ tvaṃ kuṭumbena yuto hi mat |
svargaṃ divyaṃ tato mokṣaṃ lapsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ||95||
ityuktaścarmakāraḥ sa kuṭumbasahitastadā |
mantraṃ jagrāha sādhośca harekṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||96||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ tato bheje sādhūktapaddhatiṃ vrajan ||97||
tataḥ sa tīrthayātrāyāṃ sādhunā saha vai yayau |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||98||
suvarṇaṃ bahudhā tatra dāne yajñe samārpayat |
mandiraṃ kārayāmāsa sarastaṭe tathā ca saḥ ||901||
āśramaṃ racayāmāsa bhajanārthaṃ nijaṃ śubham |
vaṃśena sahitastatra sādhunā saha cāvasat || 3.187.10 0||
athaikadāhaṃ kamale prasannastatra cāyayau |
darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tasmai caturbhujaṃ sutaijasam || 101 ||
kuṭumbaṃ pūjayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ sanātanam |
mṛtādano mama pādavāri prakṣālya saṃpapau || 1 02||
vimānaṃ tūrṇamāyātaṃ brahmadhāmno’tibhāsuram |
tatra mṛtādanaścādhyarohan mama nideśataḥ || 1 03||
gavā sākaṃ tayā tatrānayaṃ taṃ mama dhāma vai |
anyat sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca svarge devāstato’bhavan || 1 04||
puṇyaṃ bhuktvā dhenuvṛttaṃ yāsyanti dhāma me param |
sādhusevāprapuṇyaṃ ca mama bhakteḥ phalaṃ tathā || 1 05||
bhokṣyante ruciraṃ lakṣmi śāśvatānandapūritam |
evaṃ gosevayā māṃsādanapāpaṃ vināśitam || 1 06||
puṇyodbhavena ca sādhusamāgamo dhanāgamaḥ |
tīrthavāsaḥ parāmuktiḥ sarvaṃ tasya vyavartata || 1 07||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi śāśvataṃ padamarjyate || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mṛtādananāmakacarmakārasya dhenoḥ prāṇarakṣaṇena māṃsādanādipāpanāśaḥ puṇyaprāptiḥ sādhoḥ samāgamaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 187 ||

<3.188>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ stenasya mokṣaṇaṃ śubham |
āsīt śaṃkudharākhyo vai steno mālavyapattane || 1 ||
stenāvāse kṛtāvāsaḥ stenamaṇḍalapuṣṭikṛt |
stainyayātrāparaścāste rātrau śastrādidhārakaḥ || 2 ||
bhinnaveṣadharaścāpi bhinnakarmā bhavatyapi |
bhedaṃ jñātvā praveśasya yathā yatnena sarvathā || 3 ||
rātrau kṛtvā ca saṃketaṃ dhanacauryaṃ karoti hi |
kvacidaśve kvaciduṣṭre kvacittu dīrghagardabhe || 4 ||
dhanabhāraṃ nidhāyaiva dūraṃ yāti dravan hi saḥ |
evaṃ deśāntare gatvā corayitvā dhanāni vai || 5 ||
ānāyya svagṛhaṃ caurairvibhajya svaṃ prarakṣati |
utsavaṃ kurute cāpi bhuṃkte khādati modate || 6 ||
cauryaṃ tu sarvathā kāryaṃ cānyat kāryaṃ na vidyate |
stainyodyamaḥ stainyacintaḥ stainyadhyānaparo’sti saḥ || 7 ||
stainyodarabharaścāste kuṭumbodarapūrakaḥ |
kadācid yatra devānāmutsavo vā mahān bhavet || 8 ||
pāresahasraṃ janatā milanti yatra tīrthake |
caitye vā mandire cādrau grāmānte vā nadītaṭe || 9 ||
devālaye ca vā tatra yātyayaṃ cauramaṇḍalaḥ |
mārgayatyeva sarvatra dravyāṇi kutra santi hi ||3.188.1 0||
nirjanaṃ vā kadā kutra jāyate dhanino gṛham |
kva mārgo vā praveśasya niḥsṛtirvā kva vā katham || 1 1||
kathaṃ labdhiḥ kathaṃ svasya rakṣā pracchannatā katham |
evaṃ svadhyānanirataḥ sasārthaḥ śaṃkudhārakaḥ ||12||
anyānyapattane cauryaṃ kṛtvā cāharate dhanam |
evaṃvidhasya tasyaivaikadā svapnaṃ niśottare ||1 3||
abhavat svarṇaratnānāṃ labdhyātmakamasīmakam |
araṇye pūrvamevāsīd rājadhānītyalokayat ||14||
svapne tatra vane dūre nirjane koṣamuttamam |
suvarṇaratnakhacitaṃ purā rājyaprarakṣitam || 15||
guptaṃ koṣaṃ na jānāti kaścidanyo yathā tathā |
prātarutthāya bhuktvāyaṃ vihāravyājato yayau || 16||
svapne yathā dadarśāyaṃ vanaṃ mārgaṃ purāṇakam |
vṛkṣaghaṭāṃ ca pāṣāṇān pṛthvīṃ prācyastarānvitām || 17||
prācīnavasatiṃ tatra darśayitrīṃ purāṅkanaiḥ |
tathā sarvaṃ dadarśāyaṃ steno viśvāsamāptavān || 18||
pūrvajanmani ye coptāḥ saṃskārāścirakālinaḥ |
aṃkurayanti kamale janmāntare na saṃśayaḥ || 19||
cauro’yaṃ pūrvakāle tu sahasravarṣapūrvage |
rājñaḥ koṣādhyakṣa āsīt suhotrasya tu bhūbhṛtaḥ ||3.188.20 ||
suhotrasya tadā tatra nagarī pitṛnāmataḥ |
kāṃcanena janakena kṛtāsīt kāñcanī purī ||21 ||
candravaṃśīyarājñaḥ sā koṣarakṣāmayī hyabhūt |
atha kālāntare koṣā niṣkāsitāḥ sthalāntare || 22||
nītāśca nihitāḥ sarve tathāpi kapaṭena vai |
apajāpakanāmnā vai koṣādhyakṣeṇa sarvathā ||23||
anye yathā na jānīyustathā koṣastu vai manāk |
suvarṇānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ pṛthaktvasya nigartitaḥ ||24||
tatraiva śeṣito naijasvārthārthaṃ kapaṭena ha |
atha kālāntare yāte ciraṃ kāle gate’pi vai ||25||
apajāpo na vai netuṃ śaśāka guptakoṣakam |
evameva mṛtastatra mālavyapattane nave ||26||
cauryadoṣeṇa yāmyāṃ vai nagarīṃ prāpito yamaiḥ |
lohadaṇḍaistāḍitaḥ sa duḥkhāyitaśca kuṇḍake |||27||
pāśaiśca mudgarairdaṇḍairdaṇḍāyito muhurmuhuḥ |
pāpabhogottaraṃ mukto vane tatra hi nirjane ||28||
pretarūpo’bhavannānyaṃ gantuṃ dadāti tatsthalam |
araṇye ramate nityaṃ koṣaṃ paśyati kevalam ||29||
bhuṃkte vanyaṃ samastaṃ ca koṣadrume vasatyapi |
evaṃ tvaṣṭaśatānyasya varṣāṇāṃ vigatāni vai ||3.188.30||
pretasya nirjane tatra tadā prācīnabhūtale |
tapastaptuṃ samāyato vipro nāmnā sumantukaḥ ||3 1 ||
vane vijñāya ramaṇīṃ tapoyogyāṃ śubhasthalīm |
nirvighnāṃ vṛkṣavallyādistambāḍhyāṃ sujalāpagām ||32|||
nātidūre vaṭavṛkṣacchāyāmāśritya tāpasaḥ |
tapaścakre bhajan kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||33||
atha samvatsare yāte preto’yaṃ puṇyaśālinam |
matvā coddhārakarttāraṃ nijasyeti tu tāpasam ||34||
kirātarūpamāsthāya vaṭacchāyāṃ tu tatpuraḥ |
yayau naman praśaṃsam̐śca tapastasya mahātmanaḥ ||35||
sumantustapasā tvenaṃ jānāti pretarūpiṇam |
tathāpi taṃ svāgataṃ vai cakre vaṭagṛhāgatam || 36||
vaninaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca kṛśaṃ ca duḥkhinaṃ tu tam |
papraccha munirāḍ dehin kuśalaṃ te vanin tviha ||37||
preto jagāda kuśalaṃ tāpasasya pratāpataḥ |
muniḥ papraccha vāsaṃ ca grāmaṃ dharmaṃ ca karma ca ||38||
preto niṣkapaṭo bhūtvā vṛttāntamāha cāditaḥ |
pūrvamāsaṃ tviha koṣādhyakṣaḥ kapaṭapāpavān ||39||
mṛtvā yāpyapurīṃ gatvā bhuktvā duḥkhāni yātanāḥ |
pratāraṇaphalaṃ kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ pralabhya ca ||3.188.40 ||
jāto’smyatra vane preto dayayā māṃ vimocaya |
evaṃ sa upavām̐stasmai koṣaṃ nādarśayattadā ||41||
dayāluḥ sa ṛṣistasmai gāyatrīṃ prajapan jalam |
dadau pretasya muktyarthaṃ pretatā vigatāsya ca ||42||
kintu cauryasvabhāvena kāpaṭyena tu mānave |
mālavyapattane cāyaṃ cauraḥ śaṃkudharo’bhavat ||43||
pūrvasaṃskārasahitaścauryaniṣṇāta eva saḥ |
evaṃ stainyaparasyāsya lakṣmi saṃskārasadbalāt ||44||
svapne’sya smaraṇaṃ jātaṃ koṣasya pūrvajanmanaḥ |
taṃ koṣaṃ vai tato draṣṭuṃ yayau tu nirjane vane ||45||
sarvaṃ vilokayāmāsa sacihnaṃ svapnabhālitam |
prasanno’bhūttadā cāsau mānavo lobhapuṣkalaḥ ||46||
vaṭaṃ dadarśa tatraiva tāpasasya purā sthalam |
tapasvī tatra nāstyeva vaṭastu vidyate śubhaḥ ||47||
sumantukastu tapasā divyadeho yato’bhavat |
vaṭe tirobhavannāste tapasvī divyavigrahaḥ ||48||
śaṃkudharastato naiva dadarśa taṃ tapasvinam |
vaṭamātraṃ dadarśaiva neme vaṭaṃ purā smaran ||49||
yayau sthalaṃ tu koṣasya tṛptiṃ matvā suvarṇajām |
āyayau suprasannaśca svagṛhaṃ sāyameva ha ||3.188.50||
athaikalaḥ svahṛdaye cintayāmāsa vai muhuḥ |
kathaṃkāraṃ dhanaṃ tasmādāneyamatra vai mayā ||51 ||
yathā cānye na jānīyustathā cāhāryameva tat |
vane tatra nivāsaṃ vai kṛtvā śanaiḥ śanairiha |||52||
mayā tvekākinā cānetavyaṃ vai chadmanā sadā |
ityevaṃ samvicāryaiva cauryamiṣeṇa caikalaḥ ||23||
uktvā gṛhajanān śastrāṇyādāya tadvanaṃ yayau |
yāvat khanati cauryaiṇa śanaiḥ śanaistamasyapi ||54||
āprātaḥ khananaṃ kṛtvā vaṭasyādho yayau kṣaṇam |
viśrāmārthaṃ punastatrāgatyākhanacchanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||55||
nirbhayo vanamadhye vai hyekākī cāviśaṃkitaḥ |
tāvadvaṭāttatra śabdaścāyāto mānavo yathā |||56||
śrutvā paśyatyabhitaḥ sa śaṃkitaśca drutaṃ tadā
nāpaśyanmānavaṃ kaṃcit punaḥ punaḥ suśaṃkitaḥ ||57||
khanayāmāsa śanakaistāvatpāṣāṇabhāritā |
śilā tatrāgatā tvekā tāmutthāpya śilātale ||58||
vyalokayattāmrapātrāṇyaṣṭa bhūtāni sarvathā |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ bhūṣā mudrā ratnāni hīrakān ||59||
svapnadṛṣṭān samastām̐śca viśeṣān dravyasaṃjñitān |
vilokya sarvathā sarvān śāntiṃ jagāma cottamām ||3.188.60||
athaitāni tu pātrāṇi pidhāya ca yathāyatham |
tṛṇapatrādipuñjaṃ copari nyasyattataḥ sa ca ||61 ||
kaṇṭakadrumaśākhāśca cikṣepa copari drutam |
atha vaṭaṃ punargatvā viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam ||62||
smaran rātrau prakartavyaṃ dravyasya haraṇaṃ yathā |
cintayan klṛptanāṃ sarvāṃ suṣvāpa kṣaṇameva saḥ |||63||
utthitaḥ sa ghaṭikānte tāvattu purato’bhavat |
yogirāṭ mūrtimān sākṣāt sumantuko hasan muhuḥ ||64||
stabdho bhūtvā kṣaṇaṃ matvā maharṣiṃ tāpasaṃ tu tam |
purā dṛṣṭaṃ drutaṃ pratyabhijñāya praṇanāma tam ||65||
prasannavadano bhūtvoddhārakaṃ taṃ munīśvaram |
jātismaro drutaṃ prāha preto’bhavaṃ guro purā ||66||
atrāhaṃ bhavatā cāpyuddhṛto’haṃ mānavo’smi ca |
śaṃkudharākhyaścauro’haṃ cauryakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||67||
cauryeṇa kṛtanirvāho vicarāmi tu pāpavān |
uddhāraṃ kuru viprendra pūrvaguro dayānidhe ||68||
yathā me syādabhyudayo mokṣaṇaṃ ca tathā kuru |
śrutvaivaṃ śaraṇasthasya purābhaktasya vai muniḥ ||69||
sumanturdayayā prāha taduddhāraṃ vicintayan |
kariṣye tava paramaṃ śreyo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||3.188.70||
pravadāmi yathā śiṣya tathā vidhehi sādaram |
śṛṇu svalpamupadeśaṃ tava yogyaṃ vadāmi te ||71 ||
candravaṃśo bhavānāsīnmahākoṣapatiḥ purā |
tato yāmyapure gatvā bhuktvā ca yātanāstataḥ ||72||
preto jātastato me’pi kṛpayā mānavo’si vai |
tathāpi caurabhāvaste na naṣṭo’tra vadāmi te ||73||
tvayā yat khanitaṃ khātaṃ dravyaṃ tatra ca yad bhavet |
tena yajñaṃ kuru tvatra sumantuhastakāritam ||74||
sumantuścāhamevātra vaṭādhastād vasāmi tu |
sarve jānanti lokā māṃ tāpasaṃ siddhayoginam ||75||
sumantunā makhaścāpi kriyate vada cetyapi |
prajāsu tvaṃ samastāsu viśvāsaṃ sampradāpaya ||76||
āgamiṣyanti ṛṣayo munayo devatāstathā |
bhūsurā mānavāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaścātra makhe tataḥ ||77||
dravyavyayaṃ kariṣye’haṃ kariṣye makhamuttamam |
evaṃ kṛte tava puṇyaṃ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati ||78||
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ kṛṣṇasya pāvanaṃ paṃktipāvanam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||79||
harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate |
parameśa kṛpāsindho lakṣmīpate ramāpate ||3.188.80||
evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi kuru rātrindivaṃ sadā |
tava pāpāni sarvāṇi nāśameṣyanti sarvathā ||8 1 ||
yajñapuṇyaṃ tavaiva syānmamāśīrvādataḥ priya |
ātmaśuddhistathā te syād bhaktiśca śrīharau mayi ||82||
bhaviṣyatīti me vācaḥ phaliṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
bhuktirmuktiśca te kuṭumbināṃ cāpi bhaviṣyataḥ ||83||
ityuktvā tanmano jñātvā ṛṣirmantraṃ dadau tataḥ |
preṣayāmāsa ṛṣirāṭ sumantukastamāśramān ||84||
viprāśramān munyāśramān sādhūn satīḥ prati drutam |
vidvāṃsaḥ susamākarṇya yajñaṃ tatra samāyayuḥ ||85||
lakṣmi sumantumunirāṭ tadā saṃkalpamātrataḥ |
cakre samagravastūnāṃ sañcayān parvatān nadīḥ ||86||
brahmādyā devatāstatra pratyakṣaṃ tvāyayustadā |
maharṣayaḥ pitaraśca santaḥ sādhvyaḥ samāyayuḥ ||87||
viṣṇuyāgastu ṛṣiṇā saptāhena kṛtastadā |
sumantorvāñcchayā viṣṇustatra sākṣāt sthito’bhavat ||88||
agnayastu tadā sākṣād jagṛhurhavyabhojanam |
pūrṇāhutau sumantukaḥ sasmāra māṃ pareśvaram ||89||
bhaktakalyāṇakāryārthaṃ tadāhaṃ pragato’bhavam |
bubhuje havyamevāpi sumantvādyaiḥ susatkṛtaḥ ||3.188.90||
atha khātajadravyāṇāṃ dānāni tu sumantukaḥ |
adāpayacchaṃkudharahastena svarṇakoṭikam || 91||
rūpyakāṇāṃ koṭikāśca ratnānāṃ koṭikāstathā |
hīrakāṇāṃ koṭikāśca camatkārairadāpayat ||92||
dhanaṃ kasmāt samāyātaṃ vividurnaiva kecana |
camatkāraṃ hi manyante sumantoḥ sarvameva te ||93||
jayakāro mahān jāto dānaiśca dakṣiṇādibhiḥ |
tṛptā devāśca pitaro mānavāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pare ||94||
dehino’pi samastāśca tṛptāstatra mahādhvare |
avabhṛthe sumantuśca snāpayāmāsa śiṣyakam ||95||
prārthayāmāsa māṃ tatra dātuṃ bhaktasya darśanam |
ahaṃ śaṃkudharāyāpi kuṭumbasahitāya vai ||96||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau |
pāvayāmāsa sarvāṃstān sumantorvacanāt khalu ||97||
sarvapāpāni bhaktasya vidhūya puṇyaśevadhim |
datvā tasmai svargayāne cādhigṛhya divi dhruve ||98||
tārake tu mahat svargaṃ pradadau śaṃkudhāriṇe |
sakuṭumbaḥ śaṃkudharo yayau vai paśyatāṃ satām ||99||
divyadehaḥ prabhūtvaiva druta dhruvālayaṃ yayau |
vaiṣṇavasya hi yāgasya phalaṃ bhuktvā dhruvālaye || 3.188.10 0||
tato yāsyati vaikuṇṭhaṃ kuṭumbasahito hi saḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi sumantorvai pratāpena tu bhaktarāṭ || 10 1||
cauro’pi stainyarahito bhūtvā kṛtvā makhaṃ śubham |
sādhostu kṛpayā me ca prasādena surottamaḥ || 1 02||
sarvalokairvanditaḥ san khyāto dhruvapadaṃ yayau |
evaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgena pāpino’pi khalā api || 1 03||
pāpahīnāḥ prajāyante yānti vai paramaṃ padam |
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajedapi || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śaṃkudharanāmnaścaurasya sumantukarṣeryogena pāpanāśo yajñakaraṇaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 188 ||

<3.189>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ prasannatā hareḥ satām |
anuvṛttyā bhavedeva nānyena sādhanena vai || 1 ||
sākṣātkāro hareścāpi kṛpayā sevayāthavā |
dhyānena śāśvatenāpi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
vṛttisthairyaṃ harermūtau kaṭhinaṃ dehadhāriṇām |
api tvabhyāsayogena siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 3 ||
mūrtiścintāmaṇirme’sti lakṣmi cintitasampradā |
svargaṃ smṛddhiṃ mahānandaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti cintitam || 4 ||
ātmasandarśanaṃ ceśadarśanaṃ brahmadarśanam |
muktānāṃ darśanaṃ divyaṃ mamāpi darśanaṃ tataḥ || 5 ||
cintitaṃ yat samagraṃ tat prāpyate dhyānamūrtitaḥ |
ahantāmamatāmāyā naśyatyeva ca cintanāt || 6 ||
smṛtayaścāpi naśyanti māyikyo dhyānakāriṇaḥ |
triguṇā gṛhaputrastrīrūpā māyāpi naśyati || 7 ||
vāsanākhyā tathā māyā naśyatyeva tu dhyāyinaḥ |
tṛṣṇānāśo bhavatyeva śāntilābhaḥ prajāyate || 8 ||
harerdhyānabalenaiva bhaktātmā tanmayo yadā |
bhavatyeva nirutthānastadā dehasya pātanam || 9 ||
bhautikasya vikārāṇāṃ viyogaśca prajāyate |
sūkṣmadehasya vai nāśastathā dhyānabalād bhavet || 3.189.1 0||
ātmanyeva cito dhārā dhyānavṛttiḥ pravardhate |
caitanyaṃ divyamevaitad dravyarūpaṃ vivardhate || 1 1||
tadeva dhyānarūpaṃ vai bhūtvā mūrtau suyujyate |
tadyogena tu jīvasya cetanasya tadātmanaḥ || 1 2||
dhāmotkramaṇakāle vai mūrtirmūrttyā samā hareḥ |
samabhiniṣpadyate’sau cetanaḥ svayameva ha || 1 3||
brahmamūrtasvarūpo’yaṃ divyākāraḥ prakāśate |
āvirbhavati mūrtātmā brahmātmā harisadṛśaḥ || 14||
śrīharericchayā lakṣmi muktottamo’bhikāśate |
sneho’dhiko mahānande prayojako harau mayi || 15||
evaṃ snigdhāḥ sadātmāno mahātmānaśca sādhavaḥ |
pāvanāḥ pāvayantyeva punanti pāpino janān || 16||
kṛpayaiva yatasteṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktipradānakam |
pāpyuddhāraśca tatkāryaṃ nirvahanti madājñayā || 17||
tato muktiṃ prayāntyeva pāpino’pi sadāśritāḥ |
satsaṃgena parāṃ muktiṃ prāpnuvantyeva dehinaḥ || 18||
gaṇikā hiṃsakāḥ stenā vyavāyinaśca ghātakāḥ |
bhraṣṭā duṣṭā dveṣiṇo’pi satsaṃgena taranti te || 1 9||
yanmānaḥ kriyate loke cāsatsaṃgo muhurjanaiḥ |
tārayatyeva tanmānaṃ satsaṃgaścet kṛto bhavet |||3.189.20||
guṇā grāhyāḥ satāṃ nityaṃ doṣāstyājyāḥ satāṃ sadā |
guṇagrāhī taratyeva doṣagrāhī nimajjati ||21||
satāṃ sammānaḥ kartavyo nijasya tu vimānanam |
satāṃ sammānakartāraṃ tārayanti hi sādhavaḥ ||22||
satāṃ tu ye hyavamānaṃ kurvanti te patanti vai |
dagdhapuṇyāstu te bhūtvā prayāntyadhamayonikām ||23||
sādhordehasvabhāvaṃ ye vīkṣyāvasthodbhavaṃ kvacit| |
gṛhṇantyavaguṇān sādhoste bhavantyapi nindakāḥ ||24||
avaguṇāḍhyā jāyante sadā vai doṣadṛṣṭayaḥ |
kalpayanti ca pāpāni sādhujaneṣu nityadā ||25||
avaguṇān pravadanti yaśohānikarān sadā |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mānaṃ mohaṃ ratiṃ madam |
matsaraṃ cādīrghadṛṣṭiṃ tathā satkāraśūnyatām ||26||
anaudāryamanāhvānamaudāsīnyaṃ satṛṣṇatām |
abhimānaṃ cāniyamāvalokanaṃ vidṛṣṭitām ||27||
saparigrahatāṃ lolupatāṃ ca vāsanāṃ bahiḥ |
bahirvṛttiṃ rājasatvaṃ tāmasatvamabuddhatām ||28||
rasanādhīnatāṃ śiśnodaratṛpatvamityapi |
adharmaṃ rājayuktatvaṃ mamatāṃ cābhimānitām ||29||
ajñānitvaṃ yogyatāvarjanaṃ nidrāṃ ca phalgutām |
mṛṣāsatyaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ śāṭhyaṃ chadmātibhakṣaṇam ||3.189.30||
maurkhyaṃ stainyaṃ mahālasyamevametām̐stu durguṇān |
kalpayanti dveṣiṇaste nindakā durguṇānvitāḥ ||3 1 ||
pāpāḥ pāpaṃ kalpayanti pāpayuktā bhavanti te |
manyante te yathā naijaṃ karma tathaiva sādhuṣu ||32||
yathā naijā vāsanā ca tathā tāmapi sādhuṣu |
yathā vai duṣṭatā naijā tathā tāmapi sādhuṣu ||33||
pareṣu cāśriteṣvete praveśayanti durguṇān |
avaguṇān grāhayanti cābhāvaṃ ca tiraskṛtim || 34||
abhāvanāṃ prerayanti guṇānniṣkāsayanti ca |
sarvāḥ kriyāḥ satāṃ duṣṭāḥ sadoṣāḥ saṃvadanti ca ||35||
vartanaṃ sarvathā duṣṭaṃ vadantyācaraṇaṃ tathā |
duṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ cāchamayaṃ daityā vā dānavā yathā ||36||
āsurā āsurabhāvaṃ kalpayanti hi sādhuṣu |
sveṣu sarveṣu satsveva durguṇeṣvapi sadguṇān ||37||
netrairdveṣaṃ darśayanti gatyā dveṣaṃ dadhatyapi |
namane darśane dveṣaṃ vāṇyāṃ dveṣaṃ vadantyapi ||38||
satāṃ kārye hyakāryatvaṃ duṣṭakāryatvamityapi |
darśayantyaparebhyaśca kaliṃ kurvantyahetukam ||39||
anena sādhunā cedaṃ kṛtaṃ tad yogyameva na |
ayaṃ sādhurhi naivāsti sādhutā cātra nāsti ca ||3.189.40 ||
tasya pādau spṛśet kastu ko vandeta tathāvidham |
ko namettaṃ kaḥ seveta dṛṣṭā bahavastādṛśāḥ ||41 ||
bhavādṛśā vivalayā manvate tādṛśān sataḥ |
nāsmādṛśāstu paśyanti teṣāṃ mukhānyapi kvacit ||42||
evaṃ nindāṃ prakurvanti gṛhṇantyavaguṇān sadā |
grāhayantyavaguṇakān svetarān duṣṭavārtayā ||43 ||
tathā nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ samākarṇaya cāsurīm |
rītiṃ tathāsurāṇāṃ vai yeṣāṃ sneho na sādhuṣu ||44||
yeṣāṃ ca kāmanādoṣaḥ krodhaścauryamasatyatā |
kāpaṭyaṃ cāpi paiśunyaṃ vyavāyo rājasī sthitiḥ ||45||
te janā doṣavanto vai doṣām̐styaktuṃ tu nirbalāḥ |
pratyuta doṣamagnāste viṣayāsaktacetasaḥ ||46||
atasteṣāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ sādhavo yadā |
tyājayituṃ prakurvanti tadā te duṣṭamānasāḥ ||47||
sādhornindāṃ prakurvanti doṣakhaṇḍanakāriṇaḥ |
vācāvācyānabhijño’yaṃ sādhurvaktuṃ na vetti vai ||48||
ekādeśijñānavām̐śca viśālajñānavānnahi |
paṇḍitaṃmanyamānaḥ svaṃ vartate bhānavarjitaḥ ||49||
nānusarati māṃ kvāpi na gṛhṇāti mayoditam |
svoktotkarṣapramantāyaṃ naśca khaṇḍanakāryasau ||3.189.50 ||
āśramaṃ naiva jānāti na jānāti vṛṣāṃśca naḥ |
khaṇḍayatyeva bhogādīn gārhasthyocitavaibhavān ||51 ||
tasmād vivekahīno’yaṃ sādhurmūkho’yamasti vai |
evaṃ nindanti sādhuṃ vai hitopadeśakāriṇam ||52|
evaṃvidhānāṃ naiva syāt snehaḥ sādhuṣvapi kvacit |
asnehena na viśvāso sādhuvākyeṣu jāyate ||53||
aviśvāsānna vai śraddhā māhātmyajñānavardhinī |
aśraddhayā hyanabhyāso’nabhyāsād dhyānameva na ||54||
na sevā bhāvanā naiva na ca tādātmyaveditā |
ākarṣaṇaṃ tato naiva māhātmyaṃ tu kutastadā ||55||
na kathāśravaṇe tasya na vārtāśravaṇe’pi mut |
nājñāgrahaṇe cotsāhaḥ prītirgāḍhā kutastadā ||56||
śṛṇu lakṣmi yathā te’sti mayi svāmitvabhāvanā |
tvayi dāsītvamevāsti tatra bhedo na vidyate ||57||
tāḍitā dharṣitākruṣṭā vanditā vā tiraskṛtā |
tathāpi tvaṃ kadācinna viruddhā kintu sevikā ||58||
mayi sarvasvabhāvena cāsattā muditā sadā |
nisargaguṇagṛhiṇī bhaktā dāsī prasevase ||59||
na tatra nimnatābhāvo mayi te svāmini kvacit |
tathā yeṣāṃ sādhuvarge nimnabhāvo na vai kvacit ||3.189.60||
sāmyabhāvo’pi yeṣāṃ na kintūtkṛṣṭā hi bhāvanā |
māhātmyaṃ divyatā yeṣāṃ nirguṇatvaṃ ca sādhuṣu ||61||
sādhukriyāsu sarvāsu kalyāṇadatvabhāvanā |
śubhāśubhāyāṃ pravṛttau puṇyapradatvabhāvanā ||62||
yeṣāṃ vai vartate teṣāṃ svāmitvaṃ satsu vai sadā |
bhāvitaṃ divyaphaladaṃ divyamokṣapradaṃ bhavet ||63||
māyākālādikarmādibandhacchedakaraṃ bhavet |
yathā sneho nijapatnyāṃ yathā putre kuṭumbiṣu ||64||
yathā pitroryathā putryāṃ yathā bhṛtyāsu sevake |
sevikāyāṃ yathā snehastathā kuryāddhi sādhuṣu ||65||
laukiko’pi snehabhāvo divyatāṃ yāti sādhuṣu |
sādhoḥ prasannatālabdhyā sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prasiddhyati ||66||
yathā patnyā nije kānte dṛśyante dūṣaṇāni na |
kuceṣṭāḥ kusvabhāvāśca dṛśyante sadguṇā yathā ||67||
tathā sādhuṣu vai lakṣmi yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭistu nirmalā |
dṛśyante durguṇāścāpi sadguṇā eva sarvathā ||68||
te eva prāpya saṃyogaṃ prasannatāṃ satāṃ śubhām |
āśīrvādān samarjyāpi sevālābhamavāpya ca ||69||
snehaṃ labdhvā tathā prītiṃ labdhvā cātmaniveditām |
ātmaratiṃ parāṃ prāpya taranti bhavasāgarāt ||3.189.70||
teṣāṃ sneho bhavedeva sastu strīputrato’dhikaḥ |
sa eva māyāṃ tarati sādhusnehena pāvitaḥ ||71 ||
naro vā strī ca vā ṣaṇḍhaḥ sādhau snehāt pramucyate |
satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyetat sādhurūpo bhavāmyaham ||72||
manmāhātmyaṃ tu sādhubhyo jñāyate nānyataḥ kvacit |
sādhavo hṛdayaṃ mahyaṃ sādhau vāsaḥ sadā mama ||73||
sādhusantoṣaṇe tṛptirmamaiva jāyate rame |
sādhavaḥ pāvanāḥ santi nakhaśikhāntamūrtayaḥ ||74||
śṛṇu lakṣmi pare duṣṭā sādhūnudvejayanti vai |
bhojane jalapāne cāsane satkārakarmasu ||75||
ātithye śuśrūṣaṇe ca śramayanti sato janān |
bhṛtyatvaṃ kārayantyeva sādhūn gurūn mahājanān ||76||
dhīhīnāste pāpapuñjaṃ tvarjayanti tathākriyāḥ |
kecit sādhūnnijapatnīsamān matvā subhojane ||77||
yojayanti svabhojyārthaṃ pācayanti ca bhojanam |
kecijjalasya pānārthaṃ pātraṃ jalaṃ ca śītalam ||78||
ubhayaṃ taddhi yācante yathā bhṛtyāttathā sataḥ |
kejidajñā gendukādi nijāsanaṃ tu suptaye ||79||
kārayanti sārayanti yathā dāsyāstathā sataḥ |
kecidajñā ūṣṇajalaṃ tathoṣṇaṃ bhojanaṃ navam ||3.189.80||
kārayanti nijārthaṃ vai yathā bhṛtyāttathā sataḥ |
kejidajñā vācayanti nijāṃ puṣṭiṃ sabhāsu vai ||8 1||
praśaṃsāṃ kārayantyeva yathā dūtāttathā sataḥ |
yathā tu cāraṇāt tadvat sūtādvā ca tathā sataḥ ||82||
kecinmadānvitā naijāṃ peṭikāṃ vastugauravām |
vāhayanti satāṃ hastairmastakenābhimāninaḥ ||83||
kecid duṣṭā dīnasādhūn nāmayanti prasahya vai |
stavanaṃ tu nijaṃ duṣṭāḥ kārayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||84||
etādṛśāstu pāpā vai pāpaparvatasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
dhanānnavarjitāścātra bhramanto viramanti ca ||85||
sādhudvāropadeśena sādhayanti svamarthakam |
svārthaparāste kuśalāścānte yānti yamālayam ||86||
sādhuṣu nijasattāṃ ye dhārayanti ca māninaḥ |
āhaṃkārikavṛttāntāste’pi yānti yamālayam ||87||
sādhvālaye cākasmikīṃ kurvanti mārgaṇāṃ tu ye |
sādhuṣu ca mṛṣā doṣaṃ kalaṅkaṃ ca dadatyapi ||88||
kukhyātima ca prakurvanti sādhūnāṃ ye tu nirdayāḥ |
dveṣṭāraḥ sādhuvargasya te yānti vai yamālayam ||89||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā sādhūn nindanti veṣadhāraṇe |
jīrṇavastramapi khaṇḍaṃ naiva dadati ye kvacit ||3.189.90||
nindanti tu parairdattaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sumūlyamambaram |
śuddhaṃ ca raṃgasaṃśobhaṃ nindantyuktvā tu rājasam ||91||
pātraṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca nindanti vai satāṃ tathā |
sādhoḥ śālāṃ bhavanaṃ ca kuṭīṃ nindati vai tathā | |92||
aujjvalyaṃ cāpi nindanti nindanti dānamarpitam |
dravyārpaṇaṃ ca nindanti gandhasāraṃ ca mardanam ||93||
oṣadhādyaṃ ca nindanti rakṣaṇaṃ ca yathākṛtam |
nindanti gomahiṣyādidhanaṃ sādhubhirarjitam ||94||
paropakāraprabhṛti nindanti sādhusevitam |
bhikṣāṭanaṃ tapaścāpi nindanti matsarānvitāḥ ||95||
prajvalanti samīkṣyaiva sato devālayaṃ satīḥ |
divyasaṃsthā vilokyāpi projjvalantyāsurā janāḥ ||96||
ta ete kamale yānti dehānte pāpasaṃsṛtim |
pīḍyante yāmyalokeṣu duḥkhiyoniṣu vai muhuḥ ||97||
tasmāt sādhuṃ mama veṣadharaṃ vai pūjayet sadā |
māṃ vibhāvyābhiseveta prasannayet śubhārpaṇaiḥ ||98||
prasādayedanuvṛttyā sarvasvārpaṇakaistathā |
bhaktiṃ kṛtvā hareścāpi prasādayet sato janān ||99||
guruṃ prasevayennityaṃ pitarau sevayet sadā |
patiṃ prasevayedbhaktyā sādhuṃ bhaktyābhirañjayet || 3.189.100||
prabhuṃ bhajeta bhāvaiśca śraddhayā kīrtayeddharim |
devārpaṇaṃ sadā kuryāt kuṭumbaṃ tu prapoṣayet || 101 ||
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāya naivedyaṃ dhṛtvā bhuñjīta nānyathā |
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ bhuktirmuktiḥ kare sthitā | ||1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāddhāraṇādapi |
sādhusevāphalaṃ syācca bhogānte mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet| ||1 03||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sādhusamāgamena bhagavaccintāmaṇilabdhyā sarvakāmanāpūrttyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 189 ||

<3.190>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām |
mahāsaurāṣṭradeśīyā bhaktāḥ saṅghagatāḥ śatam || 1 ||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ somanāthaṃ ca raivatam |
svarṇavatīṃ kṛṣṇabhūmiṃ gopanārthaṃ ca sundaram || 2 ||
evamādīni tīrthāni kartuṃ saurāṣṭramāyayuḥ |
mārge mahīṃ tathā vāpīṃ tīrtvā nāvā tataḥ param || 3 ||
sābhramatīṃ samuttīrya gopanāthaṃ samāyayuḥ |

uttārayitvā tvekatra kārayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ || 9 ||

anye’pi bālagopālā ruruduḥ sasmaruḥ prabhum || 16||

kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe’rpayiṣyāmo dhanādikam |

vipattau cārttadīneśa śaraṇāgatarakṣaka |
