<3.191>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi bālikāśca bālakāścāpi vihvalāḥ |
astuvanmāṃ svarakṣārthaṃ yadahaṃ śrutavām̐stadā || 1 ||
divodāsasutāṃ divyādevīṃ bhāgyavihīnakām |
kaṣṭādvimucya naijāṃ yaścakre’kṣare’nayacca tām || 2 ||
bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa bhagavān naḥ prarakṣatu sevikāḥ |
bhillībhillau tava sādhoryogānmokṣaṃ gatau purā || 3 ||
subāhunṛpatirbhāryāsahitaḥ sādhusaṃśrayāt |
tava pratāpataḥ kṛṣṇa mokṣamārgaṃ yayau purā || 4 ||
aśokasundarīṃ kanyāṃ satīśaṃkaraputrikām |
tvaṃ rarakṣa purā kṛṣṇa naḥ prarakṣaya sevikāḥ || 5 ||
vihuṇḍasya vināśārthaṃ nārīrūpo’bhavaḥ purā |
kāmodāyāḥ patistvaṃ sa naḥ prarakṣatu sevikāḥ || 6 ||
śukamokṣapradastvaṃ naḥ prarakṣa nijabālikāḥ |
khaśo nāmnā viṣṇudāso rāmaṇī cāsya bhāminī || 7 ||
līlāvatī ca tatkanyā puroddhṛtāstvayā prabho |
gaṇikānāṃ purā kṛṣṇa pāpāni tu tvayā vibho || 8 ||
kṛtvā puṇyasvarūpāṇi puṇyajanān vyadhāstadā |
gaṇikā yoginīścāpi kṛtavām̐stvaṃ purā prabho || 9 ||
rakṣānāmnyāḥ śvapacyāstvaṃ sumarasya tu yoṣitaḥ |
muktidātābhavaḥ kṛṣṇa naḥ sa rakṣatu sevikāḥ || 1 0||
kauśikaṃ garuḍaṃ cakre gāyakaṃ yaḥ purā prabhuḥ |
mālavaṃ nāma vaiśyaṃ ca tathānyān gānakovidān || 11 ||
brahmalokaṃ hyanayad yo naḥ sa rakṣatu sevikāḥ |
harimiśraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo dadau mokṣaṃ sa pātu naḥ || 1 2||
cidambarāmahārājñyai jiṣṇupatnyai purā bhavān |
gadāṃ samarpya rakṣāṃ cākarod bhadrakarākṣasāt || 1 3||
prajāśca jīvināstasyāḥ sa no rakṣatu sevikāḥ |
raṇeśvaryaḥ kṛtā naijā brahmapriyā gadāsutāḥ || 14||
yena nārāyaṇenāpi kṛṣṇaḥ sa naḥ prarakṣatu |
raṇeśvarāstathā muktāḥ kṛtā yena sa rakṣatu ||15||
bindumatyāḥ kṛto yena mokṣo yayātiyoṣitaḥ |
sa hariluṇṭakebhyaścāvanaṃ karotu mādhavaḥ || 16||
paraśucandrako yena nārāyaṇena tāritaḥ |
so’yaṃ kāntaguṇaḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣatu nijasevikāḥ || 17||
sucandrikāṃ gopapatnīṃ gopālaṃ tatpatiṃ tathā |
anayad yokṣaraṃ dhāma sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu || 18||
hariprathamanoḥ patnī brahmapathākṣaraṃ pratiṃ |
prāpitā yena hariṇā sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu || 1 9||
gṛdhrāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yena kṛtaṃ purā parātmanā |
bālakṛṣṇo harikṛṣṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||20||
jīvacandrāya muktiṃ yo dadau kṛṣṇaḥ sa rakṣatu |
śatānandavinodinyoḥ putrāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ||21 ||
yena śrīhariṇā kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva naḥ prarakṣatu |
kāśīvārāṃganābhyo yo muktidaḥ sa prarakṣatu ||22||
vṛṣāyanena caṭakā yadbalena prarakṣitā |
bālakṛṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||23 ||
citraketośca mālatyā rājñyā muktiḥ kṛtā purā |
yena śrībālakṛṣṇena kṛṣṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu ||24||
śreṣṭhā yena kṛtāḥ santaḥ sa naḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu |
kṛśāṃgakaḥ kṛto yena kṛśānuḥ sa prarakṣatu ||25|||
bhaṃgāsvanaḥ kṛto yena naro nārī muhurmuhuḥ |
sa eva bhagavān kṛṣṇo rakṣatvatra svasevikāḥ || 16||
vipulaṃ ca ruciṃ devaśarmāṇaṃ yo rarakṣa ha |
mokṣado bhagavān kṛṣṇo duḥkhādasmāt prarakṣatu ||27||
gokarṇākhye purā tīrthe ṛṣayo yena vāsitā |
sa eva bhagavānasmān luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu || 28 ||
kuvalāśvaṃ tathottaṃkaṃ satyavrataṃ ca gālavam |
śreyase kalpayāmāsa yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu ||29||
yatpratāpena ca praṇadbrahmasādhuḥ pratāpavān |
samabhavat sa kṛṣṇo no luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||3 0 ||
keśariṇīsutaścālambāyano muktimāpa vai |
yatpratāpena kṛṣṇaḥ sa luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||3 1 ||
gokarṇasthān lakṣasādhūn ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ tu yaḥ |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ priyaḥ kānto naḥ prarakṣatu vallabhāḥ ||32||
śabaro rākṣaso yena mocito bhavabandhanāt |
gṛdhraśca śvapacaścāpi sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||33||
khyātiṃ śāpaparāṃ vīkṣya cakarta yastu tacchiraḥ |
sa naḥ kṛṣṇo luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||34||
bhāruṇḍaḥ puṣkaso yena tāritaḥ sa prarakṣatu |
vṛṣādarbhiḥ kṛto yena muktaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa rakṣatu ||35||
naraśāyastaskarastu mocito yena cakriṇā |
dhanino mocitā yena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||36||
kundadharmāvitā yenāvitaśca jāṃghalāmakhaḥ |
bālakṛṣṇo divyakāntaḥ kanyakā naḥ prarakṣatu ||37||
yena śaṃbhalavāro’pi prajayā saha mocitaḥ |
bālaḥkṛṣṇo vallabho’tra prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||38||
devānīkadivyavaṃśe bālakṛṣṇo vyajāyata |
sa eva bhagavānatra prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||39||
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālajanuṣe namaḥ ||40||
dīrghaśīlo vipravaryo mocito yamapāśataḥ |
yena śrīhariṇā so’yaṃ prarakṣatu svadāsikāḥ ||41 ||
brahmasatī brāhmaṇī yā mocitā paramātmanā |
so’yaṃ no bhagavānnāthaḥ prarakṣatu svasevikāḥ ||42||
kālaṃdharā mahārājñī vaivartto nāma bhūpatiḥ |
mocitau yena kṛṣṇena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||43||
romapādasya vai putro vṛṣagamo’pi viṣṇunā |
mocito yena kṛṣṇena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||44||
nagrabhaṃgaḥ purā cauro mocito yena viṣṇunā |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu ||45||
bhaṇḍāsuro hato lalitādvārā yena cakriṇā |
sa cāsmānnatra kṛṣṇaśrīkṛṣṇo rakṣatu sevikāḥ ||46||
lalitāmānasīkanyāḥ koṭiśaḥ svīkṛtāḥ purā |
yena śrīparameśena sa kṛṣṇo’vatu sevikāḥ ||47||
lohāṃgārasya vaiśyasya mokṣakṛnnaḥ prarakṣatu |
pīvaryādyā vrate yena pūrṇakāmā nirūpitāḥ ||48||
so’yaṃ kṛṣṇo luṇṭakebhyo naḥ prarakṣatu dāsikāḥ |
vasiṣṭhāgastyakau śāpānmocitau yena śārṅgiṇā ||49||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naḥ sa prarakṣatu |
paruṣo lubdhako yena mocito bhāryayā saha ||50||
puṣkaravāhanasyāpi mokṣakṛnnaḥ prarakṣatu |
sarojinī kuṃbhakartrī satīśvarīkṛpānvitā ||5 1 ||
padminī sābhavad yasya kṛpayā kamalāsamā |
sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prabhuścāsmān luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||5 2||
dharmatapaso viprasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtavām̐stu yaḥ |
surathasya manutvaṃ ca kṛtavān śrīpatistu yaḥ ||5 3||
dhanavarmā divaṃ yena preṣitaḥ paramātmanā |
balīśvarastathā rājye sthāpito mānave dvijaḥ ||14||
ānandavarṇī yenāpi sthāpito mānave tathā |
rājye ghṛṇeṣikaḥ śūdraḥ sthāpito yena mānave ||55||
bhūtiśca tarito yena kṛṣṇa rakṣatu sevikāḥ |
asuro bālako yenoddhṛto’sya maṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ ||56||
bāṣkalirnāśito yena viṣṇurnaḥ saṃprakṣatu |
gajanārāyaṇenāpi purukṛsaro ghātitaḥ ||57||
pralambo nāśito yena matsyātmakena śārṅgiṇā |
bhīmaratho ghātitaśca kūrmarūpeṇa yena vai ||58||
śāntaśatrurghātitaśca haṃsarūpeṇa yena hi |
mahākālo nāśitaśca hayagrīveṇa yena tu ||59||
hiraṇyākṣavihantā sa kṛṣṇo’vatu svasevikāḥ |
vāmano’vatu kṛṣṇaśca kālakākṣavināśakṛt ||60||
baliśatrvasurahantā harirduḥkhaṃ vyapohatu |
daśagrīvavihantā ca nārīrūpo’vatu prabhuḥ ||61 ||
tārakaghno harirnapuṃsakarūpo’pi rakṣatu |
ṭiṭṭibho vihato yena māyūrarūpiṇā purā ||62||
śuciśca ghātito yena cakriṇā naḥ sa rakṣatu |
sādhubhāvāyanarṣeśca tathā śrīmānasasya ca ||63||
cidānandasyāpi mokṣakṛt kṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu |
sadvidyāyanapatnīṃ yaḥ śrutiphalāṃ hyamokṣayat ||64||
alarkajananīmokṣaṃ kṛtavān sa prarakṣatu |
muktisrotāyanaścāpi siddhiveṣāyanastathā ||65||
ayācitāñjalibhāryā bhikṣāyanaṛṣiḥ patiḥ |
muktā yasyāśrayeṇaiṣaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo naḥ prarakṣatu ||66||
mātā nityāśrayā putraḥ keśī yena pramocitau |
bālakṛṣṇo mahārājaḥ sa nastvatra prarakṣatu ||67||
mātā tu cāraṇī putro vyāghraśca yena tāritau |
kūṭadevaḥ pitā sādhuḥ śyāmaśca yena tāritau ||68||
uttamaścāpi bhūdevo devāyanaṛṣistathā |
kaṣṭāt pramocitau yena kṛṣṇo rakṣatu sevikā ||69||
yena virālako vaiśyaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samuddhṛtaḥ |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ priyaprāṇo luṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣatu ||70||
pṛthvīdharo nṛpo madhuvindā rājñī samuddhṛtau |
tathā durvoḍhako dīnaścoddhṛto yena so’vatu ||71 ||
sāgaraḥ śūdrakaścāpi venapālābhidho nṛpaḥ |
hīrukā śūdrapatnī ca rakṣitā yena so’vatu ||72||
vṛkṇadevo bhāvaśūraḥ śīladharmāsatī tathā |
mocitā yena kṛṣṇena so’yaṃ rakṣatu sevikāḥ ||73||
mañjulakeśo bhūdevaḥ pāśupateśaviprarāṭ |
bāṇāṃgaṇastathā śūdro rakṣitā yena so’vatu ||74||
mṛtādanaḥ santadāso dharmaśālāyanastathā |
śaṃkudharaścoddhṛtāśca yena so’vatu sevikāḥ ||75||
luṇṭakādhipatiścāyaṃ nāmnā sāmantavikramaḥ |
luṇṭayatyatisarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇa hā kṛṣṇa rakṣa naḥ ||76||
tava smo’tra tava smo’tra tvatsevikāḥ prarakṣaya |
antarātman vyāpakātman bhūmannatra prarakṣaya ||77||
bālakāścāpi vai kṛṣṇastavanaṃ cakrire tathā |
śrutvāhaṃ sahasā tatra śatarūpo’bhavaṃ rame ||78||
aśvavārā uṣṭravārāḥ saśastrā bhūbhṛto bhaṭāḥ |
pañcāśadvegato dūrādāgatā rakṣaṇāya vai ||79||
uccairākrośamādadhyuḥ sajjāścaurā bhavantviti |
mārayiṣyāma evātra jāyantāṃ mātṛputrakāḥ || 80||
evaṃ nādān śrāvayanto sphoṭayanto hi dhūṣkṛtīḥ |
uṣṭrāśvādyaiḥ kṣaṇād dikṣu daśasvāvṛttayam̐śca tān ||81 ||
vartule cauralokām̐stānāvṛtya rājapārṣadāḥ |
dharṣayituṃ daṇḍayituṃ tāḍayituṃ puro’gaman ||82||
tāvatte roṣamāpannā jīvanāśāṃ vihāya vai |
dudruvurmadhyadeśācca dhūṣkṛtīsphoṭakāriṇaḥ ||83||
tadā me pārṣadairlakṣmi dhūṣkṛtayaḥ sphoṭitā drutam |
yuddhaṃ parasparaṃ jātaṃ dhūṣkṛtīgolikāmayam ||84||
mayā te golikāyantrairviddhāḥ sarve’tigarvitāḥ |
mṛtāste tatra pañcāśatsarve golyabhibheditāḥ ||85||
tān sarvānanayaṃ svargaṃ mama hastairmṛtānataḥ |
mocitān bhaktavaṇijastato’haṃ samasāntvayam ||86||
te sarve śaraṇaṃ prāptā narā nāryaśca bālikāḥ |
bālāśca petuścaraṇe mama sainyaparūpiṇaḥ ||87||
athāhamadadāṃ teṣāṃ sañcayātma dhanaṃ tathā |
bhūṣāmbarādisarvasvaṃ yathā yeṣāṃ tathādadām ||88||
sarve te sukhino jātāstāḍitāṃgeṣu cāspṛśam |
nīrujaste’bhavam̐ścāpi nīrbhayāścābhavam̐śca te ||89||
athāhaṃ sahasā lakṣmi vājyuṣṭrabhaṭavigrahān |
tirobhāvyābhavam̐ścaikaścaturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ ||3.191.90||
vanacandraṃ sukhādevīṃ darśanaṃ svamakārayam |
anyebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tadā ||91||
paramāścaryamāpannā nipetuḥ pādayośca me |
sarve te śaraṇaṃ prāptā bhaktā bhaktasamāstathā ||92||
athāhamadadāṃ tebhyo mantraṃ me’raṇyamaṇḍale |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||93||
harekṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa  |
brahmapriyāpate rādhālakṣmīpate’vanaṃ kuru ||94||
vaiṣṇavīṃ vai mahādīkṣāṃ dattavān kamale tadā |
sarvānaraṇyadeśām̐ścollaṅghayitvā tataḥ param ||95||
sarvānāpṛcchatha kuśalaṃ tīrthamārgaṃ pradarśya ca |
tiro’bhavaṃ tatra lakṣmi te’pi śanaiḥ prabhāsakam ||96||
yayustato raivataṃ ca tato’śvapaṭṭamāyayuḥ |
mānatā yāḥ kṛtāścāsam̐stīrthadānapratātmikāḥ ||97||
sarvasvārpaṇarūpāśca tāḥ sarvāste vyadhustadā |
mama pūjāṃ pracakruśca satāṃ sevāṃ vyadhustathā ||98||
svasthāḥ sarve mama bhaktiṃ cakrustīrthaṃ samastakam |
atha te svarṇanagarīṃ camatkārapurīṃ yayuḥ ||99||
prāpurdeśaṃ tato naijaṃ bhaktiṃ cakrurhi me sadā |
tāritā rakṣitāścāpi dehānte mama dhāma ca | | 3.191.1 00||
prāpitāste mayā lakṣmi mama bhaktaprasaṃginaḥ |
caurāste luṇṭakāścāpi mama svarūpavedinaḥ ||1 01||
prāpitā vai mayā svargādante vaikuṇṭhadhāma hi |
evaṃ dayāparaścāhaṃ rakṣāmi ca nayāmi ca || 1 02||
mocayāmi bhavapāśāduddharāmi mamāśritān |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne luṇṭakebhyo rakṣārthaṃ strībālikāstutyuttaraṃ rājabhaṭādirūpadhāriṇāśrīhariṇāluṇṭakā hatā bhaktāstu rakṣitā ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 191 ||

<3.192>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm |
purā dhaniṣṭhakoṣākhyo vipro’bhavad dhanādimān || 1 ||
yajñayāgakaraścāpi pañcāyatanapūjakaḥ |
bhaktiparo’tidānī ca gosahasradhanastathā || 2 ||
kṣetravāṭyaraṇyapatirvyavasāyodyamānvitaḥ |
lakṣāṇi svarṇarūpyāṇāṃ yatkoṣe santi vai sadā || 3 ||
rājamānyo’pi bahudhā yuddhapureśamānitaḥ |
rājā mālavasiṃhaśca nityaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ śubham || 4 ||
dadātyasmai mahāsaudhe sabhāyāṃ gauravorjitam |
rājyātidurvahe kārye’syaivānumatimṛcchati || 5 ||
yathāmukhyapradhānaṃ vai tathā vipraṃ samarhati |
utsaveṣu samasteṣu vihāreṣu prapāsane || 6 ||
samājeṣu śubhe sarvavidheye manute dvijam |
prajānāmanurāgaścābhavaddhaniṣṭhakoṣake || 7 ||
dhanānāṃ sa pradānaṃ vai sāhāyyārthaṃ prajāsu ha |
prakaroti vinā lekhaṃ vacomūlyaṃ hi satyatā || 8 ||
dīnānāṃ ca daridrāṇāmanāthānāṃ ca yoṣitām |
sādhūnāṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca vastrānnādisahāyakṛt || 9 ||
gṛhadānāni bahūni mandirāṇi bahūnyapi |
dharmaśālāḥ sādhumaṭhānuddadhāra sujīrṇitān || 3.192.1 0||
prapāstathānnasatrāṇi kārayāmāsa rājavat |
rājāpi tena sarvatra sāhāyyado’sya vartate || 11 ||
dhaniṣṭhakoṣo nityaṃ māṃ bhajate parameśvaram |
snātvā sampūjya māṃ bhūpaṃ militvātha tataḥ param || 12||
pañcadevādikānnatvā bhuṃkte nityaṃ na cānyathā |
kuṭumbaṃ tasya bhaktaṃ me sadā māṃ bhajate rame || 1 3||
atha rājyamado lakṣmi mado dhanasya vai tathā |
yauvanasya madaścāpi vipathaṃ nayate janam || 14||
indriyāṇāṃ pravegaśca viṣayāṇāmupasthitiḥ |
manasaścāpi cāñcalyaṃ bhaktaṃ kṣipati kalmaṣe ||15||
nityaṃ nṛtyasya yoge vā nityaṃ vādyasamājake |
nityaṃ śṛṃgārabhāvo vā rajobhāvo vivardhate || 1 6||
nityaṃ viṣayayogāśca nityaṃ padārthayogitā |
harate vegavaccittaṃ nimnagamanaśāli yat || 17||
tathaivāsya subhaktasya rājasaṃsadi vartanam |
vārāṃganādinṛtyeṣu hyupasthitirniśādiṣu || 18||
dāsīnāṃ sahavāsādyairmano vikāramāptavat |
surūpā api lobhinyo dhanavāñcchāvimohikāḥ || 1 9||
vārayoṣā hāvabhāvaiḥ sevanaiḥ sahavāsanaiḥ |
cikṣipurmama bhaktaṃ taṃ mohe dhaniṣṭhakoṣakam ||3.192.20||
viṣayeṣu suramyeṣu magnaṃ cakruḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
dhanahāryo dhanaṃ labdhvā bhogyāstiṣṭhanti tatpuraḥ ||21 ||
bhakto’pi mama bhaktiṃ ca vihāya rājasaṃgataḥ |
rājodyāne sadāvāsaṃ prāyaśaścācarattataḥ ||22||
kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ kvacinnibhālayatyeva cireṇa saḥ |
bahudhodyānavāsaṃ sa rājñā samaṃ karoti yat ||23||
rājāpi bālamitraṃ yat sadā taṃ sevate saha |
pānabhojanakhelādyairnṛtyagāyanarañjanaiḥ ||24||
evaṃ bhaktasya saṃyoge viṣayairbāhyavṛttibhiḥ |
pūjanaṃ paṭhanaṃ dhyānaṃ mama sarvaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||25||
kṣatimāptaṃ layaṃ prāptaṃ bhaktirme khaṇḍitābhavat |
smarati māṃ kadācit sa viśeṣeṇa tu yoṣitaḥ ||26||
vārāṃganābhiḥ sañjuṣṭo vartate sa vyavāyakṛt |
athāsya putrāḥ putryaśca patnī sādhvī sadharmiṇī ||27||
nāmnā snehalatādevī śuśoca svapatisthitim |
mahābhāgavatī patnī bhajate śrīhariṃ tu mām ||28||
prārthayatyeva pūjāyāṃ patyurdharmasya rakṣaṇam |
adharmasya parityāgaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ suvaṃśajām ||29||
bālakṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇa puruṣottamamādhava |
tava bhaktasya citte yaccāñcalyaṃ tatpraśāmaya ||3.192.3 0||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntakeśava |
mama patyurvyavāyasya vyasanaṃ tvaṃ pramocaya ||3 1 ||
rājāpi tava bhaktaḥ syāttathā kṛṣṇa vidhehi ca |
gaṇikā api bhaktāḥ syuryathā te paramātmanaḥ ||32||
prajāścāpi ca bhaktāḥ syustathā kṛṣṇa kṛpāṃ kuru |
vrataṃ cādyadināt te’haṃ varṣāntaṃ tvekabhojanam ||33||
kariṣye ca tathā sāghusatīsevā samāhitā |
pratyahaṃ pūjanaṃ te ca kariṣye ghaṭikāvadhim ||34||
ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca kārayiṣye tu sūtake |
preṃkhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ cāpi mūrtiṃ svarṇamayīṃ ca te ||35||
kārayiṣye śriyā yuktāṃ rādhayā ramayā yutām |
padmāvatyā yutāṃ yuktāṃ māṇikyayā ca śobhanām ||36||
lakṣmyā yuktāṃ tathā ramyāṃ vibhūṣāḍhyāṃ suyauvanām |
śayyāparyaṃkamevāpi kārayiṣye śubhottamām ||37||
svarṇarājatajanyaṃ ca tavopakaraṇānyapi |
vyajane cāmare chatraṃ pāduke bhūṣaṇāni ca ||38||
kārayiṣye svarṇaratnamayāni tava tuṣṭaye |
nityaṃ sugandhasāraiśca tailasāraiśca mardanam || 39||
abhyañjanaṃ dravaiścāpi pūjanaṃ tulasīdalaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ ghṛtamiṣṭānaiḥ kārayiṣye’tituṣṭaye ||3.192.40||
tavotsavān kārayiṣye vārṣikān kānta keśava |
vaṇijaṃ me patiṃ vārāṃganāvyasanānmocaya ||41 ||
eṣā te śaraṇaṃ prāptā patitā tava pādayoḥ |
mama patyustu pāpāni prajvālaya priyaṃ kuru ||42||
ityuktvā snehalatikā dīpotsavīdine hareḥ |
kṛtvā me pūjanaṃ cāpyāsamvatsaraṃ vrataṃ vyadhāt ||43||
uktān sarvānniyamān sā pālayāmāsa bhāvukī |
patisaṃskārakaṃ nāma vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ vyadhāddhi sā ||44||
udyāpanaṃ vratasyāpi cakre’nnakūṭavaddine |
pratipadyeva kṛṣṇasyotsavaṃ ca vratapūrtaye ||45||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa kadalīstambhaśobhitam |
toraṇādiyutaṃ ramyaṃ kuṇḍavedīsamanvitam ||46||
siṃhāsanānvitaṃ vipradevatādivirājitam |
havyakavyādisāmagrīdānasāmagrikāyutam ||47||
samidvahniyajñakarmavedamantradhvaniśrutam |
sādhusādhvīviṣṇubhaktakṛtapāṭhādighoṣitam ||48||
vādyakīrtanagītyādyairghoṣitaṃ dānavardhitam |
satyasvarādilokānāṃ vāsibhiḥ samadhiṣṭhitam ||49||
torthāgamairdivyabhāvaṃ kṛṣṇapārṣadarājitam |
brahmapriyāvilasitaṃ dhvajapatākikānvitam ||3.192.50||
sarvatobhadranāmārthaśreṣṭhamaṇḍalaśobhitam |
sthālīkalaśapātrādyaiḥ śayyādānādibhiryutam ||51||
pūjāsāmagrikābhiśca pūjyate yatra mādhavaḥ |
hūyate yatra vahnau ca havyaṃ vividhajātikam |||52||
uccāryante vedaghoṣā mantrā yatra ca bhūsuraiḥ |
dīyante yatra dānāni svarṇarūpyamayāni ca ||93||
bhujyante bhojanānīṣṭamiṣṭānnāni ca bhūsuraiḥ |
dīyante tṛptacittaiścāśīrvādāḥ śreyasāṃpradāḥ ||54||
pūrṇāhutirghṛtānāṃ ca dhārābhirdīyate tadā |
āyayau maṇḍape tatra vṛddho nārāyaṇo naraḥ ||55||
viprarūpo’titejasvī lakṣmi yo’haṃ sa eva saḥ |
svāgataṃ cārhaṇaṃ cakrurdevā me ṛṣayo’pi ca ||56||
āsanaṃ me daduḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vahnirmāṃ cāpyapūjayat |
upāviveśa tatrāhaṃ sarvasammānito dvijaḥ ||57||
kasya yajña ityahaṃ vai cāpṛcchaṃ vedhasaṃ dvijam |
somāyano dvijaḥ sopyuvāca māṃ cāṃgulidṛśā ||58||
asyāḥ snehalatikāyā vratodyāpanajo’dhvaraḥ |
vidyate’dyeṣṭasiddhyarthamasyā iṣṭaṃ bhavatviha ||59||
bhavatviṣṭamiti drāk cāvadaṃ tatrādhvare’pyaham |
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ tadodyāne vyajāyata ||3.192.60||
yatra saudhe mahān śreṣṭhī rājā bhṛtyā vasanti ca |
saudhaḥ sa kampito jāto yathā bhūkampakampitaḥ ||61 ||
udyānasahitaḥ saudho nānyat kiñcittadā rame |
madicchayaiva jātaḥ sa kampo bhayāvahastadā ||62||
saudhastu patitastena vārāṃganāḥ pracūrṇitāḥ |
rājā śreṣṭhī saudhapāte madhyāvakāśake stare ||63||
patitau tatra bhagnāṃgau kintu prajīvitau dare |
sahaiva patitau mūrchāvigame bhānasaṃyutau ||64||
parasparaṃ cāhvayataḥ kā daśā te dhanina nṛpa |
dhanī prāha mama pādo bhagno jānupradeśataḥ ||65||
nṛpaḥ prāha mama hasto bhagnaḥ kaphoṇikāsthalāt |
nānyad duḥkhaṃ vartate’tra prāṇāstiṣṭhanti cāvayoḥ ||66||
maraṇaṃ naiva jātaṃ vai parameśakṛtā tviyam |
āvābhyāṃ śrīharermārgastyaktvā vārāṃganāgatiḥ ||67||
gṛhītā pāpadā tasyāḥ phalaṃ tvidaṃ vināśakṛt |
tathāpi pūrvapuṇyena yadvā sambandhipuṇyataḥ ||68||
jīvāvo daramadhye’tra kṛṣṇadattāvakāśake |
adyaprabhṛti veśyānāṃ saṃgaṃ tyakṣyāva eva ha ||69||
parameśaṃ bhajiṣyāvo kariṣyāvo vratāni ca |
yadyetasmād durgamādvai durvibhāvyāvakāśakāt | |3.192.70||
nirgamiṣyāma evāvāṃ saprāṇau bhagnamadhyataḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ bhajāvo’tra sa nau rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ||71 ||
evaṃ tau nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā harekṛṣṇeti jepatuḥ |
lakṣmi tau snehalatikādhvarapuṇyena rakṣitau ||72||
atha yuddhapure tūrṇaṃ yajñapūrṇāhuteḥ param |
rājaprāsādapatanaṃ cāśrūyata prajāmukhāt ||73||
nāstikyastu prajāḥ prāhuryajñe vyutkramajaṃ phalam |
vāstavikaṃ na tattatra vyutkramo nābhavanmakhe ||74||
madicchayā hi tajjātaṃ pāpena śreṣṭhino’pi ca |
vārāṃganā mama bhaktapātanena sakalmaṣāḥ ||75||
mṛtā eva svapāpena bhaktastu rakṣito mayā |
rājāpi bhaktayogena bhaktyarthaṃ rakṣito mayā ||76||
āstikāstu tadā prāhuḥ pāpā mṛtāḥ svapātakaiḥ |
athāpi yajñapuṇyena na mṛtau śreṣṭhibhūbhṛtau ||77||
manuṣyāśca drutaṃ gatvā kāṭamālaṃ samastakam |
śanaiḥ kṛtvā dūramevotsārya pāṣāṇamṛttikāḥ ||78||
kāṣṭhādhobhāgasaṃvāsau sajīvau śreṣṭhibhūbhatau |
śanairnissārayāmāsurbhagnāṃgauṣadhamācaran ||79||
gaṇikāstu samastāstāḥ śavātmikāḥ prakūrcitāḥ |
mṛtā evopalabdhāstā yāmyapuraṃ siṣevire ||3.192.80||
vṛddhaspṛṣṭau vaṇig rājā svasthapādakarau drutam |
sampannau cādhvaravārtāṃ śrutvā praharṣitau hyati ||81 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vṛddhasvarūpadhṛk |
hastābhyāṃ tau supasparśa mūḍhamāro vyalīyata ||82||
pīḍāpi vigatā sarvā maṇḍape tau samāgatau |
dṛṣṭavantau puṇyakāryaṃ śrutavantau striyā vratam ||83||
patidevasya śuddhyarthaṃ rājñaḥ śuddhyarthamityapi |
prajāyāścāpi śuddhyarthaṃ vrataṃ jñātvā striyāstadā ||84||
prajā rājā dhanī sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ pativratām |
dhanyā nārī harerbhaktā mokṣārthinī ca pāvanī ||85||
śreyaso’rthe prajādīnāṃ yayā vrataṃ ciraṃ dhṛtam |
yayā dravyāṇi naijāni daivakārye kṛtāni ca ||86||
asyāḥ puṇyena bhūpo’yaṃ śreṣṭhī ceti prarakṣitau |
vayaṃ sarve bhajiṣyāmo nārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||87||
rājāpi maṇḍape tatra prakāśaṃ vyājahāra tat |
śreṣṭhī tathā prajāścāpi vyājahrurmaṇḍape yathā ||88||
vyasanāni samastāni tyakṣyāma pāpakāni ca |
bhajiṣyāmo hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam ||89||
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kṛtānāṃ pāpakarmaṇām |
bhaviṣyāmo vaiṣṇavāśca yāsyāmo’nte harergṛham ||3.192.90||
ityevaṃ lakṣaśastatrāyātā ye darśakā api |
yajñārthaṃ cāpyakasmātārthaṃ ca te’pi narāḥ striyaḥ ||91 ||
rāṣṭrajā mānavāḥ sarve parivartitamānasāḥ |
vṛddhaviprapratāpenādhvase vaiṣṇavadīkṣaṇam ||92||
jagṛhurvṛddhaviprātte vyasanāni ca tatyajuḥ |
dadhruśca taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ bālakṛṣṇeti nāma me ||93||
o namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
itimantraṃ jagṛhuścābhavam̐ste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ||94||
vrataṃ cakruḥ kārtikasya śuklasya sarva eva te |
ekabhuktastvamevāpi pratyahaṃ pūjanaṃ mama ||95||
dānaṃ nityaṃ tathānnānāṃ bhajanaṃ ghaṭikāvadhim
athāhaṃ maṇḍape tatra darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau śubham || 16||
caturbhujaṃ divyarūpaṃ rādhālakṣmīramāyutam |
padmāvatīmāṇikīśrīsahitaṃ sumanoharam ||97||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhahāraśobhitam |
divyatejoparidhyāḍhyamukhaṃ keyūramaṇḍitam ||98||
divyamuktaiḥ pārṣadaiśca maharṣibhiḥ prasevitam |
yajñānalairdevatābhirdevaiścābhiprapūjitam ||99||
snehalateṣṭapūrtyarthaṃ cāgataṃ parameśvaram |
vīkṣya māṃ pūjayāṃcakruḥ pādajalaṃ papuśca me || 3.192.1 00||
yajñaprasādaṃ jagṛhurbubhujurmahīmānakāḥ |
sarve samāptiṃ yajñasya cakruścāvabhṛthaṃ tataḥ || 101 ||
luṇīnadyāṃ prasasnuśca nṛpasya śreṣṭhinastathā |
prajānāṃ yāni pāpāni prajajvalustadā rame || 10 2|
avabhṛthaṃ mahāsnānaṃ sarvapāpavināśakṛt |
tatra snātā hi śuddhyanti mahāpāpāparādhinaḥ || 1 03||
rājā śreṣṭhī sasmaraturmokṣārthaṃ vārayoṣitām |
drāgeva madbalāt tatrāvabhṛthasnānapuṇyataḥ || 104 ||
rājñā ca śreṣṭhinā dattāt sarvā yāmyālayād drutam |
āyayurmocitā dūtaistatra luṇyāstaṭe striyaḥ || 1 05||
papurvāri prasasnuśca mayā ca prokṣitā jalaiḥ |
divyadehāstūrṇameva jātāstā pāpavarjitāḥ || 1 06||
vimānaiḥ prayayuḥ sarvāḥ svargaṃ ciraṃ tataśca tāḥ |
prayāsyanti sthiraṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 107||
evaṃ tā mokṣitāścāpi prajāśca vaiṣṇavīkṛtāḥ |
rājā śreṣṭhī nirvyasanau kṛtau bhaktiyutau striyā || 108||
tato’haṃ pūjanaṃ prāpya tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ tataḥ |
āyuṣyānte snehalatāṃ dvijaṃ somāyanaṃ tathā || 1 09||
dhaniṣṭhakoṣaṃ vaṇijaṃ mālavasiṃhabhūpatim |
prajāśca vaiṣṇavīḥ sarvā yathākālaṃ mamākṣaram || 3.192.1 10||
anayaṃ bhaktiyuktām̐ścetyevaṃ vai pāradārikam |
bhaktaṃ śuddhaṃ vidhāyāhaṃ lakṣmi muktiṃ nayāmi tam || 111 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmananādapi |
api pāpasamācāraḥ śuddho yāsyati matpadam || 1 12||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yuddhapurādhipena saha dhaniṣṭhakoṣasya śreṣṭhino vārāṃganāvyasaninaḥ svastrīkṛtabhaktivratārādhanādinā śrīhariṇā mokṣaḥ kṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 192||

<3.193>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ brahmaghnasya pramokṣaṇam |
āsīd vāṭāsīnarākhye grāme rājīvabhūpatiḥ || 1 ||
rājñī tasyābhavat sādhvī nāmnā kundanadevikā |
putrī putravatī dharmaparāyaṇā tapasvinī || 2 ||
bhaktā me śrīhareścāpi vratadhyānaparāyaṇā |
asūryampaśyā cāspṛśyā narāntaraiḥ kvacid rame || 3 ||
pativratyaparā devapūjāsnānāditatparā |
cāturmāsyavratakartrī haryutsavavidhāyinī || 4||
dānadharmaparā cāpi paropakāraśālinī |
sādhusatkārasevārthaṃ kṛtasarvasvamaṃgalā || 5 ||
dīnānāthagavāṃ sevāvidhātrī sūryapūjikā |
kanyakāmānakartrī ca mamārādhanatatparā || 6 ||
atithyabhyāgatādibhyo bhojanāmbaradāyinī |
tīrthakartrī svāminaśca pādapūjāparā sadā || 7 ||
evaṃ saṃskārasampannā nityamālāprajāpinī |
devadarśanaraktā ca nityaṃ kathāśravānvitā || 8 ||
kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vetti yā svaprajāsu vai |
ahiṃsādharmaniratā satyavrataparāyaṇā || 9 ||
yasyāḥ puṇyena rāṣṭraṃ vai śobhate modate bahu |
prajāścāsyā nirātaṃkā nirāmayāḥ susampadaḥ || 3.193.1 0||
atha lakṣmi suvarṇe vai sugandho na kṛto yathā |
tathā suvarṇabhāryāyāmapi svāmī tvadhogatiḥ || 11 ||
rājāsyāḥ svapatiḥ krūro na devān manute svacit |
dharmakarmādikaṃ vyarthaṃ jānātyevābhimānavān || 12||
na viprānna ca sādhūm̐śca gaṇayatyeva dhārmikān |
avamānaṃ karotyeva pūjyānāṃ tvavivekavān || 1 3||
na snānaṃ naiva dānaṃ ca na pūjāṃ nāpi sadvratam |
na tīrthaṃ nāpi satkāraṃ satkarmāpi karoti saḥ || 14||
devadravyaṃ vipradhanaṃ sādhudhanaṃ ca dhārmikam |
nāṇakaṃ parakīyaṃ yallabhyate balato’pi vā || 15||
āharatyeva lubdhātmā naiva muñcati kasyacit |
stainyād balāt karālluñcāyāśca yuddhāt prapīḍanāt || 1 6||
kapaṭācchadmato labdhaṃ sarvaṃ nyāyyaṃ sa vetti vai |
anyāyaṃ nyāyamevāyaṃ jānāti nṛpakarma tat || 17||
prajānāṃ yaddhanaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūmirgṛhādikam |
vyāpārā āyabhāgāśca prajāśca me dhanaṃ hi tat ||18||
putrāḥ putryo dhenavaśca vṛṣabhā vājino gajāḥ |
yānavāhanapaśavaḥ sarvaṃ rājñaśca vetti saḥ || 19||
rājyaṃ rājño na cānyasya jaḍaṃ vā cetanātmakam |
pṛthvīpatiryato rājā pārthivāśca nṛpasya vai ||3.193.20 ||
pṛthvīṃ bhuṃkte yato rājā tato bhuṃkte hi pārthivān |
sarvāṃścāpi vikārām̐ścetyevaṃ manute bhūpatiḥ ||21 ||
viśeṣatāsya vipreṣu dveṣaścāsīttu janmataḥ |
viprā vṛthā nayantyeva laḍḍukān dakṣiṇāstathā ||22||
vṛthā bhikṣāṭanāśceti viprāḥ pratyakṣaluṇṭakāḥ |
matvaivaṃ brāhmaṇān dṛṣṭvā niṣkāsayati dūrataḥ ||23||
daṇḍayatyeva bahudhā bhikṣitaṃ cāharatyapi |
śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā viprāstīrthaṃkarāstu viṃśatiḥ ||24||
bahucarāprabhaktāste vāṭāsīnaramāyayuḥ |
mārge viśrāntilābhārthaṃ rājñyā te satkṛtāstadā ||25||
bhojanāmbarapānādyairdakṣiṇādānavāhanaiḥ |
rājñā jñātaṃ dhanaṃ teṣāmagre’pi cāsti vai tadā ||26||
rājñā dattaṃ ca vipulaṃ tīrthamiṣeṇa tatparam |
lobhena nṛpatiḥ śrutvāhvayad viprān svasannidhau || 2 7||
luluṇṭa taddhanaṃ sarvaṃ viprāṇāṃ sa tato’pi ca |
kārāgāre ruṣā sarvān nyavāsayacca taddine || 28||
atha viprāstu saṃkruddhāḥ śāpaṃ dadustadolbaṇam |
rājyaṃ tava vinaṣṭaṃ syāt kuṭumbādivivarjitaḥ || 29||
āraṇyakaḥ kāpaṭī ca bhava kṣudro hi bhikṣukaḥ |
phalaṃ viṃśativarṣāṇi bhuktvā ca pāśavīṃ tanum ||3.193.30 ||
prāpya duḥkhāni sarvāṇi bhuṃkṣva nāstika nirdaya |
śāpo datto dine viprai rātrau vaṭodarādhipaḥ ||3 1 ||
sasainyastvāyayau yuddhenopāharat samastakam |
rājye nijaṃ deśapālaṃ niyojya nigaḍe sthitān ||32||
viprān vimocayitvā ca rājñyai prādāya jīvikām |
nṛpateśca kuṭumbaṃ ca saṃrakṣya tatra vai tataḥ ||3 3 ||
rājīvaṃ dhartumevāpyanveṣayāmāsa yadyapi |
kintu svanagaraṃ tyaktvā guptamārgeṇa satvaram ||34||
niryayau rājīvabhūpo narmadāvanabhūsthalīm |
viprāṇāṃ śāpadoṣeṇa viṃśativatsarāṇi saḥ || 35||
araṇye pāśavaṃ duḥkhaṃ labdhavān kṣudratānvitam |
atha rājñī bhajate sma saputraputrikā tu mām ||36||
kundanadevītināmnā khyātā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇā |
araṇyastho’pi rājīvo duḥkhito hi svapāpataḥ ||37||
pāpaṃ bahutaraṃ cakre luṇṭanaṃ paśumāraṇam |
evaṃ vane pravasataścaiko viprastu narmadām ||38||
snātuṃ gacchan vane tatra milito’sya samīpagaḥ |
rājīvaścāpi vipraṃ taṃ papraccha vada me’dhunā ||39||
kva yāsi kiṃ tavāgre’sti dehi sarvaṃ ca me’tra vai |
vipraḥ prāha mamāgre’sti pātheyaṃ ca dhanaṃ manāk ||3.193.40 ||
yātrāmātropabhogārthaṃ na dāsye te vanecara |
evaṃ vivadatostatra tayoryuddhamajāyata ||41 ||
rājīvena hato vipro pāṣāṇairmardito hṛdi |
vipro’yaṃ narmadātīre pretastatra vyajāyata ||42||
rājānaṃ prāṇahantāraṃ vavalge brahmaghātinam |
rājā śāpena durbhāgyo’dhiko’tha rakṣasārditaḥ ||43||
vicittonmattajaḍavad babhrāmāraṇyabhūmiṣu |
athāpi kundanadevī brahmaśīlaparāyaṇā ||44||
nidrāyāmekadāraṇye dadarśa taṃ tu duḥkhinam |
kṣudhātṛṣātisantaptaṃ rākṣasāviṣṭayunmadam ||45||
pāśavīṃ vṛttimāpannaṃ rākṣasīṃ rītimāsthitam |
mṛtaṃ paśuṃ ca vā patatriṇaṃ khādantamityapi ||46||
smarantaṃ coccarantaṃ ca kundanā kundaneti ca |
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ romaśaṃ ca rūkṣajaṭādharaṃ tathā ||47||
anyamiva jñāyamānaṃ vivṛttākhilatattvakam |
śabaraṃ vā pāradhiṃ vā ghātakaṃ śvapacaṃ ca vā ||48||
tadvad vilokyamānaṃ vai bhayadaṃ darśanādapi |
atidurgandhiśarīraṃ malinaṃ jaraṭhaṃ yathā ||49||
kundanā kundanā ceti vyāharantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
etādṛśaṃ pāpamūrti vanecaraṃ pravīkṣya sā ||3.193.50 ||
kṣaṇaṃ vicāramakarot svapne ko’yaṃ bhavediti |
atha sā bhayamāpannā prāha kastvaṃ vanāntare ||51 ||
sa cāha rājīvanāmā kundanāpatirasmyaham |
pīḍitaḥ śāpapāpena rakṣasāpi viśeṣataḥ |||52||
samuddharet kundanā māṃ tadā me sadgatirbhavet |
yāvacchṛṇoti nidrāyāṃ kundanā nṛpanoditam |||53||
tāvannidrā gatā rājñyāḥ prātaḥ sā prabubodha ha |
utthitā śokamāpannā patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ||54||
hastāmalakavada dṛśyaṃ vīkṣamāṇā tvarānvitā |
snātvā pupūja sādhvī māṃ śrīpatiṃ kaṣṭahāriṇīm ||55||
śokātiśokavadanottaptātitaptamānasā |
uccāryāśrukṛtāvilanetrā tuṣṭāva māṃ satī ||56||
nātha tvaṃ pūrṇakāmo’si nāptavyaṃ ve hi śiṣyate |
tathāpyatra hi saṃsāre kathamāyāsi me vada ||57||
bhaktecchāpūraṇārthaṃ cenmama vāñchāṃ prapūraya |
yadi bhaktāsmi te śiṣyā dāsī veti ca manyase ||58||
mokṣaṇīyo’raṇyaduḥkhād rājīvo rakṣasā dhṛtaḥ |
yadi pāpaprabhogeṇa karmanāśo’sti sarvathā ||59||
dayālo te dayālutvaṃ vyarthaṃ vyarthastavāgamaḥ |
vyarthā bhaktiśca te sarvārthārthino’rthāprapūraṇāt ||3.193.60||
nārī tvarthārthinī hyasmi tathāpi tava dāsikā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇoddhāraṃ vidhāpaya ||61 ||
yadi pāpikṛte kṛṣṇa kṛpā te naiva jāyate |
mama puṇyaṃ dadāmyasmai tena tvaṃ taṃ samuddhara ||62||
yadi brahmapradaṇḍena dagdhe dayā na te’sti cet |
mayi kṛtvā dayāṃ kṛṣṇa matpatiṃ pātumarhasi ||63||
yadi bhūsurahantustu daṇḍaḥ pūrṇo vidhīyate |
tadā taddaṇḍamadhunā mayi yoktuṃ samarthaye ||64||
tasya tvardhāṃganā cāsmi cārdhaśubhāśubhārthinī |
mama bhakterjanyapuṇyaṃ tvardhaṃ tasya pratiṣṭhatu ||65||
tasya pāpaṃ cārdhakarma mamātrāpi pratiṣṭhatu |
evaṃ nārāyaṇaviṣṇo nyāyena niyamena ca ||66||
api yogyavinimayenāpi taṃ pātumarhati |
āsurāṇāṃ svayaṃ hantā muktido’pi bhavasyataḥ ||67||
rājīvasyāpi bhagavan sukhakṛd bhava keśava |
bhaktāyā mama śāntyarthaṃ madarthitaṃ vibhāvaya ||68||
bhāmākṛte yathā pārijātodyamastvayohyate |
bhāmāhaṃ tava dāsyasmi matpārijātamarthaye ||69||
kalpe kalpe tvayā kṛṣṇa bhāmā tuṣṭā vidhīyate |
pārijātapradānena bhāmā tuṣṭā vidhehi mām ||3.193.70||
bhaktyā tvāṃ toṣayāmyatra tvaṃ dānena pratoṣaya |
sevayā strī naraścārthapradānena parasparam ||71 ||
prasādayataḥ sarvatra tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi |
sanāthāyā api nātha hyanāthāṃ sthitimīkṣase |
kundanā kundanā ceti rājīvo’raṇyake vadan ||72||
uddhāraṃ tvarthayatyeva samuddhara kṛpāṃ kuru |
yāvannoddhārayase tvaṃ cānaśane vasāmyaham ||73 ||
ityuktvā kundanādevī lakṣmi cānaśanaṃ vyadhāt |
ekāsanā nirjalā ca nirāhārā nirāśayā ||74||
jitanidrā jitāhārā maraṇe kṛtaniścayā |
netre pramīlya hṛdaye dhyānasthā sā babhūva ha ||75||
āvartayati mālāyāṃ māṃ jape tvanivartinī |
dhāraṇādhyānavṛttibhyāṃ māṃ babandha hṛdantare ||76||
na cacāla kṣaṇaṃ kvāpi mahāvegadṛḍhīkṛtā |
rājīvamokṣaṇaṃ kāṃkṣamāṇā matparamābhavat ||77||
ahaṃ tasyā mano jñātvā patimokṣārthameva tu |
āntarastho bahistūrṇamupāyayau surūpavān ||78||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo lakṣmīramānvitaḥ |
sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyastathā pārṣadasevitaḥ ||79|||
prasannavadanaḥ śānto varadānapratatparaḥ |
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptavigraho divyabhūṣaṇaḥ ||3.193.80||
evaṃvidhaṃ tu māmagre sthitaṃ sā kundanāntarāt |
mayā sambodhitā tūrṇaṃ samādherbahirāgatā ||8 1 ||
vīkṣya māṃ paramātmānaṃ samutthāya satī drutam |
papāta pādayorme drāk samāśliṣacca vakṣasi ||882||
mama sparśanamātreṇa divyadṛṣṭirvyajāyata |
vyalokayadvane naijaṃ patiṃ svapne vilokitam ||83||
śīghraṃ māṃ lambahastena vyadarśayatpatiṃ nijam |
duḥkhinaṃ rakṣasā vyāptaṃ mokṣayituṃ tadārthayat ||84||
ahaṃ tatraiva sahasā patyurmokṣārthameva ha |
garuḍe saṃsthito bhūtvā nītvā sākaṃ ca kundanām ||85||
yatrāraṇye vartate sa rājīvastatra pakṣiṇā |
āgacchaṃ cāvatīryāthāmbarāt sākaṃ tayā rame ||86||
rājīvaṃ tu bhramantaṃ svakamaṇḍalujalena vai |
aprokṣayaṃ tatastatra rakṣo yo valgito’bhavat ||87||
jalaṃ pītvātha tūrṇaṃ vai divyadeho babhūva ha |
māṃ stutvā matpratāpena vimānena divaṃ yayau ||88||
rājīvo’pi tadā svasthamanā suṣṭhuprabhānavān |
bhūtvā jñātvā nijāṃ patnīṃ māṃ tathā parameśvaram ||89||
nanāma pādayorme vai praṇanāma ca daṇḍavat |
kundanādevikā tasmai sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nyavedayat ||3.193.90||
tato mayā punarvārbhiḥ prokṣitaḥ pāvano’bhavat |
pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ cakre’pāyayaṃ vāri matkaraiḥ ||91 ||
garuḍe taṃ samāropyānayaṃ vāṭāsanaṃ puram |
rājñyā mantro dāpitaśca rājā tyaktvābhimānakam ||92||
jagrāha mama mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ tathā |
vaiṣṇavo bhagavadbhakto’bhavaccāstikabhāvanaḥ ||93||
putrāḥ putryastathā sarvāḥ prajāḥ prasannatāṃ gatāḥ |
atha kṣemaṃ tathā teṣāṃ kuśalaṃ samvidhāya ca ||94||
ante mamākṣare loke gamanārthaṃ vaco mama |
datvā tirobhavaṃ śīghraṃ vaṭodaranṛpaṃ prati ||95||
agacchaṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bhikṣāmiṣeṇa tatra ha |
yācito’tha sa rājā vai bhāskaravikramābhidhaḥ ||96||
vada vipra pradāsye te yadicchāviṣayaṃ tava |
jagāda mahyaṃ ca tato’rthayaṃ rājīvarakṣaṇam ||97||
vāṭāsīnasya rājyaṃ pratyarpayituṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
rājeśvarastathodāro nṛpastathāstviti drutam ||98||
uktvā patraṃ prāhiṇocca pradhānaṃ prati tadvidham |
rājyaṃ pradāpayāmāsa rājīvāya dvijo’pyaham ||99||
punā rājñyai nṛpataye datvā me darśanaṃ tathā |
tirobhāvaṃ gataścāhaṃ tataḥ kālāntare rame || 3.193.10 0||
rājīvaṃ kundanādevīṃ tathā putrān suputrikāḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ ca dhāmākṣaraṃ samānayam || 101 ||
evaṃ mayā purā bhaktyā patnyāścārādhanena vai |
pāpo’pi brahmahāścāpi rājīvo rakṣito vanāt || 1 02||
rākṣasānmocitaścāpi rākṣaso’pi pramocitaḥ |
rājīvanṛpateḥ sarve kuṭumbaṃ mocitaṃ hyaghāt || 1 03||
kundanāyāḥ pratāpena vratenānaśanena vai |
mamārādhanabhaktyā ca rājyaṃ svaṃ prāpitaṃ puna || 1 04||
evaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktyā bhuktirmuktirbhavediha |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhettathā || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vāṭāsīnāranṛpaterbrahmaghnasya rākṣasābhibhūtasya hṛtarājyasya kundanadevīrājñyāḥ paramabhaktyā bhagavaddarśanaṃ duḥkhamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 193 ||

<3.194>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktāsarojinīpateḥ |
caritraṃ pramadāghnasya devaviśrāmanāminaḥ || 1 ||
āsīccakradharo rājā virāmanagarādhipaḥ |
tasyāmātyo’bhavad devaviśrāmākhyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ || 2 ||
rājyābhyunnatikartā sa prajodayābhilāṣukaḥ |
rāṣṭrarakṣaṇayatnasthaḥ sadā devādipūjakaḥ || 3 ||
dharmamārgaparaścāpi satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
sādhusādhvīsatīsevāparāyaṇo’tisevakaḥ || 4 ||
ye kecid dravyahīnāste yācante devaviśramam |
so’pi dadātyabhīṣṭaṃ ca toṣayatyeva bhikṣukān || 5 ||
arthino’pi pratuṣṭāśca mahāśīrvādavādinaḥ |
svargaṃ rājyaṃ mahārājyaṃ tavāstviti vadanti ca || 6 ||
rājāpi dhārmiko nityaṃ sevate parameśvaram |
na caurā nāpi dhūrtāśca na śaṭhā na pratārakāḥ || 7 ||
rocante nṛpateḥ svasya rājye nāpi chalapriyāḥ |
yathā rājā tathāmātyaścaurādidaṇḍakṛt sadā ||8||
abhicāraparā ye ca mantratantrādijīvinaḥ |
ghātakā mārakā ye te rocante nāsya vai kvacit ||9||
athaikadā bahucarāmātustu sevikā striyaḥ |
yoginyo mantravettryaśca bhikṣārthaṃ niryayū rame || 3.194.10 ||
yatra dāneśvarā bhūpā yatra dānijanāstathā |
śrūyante tatra tatraitā bhikṣante vai dhanaṃ rame || 11 ||
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ cāmbarāṇi yānāni vāhanānyapi |
hīrakān māṇikyavarṇān ratnāni vividhāni ca || 1 2||
vibhūṣāścāpi bhikṣante prāpayanti ca bhikṣitam |
bahucarāṃ mahādevīṃ samarpayanti tāstathā || 13||
mātā bahucarā lakṣaguṇaṃ dāsyati dānine |
evaṃ vacaḥ paraṃ smṛtvā dānaṃ gṛhṇanti tāḥ striyaḥ ||14||
atha yena dadatyābhyaḥ śreṣṭhino vā nṛpā janāḥ |
tadā teṣāṃ gopureṣu gṛhadvāreṣu tāḥ striyaḥ || 15||
āsanāni sthirīkṛtya kīrtayanti tu saṃghaśaḥ |
vrataṃ dhṛtvā hyanaśanaṃ kaliṃ kurvanti tāstapaḥ || 16||
jaya jaya mātarbahucare jaya jaya mātarbahucare |
dāninastvaṃ dhanaṃkare jaya jaya mātarbahucare || 17||
evaṃ tālīṃ vādayantyaḥ pragāyanti gṛhāṃgaṇe |
pañca vā sapta vāhāni tiṣṭhanti na prayānti tāḥ || 18 ||
gṛhādhīśāstataḥ prāpya parājayaṃ dadatyapi |
tāśca gṛhṇanti bahudhā svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ dhanādikam || 1 9||
atha cennaivārpayanti dhanaṃ dravyaṃ yathepsitam |
prasahyānaśanaṃ kṛtvā yatante kalahairapi ||3.194.20||
gṛhītvaiva prayāntyeva nānyathā haṭhataḥ striyaḥ |
evaṃvidhāstāḥ sarvāśca yoginyo daśasaṃkhyakāḥ ||21||
haṭhaṃ cakrurdhanārthaṃ vai tadāmātyo dadau dhanam |
śataṃ suvarṇamudrāṇāṃ labdhvāpi toṣavarjitāḥ ||22||
yathācire sahasraṃ vai suvarṇānāṃ tathetarat |
ratnahīrakabhūṣādi nṛpādapi pṛthag dhanam ||23||
daśasahasramudrāśca maṇimauktikamālikāḥ |
evaṃ haṭhena yuktāstā yayācire na niryayuḥ ||24||
atha yāte tu saptāhe dīyamāne sahasrake |
sauvarṇātmakamudrāṇāṃ yadā toṣaṃ gatā na tāḥ ||26||
tadāmātyasya nāśārthaṃ mantraṃ cāpyabhicārakam |
rājñaścāpi vināśārthaṃ mantraṃ malinaṃ cakrire ||26||
athāmātyastu patito vyagro’bhavat sumūrcchitaḥ |
ghaṭyantare punaḥ saṃjñāṃ prāpya samutthito’bhavat ||27||
rājāpi ca tathāvasthāṃ prāpto mūrcchāṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
utthitaśceti tatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhicārakam ||28||
amātyaścāsahamāno’sahamāno nṛpo’pi ca |
svabhaṭairagrapūjyāyāḥ śiraśchedamakārayat ||29||
athānyā abalāḥ krūrā mṛtyubhayena dudruvuḥ |
dattaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhītvaiva tyaktvā śavaṃ mṛtastriyāḥ ||3.194.30||
pradhāvanaṃ pracakrustāḥ prayayurnagarāntaram |
loke prajāyāṃ sarvatra strīhatyāṃ kṛtavānnṛpaḥ ||3 1 ||
strīhatyāṃ kṛtavām̐ścāsyāmātyo’pītyayaśo’bhavat |
agnidā garadā śastrodyatā mantrābhicārikā ||22||
tā etā ātatāyinyaḥ śāpadā śatrudā tathā |
tāsāṃ nāśe na vai doṣaḥ prāṇahā hi vadhārhaṇā || 33||
ato lakṣmi tathārūpāvighāte naiva dūṣaṇam |
tathāpi lokavādāśca jāyante strīhanātmakāḥ ||34||
ayaśobodhakāḥ sarve lokasya citritā gatiḥ |
dhikkurvanti prajāścāsyāmātyasya nṛpaterapi ||35||
kāraṇaṃ cābhicārādi hyaviditvaiva vai mṛṣā |
ayaśaḥ saṃpragāyanti strīghno’mātyo nṛpastviti ||36||
atha rājā cakradharo’mātyaṃ prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ |
devaviśrāmanāmānaṃ kalaṃkasyāpanuttaye ||37||
kathaṃkāryaṃ kuvadantyāḥ prakṣālanaṃ mahāmate |
yathā prajāyāṃ santoṣaḥ pravādakṣālanaṃ bhavet ||38||
pāpaṃ yadyapi hanane nāstyabhicārayoṣitaḥ |
tathāpi kuvadantyā vai śāntaye vratamācaret ||39||
yathā vicārya sukhadaṃ brūhi cāmātya śobhanam |
kartavyaṃ tadyathāyogyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ yathā bhavet ||3.194.40 ||
amātyaḥ prāha bhūpa tvaṃ sabhāmāhvaya śobhanām |
vṛddhaprajājanānāṃ ca tatrāvedaya mānasam ||41||
rājā śrutvā tathā cakre sabhāṃ tatra ca mānavāḥ |
prajāvṛddhā āyayuśca narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||42|||
athāmātyena nirdiṣṭaḥ purohito’tidhārmikaḥ |
bahuśrutastathā śāstrasampanno vedapāragaḥ ||43||
dharmaviddeśakālajñaḥ prerito’mātyavākyataḥ |
rājñā cājñākṛto dharmān sabhāyāṃ vyājahāra saḥ ||44||
śṛṇvantu pūjyavargāśca vṛddhā nāryo narāstathā |
dharmasya lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi yathāśāstrānusārataḥ ||45||
nodanālakṣaṇo dharmo’rthakṛnmokṣaprado’pi ca |
anarthakṛd viruddhārthaścādhogatiprado’vṛṣaḥ ||46||
yamāryāḥ pālyamānaṃ vai praśaṃsanti vṛṣo hi saḥ |
yaṃ tu nindanti lokāḥ sa tvadharmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||47||
lokānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ yena poṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā |
sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ bhaveddharmaḥ sa ucyate ||48||
deśe kāle ca satpātre sthitaścācāra eva yaḥ |
sukhadaḥ syāt sa dharmaḥ syād duḥkhadaḥ syādadharmakaḥ ||49||
dharmeṇa jāyate kīrtiḥ sukhaṃ śāntiḥ sadā tathā |
unnatiścodayaścāpi svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ ||3.194.50||
sa eva dharma udito yena rājā prajāḥ sukhāḥ |
devapūjā tathā dānaṃ vrataṃ dayā ca dakṣiṇā ||51 ||
paropakāraḥ satataṃ dharmo’yaṃ sarvadehinām |
snānaṃ japo devanamaskāro devārpaṇaṃ tathā || 92||
vṛddhābhipūjanaṃ dharmo nṛpābhipūjanaṃ tathā |
ācāraḥ prathamo dharmo hyadharmastadviparyaye ||53||
satāmācāra evāsti dharmo na tvasatāṃ tathā |
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmavrataṃ tapo damaḥ ||54||
dharma eva paraḥ prokto vṛddhasevāpi durlabhā |
sādhusevā ca satsaṃgaḥ paro dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 65||
bhūtānāmupakāraśca yathāśakti vṛṣo mataḥ |
prasannīkaraṇaṃ dharmaḥ prasannatvaṃ hi durlabham ||56||
aprasādastathodvego’nupakāro hyasevanam |
hiṃsānṛtaṃ prasahyāpaharaṇaṃ duṣṭasaṃgitā ||97||
adharma eva bhavati tyājyāścāyaṃ sadā janaiḥ |
śraddhayā dīyate dānaṃ dharma eva mato hi saḥ ||98||
prasahya hriyate yattu sa tvadharmo hi luṇṭakṛt |
abhicāro bhavenmantraiḥ prāṇānāṃ ghātako yadi |||99||
adharma eva rājñāṃ vā prāṇanāśo’pyadharmakaḥ |
pradhānasyābhicāreṇa māraṇaṃ cāpyadharmakaḥ ||3.194.60||
deśe kāle ca pātre ca hiṃsā duṣṭāśayastathā |
ātatāyikriyā cāpi hyadharma eva kīrtitaḥ ||61||
etādṛśo yadādharmo nare nāryāṃ ca bālake |
vālāyāṃ vā pravarteta cātatāyisvarūpadhṛk ||62||
intavya eva śastrādyairadharmo’dharmavām̐stathā |
ātatāyī prahantavyaḥ sarvathā prāṇarakṣaṇe ||63||
ātatāyī yadā naiva hanyate yena so’pi vai 3|
drutaṃ hato bhavettasmāddhantavya ātatāyakṛt ||64||
etaddharmasvarūpaṃ vai mayoktaṃ bhavatāṃ puraḥ |
bahucarāyā bhaktānāṃ strīṇāmatra prapūjanam ||65||
kṛtaṃ sahasramudrābhiḥ suvarṇānāṃ yathāyatham |
tathāpi ca balānnāryo haṭhānnetuṃ dṛḍhāśayāḥ ||66||
abhicāraṃ pracakrustā nṛpe’mātye’timārakam |
atastā ātatāyinyo mārikāḥ pūtanā yathā ||67||
rākṣasya eva tāḥ proktā hiṃsikāstāmasātmikāḥ |
mantravettryaścātatāyyabhicārakāryayojikāḥ ||68||
hantavyā eva nāstyatra doṣo dharma itisthitiḥ |
vadhārhāstāḥ samastā vai kintvekā vihatāsu tu ||69||
dayā kṛtā na krauryaṃ taddharma eva na cetaraḥ |
dharma eva hi tatrāsti duṣṭānāṃ māraṇaṃ tu yat ||3.194.70||
prāṇahānāṃ prāṇanāśo dharma eva yataḥ prajāḥ |
strīvadho dūṣaṇaṃ nāsti pūtanāvadha eva saḥ ||71 ||
kṛtyāvadhe na vai doṣo dharma taṃ vai nibodhata |
siṃhyā nāmyāṃ tathā vyādhyā vṛścikyāṃ na dayālutā |||72||
prāṇaghnāyāṃ tu rākṣasyāṃ tathā dayā na sammatā |
ata eva na ghātinyāṃ dayā kāryā kvacijjanaiḥ ||73||
pravṛttāyāṃ prāṇanāśe dayā kāryā na sarvathā |
aprāṇanāśe pravṛttāvupekṣā tatra yujyate ||74||
evaṃdharmo bhavatyeva tasmāt prajāgragāminaḥ |
bhavanto yadbravantvatrābhicāriṇīvināśane ||75||
pāpaṃ vā yadi vā puṇyaṃ nobhayaṃ cobhayaṃ ca vā |
śrutvaivaṃ te sabhāpūjyā ūcuścātīva dhārmikam ||76||
ātatāyivadhe doṣo na ghātinyā vadhena ca |
abhicāraparāyāśca vadhe doṣo na vidyate ||77||
kintu nārīti prahatetyevaṃvādaviśuddhaye |
viṣṇuyajñaḥ prakartavyaḥ sarvāpavādaśāntidaḥ ||78||
ityasmākaṃ mataṃ puṇye kārye rājā karotvidam |
prajājanānāṃ vacanaṃ lakṣmi bhūpena mānitam ||79||
amātyena svīkṛtaṃ ca sabhāyāṃ sarvaśuddhaye |
athādāya muhūrtaṃ sa śubhaṃ makhamakārayat ||3.194.80||
maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍamutkṛṣṭaṃ devānāṃ sthāpanāni ca |
pūjanāni ca dānāni bhojanāni ghṛtāni ca ||81 ||
dakṣiṇā vividhāścāpi havyāni samidhastathā |
viṣṇave pūjanādīni kavyāni hyambarāṇi ca ||82||
annadhanāni yogyāni rājāmātyaprajā daduḥ |
pūrṇāhutiṃ pracakruśca tadā nārāyaṇo hyaham ||8 3 ||
agacchaṃ śvapaco bhūtvā bhojanaṃ cārthayaṃ tataḥ |
amātyaḥ pradadau bhojyaṃ dūrānme tu tadā rame ||84||
tadā bhuktaṃ mayā cānnaṃ paṃktipāvanakāriṇā |
culukaṃ ca kṛtaṃ hastaprakṣālanaṃ tathā kṛtam ||85|||
jalaṃ prapītaṃ yāvadvai tāvad rājñastu dehataḥ |
kṛṣṇavarṇo dhūmra eva nirgatyāmātyago’bhavat ||8 6||
amātyadehataḥ kṛṣṇā nārī pāpā hi nirgatā |
mṛtā sā yoginī hatyārūpā strī hyabhavaddhi sā ||87||
ākṛṣṭā śvapacenaiva śvapace sā tirohitā |
agnidagdhā drutaṃ tasya śvapacasya tu mastakāt ||88 ||
vidyudrūpā prabhutvaiva śīghraṃ sā vyomagābhavat |
astaud divyasvarūpā ca śrīpatiṃ māṃ ramāpatim ||89 ||
abhicārikanāryā me mokṣārthaṃ bhagavān bhavān |
upasthito’sti yajñe’tra pūrtyarthaṃ nṛpayajñayoḥ || 3.194.90 ||
bhaktahastena yā hatyā sāpi mokṣāya jāyate |
pāpāyā mama hatyāpi tvadyogena divaṃpradā || 91 ||
mokṣapradā bhavatyeva puṇyaṃ me jāyate’dhunā |
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate parameśvara || 92||
bahucarāyāste śakteḥ sevikāṃ māṃ samuddhara |
ityuktvā bhagavaddṛṣṭyā tūrṇaṃ sā svargatiṃ gatā ||9 3 ||
kālāntare harerbhaktyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sā yayau satī |
atha rājā kuṭumbaṃ cāmātyo’pi parameśvaram || 94||
māṃ vijñāya hariṃ cāpi pupūjuśca prajājanāḥ |
tadahaṃ drāk caturbāhurbhūtvādhvare śubhāsane ||95 ||
niveśito niṣasāda prasādaṃ me dadau tadā |
sarvebhyaḥ kaṇakārūpaṃ carūsthaṃ te’pi jagṛhuḥ || 96||
pāvanāste samastā vai jātāḥ sarve mamāgamāt |
evaṃ hatyākalaṃkaṃ vai mayā vināśitaṃ tayoḥ ||97||
kāṇḍikānāmikāyā vai yoginyā mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam |
rājāmātyau varadānaiḥ svargārthaṃ mokṣaṇāya ca || 98 ||
āśīrvādairyojitau ca kuṭumbe cāpi vai tayoḥ |
atha kālāntare svargavāsinau tau mayā kṛtau || 99 ||
mokṣabhājau tathā tasmāt kṛtau lakṣmi nṛpānugau |
evaṃ yajñottaraṃ sarvaṃ kṛpayā kṛtavānaham || 3.194.100 ||
tiro’bhavaṃ tvadhvare cākaṣaryan tanmanāṃsyapi |
sasmarurthe narā nāryo’pi taṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ || 101 ||
evaṃ mayā strīhatyāyāḥ pāpaṃ vināśitaṃ priye |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhetāpi pāṭhakaḥ śrāvako’sya ca || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne cakradharanṛpājñayā devaviśrāmākhyāmātyasya kāṇḍikāyoginīstrīhatyāyāḥ pāpasya yajñe śrīhariṇā nivṛttiḥ kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 194 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ pāpavināśinīm |
saurāṣṭe māyūrapuryāṃ matsyāyāḥ saritastaṭe || 1 ||
mahodyāne tadudyānapālo mālī kuṭumbavān |

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
evaṃ nārāyaṇīśri vai tadā mayā śubhāvaham |
upadiṣṭaṃ mokṣadaṃ tatstrībhyāṃ ca harṣulāya ca || 1 ||

ciraṃ dhyāyanmaya mūrti tato yāti parāṃ gatim |
sādhusevāṃ prakuryādvā tathā yāti paraṃ padam || 9 ||
sādhūnāṃ ca guṇāneva gṛhṇīyād durguṇām̐styajan |
nnākṛtau parameśe ca sādhau cāpi guṇānnayet || 3.196.10 ||
satāṃ prasannatāhetuṃ sadācāraṃ caret sadā |
ācāre vacane kārye satāṃ yoge prasevane || 1 1||

viśvāsena prakurvīta satāṃ ceṣṭaṃ harestathā || 1 2||
tadeva muktidaṃ syādvai niḥsaṃśayo jayaṃ vrajet |
adhamoddhārakaścāhamuddharāmi madāśritam || 1 3||
