nijendriyāṇāṃ vyāpārā arpaṇīyā parātmani |
tadā divyakriyāḥ sarvā bhavanti matparāyaṇāḥ || 17||
vartate tasya tṛptiśca sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya yogataḥ |
sākṣāddharestu saṃyogastathā brahmadaśā nijā || 18||
yasyāsti tasya kartavyaśeṣo nāsti pramuktaye |
jñānendriyāṇi sarvāṇi yadgṛhṇanti nijādanam || 1 9||
adanaṃ taddhariḥ sākṣāddharerguṇāśca śāśvatāḥ |
evaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ viṣayo hariḥ ||3.196.20||
bhaved yasya tu tasyātrānando bhaveddhi śāśvataḥ |
divyaguṇādisaṃprāptau sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ bhavet || 21 ||
evamatraiva kartavyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tathā sadā |
rūpaṃ satāṃ hareścāpi rasaḥ satāṃ harestathā || 22||
gandhaḥ satāṃ hareścāpi śabdaḥ satāṃ harestathā |
sparśaḥ satāṃ hareścāpi śuddhikṛnmokṣakṛt sadā ||23||
satāṃ harerdarśanaṃ ca sparśanaṃ dehasevanam |
pādasammardanaṃ cāpi pāvanaṃ śodhakaṃ sadā ||24||
satāṃ harergṛhe vāsastadājñāpālanaṃ tathā |
asaṃśayastadācāre pāvano mokṣadaḥ sadā ||25||
bhoktavyaṃ bhogyamevārpya śrīkṛṣṇe nānyathā kvacit |
kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇamūrtyātmasatpuruṣāya vārpayet ||26||
arpitaṃ divyatāṃ yāti tadbhoktā mokṣago bhavet |
hareryogānnirguṇaṃ tattadbhoktā nirguṇo bhavet ||27|||
sadyo’ntaḥkaraṇaṃ śuddhaṃ karoti nirguṇaṃ hi tat |
bandhanaṃ naiva jāyeta nirguṇasyopabhogataḥ ||28||
evaṃ vijñāya pañcāpi tathānye viṣayā api |
sevyāḥ śuddhikarā divyā prasādarūpiṇaḥ sadā ||29||
anarpitā na vai sevyāḥ parihāryā hi dūrataḥ |
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ vikṣepo naiva jāyate ||3.196.3 0 ||
bandhanaṃ na bhaveccāpi puṇyā muktiḥ kare sthitā |
śuddhyanti sarvakāmāśca siddhyanti kāmitāḥ sadā ||31 ||
mama vāsaḥ sadā tasyāntare bhavati saukhyadaḥ |
evaṃ vivicya kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṃgo harestathā ||32||
satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryo niḥśreyasaprado hi saḥ |
nāsti tādṛk padārtho vā vastu yanmama yogataḥ ||33|
nopeyād divyabhāvaṃ vā mokṣadaṃ na bhavediti |
sarvaṃ pavitraṃ madyogācchreṣṭhaṃ nikṛṣṭamityapi ||34||
evaṃ jñātvārpaṇīyaṃ me sarvaṃ varṣma ca daihikam |
evaṃ śaraṇamāptasyāpyahaṃ tasya bhavāmi hi ||25|||
brahmātmaniṣṭhāyuktasya gurudharmayutasya ca |
rāgaśūnyasya sarvatra snehayuktasya vai mayi ||36||
mama māhātmyavijñasya mama prasādaśevadheḥ |
mamaiśvaryaṃ samastaṃ vai dhāmni tasya bhavatyapi || 37||
mama prasannatālabhyamaiśvaryaṃ tena cārjyate |
satāṃ samāgamānnityaṃ siddhadharmaṃ samālabhet || 38||
muktidaḥ siddhadharmo vai tamarjayet satāṃ śrayāt |
sādhyadharmo hariścāhaṃ prāpyo bhavāmi siddhataḥ ||39||
yasya sākṣāddhareḥ prāptiḥ sākṣād yogaḥ prasevanam |
sarvadā darśanaṃ cāsti tathāpi māyikaṃ sukham ||3.196.40||
yadi vāñcchati tasyātmā na tṛpto nirayābhigaḥ |
sa eva jñānahīno vai bodhyo yo na tṛṣāṃ tyajet ||41||
sadasadbodhamāsādya māyāsukhaṃ tatastyajet |
ātmasukhaṃ parityajya māyāsukhe pramodate |||42|||
tasya śāśvatakāryāṇi naiva siddhyanti kānyapi |
ātmasthasya harerme ca sukhaṃ bhuṃkte tu yo janaḥ ||43||
sa eva vidvān muktātmā bhaktātmā sarvato’dhikaḥ |
upāsanābalenāyaṃ jāyate hi narāyaṇaḥ ||44||
nārī nārāyaṇī syācca rādhā lakṣmīryathā ramā |
satsamāgamamāptasya nijātmaparamātmanoḥ ||45||
sākṣād vai darśanaṃ divyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
satsaṃgo vidyate yasya tasya cātmapradarśane ||46||
paramātmadarśane’pi svātantryaṃ kṛpayā bhavet |
ātmadarśanayatnodyoginaḥ satsaṃgavartinaḥ ||47||
mama pratāpamālambya cāntardṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca |
vīkṣate svasvarūpaṃ ced bhāsvadbhāsuramīkṣate ||48||
ātmaprakāśe vimale sākṣānmāṃ parameśvaram |
vīkṣate bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai śāśvatānandavān bhavet ||49||
bhaktā tvaikāntikī yā ca nārī vāpi naro’pi vā |
madarthakṛtasarvasvā māṃ prayāti pare pade ||3.196.50||
kriyāsu kriyamāṇāsu sarvāsvapi hariḥ svayam |
cintanīyo dhāraṇīyo yathādṛṣṭo yathāśrutaḥ ||51 ||
bhojanīyaḥ sevanīyo rañjanīyo haristvaham |
tena bhaktāḥ prayāntyeva brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ param ||52||
śāntacitte vīkṣaṇīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo’ntardṛśā ciram |
sarvānandāḥ prāpaṇīyā mama mūrtestadātmataḥ ||53||
jīvo’yaṃ dehināṃ dehe saṃsāre’pārasāgare |
caturaśītilakṣeṣu deheṣu khaniyogiṣu |||54||
utpanno bahuvāraṃ vai strī vā pumān punaḥ punaḥ |
narā bhuktāstathā nāryo bhuktāścānena vai muhuḥ ||55||
pītāni sarvadugdhāni garbhakuṭyo vilokitāḥ |
maraṇaṃ jananaṃ cāpi dṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ punastathā |||56||
ahantā mamatā cāpi dehe daihikavastuṣu |
kṛtāpi bahudhā yatra dehe sthitimavāptavān ||57||
vismṛtāni samastāni pūrvavarṣmāṇi tāni vai |
idaṃ janmāntare prāpte vismaryate tathaiva ha ||58||
tadidaṃ cātra dehe vai saṃgastyājyo yathocitaḥ |
ahantā mamatā tyājyā jñānena pūrvage yathā ||59||
vivekena viṣayeṣvāsaktiṃ tyaktvā harau mayi |
sajjeta dehavān yaḥ sa mukto bhavati macchrayāt ||3.196.60||
muktyarthaṃ ca vivekārthaṃ māhātmyārthaṃ mamāpi ca |
sevyāḥ santaḥ sadā pūtāḥ pāvanā matsyarūpiṇaḥ ||61 ||
sevayā ca tataḥ prāpyaikāntikatvaṃ ca divyatām |
dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ prāpyākṣarasādharmyayogataḥ ||62||
sevante koṭiśo muktā yathā māṃ sevate tvayam |
tanmuktapaṃktau sthātavyamityevaṃ māṃ prasevayet ||63||
sukhaṃ cānyat samagraṃ tu tucchaṃ ca kṣaṇikaṃ tathā |
vicāryaikāntabhaktiṃ me kuryād rahasyavedinīm ||64||
alobhi svamanaḥ kāryaṃ māyike viṣaye tviha |
yenātra ramyarūpādau lobho naiva prajāyate ||65||
tadbalena harerdhāma pratiyāne’pi mārgagāḥ |
āyānti siddhayastāsu lobhaścāsya na vai bhavet ||66||
paraṃ pāraṃ prakṛteḥ sa prayātyeva mamāśritaḥ |
ananyacetā bhūtvaiva bhuṃkte matsukhamūrjitam ||67||
yasya kriyāsu sarvāsu mama mūrtismṛtirbhavet |
tasyaiva sthiratā syādvai sarvathā svāminī prabhau ||68||
yadyatsukhepsā yasya syāt tattat sukhaṃ madagrataḥ |
grahaṇīyaṃ nānyatastu sarvaṃ dadāmi tasya vai ||69||
mama rājyaṃ bhaktarājyaṃ bhedastatra na vidyate |
tasmād rājñyā sadā bhāvyaṃ na bhāvyaṃ veśyayā kvacit ||3.196.70||
ityevaṃ tu mayā lakṣmi hyupadiṣṭaṃ tataśca te |
pupūjurmāṃ paramayā bhaktyā va snehārdramānasāḥ ||71 ||
phalānyuttamajātīni bhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
athāpi sādhurūpaṃ māṃ prasādayitumutsukāḥ ||72||
sevayituṃ samutsāhā uṣituṃ cakrurāgraham |
athāha sādhurūpo vai teṣāmāgrahatastadā ||73 ||
uṣituṃ ca divārātramadhikaṃ svīcakāra ha |
divase tūṣṇavārbhiste snāpayāmāsurādarāt ||74||
puṣpāṇāṃ bahubhirhāraiḥ puṣpanirmitabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
puṣpavastraiḥ puṣpaśṛṃgārakairarhaṇamādadhuḥ ||75||
mukuṭaḥ pītapuṣpāṇāṃ kaṭake cāṃgade tathā |
vibhūṣāḥ pītapuṣpāṇāṃ kṛtāstaiśca dhṛtā mayā ||76||
ambarāṇi samastāni saptarūpasumāni vai |
sugandhīni vicitrāṇi dhṛtāni ca mayā tadā ||77||
dolā kadambavṛkṣasya śākhāyāṃ rajjubhiḥ kṛtā |
baddhā supallavapuṣpatoraṇādyairvibhūṣitā ||78||
niṣādya māṃ tu dolāyāṃ trayaste bhāvagarbhitāḥ |
āndolayāmāsuriṣṭaṃ svāminaṃ prāṇarakṣakam ||79||
pāyayāmāsurikṣūṇāṃ rasaṃ nāraṃgiṇāṃ tathā |
nālīkerajalaṃ cāpi miṣṭavāri sugandhi ca ||3.196.80||
rātrau vādyaviśeṣaiśca kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ |
sahasraśo janāstatrāyayurdarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||8 1 ||
pāvanāste tato jātā darśanasparśanādibhiḥ |
prasādagrahaṇaiścāpi yayuste tu nijālayān ||82||
harṣulaścāpi tatpatnyau siṣevire ca māṃ niśi |
sarvārpaṇena nirdoṣabuddhyā divyaprasevanaiḥ ||83||
atha yā śreṣṭhabhāryā sā nāmnā vidrumavallakī |
sarvasuptyuttaraṃ cārdharātrottaraṃ rahaḥ svayam ||84||
pracchannaikākinī tatrāgatya māṃ parameśvaram |
dehasammardanenaiva siṣeve putrakāminī ||85||
śanakairmama karṇe sā kṛtvānanaṃ ca maunavat |
arthayāmāsa bhagavana putraṃ me dehi keśava ||86||
prasanno’haṃ sevayā ca bhaktāyāḥ sarvathā hariḥ |
tathāstviti mayā spṛṣṭā putravatī bhaveti ca ||87||
samudghāṭitabhāgyā sā prasannā bahudhābhavat |
yatheṣṭaṃ sevayāmāsa māṃ tato’dhikabhāvanā ||88||
supto’haṃ sā ca patyuśca sevāyāṃ pragatā tadā |
landhamanorathā jātā sagarbhā śobhanā tathā ||89||
atha prāpte tu samaye suṣuve bālakaṃ śubham |
putraṃ samujjvalaṃ tvekaṃ harṣulo harṣamāpa ha ||3.196.90 ||
vidrumavallakī tvevaṃ labdhvā putraṃ tataḥ param |
mānapātraṃ sadā jātā sarvasaubhāgyasundarī ||91 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā tāritā sevayā tadā |
prasannena mayā sāpi tāritā bālahatyayā ||92||
bālaścojjīvitaścāpi sevāpi svīkṛtā tathā |
evameva hi bhaktānāṃ karomi rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ||93||
jīvāstu dehasaṃyuktā yāvantaḥ santi tāvatā |
sadoṣā eva vartante kintu bhaktyā taranti te ||94||
bhaktyāhaṃ tārayāmyetān pāpām̐ścāpi narān drutam |
athāhaṃ gantukāmaśca pūjito vanditaśca taiḥ ||95||
sādhuveṣeṇa sahasā cāntarhito’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāt |
harṣulādyā yathādṛṣṭaṃ dhyāne sasmaruranvaham ||96||
bhaktiṃ cakrurbhāvataste sādhusevāṃ ca cakrire |
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulām yayuste svargamuttamam ||97||
svargāt svargottaraṃ prāpya mama dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
evaṃ niṣkāmasevābhiryānti brahma nirāmayam ||98||
sevayā labhyate putraḥ sevayā labhyate sukham |
sevayā labhyate cāpyabhayaṃ niṣpāpatā tathā ||99||
sevayā bhogakoṭyaśca sevayā śāśvataṃ sukham |
sevayā śrīhariścāhaṃ prāpyaḥ pūrṇeṣṭasampradaḥ || 3.196.1 00||
bhaktyā bhaktān tārayāmi gṛhṇāmi sevayā tataḥ |
tādātmyenānandayāmi sarvaṃ dadāmi tatparam || 101 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt sevanāttathā |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva smṛddhiśca śāśvatīrbhavet || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne harṣulākhyabhaktasyodyāne śrīharerupadeśo harṣulasya jyeṣṭhapatnyā api putralābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||196 ||

<3.197>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ pitṛhaṇaḥ kathāṃ tathā |
saurāṣṭre karṣuko bhakto vṛddho’bhavat kuṭumbavān || 1 ||
koṭināranagarasyābhyāśe grāme paṭolake |
nāmnā śāṇadharaśceti pañcaputraprapautravān || 2 ||
saptaputrīpitā cāpi vāṭikākṣetragodhanaḥ |
bhajate śrīhariṃ māṃ ca nityaṃ kṛṣeśca karmasu || 3 ||
yadutpannaṃ bhaved sarvaṃ mahyaṃ nivedya vai tataḥ |
bhuṅkte kuṭumbasahito navānnādīni yānyapi || 4 ||
śākapatrāṇi sarvāṇi pakvāpakvakaṇām̐stathā |
kandamūlādi yadyogyaṃ bhājīpallavasatphalam || |9 ||
bhūṣāmbarādikaṃ dugdhadadhigūḍarasādikam |
yadyat prāpnoti yatnena mahyaṃ samarpya sarvathā || 6 ||
bhuṃkte yānaṃ vāhanaṃ ca tathopakaraṇānyapi |
nityaṃ nivedya mahyaṃ ca jalānnamapi sarvathā || 7 ||
gṛhṇātyeveti bhakto me śraddhābhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
mūlakṛṣṇapurītīrthaṃ prācīsārasvataṃ tathā || 8 ||
somanāthamahātīrthaṃ gopanāthāditīrthakam |
svarṇarekhānadītīrthaṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām || 9 ||
prayātyeva pragacchan vai bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya pūrvakarmakṛtaṃ tu yat || 3.197.1 0||
janmāntare ca tatprāptametajjanmani colbaṇam |
pūrvamāsīt sa gopālo gorakṣātatparaḥ sadā || 11 ||
tadā tu vṛṣadaṃśān sa pragṛhya govṛṣāt tataḥ |
pakṣau vicchidya sarvān govṛṣadaṃśān vipakṣakān || 11||
kṛtvā kṣipati bhūmau vai daṃśāste pakṣavarjitāḥ |
bhūtale patitāḥ sarve kṣudhātṛṣārditāstathā || 1 3||
mriyante cātiduḥkhena śāpaṃ datvā punaḥ punaḥ |
hastahīnān naḥ kuruṣe tathā tvaṃ bhava duḥkhitaḥ || 14||
daṃśānāṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ pratyahaṃ śāpakāraṇāt |
atra janmani tasyāpi śāṇadharasya hastayoḥ || 15||
pādayoścāpi sarvāṃguṣṭhāṃgulīṣu gado mahān |
galatkuṣṭhātmako jāto durgandhasrāvavāhakṛt || 16||
oṣadhāni kṛtānyeva vaidyānāṃ subahūnyapi |
galatsrāvo na vai naṣṭo roganāśo manāṅ na ca || 17||
mānatā api devānāṃ bahudhā ca kṛtāstathā |
dānapuṇyādikaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ tu bahudhā muhuḥ || 18||
gadastathāpi vavṛdhe nakhā naṣṭāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
aṃgulyagrāṇi naṣṭāni madhyabhāgā galanti ca ||1 9||
āmūlaṃ galitāḥ sarvāṅgulikāṃguṣṭhakāstataḥ |
pūrvakarmānurodhena paraṃ duḥkhamavāpa saḥ ||3.197.20||
putrādyairvāṭikākṣetre ghāsagṛhaṃ vidhāya ca |
tatra pitā sukhaṭvāyāṃ rakṣitaḥ sarvadā rame ||21 ||
ghṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā nitambau sa prayāti pārśvabhūmiṣu |
malaṃ ca kurute tatra mūtraṃ ca kurute’bhitaḥ ||22||
thūtkāraṃ cāpi kurute pārśve kaścinna gacchati |
parito’tīva durgandhā bhūmirjātā ca tadgṛham ||23||
durgandhamalayuktaṃ ca makṣikākākavāsitam |
evaṃvidhāya vṛddhāya putrāstu bhojanaṃ sadā || 24||
dūrāt kṣipanti salilaṃ dūrād dadatyabhāvitāḥ |
makṣikāṇāṃ pakṣahīṇīkṛtānāṃ kramaśaḥ phalam ||29||
bhuṃkte śāpadharo vṛddho jīvo dehāt prayāti na |
nirayaṃ ceha dehe’syāgataṃ bhogāya dāruṇam ||26||
mārjyate naiva kenāpi cikitsitaṃ tu vardhate |
hastapādaphaṇāścāpi galatkuṣṭhena khāditāḥ || 27||
prakoṣṭhaprāntamāptaśca gado’pi vegavānati |
lakṣmi cārājanā loke pakṣijantusarīsṛpān || 28||
paśūn kīṭān mārayanti kumṛtyunā hyaghaṃ mahat |
unduruṃ nakulaṃ godhāṃ caṭakāṃ maṇḍūkaṃ ca vā ||29||
tatphalaṃ krūramevātra labhante sarvanāśakṛt |
apatyāni ca jantūnāṃ mārayanti tathābudhāḥ ||3.197.30||
vṛthā niraparādhān vai śāpasteṣāṃ prajāyate |
vāhanānāmaśvavṛṣagajoṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛthā hyapi ||31 ||
pravṛttānāṃ svakārye’pi kurvanti tāḍanaṃ muhuḥ |
teṣāṃ śāpena sarvasvaṃ naśyati svāminaḥ sukham ||32||
nāryastvajñaiḥ pratāḍyante bālaiśca śvāna ityapi |
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ praśāpena dagdhā bhavanti tāḍakāḥ || 33||
rogiṇaścāpi dīnāśca jalānnavarjitā api |
daridrā dravyahīnāśca gṛhasampadvihīnakāḥ ||34||
kṛtaṃ karma ciraṃ vādyopatiṣṭhatyeva sarvathā |
evamasya kṛtaṃ karma samupapannamulbaṇam |||35|||
mriyate nātiduḥkhe’pi putrādyā bhagnamānasāḥ |
kuṭumbaṃ bhagnavāñcchaṃ ca hatāśaṃ samajāyata ||36||
bhagnaśraddhāstataḥ putrā mantraṇāṃ sapracakrire |
mriyate na pitā rugṇo vāṭikā rogavāyunā ||37||
rugṇasasyānnarūpā ca jātā rugṇasya vāsataḥ |
galatpittasrāvakuṣṭhī mriyeta cecchubhaṃ bhavet || 38||
pūrveṣāṃ cāsya pāpānāṃ bāhulyānmaraṇaṃ na vai |
samāyāti na rogo’pi śānto bhavati vardhate ||39||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ hyupāyo bhāsate na vai |
athāpi hiṃsanaṃ kāryaṃ pituḥ putrairaśobhanam ||3.197.40||
mārayitavya evātra kṣeptavyo’nyatra gartake |
jale pravāhaṇīyo vā jīvan piteti vaiśasam ||41||
rakṣaṇaṃ yujyate nātra kiṃ kāryaṃ duḥsahe vrate |
ityevaṃ pañcaputrāṇāṃ vicāraḥ sampravartate ||42||
kanīyām̐statra sahasā dharmasnehayuto yataḥ |
pitṛsevāphalaṃ jānan bhrātṛmadhye hyuvāca ha ||43|||
pitā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt pitā brahmā tathāparaḥ |
pitṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ pitā sevyo hi vaṃśajaiḥ ||44||
putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevāyāḥ phalaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |
tasmāt prasevanīyaśca rugṇo durvṛtta ityapi ||45||
dvitīyo’pi tataḥ prāha śrutvā kanīyaso vacaḥ |
yogyaṃ tvayoktaṃ śubhadaṃ kintu svāsthye suvartite ||46||
maraṇādadhikaṃ cāsya duḥkhamatra vilokyate |
tasmāt sevā duḥkhadāsya sarvasvarogavardhinī ||47||
yo’sya sevāparaḥ syādvai tasya rogo bhavedapi |
saṃkramaṇādijātīyo gado’yaṃ parasaṃkramaḥ ||48||
tasmāt sevāsya yogyāpi sarvārogyavināśinī |
duṣṭaphalā bhavet tasmāttāṃ sevāṃ nānumodaye ||49||
tṛtīyastu tataḥ prāha sevāyāṃ tvaparaṃ janam |
bhṛtyaṃ vā bhṛtyikāṃ nityaṃ yojayāmaḥ suvetanām |||3.197.50||
caturthaḥ prāha yogyaṃ tattathāpi pramadā naraḥ |
kaścidapi na cāpyeta sevākṛd vetanairapi ||51||
tadā kartavyamevātra kiṃ bhavettad vicāryatām |
pañcamaḥ prāha vai śreṣṭhastadā tu jīvanaḥ pituḥ ||52||
pravāhaṇaṃ tīrthajale nadyāṃ vā sāgare’pi vā |
bhṛgupātā vividhā vai śāstreṣu darśitā yathā ||53||
parvatāt patanaṃ vahnau jvalanaṃ vārigāhanam |
bhūmigarte śayanaṃ vānaśanaṃ tīrthabhūmiṣu ||54||
asādhyarogiṇāṃ virāgiṇāṃ ca nyāsināṃ tathā |
svargecchūnāṃ bhagupātāstādṛśā iṣṭasiddhidāḥ ||55||
antataḥ khalu kartavyaṃ pitṛrbhṛguprapātanam |
yadi bhṛtyo milennaiva na ca seveta vetanaiḥ |||56||
evaṃ vicārya pañcaite kanīyāṃsaṃ nyayojayat |
sevāyāṃ kintu ghṛṇayā vimanāḥ sa vyajāyata ||57||
vītaśraddho’bhavaccāpi bhṛtyaṃ nyayojayattataḥ |
bhṛtyāśca bahavo jātā dinaṃ vā dvidinaṃ ca vā ||58||
kecit pañcadinaṃ bhṛtyāścānye’rdhadinamātrakam |
ghṛṇānvitā na kurvanti sevanaṃ te prayānti hi ||59||
evaṃ bhṛtyānabhilābhe putrāste pañca sammatāḥ |
parvatāt pātanaṃ tvasya rocate’smai vidhīyatām ||3.197.60 ||
pṛṣṭaḥ pitāpi śrutvaiva netyuvācātirāgavān |
vahnau prajvalanaṃ pṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān ||61 ||
galapāśaṃ pratipṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān |
dehāhaṃbhāvayukto’yaṃ maraṇaṃ svīkaroti na ||62||
bhūgarte kṣepaṇaṃ pṛṣṭastathāpi netyuvāca tān |
maraṇaṃ rocate nāsya saritpravāhaṇaṃ na ca ||63||
jīvanaṃ rocate tvasya rugṇadehasya vai pituḥ |
atinikṛṣṭadehe’pi tasya jīvātmanastviha ||64||
nityāśrayatvaṃ snehaśca tādātmyaṃ vai paśoriva |
manuṣyasyāpi devasya jñānino’pi pravartate ||65||
ajñānināṃ viśeṣeṇa kimāścaryaṃ hi saṃsṛtau |
evaṃ pitāpi rugṇe svadehe vṛddhe galaddrave ||66||
tādātmyaṃ samabhiprāptastyaktuṃ notsahate sma vai |
prāha putrān dīnavacca nāhaṃ martuṃ samutsahe ||67||
yathā me dīyate tvannaṃ jalaṃ ca dūratastathā |
dīyatāṃ vāṭikāyāṃ vā pārśve vane’thavā tu me ||68||
ātmaghāto mayā naiveṣyate putrā bhayaṃ mahat |
dṛśyate jāyate prāṇatyāge prasahya cāpyadhi ||69||
smariṣyāmi parātmānaṃ dūraṃ kṣipantu māmitaḥ |
karmaphalaṃ prabhuktvaiva martumicchāmi sarvathā ||3.197.70||
ityuktāste sutāḥ prāhuścāntare kapaṭānvitāḥ |
evamastu pitastvāṃ vai vane kṣipāma eva ha ||71 ||
dāsyāmastatra bhakṣyādi vāṭikāyāṃ tu naiva hi |
kintu vai prathamaṃ tīrthaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ yataḥ śubham ||72||
puṇyaṃ bhavet samastaṃ ca pāpaprakṣālanaṃ bhavet |
mūladvārāvatītīrthaṃ samudratīragaṃ tu yat ||73||
snāpayitvā pitastatra neṣyāmo vāṭikāntikam |
vane saṃrakṣayiṣyāmo rogasaṃkramabhītitaḥ ||74||
ityuktvā te sutāḥ sarve tīrthachadmadharā hi te |
śakaṭyāṃ pitaraṃ dhṛtvā yayuḥ samudrasannidhim |||75|||
taṭaṃ gatvā tu velāyāṃ snāpayāmāsureva tam |
prāhuḥ pitaḥ smagṇīyaṃ smara nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||76||
dravyādi bhūtale nyastaṃ garte vānyatra ced yadi |
darśanīyaṃ kathanīyaṃ pradarśaya nivedaya ||77||
bhṛgupātaṃ samudrasya jale nikṣepaṇātmakam |
kurmaste svargatidaṃ tanmanaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśaya ||78||
ityuktaḥ sa pitā prāha prārabdhaṃ mama tādṛśam |
putrāścātra na vo doṣo maraṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ mama ||79||
bahūni pūrvapāpāni yatphalaṃ cedṛśaṃ tviha |
satsu pañcasu putreṣu satyāṃ patnyāṃ sutāsu ca ||3.197.80||
samudre maraṇaṃ me yad rugṇasya vivaśasya ca |
astvevaṃ kintu sauvarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ nāṇakaṃ bahu ||81 ||
cullyā adho mayā pūrvaṃ nihitaṃ tad vidantvapi |
lakṣādhikaṃ bhavatyeva bahuvarṣārjitaṃ tu tat ||82||
anye naiva prajānanti pañca jānantu me dhanam |
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā hyekabandhuṃ prarakṣakam ||83||
sasmāra hṛdaye śīghraṃ sarvavṛttibhirekadhā |
ekatānena māṃ kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ||84||
dehabhānaṃ tirobhāvyendriyavṛttīrvikuṃcya ca |
āntaraṃ sarvathā bhānaṃ jīvātmani samādadhat ||85||
sve rūpe saccidānandaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rameśaṃ māṇikīpatim ||86||
padmāvatīśvaraṃ brahmapriyānāthaṃ satāṃ patim |
tuṣṭāva svāminaṃ bhaktyā prāṇānte samupasthite ||86||
putrāstu taṃ samuttolya cikṣipurvārdhivāriṣu |
vīkṣamāṇā hyatiṣṭhanta tīre sasnuśca tanmiṣāt ||87||
pitṛdeho jale magno jīvatastasya vai tadā |
mṛto vā jantunā grasta ityamanyanta cātmajāḥ ||88||
rurudustatra putrāste snehādhīnotthamāyayā |
parameśaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca sasmaruḥ pāpanuttaye ||89||
kṣamāṃ kuru harekṛṣṇa pitṛhatyā bhayaṃkarī |
puṇyahantrī svargahantrī mokṣahantrī kṣayaṃkarī ||3.197.90 ||
sā kṛtāsmābhirabdhau vai tāṃ kṣamasva pareśvara |
viṣṇuyajña kariṣyāmaḥ pitṛdravyeṇa bhūriṇā ||91 ||
pituruddharaṇaṃ svarge mokṣe vā saṃvidhehi vai |
ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā mama cānte piturmṛtau ||92||
sapta putryastathā patnī cānaśanaṃ gṛhe vyadhuḥ |
avalāstā nirbalāścāśaktā vaktuṃ durantakam ||93||
balaṃ tvanaśanaṃ cakrurviditvā pitṛghātanam |
pupūjurmāṃ gṛhe tāśca ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ||94 ||
tuṣṭuvuḥ pitṛrakṣārthaṃ vratānāṃ mānatā vyadhuḥ |
lakṣatulasīpatraiśca pūjāṃ me cakrire hi tāḥ ||95||
athāha sahasā lakṣmi bhaktānāṃ śubhakṛt prabhuḥ |
prāvirāsaṃ samudre drāk pitṛdehasya sannidhau ||96||
mūrchāṃ prāpto jalamadhye spṛṣṭo mayā hi rogavān |
rogo naṣṭastadā śīghraṃ sāṃgulihastapādavān ||97||
śāṇadharo’bhavad vṛddhaḥ puṣṭo divyavapurdharaḥ |
uttolito mayā vārdhau jalopari tatastaṭam ||98||
putrāṇāṃ sannidhau kṣiptaḥ pūrṇāṃgo rogavarjitaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ māṃ tatsutāśca saḥ ||99||
pupūjurādarāt sarve tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ tataḥ |
gṛhe cāvirbhūya tatrānaśanārthe sthitāstu yāḥ ||3.197.1 00 ||
striyastābhyo’vadaṃ śāṇadharaścojjīvito mayā |
arugṇaścālayaṃ putraiḥ sākamāyāti satvaram ||1 0 1||
somanāthaṃ tatastīrthaṃ kṛtvā cāyānti te’tra vai |
ityuktāstāḥ pupūjurmāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum ||102||
pratīkṣante sma vāṭaṃ svapituścāgamadaiśikam |
tiro’bhavaṃ tataścāhaṃ dinānte tu pitā gṛham || 1 03||
āyayau putrasahitaścānandotsavayogakṛt |
kuṭumbaṃ suprasannaṃ vai jātaṃ cānye janā api ||104|||
mama māhātmyavettāro’bhavam̐ścāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
bhaktiṃ te kāraṇaṃ prāhuścārogye prāṇarakṣaṇe || 1 05||
atha putraiḥ kṛto yajño mahān vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakaḥ |
devarṣipitaraścāhaṃ tṛptāstatrārpitānnakaiḥ ||1 06||
dakṣiṇābhirdīnajanā bhojanairdehadhāriṇaḥ |
bhaktyā cāhaṃ śrīhariśca prasannā hyabhavan makhe ||107||
evaṃ pitṛghātakānāṃ pituśca rakṣaṇaṃ mayā |
kṛtaṃ lasmi prabhaktānāṃ dayālunā mahātmanā || 1 08||
athānte prāpitā mokṣaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 10 9||
ārogyaṃ jāyate cāpi saubhāgyaṃ cāpi vardhate |
vighnānāṃ ca vināśaḥ syācchatrunāśo bhavedapi ||3.197.1 10 ||
kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vindeta mama bhaktimān |
svargaṃ smṛddhiṃ tathā sveṣṭaṃ jīvanaṃ ca labheta vai ||1 11 ||
bhaktyāhaṃ sarvathā tuṣṭo dadāmi samabhīpsitam |
aiśvaryaṃ ca tathāyuṣyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ sutām ||112||
sarva dadāmi bhaktāyai bhaktāyāpi samudraje |
ityevaṃ bhaktivaśago varte saṃrakṣayāmi ca || 1 13||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śāṇadharākhyakarṣukasya prāgjanmakarmabhirjātagalatkuṣṭharogasya bhayena putraiḥ samudre kṣiptasya bhagavatā roganāśo rakṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 197 | |

<3.198>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ nimbadevo dvijottamaḥ |
saurāṣṭre tvabhavad bhaktaḥ sadālayākhyakharvaṭe || 1 ||
nityaṃ māṃ bhajate bhaktyā dharmajñānavirāgavān |
paropakāranirataḥ sadā dānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
ahiṃsāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ tataḥ param |
hareḥ sevāṃ tato’tyūrdhvāṃ manute cātmaviddhi saḥ || 3 ||
gavāṃ sevāṃ ca kurute viprasevāṃ yathocitām |
prajāsevāmatithīnāṃ sevāṃ karoti cādarāt || 4 ||
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhavaścābhyāgatā yātriṇastathā |
ye cāyānti nijadvāre sevate tān subhāvanaḥ || 5 ||
annasatraṃ kṛtaṃ tena dīnāndhakṛpaṇārthakam |
paśusatraṃ kṛtaṃ tena paṅguvṛddhapaśūpakṛt || 6 ||
evaṃvidho nimbadevo bhajate māmaharniśam |
mandire mama gatvaiva dhyāyati puruṣottamam || 7 ||
mārjanaṃ dīpadānaṃ ca dhūpadānaṃ sumārpaṇam |
jalārpaṇaṃ ca naivedyārpaṇaṃ karoti me sadā || 8 ||
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo hare vibho || 9 ||
evaṃ māṃ kīrtayan yāti mandiraṃ pratiyāti ca |
gṛhaṃ nijaṃ śrāvayam̐śca janān prapāvayan prajāḥ || 3.198.10 ||
atha grāme’bhavattatra vṛṣabho grāmapālitaḥ |
mahākāyo’tibalavān puṣṭaḥ śvetaḥ padāṅkitaḥ ||1 1||
mahākakughnī ca mahāśṛṃgī ca surūpaśobhitaḥ |
grāmopaśalye divase pippalīchāyite sthale ||1 2||
niṣīdati kvacid grāme rājapathe’pyaṭatyapi |
rātrau carati kṣetreṣu sasyāni vāṭikāsvapi ||1 3||
punaḥ prātaḥ samāgatya tiṣṭhati grāmabhūmiṣu |
etādṛśo’yaṃ vṛṣabho yadā yadā prapaśyati ||14||
nimbadevaṃ grāmamadhye mārge kṣetre ca catvare |
upaśalye vāṭikāyāṃ yatra kvāpi prapaśyati || 15||
tāvaddrutaṃ catuṣpādaiḥ raudrarūpo’bhidhāvati |
mārayituṃ nimbadevaṃ mardayituṃ vināśitum || 1 6||
pūrvavairaṃ smaran yadvanmarākrodhena dhāvati |
vairaniryāpanārthaṃ kiṃ vāsya pūrvasya janmanaḥ || 17||
evaṃ jāte bahuvāre nimbadevo nijaṃ drutam |
rakṣatyeva ca kauśalyādāpaṇe vā gṛhe viśan ||18 ||
vedyāmāruhya ca vṛkṣaṃ samāruhyoccasaṃstare |
rakṣatyeva nijaṃ nityaṃ rathyāyāṃ yāti bhītavat ||1 9||
yatra tiṣṭhati vṛṣabhastāṃ rathyāṃ sa vihāya vai |
anyayā rathyayā yāti kāryārthaṃ tu bahirgṛhāt ||3.198.20 ||
rājamārge catvare vā kṣetre vāṭyāṃ ca gopure |
upaśalye bhūtalādau taddṛṣṭyagre na yāti vai ||21 ||
evaṃ bhītamanā nityaṃ nimbadevaḥ pravartate |
vṛṣabho’pi sadā nimbadevaṃ sammārgayatyapi ||22||
kadā milenmārayāmi tathāsannaddhavatsthitaḥ |
evaṃ kāle bahugate hyekadā devamandiram ||23||
darśanārthaṃ nimbadevaḥ prayāti yaṣṭivarjitaḥ |
niśāmukhe’tha bhāgyena daivayogāttu sannidhau ||24||
rathyāyāṃ militaścāyaṃ vṛṣabhastaṃ nirāyudham |
ativegena dudrāva ruṣā sa vṛṣabho balī ||25||
mārayituṃ nimbadevaṃ kurvan gogarjanāṃ tadā |
paścāttu śakaṭaṃ cāyātyeva paścād dvitīyakam ||26||
mārge saṃkucite pārśvayoścāpi nāvakāśakaḥ |
vidyate dhāvituṃ kvāpi vṛṣabho’bhipradhāvati ||27||
eva cobhayataḥpāśe mārge mṛtyupradāyake |
drāgeva nimbadevastu hariṃ sasmāra māṃ tadā ||28|||
dadarśa patitaṃ tatra grāvāṇaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tathā |
karatolyaṃ satvaraṃ taṃ coddhṛtya vai kare balāt ||29||
sarvavegena hastena vṛṣabhasya tu mastake |
tāḍayāmāsa sahasā ghātayāmāsa sarvathā ||3.198.30||
bhedayāmāsa śiraso lalāṭaṃ vṛṣabhastadā |
tāḍanena drutaṃ mūrchāmavāpya bhramaṇadvayam ||31||
nipapāta kṣitau tatra mamāra ca kṣaṇāditi |
ātatāyivadhe doṣo nāsti cedaṃ tathābhavat ||32||
daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śṛṃgiṇāṃ kvāpi viśvāsaḥ śastriṇāṃ tathā |
vicittānāṃ na kartavyaścaurāṇāṃ kṣuttṛṣārthinām ||33||
rājñāṃ cāpi ca veśyānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tathā |
nakhināṃ tāmasānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||34||
agnīnāṃ ca jalānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ svārthināṃ tathā ||
kunārīṇāṃ kusādhūnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na |35||
jīrṇānāṃ cāpi yantrāṇāṃ vāhanānāṃ vinodinām |
hiṃsrāṇāṃ hāsyakartṝṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||36||
yūnāṃ ca rogiṇāṃ krodhāviṣṭānāṃ tyāgināmapi |
bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca mūrkhāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||37||
apakvaśemuṣīṇāṃ cālasānāṃ dharmaghātinām |
nāstikānāṃ ratisthānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||38||
aparicitavargāṇāṃ śaṭhānāṃ lobhināṃ tathā |
astrīkāṇāṃ kāmināṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na || 39||
meghānāṃ cātapānāṃ ca rajasāṃ marutāṃ tathā |
tamasāṃ tāmasānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.40||
mohavatāṃ madavatāṃ bahunamrasvabhāvinām |
antaḥpraveśaṃ dadhatāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||41 ||
yātriṇāṃ kṣaṇasārthānāṃ mahīmānādidehinām |
svatantrayoṣitāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||42|||
sapatnīnāṃ ca duṣṭānāmanavadhānaśālinām |
anākṣāvartamāna|nā kāryo viśvāsa eva na |||42||
śraddhāśūnyajanānāṃ ca naṭanartakayoginām |
dyūtasthānāṃ raṇasthānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||44||
snehaśūnyahṛdayānāṃ vijātīyopakāriṇām |
nāpitānāṃ madyapānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||45||
chidravīkṣāsvabhāvānāmirṣyukāṇāṃ pramādinām |
anabhyastanavīnānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||46||
bahumiṣṭavacasāṃ ca nītimārgavirodhinām |
aśāstragāmināṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||47||
amanaskāṅgīkartṝṇāṃ yaśaḥkīrtivināśinām |
vivādaśālīmanasāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||48||
luñcāvṛttiprajīvānāmanṛtānyāyavartinām |
satyarodhavatāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||49||
gahvarāṇāṃ vanānāṃ cāraṇyānāṃ sarasāṃ tathā |
śāntendriyādivṛttīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.50||
asthirāṇāṃ ca dīrghāṇāṃ vāmanānāṃ vilambinām |
kāṇānāṃ cāpi khañjānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||51 ||
saṃkucitapraṇāḍīnāṃ tyaktakuṭumbināṃ tathā |
tyaktadeśaprajānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||52||
gaṇikānāṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ śaraṇāgatayoṣitām |
rājasambandhinārīṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||53||
ativṛṣṭipradeśānāṃ śādvalānāṃ bhuvāṃ tathā |
parvatānāṃ kardamānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||94||
ajñātavṛttavaidyānāṃ śmaśānānāṃ tarasvinām |
ajñātānāmoṣadhīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||95||
śatrudāpitabhojyānāṃ śatrudāpitagandhinām |
śatrupreṣitalokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||56||
śanupoṣyaśukānāṃ ca śanupālitapakṣiṇām |
śatrusambadhipatrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||57||
atikrodhitapatnīnāmatikrodhitasvāminām |
atibhuktajanānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||568||
atijīrṇālayānāṃ ca tathātijīrṇadehinām |
atijīrṇauṣadhānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||5 9||
mantratantraprasaktānāṃ rasāyanapravedinām |
āsurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.60||
atra mānaṃ tatra mānaṃ ceti mānābhilāṣiṇām |
dvijihvānāṃ caikalānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||61 ||
vidhurāṇāṃ vidhavānāṃ kūṭanīnāṃ ca yoṣitām |
virāgiṇīnāṃ bhūtīnāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||62||
digbhramāṇāṃ pretabhūtāviṣṭānāṃ vāyurogiṇām |
paracakragatānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||63||
sarīsṛpāṇāṃ jalināṃ yādasāṃ vakragāminām |
bubhukṣitānāṃ lokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||64||
cārāṇāṃ vanavāsānāṃ pararāṣṭrapraveśinām |
asnigdhānāṃ cāśritānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||65||
pratiṣṭhāpitadevānāṃ tāmasānāṃ tu sarvathā |
aparādhātmake kārye kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||66||
āpatkālābhibhūtānāṃ bāliśānāṃ vacassu ca |
svārthasādhakalokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||67||
anekagṛhabhṛtyānāṃ naikanṛpaiḥ suyoginām |
sīmni kṛtālayānāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||68||
rātricarāṇāṃ prasahya hāṭakāṇāṃ ca duḥkhinām |
avijñātacaritrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||69||
udvegināṃ virāgāṇāṃ vratināṃ haṭhadharmiṇām |
bāhyavṛttiparāṇāṃ ca kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||3.198.70||
śaivālitakṣitīnāṃ ca bhagnanāvāṃ manasvinām |
kṣaṇe ruṣṭapratuṣṭānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||71 ||
dehendriyādisaktānāṃ daityānāṃ parayoṣitām |
samāje bahulokānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||72||
utsave cerṣyukāṇāṃ copapatyuścopayoṣitām |
tathaiva copaputrāṇāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||73||
upamātṝṇāmandhānāṃ vaṇijāṃ ca kutarkiṇām |
mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||74||
rogāṇāṃ ca kṣatānāṃ ca phullānāṃ kampināṃ tathā |
bahusvapnavatāṃ cāpi kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||75||
ajñātānāmaśrutānāmanabhyastādikarmiṇām |
anabhyastapācakānāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||76||
ardhābhyāsavatāṃ nirmūlānāmapāravarṣmaṇām |
ākāśālambanavatāṃ kāryo viśvāsa eva na ||77||
tatra tatra hi viśvasto duḥkhaṃ kṣatiṃ tathāpadam |
maraṇaṃ vā prayātyeva lakṣmi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||78||
nimbadevastathā matvā jaghāna vṛṣabhaṃ tadā |
gohatyā sāsya saṃlagnā nimbadevo vicittatām ||79||
upāgamad drutaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇatāṃ kuṣṭharogitām |
yathākathañcit sahasā svālayaṃ samupāyayau ||3.198.8 0||
viprānāhūya hatyāṃ tāṃ nyavedayaddvijā api |
ūcustaṃ viṣṇuyāgārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca vatsaram ||8 1 ||
ekabhuktatvamevāpi sahasragopradānakam |
so’pi sarvaṃ pracakre ca yajñānte dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ||82||
tathāpi śyāmavarṇo’sya vicittatā na nirgatā |
atha khedaṃ jagāmāpi prasasmāra ca māṃ harim ||83||
bhaktaṃ jñātvā paraṃ nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ puro’bhavam |
pratyakṣo divyarūpaśca pasparśa taṃ svabāhunā ||84||
drāgeva bhaktaḥ śveto’bhūt sucittaḥ svastha eva ca |
tasmai datto mayā mantrastaṃ jagrāhātibhāvataḥ ||85||
bālakṛṣṇo hariḥ sākṣānmokṣado bhagavān mama |
so’pi mantramuvācaivaṃ sarvadātha tataḥ sa tu ||86||
prāpte kāle yayau muktiṃ bhakto me nimbadevakaḥ |
evaṃ hatyāghanāśo vai mayādhvare’sya vartitaḥ ||87||
nāśubhaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ tiṣṭhatyeva hi madbalāt |
śṛṇu lakṣmi nimbadevasyāsīd bhṛtyaḥ sa prāgbhave ||88||
vetanaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca labdhvāpi pūrṇakarma saḥ |
karoti naivālasaḥ sa pramādī krodhano’pi ca ||89||
jvareṇa sa mṛto bhṛtyo balīvardo babhūva ha |
jātismaro’yaṃ nityaṃ vai yāvat paśyati svāminam ||3.198.90 ||
nityaṃ kārye yojakaṃ svaṃ cādhikṣepiṇamityapi |
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā vairabhāvaṃ prakāśayati tatra ca ||91 ||
dhāvatyeva svāminaṃ svaṃ mārayituṃ krudhā ruṣā |
evaṃvidho hi vṛṣabhaḥ svāmihastena vai mṛtim |||92||
prāpya ṛṇaṃ pradātuṃ ca punastasya suto’bhavat |
śobhano jñānavām̐ścāpi bahukāryakaro’pi ca |||93||
nimbadevastu vārdhakye sarvaṃ datvā sutāya ha |
bhajate māṃ prabhuṃ nityaṃ kuṭumbena yuto rame ||94||
suto’pi māṃ bhajate ca nāmnā gokulavardhanaḥ |
anne muktiṃ hyavāpāpi bhaktyā me sa suto’pi vai ||95||
evaṃ lakṣmi kṛtā doṣā naśyantyeva pratāpataḥ |
mama bhaktestathā dhyānāt kīrtanāccharaṇāgamāt ||96 ||
satāṃ sevāprasaṃgācca naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ |
bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sevanādapi ||97||
āśīrvādād vinaśyanti sarvāṇyaghāni sarvaśaḥ |
sarvavighnāni naśyanti sarvāpannāśanaṃ tathā ||98||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nimbadevākhyabhaktasya gohatyāpāpaṃ bhagavatā nivāritamityādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||

<3.199>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kāruṇyāt pravadāmi yat |
sarvairjanaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ sacchāstrāṇāṃ prasevanam || 1 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāścāsyāḥ prasevanam |
nārībhiśca naraiścāpi kartavyaṃ sarvadehibhiḥ || 2 ||
mama bhaktiprakārāśca mokṣasya sādhanānyapi |
svargasya hetavaścāpi sṛṣṭīnāṃ vartanāni ca || 3 ||
uktānyatra samastāni bahūni kṛpayā mayā |
aikāntikā mama bhaktā uditā hi mayā śubhāḥ | | 4 ||
dehātmabuddhayaścāpi brahmātmabuddhayastathā |
svārthaparāstathā coktāḥ parārthā divyadharmiṇaḥ || 5 ||
divyāstu dehatritayād bhinne cātmani niṣṭhitāḥ |
ātmanyatiprakāśe te sākṣānmāṃ samupāsate || 6 ||
īkṣante te cātiprakāśātmarūpaṃ sanātanam |
ātmarūpe bālakṛṣṇamīkṣante māṃ pareśvaram || 7 ||
atitejasvinaṃ sākṣād ramantaṃ cātmanā saha |
ta ete divyadṛgvantaścātra loke sthitā api || 8 ||
brahmapurasthitāḥ santi yūyaṃ brahmapriyā yathā |
brahmabhāvastu bhaktābhiḥ sādhanīyo’tisaukhyadaḥ || 9 ||
śrīpatau mayi yāsāṃ vā yeṣāṃ manuṣyabhāvanā |
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ vighnabhayaṃ viraho me bhavediti || 3.199.10 ||
aprāptirmama dhāmnaśca kvacit syānmadabhāvataḥ |
ato loke mama bhaktā naiva kurvanti vai mayi || 11 ||
manuṣyabhāvanāṃ kvāpi kurvanti divyabhāvanām |
yathā tu bhāvanā divyā mayi tathā nije’pi ca || 12||
kartavyā bhāvanā divyā na tu dehātmabhāvanā |
dehātmabhāvanā vighnapradā bhavati dehinām || 1 3||
brahmā mohaṃ gato vīkṣya pārvatīrūpameva ha |
skhalitaśca tato jātā bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ || 14||
śaṃkaro mohinīṃ māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mugdho’bhavattathā |
nārado dehabhāvena vivāhaṃ samiyeṣa ca || 15||
evamanye’pi bahavo mohaṃ muktā gatā api |
mohātmakaṃ mahadvighnaṃ jāyate dehabhāvinām ||1 6||
divyabhāvayutānāṃ tu cātmaniṣṭhānivāsinām |
śukavad brahmabhāvo vai jāyate sanakādivat || 17||
sarvā līlā mama divyā boddhavyā ratirāsajā |
muktidā sā bhavatyeva mayi snehena yoginī ||18||
sneho gāḍhānurāgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi |
premātirekaḥ satataṃ nijātmani sthirastu yaḥ || 1 9||
snehenānena bhaktānāṃ māyāsneho vilīyate |
māyāsneha sthitiṃ kartuṃ dadātyeva na cāntare |||3.199.20||
dhyānaṃ snehena satataṃ kartavyaṃ mama nityadā |
dhyānavṛttiḥ sthirā syācca mahāsamādhikāraṇam ||21 ||
vṛttisthairye bhavedekāntikatā mayi keśave |
śāśvatānandasandohe mahāsukhaprade prabhau ||22||
sarvakriyāsu satataṃ mayi sthairyaṃ vidhāpayet |
evamabhyasane jāte cātmā niruddhyate mayi ||23 ||
sendriyāntaḥkaraṇaḥ saṃpralagno jāyate mayi |
evaṃ cittanirodhena sarvarodhe bhavenmayi |||24|||
premātirekastatrāsti kāraṇaṃ netarad rame |
bhaktānāṃ mānasaṃ snehāt sthiraṃ syānmayi tattathā ||25||
teṣāmātmasu sahasā vāso me ca bhaved rame |
premṇā vāsastu mūrterme sākṣādvat smārako bhavet ||26||
mahātmyajñānamevāpi premṇā nityaṃ pravardhate |
māhātmyajñānayukpremā brahmātmasthitimṛcchati ||27||
na sa māyāṃ prapaśyet saṃpaśyenmāṃ brahma śāśvatam |
akṣaraṃ divyarūpaṃ ca saccidānandasaṃbhṛtam ||28 ||
tatra nijātmarūpe vai cākṣare brahmaśāśvate |
sadaikarasacaitanyaprakāśe vyāpake’bhitaḥ ||29||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ parameśvaram |
divyaṃ kāntaṃ samīkṣeta nānyamākāramīkṣate ||3.199.3 0||
eṣā brāhmī sthitirdivyā parāvidyāsthitistathā |
divyajñānasthitiścāpi jñānapralayasaṃjñikā ||3 1||
sākṣātkṛṣṇe pare deve śāśvatasthiratātmikā |
asyā nityaṃ samārambhaṃ yaḥ karoti tu dehabhāk ||32| |
sa yāti paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ lakṣmi yathā tava |
pratyakṣasya mahimā me yāvaj jñāto’sti yena vai ||33 ||
tasya tāvān prakāśo’pi hṛdaye kṛpayā bhavet |
cinmayaṃ taṃ prakāśaṃ ca vardhamānavekṣate ||34||
mahimānaṃ vardhamānaṃ yāvantaṃ vindate tathā |
tāvantaṃ praṇavaṃ cāpi tāvadrūpaṃ ca me tathā ||35||
vardhamānaṃ brahmarūpe vindate kṛpayā mama |
kramāt sarvatra sampūrṇaṃ prakāśaṃ paripaśyati ||36||
śṛṇoti mama nāmnāṃ vai nādānāṃ madhurān dhvanīn |
brahmanādeṣu magnasya magnasya svātmani dhruve ||37||
amāyikasya muktasya brahmībhūtatvameva tat |
mama māhātmyānubhavo yasyādhikyena yāvatā ||38|||
tāvatā brahmabhāvasya parātmano mamekṣaṇam |
parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prapannasya mama māhātmyavedinaḥ ||39||
kālamāyāniyantṛtvādyaiśvaryaṃ samajāyate |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ matsamo’pi saḥ ||3.199.40||
sarvāvatāradhartāhaṃ kālamāyāniyāmakaḥ |
guṇātīto nirvikāraḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ ||41 ||
śreyo’rthaṃ dehināmatra svecchayā bhāmi martyavat |
martyavacca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ karomi bhaktahetave ||42||
tatra vimūḍhamatayaścālpajñāścarmacakṣuṣaḥ |
nijadṛṣṭāntamāsādya doṣān prakalpayanti te ||43||
nirdoṣo’haṃ sadā lakṣmi cintāmaṇisamaḥ sadā |
kalpakeṣu kalpyadoṣāḥ praviśanti hi te’khilāḥ ||44||
manyante kāminaṃ māṃ ye kāminaste bhavanti vai |
krodhinaṃ māṃ kalpayanti krodhinaste bhavanti ca ||45||
manyante māṃ lampaṭaṃ ye bhavanti lampaṭāstu te |
māyāvinaṃ tu jānanti māyāvino bhavanti te ||46 ||
adivyaṃ māṃ vijānanti hyāsurāḥ kṣudrabuddhayaḥ |
divyaṃ cāpi manuṣyaṃ māṃ divyaṃ jānanti ye tu vai ||47||
te tu bhavanti divyāśca hyadivyā api devatāḥ |
api nrākṛtimīśaṃ māṃ nirdoṣaṃ māṃ vidanti ye ||48||
sadoṣā api jāyante nirdoṣāste balānmama |
vaśe yasya samastānīndriyāṇi cāntarāṇi ca ||49||
saṃkalpo’pi vaśe yasya pratyakṣakṛṣṇaniścayaḥ |
sa eva pūrṇo dhanyaśca kṛtārthaśca mataḥ sadā ||3.199.50 ||
yathā muktastathā so’pi yathākṣare tathātra saḥ |
yathā divyastathā cātra sarvaiśvaryānvito bhavet ||51 ||
manyeta sa nijaṃ bhāgyaṃ bhāgyena śrīhareḥ saha |
miśritaṃ na pṛthak lakṣmi dhanyaṃ manyeta vai nijam ||52|
kāmādidāvadagdhe’tra loke dhanyo’smi yanmama |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmimela ha ||53||
santastasya tu militā mokṣadā doṣanāśakāḥ |
yatprasādena jeṣyāmi kāmādīnāntarānarīn ||54||
brahmarūpeṇa ca kṛṣṇopāsanāṃ mokṣadāyinīm |
kariṣyāmi bhāgyayogaiḥ kṛpayā śrīharestathā ||55||
etādṛśā mama bhaktā bhāgyavanto rame matāḥ |
prāptapūrṇaguṇāste vai cintāmaṇiprayogiṇaḥ ||56||
nahi teṣvastyapūrṇatvaṃ paripūrṇā mamāśrayāt |
pratyakṣo’haṃ yadeteṣāṃ milito rādhikāpatiḥ ||97||
pūrvajanmotthasukṛtaṃ tveteṣāṃ bahulaṃ yataḥ |
satsaṃgasya mahāyogo jāto’sya mokṣado yataḥ ||58||
prapannasya tu bhaktasyāpūrṇatā ced bhaved yadi |
apaneyātmaniṣṭhāḍhyamāhātmyajñānatastu sā ||59||
ātmaniṣṭhā nirbalā cet samādhāvapi duḥkhadā |
śrūyante tu yadā nādā brahmāṇḍabhedakā iva ||3.199.60 ||
samādhau tu tadā cātmaniṣṭhāhīno bibheti ha |
ātmasatto nirbhayo vai brahmatādātmyameti ca ||6 1 ||
brahmāṇḍadāhakaṃ tejastatrekṣate samādhimān |
tadā bibhetyasāvātmaniṣṭhāhīno vināśrayam ||62 ||
harirvā tasya tanmārge sahāyaḥ premabhāvitaḥ |
ātmavidvā bhayaṃ naiti hareḥ sahāyavām̐śca vā ||63||
ātmavidaḥ pratruṭyanti sarvā viṣayavāsanāḥ |
nirodhaṃ tvekavṛttitvāccittaṃ kṛṣṇe’sya vindati ||64||
sarvendriyapravāhāṇāṃ kṛṣṇe mayi visarjanam |
kṛtvā stheyaṃ mama bhaktairvighnaṃ nāsya prajāyate ||65||
ekabalaṃ caikavṛtti cittaṃ bhaktasya susthiram |
mayyeva tu yadā jātaṃ tadākraṣṭuṃ na śakyate ||66||
ramyaiścāpi padārthairvai yato nirvāsanaṃ hi tat |
niruddhaṃ mama mūrtau tanmadanyacintanojjhitam ||67||
evaṃ satāṃ mānasaṃ vai mayi ruddhaṃ prajāyate |
hitvānyat kṛṣṇapūrṇārthāḥ kurvate madupāsanam ||68||
evaṃ lakṣmi kṛpāsādhyo bhavāmi pūrṇakāmadaḥ |
mahābhāgavatāḥ santo bhajante navadhā hi mām ||69||
brahmaniṣṭhā ātmavido mama māhātmyavedinaḥ |
bhaktiniṣṭhaḥ sadā sevāniṣṭhasteṣāṃ pravardhate ||3.199.70||
tathā tādātmyaniṣṭhaśca sampadyate mayā saha |
sadbhistathāpi nodricyaṃ hyudreke dagdhabījatā ||71 ||
hareḥ kṛpā tādṛśācca nivartate hi niṣphalā |
tasmānmayyeva saṃsthāpyaṃ sarvaṃ cābhyudayādikam ||72||
buddhirmano’pyahaṃkāraścittaṃ cendriyavṛttayaḥ |
deho dehaguṇāścāpi sthāpanīyā mayīśvare |||73||
rasikatvaṃ harāveva bālakṛṣṇe mayi prabhau |
samarpaṇīyaṃ satataṃ śrīlakṣmīrādhikāpatau ||74||
gāyanasya rasaścāpi samarpaṇīya īśvare |
kīrtanaṃ hāvabhāvāścārpaṇīyā parame mayi ||75||
mayyarpaṇaṃ vinā bhāvo raso’nyatra bhaved yadi ||
tatra syālagnatā tena bhraṃśaḥ syācchreyasāṃ pathaḥ ||76||
ekāntikasya bhaktasya rasikasya na saṃbhavet |
rasaḥ kvāpi madanyeṣu padārtheṣu jagatsu vai ||77||
mama līlāguṇabhāji śabde yasya raso mataḥ |
nānyatra sa eva me’sti śābdiko rasikaḥ priyaḥ ||78||
mamāṃgayogisaṃsparśe yad bhaktasya rato mataḥ |
nānyatra spārśane kvāpi sparśīyarasikaḥ sa me ||79||
mamaivekṣā māmakānāmīkṣā yasya rasānvitā |
nānyā yasyāsti didṛkṣā rūpīyarasikaḥ sa me ||3.199.8 0||
madarpitānnatāmbūlaprabhṛtisvādasadrasaḥ |
yasyāsti na tvitaratra rasīyarasikaḥ sa me ||8 1 |
madarpitasugandhāderghrāṇane yasya sadrasaḥ |
nānyatra saurabhādau sa gandhīyarasiko mama ||82||
grahaṇaṃ mama divyānāṃ padārthānāṃ tu hastayoḥ |
gamanaṃ mandirāṇāṃ me pradakṣiṇaṃ ca pādayoḥ ||83 ||
kathanaṃ matkathādīnāṃ vāco yasya rasātmakam |
ānandādyaṃ mama yogānmadratau yasya sadrasaḥ ||84||
evamādyāni sarvāṇi madarthe rasabhāñji vai |
mano buddhistathā cittamahaṃkāro’pi mārutaḥ ||85||
sarve madrasabhāvā vai yasya bhaktasya santi hi |
pramodo yasya manmūrtau mūrteśca viṣayeṣvapi ||86||
bhāgavateṣu divyeṣu rasotkarṣo hi sarvathā |
ātyantikī ruciścāpi mayyeva yasya vartate ||87||
jāgrataḥ svapato vāpi mūrchitasyāpi sarvathā
turyāsthitasya mayyeva yasya sarvo raso mataḥ ||88||
tasya bhaktasya divyasya satyā rasikatā matā |
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya rasikasya sadā hṛdi ||89||
bhāse’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ divyamūrtimān |
paśyato mama mūrtiṃ ca hṛdaye drāgalaukikīm ||3.199.90 ||
prakāśate brahmatejo bhāse tasminnahaṃ prabhuḥ |
tasmād bhaktaiḥ pradhāryaṃ me rūpaṃ gāyanakīrtanaiḥ ||91 ||
mānasaṃ ca mama rūpe sātma śraddhāsamanvitam |
yatra kvāpi praveṣṭuṃ na śakyetānyena vastunā ||92||
yataḥ samartho bhagavān māyikāni samastataḥ |
dūrīkaroti vighnāni sarveśvareśvaro hi saḥ ||93 ||

evaṃvidhasya vijñasya brahmasthitirbhavediha |
hṛdi tasya praveśaṃ na kurvanti māyikāni vai || 3.199.100 ||
divyā sthitirbhavatyeva sukhaduḥkhasamāsya vai |
pūjane tāḍane hastyārohaṇe kharavāhane || 101 ||
śatrau mitre tathā svarṇe lauhe rūpe kurūpake |
avamāne ca māne ca samatāsya hi vartate || 102 ||
etādṛśasya hṛdaye vāso me sarvadāsti vai |
asya prapūjanaṃ devā īśvarā vidadhatyapi || 10 3||
saṃsāriṇāṃ samuddhartā bhavatyayaṃ bhavārṇavāt |
ādhāro jagatāṃ cāyaṃ sāmarthyavān bhavatyapi || 1 04||
asaṃkhyaguṇakalyāṇairyukto mokṣaṃ dadātyapi |
asya mūrtau mama mūrtirvasatyeva sadā rame || 1 05||
asyendriyeṣu sarvāṇīndriyāṇi me vasantyapi |
asyāntaḥkaraṇe sarvaṃ madantaḥkaraṇaṃ rame || 106 ||
ataḥ sa sarvalokānāṃ netrādīnāṃ prakāśane |

paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed rame || 3.199.110 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śrīhariṇā svaikāntikabhaktānāṃ brahmaniṣṭhataiśvaryādīni kathitānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 199 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca

sarvaguṇāguṇādhāraṃ divyamāyādhipaṃ tathā || 1 07||
doṣādoṣāśrayaṃ nyāyānyāyāśrayaṃ prabhuṃ vibhum |
aṇuṃ mahāntaṃ dīrghaṃ ca kāmākāmāśrayaṃ tathā || 1 08||
aiśvaryānaiśvaryayuktaṃ bhayābhayasamanvitam |
sadasatsarvakośaṃ ca yāvadāścaryasaṃbhṛtam || 1 09||
karmākarmāśrayaṃ cāpi sarvāśrayaṃ yathāyatham |
asaṃbhavo harau nāsti yasya kasyāpi sarvathā || 3.200.11 0||
asuṣṭhoścāpi suṣṭhośca mahāśrayo harirhi saḥ |
sarvaṃ ghaṭate kṛṣṇe vai sarvaśarīraśāyini || 111 ||
anvite tatra sarvatra ghaṭate dehavat kriyā |
vyatireke’pi sarvaṃ vai ghaṭate māyayojjhitam || 112||
samāye māyayā tulyamamāye nijatulyakam |
ghaṭate ca tato nāsyāśraye vighnaṃ prajāyate || 11 3||
evaṃ samāśritaḥ kṛṣṇo jñānena cet pareśvaraḥ |
sarvakalānidhiḥ syāt sa sarvādhiśreyasāṃ pradaḥ || 11 4||
āśrayeṇa samastāni kṛtāni sādhanāni vai |
bhavantyeva na saṃdehastaṃ prasādhya pramokṣayet || 1 15||
kālīndara sadā jñātvā kurvāśrayaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
śasyasyeva paraṃdhāma bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 11 6||
ityuktvā prayayau sādhuranyāṃ diśaṃ yathocitām |
kālīndarādyā bhejuśca lakṣmi māṃ tadvacaḥsthitāḥ || 1 17||
athāhaṃ nītavām̐stām̐ścākṣaraṃ me paramaṃ padam |
dehānte me dṛḍhamāśrayaṃ gatān bhaktibhāginaḥ || 1 18||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād vartanāttathā |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva kṛpayā me rame sadā || 11 9||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhāṇḍīragrāmasthasya kālīndarabhāṇḍasya nartakyādisahitasya paramabhaktyā mokṣaṇaṃ kamalāyanamaharṣerupadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 200 ||

<3.201>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya nartakasya vai |
nāmnā rāyaṇadevasya kathāṃ bhaktividhāyinīm || 1 ||
ākhoṭake mahāgrāme bhakto rāyaṇadevakaḥ |
nyavasat sakuṭumbo vai bhajate sma ca māṃ sadā | | 2 ||
pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatraivopatiṣṭhate |
prāgjanmani mayūro’bhūd grāmagopurasannidhau || 3 ||
upaśalyatarau nityanivāsaścarate’bhitaḥ |
sādhavo ye samāyānti tairthikā yātrikāśca vai || 4 ||
vihāriṇaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ye te vāṭe grāmamāpya ca |
taruṣaṇḍe’vatiṣṭhantyāsate dinadvayaṃ ca vā || 5 ||
bhajanaṃ tatra kurvanti pācayanti ca bhuñjate |
niveditaṃ haraye te jalaṃ pibanti sarvathā || 6 ||
ucchiṣṭāni ca pātrāṇi patrāṇi ca jalānnakam |
kṣipanti taruṣaṇḍeṣu sthitapakṣyarthamityapi || 7 ||
ucchiṣṭānnāni pānīyaṃ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā |
kīṭādyā bhakṣayantyāpaḥ pibanti ca viyanti ca || 8 ||
hareḥ prasādānnavāri mayūro’tti pibatyapi |
sādhoḥ prāsādikaṃ cāpi samyak pibati cātti ca || 9 ||
evaṃ prasādamāptasya tasya supuṇyamūrjitam |
pāpaṃ tu pralayaṃ prāptaṃ mṛtaḥ kālena so’bhavat || 3.201.10 ||
hārītakākhyaśūdrasya patnyāṃ kastūrikāstriyām |
garbhe viveśa puṇyena pakṣī mānavajanmavān || 11 ||
garbhe vāsottaraṃ tatrāṣṭame māsi subhaktimān |
bodhāyano maharṣiśca sādhudharmā samāyayau || 1 2||
vipro bhikṣākṛte’gācca hārītakagṛhaṃ tadā |
hārītakaḥ prārthayacca jñātvā daivajñabhūsuram || 1 3||
gṛhṇa bhikṣāṃ pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarāstathā |
sthiro bhavātra divase saṃśayānme nirākuru || 14||
ityuktvā pradadau bhikṣāṃ miṣṭamannaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ |
piṣṭaṃ phalāni madhūni cāsanaṃ jalamuttamam || 19||
bodhāyanaḥ pācayitvā nivedya paramātmane |
bubhuje’tha prasādaṃ ca śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tadā || 16||
hārītakakuṭumbāya bubhuje’pi kuṭumbakam |
sāyaṃ svāsthye sthiravṛttau papraccha taṃ mahāmunim || 17||
patnyā garbhe bālako vā bālā vā kiṃ bhavediti |
kathaṃguṇaṃ madapatyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti me vad || 18||
cirāyurvāpi vai svalpāyuśca bhakto bhavenna vā |
kathaṃ nārāyaṇe deve bhaktiḥ śraddhā bhavedapi || 1 9||
kathaṃ mokṣo divyatā ca kathaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ |
kathaṃ sādhoḥ prasaṃgaśca sevā dharmāvalambanam ||3.201.20||
kathaṃ muktiḥ kathaṃ tyāgaḥ kathaṃ saṃsāranāśanam |
kathaṃ caiśvaratā syācca muktatā gṛhamedhinaḥ || 21 ||
ityetāni samastānyamṛtāni me prapāyaya |
ityuktaḥ sādhuvaryastu bodhāyano hi bhaktarāṭ ||22||
pratyuvāca kuṭumbasya sannidhau yatra garbhiṇī |
vartate sā śṛṇotyeva kathāṃ paramapāvanīm || 23||
śṛṇu hārītaka tvaṃ vai patnī te ca śṛṇotvapi |
kuṭumbaṃ te śṛṇotvatra hitaṃ vacmi hitottamam ||24|||
bālakaste hi bhavitā putraścoddhārakṛcchubhaḥ |
sādhubhakto harerbhaktaḥ pūrvasaṃskāravāniha || 25||
mayūravat samastāni nṛtyāni prakariṣyati |
sādhuprasādabhoktā ca cirāyurbhaktimān sadā ||26||
muktiṃ tava kuṭumbasya bhaktyā sa vai kariṣyati |
lakṣmīpradaste satataṃ bhāgyaśālī bhaviṣyati || 27||
nārāyaṇapradaścāpi vaiṣṇavaḥ sa bhaviṣyati |
parātparatare kṛṣṇe mahānandanidhau prabhau ||28||
lagnavṛttirhi bhavitā cābālyāttava bālakaḥ |
prāgjanmāsya mayūrasya tato nṛtyakalāvidām ||29||
mūrdhanyo’yaṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati prabhaktarāṭ |
tasya nṛtye ca ye nṛtyavido janāstathāpare ||3.201.3 0||
nartakyaścāpi sarvāśca miliṣyanti kalāvidaḥ |
sarve tvatputrasaṃgena bhaviṣyantyapi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||3 1 ||
mokṣamārge śrayiṣyanti yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
api jīvā māyikā vai māyāsṛṣṭe jagatyapi |||2||
vartante bahavo nityaṃ nṛtyagītivilāsinaḥ |
pūrvaṃ nārāyaṇenedaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ jagad yadā tadā ||33||
jagatpravāhasiddhyarthaṃ snehapāśo’pi nirmitaḥ |
snehabaddhamidaṃ sarvaṃ kalayā bhramate jagat ||34||
narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ prītiḥ sāhajikī tayā bhavet |
snehasya kalayā putre patyau vitte gṛhe striyām ||35||
vāṭyāṃ kṣetre paśau lābhe kuṭumbe jāyate hi sā |
prasvāṃ pitari māyaiva nihitā viśvavarddhinī ||36||
tādṛśyā māyayā baddhā jīvāḥ kalāvido’pi ye |
tava putraṃ miliṣyanti te bhaviṣyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ||37||
tava putrasya yogena bhaktiṃ mokṣapradāyinīm |
kariṣyanti hareryogaṃ pralapsyanti ca nartane ||38||
māyāparo yo bhagavān janānāṃ śreyase bhuvi |
āvirbhūya sadā cāste taṃ te bālo bhajiṣyati ||39||
pūrvapuṇyayutā lokā bhajiṣyanti hariṃ tadā |
taruṣaṇḍe ca ye pakṣipaśavaśca tarumṛgāḥ ||3.201.40 ||
mṛtā ye te’bhitaścātra sādhuprasādabhojinaḥ |
mānuṣyaṃ prāpya vartante pāvanāḥ puṇyayoginaḥ ||41 ||
sarve te vai nartakāśca gāyakā vādakā api |
grāme’tra paragrāme vā jātāste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ||42||
prākśrīkṛṣṇatadīyekṣāprasādādiprabhoginaḥ |
saṃskāriṇaḥ prajātāste grāme’tra bālakāḥ śubhāḥ ||43 ||
teṣāṃ satāṃ prasaṃgena harervārtāśraveṇa ca |
kṛṣṇabhaktirvartate ca vartiṣyate dṛḍhādhikā ||44||
te ca sarve militvaiva kariṣyanti satāṃ hareḥ |
sevāṃ bhaktiṃ bhṛtyatāṃ ca paricaryāṃ pramokṣadām ||45||
śraddhāvanto bhaviṣyanti sarve te kṛpayā satām |
atiprītiṃ gamiṣyanti sādhau ca parameśvare ||46||
samarthāśca bhaviṣyanti svīyasnigdhān parānapi |
bhavapāśānmocayituṃ prītiṃ kārayituṃ harau ||47||
tena saṅkṣyanti vai tucchasukhe susādhuyoginaḥ |
dṛḍhāḥ sarve satāṃ saṃge hareḥ saṃge’tiniṣṭhitāḥ || 48||
māyānāśakarāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti virāgiṇaḥ |
bhaktyantarāyakṛtsarvaṃ tyakṣyanti brahmaniṣṭhitāḥ ||49||
cireṇa māṃ prasādyaiva phalamāpsyanti śāśvatam |
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ divyaṃ divyasvarūpiṇaḥ ||3.201.50 ||
satāṃ prasaṃgato bhaktirvardhate paramātmani |
satāṃ prasaṃgato jñānaṃ jāyate paramātmanaḥ ||51 ||
harermāhātmyavijñānaiḥ śraddhā nityaṃ pravardhate |
vivekena harau nityaṃ divyatā bhāsate na vā |||52||
satsu prakāśate cāpi divyatā bhagavannibhā |
vivekena bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe dṛḍhāśrayaḥ ||53||
tasyāśrayeṇāśrayiṇāmāśrayo jāyate satām |
sadācāraratasyaiva satsevāṃ kurvato bhavet ||54||
mahābhāgavatadharmālambanaṃ sevanādi ca |
sevayā satataṃ pravartate kṛpā satāṃ hareḥ ||55||
kṛpayā muktatā tyāgaḥ saṃsāravilayastathā |
nārāyaṇena tādātmyaṃ jāyate dhyānato hareḥ ||56||
aikāgryaṃ ca nirodhaśca samādhirjāyate harau |
sarvānandamahānandabhogo’sya jāyate’niśam ||17||
tasmāt santo bhojanīyāḥ sevanīyā jalānnakaiḥ |
kāryā ca dāsavat sevā dāsīvad bhṛtyavattathā ||58||
patnīvat putravaccāpi sevā kāryā satāṃ sadā |
pitṛvanmātṛvaccāpi mānanīyāśca rājavat ||56||
svāmivat pativad bhrātṛvacca rakṣakavattathā |
sevanīyāḥ sadā santo hariprasaṃgayoginaḥ ||3.201.60 ||
prasādanīyāḥ tato’tra vandanīyā muhurmuhuḥ |
kṣamāpanīyāḥ satataṃ toṣaṇīyāstu devavat ||6 1 ||
pūjanīyā hi santo’tra rakṣaṇīyāstu putravat |
satāṃ prasannatāṃ prāpya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha ||62||
satāmājñāṃ samālambya vartanīyaṃ hi satpathe |
sarvato’pi samākṛṣyendriyāntaḥkaraṇāni ca ||63||
nidhātavyāni kṛṣṇe vai vrajeyuḥ kupathaṃ na yat |
kupathaṃ ced vrajeyuśca samākṛṣya drutaṃ tadā ||64||
haṭhāt kṛṣṇe prayojyāni sukhade parameśvare |
yādṛṅmānaṃ nyūnabhāvaṃ māhātmyaṃ śrīharerbhavet ||65||
tādṛgbalaṃ tu viṣaye yātyantaḥkaraṇaṃ bahiḥ |
nyūnatāparihārārthaṃ kāryaḥ saṃgaḥ satāṃ sadā ||66||
kṛṣṇe eva ruciḥ sādhyā heyaḥ saṃgastu cāparaḥ |
kupathe vrajato bhītiḥ kṛṣṇapathe tu nirbhayam ||67||
kṛṣṇaprāptau dehināṃ tu prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
kṛṣṇānandaparaḥ kaścidānando nāvaśiṣyate ||68||
taṃ hariṃ ced vihāyātra tucchasaukhyasya labdhaye |
yatante cettadā bodhyā te janāstu bubhukṣavaḥ ||69||
saṃsāriṇasta evoktā nirayārthaṃ prajanminaḥ |
lumpanti bhagavadvāṇīṃ satāmājñāṃ vahanti na ||3.201.70 ||
te prāpnuvanti satataṃ kleśaṃ tucchārthadhāvinaḥ |
yadyapi syurbuddhimanto bahuśrutāḥ pratarkiṇaḥ ||71 ||
atha yaḥ svalpadhīścāpi sevate śrīhariṃ sataḥ |
śreyo’dhvānaṃ śrayate’tra vartate satpumarthake ||92||
sadguṇān gṛhṇate nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ bhaktiyoginām |
bhāgavataṃ mahādhvānaṃ divyaṃ samadhitiṣṭhati ||73||
sa eva buddhimān proktaḥ svarthamokṣaparāyaṇaḥ |
sa eva sādhurevokto mokṣārthakṛtaniścayaḥ ||74||
bahubuddhistu nirayaṃ gamiṣyati prabhogavān |
tucchārthadhāvanaparaḥ sādhumārgavinindakaḥ ||75||
hareḥ satāṃ guṇānāṃ sa dūṣako nāstikaḥ khalaḥ |
dhiyā dūṣitayā prāpnotyeva pāpaṃ yamālayam ||76||
kṣīraṃ śarkarayā yuktaṃ viṣāktaṃ ced vināśakṛt |
tathā dhīrdūṣitā śreyovighātinī mahatyapi ||77||
tayā yuktaḥ patatyeva drogdhā janmāntare bhavet |
sadgatirna bhavettasya tatsaṃgino’pi naiva ca ||78||
na cāyaṃ bhāṣaṇayogyaḥ pātayatyeva bhāṣaṇāt |
avaguṇān darśayitvā mālinyaṃ nidadhātyataḥ ||79||
alpamatirbhāvayuktaḥ sevakaḥ saṃgamocitaḥ |
gṛhṇannāśīrvacāṃsyeva śreyomārge sthito hi saḥ ||3.201.80||
mānaṃ kapaṭaṃ krodhaṃ ca tatherṣyāṃ prajahāti yaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ dāsabhāvena sevako vartate tu yaḥ ||81 ||
divyabhāvaṃ vidan satsu satāṃ kriyāsu sarvathā |
sa evaṃ sādhuratroktaḥ sarvathā sevanocitaḥ ||82||
sa eko’nugrahapātraṃ satā hareśca sarvathā |
āśritānāṃ samuddhārakartā hyapi pratāpavān ||83||
sa eva mokṣadaḥ syādvai yathā santo hariryathā |
anyastvāsurabuddhirvai bhūtaḥ preto bhavediha ||84||
rākṣaso drohakartā vā bhaved daityo hi pāpakṛt| |
naiva muktirbhavettasya drohiṇo vai hareḥ satām || 85||
vairabhāvena kṛṣṇe sa yujyate ca cireṇa vā |
anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasya kvacijjahāti daityatām ||86||
tataḥ kālāntare kṛṣṇakṛpayā vaiti sadgatim |
tasmāttucche padārthe tu prītiḥ kāryā na sarvathā ||87| |
harau satsu sadā kāryā prītiḥ sevānuvṛttitā |
yasya sarvaṃ jagat svarṇaṃ loṣṭhaṃ samaṃ divaṃ ca bhūḥ ||88 ||
sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ yasya taṃ praseveta dāsavat |
dāsīvat sampraseveta sādhvī nārāyaṇī bhavet ||89| |
ityevamupadiśyātha lakṣmi bodhāyano muniḥ |
yayau deśāntaraṃ prāpya pūjāṃ kālena vai tataḥ ||3.201.90||
kastūrikā sutaṃ divyaṃ suṣuve bhaktayoginam |
bodhāyanoktaṃ vijñānaṃ garbhe yaḥ śrutavān param ||91||
sarvajñānena sahito jajñe putraḥ pratāpavān |
bhaktiṃ cakre hi bālyāt sa nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ tathā ||92||
kathāṃ cakre vivekāḍhyāṃ pūjāṃ karoti nityadā |
bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakre sarvāṃ kṛṣṇamayīṃ kriyām ||93||
atha bodhāyano draṣṭuṃ samāyātaḥ punastvimam |
bhaktaṃ vilokya śiṣyaṃ taṃ nāmnā rāyaṇadevakam ||94||
mumude dīkṣayāmāsa śataśiṣyairyutaṃ ca tam |
śataśiṣyābhirevāpi sahitaṃ rāyaṇaṃ muniḥ ||95||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ mantraṃ datvā muniryayau vanam ||96||
sarve rāyaṇadevādyā nartakāḥ sādhavastathā |
gāyakāścāpi sādhvyaśca bhejurmāṃ nṛtyakīrtanaiḥ ||97||
sahasraśo janāścaiṣāṃ śiṣyāśca puruṣāḥ striyaḥ |
sañjātā vaiṣṇavā lakṣmi mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||98 ||
samāje tvekadā tebhyo darśanaṃ paramaṃ dadau |
ahaṃ sākaṃ śriyā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ||99||
taiśca sampūjitaścāhaṃ pāyayāmāsa pajjalam |
tebhyo muktiṃ divyagatiṃ dadau brahmamayīṃ parām || 3.201.100 ||
tacchiṣyāśca praśiṣyāśca vartante bhūtale’pare |
te bhajante’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ ca mām ||1 01 ||
evaṃ mayā sāghuyogānnartakaścoddhṛto rame |
uddhṛtāścāpi nartakyo mokṣamārgaṃ praṇoditāḥ || 1 02|||
evaṃ mama balaṃ bhakteḥ sādhoḥ sevābalaṃ tathā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne rāyaṇadevasya nartakasya bodhāyanopadeśena garbhasthasya vijñānaṃ bhaktiśca haridarśanaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||20 1 ||

<3.202>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gāyakasya mahātmanaḥ |
vratardinaḥ kathāṃ ramyāṃ mama prasannatānvitām || 1 ||
vratardīṃ tvabhavadbhakto nākirālākhyapattane |
vaiśyo vīṇāmṛdaṃgādiyāvadvādyaviśāradaḥ || 2 ||
yasyāgre bahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ śiṣyikāśca vasantyapi |
abhyāsārthaṃ gānakalādīnāṃ gāyanaśīlinaḥ || 3 ||
deśadeśāntarebhyaśca samāyānti vratardinam |
gānavidyādhipaṃ śrutvā śikṣāṃ prāpya prayānti ca || 4 ||
atha rājābhavannimbaṭikānagarīśāsakaḥ |
puṇḍravarmā dharmavām̐śca bhagavadbhaktitatparaḥ || 5 ||
saurāṣṭre gāyakaśreṣṭhaṃ śrutvā vratardinaṃ nṛpaḥ |
āhvayāmāsa gītyarthaṃ rājadhānīṃ nijāṃ prati || 6 ||
dūto gatvāvedayattaṃ gāyakaṃ rājabhāṣitam |
ehi rājotsave rājetyāha tvāṃ gāyakottama || 7 ||
vratardī pratyuvācetthaṃ na rājotsavagāyanam |
kariṣye bhagavadbhakto bhavāmyātmanivedanaḥ || 8 ||
vinā hariṃ na me jivhā gāsyatyanyaṃ kadācana |
vinā hariṃ na me netraṃ drakṣyatyanyaṃ kadācana || 9 ||
vinā hariṃ na me cittaṃ dhyāyatyanyaṃ kadācana |
bhagavataśca bhaktānāṃ bhakto’haṃ dāsyasaṃhitaḥ || 3.202.10 ||
so’haṃ kathaṃ rājaguṇān gāyāmi māyikāniha |
vada tvaṃ bhūbhṛte dūta nānyaṃ gāsyati gāyakaḥ || 11 ||
vratardī gāyakaḥ kṛṣṇagāyako nānyagāyakaḥ |
mokṣagāyaka evāste bhaktānāmapi gāyakaḥ || 1 2||
abhaktānāṃ gāyako na vratardī bhavati kvacit |
iti pratyuktadūtaśca yayau rājñe nyavedayat || 1 3||
rājā tutoṣa sahasā dhanyo’haṃ bhūpatiḥ sadā |
mama rājye mahābhāgavato’sti kṛṣṇagāyakaḥ || 14||
mayā bhāgavatenāpi bhavitavyaṃ pramuktaye |
vaiṣṇavena bhavitavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ tataḥ || 15||
vratardinā pragītaṃ ca kṛṣṇakīrtanamuttamam |
śrotavyaṃ sarvathā paścād bhūtvā satpātrabhūbhṛtā || 1 6||
vicāryetthaṃ prāha dūtaṃ bhāvyaṃ bhaktimatā mayā |
tasmādāgaccha gehaṃ me māṃ prapāvaya bhūbhṛtam || 17||
kṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktaṃ tataḥ śrāvaya kīrtanam |
ityevaṃ brūhi bhakteśaṃ vratardinaṃ prayāhi ca || 18||
śrutvā dūto yayau śīghraṃ rājoktaṃ tu vratardine |
kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ sa śrutvā tutoṣa gāyakaḥ || 1 9||
sajjo bhūtvā yayau bhūpamandiraṃ gaṇamaṇḍitaḥ |
rājā taṃ mānayāmāsa bhaktaṃ vratardinaṃ muhuḥ || 3.202.20 ||
yayāce tu tato vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca dīkṣaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ |
vratardī tūrṇamāśrutya dhṛtvā datvā jalaṃ kare || 21 ||
nṛpāya pradadau mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa satvaram |
omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||22||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
rājā gṛhītvā mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ dadhāra taulasīm |||23||
mūrtiṃ me bālakṛṣṇasya jagṛhe gāyakārpitām |
rājñī kanyāśca putrāśca rājñaḥ kuṭumbakaṃ tathā ||24||
sarve bhṛtyāstathā dāsyo’bhavam̐statra hi vaiṣṇavāḥ |
haraye cārpitaṃ vāri phalaṃ cānnaṃ ca candanam ||25||
vratardī pradadau rājakuṭumbāya prasādakam |
bhuktvā pītvā prasādaṃ ca sabhāṃ cakre tato nṛpaḥ ||26|||
madhyasiṃhāsane kṛṣṇamasthāpayat suśobhitam |
rājā kṛṣṇasya sevāyāṃ dhṛtvā chatramanuttamam || 27||
atiṣṭhattatkuṭumbaṃ ca cāmare vyajane tathā |
vetraṃ ca naktakaṃ dhūpapātraṃ dhvajaṃ patākikām ||28||
darpaṇaṃ pānapātraṃ ca tāmbūlapātrakaṃ tathā |
sugandhasārapātraṃ ca tailasāraṃ ca candanam ||29||
pūjāpātraṃ puṣpahārān dhṛtvātiṣṭhad yathāyatham |
pūjayitvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ vratardī gāyanaṃ vyadhāt || 3.202.30||
ehi kṛṣṇa ehi kṛṣṇa kānta ehi ehi |
dehi kṛṣṇa dehi kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ sudehin ||3 1 ||
navīnabhaktamaṇḍalaṃ vidhehi divyasatkulam |
jahīhi janmavāsanāṃ pradehi dhāmavāsanam ||
ehi kṛṣṇa || 32||
tvameva muktasatpatistvameva dhāmasadgatiḥ |
tvameva cāvatāradhṛk tvameva sarvasākṣadṛk ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||33||
purā bhavān pumuttamastato bhavānnarottamaḥ |
tato bhavān janārdanastato’sti sarvamardanaḥ ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||34||
prasannamānaso bhavān susampadāṃ prado bhavān |
nijārthyasaukhyado bhavān nijātmaśāntido bhavān ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||35||
rādhāramāpatirbhavān pramāsatīpatirbhavān |
satāṃ śriyāḥ patirbhavām̐śca māṇikīpatirbhavān ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||36||
brahmapriyāpatirbhavān haripriyāpatirbhavān |
ajāprajāpatirbhavān vratardinaḥ patirbhavān ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||37||
nidhiśca tejasāṃ bhavān nidhiścamatkṛtāṃ bhavān |
nidhiḥ parāmudā bhavān nidhiḥ parāvidāṃ bhavān ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||38||
suto vṛṣasya vai bhavān sutaśca gopajo bhavān |
sutaśca kāśyapo bhavām̐śca kambharāsuto bhavān ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ||39||
sadaiva citsu vartase’pyacitsu vartase hare |
pravartase pravartase svabhaktamaṇḍale hare ||
ehi kṛṣṇa ehi kṛṣṇa kānta ehi ehi |
dehi kṛṣṇa dehi kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ sudehin ||3.202.40||
ityevaṃ māṃ prārthayat sa lakṣmi gītipramaṃgalam |
akaronmāṃ smaram̐statra vratardī premapūritaḥ ||41 ||
gāyikā gāyakāścāpyapūrayan gītikāsvarān |
śrutvāhaṃ premaraśanākṛṣṭo mūrterdrutaṃ bahiḥ ||42||
āvirjāto’tisubhago manoharaḥ suyauvanaḥ |
rūparūpānurūpaścāvayavaiḥ puṣṭa ujjvalaḥ ||43||
śriyā ca rādhayā yukto hāramukuṭaśobhitaḥ |
sarvābhūṣābhirāmaśca sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ ||44||
prasannahāsyavadano divyatejo’bhidīpitaḥ |
sarvasugandhavātsalyalāvaṇyānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||45||
sarvakāmaprapūraśca sabhānandavivardhanaḥ |
nirodhayan sabhāsthānāṃ cetāṃsi mayi saṃsthitaḥ ||46||

tatsamastaṃ sabhāsthebhyo dadau kṣaṇaṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||47||
divyatāyāstirobhāvaṃ kṣaṇottaraṃ vyadhāṃ rame |
