pupūjuḥ sarvabhāvaiśca varārthaṃ noditāśca te ||49||
vavrurmuktiṃ parāṃ sevāmadadāṃ ca tathāstviti |
tirobhāvaṃ drutaṃ cāpi sabhāścaryaparābhavat ||3.202.50||
vratardinaḥ pratāpena hyavāpuḥ kṛṣṇadarśanam |
bhejuste māṃ divyabhāvairananyabhāvanaiḥ sadā ||51 ||
pātivratyena māṃ bhejurnṛpādyā vaiṣṇavāstataḥ |
parihāro’bhavad bhakto mumude darśanānmama |||52||
pāritoṣikamāsādya yayau samaṇḍalo nijam |
ālayaṃ sa vitardī vai nṛpo nṛpālayaṃ yayau ||53||
atha kāle tataḥ prāpte nṛpādīn bhaktamaṇḍalam |
ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ me ca vratardimaṇḍalaṃ tathā ||54||
tathā ye ye vaiṣṇavāścābhavan vai lakṣaśo janāḥ |
camatkāraṃ smaranto me bhajanto māṃ nirantaram ||55||
ninye tānmekṣaraṃ lokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma cottamam |
śṛṇu lakṣmi janā loke bhavanti tyāgavṛttayaḥ ||56||
tīvratyāgavirāgasya sneho mayyatiśobhate |
rāgiṇastu smṛtirnityaṃ viṣayāṇāṃ prajāyate ||57||
tucchārthasnehabaddhāste kṛṣṇasnehaṃ na kurvate |
kṛṣṇe snehavihīnāste mokṣaṃ phalaṃ na yanti vai ||58||
tasmāt snehaḥ sadā kāryo mayi śrīparamātmani |
hātavyaścāntyajaḥ sneho mama māhātmyavedinā ||59||
ātmajñānena ca tyājyaḥ sneho māyikavastuṣu |
ātmāyaṃ saccidānando jaḍādbhinnaḥ śarīrataḥ ||3.202.60 ||
nāsya deho na saudhaśca na kuṭumbaṃ na vāṭikāḥ |
na jātirna kulaṃ yogo dhanaṃ nāsya ca sampadaḥ ||61 ||
māyāhīno bhavāmyevetyātmānaṃ cintayet sadā |
etādṛśaṃ nijaṃ matvā daihikaṃ nahi saṃsmaret ||62||
kuṭumbino na smartavyāḥ pūrvajāścādyajā api |
bhagavadbhaktihīnā ye ye tu bandhanakāriṇaḥ ||63||
yatsmṛtyā bandhanaṃ vai syāt smartavyā na tathā kvacit |
śrāddhakāle prasmartavyāstṛptyarthaṃ muktaye’pi ca ||64||
yajñe dāne tīrthakārye dharmakārye vratādiṣu |
smartavyāstṛptaye teṣāṃ muktaye mandire hareḥ ||65||
anyathā rāgavaśataḥ smartavyā na kadācana |
smartavyāḥ sādhavo divyāḥ smartavyāḥ pratimā mama ||66||
brahmapriyāstathā sādhvyaḥ smartavyā mokṣasiddhaye |
jñānibhirjñānavijñānairvismartavyāstu bāndhavāḥ ||67||
bandhanasya pradā nāryo narāścāpi kuṭumbinaḥ |
viṣayā mokṣavighnāśca vismartavyāḥ samastataḥ ||68||
brahmadṛṣṭyā yena sarve putrādyā vismṛtāḥ khalu |
tasya prītirharau syācca mokṣapradeṣu satsu ca ||69||
sarvai santo bhavantyeva divyā brahmanivāsinaḥ |
yathā haristathā santaḥ smartavyā mokṣadā hi te ||3.202.70||
āśrayaṇīyāḥ satataṃ sādhavaśca haristathā |
bhajanīyaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāddhariścāhaṃ janārdanaḥ ||71 ||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya bhīrna kālasya karmaṇām |
māyāyā yamarājasya bhīrnāpi bandhanasya ca ||72||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchā bhaktayoginaḥ |
prārabdhaṃ khalu mantavyaṃ netarat pāpijīvavat ||72||
etādṛśaḥ pravandyo vai sarveṣāṃ pūjya eva saḥ |
gṛhastho vā yatirvā sa viśeṣo nātra vidyate ||74||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya samaloṣṭhādikasya ca |
pattalābjarajo mūrdhnā dhārayanti surādayaḥ ||75||
sarvadā ca surairasya darśanaṃ kriyate prage |
mama pratāpamālambya kurvan bhaktiṃ sthito gṛhe ||76||
tyāge bā prasthitaścāyaṃ pāraṃ yātyañjasāmbudheḥ |
etādṛśo mama bhakto dehānte cinmayākṛtiḥ ||77||
brahmamukto divyadehaḥ sevāyāṃ dhāmni me bhavet |
tasya vai darśanaṃ māyāpāpakālādināśakṛt ||78||
karmanāśakaraṃ lakṣmi tulyaṃ mamekṣayā matam |
sarvakriyā madarthaṃ vai yasya tasyāhamacyutaḥ ||79||
sarvathā tu vaśībhūtaḥ pravarte tasya gocaraḥ |
yo bhakto yaddināllakṣmi satsaṃgaṃ prakaroti vai ||3.202.8 0||
tata āramya kurute vivekaṃ guṇadoṣayoḥ |
īdṛgguṇān labdhavām̐śca tyaktavān durguṇānimān ||8 1||
prativarṣaṃ vyatirekaṃ vicintayati lābhakṛt |
satsaṃgasya pratāpena satāṃ hareśca sevayā ||82||
guṇāḥ prāptā ime sarve doṣā gatāśca te mama |
śeṣāṇāṃ khalu doṣāṇāṃ nāśane yatnavān bhavet ||83||
śeṣāṇāṃ sadguṇānāṃ saṃgrahaṇe yatnavān bhavet |
evaṃ prayatnaśīlasya guṇāḥ syurmama tuṣṭidāḥ ||84||
doṣāṇāṃ prakṣayaḥ syācca divyatātra bhavettathā |
kṛṣṇasukhaṃ cottamaṃ ca jāyate’sya hi śāśvatam ||85||
mano nirvāsanaṃ syācca niḥsaṃkalpaṃ sthiraṃ bhavet |
anekeṣu caritreṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ||86||
manaścāvartayennityaṃ ramamāṇaṃ mayi kriyāt |
mahāśāntimayaṃ syād yat tyāgināṃ gṛhiṇāmapi ||87||
dehayātrāmātrarūpo vyavahārastu bāhyataḥ |
kartavyo naṭavallakṣmi mano dhāryaṃ harau mayi ||88||
caritrāṇi satāṃ nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇayoṣitām |
bhaktānāṃ śrīhareścāpi cintanīyāni sarvadā ||89||
mano nirvāsanaṃ tena bhavenmokṣe yathā sukham |
teṣāṃ samāgamaḥ kāryo mokṣakṛd yatphalaṃ bhavet ||3.202.90 ||
vratardinaḥ prasaṃgena gāyakasya nṛpottamaḥ |
puṇḍravarmā yayau muktiṃ tathānye ca sahasraśaḥ ||91 ||
ataḥ sevyā mama bhaktāḥ satyāśconmūlitāśayāḥ |
divyakriyā mama dhyānaparāścāśritatārakāḥ ||92||
antarāyavihīnāśca sarvavighnavivarjitāḥ |
dharmaṃ bhāgavataṃ divyaṃ mama sevāṃ samāśritāḥ ||9 3||
satāmāśrayakaraṇāt prasannatāsamarjanāt |
ājñānuvṛttikaraṇāddhāmākṣaraṃ kare bhavet ||94||
evaṃ lakṣmi bhūtale vā svarge satye vikuṇṭhake |
goloke cākṣare śvetadvīpe śrīpurake’mṛte ||95||
avyākṛte badaryāṃ vā ye vartante madāśritāḥ |
muktā muktānikāḥ sarve sarvasvārpaṇakṛṣṇakāḥ ||96||
śāśvatānandabhoktārastathā vratardigāyakāḥ |
sarve muktiṃ mama prāptāḥ śāśvaṃtānandasevinaḥ ||97||
ye ye kalāvido loke’rpayanti tatkalā mayi |
te te yāntyakṣaraṃ dhāma kṛpayā me na saṃśayaḥ ||98||
yeṣāmagre ca yo dharmo guṇaḥ kalā kriyā tathā |
sādhanaṃ śrīhariṃ prasādayituṃ vai svakaṃ bhavet ||99||
tena prasādanīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
prasādanīyāḥ santaśca naraiśca yoṣitāṃgaṇaiḥ ||3.202.1 00||
tadā divyo bhaved bhāvo deho manastathāntaram |
guṇāḥ kriyā vartanaṃ ca sevā divyāḥ samastataḥ | | 101 ||
harerbhūtvā hariṃ prāpya modate sa samarpakaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tathaiva modate mayi || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vratardināmakagāyakabhaktasya yogena puṇḍravarmanṛpasya saprajasya vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 202 ||

<3.203>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vāyakasya kathāṃ śubhām |
dhurilākhye pure nāmnā tūlavāyīti vāyakaḥ || 1 ||
nyavasat sakuṭumbo’yaṃ rājaprajādṛtaḥ sadā |
sūkṣmatantvādivayane kuśalaḥ sūtranirmitau || 2 ||
sūkṣmātisūkṣmasūtrāṇi nirmāti kalayā nakhaiḥ |
sūtrayantreṇa ca lūtātantusamā hi tantavaḥ || 3 ||
jjāyante kalayā tasya sūkṣmātisūkṣmapeśalāḥ |
ambare tasya tantūnāṃ nirmitaṃ dhāryate’mbaram || 4 ||
dṛśyate naiva kiraṇeṣvevaṃ tanu prajāyate |
svarṇormikāyāṃ śāṭīṃ ca prasārayituṃ śakyate || 5 ||
dhotraṃ tathottarīyaṃ coṣṇīśaṃ tādṛk prajāyate |
rājñīveṣārhavastrāṇi tattantubhyo bhavanti vai || 6 ||
vāyako’yaṃ turīṃ vemānaṃ ca saṃyojikāṃ tathā |
śalākāṃ ceti sūkṣmāṇi vayane saṃyunakti hi || 7 ||
sūkṣmatamāḥ sūkṣmatarā sūkṣmāśca sūkṣmasadṛśāḥ |
sthūlasūkṣmā madhyasthūlāḥ sthūlāḥ sthūlatarāstathā || 8 ||
sthūlatamā jāḍyagātrāstantavaḥ saṃbhavanti vai |
phālikā vividhā ramyāḥ kukaṭyaḥ saṃbhavanti ca || 9 ||
peṭikāścāpi tantūnāṃ śālāyāṃ tūlavāyinaḥ |
utpadyante karajaiśca yantratarkaṭikādibhiḥ || 3.203.10||
ranṭakairbhramacakraiśca jāyante tantavaḥ śubhāḥ |
nāryo narā hi bahavo bahvyaśca karmacārikāḥ ||1 1 ||
utpādayanti sūtrāṇi kārpāsānyaparāṇi ca |
samanāḍikasūtrāṇi yathārthavalayāni ca || 1 2||
anyūnānatiriktāni granthitrūṭīviyuñji ca |
sthūlasūkṣmādidoṣaiśca varjitāni śubhāni ca || 13||
eteṣāmeva tantūnāṃ prāyo vastrāṇi vai prajāḥ |
rājānaḥ śreṣṭhinaścāpi dhārayantīti viśrutam || 14||
tūlavāyimahāmudrā mudryate mānavardhinī |
sūtreṣu tajjavastreṣu śraiṣṭhyaṃ pradyotate sadā || 15||
evaṃvidhastūlavāyī viśālakāryakārakaḥ |
tathāpi sarvakāryeṣu mama bhaktiṃ cakāra saḥ || 16||
yantreṣu śrīkṛṣṇanāma sādhaneṣvāyaseṣvapi |
śrīkṛṣṇanāma sarvatra phālikākukaṭīṣvapi || 17||
vāse bhittau ca śālāyāṃ mudritaṃ kṛṣṇanāma ha |
karmacārāḥ samastāśca karmacāriṇya ityapi || 18||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāma gṛṇanti hi |
tūlavāyī svayaṃ nityaṃ bhajate māṃ narāyaṇam || 1 9||
snātvā prapūjya māṃ paścādudyame cānurohati |
prasādaṃ mama naivedyaṃ cānnaṃ jalaṃ phalādikam ||3.203.20||
bhuṃkte kuṭumbasahitaścātmanivedivat sadā |
vastrapātrāsanādyāni nivedya me yunakti ca ||21 ||
evaṃvidho bhaktarāṇme bhajate māṃ samāhitaḥ |
athāyaṃ vāyako yantre’navadhānatayā drutam ||22||
cakravege gatahastaḥ patitaścūrṇitaḥ kare |
skandhāt karaḥ pṛthagjāto mūrchito mama bhaktarāṭ ||23 ||
sasmāra māṃ drutaṃ so’pi hṛdi rakṣāmayācata |
karmacārāḥ samastāśca jñātvā me nāmakīrtanam ||24||
cakruḥ pārśve samāgatya tatrāhaṃ cauṣadhapradaḥ |
kuśalo vaidyarāṭ bhūtvā cikitsakaḥ samāgataḥ ||25||
sandhinīṃ raktarodhāṃ ca poṣiṇīṃ sthitisthāpikām |
oṣadhiṃ saha nītvaiva tūrṇaṃ copasthito’bhavam ||26||
kareṇa tu jalaṃ datvānane mūrchāṃ nyavārayam |
sandhinyā skandhamūlaṃ ca kabandhe sannyayojayam ||27||
raktarodhanikayā ca raktasthairyaṃ vyadhāpayam |
poṣiṇyā bāhukarayoścāṃgulīnāṃ yathāyatham ||28||
puṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca sthitisthāpinyā sukaraṃ karam |
akaravaṃ tathā dhairyaṃ datvāsane sthito’bhavam ||29 ||
atha te divyarūpaṃ māṃ vilokya mugdhamānasāḥ |
viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ prāptā māṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hi menire ||3.203.30||
tuṣṭuvuste vavanduśca pupūjuśca yayācire |
kṣamāmuddharaṇaṃ cāpi māyāpāśavimocanam ||3 1 ||
satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃ jñānaṃ yayācire |
tathāstvityavadaṃ tebhyo jñānaṃ ca māmakaṃ param ||32||
adadāṃ lakṣmi sarvebhyo divyaṃ ca mama darśanam |
tathāstvityadadāṃ tebhyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca sampadaḥ ||33 ||
tirobhāvaṃ tataḥ sthānādatha kālāntare punaḥ |
dehānte kramaśastām̐śca nītavānakṣaraṃ mama ||34||
tūlavāyī yadā vṛddho’bhavannaddhaśca muktaye |
punaścāhaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ dattavān tūlavāyine ||35||
tūlavāyī samapṛcchanmāṃ hite jagatāṃ kṛte |
kīdṛśo’sti bhavān dhāmni kīdṛśyo muktakoṭayaḥ ||36||
kīdṛśaṃ te gṛhaṃ dhāma kīdṛśā īśvarā api |
kīdṛśyaścāvatāriṇya īśvaryaḥ satya ityapi ||37||
kīdṛśāḥ sādhavaste ca kīdṛśyo muktayastava |
kīdṛśyaḥ siddhayaste’pi kīdṛśo’haṃ tavāśritaḥ ||38||
kathaṃkāro nivatsye te dhāmni me vada mādhava |
ahaṃ lakṣmi tūlavāyijijñāsāṃ samaśāntayam ||39||
śṛṇu bhakto bhavāmyatra divyaste netragocaraḥ |
so’haṃ dhāmni bhavāmyeva sarvathā divyamūrtimān ||3.203.40||
apāraguṇasaundaryalāvaṇyaujjvalyasāgaraḥ |
sākāraḥ sarvamuktānāṃ nibhālanīyo mādhavaḥ ||41||
dvibhujaḥ sarvadā cāsmi rūpāntarāṇi cecchayā |
dhārayāmi sahasrādibhujāni bahurūpavān ||42||
sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarūpo bhavāmyaham |
sarvasparśaḥ sarvaśabdaḥ sarvānando bhavāmyaham ||43||
kiśoro’smi brahmapriyāsaṃkhyamuktānikāpatiḥ |
haripriyāsaṃkhyamuktapatiḥ puṣṭaśarīravān ||44||
sevāyogyaḥ sarvakāmaprapūro’smi mamākṣare |
akṣare dhāmni tatraiva vasanti muktakoṭayaḥ ||45||
sarve matparamā divyā matsamānasumūrtayaḥ |
divyasarvaguṇāḍhyāste sākārāḥ sukhavārdhayaḥ ||46||
etādṛśā mama muktāḥ kiśorāścātisundarāḥ |
tejasvino’tiramyāśca manoharā vasanti hi ||47||
mamākṣaraṃ paraṃ vyoma paraṃdhāma paraṃ gṛham |
sahasrakoṭistambhālīsaṃśobhatsvarṇanirmitam ||48||
sahasrakoṭikalaśaṃ sarvarddhisiddhisaṃbhṛtam |
sahasrakoṭikakṣāḍhyaṃ vartate bahuvistaram ||49||
sarvakāmāḥ sarvakalpā sumūrtāstatra santi vai |
sarvabhogamayīśayyāḥ sarvasiṃhāsanāni vai ||3.203.50||
gajāsanaṃ mahārghyaṃ ca vidyate mama mandire |
etādṛśaṃ paraṃ dhāma yatra vasāmi śaktibhiḥ ||51 ||
sahitaścāpi muktaiśca sahito divyavigrahaḥ |
mattaḥ prāvirbhavantyevāvatārāḥ kṛṣṇakoṭayaḥ ||52||
nārāyaṇā asaṃkhyātā rāmā narāśca koṭayaḥ |
munayo’saṃkhyadhāmāno bhavantyavataranti ca ||53||
vāsudevādayaścāpi hiraṇyagarbhakoṭayaḥ |
vairājā īśvarā bhūmānaśca brahmāṇa ityapi ||54||
rudrāśca viṣṇuvaryāśca bhavantīśvarakoṭayaḥ |
mattaḥ prāpya mahaiśvaryāṇyevāvatārakoṭayaḥ ||55||
bhavanti ceśvarāḥ śuddhasattvaprakarṣabhoginaḥ |
teṣāṃ ca śaktayaḥ sarvā mayā vai prakaṭīkṛtāḥ ||56||
īśvarāṇyo bhavantyeva saṃsārasāraśaktayaḥ |
ānandakhanayastāśca tataḥ satyo bhavanti ca ||57||
sādhvyastā brahmarūpiṇyo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ |
śīlavratārthidehinyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||58||
avatāriṇya evāpi lakṣmyastāḥ kamalāḥ śriyaḥ |
ramāstā rādhikāstāśca sampadastā bhavanti ca ||59||
evaṃvidhāni me dhāmni caiśvare maṇḍalāni vai |
bhavanti tādṛśāllokādihāyānti tu pārṣadāḥ ||3.203.60||
tyāgamātraparā bhaktāste divyā mūrtayo mama |
sādhavaste bhavantyeva sarvakalyāṇakārakāḥ ||61 ||
muktayaḥ sādhusevāyāṃ vartante divyavigrahāḥ |
sālokyāḥ sārṣṭayaścāpi sārūpyāśca sayogikāḥ ||62||
etādṛśā bhavantyeva muktayo divyasaukhyadāḥ |
siddhayaḥ sarvadarśinyaḥ sarvaśrāvaṇikāstathā ||63||
sarvaprāptisvarūpāśca satyakāmāvasāyitāḥ |
sarvakāmadughāścāpi pūrṇānandabhṛtāḥ sadā ||64||
sumūrtāḥ sarvapūrṇāśca bhavanti sevikā mama |
mukto bhūtvā bhavām̐statra tūlavāyin nivatsyati ||65||
mama mūrtisamākāro divyaiśvaryayuto’nvaham |
pūrṇānandabhṛto divyaḥ kiśoraḥ saṃnivatsyati ||66||
tatra vasato bhavato nirvikalpā sthitiḥ parā |
bhaviṣyati yathā nānyad dṛṣṭigataṃ ca te bhavet ||67||
brahmībhūtasya te tatra madanyannaiva gocaram |
sarvaṃ khalu tvidaṃ brahma paraṃ nānyad vilokanam ||68||
mama tādātmyamāptasya muktāste’pi na gocarāḥ |
akṣaraṃ gocaraṃ tena tvaṃ na tavāpi gocaraḥ ||69||
etādṛśīṃ parāṃ brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ tatra gamiṣyasi |
sākāre mama rūpe tvaṃ sadā magno bhaviṣyasi ||3.203.70||
tava dṛṣṭyāṃ na vai muktā nākṣaraṃ kuta īśvarāḥ |
kuto māyā kuto jīvāḥ sarvaṃ brahmātmakaṃ tava ||71 ||
evaṃsthitistava tūlavāyiṃstatra bhaviṣyati |
kṛpayā me tava muktistādṛśī saṃbhaviṣyati ||72||
nirvikalpā videhā mattādātmyā sa sthitirmatā |
atratyā ye mama muktāḥ santi jīvanamuktayaḥ ||73||
te tu māyāṃ prapaśyanti jīvām̐stattvāni sarvathā |
īśvarān sarvadhāmāni savikalpasamādhayaḥ ||74||
vīkṣamāṇā api māyākālakarmasu naiva te |
badhyante nāpi hanyante sajjante naiva teṣu ca ||75||
nirlepāste pravartante dehendriyādibhistviha |
ta ete mama bhaktā vai bhavantyātmanivedinaḥ ||76||
dharmajñānavirāgāḍhyāṃ bhaktiṃ kurvanti me sadā |
savikalpā bhaktimanto muktā me sādhavastviha ||77||
tathā ca gṛhiṇaścāpi yatayo nyāsavedinaḥ |
sannyāsinyo virāgiṇyo bhavanti sādhvikā api ||78||
savikalpasthitayaste tāśca navavidhāṃ mama |
bhaktiṃ kurvanti satataṃ premṇā sarvārpaṇātmanā ||79||
śravaṇaṃ me kathāyāśca mallīlānāṃ prakīrtanam |
smaraṇaṃ mama mūrteśca mama pādādimardanam ||3.203.80||
sādhūnāṃ pādayoścāpi dehasyāpi pramardanam |
arcanaṃ candanādyairme vandanaṃ vacanairmama ||81 ||
dāsyaṃ datvā samastaṃ me samīpe cāsanaṃ mama |
sarvājñāpālanaṃ dāsyaṃ cānuvṛttyā hi vartanam ||82||
sakhyaṃ sauhārdabhāvaśca kriyaikyaṃ ca nirantaram |
ātmanivedanaṃ cāpyātmīyasarvanivedanam ||83||
sarvathā sahavāsaśca patnīvad bhṛtyatā tathā |
evaṃvidhā mama bhaktiḥ savikalpasya yoginaḥ ||84||
sarvathā manmayatvena bhavatyeva sukhapradā |
evaṃvidhayā bhaktyā ca snehena sevayā mama ||85||
jñānenotkarṣabhāvena sānnidhyakaraṇaṃ tu yat| |
upāsanā matā sā ca sarvadivyaprakāśinī ||86||
sarvavidhānāṃ jñānānāṃ pravāhāṇāṃ harau mayi |
yojanaṃ bahudhā cāpi muhuścopāsanā hi sā ||87||
mananaṃ niścayaścāpi smaraṇaṃ śrīharermama |
divyaḥ kiśoraḥ kṛṣṇo’haṃ koṭimuktādisevitaḥ ||88||
akṣare santi me vaṃśā muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ |
sarvabhūṣānvitaścāsmi sarvamanoharo hariḥ ||89||
anantaiśvaryasampadvānanantarddhiguṇāśrayaḥ |
evaṃvidhasya me jñānaṃ vedanaṃ sā hyupāsanā ||3.203.90 ||
bhaktiṃ snehaṃ tathā sevāmupāsanāṃ vacaḥsthitim |
saṃsādhayati yo dehī jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyate ||9 1||
so’yaṃ bhavati loke’tra savikalpasamādhimān |
tato brahmasthitiṃ labdhvā sajjate mayi mādhave ||92||
dehena manasā vācā kriyayendriyavṛttibhiḥ |
ātmanā bhāvanayā ca saṃskārairvedanādibhiḥ ||93||
dhyānenāpi dhāraṇayārpaṇena rodhanena ca |
tādātmyena dravībhāvenaikyena yo videhavat ||94||
videhī sa bhaved bhakto nirvikalpasamādhimān |
prāpyaivaṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ mudaṃ sa modate mayi ||95||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tūlavāyin drutaṃ kuru |
yāhi me dhāma paramaṃ sarvānandabhṛtaṃ drutam ||96||
ityuktaḥ sa mayā lakṣmi tūlavāyī naman prabhum |
dehaṃ vihāya divyo vai jāto muktaśarīravān ||97||
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
evamanye’pi bhaktā me tūlavāyisakarmiṇaḥ ||98||
mayā kālena sarve te prāpitā me’kṣaraṃ padam |
evaṃ bhakto bhavellakṣmi bhaktimān madupāsakaḥ ||99||
tasmai datvā darśanaṃ me nayāmi dhāma me param |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadāmyeva rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā || 3.203.1 00||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pālanāttathā |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi sukhaṃ me paramaṃ labhet || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tūlavāyināmakasya sūtravāyakasya bhaktyā bhagavām̐stasya tatkarmacārāṇāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kṛtvā darśanaṃ datvā mokṣaṃ kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 203 ||

<3.204>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kāṣṭhahārasya vai kathām |
nāmnā jāṃgaladevasya mama bhaktasya śobhanām || 1 ||
niśāragrāmavāstavyo’bhavadbhaktaḥ kuṭumbavān |
śūdro jāṃgaladevākhyaḥ kāṣṭhahāro’tibhaktimān || 2 ||
nityamutthāya kalye’yaṃ muhūrte brāhmasaṃjñake |
kūpe snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā nivedya roṭakaṃ ca me || 3 ||
āranālena sākaṃ ca jalaṃ tataḥ praṇamya mām |
sugandhikāṣṭhagundrādidhūpaṃ kṛtvā madagrataḥ || 4 ||
vanyaṃ phalaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca patraṃ ca tūlasījanim |
samarpya mahyaṃ bhakto’yaṃ patnīmāpṛcchya bālakān || 5 ||
rajjuṃ nītvā kuṭhāraṃ ca yātyaraṇya prage’nvaham |
vividhāni ca śuṣkāṇi kāṣṭhanyācchidya yatnataḥ || 6 ||
bhāraṃ baddhvā ca madhyāhne vṛkṣacchāyāmaye sthale |
sahanītaṃ roṭakaṃ ca smṛtvā māmatti manmanā || 7 ||
viśrāmaṃ prāpya vai paścāt tāpamāndye gṛhaṃ nijam |
prayātyeva hi kāṣṭhānāṃ bhāraṃ dhṛtvā sa mastake || 8 ||
yadā vṛkṣe śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaśākhāṃ chinatti saḥ |
tadā tadā hariṃ smṛtvā natvā vṛkṣaṃ chinatti saḥ || 9 ||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cet prāpyate mahyaṃ dadāti saḥ |
vṛkṣa nārāyaṇayogaṃ yāhi ceti vadatyapi ||3.204.1 0||
harekṛṣṇa hareviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa pareśvara |
antaryāmim̐starorasya kalyāṇaṃ kuru vakti ca || 11 ||
etādṛśo hi me bhakto vṛkṣaśreyovicāravān |
bhajate’raṇyamadhye’pi śrīpatiṃ māṃ pumuttamam || 12||
anye ca bahavaḥ kāṣṭhahārāḥ svayogamāgatāḥ |
kṛtā bhaktā vaiṣṇavāśca nāmakīrtanatatparāḥ || 13||
araṇye pippalataroradhastād vedikopari |
militvā kāṣṭhahāraiśca mūrtirme tu śilāmayī || 14||
darśanārthaṃ sthāpitā ca tatra puṇye kṣaṇe dine |
milanti cāpi madhyānhe bhajante kīrtayanti mām |||15||
pūjayanti hariṃ māṃ ca phalairjalairdalādibhiḥ |
vanyakandaistataḥ sarve bhuñjate yānti viśramam || 16||
śubhe dine prakurvanti mahotsavaṃ navaṃ navam |
patramaṇḍapaśobhābhistoraṇaiḥ puṣpahārakaiḥ || 17||
pranṛtyanti kīrtayanti mṛdaṃgādibhirādarāt |
evaṃ kīrtanabhaktānāṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ mama || 18||
priyaṃ jātaṃ tato lakṣmi pūjākāle ca nartane |
kīrtane cādṛśyarūpo bhavāmyākarṇayam̐stadā ||19||
athāhaṃ sādhurūpo vai vanī bhūtvā yayau tadā |
maṇḍale kāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ pippale vedikāsthale ||3.204.20 ||
satkṛtastaiḥ sādhurūpaḥ svāgataiḥ pūjitastathā |
bhojitaḥ phalakandādyaiḥ pādorvāhitastathā ||21 ||
dehe sammarditaścāpi vandito’haṃ tadā janaiḥ |
sthitastaiścāpi saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ vai bhagavān prabhuḥ ||22|||
nirākāro netralabhyo bhavedatra janārdanaḥ |
kathaṃ mokṣo bhavet kāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ vanināṃ tvihi ||23 ||
tadāhaṃ kamale jñānaṃ pradadau tatra cottamam |
kṛpayā ca prakāśaṃ vai hṛtsvakaravaṃ vaiṣṇavam ||24||
kāṣṭhānāṃ sañcaye nārāyaṇaḥ smartavya eva ca |
kāṣṭhānāṃ haraṇe cāpi smartavyaḥ śrīhariṃ sadā ||25||
bhārasya bandhane cāpi smartavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
vikraye’pi pravaktavyaṃ vikrīṇantu hariṃ janāḥ ||26||
rāmasamidhaḥ keśavasamidhaḥ kṛṣṇaśākhinaḥ |
vikrīṇantu janāḥ kṛṣṇasamidhaḥ kṛṣṇakāṣṭhakam ||27||
ityevaṃ raṭanīyo’yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pade pade |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mokṣapradaḥ prabhuḥ ||28||
smaraṇīyaḥ sadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ |
mokṣadātā sa evāste cāntarātmā dayānidhiḥ || 29|||
svargadaḥ sukhadaścāpi sampadāṃ ca pradaḥ prabhuḥ |
śāśvatānandadaścāpi sṛṣṭisāgaratārakaḥ ||3.204.30||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
prajapantu sadā mantraṃ pāvanaṃ pārameśvaram ||3 1 ||
sarvārpaṇaṃ prakurvantu kāṣṭhahārā mayīśvare |
naiṣkarmyaṃ puṇyadaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyākhyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||32||
śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānasti sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
prakāśakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prakāśasamprado hariḥ ||33||
yasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ bhāsate ca vibhāti ca |
sṛṣṭyādau cākṣare dhāmni vartate parameśvaraḥ ||34||
rādhālakṣmīpatirmuktapatirbrahmapriyāpatiḥ |
prakṛtiḥ svecchayā tena vyaktiṃ nītā tathā pumān ||35||
tābhyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ purā jātā nārāyaṇapraveśitā |
pradhānapuruṣau tābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ hiraṇyapūruṣaḥ ||36||
tato virāṭ tato brahmā tato maharṣayaḥ surāḥ |
mānavāśca tato jātāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo drumāḥ ||37||
evaṃ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ śrīparamātmanā |
bhūtendriyārthadevādyā vāsitā paramātmanā ||38||
yathāpātraṃ haristeṣu vasate cāntare’sti saḥ |
prerakaḥ sa hariḥ kārye prakāśakaśca mādhavaḥ ||39||
nityasakhā hariḥ kṛṣṇo jīvasya pāralaukikaḥ |
iha loke’pi lokānāṃ sakhā draṣṭā hariḥ svayam ||3.204.40 ||
jīvānāṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma vīkṣya phalapradaḥ prabhuḥ |
phalaṃ dadāti jīvebhyo dehagehādisampadaḥ ||41||
svargaṃ vā narakaṃ cāpi yathākarma dadāti saḥ |
evaṃ sākṣī sadā kṛṣṇo bhavatīti nibodhata ||42||
sākāro bhagavānevaṃ sarvāntaryāmitāṃ gataḥ |
vyāpako vartate cāpi vartate netragocaraḥ ||43||
sādhurūpo vartate ca sādhurhariḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
sādhoḥ prapūjane kṛṣṇapūjā bhavati śāśvatī ||44||
sādhurūpo milatyeva harirdayānidhiḥ paraḥ |
bhaktānāṃ pāvanaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpayā satsu vartate ||45||
sādhusevāparā bhaktāstaranti sṛṣṭivāridhim |
sādhavo brahmaparamā mokṣakā dehināṃ sadā ||46||
yeṣāṃ sarvamidaṃ brahmarūpaṃ dṛṣṭau pradīvyati |
nirvikalpakacittāste tārakā pāpināmapi ||47||
ye tu jīveśamāyādīnnekṣante brahmadarśinaḥ |
sukhinaste kṛṣṇasukhaiḥ sukhayanti śritān janān ||48||
kāmakrodhādirahitāḥ śrīharau lagnamānasāḥ |
devyadehā api santo vicaranti janā iva ||49||
kārayanti harerbhaktiṃ janānupadiśanti ca |
tārayanti janān sarvān narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||3.204.50||
bhāvayanti kathāṃ ramyāṃ pālayanti vṛṣottamān |
mokṣayanti bandhanātte sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||51 ||
jīvānāṃ bahuyonīnāṃ svasvakarmaphalāni vai |
bhuñjānānāṃ pramoktāraḥ sādhavo bhavasāgarāt ||52||
yatra vasanti santaśca teṣu nārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
mānuṣyavigrahaṃ dhṛtvā vasatyevāprakāśavān ||53||
sarvaprakāśayukto’pi naranāṭyaṃ samīhate |
kvacit kṛpāvaśāddhatte hyatimānavasatkriyāḥ ||54||
mānavaṃ bhagavantaṃ taṃ santo jānanti netare |
itare tu satāṃ yogājjānanti mādhavaṃ tataḥ ||55||
āśrayanti prasnihyanti ramante paramātmani |
ye te vai saṃsṛtermuktā yāntyante brahmadhāma ha ||56||
tasmin kṛṣṇe’nurajyante dīvyanti tatra modinaḥ |
ānandayanti tatraivāśnuvate sukhasampadaḥ ||57||
jānannajānannapi yaḥ kṛṣṇe snihyennarākṛtau |
sa bhūtvaiva guṇātīto yātyante hyakṣaraṃ padam ||58||
kṛṣṇasya divyarūpatvāt tatsambandhāttadāśritāḥ |
divyā divyasvarūpāśca bhavanti brahmagāminaḥ ||59||
māyeśasya harermāyārahitatvācchritā api |
harerbalena māyāṃ vai taranti prākṛtā api ||3.204.60||
kāmabhāvena yā nāryo vrajāṅganā harau sadā |
snigdhāstā api muktiṃ vai gatā nirguṇavigrahāḥ ||61 ||
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca bālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
snigdhāstā nirguṇe kṛṣṇe nirguṇatvaṃ prapedire ||62||
kāmāt snehād guṇāt svārthāllagnāyāḥ paramātmani |
jahurguṇamayān dehān sadyastāḥ kṣīṇabandhanāḥ ||63||
mādhavo nirguṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ |
tasya yogaṃ yayurye yā nirguṇā divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||64||
evaṃ harau satyarūpe snehānmokṣo bhaveddhruvaḥ |
sādhau snehāttathā mokṣaḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇasya mūrtayaḥ ||65||
satāṃ yogāt prayāntyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ |
harerekāntikā bhaktā vāñchanti sevanaṃ hareḥ ||66||
na svargaṃ nāpavargaṃ vā na lokaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
naiśvaryāṇyabhivāñcchanti na vāñcchanti sarūpatām ||67||
sāmīpyaṃ nābhivāñcchanti naikatvaṃ tu kadācana |
vāñcchāvantaḥ sakāmāḥ syurnimnakoṭaya eva te ||68||
sarvārpaṇātmabhaktau sā trūṭīreva nigadyate |
ātmaniveditāyāṃ vai saṃkalpasyāpi cārpaṇam ||69||
kṛtaṃ yataḥ punarnaiva saṃkalpayanti svārthakam |
ata eva hi niṣkāmāḥ sarvathā hyuttamottamāḥ ||3.204.70||
hareḥ samājñayā sevāṃ vāñcchanti svecchayā tu na |
sevāphalaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ tatra samāpyate ||71 ||
prasannatā phalaṃ kṛṣṇasevayā samavāpyate |
nāsmāt phalaṃ paraṃ tvanyanniṣkāmānāṃ hṛdi sthitam ||72||
sevayā labhyate śreṣṭhaṃ kiṃ sālokyādibhistataḥ |
ekatvaṃ tu sadā naiva vāñchanti dāsyahantṛ yat ||73||
ekībhāve kathaṃ sevā kathaṃ prasannatā sukham |
tato niṣkāmabhaktā vai priyā harerbhavanti hi ||74||
bhaktānniṣkāminaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāntike saṃprarakṣati |
premṇā kṛtāṃ ca tatsevāṃ premṇā cāṅgīkaroti saḥ ||75||
anicchadbhyo’pi bhaktebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān hariḥ |
mahaiśvaryāṇi naijāni dadāti tvakṣare prabhuḥ ||76||
evaṃ santoṣiṇo bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇābhāḥ saṃbhavanti te |
tatkṛpayā sadā sarvaiḥ sākaṃ ramate māpatiḥ ||77||
ātmavat tatpriyāste ca santuṣṭā jñāninaḥ sukhāḥ |
niṣkāmā uttamāste vai bhaktā bhavanti tatpriyāḥ ||78||
bhojane śayane snāne gamane ramaṇe kṛtau |
khelane helane vāṇyāṃ vinode hasane dhṛtau ||79||
niṣkāmān sahavāsām̐stān rakṣatyeva janārdanaḥ |
asaṃśayāḥ sadā bhaktāḥ priyā bhavanti śārṅgiṇaḥ ||3.204.80 ||
ityevaṃ copadiṣṭāste lakṣmi sādhusuveṣiṇā |
kāṣṭhahārā mayā sarve’bhavam̐ste jñānayoginaḥ ||8 1 ||
atha māṃ paramaṃ sādhuṃ jñātvā nārāyaṇātmakam |
śiśriyuste mumuduścārthayāmāsurataḥ param ||82||
sādhorguroryogataśced darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
yogyā vayaṃ te śiṣyāḥ smastadā kāraya muktidam ||83 ||
athāhaṃ tānuvācedaṃ dhyānaṃ kurvantu vai hṛdi |
drakṣyatho’traiva śrīnāthaṃ pareśaṃ mādhavaṃ harim ||84||
ityuktāste netravṛttīścitte nidhāya keśavam |
dadhyustāvat sādhuveṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ vilulokire ||85||
sādhorveṣād divyarūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ pareśvaram |
śrīkāntaṃ rādhikākāntaṃ pareśaṃ vilulokire ||86||
kāṣṭhahārāḥ samastāste’kṣaraṃ dhāma mahojjvalam |
prapaśyan śrīharermuktaiḥ koṭyasaṃkhyairvirājitam ||87||
tatra siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ gajāsanaṃ mahottamam |
tatra sthitaṃ hariṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyānvitam ||88||
vīkṣayāmāsurīśeśeśvaraṃ rādhāpatiṃ prabhum |
brahmapriyāpatiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||89||
sevamānamanantaiśca muktairaikāntikaiḥ sukhaiḥ |
evaṃ vilokya sahasā hṛdaye sādhurūpiṇam ||3.204.90||
punaste dadṛśuḥ sarve tato bahiḥsthitaṃ yatim |
sādhuṃ vilokayāmāsuḥ sahasā snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||91 ||
utthāya māṃ parātmānaṃ jñātvāraṇye samāgatam |
pupūjurāśliṣam̐ścāpi papuḥ pādajalaṃ tataḥ |||92|||
prasādaṃ ca mayā dattaṃ cakhaduste’timoditāḥ |
divyabhāvaṃ gatāḥ sarve daṇḍavat saṃpracakrire || 93||
utthāyotthāya dhanyaṃ ca manyamānāḥ pramodinaḥ |
nanṛtustālikātānaiḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrire tathā ||94||
mama pādatale jihvābhiśca cakruḥ sulohanam |
pādayorantike sarve luluṭurdhūlikāstare ||95||
atha śāntiṃ yayuścāpi vavandurmāṃ sanātanam |
sevanaṃ cārthayāmāsurdhāmni dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tathā ||96||
tathāstvevaṃ samuccārya tiro’bhavaṃ druta tvaham |
atha te nirvikalpā vai mamopāsanavedinaḥ ||97||
divyā bhaktā abhavam̐śca kālenāpi tanutyajaḥ |
yayurme dhāma paramaṃ yatra sādhyā vasanti vai ||98||
evaṃ mayā kāṣṭhahārā uddhṛtā bhaktitatparāḥ |
lakṣmi jāṃgaladevādyāḥ sahasraśo’pi tatparāḥ ||99||
sakāmāstatra ye tvāsan prāpitāste divaṃ prati |
niṣkāmāḥ prāpitā lakṣmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā || 3.204.10 0||
kecittu prāpitā dhāma golokaṃ sumahojjvalam |
kecicca prāpitā lakṣmi śrīpuraṃ lalitāgṛham || 101 ||
anye śrībadarīdhāma śvetadvīpaṃ tathāpare |
kecidavyākṛtaṃ dhāma prāpitāścāmṛtaṃ pare || 10 2||
evamete mayā lakṣmi coddhṛtāḥ kāṣṭhahāriṇaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam || 10 3||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jāṃgaladevādikāṣṭhahārāṇāṃ bhaktyā sādhurūpeṇa śrīharerdarśanaṃ cānte mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||

<3.205>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya paṇyakāriṇaḥ |
nāmnā vātsalyadhīrasya kathāṃ paramapāvanīm || 1 ||
nāgaśālāyane grāme bhakto vaiśyo’bhavanmama |
kuṭumbadhanavāṭyādidhenukṣetrādisampadā || 2 ||
vardhamāno’timānyaśca lokānāṃ ca nṛpasya ca |
viprāṇāṃ pūjakaścātidhyānavṛttirharau mayi || 3 ||
pūjāpāṭhaparo nityaṃ bhaktikīrtanatatparaḥ |
tīrthasādhusatīmantā gosevaḥ surasevakaḥ || 4 ||
vṛddhābhipūjakaścānnadānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
dhanāḍhyaḥ sa dhanaṃ varṣe varṣe yajñārthamuttamam || 5 ||
dadātyeva tathā vṛkṣāropaṇārthaṃ dadātyapi |
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ khātārthaṃ ca dadātyapi || 6 ||
jīrṇadevālayādīnāmuddhāre vitaratyapi |
anāthabāladīnānāṃ sahāyārthaṃ dadātyapi || 7 ||
govṛṣaśvaśukānāṃ ca pārāvātādipakṣiṇām |
ghāsānnakaṇakān śreṣṭhī dadātyeva sudharmavān || 8 ||
vyadhādannādisatrāṇi dharmaśālāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ |
prapāparvāṇi ramyāṇi vedikāścatvarādiṣu || 9 ||
sīmni jalānnasatrāṇi kuṭīścāśrayadāyikāḥ |
akarot sa ca devānāṃ pūjāpravāhamuttamam || 3.205.1 0||
evaṃ nityaṃ tasya lakṣmi dravyaṃ dāne’pi dīyate |
akṣayyaṃ vardhate nityaṃ vātsalyadhīranāṇakam || 11 ||
etādṛśaḥ sa bhakto me vrate mahotsavaṃ param |
karoti rājavacchreṣṭhopacārairbahumūlyakaiḥ || 1 2||
vādyagāyanagītyādyaiḥ kīrtanairbhajanairapi |
nṛtyotsavādibhiścāpi kārayatyeva sūtsavam || 13||
niveditānnasalilamiṣṭānnaphalapāyasaiḥ |
tarpayatyeva sarvān sa mahotsave samāgatān || 14||
pūrve dattaṃ tataścātra labdhaṃ tato’pi dīyate |
lapsyate cākṣayaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇāya dīyate || 15||
evaṃ matvā dadātyeva dattaṃ cākṣayatāṃ vrajet |
vṛddhiṃ yāyānna tu hrāsaṃ tasmād deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 16||
puṇyaṃ phalaṃ mahaccāpi dānasya svargamuttamam |
prasannatā hareścāpi tṛptiścātmagatā bhavet || 17||
sukhadaṃ sarvathā dānaṃ rasānnadhanasampadām |
gṛhakṣetravāṭikānāṃ dhenūnāṃ payasāṃ tathā || 18||
dravyāṇāmupakaraṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ tathākṣayam |
dātavyaṃ sarvathā sampadyuktaiḥ sampanmiliṣyati || 19||
adattaṃ labhyate naiva nārīdhanagṛhādikam |
dattamevāpyate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ cendriyadehajam ||3.205.20||
lakṣmi vātsalyadhīrastu satre satre sthale sthale |
lilekha kṛṣṇanāmāni kapāṭeṣu prapāsu ca ||21 ||
kuṭīṣu bhittiṣu pātreṣvapi vastreṣu vastuṣu |
japate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīvallabham prabhum ||22||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya nityaṃ prapūjakasya me |
gṛhaṃ cāhaṃ jagāmaiva bhūtvā tu jaṭilo yatiḥ ||23 ||
ahaṃ cākāritastena bhojanārthaṃ tṛṇāsane |
mayā cābhihito bhaktaḥ pādaprakṣālanāya me ||24||
suvarṇakalaśe bhṛtvā jalaṃ sugandhimiśritam |
snehenākṣālayat pādau papau vāri prasādajam ||25||
athāpi bhaktarāṭ tūrṇaṃ mayā punarniveditaḥ |
dehasammardanārthaṃ vai tailaiḥ sugandhisārakaiḥ ||26||
so’pi prasannamanasā me’ṅgānyamardayattathā |
mayoktaḥ sa tataścāpyuṣṇādbhiḥ snāpayituṃ tu mām ||27||
drāguṣṇādbhiḥ saha tatrāyayāvutsāhavān svayam |
mayā nirākṛtaḥ so’pi yācitastatstriyaṃ prati || 28||
tūrṇaṃ sā sahasā mañjulikānāmnī pativratā |
patyājñayopatasthe māṃ snāpayituṃ niḥśaṅkinī ||29||
prasannamānasā sādhvī dadau svarṇāsanaṃ tu me |
ahaṃ kaupīnamātrāḍhyo niṣasāda śubhāsane ||3.205.30||
sā hastābhyāṃ satī sādhvī bhaktānikā ca māṃ muhuḥ |
sarvāṃgeṣu prasammṛdya snapayāmāsa bhāvukī ||3 1 ||
mayā tasyai darśitā vai vikṛtirjāgratātmikā |
tathāpi sā viśaṃkā māṃ snapayāmāsa sādaram ||32||
sparśaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kṛtvā sarvāṃgeṣu pativratā |
prasannamānasā mañjulikā na vikṛtiṃ yayau ||33 ||
dhīrā sthirā dharmavatī tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ |
prasanno bhava muktātman yatte sevāṃ karomi te ||34||
patyurājñā yathā syātte sevāṃ kuryāṃ visaṃśayā |
sādhurnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād divyamūrtiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||35||
tasya sevā tu bhāgyena labhyate khalu yoṣitā |
patyājñā cet tavāsmyeva yataścāsmi pativratā ||36||
uktaścaivaṃ tathāhaṃ ca lakṣmi tatpatimāhvayam |
patnī te dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ bādhate mānasaṃ mama ||37||
patiḥ prapūjya pādau me tadā tathāstu saṃdadau |
sāpi matparabhāvā ca vyajāyatājñayā rame ||38||
aspṛṣṭvā tāṃ tadā tūrṇaṃ divyaścaturbhujo’bhavam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||39||
sāpi dhanyāṃ manyamānā svāṃ papāta ca pādayoḥ |
tasyāḥ patiśca vātsalyadhīro’pi premavihvalaḥ ||3.205.40||
sādhurūpaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca jñātvā papāta pādayoḥ |
bhaktān samāhvayāmāsa sevāṃ cakre ca tatkṣaṇam ||41 ||
vastravibhūṣaṇaiścāpi candanaiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ |
arpayāmāsa sarvaṃ me bhojanaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam ||42||
mañcaṃ svarṇāsanaṃ cāpi śṛṃgāraṃ ca parārhaṇam |
nīrājanaṃ cakārāpi śayanaṃ me dadau tataḥ ||43||
atha sādhusvarūpo’haṃ sarvaiḥ sampūjitaḥ prabhuḥ |
yayācire ca bhaktāśca tathā vātsalyadhīrakaḥ ||44||
bhuktirlabdhā divyagatirdīyatāṃ parameśvara |
jñānaṃ māhātmyasampannaṃ dīyatāṃ te parātparam ||45||
ahaṃ lakṣmi dadau tasmai tebhyaśca jñānamuttamam |
snehaḥ kāryo bhagavati mayi śrīparameśvare ||46||
sarvārpaṇaṃ vidheyaṃ ca niḥśaṃkaṃ mayi mādhave |
niḥspṛhatvaṃ vidheyaṃ ca sāṃsārikeṣu sarvathā ||47||
vairāgyaḥ sarvathā rakṣyo bandhanasya vichittaye |
kṛṣṇe mayyanurāgaśca prema sneho’tisnigdhatā ||48||
kartavyā sarvathā nārīnarairmadarpaṇāya vai |
yatitavyaṃ nityaśaśca prāpto bhavāmi tena ha ||49||
snehena hṛdaye’khaṇḍaṃ smaraṇaṃ me harerbhavet |
mama mūrteḥ sadā sphurtirvarteta tena saukhyadā ||3.205.50||
anyabhānāstu saṃkalpāścodayaṃ neyureva ha |
vilīnā māyayā sākaṃ nirbījāste bhavanti vai ||51||
pūrṇapremavatāṃ pūrṇāḥ saṃkalpā mama gocarāḥ |
nānyagocarā jāyante sarvadā bhaktiyoginām ||52||
viparīte deśakālasaṃgādau cet tu māyikaḥ |
saṃkalpo yadyutpadyeta tadā vyathā bhaveddhṛdi ||53||
yathā netre tīkṣṇasūcīkṣepe vyathā bhavettathā |
yathā tīkṣṇā śalyadhārā hṛdgatā vai vyathāṃ kriyāt ||54||
tathodbhūtānyasaṃkalpo vyathāṃ kuryājjanaṃ śritam |
etādṛśaḥ paraḥ snehaḥ kartavyo mayi keśave ||55||
snehastu mama māhātmyajñānād bhavati vardhitaḥ |
varamālāgrahaṇācca naisargiko bhavedapi ||56||
kaṇṭhī mālā varamālā mantro me ca varaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tadādāne bhavet snehaḥ kanyāyā iva kāntake ||57||
adṛṣṭe’pi bhavet snehaḥ sarvādhāre hi rakṣake |
tadarpaṇātmikā vṛttiḥ sarvā bhaktasya jāyate ||58||
karagrahe’pi saṃsparśe snehaścātīva vardhate |
sarvātmanārpaṇe snehaḥ niḥsīmā sampravardhate ||59||
guroḥ prasaṃgataḥ sneho guruḥ sādhujano mataḥ |
satāṃ prasaṃgamāsādya māhātmyaṃ cāpnuyānmama ||3.205.60||
dehe daihikaviṣaye sampatsvapi vivekavān |
rāgaṃ hitvā harau kṛṣṇe mayi snehaṃ vivardhayet ||61 ||
jaḍaṃ dehaṃ daihikaṃ ca na mantavyaṃ nijaṃ kvacit |
ātmāhaṃ cetano divyo bhagavaccharaṇāgataḥ ||62||
saccidānandarūpo’smi mukto’smi brahmasaṃsthitaḥ |
māyā me nāsti loke’tra vinā hariṃ na kiñcana ||63||
evaṃ vivekavān kṛṣṇe snigdho bhavati sarvathā |
ahantāmamatāhīnaḥ sarvarāgādivarjitaḥ ||64||
na mātā na pitā me’sti na strī na dravyamasti me |
na putro na sutā me’sti na gehaṃ me na vāṭikā ||65||
pūrvabhaveṣu bahavo jātā vai janakādayaḥ |
ajñānena mayā cātra vismṛtāstattathā tvime ||66||
ātmano nahi mātāsti kutaḥ pitā kuto gṛham |
ahantāmamatārāgadveṣāścāpi kutastarāḥ ||67||
evaṃ vivekināṃ sarvā naśyanti mamatādikāḥ |
mayyeva śrīharau cāhaṃmamatvaṃ tūpajāyate ||68||
satyaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ bhaktāstarantyetena majjanāḥ |
vivekahīnāḥ saṃsāre badhyante na taranti te ||69||
yathā nāṭyagṛhe prauḍhāḥ kiśorā raṃgabhūkṛte |
nāṭyasampādanārthaṃ vai veṣān vahanti cocitān ||3.205.70 ||
veṣāṇāṃ kuśalāsteṣāṃ dhārayanti suveṣakān |
sajjayanti suśobhāḍhyān śṛṃgārayanti śobhanān ||71||
kiśorān strīsvarūpām̐śca klṛptayanti surūpiṇaḥ |
tatra veṣadharo veṣasampādakān janān yadi ||72||
manyeta pitarau janmapradau mauḍhyāttadā tu saḥ |
ajña eva bhavet sarvavivekādivivarjitaḥ ||73||
tathā dehopi veṣo’sti dehādau pitarau na tu |
mantavyau cātmanā brahmarūpeṇa vartinā tviha ||74||
evameva yathā nānājātiṣu bahavo gatāḥ |
dehasyotpādakāścāpi tathāsya varṣmaṇo’pi tau ||75||
evaṃ vivekaṃ kṛtvaiva strīputradhanasampadi |
snehaṃ tyaktvā prakuryādvai snehaṃ mayi pareśvare ||76||
dehe’hantā vinaṣṭā syād daihike mamatā tataḥ |
ātmaniṣṭhābalaṃ nityaṃ pravardhetākṣarapradam ||77||
varṇāśramābhimānaśca layaṃ yāyād vivekataḥ |
muktiṃ pratyeva valayaṃ nijātmanaḥ samudbhavet ||78||
tad gṛhītvā bhujāyāṃ vai kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ samāśrayet |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedasya karasthā naiva saṃśayaḥ ||79||
gṛhastho’pi bhaveccāpi mantavyaḥ sādhureva saḥ |
bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ tu yastādṛgjñānaniṣṭho virāgavān ||3.205.80 ||
yasmāddharirna vai dūre durlabhaḥ sādhureva saḥ |
tasmād bandhā vinaśyanti sevyaḥ sādhuḥ sa eva saḥ ||8 1 ||
brahmātmanā vartate’sau dehādibhāvavarjitaḥ |
sarvārpaṇātmanā lakṣmi tasmāt kiñcinna śiṣyate ||82||
apityāgavatāṃ tyaktagehādīnāmapi kvacit |
abhimānaṃ bhaveccettadasya yogād vilīyate ||83||
evaṃ sa paṇyakṛcchreṣṭhī lakṣmi mayā nibodhitaḥ |
mahāsādhusamo jātaḥ patnīputrādisaṃyutaḥ ||84||
vyāpārān sarvathā kṛṣṇe’rpitān cakre kuṭumbayuk |
viśeṣataścātmaniṣṭhāṃ māhātmyaṃ me viveda saḥ ||85||
atha vairāgyamāpannaḥ patnyā sākaṃ sa bhaktarāṭ |
iyeṣa vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ sādhavīṃ sādhusammatām ||86||
mamājñayā sa pradadau putrebhyo dhanasampadaḥ |
svayaṃ vātsalyadhīraḥ sa mañjulikāsatīyutaḥ ||87||
dīkṣāṃ jagrāha mantraṃ ca sādhuryatyāśramo’bhavat |
sādhvī patnī ca tasyābhūt sāṃkhyayoginyataḥ param ||88||
vātsalyāyananāmāyaṃ mayā sādhustadā kṛtaḥ |
vairāgyeṇa yutastīrthayātrārthamudyamaṃ vyadhāt| ||89||
tiro’bhavaṃ tvahaṃ drāk ca sādhuḥ prajāṃ praṇamya ca |
putrānāpṛcchya tīrthārthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ||3.205.90||
ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ prāpa kuṃkumavāpikām |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ prāṅnibhālitam ||96. ||
tīrthaṃ cakre’bhitastatrovāsa śrīlomaśāśrame |
mañjulikā mahāsādhvī brahmapriyāsu cāvasat |||92||
ubhau tau sādhurūpau māṃ bhajete cātmavedinau |
vartamānāvimau lakṣmi paśya mañjulikāṃ satīm ||93||
taveyaṃ sevikā cāste pāvanī bhaktisaṃbhṛtā |
niḥsaṃśayābhavad yā sā sādhave me purā gṛhe ||94||
arpaṇārthaṃ sthitā patyurājñayātra tataḥ sthitā |
divyā divyasvarūpādya vartate brahmayoginī ||95||
vātsalyāyanasādhuśca vartate brahmarūpavān |
ātmaniṣṭhastathā samyagjñānī snehaparaṃ gataḥ ||96||
māyāṃ kālaṃ ca karmāpi gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ |
madbalāt sarvatattvānāmucchraye vartate hyasau ||97||
ākaśe’yaṃ prayātyeva dehenānena sarvathā |
samudre parvate’raṇye meghe prayātyanargalaḥ ||98||
vahnau candre tathā sūrye lokālokācale divi |
merau yāti punaryāti svāśrayaṃ yogapāragaḥ ||99||
mama mūrtiṃ sadā dhyāyati matkṛpayā sādhurāṭ |
dhartuṃ kartuṃ ca saṃhartuṃ samartho vidyate’dhunā || 3.205.1 00||
mamopāsanayā lakṣmi sevayā cāpyaśaṃkayā |
mama yogena divyatvaṃ prāpto’yaṃ muktavat sadā ||1 01 ||
evaṃ bhaktiṃ prakurvanto bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne paṇya
kṛto vātsalyadhīrākhyabhaktasya tatpatnyā mañjulikādevyā bhaktyā prasanno bhagavān darśanaṃ dadau, sādhubhūtau tau ca vartete ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 205 ||

<3.206>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ vanapālasya vai kathām |
nāmnā tilakaraṃgasya śūdrasyāraṇyavāsinaḥ || 1 ||
mahākālavane lakṣmi vanapālo’tibhaktimān |
āsīt tilakaraṃgākhyaḥ śivabhakto’tibhāvanaḥ || 2 ||
sureśikāsarittīre vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe kṛtālayaḥ |
araṇyarakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ bhraman karoti sāyudhaḥ || 3 ||
vanyakandaphalāhāraḥ kvacillabdhānnabhojanaḥ |
ṛtupakvakaṇāhāro vartate sakuṭumbakaḥ || 4 ||
vanevāse’pi satataṃ prāṇihiṃsāvivarjitaḥ |
dayādharmaparo yogye kāle śaṃkarapūjakaḥ || 5 ||
prātaḥ snātvā vārighaṭaṃ bhṛtvā śrīśaṃkarālayam |
gatvābhiṣekaṃ carati bilvapatrāṇi candanam || 6 ||
karṇikāyāḥ kanakānāṃ puṣpārpaṇaṃ karoti ca |
madhyānhe’pi jalādhārī datvā prapūjya śaṃkaram || 7 ||
tato naivedyaṃ prāpyaiva bhuṃkte sāyaṃ tathaiva ca |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 8 ||
ārādhanaṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā karoti kīrtanam |
svapityeva tatastatra vedyāṃ śaṃkarasannidhau || 9 ||
prātarutthāya sammārjya gālavādanapūrvakam |
kṛtvā smaraṇaṃ śaṃbhośca tataḥ snātuṃ prayāti ca || 3.206.10 ||
asya patnī śikhādevī tathaiva śaṃkarārhaṇam |
nityaṃ karoti śaktyā vai liṅgaṃ saṃsnāpayatyapi || 11 ||
mandire vasati tatra divase bhaktiyoginī |
vāṭapravāsinaḥ kecinnarā nāryo’pi mārgagāḥ || 12||
yadyāyānti viśrāmyanti tebhyo jalaṃ phalaṃ sthalam |
dadāti sā śikhādevī satkaroti yathāyatham || 13||
śaṃkarasya guṇān dharmān camatkārān vadatyapi |
śaṃkaro vai bhaktabhaktiṃ vilokya ca tutoṣa ha || 14||
ekadā vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā yātrālustatra cāgataḥ |
kṛtavaiṣṇavatilakaḥ skandhe kṛtasupeṭikaḥ || 15||
kukṣau śālagrāmayukto nārāyaṇaṃ raṭan muhuḥ |
śikhādevī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsaṃ vedyāṃ dadau tataḥ || 16||
nidhāya peṭikāṃ tatra snātuṃ sukeśikānadīm |
yayau snātvā snāpayitvā śālagrāmaṃ prapūjya ca ||17||
āyayāvāsane vedyāṃ niṣasāda kṣaṇaṃ sthiraḥ |
tāvat tilakaraṃgo’pi vanāntarādupāgataḥ || 18 ||
ānīya kandamūlāni nidadhe vedikopari |
yātrāluṃ viṣṇuyuktaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ || 19||
svāgatādi punaścakre phalamūlāni śaṃbhave |
nivedya pradadau tasmai papracchāgamanaṃ kutaḥ ||3.206.20||
kva gamyate mahārāja yadīṣṭaṃ vasa madgṛhe |
śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha bhaktārthaṃ tvāgamo mama ||21 ||
gamyate yatra bhakto’sti tīrthaṃ madiṣṭaṃ sarvathā |
yatra bhaktā nivasanti tatra vasāmi sādhuvat ||22||
tvaṃ bhakto’si vane nityaṃ satāmātithyakārakaḥ |
tvadgṛhaṃ pāvanīkṛtya yāsyāmyanyat sutīrthakam ||23||
śrutvaitad vanapālo’pi papraccha punareva tam |
kva tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ sādho vidyate yatra gamyate || 24||
jaṭī prāha tadā bhaktaṃ tīrthaṃ satāṃ samāgamaḥ |
yatra satsaṃga utkṛṣṭastatra vai gamyate mayā |||25|
sādhavo bahavaḥ santi saṃsārānmokṣakāriṇaḥ |
viṣṇordhyānaparāścāpi śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇakāriṇaḥ ||26||
tyāginaśca tapoyuktā nigrahe ca yame ratāḥ |
sevābhaktiparāścāpi vanāraṇyanivāsinaḥ ||27||
yadgṛhe vartate viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurvā śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
vāsudevo bālakṛṣṇastadgṛhaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||28||
yatra hiraṇyavarṇaśca hiraṇyakeśavān prabhuḥ |
sarvaḥ suvarṇamūrtiḥ śrīharirvirājate sadā ||29||
tattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ bhakta tatra tīrthe vasāmyaham |
bhūritejodivyamūrtirbhagavān yatra rājate ||3.206.30||
yatra bhaktā hareḥ santi sādhvyaśca sādhavo’pi ca |
tattīrthe pāvanaṃ bhakta tatra vai gamyate mayā ||31||
saccidānandarūpaṃ yat pūrṇaṃ brahma prakāśakṛt |
mahātejo yataḥ saṃprakāśate’tra vasāmyaham ||32||
tameva puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam |
dhyātvā parātparaṃ divyaṃ parameśamupaimyaham ||33||
tenedaṃ ca jagat pūrṇaṃ pūrṇena puruṣeṇa vai |
taṃ śyāmasundaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇamupaimyaham ||34||
karmaphalapradātāraṃ jīvānāmīśvareśvaram |
mukteśvaraṃ divyamūrtiṃ lakṣmīpatimupaimyaham ||35||
yasya mūrteścāti tejo mahad vyāpakamūrdhvagam |
sarvasthaṃ brahmasaṃjñaṃ ca taṃ śrīpatimupaimyaham ||36||
yasyānvayena sarvatra mahaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prakāśate |
mūrtavat phaladaṃ cāste taṃ tejasvinamemyaham ||37||
īśvarā devatāḥ siddhā yatpratāpena mādhavāḥ |
bhavanti taṃ divyamūrtiṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samupaimyaham ||38||
yasya mūrtau samādhiṃ samprāptasya divyayoginaḥ |
māyātatkāryatattvānāṃ layo’sti tamupaimyaham ||39||
cidākāśo’tisukhavān mahānandabhṛtaḥ sadā |
yanmūrteḥ svacchatātmāste taṃ pareśamupaimyaham ||3.206.40||
yadakṣaraṃ brahmadhāma divyaṃ vyoma mahaḥ sukham |
sarvānandapradaṃ yasya tamupaimi hariṃ prabhum ||41||
yadakṣaraṃ samasteṣu māyāyāṃ māyikeṣu ca |
ātmatattveṣu cāpyāste taṃ prabhuṃ samupaimyaham ||42||
puruṣe prakṛtau kāle yadanvayatayā balam |
samastakāryakāritvaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samupaimyaham ||43||
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ ca yasmādvai śobhate layameti ca |
sṛṣṭitraye vartamānaṃ taṃ hariṃ samupaimyaham ||44||
yatprasādād divyadṛṣṭirmānavo’pi suro’pi vā |
sarvaṃ brahmekṣate taṃ māṇikīkāntamupaimyaham ||45||
anantāḥ śaktayo yasmādanantaiśvaryakoṭayaḥ |
prabhavanti ca rudrādyāstaṃ pareśamupaimyaham ||46||
aṣṭāṃgayoginaḥ santaḥ sādhyā devāśca yaṃ prabhum |
samādhau saṃprapaśyanti taṃ hariṃ samupaimyaham ||47||
yanmūrtau dehināṃ nāḍīprāṇāmbarāṇi sarvathā |
saṃkucitānyākṛṣṭāni jāyante tamupaimyaham ||48||
īśvarā brahmarudrādyā mādṛśāḥ sādhavastathā |
nārāyaṇā hyasaṃkhyātā yaṃ śritvaiśvaryaśālinaḥ ||49||
bhagavanto bhavantyeva nārāyaṇyo bhavantyapi |
avatārāvatāriṇyastamupaimi pareśvaram ||3.206.50||
bhaja tvaṃ sarvathā taṃ ca devaṃ śrīpatimīśvaram |
sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ dhartāraṃ rādhikāpatim ||51||
ahaṃ bhajāmi taṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīparameśvaram |
anye bhajitvā taṃ devaṃ paraṃ padaṃ purā yayuḥ ||52||
yānti yāsyanti cānye’pi bhaja taṃ parameśvaram |
ityevamuktvā śānto’bhūd rudro vai bhaktavatsalaḥ ||53||
tato lakṣmi śikhādevī tathā tilakaraṃgakaḥ |
jñātvā sādhuṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ rudrasamaṃ vavandatuḥ ||54||
aho sādho dhanyabhāgyamasmākaṃ vai kuṭumbinām |
jñānametādṛśaṃ cādya labdhavanto yataḥ sataḥ ||55||
bhavādṛśasya sādhorvai darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ tviha |
vanapānāṃ kathaṃ sādhusaṃgamo mokṣado bhavet ||56||
viṣṇorbhakto bhavānāste vayaṃ bhaktā harasya ca |
harasya darśanaṃ kasmād bhavettadvada śobhanam ||57||
śrutvā śaṃbhustadā prāha śaṃbhostu darśanaṃ tava |
vṛttīrniruddhya cātraiva bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||58||
antarvṛttīḥ samādhāya paśyantu māṃ hṛdantare |
sādhumūrtau darśanaṃ te bhaviṣyati harasya vai ||59||
ityuktāste tilakādyā vanapāstatra cābdhije |
antarvṛttīstadā kṛtvā dhyāyanti hṛtsu yāvatā ||3.206.60||
tāvat sādhuḥ svayaṃ rudrastriśūladhṛg vyajāyata |
trinetro vyāghracarmadhṛk satīśrīpārvatīpatiḥ ||61 ||
harau magno’tisukhakṛt saumyarūpaḥ samujjvalaḥ |
mahāyogī gaṇeśādyaiḥ sahitaḥ samadṛśyata ||62|||
atha tatra hareḥ rūpaṃ caturbhujasya me śubham |
lakṣmyā samaṃ mahādivyaṃ harasya hṛdaye param ||63||
vyadṛśyata mahānandabhṛtaṃ śaṃkarapūjitam |
śaṃbhostu hṛdayāt tacca nirgataṃ śobhanaṃ bahiḥ ||64||
śaṃbhunā pūjyamānaṃ ca vyadṛśyata sukhapradam |
evaṃ tu darśanaṃ datvā sādhurūpastu śaṃkaraḥ ||65 ||
viṣṇurūpaṃ nijarūpaṃ tirobhāvayadeva saḥ |
sādhurūpo’bhavacchīghraṃ hṛdaye ca tataḥ param ||66||
sarvān tilakaraṃgādīn bahirvṛttīnakārayat |
utthitā dadṛśuḥ sādhuṃ yathāpūrvaṃ jaṭādharam ||67||
jñānavantaśca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ sveṣṭadevaṃ satīpatim |
nipetuḥ pādayoḥ sarve śaṃbhoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||68||
aparādhakṣamāṃ yayācire muktiṃ yayācire |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā cāsmi vaiṣṇavo bhaktavatsalaḥ ||69||
bhaktānāṃ śrīharau bhaktiṃ kārayitumihāgataḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdaye’haṃ rakṣāmi sarvadā prabhum ||3.206.70||
dhyāyāmi taṃ paraṃ brahma bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyāḥ patim |
bhavanto mama bhaktāśca bhajantu parameśvaram ||71 ||
ityuktvā pradadau lakṣmi mantraṃ tebhyaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||72||
atha nārāyaṇapūjāṃ bhajanaṃ cādideśa tān |
muktyarthaṃ vacanaṃ datvā sahasā sa tiro’bhavat ||73 ||
tatastilakaraṃgo’pi bheje śaṃbhoḥ samājñayā |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ māṃ vai patnīkuṭumbayuk sadā ||74||
vane vanyānmānavām̐śca tata ārabhya sarvathā |
narānnārīścāhvayitvā kārayatyeva kīrtanam ||75||
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramāpate |
hareviṣṇo hare jiṣṇo’nādikṛṣṇa śriyaḥpate ||76||
evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ karoti kārayatyapi |
vane vedyāṃ nityamevārcayatyeva janārdanam ||77||
phalapuṣpādibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ tu mām |
toṣayatyeva ca nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ||78||
nṛtyatyeva savādyaṃ ca premṇā sāyaṃ niśāgame |
sādhuṣveva haraścāste hare harirvirājate ||79||
matvaivaṃ vanamadhye’pi sādhūn sadā prasevate |
karmaṇā manasā vācā dehena ca dhanena ca ||3.206.80||
patrapuṣpaphalaistoyaiścātmārpaṇena sevate |
sādhvarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaḥ pratyakṣasādhusevanaḥ ||81 ||
pratyakṣaniścayaḥ samyak samarpya sevate sataḥ |
bhāryā sukhārthinī sarvaṃ tyaktvā sukhaṃ virāgiṇī ||82||
yathā tathā sataḥ sādhvī sevate paramārthinī |
putraputryādikāścāsya sevante sādhumīśvaram ||83||
sarvaṃ vai vartate sādhau haro harirnarāyaṇaḥ |
brahma mokṣo mahānandaḥ sādhuṣu śāśvataṃ sukham ||84||
sādhureva paraṃbrahma sādhurdevo guruḥ paraḥ |
sādhujano harermūrtiḥ sādhoḥ sevā hi muktidā ||85||
ityevaṃ te prasevante vanapā vanyavastubhiḥ |
athaikadā kārtikasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine tu te ||86||
mahotsavaṃ pracakrurvai vane kuñje tu dārave |
vṛkṣaśākhānaddhadolāṃ vallīpallavapuṣpitām ||87||
śobhitāṃ saṃvidhāyaiva māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ te nyaṣādayan |
āndolanaṃ pracakruśca kīrtanaṃ pūjanaṃ mama ||88||
janmamahotsavaṃ cakruranāderme tadā tvaham |
nṛtyagītottaraṃ rātrau brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ||89||
divyakiśorarūpeṇa pratyakṣastvarito’bhavam |
divyadivyātidivyāḍhyarūpabhūṣāmbarānvitaḥ ||3.206.90||
prāvirāsaṃ sudolāyāṃ tejaḥparidhisatprabhaḥ |
prasannahāsyavadanaḥ kiśoro māṇikīpatiḥ ||91 ||
rādhālakṣmīpatiprajñāpramāśrīkamalāpatiḥ |
āścaryaṃ te yayuḥ sarve kṣaṇaṃ cakruśca darśanam ||92||
atha mūrtisvarūpo’hamabhavaṃ ca drutaṃ tataḥ |
pramodamagnāste sarve prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ |||93||
harekṛṣṇa dayāsindho tārayāsmānnijāñjanān |
saṃsārasāgarādasmāttava dhāma pradehi naḥ ||94||
tathāstvevamahaṃ tebhyo varaṃ dadau tadā rame |
mūrtermukhād varadānaṃ datvā cāttvā tadarpitam ||95||
adṛśyo’hamabhavam̐śca te cakruḥ parihārakam |
atha kālāntare prāpte tilakaraṃgayoginaḥ ||96||
śikhādevyāstathā cānyavanapānāṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ |
muktidātā vimānena hyupasthito’bhavaṃ vane ||97||
divyadehān vidhāyaitān vimāne tānnyaṣādayam |
agamaṃ divyadhāmordhvaṃ cākṣaraṃ paramaṃ mama ||98||
evaṃ muktiṃ dattavān vai vanapebhyaḥ paraṃ padam |
anye’pi vanapāstatra bhajante mā hariṃ prabhum ||99||
prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma prāpte cāyuṣyasīmake |
ye ye śaṃbhornideśena bhajante māṃ janārdanam || 3.206.100 ||
nayāmi tānmama dhāmākṣaraṃ lakṣmi parātparam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||1 01 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne tilakaraṃgasya vanapasya śivabhaktasya sādhurūpaśivoktabhaktyā nārāyaṇopāsanayā paramamuktiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||

<3.207>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kṣetrapasya kathāṃ śubhām |
nāmnā nāñjakadevasya mama bhaktasya tāraṇīm || 1 ||
nāñjabhakto’bhavacchūraḥ sīmakṣetraprarakṣakaḥ |
kuṃkume laumaśe kṣetre śastrāstravinmahābalaḥ || 2 ||
sīmni vasati nityaṃ sa nagare yāti cotsave |
sasyarakṣākaro nāñjo vāṭikānāṃ ca rakṣakaḥ || 3 ||
khalasthānnakaṇagañjarakṣakaśca sa eva saḥ |
rātrindivaṃ bhramatyeṣo rakṣārthaṃ paritaḥ kṣitau || 4 ||
caurāpahārakebhyaśca rakṣāṃ karoti sarvathā |
karṣukāṇāṃ ca dhanināṃ nāgarikādisampadām || 5 ||
patrakāṇḍādikānāṃ ca sañcayānāṃ tu sīmasu |
nityaṃ māṃ bhajate nāmnā śrīkṛṣṇaśrīnarāyaṇa || 6 ||
mālāmāvartayatyeva mārgeṣu sīmabhūmiṣu |
nāñjasya nāma saṃśrutvā caurā nāyānti tāṃ diśam || 7 ||
bhakto bhaktau nipūṇo’ti dharme’pi pūjane’pi me |
bhajane kīrtane dhyāne yatnavān vartate sadā || 8 ||
sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇe śūro gavāṃ ca dīnayoṣitām |
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ rakṣaṇe tathā || 9 ||
devānāṃ daivavṛkṣāṇāṃ devabhuvāṃ ca rakṣaṇe |
śraddhāvān sevakaścāyaṃ nirmāno dāsavat sadā || 3.207.1 0||
evaṃvidho’yaṃ bhakto me lakṣmi prātaḥ sadā mama |
pūjanaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva vīkṣārthaṃ cāṭavīṃ prati || 11 ||
sarvadikṣu prayātyeva duṣṭānāṃ śāsanāya vai |
ekadā pūrvadigbhāge prātaḥ krośadvayaṃ yayau || 12||
dūre’marāpurato vai mṛdaṃgapurasannidhau |
tatra śatruṃjayādeśālluṇṭakāḥ samupāyayuḥ || 1 3||
bahavo’śvasamārohāḥ saśastrā annahāriṇaḥ |
karṣukāṇāṃ khalabhūmerapahartuṃ khaleṣu te || 14||

rakṣakaṃ naiva cāsādya hyākruśya kaṇasañcayān || 15||
vihāya prayayurdūraṃ tatra nāñjaḥ samāyayau |
kathaṃ vimanaso yūyaṃ nāñjaḥ papraccha karṣukān || 1 6||
karṣukā jagadustaṃ ca luṇṭakā annahārakāḥ |
prasahya khalabhūmeśca harantyannāni no’dhunā || 17||
rakṣāṃ kuru balaṃ te celluṇṭakebhyaḥ prarakṣaka |
śrutvā tūrṇaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā māṃ puruṣottamam || 18||
aśvavāraḥ svayaṃ śīghraṃ dudrāva tatsthalīṃ prati |
yatra te luṇṭakāścānnasañcayān vai haranti ha || 19||
aśveṣūṣṭreṣu cānnāni nikṣipya te vahanti vai |
tān dṛṣṭvā śūrabhāṣābhirgarjanāṃ nāñjako vyadhāt ||3.207.20||
luṇṭakā balino yūyaṃ mātṛjāḥ pitṛjāḥ ṛtāḥ |
māṃ vijitya tato yāntu jitānnānānyathā tviti ||21||
śrutvā balodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sanmukhā yuddhavedinaḥ |
abhavan śastrayuktāste nāñjasya vijayāya vai ||22||
śastrāṇāṃ sahasā kṣepaḥ sānnidhye samajāyata |
prāvartata tadā yuddhaṃ bāṇaiḥ śastraiśca tomaraiḥ ||23||
eko nāñjastu viṃśatyā saha yuddhyati madhyagaḥ |
śastrakṣato’pi bahudhā māṃ smaran bahu yuddhyati ||24||

caurāstato hi caurāṇāṃ khaṅgāghātairmuhurmuhuḥ ||286||

tadāhaṃ tatsthale śūraḥ khaḍgadhraḥ pārśvato drutam ||26||
āvirāsaṃ mahādeho vajrāṃgo yuddhakovidaḥ |
khaḍgaśastān śeṣacaurān bibhedātyavicārayan ||27||

ekaviṃśastvekacauro rāmarāmetisaṃvadan ||28||
mṛtyave saṃyayau mūrchāmāptaḥ śīghraṃ visaṃjñakaḥ |
tato’haṃ dayayā spṛṣṭvā rāmanāmaparāyaṇam ||29||
ujjīvayan prabhaktaṃ taṃ nīrujaṃ samakārayam |
utthitaḥ sa tato bhakto nāmnā mahāmayābhidhaḥ ||3.207.3 0||
prārthayanmāṃ tu nāñjasyojjīvanārthaṃ dayāvaśaḥ |
tato nāñjaṃ karābhyāṃ saṃspṛśannahaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||3 1 ||
mūrchāṃ tasya vyapanīyautthāpayaṃ taṃ sukhānvitam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tau tadā ||32||
tuṣṭuvatuḥ sārdabhāvau mṛtānāṃ prāṇalabdhaye |
aho nārāyaṇastvaṃ vai rāmo rākṣasamokṣakṛt ||33||
aho nṛsiṃho bhagavān bhavān daityavināśakṛt |
aho kṛṣṇa hare rāma tvaṃ gajoddhārakārakaḥ ||34||
tvamevāsuranāśārthaṃ vartase bhaktavatsalaḥ |
pāpināṃ pāpanāśaśca jāyate tava darśanāt ||35||
sparśanāt smaraṇāccāpi pāpino’tra taranti hi |
viśvaṃbharo bhavānāste poṣako rakṣako’pi ca || 36||
hantā saṃkarṣaṇo rudraḥ kālo bhavān prakāśate |
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho mṛtānujjīvayātra vai || 37||
caurayogena bhakto’pi saṃgāccauraḥ prajāyate |
bhakto mahāmayaścāhaṃ cauryakārye’bhisaṃhataḥ ||38||
tathāpi rāmanāmnā tvaṃ bhaktaṃ rakṣitavāniha |
nāñjaṃ rakṣitavānatra rakṣā tadyogato mama ||39||
jātātra bhagavan kṛṣṇa bhaktecchāsaṃprapūraka |
bhaktayogaṃ gatāśceme rakṣaṇīyā dayālunā ||3.207.40||
mṛtāścejjīvitāḥ syuste bhajiṣyanti narāyaṇam |
athavā te rucisteṣāṃ mokṣaṇe cettathā kuru ||41 ||
ityukto’haṃ tadā lakṣmi mṛtānāṃ mokṣahetave |
svargavāsaṃ prathamaṃ vai kṛpayā samakalpayam ||42||
pāpānyeṣāṃ bhaktayogānmadyogādavināśayam |
yāmyaduḥkhāni sarvāṇi tacchirobhyo vyanāśayam ||43||
smṛtvā devavimānaṃ ca kṛtvā tān devavigrahān |
apreṣayaṃ divaṃ tūrṇaṃ viṃśatiṃ samare mṛtān ||44||
mahāmayaṃ tathā nāñjaṃ bhaktaṃ kareṇa vai muhuḥ |
sparśaṃ kṛtvā ca nīrujaṃ yathāpūrvamakārayam ||45||
puṣṭau vigataduḥkhau tau bodhitau ca mayā tadā |
anityo’yaṃ hi saṃsāro deho’nityo gṛhādayaḥ ||46||
anityāḥ sarvamāyotthāḥ padārthāḥ kṣayagocarāḥ |
tathāpyajñā janā nītiṃ vihāyotpathagāminaḥ ||47||
hiṃsāyāṃ sampravartante’pahāre nāśane muhuḥ |
satāṃ yogaṃ na kurvanti bhajante na pareśvaram ||48||
śāstrakathāṃ na śṛṇvanti pāpaṃ kurvantyasaṃśayāḥ |
tena yāmyamahāduḥkhānyanubhavanti daṇḍitāḥ ||49||
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ janmānyapi gṛhṇanti pāpinaḥ |
duḥkhottaraṃ ca duḥkhaṃ samprāpnuvanti vidharmiṇaḥ ||3.207.50||
parānnaharaṇe janma mūṣakāṇāṃ prajāyate |
ghṛtadugdhādiharaṇe mārjārajanmavān bhavet ||51 ||
śākamūlādiharaṇe māyūraṃ janma cāpyate |
vastropakaraṇācchede māhiṣaṃ janma jāyate ||52||
phalapatrādiharaṇe vānaratvaṃ prajāyate |
svarṇaratnādiharaṇe bhallukatvaṃ prajāyate ||53 ||
jalapānādiharaṇe pretatā nirjale vane |
dārāputryādiharaṇe ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ gaṇikājanuḥ ||54||
vādyavāditraharaṇe bhāṇḍatvaṃ naṭatā tathā |
viśvāsaghātakānāṃ tu vṛkatā kṛkalāsatā ||||55||
apahārakṛtāṃ cāśvajanma vāhanajīvinām |
ṛṇināṃ tu vṛṣabhatvaṃ nindakānāṃ tu mūkatā ||56||
ṣaṇḍhokṣatvaṃ kāmināṃ ca kāminī tu piśācinī |
pratārako bhikṣukaśca bhaved dāridryaduḥkhavān ||57||
devānnadhanabhoktā ca bhavecchvā kāka unduruḥ |
kulahantā nakulaḥ syānnārīhantā tu rākṣasaḥ ||58||
dharmahantā bhāgyahīno vārāho jāyate vane |
bhaktihantā nārakī syānnirvaṃśo yamadūtakaḥ ||59||
madyapo mūtrakīṭaḥ syād vṛściko viṣabhakṣakaḥ |
kruddhaḥ sarpo bhaveccāpi nīlamarkaṭikastathā ||3.207.60 ||
ityevaṃ karmajanmāni jñātvā tāni vivarjayet |
śubhaṃ kuryānmānavena dehena nāśubhaṃ kvacit ||61 ||
śubhaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ jñānaṃ śubhaṃ vairāgyamityapi |
śubhāṃ bhaktiṃ prakuryācca mokṣadaṃ satsamāgamam ||62|||
nirdaṃbhaṃ satparicaryāṃ kuryāddhareḥ satāṃ sadā |
kṛṣṇamandiravāṭyādi kārayellepamārjane ||63||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ ca satāṃ kriyāt |
naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ vāripānaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ||64||
sadyo dadyād yatheṣṭaṃ ca seveta gurumaṇḍalam |
kathāṃ ca śṛṇuyānnityaṃ nāmakīrtanamācaret |||65||
ātmaniṣṭhayā varteta brahmarūpeṇa cātmanā |
jānīyānmāṃ hariṃ divyaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam ||66||
vārtāṃ madīyāṃ kuryācca snehaṃ kuryāt sadā mayi |
māyāmāyikakāryeṣu rāgahīnastathā bhavet ||67||
sādhusevāṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ prakurvīta sadā śubham |
viṣayeṣu prakuryāccāruciṃ cāntermatirbhavet ||68||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe matiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kriyāt |
anyatra mānasaṃ naiva dhārayettu kadācana ||69||
premṇaiva kārayet kuryāt sevāṃ me’laṃkṛtiṃ tathā |
mama mūrtiṃ dhārayecca mānuṣīṃ devatāṃ ca vā ||3.207.70||
mama bhakteṣu vai prītiṃ kuryānnānyatra kutracit |
strīputrādau bandhanaṃ tu snehaṃ sadā vivarjayet ||71 ||
kṛṣṇasambandhinīṣveva kriyāsu vyāpṛto bhavet |
kṛṣṇasambandhaśūnyābhyo nivarteta samāhitaḥ ||72||
nityaṃ pūjā mama kuryāt prārthayecca nijaṃ hitam |
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa viṣṇo svāmin pareśvara ||73||
adharmamārgagāllokāt pāhi māṃ nāstikāttathā |
samāgamaṃ te bhaktānāṃ dehi nityaṃ śubhaṃ kuru ||74||
asatāṃ saṃgamo mā syāttathā rakṣāṃ sadā kuru |
caurāṇāṃ pāpināṃ saṃgaṃ nindakānāṃ na me’rpaya ||75||
madyamāṃsāśanānāṃ ca saṃgaṃ vyavāyināṃ na me |
mūrtikhaṇḍanakartṝṇāmupāsanāvināśinām ||76||
saṃgaṃ me mārpaya kṛṣṇa śaraṇāgatavatsala |
bhaktiṃ vinā dinaṃ vandhyaṃ mā me yātu tathā kuru ||77||
manovṛttiḥ sadā kṛṣṇe tiṣṭhettathāvidhāpaya |
sāṃsārikeṣu cittaṃ me virāgaṃ syāttathā kuru ||78 ||
satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇa tava mūrteḥ samāgamam |
ciraṃ ca darśanaṃ te ca dehi hṛdvāsamācara ||79||
bahirvā cāntare vā te darśanaṃ divyameva tat |
sarvadā syāttathā kṛṣṇāntardṛṣṭi dehi me śubhām ||3.207.80 ||
ante dhāmākṣaraṃ dehi tava mūrtyā virājitam |
arthayāmi tathā kṛṣṇa muktiṃ te sevanātmikām ||81 ||
ityevamarthayennityaṃ bhagavantaṃ hariṃ tu mām |
bhaktau yuvāṃ yatastasmādahaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ||82|||
kalyāṇaṃ bhavatorastu prayāmi mama mandiram |
ityuktvā karṣukān dhairyaṃ datvā śrībhagavām̐stataḥ ||83 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
datvā mantraṃ karṣukebhyo bhaktābhyāṃ ca tiro’bhavat ||84||
karṣukāste camatkāraṃ vīkṣya cakrurmamāśrayam |
pūjanaṃ bhajanaṃ ceti kṣetrapo’pi viśeṣataḥ ||85||
mahāmayo’pi sahasā nārāyaṇasamāgamāt |
nirāmayo’bhavallakṣmi nāñjo’pi cāñjanojjhitaḥ | |86||
te sarve nityadā bhejurmāṃ śrīrādhāramāṃpatim |
pūjanaṃ bhojane dhyānaṃ ramaṇe smaraṇaṃ mama ||87||
cakruśca kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ dehānte ca tataḥ param |
vimānenāyayau cāhaṃ viṣṇuvimānaśobhanaḥ ||88||
pārṣadaiḥ sahitaścāśvapaṭṭasīmni tadā drutam |
karṣukānnijalokaṃ ca ninye divyaśarīriṇaḥ ||89||
nāñjaṃ bhaktaṃ punarninye ninye nirāmayaṃ tataḥ |
evaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prāptā bhaktā me kṣetrapā api ||3.207.90| |
lakṣmi kṣetrodbhavaṃ dhānyaṃ nūtanaṃ me samarpayet |
cirbhaṭaṃ makkikāṃ cāpi patraṃ puṣpaṃ samarpayet ||91 ||
kandaṃ phalaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca miṣṭaṃ śākaṃ ca mañjarīm |
stambaṃ nālaṃ ca kāṇḍaṃ ca śākhāṃ vā me samarpayet| ||92||
kaṇaṃ ca badaraṃ vāpi mṛdaṃ vā pāvanīmapi |
arpayenmāṃ tu yo bhaktyoddharāmi taṃ samarpakam ||93||
samidhastulasīpatraṃ candanadruṃ phaladrumam |
tṛṇaṃ darbhaṃ cāṃkuraṃ vārpayenme muktibhāktu saḥ ||94||
kārpāsaṃ pūlakaṃ vāpi śimbiṃ vā kośameva vā |
gucchaṃ vā kuṇḍikāṃ vā me’rpayenmokṣagato bhaveta || 95||
tilān vā godhumakām̐śca caṇakān dvidalāstathā |
nivārān vā sārikā vā kharjuraṃ vā samarpayet ||96||
śarkarāṃ vā haridrāṃ vā lavaṇaṃ cārdrakaṃ ca vā |
āranālaṃ ca vividhaṃ laviṃgaṃ pūgikāphalam ||97||
elāṃ ca kesaraṃ vāpi me’rpayenmuktibhāg bhavet |
āsanaṃ vāpi pātraṃ vā latāṃ vā vetramityapi ||98 ||
yānaṃ vastraṃ carvaṇaṃ ca tailaṃ sugandhamuttamam |
śṛṃgāraṃ cārpayenmahyaṃ jāyate mokṣabhāgdhi saḥ ||99||
dugdhaṃ rasaṃ ca pakvānnaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca śītalam |
vyajanaṃ vyañjanaṃ cāpi me’rpayenmokṣabhāg bhavet ||3.207.1 00 ||
ātmārpaṇena sarve vai kamale yānti matpadam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi mokṣabhāg ||1 01 | |
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kṣetrapasya nāñjabhaktasya mahāmayabhaktasya karṣukāṇāṃ ca caurebhyorakṣaṇaṃ bhagavatā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 207 ||

<3.208>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktaṃ kirātajātijam |
sāgarākhyaṃ mahāśāṭīnagarīvāsinaṃ śubham || 1 ||
kuṭumbasahitaścāyaṃ mahīnadītaṭe vane |
carati dehayātrārthaṃ kurute sañcayaṃ gṛhe || 2 ||
vanyānāṃ kandamūlānāṃ cānnānāṃ kaṇināṃ tathā |
śimbīnāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bījānāṃ rasināṃ tathā || 3 ||
kvacidannaṃ phalaṃ patraṃ kvacit kandaṃ bhunakti saḥ |
dehayātrāsu nirvāhaṃ karoti bhajate ca mām || 4 ||
vāṭagānāṃ dhanāḍhyānāṃ bhāravāhī bhavatyapi |
śreṣṭhināṃ bhṛtyatāṃ cāpi kvacit karoti bhīlakaḥ | | 5 ||
evaṃ kurvan sa nirvāhaṃ kvacinnāpnoti bhojanam |
tadopavāse nirato bhajate māṃ mudā yutaḥ || 6 ||
mālikāvartanaṃ cāpi karoti kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa ca |
vrataṃ sāhajikaṃ tadvai matvā ca jāgaraṃ niśi ||7 ||
karoti kīrtanaṃ rātrau kṣudhātṛṣānvitaḥ sa vai |
patnī putrāstathā putryaḥ sarve kurvanti vai vratam || 8 ||
ekadā kamale teṣāṃ śravaṇe śuklapakṣake |
ekādaśīdine naiva militaṃ bhojanaṃ manāk || 9 ||
vrataṃ jātaṃ sahajaṃ caikādaśījaṃ sajāgaram |
nirjalaṃ te pracakruśca pūjanaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca me || 3.208.1 0||
atha prātastu te sarve bhājīṃ nivedya me rame |
jalaṃ samarpya mahyaṃ ca bubhujurbhājīmeva ha | | 11 ||
papurjalaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
gṛṇantaśca mudā lakṣmi tadāhaṃ karuṇālayaḥ || 12||
teṣāmagre godhumānāṃ śakaṭyā saha saṃyayau |
te sarve māṃ vikrayiṇaṃ matvā śreṣṭhinamuttamam || 13 ||
nemurjalaṃ daduścāpi viśrāntyarthaṃ jaguḥ kṣaṇam |
ahaṃ matvā ca tadvākyaṃ śakarīṃ tadgṛhāṃgaṇe || 14||
avasthāpya vṛṣabhau ca nirbadhya tatkṛtāsane |
upāviśaṃ ca te sarve pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mama || 15 ||
vyadhuśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti vadanto magnamānasāḥ |
atha pṛṣṭā mayā sarve kiṃvṛttāḥ kiṃprajīvanāḥ || 1 6||
te procurjīvanaṃ kṛ6ṇo dadāti jīvyate tathā |
adya bhājyā kṛtaṃ kṛṣyapūjanaṃ ca jalena ca || 17||
bhuktā bhājī jalaṃ pītaṃ śāntistatra hi naḥ sadā |
vartate sukhadā śreṣṭhin kiṃ lakṣaiḥ koṭibhirdhanaiḥ || 18||
bhajāmaḥ śrīhariṃ nityaṃ dadātyeva sa bhojanam |
sarvārpaṇaṃ prakurmaśca haraye nirguṇāyitam || 19||
bhavān śreṣṭhī vartate’dya mahīmāno gṛhe’tra naḥ |
bhavadyogyaṃ mahānnaṃ tu nāsti svāgatakārakam || 3.208.20 ||
tato bhājīṃ pradadmaste rocate saṃgṛhāṇa tām |
ityukto’haṃ tadā lakṣmi premṇā bhājīṃ cakhāda tām |||1 ||
jalapānaṃ cakārāpi tṛptiṃ jagāma bhaktijām |
athāhaṃ pradadau tebhyo godhumānāṃ samastakam | |22|
dhanaṃ ca pradadau tebhyo sahasraṃ rūpyamudrikāḥ |
tataste māṃ papracchuśca nāma grāmaṃ kuṭumbakam || 23||
ahamāha harikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo bhavāmyaham |
grāmaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me ca kuṭumbaṃ bhaktamaṇḍalam || 20||
teṣāṃ gṛhe mama yātrā mahīmāno bhavāmyaham |
bhavadbhiryat kṛtaṃ tvekādaśyā vrataṃ sajāgaram ||25||
bhājyā cādbhistoṣito’haṃ rakṣārthaṃ samupāyayau |
