bhaviṣyanti kusule ca nikṣipyopari chādanam || 27||
kṛtvā chidrāt niṣkāsanīyā na cānyathā |
akṣayāste bhaviṣyanti mama pratāpataḥ khalu ||28||
bhavantu sukhino bhaktā vaṃśaparamparābhavāḥ |
yadā me pūjanaṃ naiva bhaviṣyati gṛhe’tra vai || 29||
tadā kṣayamavāpsyanti godhumāste mayārpitāḥ |
ityuktvā pradadau sarvān darśanaṃ divyamityapi || 3.208.30 ||
dadau caturbhujaṃ me ca śriyā yuktaṃ manoharam |
tuṣṭuvurmāṃ tu te sarve nipetuḥ pādayormama || 31 ||
mumucuḥ premabhāvenāśrūṇi sarve tu vihvalāḥ |
vavrire rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ tvante paraṃ padam |||32||
ahaṃ dhairyaṃ vaco datvā śakaṭena samaṃ tathā |
vṛṣabhābhyāṃ samaṃ lakṣmi tūrṇaṃ tatra tiro’bhavam ||3 3 ||
ājīvanaṃ kirāto me bhakto godhumapolikāḥ |
kārayitvā nijapatnyā bhājyā sākaṃ nyavedayat ||34||
yatayaḥ sādhavaścānye satyaḥ sādhvyaśca bhikṣukāḥ |
ye cāyānti labhante te bhājīṃ godhumapolikāḥ ||35 ||
annasatraṃ sāgarasya prāvartata nirantaram |
tārthayātrālavo’pyasya gṛhe śāntiṃ prayānti hi ||36||
satāṃ sevāṃ mahālābhaṃ labhate sāgaraḥ sadā |
bahupuṇyayuto jātaḥ sāgaraḥ sāgaropamaḥ || 28||
yadgṛhe munayo yānti devaprasādabhojinaḥ |
devatāḥ sādhuveṣāśca bhoktuṃ godhumapolikāḥ || 38 ||
matvā prasādaṃ divyaṃ ca samāyānti hi bhikṣukāḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇadattagaudhumyaḥ polikāḥ sudhayā samāḥ || 29||
bhujyante devatābhiśca pitṛbhirbhikṣukātmakaiḥ |
siddhaiśca divyadehaiśca bhujyante puṇyapolikāḥ ||3.208.40||
prātarārabhya cāsāyaṃ pravartante hi polikāḥ |
akṣayā godhumāḥ sarve vardhante kusulodare ||41 ||
sāgarasya gṛhaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ jagatprasiddhakam |
trailokyāṃ khyātamevāpi pāvanaṃ jāyate tadā ||42 ||
atha śrutvā tu durvāsā akṣayaṃ cānnasatrakam |
daśasāhasraśiṣyaiścākasmāt prātarupāyayau ||3|||
sāgareṇa kṛtamānaḥ kṛtasvāgata ādarāt |
bhojanārthaṃ tataḥ paṃktīḥ kṛtavān samakālikīḥ ||44||
sāgaraścintayāmāsa bhītaḥ śrīpatimīśvaram |
māṃ tadāhaṃ śriyā sākaṃ prāvirāsaṃ gṛhodare ||45||
sāgaraścātimumude dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca śriyaṃ tathā |
lakṣmīrmayā tadājñaptā polikānirmitau drutam ||46||
sā nirmame tu pañcaiva polikāḥ sahasā ramā |
culyāśca vahninā paktā mayā dhṛtā kareṇa sā ||47||
akṣayāḥ pañca caitāśca nyūnā bhavanti naiva ha |
sāgareṇa kare dhṛtvā sthālīṃ tāḥ pariveṣitāḥ ||48||
ekaikasmai daśasakhyāḥ sahasrebhyaḥ samarpitāḥ |
evaṃ daśasahasrebhyaḥ polikāḥ pariveṣitāḥ ||49||
bhājāpi sthālato dattā sarvebhyaḥ pariveṣitā |
mayā spṛṣṭā svādavatī bhājā ca polikāstathā ||3.208.50||
bubhujuśca samastāste durvāsaso’nuyāyinaḥ |
tṛptāste culukaṃ kṛtvā mahāścaryaṃ hi menire ||51 ||
atha sthālyāṃ polikāścāvaśiṣyante tu pañca vai |
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ durvāsā gṛhamāyayau ||52||
parākṣārthaṃ hariścāhaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ tiro’bhavam |
durvāsāḥ kusulaṃ natvā natvā bhaktaṃ ca sāgaram ||53 ||
tatpatnīṃ sārikānāmnīṃ datvāśīrvādamuttamam |
akṣayaṃ te dhanaṃ cāstu dhānyamakṣayamastu te ||54||
bhājā te cākṣayāpyastu śraddhā te’stu tathākṣayā |
annasatraṃ cākṣayaṃ tai puṇyaṃ te cākṣayaṃ tathā ||55||
muktiste tvakṣayā cāstu bhaktiste cākṣayāpi ca |
dānadharmaścākṣayaste bhavatvevaṃ prayāmyaham ||56||
ityuktvā pūjitaścātiprasannaḥ prayayau vanam |
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā tatra sāgaraḥ parirakṣitaḥ ||57||
atha śrutvā vālakhilyā brahmaputrā maharṣayaḥ |
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vāmanāstatra cāyayuḥ ||58||
prasādapolikā bhoktumamāyāṃ prātareva ha |
teṣāṃ cakre sāgaraśca sammānaṃ svāgataṃ tathā ||59||
āmantraṇaṃ bhojanārthaṃ paṃktiśaste tato’bhavan |
tadā nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sasmāra māṃ ca sāgaraḥ ||3.208.60||
drāgeva cāgatastatra lakṣmyā sākaṃ janārdanaḥ |
brāhmaṇaścābhavaṃ tatra lakṣmīśca brāhmaṇī tathā ||61||
kṛtvā hastatalamānāḥ polikāḥ sahasā daśa |
aṣṭāśītisahasrebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa vai daśa ||62||
bhājayā sahitā adadāṃ bubhujuste’tiharṣitāḥ |
tṛptāste vai tato jātāḥ kṛtvā ca culukaṃ yayuḥ ||63||
praśasantaḥ sāgarasya bhaktiṃ prasannatāṃ hareḥ |
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā tatra tvayā sākaṃ sa sāgaraḥ ||64||
rakṣitaḥ susahāyena bhojitāḥ ṛṣayo’khilāḥ |
atha jñātvā śaṃkarastadgṛhaṃ pāvanamuttamam ||65||
daśalakṣagaṇaiḥ sākaṃ madhyāhne samupāyayau |
sarve sādhusvarūpāste jaṭācarmadharāḥ khalu ||66||
annasatraṃ paraṃ jñātvā cākṣayaṃ tad yayācire |
bhojanaṃ polikānāṃ ca bhājānāṃ kṛṣṇapāvanam ||67||
sārikāsāgarau tatra bhītau sasmaratuśca mām |
lakṣmyā sākaṃ tadā tūrṇamupasthito’bhavaṃ gṛhe ||68||
śataṃ ca polikāḥ kṛtvādadāṃ pratyekasādhave |
daśalakṣayatibhyo vai dattavānahameva ha ||69||
bahurūpadharaścāha śataṃ tvante’vaśeṣitāḥ |
bhuktvā te polikā bhājāstṛptāḥ praśaṃsya sāgaram ||3.208.70 ||
yayurnijaṃ hi kailāsaṃ śaṃkaro dhyānamācarat |
dadarśa kāraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyā yutam ||71 ||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpa bhaktādhīnaṃ vilokya mām |
ityevaṃ vai mayā lakṣmi sāgaraścāvitastadā ||72||
atha śrutvā svayaṃ brahmā polikārthamupāyayau |
koṭisiddhairupeto vai prasādalabdhaye drutam ||73||
yayāce vyomamārgeṇa prasādaṃ polikodbhavam |
koṭisiddhapratṛptyarthaṃ sāgaraśca punarharim ||74||
sasmāra māṃ rakṣakaṃ copasthito’haṃ tadābhavam |
lakṣmyā sākaṃ śriyā sākaṃ rādhayā sākamityapi ||75||
sākaṃ lalitayā cāpi māṇikyā ramayā saha |
padmāvatyā saha brahmapriyābhiḥ saha vai tadā ||76||
koṭyarbudābhiḥ patnībhiścāmbare’vasthito’bhavam |
sahasraṃ polikāḥ kārayitvā koṭipriyāyutaḥ ||77||
siddhebhyaścādadāṃ pratyekāya sahasrapolikāḥ |
sahasraṃ cāvaśiṣṭāścetyāścaryaṃ viśvasṛṭ yayau ||78 ||
athaivaṃ sāgaraścāpi matvā bhāgyaṃ mahattamam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhīnaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā hi vartate ||79||
mahīmānasvāgataṃ ca rātriṃdivaṃ karoti saḥ |
akṣayā kusulā tasya trailokye khyātimāpa ha ||3.208.80 ||
āyānti ca parāyānti mahīmānāstrilokataḥ |
āyāsaṃ paramaṃ prohya sāgaraḥ sevate mudā ||8 1 ||
nāyācata sahāyārthaṃ cāparaṃ balamaiśvaram |
māmeva smarati bhakto yadā bhītiṃ sa gacchati ||82||
evamātmanivedasya bhaktasya vīkṣya bhāvanām |
sevāṃ trilokijīvānāṃ prasanno’haṃ tato’bhavam ||83||
viśeṣeṇa mayā bhaktakṛte tatra vicintitam |
deyamasmai kalpapātraṃ yatrāsaṃkhyāstu polikāḥ ||84||
āvirbhaveyuḥ satataṃ bhājāpātraṃ tathāparam |
bhājā yatrāpyanantāścāvirbhaveyuḥ supācitāḥ ||85 ||
vicāryetthaṃ dadau tasmai pātradvayaṃ sutaijasam |
prātareva supaktvātra polikā bhājikāstathā ||86||
nityaṃ rakṣati cācchādya pātrayorubhayorapi |
mayoktaḥ sāgarastatra tvaṃ vā te strī pativratā ||87||
pūrṇapātrāṇyanantāni yāvadiṣṭāni tāni vai |
sakalpayasi tāvanti pūritāni śubhāni ca ||88||
nissariṣyanti ramyāṇi cābhyāṃ saṃkalpamātrataḥ |
pariveṣaṇayatno vā pātradānakriyā api ||89||
kartavyā na bhaviṣyanti paṃktau yāsyanti vai svataḥ |
evamuktvā pūjito’haṃ datvā jalasya bhājanam ||3.208.90||
tādṛśaṃ cākṣayaṃ pūrṇaṃ pūrṇakalaśakāraṇam |
tiro’bhavaṃ tataḥ sthānāt sāgaro mumude hyati ||91 ||
atha jñātvā mahāścaryaṃ bhādrāmāvāsyasaddine |
koṭyarbudāśca pitaro maharjanatapobhavāḥ ||92||
āyayuḥ suprasādasyecchayā tṛptyarthamutsukāḥ |
śarīriṇaḥ samastāste paṃktiśo’vasthitāstadā ||93||
sārikā snānaśuddhā ca kṛtvā bhājāśca polikāḥ |
dugdhapākaṃ śrāddhayogyaṃ nyadhāt tayostu pātrayoḥ ||94||
ācchādya viṣṇave prārpya yathoktaṃ samakalpayat |
sāgaro’pi kṛtasnānaḥ pātrāntikamupāyayau ||95||
acintayat koṭyayutārbudapātrāṇi vai tadā |
pūritāni hyasaṃkhyāni niryayuḥ pātrayugmakāt ||96||
pratyekapitṛdevāya pratyekaṃ samupasthitam |
pātraṃ pūrṇaṃ polikābhiḥ pāyasānnaistathā rame ||97||
bhājābhiśca tathā vārikalaśaśceti tṛptidaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjapitaro bhuktvā tṛptāstato yayuḥ ||98||
riktapātrāṇi vilayaṃ svabhāvāt samupāyayuḥ |
evaṃ sa sāgaro bhakto mayā godhumasatrake ||99||
vardhito’tikṛpayā vai sarvasvāgatakṛd yathā |
kirāto’nvabhavad bhaktyā devarāto hi sarvathā || 3.208.100 ||
atha kālāntare cāhaṃ dampatī divyapārṣadaiḥ |
sahitaḥ suvimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 10 1||
mahīśāṭīnagarī ca paścād godhumabhājikā |
itināmnābhavallakṣmi tathā godhumasārikā || 1 02||
godhumarā tataścāpi kathyate pāvanī dharā |
ityevaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā kṛpālunā || 1 03||
dampatyormokṣaṇe paścād rājñā godharasūriṇā |
kusulā sā nijāyattā kṛtā tāvattu godhumāḥ || 1 04||
adṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ pātratrayaṃ cādṛśyatāṃ gatam |
annasatraṃ samāptaṃ ca camatkāro layaṃ yayau || 1 05||
ityevaṃ godharasūrirvīkṣya daivakṛtaṃ hi tat |
kusulaṃ nityadā riktaṃ hyapūjayat smaran hariḥ || 1 06||
tathāpi tu camatkāro gato yastu gato hi saḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmi divyagatiṃ labhet || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāgarākhyakirātabhaktasya bhaktyā prasannena śrīhariṇā śreṣṭhirūpeṇa godhumapuñjo’rpitaḥ kusulastho’kṣayaśca kṛtastatpolikābhājājalapātrāṇyakṣayāṇi kṛtāni mokṣaścakṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||

<3.209>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ hūṇabhaktasya satkathām |
nāmnā sāraṃgasaṃjñasya bhūdharīgrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 ||
araṇye bhūdharīgrāme saurāṣṭre bhaktarāṇmama |
kuṭumbasahito hūṇajātīyo vartate rame || 2 ||
karoti snānamādyaṃ ca prapūjya māṃ tataḥ param |
mahiṣīmaṇḍalaṃ nītvā cāraṇārthaṃ tu śādvale || 3 ||
ghāsāraṇye prayātyeva sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ prayātyapi |
araṇye santi siṃhāśca vyāghrāśca bhallukā api || 4 ||
vṛkāśca dvīpakāścāpi hiṃsrā vai prāṇino’pare |
vyāghrāḥ siṃhā dharṣayanti kvacid gomahiṣīvṛṣān || 5 ||
mārayitvā bhakṣayanti trāsadā duḥkhadā hi te |
hūṇaḥ sāraṃganāmā ca pañcāśanmahiṣīdhanaḥ || 6 ||
ghāseṣūttamamiṣṭeṣu mahiṣīścārayatyayam |
atha madhyāhnasamaye pārśvadruṣaṇḍamadhyataḥ || 7 ||
karmadyaraṇyamārgeṇa siṃhāḥ pañca samāyayuḥ |
mahiṣīṇāṃ ghāsacāravṛttīnāṃ maṇḍalopari || 8 ||
nipetuḥ sahasākasmāt siṃhāḥ pañcaiva śabditāḥ |
balinaścātipuṣṭāścāpradhṛṣyāḥ kṣudruḍanvitāḥ || 9 ||
akasmāttā mahiṣyo’pi pṛṣṭhabinduṃ vidhāya ca |
parito mukhacakraṃ saṃrakṣyāpatyāni madhyake || 3.209.10 ||
krudhā prāṇaprarakṣārthaṃ bhayena maṇḍalīkṛtāḥ |
saṃbhūya grāmaracanāṃ vidhāya cakrire’vanam || 11 ||
siṃhā mahiṣīgrāmaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā prāpya bhayaṃ drutam |
paścād vivṛtya te dūre mumucurvai muhurmuhuḥ || 12||
kugandhivātanivahān paśūnāṃ bhayahetave |
yena svamaṇḍalād bhūtvā pṛthak ced vidravet tadā || 13 ||
siṃhāstā dharṣayeyuśca mārayeyuḥ svabhojanam|
tathā cakrurgarjanāśca darśayāmāsurugratām || 14||
tathāpi tā mahiṣyastu sārthād bahirna niryayuḥ |
evameva sthitau siṃhā garjantyeva bhayaṃkaram || 15||
śrutvā cānye daśa siṃhāścāyayurbhakṣyahetave |
cakrakaṃ paritaścakraḥu siṃhāste daśapañca ca || 1 6||
mahiṣyastu samagrāstāḥ praticakre yathāsthitāḥ |
na dravanti nissaranti nāpnuvanti na tāśca te || 17||
evamevābhavat sāyaṃ siṃhā dūre bhavanti na |
atha sāraṃgahūṇaśca prajajvāla tadānalam ||18||
mahiṣīṇāṃ paritaśca samidhāṃ sañcaye pṛthak |
vahnibhayena siṃhāśced dūre yāntīti cintayā || 19||
tathāpi krūrakālāste dūre yātā na sarvathā |
paritaste bhramantyeva māraṇārthaṃ dravanti ca ||3.209.20||
niśāmukhaṃ samāpannaṃ sāhāyyastatra nāsti ca |
rātrau siṃhabalaṃ cāti jāyate tamasi vṛte ||21 ||
mahiṣīṇāṃ vināśaḥ syāt kiṃ kartavyaṃ vipadbhuvi |
vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sahāyado na vidyate ||22||
rakṣako bhagavāneva mahāpatkāla āgate |
matvaivaṃ tena vai labdhaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa tanmayaḥ ||23||
lomaśād yo mantravaraḥ prāpto’śvapaṭṭatīrthinā |
tena purā ca taṃ mantraṃ jajāpa hūṇabhaktarāṭ ||24||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japtvā neme’mbare harim ||25||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagadguro |
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa rakṣa rakṣaya māmiha ||26||
śaraṇāgatasaṃtrātaḥ pāhi siṃhāpadastviha |
araṇye tvāṃ vinā kṛṣṇa rakṣako’nyo na vidyate ||27||
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śīghramāyāhi rakṣa naḥ |
andhakāre vardhamāne mṛtyurnaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ||28||
bhakto’smi cettava kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa prarakṣaya |
prāṇināṃ jāyate mṛtyuḥ kvāpi naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||29|||
kintu kṛṣṇa prasahyātra dehānāṃ nakhabhedanaiḥ |
mahiṣīṇāṃ tvakāle’tra mṛtyuryogyo na me mataḥ ||3.209.3 0||
yāsāṃ dugdhaṃ hi bhagavan pīyate pratyahaṃ tvayā |
prātarvai pūjane kṛṣṇa naivedye divase niśi ||31||
yadghṛtena pradīpaṃte kārayāmi niśāmukhe |
tāsāṃ tvaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cenna karoṣi nirdayo nu kim ||32||
yāsāṃ sumadhuraṃ cāpi picchalaṃ dadhi cottamam |
āsvādayasi kṛṣṇa tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva prarakṣasi ||33||
śīghramāyāhi rakṣārthaṃ no ced bhaktastavāsmi yaḥ |
sa eva prathamaṃ prāṇām̐styakṣyāmi paśuhetave ||34||
āśritānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ vai kāryaṃ prāk svāminā sadā |
svāmināśe tato nāśaḥ svāmidoṣāya neṣyate || 35||
imā mahiṣyo māṃ kṛṣṇa vīkṣanti rakṣakaṃ prati |
mayi kṛṣṇa hṛdaye tvaṃ sthitaḥ san kinna paśyasi ||36||
paśya paśya hare kṛṣṇa mahāpatpatitā imāḥ |
bhakṣako bhakṣaka eva māstu cāstvapi rakṣakaḥ ||37||
ityuktvāśrūṇi lakṣmi saṃmumoca bhaktarāṇmama |
sāraṃgahūṇo dīrghaṃ vai śvāsaṃ mumoca nispṛhaḥ ||38||
mṛtyuṃ gatā vayaṃ ceti matvā ruroda vai kṣaṇam |
siṃhā balaṃ prakurvanti dūre vahnibhayāt sthitāḥ ||39||
sāraṃgo vahnibalavān vahnikāṣṭhāni cābhitaḥ |
prājvālyāpyabhiprājvālya nikṣipati sthale sthale ||3.209.40 ||
yāvadbuddhibalaṃ yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇe |
matvaivaṃ kurute yatnaṃ viṣṇoricchā balīyasī ||41 ||
haste kṛtvā jvalatkāṣṭhaṃ bhramam̐śca paritastadā |
rakṣārthaṃ svamahiṣīṇāṃ bhajanaṃ kurute hyati ||42||
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥ pate |
hare viṣṇo hare jiṣṇo kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa ramāpate ||43||
ityevaṃ cordhvakaṇṭhena cakre me kīrtanaṃ rame |
athāha tasya rakṣārthaṃ mahiṣīrakṣaṇāya ca ||44||
drāgeva siṃharājasya rūpaṃ kesariṇo mahat |
saśuṇḍhaṃ sandadhāraiva yena bibhyati vai drutam ||45||
siṃhā vyāghrā gajāścāpi śarabhāḥ kimuta mṛgāḥ |
atikrūraṃ vikarālaṃ śuṇḍhādaṇḍadharaṃ navam ||46||
mahākesarirājasya rūpaṃ dhṛtvā gato’bhavam |
garjanāṃ meghavat kṛtvāraṇyaṃ paśūnakampayam ||47||
siṃhāste māṃ mahāsihaṃ vidyudbhācakṣuṣaṃ naram |
samastasiṃhajātīnāṃ rājānaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram ||48||
śatordhvabalinaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃ cāpurmahāvane |
athāhaṃ sahasāraṇyādutplutyākāśameva tu ||49||
śatahastāmbaraṃ vidhvā nyapataṃ siṃhasannidhau |
tāvat siṃhā mahābhītinaṣṭadhairyā mamāgrataḥ ||3.209.50||
sahasā mṛtyurūpasya mukhātte samupādravan |
araṇye viviśuḥ sarve madbhayena mṛgādhipāḥ ||51 ||
siṃhādhipo’haṃ sahasā vidrāvya tān mṛgādhipān |
dhṛtamānavaveṣo’haṃ tūrṇamabhavaṃ gocaraḥ ||52||
prasannavadanaḥ śāntaḥ śaṃkhacakragadābjavān |
sāntvayan bhaktamahiṣīrbhaktaṃ ca sāntvayannapi ||53||
antikaṃ prayayau sāraṃgo’pi dṛṣṭvā hariṃ ca mām |
mumude prāptajīvaśca tuṣṭāva parayā mudā ||54||
papāta pādayoścāpi mahiṣīrnirbhayai ravaiḥ |
bodhayāmāsa sarvāśca mahiṣyo nirbhayā api ||55||
mumuduḥ sukhavatyaśca jātāstatra naradvayāt |
prāptadhairyāḥ samabhavannatha sāraṃgabhaktarāṭ ||56||
lakṣmi dugdhaṃ praduhyaiva pāyayāmāsa me tadā |
papau cāhaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ dugdhamuttamam ||57||
tataḥ sāraṃgabhaktena sākaṃ mahiṣībhistathā |
śanaiḥ śanairagacchaṃ taddhoṣaṃ bhūdharīgopure ||58||
āprātastatra mudito nyavasaṃ bhaktapūjitaḥ |
bhaktānikayā tatpatnyā sevito’nyaiśca hūṇakaiḥ ||59||
nāmasaṃkīrtanādyaiśca pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
jalārpaṇaistathā cānyamahotsavaiḥ pratoṣitaḥ ||3.209.60||
atha prātaḥ sādhurūpo’bhavaṃ sūryaprabhāgame |
sevitastaiḥ samastaiśca bhojanaiḥ puṣpagandhibhiḥ ||61 ||
pṛṣṭo’haṃ hūṇabhaktaiśca kalyāṇāya tathā rame |
pāpapraṇāśanārthāya tebhyaścopādideśa ca ||62||
śṛṇvantu mama bhaktāḥ stha sarve’pi sthūlabuddhayaḥ |
tathāpi śreyase yatnaṃ kurvantaḥ sūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ||63||
bhavantaḥ khalu vidyante mokṣadhīḥ sūkṣmadhīrhi sā |
svaśreyase ya udyuktāste vai susūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ||64||
laukikavyavahāreṣu nipuṇāścet svaśreyase |
suptā yadi te mūrkhā vai sthūladhiyo matāḥ sadā ||65||
māyāvṛtā jaḍā mūrkhāḥ kathyante paśusadṛśāḥ |
api rājā pradhāno vā gururvā śikṣako’pi vā ||66||
adhītavidyo vā syācced yatate na svamuktaye |
sa eva sthūlabuddhirvai mūrkho yāmyaṃ gamiṣyati ||67||
mama bhaktau vartamānā divyāste mānavāḥ striyaḥ |
abhaktā ye te tu bodhyā nirayasthāḥ paśuprabhāḥ ||68||
mama bhaktāḥ svanetrābhyāṃ labhante darśanaṃ mama |
aprākṛte hi tannetre bādhye madyogataḥ sadā ||69||
bhaktacitte hariścāhaṃ vasāmi divyameva tat |
bhaktānāṃ varṣma divyaṃ cendriyāṇi divyakāni ca ||3.209.70||
antaḥkaraṇaṃ divyaṃ ca kriyā divyāḥ sadā tathā |
ahamakṣaradhāmastho vasāmi bhūtale kvacit ||71 ||
kvacidatra samāyāto bhavāmi bhaktasadṛśaḥ |
tathāpi divya evāsmi bhavanto divyamūrtayaḥ |||72||
divyāśca mahiṣyaḥ sarvā bhaktā divyā narāḥ striyaḥ |
sarvātmātmā svatantro’haṃ sarvaśaktipatiḥ prabhuḥ ||73||
parātparataraścāsmi rādhālakṣmīpatirhariḥ |
sarvakāraṇarūpaśca vyatiriktaśca dhāmani ||74||
sa evāhaṃ sādhurūpo bhavāmyatra sugocaraḥ |
mama yogena vallavyo hūṇyaśca divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||75||
vaśca bāhyānyāntarāṇi karaṇānyakhilānyapi |
tādātmyaṃ prāpya māṃ sākṣātpaśyanti divyakāni tat ||76||
amāyikena dṛśyo’haṃ nānyathā tu kadācana |
kṛpayā ca svayaṃ bhaktā grāhyo’smi netareṇa vai ||77||
māyātattvāni sarvāṇi divyatāṃ yānti matspṛśeḥ |
pañcaviṃśo hi jīvātmā mukto bhavati madyujeḥ ||78||
ṣaḍviṃśo’haṃ ca bhagavān puruṣottama eva yaḥ |
vaśe bhavāmi bhaktasya sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||79||
māyāguṇarahito’smi divyamadguṇamaṇḍitaḥ |
īśvarādyaiḥ pūjitaśca bhaktamadhye ca tādṛśaḥ ||3.209.80 ||
māṃ bhajitvā sevayitvā matvā divyaṃ narāyaṇam |
yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ bhaktā divyapārṣadasevitam ||8 1||
striyo madyogamāpannā bhavanti divyavigrahāḥ |
gāvo mahiṣyo vṛṣabhā madyoge divyatāṃ gatāḥ |||82||
kanyakā mama yogena ṛṣayaḥ sādhavastathā |
kumārā api gopālā divyatāṃ matsamā gatāḥ ||83||
api brahmapriyāḥ patnyo vṛkṣāśca vallikāstathā |
mama yogena divyāstā matsamāḥ parivartitāḥ ||84||
māṃ bhajantu tato nityaṃ pāyayantu jalaṃ payaḥ |
phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca kandaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ patramityapi ||85||
prātarbhaktiṃ prakurvantu madhyāhne sāyamityapi |
rātrau divā ca māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smarantu sarvakarmasu ||86||
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ nityaṃ kurvantu cānnavāribhiḥ |
bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ me ca kurvantu nityamutsukā ||87||
muktimante’kṣare loke dāsye gopīpatistvaham |
svargabhogām̐stu nipuṇān sakāmebhyaḥ sukhāvahān ||88||
ityuktvā ca mahāśaṃkhaṃ datvā yaddhoṣataḥ sadā |
hiṃsrā dūraṃ prayāsyantītyuktvā labdhvā prapūjanam ||89||
tiro’bhavaṃ vanāllakṣmi te ca sāraṃgahūṇakāḥ |
sukhinaścābhavam̐ścānte dhāmākṣaraṃ prapedire || 3.209.90 ||
evaṃ ye vanavāsā vā grāmavāsāḥ pṛthaggṛhāḥ |
dīnā vāpi narā nāryo ye bhajante hariṃ tu mām || 91 ||
tānuddharāmi kaṣṭādvai smṛtamātraḥ prabhustvaham |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadāmyevānanditāṃ śāśvatīṃ sthitim || 91||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi pāpinām |
pāpanāśo bhavenmuktirbhaved rakṣā ca śāśvatī || 92 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne sāraṃganāmakasya hūṇabhaktasya mahiṣīpaśudhanasyāraṇye siṃhakṛtāpadaḥ śrīhariṇā rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 209 ||

<3.210>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya cāparām |
puṣkaso nāmato yajñarādho virādhakheṭagaḥ || 1 ||
ānarteṣvabhavadbhaktaḥ samudrakhāḍikātaṭe |
naukānāṃ vastupūrṇānāmāgamo vigamastathā || 2 ||
yatra prajāyate nityaṃ tatra mārjanakarmaṇi |
niyuktaḥ sa mahānaukādhyakṣeṇa jīvikāvitaḥ || 2 ||
naukānāṃ taṭabhūmīnāṃ kaccarāṇāṃ pramārjanam |
karoti nityamevāyaṃ patnyā sākaṃ sthale sthale || 4 ||
naukādhīśāstathā cānye śreṣṭhinaḥ karmacāriṇaḥ |
śeṣānnabhojanaṃ cāsmai dadatyapi kṛpālavaḥ || 5 ||
śākaṃ patrādikaṃ cāpi roṭakaṃ ca payo’pi ca |
bharjitānnaṃ ca pakvānnaṃ vastrādikaṃ dadatyapi || 6 ||
evaṃ prāptena bhakto’yaṃ tathā sadvetanena ca |
nirvahatyeva nityaṃ vai svakāryakuśalaḥ sadā || 7 ||
yadyat saṃprāpyate tatra jalaprokṣaṇamuttamam |
kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tulasīdalaṃ smṛtvā ca māṃ tadā || 8 ||
samarpya mahyaṃ manasā bhuṃkte pāti na cānyathā |
prātarnityaṃ pippalasya vṛkṣamūle hariṃ ca mām || 9 ||
pūjayatyeva saṃsmṛtvā jalānnaphalapatrakaiḥ |
madhyāhne’pi tathā sāyaṃ māṃ smṛtvā sa bhunakti ha || 3.210.10 ||
rātrau kṛtvā militvaiva kīrtanaṃ māṃ smaram̐stathā |
mālāmāvartayan bhakto nidrāti strī sutaḥ sutā || 11 ||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya nityaṃ vai vighasāśinaḥ |
datvā śune gave kākebhyaśca puṣkasajātaye || 1 2||
pipīlikābhyo datvā ca datvāmbare surāya ca |
bhuṃkte’yaṃ vighasāśī vai datvā matsyebhya ityapi || 13||
paśyatyeva hariṃ sarvaprāṇiṣu puṣkaso’pi saḥ |
sarvavrahmātmavijñāno bhaktarājjñānavām̐stathā || 14||
puṣkasaṃ tu śarīraṃ vai sadā malasya bhājanam |
sarvadehāstathā santi malapātrāṇi sarvathā || 15||
yadi śuddhā na manasi samānāḥ puṣkasā yataḥ |
manaḥ śuddhaṃ yasya tasya puṣkasatvaṃ vilīyate || 1 6||
garbhe bālo na śuddho’sti cāśuddhadvārasevanaḥ |
aśuddhāśca tathā janma janmottaramaśuddhimān ||17||
śaucahīnastathā nityamaśuddhaḥ kalmaṣānvitaḥ |
manomālinyayuktaśca kāmakrodhādikalmaṣaḥ || 18 ||
svārthakāpaṭyabhāvaśca vāsanāvāsito malī |
aśuddha eva dehāḍhyo mānerṣyāmatsarānvitaḥ || 19||
ahantāmamatāyuktaḥ pramādamohakarṣitaḥ |
aśuddha eva strīputraparivāranibandhanaḥ || 3.210.20||
avidyārāgasaṃsaktyabhiniveśādikalmaṣaḥ |
asmitādibhṛtaścāpi bhogavilāsapāpavān ||21 ||
rogavyādhijarāmṛtyumahākaṣṭānuyogavān |
deho’yaṃ puṣkasaḥ proktaścidātmāhaṃ na puṣkasaḥ ||22||
sarve dehāḥ puṣkasā vai nātmā puṣkasaḥ karhicit |
brahmātmā nirmalaḥ śāntaḥ śuddho bhaktaḥ samujjvalaḥ ||23|||
parameśapratāpena saccidānandabodhavān |
mukto bandhanahīnaśca sadāhaṃ mokṣabhāgiha ||24|||
evaṃ lakṣmi prajānāti puṣkaso’pi nijaṃ sadā |
muktavat vartate nityaṃ mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||25||
bhagavanniṣṭha evāyaṃ tathātmaniṣṭha uttamaḥ |
na svārtho’sya na vai vyādhirmānaso’pi manāgapi ||26||
etādṛśasya bhaktasya vada lakṣmi kathaṃ na vai |
karomi rakṣaṇaṃ cittāhlādanaṃ ceṣṭapūraṇam ||27|||
mama lakṣmi sadā tulyā jīvā devāstatheśvarāḥ |
sarve putrā mamaivātra māyāyāṃ santi dehinaḥ ||28||
vipro nṛpo dīnajanaḥ puṣkasaḥ strī napuṃsakaḥ |
paśuḥ pakṣī kīṭa ārto vṛkṣo vallī ca vai tṛṇam ||29|||
sarvaṃ putrātmakaṃ me’sti yādaḥ pataṃga ityapi |
bhajante māṃ tu ye sevāmagnāsteṣāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||3.210.30 ||
pitāsmi rakṣako dhātā pātā netā paraṃ padam |
anyeṣāṃ tu kṛtasyaiva phaladaḥ sākṣirūpavān ||31||
athaikadā tu bhaktasya saṃkalpo’pi vyajāyata |
nārāyaṇaḥ kathaṃ sākṣād bhavennetrasya gocaraḥ ||32||
śrutaṃ tena tataḥ sādhormukhāt sādhau hariḥ svayam |
vartate satpuruṣasya sevayā gocaro bhavet ||33||
athāyaṃ yajñarādho vai mārgayatyeva sevanam |
yatra sādhuḥ śrūyate ca tatsthale sa prayāti vai ||34||
camatkārapure śrutvā sādhum̐ nāgamatītaṭe |
yayau tīrthasya miṣavān sasnau nadyāṃ tu bhāvataḥ ||35||
nāganāthasya tīrthe vai sādhuṃ dadarśa tāpasam |
tryavasthāpāragaṃ divyaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ haripriyam ||36||
nāmnā brahmāyanaṃ śāntaṃ maharṣiṃ tyāginaṃ munim |
āsane dhyānamagnaṃ ca brahmaṇi dhyāninaṃ tadā ||37||
gatvā puro nanāmāsau daṇḍavat pracakāra ha |
ghaṭīmātraṃ purastasthau kṛtāñjaliśca niścalaḥ ||30||
ghaṭikānte sādhuvaryo dhyānād bahirupāyayau |
dadarśa purato bhaktaṃ puṣkasaṃ yajñarādhakam ||39||
yajñarādhaḥ praṇamyaiva tasthau kṛtāñjalistathā |
sādhunā kuśalaṃ te’stu procya niṣadya bodhitaḥ ||3.210.40||
so’pi bhāvena bahunā niṣasāda puraḥ sataḥ |
papraccha guṇavṛddhyarthaṃ satsaṃgatyarthamityapi ||41 ||
parameśasya lābhārthaṃ sākṣādvai sādhanāni hi |
brahmāyano muniḥ śrutvā mumodātmaparātmavān ||42||
smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca jagādopādideśa tam |
śṛṇu bhakta satāṃ guṇān gṛhṇanti ye janāstviha ||43||
guṇavanto bhavantyete santo hi guṇasāgarāḥ |
satāṃ doṣān pragṛhṇanti duṣṭāste tu bhavanti vai ||44||
satāṃ samāgame nityaṃ guṇā āyānti bhāvinaḥ |
satāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇe māhātmyavedane’niśam ||45||
vardhante svaguṇā ramyāḥ siddhadaśāpradāḥ śubhāḥ |
naiva grāhyāḥ satāṃ dehadoṣāḥ kvācitkasaṃbhavāḥ ||46||
doṣāgrāhā bhavantyeva guṇino’pi tu doṣiṇaḥ |
acireṇa mahāpāpād guṇā naśyanti mūlataḥ ||47||
ataḥ satāṃ sadguṇā vai grāhyā na tvaguṇāḥ kvacit |
svalpadurguṇagrahaṇe vinaṣṭirmahatī bhavet ||48||
satāṃ samāgamenaiva vardhante guṇakoṭayaḥ |
bhāgavatāstathā dharmā vardhante satsamāgamāt ||49||
satāmekāntikānāṃ vai sevanād divyatā bhavet |
satāṃ saṃgatiḥ snehena jāyate dehināmiha ||3.210.50||
sādhavo mokṣadāḥ santi sarvapāpavināśakāḥ |
iṣṭadāḥ santi santaścetyavagatya satāṃ puraḥ ||5 1 ||
dāsavad vartate nityaṃ tasya satsaṃgatirbhavet |
aikāntikāḥ sarvadharmāḥ puṣyanti satsamāgamāt ||52||
vairāgyaṃ jāyate cātmaparātmanośca vedanam |
māhātmyajñānasahitā bhaktirharau bhavettataḥ ||53||
āśrayo’pi dṛḍhaḥ syācca kṛṣṇārthāḥ sakalakriyāḥ |
bāhyāntaḥkaraṇānāṃ ca vyāpārā bhagavanmayāḥ ||54||
bhavantyeva hi bhaktasya mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam |
jāyate dhāmadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahāmārgagatipradam ||55||
strīdhanādau mahāsaṃgo dehino durjaro’sti yaḥ |
satsu tathaiva ca kṛto mokṣaṃ dadāti dehine ||56||
snehaḥ satsu sadā kāryaḥ strīputrādyadhikaḥ khalu |
snehena satsu lagnānāṃ muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||57||
satsevāyāṃ mahāśraddhā kāryā nāryā nareṇa ca |
sarvātmanā kṛtā sevā tārayatyeva māyinam ||58||
sarvārpaṇakṛtā sevā kṛtārthaṃ kurute janam |
santaḥ prasannā dadyurvai dhāmākṣaraṃ ca divyatām ||59||
deśaḥ kālaḥ śubhau sevyau saṃgaḥ sevyaḥ śubhastathā |
kriyā kāryā śubhā nityaṃ mantro dhāryaḥ śubhottamaḥ ||3.210.60||
dhyānaṃ kāryaṃ harernityaṃ santo dhāryā sadā hṛdi |
dīkṣā grāhyā bhāgavatī śaraṇaṃ ca hareḥ sadā ||61 ||
evaṃ vai vartamānasya sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavet |
asaddeśādisaṃyoge naṣṭā bhraṣṭā matirbhavet ||62||
saddeśādisamāyoge śreṣṭhā śuddhā matirbhavet |
baliṣṭhapuṇyayogena saddeśādi labhejjanaḥ ||63||
satsaṃgo jāyate tasya divyatā jāyate tataḥ |
nirmalā yasya buddhirna deśādyā doṣiṇastathā ||64||
yasya bhavanti tasyātra pāpaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ mahat |
upasthitaṃ hi mantavyaṃ yena pāpe pravartate ||65||
yadvātra mahatāṃ tena satāṃ drohaḥ kṛto’sti yat |
tatphalaṃ pāpabuddhirvai jātā pātakadāyinī ||66||
tāṃ vināśayituṃ sevāṃ kuryānniśchadmabhāvataḥ |
satāṃ prasannatāṃ cāpi prāpnuyāt sevanaṃ hareḥ ||67||
atha yaḥ pāpavānasti sa tu drohaṃ karoti hi |
vadatyeva ca nāstikyabhāvena nimnagaṃ vacaḥ ||68||
sādhūnāṃ kiṃ bhavedatra samāgamena vai bhuvi |
dhūrtā hi sādhavaḥ santi mā kurvantu samāgamam ||69||
evaṃ vadanti duṣṭā vai tyājyāste dūrataḥ sadā |
tasmāt saṃgaḥ satāṃ kāryaḥ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam ||3.210.70||
pāpisaṃgo na vai kāryaḥ pāpisaṃgo viṣaṃ param |
duḥkhī bhajate śrīnāthaṃ duḥkhahānyarthameva tu ||71 ||
arthārthī tvarthasiddhyarthaṃ hyaiśvaryārthī sa vai bhavet |
āpmaniṣṭho’pi bhajate kaivalyārthaṃ hariṃ sadā ||72||
jñānī tu bhagavanniṣṭhaḥ sevate parameśvaram |
ātmanivedī bhagavanniṣṭho hareḥ priyo bhavet ||73 ||
sākṣātkāro bhavettasya hariniṣṭhasya bhūtale |
asya māhātmyavijñānaṃ harerbhavati sarvathā ||74||
hareḥ sneho’sya bahudhā sarvathā vartate’niśam |
kṛṣṇetarāḥ samastā vāsanā naṣṭā hi tasya vai ||75||
ekāntikānāṃ sevābhirnaṣṭāḥ samastavāsanāḥ |
bhavantyeva tato jñānī bhūtvā satsaṃgamācaret ||76||
akṣarādhipateḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vedanam |
māhātmyasahitaṃ kuryāt satāṃ prasaṃgataḥ sadā ||77||
mānaṃ nirmūlanīyaṃ ca satāṃ samāgamāt sadā |
mānino na pravardhante divyā guṇāḥ kadācana ||78||
mānī sevāṃ na kurute satāṃ vai nimnakoṭigām |
sadagre prāñjalirna syānna praśaṃsedgirā sataḥ ||79||
raṃkavadvartamānaṃ ca santaṃ na mānavānnamet |
māno doṣo mahānasti mānastambho hi nāśakṛt ||3.210.8 0||
bhaktijñānavirāgādyā vardhante naiva māninaḥ |
bhakto galitamānastu vardhamānamahāguṇaḥ ||8 1 ||
jāyate tasya hṛdaye sākṣānnārāyaṇo vaset |
satāṃ hareśca nityaṃ vai sevayā paricaryayā ||82||
māno vilīyate tīvravairāgyāḍhyasya vai drutam |
brahmātmabhāvanābhaktyā haristasmai prasīdati ||83||
prasannasya harermūrtiḥ prasannāsya hi dṛśyate |
madhurā hṛdaye mūrtirbahiścāpi hi dṛśyate ||84||
nirmāno bhaktarāṭ śreṣṭho bhagavadbalavān mataḥ |
bhajate śrīhariṃ mānaṃ hitvātmabrahmaniṣṭhitaḥ ||85||
ātmaniṣṭhā ca bhagavanniṣṭhā pakvāsti yasya vai |
māyikaḥ sakalo vyādhistasyātraiva vilīyate ||86||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi satāṃ prasevayā tathā |
bhaktyā nārāyaṇasyāpi tathopāsanayā hareḥ ||87||
siddhadaśāmāpnuvanti sārvajñyaṃ ceśatāṃ tathā |
upāsanābalaṃ sveṣṭadevasya yasya yādṛśam||88||
tādṛśaṃ jāyate tasya mahaddivyaṃ sukhaṃ param |
māyikaṃ duḥkhamatyantaṃ nāśameti na saṃśayaḥ ||89||
vrajāṃganāsamā prītiryeṣāṃ svāmini mādhave |
jāyate sīmavajyaiṃṣāṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||3.210.90||
satāṃ prasevayā kṛṣṇamāhātmyadṛḍhatā bhavet |
upāsanāyāḥ siddhiśca dṛḍhā drāgabhito bhavet ||91 ||
akṣare parame dhāmni yo’sti golokadhāmani |
vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure cāvyākṛte’mṛte ca dhāmani ||92||
brahmapatirharī rādhāpatiśca kamalāpatiḥ |
lalitāśrīpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ||93|||
antaryāmī vallabhaśca sa eva bhagavān svayam |
samādhau dṛśyate bhaktyā tato bahistu sevayā ||94||
milatyeva harirnārāyaṇo mānavavigrahaḥ |
prākṛtena janenāpi samo bhavati mānave ||95||
yattejasākṣaraṃ brahma muktā īśvarakoṭayaḥ |
sūryacandrādayastejasvino bhānti sa eva saḥ ||96||
dhṛtamānavarūpo vai pradīpena vilokyate |
sūryacandraprabhāyāṃ sa dṛśyo bhavati mānavaiḥ ||97||
dehānte’pi mahāpāpī yannāmasmaraṇād drutam |
śuddho bhavati niṣpāpo mokṣamārgāya kalpate ||98||
sa eva niśchadmabhaktabhaktyā bhavati gocaraḥ |
bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ śrīśaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||99||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
japa mantraṃ tathā dhyāhi hṛdaye bālakṛṣṇakam || 3.210.10 0||
jalaṃ prāsādikaṃ nityaṃ piba khāda niveditam |
smara brahmapriyānāthaṃ prabhuṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi || 101 ||
ityuktaḥ kamale tena brahmāyanena puṣkasaḥ |
jñānaṃ labdhvā prapūjyainaṃ gṛhaṃ nijaṃ yayau tataḥ || 1 02||
yathoktarītyā bhajate dhyāyati sevate tathā |
satāṃ sevāṃ karotyeva paśyati smarati prabhum || 10 3||
yajñarādhastvekadā tu pippalasya samīpataḥ |
dadarśa sādhuṃ rūpāḍhyaṃ brahmāyanasamaṃ śubham ||1 04||
sahasā taṃ vīkṣya cakre daṇḍavat svāgatādikam |
kuśalaṃ cāpi papraccha sādhustaṃ snehamāvahan || 1 05||
bhaktaḥ prāha kuśalo’smi sādhulābhād viśeṣataḥ |
ājñāṃ kuru yathā sādho seve’haṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ ||106||
sādhuḥ prāha mayā cāsmātsthalād gantavyamasti hi |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||107||
sahasārtho bhavān bhūtvā samāgacchatu vai mayā |
tathāstviti puṣkasaḥ sa svīkṛtya niryayau saha ||1 08||
kuṭumbena samastena sahito’patyabālakaiḥ |
tāvattūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ cāgataṃ divyaṃ tadāmbarāt || 1 09||
ahaṃ lakṣmi svayaṃ cāsaṃ mokṣado’smai kṛpāvaśaḥ |
ādāya tān vimāne vai divyān kṛtvā hi pārṣadān ||3.210.1 1 0||
bhautikadehān tyājayitvāhaṃ ninye nijākṣaram |
śāśvataṃ te padaṃ prāptā bhaktā me divyamūrtayaḥ ||1 1 1||
ityevaṃ kṛtavām̐steṣāṃ kalyāṇaṃ satsamāgamāt |
sarve jīvā bhajante māṃ ye te bhavanti tādṛśāḥ || 1 12||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva divyagatiśca sampadaḥ || 11 3||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne yajñarādhanāmakapuṣkasasya sakuṭumbasya brahmāyanarṣisādhoḥ samāgamena śrīharibhaktyā mokṣaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 210 ||

<3.211>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ caṇḍālasya kathāmapi |
rāyaṇāgramavasaternāmnā kapikṣayasya vai || 1 ||
kapikṣayo hi cāṇḍālo raivatācalasannidhau |
abhavat sakuṭumbaḥ sa rāyaṇāyāṃ sunītimān || 2 ||
prathamaṃ jātidoṣeṇa hiṃsro’bhavad vane bhraman |
vānarān vanajān raktān mārayitvā sa khādati || 3 ||
atastvanyavanevāsaiḥ kapikṣayetibodhitaḥ |
vānaramāranāmnaiva prasiddhimagamadvane || 4 ||
athaikadā vane vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe sthitaṃ tu maṇḍalam |
vānarāṇāṃ mahadvīkṣya tān hantuṃ śaramādadhe || 45 ||
yāvanmukto na vai bāṇastāvadvānarasattamaḥ |
divyavāṇyā jagādainaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ śvapacottama || 6 ||
śrutvā yatheṣṭaṃ yātrārthaṃ samācara nibodha me |
purā tvaṃ vṛṣalīgāmī dvijo veśyārato’bhavaḥ || 7 ||
nāmnā prājñeśvaro vipro dharmakarmāditatparaḥ |
śṛṃkhalāgrāmavāstavyo yatra hiṃsā janā api || 8 ||
vasanti sma ca tatsaṃgāt teṣāmannasya yojanāt |
dānamānasahavāsānmanaste hiṃsrakaṃ hyabhūt || 9 ||
deśakālakriyāvāṇīsahāyānāmasattayā |
asatte hṛdayaṃ jātaṃ pāpapriyaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||3.211.10||
brāhmaṇasya śubho dehastvayā veśyāsamāgamāt |
adharmaṃ yojitaścāpyabhakṣyāpeyādibhistathā || 11 ||
kṣudrakriyāparo jāto madyamāṃsaparāyaṇaḥ |
atha kālena maraṇaṃ tava jātaṃ tato bhavān || 1 2||
yayau yāmyapuraṃ tatra bhuktavān yamayātanāḥ |
avaśiṣṭena pāpena cāṇḍālo’tra pravartate || 1 3||
sā veśyā vṛṣalī te’tra bhāryāpi sahagāsti vai |
sahamitrāṇi pāpāni te te’tra sutabāndhavāḥ || 14||
vartante cāṇḍālayonau pāpāḥ pāpanibandhanāḥ |
pāpāni tvaṃ purā kṛtvā cāṇḍālatvamupeyivān || 15||
brāhmaṇatvaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ malavanmalinīkṛtam |
vināśitaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ tadā || 1 6||
idānīṃ ca punastvaṃ vai vartase māṃsabhojane |
ghātako vānarāṇāṃ yannaraghno bhavasi dhruvam || 17||
vānarā naramānuṣyāstatpāpaṃ naraghātajam |
bālaghātitvamevāpi strīghātitvamapi dhruvam || 18||
jāyate tava cāṇḍāla mānave durlabhe punaḥ |
udarārthaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ kuruṣe hiṃsrakarma yat || 19||
punaste yātanāḥ santi yāmyāścādhogatiḥ punaḥ |
yaiḥ pūrve pātitastvaṃ vai tatkṛte yatase punaḥ ||3.211.20||
kīdṛśo mūrkhavaryo’si ko lābhaste nipātibhiḥ |
paśya mūrkha manuṣyasya sārthakyaṃ dharmakarma vai ||21||
tathā paśya nijaṃ mokṣaṃ pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ sukham |
tīrthaṃ svarṇāvatīnadyāṃ dāmodaraṃ narāyaṇam ||22||
paśya puṇyaṃ kuru drāk ca tyaja hiṃsāṃ sukhī bhava |
bhavātra pāvano bhakto bhaja kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||23||
nārāyaṇahrade snātvā kuru sarvāghanāśanam |
saṃsnātvā revatīkuṇḍe kuṇḍe tathā ca vāmane |||24||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare |
snātvā śrīsomatīrthe ca sarasvatyāṃ sukhī bhava ||25||
mūladvāravatīpuryāṃ snāhi yāhi divaṃ tataḥ |
gopanārthaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yāhi gavāyanam || 26||
re mūḍha bhaja govindaṃ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham |
dayāṃ kṛtvā vṛṣaṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā bhaktiṃ harestathā || 27||
yāhi brahmaparaṃ lokaṃ sanātanaṃ ca śāśvatam |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe vartate parameśvaraḥ ||28||
divyamānuṣadeho vai brahmapriyāpatiḥ kṛtiḥ |
sa eva bhagavān jagatsraṣṭā pātāntarasthitaḥ ||29||
rādhālakṣmīpatiḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
sevito naranārībhirvartate mānavo yathā ||3.211.30||
dehānte’pi mahāpāpī tasya smaraṇamātrataḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 31 ||
taṃ gatvā bhaja gopālabālakaṃ kambharāsutam |
ātmavantaṃ pareśaṃ taṃ samāśraya hṛdi sthitam ||||2||
rādhāramāpatestasya māhātmyajñānamañjasā |
sākṣātkartavyamevāto muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||33||
gāḍhasnehād bhagavati prasannatvaṃ prajāyate |
tena muktiḥ karagatā bhagavaddhāmadāyinī ||34||
snehaḥ kāryaḥ sarvathā vai śṛṇu cāṇḍāla vacmyaham |
navoḍhāyā yathā patyau tathā cādye sute yathā ||35||
yathā mātari bālasya lobhinastu dhane yathā |
kṣudhitasya yathānne ca bhayabhītasya rakṣake ||36||
yādasāṃ tu jale yadvat pataṃgasyānale yathā |
tathā snehaḥ sadā kāryaḥ parameśe sukhaprade ||37||
tvacā spraṣṭavya īśeśo bhālanīyaśca cakṣuṣā |
śrotavyaścāpi karṇābhyāmāsvādyaścūmbanādibhiḥ ||38||
gandhastasyaiva cādeyo rūpaṃ grāhyaṃ hare sadā |
āśleṣaṇīyo bhagavān kīrtanīyaśca mādhavaḥ ||39||
ānandanīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ harau tathā |
kartavyaṃ ca harerguṇagrahaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham ||3.211.40||
māhātmyaguṇavittyādyaiḥ snehaḥ kṛṣṇe prajāyate |
yadvā sāhajikaḥ sneho bhaktasyaiva prajāyate ||41||
yathā strīputravittādau tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
snehaṃ sāhajikaṃ prāpto brahmabhūyāya kalpyate ||42||
naisargikasnehavanto bhavanti divyabuddhayaḥ |
divyakriyāśca haryarthaṃ snehasteṣāṃ prapuṣyati ||43||
snehasya poṣaṇe vighno mānaṃ cettatra vartate |
nāśanīyaṃ sarvathā tacchreyo’dhvani vighātakṛt ||44||
duḥsvabhāvāḥ samastā vai nāśanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
atiśatrudhiyā te vai nāśanīyā mumukṣuṇā ||45||
mitravad dehavāsā ye duḥsvabhāvāstu te yadi |
mokṣe virodhinaḥ syuśceddhantavyāḥ satsamāgamaiḥ ||46||
satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryaḥ satāṃ saṃgo mahauṣadham |
ātmāsmi balavān kṛṣṇasahāyavān sudharmavān ||47||
yadicchati karotyeva samartho muktaye’pi ca |
rajasāṃ tamasāṃ vegānunmūlayeddhariśritaḥ ||48||
dehādhyāsaḥ kusaṃgaśca pūrvakṛtkarmasañcayaḥ |
māyāmohakarāḥ santi hantavyāḥ satsamāgamaiḥ ||49||
vivekena prahantavyo dehādhyāsaḥ satāṃ mukhāt |
satsaṃgena kusaṃgaśca hantavyaḥ satsamāgamāt ||3.211.50||
pūrvajanmakṛtāḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ |
hantavyāste satāṃ nityaprasattyā mahatāmiha ||51 ||
atipāpasya puṃsastu pāpaphalaṃ prapīḍanam |
āpadaśca samāyānti tadā tannāśahetave |||52|
itastato dhāvati drāk samantāddhanado bhavan |
tathāpi vipado yānti vṛddhiṃ dūre na yānti ca ||53||
atha bhagnamanā bhūtvā yāti duḥkhataraṃ janam |
śrutvā sādhuṃ ca vā vṛddhaṃ nivedayati cāpadaḥ ||54||
sādhostu vacanaṃ prāpya karoti vratapūjanam |
satsaṃgaṃ bhajanaṃ cāpi sevāṃ smaraṇaṃ śārṅgiṇaḥ ||55||
evaṃ bījabalenāsya līyante kalmaṣāṇi vai |
akalmaṣaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ jāyate nirmalaṃ tataḥ ||56||
bhaktiyogyaṃ tatra kṛṣṇaḥ satāṃ vāṇyā virājate |
prakāśate śanaiścāpi puṇyaḥ prajāyate janaḥ ||57||
evaṃ vai śubhatāṃ yānti saṃskārā malinā api |
cāṇḍālo vipratāṃ yāti duṣṭaḥ sujanatāṃ tathā ||58||
prasādena satāṃ raṃko rājatāṃ labhate drutam |
prasādena satāṃ mūrkhaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ labhate tathā ||59||
prasādena satāṃ pāpī puṇyaṃ svargaṃ pravindati |
prasādena satāṃ duṣṭo jāyate paṃktipāvanaḥ ||3.211.60 ||
atiprasannatāprāptyai sādhūnāmagrataḥ sadā |
niśchadma vartitavyaṃ vai yathānuvṛttimetya tu ||61||
yatra yatra rucisteṣāṃ tattat sādhyaṃ viśaṃkayā |
yatra yatrārucisteṣāṃ tattat tyājyaṃ drutaṃ sadā |||62||
mānaṃ ca lokalajjāṃ ca guṇagarvaṃ vihāya vai |
satāṃ dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ dhāryaṃ vacaḥ satāṃ hṛdi |||63||
satāṃ prasāde vighnā ye bhavanti sevane’pi ca |
sarve te durguṇāstyājyā grāhyāḥ prasannatāpradāḥ ||64||
guṇā yaiḥ syuḥ prasannā vai santaste tu guṇā matāḥ |
dharmaḥ sa eva cokto’sti yena prasannatā bhavet ||65||
satāṃ cāprītiheturyaḥ sa tu durguṇa eva vai |
heyaḥ sa eva bhaktena kāryā prasannatā satām ||66||
anukūle dāsabhakte prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ |
satāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇairdoṣā naśyanti hṛdgatā ||67||
santo mahānta sevyāste divyatāsaṃvidhāyinaḥ |
guṇānāṃ grahaṇe bhaktirvardhate paramātmani ||68||
satāṃ niṣkāmitvaguṇagrahe niṣkāmitāṃ vrajet |
satāṃ niḥkrodhatāguṇagrahe niḥkrodhatāṃ vrajet ||69||
satāṃ nirlobhatāguṇagrahe nirlobhatāṃ vrajet |
satāṃ nirmohatāguṇagrahe nirmohatāṃ vrajet ||3.211.70 ||
satāṃ divyarūpaguṇagrahe divyasurūpavān |
bhavet satāṃ bhagavattvaguṇagrahe bhavettathā ||71 ||
mahaiśvaryādiśālī vai bhaved bhaktyā tathottamaḥ |
anyatrārucirasyāsti kṛṣṇe satsu ruciḥ sadā ||72||
bhāvaḥ kṛṣṇe satpuruṣe’nyatrābhāvo’sya vartate |
evaṃvidhasya vo dāsyaṃ harau satsu pravardhate ||73 ||
vardhamānaṃ paraṃ dāsyaṃ nirmalaṃ prītihetukam |
vivartate vai svāmitve svāminaḥ kṛpayā kvacit ||74||
yathā śiṣye sevake vā svāmitvaṃ kṛpayā bhavet |
tathā dāse dāsyabhāvaḥ svāmibhāvatvamāvrajet ||75||
hareragre satāmagre pakṣapāto na vidyate |
strī śūdro vāpi cāṇḍālo bhaktyā yāti parāṃ gatim||76||
ityevaṃ vānareṇāpi lakṣmi kapikṣayo vanī |
prabodhitastadāścaryaṃ prāptavān bodhamāptavān ||77||
kṛtakṛtyaṃ nijātmānaṃ mene vai puṇyabhāginam |
yena vai vānarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||78||
athāyaṃ pratipapraccha vānaraṃ ko bhavāniha |
jñānado mokṣadaścāpi hiṃsādidoṣanāśakaḥ ||79||
māyādoṣaharaścāpi sarvājñānavināśakṛt |
vane tvaṃ carasi ko’tra vada me tu yathātatham ||3.211.80 ||
dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ jāto’smi tava vākyataḥ |
viśeṣato bhaviṣyāmi viditvā tvāṃ ca pāvanaḥ ||8 1 ||
śrutvaivaṃ vānaraḥ prāha vayaṃ ceme vanecarāḥ |
vānarā raktavarṇā ye te sarve svargadevatāḥ ||82||
bhavāmo divyadehāśca sarve svarganivāsinaḥ |
svargaṃ puṇyaṃ prabhuñjāmaḥ kṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ prayāti ca ||83||
nūtanaṃ nārjyate tatra bhogabhūmiryato divam |
karmabhūbhiḥ pṛthivīyaṃ puṇyaṃ cātra kṛtaṃ milet ||84||
puṇyārthaṃ vānaraiḥ rūpaiḥ parvate raivatācale |
phalapatrādikaṃ labdhvā devārpaṇaṃ prapūjanam ||85||
kṛtvā bhuṃkṣmaḥ prasādaṃ vai pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham |
jalaṃ ca svarṇarekhāyā nārāyaṇahradāttathā ||86||
dāmodarahradāt pītvā vardhayāmaḥ supuṇyakam |
tīrthe snātvā bhāvimokṣaṃ cecchāmo mokṣakāminaḥ ||87||
na vayaṃ vānarāḥ kintu devā vānararūpiṇaḥ |
svargānte mānave loke janma yathā na vai bhavet ||88 ||
mokṣo bhaved yathāsmākaṃ tathā kurmo’tra tīrthakam |
bhavānapi tathā tīrthaṃ karotu vai phalādanaḥ ||89||
kuṭumbena sahitastvaṃ prayāsyasi parāṃ gatim |
lomaśaṃ yoginaṃ gatvā cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||3.211.90||
mantraṃ gṛhṇa harestatra pāvanatvaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
ityuktaḥ sa praṇamyaiva cāṇḍālo devatāgaṇam ||91 ||
śīghraṃ nārāyaṇakuṇḍavāri pītvāśvasārasam |
yayau lomaśanilayam praṇanāma jagāda ca ||92||
vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ paścādaśvapaṭṭasarovare |
snātvā ca kṛpayā mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt tu saḥ ||93||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
kuṭumbena sahito’yaṃ bhakto’bhavaddharermama ||94||
aśvapaṭṭasaroyātrāṃ cakre jātaśca pāvanaḥ |
pāpaṃ tasya gataṃ nāśaṃ bhaktyā me lomaśāśrayāt || 95 ||
atha kālāntare prāpte kāle tatyāja varṣma saḥ |
bhāryāpatyāni sarvāṇi varṣmāṇi tatyajustadā || 9 6||
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa lakṣmīkānta ramāpate |
vadantaste divyadehā abhavan muktiyoginaḥ ||97||
vimānaṃ cāgataṃ tatra mama pārṣadasevitam |
tatrāruhya yayuḥ sarve dhāmākṣaraṃ mama priyam ||98||
evaṃ bhaktasya kalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kīśaprasaṃgataḥ |
mayā lakṣmi kṛpayaiva cāṇḍālasya hi śāśvatam ||99||
evamanye’pi me bhaktyā satāṃ bhaktyā ca pāvanāḥ |
sevante māṃ sataścāpi te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim || 3.211.10 0||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇād yānti mokṣaṇam |
sakāmāḥ sampado yānti niṣkāmā matpadaṃ param || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne kapikṣayātmakasya cāṇḍālasya vānararūpadevopadeśena harau bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 211 ||

<3.212>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lohakārasya vai kathām |
me pāvanasya bhaktasya nāmnā nālīkarasya vai || 1 ||
nālīkaro mama bhakto’vasad vakranadāhvaye |
nagare lohakāro vai kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ || 2 ||
loṣṭhānāṃ śṛṃkhalā dīrghāḥ svalpāśca kīlakām̐stathā |
paṭṭām̐śca kuṇḍalām̐ścāpi paṭṭikā loṣṭapatrikāḥ || 3 ||
loṣṭapātrāṇi bahūni lohopakaraṇānyapi |
anasā ca grahāṇāṃ ca sādhanāni karotyapi || 4 ||
bhastrāyāścālane śvāse praśvāse śrīnarāyaṇam |
lohaghnonnayane tasya pātane lohapīṭane || 5 ||
lohasandhānakāryādau smarate māṃ narāyaṇam |
bhastrāṃ matvā ramādevīṃ vahniṃ matvā narāyaṇam || 6 ||
mālāṃ matvā cāladaṇḍaṃ bhajate māṃ hariṃ sadā |
lohakūṭṭīṃ pāpapuñjakūṭṭīṃ māyāṃ vicintya ca || 7 ||
loṣṭāni māyikānyeva matvā hanti vimuktaye |
lohaghātotthaśabdām̐śca praṇavān manute sa ca || 8 ||
evaṃ nālīkaro bhakto brahmadṛṣṭyātmabodhavān |
vartate bhaktiyuktaśca mūrtiṃ me pūjayatyapi || 9 ||
prātaḥ snātvā gṛhe mūrtiṃ natvā dhūpaṃ karoti ca |
dīpaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamālāṃ candanaṃ me’rpayatyapi || 3.212.1 0||
sugandhasāraṃ datvā me naivedyaṃ dugdhaśarkarām |
polikāśca samarpyaiva jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā || 11 ||
samarpya me kṣamāṃ yācitvātha bhuṃkte pibatyapi |
evameva tato lohaśālāyāmapi mādhavam ||12||
smṛtvā gatvā namaskṛtya dhūpaṃ kṛtvā ca dīpakam |
puṣpamālāṃ śarkarāṃ ca tathānyat phalamuttamam || 1 3||
yathākālaṃ samarpyaiva tataḥ kāryaṃ karoti ca |
lohakāryāṇi me bhaktyā karoti śuddhamānasaḥ || 14||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasyaikadābhavat sucintanam |
rātrau nityaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhajanaṃ bahubhiḥ saha ||15 ||
saṅghena bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ bahūnāṃ mokṣasādhanam |
evaṃ śubhena manasā svagrāmajanabāndhavān || 1 6||
jagāda maṇḍalaṃ bhaktervidhātuṃ ca tadāpi te |
praharṣeṇāsthāpayam̐śca bhaktamaṇḍalamuttamam || 17||
narā nāryo niśāraṃbhe militvā ghaṭikādvayam |
nityamārebhire kṛṣṇanāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ śubham ||18||
sarve janā nagarasthāḥ śrutvā vīkṣya śubhakriyām |
sahakāraṃ dadustatra yuyujurbhaktamaṇḍale || 19 ||
sahasraśo janā bhaktiṃ kurvantyutsāhasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
utsavān śrīhareḥ sarvān vādyanṛtyādibhistathā ||3.212.20||
śṛṃgārapūjanādyaiśca jāgarādyaiḥ samutsukāḥ |
kurvanti ca yathākālaṃ lakṣmi svaśreyase yatāḥ ||21||
teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokyāhaṃ bhaktipravartakasya me |
bhaktasya lohakārasya prasanno’haṃ tadābhavam ||22||
ekadā bhaktivṛddhyarthaṃ tejo mayātibhāsvaram |
niryanmatpratimābhālād darśitaṃ tebhya ujjvalam ||23||
śāmitaṃ ca mayā tūrṇaṃ tena te bhaktigauravāḥ |
viśeṣato mama bhaktimakurvan bhāvagarbhitām ||24||
jñātāraścābhavan mūrtau tiṣṭhato mama śārṅgiṇaḥ |
mandiraṃ kṛtavantaste lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya ha || 25||
tatra pūjāpravāhādi cakrire ca yathādhanam |
ahaṃ mūrtau nivasāmi tvayā sākaṃ samudraje ||26||
apaharāmi sarveṣāṃ duḥkhāni vipado’nvaham |
mānatāste prakurvanti rogaduḥkhavināśinīḥ || 27||
ādhyātmikādhidaivādhibhautikādhivināśinīḥ |
sarvāḥ pīḍā nāśayāmi svasthāste ca bhavanti vai ||28||
bhajante māṃ cātibhāvaiścamatkārādikīrtanaiḥ |
athaikadā satītvaṃ ca jātā tāpasīveṣiṇī ||29||
ahaṃ ca tāpaso yogī bhūtvāgamaṃ niśāmukhe |
bhaktamaṇḍalamālakṣya mandirasyāntike sthale ||3.212.30||
yathā dīnajano raṅkaḥ kaścid bhikṣuka udgataḥ |
tvaṃ tathā dīnacittā ca bhikṣukī vratavarjitā ||3 1 ||
dharmasnānārhaṇaśūnyā malinā prākṛtī yathā |
ahaṃ tathaiva malino darśakānāṃ tu cittahāḥ ||32||
ekaṃ tu bālakaṃ svalpaṃ malamūtrādisaṃbhṛtam |
garuḍaṃ bālarūpaṃ taṃ kṛtvā kukṣau puro’bhavam ||33||
evaṃ trikaṃ ca te vīkṣya yācamānaṃ ca dīnavat |
mandirāgre samāyātaṃ dayāparāstato’bhavan ||34|||
āhūya vedikāyāṃ te nyaṣādayan sukhena ca |
ayacchan bhojanaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprasādajam ||35||
apatyāya payaścāpi daduste bhāvanānvitāḥ |
kṛtvā ca bhojanaṃ pānaṃ vayaṃ lakṣmi sukhasthitāḥ |||36||
vitardikāyāmabhavan te cakrurnāmakīrtanam |
catvare rāsamārebhustālavādyasunartanaiḥ ||37||
narā nāryo’saṃkhyajanā bhaktiṃ cakrurhi bhāvukāḥ |
kṛtvā te kīrtanaṃ yāvat kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimādadhuḥ ||38||
tadotthāya tvayā sākamahaṃ tatra hi catvare |
karatālairmañjiraiśca sanṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ vyadhām ||39||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā māṃ tvāṃ ca te tadā |
prasannāste ca papracchuḥ śāntaṃ māṃ śreyase muhuḥ ||3.212.40||
sādho kalyāṇadaṃ kiñcid vadātra naḥ kṛpāṃ kuru |
śrutvāhaṃ ca tadā lakṣmi jñānaṃ tebhyo dadau mama ||41 ||
premṇo hetuṃ bhagavati māhātmyaṃ nijagāda vai |
māhātmyajñānavatpremṇi viśvāso’pi ca kāraṇam ||42||
māyāpuruṣakālānāṃ svabhāvaguṇakarmaṇām |
jaḍacetanatattvānāṃ niyantāraṃ hariṃ śrayet ||43||
sarvasvatantrakartāraṃ sarvāvatārakāraṇam |
sarvaśaktipradātāraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ śrayet ||44||
premṇāśrayet parātmānaṃ māhātmyajñānavān janaḥ |
prītyā saṃsevya taṃ nāthaṃ paradhāma samarjayet ||45||
kuryād vai vāsanānāśaṃ sarvathā tu vivekavān |
laukikeṣu viṣayeṣu ruciricchāsti me tu yā ||46||
kiyatīti vivicyaiva hyapaneyā tu sā tataḥ |
kiyatī vā harau cāste ruciricchā tu pāvanī ||47||
māyāyāṃ ca harau tulyā nyūnā vā cādhikāpi vā |
vivicyeti harau vardhanīyā prayatnataḥ sadā ||48||
hasanīyā ca māyāyāṃ nirmūlā yāvatī bhavet |
kṣayiṣṇutvaṃ duḥkhadatvaṃ bandhakṛttvaṃ tu māyike ||49||
padārthajāte bhavatītyevaṃ jñātvā vivarjayet |
ruciṃ tyajenmāyikeṣu muktānāmapi bandhanīm ||3.212.50||
arucervāsanānāśo jāyate drutameva ha |
satsaṃgāt kṛṣṇasambandhāt kṛṣṇakīrtanagāyanāt ||51||
kṛṣṇe rucirbhavatyeva sākṣād yogād viśeṣataḥ |
evamabhyāsayogena kṛṣṇe prītirvivardhate ||52||
māyike malatulye ca bhogye ramye tathetare |
rucernāśo bhavettūrṇaṃ bhagavadrasavedinaḥ ||53||
brahmamayaṃ bhāsate’sya divyaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam |
bhagavanniṣṭhabhaktasya brahmabhāvaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ ||54||
sthitiḥ sā paramā mahābhāgavatī pramodinī |
māyābhimānarahitā bhagavadbhāvaśobhitā ||55||
vāsanāyāḥ praṇāśārthaṃ prītyarthaṃ ca harestathā |
sādhayedātmaniṣṭhāṃ ca vairāgyaṃ śreṣṭhamityapi ||56||
kṛṣṇamāhātmyātiśayavijñānaṃ svasamarpaṇam |
sādhayed bhagavanniṣṭhāṃ satāṃ samāgamaṃ caret ||57||
nirvāsanātmaniṣṭhānāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ prasādhayet |
prasannatāṃ satāṃ labdhvā jayenmāyāṃ paraṃ vrajet ||58||
atidhairyaṃ labhejjñānādāśrayātparamātmanaḥ |
satāṃ satsaṃgasāhāyyāddhairyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ harau bhavet ||5 9||
ātmaniṣṭhāyujā bhaktyā dhairyasthairthaṃ tathā bhavet |
dhīrasya muktabhāvasya vighnā naiva bhavanti ca ||3.212.60||
bhaktyantarāyarūpāśca siddhayo nopayāntyapi |
pakvabhaktaparīkṣārthaṃ samāyānti hi siddhayaḥ ||6 1 ||
śrīharerājñayā tāstu lobhayanti muhuḥ śritam |
tathāpi tā na paśyecca jitvā yāti paraṃ padam ||62||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya kṛṣṇo vaśe svayaṃ bhavet |
māyāyā vāsanāśūnyo yaśca kṛṣṇārpitākhilaḥ ||63||
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvastasya prīto hariḥ sadā |
kṛṣṇe’tipremavadbhaktahṛdayācchrīhariḥ kvacit ||64||
premarajjvā naddhavarmā gantuṃ śakto na jāyate |
tasyaiva bhagavān pātā svāmī kāntaśca mokṣakṛt ||65|||
māyāduḥkhaharaścāste hṛdaye sarvathā saha |
etādṛśasya bhaktasya guṇā divyā bhavanti hi ||66||
satyaśaucādayo ye ca sarve kṛṣṇasamāśrayāt |
kṛṣṇasya divyavijñānājjāyante bhaktimatyapi || 67||
kālakarmasvabhāvānāṃ māyāyāḥ puruṣasya ca |
īśvarāṇāṃ niyantā śrībālakṛṣṇo’sti mādhavaḥ ||68||
kartā poṣṭā ca saṃhartā sṛṣṭīnāṃ śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
asti gopālabālaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ hṛdayeṣu saḥ ||69||
nirlepo vartate svāmī rādhāramāpradhīpatiḥ |
evaṃ jñātvā harau kṛṣṇe sambandhaṃ prāptavān dṛḍham ||3.212.70||
yastasya śrīhareḥ sambandhino divyaguṇā api |
āvirbhavanti bhakte vai sarvaiśvaryāṇi sarvathā ||71 ||
cakṣurdīpaprasaṃgena prabhāguṇaṃ pravindati |
yathā tathā hareryogād bhakte guṇā viśanti ca ||72||
svatantro jāyate kṛṣṇatulyaḥ kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ |
sarvaṃ kartuṃ siddhimām̐śca nityasiddho’pi jāyate ||73 ||
yathendra āyayau nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tapaḥkṣatim |
kartumapsarasāṃ vrātairnirastaścorvaśījaneḥ ||74||
evaṃ siddhyā siddhimanto nirasyante susiddhinā |
bhaktena mūlamāyāpi nirasyate harerbalāt ||75||
devā bhaktā bhavantyeva bhagavadguṇayoginaḥ |
āsurā na prajāyante bhagavadguṇinaḥ kvacit ||76||
mahatāṃ tu satāṃ kṛpāpārāvāre praviśya ca |
pāpino bhagavadbhaktyā kvacid guṇā viśanti hi ||77||
prasannāḥ sevayā santo nāśayanti hi durguṇān |
āsuratvaṃ nāśayanti kurvanti daivabhāvukam ||78 ||
yastu raṅkajanān garvādavajānāti bhaktakān |
so’pi tatpāpapuñjena daivo’pyāsuratāṃ vrajet ||79||
śapto bhaved brahmadagdho guṇāstatra viśanti na |
dīnāvamānaṃ tasmānna kartavyaṃ kvacideva ha ||3.212.80||
dīnāgre dīnavat stheyaṃ tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati |
garvavatsu kṛpāṃ naiva karoti bhagavān kvacit ||8 1||
guṇāsteṣu śubhā naiva jāyante drohiṣu kvacit |
mṛdorbhaktasya dīnasya droheṇa puṇyasaṃkṣayaḥ ||82||
jāyate nātra sandeho nāvamānyā hi durbalāḥ |
bāhyato malināścāpi hṛdaye śuddhabhāvanāḥ ||83||
bhaktā bhagavato mānyā mokṣadāḥ sādhavo hi te |
teṣāṃ hṛdaye bhagavānantaryāmī virājate ||84||
sahaiva vartate dīnanātho hyanātharakṣakaḥ |
bhaktānāmavamānena ruṣṭo bhavati mādhavaḥ ||85||
avamānayitustūrṇaṃ vināśaṃ kurute svayam |
kārayatyāśu cānyena raṅkabhaktavaśaṃvadaḥ ||86||
nālīkara vayaṃ dīnā malinā makṣikāvṛtāḥ |
sabhayāścātra bhojyārthaṃ hyāyātā dīnamānasāḥ ||87||
tiraskāro bhavadbhirna kṛtaḥ satkāra ādṛtaḥ |
ataḥ prasannahṛdayā bhavāmo’tra sukhānvitāḥ ||88|.|
yūyaṃ bhaktā bhagavataḥ satyā nirmānisevakāḥ |
varadānaṃ cārthayantu rocate yadi mānase ||89||
ityuktvāhaṃ yadā lakṣmi mūrtiṃ natvā ca māmakīm |
gantumiyeṣa dūraṃ ca tāvad bālo malaṃ vyadhāt ||3.212.90 ||
nālīkaro jalaṃ ninye dadau vai tasya yoṣite |
tatstrī nāmnā kundanikā baliṃ labdhvā karāttava ||9 1 ||
malaprakṣālanaṃ cakre bhāvena bālakasya te |
tāvanme’pi viśeṣeṇābhavat prasannatā hyati ||92||
bhaktebhyaḥ pradadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ divyamadbhutam|
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ śrīśyāmasundaram ||93 ||
tava rūpaṃ sundaraṃ ca lakṣmi vyadarśayam̐stathā |
bālakasya svarūpaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ samadarśayam ||94||
atha bhaktāḥ kṛtakṛtyā vyajāyanta hṛdantare |
nanṛturdarśanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 95||
vavruste varadānaṃ ca mokṣārthaṃ netarattadā |
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā tirobhāvaṃ kṣaṇāntare ||96||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtau viveśāhaṃ tvayā saha |
garuḍaḥ pakṣimūrtau ca viveśa sahasā tadā ||97||
evaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā sukhaṃ tebhyo’dadāṃ param |
atha kāle gate nālīkarasya lohakarmabhiḥ ||98||
vakṣasi śvāsarogo’bhūt sarvathā śvāsasañcaraḥ |
damākhyena hi rogeṇa pīḍito bhaktarāṇnijam ||99||
kāryaṃ kartumaśakto māṃ prārthayāmāsa mūrtigam |
drāgāvirbhūya hastena mayā dugdhaṃ prapāyitam ||3.212.1 0 0||
hastena tasya hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā rogo vināśitaḥ |
atha tūrṇaṃ tirobhūtvā mūrtau sadāvasaṃ rame || 101 ||
āyuṣyasya kṣaye nālīkaraṃ tathā striyam |
kundanikāṃ vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 02||
evamanyānapi bhaktānanayaṃ dhāma cākṣaram |
ye bhajanti ca māṃ bhaktyā guṇān gṛhṇanti me tathā || 1 03||
satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvanti premabhāvena sarvathā |
satāṃ prasannatā prāpya te prayāsyanti matpadam || 1 04||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇāt sevanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva yatheṣṭā paramā gatiḥ || 1 05||

<3.213>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇunārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ carmakārasya śobhanām |
kathāṃ nāmnā maṃgalasya mama bhaktisamanvitām || 1 ||
bhakto maṃgaladevākhyaścarmakāro’tisevakaḥ |
abhavad droṇikāpuryāṃ kuṭumbī carmakāryakṛt || 2 ||
mahiṣīṇāṃ gavāṃ sāraṃgāṇāṃ kesariṇāṃ tathā |
vyāghrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ cānyajātīnāṃ paśuvarṣmaṇām || 3 ||
mṛtānāṃ carmaṇāṃ śuddhiṃ saṃskāraiḥ prakaroti saḥ |
vikrīṇāti sumūlyaiśca carmāṇi saṃskṛtāni vai || 4 ||
carmaṇāṃ ca pavitrāṇāmāsanāni vidhāya tu |
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendrāṇāṃ sādhubhyaḥ sa dadātyapi || 5 ||
sādhusamāgamaṃ nityaṃ gatvā sādhumaṭhe’nvaham |
karoti catvarādīnāṃ mārjanaṃ gopurādiṣu || 6 ||
satāṃ pādarajo dhṛtvā mastake hṛdaye mukhe |
dehe snātvā rajobhiśca dhūlīṣvapi luṭhatyapi || 7 ||
aho bhāgyaṃ satāṃ puṇyarajasā snāmi carmakṛt |
satāṃ prasannatāṃ labdhvā prayāsyāmi paraṃ padam || 8 ||
evaṃ vadan mahimānaṃ pādajalaṃ pibatyapi |
satāmucchiṣṭamannaṃ ca bhuṃkte patrāvalisthitam || 9 ||
aśuddhaścarmakṛddehaḥ śuddhaḥ prasādataḥ satām |
sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni carmakṛttvaṃ gataṃ mama || 3.213.1 0||
aho santaḥ aho kṛṣṇaḥ aho janma mamātra ca |
nīcajātāvadhikohaṃ bhāgyavān sevayāsmi vai ||1 1 ||
evaṃ jānan mahimānaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa smaratyapi |
carmasu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāma likhatyapi || 12||
dadāti dāne sādhubhyaḥ śreyaḥ svaṃ cārthayatyapi |
carmajanyopakaraṇānyanyānyapi vidhāya ca ||13||
vikrīṇāti likhitvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhām |
gṛhāṃgaṇe toraṇe cālikhat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||14||
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ tasya bhaktasya vartate rame |
āpaṇo’pi kṛtastena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāpaṇaḥ || 15||
citritaścābhito bhittidvāratoraṇabhūmiṣu |
rādhākṛṣṇa hare lakṣmīnārāyaṇa ramāpate || 16||
vallabha prabho kamalāpate śrīkaṃbharājane |
gopālabālaka śrīmannārāyaṇa pareśvara || 17||
bhagavannaghahan puṇyaṃ cāvahan cāntare sthita |
evaṃ nāmabhiḥ sarvatra tathā ca pratimādibhiḥ || 18||
citritaścāpaṇaḥ sarvo gṛhaṃ ca citritaṃ tathā |
etādṛśo’yaṃ bhakto me snātvā pūjāṃ karoti me || 19||
samarpya dhūpadīpādi naivedyaṃ phalamityapi |
tāmbūlaṃ jalamityādi parihāraṃ karoti ca ||3.213.20||
bhuktvā prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ tata udyamameti hi |
karmacārāstasya bhṛtyāḥ sarve’pi pūjanaṃ mama ||21 ||
kṛtvā karmasamārambhaṃ vidadhatyaniśaṃ rame |
rātrau saṃbhūya ca kathāṃ kīrtanaṃ racayantyapi ||22||
gāyanti mama gāthāśca modante ca yadutsavaiḥ |
yadi vratāho bhavati jāgratyāprātareva ca ||23 ||
prātaḥ kurvanti militā udyāpanaṃ vratasya te |
bhojayanti pūjayanti bhaktān carmakarān bahūn ||24||
anyānapi samāyātān satkārayanti vastubhiḥ |
sādhavo ye tathāyogyā anye vā nagare nije ||25||
ya āyānti ca tebhyaste pādatrāṇe dadatyapi |
evaṃ vai bahudhā sevāṃ kurvanti bhaktisaṃvidaḥ ||26||
prasannāḥ sādhavaścaiṣāṃ bhavantyāśīḥpradā yathā |
bhavantu sukhino bhaktā bhaktau nirvighnasatphalāḥ ||27||
cirañjīvāḥ pāvanāśca sarvavipadvivarjitāḥ |
satīnāṃ ca satāṃ santu sevakāḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ||28||
evamāśīrvādamāptā bhavanti kṛpayā satām |
athaikadā pūrṇimāyāmāśvinasya niśākare ||29||
sarvakalāprapūrṇe cāmbaraṃ prāpte mahotsavam |
cakruste carmakārā vai kaumudyāṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ||3.213.30||
avasthāpyāsane ramye jyotsnāyāṃ tāṃ samarcayan |
candanai ramyavastraiścālaṃkāraiḥ śobhanaistathā ||3 1 ||
nīrājanādikaṃ cakrūrarnaivedyaṃ śarkarāyutān |
dugdhamagnān pṛthukām̐śca samārpayat hi viṣṇave 32||
mahāsthāle prasādaṃ ca nidhāya tamanāvṛtam |
rāsaṃ bhagavataścāgre khelayāmāsurutsukāḥ || 33||
hastapādāditālaiste | kīrtayāmāsuracyutam |
premamagnā abhavam̐śca bhramanto valayākṛtim ||34||
cakrayanti hariṃ māṃ te gāyanti cotplavotsukāḥ |
ālāpayanti tālaiśca kūrdanti vividhakramaiḥ ||35||
niṣadyotthāya ca bhrāntyā viluṭhyotthāya yānti ca |
tālaṃ gṛhṇanti dadati sanmukhāḥ pratisanmukhāḥ ||36||
evaṃ pramodamānandaṃ bhuñjate mama sevakāḥ |
lakṣmi yadā niśāmadhye cāndrīdugdhāyite sthale || 37||
tadāhaṃ bhagavān viṣṇurlubdho bhaktirasāyane |
rāsaikāgramanā bhūtvā paśyāmi saṃśṛṇomi ca || 38||
mūrtāveva yathā te māṃ naiva paśyanti tattathā |
prasanno’hamabhavam̐ ca premabaddhaḥ priyaḥ prabhuḥ || 39||
śṛṇu tatrābhavad yadvai gītilubdho bhujaṅgamaḥ |
pārśvavāsaḥ samāgatya gṛhakoṇe sthiro’bhavat ||3.213.40||
śrutvā rāsarasāṃ gītiṃ śrutvā satālakīrtanam |
ghrātvā sthālasthapṛthukān sadugdhaśarkarān śubhān ||41 ||
dṛṣṭvā nirjanasaṃsthām̐śca gatvā śanaiḥ śanaiśca tān |
āsvādya jihvayā dugdhaṃ pītvā miṣṭaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||42||
prasādapāvitaḥ śīghraṃ sabhayaḥ prayayau daram |
atha rāsāntaviśrāntiṃ prāpya prasādalabdhaye ||43||
paṃktiśaścābhavan sarve viṣāktān pṛthukān janāḥ |
paryaveṣayan bhaktāstān paṃktau sahasradehinām ||44||
pṛthukān bhuktavantaste māhātmyavedino janāḥ |
ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve te kṛṣṇasarpaviṣānvitān ||45 ||
sarve bhuktvā jalaṃ pītvā suptāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tu catvare |
viṣamūrchāmagamam̐ste bahavo maraṇonmukhāḥ ||46||
abhavan viṣadagdhāste dehabhānavivarjitāḥ |
athānye nyūnagaralasparśā vividurulbaṇam ||47||
viṣaprakopamanyeṣāṃ sveṣāṃ ca mastakabhramam |
piśaṅganīlaharitaraṅgābhā netraraśmiṣu ||48||
te parīkṣāṃ pracakrurvai śīghraṃ ca vividurviṣam |
prakāśaṃ jagaduḥ sarve pṛthukā garalānvitāḥ ||49||
bhakṣitā vai tato mūrchā mṛtyudā samupasthitā |
sarve śīghraṃ ghṛtapānaṃ cakrurviṣanivṛttaye ||3.213.5 0||
vamanaṃ saviṣaṃ teṣāṃ jātaṃ viṣanivartanam |
athāpi bahavo bhaktā viṣeṇa vai mṛtā iva ||51 ||
abhavam̐stān jīvayituṃ prārthayan māṃ pare janāḥ |
rurudurbahavastatra strīputrāḥ patibāndhavāḥ ||52||
sasmarurmāṃ parameśaṃ prāṇadaṃ cāntarasthitam |
teṣāṃ viklavabhāvaṃ ca rodanaṃ bhajanaṃ vratam ||53||
bhaktiṃ vīkṣya prasanno’haṃ tūrṇamāvirbabhūva ha |
sādhurūpaḥ kṛtakukṣiviṣahauṣadhapeṭikā ||54||
atiṣṭhaṃ śokakartṝṇāṃ sannidhau vṛttasaṃśravaḥ |
tūrṇaṃ vṛttāntamāvedya jalamādhāya vai ghaṭe ||55||
tatrauṣadharasaṃ kṣiptvādadāṃ cācamanīyakam |
mūrchitānāṃ mṛtatulyāvasthānāṃ sahasā mukhe ||56||
tālau jalasya sparśena gatamūrchāstadābhavan |
amṛtāste’bhavam̐ścāpi labdhāsujñānasañcarāḥ ||57||
uttasthurdrāk samastā vai bhajanto nidritā yathā |
svasthāste svapnavattatra jñātavanto nijāpadam ||58||
viṣaṃ cāmṛtatāṃ prāptaṃ sādhoroṣadhivāriṇā |
atha sarve militvā te sādhordadurhi bhojanam ||59||
pānaṃ ramyaṃ cāsanaṃ ca viśrāntyarthaṃ niśottare |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tasya cakruste jīvitā janāḥ ||3.213.60 ||
sevāmagnā janāste tu papracchuḥ sādhumeva tam |
bhagavanniṣṭhatāptānāṃ kathaṃ vighnaṃ prajāyate ||61 ||
tamuvāca tadā sādhurvighnaṃ kṛṣṇecchayā khalu |
parīkṣārthaṃ jāyate vai na tu vighnaṃ hi tanmatam ||62||
kṛṣṇaprasannatādārḍhyaṃ bhaktidārḍhyaṃ bhavettataḥ |
sarvavighnavināśaṃ ca sākṣādetya karoti saḥ ||63||
āpatkāle tu bhaktānāṃ smaraṇaṃ śrīharerbhavet |
camatkāre darśite tu bhaktidārḍhyaṃ bhaved bahu ||64||
aho’yaṃ bhagavānasti sarvaduḥkhanivārakaḥ |
tasya sevā prakartavyā mokṣadā sukhadā śubhā ||656||
evaṃ bhavanti saṃkalpā aiśvaryavīkṣaṇe sadā |
athānaiśvaryavīkṣāyāṃ nṛnāṭyamanukurvati ||66 ||
kṛṣṇe khedo bhavedeva na cāyaṃ bhagavāniti |
bahukālaṃ mayā sevā kṛtā sā viphalā tviha ||67||
yathāhaṃ nirbalaścāsmyasamarthaḥ pāratāntrikaḥ |
tathāyaṃ nirbalaścāste hyaśaktaḥ pāratāntrikaḥ ||68||
mayi kāmastathā krodho lobho moho bhayaṃ yathā |
tathā kṛṣṇe kāmalobhakrodhamohabhayāni vai ||69||
santi tasmānna vai cāyaṃ bhagavān kintu mānavaḥ |
evaṃ prākṛtamatimān kṛṣṇe prākṛtamartyadhīḥ ||3.213.70||
doṣān svavat kalpayati sannaṣṭadivyabhāvanaḥ |
tasmāddharau sadā bhāvyaṃ divyabhāvaprabhāviṇā ||71 ||
mantavyā pūrṇatā svasya na me prāpyaṃ hariṃ vinā |
na me sādhyaṃ paraṃ kiñcicchiṣyate harisādhanam ||72||
atra vai militaḥ sākṣāddharistatrāsti tatpadam |
brahmadhāmāpi tatrāsti muktāstatra vasanti ca ||73||
atra harau vidyamāne pṛthvyādi sarvamuttamam |
divyameva sabhā divyā bhaktā divyā narāḥ striyaḥ ||74||
teṣāṃ yoge mamānando vartate bhagavanmayaḥ |
dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ yadatra vartate hariḥ ||75||
sādhurūpo mūrtirūpo vartate bhagavāniha |
evaṃ bhaktasya saṃkalpā jāyante cātmavedinaḥ ||76||
devāśceśā avatārā muktā yatsampadā sukhāḥ |
sa eva bhagavānatra rājate puruṣottamaḥ ||77||
yadakṣaraṃ vyāpakaṃ ca brahmadhāma parātparam |
tatparo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvihāgataḥ | |78||
milito’tra mahārājo madbhāgyānto na vidyate |
tasya kṛṣṇasya yogena jīvanaṃ naḥ punaḥ khalu ||79||
divye nitye pare dhāmni yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo virājate |
nijatulyairmahāmuktairasaṃkhyātairupāsitaḥ ||3.213.80||
teṣāṃ vai divyamuktānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ |
ekaikaromṇi tejo’sti koṭikoṭyarkasadṛśam ||81||
tādṛśānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ muktānāṃ teja ujjvalam |
samastaṃ līyate tvekaromṇi tādṛk tadakṣaram ||82||
brahmadhāmāsti divyaṃ vai saccidānandalakṣaṇam |
tathāvidhāni dhāmāni dhāmnāṃ tejāṃsi yānyapi ||83 ||
samastāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaikaromṇi līnatām |
yāntīti tādṛśī bhūtirvartate paramātmanaḥ ||84||
tādṛśo bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ samartho’ti mahān hariḥ |
kṛpāvaśo dehināṃ tu śreyase sarvaśaktiyuk ||85||
dhṛtadivyanarākāro naravannṛṣu jāyate |
tirodhāya mahaiśvaryāṇyapi narākṛtirasti saḥ ||86||
tasya bhaktyā samastāni duḥkhāni yānti līnatām |
kālasya karmaṇāṃ māyāyāśca tasya na bandhanam ||87||
sevayā śrīharestasya rakṣaṇaṃ jāyate sadā |
yathā mayā satā rakṣā bhavatāṃ vihitātra vai |||88||
tathā kṛṣṇaḥ kārayati sādhudvārā nijāvanam |
bhaktā jīvāścetanāśca māyā tattvāni yāni ca ||89||
sarvamasya śarīraṃ vai vyāpyaṃ cādhīnamityapi |
vaśyaṃ cāpi bhavatyeva sarvamasya mahātmanaḥ ||3.213.90||
teṣu sarveṣu tattveṣu muktākṣareśvareṣvapi |
vyāpako vartate kṛṣṇo māyājīvādikeṣvapi ||91||
sarveṣāṃ prerakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svatantraśca niyāmakaḥ |
savaiśvaryayutaḥ sarvaśeṣī kalyāṇakṛtprabhuḥ ||92||
āvirbhūya kṣitau nrābho nṛnāṭyaṃ vidadhāti saḥ |
sevadhvaṃ taṃ hariṃ ye vai divyabhāvā narāḥ striyaḥ ||93||
te sarve śrīhareḥ sarvamaiśvaryaṃ prāpnuvanti ha |
brahmarūpā brahmabhāvāḥ sapremasevino hareḥ ||94||
vrahmaloke’pi tadrūpāḥ sevante parameśvaram |
tasmādatra hariḥ sevyaḥ sādhurūpo’tirakṣakaḥ ||95||
sādhau nārāyaṇaścāste bhaktecchāpūrakaḥ svayam |
evaṃ maṃgaladevādyā lakṣmi proktā mayā tadā ||96||
vividuste mayi kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kecidityatha |
siṣevire’tibhāvena sādhurūpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||97||
satī maṃgaladevasya patnī nāmnā vibhāvarī |
siṣeve māṃ pādasaṃvāhanādyairatibhāvukī ||98||
athāhaṃ prārthitastaiśca mokṣārthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ |
tathāstvevākathayaṃ svāṃ divyāmadarśayaṃ tanum ||99||
vīṇāyuktaṃ samukuṭaṃ śyāmasundaravigraham |
koṭimanmatharūpātirūpaṃ kiśoramujjvalam || 3.213.1 00||
rādhādibhirvanditaṃ ca brahmapriyābhisevitam |
koṭimuktamahāmuktānikājuṣṭaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||1 01 ||
etādṛśaṃ ca madrūpaṃ darśayitvā kṣaṇāntare |
mūrtau tirobhavaṃ te tu mahāścaryaparāḥ punaḥ || 1 02||
nanṛtuḥ kīrtanaṃ cakruḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya darśanāt |
evaṃ nityaṃ bhejire te cātibhaktyā tu nityaśaḥ || 1 03||
prāpte kāle tu tān divyākṣaraṃ dhāma parātparam |
vimānenānayaṃ cāsthāpayaṃ mukteṣu tatra ca || 104||
bhaktaṃ maṃgaladevaṃ ca patnīṃ vibhāvarīṃ tathā |
arakṣayaṃ me sevāyāṃ pādayorakṣare sthale || 1 05||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtā carmakṛtāṃ tadā |
tebhyo mantraṃ dattavām̐śca sādhurūpo dayāvaśaḥ || 1 06||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
jepurbhejuḥ sasmarurmāṃ yayurme paramaṃ padam || 1 07||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi |
bhajanāllabhate bhūtiṃ divyāṃ divaṃ ca mokṣaṇam || 1 08||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne maṃgaladevākhyacarmakārabhaktasya bhaktyā sākṣādāgatya bhagavatā viṣavāraṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 213 ||

<3.214>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ rathakārasya śobhanam |
vṛttāntaṃ mama bhaktyāḍhyaṃ sutāragrāmavāsinaḥ || 1 ||
raṅgamayīsarittīre rathakāro’tipāvanaḥ |
sutārapuryāmabhavanmama bhaktaḥ kuṭumbavān || 2 ||
kāṣṭhayānāni sarvāṇi gantrīśca śakaṭāni ca |
anaścakrāṇi sarvāṇi kāṣṭhāsanāni maṃcakān || 3 ||
bṛsīḥ khadvāśca paryaṃkān kapaṭān prakaroti saḥ |
kāṣṭhapātrāṇi ramyāṇi kāṣṭhaputtalaputtalīḥ || 4 ||
kāruvaryaḥ karotyeva naukā gajāśvagovṛṣān |
vividhānyupakaraṇānyapi svakalayā tathā || 5 ||
karoti peṭikāścāpi peṭakān sucatuṣkikāḥ |
tatra sarvatra kāryeṣu harernāma likhatyapi || 6 ||
svanāma haridāseti likhitvā ca tataḥ param |
hariśceti hi sarveṣu vastuṣvayaṃ likhatyapi || 7 ||
gṛhe ca kāṣṭhaśālāyāṃ lilekha śrīhare prabho |
gṛhajālāntare kāṣṭhapratimāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 8 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsthāpayaddhi saḥ |
prātaḥ samūjayatyenāṃ pratimāṃ mama śobhanām || 9 ||
śriyā sākaṃ puṣpapatracandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ |
bhūṣāvastradravadhūpadīpanaivedyavāribhiḥ ||3.214.1 0||
evaṃ sampūjya nityaṃ vai prasādaṃ grasate tataḥ |
anyebhyaḥ sampradāyāpi tataḥ kārye pravartate || 1 1||
udyame smarati māṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
harikṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ haridāsaḥ subhaktarāṭ || 1 2||
athaikadā vicāro’syābhavad devādigocaraḥ |
anyodyogaṃ vihāyaiva pratimodyogamāvahe || 13||
yāsāṃ nirmāṇakārye vai dhyānaṃ devātmakaṃ bhavet |
smaraṇaṃ cāpi devānāṃ rūparaṅgādikarmasu ||14||
satataṃ syāt kīrtanaṃ cārpaṇaṃ mūrtimayaṃ bhavet |

harimūrtimayodyogaṃ samārabhata bhāvataḥ |
puruṣottamamūrtiṃ sa vyaracayat suśobhanām || 16||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ samāṇikīm |
rādhākṛṣṇayugalaṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇobhayam || 17||
vāsudevaṃ śriyā sākaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca kamalāyutam |
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi śeṣaśāyinarāyaṇam || 18||
śrīpatiṃ śrīgaruḍasthaṃ gajasthaṃ māṇikīsthitam |

duḥkhahāśrīsahitaṃ ca gobhiśca sahitaṃ prabhum |
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kapilaṃ ca hariṃ tathā ||3.214.20||
vāsudevaṃ rājarājaṃ pṛthuṃ dattaṃ nṛsiṃhakam |
haṃsamṛṣabhaṃ paraśudharaṃ yajñaṃ ca vāmanam ||21||
rāmaṃ kumāraṃ vyāsaṃ ca hayagrīvaṃ ca nāradam |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca buddhaṃ ca kalkiṃ nārāyaṇīpatim |||2||
haraṃ satīṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm |
prajñāṃ pārāvatīṃ durgāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca kālikāṃ tathā ||23||
sūryaṃ vahniṃ candramasaṃ gaṇeśaṃ kālabhairavam |
nandaṃ sunandaṃ liṅgaṃ cāracayat pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||24||
kāṣṭhānāṃ savanānāṃ vai sasarjānāṃ sāgaśākhinām |
vaṭānāṃ śiṃśapānāṃ ca karoti pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||25||
svalpā madhyāścottamāśca vividhāḥ sa karoti vai |
raṃgaśṛṃgārayuktāśca saṃskṛtāścihnitatvacaḥ ||26||
bhajan raṭan hariṃ nāma nirmāti pratimāḥ sadā |
yāsāṃ rūpāṇi hṛdaye bhāsante na tadā tu saḥ ||27||
raho niṣadya māṃ smṛtvā rūpaṃ dhārayate mama |
hṛdaye sve caikatāno manmūrtau sa prajāyate ||28||
samastendriyavṛttīnāṃ layo bhavati vai mayi |
yathā tathā sa yatate yogivad dhyāyati sthiraḥ ||29||
dinārdhaṃ vā dinaṃ yāti samādhāviva tasya vai |
tathāpi premamagno’sau na niryāti samādhitaḥ ||3.214.30 ||
mūrtiścintāmaṇikalpā vartate mādhavasya yat |
tasyāḥ sakāśāt saṃkalpāḥ pūrṇā bhavanti dhāritāḥ ||3 1 ||
itiniścayayuktasya haridāsasya sarvathā |

icchan draṣṭuṃ nūtnarūpaṃ racanārhaṃ suśobhanam ||33||
atha me kṛpayā mūrteḥ rūpaṃ yadābhijāyate |
kartavyapratimārūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 34||
abhyasya ca tato bhakto bahiryāti na cānyathā |
yādṛg dṛṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ vai sādhyamūrtestathāvidham |||35||
kāṣṭhācchilpakalābhiśca niṣkāsayati śobhanam |
saumyaṃ suhāsyavadanaṃ sarvayogyasuśastrakam ||36||
yogyaśṛṃgārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ tathotkaroti kāṣṭhajam |
dāravaṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ yādṛśaṃ hṛdi vīkṣitam ||37||
tādṛśaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva vikrīṇāti suraṃgitam |
evaṃ samastadevānāṃ hanumadyatiyoginām ||38||
sādhvīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtvā karoti vikrayam |
dhyāyati devatāḥ sarvā viśeṣatastu vallabham ||39||
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ dhyāyati puruṣottamam |
tato’haṃ matpratimātastadiṣṭaṃ pūrayāmyapi ||3.214.40||
khyātistasyābhavalloke haridāso harestanuḥ |
rājānaścāpi tasmādvai kārayantīṣṭadevatāḥ ||41 ||
haridāso’pi kṛtvaiva dadātyeva śubhottamāḥ |
haridāsena niyamaḥ kṛto nārāyaṇaṃ vinā ||42|||
nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ ca vinā mānavī pratimā mayā |
na vai kāryā kvacid bhaktivirodhinī tu māyikī ||43 ||
nimnacintanadā naiva kāryā mānuṣaputtalī |
abhaktānāṃ naiva kāryā tathā mānuṣaputtalī ||44||
bhaktānāṃ tu śubhā kāryā tadiṣṭadevatāyutā |
evamātmaniveditvaṃ rarakṣa nityadā hi saḥ ||45||
prasanno’haṃ tato lakṣmi parīkṣārthamupāyayau |
cakravatīśvaro bhūtvā tīrthavyājena mārgagaḥ ||46||
hastyaśvarathavān pāresahasrasainikānvitaḥ |
rājñīdāsīdāsavargasahasraparisevitaḥ ||47||
ratnahīrakahārādyairbhūṣitaśchatraśobhitaḥ |
mahāśvetagajapṛṣṭhe svarṇāmbālikayānvite ||48||
niṣaṇṇaścāmarairyukto jayaśabdābhipūjitaḥ |
astraśastradharaiścāpi bhaṭaiḥ samparivāritaḥ ||49||
gurvamātyapradhānādyairvanditaḥ sevitastathā |
lakṣmi tvaṃ ca mama patnī sāmrājñī śobhanottamā ||3.214.50||
sahasraśobhanādāsīyuvatīgaṇamaṇḍitā |
mayā preritabhṛtyābhirakṣitā bhṛtyapūjitā ||51 ||
mahāsauvarṇaratnāḍhyanarayānasthitā tathā |
upāyayitha sākaṃ vai mayā pūrvaprapreṣitā ||52||
evaṃvidho’haṃ samrāṭ vai raṅgamayīnadītaṭe |
tīrthayātrāmiṣeṇāgre vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe viniryayau ||53||
tīrthataṭaṃ mahāśālagrāmatīrthābhidhaṃ varam |
samāśritya sthiratārthamavātaraṃ gajānmama ||54||
sasainyo’haṃ nyavasaṃśca snānapūjādimānasaḥ |
athāyayuḥ sutārākhyanagarasthāḥ prajājanāḥ ||55||
guravaścāpi viprāśca bhikṣukāḥ sakutūhalāḥ |
lipsayā dakṣiṇādeśca vikṣaṇecchānvitā api ||56||
āyayau nagaraṃ sarve draṣṭuṃ rājānamityapi |
tathāpi bhaktarājo’sau nāyāti māyikaṃ vidan ||57||
athāhaṃ tīrthavidhinā kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataḥ param |
datvā dānānyanekāni śuśrāva pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ||58||
dadarśa pratimāścāpi tīrthataṭe sthirīkṛtāḥ |
papraccha mānavām̐statrāgatān śilpivaraṃ prati ||59||
te prāhuratra nagare vartate śilpirāṇnanu |
ākārito mayā dūtairharidāso’pi nāyayau ||3.214.60||
vinā bhāgavataṃ santaṃ vinā nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
vinā bhaktaṃ hareranyasyāntikaṃ naimi so’vadat ||61 ||
tato’hamuktavānnāma madīyaṃ kṛṣṇadāsavat |
śrīkṛṣṇadāsavaryāhaṃ kṛṣṇabhakto bhavāmi ha ||62||
āyāhi śilpivarya tvaṃ pratimārthaṃ madicchayā |
dūtairgatvā tathaivoktaḥ so’pi śrutvā hyupāyayau ||63 ||
puṣpahārān gṛhītvaiva nyadhārayannṛporasi |
rājānaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktaṃ vai jñātvā neme’tibhāvataḥ ||64||
rājāpi tasya sammānaṃ pracakāra suvijñavat |
śilpī lakṣmi mayā rājñā pṛṣṭo mūrtividhāpane || 65||
krīṇanārthaṃ ca mūrtīnāṃ mūlye’pi pṛṣṭa eva saḥ |
so’pi kṛṣṇasya mūrtiṃ vai dadau me rādhayā yutām ||66 ||
sahasrarūpyamudrābhistathā lakṣmīṃ narāyaṇam |
labdhvāhaṃ mudrikā datvā svarṇaśataṃ tathottaram ||67||
pāritoṣikamevāpi datvākathayaṃ matkṛte |
mamaikāṃ mama rājñyāśca mūrtimekāṃ vidhāpaya ||68||
dāsye yatheṣṭaṃ kanakaṃ ratnāni hīrakām̐stathā |
sa prāha rājan bhakto’smi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||69|||
nārāyaṇavibhūtīnāṃ nārāyaṇasya vai tathā |
devānāṃ devatānāṃ ca karomi pratimāḥ sadā ||3.214.70||
mānavīṃ na karomyeva māyikīṃ na karomi ca |
yasyāḥ saṃklṛptane vṛttirnārāyaṇaṃ na cintayet ||71 ||
māyāṃ ca māyikīṃ cāpi puttalīṃ na smare kvacit |
tava rājanmahiṣyāśca puttalyāḥ karaṇe tu me ||72||
smaraṇaṃ mānavaṃ syādvai bhaktau kṣatirbhavenmama |
tato’haṃ na kariṣye vai puttalīṃ te kṣamasva mām ||73||
yadyapi tvaṃ prabhakto’si tathāpi rājaso’si vai |
rājño ceyaṃ mahāmāyā mohinī vartate tava ||74||
tatsmṛtiṃ na kariṣye’haṃ vinā lakṣmīṃ narāyaṇam |
yadi lakṣmyā samaṃ rājñī tvaṃ sākaṃ mādhavena tu ||75||
bhaktāvivobhau tiṣṭhantau sevāyāṃ staśca rocate |
te yadi tarhi kurve’haṃ mūrtiṃ śrīpatinā saha ||76||
kevalāṃ naiva kurve’haṃ necchāmi pāritoṣikam |
namaste ca kṣamasvāpi rājā mānyaḥ prajājanaiḥ ||77||
ityuktvā bhaktarāṭ lakṣmi haridāso gṛhaṃ yayau |
rājāhaṃ mama bhaktaṃ samparīkṣyaivaṃ tu pṛṣṭhagaḥ ||78||
padbhyāṃ tasya gṛhaṃ prāpto lokāścāścaryamāpnuvan |
dadau sa bhaktarāṇmahyaṃ kāṣṭhāsanaṃ vivekataḥ ||79||
annaṃ jalaṃ śrīharaye’rpitaṃ dadāvadarśayat |
pratimā me’samastāśca dhyānārthaṃ sa upāviśat ||3.214.80 ||
avigaṇayya me bhītiṃ dhairyaṃ dhṛtvā hareḥ śubham |
samādhau hṛdaye magnastadāhaṃ hṛdaye’bhavam ||81 ||
rājarūpastathā lakṣmī rājñīrūpā yathāyatham |
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca jñātvā śīghraṃ samutthitaḥ ||82||
svāgataṃ daṇḍavaccāpi cakre pradakṣiṇaṃ tu mām |
kīrtanaṃ sahasā cakre nanarta modavihvalaḥ ||83||
athānye tu janāstatra darśakā ye’bhavam̐stadā |
sarve dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ śrutvā bhaktoditaṃ tathā ||84||
nārāyaṇo hi samrāṇme bhūtvā gṛhamupāgataḥ |
lakṣmīrbhūtvā mahārājñī cāyayau bhāgyavānaham ||85||
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ sutāragrāmavāsinām |
aho bhāgyaṃ mama patnyāḥ śrīmānavyāḥ śubhottamam ||86||
kuṭumbasya ca me bhāgyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhṛtyayoṣitām |
bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvadya yadgṛhe vallabhohariḥ ||87||
yadgṛhe śrīḥ samāyātā rājñīrūpā hareḥ priyā |
śrīmānavyāḥ śreyase ca haridāsasya muktaye ||88||
aho pratimānirmātuḥ phalaṃ sākṣāddharirgṛhe |
ātmaniveditālābhaścāho sākṣātprabhurgṛhe ||89||
kalā me sukalā jātā jīvanaṃ me sujīvanam |
prāptaḥ sākṣānmayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ ||3.214.90||
śrutvaivaṃ janatāścāpi pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ nṛpam |
daṇḍavat tāḥ pracakruśca bhaktaḥ papāta pādayoḥ ||91||
tāvallakṣmi mayā naijaṃ rūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ param |
prakāśitaṃ tvayā lakṣmyā sākaṃ divyamanoharam ||92||
nadītaṭe tu yat sainyaṃ sarvaṃ tatra kṣaṇāntare |
tattirobhāvitaṃ tatra mahāścaryaṃ tato’bhavat ||93||
gṛhe’haṃ bhagavān sākṣād datvā me darśanaṃ tataḥ |
labdhvā pūjāṃ varadānaṃ mokṣārthaṃ sampradāya ca ||94||
prasannatāṃ samarpyaiva tatastūrṇaṃ tvayā saha |
kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā jagādāhaṃ bhaktāya cātmavedine ||95||
yo māmevaṃ hi bhajate tatkṛte sarvathā tvaham |
kalpalatāsamaścāsmi pūrayāmi manorathān ||96||
śilpino ye mama mūrtiṃ mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
lobhasvārthavihīnāśca kariṣyanti śubhāśayāḥ ||97||
teṣāṃ mokṣaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā te bhaktarāḍiha |
ityuktvā svasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇe lakṣmyāṃ gṛhāntare ||98||
pūjanārthaṃ sthāpite ca sthāpitāyāṃ tirobhavam |
atha bhakto’pi nityaṃ māṃ dhyāyati smarate tathā ||99 ||
kāle’prāpte vimānena tadgṛhaṃ samupasthitaḥ |
śrīmānavīṃ striyaṃ tasya haridāsaṃ ca taṃ tathā || 3.214.10 0||
ārohayitvā divyau tau kṛtvānayaṃ mamākṣaram |
anyān kālena tadvaccānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama || 101 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhakto rathakāro hi tāritāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā ||1 02||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne haridāsākhyasya rathakārasya bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 214 ||

<3.215>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śilāhārakathāṃ tathā |
nāmnā dāmaśilādau vai purā sudāmapattane || 1 ||
nyavasat sakuṭumbo’yaṃ khanyaśmavikrayodyamaḥ |
śataśo vai janā bhṛtyā yatrodyamaṃ prakurvate || 2 ||
śilāstu mahatīrdīrghā niṣkāsayanti bhūstarāt |
preṣayanti videśeṣu devarājālayārthikāḥ || 3 ||
śikharāṇi vicitrāṇi prāsādā bhinnajātayaḥ |
śvetaśilāmayā divyāḥ śilpakalādiśobhitāḥ || 4 ||
jāyante śilpivaryāṇāṃ kalābhistacchilākṛtāḥ |
pāṣāṇānāṃ hi khananaṃ divā tu khanibhūstare || 5 ||
satataṃ tadabhijñaistu kriyate dāmanoditaiḥ |
draṣṭā dāmaśilādo vai pramātā mūlyakṛttathā || 6 ||
nirīkṣaṇaṃ yathākālaṃ kurute khanibhūstare |
karmacārā yatante ca niṣkāsane’dhirohaṇe || 7 ||
śakṭyā gantrikāyāṃ ca bahusādhanasampadaḥ |
tatra dāmaśilādo vai krayārthaṃ cāgatārthine || 8 ||
śilā dadāti mūlyena dāmnā yathocitāḥ śubhāḥ |
mūrtiyogyā bahumūlyāḥ saudhayogyāstathāvidhāḥ || 9 ||
gṛhayogyā bhittiyogyāḥ starayogyāstathāparāḥ |
vibhinnamūlyabhāvaiśca dadāti tāstadarthine || 3.215.1 0||
bhṛtyā dāmaśilādasya gantryāmārohayanti tāḥ |
vṛṣabhairuṣṭrakairhastivaryaiśca geṇḍakaistathā ||1 1||
mahiṣairyantravayaiścākarṣayanti sugantrikāḥ |
sarvatra rakṣaṇaṃ nārāyaṇo hi bhagavān svayam || 1 1||
karotyārohaṇe cāvarohaṇe ca prasāraṇe |
utthāpane’pasaraṇe vivartane vidāraṇe ||13||
śatabhārāstatra kācit kācittato’dhigurviṇī |
tadardhāśca tadardhāśca khanyante nityameva tāḥ ||14||
kvacicchilātibhāreṇa śakaṭī bhaṃgameti hi |
śilātale hi śakaṭī cūrṇitā kaccarāyate ||15||
akasmādāpadādyāsu rakṣatyeva prabhurhariḥ |
vicāryetthaṃ karmacārān dāmaśilāda uttamam ||16||
hare nārāyaṇa svāmin vallabha śrīpate hare |
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ ca raṭanaṃ hareḥ ||17||
upādideśa satataṃ rakṣaṇaṃ yena mokṣaṇam |
svayaṃ karoti bhajanaṃ bhṛtyān prakārayatyapi ||18||
śilāsu kṛṣṇanāmāni guṇavanti nyayojayat |
kṛṣṇaśilā rāmaśilā nārāyaṇaśilā tathā || 19||
lakṣmīśilā ramopalā rādhopalā haropalā |
devopalā mandirāśmā mūrtyupalā satīśilā ||3.215.20||
viṣṇuśilā brahmaśilā parameśaśileti ca |
devīśilā sūryaśilā tīrthaśilā gurūpalā ||21 ||
mokṣaśilā cātmaśilā muktiśileti vai tathā |
avatāraśilā tadvad golokaprastarastathā ||22|
vaikuṇṭhaśilā cakrāśmā śālagrāmaśilā tathā |
bhagavatprastaraścāpi janārdanaśileti ca || 23||
yogaśilā jñānaśilā dhyānaśileti nāmabhiḥ |
śilāvargāḥ kṛtāstena nārāyaṇaprasattaye ||24||
nārāyaṇaṃ raṭiṣyāmi śilāyogena mānavāḥ |
śubhanāma grahīṣyanti pāpanāśakamuttamam ||25||
ityabhipretya nāmāni hareḥ suyojitāni vai |
tena dāmaśilādena śilāsu mokṣadāni hi ||26||
mānavā api gṛhṇanti śilāvyājena śārṅgiṇaḥ |
nāmāni bhṛtyavargāśca śreṣṭhinaḥ pāvanāni vai ||27||
evaṃ bhaktena sadbhaktiḥ kāritā kīrtanātmikā |
pāvitāśca narā nāryaḥ prākṛtā api nāmabhiḥ || 28||
puṇyaṃ mahattamaṃ tasya jātaṃ prasannatātmakam |
mamānugraharūpaṃ vai vardhate’pi nirantaram ||29||
bhaktabhaktiṃ samākarṇya tadgṛhaṃ mānavā rame |
santo bhaktāḥ samāyānti dhārmikā yātribhikṣukāḥ ||3.215.30||
militvā te prakurvanti bhajanaṃ mama kīrtanam |
śilājanyāṃ mama mūrtiṃ sampratiṣṭhāpya vai gṛhe ||31||
pūjayanti sadā bhāvairmahotsavaiḥ suvastubhiḥ |
gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ gītiṃ kurvanti rāsamagrataḥ ||32||
dhūpadīpādikaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ ca me |
samarpya matprasādaṃ te gṛhṇanti ca viyanti ca ||33||
evaṃ satsaṃgasaṃgho vai dāmaśilādamandire |
puṣṭiṃ prāptastadā lakṣmi prasanno’haṃ viśeṣataḥ ||34||
abhavaṃ ca pratimāyāṃ vartamāno nirantaram |
kṛtāṃ sevāṃ ca gṛhṇāmi rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā ||35||
athaikadā gṛhe bhaktaścāsīd bhṛtyāstu vai khanau |
krośadūre’bhavan sarve śilāniṣkāsane ratāḥ ||36||
dīrghā mahopalā taiśca niṣkāsitā bahiḥ kṛtā |
āropitā śakaṭyāṃ ca bhagnā sā śakaṭī drutam ||37||
śakaṭīpārśvagā bhṛtyāḥ karmacārāstu ye’bhavan |
teṣu dvitrāḥ śakaṭyāṃ vai kaccaritāḥ śilātale ||38||
hāhā śokastadā tatra vyajāyata janeṣu vai |
jalaṃ kaccaritāḥ pātuṃ prārthayāmāsureva te ||39||
dadurvāri tato mūrchāṃ prāpuste maraṇonmukhāḥ |
athānye sasmarurnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ rakṣakaṃ prabhum ||3.215.40||
prayatna sahasā cakrarbhārākrāntāvanāya te |
śakaṭīṃ ca śilāṃ cāpyuttolya sambhūya mānavaiḥ ||41 ||
niṣkāsitāḥ kaccaritā dvitrāste karmacāriṇaḥ |
abhānā gatabhānāste mṛtyūnmukhāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ||42|||
vartante tāvadevāpi karmacārairniveditaḥ |
bhakto dāmaśilādo vai gṛhe gatvā tu satvaram ||3||
āyayau sa khaniṃ yāvat smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām |
tāvadahaṃ sādhuveṣo’ṭavītaścāyayau khanim ||44||
bhojanārthaṃ bhikṣukaḥ san jalārthaṃ bhikṣayan jalam |
vilokya tān kaccaritānāścaryaparamo’bhavam||45||
stabdho’bhavaṃ kṣaṇaṃ te tu prārthayāmāsuracyutam |
hare kṛṣṇa dīnabandho samujjīvaya dīnanṝn ||46||
manuṣyahatyā bhaktasya yathā na syāt prarakṣaya |
raṃkarakṣāvidhātā tvaṃ bhaktecchāpūrako bhavān ||47||
sarvaduḥkhaprahātā tvaṃ prarakṣaya nijāñjanān|
nātrauṣadhaṃ bhavecchaktamasthikaccaracūrṇite ||48||
dehe raktātirikte’tra vinā tvāṃ jīvanaṃ nahi |
camatkāraṃ vinā siddhiṃ vinā naiṣāṃ hi jīvanam ||49||
mṛtaprāyā mṛgāśceme nānyastvāṃ yoginaṃ vinā |
navīkartuṃ samīkartuṃ sandhiṃ kartuṃ kṣamo’paraḥ ||3.215.50|||
ityevaṃ vadamānānāṃ śṛṇvan sādhurjalaṃ kare |
samādāya dadau tebhyo mukhe tvācamanīyakam ||51||
rakṣāṃ nidhāya kukṣisthaṃ bhasma dhṛtvā karadvaye |
mardayāmāsa bhagnānāṃ deheṣvabhita ādarāt ||52||
tāvatte svasthatāṃ prāptāḥ sandhitā nīrujīkṛtāḥ |
raktapūrṇā abhavam̐śca yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva te | |53||
utthitāḥ svapnato yadvat praṇemuḥ sādhuyoginam |
jīvanaṃ prāpya viśrāntiṃ lebhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ sataḥ puraḥ ||54||
sādhurbhikṣāṃ jagṛhe ca jalānnaṃ bubhuje tataḥ |
te’pi sarve prasādaṃ ca samyag bubhujire mama ||55||
atha śāntyā niṣeduste sevamānāḥ padāmbuje |
papracchurmāṃ pāpanāśakaraṃ sādhanamuttamam ||56||
nārāyaṇasya vijñānaṃ mūrtirūpaṃ tathottamam |
ahaṃ vai kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ tebhyo yathātatham ||57||
satāṃ sevā harerbhaktistīrthānāṃ sevanaṃ tathā |
pāpanāśakarāṇyeva bhavanti bhagavatkṛpā ||58||
satāṃ samāgamenaiva vijñānaṃ śrīharerbhavet |
sacchāstrāṇāṃ śīlanena kathāyāḥ śravaṇena ca ||59||
pūrvasaṃskārabalato vijñānaṃ jāyate hareḥ |
yogābhyāsena sahasā kalmaṣāṇāṃ vināśane ||3.215.60 ||
yogigatyā brahmagatyā kṛṣṇamūrtiḥ prakāśate |
piṇḍe’sti ghaṭanā ramyā yādṛśī tādṛśī punaḥ ||61 ||
vairāje vartate cāpi sūkṣmā sthūletyabhedataḥ |
dehe tu mānave nāḍyo brahmāṇḍe nadikāstu tāḥ ||62|||
dehe tu kukṣayaḥ santi brahmāṇḍe cābdhayastu te |
pādamūlaṃ tu pātālaṃ mūrdhā satyaṃ kaṭirhi bhūḥ ||63||
dehasthendriyanāḍīnāṃ vairājendriyanāḍikāḥ |
kāraṇāni tataścaikyabhāvā bhavanti tā imāḥ ||64||
yogābhyāsaratā jihvāprāntaṃ yānti samādhinā |
tadā vairājajihvāyā antaṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ | |65||
evaṃ sarvendriyāṇāṃ tu prāntaṃ yānti samādhinā |
tadā vairājendriyāṇāmantaṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ ||66||
suṣumṇā vartate madhye dehe’tra nābhimūrdhvagā |
vāme ceḍā piṃgalā tu dakṣe sthitā sadāsti vai ||67||
suṣumṇāntaṃ tu mūrdhānaṃ gatvā vairājamīkṣate |
sā tu dīrghā brahmarandhrād vairājaṃ yogamṛcchati ||68||
tejaḥkiraṇarūpā vai vairājātpuruṣāvadhim |
mahāpuruṣarandhrāt sā tejaḥkiraṇasaṃjñitā ||69||
akṣareṇa ca tādātmyaṃ gatā tato harau hi sā |
