pramātādātmyamāpannā vidyate kiraṇātmikā |
ataḥ suṣumṇāmārgeṇa yogī yāti paraṃ padam ||3.215.70||
hareḥ kiraṇaṃ niryan syāt sarvāvatāramantagam |
īśvareṣu ca jīveṣu vartate vyāpakaṃ hi tat |
tadbrahma tacca vijñānaṃ sattvaṃ prakāśa eva tat ||71 ||
tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti jñānadīptimat |
snehātiśayataścaivaṃvidaḥ prabhā vivardhate |||72||
jāgrati vā svāpake vā suṣuptau vā yadā yadā |
harau syāllīnatā yasya snehena tatra taṃ vrajet ||73 ||
saṃkalpena hareścāpi śaktyā cāpi harestathā |
jñānaśaktyā kriyāśaktyā cecchāśaktyā harestathā ||74||
jīveśāḥ sampravartante jānantaḥ kriyayānvitāḥ |
karmavaśā sarvajīvāḥ svatantrā nahi santi vai ||75||
harerjñānakriyecchābhiḥ kriyecchājñāninaḥ khalu |
phalapradātā bhagavān karmaṇāmasti sarvathā ||76||
harestāḥ śaktayo nṝṇāṃ svasvakarmānusārataḥ |
jñānādīn prerayantyeva tena sṛṣṭiḥ pravartate ||77||
sṛṣṭerjīvā harau dhyānābhyāsād divyā bhavanti vai |
divyadṛṣṭaya evāpi tadā brahmasudarśanam ||78||
māyāguṇādiśūnyaṃ tannirguṇaṃ brahma taijasam |
nijairdivyaguṇairyuktaṃ saguṇaṃ brahma śāśvatam ||79||
pareśaṃ paramātmānaṃ parabrahma sanātanam |
prāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ satāṃ satsaṃgasatphalāḥ ||3.215.8 0||
narākāraṃ divyamūrtiṃ śrīpatiṃ taṃ satāṃ patim |
divyamūrtiṃ parātmānaṃ yānti tadyoginastvime ||81||
divyatāṃ yānti bahavastatsamā brahmarūpiṇaḥ |
yathā brahmapriyā divyā yathā muktā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||82||
yathā lakṣmīryathā rādhā yathā satī sarasvatī |
tathā divyā bhavantyeva narā nāryaḥ parātmagāḥ ||83||
tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyo hi rakṣakaḥ |
mokṣadaḥ svargadaścāpi suṣumṇāmārgalabdhimān ||84||
khanau nārāyaṇo nityaṃ smaraṇīyo janārdanaḥ |
satāṃ mūrtau hariścāste sevanīyaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ ||85||
ityuktvā nirbhayān kṛtvā dadau mantraṃ tadā tvaham |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||86||
atha te māṃ guruṃ matvā lakṣmi nijālayaṃ prati |
ninyuḥ sādhusvarūpaṃ māṃ camatkārijanaṃ gurum ||87||
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pāyayāmāsuriṣṭakam |
pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ sevayāmāsurādarāt ||88||
pūjayāmāsurevāpi kṣamāṃ yayācire tataḥ |
pādāmṛtajalaṃ me te papurmayāpi vai tadā ||89||
āśīrvādairyojitāśca kṛpayā bhaktigocarāḥ |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatāṃ vai yatheṣṭā jāyatāṃ sadā ||3.215.90||
athāhamabhavaṃ lakṣmi jigamiṣustadā tu te |
kṛṣṇapratyakṣalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasaḥ ||91||
yayācire mayā tathāstviti tatra niyojitāḥ |
apaśyan māṃ śaṃkhacakragadābjadhāriṇaṃ harim ||92||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ pratyakṣayogino yathā |
divyā divyasvarūpāste vyajāyanta tadā drutam ||93||
nanṛtuśca jaguścāpi mumuduścātiharṣulāḥ |
pupūjurmāṃ parabrahma rakṣakaṃ prāṇarakṣakam ||94||
athāhaṃ tatra mūrtau me tiro’bhavaṃ hi paśyatām |
teṣāṃ tadā samārabhya te’pi mūrtiniṣeviṇaḥ | |95| |
sarvathātmanivedāścābhavan bhaktāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
atha kāle samāyāte bhaktaṃ dāmaśilādakam ||96||
tasya bhṛtyān bahūn bhaktān tathā patnīṃ kalābhidhām |
vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ param ||97||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtā bhaktiśca kāritā |
jñānaṃ dattaṃ ca sāmarthyaṃ muktiścāpi kṛtā śubhā ||98||
evaṃ madīyabhaktānāṃ prānte mokṣaṃ karomyaham |
dadāmi divyatāṃ cāpi bhaktyā sādhyo yato’smyaham ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt stavanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva tatheṣṭā śubhadā gatiḥ |
vallabhaḥ śrīguruḥ svāmī prabhuḥ sarvagatistvaham ||3.215.1 00||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śilāhārasya dāmaśilādanāmakabhaktasya bhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dāmaśilādādeścānte mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhagavatā
kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 215 ||

<3.216>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śilpakalāvidaḥ kathām |
nāmnā sañjayadevasya mama bhaktasya śobhanām || 1 ||
kutarkapuravāso’bhūd bhakto nārāyaṇe mayi |
kuṭumbasahito nityaṃ bhajate māṃ śriyaḥ patim || 2 ||
bahudhā śilpinaṃ vetti kāṣṭhapāṣāṇadhātujam ||
vṛkṣavallīstabakādi devarṣimānavādi ca || 3 ||
paśupakṣisarpakīṭādi ca tattvādikaṃ tathā |
sarvavidhaṃ kalayā sa vijānāti yathāyatham || 4 ||
sarvavidhe śilpane sañjayadevo hariṃ tu mām |
likhatyevāntare sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmamūrtisvarūpiṇam | | 5 ||
yathānye naiva jānīyustathā vai nāntarīyakam |
śilpe cāntaraśilpaṃ ca tadantare tu māṃ śubham || 6 ||
vidadhāti smaran māṃ sa sabījaṃ śilpinaṃ yataḥ |
divyaṃ bhavati śrīkṛṣṇārpitaṃ kṛṣṇasuyogavat || 7 ||
evaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ bhaktaḥ karoti manmayaṃ sadā |
sarvaṃ madātmakaṃ śilpaṃ saphalodyamaśobhitam || 8 ||
bhakto nijāntare bhaktiṃ manute tatkalātmikām |
yatra nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ nirmītaḥ saṃbhavāmi ha || 9 ||
śilpakalāsu sarvāsu māṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
caṣṭe dhyāyati kurute namati pūjayatyapi || 3.216.10 ||
prātarnityaṃ samutthāya dhyātvārhaṇaṃ karoti me |
mūrteḥ pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ tathārghyakam || 1 1||
bhūṣāśṛṃgārāmbarāṇi samarpayanti me sadā |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ tathā || 12||
sugandhitailasāraṃ ca mahārhāsanamañcakam |
samarpayati natvā me kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat stavam || 1 3||
nityamarthayati śreyaścaihikaṃ pāralaukikam |
satāṃ samāgamaṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanam || 14||
karoti sañjayo nityaṃ keśavatyā svayoṣitā |
putreṇa suradevena sākaṃ gṛhe niśāmukhe || 15||
nṛtyaṃ ca gāyanaṃ kṛṣṇacamatkārakathāśravam |
karoti śubhanaivedyaṃ prasādasya pradānakam || 16||
bhuktvā prāsādikaṃ paścādudyoge vartate sadā |
evaṃ sañjayadevo me bhaktiniṣṭho hi vartate || 17||
tasyājñāyāṃ śilpino’nye vartante karmacāriṇaḥ |
te’pi sañjayayogena bhajante parameśvaram || 18||
athaikadā nṛpo nāmnā khaḍgavarmā vihārarāṭ |
svasya nūtanasaudhasya nirmityai taṃ samāhvayat || 19||
sāptabhaumasya kakṣāsu koṇe koṇe sthale sthale |
yāvatprasiddhajātīnāṃ puttalīsthāpanāya tu ||3.216.20 ||
ājñāṃ cakāra nṛpatirdhanavyaye’pyudāratām |
pradarśayan dadānaśca toṣayan karmaśilpinaḥ ||21 ||
bhakto’yaṃ nṛpaterājñāṃ svīcakārātimodavān |
śubhekṣaṇekṣitiṃ yogyavidhinā saṃprapūjya saḥ ||22||
khanitvā maṃgalaṃ tatra nṛpahastena saṃvyadhāt |
prāsādaḥ saptabhaumo vai sampannaścendrasaudhavat ||23||
sthale sthale puttalāni prātiṣṭhipanmahāntyapi |
ramyāṇi ca vicitrāṇi saumyamanoharāṇi ca ||24||
nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇasya rādhāyāśca śriyāstathā |
sarasvatyāśca lakṣmyāśca māṇikyā brahmayoṣitām ||25|||
śrīhareravatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ śubhānyapi |
īśvarīṇāṃ pratimāśca maharṣisurayoginām ||26||
devīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca mānavānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām |
paśūnāṃ vanyajātīnāṃ grāmīṇānāṃ ca dehinām ||27||
pāvanānāṃ maṃgalānāṃ khyātānāṃ pratimāstathā |
udbhijjānāṃ suramyāṇāṃ dṛśyāni saritāṃ tathā ||28||
parvatānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vidyutāṃ vyomacāriṇām |
meghānāṃ ca samudrāṇāṃ dṛśyānyapi vyadarśayat ||29||
evaṃvidhaṃ mahāsaudhaṃ racayitvā sthale sthale |
sūkṣmaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sa samasthāpayadacyutam ||3.216.30||
prasannamānaso bhakto vāstuṃ tasya nyavedayata |
rājā viprān samāhūya vāstupūjāmakārayat ||3 1||
havanāni bhojanāni pūjanāni hyakārayat |
dānāni dakṣiṇāḥ pāritoṣikāṇi dadau nṛpaḥ ||32||
śilpine svarṇaśṛṃgārairalaṃkṛtaṃ gajaṃ dadau |
grāmāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīstathā dadau || 3 3||
śilpibhyaśca yathāyogyadhanādīni nṛpo dadau |
athālaṅkṛtahastīndraṃ samāruhya gṛhaṃ nijam || 34||
yāvat sañjayadevastu prayāti tāvadeva tu |
mārge gajaḥ pramatto’timadāviṣṭo’bhavad drutam ||35||
apradhṛṣyaścātibalo vicittonmattasañcaraḥ |
aśāsanīyo’pyabhavanmahāvibhrama udvrataḥ ||36||
hastipakāniyamyaścāgamyo bhītikarastathā |
mahābṛṃhaṇakartā ca mahāvegadravānvitaḥ ||37||
dhāvamāno’niyamito dudrāvotpathasañcaraḥ |
mānavā dudruvurbhītāḥ prāṇarakṣārthameva ha ||38||
na ke’pi tatra tiṣṭhanti yatra yāti hi vāraṇaḥ |
ambālikā sakūthā ca vivṛtā patitā kṣitau ||39||
patitaḥ sañjayaścāpi hastipakaḥ papāta ca |
gajaḥ sañjayadevaṃ me bhaktaṃ nigṛhya śuṇḍayā ||3.216.40 ||
dūre cikṣepa sahasā bhaktaḥ papāta khātake |
khātamadhye hyaniḥsāre pātapīḍātimūrchitaḥ ||41||
sasmāra māṃ hariṃ tatra hṛdaye bhaktarakṣakam |
gajo dūraṃ gato yāvattataḥ khātaṃ tu mānavāḥ |||42||
āyayustasya vīkṣārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ parito janāḥ |
tatpūrvaṃ tu tadā lakṣmi bhaktapārśvaṃ gato’bhavam |||43|||
hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśam̐staṃ ca mūrchāṃ pīḍāmanāśayam |
darśanaṃ me dadau tasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam ||44||
haste dhṛtvā bahistaṃ cāniṣkāsayaṃ tu gartataḥ |
svastho bhakto virogaśca bādhāpīḍāvivarjitaḥ ||45||
bhajanyāṃ ca rahan māṃ ca mohamāno hi mānavān |
jagāda bhagavānatrāgato me rakṣaṇāya vai ||46||
tatkārābhyāṃ nīrujo’haṃ vipīḍo’tra bhavāmi ha |
evaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarve bhajantāṃ parameśvaram ||47||
ityuktvādarśayat sarvānaṅgulyā māṃ puraḥsthitam |
viprarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tejovyāptasuvigraham ||48||
praṇemuste hariṃ māṃ ca divya mānavavigraham |
kalyāṇaṃ prārthayāñcakruścopādideśa cāpyaham ||49||
kalyāṇaṃ jāyate kṛṣṇabhaktyā satāṃ prasevayā |
sarvamityarthakartavyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprītihetukam ||3.216.50||
satāṃ prasannatā labhyā guṇā labhyāḥ satāṃ tathā |
devādhikāḥ sadā santo mānyā mumukṣubhiḥ śubhāḥ ||51 ||
viṣṇuvaccārcanīyāste sevanīyāśca viṣṇuvat |
satāmājñā pālanīyā vacodhāryaṃ ca mānase |||52||
vartitavyaṃ ca niśchadma satāmagre tu dāsavat |
kṛṣṇatulyān sato dṛṣṭvā namanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ ||||53|||
mantavyaṃ hṛdaye naije santaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
mahāntaste samarthāśca divyāḥ sarvātmanā śubhāḥ ||54||
pāvanāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpā vikriyāvarjitāḥ parāḥ |
māyāpāragatāḥ santi māyāyāmahamasmi ca ||55||
mama māyāvilopo vai satsevayā bhaviṣyati |
pāmarasya mama sarvāṇyaghānyeṣyanti saṃkṣayam || 56||
evaṃ satāṃ guṇagrāhī guṇasindhurbhavediha |
ye tu loke duṣṭajanā nindanti sādhuyoginaḥ |||57||
kathayanti mitho nindāṃ satāṃ cāguṇavarṇanām |
yatheme sādhavaḥ santi vivekavarjitāḥ khalu ||58||
loke sthātuṃ na jānanti bhoktuṃ pātuṃ ca bhāṣitum |
paridhātuṃ ca vasanaṃ dātuṃ jānanti naiva ca ||59||
kartuṃ cābhyāgatasya svāgataṃ vidanti naiva ca |
mahattvaṃ khyāpayituṃ svaṃ yatante copadeśadāḥ ||3.216.60 ||
kāmo lobho ratiḥ krodho vidyante’sya yathā mama |
nāyaṃ sādhurmṛṣā sādhurevaṃ gṛhṇanti dūṣaṇam ||61 ||
etādṛśāścarmanetrā nirayālayabhoginaḥ |
duḥkhino’tra prajāyante mṛtvā yāmyādhikāriṇaḥ ||62||
kadāpi te na jāyante guṇino mokṣasanmukhāḥ |
āsurāste tu vijñeyāḥ satāṃ drohakarāstviha ||63||
yūyaṃ śilpakalājñā vai sañjayo’yaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
yāvatkalāsu mūrtiṃ me dhārayatyeva sarvathā ||64||
tatra sarvatra bhaktirme bhavatyasya ca vastayā |
tādṛśībhaktiyogena viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ||65||
samāyāto’smi rakṣākṛt prasannaḥ sevayā mama |
sataḥ saṃsevya ca hariṃ yāntu mokṣaṃ paraṃ padam ||66||
kṛṣṇārcā kṛṣṇavat pūjyā mānyā sevyā ca kṛṣṇavat |
santastathaiva sampūjyāḥ mānyāḥ sevyāśca kṛṣṇavat ||67||
kṛṣṇo mahāntaḥ santaśca sarvaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtāḥ |
sarvarakṣākarāḥ santi sarvagāḥ śaktiśālinaḥ ||68 ||
parakāyaṃ praviśanti rakṣantyāpadvipattitaḥ |
kṛṣṇo mūrtiṃ samāviśya vartate rakṣaṇāya vai ||69||
mūrtau nijecchayā sākṣāt praviśyaiva virājate |
sākṣānme tu yathā tadvanmaryādā sarvathā sadā ||3.216.70||
mūrteragre satāmagre pālanīyā hi gauravāt |
satāṃ hṛdaye sākṣādvai svayamāviśya sarvathā ||71 ||
varte’haṃ vai tato nityaṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
maryādā pālanīyā vai satāṃ mūrteśca me samām ||72||
ye tu matvā hi pāṣāṇaṃ mūrtiṃ satastu mānavān |
prākṛtān sādhupuruṣān matvā nindanti nāstikāḥ ||73||
mama vacāṃsi sādhūnāṃ vacāṃsi mokṣadānyapi |
mānayanti mṛṣā nirarthakāni te tu māyikā ||74||
nindakāḥ pāpino yāsyantyeva duḥkhaṃ tu nārakam |
teṣāṃ cātmaparātmādivijñānaṃ naiva jāyate ||75||
kṛṣṇasya niścayo naiva jāyate mūrtigasya me |
kalyāṇaṃ tādṛśānāṃ vai naiva bhavati naiva hi ||76||
daurmatyaṃ khalu teṣāṃ tu mūrtāveveti naiva ca |
kintu satsu tathā tadvat sveṣṭadeveṣu tādṛśam ||77||
anīśatvādināstikyaṃ jāyate bahupāpinām |
īśvarānavatārām̐śca manvate naiva sarvathā ||78||
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīpuraṃ cākṣaraṃ padam |
brahmapadaṃ ca vibhavān manvate naiva te khalāḥ ||79||
khalānāṃ samprasaṃgena jāyate khalatā tathā |
pūrvapāpādiyogena jāyate khalatā hyapi ||3.216.80||
nāstikānāṃ vacobhiśca kathābhiḥ saṃgatastathā |
kāmakrodhābhimānādyairdoṣaiśca khalatā bhavet ||81 ||
khalasya hṛdaye bhāvo na tiṣṭhate satāṃ hareḥ |
tasmāt kharāditulyasya khalasya saṃgamaḥ kvacit ||82||
vartavyo naiva loke’tra mumukṣubhistu mānavaiḥ |
śrotavyā sukathā divyā divyabodhapradā hareḥ ||83||
satāṃ kathā divyalīlā śrotavyā sevakaiḥ sadā |
kartavyaḥ saṃgamaścāpi satāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ||84||
divyatā ca satāṃ bodhyā bodhyā mūtau sthitirmama |
vijñeyaṃ mama māhātmyaṃ satāṃ bodhyaṃ ca mādṛśam ||85||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya rakṣāṃ karomi sarvathā |
yathā rakṣā kṛtā garte sañjayasya mayā tviha ||8 ||
mūrtau sthitvā parāṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣye māṃ bhajantviti |
sarvajīveṣu kṛṣṇo’haṃ nivasāmītyahiṃsayā ||87||
sarvathā vartitavyaṃ me bhaktairdayāparairiha |
adroho balavān dharmaḥ prīṇanaṃ dharma uttamaḥ ||88||
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvaiśca prīṇayenna tu hiṃsayet |
kāyena vācā manasā kriyayā sevayāpi ca ||89||
prīṇayenmāṃ sataścāpi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ labhettataḥ |
krodhāhaṃkāramānādyā doṣā varjyā hi hiṃsakāḥ || 3.216.90||
śāntatayā sadā stheyaṃ bhajanīyo janārdanaḥ |
bhajanīyāḥ sādhavaśca bhagavatpādasadrasāḥ ||91||
ityuktvā mama bhaktebhyo datvā mantraṃ madāśrayam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||92||
bhaktakṛtāṃ prapūjāṃ saṅgṛhya tiro’bhavaṃ drutam |
gajastu rājapuruṣairdhṛtaścātiprayatnakaiḥ ||93||
śamitaścopacāraiśca sañjayāya tato daduḥ |
atha smṛddhaṃ mama bhaktaṃ pūrṇāyuṣye’hamacyutaḥ ||94||
lakṣmi mokṣapradānārthaṃ pratyakṣastadgṛhe’gamam |
hastiyāne tu bhaktaṃ taṃ samādāya tathāparān | |95||
pradarśya divyatāṃ me cānayaṃ pattīyutaṃ drutam |
dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ divyaṃ tathāparān suśilpinaḥ | |96||
aprāpayaṃ paraṃ dhāma narānnārīśca bhāvukīḥ |
evaṃ rakṣā mayā lakṣmi kṛtā garte ca hastitaḥ ||97||
mama mūrtiṃ śilpavidaḥ kurvanti pūjayanti mām |
divyabhāvāstu te bhaktyā yānti me paramaṃ padam ||98||
yādṛśīṣu tādṛśīṣu śālagrāma śilāsvaham |
satsu satīṣu sādhvīṣu yogiṣvapi vasāmyaham ||99||
sarvatrāvasthitaścāsmi pratiṣṭhāpitamūrtiṣu |
viśeṣataḥ sthitaścāsmi bhaktamānasapūrakaḥ ||3.216.1 0 0||
yatra mama nivāso’sti kāṣṭhe kuḍye śilātale |
sarvaṃ divyaṃ bhavatyeva divyasya me prasaṃgataḥ || 101 ||
māyā divyā mama yogānnārī naro drumādayaḥ |
mama yogena divyāste jāyante mokṣadāḥ sadā | | 1 02||
doṣā guṇāḥ prajāyante jaḍāni cetanāni vai |
mama yogena divyāni jāyante yāni kānyapi ||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śilpakarasya sañjayadevasya bhaktyā bhagavatā gajato rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 216 ||

<3.217>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ citrakṛtaḥ śubhām |
nāmnā saṃbharadevasya mama bhaktasya pāvanīm || 1 ||
nimbakāle mahāgrāme saurāṣṭre sakuṭumbakaḥ |
bhaktaḥ saṃbharadevākhyaścitrakalāviśāradaḥ || 2 ||
abhavat sarvacitrāṇāṃ svatantro rūpadhāyakaḥ |
yathābhāvo mānavasya paśorvā pakṣiṇe’pi ca || 3 ||
kīṭānāṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ tattvānāṃ bhūjalādijaḥ |
rūpaṃ raṅgaḥ svabhāvaśca dṛśyatā ca kriyā yathā || 4 ||
yathā prabhā yathā hāsyaṃ ceṣṭāvasthā yathā tathā |
sarva citreṣu sahasā lekhinyā darśayatyatha | | 5 ||
paṭeṣu cāpi kuḍyeṣu nāṭakeṣu ca mūrtiṣu |
prāsādeṣu mandireṣu saudhakakṣāsu sarvathā || 6 ||
kāgadeṣu ca kāṣṭheṣu puttaleṣu samastataḥ |
prākṛtān guṇabhāvān sa prodbhāvayati citrakṛt || 7 ||
evaṃvidhakalāyukto bhajate māṃ nirantaram |
sarvacitreṣu vai sūkṣmaṃ mama rūpaṃ karoti ca || 8 ||
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā svaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ sa vetti vai |
yatra citre harirnāsti taccitraṃ niṣphalakriyam || 9 ||
yatra citre harermūrtiścitra tat saphalakriyam |
evaṃ kriyāpi tasyābhūt sadā śrīkṛṣṇamiśritā || 3.217.1 0||
vṛttiścitramayī kṛṣṇamayī tasyābhavat sadā |
svapne’pi citrakaraṇe bhāsate śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 11 ||
prātarutthāya me nāma gṛhṇāti he narāyaṇa |
rādhākṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 12|
evaṃ smṛtvā raṭitvātha snātvā pūjayati prabhum |
sarvalabdhopacāraiśca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ dadāti ca || 1 3||
naivedyaṃ daṇḍavad vāri nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇam |
samarpya ca kṣamāṃ prārthya bhuktvā prasādamuttamam || 14||
citraśālāṃ prayātyeva karoti citralekhanam |
anye’pi bahavastatra citrakṛto bhavanti ca || 15||
karmacārāsta evāpi bhajanti bhaktasaṃgataḥ |
māmeva paramātmānaṃ śrīnāthaṃ kambharātmajam || 1 6||
gopālabālakaṃ brahmapriyeśaṃ māṇikīpatim |
avatārapatiṃ muktapatiṃ duḥkhavināśakam || 17||
rātrau militvā sarve te kīrtayanti ramāpatim |
nṛtyanti purato mūrtergāyanti gītikāstathā || 18 ||
tadā saṃbharadevo’pi bhaktamaṇḍalanoditaḥ |
karoti varṇanaṃ mūrteḥ śrīkṛṣṇadhyānalabdhaye || 1 9||
śṛṇvantu citrakārā me bhāsate hṛdaye hariḥ |
yathādṛṣṭaṃ varṇayāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||3.217.20 ||
akṣareśaṃ brahmapriyāpatiṃ divyanarākṛtim |
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptaṃ koṭikoṭyarkatejasam ||21 || 
sudhāsrāvisamastasatkaraṇairabhikāśitam |
sapādapañcaṣaṣṭyaṃgulordhvaṃ suvarṇakeśinam ||22||
hiraṇyaśmaśruhiraṇyamūrtisarvasuvarṇakam |
prasannahāsyavadanaṃ lambagolānanaṃ prabhum ||23 ||
ākarṇāyatanetraṃ ca koṭikāmabhraśobhanam |
premasaṃbhṛtacakṣuṣkaṃ divyāparokṣadarśanam ||24||
viśālonnatabhālaṃ ca madhyoparitilānvitam |
dakṣalalāṭaromordhvasīmasthitatilānvitam ||25||
dakṣabhālordhvakoṇe ca vāmabhālordhvakoṇake |
samakṛṣṇatilaśobhilalāṭakojjvalam || 26 || 
vāmabhālordhvakeśāptasīmasūkṣmatiladvayam |
vāmanetrāntanimnaśrīkapole tiladhāriṇam || 27||
dakṣakapolake sūkṣmatilacatuṣṭayānvitam |
dvayośca karṇayorūrdhve sūkṣmaikaikatilānvitam ||28||
tilapuṣpasamanāsaṃ divyanetraṃ manoharam |
lambaśaṣkulikātulyakarṇadvayavirājitam || 29 || sūkṣmadhavalakāntyāḍhyakundavaddantaśobhitam |
pakvaraktabimbaphalabhāsauṣṭhadvayarājitam || 3.217.30 ||
puṣṭamukhaṃ sucibukaṃ sūkṣmapiṃgalakeśinam |
bhāle kaisaratilakam madhyakuṃkumacandrakam || 31 || ubhaprāntāntasaṃvyāptadīrgharekhāḍhyabhālakam |
ardhacandrasamarekhāmadhyabhālavirājitam ||32 ||
vāmagale sūkṣmatilo jatrūpari virājate |
kaṇṭhakūpe kṛṣṇatilaḥ subhagaḥ saṃvirājate || 33 ||
jihvā raktasthalapadmanibhā sarasvatīśritā |
kaṇṭhakūpādadhobhāgeṃ’gulanimne tilo’sti ca || 34||
dakṣaskandhe svalpatilastadadhaścāparastilaḥ |
tadadhaśca bhujāyāṃ vai tilastṛtīya ityapi || 35||
tadadhaśca caturtho’pi vartate ca śubhastilaḥ |
bhujāyāṃ sannidhau cāpi pañcamo vartate tilaḥ |
kaphoṇikoparibhāge bhujāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhakastilaḥ || 36 ||
kaphoṇikāyāḥ sandhau ca sūkṣmasattilapañcakam |
kaphoṇikopari pṛṣṭhabhāge tilaśca vartate |
karanālyāṃ tilaḥ sūkṣmaḥ karabhe sutilo’sti ca || 37||
laḍḍukaṣaṭkguccho’sti karapṛṣṭhe tu śobhanaḥ |
karatalematsyadhanurdhvajaśūlaśarāstathā || 38 ||
svasticakrarekhikāśca santi raktāḥ śaśiprabhe |
aṃgulyaḥ komalāḥ santi raktonnatanakhānvitāḥ || 39 ||
romāvalyaḥ subhagāśca svarṇavarṇāḥ prabhānti tāḥ |
madhyāṃgulyagre śaṃkho’sti cakrāṇi tu catusvapi ||3.217.40 ||
tarjanyāṃ yavarekhāsti hastaścandrojjvalo’sti ca |
vāmaskandhe jatrumūle śyāmacihnaṃ suśobhate |||41 ||
tadadho vartate sūkṣmatilatrayaṃ bhujāntike |
skandhapṛṣṭhe tilaścāste raktavarṇaḥ susūkṣmakaḥ ||42 ||
vāmodare nalapārśve tilaścaikaḥ praśobhate |
nābhirnimnā gabhīrā codaramujjvalamityapi ||43 ||
nābhau trivallyo dyotante samodaraṃ praśobhate |
udarasya dakṣapārśve tilatrayaṃ praśobhate ||44||
dakṣapṛṣṭhe tilaikaśca dakṣakukṣau tiladvayam |
stanacihne śyāmavarṇe saromṇiśobhayā yute ||45 ||
śrīvatsacihnasahitaṃ vakṣo viśālamunnatam |
vakṣo’dho vartate sūkṣmatilaḥ va samodaropari |||46 ||
vāmabhuje kukṣipārśve tilo ramyo hi vartate |
vāmabhujāyāṃ tilakaḥ suśobhaścāpi vartate ||47 ||
vāmakaphoṇikāsandhau sūkṣmatiladvayaṃ tathā |
prakoṣṭhe sutilaścāste karāṃgulinakhāḥ śubhāḥ ||48 | |
madhyāṃgulau śaṃkharekhā cakrāṇi tu catussvapi |
sthalapadmanibhaṃ raktaṃ hastatalaṃ nakhāstathā ||49 | |
kāntimatī samaniryatprabhākṛtiḥ sumohikā |
dhairyatyāgakarī strīṇāṃ koṭikandarpasundarā ||3.217.50 | |
bharayauvanapūrṇā ca divyā mūrtirvirājate |
yajñopavītayuktā ca kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhī virājitā ||51 ||
kare tu mālikāyuktā kvacittu lekhinīyutā |
sacakrādyāyudhā mūrtirvirājate kathānvitā ||52||
jaghane bālakṛṣṇasya lakṣmīmūrtirvirājate |
liṅge madhye hyuparyadhastiladvayaṃ virājate ||53||
dakṣe nitambe cāste ca tiladvayaṃ suśobhanam |
dakṣasakthi hyadhobhāge tiladvayaṃ virājate ||54||
jānudvayaṃ suśobhaṃ ca vartulaṃ rājate tathā |
jaṅghāyāṃ dakṣapādasya jānoradhastilo’sti ca ||55||
tathā madhye’ntaḥsupārśve kṛṣṇatilaḥ suśobhate |
vāmasakthisandhibhāge tilaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ suśobhate ||56 ||
tatpārśve sakthibhāge tu mahaccihaṃ kṣatatya(sya?) vai |
vartate’tha vāmanitambake tilaḥ susūkṣmakaḥ ||57||
vāmasakthna uparyāste śrīḥ pūrṇacandrasannibhā |
adṛśyā hyujjvalā divyā sarvakāmaprapūrikā ||58||
hastikaranibhe puṣṭe jaṃghe staḥ paramātmanaḥ |
ājānulambahastau ca vartete śrīramāpateḥ |||99||
vāmapādaprakoṣṭhe’dhastilaścaiko hi vartate |
ghaṭikāyāḥ sannidhau vai pādaphaṇāntike śubhaḥ ||3.217.60||
dvitīyaḥ sūkṣmatilako rekhāyāṃ vartate śubhaḥ |
ghūṭītrayaṃ ca pratyeke pāde bāhye hi vartate ||61 | |
kammānikānibhe pādatale śirīṣakomale |
raktābhe copari romāvalirājitapuṣṭake ||62||
agulyaṃguṣṭhaparvordhve romāṇi kānakāni vai |
vidyotante tathā sarve nakhāścandranibhonnatāḥ ||63|||
pādayostalayoḥ santi divyacihnāni śārṅgiṇaḥ |
mūrtau sūkṣmāṇi cihnāni samudroktāni santi ca ||64||
navāṃgulaṃ phullaliṃgaṃ vartate paramātmanaḥ |
pādayoścordhvarekhe ca vartete brahmage śubhe ||65||
kaṇṭhasvarastu madhuro’mṛtasrāvī hareḥ sadā |
vartate bālakṛṣṇasyaudārya saundaryamuttamam |
dayālutvaṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ kalyāṇaguṇayogitā || 66||
vartate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāvyayavīryatā |
sarvaiśvaryāṇi santyeva samastaśaktayastathā ||67||
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāśca camatkārā bhavanti ca |
sarvāścaryāṇi vidyante rājādhirājasampadaḥ ||68||
sarvā ākarṣaṇadharmiṇyaśca śriyo’sya santi hi |
sarvamādhuryabhāvāśca sarvānandābdhayo’tra vai | |69||
sarvotsavapramodāśca vidyante paramātmani |
sarvakāmaprapūrṇatvaṃ sarvāntaryāmitāsya ca ||3.217.70||
sarvakāntātikāntatvaṃ sarvadatvaṃ harāviva |
sarvajñatvaṃ sarvarūpadhārakatvaṃ hareḥ sadā ||71 ||
pārśvasthāḥ śrīrādhikāpadmāvatīmāṇikīramāḥ |
nārāyaṇīsukhadālakṣmīsatīkamalādikāḥ ||72||
brahmapriyāśca muktānyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityamum |
prasevante kumāryaśca gopyaścāpi haripriyāḥ ||73||
muktāśca pārṣadāścāpi vāhanāni ca hetayaḥ |
aiśvaryāṇi prasevante vibhūtayaśca tatsamā ||74||
mokṣārthe sarvajīvānāṃ vartate mānave bhave |
sa eva divyarūpo’sti mānavo vāpyamānavaḥ ||75||
sākṣāt sa bhagavānatra narākāro’pi vartate |
dhāmnā svena tathā muktaiḥ pārṣadādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ||76||
parivāreṇa sarveṇa vartate janagocaraḥ |
nṛtvadivyatvayorbhedo naivāsti parameśvare ||77||
yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma santi muktāśca śaktayaḥ |
sarve divyā mūrtimantaḥ sākārāḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśāḥ ||78||
narā nāryo divyarūpā divyamuktā bhavanti te |
bhavantaḥ sarva evāpi divyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇayoginaḥ ||79||
tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkāntavallabham |
gopālakambharāputraṃ vaṃśīhastaṃ bhajantviha ||3.217.80||
raṭantu śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ dhyāyantu kamalāpatim |
sevantāṃ māṇikīkāntaṃ prāpnuvantu paraṃ sukham ||81 ||
ityevaṃ mama bhaktaḥ sa bhaktamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ |
bhaktānupadiśatyeva nityaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ vacaḥ ||82||
bhaktāḥ saṃbharadevaṃ ca citrakāraṃ guruṃ nijam |
manyante pūjayantyeva bhaktiṃ kurvanti sevanam ||83||
athaikadā prasanno’hamāṣāḍhapūrṇimādine |
guroḥ pūjāṃ devapūjāṃ taiḥ kṛtāṃ vīkṣya tadgṛhe ||84||
drutaṃ saṃbharadevasya rūpamaghārayaṃ śubham |
gṛhe saṃbharadevo’sti dvitīyo’haṃ tu catvare ||85||
tau dvau saṃbharadevau saṃvīkṣya prapūjakā janāḥ |
citrakṛtaḥ samastā vai bhrāntimāścaryamiśritām ||86||
avāpuśca muhurgatvā paśyanti catvare gṛhe |
kathaṃ rūpadvayaṃ cāste guroḥ satyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||87||
atha cakruḥ parīkṣāṃ te gṛhe satyo’tha catvare |
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruste samakāle tadobhayoḥ ||88||
gṛhasthasya śarīrāntaḥprabhā sāvaraṇābhavat |
catvarasthasya dīpānāṃ jyotirnirāvaraṇakam ||89||
vyapaśyam̐ste dehamadhye niścikyuścātvaraṃ harim|
gṛhe tu gururūpaṃ taṃ prāhuḥ śrīguruve tataḥ ||3.217.9 0||
gṛhāt tūrṇaṃ bahirvedyāmāyayau saṃbharo harim |
haristūrṇaṃ saṃbhare vai līno babhūva paśyatām ||91 ||
āścaryaṃ sumahaccaitanmatvā tuṣṭuvurutsukāḥ |
hare kṛṣṇa hare viṣṇo nātha nārāyaṇa prabho ||62||
punastau darśanaṃ sākṣād yathā syāt satkṛpāṃ kuru |
nanṛtuste guroragre kīrtanāni pracakrire || 93||
pūjanāni vividhāni gurau mūrtau ca cakrire |
atha madhyāhnavelāyāṃ naivedyārpaṇasatkṣaṇe || 94||
prāvirāsaṃ punastatra gururūpaḥ svayaṃ rame |
atha te māṃ vyapaśyam̐śca divyarūpaṃ guruṃ harim ||95 ||
tataścakrādicihnāḍhyaṃ caturbhujaṃ śriyaḥpatim |
ujjvalaṃ sakirīṭaṃ ca guruvarṇitacihnakam || 96||
hārakuṇḍalakeyūrāpīḍormikādiśobhitam |
śṛṃkhalāmaṇiratnāḍhyabhūṣāmbaraviśeṣṭitam || 97||
āharād bhojayāmāsurārārtrikaṃ vyadhustathā |
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ śreṣṭhasugandhaṃ ca dadurhi me| ||98 ||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakrurnarā nāryo’pi sarvaśaḥ |
vavruścāśīrvacanaṃ me mokṣadaṃ pradadāvaham || 99 ||
proce pūjāṃ drutaṃ citrakṛto mūrtau tirobhavam |
te sarve hṛṣṭamanaso bhejurmāṃ gururūpiṇam || 3.217.100 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaṃ harim |.
atha kālāntare prāpte saṃbharāyuḥprasaṃkṣaye || 101 ||
gajena sākaṃ cānetumāyayau divyavigrahaḥ |
patnīṃ saṃbharadevasya darśayāmāsa madgajam || 1 02||
tato mama svarūpaṃ ca darśayāmāsa caiśvaram |
tataḥ saṃbharadevāya pradadau darśana mama || 1 03||
divyadehaṃ vidhāyaiva bhaktaṃ taṃ saṃbharaṃ tathā |
tappatnīṃ citrasaritābhidhāṃ ca divyavigrahām || 1 04||
vidhāyādāya sauvarṇāmbālikāyāṃ gajopari |
ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathānyān bhaktipākinaḥ || 105||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā citrakāraḥ samuddhṛto’nugaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā || 106 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃbharadevākhyacitrakārasya bhaktyā bhagavatā dattaṃ darśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 217 ||

<3.218>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāmaṃgārahāriṇaḥ |
jharaṇābhūmivāsasya bhaktasya mauktikeśinaḥ || 1 ||
mauktikeśī mamabhakto pārthakulasakhātarāṭ |
kulasānāṃ khanīnāṃ vai khātodyotakaraḥ sadā || 2 ||
sahasraśo janāstatrāṃgārakarmakarāḥ khanau |
khanayanti kulasān vai pārthān kṛṣṇān divāniśam || 3 ||
prātarbhakto bhajitvā māṃ tato yāti khaniṃ prati |
kṣaṇaṃ me bhajanaṃ tatra vidhāpayati bhṛtyakaiḥ || 4 ||
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīśa hare hare || 5 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā bhajanaṃ khanigahvare |
praveśaṃ ca karmacāraiḥ samaṃ karoti satvaram || 6 ||
kṛṣṇaśilāṃgārabhedān nikhananti ca gahvare |
bhajante bhagavantaṃ māṃ śrīpatiṃ śrāntisatkṣaṇe || 7 ||
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ kṛtvā viśrāmyanti tu karmiṇaḥ |
tadā divyaṃ bodhayati mauktikeśī janān yathā || 8 ||
vinā kṛṣṇasya bhajanaṃ saṃsāro gahvaro mahān |
tīryate naiva kenāpi hyagādho vāsanāmayaḥ || 9 ||
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhistarā asaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ |
karmastarāstathā tatra bhinnavyāpāranodakāḥ ||3.218.10||
vinā bhaktiṃ harenaiva tadantaṃ labhate janaḥ |
asaṃgī sādhusaṃgī ca vairāgyāllabhate’ntakam ||1 1||
vartete hṛdaye dvau tau viruddho bhinnagocarau |
eko nayati māyāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paramātmani || 12||
eko vadati bhuñjīya viṣayān māyikāniti |
dvitīyo vadati naiva bhuñjīya māyikāniti || 13||
tatraikaṃ mana evāsti māyikaṃ māyikārthagam |
dvitīyo jīvanāmātmā niṣedhaṃ kurute sadā || 14||
vivicyaivaṃ vijānīyādātmanā parameśvaram |
santyajed viṣayānanyān mokṣarodhakarāniha |||15|||
vāsanā manasā yuktā prerikā viṣayeṣvapi |
lokaviṣayaśabdotthā bhuṃkṣveti sā vadatyapi || 16||
satāṃ kathāprasaṃgotthā bhāvanātmanivāsinī |
mā bhuṃkṣveti niṣedhaṃ vai karoti māyikeṣu sā || 17||
niṣkāsanīyā lokoktirdhāryā sādhukathāsudhā |
pitā mātā suhṛdbandhuḥ svasā bhrātā ca mātulaḥ || 18||
putraḥ patnī mahiṣī gauraśvo vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam |
mamedaṃ ca tavedaṃ cetyevaṃ laukikavāsanāḥ || 19||
ahantāmamatāhetubhūtāḥ kṣipanti gahvare |
bhramanti karmakāṇḍaiśca jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ ||3.218.20||
satāṃ kalyāṇadātṝṇāṃ dhṛtvā vākyāni vai hṛdi |
neme pitā suhṛd bandhurmā bhrātā mātulaḥ svasā ||21||
putraḥ patnī mahiṣī gauraśvo vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam |
nedaṃ mama tavedaṃ na kintu tatparamātmanaḥ ||22||
pitā mātā suhṛd bandhuḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
ahaṃ tu śrīharerdāsaḥ śāśvatiko’smi cetanaḥ ||23||
mokṣado vai pitā mātā taddāso’haṃ subhaktimān |
na me bandho na me māyā na me’hantā na māmakam ||24||
nityaśuddho harerbhakto mukto’smi satsamāgamāt |
vāsanā khalu bandho’sti mokṣo’sti vāsanālayaḥ ||25||
saṃsāre duḥkhabahule sukhaṃ kṛṣṇapade’sti vai |
lokaśabdāḥ satāṃ śabdā yuddhyanti bodhakāriṇaḥ || 26||
tajje jñāne vivekākhye yuddhyato hṛdaye’niśam |
yeṣāṃ balaṃ mahat syādvai tasyaiva vijayo bhavet ||27||
yatra nārāyaṇaścāste yatra santaśca mokṣadāḥ |
tatraiva vijayaścāste māyābalaṃ tu niṣphalam ||28|||
sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇaḥ sādhūnāṃ vijayaḥ sadā |
upadeśasvarūpā vai santo yeṣāṃ hṛdi sthitāḥ ||29||
kathādvārā tathā kṛṣṇo yeṣāṃ hṛtsu sadā sthitaḥ |
teṣāṃ balaṃ ca vijayo jāyate mokṣalābhadaḥ ||3.218.30 ||
bāhyānāṃ tu satāṃ saṃgāt puṣyanti santa āntarāḥ |
bāhyānāmasatāṃ saṃgāt puṣyantyasanta āntarāḥ || 31 ||
puṣṭānāṃ vardhate śaktirapuṣṭānāṃ kṣayo bhavet |
ataḥ santaḥ poṣaṇīyā na tvasantaḥ kadācana |||32||
yathā yathā prasannāḥ syuḥ santo vṛttyaṃ tathā tathā |
satāṃ prasannatā puṣṭistathā kṛṣṇaprasannatā ||33||
evaṃ jāte vijayo vai jīvātmanaḥ prajāyate |
mokṣarājyaṃ labhate’pi kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ mahatsukham ||34||
kṛṣṇārthaṃ yatamānasya sādhusevārthamityapi |
yuddhyamānasya bhaktasya draṣṭāsti bhagavān svarāṭ ||35||
yuddhe eva tu maraṇe draṣṭā prasīdati dhruvam |
yuddhe mṛtyurvijayo’sti svāmī tasmai prasīdati ||36||
svāmipriyehayā mṛtyuṃ gato’yaṃ ceti vetti saḥ |
parāṅmukho na vai jātastato jayaṃ samarhati ||37||
svāmī tasmai dadātyeva phalaṃ jayādhikaṃ hyapi |
tasmād balibhiryoddhavyaṃ jaye sanmukhavakṣasā ||38||
martavyaṃ svāmiprītyarthaṃ yuddhe sanmukhavakṣasā |
bhaktyā dharmeṇa martavyaṃ hṛdi sanmukhaśārṅgiṇā ||39||
satāṃ sevayā martavyaṃ dehe cānvitacakriṇā |
narākṛterharerbhaktyā gantavyaṃ gahvarāntake ||3.218.40||
kusaṃgaḥ sarvathā tyājyaḥ satsaṃgaḥ kārya eva ha |
satāṃ kathā śravaṇīyā dhāryaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā hṛdi ||41||
sadyo niḥśreyasāyaiva gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ |
na vai śārīrasaukhyārthaṃ dhanaputrāptaye’pi na ||42||
na vā rājyādilobhena gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ |
niṣkāmabhāvayuktena gantavyaṃ śaraṇe hareḥ ||43||
sakāmabhāvanā mokṣarodhinī jāyate yataḥ |
icchāghāte śaraṇaṃ ca tyaktavyaṃ syādato na tat ||44||
sakāmaśaraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ grāhyaṃ tvakāmapūrvakam |
jāyate tu dhruvā muktiryena grāhyaṃ hi tattathā ||45||
sakāmāḥ kāmasiddhau tu bhajante bhāvato harim |
kāmāsiddhau tyajantyeva bhāvanāmapi sarvathā ||46||
satāṃ bodhaṃ tyajantyeva bhagavattvasya kā kathā |
nāstikatvaṃ nindanaṃ ca kurvanti pratyutāpi te ||47||
patantyeva nirayeṣu svārthānarthaprayojitāḥ |
tato niṣkāmabhāvena praseveta prabhuṃ harim ||48||
sakāmānāṃ hi saṃkalpān kṛpayā pūrayatyapi |
bhaktānāṃ śaraṇasthānāṃ bhaktiśaraṇajaṃ phalam ||49||
dadātyevānantaguṇaṃ kṛtasāpekṣakaḥ prabhuḥ |
mahad duḥkhaṃ tu bhaktasya svalpaṃ karoti tadvaśaḥ ||3.218.50||
karmaṇāṃ khalu maryādā baddhāstenaiva śārṅgiṇā |
antarastho hariḥ prārabdhānusāraṃ phalaṃ sadā ||51||
samavṛttirdadātyeva kṛpayā tu viśeṣataḥ |
svatantraḥ sarvakartāsti niyāmakaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||52||
atiduṣkarmiṇaścainaṃ bhaveyuryadi satprabhum |
kṛpayā śrīharisteṣāṃ karmāṇi subahūnyapi ||53||
dīrghakālena bhogyāni duṣṭāni duḥkhadānyapi |
karoti svalpakālena svalpabhogyāni tāni vai ||54||
śūlavyathāṃ kaṇṭakena nivārayati sarvathā |
atidāridryaduḥkhaṃ nivārayatyannavastradaḥ |||55||
bhaktā hareḥ kṛpāṃ tvenāṃ prajānanti na cāpare |
abhaktāstu harau doṣān kalpayantyaguṇānapi ||56||
anīśvaratvaṃ cākṣipya jahatyapi tadāśrayam |
nindanti nijatulyeṣu vadantyavācyajalpakān ||57||
mayā matvā prabhuṃ dravyavyayo vai sarvathā kṛtaḥ |
asya santaḥ pūjitāśca sarvasvārpaṇakāriṇā ||58||
tathāpyanena duḥkhaṃ me na hṛtaṃ kiñcidityapi |
upakāro na me jñātaścāgre me kiṃ kariṣyati ||59||
tasmāt tyakto mayā cāyaṃ nārāyaṇapadārthavān |
evaṃ tyaktvā prayātyeva māyāyāṃ niraye tataḥ ||3.218.60||
tasmāt kṛṣṇasya bhaktirvai kartavyā tu nirīhayā |
śreyase tvātmano lakṣmi na kāmalabdhaye kvacit ||61 ||
sevā sakāmabhaktasya nāṅgīkaroti mādhavaḥ |
sevake kāmanāvattvaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ lālasātmakam ||62|||
tṛṣṇecchā lālasā tvekā hyaparādhasya mūrtayaḥ |
na kartavyā harau kvāpi lālasā bhaktiśālinā ||63||
lālasāyā apūrṇatve drohaḥ syātparamātmanaḥ |
drohaścāstyaparādho vai mahānnārāyaṇasya ha ||64||
drohaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca nindāṃ ca doṣānuvarṇanaṃ tathā |
guṇānāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ mithyāropaṇaṃ kṣamate na saḥ ||65||
harervā haribhaktasyāparādhaṃ svalpamityapi |
kṣamate na haristasmānna kāryaḥ sarvathā hi saḥ ||66||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyākārakhaṇḍanam |
saguṇasya nirasanaṃ satāṃ ca khaṇḍanaṃ tathā ||67||
aparādho mahāneva mahānarakasampradaḥ |
na kartavyaḥ kvacit jñātvāpyajñātvā saṃgaraṃgataḥ ||68||
parame divyaloke’yaṃ nije’kṣare pade prabhuḥ |
divyākṛtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti puruṣottamaḥ ||69||
divyāsaṃkhyabrahmamuktaiḥ sevito māṇikīpatiḥ |
kṛpayā sa prabhuścātra vartate mānavātmakaḥ ||3.218.70 ||
divyo’pi dṛśyate cātra mānavo bhautiko yayā |
na tvayaṃ bhautikaścāste kintu divyo yathākṣare ||71 ||
asmaccakṣurbhautikaṃ yat tadgrāhyo vartate svavat |
kṛpayaiva hariścaiva darśayatyeva nastviha ||72||
yathā bhaktastathā tena grāhyaḥ kṛpāvaśo’sti saḥ |
sa eva bhaktavargaistu boddhavyo divyavigrahaḥ ||73||
tasmātparaṃ na caivāsti prāptavyaṃ jñeyamityapi |
yadīcchati svabhakto vai draṣṭuṃ dhāmāni sampadaḥ ||74||
tadā kṛpālurbhagavān darśayatyeva sarvathā |
yad divyaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tattu sahaiva vartate ||75||
vaibhavā hariṇā sākamaiśvaryāṇyapi santi ca |
akṣareṇa nijadhāmnā parivāreṇa saṃyutaḥ ||76||
vartate bhūtale kṛṣṇo dṛśyate naracakṣuṣā |
naravaccākṣaraṃ dhāma bhūvacceṣṭāsamā guṇāḥ ||77||
muktā mānavatulyāśca kriyāśca prākṛtā yathā |
dhāmasthānāṃ ca bhūsthānāṃ manāg bhedo na vidyate ||78||
divyasamādhinetrāstu vicakṣate sudivyakān |
yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma tatra muktāśca śaktayaḥ ||79||
te sarve mānavairbhaktairarpitānnajalāmbaram |
dhanasampadgṛhādyaṃ ca gṛhṇanti mānavā iva ||3.218.80||
tathāpi nispṛhāste tu bhaktakalyāṇahetave |
gṛhṇanti tāni divyāni jāyante tatprasaṃgataḥ ||81 ||
dātāro divyarūpaṃ tallabhante tvakṣare pade |
kṛṣṇasyaivaṃ tathā tasya bhaktānāṃ ca satāṃ sadā ||82||
vedanīyaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ cetthaṃ divyapramuktidam |
kṛṣṇamāhātmyayuktasya vipado na bhavanti vai ||8 3||
kṛṣṇabhaktaśca raṃko’pi nāvamānyaḥ kadācana |
raṃkāvamanturnāśaḥ syāt tatsthakṛṣṇasya pīḍanāt ||84||
kṛṣṇakriyāḥ samagrāśca yathā divyāstathaiva ca |
bhaktānāmapi divyāstā mantavyā bhaktivedinā ||85||
harirbhaktamanaḥprītyai ramate bhaktamānavaiḥ |
kāmena ramate cāpi hāsyena ramate tathā ||86||
ceṣṭayā cāpi sadṛśyā ramate strījanaiḥ saha |
tathāpi tūrdhvaretastvaṃ koṭistrīṇāṃ smayāvaham ||87||
dharate śrīhariḥ koṭirūpadhṛk kāmagarvahāḥ |
narākṛtiḥ svabhaktārthaṃ karoti naravat kriyāḥ ||88||
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ lobhaṃ mohaṃ śokaṃ ca matsaram |
darśayati kvacittadvai sarvaṃ maṃgalakṛnnṛṇām ||89||
śrutaṃ ca kathitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dhyātaṃ cāpyanumoditam |
caritaṃ śrīhareḥ sarvaṃ mānavānāṃ hi mokṣadam ||3.218.90||
narākāraḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vai nṛṇāṃ manāṃsi pūrayet |
nṛṇāṃ sājātyabhāvena sevādharmo harau bhavet ||91 ||
tena niḥśreyasaṃ vindet sevitācca prasāditāt |
raṃko’pi dāsyabhāvo’pi dāsyapi naguṇāpi ca ||92||
dṛḍhakṛṣṇāśrayasyaiva pramodanaṃ sadā bhavet |
jātaṃ me paramaṃ śreyo mokṣyante mama saṃginaḥ ||93||
kṛtārtho’haṃ kṛtārthāste ye me vacanavartinaḥ |
santaḥ santi mamātmānaścātmadarśī sadāsmyaham ||94||
hariṃ sato’nyannaivāsti draṣṭavyaṃ mama māyikam |
evaṃ mama nivāso’tra bhūtale’pi pare’kṣare |||95||
vidyate nātra sandehaścaivaṃ jñātvā bhajantu tam |
rakṣākṛd bhagavānatra paratrāpi tvaviṣyati ||96||
ityupādiśya saṃśrutvā yayuḥ khanau tu karmaṇe |
haristeṣāṃ parīkṣārthaṃ khanibhittau jalāgamam ||97||
mahāsaritsvarūpeṇa gartaṃ kṛtvā samānayat |
khātena bhittibhaṃgādvai mahāsaritpravāhavat ||98||
pravāhaḥ sahasā tatra gahvare samajāyata |
sarve jñānena tṛptāste mṛtyubhayavivarjitāḥ ||99||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ sasmarū rame |
jalaṃ tu gahvare tatra sarovarasamaṃ hyabhūt || 3.218.10 0||
bhagnā nimagnā bhaktāste bhajanto māṃ ramāpatim |
ātmaniṣṭhā jñāninaśca dṛḍhāśrayāstu te hṛdi || 10 1||
dadhyurmāṃ tvantarātmānaṃ samādhāviva modinaḥ |
mauktikeśī mama bhakto māṃ prasasmāra bhūkhanau || 1 02||
bhūgarbhe śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jalamagno’tibhaktimān |
athāhaṃ duḥkhahīnānāṃ bhajatāṃ karmacāriṇām ||103||
prāvirāsaṃ khanau tatra jalamadhye jalārdanaḥ |
sudarśanena cakreṇāśoṣayaṃ vāri sarvagam || 104||
kṣaṇenaiva palenaiva pravāhaṃ cāpyarodhayam |
svasthāste mama bhaktā vai dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ sudarśanam || 1 05||
dṛṣṭvā māṃ te nimagnā vai kṣaṇaṃ sukhe tu śāśvate |
atha māṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ prārthayāmāsurakṣaram || 10 6||
dhāma mokṣārthamevāpi tathāstvityavadaṃ tu tān |
bhaktidārḍhyaṃ samādiśya tūrṇaṃ tirobhavaṃ tataḥ || 1 07||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
evaṃ mantraṃ dadau tebhyo mauktikeśī khanīśvaraḥ || 108||
sarve te jāpamātreṇa divyajñānā prajajñire |
atha kālāntare mauktikeśinaṃ cānyamānavān || 1 09||
vimānenānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ me paramaṃ padam |
evaṃ māyā kulasānāṃ khanikhātāḥ parīkṣitāḥ || 3.218.1 10||
rakṣitā mokṣitāścāpi lakṣmi kṛpānukarṣiṇā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne mauktikeśināmno bhaktasya śilāṃgārakhanīśvarasya bhaktyā parīkṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||

<3.219>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ lubdhakasya tathā kathām |
bhaktasya piñjalagrāmasthitasya sādhusevinaḥ || 1 ||
nāmnā cakradharaścāsīllubdhako hiṃsane rataḥ |
śūdravarṇaḥ kuṭumbasya bharaṇe cauryakārakaḥ || 2 ||
paśūnāṃ stena evāpi sasvāmināṃ mahānapi |
āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca śaśādīnāṃ ca hiṃsakaḥ || 3 ||
karoti krūratāpūrvaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇatṛptaye |
athaikadā vane’gacchaddhariṇāśāprakarṣitaḥ || 4 ||
vṛkṣastambavaṃśaṣaṇḍepaśyaddhariṇarūpiṇam |
pautimāṣyaṃ maharṣiṃ ca tadbhāryāṃ hariṇīṃ tathā || 5 ||
nāmnā sāmakṛṣiṃ mṛgavadhūṃ mṛgīsvarūpiṇīm |
patrapuṣpatṛṇabhakṣyau navāṃkuraphalāśinau || 6 ||
surūpau sumṛgau vīkṣya lubdhakaḥ śaramādadhe |
tāvadṛṣirvilokyainaṃ tiro’bhavanmṛgīyutaḥ || 7 ||
cakradharo’pi sandihya vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe gatau hi tau |
mārgayituṃ tūrṇameva kramānukramaṇaṃ yayau || 8 ||
tadāmbaragirā prāha maharṣistaṃ tu lubdhakam |
mā pāpin pāpavānatra vṛthā mano niveśaya || 9 ||
nāhaṃ mṛgaḥ pautimāṣyo maharṣiścāsmi vanyabhuk |
sabhāryo’tra vane nityaṃ vicarāmi sukhasthitaḥ || 2.219.1 0||
yāhyanyatra mahāpāpin mokṣātpatita ityapi |
mānavaṃ dehamāsādya mokṣaṃ kathaṃ na vāñchasi || 11 ||
śrutvā tu lubdhakaścāha nityaṃ viṣayavāñchayā |
māṃsādano bhavāmyatra kāmasya puṣṭilabdhaye || 1 2||
pautimāṣyastataḥ prāha kāmo nirayadastava |
yatra hiṃsā hyadharmo’sti prāṇināṃ ghātabhakṣaṇam ||1 3||
sadā te narake vāso bhaviṣyatīti mā tathā |
saṃbhavaṃ mānavaṃ kāme nikṣipya narakaṃ vaha || 14||
śṛṇu lubdhaka vārtā me rocate yadi te tadā |
kathayāmi hitārthāya satāṃ saṃgo hi tārakaḥ || 15||
kāmo’yaṃ dehajo doṣaścānnapānādisaṃbhavaḥ |
vīryarūpaḥ sthūlabhāgo jāyate dehadhātukaḥ || 16||
dehe sarvatra vīryasya kaṇā bhavanti puṣṭidāḥ |
ta ete kāmadevasya sthūlarūpaṃ hi bhautikam || 17||
athāntaraṃ manaścāpi manovahāsthitaṃ sadā |
dehe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe kṛtvā bhramaṇaṃ sarvadhātuṣu || 18||
vīryaṃ saṃkalpayathanairākarṣayati kukṣiṣu |
sivanīnāḍikāmūle caikatritaṃ prajāyate || 19||
manasā sahitaṃ taccābhedamāpannamityapi | 
bhūtvā manasi samvyāptaṃ sūkṣmarūpamano’nvitam ||2.219.20||
hetubhirvāsanāvegaiḥ śiśne sravate karmaṇā |
tasmāt kāmastrividho’sti trideho vartate sadā ||21||
kāraṇaṃ vāsanārūpaḥ sūkṣmastu mānasātmakaḥ |
sthūlastu vīryarūpaḥ sa māyiko nātmanastu saḥ ||22||
ātmā brahmasvarūpo’sti sarvendriyaniyāmakaḥ |
romalohitamāṃsāsthimajjāsnāyūvilakṣaṇaḥ ||23||
vīryaṃ ṣaṭkoṣadharmo’sti saptamo bhogavāhakaḥ |
aśuddhadvāravāsaścāśuddhadvāravinirgamaḥ || 24||
aśuddhadehabandhaśca pāpayāmyapurapradaḥ |
kāmāddhiṃsā krodhamohau vāsanāśuddhacintanam ||25||
janma karma ca maraṇaṃ duḥkhamudvejanaṃ tathā |
jāyante taṃ duṣṭakāmaṃ tyaktvā dharmeṇa vartaya ||26||
ṛtudānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ |
nādhiko bhoga āptavyo mokṣamārgavirodhakṛt ||27||
sādhavo munayaḥ satyo sādhvyastyāgaparāyaṇāḥ |
ātmānandanimagnāste kāmaṃ tyajanti dūrataḥ ||28||
yogābhyāsena dehotthaṃ dhātuṃ rakṣanti sarvathā |
mano niyamya satataṃ nirmūlayanti vāsanāḥ ||29||
ūrdhvavīryāḥ prajāyante naiṣṭhikā brahmacāriṇaḥ |
prasvedasrāvaśūnyāste svāpnasrāvavivarjitāḥ ||2.219.30||
brahmātmānandamagnāste jāyante yatayo’malāḥ |
īśavatte samarthā vai viṣṇuvat sampadīśvarāḥ ||31||
vedhovat sṛṣṭidhātāro jāyante pārameśvarāḥ |
brahmacaryaparāṇāṃ tu pratyutthāyānalānilāḥ ||32||
mūrtimantaḥ svāgatārthaṃ prayānti mahimāvidaḥ |
bhogānte brahmaparamaṃ cāptavyaṃ manudharmiṇā ||33||
bhogastṛṣṇāntako nāsti bhoge tṛṣṇā vivardhate |
tasmād bhogān parityajya bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||34||
cakradhara hariṃ cakradharaṃ vai śaraṇaṃ vraja |
māyācakraṃ vibhidyaiva brahmacakragato bhava ||35 ||
ityukto muninā cakradharo lakṣmi śubhāśayaḥ |
upadeśairabhavacca vivṛttamānasaḥ khalu ||36||
aicchacca darśanaṃ tasya pautimāṣyasya vai guroḥ |
prārthayad darśanārthaṃ ca gururmānavarūpadhṛk ||37||
dadau svadarśanaṃ tasmai jalapānamakārayat |
pādajalaṃ dadau cāpi pāpāni samanāśayat ||38||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
mantraṃ datvā vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ vṛndāpatrairvyadhāpayat ||39||
lubdhako’pi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bheje tataḥ param |
gṛhaṃ gatvā tīrthapūtaḥ patnīṃ pūtāṃ vyadhāpayat ||2.219.40||
hiṃsāṃ cauryaṃ sadā tyaktvābhajanmāṃ parameśvaram |
tulasīpādape kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pūjayate sa mām ||41 ||
vanyaphalārpaṇaiḥ prasādajairyātrāṃ vahatyapi |
satāṃ sevāṃ vanyaphalaistata ārabhya nityadā ||42||
karoti sādhurūpo vai jaṭādharo’bhavattataḥ |
patnī jaṭādharī bhasmadharī tulasīpūjikā ||43||
abhavadvratasampannā vighasāśitvaśālinī |
evaṃ viśuddhamanaso bhaktyāhaṃ munivāñcchayā ||44||
tasya mokṣaṃ vidhātuṃ tu kālāgame hyupasthitaḥ |
divyamūrtirhariścāhaṃ tena dṛṣṭaśca yoṣitā ||45||
nipetatuśca te pādau praṇamya rajasā plutau |
mokṣārthaṃ tvaritau kṛtvā svāgataṃ mama vihvalau ||46||
premamagnau vanyaphalaṃ me samarpya drutaṃ gaje |
dehau tyaktvāruruhatustadānīṃ divyavigrahau ||47||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ jagmatustau tu mayā saṃpreṣitau rame |
evaṃ muktiḥ kṛtā lubdhakasya sadguruyogataḥ ||48||
tathaiva tu satāṃ ye syurbhaktāsteṣāṃ tu vāsanāḥ |
vinaśyanti manaścāpi nirmalaṃ jāyate sadā ||49||
kāmakrodhādayo doṣā naśyantyaghāni yānyapi |
bhūtvā divyasvarūpāste kṛpayā me satāṃ tathā ||2.219.50 ||
prayānti brahma paramaṃ lakṣmi śāśvatasaukhyadam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ||51||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lubdhakasya cakradharasya pautimāṣyarṣisaṃgena hiṃsādipāpanāśe bhaktyuttara muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 219 ||

<3.220>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ bhaktasya piśunasya vai |
kathāṃ saṃbhalanagare sthitasyātmanivedinaḥ || 1 ||
nānnābhavad vāṭadharo bhakto nṛpasya sevakaḥ |
sutārasiṃhanāmnastu sevakaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ || 2 ||
kuśalo rājanītyāṃ ca caturo rājarañjane |
kṛtaśramo vyavahāre śāstre vinimayādiṣu || 3 ||
prasādabhūto rājñaśca rājñyā mānasya cāśrayaḥ |
rāṇakuṭumbabhaktaśca khavāsavarṇamūrddhagaḥ || 4 ||
paśyati tīkṣṇayā buddhyā karoti matinā tathā |
vicārayati jñānena prajñayā mantrayatyapi || 5 ||
arthāvadhāriṇī buddhirmatirāgābhigocarā |
jñānaṃ vivekavaiśadyaṃ prajñā tu pratibhā navā |.| 6 ||
evaṃ vāṭadhare cāste vijñānaṃ kovide yathā |
asādhyasya tu kāryasya vāṭaṃ mārgayati dhruvam || 7 ||
pāraṃ karoti kāryasya praśasto’to nṛpādiṣu |
yathā vṛddho yathā mantrī yathā nyāyī yathā guruḥ || 8 ||
evaṃvidho’yaṃ vāṭadhro yadyapi śreṣṭhanītimān |
tathāpi prakṛtivaśaḥ paiśunyaṃ carati kvacit || 9 ||
rājñyā nṛpāya nṛpate rājñyai nṛpasya mantriṇe |
mantriṇastu prajābhyaśca rājñyai nṛpāya vai kvacit ||3.220.1 0||
aprakāśaṃ yathā tatsyānna jānīyu pare tu tat |
eka eva vijānīyācchrotā tathā vadatyasau || 1 1||
athaikadā tu saṃkrāntau dānaṃ rājñī dadau bahu |
viprebhyo dīnavargebhyaḥ sādhubhyo bhojanādikam || 1 2||
pracchannaṃ maṇiratnādi rājā jānāti naiva yat |
nijahastagataṃ dvaipīrājñī dānaṃ dadau dhanam || 1 3||
vāṭadharo vijānāti dvaipyā dātuṃ niyojitaḥ |
dānottaraṃ bhojanaṃ ca rājñī sadbhyo dadau śubham || 14||
sādhavo bhuñjate bhojyamiṣṭānnāni hariśritāḥ |
tatra viraktaścaiko’bhūd ghaṭyayanābhidho yatiḥ || 15||
vasati ghaṭikāmātramekasthale tu nādhikam |
tasya vai bhojane tatra jāyamāne tu paṃktiśaḥ || 1 6||
jātāsya ghaṭikā pūrṇotthāya vihāya bhojanam |
yayau vṛkṣāntaraṃ tatra ghaṭikāṃ tasthivān punaḥ || 17||
jalaṃ pītvā punastasmādanyasthalaṃ yayau hi saḥ |
eva sa ghaṭikāṃ sthitvā yāti sthalāntaraṃ muhuḥ ||18 ||
vāṭadharo vilokyainaṃ tyaktabhojyaṃ ca cañcalam |
sāye sammṛgya yatrāste tatra taṃ prāptavān drutam ||19||
gatvā natvā phalaṃ prārpya vandanaṃ saṃvidhāya ca |
papraccha kāraṇaṃ tatra cāñcalyasya naman muhuḥ ||3.220.20||
ghaṭyayanastu taṃ prāha lakṣmi cāñcalyakāraṇam |
ekatra ghaṭikordhvaṃ tvasthāyitvaṃ sadguṇo’sti saḥ ||21||
bandhanaṃ na bhavet kvāpi rāgaḥ kvāpi na jāyate |
mamatā jāyate naiva vairāgyaḥ sarvadā bhavet ||22||
aparigraha evāpi vrataṃ tena tu rakṣyate |
ciraṃ vāsastu bandhāya ciravāsaṃ na cācaret ||23||
jale sthale pādape vā ciravāso bhayāvahaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ godohamātraṃ ghaṭīmātraṃ sthirāsanam ||24||
ghaṭyāsanaṃ tu māyāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe śāśvatāsanam |
viditvaivaṃ vivekena cāñcalyaṃ niyamo mama ||25 ||
saṃgāt sañjāyate snehaḥ snehācca mamatā bhavet |
tayāsaktistayā tatra vāsanā jāyate muhuḥ ||26||
sahavāso bandhanaṃ vai viyogo mokṣaṇaṃ param |
vāsanā sarvathā tyājyā saṃgastyājyo mahātmanā ||27||
nirvāsanatvamāptabyaṃ vairāgyeṇa vivekinā |
bhagavanniṣṭhāyuktena cātmaniṣṭhāyutena ca |||28||
duḥkhadoṣānudṛṣṭyā ca vinirvāsanatā bhavet |
ahamātmā harerbhakto na māyāyā na karmaṇām || 29 ||
saccidānandarūpo’haṃ bhinno naśvaravarṣmaṇaḥ |
akṣareśasya kṛṣṇasya dṛḍhāśrayayuto’smyaham ||3.220.30||
māyāyāṃ me na vai rāgo raso nendriyagocare |
āntare śrīvāsudeve vasāmyānandayāmi ca ||3 1 ||
evaṃ vivekino nityaṃ dṛḍhavairāgyaśālinaḥ |
śreṣṭhaviṣayayoge’pi rāgāṅkuro na jāyate ||3 2||
ramaṇīye divyabhoge vartamāno’pi conmanāḥ |
asaṃgyudāsīna āste sa nirvāsanako mataḥ || 3 3||
satāṃ guṇām̐śca gṛhṇīyurvijānīyuśca divyatām |
te’pi divyaguṇāḍhyāḥ syurmāyāvijayinaḥ sadā ||34||
ye tu satāṃ pragṛhṇanti doṣānavaguṇām̐stathā |
kāmādikām̐stuṃ te kāmādyāvṛttāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 35||
kāmādyaiḥ pīḍyamānāste bhramanti cātiduḥkhinaḥ |
na mokṣaṃ nāpi susvargamaihikaṃ vāpnuvanti te ||36||
āpnuvanti hi narakān nindakāḥ pāpinaḥ khalāḥ |
narā nāryaḥ satāṃ saṃge manvate divyatāṃ tu ye ||37||
te yānti brahmaparamaṃ divyabhāvātivardhitāḥ |
tadindriyāṇi māyāyāṃ kuṇṭhitāni bhavanti hi ||38||
rājā vā syād gṛhastho vā samṛddho bhogavānapi |
jñānamīdṛk samālabhya viṣayordhve sa vartate || 39|| |
prārabdhapuṇyayogena cāste viṣayamadhyagaḥ |
tathāpi sādhuvaccāste yogīva lepavarjitaḥ |||3.220.40|| |
bhuñjannapi hyabhoktaiva jalaṃ sarojanī yathā |
ambladantaścaṇakānāṃ yathā karoti carvaṇam ||41||
tathā viṣayagrahaṇe śakto naiva prajāyate |
vāsanā līyate tena kuṇṭhitasya tu māyikī ||42||
māyārasaṃ manāg vetti yastasya vāsanā nahi |
apasarpati hṛdayānmāyārasaṃ tyajettataḥ ||43||
pratyakṣabhagavanmūrtau jānīyāt sarvapūrṇatām |
tenaiva sarvakāryāṇi siddhyanti bhaktayoginaḥ ||44||
kṛtvā satsaṃgamevātra jñātavyaṃ tvetadeva yat |
evaṃ jñāturhariḥ sarvaṃ sādhayatyeva vāñchitam | |45||
harau mano’rpayituśca naśyanti vāsanāstviha |
yenārpitaṃ manaḥ kṛṣṇe tasya kṛṣṇaṃ vinā kṣaṇam ||46||
yugāyate viyoge vā dāhaḥ syāddhṛdaye mahān |
kṛṣṇeprāpte bhavecchāntirdidṛkṣā vardhate’nvaham ||47||
kṛṣṇapratāpaśravaṇe prītirbhūritarā bhaveta |
kṛṣṇasambandhikāryeṣu ruciḥ śreṣṭhatayā bhavet ||48||
kṛṣṇādeśasyācaraṇe sadā tatparatā bhavet |
evaṃvidho dūrago’pi vartate mādhavāntike ||49||
ājñollaṃghanakārī tu premahīno hyanarpitaḥ |
sahasthito’pi dūravad bodhyaḥ svārthī khalādhipaḥ ||3.220.50||
tasmād yathā svahṛdaye vasati mādhavaḥ prabhuḥ |
tathātmanā vidhātavyo vāso’kṣare pade’sya vai ||51 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
evaṃ mantraṃ raṭa nitya pūjayācyutamīśvaram ||52||
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa ramāpate |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagatpate ||53||
evaṃ nityaṃ bhajanaṃ śrīhareḥ śrāvaya saṃgine |
prājñe rājñai prajābhyaśca tena śreyo bhaviṣyati ||54||
ityevaṃ lakṣmyupadeśaṃ dadau vāṭadharāya saḥ |
dhaṭyayano harerdāsaḥ sādhuḥ sadguṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||55||
vāṭadhro’pi gṛhaṃ gatvā bheje yathāniveditam |
bhajanaṃ ca tathā cakre hare kṛṣṇeti nityaśaḥ ||56||
ghaṭyayanastu prayayau grāmāntaraṃ hariṃ smaran |
vāṭadhrastu mahābhakto jāto mokṣakaro yathā ||57||
rājñe rājñyai prajābhyaśca dadau mantraṃ hi mokṣadam |
bhajanaṃ kārayāmāsa hare kṛṣṇeti sarvathā ||58||
bhaktiyuktasya loke’tra sadguṇāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ||
tathāpi durguṇo jātisvabhāvo na nivartate ||59||
yadyapi syānmahābhakto yathā vai garuḍastathā |.
sarpabhakṣitvametasya jātiguṇo na naśyati ||3.220.60||
vānarā rāmabhaktāśca paśudharmān tyajanti na |
siṃho bhakto’pi pārvatyā hiṃsanaṃ na jahāti saḥ ||61||
kṣatriyo viṣṇubhakto’pi saṃgrāmaṃ na jahāti saḥ |
kirāto viṣṇubhakto’pi vanyarītiṃ jahāti na ||62||
gauḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya bhaktāśca rambhaṇaṃ na jahatyapi |
khavāso’yaṃ viṣṇubhaktaḥ piśunatvaṃ jahau na ca ||63||
paraguptaṃ śatrave vānyasmai guṇāguṇātmakam |
pracchannamiva vaktavyaṃ tadvai piśunatā matā ||64||
yatphalaṃ jāyate kleśo yuddhaṃ kalaha ityapi |
vaimanasyaṃ samudvegaḥ krodho vā nāśanaṃ hyapi ||65||
taramāt kāryaṃ na paiśunyaṃ kasyaciccāparāya ha |
guṇānāṃ darśanaṃ kāryaṃ na tu doṣapradarśanam ||66||
guṇagrāhī sukhaṃ yāti jāyate puṇyavānapi |
doṣagrāhī bhaved duḥkhī jāyate pāpavānapi ||67||
hānipradaṃ hi paiśunyaṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tu guṇapradam |
paiśunyaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ śikṣaṇaṃ kvacit ||68||
yogyatā cedbhavettarhi nānyathā śikṣaṇaṃ hyapi |
pitre mātre tathā bhrātre svasre nanāndre yoṣite ||69||
pataye bandhave śiṣyāyāpi putryai sutāya vā |
vadhve vṛddhāya bālāya vaktavyaṃ piśunaṃ nahi ||3.220.70||
rājñe rājñyai hyamātyāya rājaputrāya sarvathā |
prajābhyo naiva vaktavyaṃ paiśunyaṃ nṛpateḥ kvacit ||71 ||
khavāsajātidoṣeṇa paiśunyamekadākarot |
rājñe nivedayāmāsa rājñyā dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tviti ||72|||
guptaṃ hīrakaratnādi dattavatī dvijātaye |
sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ cāpi bhūṣāśca pradadāviti ||73||
atha rājā guptadhanaṃ dāne dattaṃ viditya ca |
rājñīmāhūya papraccha vada dattaṃ dhanādikam ||74||
anājñayā pradattaṃ yanneṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ hi tanmama |
pracchannaṃ te dhanaṃ sarvaṃ tavārthaṃ rakṣitaṃ sadā ||75|
na dānārthaṃ bhavettadvai dattaṃ tannocitaṃ kṛtam |
nāryā vihāya patyājñāṃ na kartavyaṃ tu kiñcana ||76||
yātu tai pitaraṃ rājñi pracchannā na priyā priyā |
pracchannavyayakartrī yā sā kvacit sarvanāśinī ||77||
prajāyeta mayā naitādṛśī rakṣyā gṛhe priyā |
yāhi svapitaraṃ devi vasa tatra ciraṃ sukham ||78||
ityuktā sā bahuśokaṃ prāptā ruroda bhāminī |
atha rājā khavāsasya dvārarūpasya dānake ||79||
daṇḍaṃ vyadhāddhi sarvasvahārakaṃ nigaḍe’karot |
kartā kārayitā cānumodayitā samo’naye ||3.220.80||
iti rājā dadau daṇḍaṃ jahāra gṛhavāṭikāḥ |
dhanadravyaṃ jahārāpi bhaktasya vāṭadhāriṇaḥ ||8 1 ||
vāṭadhro’pi hariṃ bheje nigaḍastho’tidīnavat |
rājñī mānavihīnā ca svasaudhe’śanavarjitā |||82||
vratasthā hyabhavattūrṇaṃ martukāmā tu vaiṣṇavī |
dānadharme na vai duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ duḥkhamupasthitam ||83||
duḥkhaharo harikṛṣṇo duḥkhaṃ me vyapakarṣatu |
ityevaṃ mama mūrtyagre kṛtānaśanikā sthitā||84||
nigaḍastho’pi vāṭadhrastathaivānaśane sthitaḥ |
dānakārye na vai daṇḍo bhavenmatvā hariṃ pratiṃ |||85||||
nivedya duḥkhamutpannaṃ dadhyau svahṛdaye prabhum |
prakāśe’pi sa vṛttāntaḥ prasasāra prajādiṣu ||86||
prajāsu vipravargeṣu sādhuṣu pramadāsu ca |
śoko viveśa sahasā rājñā yogyaṃ na tatkṛtam ||87||
evaṃ vārtā tu sarvatra prācarad dānaśaṃsinī |
dānaṃ dharmo hi rājñāṃ vai rājñyā kṛtaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtam ||88||
rājño dravyasya nāstyeva nyūnatā rājyabhoginaḥ |
ityevaṃ vai prajāsvevābhavad vārtātiśobhanā ||89||
rājñīduḥkhavināśārthaṃ vāṭadhārasya śāntaye |
prajāścāpi hariṃ smṛtvāśīrvādān sukhadān daduḥ ||3.220.90||
vigate’naśane tatra saptāhe niśi mādhavaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’haṃ nigaḍālaye ||91||
bhaktarakṣākaro’gacchaṃ rājñyāśca mandire tathā |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakirīṭahāraśobhitaḥ ||92 ||
datvā svadarśanaṃ dugdhapānaṃ rājñyai dadāvaham |
vāṭadhrāya dadāveva dugdhapānaṃ tataḥ param ||93||
āśvāsanaṃ pradāyaiva rājasaudhamupāyayau |
viprarūpo’titejasvī dharmaśastravidāṃ varaḥ || 94||
rājāsanaṃ dadau me ca mayā pṛṣṭo nirāmayam |
akleśaṃ ca kuṭumbasya sa cāha māṃ tu sāmayam ||95||
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa kleśasya kāraṇaṃ nṛpaḥ |
upādiśaṃ tato rājñe strīdhane strī svatantrikā ||96||
tatrāpi dānarūpe tu yogyā sā puṇyakāriṇī |
patistarati nāryā vai dharmiṇyā bhaktiyoṣitā ||97||
godānaṃ ratnadānaṃ ca bhūṣādānaṃ hi tārayet |
patiṃ nṛpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ śreṣṭhadānaṃ hi tārayet ||98||
tasmād rājan satīṃ nārīṃ pramānaya yathocitam |
vāṭadhraṃ mānaya cāpi satkāryakāriṇaṃ tviha ||99||
ityuktvā taijasā vyāptamadarśayaṃ svayaṃ svakam |
rupaṃ rājñe mumudāsau rājā papāta pādayoḥ || 3.220.1 00||
yayāce sa kṣamāṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ nārāyaṇālaye |
adṛśyo’hamabhavaṃ ca pūjāmādāya yatkṛtām ||1 01||
rājā rājñīṃ khavāsaṃ ca mānayāmāsa satkṛtaiḥ |
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa dānaśaṃsāṃ śubhāṃ tathā || 1 02||
kalahaṃ śāntayāmāsa snehabhāṣaṇadānakaiḥ |
pratyarpaṇaistu vāṭadhrāyāpi mānaṃ vyadhāttathā || 1 03||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā rājñī tadā surakṣitā |
martukāmā mūrchitā sā kṣudhayā dugdhapāyitā ||1 04||
vāṭadharo’pi me bhakto rakṣito rājadaṇḍataḥ |
atha kāle samāpanne rājānaṃ bhaktivedinam ||105||
rājñīṃ vāṭadharaṃ cāpi vimānenānayaṃ nijam |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma paiśunyavarjitaṃ tataḥ || 1 06||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pāpanāśanam |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi svargaṃ sveṣṭaṃ paraṃ rame ||1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vāṭadharasya piśunakhavāsasya tathā dvaipīrājñyāśca sutārasiṃhanṛpaterdaṇḍād bhagavatā kṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||

<3.221>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ gṛhakārasya vai kathām |
takṣaśilāyāṃ puryāṃ vai nāmnā śivajayo’bhavat || 1 ||
bhaktaḥ prāsādakuśalo mandiragṛhakṛtkalaḥ |
nagarīracanāvijño devālayādikārakaḥ || 2 ||
śilpivaryaḥ sbabuddhyaiva kurute ca kalodbhavam |
rājaprāsādanirmātāviṣkṛtanavaghaṭṭanaḥ || 3 ||
navākṛtikaraścāpi navakakṣādigocaraḥ |
asaṃkhyanāṇakaiḥ saudhān nirmāti daivasadṛśān || 4 ||
ekadā vṛṣaparvākhyaḥ ṛṣistaṃ samupāyayau |
mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ sādhudharmā susaṃyataḥ || 5 ||
utthāya sahasā śivajayaḥ svāgatamācarat |
arghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca dadāvṛṣaye bhāvavān || 6 ||
nyaṣādayad ramyapūtāsane jalaṃ samārpayat |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāṃgamardanaṃ ca vyadhādṛṣeḥ || 7 ||
ṛṣistasya tu kuśalaṃ papraccha prītamānasaḥ |
so’pi tavāgamādatra kuśalaṃ me uvāca tam || 8 ||
yatra sādhoścaraṇau vai pūjyete śraddhayā gṛhe |
tadgṛhaṃ divyaveti śmasānaṃ tu tadanyakam || 9 ||
adya me kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tvakuśalaṃ mama |
dhanyo’smi daivapuruṣo rājate yadgṛhe’dya vai || 3.221.1 0||
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya vṛṣaparvāṇamāha saḥ |
kuśalaṃ paramaṃ yattacchādhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 1 1||
atha lakṣmi vṛṣaparvā smṛtvānādinarāyaṇam |
upādideśa bahudhā śivajayāya muktaye || 1 2||
śivajayākarṇaya tvaṃ snehaḥ kṛṣṇe tu mokṣadaḥ |
asnehaścāpi māyāyāṃ nikṛṣṭatādibuddhitaḥ ||1 3 ||
snehaḥ kṛṣṇe tu jāyeta tadutkṛṣṭatvabuddhitaḥ |
tadutkarṣo yathā parabrahma śrībhagavān svayam ||14||
savitāram sarvadhāmādhipaḥ satāṃ patiḥ |
sarvamuktapatiḥ sarvaiśvaryapatiḥ ramāpatiḥ || 15||
yāvadbhagavatāṃ kṛṣṇo bhagavān bhagavattamaḥ |
sarvopari cāntarātmā sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ ||16||
antaryāmī yamantarā kiñcit svatantrameva na |
yadicchāmantarā śuṣke parṇe’pi pavano balī || 17||
pravartate na vai cālanārthaṃ preraka eva saḥ |
sa eva bhagavānatra pṛthvyāṃ sādhusvarūpavān || 18||
yatheṣṭarūpavānāste bhaktamānasapūrakaḥ |
divyo divyacaritraśca sarvathā divyavigrahaḥ || 19||
mokṣadā hi kriyāstasya sakalā dehajā api |
evaṃ yasya hi māhātmyaṃ vidyate hṛdaye hareḥ ||3.221.20||
tasya bhaktasya vaṃśīyāḥ kuṭumbinaśca prākparāḥ |
daśa daśa svaścetyekaviṃśatiruddharanti vai ||21 ||
gṛhṇīyuste guṇaṃ tasya bhaktasya yadi sarvathā |
aho cāsmatkule kṛṣṇabhakto jāto hi pāvanaḥ || 22||
asmadbhāgyaṃ mahattena samuddhāro bhaviṣyati |
tatkṛtabhakteḥ puṇyaṃ no bhaviṣyati kuṭumbinaḥ ||23||
ityevaṃ guṇamantārastaranti nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anye’pi guṇamantāraḥ puṇyabhājo bhavanti ca ||24||
taṭantyeva ca saṃsāraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prayanti te |
ye yo guṇapravaktāro guṇagrāhiṇa eva te |||25||
dhanyavādagrahitāro yānti kṛṣṇasya dhāma te |
bhaktakathā bhaktaguṇagānaṃ bhaktasya vandanam |||26||
bhaktapraśaṃsanaṃ bhaktaprasādo mokṣadā ime |
bhaktasya dveṣakartāraḥ sambandhinastathetare ||27||
ye vā ke vā prayāntyeva nirayaṃ yāmyanoditāḥ |
krodhanānirṣyuko mānī kapaṭī kāmavānapi ||28||
dveṣī ca nindakaścaite prayānti nirayaṃ dhruvam |
tān doṣān samparityajya ye bhajanti janārdanam ||29||
te prayānti harerdhāma kṛṣṇasnehaparāyaṇāḥ |
bhagavatsnehasampūrṇā bhagavatsevane ratāḥ ||3.221.3 0||
bhagavadguṇatulyaiḥ sadguṇairyuktā bhavanti hi |
bhagavadguṇavān bhakto bhavedāśritamokṣakṛt ||31 ||
svadharmaṃ pālayan rāgābhāvaṃ sampādayam̐stathā |
ātmaniṣṭho hariniṣṭhaḥ snehī yāti paraṃ padam ||32||
śubhe deśe samaye vā jāgradādau śubhāśraye |
aśubhe vā viparīte bhaktastu dehamutsṛjan ||33||
prayātyeva paraṃ dhāma kṛṣṇakṛpānumoditaḥ |
abhakto vā harerdveṣī satāṃ dveṣī vinindakaḥ ||34||
dharmādiśūnyako yo vai śubhe deśādike’pi ca |
dehaṃ tyaktvāpi yātyeva ghoraṃ yamālayaṃ sadā |||35|||
abhyastā yā matiścānte gatirjāyeta tādṛśī |
śobhano’śobhano mṛtyurna hetuḥ sadasadgatau ||36||
bhaktasyordhvagatiścāsti tadbhinnasya tu durgatiḥ |
sarvadarśī guruḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ kṛpāprabhuḥ ||37||.
bhaktaṃ nijaṃ nayatyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
yadvā bhakto nijanārāyaṇasyopāsanābalāt ||38||
bhajan kṛṣṇaṃ svayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yāti svatantrakaḥ |
īśavat sa samartho’sti brahmāṇḍānāṃ laye’laye ||39||
kiṃmātramasya dehasya dhāraṇaṃ tyajanaṃ ca vā |
etādṛśaśca bhakto’tra bhūtale khalu durlabhaḥ ||3.221.40||
bhāvyaṃ tādṛśabhaktena nyūnatā yatra no bhavet |
bhāvyaṃ tādṛśavijñena sneho’nyatra na vai bhavet ||41 ||
bhāvyaṃ tādṛśavratinā pātivratyaṃ harau bhavet |
bhāvyaṃ tādṛśaguṇinākṣarabrahmagatirbhavet ||42||
bhāvyaṃ tādṛśadivyena māyālokordhvadṛṣṭinā |
muktakoṭau bhavedvāsaḥ śāśvatānandavarṣaṇaḥ ||43|| |
tadeva kuśalaṃ śivajayānyat kuśaletarat |
śṛṇu sarvakuśalāni śrutvā tāni samācara |||44||
samayo yasya haryarthaḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ tathāparaḥ |
pūjanaṃ yatra kṛṣṇasya samayaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||45||
gṛhe yasya harermūrtiścāpaṇe mandire bhuvi |
kṣetre vāṭyāṃ samudyoge sa deśaḥ kuśalo mataḥ ||46||
yā kriyā tu śrīkṛṣṇārthā sādhyarthā ca surārthikā |
ātmārthā cāpi muktyarthā sā kriyā kuśalā matā ||47||
yaḥ saṃgaḥ khalu satsaṃgo dharmajñānasukhāvahaḥ |
vāsanānāśakṛt kṛṣṇe snehakṛt kuśalo hi saḥ ||48||
yo mantro mohahā jñaptipradaḥ prakāśakṛddhṛdi |
kṛṣṇanāmayuto divyaḥ pāpaghnaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||49||
dīkṣā yā brahmapadadā pāvanī pāpanāśinī |
jñānakarī kṛṣṇapātivratyadā kuśalā hi sā ||3.221.50||
dhyānaṃ yacchāntidaṃ māyāduḥkhodvegādināśakam |
śāśvatānandadaṃ divyabhāvadaṃ kuśalaṃ tu tat ||51 ||
yo gururdivyatādhāyakastathā doṣanāśakṛt |
tārakaḥ kṣālako mokṣe hitakṛt kuśalo hi saḥ ||52||
yā mātā śrīkṛṣṇadugdhāmṛtapānaprakāriṇī |
bhaktipuṣṭikarī mokṣadarśinī kuśalā tu sā |||53||
yaḥ pitā dharmakarmādipālanodyogaśikṣakaḥ |
brahmalokamahāmārgapālakaḥ kuśalo hi saḥ ||54||
yo bhrātā muktidaṃ karma bibharti kārayatyapi |
dadāti bhrājanaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ kuśalo’pi saḥ ||55||
yā svasā bhojanaṃ bhrātre dadāti brahmaṇe’rpitam |
brahmamuktipradāśīrvādapradā kuśalā hi sā ||56||
yā patnī śrīhareryogapradāyinī tu sevikā |
kṛṣṇabandhanakartrī śrīpradā sā kuśalā matā ||57||
yaḥ putrastārayet kṛṣṇabhaktyā svapitaraṃ vrataiḥ |
prasannatāmarjayecca pituḥ sa kuśalo mataḥ ||588||
yaḥ patiḥ sampradadyādvai brahmānandaṃ subhaktimān |
brahmarasaṃ pāyayonnirvāṇadaṃ kuśalo hi saḥ ||59||
kuṭumbinastu ye māyāṃ kāṭavīṃ duḥkhadāyinīm |
tyājayeyurdāpayeyurmuktiṃ te kuśalāḥ sadā ||3.221.60||
prajārājādayastadvanmokṣe ye tu sahāyinaḥ |
amokṣaṇāttu vyāvṛttāḥ sarve te kuśalā matāḥ ||61 ||
guṇā ye sukhadāḥ sādhusevāpradā haripradāḥ |
anyānandapradā mokṣakarāste kuśalā matāḥ ||62||
yāḥ sampado haryarthāḥ sādhvarthāḥ puṇyayogadāḥ |
paropakāralābhārthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā matāḥ ||63||
smṛddhayo yāstu yajñārthā devārthā dānadharmadā 5 |
bhaktārthāścāpi gurvarthā divyāstāḥ kuśalāḥ sadā || 64||
gomahiṣyo vṛṣabhāśvā gajā yānāni dāsikāḥ |
kṛṣṇārthā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalāstu tāḥ ||65||
yo dehaśca mano vāṇīndriyāṇi vaibhavādayaḥ |
haryathā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā hi te ||66||
yāḥ śayyāḥ sumṛdvyaścāpi svarṇapātrāṇi hīrakāḥ |
ratnarūpyamaṇirdravyaṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ kuśalaṃ tu tat ||67||
yadānandāśca saṃbhogā utsavāḥ suprasaṃgakāḥ |
haryarthā yasya sādhvarthā mokṣadāḥ kuśalā hi te ||68||
ye’bhyāsāśca kalā vidyā vijñānaṃ jñātṛtottamā |
āviṣkārāśca haryarthāḥ sādhvarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||69||
āyavyayau tu haryarthau sādhyarthau mokṣamārgiṇau |
māyābandhakṣapaṇakau divyau tau kuśalau matau ||3.221.70||
dānaṃ vrataṃ ca niyamā ācāro lokasammatiḥ |
āśramaśca paddhatiśca haryarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||71 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca haryarpitāstu ye sadā |
yasya pumartharūpāste mokṣadāḥ kuśalāḥ sadā ||72||
śāsanaṃ dīnatā dāridryaṃ ca vanecaratvakam |
mahāprāsādavasatirharyarthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||73||
vyāpārā yasya kṛṣṇārthā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu |
turyāyāṃ brahmamuktau ca mokṣārthāḥ kuśalāstu te ||74||
atisnigdhāḥ sādhavaśca hariśca yasya santi vai |
mokṣārthaṃ ca samāraṃbhāḥ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||75||
bhaktiryasya sadā gehe hṛdaye ca kuṭumbiṣu |
harau sādhau mokṣamārge kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||76||
yasya gehe hareḥ pūjā sādhūnāṃ svāgataṃ tathā |
devānāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||77||
yasya gehe harernityaṃ prasādaścaiva bhojanam |
vighasāśitvamutkṛṣṭaṃ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||78||
haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaṃ cātmaniveditātmakam |
niṣkāmabhaktiyogaśca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||95|||
māyādṛṣṭirna vai yasya divyadṛṣṭiḥ śubhā sadā |
sarvathā guṇagrāhitvaṃ kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||3.221.80||
sādhuvākye harervākye viśvāsastasya pālanam |
mokṣārthe sarvayatnaśca kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||8 1 ||
viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ sthiratā harau |
dāsyaṃ raucyaṃ bhaved yasya kuśalaṃ tasya sarvathā ||82|||
vacmyathākuśalānyatra yāni hānikarāṇi vai |
nāstikatvamadharmitvaṃ bhaktiśūnyatvamudvratam ||83||
nindanaṃ drohakaraṇaṃ hiṃsā cākuśalāni vai |
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇapānaṃ dinavandhyatvayāpanam ||84||
kusaṃgapāpisaṃgaśca mohābhimānagarvatāḥ |
paraduḥkhapradāyitvaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||85||
parastrīlampaṭatvaṃ ca paradravyābhikāṃkṣitā |
paiśunyaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||86||
dharmabhaktivihīnatvamātmasādhanavarjitā |
ajñānaṃ māyiko mohaḥ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||87||
tṛṣṇerṣyābhayalobhāśca satkriyāvarjanaṃ tathā |
karmānubandhigamanaṃ sadaivākuśalāni vai ||88||
evaṃ viditvā satataṃ vidhehi kuśalāni vai |
tyajākuśalāni śivajaya yāsyasi mokṣaṇam ||89||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
japa mantraṃ raṭa nāma harekṛṣṇa hare hare ||3.221.90||
māyāṃ tīrtvā brahmalokaṃ paraṃ padaṃ prayāsyasi |
ityuktyā vṛṣaparvā saṃgṛhya pūjāṃ yayau vanam ||91 ||
bheje lakṣmi śivajayo’cyutaṃ māṃ puruṣottamam |
sarvaṃ vyadhāt kuśalaṃ vai tatyājākuśalāni ca ||92||
mahābhāgavato jāto dhyāne’rpaṇe ca pūjane |
anye śilpivarāścāsya gṛhe bhajanti mādhavam ||93||
satsaṃgaṃ te prakurvanti vratotsavān mahattamān |
athaikadā tu dvādaśyāṃ prātarvratottaraṃ tu te ||94||
cakrurme pūjanaṃ rātrau jāgaraṇottaraṃ tathā |
udyāpanaṃ pracakruśca kīrtanaṃ nartanaṃ tathā ||95||
tatrāhaṃ prādurabhavaṃ divyatejāścaturbhujaḥ |
śrīkāntaṃ māṃ hariṃ vīkṣya jahṛṣuḥ parito’pi te ||96||
pupūjurmāṃ hṛdayotthaiḥ premāktavastubhistadā |
mokṣaṃ te cārthayāmāsustathaityuktvā tirobhavam ||97||
atha kālāntare śivajayo bhaktasamanvitaḥ |
dehaṃ tyaktvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ matpārṣadāhṛtaḥ ||98||
evaṃ lakṣmi mama bhaktā yānti dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
bhajanāt pūjanādātmanivedanāt samāgamāt ||99||
satāṃ yogāt prayāntyeva divyā divyaṃ paraṃ padam |
suśravāḥ pāṭhakāścāpi prayānti śreyasaṃ param || 3.221.100||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne vṛṣaparvanāmarṣiyogena prāsādakārasya śivajayasya mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 221 ||

<3.222>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jālakārakathāṃ tathā |
jālakāraḥ kamalākhyāsarittīre vihārakṛt || 1 ||
vihāre cābhavanmatsyapāśajālavidhāyakaḥ |
pakṣiṇāṃ bandhanaṃ pāde paśūnāṃ śṛṃgapādayoḥ || 2 ||
matsyādīnāṃ yathā dehe bhavet tādṛśajālikāḥ |
karoti sūtrarajjūnāṃ vikrīṇāti samantataḥ || 3 ||
tadutpādyadhanādyaiśca nirvahatyeva bhojanam |
nāmnā saṃgarayādasko nirmātṛnagare sthitaḥ || 4 ||
pāśavantaḥ samakrītvā jālānyasmāttu saṃgarāt |
badhnanti jalajān vṛkṣavāsān vanajān dehinaḥ || 5 ||
ekadā saṃgarayādaḥ kṛtvā skandhe tu jālakān |
kretuṃ yayau tu nagare krīṇantu jālakāniti || 6 ||
uccairvadati śrāvārthaṃ kukṣau poṭalikāṃ vahan |
athāsya samayo jāto madhyāhnaśca kṣudhābhavat || 7 ||
krītvā bhakṣyaṃ cāpaṇādvai nagarād bahirāyayau |
kamalāyāstaṭe gatvā prabhuṃjan sa jalaṃ papau || 8 ||
tāvad dṛṣṭvā bhikṣuko vai bhikṣecchayā hyupāgataḥ |
nāmnā śuklāyanaḥ sādhurdadhan mālāṃ kare gale || 9 ||
raṭannāma harekṛṣṇa mukhe kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smaran |
dhārayannahiṃsādharmaṃ vivekaṃ tu vicintayan || 3.222.1 0||
yātrāmātraṃ vahamāno nirdvandvastaṃ hyupāyayau |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 11 ||
aśrāvayat purā paścānniṣasāda tadantike |
vāsasā varṣmaṇā cāpi malino’pi hṛdojjvalaḥ || 1 2||
ākarṣayanmanastasya saumyadṛṣṭyā vyalokayat |
athecchanniva vāñchan vai maunaṃ dhṛtvā sthiro’bhavat || 1 3||
dhairyabhṛtaṃ suviśvāsyaṃ vīkṣya viraktayoginam |
aprerito’pi daivena preritaḥ prāha jālakṛt ||14||
namaste sādhave sādho kutaḥ kathaṃ kimicchasi |
sādhuḥ prāha namaścāntaryāmiṇe kuśalaṃ tava || 15||
icchāmi bhojanaṃ kiñcijjalapānasahāyadam |
jālakāraḥ prasannātmā dadau bharjitatandulān || 16||
caṇakān bharjitām̐ścāpi manāk lavaṇayojitān |
śubhaṃ te syāttathā nityaṃ nirāmayaṃ sukhodakam || 17||
sukhanidrā bhavatātte me tandulacaṇārpaṇāt |
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā nivedya cāntarātmane ||18||
bubhuje tandulādīṃśca pītvā tṛptiṃ yayau tataḥ |
papraccha vyavasāyaṃ ca jālakārasya vai tadā ||19||
jālakāro’vadajjālavyavasāyaṃ yathātatham |
śrutvā sādhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvopadeśamācarat ||3.222.20||
śṛṇu saṃgarayādaska hitaṃ te vacmi sarvathā |
caturaśītikhanayo bhavanti dehināmiha || 11 ||
tatra mānuṣadeho vai mokṣāya kalpitaḥ paraḥ |
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante puṇyapuñjairhi mānuṣam ||22||
dehaṃ labhate dehīti tataḥ puṇyena vai divam |
bhaktyā mokṣaṃ svadharmeṇa smṛddhiṃ saukhyaṃ vivekataḥ |||23||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sādhayenmānavaḥ sadā |
paśuprāyaṃ jīvanaṃ tu hiṃsakaṃ parivarjayet ||24||
hiṃsayā labhyate yāmyaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca narakālayaḥ |
pāpa droho’pyaniṣṭaṃ ca hiṃsayā jāyate tathā || 25 ||
sāṃkaryaṃ jāyate cāpi dāridryaṃ janasaṃkṣayaḥ |
hiṃsakānāṃ jāyate’dhogatirnirayagāmitā ||26||
hiṃsakānāṃ pāśadasya hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate |
jālakṛto’pi prāṇināṃ hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate ||27||
mārakaḥ khādakaścāpyanumodakaḥ sahāyakaḥ |
śastradaḥ pāśadaścāpi jāladaḥ samabhāg bhavet ||28||
jālakṛtastvavaśyaṃ te hiṃsāpāpaṃ prajāyate |
jālabaddhā dehinastvāṃ niḥśvasantīva jālakam ||29||
jāladharaṃ jālakṛtaṃ śapanti santu duḥkhinaḥ |
tasmāt sādhurahaṃ te’tropadiśāmi sukhāya te ||3.222.3 0||
prāṇatrāṇaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ sukhamuttamam |
prāṇihiṃsāphalaṃ pāpaṃ tatphalaṃ duḥkhamulbaṇam ||3 1 ||
jālakāryaṃ jālakarma tyaktvā vastrāṇi saṃkuru |
vastraiścāvaraṇayogyaiḥ pāpaṃ nodbhavati kvacit ||32||
ātmasādhanamāsādya kuru kalyāṇamātmanaḥ |
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ paropakṛtimarpaṇam ||33 ||
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā puṇyaṃ divaṃ vraja |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ || 34||
vratotsavām̐śca dānāni kṛtvā svargaṃ paraṃ vraja |
mā hiṃsākārakaṃ jālaṃ saṃviracaya pāpadam ||35||
mānuṣajīvanaṃ sārthaṃ kuru mokṣādyupārjanāt |
śāstrakathāṃ sadā śrutvā nārāyaṇaṃ samarjaya ||36||
nārāyaṇaṃ viditvaiva paraṃ padaṃ prayāhi ca |
smara nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalāpatim | |37||
akṣareśaṃ māṇikīśaṃ rādheśaṃ puruṣottamam |
sa eva bhagavānatra mānave bhūtale’pi ca ||38||
divyadhāmeśvaraḥ sākṣājjāyate mānavākṛtiḥ |
tasya sarvacaritrāṇi śubhāśubhāni yāni ca ||39||
divyānyeva bhavantyeva cintanīyāni tāni vai |
mokṣadāni mahāśāntipradāni śubhadāni ca ||3.222.40||
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ śokaḥ prītirjayaḥ parājayaḥ |
kṣudhā tṛṣā kṛtirnidrā tatsarvaṃ tasya maṃgalam ||41 ||
nindyaṃ vācyaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ ca nṛśaṃsyaṃ tasya karma yat |
sarvaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ bodhyaṃ na doṣo vidyate harau ||49||
harernirguṇabhāvatvād divyatvāttasya sādhuṣu |
hareḥ sambandhamāpteṣu nirguṇatvaṃ ca divyatā ||43 ||
vartate ceti vijñāya sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhuṣu snehamāsādya harau snehaṃ vidhāya ca ||44||
anyarāgaṃ vihāyaiva sthairyaṃ labhet pareśvare |
evaṃ nityaṃ samabhyāsāt saṃskāro balavān bhavet ||45||
tena snehātiśayitā kṛṣṇe prajāyate muhuḥ |
tathā satyeva bhaktasya jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu ||46||
śrīharerdivyamūrtestu darśanaṃ samprajāyate |
atisnehena sādhvīnāṃ tathā vīkṣā harerbhavet ||47||
atikāmena patnīnāṃ gopīnāṃ harivīkṣaṇam |
atidveṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ daityānāṃ harivīkṣaṇam ||48||
atisvārthena devānāṃ muhurvai viṣṇudarśanam |
atitādātmyayogena yogināṃ brahmadarśanam ||49||
atijñānena viduṣāṃ sarvathā brahmadarśanam |
evaṃ dāsyena bhavati sevayā kṛṣṇadarśanam ||3.222.50||
atyanuvṛttidharmeṇa hareḥ prasannatā bhavet |
kṛpayā jāyate vīkṣā sarvadā śrīharestathā ||51 ||
satāmāśīrvacobhiśca nairmalye sati sarvathā |
bhaktānāṃ hṛdaye bāhye sarvatra haridarśanam ||52|||
harau ca kṛṣṇabhakteṣu pakṣapāto’sti yasya vai |
kuṭumbiṣu yathā tadvat tatsatsaṃgo hi śāśvataḥ ||53||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya naśyanti doṣakoṭayaḥ |
vāsanāśca vinaśyanti prodbhavanti satāṃ guṇāḥ ||54||
vinā snehaṃ harau satsu satsaṃgo naṣṭamūlakaḥ |
yastu syānmānahīnaśca mumukṣurdivyadṛṣṭimān ||415 ||
mahimānaṃ vidan hareḥ sādhūnāṃ bhaktayoṣitām |
tasya bodhyastu satsaṃgaḥ sadaiva dṛḍhamūlakaḥ ||16||
etādṛśānāṃ bhaktānāṃ virahaṃ cāsahan prabhuḥ |
akṣarastho’gocaro’pi śreyase kṛpayā tviha |||77||
svecchayaiva narākāraṃ gṛhṇan carati bhūstare |
tasyānuvṛttimāśritya vartitavyaṃ nirantaram ||58||
anuvṛttirasandehā hariprasādarādhanam |
hareḥ prasādo yasyāsti tasya satāṃ prasannatā ||59||
prasannatāyā labdhyarthaṃ naiṣṭavyaṃ varṣmaṇaḥ sukham |
satsaṃgo vapuṣā tanvā poṣṭavyo manasāpi ca ||3.222.60||
ayaṃ sākṣātprabhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagadguruḥ |
avatārī parabrahma śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ||61||
ime santo harerbhaktā akṣaravyomavāsinaḥ |
muktāḥ sarve’tra santyeva yoṣito’pi ramāsamāḥ ||62||
iyaṃ bhūścākṣaraṃ dhāma bālakṛṣṇasya yogataḥ |
vayaṃ sarve divyamuktā nārāyaṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||63||
yatra kṛṣṇastatra dhāma muktā muktānikāstathā |
mahadbhāgyamidaṃ naśca yad divyānāṃ samāgamaḥ ||64||
ebhiḥ samaṃ nivāso naḥ sarvaṃ divyaṃ yato mama |
sevanīyo hariścāpi sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||65||
ājñāsteṣāṃ pālanīyāstato divyatvamāpyate |
sādhuguṇāḥ samāyānti sādhvājñā pālanāt khalu ||66||
sādhūn seveta satataṃ devavat kṛṣṇavattathā |
kṛṣṇadhyānaṃ paraṃ kāryaṃ kāryā bhaktiranekadhā ||67||
duḥsvabhāvāstathā pāpaṃ tyājyaṃ satāṃ prasevayā |
śreyaḥśaktirvardhanīyā jetavyāścāntarārayaḥ ||68||
pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā kṛṣṇo bodhyo nijāntike |
pratyakṣadraṣṭā sarvatra vyāpako naikarūpadhṛk || 39||
antarātmā paramātmā lakṣmīśrīmāṇikīpatiḥ |
pratyakṣaṃ cekṣate sarvaṃ sarvatrāsti paraḥ prabhuḥ ||3.222.70 ||
sthāvare jaṃgame cāsti sthūle sūkṣme tathetare |
na tadvāñcchā vinā patracālane sabalo’nilaḥ ||7 1 ||
sarvakarmaphaladātā sarvaṃ dhṛtvā sa tiṣṭhati |
pṛthvyāṃ dhāraṇaśaktirvai tasyaivāsti tathā jale ||72||
tṛptiśaktistasya cāsti gagane vidhṛtistathā |
candrārkāgniprakāśānāṃ dātā sa parameśvaraḥ ||73||
etādṛśaḥ samartho’yaṃ vartate mānavo’tra vai |
datte svadarśanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃbharāśrīsuto hariḥ ||74||
evaṃ nirantaraṃ citte cintanīyo hariḥ prabhuḥ |
sa eva svāśritānāṃ tu duḥkhānyapākaroti hi |||75||
paritrāṇe samartho’sti vartate divyabhāvavān |
kvacinmānavabhāvaistu sahate kaṣṭamityapi || 76| |
bhayameti kāmayate kṣamate rauti vai kvacit |
sarvāḥ kriyā hareratra kalyāṇadā hi pāvikāḥ ||77||
tasya prabhoḥ sādhavo’pi santi svātmeva tatpriyāḥ |
aho’yaṃ bhagavān bhaktavaśo’tra vartate’pi ca ||78||
tatpratāpāttasya bhaktāḥ santi kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ |
sādhavo mokṣadā naścetyevaṃ māhātmyamarjayet ||79||
alaukikī yasya buddhirharau satsu sadā yathā |
sā vardhanīyā satataṃ na kubuddhiṃ prasaṃgajām ||3.222.80||
svabhāvadoṣaṃ paśyenna divyaṃ paricayaṃ caret |
tenāsadvāsanādoṣo hṛdayādapasarpati ||81 ||
bhaktiṃ vivardhayet sacca dehendriyamanaḥkṛtām |
sarvasvārpaṇarūpāṃ tāṃ mahāmokṣapadāyinīm || 82||
mokṣasya sādhanaṃ mukhyaṃ satāṃ dāsyaṃ mataṃ padam |
āpatkāle’pi satataṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||83||
sādhukathāṃ harervārtāṃ śṛṇuyāt pāpanuttaye |
mokṣāya cārpayet sarvaṃ dehaṃ gehaṃ dhanādikam ||84||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim |
jānīyāt paramātmānaṃ śrīpatiṃ rādhikāpatim ||85||
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ keśavādyāśca mūrtayaḥ |
matsyādyā avatārāśca bālakṛṣṇasya santi vai ||86||
evaṃ māhātmyamāsādya satīva saṃśrayet patim |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet kṛṣṇāt patnīva śaraṇī janaḥ ||87||
evaṃ saṃgarayādaska tyaktvā jālakriyāṃ bhavān |
samācaratu vastrāṇāṃ vayanaṃ ca kaṭādikam ||88 ||
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma labha muktiṃ paraṃ padam |
yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ tvaṃ subhaktimān ||89||
iti śuklāyanaḥ sādhurupaviśya nadītaṭe |
āśīrdatvā ca taṃ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktisevinam ||3.222.90 ||
tirobhavaddhi sahasā saṃgaro nijajālakam |
gṛhe gatvā vibhidyeva rajjanāṃ dīrghanāḍakam ||9 1 ||
kṛtvā rarakṣa ca gṛhe tatyāja jālakāritām |
bheje māṃ sakuṭumbaḥ sa bahubhaktān vyadhāpayat ||92||
bhajanaṃ me pūjanaṃ ca lakṣmi mokṣapradaṃ yathā |
tadārabhyādrohadharmaṃ pālayāmāsa sarvathā ||93||
mūrtau māṃ gocaraṃ cakre dāsyasnehādibhiḥ sa ca |
atha kāle samāyāte rathena saha mādhavaḥ ||94||
prayayau tadgṛhaṃ cāhaṃ netuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
rūpāvatīṃ tu tatpatnīṃ saṃgaraṃ ca rathe tvaham ||95||
niṣādya divyadehaṃ ca kṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau |
anye’pi bhaktasaṃghā me mayā nītā yayuḥ param ||96||
sarvapāpasamūhāstu mayā prajvālitā rame |
bhaktānāṃ sādhubhaktānāṃ nairmalyaṃ kṛpayādadhe || 97||
api pāpāḥ pāpasaṃgā ajñā viṣayiṇo’pi ca |
satāṃ yogena jāyante pāvanā brahmabhoginaḥ ||98||
striyo vā paśavaścāpi jaḍā vā malinā api |
āsādya sādhusevāṃ saṃjāyante paṃktipāvanāḥ ||99||
na viprā na surā gāvo vratāni niyamā yamāḥ |
na tīrthāni tathā śreṣṭhāḥ santaḥ śreṣṭhatamā yathā || 3.222.1 00||
sanmūrtirānakhaśikhaṃ sarvā divyā hi pāvanī |
yathā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīrnārāyaṇī yathā ||10 1 ||
satāṃ prasādo divyo’sti satāṃ sparśastathottamaḥ |
satāṃ sevā hi sukhadā duḥkhahantrī haripradā || 102||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
pāpanāśaḥ puṇyalābho bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā ||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne saṃgarayādaskabhaktasya jālakāryaṃ tyājayitvā śuklāyanasādhunā bhagavatprāptiḥ kāritetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 222 ||

<3.223>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamajapālakathāṃ tathā |
candrprabhāyāḥ sarito nikaṭe nandipattane || 1 ||
udyamaśrīsamākhyo’bhūd bharavāṭo hyajādhanaḥ |
pañcaśatāni santyasyājānāṃ śataṃ gavāṃ tathā || 2 ||
uraṇānāṃ pañcaśataṃ gardabhānāṃ śataṃ tathā |
śunāṃ tu daśakaṃ cāpi mahiṣīṇāṃ tu viṃśakam || 3 ||
cārāṇāṃ bhṛtyakāryāṇāṃ daśakaṃ tasya vidyate |
patnīṣaṭkaṃ putraputrīsaptatiścāsya vidyate || 4 ||
sīmni nadītaṭe’raṇye śādvale ghāsasampadi |
nibīḍauṣadhisaṃśobhe puṣkalatṛṇabhūtale || 5 ||
vasati nandipurato nātidūre suvṛttike |
yatrānyabharavāṭānāṃ vasatiḥ paśurakṣiṇī || 6 ||
ghoṣātmikā vidyate vai vanyabhakṣyādikāriṇī |
udyamaśrīrmahānāste yaśasā ca tathāyuṣā |7 ||
paśudhanena ca kuṭumbenātithiprasevayā |
yasya vāse samāyānti vanino bahavo muhuḥ || 8 ||
svāgataṃ so’pi sarveṣāṃ karoti payaādibhiḥ |
sādhavo yatayaḥ siddhāḥ samāyānti ca yoginaḥ || 9 ||
sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti sevābhāvigṛhe muhuḥ |
satkārayati sarvān saḥ prasannayati bhojanaiḥ || 3.223.10 ||
dānamānaiḥ susanmānaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
striyaḥ putrāśca putraśca bharavāṭyo’pi nityadā || 11 ||
sevante sādhupuruṣān sādhvīśca bahubhāvataḥ |
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena sādhūnmatvā prabhuṃ harim || 12||
sādhuṣvāste hariḥ sākṣāt sādhvīṣvāste ramā svayam |
abhyāgateṣu devāścāsate pūjyā yato hi te || 1 3||
evaṃ sevāṃ kurvatastu bhajamānasya māṃ prabhum |
gṛhe tasyāyayuḥ sādhvyo viṃśatiḥ sāṃkhyayogagāḥ || 14||
yatinyastāśca vaiṣṇavyo vṛddhā bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
tāsāṃ dugdhādibhiścāpi vanyabhojanasampradaiḥ || 15||
sanmānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre vāsaṃ kāṇḍagṛhe dadau |
uṣustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktānikāḥ striyaḥ || 1 6||
divyā divyaguṇopetāḥ snātvā nadyāmapūjayan |
harikṛṣṇaṃ prāṇapatiṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 17||
tatastā bhojanaṃ cakrurnivedya paramātmane |
viśrāntiṃ ca samālabhya sāyaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||18||
ārārtrikaṃ caritrāṇāṃ kathāṃ cakruśca vārtikāḥ |
vallavyo bālakāḥ kanyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ sahasraśaḥ || 1 9||
āyayuḥ parito jñātvā sādhvīmaṇḍalamuttamam |
mātarastā harermūrtau vimagnavṛttayaḥ sadā || 3.223.20 ||
bhajante ca raṭantyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum |
tāsu gurupadaṃ prāptā satīśvarītināmikā |||21 ||
sādhvī kathāṃ hareścakre śuśruvurgopikāstriyaḥ |
vallavāśca tathā sarve śraddhayā bhaktibhāvayā ||22||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ sumokṣadām |
pāpaprajvālikāṃ satīśvarī jagāda śobhanām ||23||
manaḥ kṛṣṇe dhṛtaṃ yena jitaṃ tena jagat khalu |
jitaṃ bhavenmanastadvai yad dhṛtaṃ paramātmani ||24||
indriyāṇi viṣayeṣu prayānti manasā saha |
ajitaṃ tu manastadvai viṣayaṃ prati yadgatam ||25||
parāvṛttya manovṛttimindriyavṛttikā harau |
dhārayettanmanaścendriyāṇi jitāni tattadā ||26||
rāganāśe virāgaḥ syāttena mano jitaṃ bhavet |
harau prītyā ca nānyatra gacchenmano jitaṃ bhavet ||27||
brahmasthityā vinaśyedvai rāgaśca kāmanādayaḥ |
bhogabuddhirvinaśyecca manastena jitaṃ bhavet ||28||
śrīhareḥ śrīpaterdivyasukhe yasya tu magnatā |
māhātmyajñānayuktasya tasya mano jitaṃ bhavet ||29||
dehabhāvavināśena cidbhāvo yasya vartate |
manastasya jaḍaṃ nirutsāhaṃ jitaṃ bhavedapi ||3.223.30||
nityatṛptirhareḥ kāntānmāyikāttu nivartanam |
tasya tṛptaṃ sthiraṃ cittaṃ mano jitaṃ sadā matam ||3 1 ||
dehābhimānanāśena cātmaniṣṭhābalena ca |
rāgavāsanātyāgena mano jitaṃ sadā bhavet ||32||
nārīrūpaṃ manaḥ proktaṃ jīvātmā nararūpadhṛk |
mano bhogaṃ jahātyeva mano jitaṃ bhavet svataḥ ||33||
ātmāhaṃ cetano nārī paramātmā naro mama |
patirbhoktā sukhadātā nānyo me bhogakṛtparaḥ ||34||
sākṣātkṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo hariḥ śrīkāntavallabhaḥ |
pātā dhātā vidhātā saḥ priyaḥ prāṇapatiḥ patiḥ ||35||
svāmī dhāmī ca niṣkāmī sarvānandapariplutaḥ |
mamānandapradaḥ kāntaścetyayaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 36||
īśvarāṇāmavatārāvatāriṇīnāṃ śāsakaḥ |
golokādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ vallavīsvāmitāṃ gataḥ || 37||
vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ pārṣadāṇīpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
muktānikāpatiḥ kṛṣṇo’kṣaradhāmavirājitaḥ || 38||
śrīpure’vyākṛte’mṛte śrīlakṣmīkamalāpatiḥ |
lalitāmāṇikīnāthaḥ prabhāpadmāvatīpatiḥ ||39||
brahmapriyāpatiścāyaṃ haripriyāpatiḥ sa ca |
viśālābadarīnāthaḥ śvetadvīparamāpatiḥ ||3.223.40||
kṣirodaśāradāsvāmī sītāpatiḥ satīpatiḥ |
sarvasādhvīpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kumbhakārīpatiḥ sa hi ||41 ||
sarvamuktapatiḥ sādhupatiḥ sarvasakhīpatiḥ |
sarvadāsīpatiḥ prāṇamātrapatiḥ paraḥ pumān ||42||
evaṃ jñātvā hariṃ kāntaṃ bhajet sarvasukhāśrayam |
tasya mano bhavellagnaṃ kṛṣṇe tadvai jitaṃ matam ||43||
sa cāyaṃ bhagavānāste hṛdaye me madātmani |
sañcidānandarūpaśca sādhusādhvīṣu rājate ||44||
śrīmadgopālabālaśca rājate’kṣarakṣetrake |
sarvasukhanidhiḥ sākṣād vāsudevaḥ sa eva saḥ ||45||
mānavānāṃ ca devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ siddhayoginām |
īśvarāṇāmavatārakoṭīnāṃ susukhāni vai ||46||
muktānāṃ brahmadhāmnāṃ ca yāni yāni sukhāni vai |
tāni sarvāṇi kṛṣṇasya śrīkambharātmajasya tu ||47||
romṇa ekasya tu prānte vartante cedṛśaḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvasukhanidhiḥ svāmī kṛṣṇo yo milito’sti naḥ ||48||
tasya dhāmnaḥ sukhasyāgre dhāmnāṃ sukhāni yāni vai |
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ vyūhānāmīśadhāminām ||49||
grahāṇāṃ marutāṃ viśvedevānāmaśvinorapi |
sādhyānāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca rudrāṇāṃ dyusadāmapi ||3.223.50||
sūryāṇāṃ vrahmaviṣṇūnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ paraukasām |
sthānāni nirayāṇyeva dhāmnaścāsya parātmanaḥ ||51||
tamimaṃ śrīpatiṃ kāntaṃ hitvā tu nirayābhidhān |
kathamanyān sukhasaṃjñān bhaje’haṃ parameśvarī ||52||
evaṃ vijñāya māhātmyaṃ divyabhāvayutā satī |
tyajenmohaṃ nirayāṇāṃ jitaṃ tasyā manaḥ sadā |||53||
vāsanā vilayaṃ yānti māyikyaḥ satataṃ tadā |
etādṛśyā dehavāñcchā bhogavāñcchā ca māyikī ||54||
