na jāyate sadā dagdhā jātā nirmūlikā hi sā |
etādṛśaṃ mahimānaṃ yā na vetti harestviha ||55||
tasyā nare bhaved vṛttiḥ prākṛte’pi sakāmanā |
putre mitre kalatrādau patyau sneho’pi bandhanam ||56||
manaso vartate tasyāḥ svārthavartanayoṣitaḥ |
sā tyajet paramātmānaṃ kuṭumbasnehakarṣitā ||57||
rogādipīḍayā vā ca viṣayāprāptitastyajet |
keśave tu manastasyā viṣayārthaṃ caret sadā ||58||
alābhe viṣayāṇāṃ tu pāmarā sā bhavettataḥ |
patatyeva harerbhaktermokṣamārgaṃ na vindati ||59||
tasmāt sneho harau kāryaḥ svārthaśūnyo nisargajaḥ |
na vai rūpānna vai kāmānna lobhānnaiva lābhajaḥ ||3.223.60||
na svārthādvā prakartavyaḥ snehaḥ kintu nisargajaḥ |
divyaguṇacamatkāramāhātmyajñānasaṃbhavaḥ ||61 ||
kartavyo vai sadā sneho yasya nāśo na karhicit |
guṇā divyā harau santi satyaśaucasukhādayaḥ ||62||
apāraṃ cāpi vātsalyaṃ mādhuryaṃ ca suśīlatā |
sauhārdaṃ ca kṛpā sneho dayā śāntiḥ kṣamā ratiḥ ||63||
prītirhitakaratvaṃ ca sahanaṃ divyatā dhṛtiḥ |
audāryaṃ śāśvatānanditvaṃ ca śaraṇarakṣitā ||64||
ete guṇāḥ samāyānti bhakteṣvapi prasevanāt |
sadvārtāśravaṇenāpi guṇāḥ prāvirbhavanti hi ||65||
evaṃguṇiṣu bhakteṣu snehaḥ kṛṣṇasya jāyate |
vapuṣā manasā vāṇyā dāsyaṃ kāryaṃ harestataḥ ||66||
hareḥ rucyanusāreṇa vartitavyaṃ tu varṣmaṇā |
tapa ādi prakartavyaṃ hareḥ rucyanusārataḥ ||67||
hareḥ satāṃ yogināṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ śraddhayā sadā |
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ kṛṣṇe sneho dṛḍho bhavet ||68||
vacaḥ kaṭu na vaktavyaṃ satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ tathā |
mahadbhirna vivādo’pi kartavyo na jayo’pi ca ||69||
nirmānaṃ komalaṃ vācyaṃ pramāṇaṃ namratānvitam |
utkṛṣṭā vāk pravaktavyā mānyaṃ cājñāvaco hareḥ ||3.223.70 ||
ādarāt kaṭhinaṃ cāpi grāhyaṃ vaco hareḥ sadā |
kriyānarhamasaṃbhāvyaṃ grāhyameva vaco hareḥ ||71 ||
evaṃ bhaveddhareḥ snehaḥ satāṃ snehastathā bhavet |
darśane śravaṇe dhyāne pūjane sevane hareḥ ||72||
sannidhau śrīharermūrtāvaikāgryaṃ ceṣṭasiddhikṛt |
muhurnavaṃ navaṃ yadvaddarśanaṃ cāpyalaukikam |||73|||
sthiraṃ ciraṃ prakuryācca nānyat paśyettadā khalu |
etādṛśaṃ darśanaṃ vai hareḥ snehasya kāraṇam ||74||
bahirvā cāntare vedṛg darśanaṃ snehakāraṇam |
caladṛṣṭijane prītirjāyate naiva śārṅgiṇaḥ ||75||
satāṃ cāpi bhavennaiva prītiścānyavilokini |
nare nāryāṃ paśau citre kapāṭe caladṛṣṭike ||76||
bahudhāreṇa manasā dṛṣṭiḥ kriyate cañcalā |
tayā dṛṣṭyānyatra ganturna tatprītiḥ prajāyate ||77 ||
yathā kāmī janaḥ paśyet kāmukīṃ tvekacetasā |
premaikatānabhāvena tathā paśyet prabhuṃ patim ||78||
antarā tvāgataṃ kiñcinnānusandheyamaṇvapi |
ādyakṣaṇe yathā patyurvadhūṭyā darśanaṃ navam ||79||
dṛḍharūpadhṛtiprāptikaraṃ sphuraṇadāyakam |
tathā nityanavaṃ tadvai darśanaṃ snehakāraṇam ||3.223.80 ||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tvevamaikāgryaṃ kāryameva yat |
sphureccaritraśravaṇād bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||81 ||
sarvendriyeṣu cakṣurvā karṇo vā mana ityapi |
cañcalāni viśeṣeṇa niyantavyāni tāni vai .||82||
kāmendriyaṃ tathā tebhyo’dhikaṃ vai cañcalaṃ yataḥ |
mano niyamya kāmo’pi niyantavyo manoyutaḥ ||83||
anyathā śrīharerdhyāne pūjane grāmyamūrtayaḥ |
viṣayāḥ kleśadāścāpi sphureyurvighnakāriṇaḥ ||84||
prabalaṃ cenmano liṅgaṃ cakṣuḥ karṇaḥ prayāti vai |
viṣayeṣu tu grāmyeṣu tadā kāryaṃ vicāraṇam ||85||
hariṃ tyaktvānyaviṣaye gamane lābha eva na |
viṣayā duḥkhadāḥ sarve māyābandhakarā yataḥ ||86||
ānandamūrtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaḥ |
tatra stheyaṃ śāśvatasyānandasya parilabdhaye ||87||
siddhadaśā divyadaśā modapramodaśevadhiḥ |
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇādbhavatyeva tasmāllabha sukhaṃ mahat ||88||
anyatra yatamānasya kiñcit sukhaṃ bhavedapi |
sarvaṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ tannirayasya pradaṃ tathā ||89||
tasmācchṛṇu kathāṃ paśya kṛṣṇaṃ cintaya sarvathā |
ānandaṃ yāhi tasmādvai kṛṣṇāt kāntānna cetarāt ||3.223.90 ||
evaṃ kṛṣṇe kṛtasnehād vāñchitāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt |
vibhūtiṃ sampado rūpaṃ śrīrādhāmāṇikīprabhum ||91 ||
viṣṇunārāyaṇatulyaṃ sarvamāpnoti tadrateḥ |
sadehe sarvamāpyeta mṛtau vā dhāmni sarvathā ||92||
tasmāddharau sadā stheyaṃ cakṣuṣā manasā girā |
karṇena hṛdayenāpi kāmena yāvadātmanā ||93||
evaṃ nityamanuvṛttyā kṛṣṇe prītimataḥ khalu |
prītimatyā yoṣito vā syāt kṛṣṇaprītipātratā ||94||
kṛṣṇavat saṃsthitirdivyā lakṣmīvadvā bhavettataḥ |
na nyūnaṃ syāddharestasya tasyāḥ śriyorna nimnatā ||95||
evaṃ lakṣmi mahāsādhvī satīśvarī tu vallavīḥ |
vallavān bhagavatsnigdhānupādideśa muktaye ||96||
vallavyo vallavāścāpi bharavāṭāstathāpare |
udyamaśrīprabhṛtayo jagṛhurbhaktimuttamām ||97||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
itimantraṃ satīśvaryā jagṛhurnāma cottamam ||98||
bālakṛṣṇa hare kānta rādhāpate ramāpate |
mokṣakṛt vallabha sarvakāmaprada pumuttama ||99||
itināmāni jagṛhuḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurādarāt |
sādhvyastu bhajanaṃ kṛtvā prātarbhuktvānyakheṭakam || 3.223.10 0||
prayayurbharavāṭāśca bharavāṭyastathā muhuḥ |
bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā || 10 1||
tāsāṃ bhaktyā hi bhagavān rādhayā ramayā saha |
prādurbabhūva sahasā māṇikyā ca śriyā saha || 1 02||
caturbhujasvarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahotsave gṛhe |
mandire vratadivase dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ha || 1 03||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ sahasraśo janāstadā |
datvā svadarśanaṃ cāpi prasādaṃ pāyasaṃ śubham || 104||
mokṣārthaṃ varadānaṃ ca datvā tiro’bhavat prabhuḥ |
so’haṃ lakṣmi tataḥ kāle prāpte udyamaśrījanam || 1 05||
bharavāṭān bhaktavaryān gopīśca premasaṃplutāḥ |
ninye’haṃ mama dhāmaiva golokaṃ nityamuttamam || 1 06||
evaṃ sādhvīprasaṃgena bharavāṭyaśca vallavāḥ |
tāritā māyikāllokāt snehabhaktyā kṛpālunā || 1 07||
evaṃ nāryo narā ye māṃ bhajiṣyanti samarpitāḥ |
sarve yāsyanti paramaṃ matpadaṃ kāntasevanam || 1 08||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccaraṇādapi |
bhuktirmuktirmahāsaukhyaṃ bhavenmayā samarpitam || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne udyamaśrīprabhṛtigopālakānāṃ satīśvarīsādhvīsevayābhaktirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 223 ||

<3.224>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamuṣṭrapālo marudbhuvi |
nāmnābhavad dīrgharaṃbho grāme citrordhvasaṃjñake || 1 ||
uṣṭrā yasyābhavan pāreśataṃ śamīprabhojanāḥ |
uchrāyabhūnivāsaśca kramelakorṇavikrayī || 2 ||
uṣṭravikrayakartā ca dhānyavyāpārakṛttathā |
ekadeśādanyadeśe dhānyaprāpaṇakārakaḥ || 3 ||
prāyaśo vai vane vāsaṃ kurvannuṣṭrābhirakṣakaḥ |
vane rātrau nivasati daśoṣṭrapālakaiḥ saha || 4 ||
śamīvane’titarale carantyuṣṭrāḥ samantataḥ |
dīrgharaṃbhādayaḥ kṛtvā vahniṃ tadabhitastadā || 5 ||
niṣadya kambalairyuktā gṛṇanti rāmakīrtanam |
devānāṃ ca kathāgītiṃ kurvanti militāstathā || 6 ||
pibantyuṣṭrāpayaścāpi nivedya prabhave hṛdi |
khādanti roṭakān kṛtvā śamīśimbyāranālakaiḥ || 7 ||
nirgacchanti vanyamārge yadi kecitpravāsinaḥ |
tebhyo dadati satkṛtya dugdhaṃ ca roṭakādikam || 8 ||
paropakāraḥ kartavyaścānnakambaladānakaiḥ |
matvaivaṃ te cārpayanti kambalānapi cottamān || 9 ||
sādhavo vā tīrthayātrālavo milanti tatpathi |
tebhyo’rpayantyannavāri kurvanti svāgatādikam || 3.224.10 ||
rāmabuddhyaiva satataṃ puṇyasatkarmavāñcchayā |
yatheṣṭaṃ bhaktibhāvena sevante sādhumaṇḍalam || 11 ||
athaikadārbudayātrākaraṇāya tripuṣkaram |
prāgacchanmaṇḍalaṃ sādhusādhvīnāṃ pathi cāgatam || 12||
kīrtayad vādyaghoṣaiśca rāmakṛṣṇajanārdana |
narasiṃha hara viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇācyuta || 1 3||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃstu dīrgharaṃbho gatvā pratipraṇamya ca |
dugdhaṃ ca roṭakān tebhyo dadau madhyāhnake jalam ||14||
sāyaṃ te sādhavastatra viśrāntiṃ prāpurutsukāḥ |
rātrau sarve tūṣṭrapālā asevanta sato janān || 15||
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kathāṃ rāmasya śuśruvustathā |
atha sādhuvaraṃ rāmāyaṇākhyaṃ vaiṣṇavottamam || 1 6||
papraccha svātmakalyāṇaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cānataḥ |
rāmāyaṇaḥ pratyuvāca tadā kalyāṇasādhanam || 17||
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi rāmanāmnāṃ sukīrtanam |
bhaktiṃ viṣṇornavadhāṃ ca kalyāṇasādhanāni hi || 18||
rāmasya vandanaṃ nityamarcanaṃ bahuvastubhiḥ |
mānasairupacāraiścāpyarcanaṃ hṛdaye’nvaham ||1 9||
kalyāṇasādhanaṃ ceti dhyānaṃ rāmasya cintanam |
premṇā pulakitagātro gadgadākṣaravāk tathā ||3.224.20||
tatsvarūpaikacintaśca bhavedbhakto’rcane hareḥ |
bāhyapūjākaro yadvā cāntarārhaṇakārakaḥ || 21||
viśiṣyate’yaṃ bhaktau vai sarvebhyo bhaktasammataḥ |
aikāgryarahitaḥ sneharahitastu na śasyate ||22||
pūjane sevane yasya śraddhā bhavati bhūyasī |
kathāyāṃ kīrtane yasya śraddhādarau viśeṣataḥ ||23||
māhātmyaṃ yasya cotkṛṣṭaṃ bhakte yasya sumitratā |
yasya rāmārcanādau vai bhūrikālo yathā kṣaṇaḥ ||24||
navadhāpi hareḥ sevā yasya nūtnānuvāsaram |
na gauṇī yasya jīrṇā na kvacit kvāpi bhavediyam ||25||
śraddhābhaktiryasya nityaṃ nūtanā nūtanojjvalā |
sa mukto’tra ca muktā sā naro nārī hi bhūtale || 26||
dūrasthā api bhaktā īdṛśāḥ kṛṣṇāntikasthitāḥ |
yadi naitādṛśāḥ pārśvasthitāste dūravanmatāḥ ||27||
tasmāt prītyudayasiddhyai yatitavyaṃ nirantaram |
śravaṇe manane nididhyāsane divyadarśane ||28||
kṛṣṇe tādātmyamāpannāt sādhormukhāddhareḥ kathā |
śrotavyā śrīhareḥ smṛtyā sahitārthasya dhāriṇī ||29||
śrutārthasya tu mananaṃ punaḥ punarvicāraṇam |
sapremamūrtisahitaṃ kartavyaṃ vāsanāpaham ||3.224.30||
tataḥ saṃskārajaṃ śuddhaṃ smaraṇaṃ nididhyāsanam |
kartavyaṃ śraddhayā prītyā prasannastasya mādhavaḥ ||31||
bhavettena hareḥ sphūrtiḥ sahajā nityamāntare |
sākṣātkāro bhavet sphūrtau divyamūrterhareḥ sadā ||32||
evaṃ prītirharau kāryā tayā prītirharerbhavet |
parasparaprītimatostādātmyaṃ jāyate tataḥ ||33||
brahmacaryamātmaniṣṭhā vairāgyaṃ śravaṇādayaḥ |
kṛṣṇāśrayaśca sākṣātkārahetavasta īritāḥ ||34||
mananaṃ ca nididhyāso bhakteṣṭasiddhidāyakau |
kevalaṃ śravaṇaṃ naiva sākṣātkāraphalapradam ||35||
vāsanā nahi naśyanti nididhyāsanamantarā |
hṛdgranthayo vinaśyanti kṛṣṇākhaṇḍavicintanāt ||36||
nididhyāsanayuktasya pratyakṣadraṣṭureva ha |
pūrṇakāmatānandāśca vartante netarasya tu ||37||
bāhyaṃ kṛṣṇasya draṣṭurvai mantuśca hṛdaye tathā |
smartuḥ rūpaṃ ca satataṃ drutaṃ sphurati keśavaḥ ||38||
anevaṃvartamānasyānevaṃyatnakṛto’pi ca |
naiva sphurati viśvātmā divyātmā bhagavān hṛdi ||39||
tasmāt kṛṣṇasya hṛdye sākṣātkārasya sādhanam |
śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ nididhyāsanaṃ prītirucyate ||3.224.40 ||
prītyā satatasandhātryā sphurati kāntavaddhariḥ |
tasmācchrutasya dṛṣṭasya harestu mananaṃ tathā ||41||
smaraṇaṃ premasahitaṃ śraddhānvitaṃ samācaret |
tasyopari hareḥ prītirjāyate dhāmayojikā ||42||
dehe jīvasya tādātmyaṃ yāvadvai vartate ca tat |
kṛṣṇe snehe mahāvighnaṃ bodhyaṃ saṃsārajanmakṛt ||43||
tasmād dehādayamātmā bhinna ityavabodhanam |
guroḥ sataśca śāstrācca prāptavyaṃ ca vivekinā ||44||
bhramo nāśayitavyaśca tādātmyasya jaḍātmanoḥ |
svarūpāṇi jaḍasyāpi cetanasyāpi sarvathā ||45||
dharmāścāpi praboddhavyā yairvailakṣaṇyametayoḥ |
sphurettena tu tādātmyabhrāntirnaśyet samūlikā ||46||
jaḍo duḥkhamayo rugṇo naśvaro vikṛtaḥ kṣayī |
lālāmūtramalavyāpto janmamṛtyujarānvitaḥ ||47||
khaṇḍanaddho bahvavastho māyiko bhautikaścayī |
piṇḍo hrāsī naikarūpo deho’yaṃ vartate sadā ||48||
indriyāṇi samagrāṇi sūkṣmadehaguṇāni vai |
duḥkhadoṣodvegacintākarāṇi tādṛśāni ca ||49||
etādṛśo nāhamasmi cidrūpaḥ sukhavānaham |
arogī śāśvato nirvikāraḥ kṣayavivarjitaḥ ||3.224.50||
saccidānandarūpo’smi janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ |
akhaṇḍaḥ sthira eko’haṃ divyo māyāvivarjitaḥ ||51 ||
abhautikaścayaśūnyaḥ prakāśī hāsavarjitaḥ |
ekarūpo nirmalaścāsaṃgī draṣṭāmaro’smi ca ||52||
śaktayo mama divyāścendriyaśaktipraprerikāḥ |
etādṛśo bhavāmyeva cetano mokṣadharmavān ||53 ||
ityātmānātmanoḥ samyag vivekaṃ samacintayet |
satāṃ mukhācchāstrato vā jñātvā taṃ pariśīlayet ||54||
pakve jñāne dehadharmasāṃkaryaṃ nātmadharmasu |
ātmaniṣṭho bhavettena bhagavanniṣṭha ityapi |||55||
brahmarūpo bhavedeva muktarūpo’tra mānavaḥ |
na tasya vāsanā tiṣṭhenna bhramo nāpi yātanāḥ ||56||
ātmānātmaviveko’yaṃ yasya nāsti dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ |
sa dehadharmairduḥkhādyaiḥ pīḍyate bhramanoditaḥ ||57||
yāvadabhyāsaśaithilyaṃ tāvaddehātmadhīvaśaḥ |
paśuvat pāśavīṃ vṛttiṃ caratvahaṃmamātmikām |||58||
dehendriyādyaikyarūpāṃ kāmasaṃkalpamohinīm |
strīpuṃvittarasāsaktiduḥkhatṛṣṇāghasaṃbhṛtām ||59||
miṣṭabhokṣye garavat sā duḥkhadā cātmamodane |
tayā vṛttyā nirayān sa prayātyeva tu māyikān ||3.224.60 ||
nirayeṣu gatirnaiva yathā syāt prayateta tat |
ātmaniṣṭhāṃ sādhayīta hareḥ satāṃ prasevayā ||61 ||
premṇā māhātmyavittyā ca dehaniṣṭhāṃ parityajet |
śraddhayā sampraseveta sādhūn bhaktyā janārdanam ||62||

śāstradharmān pālayecca māhātmyajñānamarjayet ||63||
evaṃ nirvāsanatvaṃ syāt kṛṣṇe snehāttu tad drutam |

māhātmyajñānayuktasya guṇāḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||65||
sarve tvāgatya vartante hṛdaye tu yathā satām |

bhajamānasya bhaktasya vāsanāśeṣasaṃbhave |
mṛtyuścejjāyate tasya janma devādiṣūjjvalam ||67||
sampadbhogakaraṃ syādvai bhaktānāṃ ca gṛhe tataḥ |
vāsanānāśamāsādya tato muktirbhavet dhruvā ||68||
savāsanasya bhaktasya yāmyagatirna vidyate |
bhaktiphalaṃ devaloka īśaloko’thavā mataḥ ||69||
mahācakravartirājā bhakto bhūtvākṣaraṃ vrajet |
apārakaruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktasya paramā gatiḥ ||3.224.70||
sa taṃ nirvāsanaṃ kṛtvā svabhaktaṃ parirakṣati |
kṛṣṇadhāmnaḥ sakāśāttu māyikā vaibhavā api ||71 ||
bhaktānāṃ nirayā eva bhāsante cātmavedinām |
bhuktvā tyaktvā tataste tān prayānti cākṣaraṃ padam ||72||
rāmanāma japan kṛṣṇaṃ spṛśan paśyan narāyaṇam |
divyaśca nirmalo brahmarūpo bhūtvā paraṃ padam ||73||
prayāti yogināṃ sthānaṃ muktānāṃ padamuttamam |
satāṃ maṇḍalamadhyastho’śnute’kṣare mahāsukham ||74||
bhaktā yadvāpyabhaktā vā sākṣāddharestu darśanam |
sparśanaṃ sevanaṃ kuryuste divyāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ||75||
abhaktāścet samanaskāḥ sevante prītisaṃbhṛtāḥ |
tadā te vāsanāṃ tyaktvā prayānti paramaṃ padam ||76||
api bhaktā nirmanaskāḥ sevante śrīpatiṃ prabhum |
tadā te’pi śanairjanmāntare yāsyanti tatpadam ||77||
tīvrasaṃvegabhaktānāmāsannatama īśvaraḥ |
mandasaṃvegabhaktānāṃ dūratamo janārdanaḥ ||78||
nirmanaskaṃ harernāmakīrtanaṃ darśanaṃ spṛśiḥ |

sarvārpaṇaṃ cānuvṛttirdāsītvaṃ muktaye harau ||3.224.90||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
japantu paramaṃ mantraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ raṭantvapi ||9 1||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ ratnaprabheti nāminaḥ |
kharapālasya bhaktasya kathāṃ mokṣapadāṃ śubhām || 1 ||

śreṣṭhināṃ ca nṛpādīnāṃ vyāpārān gardabhaiḥ sa tu |
karotyānayanaṃ cāpi nayanaṃ śramamūlyataḥ || 4 ||

bhaktihīnā dharmahīnāḥ puruṣārthavivarjitāḥ |

sādhusevādirahitā mānavā rāsabhā iva ||21||

krameṇa nītavān dhāmākṣaraṃ mokṣapadaṃ rame ||107||
evamuddhāritā bhaktāḥ sādhuyogena vai mayā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirdhruvā bhavet ||108||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne bhaktasya rāsabhapālasya ratnaprabhasya nṛsiṃhasvāmisādhuyogena bhagavatprāptirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 225 ||

<3.226>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvam ājīvanīnadītaṭe |
saurāṣṭre tvabhavadvaidyo nāmnā gadārdaneśvaraḥ || 1
jīradurgakṛtāvāsaścauṣadhitattvamarmavit |
vipraḥ kuṭumbasahito jīradurge nijāpaṇam || 2
kṛtvā karoti rugṇānāṃ cikitsāṃ cauṣadhaṃ tataḥ |
nāmābhavaddhi vikhyātaṃ roganāśakalāvidaḥ || 3
parito grāmavargeṣu deśalokeṣu cāpyati |
prajājanāḥ samāyānti tadgṛhaṃ roganuttaye || 4
so’pi nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā dadāti cauṣadham |
suphalaṃ tadbhavatyeva guṇakṛdrogahārakam || 5
yajñabhasmānvitaṃ devaprasādaśarkarānvitam |
tulasīpatracūrṇāḍhyaṃ kāṣṭhauṣadhaṃ ca dhātujam || 6
bhasmādi ca rasān vahnipakvān śarannivartakān |
kaphanāśakarān jīrṇajvaraghnānāsavām̐stathā || 7 |
virecakān gūṭikāṃśca pācakān vāyunāśakān |
śaktidān dhātupuṣṭikṛdvṛkṣabījāni yāni ca || 8 |
jantujān cūrṇitān rogaharām̐stuṣām̐śca mūlajān |
patrajān puṣpajām̐ścāpi tvacāṃ cūrṇāni yānyapi || 9 |
dadāti rogiṇe rogānnāśayatyeva sarvathā |
viṣaṃ harati śīghraṃ ca sarpādīnāṃ rasodbhavam || 3.226.1 0||
evaṃvidhasya vaidyasya śālāyāṃ mānavā daśa |
kurvanti peṣaṇaṃ cāpi mardanaṃ pācanaṃ tathā || 11 ||
sāraniḥsāraṇaṃ cūrṇanaṃ ca prajvālanaṃ sadā |
auṣadhāni yathāyogyaṃ sampādayanti yatnataḥ ||12||
varṣāraṃbhe svayaṃ gadārdanaḥ kṣetre nadītaṭe |
yāti kācādipātrāṇi nītvā jantumaye sthale || 1 3||
sarīsṛpām̐stāmrakaṇaśendragopān pipīlakān |
raktapuṣṭikarān jantūn dhṛtvā dadhāti pātrake || 14||
sahasraśaḥ prāṇaraudhairvyasavaste bhavanti hi |
uttejakāni tailāni kartuṃ gartādigodhikāḥ ||15||
dhṛtvā kāce tu nikṣipya vyasūn karoti vaidyarāṭ |
nirdayo nijalābhārthaṃ paraprāṇavighātakaḥ || 16||
vipro’pi rākṣasadharmā hiṃsāmārgaparo’bhavat |
nāṇakāṇāṃ pralobhena tṛṣṇayā hiṃsako’bhavat || 17||
evaṃ gadārdanaḥ kāle kāle jantuvināśakaḥ |
auṣadhārthaṃ koṭijantunāśakṛddhiṃsako’bhavat || 18||
jantavo’pi mūrchitā arditāḥ śapanti taṃ dvijam |
naḥ prāṇaghnasya te prāṇān hariṣyantyapi jantavaḥ || 19||
caturaśītilakṣāsu yoniṣveva muhurmuhuḥ |
asmadvadduḥkhamāsādya mṛtyuṃ yāhi punaḥ punaḥ || 3.226.20||
śaptaścaivaṃ bahuśāpaistīvravegaiḥ sa vaidyakaḥ |
karmavipākakālena jvarāviṣṭo’bhavacchanaiḥ ||21||
jvaranāśāya sahasāyujat sa gūṭikādikam |
jvaraḥ śāntiṃ na cāyāti pratyuta saṃpravardhate ||22||
prārabdhāgatavighnaṃ hi koṭyupāyairna naśyati |
śāpāgataṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ tvanyopāyairna līyate ||23||
vaidyasya yamarājasya devasya ca vṛṣasya ca |
īśvarasya samarthasya mānavasya tu kā kathā ||24||
līyate śāpadasyaiva prasādena na cānyathā |
atra te jantavo naṣṭāḥ prasādaḥ kuta ālabhet ||25||
jīrṇajvaro hi vaidyasya balavattvamupāgamat |
nityaṃ gadārdanaraktaṃ śoṣayatyeva bhūtavat ||26||
athāyaṃ tannirāsārthaṃ kvāthān pibati nityaśaḥ |
aprārabdhahatāḥ kvāthā viparītā bhavanti yat ||27||
raktanāśakarāścāpyuṣṇatāvivardhakāstathā |
nāḍīṣu māṃsapiṇḍeṣu sūkṣmachidrakarā api || 28||
vyavartanta samastāste kvāthāḥ kṣatakarāstataḥ |
mūtre male ṣṭhīvane’sya raktabhāgaḥ sravatyapi ||29||
nirvṛttātyupacāro’pi vaidyo rugṇataro’bhavat |
na buddhirna balaṃ dravyaṃ nopacārā vibhāgyake || 3.226.30||
mahāpāpe prabhavanti yojitāḥ kuśalairapi |
lakṣmi prasiddhavaidyasya kṛtaśramasya śāntaye ||3 1 ||
anye vaidyāścāyayuśca cikitsārthaṃ vidūrataḥ |
kṛtvā mūlacikitsāṃ te prayojayanti cauṣadham ||32||
tathāpyaghahatasyāsya leśalābho na dṛśyate |
āśāhatāśca te bhūtvā prayānti nijamandiram ||33||
raktasrāvā hi vaidyasya na śāntiṃ pragatāḥ khalu |
tatrauṣadhaiḥ kṛtairlakṣmi pratyutādhikatāṃ gatāḥ ||34||
varṣaṃ tvevaṃ gataṃ tasya yāmyasadṛśaduḥkhinaḥ |
tato mātrā tu bhasmotthā bhakṣitā bhiṣajā svayam ||35||
sāpi vikṛtimāsādya visphoṭān parito vyadhāt |
pācapūrṇaṃ ca durgandhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ varṣma cābhitaḥ || 36||
pācasrāvi kleditaṃ ca nārakaṃ kuṇḍavaddhyabhūt |
na pārśve ke’pi gacchanti vaidyo roditi śūlitaḥ ||37||
utpannakīṭajantukṛddaṃśairardita ityadhī |
ākrūśyatyatiduḥkhena jantukhāditamāṃsakaḥ ||38||
etādṛśamahāduḥkhaṃ prāptavān vaidyarāṭ rame |
duḥkhī māṃ bhajate nityaṃ duḥkhanāśāya kevalam ||39||
śāpaduḥkhavināśe’haṃ samartho na bhavāmi vai |
śāpadasya hṛdaye’haṃ sthitastadā samarditaḥ ||3.226.40||
śāpadastvahamevāsmi kathaṃ cāśāpakṛt punaḥ |
vinā taṃ śāpadaṃ jantuṃ prabhavāmi nivṛttaye ||41 ||
evaṃ vidhasya vaidyasya bhajamānasya māmapi |
duḥkhaṃ nivartate naiva maraṇaṃ nāpi jāyate ||482||
bhojanaṃ prāṇadhāraṃ cādatte’sya jāṭharo laghu |
tena prāṇā na prayānti śāpabhogaprabandhinaḥ ||43||
bahudānāni puṇyāni kṛtavān vaidyarāḍapi |
prāṇāḥ sthānaṃ na muñcanti yāmyapurīsamaprabhāḥ ||44||
oṣadhānāṃ prayogaiśca manāk svāsthyaṃ pradṛśyate |
māsaṃ svāsthyaṃ dṛśyate ca māṃsamajjā vivardhate ||45||
punaśca jantavastatra jāyante ca sahasraśaḥ |
kīṭā daśanti bahudhā yāmyakuṇḍo yathā tviha ||46||
evaṃ muhuḥ śāpavaśādasya vaidyasya vartate |
daśavarṣāṇi caivaṃ vai vyatītānyasya rogiṇaḥ ||47||
yāvanto jantavastena māritāstāvadeva tat |
duḥkhaṃ sākṣādatra jātaṃ yāmyaṃ tathāpi śiṣyate ||48||
madhye lakṣmi tathā tasya putrāḥ ṣaṭ pāpisaṃgataḥ |
atiriktātisāraiśca śanaiḥ kramānmṛtiṃ yayuḥ ||49||
vidhvastā vidhavā jātāḥ ṣaḍevāpatyavarjitāḥ |
gadārdanasya putryaśca sapta tāḥ saṃgadoṣataḥ ||3.226.50||
sarvā api tu vidhavā jātāḥ pitṛprapāpataḥ |
āsanācchayanādvāsād bhojanāt sahakarmaṇaḥ ||51 ||
utpādād dāyabhāgācca pāpaṃ saṃkramate jane |
jantūnāṃ māraṇe teṣāṃ kuṭumbināṃ yathā bhayam ||52||
duḥkhaṃ cābhūttathā śāpādasya kuṭumbināṃ tathā |
sarvamatraiva sañjātaṃ duḥkhaṃ tīvrapraveginaḥ ||53||
evaṃ nirvaṃśatāṃ prāptā patnī tvekāvaśiṣyate |
sāpi cintāparā bhrātṝn nijānāhūya sarvathā |||54||
dravyaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tebhyo gṛhaṃ śūnyamivābhavat |
patnī bhrātara evāpi dravyapāśena pāśitāḥ ||55||
rugṇāḥ sarve’bhavam̐stūrṇaṃ mṛtāste dravyabhoginaḥ |
nirvaṃśāste’pi jātā vai pāpadravyaprasaṃgataḥ ||56||
vaidyasyānnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ prāyaścittī yato bhavet |
lakṣmi śataghno vaidyo vai tadannaṃ pāpadaṃ matam |||57||
paśya vaidyā nirdayā vai yamadūtasamāḥ sadā |
chedane ghātane mṛtyudāne śavādisevane ||58||
nagnaśavābhyasane ca nagnaśavāvalokane |
nagnadurgandhakīṭāḍhyaśavānāṃ nityadarśane ||59||
rogasaṃskārakaraṇe pācakledādiśīlane |
yamadūtasamā vaidyā aśuddhāḥ prāṇapāragāḥ ||3.226.60||
anubhūtiṃ vinā ye te pāpinaḥ prāṇahārakāḥ |
teṣāmannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ vinaṣṭikṛt tadannakam ||61||
nahi sarve tviha loke dhanvantarisamāḥ khalu |
tattvajñā yadi puṇyāḥ syurahiṃsakāstu pāvanāḥ ||62||
aśvinīputrasadṛśāḥ pūjyāste tu matāḥ sadā |
lokakalyāṇakartāro hiṃsāmārgavivarjitāḥ ||63||
yathāpekṣauṣadhānāṃ tu prayogiṇaḥ subhaktayaḥ |
jantuhiṃsāvihīnāśca kāṣṭhadhātvādiyoginaḥ ||64||
durlabhāste devavaidyāsteṣāṃ pūjā tu puṇyadā |
atha lakṣmi gate kāle patnī gadārdanasya sā ||65||
kṣayarogeṇa vai vyāptābhavannāmnā mukundinī |
vaiṣṇavī patibhaktā ca śraddhābhāvaguṇānvitā ||66||
sā tvābālyāddharerbhaktābhavat snātrī prapūjikā |
bhaktimatī dharmavatī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||67||
vratadānatapaḥkartrī nityaṃ sādhuprasevikā |
kṛṣṇakathāyā raktā ca śaucasantoṣaśobhanā ||68||
tanvā manasā vāṇyā ca karmabhiḥ sādhusevikā |
kṛṣṇasevāparā nityaṃ navadhābhaktisaṃyutā ||69||
hāranaivedyadhūpādividhātrī viṣṇupūjikā |
ātmanivedinī mahābhāgavatī haripriyā ||3.226.70||
śīlasatyaparā sādhvīdharmayuktātmanaiṣṭhikī |
divyā divyaguṇopetā bhagavannaiṣṭhikī sadā ||71 ||
dhyānaparā ca sarvasvārpaṇaparā harau mayi |
lakṣmi tvetādṛśī bhaktā kintu saṃgāt suduḥkhitā ||72||
patyurardhaṃ samastaṃ vai bhujyate nijayoṣitā |
saivaṃ duḥkhaparā rugṇā vartate bhajate tu mām ||73||
tasyā varṣe gate kṣīṇāyāstu patirmṛto’bhavat |
parādhīnā ca vidhavā ruroda kurarīva sā ||74||
patyurasadgatiṃ vīkṣya smṛtvā putrīsutādikān |
mṛtān bhrātṝm̐śca vai smṛtvā svasyā asadgatiṃ tathā ||75||
cukrośākrandanairdhairyavarjitā kṣayarogiṇī |
śrutvā cākrośanaṃ devāḥ kṣaṇaṃ stabdhāstadābhavan ||76||
ṛtavaścāpi tattvāni kṣaṇaṃ jaḍāni cābhavan |
athāhaṃ sahasā lakṣmi cāntarātmā nijānumaḥ ||77||
mukundinyā hṛdayastho vatsalo duḥkhito’bhavam |
dhairyaṃ dadau cāntarātmā sadvicāreṇa cāpyaham ||78||
sāpi vijñānamāsādya dhairyamālambya māṃ harim |
asmarad bahudhā lakṣmi nātha nātha kṛpāṃ kuru ||79||
bhaktāyā cāpi duḥkhāyāṃ vidhavāyāṃ kṛpāṃ kuru |
sarvasvanāśayuktāyāṃ śeṣāyāṃ vatsalo bhava ||3.226.80||
duḥkhānāṃ nāsti me sīmā samuddhara bhavārṇavāt |
prathamaṃ māṃ mārayitvā tataḥ patiṃ pramāraya ||81||
sadhavāyā gatirme syād vidhavāyā gatirnahi |
eṣāhaṃ vahnimutpādya sajīvā prajvalāmi vai ||82||
satītvaṃ sarvathā yogyaṃ vidhavātvaṃ bhayāvaham |
kṛpā te’sti samāyāhi jīvayainaṃ nirogiṇam ||83 ||
naivaṃ cenmaraṇaṃ dehi yugapattūbhayorapi |
ityuktyā sā mama bhaktā kṣaṇaṃ dadhyau tu māṃ hṛdi ||84||
tāvanmayā pārṣadā me preṣitāstatpatiṃ prati |
yāmyadūtairnīyamānaṃ duḥkhinaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇam ||85||
pārṣadairme drutaṃ gatvā viyojito yamārthibhiḥ |
gṛhītaścānīta eva dehaṃ praveśitaḥ punaḥ ||86||
utthitaḥ sahasā deho’kasmād bandhanabandhitaḥ |
śavārthino’bhavan stabdhā mahāścaryasamanvitāḥ ||87||
kecijjagaduḥ pāpānāmapūrṇaṃ pāpabhoganam |
punaḥ pāpaprabhogāyāgato yāmyairna rakṣitaḥ ||88||
apare tu tadā prāhuḥ satyāḥ patnyāstu bhaktitaḥ |
utthitaścātibhaktyā vai nīrogo’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||89||
anye prāhurvāsaniko vartate’yaṃ hi pāpavān |
na yāti paralokaṃ svāṃ patnīṃ vihāya caikalaḥ ||3.226.90||
itare tu tadā prāhuḥ karmarekhā hi durgamā |
ityevaṃ te viremuśca nirbandhanaṃ vyadhuśca tam ||91||
atha lakṣmi tadā cāhaṃ patnyā bhakteḥ pratāpataḥ |
puro divyamabhavam̐śca mūrtimān pārṣadaiḥ saha ||92||
caturbhujo divyadehaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
avadaṃ ca mukundinyai varaṃ vṛṇu madagrataḥ ||93||
sāpi cotthāya sahasā patitā pādayormama |
gadārdano’pi māṃ vīkṣya nīroga iva nidritaḥ || 94||
utthāya nyapatacchīghraṃ pādayormama bhūtale |
varadānāya ca mayā niyuktāvūcatuśca tau ||95||
mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho parameśa ramāpate |
sarvaṃ kālena nītaṃ nau hyāvāṃ nirvāsanau kṛtau ||16||
vaidyavaidyo mahākālastadvaidyaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
yāmyahūtau drāvitau tvatpārṣadairiha sarvathā ||97||
mokṣaṃ dehi yatheṣṭaṃ vā niyojaya pareśvara |
evaṃ prārthayamānābhyāṃ tathetyuktvā vimānake ||98||
adhyāropya divaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣayāmāsa pārṣadaiḥ |
satībhaktipratāpena satī mukundinī tadā ||99||
divaṃ tyaktvā satīlokaṃ patyā saha yayau drutam |
pārṣadā me tu tāṃ svāmisahitāṃ vai mukundinīm || 3.226.100 ||
avasthāpya satīlokaṃ prayayurmama dhāma ha |
evaṃ kālāntare prāpte tau yāsyataḥ paraṃ padam || 101 ||
lakṣmi bhaktāpratāpena vaidyo yāmyaṃ vihāya ca |
satīlokaṃ yayau yasya pāpapuñjo’bhavanmahān || 1 02||
tathāpi strīpratāpena kṛpayā me layaṃ gataḥ |
ardhāṃganākṛtaṃ puṇyamardhaṃ tu labhate patiḥ || 1 03||
vratadānādikaṃ bhaktiḥ sarvamardhaṃ prapadyate |
evaṃ sambandhinaḥ putrāḥ striyo mitrāṇi cāpare || 1 04||
kurvanti pretanāmnāpi puṇyaṃ prete prapadyate |
tasmācchrāddhaṃ makhaṃ dānaṃ kurvanti pṛṣṭhato janāḥ || 1 05||
bhaktitulyaṃ mokṣadaṃ vai sādhanaṃ netarad rame |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktiśca vai bhaveta || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne gadārdaneśvaranāmakavaidyasya pāpairduḥkhāni tatpatnyā mukundinyā bhaktyā ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 226 ||

śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya śobhanām |
kīśanakulapālasya nāmnā deśyāvanasya vai || 1 ||
deśyāvano’bhavad yogī candrāvanasya cātmajaḥ |
gomaṇḍalyāścāpagāyāstaṭe gauvādikheṭagaḥ || 2 ||
pitrā putraḥ śikṣito vai kīśanakulapālane |
kīśayornartane cāpi nakulayostu yodhane || 3 ||
vānaro bhavati rājā vānaro ghargharīyutā |
śāṭīdharā ca lajjāyāṃ vartate kīśasannidhau || 4 ||
rājñīva vartate cāpi nṛtyasyeva praśikṣitā |
nṛtyakṣatau vānarastāṃ tāḍayatyeva roṣataḥ || 5 ||
bānaro’pi tataḥ khātavaṃśayormadhyarajjugaḥ |
naṭavat saṃprayātyeva sthālyā chatradharo naṭaḥ || 6 ||
vānarī ḍamarūvādyaṃ vādayatyeva raṃgagā |
janān pradarśayatyeṣā yaṣṭyā hastena vānaram || 7 ||
janā dṛṣṭvā magnacittā arpayanti dhanānnakam |
athāpi vānaraścādho’vatīrya śakaṭīṃ navām || 8 ||
āyuktvā tu śṛgālau dvau tatrāropya tu vānarīm |
svayaṃbhūtvā sūtakarmā cālayatyeva rājavat || 9 ||
nakulau vānarīpārśve pārṣadāviva tiṣṭhataḥ |
cāmare śobhite dhṛtvā vīkṣante kautukaṃ janāḥ || 3.227.1 0||
śṛgālau vahamānau tau kīśo yaṣṭyā pratāḍanam |
yāvat karoti jambukau kruddhau pratimukhau dhuri | 11 ||
bhūtvā nirgatya dhurataścotplutyākruśya roṣataḥ |
vānareṇa samaṃ samyag yudhyataḥ saṃprapaśyatām || 12||
janānāṃ tatra kīśena yuddhyatyekastu jambukaḥ |
dvitīyo vānarīkarṇe dhṛtvā nītvātigo’bhavat || 1 3||
deśyāvanastadā tyaktvā raṃgaṃ dudrāva vānarīm |
ānetuṃ ca śṛgālāṃ tu tāvat kīśo’pi dhāvati ||14||
ānetuṃ vānarīṃ tāvajjambuko’pyanudhāvati |
nakulī pṛṣṭhatastatra vaṃśayoradhirohataḥ ||15||
prapaśyato hi vānaryā haraṇaṃ kroṣṭṛṇā kṛtam |
yuddhaṃ tatra punastāvad deśyāvanakṛtāvanam ||16||
punā raṃgānayanaṃ ca śṛgālasya kṣamārthanam |
bhikṣāṃ janebhyaḥ purikānāstī tatstrī prayācate || 17||
evaṃ deśyāvano nityaṃ nagare kharvaṭe pure |
gatvā gatvā hāsyanāṭyaṃ kārayatyeva pāśavam || 18 ||
tadutpannānnavastrādyairdhanaiḥ piṣṭādibhiḥ sadā |
nirvahatyeva satataṃ patnyā sākaṃ pratiṣṭhati || 19||
paśūnāṃ poṣaṇaṃ cāpi karoti dayayā yutaḥ |
naisargiko bhaktadharmā deśyāvanaḥ prage’nvaham ||3.227.20||
snāti kṛṣṇaṃ citrachaviṃ namati ca prapaśyati |
jalaṃ phalaṃ ca dharati bhojanaṃ purikākṛtam ||2 1||
nivedya viṣṇave datvā paśubhyo nijayoṣite |
tato bhuṃkte nānyathaiva nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ smaran ||22|||
lakṣmi sarvatra bhaktā me saṃskṛtāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ |
ye’pi ke’pi bhajante māṃ yathā tathāpi ceśvaram ||23||
teṣāṃ manaḥprapūrtyarthaṃ prayate bhaktikarśitaḥ |
purikāpi tu śūdrāṇī snātvā māṃ sevate’nvaham || 24||
śakaṭyāṃ mama mūrtiṃ ca rakṣatyeva chaviṃ śubhām |
nānyadharmaṃ prajānāti jānāti śaraṇāgatim ||25||
chavistho bhagavān kṛṣṇa uddhāraṃ naḥ kariṣyati |
tadarpaṇaṃ vinā naiva bhoktavyaṃ jalamityapi ||26||
harerbhaktiṃ vinā vandhyo netavyo divaso na vai |
antarātmā hariścāste kīśe nakule kroṣṭari ||27||
nāryā nare ca sarvatra vṛkṣe jaḍe ca cetane |
evaṃ tau budhyato lakṣmi kīśanakulapālakau ||28||
atastau pāvanau snigdhau bhaktau me mama sammatau |
dine khelaṃ viracayyotpādyopārjanabhojane ||29||
yathālabdhe susantuṣṭau rātrau kurutaḥ kīrtanam |
ḍamarūvādyasahitaṃ kṛṣṇa rāma ramāpate ||3.227.3 0||
evaṃ nityaṃ hi kuruto bhajanaṃ vai niśāmukhe |
pūrṇimāyāṃ tu miṣṭānnaṃ nivedayato matpuraḥ || 31 ||
paśubhyaḥ sampradāyaiva tatastau matprasādajam |
bhuñjāte pratimāsaṃ tau vrataṃ tvetannirantaram ||35|||
tulasīmiśritaṃ vāri pibatastau sadā rame |
nahi bhaktau kāraṇaṃ vai vanaṃ sthalaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam ||33||
snehastu kāraṇaṃ tatra hṛdayaṃ bhaktikāraṇam |
śraddhā ca kāraṇaṃ tatra puṇyaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ mahat ||34||
evaṃ gomaṇḍalītīre vasatoścobhayorapi |
ekadā sādhusaṃgho vai yātrārthī pārśvato’gamat ||35||
tāvubhau sahasā gatvā nematuḥ sādhupādayoḥ |
viśrāntyarthaṃ ghaṭikāṃ cārthayāmāsaturīśvarān ||36||
sādhavo’pi nadītīraṃ vṛkṣachāyāṃ vilokya tu |
kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpuste papurjalaṃ tu śītalam ||37||
pūrṇimāsīd bhāgyayogānmiṣṭamāsīt kṛtaṃ tadā |
saṃyāvaṃ śrīharaye vai niveditaṃ samastakam ||38||
sādhubhyo dadaturbhaktyā bhuktavantaśca sādhavaḥ |
mama smṛtiyutā lakṣmi saṃyāvo vṛddhimāptavān ||39||
mayāntaryāmiṇā jñātvā saṃyāvo vardhito hyati |
viṃśatiḥ sādhavaḥ sarve tṛptāstāvān sa cābhavat ||3.227.40||
saṃyāvaḥ pūrvamāno vai nyūnatāṃ nāvrajanmanāk |
sādhavo’pi vividurvai bhakteḥ pratāpameva tam ||41 ||
tanmadhye maṇḍalīśo yaḥ sādhurnāmnā sudhāmaraḥ |
upādideśa vākyāni matvā bhaktaṃ tu pātrakam ||42||
śṛṇu bhakta sadā sevyo hariśca tasya sādhavaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ satsu cāste kāmasaṃkalpapūrakaḥ ||43||
na jātirna dhanaṃ rājyaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādasādhanam |
snehabhaktiḥ sādhusevā kṛṣṇaprasādasādhanam ||44||
sādhavo bhagavanniṣṭhā tathā śrībhagavān svayam |
kṣetraṃ vai naimiṣāraṇyaṃ kuṇṭhitaṃ yatra mānasam ||45||
indriyāṇi kuṇṭhitāni nivṛttāni sthirāṇi ca |
viṣayebhyaḥ parāvṛtya jāyante śāntidāni ca ||46||
tatra kṣetre sāghurūpe tathā nārāyaṇātmake |
satsaṃgasalile snātvā puṇyayajñān samācaret ||47||
āśu siddhirbhavettatra mokṣadharmasya cottamām |
dhyānaṃ siddhistathā śīghraṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ prajāyate ||48||
vānarā indriyāṇyeva tvahaṃmanasī jambukau |
pūrvakarmāṇi nakulāstān vaśān sannayet sadā ||49||
dharme jñāne ca vairāgye bhaktau sādhuprasevane |
harermūrtau ca tiṣṭheyustathā vaśān vidhāpayet ||3.227.50||
parotkarṣāsahiṣṇvākhyāmirṣyāṃ tyajet sadā sudhīḥ |
mānaṃ tyājyaṃ prayatnena sudhiyā sarvarodhakam ||51 ||
sattvena bhāvyaṃ satataṃ dharme ruciryato bhavet |
sattvaṃ proktaṃ kṛtayugaṃ yatra dhyānaṃ bhaveddhareḥ ||52||
rajovegān rodhayedvai kāmyakarmapraperakān |
rajastretāyugo bodhyaḥ sevā kāryātra daihikī ||53||
rajastamobhyāṃ yuktātmā dvāparātmā prakathyate |
tatra lojārjanatṛṣṇā tyajet sevāṃ careddhareḥ ||54||
tamomayaḥ kalirbodhyo yatra māyānṛtādikam |
tatra samāgamaḥ kāryaḥ satāṃ ca bhajanaṃ muhuḥ ||55||
uccaiḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kalervego nivartate |
pūrvakarmānusāreṇa pravartante yugā hṛdi ||56||
ato dhyānaṃ cātmaniṣṭhā māhātmyabuddhiruttamā |
sādhanīyā viśeṣeṇa yugadharmādirodhinī ||57||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhajato bhītirnāstyeva kālakarmajā |
kṛtārtho’smīti matvaiva seveta sādhusattamān ||58||
bhaktiṃ kuryānnavadhāpi sarvasvārpaṇabhāvanām |
kṛṣṇasādhvāśrayeṇaiva kalirnaśyati vai hṛdaḥ ||59||
yatra kṛṣṇanivāso’sti tatra kalirna vidyate |
yatra santaḥ sthitāḥ santi tatra māyā na vidyate ||3.227.60||
mahābhāgavato dharmo mahāvaiṣṇavatātmakḥ |
sarvanivedanātmā sa pālanīyaḥ sadā śubhaḥ ||61 ||
cauryaṃ piśunatā dambhaḥ kartavyā naiva sarvathā |
satāṃ samāgamaḥ kāryo viśvāso’pi sadā satām ||62||
maryādā ca satāṃ pālyā yathā kṛṣṇasya sā tathā |
sevā satāṃ sadā kāryā yathā kṛṣṇasya sā tathā ||63||
yeṣu hiṃsā madaścauryamanṛtaṃ kapaṭaṃ tathā |
nāstikatvaṃ ca māyā ca te na viśvāsabhūmayaḥ ||64||
te tu ruciṃ na kurvanti satsaṃge satsu vā harau |
druhyantyeva te satataṃ kalipriyāstu pāpinaḥ ||65||
ato mumukṣuṇā sevyāḥ santo naiva tu nāstikāḥ |
satāṃ yogena sarveśa bhajitvā muktimarjayet ||66||
satsaṃge śraddhayānanyabhāvena bhajate tu yaḥ |
dehānte sa vrajatyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ param ||67||
golokaṃ vāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vrajennārāyaṇāśramam |
śvetadvīpaṃ vrajedvāpi śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ vrajet ||68||
divyadṛṣṭimatāṃ tāni cāntike santi sarvathā |
bāhyadṛṣṭimatāṃ tāni dhāmāni santi dūrataḥ ||69||
dehe jīvo yathā tatra jīve śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
vartate tanmayīdṛṣṭyā paśyeddhāmāni cāntike ||3.227.70||
yatra kṛṣṇo’sti hṛdaye bahirvā tatra santi vai |
sarvadhāmāni kṛṣṇasyaiśvaryāṇi nikhilānyapi ||71 ||
evaṃvijñāstu ye bhaktāste śrīkṛṣṇasamā matāḥ |
teṣāṃ darśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanasadṛśam |||72||
anyaiḥ sarvairīdṛśānāṃ samāgamena mokṣaṇam |
prāpyate durlabhaṃ yadvai sulabhaṃ satprasādataḥ ||73||
satsu snehena santaḥ svāśritān nayanti cākṣaram |
vāsanāḥ kṣapayitvaiva nayanti paramaṃ padam ||74||
strīvargaṃ naravargaṃ vā sakāmaṃ vāpi dehinam |
santo viśodhya divyaṃ taṃ kṛtvā nayanti cākṣaram ||75||
śṛṇu deśyāvana tvaṃ vai smara nāṭye prabhuṃ harim |
vaṃśarajjvā dhāma divyamakṣaraṃ smara sarvathā ||76||
rajjusthe vānare viṣṇuṃ smara chatre tu chatrakam |
vaṃśe pūrve tu golokaṃ dvitīye tu vikuṇṭhakam ||77||
smara divyaṃ rathaṃ taṃ tu yatra sā vānarī sthitā |
brahmarathaṃ smara tatra māyāṃ viṣṇostu vānarīm ||78||
kroṣṭāraṃ cāpyahaṃkāraṃ dvitīyaṃ mānasaṃ smara |
tābhyāṃ sā sajjate māyā tāṃ samarpaya viṣṇave ||79||
nakulaṃ tu guruṃ sarvadraṣṭāraṃ smara tatra hi |
rajjvakṣarasthito divyo gurustvāṃ tārayiṣyati ||3.227.80||
ḍamarūtthaṃ mahānādam oṃnārāyaṇamādhavam |
vidhehi satataṃ sarvajīvānāṃ śravaṇāya vai ||8 1 ||
paśya sevātmikāṃ bhaktiṃ raṃgarakṣākarīṃ naṭīm |
paśya bhikṣāṃ mokṣayātrāṃ nityadravyamayīṃ tathā ||82||
bhikṣāpradān śaraṇe vai samāyātān śarīriṇaḥ |
paśya sādhoḥ saṃgamena pāvanān dattacittakān ||83||
sādhuṃ sudhāmaraṃ māṃ tvaṃ paśyāntaryāmiṇaṃ harim |
jñānadaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hitārthinam ||84||
deśyāvanaṃ nijātmānaṃ paśya kīśādipālakam |
svāminaṃ ca niyantāraṃ raṃgakhelavidhāyinam ||85||
raṃgabhūmiṃ paśya jātiṃ dehaṃ gehaṃ samastakam |
khelāntaṃ paśya maraṇaṃ visarjanaṃ tu karmaṇām ||86||
darśakānāṃ manorañjanaṃ tu paśya śamādikam |
evaṃ kṛtvā tava tṛptiṃ jātāṃ paśya tu śāśvatīm ||87||
ityevaṃ nityamīkṣam̐stvaṃ paraṃ padaṃ prayāsyasi |
hṛdaye brāhmīmupaniṣadaṃ prāpya bhayaṃ nahi ||88 ||
yāvadvai vāsanā cāsti tāvat khelaḥ pravartate |
upaniṣannivāsena khelaḥ khelo bhavet sadā ||89||
parā śāntiḥ pravarteta deśyāvana tathācara |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||3.227.90||
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama |
bhaja nityaṃ parameśaṃ tvevaṃ samāhito bhava ||91 ||
ityuktvā kamale sādhuḥ samaṇḍalaḥ supūjitaḥ |
prasannamānaso bhūtvā datvāśīrvacanaṃ yayau ||92||
athāyaṃ deśyavacano vilokya pātrake dhṛtam |
prasādātmakasaṃyāvaṃ sampūrṇaṃ tu yathātatham ||93||
camatkāraṃ mahāścaryaṃ mene kṛpāṃ harerapi |
kuṭumbayug bubhuje’pi prasādaṃ tāvadeva saḥ ||94||
divyadṛṣṭirabhavadvai kuṭumbasahitaḥ khalu |
agre pārśve pṛṣṭhataśca haristasyābhito’bhavat ||95||
yatra paśyati tatraiva viśvātmānaṃ prapaśyati |
ūrdhve’dho bhūtale pātre vastre rathe ca vānare ||96||
jambuke nakule naṭyāṃ parātmānaṃ prapaśyati |
divyabhāvo’bhavadbhaktaḥ kalpitaṃ labhate kare ||97||
nārāyaṇasya me mūrtiḥ sarvato gocarābhavat |
kṛpā sā me guroḥ sādhoścāpi lakṣmi śubhā hi sā ||98||
yayā sarvamasya jātaṃ brahmadarśanamuttamam |
atha vāksiddhamājñāya janāścāyānti saṃghaśaḥ ||99||
kṛtvā tu darśanaṃ tasya bhavanti pāvanā api |
mantraṃ gṛhṇanti me tasmād bhaktād viyanti vai tataḥ || 3.227.100 ||
kṛtakṛtyāḥ prajāyante mahābhāgavatekṣaṇāt |
atha kāle samāyāte tvāvirbhūto’bhavaṃ puraḥ | 101 ||
vimānena sahitaśca pārṣadaiśca samanvitaḥ |
tvayā sākaṃ tathā lakṣmi divyadehānakārayam || 1 02||
kīśanakulakroṣṭṝm̐śca kīśapaṃ kīśapāṃ tathā |
vimāne tām̐ścādhirohayitvānayaṃ mamākṣaram || 103 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi dadau muktiṃ muktamaṇḍalamadhyagām |
mama prasādabhoktṛbhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhaktiyogataḥ || 1 04||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mananādvartanāttathā |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi divyaṃ svargaṃ ca śāśvatam || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne deśyāvanasya kīśapālasya sudhāmarasādhoḥ prasaṃgena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 227 ||

<3.228>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ cānyāṃ vadāmyaham |
harṣadharmābhidho bhakto nāpitaḥ pārvatīpure || 1 ||
nyavasat sakuṭumbo vai rājabhṛtyatvakarmavān |
rājā nāmnābhavattatra svarṇadhanvetiśāsakaḥ || 2 ||
tasya sevāṃ karotyeṣo nāpitaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ |
nāpitasyābhavadbhāryā nāmnā nigamikā satī || 3 ||
pātivratyaparā viṣṇubhaktiparā sudhārmikī |
vratadānajapasevāparā nārāyaṇe ratā || 4 ||
sādhusevātatparā ca divyabhāvavatī sadā |
putrāḥ pañcābhavam̐stasyāḥ pañcaputryaśca śobhanāḥ || 5 ||
sarve te bhagavadbhaktā vaiṣṇavā bhaktiśālinaḥ |
raṭanti māṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ gopipatiṃ śriyaḥ patim || 6 ||
bhajante satataṃ cāpi gṛhe’rcananivedanaiḥ |
ṣoḍaśopacārakaiśca nityaṃ māmarcayanti te || 7 ||
mūrtau sthitvā sadā teṣāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi prītimān |
nāpito’pi sadā snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca me tataḥ || 8 ||
naivedyaṃ me samarpyaiva bhuktvā yāti nṛpālayam |
nṛpaṃ saṃsevate sarvātmanā bhṛtyo hi nāpita || 9 ||
nāpitasya tathā putrāḥ putryo rājakuṭumbinaḥ |
sevante ca yathāyogyaṃ kṛtvā matpūjanādikam || 3.228.1 0||
pratyahaṃ nāpitabhāryā prātarnigamikā tu sā |
prathamaṃ vai samutthāya snātvā gṛhādiśodhanam || 11 ||
kṛtvā matvā jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃsnāpya keśavam |
śālagrāmaṃ tu māṃ cāpi prapūjya sarvavastubhiḥ || 1 2||
phalaṃ cānnaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ roṭakaṃ dadhi dugdhakam |
śubhaṃ coṣṇaṃ vidhāyaiva picchalaṃ me’rpayatyapi || 13 ||
tato nirājanaṃ kṛtvā parihāraṃ karoti ca |
patimutthāpya saṃsnāpya patipādodakaṃ tathā || 14||
kṛṣṇapādodakaṃ pītvā patiṃ sampūjayatyapi |
samarpayati paścācca patīṣṭaṃ yadapekṣitam || 15||
tato’tithaye sādhubhyo’nāthebhyo’pi prayacchati |
annaṃ jalaṃ yathāyogyaṃ samarpya ca gave’pi ca || 1 6||
sūryāya ca jalaṃ datvā viṣṇave’rghyaṃ samarpya ca |
datvā piṣṭaṃ pipīlikākulāya ca tataḥ param || 17 ||
pitṛbhyaścāpi datvaiva yatsarvaṃ śuddhimat punaḥ |
pataye bhojanādyaṃ ca jalaṃ samarpya vai tataḥ || 18||
putryādibhyaḥ samarpyaiva bhojanaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam |
svayaṃ bhuṃkte nigamikā prasādaṃ tvavaśeṣitam || 19||
kavale kavale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cārpaye |
iti smṛtvā prabhuṃkte sā jalaṃ pibati vai tathā ||3.228.20||
madhye śvā nakulaḥ kīśaḥ śukaścaṭakā gaurvṛṣaḥ |
mārjārikāpi cāgacched datvā tebhyo’tti nānyathā ||21||
evaṃvidhā tu bhaktā sā śrīkṛṣṇasyeva dāsikā |
gṛhakāryāṇi sampādya prātareva suveginī || 22 ||
rājñyālayaṃ prayātyeva nigamikātidhārmikī |
rājñīṃ nāmnā pañcadevīṃ suptāṃ śayanagāṃ śanai ||23|||
sammardayati cāṃgeṣu saṃvāhayati pādayoḥ |
rājñyāḥ kṛte jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ sampādayati satvaram ||24||
dantadhāvanacūrṇaṃ ca jalagaṇḍūṣakādikam |
śaucādyaṃ nirvartayati saṃsnāpayati vāribhiḥ ||25||
sugandhamardanaṃ cāpi dehaśodhanamityapi |
keśasaṃskaraṇaṃ cāpi keśaveṣādiśobhanam ||26||
śṛṃgāraveṣabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ kajjalāñjanam |
alaktakapradānaṃ ca nakhoṣṭhādiprarañjanam ||27|||
sarvaṃ yathāvad datvaiva pūjayitvā śriyaṃ yathā |
vyajanena mahārājñīṃ prasannayati vāyudā || 28||
gṛhakāryaṃ samastaṃ ca niṣpādayati śobhanam |
mādhyāhnikaṃ tathā sāyaṃtanīyaṃ sevanādikam ||29||
rājñyāstāmbūladānāntaṃ sampādayati nāpitī |
śayyāṃ kusumagandhāḍhyāṃ samāstṛṇāti nityaśaḥ ||3.228.30 ||
rājñī svapiti sukhinī samvāhayati nāpitī |
rājñī nidrāṃ karotyeva gāḍhāṃ prayāti nāpitī ||31 ||
gṛhe gatvā patisevāṃ pādasamvāhanātmikām |
karotyapi ca nityaṃ vai tataḥ svapiti nāpitī ||32||
kṛtabhūpasusevaśca patistvardhaniśātyaye |
nityaṃ gṛhaṃ samāyāti sevate nāpitī tataḥ ||33 ||
dhanyā śraddhā sevakānāṃ tatrāpi dāsasevinām |
tatrāpi yoṣitāṃ lakṣmi pātivratyānvitātmanām ||34||
karmabandhanaloko’yaṃ karmādhīnaḥ karoti hi |
niṣkāmabhāvavaśagaḥ kaścit karoti bhaktarāṭ ||35 ||
nāpitī nāpitaścobhau jānītaḥ karmabandhanam |
rājasevā karmabandhaṃ udyamo’yaṃ dhanāptaye ||36||
upārjanaṃ vinā dehayātrā naiva hi siddhyati |
annaṃ dhanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca labhyate rājasevayā ||37||
tathāpi bhaktimantau tau mṛṣāsevādyapekṣayā |
mama sevāṃ hi kurutaḥ śāśvatānandavāñcchayā ||38||
dehendriyārthaṃ kartavyaṃ karmavaśena dehinā |
ātmārthaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ jñānena tu mumukṣuṇā ||39||
śrīharyarthaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sarvārpaṇena bhāvinā |
evaṃ matvā tu kurutaḥ sevanaṃ mama tau sadā ||3.228.40 ||
rājagṛhe’pi kuruto bhajanaṃ mama tau sadā |
kīrtanaṃ kuruto me’pi gopīgītaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||41 ||
rāsalīlāṃ ca vadataḥ kathāṃ ca kuruto mama |
rājñī rājā tu tacchrutvā nidritaḥ kṛṣṇamānasau ||42||
evaṃ bhajete cānyām̐śca bhaktiṃ kārayato’pi ca |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||43|||
japato jāpayataśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa muhurmuhuḥ |
evaṃ bhaktimatornityaṃ niyamo rājasevane ||44||
vartate tvekadā sāyaṃ nāpite nirgate gṛhāt |
rājñastasyaiva sevāyāmupasthite gṛhe hyanu ||45||
nāpitānyāstu vai nirgamasya kṣaṇe hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhvyaścāpi daśasaṃkhyā mahīmānāḥ samāyayuḥ ||46||
mahābhāgyena puṇyena mahatāyānti sādhavaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ svāgatārthaṃ vai sarvaṃ kartavyamādarāt ||47||
śatakāryāṇi santyajya sādhusevāṃ samācaret |
ātitheyaḥ paro dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ sadā mataḥ ||48||
tatrāpi ca satāṃ sādhvīnāṃ kṛte cottamo vṛṣaḥ |
sarvaṃ vihāya sevāyāṃ vartitavyamiti dhruvaḥ | | 49||
mokṣārthaṃ mānavo deho mokṣārthaṃ sādhavo bhuvi |
teṣāṃ yoge tu sarvasvaṃ cārpaṇīyaṃ drutaṃ janaiḥ | |3.228.5 0 ||
anyathā mānave dehe ko lābhaḥ sevanaṃ vinā |
yadgṛhe’tithayo yānti tuṣyanti svāgatādibhiḥ ||5 1 ||
tadgṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ lakṣmīnivāsārhaṃ sadā bhavet |
yadgṛhe’tithayo bhagnamānasā vai bhavanti cet ||52||
asatkṛtā asantuṣṭāstadgṛhaṃ dagdhavat smṛtam |
puṇyahīnaṃ bhavatyeva lakṣmīsampadvivarjitam | |53||
yadgṛhaṃ sādhusanyāsiyatiyogikṛtāśrayam |
tadgṛhaṃ devavasatirdivyaṃ tīrthottamaṃ sadā |||54||
yadgṛhe sādhavo naiva naivātithiprasevanam |
śmaśānaṃ tadgṛhaṃ proktaṃ sūtakaṃ tatra vai sadā ||55||
yadgṛhe sādhavaḥ santi tadgṛhe santi devatāḥ |
vighnāḥ sarve nivartante vasanti tatra siddhayaḥ |||56||
tīrthāni tatra cāyānti sādhūnāṃ pādavāñcchayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra virājate | |57||
yatra nārāyaṇastatra rādhikā kamalā ramā |
muktāstatra vasantyeva divyadehā haripriyāḥ ||58||
yatkuṭumbe kṛpā sādhostatkuṭumbaṃ videhavat |
muktatāṃ bhajamānaṃ vai divyaṃ pāpaharaṃ matam |||59||
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ tatkuṭumbakam |
yadgṛhe sādhavo dhīrā bhuñjate ca pibanti ca || 3.228.6 0||
svapanti kīrtayantīśeśvaranāma narāyaṇam |
putrāḥ putryaḥ striyaścāpi sevante yānti divyatām ||6 1 ||
sarve muktā bhavantyeva sādhusatsaṃgalābhataḥ |
sādhusevā hyakṣayo’sti kośastvanyastu sakṣayaḥ ||62||
tasmāt sādhūn sevayitvā bhojayitvā tathā punaḥ |
śāyayitvā tadājñāṃ saṃlabdhvā yāsyāmi vai tataḥ || 63 ||
rājñyāḥ sevārthamevāhaṃ ceti niścitya nāpitī |
cakre satāṃ svāgataṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau mudā ||64||
āsanāni dadau cāpi samidhaśca dadau jalam |
phalaṃ tathā ca miṣṭānnamuṣṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau mudā ||65||
bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca sādhūn sādhvīstataśca sā |
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi ||66||
cakre dhairyeṇa niratā kīrtayantyapi sādhavaḥ |
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kīrtayanti rātryardhaṃ vigataṃ tataḥ || 67||
sarve suptāḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyaścātha tu nāpitī |
cintāṃ cakre manāg rājñyāḥ sevāṃ kartuṃ susatvarā ||68|||
natvā cājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca yayau rājñīṃ prati drutam |
atha rājñyapi samaye vigate’pi tu nāpitī ||69||
nāgateti mahākruddhā daṇḍaṃ dātuṃ samicchati |
śvaḥ sarvasvaṃ hareyaṃ vai nāpitānyā mayārpitam ||3.228.70 ||
niṣkāsayiṣye grāmādvā kariṣye nigaḍe sthitām |
evaṃ kruddhā hyabhavatsā jānātīdaṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||71 ||
lakṣmi tadāhaṃ bhagavān niśādyaprahare drutam |
bhaktāyā nāpitānyā vai rūpaṃ dhṛtvā suśobhanām ||72||
kruddhārājñyāḥ praśāntyarthaṃ sevārthaṃ pramadāgamam |
vicāryetthaṃ mama bhaktā sādhūn sādhvīḥ prasevate ||73 ||
bhaktāyā jīvikānāśaṃ rājñī kruddhā kariṣyati |
tanmā bhūnmama bhaktāyāḥ sevikāyāḥ satāṃ tathā ||74||
mayā rakṣayitavyeyaṃ bhaktā me dharmaśālinī |
kuṭumbaṃ ca samastaṃ tad rakṣaṇīyaṃ hi bhaktimat ||75||
vicāryetthaṃ bhaktarakṣākaraścāhaṃ tu nāpitī |
bhūtvā niśādyaprahare yayau rājñīgṛhaṃ drutam ||76||
rājñyāḥ samastasevāstu kuśalinyā mayā kṛtā |
nārīrūpeṇa rātryāṃ vai śṛṃgāro bhojanādikam ||77||
pātrāṇāṃ śuddhikaraṇaṃ pānaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sugandhi ca |
śayyāvidhānaṃ ramyaṃ ca tāmbulādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||78||
rājñyā dehasya samyag vai saṃvāhanaṃ sumardanam |
vyajanena pavanasyārpaṇaṃ vārtāpralāpanam ||79||
upadeśādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā tadā niśi |
śṛṇu lakṣmi copadeśaṃ kṛtavānahameva yam ||3.228.80||
śāstrakathā śravaṇīyā guruḥ pūjyo hi sarvathā |
dānaṃ deyaṃ tathā rājñyā śraddhayā dharmayoṣitā ||81 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sevyaḥ sadā dhiyā |
ahantāmamate tyājye garvaḥ kāryo na sarvathā ||82||
dīnānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ krodhaḥ kāryo na bhṛtyake |
dāsīṣu ca kṛpā kāryā na hartavyaṃ kṣatāvapi ||83||
annaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ vāpi sevākṣatāvapi kvacit |
bhajanīyaḥ paramātmā rājñyā tasyāṃ kṛpā hareḥ ||84||
bhavatyeva sadā tena mokṣo’kṣare prajāyate |
nirañjanā mahāmuktā jāyate kṛṣṇasadṛśī ||85||
na baddhyate ramāvat sā karmabhiśca śubhāśubhaiḥ |
atisnehena lakṣmīvat prāpnotyaikyaṃ harau tu sā ||86||
yadvā prasevate bhaktyā patnī bhūtvā pṛthak sthitā |
hareḥ kṛpayā kāryeṣu svatantrā jāyate sadā ||87||
brahmaniṣṭhā brahmaśīlā muktimāpnoti cākṣare |
yā tu bhogaparā rājñī kṛṣṇasevāvivarjitā ||88||
sā tu mṛtvā divaṃ gatvā bhuktvā martye’tra jāyate |
mānuṣyevaṃ bahujanmasiddhā bhaktyā tu mokṣyate ||89||
sādhorguroḥ kṛpayā ca yāsyatyante’kṣaraṃ padam |
kṛpayā śrīhareratra kṣayaṃ yānti hi vāsanāḥ ||3.228.90||
kṛtvā satsaṃgamevātra bhajitvā parameśvaram |
mānuṣyaṃ sārthakaṃ kuryānmokṣātmanityarājyadam ||91 ||
ātmāyaṃ brahmarūpo’sti kṛṣṇaṃ paśyeddhi tatra ca |
evaṃ lakṣmi tūpadiśya tāṃ rājñīṃ saṃprasevya ca ||92||
jāgradvannidritāṃ kṛtvā niragamaṃ tadālayāt |
tāvattatra samāyātā nāpitānī niśārdhake ||93||
sevituṃ tāṃ mahārājñīṃ kampamānā bhayānvitā |
śayyāsthale hyupasthitvā kṣamāmayācatānatā ||94||
mahīmānaprasaṃgena kālo me vigato bahuḥ |
mahārājñyā kṣamā kāryā sevāyāṃ nāhamāgatā ||95||
śrutvāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptā rājñī sandehamāgatā |
yā sevitvā gatā bhṛtyā seyaṃ punaḥ kathaṃ nanu ||96||
samāyātā yācate ca kṣamāṃ vināparādhanam |
vicāryetthaṃ jagādaināṃ nāpiti tvaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ ||97||
samāyātā kṣamāyāñcāṃ kuruṣe ca kathaṃ vada |
idānīṃ tvaṃ samastaṃ me naiśikaṃ sevanādikam ||98||
kṛtvā yāsi nijaṃ gehaṃ kathaṃ vai yācase kṣamām |
nāpitī prāha nāhaṃ vai tvāgatā sevane’dya vai ||99||
asmin kṣaṇe samāyāmi kiṃ bhrāntā vadasīva mām |
pūjye mā kuru narmaivaṃ nāhamatra sthitābhavam || 3.228.10 0||
anyayā tu kayācitte kṛtā sevā hi sā bhavet |
śrutvaivaṃ bhrāntimagamad rājñī kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ sukham || 101 ||
visṛjya nāpitīṃ nidrāṃ jagāma sā prajeśvarī |
atha sā nāpitī naijaṃ gehaṃ yāti tu yāvatā || 1 02||
tāvatā svagṛhe nārīṃ dadarśa bahurūpiṇīm |
rūpeṇa vayasā veṣeṇāpi svasadṛśīṃ tadā || 103||
kṣaṇamāścaryamāpannā papraccha smeraśobhanām |
kā tvaṃ kathaṃ kutaścātra madgṛhe kamalāsamā || 104||
ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā naijaṃ rūpaṃ vyāvṛttya sundaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumadarśayam || 1 05||
tavārthe nāpitīrūpe bhūtvāhaṃ tāmasevayam |
tvayā tu sevitāḥ santo rājñī kruddhābhavattadā || 1 06||
asevayā tava sarvaṃ hartavyaṃ niścikāya sā |
mayā dhṛtvā tava rūpaṃ sevitā sā prajeśvarī || 107||
bhakte’haṃ bhagavānasmi śreyo’rthaḥ tava cāgataḥ |
tvaṃ patiputraputryādyaiḥ sahitāsi sadā mama || 1 08||
nityaṃ dhyānaṃ mamaivaṃ tvaṃ samācara hi gocaram |
neṣyāmi matparaṃ dhāma kuṭumbaṃ tava gocaram || 1 09||
ityuktvāhaṃ tayā ruddhaḥ śayyāyāmabhavaṃ kṣaṇam |
mamānandaṃ paraṃ datvā tiro’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāntare || 3.228.11 0||
svapne tu nāpitaḥ putrāḥ putryaśca sādhavo’pi ca |
sarve māṃ te vyapaśyan vai prātarjajāgaruśca te || 11 1||
parasparaṃ harermūrtervarṇanaṃ darśanātmakam |
cakruste menire bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yad brahmadarśanam || 112||
atha prātaḥ punaḥ snātvā bhuktvā te sādhavo yayuḥ |
grāmāntaraṃ ca sā nāpitānī divyakuṭumbinī || 11 3||
bhajate māṃ nāpito’pi bhajate tatkuṭumbakam |
atha kālāntare sarvānanayaṃ sadvimānakaiḥ ||1 14||
dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ me vai lakṣmi kṛpāvaśo hariḥ |
rājā rājñyādayaścāpi menire caritaṃ mama || 1 15||
divyaṃ taditi niścitya bhejurmāṃ saprajā hi tam |
te’pi kālāntare dhāmākṣaraṃ yayurmamottamam ||1 1 6||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktā uddhāritāḥ kṛpālunā |
sādhoḥ kalyāṇadhāmnākhyasyāpi sevāmiṣeṇa ha || 1 17||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā |
yatheṣṭakāmanāpūrtirbhavenme kṛpayā rame ||1 18||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne svarṇadhanvanṛpateḥ sevakasya harṣadharmanāmakanāpitasya patnyā nigamikānāmnyā bhaktyā kalyāṇadhāmādisādhusādhvīsevāyāṃ sthitāyāḥ sevayā samprasanno bhagavān nigamikārūpo bhūtvā rājñīsevāmakarot, nāpitakuṭumbasya rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cākarodityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 228 ||

<3.229>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ kathāṃ bhaktānikodbhavām |
ābhīrī mama bhaktāsīdārdraśṛṃgapure sthitā || 1 ||
vyāghrāraṇye siṃhavyāghrahiṃsraprāṇimaye sthale |
nāmnā rūṭāṇakīdevī pūrvasaṃskārapāvanī || 2 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāścaryaṃ bhaktāyāḥ pravadāmi te |
pūrvajanmani sā śūdrā dhīvarī saritastaṭe || 3 ||
dhīvarasya tu naukāyāṃ vartamānābhavat satī |
śatruṃjayābdhisaṃgasthabhūmau vāsavatī sadā || 4 ||
gopanāthamahātīrthagāminaḥ sā tu mānavān |
pratitīraṃ nayatyeva naukayā kṛṣṇamānasā || 5 ||
sādhavo ye samāyānti tān vai bhāvena sā satī |
vinā dravyagrahaṇaṃ vai paraṃ tīraṃ nayatyapi || 6 ||
anyām̐stu dravyamādāya paraṃ tīraṃ nayatyatha |
ekadā śrīharicaitanyākhyaḥ sādhustu yogirāṭ || 7 ||
paraṃ pāraṃ pragantuṃ tu sarittīramupāyayau |
siddhaḥ sa sādhuvaryo vai pādukābhyāṃ jalopari || 8 ||
yāti svasiddhatapasā kvacid vyomnā prayātyapi |
tathāpi svecchayā bhūmau viharan saritastaṭe || 9 ||
yadṛcchayāyayau taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tu dhīvarī hi sā |
namaskṛtya svanaukāyāmāgantumārthayad hudā || 3.229.1 0|||
yogivaryastu dhīvaryāḥ śreyase nāvi māṃ bhajan |
āruroha tatra copādideśa bhaktitoṣitaḥ ||1 1 ||
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
bhaja sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīḥ sadgatiṃ tva prayāsyasi || 1 2||
dehaste dhīvarīrūpa ātmā te citsvarūpavān |
deho’yaṃ ca vaśe jīvātmanaḥ sadā hi vartate || 1 3||
yathā naukā vaśe te’sti tathā deho vaśe tava |
yathā naukā dṛśyarūpā draṣṭrī tva prerikāsi ca || 14||
tathā deho dṛśyarūpo draṣṭātmā prerako’ti ca |
deho duḥkhādinā vyāpto draṣṭā duḥkhādivarjitaḥ || 15|
tatra draṣṭari sarvajñaḥ kaścidanyo virājate |
yaḥ satkārye prerayati duṣṭakārye niṣedhati || 1 6|
antarātmā sākṣirūpaḥ sa eva bhagavān hariḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 17|
tameva bhaja yogīndrasādhusādhvīprapūjitam |
bhaktyā hyananyayā snehamayyā taṃ saṃprasevaya || 18 |
hṛdaye taṃ prabhuṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā nibhālaya |
dhyānaṃ gopīpaternityaṃ kuru svarūpaśālinaḥ ||19||
bāhyaviṣayān santyajya hṛdaye paśya mādhavam |
indriyāṇi samastāni tasmin kṛṣṇe samarpaya ||3.229.20||
parāvṛttyendriyavṛttīstasmin kṛṣṇe niyojaya |
saccidānandasandohān mahānandaṃ samarjaya ||21 ||
kṛṣṇānandasya saṃbhoktrī bhava nityaṃ ramāsamā |
kṛṣṇabhogasya samprāptyā bhogāścānye viṣaṃ yathā ||22||
tathā te vai bhaviṣyanti bhuṃkṣva kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum |
śrīkṛṣṇasya caritrāṇi divyāni mānuṣāṇi ca ||23||
saṃkīrtaya sadā bhaktyā svargamokṣapradāni vai |
adbhutāni samastāni caritrāṇi ramāpateḥ ||24||
kāmaceṣṭācaritrāṇi yuddhāyojanakāni ca |
utsavādyāni sarvāṇi smara nityaṃ śriyaḥ pateḥ || 25||
laukikālaukikānyeva nikṛṣṭānyuttamāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi divyāni caritrāṇi ramāpateḥ || 26||
jaḍaṃ kuryāścetanaṃ tu cetanaṃ tu jaḍaṃ hariḥ |
evaṃvidhasamarthasya hareḥ saṃgaṃ sadā kuru ||27||
pramādaṃ ca mahālasyaṃ mahāmohaṃ madaṃ tyaja |
ahantāṃ mamatāṃ tyaktvā cātmarūpā sadā bhava || 28||
saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ satsu nauṣu sthirā bhava |
pativratā harau bhūtvā hariṃ patiṃ sadā bhaja ||29||
dehadaśāṃ vihāyaiva brahmadaśāṃ samāśraya |
bhogān sarvān harau kṛṣṇe sthūlān sūkṣmān samarpaya ||3.229.30||
ātmāhaṃ na tu dehrosmītyevaṃ vai mananaṃ kuru |
dāsyasi śrīpateścāhamipyevaṃ divyatāṃ vaha ||31||
evaṃvivekamāsādya nirbandhā karmabhirbhava |
dehābhimānajaṃ pāpaṃ tyaja yāmyagatiṃ tyaja ||32||
bhajitvā śrīpatiṃ cānte dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ ramāpatim |
tena sākaṃ vimānena divyākṣarapadaṃ vraja ||33||
dhīvarītvaṃ vihāyaiva buddhivarītvamāvaha |
mama sādhoḥ prasaṃgena vaiṣṇavī paramā bhava ||34||
anena janmanā yadvā dvitīyenākṣaraṃ vraja |
evaṃ lakṣmi tadā nāvi tūpadiṣṭā hi sādhunā ||35||
paraṃ bodhaṃ prāptavatī dhīvarī dhīmatī hyabhūt |
paratīraṃ samāyātaṃ cāvatīrya tu sādhurāṭ ||36||
yayau tīrthaṃ ca dhīvaryai datvā jñānamanuttamam |
atha sā śrīkṛṣṇanāma japatyaharniśaṃ tataḥ ||37||
matsyādā dhīvarī bhāgyavaśena kālayogataḥ |
mṛtā sā mānavī jātā hyābhīrī mahiṣīvatī ||38||
punareva strīsvarūpā mahābhāgavatī satī |
sādhūnāṃ sevikā bālyād brahmacaryaparāyaṇā ||39||
vivāhecchā yayā naiva kṛtā dagdhā tu kāmanā |
yauvane vidyamāne’pi vārdhakye iva saṃsthitā ||3.229.40 ||
pūrvasaṃskāravaśato jātismarā tu yoginī |
svabhāvataścātmaniṣṭhāparāyaṇābhavaddhi sā ||41||
nāmnā ruṭāṇakīdevī divyajñānaparāyaṇā |
sādhusevāparā sādhvī sāṃkhyayoginikā sadā |||42||
ātmanivedinī tyāgavatī vairāgyaśālinī |
mālāvartanamaniśaṃ karoti kīrtanaṃ hareḥ ||43||
mahiṣāṇāṃ tu dugdhāni sādhūn miṣṭāni nityaśaḥ |
kṛtvā pāyasarūpāṇi bhojayatyeva bhaktitaḥ ||44||
snātvā prātarharikṛṣṇaṃ prapūjyārghyaṃ pradāya ca |
sūryāyārghyaṃ ca pitṛbhyo datvā kṛtvā samarpaṇam ||45||
śrāddhaṃ pāyasasiddhānnaiḥ phalairjalaiḥ pradāya ca |
tataḥ sā bhojanaṃ sādhūn kārayitvā satīstathā ||46||
bhuṃkte prāsādikaṃ nityaṃ vartate paṃktipāvanī |
yathā lakṣmīryathā gaṃgā yathā devī sarasvatī ||47||
tathā sā brahmaparamā ruṭāṇakī hi dīvyati |
yasya gṛhe nityameva samāyānti hi sādhavaḥ ||48||
sādhvyaścāpi samāyānti bhaktāṃ jñātvā tu sevikām |
kīrtanāni prakurvanti rāsān mahotsavān śubhān ||49||
evaṃ vai bhajamānāyāḥ sevikāyā gṛhe kvacit |
niśārdhe saṃvyatīte vai supteṣu sarvadehiṣu ||3.229.50 ||
daityo’raṇyāt samāyātaḥ kaścidāyasakuṇḍalaḥ |
tāḍavaddīrghadehaśca kṛṣṇavarṇo’tiromavān ||91 ||
yuvā ca balavān puṣṭo vaṭavṛkṣa ivāparaḥ |
sa tāṃ suptāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ jagṛhe tvatilāghavāt ||52||
nītvā yayau vyomamārge mahāraṇye gato’bhavat |
avātatāra nibiḍe vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe’pi lāghavāt ||53||
pṛthvyāṃ nidhāya tāṃ ruṭāṇakīṃ surūpiṇīṃ śanaiḥ |
prabodhayāmāsa daityaḥ sāpi bubodha yāvatā ||54||
dadarśa vanamadhye svāmānītāṃ vanavāsinā |
āyasakuṇḍalanāmnā daityena svavaśīkṛtām ||55||
athāpi sā mahābhaktā dhairyavatī satīśvarī |
mahābhāgavatī durgāsamā devī hi vaiṣṇavī |||56||
kṛṣṇabalavatī sādhvī bhayaṃ prāptā na vai manāk |
sasmāra hṛdaye kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ jagatpatiṃ patim ||57||
yadyahaṃ tava bhaktāsmi tvayā naijā kṛtāsmi ca |
tavaiva pātivratyena varte’haṃ śrīsamā yadi ||58||
tvayi cāsmi tvātmanivedinī vai sāṃkhyayoginī |
tvayā karo gṛhīto’sti mama cet svāminā sadā ||59||
tava santaśca sādhyaśca sevitā vai mayā yadi |
tvadarthakṛtasarvasvā yadi cāsmi tava priyā ||3.229.60||
tadā tvāyāhi viṣṇo tvaṃ kṛṣṇa śīghraṃ puro bhava |
sākṣādāgatya rakṣāṃ me kuru daityāddhi dāruṇāt ||61 ||
yadi te’haṃ na jātāsmi bhavāmi bhaktivarjitā |
tarhi daityo baliḥ sparśaṃ karotu yadi te ruciḥ ||62||
yatheṣṭaṃ kuru kānta tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ nijanāṇake |
yatnaṃ vidhehi bhagavannaudāsīnyaṃ ca vācara ||63||
ityuktvā hṛdaye mahyaṃ pūjāṃ dattavatī tadā |
daityo’pi tāṃ tadā vācā rañjayan bahubhāvataḥ ||64||
vārtāṃ kartuṃ tu vividhāṃ prerayatyeva cotsukaḥ |
tathāpi maunamāpannā maccittā na vadatyapi ||65||
daityo nanarta purato bahuhāsyakṛtirmuhuḥ |
tathāpi kṛṣṇacittā sā bahirmano na vai vyadhāt ||66||
atha gṛhe’pi nidrāyāṃ sarve’bhavan jaḍā yathā |
sādhavaścāpi sādhvyaśca jaḍāśca mahīmānakāḥ ||67||
ruṭāṇakyāḥ pitā nāmnā durvāraṇo’pi nidritaḥ |
mātā nāmnā khaṭamiṣṭādevī tvāsīddhi nidritā ||68||
anye grāmajanāḥ sarve āsam̐stadātinidritāḥ |
kaiścijjñātaṃ na haraṇaṃ ruṭāṇakyāstamomaye ||69||
atha mahiṣyaḥ paśavo gandhadṛṣṭaya eva tāḥ |
vividurdaityagandhaṃ ca jāgrannidrāvinidritāḥ ||3.229.70||
bubudhustā mahiṣyo vai daityaṃ samāgataṃ tathā |
nītvā ruṭāṇakīdevīṃ yāntaṃ vyomni tamomaye ||71 ||
raṇakāṭaṃ rambhaṇaṃ ca paśvākrośaṃ pracakrire |
jajāgaruḥ samastāste śrutvā bhayaṃ samāgatam ||72|||
cakruḥ paritaḥ kāṣṭhānāṃ vahnīn śārdūlaśaṃkayā |
dīrghaśabdān mahānādān cakruste paritaḥ khalu ||73||
siṃhaśaṃkāmayāḥ sarve daityaṃ na vividustadā |
evaṃ ghaṭikā vigatā kṛte’pi rakṣaṇe’bhitaḥ ||74||
mahiṣyo nābhavan śāntā garjanti vihvalā yathā |
ekā tu mahiṣī rūṭāṇakyāsanaṃ drutaṃ yayau ||75||
śṛṃgābhyāmāsanaṃ nītvā bhramaṇaṃ pracakāra sā |
āhūtā tu tadā sarvai rūṭāṇaki ruṭāṇaki ||76 ||
kva gatā tvāsanaṃ ceyaṃ mahiṣī nāśayatyapi |
samāhūtā cāpi yadā na pratyuvāca bhāminī | |77||
na dṛśyate janamadhye gṛhe sādhvīsatīṣvapi |
tadā śaṃkāspadā jātā nītā kenāpi putrikā ||78||
atha vai vihvalāḥ sarve rurudurmārgaṇāya ca |
parito niryayuścāpi sīmni kvāpi na dadṛśuḥ ||79||
pratyāyayurgatāśāste sasmarurmāṃ pareśvaram |
sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ sarve nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||3.229.80||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakṛṣṇamādhava |
tadā yayāvahaṃ cakragaruḍābhyāṃ yuto vane ||8 1 ||
nṛtyantaṃ daityarājaṃ taṃ cakartāhaṃ sulāghavāt |
tattejo mayi tvākṛṣya kṛtvā tāṃ garuḍopari |||82||
ānandayitvā prītyā tāmanayaṃ tadgahaṃ drutam |
sāpi divyatamā jātā sādhvī matsparśamātrataḥ |||83||
divyaiśvaryavatī lakṣmi yathā tvaṃ tvādṛśī hi sā |
evaṃ tāṃ vyomamārgeṇa cārdraśṛṃgapure gṛhe ||84||
avasthāpya tathā sarvabhaktebhyo darśanaṃ mama |
datvā tejomayaṃ divyaṃ sthitvā ca ghaṭikādhikam ||85||
sādhusādhvīkṛtāṃ sevāmaṃgīkṛtya ca pāyasam |
bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ vāripānaṃ tāmcūlakādikam ||86||
bhuktvā garuḍavāho’haṃ gantuṃ sajjo’bhavaṃ yadā |
tadā bhaktāḥ premamagnāḥ prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||87||
saha tvasmānnaya kṛṣṇa yadi te smo’tisevakāḥ |
rūṭāṇakī sādhavaśca sādhvyaścāpi tathārthayan ||88 ||
ahaṃ lakṣmi tadā tebhyo mama mantraṃ dadau śubham |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||89||
pādajalaṃ prasādānnaṃ pāyasaṃ ca dadau tadā |
apakvānmānavān bhaktiṃ kartumādiśya tatra ca ||3.229.90||
pakvān sādhvīḥ sādhujanān ruṭāṇakīṃ tathā satīm |
mātaraṃ janakaṃ tasyāstathā tāṃ mahiṣīmapi ||9 1 ||
vidhāya divyadehām̐śca muktān muktānikāstathā |
nidhāya gāruḍe pṛṣṭhe’nayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||92||
anyānapakvān kālenānayaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam |
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā rakṣā kṛtābhīryā hi yoṣitaḥ ||93||
sā tu muktānikā jātā brahmapriyā madakṣare |
rūpeśvarītināmnādya vartate tava maṇḍale ||94||
yuvatī mama patnīyaṃ paśyaināṃ madvivāhitām |
anyāḥ sādhvyo yuvatyo’tra santi daśa striyo mama ||95||
mandārakalikādyāstāstava sakhyo’tra yoṣitaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre brahmapriyā mama priyāḥ ||96||
divyacakṣuṣa evaitāṃ kathāṃ vidanti netare |
camatkāro mama divyaste rame kathito mayā ||97||
bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caivaṃ karomi sarvathā sadā |
pakvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi dhāmākṣarapradānakam ||98||
ye māṃ bhajeyuḥ satataṃ sarvasvārpaṇabhāvanāḥ |
teṣāmahaṃ ca te me’pi sambaddhāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||99||
madarpitānāmavanaṃ karomi sarvathā sadā |
kālād yamāt karmataścendriyādibhyaśca doṣataḥ || 3.229.10 0||
paṭanācchravaṇādasya cintanāt kathanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva mama prāptiḥ sukhapradā || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūrvajanmani dhīvaryā rūṭāṇakyā ābhīrībhaktāyāḥ sādhvīnāṃ ca daityād rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇa ca śrīhariṇā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 229 ||

<3.230>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ matsyapattanavāsinaḥ |
matsyādasya dhīvarasya tathāpi bhaktikāriṇaḥ || 1 ||
kathāmuddhārakartrī vai sādhusamāgamodbhavām |
pāpināṃ pāvanīṃ māyāmohanāśakarīṃ tathā || 2 ||
dhīraparvābhidhaścāsīd dhīvaro matsyapattane |
śatanaukādhipaḥ kṛṣṇānadyabdhisaṃgame sadā || 3 ||
yasya nāvo bhṛtyayuktā matsyān gṛhṇanti jālikāḥ |
brāhmamuhūrtādārabhyāsūryodayaṃ tu nityaśaḥ || 4 ||
nityaṃ vai lakṣamatsyānāṃ jālagrahaḥ prajāyate |
sūkṣmasthūlasudīrghāṇāṃ bhinnaguṇādivarṣmaṇām || 5 ||
teṣāṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate dhīraparvaṇaḥ |
lakṣavarṣāyuṣyako’pi dhīraparvātihiṃsayā || 6 ||
āyuṣā hīyate nityaṃ śatāhapramitena vai |
varṣadvayāntare tasya sahasrāṇi tu saptatiḥ || 7 ||
varṣāṇi cāyuṣaḥ pāpaiśchinnāni matsyaśāpataḥ |
triṃśadvarṣottaraṃ tena matsyavyāpāra ādṛtaḥ || 8 ||
militvā lakṣavarṣāṇi dvātriṃśe vigatāni ha |
dvātriṃśe cāntime māse varṣāyāṃ meghavarṣaṇam || 9 ||
saptāhaṃ satataṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇādeśeṣu sarvaśaḥ |
tuṃgabhadrāpradeśeṣu tathaiva meghavarṣaṇam ||3.230.1 0 ||
abhavat satataṃ lakṣmi mūśaladhārasadṛśam |
jalāni pūravegāni mamurna saritostadā || 11 ||
sarinmārgaṃ vihāyaiva bhūmārgān viṣayān vyadhuḥ |
bahavo mānavāstatrāraṇyasthāḥ sādhavo’pi ca || 12||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jalapūraiḥ pravāhitā |
mṛtāstu bahavasteṣu pūreṣu dūrakarṣitāḥ ||1 3||
nirādhārā mṛtāḥ sarve sādhārāḥ kāṣṭhalambanāḥ |
vṛkṣādyālambanāścānye jīvantaḥ pūramadhyagāḥ || 14||
āyayurmatsyapaṭṭasya kṛṣṇasāgarasaṃgame |
dehino jīvato vīkṣya mahājale’pi vai tadā ||15||
dhīraparvā nijabhṛtyān yantrinaukābhirakṣiṇaḥ |
sarvānājñāpayāmāsa śatanaukādhināyakān || 16||
mā matsyagrāhaṃ kurvantu yāvannadyā upadravaḥ |
jīvanmānavagrahaṇaṃ kurvantu pūramadhyataḥ || 17||
sarvathā prāṇadānaṃ vai prāṇamātraṃ tu jīvinām |
pravāhavāhitānāṃ vai kartavyaṃ pralaye’tra tu || 18||
bhojanaṃ cāpi śuṣkānnaṃ bharjitaṃ caṇakādikam |
dātavyaṃ kambalavastrādyaṃ śītaharaṇārthakam || 19||
evaṃ vai rakṣaṇaṃ tatra vihitaṃ dhīraparvaṇā |
dhanānnāmbaranaukādipradānairbhṛtyamānavaiḥ ||3.230.20||
narā nāryo bālakāśca vṛddhā vā kāṣṭhasaṃgatāḥ |
vaṃśastambamahāvṛkṣalagnāḥ śākhāvilambanāḥ ||21 ||
ghāsapeṭādisaṃsaktāścānye śavādikāśrayāḥ |
taradvastusamādhārāḥ sahasraśo hi mānavāḥ ||22|
yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo viraktā vaiṣṇavā api |
bhaktā nārāyaṇaparā jīvanto rakṣitāstadā ||23||
teṣāmāśīrvādalabdhamahāpuṇyātisāgaraḥ |
jīvadānamahāpuṇyodayaścāpi vyajāyata ||24||
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vinā bhogaṃ kṣapayituṃ na śakyate |
āyuḥkṣayānnasaptāhe yogo’yaṃ samajāyata ||25||
pāpairāyuḥ kṣīyate vai puṇyairāyurvivardhate |
pūrvasya pūrvabhogo vai paścimasya sa paścimaḥ ||26||
hiṃsāghātādikarmotthaṃ phalaṃ tu maraṇaṃ muhuḥ |
ghātenaiva bhaveddhātakinastasya yamālaye ||27|||
tīvrasaṃvegitaṃ karma matsyamārodbhavaṃ bali |
pūrvaṃ bhogāya vai prāptaṃ kālapāśābhiyojitam |||28||
yāmyadūtaiśca saṃyuktaṃ koṭimatsyādighātajam |
saptāhānte dine varṣāvege tu nyūnatāṃ gate ||29||
naukāyāṃ yantrayuktāyāṃ niṣadya bhṛtyasevitaḥ |
patnīputrādisahito draṣṭuṃ velāṃ jale yayau ||3.230.3 0||
kṛṣṇāsāgarasaṃyoge mahāpravāhavegite |
mahājale yayau yāvat krośadūraṃ tu sāgare ||3 1 ||
tāvannaukātale vṛkṣaśākhocchālanamadbhutam |
acintitaṃ samāyātaṃ vāribhramo mahocchrayaḥ ||30||
acintitaḥ samutpanno mahāvicyudayo’pi ca |
mitho mahājalabhittidvayatāḍanasaṃbhave ||33||
mahānaukāgrato bhāge khe tūtplutya suvegataḥ |
adhogatāgrato yāvattāvat pṛṣṭhe mahājalaiḥ ||34||
utkṣiptā khe vegataśca tāḍavat sā tato’bhavat |
naukāgraṃ jalabhittibhyāṃ nītaṃ cādho jalāntare ||35||
tāvatpārśvamahāvegijalairvyāvartitā hyavāṅ |
nimagnā kṣaṇamātreṇa tatra samudravāriṣu || 36||
talaṃ gatā bhuvaḥ sā tu nirāśrayāsahāyinī |
dhīraparvādayaḥ sarve mṛtā vāriṣu mūrchitāḥ ||37||
yāmyadūtairyamalokaṃ nītāste pāpino drutam |
śavāstu bhakṣitā matsyairdhanāni bhṛtyamānavaiḥ ||38||
naukāstu nāvikairnītāḥ prāṇāstu yamapārṣadaiḥ |
puṇyapāpāni nītāni mṛtaistaistu kuṭumbibhiḥ ||29|||
pātheyāni yathā tāni cātmabhiḥ saha saṃyayuḥ |
yathākālaṃ ca te dūtairnītā yamālayaṃ prati ||3.230.40||
citraguptena pāpāni śrāvitāni yamāntike |
dharmarājā tu tān sarvānadaṇḍayad yathākṛtam ||41 ||
kālasūtre nyakṣipacca bahukālaṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
galapāśākhyanarake nyakṣipanmatsyaghātinaḥ ||42 ||
tataḥ kṣārakardame ca nyakṣipaccirameva tān |
tato viśasane kuṇḍe nyakṣipattān saśastrake ||43|||
tataścāsipatravane nyakṣipattām̐ściraṃ tataḥ |
nyakṣipattān vahnikuṇḍe mahājvālāsamākule ||44||
tatastānnyakṣipajjantubahule kuṇḍake’tra ca |

nyakṣipattān jālanaukāyāmyabhaṭaiḥ prapīḍite |

matsyairutkartitāścāpi bhakṣitāste punaḥ punaḥ |
ujjīvinaḥ punaścāpi bhūtvā kaṣṭāni yānti te ||588||
tato niṣkāsitāḥ sarve dīrghakālena kuṇḍataḥ |
sarvapāpātidaṇḍasya prānte dharmājñayā ca te ||49||

dṛḍhā sthitirharau tasya jāyate cānapāyinī |

sarvasvārpaṇabhāvā syāt sadārpitā harau bhavet| |
evaṃ nāryo bhavantyeva mugdhā raktāḥ samarpitāḥ ||75||
tredhā tāsāṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samuddhartā mahārṇavāt |
tāsāṃ tu śreyase kṛṣṇo mānavo jāyate patiḥ ||76||
anugrahāya rājā vai ramaṇo mokṣado hariḥ |
sādhūnāṃ tu śreyase sa tāpaso jāyate ṛṣiḥ ||77||
rājarūpaṃ sādhurūpaṃ patirūpaṃ prabhuṃ tu yāḥ |
āśrayanti tu tā divyā bhavanti muktakoṭikāḥ |||7|||
divyadṛṣṭyā harikṛṣṇaṃ vidanti parameśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māpativallabham ||79||
yathā miṣṭasamudrasya jalaṃ pibanti dehinaḥ |
yathādehaṃ yathāśakti tṛpyanti ca yathābalam ||3.230.80||
pipīlikādikamahāmatsyāntāḥ sarvadehinaḥ |
tathāpi te samudrasya pāraṃ na yānti vai kvacit | |8 1 ||
yathāmbarasya maśakādayaśca garuḍādayaḥ |
yathāśakti sukhaṃ prāpyoḍḍayanaṃ racayanti hi ||82 ||
tathāpyantaṃ na yāntyeva vyomāpāraṃ nigadyate |
tathā śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya pāraṃ yānti na ke’pyapi ||8 3||
yathā bhūmigato dehī candraṃ sthālaṃ prapaśyati |
sa evāntikatāṃ prāpto mahāntaṃ taṃ prapaśyati ||84||
candragato janaścandramapāraṃ samprapaśyati |
tathā bhaktaḥ samīpastho’pāraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pravindati ||889||
upāsanābalaṃ svalpaṃ dīpavat kathyate hi tat |
tato’dhikaṃ balaṃ dāvavahnivajjāyate khalu | |86||
tato’dhikataraṃ tattu mahābhūtānalādivat |
tato’dhikatamaṃ tattu brahmadhāmasamaṃ matam 87||
brahmatejobhirāpūrṇo bhakto vindati mādhavam |
apāraṃ cātidivyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ||88||
brahmarūpo mahāmukto niṣevate parātparam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiramāpatim ||89||
bhaktyabhyāsavaśā nārī prāpnoti māṇikīpatim |
satāṃ patiṃ muktapatiṃ brahmapatiṃ mahāprabhum ||3.230.90 ||
yathā snehaprakāśāderādhikyaṃ jāyate tathā |
kṛṣṇasukhaṃ mahaddivyamāpnoti muktatāṃ gataḥ || 91||
kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇamūrtiśca kṛṣṇānandapariplutaḥ |
muktottamo jāyate vā naro nārī samarpitaḥ ||92||
bhaktyabhyāsapratāpena kṛṣṇaikyaṃ cāpi jāyate |
lakṣmīvad rādhikāvacca māṇikīvat suśāśvatam ||93||
nityaṃ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
hare śrībālakṛṣṇaśrīpate’kṣarapate vibho ||94||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
mantraṃ japantu nityaṃ vai nārāyaṇasya sevakāḥ ||95||
ātmanivedinaḥ santu kṛṣṇārthasarvaniścayāḥ |
ityuktvāhaṃ kathānte vai caturbāhustadābhavam ||96||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamaṇikirīṭakuṇḍalaiḥ |
tejobhiḥ śobhito lakṣmi sarvairjayetiśabditaḥ ||97||
pūjito hṛdayaiścāpi bhaktyā candanavāribhiḥ |
vandito nijamokṣārthaṃ tathāstvityavadaṃ ca tān ||98||
manāṃsyākṛṣya sahasā tirobhāvaṃ cidambare |
atha prāpte samaye tān anayaṃ dhāma me’kṣaram ||99||
kām̐ścit svargaṃ tathānyām̐śca satyaṃ vairājakaṃ padam |
aparān śrīpuraṃ cānyānamṛtaṃ tvanayaṃ tathā || 3.230.10 0||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokamavyākṛtaṃ paraṃ padam |
prāpayāmāsa bhaktām̐stānnāvikān jīvarakṣakān || 101 ||
sādhurakṣakarān sādhvīrakṣakān bālarakṣakān |
jīvadānapradātṝm̐śca bhaktān dvitīyajanmajān || 10 2||
evaṃ lakṣmi mahāpāpān kadācid bhagavatkṛte |
sādhvīsādhukṛte gavāṃ kṛte’pi puṇyakārakān || 10 3||
kālāntare’pi puṇyānāmudaye sādhuyoginaḥ |
kṛtvā nayāmi dhāmordhvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam || 1 04||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva yatheṣṭā ca gatirbhavet || 105||
pāpipāpāni naśyanti śrīhareḥ smaraṇādapi |
bhaktānāṃ ca yaśogānaiḥ śuddhyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne pūrvajanmani dhīvarāṇāṃ matsyamārāṇāṃ dhīraparvādīnāṃ yāmyayātanottaraṃ pūrvālpapuṇyena naupatijanmāni tatra bhajanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 230 ||

<3.231>
puruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śūlāropaṇakāriṇaḥ |
jallādasya kathāṃ nāmnā tārakādarśakasya vai || 1 ||
cambāvatyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai rāvīnadyāstaṭāntike |
mahākārāgāradurge śūlīdaṇḍavidhāyini || 2 ||
niyukto’bhūt tārakādarśakaḥ śūlyadhiropakaḥ |
rājadaṇḍena ye daṇḍitāḥ syurmahāparādhinaḥ || 3 ||
strīghnā goghnāśca bālaghnā naraghnā mūrtibhañjakāḥ |
devālayavineṣṭāraḥ sarve śūlyarhadaṇḍinaḥ || 4 ||
teṣāṃ śūlyagrādhirohaṃ karoti tārakādṛśiḥ |
cambāpuryā mahārājo nāmnā vai supathānakaḥ || 5 ||
tārakādarśakaṃ jallādakaṃ rarakṣa śūlinam |
durgamadhye śūlikāste yatra vaihāyasāḥ sadā|| 6 ||

yāṃ smṛtvā romakampo vai jāyate dhairyaśālinaḥ || 7 ||
dṛṣṭvā hṛtstabdhatā cāpi nirbalasya prajāyate |
daṇḍaṃ śrutvā parameśaṃ smaranti sajjanā api || 8 ||
pāpino’pi prabhuṃ smarantīśeśa pāhi māmiti |
yamālayo yathā tadvad bhayānakaṃ sthalaṃ tu tat || 9 ||
tatra jallādavāso’bhūd divāniśaṃ hi durgake |
vetana labhate rājyāt prāṇayātrāṃ karoti ca || 3.231.10 ||
śūlīdaṇḍārhaduṣṭāya daṇḍadānakṣaṇāt puraḥ |
śrāvayatyeva nāmāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ || 11 ||
rakṣa mādhava govinda punaḥ pāpāt prarakṣaya |
eṣo’haṃ śūlikārūpe kṛṣṇe’rpito bhavāmi ca || 1 2||
mama pāpaphalaṃ cedaṃ bhuṃje nānyo’tra doṣabhāg |
punarnaivaṃ kariṣye’ghaṃ pāpānmukto bhavāmi cet || 13||
śṛṇvantu mānavāḥ sarve’dhirohāmi svakarmaṇā |
mā śocantu mama nāśaṃ śocantu pāpakarma vai || 14||
mā kurvantvapi pāpāni mā śūlīmadhiyantu ca |
bāndhavāḥ pitaro mātā sambandhī putraputrikāḥ || 15||
suhṛdaśca prajālokā ye tu paśyanti māmiha |
te dharmaṃ saṃpālayantu me vaktavyaṃ na cetarat || 1 6||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
iti sarvaṃ tadoccārayitvā taṃ daṇḍaśālinam || 17||
netrayoḥ paṭṭabandhaṃ ca kṛtvottolya janaiḥ śanaiḥ |
śūlyagre tīkṣṇadhāre’vasthāpyate pṛṣṭhage tale || 18||
madhyabhāge pṛṣṭhavaṃśe samatole śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
uttānaṃ doṣiṇaṃ śūlaṃ yathā viśati pṛṣṭhake || 1 9||
tadā jallādako bhakto gṛṇāti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa vai |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇa saṃśrāvayati doṣiṇam ||3.231.20 ||
pāpanāśastathā mokṣo yadodayaḥ prajāyate |
yadvā punaḥ śubhaṃ janma yathā syāddoṣiṇastathā ||21||
salilaṃ tulasīmiśraṃ tasmai dadāti doṣiṇe |
oṣṭhayoścāntime prāṇayānakāle hariṃ gṛṇan ||22||
vādyāni bahudhā tatra vādayanti nṛpānugāḥ |
duḥkhaśabdākrośanādi yathā śrūyeta naiva ha ||23||

kuṭumbine dadātyeva rājājñayā yathātatham |
evaṃ sa tārakādarśo doṣiṇaṃ preṣayatyapi ||25 ||

antarāmā harikṛṣṇo jānāmyahaṃ rame hi tat ||26||
bhakto me tārakādarśo vartate nāmakīrtane |
evaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍakarma tataḥ snātvā ca mālikām || 27||
kare dhṛtvā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa sahasraṃ sa japatyapi |
prāyaścittaṃ tathā saptopavāsān sa karotyapi ||28||
kṣamāṃ prayācate kṛṣṇācchūlīpāpaṃ kṣamasva me |
atha tīrthe śubhe rāvīnadyā jambupradeśake ||29||
snātvā dānaṃ dadātyeva vetanāttaddinodbhavam |
sādhūn prasevate nityaṃ karoti smaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||3.231.3 0 ||

naivedyārpaṇamevāpi tāmbūlasalilārpaṇam ||3 1 ||

adṛśyo vai bhavāmyeva śṛṇomi kīrtanādikam |

tasmānmocayitavyo’yaṃ śūlīkarmādhikārataḥ ||45||

śūlī daṇḍapradānārthaṃ duṣṭānāṃ bhavatā hyapi ||48||

pāpaṃ tu manyate śūlyāropaṇaṃ daṇḍyadehinaḥ ||49||
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti japati saptāhaṃ na bhunakti ca |

anayaṃ tānakṣaraṃ me dhāma lakṣmi parātparam ||97||
evaṃ bhaktasya mokṣo vai mayā kṛto dayālunā |
mumukṣūṇāṃ hṛdaye’smi viśeṣato’vanārthakaḥ ||98||
pāpāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ pāpisaṃgāśca mānavāḥ |
pāpanāśecchayā māṃ vāśrayeyuḥ sādhusattamān ||99||
vidhūya teṣāṃ pāpāni datvā puṇyāni sarvathā |
pāvanān dehinaḥ kṛtvā datvā divyatanūstataḥ || 3.231.10 0||
nayāmi vā divaṃ satyaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca vā |
avyākṛtaṃ vā vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ padam || 101 ||
paraṃ padaṃ prāpayāmi rājādhirājaśobhanam |
dadāmi sevanaṃ tatra pādayormama sarvadā || 1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sparśanād vartanādapi |
bhuktirmuktirdivyagatirjāyate mokṣaṇaṃ rame || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne śūlīpradasya tārakādarśasya tatpatnyāḥ kṛtaśalyāyāśca bhaktyābhyudayau mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇānāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 231 ||

<3.232>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvamagnidasya kathāmapi |
jvālāprasādanāmābhūcchūdro’raṇyaprapālakaḥ || 1 ||
vṛtraprasthavane kālindīsaritastaṭe purā |
kuṭumbasahitastatra vane vāsaṃ karoti saḥ || 2 ||
vanyamūlaphalādaśca kāṣṭhavyāpārakṛttathā |
ghāsavallītṛṇastambauṣadhivyāpārakṛttathā || 3 ||
ahiṃsakavicāro’pi prāṇayātrābhivṛttaye |
nirarthakānāṃ kāṣṭhānāmaṃgārān vidadhāti saḥ || 4 ||
kāṣṭhānāṃ sañcayān kṛtvā vahniṃ dadāti tatra ca |
aṃgārāḥ samprajāyante śāntānalāḥ sumūlyakāḥ || 5 ||
vikrīṇāti tvardhadagdhān maṭṭhīsthān kulasān sadā |
taiśca dravyairdhanavān sa vartate dānapuṇyakṛt || 6 ||

dahyanti sañcaye tatra pāpaṃ tasya mahanmama || 7 ||
tacchāntyarthaṃ vidhātavyaṃ dānaṃ viṃśatikāṃśajam |
dharmakāryaṃ prakartavyaṃ sādhvīsādhuprasevanam || 8 ||

paropakārāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ makhine tathā ||3.232.1 0||
tadā pāpaviśuddhirvai jāyate nānyathā kvacit |

kamaleśaṃ prabheśaṃ śrīmāṇikīsvāminaṃ harim || 14||

athāyaṃ kṛtavān kāṣṭhapratimāṃ śrīharermama || 16||
sākaṃ śrīmāṇikīdevyā śobhamānāṃ sutaijasīm |
prasannavadanāṃ śāntāṃ raṃgaśṛṃgāraśobhitām || 17||
sarvāvayavasampūrṇāṃ divyābhūṣaṇacitritām |
prātaścāyaṃ sadotthāya snātvā prasevate hi tām || 18||
kāṣṭhasiṃhāsane ramye sthāpitāṃ pārṣadairyutām |
pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ snānaṃ tailādimarṣaṇam || 1 9||
godugdhaghṛtadadhyāḍhyaśarkarāmadhubhistathā |
snapanaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca pādāṃguṣṭhe karoti saḥ ||3.232.20||
vastreṇa mārjanaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ gaṇḍuṣāṃstathā |
kārayitvā vibhūṣādi divyāmbarāṇi yāni ca ||21 ||
śṛṃgārāṇi samastāni gandhacandanakuṃkumam |
puṣpahāramukuṭādi puṣpaveṣān dadāti me ||25||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalānnamiṣṭamuttamam |
jalaṃ dugdhaṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhi pakvānnamuttamam || 23 ||
mahyaṃ dadāti tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ tathottamam |
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavaccārārtrikaṃ namanaṃ stavam ||24||
aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ karotyātmasamarpaṇam |
parihāraṃ ca pūjāyāḥ kṛtvā niveditānnakam ||25 ||
bhuṃkte prasādamevāyaṃ tatpatnī ca tathāvidhā |
nāmnā prabhāvatīdevī putrāḥ putryastathāpare || 26 ||
bhuñjate tatprasādānnaṃ tato yāntyudyamāya te |
madhyāhne’pi tathā rātrau pūjāṃ me vidadhatyapi ||27||
naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ cārārtrikaṃ stavanaṃ tathā |
kīrtanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaviṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaramāpate || 588||
rādheśamāṇikīsvāmin śrīpate kamalāpate |
kṛtvā ca parihāraṃ te nayanti purato mama ||29||
gāyanti gītikā ramyāḥ svapanti ca tataḥ param |
evaṃ nityaṃ bhajamānā vartante sarva eva te ||3.232.30 ||
athaikadā mahāyogī nāmnā narāyaṇāyanaḥ |
sādhusādhvīśatayuktaścāyayau tasya mandiram ||3 1 ||
prabhāvatī tathā jvālāprasādaḥ svāgataṃ satām |
sādhavīnāṃ sādhuvaryasya vyadhātāṃ satkṛtiṃ tathā || 32||
āsanāni jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭānnāni phalāni ca |
madhūni ca rasām̐ścāpi kandān śimbīśca cirbhaṭān |||33||
bharjitānnāni śuṣkāṇi saktūm̐śca caṇakām̐stathā |
śākāni patrabhājāśca dadatuścātiharṣitau ||34||
sādhusādhvyaḥ prasannāśca tṛptāścāsam̐stadā sukhāḥ |
sāyaṃ snānaṃ bhojanādi dugdhapānaṃ ca pūjanam ||35||
śrīhareḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurvādyagītisutālakaiḥ |
tatrotsave janā rātrau bahavo vai samāyayuḥ || 36||
narā nāryaḥ sahasrāṇi sādhudarśanalālasāḥ |
vṛtraprasthanagarasya prajāścāpi samāyayuḥ ||37||
araṇyaṃ yamunātīre svargavat tvabhavajjanaiḥ |
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhanti mānavāstadā ||38||
niṣīdanti sabhāyāṃ ca kathāśravaṇalālasāḥ |
nārāyaṇāyanastatropādideśa hitāya vai ||39||
snehena bhaktiyogena kṛṣṇasya tatsatāṃ ca vā |
satīnāṃ sevayā mūrtipūjanairdevatārcanaiḥ ||3.232.40||
pavitratā bhaveccāpi divyatā mokṣaṇaṃ tathā |
parameśasya sākṣādvai prāptirbhavecca sevayā ||41 ||
bhaktyā bhavati sānnidhyaṃ snehena paramātmanaḥ |
māyānāśo bhavatyatra divyadṛgjāyate janaḥ ||42||
sākṣātpaśyati govindaṃ cāntare ca bahistathā |
māyāvaraṇarahito jāyate īśvaro yathā ||43||
golokaṃ vīkṣate tvatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam |
sevayātastoṣaṇīyāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo haristathā ||44||
prasannānāṃ satāmāśīrvādaiḥ sākṣādbhaveddhariḥ |
satsu nārāyaṇastvāste ravargamokṣasukhapradaḥ ||45||
divyānandasya lābhārthaṃ sevyāḥ santastathā hariḥ |
śraddhayā ca vivekena satsaṃgaḥ kārya uttamaḥ ||46||
dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca satsevā mokṣadā ime |
kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ sarve upārjanīyāḥ sadguṇāḥ ||47||
asatsu naiva sahasā viśvasitavyamarthinā |
tathā sati vivardhante tṛṣṇādyā durguṇāḥ sadā ||48||
kṣārabhūmisamo martyo yo’sti nāstikyabhāvavān |
tatra bījaṃ snehabhaktirnodeti dagdhatāmiyāt ||49||
asajjanaprasaṃgo hi patanasyaiva kāraṇam |
mahān pāpmā samudeti kusaṃgijanasaṃgataḥ ||3.232.50||
satsaṃgaḥ sarvapuṇyānāṃ śevadhiḥ pāpanāśakṛt |
sasaṃgamūlyāvijñāstu mānuṣyārthaviruddhagāḥ ||51||
kurvate ca kusaṃgaṃ vai tato yāntyadhamāṃ sthitim |
kalahena vivādena nidrayā pāpakarmabhiḥ ||52||
akāryācaraṇaiścāpi mriyante doṣapīḍitāḥ |
punarjanma ca maraṇaṃ nirayaṃ cāpyadhogatim |||53 ||
vindanti yāmyanagarīṃ yātanāstatra yojitāḥ |
vivekinastu loke’tra viditvā jaḍavarṣma ca ||54||
indriyāṇi mano buddhiṃ jñātvā māyāmayāni ca |
triguṇān prakṛtiṃ cāpi vāsanā vividhāstathā ||55||
jīvabandhapradā jñātvā bhaveyuḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ |
nityābhyāsaparasyaiva naśyanti vāsanādayaḥ ||56||
tyāgino na prajāyante saṃskārā mūlavarjitāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’styeṣāṃ hṛdantare ||57||
praveṣṭuṃ na dadātyeṣo doṣān bhaktahṛdantare |
dehābhimānayuktasya prabhurhṛdi na bhāsate ||58||
abhāse hṛdaye tamomaye māyā vivardhate |
ahantāmamate puṣṭiṃ gacchatastena vāsanāḥ ||59 ||
prajāyante tu bahudhā tṛṣṇātanturvivardhate |
punaḥ pāpāni jāyante tṛṣṇayā viṣayeṣviti || 3.232.60 ||
tasmādātmā cetano’smi dehādīnāṃ niyāmakaḥ |
kṛṣṇabhakto brahmadhāmā matvaivaṃ tṛṣṇikāṃ tyajet || 61 ||
apramattena vijñena sadā bhāvyaṃ sukhārthinā |
hareḥ sukhārthaṃ satataṃ yatitavyaṃ nijārthinā || 62||
doṣāstaṃ nārdayeyurvai te naśyanti harerbalāta |
ātmaniṣṭhaṃ janaṃ nābhibhavanti vāsanādayaḥ || 63||
sādhusevārthinaṃ niṣkapaṭinaṃ bhaktamānatam |
sādhuprasannatāśīrṇā doṣāḥ parābhavanti na || 64 ||
duṣṭasvabhāvaḥ satsaṃgānnaśyatyeva samūlataḥ |
tena doṣā vilīyeran satsaṃginastu dehinaḥ || 61 ||
ābālyādeva kartavyaḥ satsaṃgaḥ prītiracyute |
harerbhakteṣu vai snehaḥ kartavyo haridāyakaḥ || 66 ||
tāruṇye yena vai bhaktiḥ pravarteta dṛḍhā harau |
bhaktibalena kāmādyā nārdayeyurhi dehinam || 67||
sādhūn śāntān praseveta vikāravarjitān sadā |
vikāro vilayaṃ gacched yauvanaṃ taritaṃ bhavet || 68 ||

avivekena doṣairvai kalpitaiḥ pīḍyate svayam |
tasmād divyān prapaśyedvai sādhūnnārāyaṇātmakān | |3.232.7 0 | |
yadi kaścitpratīyeta doṣaḥ satsu tadā svayam |
doṣo nāyaṃ guṇaścāsti divya eva na saṃśayaḥ | |7 1 | |
evaṃ divyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ svasya syād divyatā tathā |
doṣagrāhī bhaved doṣī guṇagrāhī guṇī bhavet | |72||
dehatrayaṃ pṛthaṅamatvā śāntaṃ sādhuṃ niṣevayet |
śāntiṃ vrajet sevayā ca śāśvatīṃ pārameśvarīm | |73| |
niśchadmopāsanā kāryā hareḥ satāṃ śubhāvahā |
hareḥ prasannatāprāptyā haritvaṃ jāyate’nuge | |74||
jñānadārḍhyaṃ snehadārḍhyaṃ harau satsu pramuktidam |
sevā snehena bhavati prityā smṛtirhi śāśvatī | |75 | |
satyeva tanmayatvaṃ syāt tryavasthāsu hi darśanam |
sākṣātkāre tu sañjāte kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate | |76 | |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mānavarūpiṇi |
dehe prāgdarśanaṃ paścādindriyeṣu hi darśanam | |77| |
tato’ntaḥkaraṇeṣveva tato jīve hi darśanam |
evaṃ divyo hi bhagavānāste dehendriyātmasu ||78||
daihikīṃ prakṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasya divyatāṃ tu yaḥ |
mānasīṃ prakṛtiṃ jñātvā divyatāṃ manute ca yaḥ ||71||
ātmīyāṃ bhāvanāṃ bhāvya divyatāṃ cintayettathā |
sarvā divyāḥ kṛṣṇalīlā mokṣadāśceti kalpayet ||3.232.80||
evaṃ kṛṣṇasya yogena āntaraṃ bāhyamityapi |
karaṇaṃ varṣma sarvāṇi divyānyeva bhavanti hi ||81||
divyena divyabhagavān gṛhyate bhaktiyoginaḥ |
nādivyena harirgrāhyo jāyate mānavo’pi san ||82||
bhaktā divyāstataḥ sarve divyakṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ |
vyavasthā api divyāśca divyāḥ kāmādayo’pi ca ||8 3||
divyaṃ bhaktasya sarvaṃ vai yat kṛṣṇārthaṃ prakalpitam |
jīvānāṃ śreyase kṛṣṇaḥ mahatyā kṛpayā prabhuḥ ||84||
akṣarātparamāllokādiha bhūmau prajāyate |
kalyāṇāya janān naijaṃ satsaṃga kārayatyapi ||85||
narākṛtiśca naravat kurute laukikīḥ kriyāḥ |
tā api tasya līlā vai divyā vidantu mānavāḥ ||86||
kalyāṇadā samastā vai divyā bhavantu darśakāḥ |
evaṃ vai bhagavān svecchākṛtadivyānnijāśritān ||87||
dadāti darśanaṃ saṃgaṃ svasya bhaktasya kevalam |
ato bhaktendriyādīni kṛṣṇabhāvaṃ prayānti hi ||88||

narā nāryaḥ sadā divyā adoṣagrāhiṇastu ye ||3.232.90||
