nirdoṣā mokṣadāḥ sarve māyākāryavivarjitāḥ ||91 ||
yasya teṣu bhaved doṣagrahaṇaṃ tasya vai matiḥ |
pitṛbhyāṃ śāpitā pūrvaṃ sādhubhistu tataḥ param | |92||
atikrameṇa sādhūnāṃ śāpād buddhiḥ praduṣyati |
sādhavo dinavat santi durbalā bhagavatpriyāḥ ||93||

ardito jāyate tena śaptasya dhīḥ suśāpitā ||94||
dagdhā bhavati duṣṭā vai doṣagrāhā na nirmalā |
tāṃ vināśayituṃ nityaṃ yateta sevane satām || 95||
tanvā manasā dravyaiścendriyaiśca sampadā sadā |

śuddhiṃ labhettataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādyākṣaramāvrajet |
sādhūn prasādya ca divyaṃ nārāyaṇāśramaṃ labhet ||98||

jñānāgninā pradāhyedaṃ brahmāgnau juhvatu svakān ||99||
ityevaṃ tūpadiśyaiva dadau mantraṃ hareḥ rame |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 3.232.100 ||
pādavāryamṛtaṃ tebhyo dadau nārāyaṇāya naḥ |
lakṣmi rātrau praviśramya prātaḥ snātvā ca sādhavaḥ || 101 ||
prapūjya padamātmānaṃ bhuktvā phalādikaṃ payaḥ |
bhaktānāśīrvacaścoktvā yayustīrthāya sādhavaḥ || 1 02|||
bhaktāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ kṛṣṇavallabham |
bhejuḥ snehena satataṃ jvālāprasādabhāvitāḥ ||1 03||
athotsavaṃ pracakruste kārtike dvādaśīdine |
śukle caikādaśīrātrau jāgaraṇe prage sati || 1 04||
nṛtyatāṃ kīrtayatāṃ ca prāvirāsaṃ puraḥsthale |
caturbhujo māṇikīśrīsahito divyabhūṣitaḥ ||1 05||
taiḥ kṛtāmarhaṇāṃ sarvāṃ prāpya tiro’bhavaṃ kṣaṇāt |
mūrtau tatraiva nityaṃ ca nyavasaṃ premapāśagaḥ ||1 06||
prāpte kāle mama dhāmānayaṃ jvālāprasādakam |
prabhāvatīṃ ca tatpatnīṃ tathā bhaktān sahasraśaḥ || 1 07||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktastārito bhavasāgarāt |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhavatāraṇamāpnuyāt || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jvālāprasādākhyasyāṃgārāgnikṛto bhaktasya bhaktyā nārāyaṇāyanasādhusamāgamena tasya tatpatnyāḥ sahasrāvadhidehināṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ bhagavatā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 232 ||

<3.233>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ garadasyāpi mokṣaṇam |
kāśamitre ramyadeśe śrīnagare sukhāvahe || 1 ||
jhillimāsaritastīre’bhavadbhakto lavādanaḥ |
kuṭumbavān vipravaryo’dhītavidyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ || 2 ||
khyātavaṃśī mahāmānaḥ śrīpurādhipamānitaḥ |
rājā śrīnagarasyāsīnnāmnā śrīmānaveśvaraḥ || 3 ||
tena sammānito nityaṃ sabhāyāṃ kṛtaśekharaḥ |
nyāyālaye’pi mūrdhanyaḥ prajāyāṃ cātimānavān || 4 ||
lavādano’paro rājā rājeva vartate tadā |
kṛtarājyasamastābhyudayaḥ śikṣāvibhāgake || 5 ||
sainyasthānātikuśalo vyāpāre nipuṇastathā |
buddhimān vartate caivaṃ rājñyāpyatīva mānitaḥ || 6 ||
evavidhaḥ pradhāno’yaṃ guruścāpi nṛpasya vai |
karoti rājyakāryāṇi rāṣṭrakāryāṇi yānyapi || 7 ||
nṛpe prajāyāṃ sainye vā rāṣṭre kṣatiṃ pravīkṣya saḥ |
niḥsaṃśayaḥ samānaśca buddhyā vārayati kṣatim || 8 ||
nṛpaṃ prajāśca sainyāni tvāpadgatāni rakṣati |
āstiko devavalloke mānapātraṃ sa vartate || 9 ||
nityaṃ sūryaṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ candramasaṃ ca vedhasam |
vahnimindraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca māyāṃ jīvaṃ sacārhati || 3.233.1 0||
daśāyatanabhakto’yaṃ daśadharmān karotyapi |
jaladānaṃ carmadānaṃ lakṣmīdānaṃ tu naikadhā || 1 1||
oṣadhyarpaṇamābhūṣārpaṇaṃ ghṛtārpaṇaṃ tathā |
dhanurdānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ kathārpaṇam || 1 2||
evaṃ dharmān karotyeva tathānyānapi cocitān |
gṛhakṣetrālayavāṭyudyānārpaṇaṃ karotyapi || 13 ||
rājyalakṣmīvyayādānasamartho vartate mahān |
evaṃvidho’yaṃ bhaktaśca daśadevān prasevate || 14||
jñānavānapi dharmātmā kvacittāmasabhāvavān |
karoti tāmasaṃ kāryaṃ daṇḍe hiṃsātmakaṃ mahat || 15||
rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā svaputraṃ vā paraṃ prajāḥ |
daṇḍyaṃ daṇḍaṃ karotyeṣo dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ || 1 6||
atha kāle gate rājā prauḍho yuvātirājasaḥ |
mṛgayāyāṃ pravṛtto’bhūd vyavāye ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 17||
prajāyāṃ savyavāyaṃ vai prasahya prakaroti hi |
tenāsya mānaveśasya prajāsu nindanaṃ tathā || 18||
trāsaḥ prajāyate nityaṃ prajādharṣaṇakāraṇāt |
putrā nṛpaterabhavan pañca putryaśca viṃśatiḥ || 19||
rājñyaḥ saptābhavam̐ścāpi yuvatyaśca tathāpi saḥ |
kāmanābalasaṃkṛṣṭo vyavāye vartate sadā ||3.233.20||
madyāsavapiśatādaścātipāpaparo’bhavat |
athāsya nigrahārthaṃ vai prajā lavādanāya ha ||21 ||
muhuḥ samprārthayāmāsurdharmadaṇḍapradānakam |
lavādanaḥ śuśocāpi rājadroho bhavettathā ||22||
adaṇḍe tu prajādrohaḥ kartavyamatra kiṃ mayā |
evaṃ vicāryamāṇe ca mārgaḥ śanairabudhyata ||23||
yuvarājāya dātavyaṃ rājyaṃ rājā nirarthakaḥ |
śāsanīyaḥ svayameva bhaviṣyatyapasattayā ||24||
lavādanenaikadā tu rājñe sattvasthitāya ca |
āveditaṃ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ jñānagoṣṭhyā hitāvaham ||25||
asāraḥ khalu saṃsārastatra sāro hi mokṣaṇam |
sevayā tu satāṃ yadvā nārāyaṇasamāśrayāt ||26|||
pāpanāśastathā mokṣaḥ prajāyate hi dehinām |
rājyaṃ sampad bāndhavāśca prāṇayāne hyupāgate ||27||
na rakṣanti mahārājaṃ cakravartinamityapi |
rakṣatyeva kṛto dharmo nādharmo rakṣati kvacit |||28||
dharma eva pare loke sevitaḥ sevate janam |
adharmo bādhate tvatra pare loke’pi śatruvat ||29||
nivṛttiṃ prāpya bhagavān bhajanīyo hitaiṣiṇā |
putre yogye dhuraṃ datvā mokṣaḥ sādhyaḥ sukhārthinā ||3.233.30||
kāmānāṃ naiva sīmāsti vardhante tṛṣṇayā saha |
pātayanti niraye te’rdayanti jvālayanti ca ||3 1||
kāmām̐styaktvā hṛdayasthān nārāyaṇārpaṇaṃ caret |
vyavahārasya bhakteśca kāmānāṃ na saha sthitiḥ ||32||
bhaktiṃ kartuṃ vyavahāraṃ kāmām̐styajet vṛṣārthavān |
tasmād rājyaṃ kumārāya deyaṃ śānteśvarāya te ||33||
jyeṣṭhaputrāya yogyāya śobhanaṃ tad bhaviṣyati |
śrutvā rājāntare vahnijvālayeva hyadahyata ||34||
satṛṣṇasya viṣaṃ sarvaṃ cāmṛtaṃ hyapi padmaje |
hitavākyaṃ tyāgavākyaṃ viṣāyate na saṃśayaḥ ||35|||
sa tu nītyāvadattaṃ svapradhānaṃ gurumuttamam |
lavādana guro yogyaṃ bhavatā me niveditam ||36||
tathāpi kasyacit kālasyānte dāsyāmi tattathā |
putre tu yogyatā pakvā tāvadrājye bhaviṣyati ||37||
abhyāsena tato rājyaṃ dāsye śaighryaṃ na vidyate |
ityuttarito gururāṇ maunamāpyānamannṛpam ||38||
rājāpi kaitavaṃ nityamacintayannijārthakam |
guruścāyaṃ rājyaguruḥ pradhānaśca sabhādhipaḥ ||39||
utsādanīyaḥ sthānādvai sthāpanīyo’paro guruḥ |
tadā me bhavitā kṣemaṃ kuśalaṃ sarvadā tathā ||3.233.40||
vicāryetthaṃ trimāsānte sthānād dūrīcakāra tam |
lavādano’pi daivecchāṃ matvātyajannijaṃ padam ||41 ||
nivṛttiṃ prāpya devān sa hyabhajad daśa tān sadā |
rājā vyavardhata cātivyavāye svaprajāsu vai ||42||
prasahya kanyakā nītvā prajāyāstu surūpiṇīḥ |
karoti kāmanāṃ tāsu vimuñcati kṛtārthakaḥ ||43||
ākrośaśca prajāsveva vyavardhatātiroṣataḥ |
rājāyaṃ nāśanīyo vai pradhānasya vivāsakaḥ ||44||
ekaśabdaḥ śrūyate vai sarvaprajāsu sarvathā |
prajāvyavāyavyasanī nāśanīyaḥ nṛpo’pi vai ||41||
anyathā mahatī hānirbhavedeva prajāsu vai |
itiniścitya ca sarve prajāgryāstu lavādanam ||46||
mimilurnṛpanāśāya daivena noditā hi te |
lavādanena sahitā yayuḥ senāpatiṃ prati ||47||
sūryakāntābhidhaṃ cāpi kathāyāmāsurudvratam |
rājño vināśanaṃ syādvai yadi dharme na yāti saḥ ||48||
bhavān prajānāṃ śāstāpi nītimāśrayatu dhruvām |
rājāyaṃ rājyapadato’vatārya eva sarvathā ||49||
sūryakānto marmavākyaṃ śrutvā tathāstu cāvadat |
atha sarve yayuḥ śānteśvaraṃ tu yuvarājakam ||3.233.50 ||
rājāyaṃ vipathe tvāste padayogyo na vidyate |
avatārya padāt tvaṃ ca sthāpyaḥ prajābhirādarāt ||51 ||
anyathā mahatī hānirbhaviṣyatīti viddhi vaḥ |
kumāro’pi tathāstvevaṃ prāhātha mahiṣīṃ prati ||52||
śreṣṭhottamāṃ prati sarve’kathayannitinirṇayam |
sāpi daivavaśāttathāstvevaṃ prāha vivekinī |||53||
atha prajābhirmahatī sabhā kṛtā nivṛttaye |
tatra rājñī tathā rājñyaḥ kumārāśca prajottamāḥ ||54||
senāpatiḥ pradhānaścāyayurnirṇayahetave |
pradhānāya navīnāya nirṇayaṃ te nyavedayan |||55|||
gartamaṇiḥ pradhānastu nirṇayaṃ nābhyamodayat |
utthāya prayayau bhūpaṃ nyavedayadaniṣṭakam ||56||
rājā roṣeṇa sahasā gartamaṇimuvāca ha |
kārāgāre prakarotu senāpati kumārakam ||57||
rājñīṃ prajāḥ pūrvapradhānaṃ ca tathā virodhinaḥ |
śrutvā gartamaṇinā vai rājabhaṭā nṛpājñayā ||58||
prahitā nigaḍe kartuṃ rājavirodhino drutam |
śataśo’tha rājabhaṭā dudruvuḥ paritastadā ||59||
vidhṛtā bahavastatra kṛtāśca nigaḍeṣu vai |
atha lavādanastatra rājñīṃ rājakumārakam ||3.233.60||
senāpatiṃ prasaṃprāpya mantraṇāṃ saṃvidhāya saḥ |
garaṃ tīvratamaṃ nītvā rājānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||61 ||
puṣpahāraṃ sagaralaṃ kaṇṭhe rājño nyadhāttadā |
rājā sugandhamāsādya śanairmūrcchāmavāpa ha ||62||
mṛtastūrṇaṃ tato gartamaṇiḥ saṃbhraṃśitaḥ padāt |
lavādanaḥ pradhānasya pade prajābhirādṛtaḥ ||63||
kārāgārasthitāḥ sarve lavādanena mocitāḥ |
śānteśvaro yuvarājo rājadhiṣṇye’bhiṣecitaḥ ||64||
mānaveśo mṛtaśceti ghoṣitaṃ vai prajāsvapi |
rājñyastāśca kumārāśca nṛpaurdhvadaihikaṃ vyadhuḥ ||65||
yajño nṛpasya śuddhyarthaṃ kṛtavān sa lavādanaḥ |
viprā anāthāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca kanyakāstathā ||66||
prajājanā bhojitāśca toṣitāḥ svarṇadānakaiḥ |
godānairgṛhadānaiśca kanyādānaiḥ kumārakāḥ ||67||
dharmakāryairmakhe rājā mṛtaḥ puṇyena yojitaḥ |
yamapūryāṃ ca sūrmyādiyātanā bahuduḥkhadāḥ ||68||
bhuktvā svargaṃ yayau paścānmakhapuṇyena vai nṛpaḥ |
yuvarājo’bhavad rājā rājyaṃ dharmyaṃ vyadhāddhi saḥ ||69|||
sādhubhakto’bhavannityaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
sahasrasādhavastasya bhuṃjate nityameva tu ||3.233.70||
karoti rājyaṃ dharmyaṃ ca lavādanānumoditaḥ |
atha sādhūttamo nāmnā kiṃśukāyanasadguruḥ ||71||
ātmaniṣṭho bhagavanniṣṭhito lavādanaṃ gurum |
tathā śānteśvaraṃ bhūpaṃ senānī sūryakāntakam ||72||
prajāgryām̐ścopādideśa hitaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ tadā |
karmabhirdehino loke jāyante ca viyanti ca ||73 ||
dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca bhaktirharau ca sādhuṣu |
kṛtaṃ yat sevanaṃ puṇyaṃ dānaṃ saha prayāti vai ||74||
dharmī nṛpaḥ pitṛtulyo’dharmī daṇḍyastu śatruvat |
dharmiṇā bhūbhṛtā śreyaḥ prajānāṃ nityadā bhavet ||75||
sāghusevāvidhātā vai rājā prajāsu rājate |
biḍālabakavṛttistu prajābhiḥ paribhūyate ||76||
yastu nirmalahṛt kṛṣṇasevāparo jitendriyaḥ |
prajārakṣākaro bhūpo vardhate’nugrahaiḥ satām ||77||
bālye kaścit sādhudharmā yauvane viparītakṛt |
bālye duṣṭo’pi kaścittu yauvane dhārmiko bhavet ||78||
satāṃ samāgamairdehī tvābālyājjīvanāvadhim |
satpumāneva jāyeta śreyomārgasthitaḥ sadā ||79||
asatpumānasatsaṃgādasannevābhivardhate |
sahavāsavyavahārakhānapānāpamānataḥ ||3.233.80||
guṇā aguṇā dṛśyante bāle yuni viśeṣataḥ |
bālye puṇyapratāpena dharmī yunyapi sabhavet ||8 1 ||
śamena manasaḥ śāntirdamena bāhyavājinām |
tābhyāṃ doṣāḥ pradātavyāḥ kāmakrodhādayo’khilāḥ |||82||
ubhāvetau tyāgināṃ ca gṛhiṇāṃ hitakāriṇau |
sādhusevāparāṇāṃ tu doṣā naśyanti mūlataḥ ||83 ||
jīvo vivekanipuṇo nāśayed doṣamaṇḍalam |
sākṣī kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā prāpayeddhāma cottamam ||84||
kalyāṇamūrtirbhagavān jīvānāṃ śreyase bhuvi |
prāvirbhavati śrīkāntastaṃ prasevya vimucyate ||85||
yadyapi śrīharirdhāmni sthita eva tu muktidaḥ |
samartho’sti tathāpyatra premibhaktā bhavanti ye ||86||
nāryo narāḥ premiṇo vai teṣāṃ yo viraho hareḥ |
asahyaḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ tu tannāśāya yathā sukham ||87||
tebhyo dātuṃ bhaktivaśo bhaktecchāpūraṇāya ca |
tadihānupramodādipūraṃ rūpaṃ dadhāti saḥ ||88||
yogaṃ datvā pūrayati bhaktasarvamanorathān |
sajātīyo hi bhavati premavṛddhyarthameva ha ||89||
kṛpaiva sā harerbodhyā bhaktajātīyajanmani |
asaṃkhyadivyasadguṇaiśvaryapratāpatejasā ||3.233.90||
pūrayannaranārīṇāṃ manāṃsi tadvaśe sthitaḥ |
putratvena patitvena suhṛttvena sakhitvataḥ ||91||
pitṛmātṛsatītvena sādhutvena pravartate |
śiṣyatvena gurutvena nṛpatvena ca vartate ||92||
sukhayitvā yatheṣṭaṃ tān dharmasthāpanamuttamam |
āsurāṇāṃ vināśaṃ ca kurvaṃstadānuṣaṃgikam ||93||
tirobhavati bhaktānāṃ tṛptyuttaraṃ nijecchayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ ||94||
gopālabālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktyā grāhyaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ chalaṃ lobhaṃ mānamirṣyāṃ ca matsaram ||95||
tyaktvā pāpāni sandahya bhajettaṃ māṇakīpatim |
bhaktyā satāṃ sevayā ca sa prabhuḥ samprasīdati ||96||
agnidasya garadasya nārīhatyodbhavasya ca |
pāpaṃ naśyati kṛṣṇasya sevayā tatsatāmapi ||97||
bālaghnasya dhenuhatyodbhavasya nṛpanāśinaḥ |
mātṛghnasya tathā pāpaṃ līyate kṛṣṇasevinaḥ ||98||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
japantu satataṃ mantraṃ pāpaśuddhirbhaviṣyati ||99||
ityuktvā kamale kiṃśukāyanaḥ pradadau manum |
lakṣaprajābhyastatraiva sarvān vyadhāt suvaiṣṇavān || 3.233.1 00||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhejuśca māṃ hi te |
lavādano daśadevairmāṃ tataḥ puruṣottamam ||1 01 ||
viśeṣeṇābhajat sarve cānye rājaprajādayaḥ |
bhejurmāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cātmanivedinaḥ || 1 02||
sādhavaḥ prayayurbadrīnārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ khalu |
lavādanasya vārdhakye sevayā tuṣṭatāṃ gataḥ || 1 03||
ahaṃ lakṣmi puro divyamūrtirāvirbabhūva ha |
garadasya mahatpāpaṃ vidhūya divyavarṣmaṇā || 1 04||
divyamuktaṃ vidhāyaivānayaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
rājñīḥ sarvāstathā senāpatiṃ ca nṛpatiṃ navam || 1 05||
bhaktyā tuṣṭo’nayaṃ sarvānakṣaraṃ kramaśaḥ padam |
prajāśca bhaktisampannāḥ pāvanīścānayaṃ padam || 1 06||
evaṃ mayā samastāste sādhudvārā vimocitāḥ |
māyābandhanarahitāḥ kṛtā lakṣmi pare’kṣare || 1 07||
garadānamahatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyā layaṃ gatam |
evaṃ bhaktyā vilīyante pāpāni sarvathā rame || 1 08||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayāntyeva bhajanasya balānmama |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavet sadā || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne lavādanākhyapradhānasya rājñe garadasya bhagavadbhaktyā kiṃśukāyanasādhusevayā ca tasya ca rājñīnāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 233 ||

<3.234>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ śastradharakathāṃ tathā |
nāmnā vikhaṇḍalavarmā śastradhārī purābhavat || 1 ||
kṣattriyo nāndale grāme mahīnadītaṭe śubhe |
vanasthānāṃ kirātānāṃ caurāṇāṃ śāsako mahān || 2 ||
luṇṭakānāṃ śāsakaśca dhanurbāṇadharastathā |
pariṇītayugalānāṃ mārge nirbhayarakṣakaḥ || 3 ||
vivāhārthaṃ prayātānāṃ vāhinīnāṃ ca rakṣakaḥ |
vyāpāriṇāmanasāṃ ca trātā nāmadharo’bhitaḥ || 4 ||
śrutvā tannāma caurāśca prayānti dūrataḥ sadā |
evaṃ bhītipradaḥ śāstā śāsakānāṃ tu śāsakaḥ || 5 ||
kintu bhakto hi hṛdaye nītimārgamupāśritaḥ |
rakṣaṇena pradattaṃ yacchreṣṭhibhiḥ rājabhistathā || 6 ||
vetanaṃ tena mātreṇa nirvahatyeva nānyathā |
yāmyadūtasamo veṣe dayāyāṃ dharmavat sadā || 7 ||
rakṣaṇe rājavaccāpi nītimārge tu śukravat |
bṛhaspatisamo bodhe bhaktau ye garuḍo yathā || 8 ||
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvena vartate cātmavedanaḥ |
kintvanītiparāṃ vyaktiṃ prāpya daṇḍaṃ karoti saḥ || 9||
yathāyogyaṃ daṇḍayati naraṃ duṣṭaṃ śaṭhaṃ sadā |
śastraghātena vā cātiduṣṭaṃ hanti balena vai ||3.234.1 0||
evaṃ ghātādipāpaṃ ca bhavatyeveti taddhṛdi |
saṃkalpo jāyate nityaṃ pūjāyāṃ yācate kṣamām || 11 ||
prātaḥ snātvā mama mūrteḥ pūjāṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ |
kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ cānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ datvā nivedanam || 12||
jalaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tataḥ param |
śastraṃ madagre nikṣipya kṣamāṃ prayācate yathā || 13||
nāhaṃ krūro hiṃsakaśca nāhaṃ svārthī na lampaṭaḥ |
śastraṃ me mā bhaved duṣṭaṃ patitaṃ doṣavarjite || 14||
nayānvite ca bhakte cādaṇḍye mā patitaṃ bhavet |
ajñānena na me śastraṃ doṣaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavet prabho || 15||
duṣṭānāṃ śāsane caitanmā parājayamāpnuyāt |
māhaṃ pāpena lipyeya nītibahiḥpravartinā || 16||
evaṃ satyapi mānuṣyājñānavegena karhicit |
cedākrameta pāpaṃ vai mayi dīnāparādhataḥ || 17||
daṇḍyo’haṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇa kṣamyaścet kṣamyatāṃ tadā |
ityevaṃ mama bhakto’yaṃ khaṅgabāṇādi matpuraḥ ||18||
samarpya nityamāvakti tato bhuktvā prasādajam |
pītvā pādāmṛtaṃ yāti rakṣyarakṣaṇahetave ||19||
grāme vane khale vāṭyāṃ kṣetre rakṣati sarvathā |
rakṣyavastūni sarvāṇi vikhaṇḍalaḥ pramodavān ||3.234.20||
madhyāhne me nivedyānnaṃ prasādaṃ cātti sarvadā |
sāyaṃ sīmnaḥ samāgatya gṛhe karoti pūjanam ||21 ||
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalamuttamam |
nīrājanaṃ stavanaṃ ca tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhi ca ||22|
mahyaṃ samarpya śastrāṇi nikṣipyāpi puro mama |
punaḥ prārthayate nityaṃ kṣamasvājñānajaṃ hyagham ||23||
tavāsmi tava dāso’smi tava bhakto’smi tāmasaḥ |
tava tādātmyamāpannastava śeṣo bhavāmyaham ||24||
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā mahyaṃ śastraṃ samarpya karma ca |
samarpyaiva śayane vai nidrāṃ karoti māṃ smaran ||25|||
tasya bhāryā harasatīnāmnī prasevate ca tam |
mahābhaktā bālakṛṣṇe mayi śrīśanarāyaṇe ||26||
patyau nārāyagaṃ māṃ ca paśyatyeva na cetarat |
patimūrtau sarvasevāṃ karoti mayi saṃsthite ||27||
pratimāyāṃ pṛthak sevāṃ karoti svāmino mama |
snānaśṛṃgārabhūṣādi nīrājanaṃ subhojanam ||28||
pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ vāyudānaṃ dolābhidolanam |
gītikāṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhotthāṃ mama līlābharāṃ tathā ||29||
parihāraṃ ca nidrāyāḥ kīrtanaṃ prakaroti ca |
tato naijaṃ nityakāryaṃ nirvartayati bhāminī ||3.234.30 ||
evaṃ bhaktātisaṃsnigdhā bhajate māṃ nirantaram |
sādhavaścāpi sādhvyaśca tadgṛhaṃ yānti pāvanam ||3 1 ||
bhuktvā pītvā śramaṃ tyaktvā prayānti tīrthamuttamam |
athaikadā samāyācca sādhurnirmohanāyanaḥ ||32||
pūjito bhojitaścāpi rātrau saṃvāhitaḥ padoḥ |
upādideśa tābhyāṃ sa mokṣasādhanamuttamam ||33||
kṣamāśastraṃ pare śastraṃ sarvaśāntipradaṃ śubham |
kṣamā tejasvināṃ tejaḥ kṣamā tapastapasvinām ||34|||
kṣamate sarvatāmyāni sa vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ |
kṣamā pṛthvyāṃ sadā cāsti mātari sarvadehinām ||35||
kṣamā satsu sadā divyaguṇātmikā pravidyate |
sā vai jayapradā loke svargamokṣasahāyinī ||36||
āpattīnāṃ samastānāṃ kṣamā śastraṃ nibarhaṇam |
kāme krodhe made lobhe māne kṣamā hi śāntidā || 37||
nirbalasya kṣamā śastraṃ yadvacchastraṃ vivekinām |
sādhūnāṃ ca kṣamā śastraṃ śāsakaṃ tārakaṃ hyapi || 38 ||
kṣamiṇāṃ hṛdye kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā sadāsti ca |
sa eva kṛpayā rakṣāṃ karotyasya viśeṣataḥ ||39||
śāsakaṃ kathyate trātṛ śastraṃ taddhi mataṃ janaiḥ |
māyākālabhayāt karmabhayācchāstṛ ṛtaṃ hi tat ||3.234.40||
dehasya śāsakaṃ naiva ṛtaṃ śastraṃ yathārthakam |
indriyāṇāṃ śāsakaṃ vā tathaivāti ṛtaṃ na tat ||41 ||
dehendriyāṇi māyāyāḥ kāryāṇi naśvarāṇi ca |
rakṣaṇe’yutadhā jāte’pyabhinaśyanti vai laye ||42||
vināśino rakṣaṇaṃ vai viphalaṃ tattadarthakam |
śastraṃ ca viphalaṃ tvevaṃ yatno bhāraḥ phalojjhitaḥ ||43||
araṇyaṃ nāśaśīlaṃ vai sīmāpi ca tathaiva ha |
kṣetravāṭyādisarvaṃ vai nāśaśīlaṃ pravartate ||44||
caurā maraṇadharmāṇaḥ sasyānyapi tathaiva ca |
śāstā tvaṃ deharūpastu tathaiva nāśadharmavān ||45||
mṛtidharmā mṛtidharmaiḥ śikṣyate tat kutūhalam |
varaṃ vai kardamāsparśaḥ paṃkaprakṣālanātpurā ||46||
tasmād dehasya śastrāṇi mokṣadāni na santi hi |
mokṣadāni tu śastrāṇi gopanīyāni sarvathā ||47||
rakṣaṇīyāni dhāryāṇi yoktavyāni tu muktaye |
vikhaṇḍala divyaśastrāṇyetāni me nibodha ha ||48||
yauvanaṃ śatrurūpaṃ vai tacchastraṃ tu vratārjanam |
kāmaḥ śatrurmahām̐statra tacchastraṃ brahmacaryakam ||49||
vāsanā śātravī mātā tacchastraṃ cātmasaṃsthitiḥ |
vivako bhedavijñānaṃ bhajana śrīharermuhuḥ ||3.234.50 ||
tyāgo vairāgyamevāpi caudāsīnyaṃ bahiḥ sadā |
evaṃ śastrāṇi māyāyā nāśakāni bhavanti vai ||51 ||
śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ nityaṃ sādhusevāsamāgamaḥ |
śrīharernavadhā bhaktirbhajanaṃ cātibhāvataḥ ||52||
amāyikānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sarvasvārpaṇasevanam |
hṛdaye śrīharerdhyānaṃ dehenātmasamarpaṇam ||53||
manasā cintanaṃ nityaṃ buddhyā sphūrtiḥ sadā hareḥ |
ānandādikriyāṇāṃ tu sarveśvare samarpaṇam ||54||
rasāsvādādikaṃ kṛṣṇaprasāde eva nānyathā |
śabdasparśādayaḥ sarve kṛṣṇasyaiva na cetarāḥ ||55||
ebhiḥ śastrairbhavenmāyānāśaḥ karmalayastathā |
niṣkāmakarmaṇā śāntirvitṛṣṇasya prajāyate ||56||
kāmasaṃkalpahīnāśca yasyāraṃbhā hi nirguṇāḥ |
nairguṇyaṃ cāpyate tena sādhusaṃgena daivatam ||57||
hareḥ prāptyā tu divyatvaṃ sākṣādyogena mokṣaṇam |
māhātmyajñānayuktasya harau snehaḥ prajāyate ||58||
harau snehena saktasya hareḥ sphuraṇamavyayam |
pravarteta tataścendriyāṇi tadrūpakāṇyapi ||59||
jāyante’ntaḥkaraṇāni kṛṣṇasya mandirāṇi vai |
ātmā siṃhāsanaṃ tasya nārāyaṇasya jāyate ||3.234.60||
tenātmā ramate śete’śnute harṣati modate |
ānandayāti tādātmyabhāvairbrahmadaśāmayaḥ ||61 ||
vyavahāre vartamānaḥ sarvatra brahmabhāvanaḥ |
karmabandhananirmukto brahmaiva nātra saṃśayaḥ ||62||
harau sthiramanā divyo brahmaiva brahmatanmayaḥ |
kṛṣṇadṛḍhāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇe ramate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||63||
adhamoddhārakaḥ kṛṣṇo gṛhṇāti śaraṇe’rpitam |
punāti patitaṃ cāpi dīvyati snehinā saha ||64||
satīṃ gatiṃ dadātyeva svasmin raktāya mādhavaḥ |
ātyantikaṃ padaṃ śreya āpnoti mādhavārpitam ||65||
prakṛteḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ laye cākṣaradhāmani |
bhaktasya saccidānandamayaṃ tejaḥ prakāśate ||66||
tatra tejasyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ |
virājate cidacitāṃ niyāmako’ntarāsthitaḥ ||67||
divyamūrtirdivyavāsā divyabhūṣāvibhūtimān |
sevyamāno mahābrahmabhūtamuktairasaṃkhyakaiḥ ||68||
anantaśaktibhiḥ rādhāramāmuktānikādibhiḥ |
kṛtārcanapādasaṃvāhanānandapradāyibhiḥ ||69||
sa eva svacaraṇayoḥ sevāṃ dadāti sevine |
sa eva vartate bhūmau kṛṣṇo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ||3.234.70||
niḥśreyasāya lokānāṃ divyaguṇārthavigrahaḥ |
vicāryetthaṃ parabrahma puruṣottamamāśrayet ||71||
āśritāḥ pakvaniṣṭhāśca sākṣāt paśyanti taṃ tataḥ |
sūkṣmadṛśo’ntarātmānaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti cāntare ||72||
sthūladṛśaḥ sthūlarūpaṃ sthūle paśyanti taṃ prabhum |
māyā kāyānavacchinnā līnā sāmyā yadākṣare ||73||
tadā sūkṣmā tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sūkṣmarūpo’tra lokyate |
cetanāśca yadā līnāstattvāntaravivarjitāḥ ||74||
tadā sūkṣmāstatra kṛṣṇaḥ sūkṣmarūpo vilokyate |
māyā tu viṣamāvasthā cetanāḥ karmiṇastathā |175||
tadā sthūlāsteṣu kṛṣṇaḥ sthūlarūpo vilokyate |
divyadṛṣṭimatāṃ kṛṣṇavīkṣaṇaṃ divyatānvitam ||76||
adivyadarśināṃ kṛṣṇavīkṣaṇaṃ prākṛtaṃ yathā |
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni sūkṣmasthūlāni vai hareḥ ||77||
sūkṣmasthūlapadārtheṣu nihitāni tu śārṅgiṇā |
aiśvaryaiḥ sakalā māyā cetanā vā parasparam ||78||
pṛthag vā samprakāśante saguṇā nirguṇāśca vā |
sarvāstāḥ sampado’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ||79||
bhuṃkte bhakto’rpitasarvasvo’tibhāgavatottamaḥ |
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni prāpnoti patibhaktimān ||3.234.80||
patitvamekaṃ deveśe mukteśe śiṣyate harau |
anyat sarvaṃ nijaṃ tasmai bhaktāyārpayati prabhuḥ ||8 1||
snehaśastraṃ svāmino’pi vaśaṃkaraṃ vṛhat sadā |
tenaiva snehaśastreṇa śāsanīyo harirhadi ||82||
bandhanīyaḥ snehapāśairhṛdi dūraṃ na saṃcaret |
eṣaiva cākṣarī muktirdehināmiha divyatā ||83||
divyanāthapradabhogānandabhoktrī sthitistu yā |
sā pratyakṣe gurau kṛṣṇe prāptavyeha kṣitau purā ||84||
tato brahmapure saiva vartamānā prakāśate |
mohinī sā hareḥ prītirmahānandapradā sadā ||85||
koṭyabjakāmadevānāṃ sukhaṃ yatra harau sadā |
tādātmyabhāvamāpanno labhate svāmini prabhau ||86||
netrasukhamanantaṃ ca sparśasukhamanantakam |
cumbanānandamatulaṃ labhate svāmini prabhau ||87||
āliṅganamahānandaṃ labhate paramātmani |
sarvendriyarasaṃ divyaṃ dikṣeyamāsvādanaṃ tathā ||88||
labhate ca tathā divyaprītipramodamutsavam |
harṣaṃ divyaṃ tathā śāntiṃ śaityaṃ cāmṛtamiśritam ||89||
labhate śrīharau kānte svāmini śrīpatau prabhau |
caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ ye cānandā bhavanti vai ||3.234.90||
sṛṣṭitrayāṇāmānandā ye ye yatra bhavanti vai |
tān sarvān labhate mūrtau svāmini śrīparātmani ||91||
evaṃ lakṣmi copadeśaṃ kṛtvā nirmohanāyanaḥ |
rātrimuṣitvā prayayau tīrthāntaraṃ supūjitaḥ ||92||
prātarvikhaṇḍalo bhaktiṃ cakāra ca yathoditām |
jñānena sahitāṃ tasya patnyapi brahmarūpiṇī ||93||
vidadhe tādṛśīṃ bhaktiṃ snehayuktāṃ pravardhitām |
mūrtervai pūjane sarvaṃ kurutastau yathocitam ||94||
tayorbhaktyā prasanno’haṃ prāvirbarbhūva tatpuraḥ |
divyacaturbhujaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tisundaraḥ ||95||
prahasan cārpitān sarvopacārān cottamottamān |
ādade’haṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhuktvā dade prasādikam ||96||
tau bhuktavantau prītyā ca pītavantau jalāmṛtam |
tāvad divyasvarūpau cājāyetāṃ matsamānakau ||97||
prārthitavantau mokṣāya nirmohināvubhāvapi |
ahaṃ vimāne tau dhṛtvā divyau dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||98||
anayaṃ pārṣadaiḥ sākaṃ tayoḥ saṃkalpapūrakaḥ |
muktau tau cākṣare dhāmni vartete kamale sadā ||99||
evaṃ sādhuprasaṃgena samuddhṛtau nijānugau |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmi muktimavāpnuyāt || 3.234.10 0||
svargaṃ vā satyalokaṃ vā rājyaṃ vā caiśvaraṃ padam |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ vā labhate bhaktimān mayi || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne nirmohanāyanasāghuprasaṃgena vikhaṇḍalākhyaśastradharasya tatpatnyā harasatyāśca bhagavaddarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 234 ||

<3.235>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ jīrṇodbhavasya satkathām |
ārāmanagare vīṇānadītīre’tivistare || 1 ||
jīrṇodbhavābhidhaścāsīt karṣukaḥ kṛṣimānmahān |
śataputraḥ śatabhṛtyo viṃśatistrīpatirbalī || 2 ||
śataputrīpitā pautracatuḥśatābhiśobhanaḥ |
pautrīśatadvayaśobhanmahāsaudhanivāsakṛt || 3 ||
evaṃ viśālavaṃśāḍhyaḥ kṛṣīvalo’tipāvanaḥ |
dharmadānarato nityaṃ gosevādiparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
pañcaśataṃ godhanaṃ tu mahiṣīdviśataṃ tathā |
aśvaśataṃ vartate’sya vṛṣabhāṣṭaśatāni ca || 5 ||
kṣetrāṇi vāṭikā mahodyānāni sasyabhūmayaḥ |
ghāsabīḍamaraṇyaṃ ca bhūmyucchrayo’sya santi ca || 6 ||
yojanaṃ bhūtalaṃ vīṇānadītīre’sya vartate |
tatra kṛṣiṃ karotyeṣo bījādhānaṃ yathartu ca || 7 ||
dhānyāni vividhānyeva jāyante’nnāni sarvaśaḥ |
dvidalāḥ kandamūlāni bhavanti puṣpapatrikāḥ || 8 ||
phalāni kaṇiśāḥ śimbyo bhavanti veṣavāṭakam |
granthayo daṇḍasasyāni śākāni bhājikāstathā || 9 ||
āranālāni sarvāṇi tiktakaṭūni yāni ca |
bhavantyasya mahāvāṭyādiṣu kṣetreṣu sarvathā ||3.235.1 0||
oṣadhayo’pi vividhāḥ prajāyante prasecitāḥ |
narā nāryaḥ prayatante kṛṣyudyamaparāyaṇāḥ || 11 ||
utpādayanti bījoptyā khādyānnāni bahūnyapi |
utpannebhyaḥ samastebhyo viṃśatyaṃśaṃ prapūrṇakam ||12||
dharmārthaṃ sa dadātyeva dānapūjādikarmasu |
jīrṇodbhavagṛhe nityamanāthāḥ sādhavo dvijāḥ || 1 3||
bhikṣukā yātriṇaḥ sādhvyo dīnā adanti bhojanam |
dadhīni picchalānyeva payāṃsi madhurāṇi ca || 14||
ghṛtāni puṣṭiyuktāni śarkarā gūḍakām̐śca vai |
madhūni miṣṭagariṣṭānnāni śreṣṭhāni bhuṃjate || 15||
arpayanti haraye me pakvānyannāni te’nvaham |
evaṃ dharmaprasaṃgena vardhante cāsya sampadaḥ || 16||
na hīyante puṇyavaśād bhujyamānāśca sādhubhiḥ |
athāsya bhāgyamevāpi bahusmṛddhaṃ vyajāyata || 17||
yadgṛhe vai makhāḥ pañca sampādyante dvijaiḥ sadā |
makhe’syābhyāgataḥ sādhurnāmnā caitanyakāyaniḥ || 18||
mahābhāgavato bhaktottamastyāgavirāgavān |
āyayau svāgataṃ tasya jīrṇodbhavaścakāra ha || 19||
jalaṃ śubhāsanaṃ miṣṭaṃ madhuparkaṃ dadau naman |
vāsaṃ ca hariśālāyāṃ dadau sevāṃ cakāra ca ||3.235.20||
rātrau devārcanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā caitanyakāyaniḥ |
cakre’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇalīlādikīrtanam ||21||
brahmaṇo’sya tripañcāśadvatsareṣu harerjanim |
akīrtayattatra tatra kṛtā līlāḥ pramokṣadāḥ ||22||
tataḥ sa stavanaṃ cakre śuśruvuḥ sarvakarṣukāḥ |
yaḥ parabrahma bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ||23||
akṣare parame vyomni rājate muktasevitaḥ |
yasmād bhavanti sṛṣṭau vai prāvirbhāvā anekaśaḥ ||24||
so’yaṃ śrīkambharāputraścāste gopālabālakaḥ |
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’śvapaṭṭasārase ||25||
yatra śrīlomaśaścāste brahmapriyā vasanti ca |
sarvatīrthāni devāśceśvarā vibhūtayaḥ śriyaḥ |||26||
lakṣmīrādhāramāpadmāvatīśrīrmāṇikīpradhīḥ |
haripriyā vasantyetāḥ śrīkṛṣṇabrahmayoṣitaḥ ||27||
asaṃkhyāḥ sādhavo yatra svataḥprakāśarūpiṇaḥ |
divyā vasanti ṛṣayaḥ śaraṇyaṃ prabhajanti ca ||28||
namastasmai nṛnāṭyāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ |
ābhyantarebhyaḥ śadhubhyo’vanaṃ karoti yo hariḥ ||29||
namastasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane |
ādhyātmikebhyastāpebhyaścādhidaivikatastathā ||3.235.30||
ādhibhūtādikaṣṭebhyo rakṣakāya namonamaḥ |
sāmantavikramāt krūrālluṇṭakād vanacandrakaḥ ||31 ||
sukhādevī ca tatpatnī vaṇijo yena rakṣitāḥ |
sāyanāyanasādhostu samāgamena mokṣitāḥ || 32||
sa kṛṣṇo vartate rakṣākarastasmai namonamaḥ |
dhaniṣṭhakoṣaṃ vipraṃ ca vārāṃganāsu vartitam ||33|.
snehalatāṃ ca tatpatnīṃ guruṃ somāyanaṃ tathā |
nṛpaṃ mālavasiṃhaṃ ca rarakṣa mokṣaṇaṃ dadau ||34||
namastasmai pareśāya śrīkāntāya tu śārṅgiṇe |
rājīvākhyaṃ nṛpaṃ rājñīṃ sādhvīṃ kundanadevikām || 35||
arakṣayat tathāmokṣayad yastasmai namonamaḥ |
devaviśrāmasya rakṣāṃ kāṇḍikāyāśca mokṣaṇam ||36||
kṛtaṃ yena ca tasmai śrīharaye vai namonamaḥ |
harṣulamālinaṃ patnīṃ tasya vidrumavallakīm ||37||
uddadhāra hariryaḥ śrīpatistasmai namonamaḥ |
śāṇadharaṃ pitṛhaṇaṃ karṣukaṃ ca rarakṣa yaḥ ||38||
vṛṣahaṃ nimbadevaṃ ca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
bhāṇḍaṃ kālīndaraṃ sādhukamalāyanayogataḥ || 39||
mokṣaṇaṃ cāprāpayad yastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
nartakaṃ rāyaṇadevaṃ bodhāyanasya yogataḥ ||3.235.40||
gāyakaṃ nākirālākhye pattane tu vratardinam |
rājānaṃ puṇḍravarmāṇaṃ ya uddadhāra te namaḥ ||41 ||
vāyakaṃ tūlavāyākhyaṃ samuddadhāra yaḥ prabhuḥ |
kāṣṭhahāraṃ tathā jaṃgaladevaṃ te namonamaḥ ||42||
paṇyakṛdvātsalyadhīraṃ patnīṃ mañjulikāṃ tathā |
sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ kṛtavān yastasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ||43||
tilakaraṃgaṃ vanapaṃ śikhādevīṃ ca tatpriyām |
uddadhāra hariryaḥ sa hṛdayastho’pi rakṣatu ||44||
kṣetrapaṃ nāñjakadevaṃ tathā stenamahāmayam |
uddadhāra hariryaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ ||45||
kirātaṃ sāgarākhyaṃ tatpatnīṃ ca sārikāṃ tu yaḥ |
uddadhāra hariryaśca tasmai śrīpataye namaḥ ||46||
hūṇaṃ sāraṃganāmānaṃ rarakṣa yaśca te namaḥ |
yajñarādhaṃ puṣkasaṃ ca brahmāyanaprasaṃgataḥ ||47||
kuṭumbayuktaṃ yaḥ kṛṣṇo’mokṣayatte namo namaḥ |
kapikṣayaṃ tu cāṇḍālaṃ prājñeśvaraṃ dvijaṃ tathā ||48||
amokṣayaddhariryaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
nālīkaraṃ lohakāraṃ patnīṃ kundanikāṃ ca yaḥ ||49||
amokṣayad bhavapāśāttasmai śrīviṣṇave namaḥ |
carmakāraṃ maṃgalākhyaṃ patnīṃ vibhāvarīṃ ca yaḥ ||3.235.50||
viṣād rarakṣa bhagavān yastasmai vai namonamaḥ |
rathakāraṃ haridāsaṃ patnīṃ śrīmānavīṃ tu yaḥ ||51||
amokṣayat prabhave te vāraṃ vāraṃ namonamaḥ |
śilāhāraṃ dāmaśilādakaṃ patnīṃ kalābhidhām ||52||
tadbhṛtyām̐ścāmokṣayad yastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
śilpinaṃ sañjayadevaṃ patnīṃ keśavatīṃ ca yaḥ ||53||
rājānaṃ khaḍgavarmāṇaṃ tathānyān śilpino’pi ca |
uddadhāra haristasmai bālakṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ ||94||
citrakṛtsaṃbharadevaṃ ca citraṃsaritāṃ priyām |
citrakārānaparān yo’mokṣayatte namonamaḥ |||55|||
aṃgārahāriṇaṃ mauktikeśinaṃ tu nijāśritam |
tathāparān karmacārān yo rarakṣa ca te namaḥ ||56||
cakradharaṃ lubdhakaṃ yaḥ pautimāṣyopadeśataḥ |
amokṣayaddhi saṃsārāttasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||57||
vāṭadharaṃ piśunaṃ yo nṛpaṃ sutārasiṃhakam |
ghaṭyayanaprasaṃgenāmokṣayatte namonamaḥ ||98||
vāṭadharaṃ savāsaṃ ca dvaipīrājñīmarakṣayat |
amokṣayacca yaḥ kṛṣṇastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ ||59||
gṛhakāraṃ śivajayaṃ vṛṣaparvaprasaṃgataḥ |
amokṣayattu yaḥ kṛṣṇastasmai śrīharaye namaḥ ||3.235.60||
yaśca saṃgarayādaskaṃ jālakāramamokṣayat |
patnīṃ rūpāvatīṃ śuklāyanarṣisevayā hariḥ ||61 ||
tathā jātyā bharavāṭamudyamaśrītināmakam |
satīśvarīṃ ca tatpannīṃ vallavīścoddadhāra yaḥ ||62||
uṣṭrapālaṃ dīrgharambhaṃ rāmāyanaprasaṃgataḥ |
uddadhāra hariryastaṃ vallabhaṃ praṇame prabhum ||6 3||
ratnaprabhaṃ kharapālaṃ nṛsiṃhasvāmiyogataḥ |
uddadhāra harirnārāyaṇastaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||64||
gadārdaneśvaraṃ vaidyaṃ tatpannīṃ ca mukundinīm |
amokṣayaddhi saṃsārād yastaṃ namāmi māpatim ||65||
kīśanakulapālasya deśyāvanasya mokṣaṇam |
tatpatnyāḥ purikāyāśca cakre yastaṃ namāmi vai ||66||
nāpitaṃ harṣadharmākhyaṃ patnīṃ nigamikāṃ ca yaḥ |
bhūbhṛtaṃ svarṇadhanvānaṃ rājñīṃ ca pañcadevikām ||67||
kalyāṇadhāmasādhostu samāgamena tān prabhuḥ |
uddadhāra harirnārāyaṇastaṃ praṇamāmi vai ||68||
yaśca rūṭāṇakīdevīmābhīrīṃ daityadharṣitām |
arakṣayad brahmapriyāmadhye rūpeśvarīṃ tu tām ||69||
mandārakalikādyāśca tathānyā divyarūpiṇīḥ |
vyadhācchrībhagavān patnīstaṃ namāmi janārdanam ||3.235.70 ||
dhīvaraṃ dhīraparvāṇaṃ nirvāṇāyanayogataḥ |
kṛtvā tu pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇo’mokṣayattaṃ namāmyaham ||71 ||
tārakādarśakaṃ śūlāropakaṃ coddadhāra yaḥ |
supathānakabhūpaṃ ca kṛtaśalyāṃ śūlyaṃganām ||72||
uddadhāra jaṭī bhūtvā hariśrīkṛṣṇanandanaḥ |
gopālanandanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabha taṃ namāmyaham ||73||
jvālāprasādanāmānaṃ cāgnidaṃ ca prabhāvatīm |
nārāyaṇāyanayogādamokṣayannamāmi tam ||74||
lavādanaṃ tu garadaṃ nṛpaṃ śrīmānaveśvaram |
śānteśvaraṃ yuvarājaṃ sūryakāntaṃ tu sainyapam ||75||
kiṃśukāyanayogena samuddadhāra yaḥ prabhuḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇaṃdeśikaṃ bhaktahṛdayasthaṃ namāmi tam ||76||
vikhaṇḍalaṃ śastradharaṃ bhāryāṃ harasatīṃ ca yaḥ |
nirmohanāyanayogādamokṣayacca te namaḥ || 77||
evaṃ lakṣmi stavanaṃ vai sādhuścaitanyakāyaniḥ |
cakre neme hariṃ sarvasthitaṃ ca paritastadā ||78||
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā karṣukāste parāścaryaṃ prapedire |
jīrṇodbhavaḥ karṣukeśo natvā papraccha taṃ munim ||79||
yeṣāṃ rakṣā tathā muktiḥ kṛtā śrīparamātmanā |
kimatra kāraṇaṃ tanme brūhi caitanyakāyane || 3.235.80||
śrutvā munistu tānāha mantraṃ nārāyaṇasya me |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||8 1 ||
japa mantramimaṃ nityaṃ japantvanye mumukṣavaḥ |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavet | |82||
āpatkāle mahārakṣāṃ vidadhyātparameśvaraḥ |
ityuktvā virarāmāsau nidrāṃ jagrāha māṃ smaran ||83 ||
karṣukā nidritāścāsan japanto mantrameva tam |
prātarutthāya sādhustu snātvā prapūjya māṃ tataḥ ||84||
niveditānnaṃ bhuktvā ca prāpya pūjāṃ yayau vanam |
karṣukāste nityameva japanti mantramuttamam ||85||
pūjayanti hariṃ māṃ ca kurvantyapi mahotsavān |
cāturmāsye kṛtavanto vratāni vividhāni me ||86||
athāśvine vāṭikāsu kṣetreṣu vanabhūmiṣu |
araṇyeṣu ca bīḍeṣu stambasasyatṛṇāni ca ||87||
phaladrūpāṇi sarvāṇi kaṇiśānyabhavan yadā |
dhānyarddhisaṃbhṛtānyeva pakvaprāyāṇi sarvathā ||88||
caturyojanabhūmau vai kṣitiḥ sā sasyaśālinī |
pakvapatrauṣadhibhiśca svarṇavarṇā praśobhate ||89||
atha vai daivayogena vāyuvegena sīmataḥ |
uparisthapradeśādvai vahniḥ karṣukacullikām ||3.235.90 ||
tyaktvā ca vāyunotkṣiptaḥ sahasā sasyabhūmiṣu |
śuṣkatṛṇeṣu cāvyāpnot tataḥ sasyeṣu sarvataḥ ||91 ||
tataḥ kṣetreṣu kaṇiśaiḥ sasyayukteṣu sarvataḥ |
dāvāgnivat sa cāvyāpnot krośārdhaṃ prasasāra ha |92||
hāhākāraḥ karṣukasya prajāyāmabhavattadā |
dudruvuḥ śāntaye vahneḥ sahasraśo hi mānavāḥ |||93||
kintu vāyupravegeṇa coḍḍīyoḍḍīya dūragaḥ |
vyomnā bhūtvānyavāṭyāṃ ca pare kṣetre sasāra ha ||94||
niro’ddhuṃ śakyate naiva bhayadaḥ prasasāra vai |
utpannakaṇanāśārthaḥ sarvatṛṇādidāhakaḥ ||95||
durbhikṣāpādakarūpaḥ prasasāra samantataḥ |
kṛtayatnā janāḥ sarve nirāśāścābhavam̐stadā ||96 ||
caitanyāyanataḥ prāptaṃ mantraṃ jepuḥ prarakṣakam |
ekaikāṃ mālikāmāvartayan yāvattu te sthirāḥ ||97||
smaranto hṛdaye rakṣākaraṃ māṃ duḥkhanāśanam |
tāvanmayā hi rakṣārthaṃ cintitaṃ cāmbare drutam ||98||
meghamudbhāvya vṛṣṭiṃ vai vidyudgarjanayā yutām |
akaravaṃ ghaṭikānte sasyāgniḥ praśaśāma ha ||99||
krośamātre bhasmasādvai jātaṃ yattatra sarvathā |
viśeṣato’karavaṃ vai vṛṣṭiṃ sasyasamṛddhaye || 3.235.100 ||
punastatra hi sasyāni tṛṇāni kaṇiśāni vai |
vyajāyanta yathāpūrvaṃ yathartvanusṛtāni vai || 101 ||
evaṃ mayā tadā lakṣmi vṛṣṭyagniḥ śāmitaḥ khalu |
tataśca karṣukaiḥ sarvairannakūṭo navaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 02||
nave varṣe sarvamiṣṭānnāni śākāni yāni ca |
odanāni dvidalāśca kṣārānnāni parāṇi ca || 10 3||
bharjitānnāni rasyāni svādūni cottamāni ca |
pakvānnāni sudhāktāni pāyasānyuttamāni ca || 1 04||
niveditāni sarvāṇi mahyaṃ viśālamandire |
tatra mūrtāvahaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 1 05||
bubhuje sarvabhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni lehyakāni ca |
coṣyāṇyapi ca peyāni tathā tāmbūlakāni ca || 1 06||
caturbhujaḥ prabhuḥ sākṣād bhuktvā datvā prasādajam |
nīrājanāṃ tathā pūjāṃ labdhvā tūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavam || 1 07||
āścaryaṃ lebhire sarve vaiṣṇavā matprasādajam |
bubhujire ca te divyā vyajāyanta ca pāvanāḥ || 1 08||
nityaṃ cakruśca me bhaktiṃ sarve kuṭumbinastu te |
atha kāle cāgate ca yathākramaṃ yathocitam || 1 09||
anayaṃ svaṃ padaṃ divyamakṣaraṃ karṣukān rame |
śataṃ tu kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ svāmivrataparāyaṇāḥ || 3.235.11 0||
bhajitvā māṃ prajātā vai brahmapriyāstavāśritāḥ |
imāstā devamaṇikāprabhṛtayastvadālaye || 11 1||
vartante divyadehinyaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇagopikāḥ |
anye muktā abhavam̐śca mamārādhanayā rame || 1 12||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā bhaktāḥ karṣukā mokṣitāstadā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādvartanādapi || 1 13||
jāyante muktasadṛśā mamānandaprabhogiṇaḥ |
sarvakāmaprapūrāśca madanyūnā madātmakāḥ ||1 14||
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
hare svāmin pate sarvasukhade snehapātrikā |
bhaktā patnī tava toṣārthaṃ kathaṃ syāt surūpiṇī ||1 15||
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
sarvāṃgasundarī naijāṃ bhavituṃ vratamuttamam |
mama kuryājjanmajayantyākhyamūrjāsitāṣṭamīm ||1 16||
upāvasettu vā phalaṃ payo dadhyādi bhakṣayet |
yathālabdhopacārairmāṃ śrīyuktaṃ pūjayet satī || 1 17||
candravanmukhalābhārthaṃ svarṇacandraṃ dadettu me |
netrabhrubhālaśobhārthaṃ svarṇapatratrayaṃ dadet || 118||
kapolakarṇanāsauṣṭhasauṣṭhavārthaṃ suvarṇajam |
svarṇapatraśaṣkulīsatpuṣpabimbāni vai dadet || 1 19||
dantasvarasugandhārthaṃ svarṇakundapradā tathā |
śarkarākesarakaiśarādipradā bhaved vrate || 3.235.120||
sustanārthaṃ dāḍimādiphale svarṇe dadet vrate |
suśobhitakarārthaṃ tu svarṇekṣudaṇḍamarpayet || 121 ||
supārśvodaravakṣo’rthaṃ svarṇakalaśapaṭṭikāḥ |
svarṇarūpyaphalakāni dadyāt saundaryadāni hi || 1 22||
raśanāstanukaṭyarthaṃ śroṇyarthaṃ dvau ghaṭau dadet |
svarṇajau yonisaukṣmyārthaṃ svarṇormikāśca mauktikān || 1 23||
svarṇakapardikāṃ śaṃkhalikāṃ śuktiṃ dadettathā |
alomajaghanārthaṃ tu dadet pātraṃ suvarṇajam || 124||
yonyārogyakṛte dadyāt kastūrīhīrakādikam |
cārusakthikṛte dadyād rūpyakadalikādvayam ||125|||
sveṣṭaliṅgapādajaṃghācārvarthaṃ kadalīphalam |
vāhanaṃ pāduke svarṇe rajo’rthaṃ mauktikān dadet || 1 26||
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvīṃ prasādya sarvamāpnuyāt |
vratottaradine sādhūn bhojayet phalamāpnuyāt || 127||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam |
sarvā nāryo labheran me vrate dānena vāñcchitam ||1 28||
ityevaṃ te kathitāni caritrāṇi nijāni vai |
bhaktarakṣākarāṇyeva ṣoḍaśe vatsare mama || 129||
tvayā śrutāni sarvāṇi mano’bhilaṣitāni vai |
sādhumāhātmyayuktāni mahāmokṣapradāni ca || 3.235.1 30||
kṛpayaiva mayoktāni śreyase smaratāṃ rame |
dhyāyatāṃ muktaye cāpi vadatāṃ pāpanuttaye || 131 ||
mahānandapradānyeva tādātmyabhāvayoginām |
sarvasvārpitanārīṇā brahmapriyātvadāni ca || 1 32||
sarvasvārpitapuṃsāṃ tu brahmamuktatvadāni ca |
sakāmānāṃ sarvakāmapūrakāṇi sukhāni ca || 1 33||
niṣkāmānāṃ kṛpayā me mattulyatāpradāni ca |
lakṣmi līlā mama divyā divyā madyogimānavāḥ || 1 34||
sarvaṃ divyaṃ mama kṣetraṃ paradhāmātmakaṃ bhuvi |
ṣoḍaśaṃ vigataṃ varṣaṃ mahānandapariplutam || 1 35||
saptadaśaṃ janmadine mamāyāti drutaṃ khalu |
utsavo’tra mahān bhāvī lomaśādyaiḥ pravartitaḥ || 1 36||
viramāmi samastānāṃ patnīnāṃ śrāntaye’pi ca |
oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 1 37||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne jīrṇodbhavābhidhakṛṣīvalasya caitanyakāyanisādhuyogena bhagavaddarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, strīsaundaryādipradavratadāna varṇanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 235 ||

<3.236>
śrīpuruṣottama uvāca 
śṛṇu nārāyaṇīśri tvaṃ saptadaśamahotsavam |
mama janmadivasasya caturvyūhaḥ kariṣyati || 1 ||
vāsudevastathāsaṃkarṣaṇo’niruddha ityapi |
pradyumnaśceti te sarve tatheśvarā maharṣayaḥ || 2 ||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’kṣare divye mahāyate |
āgatya śvo nivatsyanti sannaddhāḥ santu sevikā || 3 ||
ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ cāndre māse tu noditāḥ |
lakṣmyaḥ sarvā brahmapatnyaḥ samārambhaṃ pracakrire || 4 ||
sabhādevyaḥ sabhāsthānaṃ sabhāsthānāni yāni ca |
pracakrire hi sahasā yeṣu sṛṣṭyabhibimbanam || 5 ||
śṛṃgāradevikā divyaśṛṃgārāṇi pracakrire |
dhāmadevyaḥ prakāśāni vanadevyo vanāni ca || 6 ||
udyānāni tarudevyo māyā dṛśyāni cakrire |
rasadevyo rasān sarvān gandhadevyaḥ sugandhinaḥ || 7 ||
sarasvatyo gāyanāni niśā svargaṃ pracakrire |
annapūrṇā gariṣṭāni miṣṭānnāni pracakrire || 8 ||
kalpalatāḥ puṣpapatradalāni saṃpracakrire |
kalpamaṇayo bhūṣāśca vahniḥ svarṇaṃ pracakrire || 9 ||
bhūdevī ramyaśayyāśca vāyurvai vāhanāni ca |
rasaśālāḥ kamalādyāḥ pānaśālāśca vāruṇī || 3.236.10 ||
lalitāśrīmahālakṣmīrdāsikābjābjamānayat |
viṣṇustu pārṣadān muktānānayannijasevakān || 11 ||
yajñanārāyaṇo yajñamaṇḍapān saṃvyadhād drutam |
oṣadhayaḥ samidhaścānayan sarvavidhā drutam || 1 2||
gāndharvā gāyakān vādyasahitān prasamānayan |
nartakyaścāpi kinnaryo’psarasaścāyayurdrutam || 1 3||
muktāvatārā īśeśā īśvarāścāyayustadā |
svāgatārthaṃ mahāsenāpatayaḥ śāṃkarādayaḥ || 14||
sotsāhāśca pratijagmurmaharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ |
vāsudevādayo vyūhā nārāyaṇāstathāyayuḥ || 15||
rudrā ajāḥ siddhajanā viṣṇavastatra cāyayuḥ |
īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ sarvā ramāḥ samāyayuḥ || 16||
rādhāsakhyo ramāsakhyo brāhmīsakhyaḥ samāyayuḥ |
vairājāśca hiraṇpuṃso māyātattvāni cāyayuḥ || 17||
devā devyaḥ pitaraśca dikpālā lokapālinaḥ |
ṛṣayo mānavā bhaktāḥ kāśyapāśca samāyayuḥ || 18||
dhārmikāḥ sādhavaḥ satyo brahmaśīlāḥ samāyayuḥ |
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇastīrthottamāni cāyayuḥ || 19||
ītirdhṛtiḥ śivā śaktirvedapatnyaḥ samāyayuḥ |
samudrāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca rādhādyāśca samāyayuḥ || 3.236.20 ||
yoginyaḥ śāṃkarāḥ sarve gaṇāścāpi samāyayuḥ |
naranārāyaṇādyāśca tāpasāstatra cāyayuḥ || 21 ||
araṇyāni vanānyeva bhūgolāni samāyayuḥ |
caityāśca ṛtavaḥ kālāḥ vatsarādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||22||
puruṣottamamāso’pi mahābherīṃ ninādayan |
āyayau cākṣare kṣetre sarvakalyāṇakṛcchubhaḥ ||23||
yogāḥ samāyayuryajñā bhaktiputrāḥ samāyayuḥ |
vimānānāṃ na pāro’sti gajānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||24||
vāhanānāṃ na pāro’sti sūtamāgadhadehinām |
bandīnāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ manorañjanakāriṇām ||25||
ūrjasaptamikārātrāvāyayuḥ sarvadehinaḥ |
teṣāṃ svāgatamutkṛṣṭaṃ devyo devāḥ pracakrire ||26||
pārṣadāḥ sādhavaścāpi brahmapriyāḥ pracakrire |
pitā mātā ca bhaginī bhrātaraḥ saṃpracakrire ||27|||
tathā samastaśiṣyāśca svayamārṣāśca īśvarāḥ |
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca lālāyanādyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||28||
svāgataṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ pracakrire dadustathā |
sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ payāṃsi ca dadustadā ||29||
sarvā dāsyo’pi dāsāśca mahīmānaprasevanam |
niśīthe cakrire tatra nyūnaṃ nābhūddhi kiṃcana ||3.236.30||
prātarutthāya ca lakṣmi cāhaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtaśṛṃgārakaḥ priyābhiranvitaḥ ||31 ||
mātrā pitrā vardhitaśca sabhāyāmagamaṃ drutam |
tadā vādyānyavādyanta vāsudevādayastathā ||32||
avatārā īśvarāśca hīśvarāṇyastu sarvaśaḥ |
muktāśca gopikā gopā āyayurmama maṇḍapam ||33||
divyasiṃhāsanasthasya kṛtvā me pūjanaṃ ca te |
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ sarve’kṣatakuṃkumacandrakān ||34||
cakruścāśīrvacanāni jagurviprā maharṣayaḥ |
dhāmakoṭyaśceśakoṭyo devarṣipitṛkoṭayaḥ ||35||
tatpatnyaścākṣatapuṣpairvardhayāmāsureva mām |
mānavāḥ sarvatīrthāni tattvāni vedavedikāḥ ||36||
sarasvatyaḥ śāradāśca lakṣmyaḥ sarvā mamārhaṇam |
cakruḥ sarvopadā me ca dadurdivyāḥ sabhāsthale ||37||
evaṃ madhyāhnaparyantaṃ pūjanaṃ bahuśobhanam |
jātaṃ me tatra cāyātaṃ sarvaṃ dāne dadāvaham ||38||
bhojanāni mahīmānebhyaśca dattāni vai tataḥ |
parihāraḥ kṛtaścāpi dakṣiṇāḥ prāpitāḥ śubhāḥ ||39||
pāritoṣikarūpāṇi dattāni yogyatā yathā |
rātrau vādyamahāgītinṛtyarañjanakādikam ||3.236.40||
abhavattvardharātryantaṃ virāmaśca tato’bhavat |
navamyāṃ ca mahīmānāḥ pūjitā bhojitāstathā ||41||
sammānitāśca prahitā yayurnijālayān prati |
evaṃ saptadaśe varṣārambhadine’ṣṭamītithau |||42||
kṛṣṇe corje mama janmajayantyutsavitā rame |
bhavatīnāṃ yaśaścedaṃ trisṛṣṭau samprakāśate |||43|||
ṣoḍaśasya tu varṣasya camatkārā mamātra vai |
tṛtīye dvāparasantānake saṃvarṇitā mama ||44||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ |
caritrāṇāṃ vidhātā ca kartā vaktā pralekhakaḥ ||45||
etattṛtīyakhaṇḍasya pārāyaṇaṃ karoti yaḥ |
tasya sampad vividhā syād vaṃśo vistāravān bhavet ||46||
sauvarṇe garuḍe dhṛtvā dadyād dvāparapustakam |
tena vai pṛthivīdānaṃ dattaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||47||
asya kathākṣaṇe yadyat samarpyate’lpakaṃ hyapi |
anantaguṇitaṃ tatsyānmahāsvargapradaṃ bhavet || 48|||
godānaṃ vāṭikādānaṃ svarṇaratnapradānakam |
kanyādānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ gajadānaṃ makhe’rpaṇam ||49||
sarvadānaphalaṃ tvasya dānena samprajāyate |
vimānadānaṃ nagarīdānaṃ vanārpaṇaṃ tathā ||3.236.50||
sarvasvārpaṇamevāsya dānena samprajāyate |
brahmadānaṃ vedadānaṃ mokṣadānamathottamam |||51|||
ātmasamarpaṇamasya dānena samprajāyate |
taranti pitaraścāpi bhavanti dhāmavāsinaḥ ||52||
sāmrājyārpaṇamevāsya dānena samprajāyate |
rogā vighnāḥ praṇaśyanti duritāni hrasanti ca ||53|||
durbhāgyāni vinaśyanti dvāparakhaṇḍadānataḥ |
saptāhaṃ pākṣikaṃ vāpi māsikaṃ vā pravācayet ||54||
sādhūn viprān bhojayecca śrotṝn vaktṝn yathādhanam |
sādhvī satīrbhojayeccānāthān dīnān samastataḥ ||55||
vācakaṃ varayānena bhrāmayennagare striyaḥ |
viprāśca bhūbhṛtaścāpi śreṣṭhinaśca prajājanāḥ |||56|||
kumāryaḥ kalaśairvāribhṛtaiśca nārikelajaiḥ |
mauktikairāsinībhiśca suveṣairbhrāmayettathā |||57||
suvāsinyo gītikābhirakṣataiḥ puṣpakuṃkumaiḥ |
pūjayed vardhayeccāpi bhrāmayennagare tathā ||58||
mahādānāni dadyuśca vācakāya mahātmane |
yathā sādhuḥ prasannaḥ syāttattaddadyurhi sādhave |||59||
bhuktirmuktirbhavedasya śravaṇena ca divyatā |
vāsanānāṃ praṇāśaśca kalmaṣāṇāṃ layo bhavet ||3.236.60||
tāpatrayavināśaśca śāntistu śāśvatī bhavet |
putraṃ putrīṃ samīhānā dvāparakhaṇḍadānakam ||61||
nūtnaveṣṭanasahitaṃ svarṇamudrānvitaṃ caret |
śatrubhīstena naśyedvai rājabhayaṃ na jāyate ||62||
kārāgāravimuktaḥ syādasya dānena bhāvataḥ |
asādhyaṃ sādhyamevāpi bhavedasya śruteriha ||63 ||
sārvajñyaṃ bahudhā tvasya śravaṇena prajāyate |
vallabhāryaḥkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī mahāprabhuḥ ||64||
rādhālakṣmīpatiḥ padmāvatīśrīmāṇikīpatiḥ |
prajñāmuktāpatirnityaṃ sphuret svahṛdaye śravāt ||65||
sākṣānmileddhi varṣānte śṛṇuyānnityameva tam |
miled rahasi viśvātmā svapne milenna saṃśayaḥ ||66||
āpatkāle rakṣayecca dvāparakhaṇḍasaṃsmṛteḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhiteyaṃ me pratimāsti hi ||67||
khaṇḍo’yaṃ dvāparasantāno me’styudaramāntaram |
spṛṣṭvā dhyātvā sevayitvā manmūrtiṃ labhate’kṣare ||68||
yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ bhaved vāñcchā sākṣād yogyasya me hṛdi |
taistābhiśca kathā śravyā japtavyaśca manurmama ||69||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
āgatyāhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai sukhaṃ dāsye ca darśanam ||3.236.70 ||
lakṣajapena siddhyedvai mantro’yaṃ mama nāmavān |
daśāṃśahomaḥ kartavyo bhāvanīyo’māntare ||71 ||
kaustubhakirīṭayuktaḥ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ |
prasannavadano lakṣmi kāntaḥ kandarpasundaraḥ ||72||
trailokye nāsti tadvastu yadvastu na dadāmyaham |
sṛṣṭitraye’pi tannāsti yanna bhaktāya sandade ||73||
siṃhāsanaṃ tathāṅkaṃ ca dhāmākṣaraṃ madāsanam |
mamaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi dadāmi mantrajāpine ||74||
etallakṣmi hṛdayaṃ me kṛpā me’nugrahaśca me |
sarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ dāsye vai tādātmyamantrajāpine ||75||
kalpavṛkṣāḥ kāmadughāḥ kalpavallyaśca yā matāḥ |
kalpastambāstathā cintāmaṇayo’kṣayapātrikā ||76||
padmacihnaṃ camatkārāḥ siddhayaścāpi sarvaśaḥ |
bhavanti hṛdaye tvasya tādātmyamantrajāpinaḥ ||77||
śṛṇoti dvāparasantānakaṃ japati manmanum |
śāśvataṃ puṇyamevāsya kalpasiddhiśca śāśvatī ||78||
avyāhatagatistasya hyanāvaraṇadarśanam |
mantrasiddhyā jāyate vai madicchayā na saṃśayaḥ ||79||
devatvaṃ vā munitvaṃ vā siddhatvaṃ ceśatāṃ ca vā |
avatāratvamevāpi dvāparasya śravāllabhet ||3.236.80 ||
bhūmapadaṃ śivapadaṃ hiraṇmayapadaṃ tathā |
mahāpuruṣadhiṣṇyaṃ vā dvāparasya śravāllabhet ||81 ||
śṛṇuyācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kṛtvā manaḥsthiram |
mahotsavena śṛṇuyāccatuḥpumarthadaṃ bhavet| ||82||
nityaṃ phalāni dhānyāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca |
nityopayogivastūni dadyāt saṃśṛṇuyāt kathām ||83||
nindakānāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā nāstikānāṃ bhayaṃ tathā |
viruddhānāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā śṛṇuyādvai mamāśraye ||84||
yatrāhaṃ tatra vijayo yatrāhaṃ tatra cotsavāḥ |
yatrāhaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tatra macchūnye bhayamasti hi ||85||
śrutvā śrutvā rasavettryo bhavantu buddhayo hi vaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama gocarāḥ ||86||
adhyāyaṃ vāpyaikapadyaṃ ye śroṣyanti samāhitāḥ |
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ tārako’haṃ kṛṣṇo’smi bhavasāgarāt ||87||
api pāpā nīcadehā nīcakarmāṇa eva vā |
anācārāḥ satāṃ yogād yathā śuddhyanti sarvathā ||88||
tathāsya śravaṇāt pāpāḥ praśuddhyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
madyogānnirguṇāḥ sarve śrotāraḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||89||
atra mānavarūpāste muktā muktānikā matāḥ |
kathāsthānaṃ tvakṣaraṃ me dhāma bodhyaṃ na māyikam ||3.236.90||
vaktāsti mama rūpo’sya vadāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
śloke śloke mayā lakṣmi kṛpā pravarṣitā tviha ||91 ||
api manāk hariṃ kāntaṃ pratyabhiyānti bhāvataḥ |
tān pratyahaṃ śataguṇamabhiyāmi pramoditaḥ ||92||
kṛteṣu sarvayajñeṣu yadyāpanna vyapohati |
smarenmāṃ mama tādātmyamantraṃ japenmuhurmuhuḥ ||93||
sarvāpado vinaśyanti pratijñeyaṃ mayoditā |
etaddvāparasantānakhaṇḍaśravaṇamānatām ||94||
kuryādvā vipadāṃ nāśaḥ saṃkalpakaraṇād bhavet |
ekatastu kathāḥ sarvā ekatastu manurmama ||95||
manurviśiṣyate lakṣmi kathāyuktastu kiṃ punaḥ |
śaṃ vo’stu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya karuṇālavāt ||96||
ācāryaḥ kambharāputro’stu śaṃ gopālanandanaḥ |
santuṣṭānujasaumyaśrīprajñāsārvajñyasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||97||
sarvajñaḥ sarvavit sarvāntarātmā sarvakāraṇam |
śaṃ vo’stu śvetavyāsādiryāvadvyāseśvaro hariḥ ||98||
sarvadharmāśrayaḥ sarvāśramaḥ sarvārthavarṇavān |
śaṃ vo’stu sarvakakṣāḍhyaḥ sarvakhanīśvaro’gragaḥ ||99||
yadvāsāt khalu saurāṣṭraṃ saurāṣṭratāṃ bhajatyati |
so’haṃ so’yaṃ sākṣaparokṣakaḥ śaṃ vo’stu śāśvatam || 3.236.1 00||
ākṣarakuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśasaṃśrite |
devadeveśvaraḥ śaṃ vo brahmeśo’stu hariḥ sadā || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye dvāparasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saptadaśajanmadinajayantyutsavo dvāparasantānakathāśravaṇadānamantrajapamahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 236 ||

<3.237>
śrīnārāyaṇīśrīruvāca 
hṛdayasya priyaprāṇakāntacānandavāridhe |
kṛpālo śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhaṃ pāvanīkṛtā | | 1 ||
divyānāṃ śrībhavataḥ satkathānāṃ śrāvaṇena vai |
imā brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāstathāparāḥ || 2 ||
paramaṃ pāvanaṃ bhāvaṃ prāptā bhavatkathāśravāt |
sarvā muktānikā gopyo ramā lakṣmyaḥ śriyaḥ striyaḥ || 3 ||
īśvarāṇyaśca siddhānyo devyo mānavya ityapi |
kāśyapyaśca talinyaśca kṛtakṛtyā hare’bhavan || 4 ||
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ daityadānavarakṣasām |
kanyakānāṃ kṛṣṇakāntātmikānāmiha no yathā || 5 ||
aho kṛpā hyaho cānugrahaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
śrottryaḥ patnyaḥ patirvaktā svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 6 ||
yāsāṃ bhāgyāni chinnāni sphuṭitāni ca vā prabho |
tāsāṃ kṛṣṇamukhāmbhojakathāśravakṣaṇo na vai || 7 ||
śroṣyanti bahunāryaśca narāścāsya kathāmṛtam |
saṃkṣepāccālpabuddhīnāṃ kathāsmṛtiṃ prakāraya || 8 ||
puruṣottama uvāca 
svalpakṣaṇāptaśraddhānāṃ smaraṇārthaṃ narāyaṇi |
kathāyāmyasya khaṇḍasya kathābījāni saṃśṛṇu || 9 ||
adhyāyāścāsya khaṇḍakasya ṣaṭtriṃśacchatadvayam |
ślokānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi pañcaviṃśatirityadhi || 3.237.1 0||
satyatretādvāparāṇāmadhyāyā vai ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ |
tathā śataṃ sahasraṃ ca bhavanti mokṣadā rame ||1 1 ||
ślokāḥ khaṇḍatrayāṇāṃ tu lakṣaṃ tvekaṃ tathādhikāḥ |
te dvādaśasahasrāṇi śataṃ santi bhuṅmukpradāḥ || 12||
eṣā saṃkhyā mānave’tra loke bodhyā na cetare |
saṃhiteyaṃ viśālāsti prāgeva kathitaṃ tava || 1 3||
atra dvāparasantāne hyāraṃbhe śrīkṛtā stutiḥ |
sṛṣṭikālasya gaṇanoditā tatastu vedhasaḥ ||14||
dvāpañcāśadvatsarākhyāḥ kalpākhyāḥ kathitāstataḥ |
rohiṇāsuranāśārthaṃ śrīdyunārāyaṇo hariḥ || 15||
merudhartā merunārāyaṇaśca kīrtitastataḥ |
raveḥ śātanakṛdviṣṇunārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ ||16||
dhūmrāsuravināśārthaṃ devanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
makhapravartako yajñanārāyaṇaśca kīrtitaḥ ||17||
rudraśāstā brahmanārāyaṇaśca kathitastataḥ |
devadhiṣṇyaniyamārthamādityanrāyaṇastataḥ ||18||
nāgaśāstā śrīgarutmannārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ |
ārṣanārāyaṇaścāpi dhruvasthairyakarastataḥ || 19||
thurānandapraśāstā śrīprājñanārāyaṇastataḥ |
kathito naiṣṭhikavīranārāyaṇastu śīlavān ||3.237.20 ||
mokṣadaśca tato bhadranārāyaṇo’pi varṇitaḥ |
tuṃgabhadrāsanāputryā lakṣmyā vivāhasūtsavaḥ ||21 ||
anādiśrīharinārāyaṇāvatāra īritaḥ |
bījarakṣākaro bījanārāyaṇastataḥ param ||22||
dharmavratagṛhe jāto varanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
sudarśanyāḥ śāpajātasamastastrīsvarūpiṇām ||23||
śāpamokṣakaraḥ strīpuṃnārāyaṇaśca kīrtitaḥ |
mākarāsuranāśārthaṃ jalanārāyaṇastataḥ ||24||
sādhudharmasthāpanārthaṃ śīlanārāyaṇastataḥ |
vyāghrāsuravināśārthaṃ vārdhinārāyaṇastataḥ ||25|||
tataścaturmukhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kathitaḥ sṛṣṭisadṛśaḥ |
rādhanikāpuṇyavrātagṛhe śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||26||
avātarat kathā caiṣoditā tataḥ paraṃ rame |
tīrthapāvanakṛttīrthanārāyaṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||27||
bhaktipravartaka ukto jīvannārāyaṇastataḥ |
tato’rdhaśrīśvaranārāyaṇaḥ saṃvarṇito rame ||28||
tataścārdhapitṛnārāyaṇaḥ plakṣanarāyaṇaḥ |
naramedhe puṃstvanārāyaṇastataḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||29||
tata uktaḥ śyāmanārāyaṇo vaṭaśriyā saha |
māyūrāsuranāśārthaṃ rājanārāyaṇastataḥ ||3.237.30||
kāmabhasmottaraṃ brahmacārinārāyaṇastataḥ |
śaṃbhūjjīvaka uditaḥ śivanārāyaṇastataḥ ||3 1 ||
kuberojjīvakaḥ svarṇanārāyaṇaśca varṇitaḥ |
jvālādāhāvanakartā svāminārāyaṇastataḥ ||32||
nirvāṇikāgṛhe śrīsāvananārāyaṇastataḥ |
sāghunārāyaṇaścāpi sādhvīlakṣmyā sahoditaḥ ||3 3||
varṇiśālamanorujjīvako bhaktanarāyaṇaḥ |
aśvībhūtavarmadharanṛparakṣākṛte punaḥ ||34||
medhanārāyaṇo medhālakṣmyā sahoditaḥ prabhuḥ |
analādavināśārthaṃ vahninārāyaṇastataḥ ||35||
ilodaravināśārthaṃ rasanārāyaṇastataḥ |
daityahā śrīcakranārāyaṇastataḥ pravarṇitaḥ ||36||
satyadharmasthāpayitā satyanārāyaṇastataḥ |
sthityarthaṃ parvatānāṃ hiraṇyanārāyaṇastataḥ ||37||
naiṣkiñcanīśriyā sākaṃ nairañjaninarāyaṇaḥ |
puṇyavatīśāpaśāntyai śāpanārāyaṇastataḥ || 38||
apsarasāṃ manaḥpūrtyai brahmadbrahmanarāyaṇaḥ |
brahmavidyāprakāśāya gurunārāyaṇastaḥ ||39||
bṛhaddharmanṛpataye sādhudīkṣāpradaḥ prabhuḥ |
ācāryāṇīśriyā sākamācāryanrāyaṇastataḥ ||3.237.40||
vidyutsrāvādināśārthaṃ vidyunnārāyaṇastataḥ |
madhubhakṣādināśārthaṃ madhunārāyaṇastataḥ ||41 ||
daityahā śrīnāthanārāyaṇaścāpi pravarṇitaḥ |
sākaṃ vibhvīśriyā svarṇotsave vibhunarāyaṇaḥ ||42||
mokṣanārāyaṇaścāpi muktiśrīsahitastataḥ |
śivarājīśriyā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastataḥ ||43||
koṭyarbudābjamahiṣīkāntaḥ prabhuḥ pravarṇitaḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇa dvandvadvādaśordhvasahasrakam ||44||
dvandranāmastavaścoktaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ |
naranārāyaṇe parabrahmarūpapradarśanam ||45||
gṛhastrīṇāṃ vidheyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ varṇanaṃ tataḥ |
vadhūṭīnāṃ sadācārā vadhūpālyā vṛṣāstathā ||46||
satīsatyabalaṃ coktaṃ bhaktiyogaśca nirguṇaḥ |
puruṣottamayogaśca parabrahmaṇa ityapi ||47||
akṣarātītatādātmyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam |
gurośca mahimā divyādevīpramokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||48||
adattānna jaladāne subāhornṛpateḥ kathā |
nahuṣasya kathā kuñjalasya śukasya vai kathā ||49||
kāmodāyāḥ kathā coktā cyavanasya kathā tataḥ |
guroḥ rahasyakathanaṃ sadācārādivarṇanam ||3.237.50||
ṛṣidharmarṣiyogena brahmapriyātvamuttamam |
līlāvatīsuśīlādisakhīnāṃ tatkathānakam ||51 ||
tato rakṣāśvapacyāstu mokṣaṇasya kathoditā |
gurorharisvarūpatvaṃ sarvārpaṇastavastataḥ ||52||
vaiṣṇavottamatāyāṃ tu kauśikādinidarśanam |
gānaśikṣarjanaṃ coktaṃ nāradasya tataḥ param ||53||
ulūkasya garuḍatvaprāptiruktā tataḥ param |
mahā bhāgavatabhaktacihnānyuktāni vai tataḥ ||544||
parīkṣaṇaṃ cidambarārājñyā uktaṃ tataḥ param |
bhagavadgadayā rājñyāḥ kṛtā rakṣā pravarṇitā ||55||
vidyāmantragurūṇāṃ ca balotkṛṣṭatvamīritam |
anāvaraṇasevā ca vrataṃ damanakaṃ tataḥ ||56||
bhinnatithau bhinnarūpahareḥ pūjā prakīrtitā |
bhaktermāhātmyakathanaṃ vadhūbhaktirahasyakam ||57||
hareḥ kṛpāyāḥ sarvasvaṃ phalaṃ pravarṇitaṃ tataḥ |
mahāmantrarahasyāni sārthanyāsāni vai tataḥ ||58||
gāyatrī, cordhvapuṇḍrādi, gūḍhārthajñānamityapi |
tripādvibhūtiścaikapāddivyatādi samīhitam ||59||
nāmabhaktyā yayāteśca prabhāvo varṇitastataḥ |
hareḥ prasannatāsādhanānāṃ ca varṇanaṃ tataḥ ||3.237.60||
kadaryasya kathā, bhinnaphalaṃ, sādhusamāgamaḥ |
brahmiṣṭhatāsādhanāni pativratāvṛṣāstathā ||61 ||
sucandrikāgopikāyāścamatkārakathoditā |
manoḥ patnyāḥ kathā brahmaprathāyāstūditā tataḥ ||62||
dīrghāyusādhanaṃ coktaṃ śatagṛdhrapramokṣaṇam |
vinodinyāḥ śataputratyāgitā coditā tataḥ ||63||
vātsyāyanaprasaṃgena gaṇikānāṃ tu mokṣaṇam |
sādhutve hetavaścoktā mokṣopāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||64||
vṛṣāyanena carakāvitā śyenādudīritam |
citraketośca mālatyāḥ satsevāphalamīritam ||65||
viprebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhā uktā viṣṇunidarśanāt |
durgāyāścāpi dṛṣṭāntaṃ, sahadharmā udīritāḥ ||66||
pratyakṣanirayāḥ proktāḥ karṣukasya nidarśanam |
svargagāmni uktāśca proktā ghātakinastathā ||67||
sādhavo jaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ proktaṃ sarvasya pāvanam |
dvijāputrakṛśāṃgasya vṛṣalotpāditasya tu ||68||
brahmiṣṭhatvaṃ kṛśānutvaṃ tapobhiścendrakṛdvarāt |
nidarśanāni bahūni jātīnāṃ parivartane ||69||
bhaṃgāsvananṛpasyāpi nārītve ca nidarśanam |
nidarśanaṃ brahmayogabale viṣulayoginaḥ ||3.237.70||
lomakapardakarakṣonāśo rucervṛṣāvanam |
indraparājayo guroḥ prasannatā ca varṇitā ||71 ||
abdhimagnasya gokarṇatīrthasyoddharaṇaṃ tataḥ |
kuvalāśvakathā triśaṃkośca tataḥ kathoditā |||72||
praṇadbrahmakathā kaśyapasya tathā kathoditā |
mokṣasādhanamānāni satāṃ samāgamo balam ||73||
ālambāyanasādhośca saṃgāllakṣapramokṣaṇam |
gṛdhraśvapacayoścāpi śabarasya ca mokṣaṇam ||74||
satsu lakṣmīnivāsaśca śrīvāsā uditāstataḥ |
avatāre bhṛgoḥ śāpaḥ svecchā hetustathoditaḥ ||75||
godānaṃ ca gavārādhanāvrataṃ kathitaṃ tathā |
bhāruṇḍoddharaṇaṃ cāpi pretoddhārasya kāraṇam ||76||
